rows.translation: 这里没有标出价格。除了显示现有饮品的全息菜单和一些含糊的营销文案外，你什么也找不到。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo prices are listed. You can’t find more than holographic menus displaying the beverages on tap and some vague marketing. "

rows.original: “Uhhh... no prices, so I guess it’s free, huh?” you laugh.
rows.translation: “呃...没标价格，所以我猜是免费的，嗯？”你笑道。
rows.raw: "“Uhhh... no prices, so I guess it’s free, huh?” you laugh."

rows.original: “How much?” you ask.
rows.translation: “多少钱？”你问。
rows.raw: "“How much?” you ask."

rows.original: “I’m looking for the prices right now...” you reply, slightly nervous.
rows.translation: “我正在找价格...”你略显紧张地回答。
rows.raw: "“I’m looking for the prices right now...” you reply, slightly nervous."

rows.original: “Looking for a lot of things...” you start, taking one last look around. “...Like how much a [pc.guyGirl] has to pay to get drunk.”
rows.translation: “我在找很多东西...”你开口说道，最后又环顾一圈。“...比如一个[pc.guyGirl]得付多少钱才能喝醉。”
rows.raw: "“Looking for a lot of things...” you start, taking one last look around. “...Like how much a [pc.guyGirl] has to pay to get drunk.”"

rows.original: “Your prices, first of all,” you scowl.
rows.translation: “首先是你们的价格，”你皱眉说道。
rows.raw: "“Your prices, first of all,” you scowl."

rows.original: “Oh, don’t worry! Drinks are always free!” she chimes.
rows.translation: “哦，别担心！饮品永远免费！”她欢快说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, don’t worry! Drinks are always free!” she chimes."

rows.original: “Well, umm, I dunno. I just keep glasses full,” replies the server with a nervous smile and arched eyebrows.
rows.translation: “这个，呃，我不知道。我只负责把杯子装满，”服务员扬起眉毛，紧张地笑着回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, umm, I dunno. I just keep glasses full,” replies the server with a nervous smile and arched eyebrows."

rows.original: You let it go with a shrug; there’s no prying answers out of the help in a place like this.
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩，不再追问；在这种地方，不可能从服务人员嘴里撬出答案。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let it go with a shrug; there’s no prying answers out of the help in a place like this."

rows.original: Empty glasses and mugs are proffered. Anyone can just pick one out and demand it filled. If your objective was to frag your liver, then have a seat and pick your poison from one of the numerous floating menus.
rows.translation: 空玻璃杯与酒杯被递到面前。任何人都可以随手拿一个，要求把它装满。如果你的目标是炸烂肝脏，那就坐下来，从众多漂浮菜单里挑选自己的毒药。
rows.raw: "\n\nEmpty glasses and mugs are proffered. Anyone can just pick one out and demand it filled. If your objective was to frag your liver, then have a seat and pick your poison from one of the numerous floating menus."

rows.original: Close to the lifts and the stairwells are large, buzzing dispensaries with shifting imagery. Pornstars, courtesans, and bonafide sluts adorn the front covers of handheld digi-pads, the most popular of them all appearing on the catalogue wall itself. A soft hand touches yours before you can swipe left.
rows.translation: 靠近升降梯与楼梯井的地方，摆着大型嗡鸣的商品机，画面不断变化。色情明星、交际花和货真价实的荡妇装点着手持数字板的封面，其中最受欢迎的更会出现在图册墙本身。你还没来得及向左滑动，一只柔软的手便触上你的手。
rows.raw: "Close to the lifts and the stairwells are large, buzzing dispensaries with shifting imagery. Pornstars, courtesans, and bonafide sluts adorn the front covers of handheld digi-pads, the most popular of them all appearing on the catalogue wall itself. A soft hand touches yours before you can swipe left."

rows.original: “Greetings, off-worlder,” croons a zaika, dressed in sea-blue robes of silk lined with personal, alien touches. An interesting cross-work of Core fashion as interpreted by one of Dhaal’s daughters. She moves around you like a whisper with all the nimbleness of a life-long merchant. “I see our selection has caught your eye - you have discrimination, I can tell.” Twilight-purple fingers stroke their way up your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]; her posture shifts subtly, always keeping those voluptuous curves in view. “Allow me to recommend our finest. It would be an honor. Zaika, or others familiar to your senses, we have something for everyone here.”
rows.translation: “您好，外星人，”一个扎伊卡柔声说道。她身穿海蓝色丝绸长袍，点缀着私人风格与异星元素，呈现出由达尔之女诠释核心世界时尚的有趣交融。她轻盈得仿佛低语，以毕生为商所练就的敏捷绕着你移动。“看来我们的选择吸引了您的目光——我看得出，您很有鉴赏力。”暮紫色的手指一路抚过你的[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]；她巧妙调整姿态，始终让丰满曲线留在你眼前。“请允许我推荐这里最上乘的选择。这将是我的荣幸。无论是扎伊卡，还是其他符合您熟悉口味的人，这里都能满足每位客人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Greetings, off-worlder,” croons a zaika, dressed in sea-blue robes of silk lined with personal, alien touches. An interesting cross-work of Core fashion as interpreted by one of Dhaal’s daughters. She moves around you like a whisper with all the nimbleness of a life-long merchant. “I see our selection has caught your eye - you have discrimination, I can tell.” Twilight-purple fingers stroke their way up your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]; her posture shifts subtly, always keeping those voluptuous curves in view. “Allow me to recommend our finest. It would be an honor. Zaika, or others familiar to your senses, we have something for everyone here.”"

rows.original: You squint. “And you are?”
rows.translation: 你眯起眼睛。“那你是谁？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou squint. “And you are?”"

rows.original: “Immaterial,” she responds, smiling warmly. “Not as important as those whose services I’m to detail for you.” Her fingers drift across the catalogue in your hand, one gently lifting it between you and her bountiful rack. “Nights upstairs are sought after; prized. But don’t feel rushed, my dear. Take your time...”
rows.translation: “无关紧要，”她温暖地笑着回答。“与那些要由我向您详细介绍服务的人相比，我并不重要。”她的手指滑过你手中的图册，一根手指轻轻将它挑起，置于你和她丰满的胸脯之间。“楼上的夜晚备受追捧；珍贵难求。但别觉得需要仓促决定，亲爱的。慢慢来...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Immaterial,” she responds, smiling warmly. “Not as important as those whose services I’m to detail for you.” Her fingers drift across the catalogue in your hand, one gently lifting it between you and her bountiful rack. “Nights upstairs are sought after; prized. But don’t feel rushed, my dear. Take your time...”"

rows.original: “‘Kay, miss immateeryul!” you beam.
rows.translation: “好哒，无关紧要小姐！”你喜笑颜开。
rows.raw: "\n\n“‘Kay, miss immateeryul!” you beam."

rows.original: Alright then...
rows.translation: 那好吧...
rows.raw: "\n\nAlright then..."

rows.original: Examining the Playground’s catalogues in private is not an option. Like a ghost, one of the chosen madames appears at your side, a serene companion touching you softly and whispering in your ear promises of genuine pleasure while catching your attention with her exotic form. Blue silk over black-purple flesh, white, gleaming freckles, and bright, sparkling eyes - all of this sits atop thick, natural curves controlled by a creature of unmistakable allure. Your defenses lower.
rows.translation: 想要独自查看乐园的图册是不可能的。某位获选的鸨母会如幽灵般出现在你身旁，化作一位安详的陪伴者，温柔地触碰你，在耳边低声承诺真正的欢愉，同时用异域身姿吸引你的注意。黑紫色肌肤外罩蓝色丝绸，白色闪亮雀斑与明亮璀璨的双眼点缀其间；这一切都落在一副由魅力无可置疑的生物掌控、丰满天然的曲线之上。你的戒心逐渐放松。
rows.raw: "Examining the Playground’s catalogues in private is not an option. Like a ghost, one of the chosen madames appears at your side, a serene companion touching you softly and whispering in your ear promises of genuine pleasure while catching your attention with her exotic form. Blue silk over black-purple flesh, white, gleaming freckles, and bright, sparkling eyes - all of this sits atop thick, natural curves controlled by a creature of unmistakable allure. Your defenses lower."

rows.original: “Tell me what you seek,” asks the woman, her jewelry-laden ears flickering, “and I shall guide you to an unforgettable experience.”
rows.translation: “告诉我您在寻找什么，”女人问道，戴满珠宝的耳朵轻轻抖动，“我会引导您获得一段难忘的体验。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Tell me what you seek,” asks the woman, her jewelry-laden ears flickering, “and I shall guide you to an unforgettable experience.”"

rows.original: “Linxx and Ssong. Are you interested? Dhaal is full of lost souls, you know, but when they came to Paragon, they found everything they could have ever wanted.” The mistress laughs to herself. “Not merely performers, they are obedience incarnate. Anything you want from them, even if it is to break that sumptuous character they’ve built - they will obey, and carry out your orders. They will provide everything ‘you’ could ever want - I promise,” she finishes in smoky vocals.
rows.translation: “林克丝和桑。您有兴趣吗？您知道，达尔到处都是迷失的灵魂，但她们来到典范后，便找到了自己梦寐以求的一切。”女主人自顾自地笑了。“她们不只是表演者，更是服从本身的化身。无论您想对她们做什么，即使是打破她们塑造出的诱人性格——她们都会服从，执行您的命令。她们会满足‘您’的一切愿望——我保证，”她以烟雾般低沉的嗓音收尾。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Linxx and Ssong. Are you interested? Dhaal is full of lost souls, you know, but when they came to Paragon, they found everything they could have ever wanted.” The mistress laughs to herself. “Not merely performers, they are obedience incarnate. Anything you want from them, even if it is to break that sumptuous character they’ve built - they will obey, and carry out your orders. They will provide everything ‘you’ could ever want - I promise,” she finishes in smoky vocals."

rows.original: Two obedient zaika - irresistible. The madame leads you into the upstairs gloom after deducting the fee, leaving you at a door with no visible means of entry. At least, until it slides open on its own. Dark scarlet lights the path down a narrow hallway that delivers you to a soundless, spacious bedroom, lovingly decorated. There’s a table near the sole window upon which a bowl of fruits is set. Nightstands equipped with dim lamps highlight the wide comfort of a bed draped in crimson linens. Vague scents - incense and heady perfumes - crowd your nostrils. Something else, too: occasional, teasing twinges; soothing wafts of approaching comfort.
rows.translation: 两个乖巧顺从的扎伊卡——令人无法抗拒。鸨母扣除费用后，领你走进楼上的昏暗空间，将你留在一扇看不出任何开启方式的门前。至少直到它自行滑开。暗红色灯光照亮一条狭窄走廊，将你引入一间寂静宽敞、精心装饰的卧室。唯一的窗户旁摆着一张桌子，上面放着一碗水果。床头柜配备昏暗台灯，衬托出铺着深红床单的宽大舒适床铺。若有若无的气味——熏香与浓郁香水——挤满你的鼻腔。还有些别的东西：偶尔撩拨你的刺痒；预示慰藉将近的舒缓气息。
rows.raw: "Two obedient zaika - irresistible. The madame leads you into the upstairs gloom after deducting the fee, leaving you at a door with no visible means of entry. At least, until it slides open on its own. Dark scarlet lights the path down a narrow hallway that delivers you to a soundless, spacious bedroom, lovingly decorated. There’s a table near the sole window upon which a bowl of fruits is set. Nightstands equipped with dim lamps highlight the wide comfort of a bed draped in crimson linens. Vague scents - incense and heady perfumes - crowd your nostrils. Something else, too: occasional, teasing twinges; soothing wafts of approaching comfort."

rows.original: The advertised twins hustle out of a side-room, their appealingly-flared proportions drawn over by the delicate slips and chains of Egyptian-themed concubines. Gold, silver, and translucent white top generous, sangria-hued curves. True to the marketing, they waste no time kneeling at your [pc.footOrFeet], glowing teal eyes locked on yours, shining with adulation.

rows.raw: "\n\nThe advertised twins hustle out of a side-room, their appealingly-flared proportions drawn over by the delicate slips and chains of Egyptian-themed concubines. Gold, silver, and translucent white top generous, sangria-hued curves. True to the marketing, they waste no time kneeling at your [pc.footOrFeet], glowing teal eyes locked on yours, shining with adulation."

rows.original: Now that you’ve got the full picture... yep, they really are twins. “So... which one’s which?” you murmur, drinking in their matched appearances, noting the prehensile swish of their spongy tails and jingle of their studded ears. rows.original: Whatever it is, it is without a doubt one of the strongest drinks you’ve had. Nothing could drown out the taste of alcohol. It burns going down in that numbing, intoxicating way. Good to start with, but your liver is going to be pissed off later. It’s stale and tasteless, yet there’s something you can’t quite identify in the aftermath. Whatever it is, you don’t like it.
rows.translation: 不管这是什么，毫无疑问都是你喝过最烈的酒之一。没有任何东西能盖过酒精味。它带着令人麻木、陶醉的灼热一路烧下喉咙。开头还不错，但你的肝脏迟早会大发雷霆。它走味又寡淡，然而余味里似乎还有某种你辨认不出的东西。不管是什么，你都不喜欢。

New Texas was a long stop, but the original plan never changed,” he shrugs. “I kept catching rides from one planet to the next, until eventually I found myself here.” You point out that it still doesn’t explain why he’s at the frontier of a Planet Rush. The twink responds with an incredulous look before finding his voice again, “Do you even need to ask?! We’re in the middle of a Planet Rush — this is the event of a lifetime! rows.original: “Look,” you tell her, “We’re both trying to get a probe that landed somewhere on Dhaal. I have to get to it before [rival.name] does, or [rival.heShe]’ll screw me out of my inheritance. There’s a fortune on the line here!” “Yeah, [rival.heShe] said something like that, too. Lot more bluster and self-aggrandizement, though. And calling you stinky. You must be [pc.name], right?” God damn it. “Yeah.” She stifles a giggle into the back of her hand. “Okay, well, tell you what: your cousin paid me for the information, but not for exclusivity. Shoulda got a lawyer to work up a contract, if you’re making deals on Dhaal. So maybe you and I can work something out.” “Oh?” The woman takes a long drag on her cig, a mischievous twinkle in her eye. “Yeah. The place I sent [rival.name] to has something I want. I asked [rival.himHer] to get it — if [rival.heShe] fell through, I guess it falls to you.” “What are you looking for?” “Mmm, that’s more like it. It’s just an item that should be on your way to rescuing [rival.name] anyway. Sign an NDA and a freelancer’s contract, and I’ll tell you everything you need to know.”
rows.translation: “听着，”你告诉她，“我们都在寻找多年前坠落在达尔某处的探针。我必须赶在[rival.name]之前拿到它，否则[rival.heShe]就会害我失去遗产。这关系到一大笔财富！” “对，[rival.heShe]也说过类似的话，不过更会虚张声势、自吹自擂。还说你很臭。你一定就是[pc.name]，对吧？” 该死。“对。” 她用手背掩住窃笑。“好吧，那这么说：你表亲为情报付了钱，但没买独家权。既然要在达尔做交易，就该找律师拟份合同。所以也许我们俩可以谈个条件。” “哦？” 女人深吸一口香烟，眼里闪着恶作剧般的光。“没错。我让[rival.name]去的地方有件我想要的东西。我让[rival.himHer]把它取来，如果[rival.heShe]没办成，那就轮到你了。” “你在找什么？” “嗯，这才对。那件东西反正就在你营救[rival.name]的路上。签一份保密协议和自由职业者合同，我就把你需要知道的一切都告诉你。”

rows.original: The latex-clad woman leads you back upstairs and into a private booth — one that has both a privacy screen and a dampener that, when activated, mutes the rest of the brothel. Presumably the effect also is keeping your conversation from any outside ears, though given Paragon’s love of thorough security... The woman plants her chin in her hands and smiles prettily. “So, here we are. A few days ago, Captain Steele — the other one — hired me to find a corporate probe that crash landed on Dhaal some years ago, around the same time the initial Warp Gate made its way into the system. Apparently [targetFactionName] discovered it when the Farrow — that’s the big industrial ring around the city — was still getting spun up. They built a major industrial center right on top of the alien artifact, hid it from the other corpos. Er, zaibatsu. Whatever. They’ve been sitting on it for decades now, studying it at a blacksite hidden under the factory.” “And [rival.name] went in there?” you sigh. “Just like Myrellion all over again...” “Myr-what?” You shake your head. “Never mind. So [rival.heShe]’s at this factory?” Your contact nods, finally stamping out her cigarette. “Mmhm. Sent [rival.himHer] in with a pass that [favoredFactionName] acquired through... ulterior means.” “You are working with [favoredFactionName] then?” The woman smirks. “Maybe. Maybe I just have a few friends in high places, and the good captain had enough grease to whet the zaibatsu’s wheels. Either way, [rival.heShe] got a pass down into the Farrow and the coordinates of the facility and went on [rival.hisHer] way. Lucky for you, captain... I just so happened to make a copy of all that before I handed it off to [rival.name].” She flourishes her fingers and produces an electrum chit, about the size of your thumb. “Give this to any of the city taxi corp, and they’ll get you where you want to go. Security clearance and destination all rolled up into one tight little package. Just don’t expect it to get you inside the facility: this will just get you to the nearest transit stop. Getting in the building — you’ll have to figure it out yourself. I can’t do everything for you.” You reach for it, but the girl pulls back before you can reach your prize. She tuts, waggling it back and forth. “What do we say to people that help us out?” [pc.nmh |“Thank you,” |“Thanks?” |“Fuck you,” ] you say. Your contact giggles and flicks you the credentials. “See you around, captain. You know where to find me.” She blows you a flirty kiss and slips out of the private room. You draw in a deep breath and tuck the chip away.
rows.translation: 乳胶紧身衣女人带你回到楼上，走进一间私人卡座。这里既有隐私屏障，也有一个启动后便会隔绝妓院其他声音的消音器。它大概还能避免你们的谈话传到外面，不过考虑到典范对严密安保的热爱... 女人双手托腮，甜美地微笑。“好了，我们到了。几天前，斯蒂尔船长，也就是另一位，雇我寻找一枚多年前坠毁在达尔的公司探针，时间大概是最初那座跃迁门进入这个星系的时候。显然，[targetFactionName]在法罗，也就是环绕城市的巨大工业环，尚处于启动阶段时发现了它。他们直接在那件外星文物上建起大型工业中心，并对其他公司隐瞒了此事。呃，财阀，随便吧。他们已经占有它几十年了，一直在工厂下方隐藏的黑站里研究。” “然后[rival.name]进去了？”你叹气。“又来一遍米瑞利恩那档事...” “米什么？” 你摇摇头。“没什么。所以[rival.heShe]就在这座工厂里？” 联系人点点头，终于捻灭了香烟。“嗯哼。我给了[rival.himHer]一张[favoredFactionName]通过... 非常规手段弄来的通行证，随后将其送了进去。” “所以你确实在为[favoredFactionName]工作？” 女人坏笑。“也许吧。也许我只是有几位身居高位的朋友，而那位好船长又给财阀的齿轮上了足够的油。不管怎样，[rival.heShe]拿到了进入法罗的通行证和设施坐标，然后踏上[rival.hisHer]的路。你很幸运，船长... 在把所有资料交给[rival.name]之前，我恰好留了一份副本。” 她手指一翻，亮出一枚拇指大小的琥珀金筹码。“把这个交给城里任何一家出租车公司，他们都会把你送到目的地。安全许可和目的地全塞在这么小巧的包装里。不过别指望它能让你进入设施，它只会把你送到最近的公交站。至于如何进楼，你得自己想办法。我可不能什么都替你做。” 你伸手去拿，女孩却在你碰到奖品前把手缩了回去。她咂咂舌，来回晃动筹码。“别人帮助我们时，该说什么？” [pc.nmh |“谢谢，” |“谢谢？” |“操你，” ]你说道。 联系人咯咯笑着把凭证弹给你。“回见，船长。你知道去哪里找我。” 她朝你送来一个调情的飞吻，溜出私人房间。你深吸一口气，把芯片收好。
rows.raw: " The latex-clad woman leads you back upstairs and into a private booth — one that has both a privacy screen and a dampener that, when activated, mutes the rest of the brothel. Presumably the effect also is keeping your conversation from any outside ears, though given Paragon’s love of thorough security... The woman plants her chin in her hands and smiles prettily. “So, here we are. A few days ago, Captain Steele — the other one — hired me to find a corporate probe that crash landed on Dhaal some years ago, around the same time the initial Warp Gate made its way into the system. Apparently [targetFactionName] discovered it when the Farrow — that’s the big industrial ring around the city — was still getting spun up. They built a major industrial center right on top of the alien artifact, hid it from the other corpos. Er, zaibatsu. Whatever. They’ve been sitting on it for decades now, studying it at a blacksite hidden under the factory.” “And [rival.name] went in there?” you sigh. “Just like Myrellion all over again...” “Myr-what?” You shake your head. “Never mind. So [rival.heShe]’s at this factory?” Your contact nods, finally stamping out her cigarette. “Mmhm. Sent [rival.himHer] in with a pass that [favoredFactionName] acquired through... ulterior means.” “You are working with [favoredFactionName] then?” The woman smirks. “Maybe. Maybe I just have a few friends in high places, and the good captain had enough grease to whet the zaibatsu’s wheels. Either way, [rival.heShe] got a pass down into the Farrow and the coordinates of the facility and went on [rival.hisHer] way. Lucky for you, captain... I just so happened to make a copy of all that before I handed it off to [rival.name].” She flourishes her fingers and produces an electrum chit, about the size of your thumb. “Give this to any of the city taxi corp, and they’ll get you where you want to go. Security clearance and destination all rolled up into one tight little package. Just don’t expect it to get you inside the facility: this will just get you to the nearest transit stop. Getting in the building — you’ll have to figure it out yourself. I can’t do everything for you.” You reach for it, but the girl pulls back before you can reach your prize. She tuts, waggling it back and forth. “What do we say to people that help us out?” [pc.nmh |“Thank you,” |“Thanks?” |“Fuck you,” ] you say. Your contact giggles and flicks you the credentials. “See you around, captain. You know where to find me.” She blows you a flirty kiss and slips out of the private room. You draw in a deep breath and tuck the chip away. "

rows.original: Drift down paths less traveled and you end up in the strangest places. Through a blue-silver hardlight screen you enter what at first glance seems like an elaborate back-alley garage, but this place is so much more. Blue sparks fizzle between a pair of mini-pylons, generating a blue screen that covers his eyes. A spindly pair of restraints from above are fastened to his wrists to hold him aloft, followed by a pair of anklets. Incredulously, he appears on the screen directly opposite of his real-world ‘twin’, and... seems to be fully aware that he is experiencing an out-of-body sensation. What draws your attention is her left ear, cut off halfway, the missing organic half replaced by durable machinery. “Ah, I get ‘ya,” she remarks in an unnerving half-electric half-organic voice that sounds like it’s being generated by a faulty vox unit. “New face seein’ wizardry for the first time.” She tilts back, rustling her chunky toolbelt. “Almost missed that look in ‘yer eye, but everyone’s shocked the first time they see all ‘a this; don’t matter how traveled they’r!” The more she talks, the more your [pc.ears] adjust to the horny enjoyment in the background[pc.cockVagBothNeither | that kindles your urges, sending little beats of pleasure through your [pc.cocksLight] |, and the wetter your [pc.pussiesLight] become with a heavy, moist urge |, and the stronger your dual anatomies rouse to the bizarre ardor |. rows.original: You’re [inShip|lazing about|going on about your business] when you feel a strange wetness trickling down your [pc.legOrLegsNoun]. After the initial moment of confusion, you realize the cause: your water just broke! Taking a few deep breaths to collect yourself, you [inPlanet dhaal|call Chance and tell him the time has come. He arranges|arrange] transport to a hospital.[inPlanet dhaal| Given the state of things on Dhaal, you wind up aboard a medical ship operating under the U.G.C. embassy.] The staff proves to be very attentive — especially after word circulates that you’re a Steele — and a nurse stands by to assist you with breathing techniques and positions while keeping an eye on your condition.[inPlanet dhaal| Chance stays with you throughout all stages of labor, catering to your every need and helping you to stay calm despite the growing discomfort. You find that having him by your side is very reassuring, and time flies by in a daze.] Eventually, the contractions peak. The nurse takes you to the delivery room, where a doctor waits to assist with the child-birthing process, making sure that the baby is in the right position and telling you when to push or relax.[inPlanet dhaal| Chance holds your hand the entire time, whispering words of encouragement into your ear and not complaining even once when you squeeze his hand hard — which you do several times.] Soon enough, the child’s head appears between your legs, gradually followed by the rest of the body. The baby cries healthily as the nurse cleans them before wrapping them in white cloth and passing them into your arms. It’s a [var0|herm|girl|boy]! You take a fleeting moment to cradle the child while humming a soothing tune. [inPlanet dhaal|Chance watches with a dorky smile on his face, the pride of fatherhood evident in his feline eyes. The twink only breaks out of the daze when you gently pass the sleeping baby into his arms, and he holds them for a moment before taking|You gently pass the sleeping baby back to the nurse, who takes] them to the crib.[var1| No sooner have you finished than the doctor gently urges you to start delivering your next child.[var2| The process repeats until all kids have been safely delivered.]] When all is said and done, you’re feeling bruised and exhausted, but also deeply relieved. Your heart swells with motherly pride in knowing your [var1|children are all|child is] hale and hearty, so you take a moment to admire them. For now, it’s hard to tell their distinguishing features, since their eyes are closed and they barely have any hair, but they[var1| all] bear distinctive half-kaithrit traits: feline ears and twin tails. So cute! You can barely wait to see how they’ll turn out. Some time later, following the instructions you left when checking in, the[inPlanet tavros| [var1|babies are|baby is] safely transported to| [var1|babies are safely tucked into space pods|baby is safely tucked into a space pod] and sent to] the Tavros nursery, where they will be well cared for while you continue your quest. You[inPlanet dhaal| and Chance] watch longingly as they go, and you make a resolution to visit them as soon as possible.[inPlanet dhaal| The twink keeps you company in the hospital for the rest of the day while you recover, but eventually you decide to send him on his way before going to sleep.]

rows.original: You step down towards the back rooms of the Playground, getting tight on the narrow stairs to make room for a group of exhausted-looking twenty-somethings coming up for air. Probably literally — it’s a smoggy hell down here today, with clouds of cigarette smoke and other, less-identifiable chemicals creating a haze between you and the ceiling. You cough into your arm and wave as much of the smog away as you can as you finish your descent. The lights have been dimmed down to almost nothing, presumably to help people coming out of long VR sessions cope, but the smell... that hits you like a truck. Sex, drugs — if rock and roll had a reek, you’re sure that’d be down here too. Instead it just thumps from the sound system in the one private room with its door hanging open, so obnoxiously loud that you can feel the bassline in your [pc.ra galotian |core |bones ]. You’re just about to peek into the open room when you feel a tap on your shoulder. You turn, and find a human woman with a half-burned cig clutched between a plump pair of lips, her lean, slender figure clad in a tight [favoredFactionCorp] bodysuit. She’s bottom-heavy, with long brown hair that falls all the way to her generous rear in rich curls, drawing your eye to the way the latex hugs her hips. “How do you do, Captain?” she drawls casually, taking a puff. A black choker around her neck bobs as she licks her red-painted lips. “I understand you’ve been looking for me.” This must be your girl. “That’s right. I heard you gave some information to another rusher...” “Maybe I did. Maybe I didn’t. Depends: what’s it to you?”

rows.original: Zenn is casting over her desk, a noisome source of tool usage. She plods around on a platform of criss-crossed cables hooked into a stacked row of bizarre machinery. Blue, red, and green lights flicker arhythmically around rising and falling bars. There’s enough gear in here to power a thousand studios. You can make out a humming sound in the air all ‘round the teflon-chrome boxes — and the occasional electrical discharge. At your approach, the tireless mechanic hops off the wires, ears wiggling. In a big, no-nonsense voice she greets you, “Yo! What’s got y’over here rather than in there?”
rows.translation: 泽恩俯身在桌前摆弄工具，发出一阵嘈杂声响。她拖着步子走过一处交错电缆构成的平台，那些电缆连接着一整排堆叠起来的怪异机械。蓝、红、绿三色灯光在起伏的指示条周围不规律地闪烁。这里的设备多到足以为上千间演播室供能。你能听到铁氟龙镀铬箱体四周传来的嗡鸣声，偶尔还有电流放电。 你走近时，这个不知疲倦的技师从电线上跳下来，双耳抖动。她用洪亮而直截了当的声音向你打招呼：“哟！你怎么跑到这边来了，没待在里面？”

rows.original: Zenn hasn’t emerged from Dhaal’s wickedest backstreets unscathed, if the synthetic parts covering old wounds are any indication. Standing at only a scant five-foot-four, her threat profile is nearly non-existent. No hint of makeup conceals her age or the sullen, angular features of a woman who’s seen the worst her planet has to offer and survived it. Her thin lips are all smiles, but the occasional flash in her blue, wrinkle-rimmed eyes pries the edges downward. Both of her long ears measure at least sixteen inches, and the left one has been visibly cut off halfway, replaced with artisanal machinery and prettied up with a few delicate piercings. Her violet skin lacks a smooth lacquered quality you’ve seen on plenty of other zaika, and her solid-white hair is years overdue for a conditioning. Even the glowing freckles beneath her upraised safety goggles don’t possess that captivating glow. Covering her scarred flesh is a simple set of brown overalls. The suspenders loop around her shoulders, shrouding the peaks of her C-cups where nipples and areolae would sprout on most other races. About the only part of her not modified is her tail, a full three-feet long with a small-ish head encased in — you guessed it — a handmade metal covering. “Look, if y’wanna stare, there’s a lot of other things in here to keep ‘ya busy,” she smirks, tilting her head.
rows.translation: 从遮盖旧伤的合成部件来看，泽恩从达尔最险恶的后街闯出来时并非毫发无损。她身高只有五英尺四英寸，几乎看不出任何威胁。脸上没有半点妆容，年龄和那副阴沉凌厉的轮廓一览无遗——这是一个见识过母星最糟一面、却仍活下来的女人。她薄薄的嘴唇总带着笑，可那双布满皱纹的蓝眼睛偶尔闪过的神色，却会把嘴角向下扯去。两只长耳都至少有十六英寸，而左耳显然从中段被切断，换成手工打造的机械结构，又用几枚精致的穿孔饰品加以装点。 她的紫色皮肤没有你在许多其他扎伊卡身上见过的光滑漆亮质感，一头纯白长发也早该好好护理了。就连抬起的护目镜下那些发光雀斑，也缺乏那种摄人心魄的光彩。她只穿着一套简单的棕色工装裤，背带绕过肩头，遮住C罩杯乳房的顶端——对大多数其他种族来说，那里本该长着乳头和乳晕。她身上大概只有尾巴未被改造；尾巴足有三英尺长，小巧的尾端也包在——你猜对了——手工制作的金属外壳里。 “听着，你要是想盯着看，这里还有一大堆别的东西够你忙活。”她歪着头坏笑道。

See that biggun over there?” Zenn indicates a broad-shouldered man with cow’s horns and an erection so rigid that you could mast a flag to it. “Body’s over there, but his mind’s right here. Goes for everyone. See, long time ago Utopian Skies — you know ‘em, right? - came up with this beauty. Don’t need fancy jails or expensive training grounds when you can just... be somewhere else, know what I mean? Once you’re set up and the visor clicks on, you’re in fantasy land. Do whatever you want!” [pc.isBimbo |“Fancy jail? Like a sex dungeon!?” you ask excitedly, hopping up and down[pc.hasTail |‘n wagging your [pc.tail] ] |“Jail?” you ask tentatively ]. “Yep. Now, our system’s set to eject you after one hour so there’s no damage. Once you’re on the big screen... in it, I mean, heh heh, anything goes. Unlimited power is pretty dangerous, and off worlders like yourself tend to have vivid imaginations. The boss lady, Carver, said your kind has minds like kaleidoscopes of fire. Dunno what that meant, but hell if it isn’t like my own personal theater in here. Folks’re just payin’ to show us all what they won’t show anyone else!” And to let others use them, you observe: see how the dzaan alpha unwittingly finds herself addicting a couple of hapless zaika bemused with the tall, thick, curvy hermaphrodite. Your [pc.face] warms. “Sorry, went off on a ramble. Pretty easy getting distracted around here. Anyway, yeah, kind of a jail, if they wanted to use it like one. Probably still do. rows.original: Zenn’s lips gently part, and shut much the same way. Your personal inquiry softens her already affectionate demeanor more. The wrinkles of age disappear for but a second. “Been getting that a lot, and I’m gonna tell you what I tell everyone else: think about the crappy parts of your life. Not the really, really bad stuff you’d never tell anyone because if you did they’d never treat you like an equal again, but the crappy parts. Tripped and scraped a knee, fell off your bike, stubbed your toe, had to work ten hours and go back to work two hours later. Get mugged every third day.” She chortles. The sound is sibilant enough to grate. “So, nothing special. That’s about every day on Dhaal, not much to tell. Everyone’s got problems and I’ve seen enough of ‘em get expressed on yonder screen.” She wags a finger to the broadcast, currently displaying the rutting of nubile women by strong, able bodies. Bellies swell to pregnant capacities; thighs fatten, and jaws drop. “Y’don’t have to ingratiate yourself to everyone you see, kiddo. Just be yourself. You seem like you’ve gotten around enough places to know the fundamentals by now.” Zenn stands tall on a foundation of contentment, tails waving curiously. Her smile is simultaneously annoying but infinitely compassionate.
rows.translation: 泽恩的嘴唇轻轻张开，又以同样的方式合上。你的私人问题让她本就亲切的神态更加柔和，岁月留下的皱纹也短暂消失了一瞬。 “最近总有人这么问，我就把对其他人说的话也告诉你：想想你人生里那些糟心事。不是那种你永远不敢告诉别人、否则对方再也不会平等看待你的真正惨事，只是普通的糟心事。绊倒擦破膝盖、从自行车上摔下来、踢到脚趾，连续工作十小时后隔两小时又得上工。每三天被抢一次。” 她咯咯笑了起来。那嘶嘶作响的声音颇为刺耳。 “所以，没什么特别的。这差不多就是达尔的每一天，没多少好说的。人人都有难处，我也已经看够它们在那块屏幕上被表现出来了。”她朝正在播放节目的屏幕摇了摇手指；画面中，年轻女人正被强壮健美的身体交配。肚子胀大到怀孕般的程度，大腿逐渐丰满，下巴也垂了下来。“孩子，你不必讨好见到的每一个人。做自己就好。你似乎已经去过足够多的地方，该懂这些基本原则了。” 泽恩心满意足地挺直身体，尾巴好奇地摆动。她的笑容既让人恼火，又充满无尽的同情。
rows.raw: " Zenn’s lips gently part, and shut much the same way. Your personal inquiry softens her already affectionate demeanor more. The wrinkles of age disappear for but a second. “Been getting that a lot, and I’m gonna tell you what I tell everyone else: think about the crappy parts of your life. Not the really, really bad stuff you’d never tell anyone because if you did they’d never treat you like an equal again, but the crappy parts. Tripped and scraped a knee, fell off your bike, stubbed your toe, had to work ten hours and go back to work two hours later. Get mugged every third day.” She chortles. The sound is sibilant enough to grate. “So, nothing special. That’s about every day on Dhaal, not much to tell. Everyone’s got problems and I’ve seen enough of ‘em get expressed on yonder screen.” She wags a finger to the broadcast, currently displaying the rutting of nubile women by strong, able bodies. Bellies swell to pregnant capacities; thighs fatten, and jaws drop. “Y’don’t have to ingratiate yourself to everyone you see, kiddo. Just be yourself. You seem like you’ve gotten around enough places to know the fundamentals by now.” Zenn stands tall on a foundation of contentment, tails waving curiously. Her smile is simultaneously annoying but infinitely compassionate. "

rows.original: Zenn’s spectacular vibrancy dims and flashes back in the moment it takes for her to construct a response. “What’s it to ‘ya?” A moment’s pause, long enough to take a hint. Then, her eyebrows wiggle. “S’what I’d say if being friendly and polite wasn’t in my contract!” More throbbing, electrical laughter. “Mm Mm Ahem! By no means am I criticizing my fantastic employers at Paragon, no zirree; everyday I’m thankful to have a chance to learn and tinker and experiment! Best job of my life, and I can’t think of havin’ any other!” You fold your arms; she looks down from the ceiling and shrugs. “What’s it like workin’ for miners? Just, you know, up past the smog. Can’t be much different than working our mines, am I right?” Zenn sucks in her cheeks, and goes on after she makes a popping sound with her lips. “I dunno, what’s it like working for Paragon, you said? Compared to what? Y’working for some fancy schamncy technogroup up between Zerrine and Verrick?” Her ears twitch. “Oh, sorry. Those are just star clusters that I saw when I sent a probe up to the sky. Got shot down though, what a shame. Looked beautiful, where you come from.” A thumbs up. “But yeah, dunno what you’re really asking. Paragon’s doing a lot of everything on Dhaal. Motocults can’t live without ‘em. Paragon makes most of everything people wear, run the most bars, run the most races, run the most love houses, and are always eager to get girls up to date on the latest tech. Like this baby here.” Zenn pats the wall of electronics that enable virtual reality debaucheries never before seen. “What’s not to like about working for ‘em? Sure, hours can suck, sure, sometimes you’re filling in for a girl who had a bad case of mortality.” Her eyes narrow slightly. “But, can’t complain. Got plenty to eat, got plenty of savings, and if you play your cards right you can move up. Looking forward to seeing how your Carver lady does. Exciting times if I do say so myself!” She snatches up a mechanical instrument of some kind and goes back to fiddling with some sort of device.
rows.translation: 泽恩耀眼的活力黯淡下去，又在她组织好回答的瞬间重新亮起。“关你什么事？” 片刻沉默，长得足够让人听懂暗示。随后，她的眉毛动了动。 “要不是合同规定我必须友好礼貌，我就会这么说！”又是一阵带着电子脉动的笑声。“嗯，嗯，咳咳！我绝对不是在批评典范那些了不起的雇主，不是不是；每天我都很感激自己有机会学习、摆弄和实验！这是我一生中最棒的工作，我根本想不到还会干别的！” 你抱起双臂；她把目光从天花板移下来，耸耸肩。 “替矿工工作是什么感觉？就是，你知道的，烟雾上面那些人。应该和在我们的矿场工作没多大区别，对吧？”泽恩吸了吸脸颊，用嘴唇发出一声轻响后继续说道。“我不知道，你问为典范工作是什么感觉？和什么相比？你是在泽林和维里克之间某个花里胡哨的科技集团工作吗？” 她的耳朵抽动了一下。“哦，抱歉。那些只是我把探测器送上天空时看到的星团。不过它被击落了，真可惜。你来的地方看起来很美。” 她竖起大拇指。“不过话说回来，我还是不知道你到底想问什么。典范在达尔什么都做一点。机车教团离了她们根本活不了。典范生产人们穿的大多数东西，经营最多的酒吧、最多的比赛、最多的欢爱屋，还总是很乐意让姑娘们用上最新科技。就像这里这个宝贝。” 泽恩拍了拍那面电子设备墙，正是它们让前所未见的虚拟现实放荡成为可能。“替她们工作有什么不好的？当然，工时有时很烂；当然，有时候你得替一个严重死亡的姑娘顶班。”她微微眯起眼睛。“不过，没什么可抱怨的。吃的充足，存款也不少，要是懂得把牌打好还能往上爬。我很期待看看你们那位卡弗女士干得怎么样。要我说，这可是令人兴奋的时代！” 她一把抓起某种机械工具，又回头摆弄起某台装置。

[flags.PARAGON_JACK_IN |Even with prior experience, she hones in on the swell of excitement you exhibit. |You’ve got all the subtle, quivering hallmarks of a newbie about to take the controls. ] The zaikan technomancer taps a few buttons on her wrist-mounted terminal, bringing the nearest Mindstream interface whirring to life. Her parched-looking lips curve into a sly smirk as she gestures you forward, calling out to a pair of luscious attendants. “Girls, one ‘streamer for station four!” “Right away!” they chime in unison. The first attendant, a beauty with shimmering indigo skin and striking red highlights in her ponytail, beckons you over. “Just sit yourself down here and we’ll get you all strapped in!” The other girl, whose skin is a pretty shade of pale lilac, takes your hands once you’re stood on a delineated plinth, fixing restraints around your wrists and [pc.footOrFeet]. [flags.PARAGON_JACK_IN |“Ooh, you get a little less tense each time,” she purrs, her lengthy tail looping around your waist suggestively. “...Maybe there’ll be a little bondage play for us to watch this time, hmm?” |“These’ll keep you safe. Last thing anyone wants is you having an actual slip while you’re in there,” she purrs. ] Red giggles as she cinches the ankle cuffs. [flags.PARAGON_JACK_IN |“Hehe, don’t listen to her. Just act natural, do whatever comes to mind...” |“Oh yes, some folks really lose control once they’re in the Mindstream. It’s quite a sight! One really big lug managed to snap his cuff-cables, he was having so much fun!” ] “Now, let’s get the visor on...” Lilac holds up the lightweight headgear, a sleek chrome contraption bristling with blinking lights and wires trailing to the ceiling. [flags.PARAGON_JACK_IN |Giving up control for someone to fit tech to you in a place like this doesn’t get much easier, but you relax well enough |You flinch slightly as it’s lowered onto your head, the padded clamps pressing snugly on your temples ]. A translucent blue optical screen flickers across your eyes, encompassing your vision. Quick-fingered hands skim over your [pc.skinFurScales][pc.isNude | |, divesting you of any and all obstructions to sexual euphoria ]; Red and Lilac affix a number of sensors to your body here or there, each one adhering as if magnetized. “Here goes!”

rows.original: [var0 |There’s a sharp sting at the base of your skull that makes you flinch. A low hum builds in your ears, a vibration that seems to come from everywhere and nowhere all at once. A rush of static fills your mind, like a TV searching for a signal. Suddenly, your perception... shifts. It feels like you’re being pulled in two opposite directions at once — part of you is still acutely aware of standing in a den of debauchery... ...But another part begins to detach, slipping into an artificial mindscape. The white noise crescendos, rising in pitch until it’s almost painful. In a sudden, terrifying moment, there’s nothing! All has gone dark, your consciousness returned to a primordial slumber. Then, a kaleidoscopic explosion of swirling shapes coalesces into the familiar and fantastical. Digital reality supplants the waking world as you knew it, dominating your attention with all-new imagery and audio. Fractals dance across your vision, patterns that twist and morph into impossible shapes. You’re falling, tumbling through an endless expanse of morphic hues. But fear gives way to amazement. Soon, there’s only a rising sense of euphoria, of boundless possibility. Every thought you dare to think and every idea you entertain becomes real. You’re being carried away on the slipstream of fantasy. And yet, despite the new world stretching out before you, feeling persists — hints of the body you left behind. Back in the real world, the zaika attendants surround your quivering body in flesh and warmth, tracing teasing caresses along your [pc.thighs] and brushing over sensitive places. Ghostly sensations of real-world stimuli ripple across your avatar. Even though your own body feels distant and dreamlike, the barrier between realities grows thinner by the second, every nerve ending singing with pleasure beneath a sensual caress that seems to come from within and without simultaneously. You are hyper aware of every breath, every heartbeat... ...But they belong to someone else. Something else. What you perceive amalgamates into a room. Or maybe the room was always there, hidden behind the psychedelic maelstrom. Everything feels fluid here, mercurial. The walls are a deep, pulsing red, the color of passion and lust. The floor is cool against your [pc.footOrFeet]... wait, you can see ‘yourself’ now? You conceive your digital presence, wrapped in a gossamer shift, a wisp of fluctuating fabric that conceals nothing. You are whatever or whoever you want to be here. You turn slowly, taking in your surroundings. The room is lavish, almost opulent. A massive bed dominates the center, draped in silks the color of a bruise. Decadent pillows are scattered everywhere — even the floor is inviting, with countless nooks of ruffled sheets and plump cushions waiting for paramours. The air is thick with scents of perfume, of... intimacy. And there, lounging on the bed like an indolent god, is... you? No, not quite. Similar, but different. Perfected. This version of you is all sinuous curves. ‘[pc.HisHer]’ hair tumbles down ‘[pc.HisHer]’ back in rich, glossy waves; ‘[pc.hisHer] eyes sparkle with mischief and hunger. “Hello, [pc.name],” the doppelganger purrs. “We’ve been waiting for you.” The words send a shiver down your spine. We? As if in answer, more figures emerge from the shadows. Men and women and those blessed with it all — each of them heart-stoppingly beautiful. They move with a predatory grace, circling you like wolves stalking prey. Yet at a thought, they still. In the Mindstream, you are swarmed by temptations entirely of your own making. In the real world, your body, devoid of its guiding will, becomes a conduit for the pleasure and sensation unfolding before you. A line of drool runs down your chin. In the material world, Red and Lilac cease touching your body, no doubt to step back and admire their handiwork. rows.original: You tell Zenn you’d like to use one of her terminals to go through a disc you found. The engineer looks at you with an arched eyebrow and a tight-lipped smirk. “Fine by me. 3000 credits either way, and the other guests will be watching along,” she notes, pointing a finger up at the display screens above each station. You pay the tired-looking zaika and are escorted to your seat, submitting to the various strap-on fittings they use for the machine’s haptic feedback. The sleek, chrome visor goes on last and you buckle in - both figuratively and literally - for the experience. The last thing you see is a small crowd piling in to see what’s on the docket for tonight’s entertainment. Light floods your senses, a neural snap pinches your neck, and...

rows.original: You don’t really need to get into the specifics, but you explain that you ‘found’ a VR disc in the Gyre that looks like it could be compatible with zaika technology. You ask the proprietor of the Paragon-brand Mindstream if she thinks it would be worth giving it a try. The perpetually weary engineer behind the massive console offers a perfunctory nod. “Entirely possible. With all the off-world tech coming in, there’s some who’re trying for a middle ground between our stuff and yours. I could give it a shot, though if it fries my system,” she crosses her arms and waves her tail behind her in a decidedly predatory way, “I’ll use your brain to replace it.” The engineer takes the program from you and fits it into one of her spinning trays. Her hands fly across the various buttons, scanning and checking it for... whatever zaika tech has to worry about. Compatibility? Viruses? Back-door cybernetics hacks? The technician makes a thorough investigation and it comes up clean. She reports back that you’re all set. She can load the program onto a terminal just like the normal system. “Of course, everything going on in here,” she points at your head, “will be transmitted there,” she swings her finger over to the flickering screen above the various terminals. “So, if you value privacy, you’ll probably need a personal headset. Of course, you wouldn’t bring this to me if you weren’t looking for a bit of exhibition in the first place, right?” Zenn accuses playfully. No sense in denying it. The thrill of being watched - and possibly used - while you’re lost in the digital thrill of lurid fiction is half the point of the thing. You transmit the money and are escorted by the station’s pink and indigo-hued assistants. They cheerfully strap you in, adding the sensors, cuffs, and visor with enough giddy glee that you suspect these two get off on plugging people in all day. A small crowd of zaika, off-world corpo mercs, and rushers starts to form, eager to check out the new display. Whatever you’re getting yourself into, you’ll have an audience! Light floods your senses, a neural snap pinches your neck, and...

rows.original: When you clear the outer atmosphere and descend through thick, pollution-blacked clouds toward a city-sized tarmac, the mystery of corporate paralysis becomes clear: Dhaal is already civilized! The twilight-draped skyline is dominated by towering highrises and monolithic structures worthy of any presidential palace. Galactic corporations typically use the Planet Rush to settle primitive worlds, so the prospect of one ripe for immediate commerce must have them falling over one another to gobble it up.
rows.translation: 当你穿过外层大气，越过厚重且被污染熏黑的云层，朝一块城市般巨大的停机坪下降时，企业迟迟不动的原因便一目了然：达尔早已有了文明！暮色笼罩的天际线上，高耸的摩天楼与足以媲美总统府的宏伟建筑占据主导。银河企业通常借行星淘金热殖民原始世界，因此面对一个能立刻开展商业活动的星球，它们恐怕正争先恐后地想把这里吞下。

The twilight-draped skyline is dominated by towering highrises and monolithic structures worthy of any presidential palace. Galactic corporations typically use the Planet Rush to settle primitive worlds, so the prospect of one ripe for immediate commerce must have them falling over one another to gobble it up."

rows.original: While the massive city that stretches as far north and south as your equipment can read, you are directed towards an open landing site that appears to be a work in progress. Huge industrial machines toil to bulldoze and pave as much of their world as needed, adding more parking for the off-world visitors. Automated shuttles zip from one craft to the next, their flickering signs inviting you to disembark for transportation to some place called the Gyre.

rows.original: You cycle through the airlock and are immediately assaulted by the reek of industrial smog. it’s far worse than any of the mining or refinery worlds you’ve visited with your father; Steele Tech at the very least tries to keep the atmosphere from burning eyes and noses just stepping onto the tarmac. rows.original: A mere moment after you start flagging, a gunmetal gray hovercraft zips over to you and pops its hatch, allowing you to climb into a bus-like back crammed with fellow Rushers. The woman in the driver’s seat, though, is of a race you’ve never seen before: she’s humanoid, a bit over five feet tall and slender, with dusk-hued purple skin and almond-shaped blue eyes. A messy mane of silver hair falls around her shoulders, breached on either side by a pair of elfin ears. Indeed, you’d easily mistake her for some kind of fantasy-game elf if it wasn’t for the long, alien tail running out of a hole in the back of her cargo shorts and flicking around on the floor. The tip’s covered in some kind of thick sock, shielding it from view, but it seems much more bulbous than the rest of the appendage.

rows.original: “First time, huh?” the woman quips, throwing an arm over the back of her seat. “In that case, welcome to sunny, scenic Dhaal! I’m a zaika, and we’re the dominant species. Nearly as advanced as any of you alien types, don’t doubt it for a second. Be happy that Paragon Inc. has your best interest at heart; a lot of my sisters down at street level aren’t as happy as we are that there’s a whole galaxy coming down on our little slice of Dhaal all of a sudden.”
rows.translation: “第一次来吧？”女人打趣道，一条胳膊搭在座椅靠背上。“既然如此，欢迎来到阳光明媚、风景如画的达尔！我是扎伊卡，我们是这里的主导种族。我们几乎和你们这些外星人一样先进，千万别怀疑。你们该庆幸典范公司把你们的利益放在心上；街面上的许多姐妹可没我们这么高兴，她们一点也不喜欢整个银河突然降临到我们这片小小的达尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“First time, huh?” the woman quips, throwing an arm over the back of her seat. “In that case, welcome to sunny, scenic Dhaal! I’m a zaika, and we’re the dominant species. Nearly as advanced as any of you alien types, don’t doubt it for a second. Be happy that Paragon Inc. has your best interest at heart; a lot of my sisters down at street level aren’t as happy as we are that there’s a whole galaxy coming down on our little slice of Dhaal all of a sudden.”"

rows.original: Your Codex quite unhelpfully chirps, “Zaika detected! This friendly species is on track for rapid integration into the United Galactic Confederacy, though 4,388 different travel advisories have been issued advising lactating species to explore elsewhere.”
rows.translation: 你的终端毫无帮助地提示：“检测到扎伊卡！这个友善种族正迅速融入银河联合邦联，不过目前已有4388条不同的旅行警告，建议会泌乳的种族改去别处探索。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour Codex quite unhelpfully chirps, “Zaika detected! This friendly species is on track for rapid integration into the United Galactic Confederacy, though 4,388 different travel advisories have been issued advising lactating species to explore elsewhere.”"

rows.original: Zaika
rows.raw: "Zaika"

rows.original: That’s... encouraging. By now the other passengers - a motley mix of rugged Rushers from several species - are grumbling about the delay, so your native driver motions for you to sit and strap in. You barely have the time to comply before the shuttle shudders underfoot and starts careening through the air towards the sprawl of the city. Whatever that “Gyre” place is, it seems you’re enroute now!
rows.translation: 这还真是...令人鼓舞。此时其他乘客——一群来自多个种族、鱼龙混杂的粗犷淘金者——已经开始抱怨耽搁，于是当地司机示意你坐下系好安全带。你刚来得及照做，接驳车便在脚下震颤起来，朝城市蔓延的建筑群疾驰而去。无论那个“旋环区”是什么地方，看来你已经上路了！
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s... encouraging. By now the other passengers - a motley mix of rugged Rushers from several species - are grumbling about the delay, so your native driver motions for you to sit and strap in. You barely have the time to comply before the shuttle shudders underfoot and starts careening through the air towards the sprawl of the city. Whatever that “Gyre” place is, it seems you’re enroute now!"

rows.original: A few minutes later, your shuttle makes an abrupt landing that has you straining against your harness. An ausar man sitting a couple places down from you gets thrown forward in punishment for not wearing one at all, planting his face into a handrail. Ouch. “Welcome to the Gyre, dude,” your zaika driver laughs. The shuttle hatch pops open, and you’re once again battered by a surge of smog and industrial reek - but it’s not nearly as bad as up on the tarmac. It doesn’t hurt to breathe, at least, but there’s a distinct and unmistakable haze as you climb out of the shuttle and onto the street.
rows.translation: 几分钟后，接驳车猛然着陆，安全带勒得你身体绷紧。坐在你下方几席的一名奥萨尔男子因为完全没系安全带而被甩向前方，一脸撞上扶手。好痛。“欢迎来到旋环区，老兄。”扎伊卡司机笑道。舱门弹开，你又一次被烟雾与工业恶臭扑面袭击——不过远没有停机坪上那么糟。至少呼吸不会痛，但你爬出接驳车走上街头时，空气中仍笼罩着清晰可辨的雾霾。
rows.raw: "A few minutes later, your shuttle makes an abrupt landing that has you straining against your harness. An ausar man sitting a couple places down from you gets thrown forward in punishment for not wearing one at all, planting his face into a handrail. Ouch. “Welcome to the Gyre, dude,” your zaika driver laughs. The shuttle hatch pops open, and you’re once again battered by a surge of smog and industrial reek - but it’s not nearly as bad as up on the tarmac. It doesn’t hurt to breathe, at least, but there’s a distinct and unmistakable haze as you climb out of the shuttle and onto the street."

rows.original: You stand in the shadows of stratospheric buildings, lit by flickering neon advertisements and pale glows from the windows. The twilight sky is all but invisible unless you stare straight up in the mist of pollutants bearing down on you, drooling thick drops of rain down onto the narrow road you’ve been deposited on.
rows.translation: 你站在直插云霄的建筑阴影下，闪烁的霓虹广告和窗户透出的惨白光芒照亮四周。除非笔直仰望，否则暮色天空几乎完全被压在头顶的污染雾气遮住；浓重雨滴从雾中滴落，打在你被扔下的狭窄道路上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stand in the shadows of stratospheric buildings, lit by flickering neon advertisements and pale glows from the windows. The twilight sky is all but invisible unless you stare straight up in the mist of pollutants bearing down on you, drooling thick drops of rain down onto the narrow road you’ve been deposited on."

rows.original: A pretty large gang of other zaika are heading up the road towards you, maybe a dozen of them in various torn-up leather outfits and black coats. Either they’re an all-female race or the males are vanishingly rare, because this particular gang are all various shades of buxom purple alien babe.
rows.translation: 一大群扎伊卡正沿路向你走来，大约有十来人，穿着各式破旧皮衣和黑色外套。她们要么是全雌性种族，要么雄性稀少得近乎绝迹，因为这一帮全都是身材丰满、肤色深浅各异的紫色外星美女。
rows.raw: "\n\nA pretty large gang of other zaika are heading up the road towards you, maybe a dozen of them in various torn-up leather outfits and black coats. Either they’re an all-female race or the males are vanishingly rare, because this particular gang are all various shades of buxom purple alien babe."

rows.original: “Ah, shit, gangers already?” your driver complains, ratcheting a lever next to her seat. “Better make yourselves scarce, aliens, unless you want trouble!”
rows.translation: “啊，见鬼，这么快就碰上帮派了？”司机抱怨着，扳动座位旁的一根拉杆。“外星人，最好赶紧散开，除非你们想惹麻烦！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, shit, gangers already?” your driver complains, ratcheting a lever next to her seat. “Better make yourselves scarce, aliens, unless you want trouble!”"

rows.original: Armor plates fall down over the viewports as the last of the Rushers disembarks, and your fellow passengers quickly scatter down alleys and back streets before the gang overtakes you. You turn to leave as well, but just in time to hear a loud ka-bang! from the back of the hovercar. Black smoke billows out of the grav-plating under it and from the engines, followed by a string of cursing from the driver as the hatch closes back up.
rows.translation: 最后一名淘金者下车后，装甲板落下遮住观察窗，其他乘客也迅速四散进小巷和后街，以免被帮派追上。你也转身要走，却恰好听见悬浮车后方传来一声巨大的砰！。黑烟从车底的重力板和引擎中涌出，紧接着司机骂声连连，舱门也重新合拢。
rows.raw: "\n\nArmor plates fall down over the viewports as the last of the Rushers disembarks, and your fellow passengers quickly scatter down alleys and back streets before the gang overtakes you. You turn to leave as well, but just in time to hear a loud ka-bang! from the back of the hovercar. Black smoke billows out of the grav-plating under it and from the engines, followed by a string of cursing from the driver as the hatch closes back up."

rows.original: The sound of the armor and hatch engaging seems to drive the group of zaika thugs into a frenzy, and in the blink of an eye almost every member of the gang has produced a pipe, chain, or club from somewhere on her person. They charge at the shuttle with screams of “Traitor!” “Paragon of shit!” “
rows.translation: 装甲和舱门合拢的声音似乎令这群扎伊卡暴徒陷入狂热；转眼之间，几乎每个成员都不知从哪掏出一根管子、链条或棍棒。她们尖叫着冲向接驳车：“叛徒！” “狗屁典范！” “
rows.raw: "\n\nThe sound of the armor and hatch engaging seems to drive the group of zaika thugs into a frenzy, and in the blink of an eye almost every member of the gang has produced a pipe, chain, or club from somewhere on her person. They charge at the shuttle with screams of “Traitor!” “Paragon of shit!” “"

rows.original: ” and worse, and you recoil back as several bludgeons slam into the engine block. Sparks fly while other members of the gang start climbing onto the helpless shuttle, pounding on the door or trying to break in the windows.
rows.translation: ”以及更难听的话。几根钝器砸向引擎舱，你向后缩去，火花四溅；帮派的其他成员开始爬上动弹不得的接驳车，猛砸车门，或试图打破车窗。
rows.raw: "” and worse, and you recoil back as several bludgeons slam into the engine block. Sparks fly while other members of the gang start climbing onto the helpless shuttle, pounding on the door or trying to break in the windows."

rows.original: Almost as soon as they’ve started, you hear a siren wailing somewhere nearby. A few seconds later and a bulky armored truck colored the same silver-and-blue of the shuttle barrels down the road, skids to a stop a few yards off, and disgorges a group of armored zaika women wielding truncheons and shields. All of them have the word “PARAGON” emblazoned over their backs and shoulders. They form up into a shield wall and advance, as a voice booms from speakers on the carrier: “YOU ARE IN VIOLATION OF ZAIBATSU ACCORDS. CEASE DAMAGING PARAGON PROPERTY. DISPERSE NOW.”
rows.translation: 她们才刚动手，你便听到附近响起警报。几秒后，一辆涂着与接驳车相同银蓝配色的重型装甲卡车沿道路冲来，在几码外急停，放出一队手持警棍与盾牌、身披铠甲的扎伊卡女子。所有人的背部和肩头都印着“典范”字样。她们组成盾墙向前推进，运兵车的扬声器则传出洪亮声音：“你们违反了财阀协定。立即停止破坏典范财产。现在散开。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAlmost as soon as they’ve started, you hear a siren wailing somewhere nearby. A few seconds later and a bulky armored truck colored the same silver-and-blue of the shuttle barrels down the road, skids to a stop a few yards off, and disgorges a group of armored zaika women wielding truncheons and shields. All of them have the word “PARAGON” emblazoned over their backs and shoulders. They form up into a shield wall and advance, as a voice booms from speakers on the carrier: “YOU ARE IN VIOLATION OF ZAIBATSU ACCORDS. CEASE DAMAGING PARAGON PROPERTY. DISPERSE NOW.”"

rows.original: It’s a short, brutal melee as the police-looking aliens wade into the crowd, dragging them off the hover-car and batting them around with their clubs. The Paragon troops have so much armor that it’s no contest between them, shrugging off the worst the mob can throw at them until the last members are being dragged down and cuffed.
rows.translation: 战斗短暂而残酷。看似警察的外星人冲进人群，把暴徒从悬浮车上拖下来，用警棍四处痛打。典范部队的装甲厚重得令双方根本没有悬念；她们轻易承受暴徒最猛烈的攻击，直到最后一批成员也被按倒并戴上手铐。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a short, brutal melee as the police-looking aliens wade into the crowd, dragging them off the hover-car and batting them around with their clubs. The Paragon troops have so much armor that it’s no contest between them, shrugging off the worst the mob can throw at them until the last members are being dragged down and cuffed."

She’d look more at home in a high-class bondage dungeon somewhere in the core

rows.original: Still and all, as you step up to the desk she greets you with a pretty smile and a wiggle of her elfin ears. “Greetings new customer! Welcome to the Paragon Capsule Resort - the paragon of comfort for any budget!”
rows.translation: 尽管如此，当你走到前台时，她仍带着漂亮的笑容迎接你，精灵般的耳朵也轻轻摆动。“新客人您好！欢迎来到典范胶囊度假村——任何预算都能享受的典范舒适体验！”
rows.raw: "\n\nStill and all, as you step up to the desk she greets you with a pretty smile and a wiggle of her elfin ears. “Greetings new customer! Welcome to the Paragon Capsule Resort - the paragon of comfort for any budget!”"

rows.original: She recites the canned line cheerily, tapping a button on her desk so that a menu of available rooms and services appears behind her. “I am Myssah, the manager of this establishment. Whenever you’re ready to rest and relax here at the resort, please don’t hesitate to let me know.”
rows.translation: 她欢快地背出这句套话，轻敲桌下的按钮，于是可用房间与服务菜单在身后显现。“我是米萨，本店经理。您准备好在度假村休息放松时，请随时告诉我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe recites the canned line cheerily, tapping a button on her desk so that a menu of available rooms and services appears behind her. “I am Myssah, the manager of this establishment. Whenever you’re ready to rest and relax here at the resort, please don’t hesitate to let me know.”"

rows.original: Myssah gives you that pretty smile of hers as you approach the dest, ears wiggling up and down. “Welcome back, honored guest. Will you be staying with us today?”
rows.translation: 你靠近前台时，米萨露出她那漂亮的笑容，双耳上下摆动。“欢迎回来，尊贵的客人。您今天要在这里住宿吗？”
rows.raw: "Myssah gives you that pretty smile of hers as you approach the dest, ears wiggling up and down. “Welcome back, honored guest. Will you be staying with us today?”"

rows.original: She taps a button under her desk, and the resort’s menu appears holographically behind her. “Our capsules are economically priced,” she says, leaning forward over the desk in a way that makes all the leather she’s wearing creak, “but perhaps I could interest you in a full service experience?”
rows.translation: 她按下桌下的按钮，度假村的菜单在身后以全息影像显现。“我们的胶囊房定价实惠。”她说着向前俯身压在桌面上，身上的皮衣随之吱嘎作响，“不过，也许我能让您对全套服务体验产生兴趣？”

rows.original: “Very well,” Myssah answers, crisp and professional. She turns an old-fashioned touch-screen display around to face you, showing an agreement and cost that you quickly scan over before swiping your Codex over a recently-added scanner bolted onto the side. The transaction completes, and Myssah smiles and hands you a plastic keycard from under the desk.
rows.translation: “好的。”米萨干脆而专业地回答。她把一台老式触摸屏转向你，上面显示着协议和费用；你快速浏览后，将终端扫过固定在一旁、最近才加装的扫描器。交易完成，米萨微笑着从桌下取出一张塑料钥匙卡递给你。

rows.translation: 号胶囊房。”她说着，指向身后左侧的一扇门。“里面有一个可用钥匙开启的储物柜供您存放物品，后方房间还有公共淋浴间。”
rows.raw: ",” she says, pointing towards a door behind her and to the left. “There’s a cubby for your belongings accessible by your key, as well as a public shower, in the room beyond.”"

rows.original: You head on back, using your keycard to unlock the door and head through into a dark chamber. When your eyes adjust to it, you see a vast, sprawling narrow row of three-foot hatches in the wall stacked twenty feet high. You quickly walk through the stacks towards the clearly-marked shower room. There’s another door inside the showers marked private, but your card only gets you access to the main, open showers - luckily for you it’s empty at the moment, and you’re able to get cleaned up fairly quick before trying to find your sleeping arrangements.
rows.translation: 你往里走，用钥匙卡打开门，进入一间昏暗的大厅。双眼适应后，你看到墙上排列着漫长而狭窄的三英尺舱门，一直堆叠到二十英尺高。你快步穿过层层胶囊，走向标识清楚的淋浴室。公共淋浴间里还有一扇标着“私人”的门，但你的卡只能进入主要的开放式淋浴区——幸好此刻空无一人，你很快便洗净身体，随后去寻找自己的睡处。

When your eyes adjust to it, you see a vast, sprawling narrow row of three-foot hatches in the wall stacked twenty feet high. You quickly walk through the stacks towards the clearly-marked shower room. There’s another door inside the showers marked private, but your card only gets you access to the main, open showers - luckily for you it’s empty at the moment, and you’re able to get cleaned up fairly quick before trying to find your sleeping arrangements."

rows.original: You end up climbing up to one of the hatches, using the handles on other units to heft yourself up to your own. It opens with a swipe of your keycard, and with some effort, you’re able to swing yourself into the hatch and squeeze inside. The capsule is barely big enough for you to fit inside it, with just enough room to lay down and nestle your head into the cheap pillow.
rows.translation: 你最终爬到其中一个舱门前，借助其他单元的把手将自己撑到所属胶囊。刷过钥匙卡后舱门开启，你费了些力气才把身体荡进去并挤进内部。胶囊仅勉强容得下你，只有足够平躺并把头靠在廉价枕头上的空间。

It opens with a swipe of your keycard, and with some effort, you’re able to swing yourself into the hatch and squeeze inside. The capsule is barely big enough for you to fit inside it, with just enough room to lay down and nestle your head into the cheap pillow."

rows.original: It’s hardly the most comfortable sleep you’ve ever had - there’s no room to stretch out, and barely enough clearance just to roll over, like the hotel picked a capsule the perfect size to sardine-ify you - but you are able to sleep eventually. It’s blessedly quiet and the air is cleaner than outside by far, plus with the cannons outside, you don’t need to worry about the street gangs barging in. It’s a momentary illusion of safety and security, if not necessarily comfort, here on Dhaal, and you’re happy to take what little is offered.
rows.translation: 这算不上你睡过最舒服的一觉——没有伸展空间，连翻身都几乎不够，仿佛旅馆特意挑了一个大小刚好能把你塞成沙丁鱼的胶囊——不过最终你还是睡着了。值得庆幸的是这里十分安静，空气也远比外面干净；再加上门外的大炮，你不必担心街头帮派闯进来。在达尔，这里提供了一种短暂的安全假象，即便谈不上舒适，你也乐于接受仅有的一点好处。

rows.original: You wake to faint but insistent beeping coming from inside your capsule. Slowly, you open your eyes, only to find that one of the walls is projecting holographic text over itself: “YOUR ALLOTTED SLEEPING HOURS ARE NOW OVER. PLEASE COLLECT YOUR BELONGINGS.”
rows.translation: 你被胶囊内持续而细微的蜂鸣声唤醒。你慢慢睁眼，只见一面舱壁上投射出全息文字：“您分配到的睡眠时段已经结束。请取走您的物品。”

rows.original: Lame. With a big yawn, you wiggle out of the capsule and slide down to the ground level. Your gear’s locked away right where you left it, and so you kit up, clean up, and get ready to head back out onto the mean streets once more...
rows.translation: 真扫兴。你打着大大的哈欠，扭身爬出胶囊，滑到地面。装备仍锁在原处，于是你重新穿戴、洗漱，准备再次踏上凶险的街道...

rows.original: The water is nice and hot, and just a little bit salty from some kind of purification system. You help yourself to some complimentary cleaning products and enjoy this fleeting bit of luxury on this otherwise hostile, grimy world. You come away feeling surprisingly clean, and when you head back out to the vast rows of capsule “rooms,” you find yours has a small drone hovering next to it with a steaming tray balanced on its head.
rows.translation: 水温舒适而滚烫，某种净化系统让它略带咸味。你随意使用免费的清洁用品，享受这个敌意而肮脏的世界上短暂的奢侈。洗完后，你感觉出乎意料地干净。回到胶囊“房间”的漫长队列时，你发现自己的胶囊旁悬停着一架小型无人机，头顶托着一盘热气腾腾的餐点。

rows.original: The capsule is barely big enough for you to fit inside it, with just enough room to sit up and use the pillow as a back rest. You open up the plastic seal over your tray and dig into the... whatever it is: some sort of browned meat-thing and pale white vegetables that are still steaming, and covered in a thick red powder. A native chili maybe? The meal is fairly tasty, if not particularly extravagant, and you quickly finish up and snuffle into the sleeve-like bed for the night.
rows.translation: 胶囊只勉强容得下你，不过空间足以让你坐起身，把枕头当成靠背。你揭开餐盘上的塑料封膜，开吃...不管这究竟是什么：某种煎成褐色的肉块和仍冒着热气的惨白蔬菜，上面覆盖着厚厚的红色粉末。也许是当地辣椒？这顿饭味道还不错，只是谈不上奢华。你很快吃完，钻进套筒般的床铺过夜。

rows.original: Following the archived coordinates you received brings you to a region of backwater space so far from any civilization that at first you’re worried there was some sort of glitch. As you draw closer, your sensors begin spitting out reassurances and your main screen beeps with a magnified visual.

As you draw closer, your sensors begin spitting out reassurances and your main screen beeps with a magnified visual."

rows.original: The planet is a strange sight. Half of the world is frozen in a jet black ice, seemingly as lifeless as the void, while the other half bakes in the molten heat of its star. The readout explains that Dhaal is tidally locked: the planet’s rotation matches its orbit in such a way that the far side never sees day and the near side never sees night. The only part of the planet on which life can exist at all is a band running from the north pole to the south and back again, perfectly situated between the unforgiving extremes and bathed in an eternal twilight.
rows.translation: 这颗行星景象奇异。半个世界冻结在漆黑的冰层中，仿佛虚空般死寂；另半边则承受恒星熔融般的炙热。读数说明达尔已被潮汐锁定：行星自转与公转完全同步，使背面永远见不到白昼，正面永远见不到黑夜。整颗行星唯一能让生命存续的地方，是一条从北极延伸至南极再绕回来的地带，恰好位于无情的两极端之间，永远沐浴在暮光中。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe planet is a strange sight. Half of the world is frozen in a jet black ice, seemingly as lifeless as the void, while the other half bakes in the molten heat of its star. The readout explains that Dhaal is tidally locked: the planet’s rotation matches its orbit in such a way that the far side never sees day and the near side never sees night. The only part of the planet on which life can exist at all is a band running from the north pole to the south and back again, perfectly situated between the unforgiving extremes and bathed in an eternal twilight."

rows.original: At first, it appears as if the planet has a thin, glittering ring orbiting it. This illusion is dispelled by the chatter of hundreds of signals filling your scanners with buzzing babble. There are so many ships in the planet’s thermosphere that they fill the darkness with a halo of twinkling lights. The easily recognizable logos of various MegaCorps are brightly branded across the hulls; galactic civilization impatiently waits for the go-ahead to descend on Dhaal like vultures.
rows.translation: 起初，这颗行星看起来像有一道纤薄闪亮的行星环。但数百个信号的通讯杂音很快打破了这种错觉，嗡嗡的嘈杂声塞满你的扫描器。行星热层内的飞船多得足以用闪烁灯火为黑暗镶上一圈光晕。各大巨型企业易于辨认的标志鲜明地印在船体上；银河文明正不耐烦地等待许可，准备像秃鹫一样扑向达尔。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt first, it appears as if the planet has a thin, glittering ring orbiting it. This illusion is dispelled by the chatter of hundreds of signals filling your scanners with buzzing babble. There are so many ships in the planet’s thermosphere that they fill the darkness with a halo of twinkling lights. rows.original: The ever-expanding planetary landing site is still growing, plumes of industrial smoke swirling around the vibrant neon of the nearby Gyre. Garish colors punch through the perpetual dusk to advertise a dizzying multitude of commercial ventures. A shuttle zips up to your ship, ready to whisk you into the city proper. Good thing, too. You’re happy to spend as little time as possible in the noxious open ground. The Paragon transport quickly pops the hatch, allowing you to climb in and ride down to the Gyre where it’s... well, a little less polluted anyway.
rows.translation: 仍在扩建的行星着陆场继续向外生长，工业烟柱在附近旋环区鲜艳的霓虹灯间盘旋。俗艳的色彩穿透永恒的暮色，为数量多到令人目眩的商业项目招徕顾客。一架穿梭机疾驰到你的飞船旁，准备把你送进真正的城区。这正合你意，你巴不得尽量少在有毒的露天地面停留。典范公司的交通艇迅速打开舱门，让你登船前往旋环区，那里... 嗯，至少污染稍微轻些。

rows.original: You turn to see a heavyset kaithrit man standing an arm’s length away, surrounded by several large cases at his feet. “What a warm welcome!” he chuckles. “Lets you know that even the streets here aren’t safe. Kattom Osgood, by the by. Purveyor of self-defense tools... and clearly, business here is going to be quite good! Care to sample the wares before you set off? You’ll want the best of the best if you’re going to be exploring the mean streets of Dhaal!”

Either way, I think you’ll want the best means of self-defense money can buy before setting out into the mean streets of Dhaal. Care to take a gander are the wares while we wait? I’m set up a mere step to the west!”

rows.original: A narrow building sits wedged between the ground floor of two massive skyscrapers to the east, lit by a neon blue sign advertising “PARAGON CAPSULE RESORT” in flashing letters. Bulletproof glass covered in metal bars make up the actual storefront, but you can see a well-lit if well-worn lobby inside, and the movement of other people. A pair of automated gun turrets on either corner of the building track your movements as you approach, but don’t fire. Better keep your hands off your weapons just in case.
rows.translation: 一栋狭窄建筑挤在东边两座摩天大楼的一层之间，霓虹蓝招牌用闪烁文字宣传着“典范胶囊度假村”。店面本身由覆着金属栏杆的防弹玻璃构成，但你能看见里面灯火通明、略显破旧的大厅，还有其他人的身影。建筑两角各有一座自动炮塔，随着你的靠近追踪你的动作，却没有开火。保险起见，最好别碰武器。

rows.original: The inside of the capsule hotel is run down but well lit, inviting if it weren’t for the clear signs of age on the walls and cheap furniture - chunks of wallpaper have come out, revealing solid metal underneath, and posters advertising various Paragon Inc. products have been plastered up to cover the worst of the damage. A handful of other Rushers are sitting around in the lobby, resting up before their next expedition into the Gyre, but the most notable individual here is the zaika standing behind the counter - a tall, willowy example of the native race with flowing silver hair and near-black purple flesh that’s zipped up tight in a Paragon-blue leather corset, shoulder-length gloves, and boots that disappear up under a thigh skirt.
rows.translation: 胶囊旅馆内部破旧但灯光充足，若不是墙上明显的岁月痕迹与廉价家具，本该颇为宜人——大块墙纸脱落，露出下面的实心金属；宣传典范公司各种产品的海报被贴上去，遮住最严重的破损。几名其他开拓者坐在大厅里休息，为下一次深入旋环区的探索养精蓄锐；不过这里最显眼的人，是柜台后站着的扎伊卡。她是本地种族中高挑纤细的一员，银发飘逸，近乎黑色的紫色肌肤被紧紧束在一套典范蓝皮质胸衣、长及肩头的手套，以及没入大腿裙下的靴子中。
