rows.original: When you reach the landing, an underground area opens up around you. It’s a single long chamber, big enough to hold a small starship, with a long metal track running down the center. Most of the floor is covered with gray dust. Piles of rubble sit on either end of the track, blocking off what looks like a tunnel. Lights flicker on the domed ceiling, growing brighter and dimmer in uneven waves, making the whole place seem hazy and dangerous.
rows.translation: 抵达平台后，一片地下空间在你四周展开。这是一间狭长的大厅，足以容纳一艘小型星舰，中央贯穿着一条长长的金属轨道。大部分地面覆着灰尘。轨道两端都堆着瓦砾，堵住了看似隧道的入口。穹顶上的灯光闪烁不定，忽明忽暗地起伏，让整片空间显得朦胧而危险。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you reach the landing, an underground area opens up around you. It’s a single long chamber, big enough to hold a small starship, with a long metal track running down the center. Most of the floor is covered with gray dust. Piles of rubble sit on either end of the track, blocking off what looks like a tunnel. Lights flicker on the domed ceiling, growing brighter and dimmer in uneven waves, making the whole place seem hazy and dangerous."

rows.original: Graffiti covers the walls, crude drawings of zaika girls and giant sex organs and anti-zaibatsu scribbles. High up on one wall, you can make out faded lettering, spelling out “yre Station”. It looks like this was supposed to be part of some kind of underground rail system, but there’s no train.
rows.translation: 墙面布满涂鸦，其中有扎伊卡女孩、硕大性器官的粗陋图画，还有反财阀的潦草字句。高处的一面墙上，你勉强辨认出褪色文字，拼成“环城车站”。这里似乎原本要成为某种地下铁路系统的一部分，但并没有列车。
rows.raw: "\n\nGraffiti covers the walls, crude drawings of zaika girls and giant sex organs and anti-zaibatsu scribbles. High up on one wall, you can make out faded lettering, spelling out “yre Station”. It looks like this was supposed to be part of some kind of underground rail system, but there’s no train."

rows.original: There’s a door beneath the lettering, a giant piece of riveted metal that looks like someone pulled it off a spaceship and jammed it onto the wall. It doesn’t match anything else down here, almost conspicuously out of place. There’s no knob or handle on the door, and more of the yellow lights flicker around its frame. Is this where the graffiti arrows on the street above were pointing?
rows.translation: 文字下方有一扇门，是一整块铆接金属，看起来像有人从飞船上拆下来，硬塞进墙里。它与这里的其他一切都不搭，突兀得近乎刻意。门上没有旋钮或把手，更多黄色灯光在门框四周闪烁。地面街道上的涂鸦箭头指的就是这里吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a door beneath the lettering, a giant piece of riveted metal that looks like someone pulled it off a spaceship and jammed it onto the wall. It doesn’t match anything else down here, almost conspicuously out of place. There’s no knob or handle on the door, and more of the yellow lights flicker around its frame. Is this where the graffiti arrows on the street above were pointing?"

rows.original: You look at the graffiti some more, then spot what you’re looking for – an arrow done in the same curling style, with “moo” written beneath it, pointing at the metal door. It blends in so well with the rest of the crude drawings, you wouldn’t have seen it if you didn’t know what to look for.
rows.translation: 你又看了看涂鸦，终于发现要找的东西——一道以相同卷曲风格画成的箭头，下方写着“哞”，正指向那扇金属门。它与其他粗陋图画融合得太好，要不是事先知道该找什么，你根本发现不了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look at the graffiti some more, then spot what you’re looking for – an arrow done in the same curling style, with “moo” written beneath it, pointing at the metal door. It blends in so well with the rest of the crude drawings, you wouldn’t have seen it if you didn’t know what to look for."

rows.original: Might as well find out what’s down here, since you’ve come this far. You approach the giant steel door, but before you can get close enough to knock, harsh lights around it flare to life.
rows.translation: 既然已经走到这里，不妨看看下面究竟有什么。你走向巨大的钢门，可还没靠近到足以敲门，门四周刺眼的灯光便骤然亮起。
rows.raw: "\n\nMight as well find out what’s down here, since you’ve come this far. You approach the giant steel door, but before you can get close enough to knock, harsh lights around it flare to life."

rows.original: A blue hardlight projection appears in front of the door, a sneering thraggen woman standing at seven feet tall. Her scar-striped arms are folded over a pair of tits big enough to lose your entire head between, barely kept in place by an armored vest that’s way too small for her and leaves her thick, muscular arms free. Armored pants and heavy boots complete her ensemble, and she has a stun baton and some kind of large pistol at her belt. A sleek mechanical cannon is mounted on her left shoulder, pointing down at you, and she wears a cybernetic monocle over her left eye. A tattoo of the letters “RR” marks her right shoulder. Her hair is spiked up in an aggressive mohawk, her fangs are jutting up from behind her lower lip, and she does not look happy to see you.
rows.translation: 一道蓝色硬光投影出现在门前，那是一名面带冷笑、足有七英尺高的特拉根女子。布满伤疤的双臂交叉在一对足以把你整颗脑袋埋进去的巨乳下方，那件对她而言小得过分的装甲背心几乎兜不住乳房，却让粗壮结实的双臂完全裸露。装甲裤和重靴补全了她的装束，腰带上挂着一根电击棍和某种大型手枪。左肩安装着一门流线型机械炮，炮口向下对着你；左眼上还戴着一只机械单片眼镜。右肩纹着字母“RR”。头发梳成极具攻击性的莫西干头，獠牙从下唇后方突起，而她显然一点也不高兴见到你。
rows.raw: "\n\nA blue hardlight projection appears in front of the door, a sneering thraggen woman standing at seven feet tall. Her scar-striped arms are folded over a pair of tits big enough to lose your entire head between, barely kept in place by an armored vest that’s way too small for her and leaves her thick, muscular arms free. Armored pants and heavy boots complete her ensemble, and she has a stun baton and some kind of large pistol at her belt. A sleek mechanical cannon is mounted on her left shoulder, pointing down at you, and she wears a cybernetic monocle over her left eye. A tattoo of the letters “RR” marks her right shoulder. Her hair is spiked up in an aggressive mohawk, her fangs are jutting up from behind her lower lip, and she does not look happy to see you."

rows.original: “New meat,” the thraggen growls. “The fuck do you want?”
rows.translation: “新来的肉，”特拉根低吼道。“你他妈想干什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“New meat,” the thraggen growls. “The fuck do you want?”"

rows.original: You tell her you saw the graffiti pointing to this place, and you wanted to know what’s down here. Sure, she’s a hardlight projection, but she’s also clearly meant to be a threat. Whatever’s behind that door, whoever’s guarding it, they wouldn’t be using this image if they weren’t trying to hide something. And that cannon on her shoulder makes it clear they’re willing to shoot you if you don’t say the right thing.
rows.translation: 你告诉她，自己看见了指向这里的涂鸦，想知道下面有什么。没错，她只是硬光投影，但显然也代表着威胁。不管那扇门后是什么、守门的又是谁，要不是想隐藏什么，他们不会使用这种形象。而她肩上的炮清楚表明，如果你说错话，他们真会向你开火。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her you saw the graffiti pointing to this place, and you wanted to know what’s down here. Sure, she’s a hardlight projection, but she’s also clearly meant to be a threat. Whatever’s behind that door, whoever’s guarding it, they wouldn’t be using this image if they weren’t trying to hide something. And that cannon on her shoulder makes it clear they’re willing to shoot you if you don’t say the right thing."

rows.original: The thraggen curls her upper lip in what’s either a smirk or a sneer. “Thought so,” she says. “The Gyre’s a dangerous place to be curious.”
rows.translation: 特拉根扬起上唇，像是在得意地笑，也可能是在龇牙。“我就知道，”她说。“在旋环区，好奇心可是很危险的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe thraggen curls her upper lip in what’s either a smirk or a sneer. “Thought so,” she says. “The Gyre’s a dangerous place to be curious.”"

rows.original: You point out that you’re a rusher, and going to dangerous places and being curious about what’s there is what you do. No need to say more than that.
rows.translation: 你指出自己是个开拓者，前往危险之地、对其中事物抱有好奇，正是你的工作。无需再多说。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou point out that you’re a rusher, and going to dangerous places and being curious about what’s there is what you do. No need to say more than that."

rows.original: She grunts. “Got me there. You with any of the corps? The zaibatsu paying your ass?” She looks you up and down, and the cannon on her shoulder tilts to follow her gaze. “You don’t look like one of them, but you’re damn sure not hurting for creds.”
rows.translation: 她哼了一声。“这倒没错。你替哪家公司干活吗？ 财阀付钱买了你的屁股？”她上下打量你，肩上的炮也随视线移动。“你看着不像他们的人，但肯定也不缺信用点。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe grunts. “Got me there. You with any of the corps? The zaibatsu paying your ass?” She looks you up and down, and the cannon on her shoulder tilts to follow her gaze. “You don’t look like one of them, but you’re damn sure not hurting for creds.”"

rows.original: No, you’re not with any of the local corps. Again, you leave it at that. This doesn’t look like a good place to talk about who you really are.
rows.translation: 不，你不属于任何本地公司。你依旧点到为止。这里似乎不适合谈论自己的真实身份。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo, you’re not with any of the local corps. Again, you leave it at that. This doesn’t look like a good place to talk about who you really are."

rows.original: “Let’s find out.” The thraggen reaches out to the side, and her hand disappears from the hardlight projection for a moment before reappearing. So there’s a real person behind this, somewhere. “Facial scan’s clean.” She snorts. “Okay, meat. Congratulations on finding the Crash Landing. Listen up and I’ll tell you how things work down here.”
rows.translation: “那就来查查。”特拉根向旁边伸出手，手掌一度消失在硬光投影外，随后重新出现。所以这背后确实有个真人，正待在某处。“面部扫描无异常。”她嗤了一声。“好了，肉块。恭喜你找到‘迫降’。听好了，我来告诉你这里的规矩。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s find out.” The thraggen reaches out to the side, and her hand disappears from the hardlight projection for a moment before reappearing. So there’s a real person behind this, somewhere. “Facial scan’s clean.” She snorts. “Okay, meat. Congratulations on finding the Crash Landing. Listen up and I’ll tell you how things work down here.”"

rows.original: UOND EPHINE.DHAAL.CRASH LANDING STATION
rows.raw: "UOND EPHINE.DHAAL.CRASH LANDING STATION"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Put it real simple, this is a milk bar,” the thraggen says. “You don’t look like you get fucked up on milk like the locals do, but we’ve got regular booze too. Bar games, dancing, shit like that. Sound like your kind of fun?”
rows.translation: “简单来说，这里是家乳吧，”特拉根说道。“看你不像本地人那样喝奶就能嗨，但我们也有普通酒水。酒吧游戏、跳舞之类的破事。合你的胃口吗？”
rows.raw: "“Put it real simple, this is a milk bar,” the thraggen says. “You don’t look like you get fucked up on milk like the locals do, but we’ve got regular booze too. Bar games, dancing, shit like that. Sound like your kind of fun?”"

rows.original: After the welcome you got when you arrived on Dhaal, a drink might be a really good idea. And if it’s not under the corporations’ control, so much the better.
rows.translation: 经历了初到达尔时受到的欢迎后，喝一杯或许真是个好主意。如果这里不受公司控制，那就更好了。
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter the welcome you got when you arrived on Dhaal, a drink might be a really good idea. And if it’s not under the corporations’ control, so much the better."

rows.original: “Good,” the thraggen says, then gives you a look like she’s about to bite your throat out. “You want in, you agree to the rules. Listen up.”
rows.translation: “很好，”特拉根说道，随后用一副随时会咬断你喉咙的神情看着你。“想进去，就得同意规矩。听好了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good,” the thraggen says, then gives you a look like she’s about to bite your throat out. “You want in, you agree to the rules. Listen up.”"

rows.original: “First up: you don’t touch the girls unless they say so. We’ve got a fucking genius techie who rigged up a system here to stun the living shit out of you from anywhere in the bar if you put one finger where it doesn’t belong. Then we toss you out for the milk thieves. And if you’re real bad, before we do that, I chop off your hand and pin it on my wall. Got it?”
rows.translation: “第一：姑娘们没同意，你就不能碰。我们这儿有个他妈的天才技术员，装了一套系统；只要你把一根手指放到不该放的地方，不管在酒吧哪个角落，都能把你电得他妈死去活来。然后我们会把你扔出去喂偷奶贼。要是情节特别恶劣，我会先砍掉你的手，钉在墙上。明白了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“First up: you don’t touch the girls unless they say so. We’ve got a fucking genius techie who rigged up a system here to stun the living shit out of you from anywhere in the bar if you put one finger where it doesn’t belong. Then we toss you out for the milk thieves. And if you’re real bad, before we do that, I chop off your hand and pin it on my wall. Got it?”"

rows.original: Sounds like a rough place, but you know how to keep your hands to yourself. What’s the second rule?
rows.translation: 这里听起来很粗野，但你知道该管好自己的双手。第二条规矩是什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nSounds like a rough place, but you know how to keep your hands to yourself. What’s the second rule?"

rows.original: “Second: you hold your milk, or your booze, or whatever gets you off. People are here for a good time in this shithole city, not to watch you make an ass of yourself. Keep it together or we throw you out and you don’t get to come back.”
rows.translation: “第二：不管是奶、酒，还是任何能让你兴奋的玩意，都得控制好量。人们来这座狗屎城市是为了找乐子，可不是来看你出丑的。保持清醒，否则我们会把你扔出去，而且永远不许回来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Second: you hold your milk, or your booze, or whatever gets you off. People are here for a good time in this shithole city, not to watch you make an ass of yourself. Keep it together or we throw you out and you don’t get to come back.”"

rows.original: You’re not in the habit of making a fool of yourself at bars anyway.
rows.translation: 你本来也没有在酒吧出丑的习惯。
rows.raw: "You’re not in the habit of making a fool of yourself at bars anyway."

rows.original: That doesn’t sound like much fun, but you might be able to restrain yourself.
rows.translation: 这听起来不怎么有趣，但你或许能克制自己。
rows.raw: "That doesn’t sound like much fun, but you might be able to restrain yourself."

rows.original: Sounds like a pretty weak bar if they can’t deal with a few drunks getting rowdy.
rows.translation: 连几个醉汉闹事都应付不了，听起来这酒吧也太弱了。
rows.raw: "Sounds like a pretty weak bar if they can’t deal with a few drunks getting rowdy."

rows.original: Anything else?
rows.translation: 还有别的吗？
rows.raw: " Anything else?"

rows.original: “Don’t fuck the place up. We’ve got a lot of customers and only the space we could hammer out, so don’t go trashing the bar. Or anything else. You pull a weapon, same thing happens like you touched the girls, and I keep your gear. Unless the corps try to raid the bar, and if that happens, shoot the fuckers.” The thraggen sighs between her teeth. “Just act like you grew up someplace where you weren’t wiping your ass on leaves, and you’ll be fine. Got it?”
rows.translation: “别把这里搞砸。我们顾客很多，地方却只有这么一点，还是硬砸出来的，所以别砸酒吧。别砸其他东西。拔武器的下场跟碰姑娘一样，而且装备归我。除非公司来扫荡酒吧，那时候就尽管射杀那些混蛋。”特拉根从齿缝间叹了口气。“表现得像是在一个不用树叶擦屁股的地方长大，你就不会有事。明白了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t fuck the place up. We’ve got a lot of customers and only the space we could hammer out, so don’t go trashing the bar. Or anything else. You pull a weapon, same thing happens like you touched the girls, and I keep your gear. Unless the corps try to raid the bar, and if that happens, shoot the fuckers.” The thraggen sighs between her teeth. “Just act like you grew up someplace where you weren’t wiping your ass on leaves, and you’ll be fine. Got it?”"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: You head into the abandoned station again. The yellow lights flicker above you as you go down the stairs, and the platform looks the same as before. Maybe there’s a new penis drawn on the wall, maybe not. You approach the door to the Crash Landing, then stop as the muscular thraggen’s hardlight projection appears.
rows.translation: 你再次走进废弃车站。沿楼梯向下时，黄色灯光在头顶闪烁，站台和以前一样。墙上或许多画了一根阴茎，也可能没有。你走向‘迫降’的大门，随后在肌肉发达的特拉根投影出现时停下脚步。
rows.raw: "You head into the abandoned station again. The yellow lights flicker above you as you go down the stairs, and the platform looks the same as before. Maybe there’s a new penis drawn on the wall, maybe not. You approach the door to the Crash Landing, then stop as the muscular thraggen’s hardlight projection appears."

rows.original: “You again?” the thraggen asks. She snarls at you. “You ready to follow the rules? If not, don’t waste my fucking time.”
rows.translation: “又是你？”特拉根问道。她朝你龇牙。“准备好遵守规矩了吗？ 没准备好就别他妈浪费我的时间。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You again?” the thraggen asks. She snarls at you. “You ready to follow the rules? If not, don’t waste my fucking time.”"

rows.original: UOND EPHINE.DHAAL.CRASH LANDING STATION
rows.raw: "UOND EPHINE.DHAAL.CRASH LANDING STATION"

rows.original: Yes
rows.translation: 是
rows.raw: "Yes"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: Walk Away
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Walk Away"

rows.original: UOND EPHINE.DHAAL.DHAAL L11
rows.raw: "UOND EPHINE.DHAAL.DHAAL L11"

rows.original: You can manage that. You’ve been to some rough places during your travels, this doesn’t sound like anything too different. And you know better than to just pull your gun out in a bar. You tell the thraggen that you’re fine with the rules.
rows.translation: 这你能做到。旅途中你去过一些粗野的地方，这里听起来也没什么特别。你更清楚不能在酒吧随便拔枪。你告诉特拉根，自己接受这些规矩。
rows.raw: "You can manage that. You’ve been to some rough places during your travels, this doesn’t sound like anything too different. And you know better than to just pull your gun out in a bar. You tell the thraggen that you’re fine with the rules."

rows.original: “Good,” she says. “Hold up.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good,” she says. “Hold up.”"

rows.original: The hardlight image disappears, and a moment later, the sound of large bolts slamming open rings out from the heavy metal door. The door swings open, and the faint sound of pumping music spills out into the abandoned rail station. A metal-walled hallway stands on the other side.
rows.translation: 硬光影像消失，片刻后，沉重金属门内传来巨型门闩轰然开启的声响。大门摆开，隐约的强劲音乐声流进废弃铁路车站。另一边是一条金属墙壁的走廊。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe hardlight image disappears, and a moment later, the sound of large bolts slamming open rings out from the heavy metal door. The door swings open, and the faint sound of pumping music spills out into the abandoned rail station. A metal-walled hallway stands on the other side."

rows.original: Also standing on the other side is the thraggen woman, the same size and shape as the projection showed her. She looks
rows.translation: 站在另一边的还有那名特拉根女子，体形与投影显示的完全相同。她
rows.raw: "\n\nAlso standing on the other side is the thraggen woman, the same size and shape as the projection showed her. She looks"

rows.original: up
rows.translation: 抬头
rows.raw: " up"

rows.original: down
rows.translation: 低头
rows.raw: " down"

rows.original: at you, clearly not impressed, one hand resting on the stun baton at her hip. The cannon on her shoulder still moves to aim wherever she’s looking.
rows.translation: 看向你，显然毫无兴趣，一只手搭在腰间的电击棍上。她肩上的炮依旧随着视线移动，瞄准她所注视的位置。
rows.raw: " at you, clearly not impressed, one hand resting on the stun baton at her hip. The cannon on her shoulder still moves to aim wherever she’s looking."

rows.original: “Got a name?” she asks. You tell her your first name, and she nods once. “Karrah,” she says. “Welcome to the Crash Landing.” She steps aside, putting her back to the wall, though her boobs jut out into the hallway. “Go,” she says, waving one hand down the hall, “play.”
rows.translation: “有名字吗？”她问。你告诉她自己的名字，她点了一下头。“卡拉，”她说。“欢迎来到‘迫降’。”她让到一旁，后背贴住墙面，但胸前的巨乳仍突进走廊里。“进去，”她一手挥向走廊深处，“玩吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Got a name?” she asks. You tell her your first name, and she nods once. “Karrah,” she says. “Welcome to the Crash Landing.” She steps aside, putting her back to the wall, though her boobs jut out into the hallway. “Go,” she says, waving one hand down the hall, “play.”"

rows.original: Enter
rows.translation: 进入
rows.raw: "Enter"

rows.original: That’s asking a lot. What kind of an underground bar slaps all kinds of rules on how you have to act while you’re there? No, you won’t agree to that.
rows.translation: 这要求未免太多了。哪家地下酒吧会给顾客的行为立下这么多规矩？ 不，你不会答应。
rows.raw: "That’s asking a lot. What kind of an underground bar slaps all kinds of rules on how you have to act while you’re there? No, you won’t agree to that."

rows.original: “Then fuck off,” the thraggen says. The hardlight projection disappears, leaving you alone on the platform.
rows.translation: “那就滚蛋，”特拉根说道。硬光投影随之消失，只剩你独自站在站台上。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then fuck off,” the thraggen says. The hardlight projection disappears, leaving you alone on the platform."

rows.original: With nothing else to do there, you head up and out.
rows.translation: 这里已经无事可做，你便上楼离开。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith nothing else to do there, you head up and out."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: UOND EPHINE.DHAAL.DHAAL L11
rows.raw: "UOND EPHINE.DHAAL.DHAAL L11"

rows.original: You approach the door to the Crash Landing, then stop as Karrah’s hardlight projection appears.
rows.translation: 你走向‘迫降’的大门，随后在卡拉的硬光投影出现时停下脚步。
rows.raw: "You approach the door to the Crash Landing, then stop as Karrah’s hardlight projection appears."

rows.original: “[pc.name],” the thraggen says. “You again.”
rows.translation: “[pc.name]，”特拉根说道。“又是你。”
rows.raw: "“[pc.name],” the thraggen says. “You again.”"

rows.original: Yes, it’s you again. How’s life down under the city?
rows.translation: 没错，又是你。城市地下的生活怎么样？
rows.raw: "Yes, it’s you again. How’s life down under the city?"

rows.original: Yes, it’s you again. Did she miss you?
rows.translation: 没错，又是你。她想你了吗？
rows.raw: "Yes, it’s you again. Did she miss you?"

rows.original: Yeah. And you’re here for a drink, not to talk, so she can open up.

rows.original: “Okay, I thought I’d end up dead somewhere by now,” Karrah says, and bares her teeth in a strained grin. “Piracy ain’t the kind of work you get to walk away from. Not supposed to be, anyway. But we did. Walked right away and into this place.” She thumps her fist against the metal wall. “Could be worse.”
rows.translation: “好吧，我以为自己早该死在某个地方了，”卡拉说道，勉强咧嘴露出牙齿。“干海盗可不是能活着脱身的工作。至少本来不该是。但我们做到了。直接脱身，走进了这个地方。”她用拳头敲了敲金属墙。“还能更糟。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, I thought I’d end up dead somewhere by now,” Karrah says, and bares her teeth in a strained grin. “Piracy ain’t the kind of work you get to walk away from. Not supposed to be, anyway. But we did. Walked right away and into this place.” She thumps her fist against the metal wall. “Could be worse.”"

rows.original: It doesn’t seem so bad. She’s still sort of doing the piracy thing, even if it’s just working out of sight of the corps. That’s got to count for something.
rows.translation: 这里似乎没那么差。她仍算是在做海盗的事，哪怕只是在公司看不见的地方经营。这多少也该算数。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt doesn’t seem so bad. She’s still sort of doing the piracy thing, even if it’s just working out of sight of the corps. That’s got to count for something."

rows.original: “Yeah, but I miss punching people,” she says, smacking one fist into her palm. “We get assholes in here who try to start fights, and I get to beat them up and throw them out. But that lasts, what, a few seconds? Most of the zaika aren’t built for a real fight. So most of the time, I’m just standing here. It’s not fun.”
rows.translation: “是啊，但我想念揍人的感觉，”她说着，一拳砸进掌心。“这里偶尔会有混蛋挑起斗殴，我就能揍他们一顿，再扔出去。但那能持续多久，几秒？ 大多数扎伊卡都不是打真架的料。所以大部分时间里，我只能站在这里。一点也不好玩。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, but I miss punching people,” she says, smacking one fist into her palm. “We get assholes in here who try to start fights, and I get to beat them up and throw them out. But that lasts, what, a few seconds? Most of the zaika aren’t built for a real fight. So most of the time, I’m just standing here. It’s not fun.”"

rows.original: Okay, so that’s the bad part about the bar. What about the good parts? There’s got to be something, or she would have left by now.
rows.translation: 好吧，这就是酒吧不好的地方。那好的一面呢？ 总该有点什么，否则她早就离开了。
rows.raw: "\n\nOkay, so that’s the bad part about the bar. What about the good parts? There’s got to be something, or she would have left by now."

rows.original: “I don’t walk away from the crew,” Karrah says, glaring at you. “We’re all that’s left and we stick together. And that’s the end of that.”
rows.translation: “我不会抛下船员，”卡拉瞪着你说道。“只剩我们这些人了，我们会团结在一起。就这样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t walk away from the crew,” Karrah says, glaring at you. “We’re all that’s left and we stick together. And that’s the end of that.”"

rows.original: Looks like you hit a nerve. Karrah clearly doesn’t want to talk about this any more. Maybe if you come back when she knows you better, she’ll open up some more.
rows.translation: 看来你触到了痛处。卡拉显然不想再谈这个。也许等她更了解你之后再来，她会多敞开一些心扉。
rows.raw: "Looks like you hit a nerve. Karrah clearly doesn’t want to talk about this any more. Maybe if you come back when she knows you better, she’ll open up some more."

rows.original: After a moment, Karrah looks away from you, and blows out a breath. “I thought it was going to be the end of us, getting stuck on this rock,” she says, and leans her head back against the wall. “Most of the crew bailed on us, said we were lucky to get the Void to stop looking for us.” She narrows her eyes. “Cowards.”
rows.translation: 片刻后，卡拉移开视线，吐出一口气。“困在这颗破石头上时，我以为我们就要完了，”她说着，把后脑靠在墙上。“大多数船员都抛下了我们，说我们能让黑色虚空停止追捕已经算走运。”她眯起眼睛。“胆小鬼。”
rows.raw: "After a moment, Karrah looks away from you, and blows out a breath. “I thought it was going to be the end of us, getting stuck on this rock,” she says, and leans her head back against the wall. “Most of the crew bailed on us, said we were lucky to get the Void to stop looking for us.” She narrows her eyes. “Cowards.”"

rows.original: So there must have been some serious trouble. Is that why she and the others are hiding down here?
rows.translation: 那肯定出过严重的麻烦。她们躲在这里也是这个原因吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo there must have been some serious trouble. Is that why she and the others are hiding down here?"

rows.original: “Nah,” Karrah says, and shakes her head once. “If the Void was still after us, they’d have had our asses by now. But when we learned how life is around here, Monika said we could do worse if it was our last port. We needed a place to call home, and this is what we found.”
rows.translation: “才不是，”卡拉摇了一下头，说道。“如果黑色虚空还在追我们，早就抓住我们的屁股了。但了解这里的生活后，莫妮卡说，如果这是我们的最后一个港口，也有可能找到更糟的。我们需要一个能称为家的地方，最后找到了这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nah,” Karrah says, and shakes her head once. “If the Void was still after us, they’d have had our asses by now. But when we learned how life is around here, Monika said we could do worse if it was our last port. We needed a place to call home, and this is what we found.”"

rows.original: And she and the others made it into a bar. Not a bad way to do things.
rows.translation: 于是她和其他人把这里改成了酒吧。这做法不坏。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd she and the others made it into a bar. Not a bad way to do things."

rows.original: “It was a pain in the ass at first.” Karrah gives you a look up and down, different from the ones she’s given you before. It looks more like she’s trying to see if she could count on you to do something for her. “You have any fucking idea what it’s like to carry a shitload of spaceship parts halfway through a city and down into a place like this?”
rows.translation: “刚开始真他妈麻烦。”卡拉上下打量你，这次的眼神和之前都不一样，更像是在判断能否指望你替她办事。“你他妈知道把一大堆飞船零件扛过半座城市，再搬进这种地方是什么滋味吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was a pain in the ass at first.” Karrah gives you a look up and down, different from the ones she’s given you before. It looks more like she’s trying to see if she could count on you to do something for her. “You have any fucking idea what it’s like to carry a shitload of spaceship parts halfway through a city and down into a place like this?”"

rows.original: No, you do not. But you’re not surprised that she did most of that heavy lifting. The place looks like it’s mostly made out of a spaceship, so that must have been a lot of work.
rows.translation: 不，你不知道。但大部分重活由她来做，你一点也不意外。这里看起来基本由飞船部件搭成，工作量肯定很大。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo, you do not. But you’re not surprised that she did most of that heavy lifting. The place looks like it’s mostly made out of a spaceship, so that must have been a lot of work."

rows.original: “Took fucking forever,” Karrah mutters. “Okay, maybe it was only a few days. Takes a lot for me to get worn out, but that did it.” She pauses, and runs a hand down one of the metal-plated walls. “But you know what? It was worth it.”
rows.translation: “他妈像是干了永远那么久，”卡拉嘟囔道。“好吧，或许只有几天。一般的活很难把我累垮，但这次做到了。”她停顿了一下，用手抚过一面覆有金属板的墙。“不过你知道吗？ 值得。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Took fucking forever,” Karrah mutters. “Okay, maybe it was only a few days. Takes a lot for me to get worn out, but that did it.” She pauses, and runs a hand down one of the metal-plated walls. “But you know what? It was worth it.”"

rows.original: How so?
rows.translation: 怎么说？
rows.raw: "\n\nHow so?"

rows.original: “This place is ours,” Karrah says. “Living on a ship, you know somebody can always take it from you. We took over a few ships when we were doing our thing, mostly small ones with maybe ten or twelve in the crew.” She grins, her tusks jutting out. “The look of raw fucking terror some of those people got when we charged through their airlock? Never got old. I miss that.”
rows.translation: “这个地方属于我们，”卡拉说道。“住在船上，你知道总会有人能把它抢走。以前干活时，我们夺过几艘船，大多是只有十到十二名船员的小船。”她咧嘴一笑，獠牙向外突起。“我们冲过气闸时，有些人脸上那股原始的他妈的恐惧？ 永远看不腻。我很怀念。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This place is ours,” Karrah says. “Living on a ship, you know somebody can always take it from you. We took over a few ships when we were doing our thing, mostly small ones with maybe ten or twelve in the crew.” She grins, her tusks jutting out. “The look of raw fucking terror some of those people got when we charged through their airlock? Never got old. I miss that.”"

rows.original: Her grin disappears as quickly as it came. “But we always knew we could get boarded and shut down just as easy. This place? Not gonna happen. Nobody can take this away from us.”
rows.translation: 她的笑容来得快，消失得也快。“但我们一直知道，自己同样可能轻易遭人登船，被彻底击垮。这里？ 不可能。没人能从我们手里夺走这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer grin disappears as quickly as it came. “But we always knew we could get boarded and shut down just as easy. This place? Not gonna happen. Nobody can take this away from us.”"

rows.original: How can she be so sure of that? The city’s mostly run by the corporations, and they wouldn’t like the competition with their milk bars.
rows.translation: 她怎么能如此肯定？ 这座城市大部分由公司掌控，而那些公司不会喜欢自家乳吧面临竞争。
rows.raw: "\n\nHow can she be so sure of that? The city’s mostly run by the corporations, and they wouldn’t like the competition with their milk bars."

rows.original: Karrah only gives you another smug grin. “Don’t think I’m gonna tell you all our secrets. Nice try, though.”
rows.translation: 卡拉只是又得意地咧嘴一笑。“别以为我会把所有秘密都告诉你。不过尝试得不错。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah only gives you another smug grin. “Don’t think I’m gonna tell you all our secrets. Nice try, though.”"

rows.original: It’s hard to tell if she’s joking or not, but it’s clear she’s not going to tell you any more. Maybe if you ask about this when they know you better at the bar, she’ll be willing to go into more detail.
rows.translation: 很难说她是不是在开玩笑，但她显然不会再透露了。也许等酒吧里的人更了解你之后再问，她会愿意讲得更详细。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s hard to tell if she’s joking or not, but it’s clear she’s not going to tell you any more. Maybe if you ask about this when they know you better at the bar, she’ll be willing to go into more detail."
