rows.translation: 她怎么能如此肯定？ 这座城市大部分由公司掌控，而那些公司不会喜欢自家乳吧面临竞争。
rows.raw: "\n\nHow can she be so sure of that? The city’s mostly run by the corporations, and they wouldn’t like the competition with their milk bars."

rows.original: Karrah squints and looks closely at you, then seems to make a decision. “You remember when you first came here, I scanned your face?” You nod, and she continues. “We know people who know people. Kiki did her geek-talk thing with someone on the inside, got us access to the corps’ data about who’s who. Nothing but names and faces, she says, but that’s all we need to make sure they don’t get in.”
rows.translation: 卡拉眯起眼仔细打量你，随后似乎下定决心。“还记得你第一次来时，我扫描过你的脸吗？”你点点头，她继续道。“我们认识些人，那些人又认识另一些人。琪琪对内部人士讲了通她那套技术宅黑话，替我们弄到了公司记录的人员资料。她说里面只有名字和面孔，不过这足够确保他们进不来了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah squints and looks closely at you, then seems to make a decision. “You remember when you first came here, I scanned your face?” You nod, and she continues. “We know people who know people. Kiki did her geek-talk thing with someone on the inside, got us access to the corps’ data about who’s who. Nothing but names and faces, she says, but that’s all we need to make sure they don’t get in.”"

rows.original: That’s pretty impressive, and you can see how that keeps people out of here if she doesn’t want them in. But modding’s cheap enough, so that’s not going to keep everyone from the corps out all the time.
rows.translation: 这相当厉害，你也明白，只要她不想让某人进来，这套方法就能把人挡在外面。不过改造费用相当低廉，所以不可能始终把公司的每个人都挡住。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s pretty impressive, and you can see how that keeps people out of here if she doesn’t want them in. But modding’s cheap enough, so that’s not going to keep everyone from the corps out all the time."

rows.original: Karrah grunts. “Yeah, it’s not perfect. But we don’t need perfect, we just need good. I told a few spies to fuck off in our first month down here. Don’t know if they’re still trying to get people in or if they figured we’re not worth their time.” She pats the gun at her hip, and the cannon on her shoulder. “But we’re ready if they try to pull some shit.”
rows.translation: 卡拉哼了一声。“对，不完美。但我们不需要完美，只需要够好。来这里的第一个月，我叫几个间谍滚了出去。不知道他们还在设法安插人手，还是觉得我们不值得浪费时间。”她拍了拍腰间的枪和肩上的火炮。“不过他们敢耍花招，我们就准备好了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah grunts. “Yeah, it’s not perfect. But we don’t need perfect, we just need good. I told a few spies to fuck off in our first month down here. Don’t know if they’re still trying to get people in or if they figured we’re not worth their time.” She pats the gun at her hip, and the cannon on her shoulder. “But we’re ready if they try to pull some shit.”"

rows.original: She seems to really like the idea of keeping the corps out of here. You guess she’s not a fan of them at all.
rows.translation: 她似乎非常喜欢把公司拒之门外。看来她一点也不喜欢它们。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems to really like the idea of keeping the corps out of here. You guess she’s not a fan of them at all."

rows.original: “Fuck every single one of them and anyone who works for them,” Karrah spits. “They act like they’re the law, and on this rock, they are. Most everyone here’s already been bought, or they’re fighting for whatever scraps they can get.” She snorts. “Shit like that’s why I liked being a pirate.”
rows.translation: “去他妈每一家公司，还有每一个替它们干活的混蛋，”卡拉啐道。“它们表现得仿佛自己就是法律，而在这颗破石头上，它们确实是。这里的大多数人早就被收买了，剩下的人则在争抢一切能拿到的残羹剩饭。”她嗤了一声。“这种破事正是我喜欢当海盗的原因。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck every single one of them and anyone who works for them,” Karrah spits. “They act like they’re the law, and on this rock, they are. Most everyone here’s already been bought, or they’re fighting for whatever scraps they can get.” She snorts. “Shit like that’s why I liked being a pirate.”"

rows.original: So even if this isn’t the same as actually being out in space, running the bar here is just another kind of piracy. Even if it means she’s stuck guarding the door.
rows.translation: 所以，即使这和真正在太空中不同，在这里经营酒吧也只是另一种海盗行为。哪怕这意味着她只能守着大门。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo even if this isn’t the same as actually being out in space, running the bar here is just another kind of piracy. Even if it means she’s stuck guarding the door."

rows.original: “Yeah....” Karrah leans back against the wall and taps her head against it, flattening the back of her mohawk against her scalp. “I try to think of it like that, but it’s hard when I just want to punch somebody again.” She looks back to you and grins. “But you’re right. Every day we’re here, every smuggled shipment that makes it to us, every zaika that gets high on Josie’s milk instead of some drugged-up tit-slave’s? It’s all a big ‘fuck you’ to the corps. We’re giving people what they want and those assholes aren’t getting a single credit.”
rows.translation: “是啊....”卡拉靠回墙上，用脑袋轻轻敲墙，把莫西干头的后半部分压平在头皮上。“我努力这么想，但当我只想再揍个人时，这很难。”她回头看向你，咧嘴一笑。“不过你说得对。我们待在这里的每一天，每一批成功运到的走私货，每一个喝乔茜的奶而不是某个被下药的乳奴之奶上瘾的扎伊卡？ 这一切都是对公司竖起的一根巨大中指。我们把人们想要的东西给他们，而那些混蛋拿不到一个信用点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah....” Karrah leans back against the wall and taps her head against it, flattening the back of her mohawk against her scalp. “I try to think of it like that, but it’s hard when I just want to punch somebody again.” She looks back to you and grins. “But you’re right. Every day we’re here, every smuggled shipment that makes it to us, every zaika that gets high on Josie’s milk instead of some drugged-up tit-slave’s? It’s all a big ‘fuck you’ to the corps. We’re giving people what they want and those assholes aren’t getting a single credit.”"

rows.original: Karrah chuckles, baring her tusks. “It’s not gonna replace punching down someone’s airlock door and stealing all their shit, but it’s something.”
rows.translation: 卡拉露出獠牙，咯咯笑道。“这无法取代打穿别人的气闸门、抢走他们全部破烂的感觉，但总算有点意思。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah chuckles, baring her tusks. “It’s not gonna replace punching down someone’s airlock door and stealing all their shit, but it’s something.”"

rows.original: Sounds like she’s feeling better about it. How long does she think they’ll stay down here, running the bar?
rows.translation: 听起来她感觉好多了。她觉得她们会在这里经营酒吧多久？
rows.raw: "\n\nSounds like she’s feeling better about it. How long does she think they’ll stay down here, running the bar?"

rows.original: “[flags.MASTODON_END|Until the ship’s done.|Who knows?]” Karrah shrugs, the cannon on her shoulder still following her gaze even as it moves. “I let Monika worry about that shit. I make sure we let the right people in and everybody else can fuck off. And if [flags.MASTODON_END|I can keep us safe until we’re ready to leave this rock|that’s all I gotta do for now], then that’s okay.”
rows.translation: “[flags.MASTODON_END|直到飞船修好。|谁知道呢？]”卡拉耸耸肩，即便肩膀随之移动，肩炮依旧跟着她的视线。“我让莫妮卡操心那种破事。我负责确保放对的人进来，其他人都可以滚蛋。而且，只要[flags.MASTODON_END|我能保护大家，直到准备好离开这颗破石头|目前我只需要做好这些]，那就行。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[flags.MASTODON_END|Until the ship’s done.|Who knows?]” Karrah shrugs, the cannon on her shoulder still following her gaze even as it moves. “I let Monika worry about that shit. I make sure we let the right people in and everybody else can fuck off. And if [flags.MASTODON_END|I can keep us safe until we’re ready to leave this rock|that’s all I gotta do for now], then that’s okay.”"

rows.original: You ask Karrah to tell you about herself. Sure, she ended up as a space pirate before coming here, but what about her life before that?
rows.translation: 你请卡拉讲讲自己。没错，她来到这里前成了太空海盗，但在那之前的生活呢？
rows.raw: "You ask Karrah to tell you about herself. Sure, she ended up as a space pirate before coming here, but what about her life before that?"

rows.original: “You want to know?” She gives you a surprised look, though it quickly turns to a frown. “Most people think they’ve met every thraggen if they’ve met one of us.”
rows.translation: “你想知道？”她惊讶地看着你，不过很快皱起眉头。“大多数人只见过一个特拉根，就以为自己见过了所有特拉根。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You want to know?” She gives you a surprised look, though it quickly turns to a frown. “Most people think they’ve met every thraggen if they’ve met one of us.”"

rows.original: You’ve met too many people in your travels to think that’s true. Not many thraggen, though that might be because of the UGC blockade on their homeworld.
rows.translation: 旅途中你遇见过太多人，不会相信这种说法。不过特拉根确实不多见，或许是因为银河联合邦联封锁了她们的母星。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve met too many people in your travels to think that’s true. Not many thraggen, though that might be because of the UGC blockade on their homeworld."

rows.original: “Don’t fucking get me started about that,” Karrah says, and gives a bitter chuckle. “Like I said, most people think we’re only good at two things, fighting and fucking. Sometimes at the same time. And they’re not wrong. I’m really good at those.”
rows.translation: “别他妈让我说起这事，”卡拉说着，苦涩地笑了一声。“就像我说的，大多数人觉得我们只擅长两件事，打架和性交。有时同时来。而且他们没说错。这两样我确实很拿手。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t fucking get me started about that,” Karrah says, and gives a bitter chuckle. “Like I said, most people think we’re only good at two things, fighting and fucking. Sometimes at the same time. And they’re not wrong. I’m really good at those.”"

rows.original: She leers at you. “But you know that, don’t you.”
rows.translation: 她色眯眯地看着你。“但你知道，对吧。”
rows.raw: " She leers at you. “But you know that, don’t you.”"

rows.original: She runs a hand over her mohawk, and leans back against the wall. “But that’s why the only damn work I could ever find was merc stuff. Pretty much anything that meant grabbing a gun or a blade or whatever and killing anything in my way, that’s all anyone wanted to hire me for. Fuck, I was born on a merc ship, part of some rough-neck group out on the rim. So for a long time, I thought that’s all there was.”
rows.translation: 她用手摸过莫西干头，靠回墙上。“但正因如此，我能找到的该死工作只有雇佣兵。基本上只要意味着拿起枪、刀或其他东西，再杀光挡路者，那就是所有人愿意雇我做的事。妈的，我出生在一艘佣兵船上，属于边缘地区某个粗野的团体。所以很长一段时间里，我以为人生只有这些。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe runs a hand over her mohawk, and leans back against the wall. “But that’s why the only damn work I could ever find was merc stuff. Pretty much anything that meant grabbing a gun or a blade or whatever and killing anything in my way, that’s all anyone wanted to hire me for. Fuck, I was born on a merc ship, part of some rough-neck group out on the rim. So for a long time, I thought that’s all there was.”"

rows.original: So you take it she’s never been to the thraggen home worlds. Then again, it’s not like anyone’s allowed to get there these days.
rows.translation: 所以她从没去过特拉根的母星。话又说回来，如今本来也没人获准前往。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo you take it she’s never been to the thraggen home worlds. Then again, it’s not like anyone’s allowed to get there these days."

rows.original: “And that’s fucking wrong,” she snarls. Karrah looks away with a snort, and for a moment, it seems like she’s done talking. “Fucking UGC. Keep us from the rest of the galaxy just because we’re good at fighting, then act like that’s all we’re allowed to do.” She huffs out a breath, and looks back to you. “Where was I?”
rows.translation: “这他妈就是错的，”她咆哮道。卡拉嗤了一声，把脸转开；有那么一瞬间，她像是已经说完了。“该死的银河联合邦联。就因为我们擅长战斗，便把我们和银河其他地方隔开，然后又表现得仿佛我们只准做这一件事。”她呼出一口气，重新看向你。“我说到哪了？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And that’s fucking wrong,” she snarls. Karrah looks away with a snort, and for a moment, it seems like she’s done talking. “Fucking UGC. Keep us from the rest of the galaxy just because we’re good at fighting, then act like that’s all we’re allowed to do.” She huffs out a breath, and looks back to you. “Where was I?”"

rows.original: Something about being born on a mercenary ship. Did she start work as a merc with that crew, or was that just where she learned the trade?
rows.translation: 说到在佣兵船上出生。她是和那群船员一起开始做佣兵的，还是只在那里学会这一行？
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething about being born on a mercenary ship. Did she start work as a merc with that crew, or was that just where she learned the trade?"

rows.original: “Both,” Karrah says. “The crew made me part of them soon as I could walk and talk. I went from being the mascot to the ammo-carrier to a private as I grew up.” She looks to the bar’s massive steel door, but her gaze is elsewhere. “I remember when I got my first gun. It’d be a tiny pistol now, but when I was six, that was a fucking beautiful piece. This old ausar with one eye and his ears shot full of holes, he taught me how to use it. Everybody called him Gramps. He was good to the crew, but rough as all fuck, a real survivor. You don’t get old as a merc if you don’t know your shit.”
rows.translation: “都有，”卡拉说道。“我一能走路说话，船员就让我成为他们的一员。随着长大，我从吉祥物变成弹药搬运工，再成为列兵。”她望向酒吧巨大的钢门，思绪却飘在别处。“我还记得拿到第一把枪的时候。如今看会是把小手枪，但对六岁的我而言，那是件他妈漂亮的宝贝。一个独眼、两只耳朵都被子弹打穿的老奥萨教我怎么用。所有人都叫他爷爷。他对船员很好，但也他妈严格，是个真正的生存专家。当佣兵的人要是不懂行，可活不到老年。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Both,” Karrah says. “The crew made me part of them soon as I could walk and talk. I went from being the mascot to the ammo-carrier to a private as I grew up.” She looks to the bar’s massive steel door, but her gaze is elsewhere. “I remember when I got my first gun. It’d be a tiny pistol now, but when I was six, that was a fucking beautiful piece. This old ausar with one eye and his ears shot full of holes, he taught me how to use it. Everybody called him Gramps. He was good to the crew, but rough as all fuck, a real survivor. You don’t get old as a merc if you don’t know your shit.”"

rows.original: It sounds like a hell of a life for her. What happened to that crew?
rows.translation: 对她而言，这生活可真够疯狂。那群船员后来怎么了？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt sounds like a hell of a life for her. What happened to that crew?"

rows.original: “Bad jobs,” Karrah says, turning back to you with a scowl. “The company got bought by some corporate shitheads, I don’t remember the name. But they sent us on suicide missions. We came back with a smaller crew every time. Then someone heard they only picked us up as a tax writeoff, and it all kind of went to shit from there.”
rows.translation: “接了烂差事，”卡拉皱着眉转向你，说道。“公司被某些企业混蛋买下了，我不记得名字。但他们让我们执行自杀任务。每次回来，船员都会少一些。后来有人听说，他们收购我们只是为了税务核销，接着一切就彻底崩了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bad jobs,” Karrah says, turning back to you with a scowl. “The company got bought by some corporate shitheads, I don’t remember the name. But they sent us on suicide missions. We came back with a smaller crew every time. Then someone heard they only picked us up as a tax writeoff, and it all kind of went to shit from there.”"

rows.original: Karrah sneers. “Half the crew bailed. The other half stormed the corp’s offices. Seemed like a waste to me, so I didn’t go. I was right. They didn’t come back. And that was the end of the company.”
rows.translation: 卡拉冷笑道。“一半船员离开了。另一半冲进那家公司的办公室。我觉得这是浪费，所以没去。我是对的。他们没回来。公司就此完蛋。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah sneers. “Half the crew bailed. The other half stormed the corp’s offices. Seemed like a waste to me, so I didn’t go. I was right. They didn’t come back. And that was the end of the company.”"

rows.original: Did she become a pirate after that?
rows.translation: 她之后就成了海盗吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nDid she become a pirate after that?"

rows.original: “Doesn’t matter,” Karrah says all at once. She looks away. “I don’t know why you made me bring up this old shit. I’m done.”
rows.translation: “不重要，”卡拉突然说道。她移开视线。“我不知道你为什么让我提起这些陈年破事。我不说了。”
rows.raw: "“Doesn’t matter,” Karrah says all at once. She looks away. “I don’t know why you made me bring up this old shit. I’m done.”"

rows.original: It’s clear she doesn’t want to talk about this anymore. Maybe if you come back when she knows you better and ask again, she’ll feel like opening up some more.
rows.translation: 她显然不想再谈。也许等她更了解你之后再回来询问，她会愿意多敞开一些心扉。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s clear she doesn’t want to talk about this anymore. Maybe if you come back when she knows you better and ask again, she’ll feel like opening up some more."

rows.original: She gives you a look like she’s not sure if she wants to keep talking, then sighs, and nods. “Pretty soon after that, yeah,” she says. “The old crew’s last port was this ragged-as-fuck junkheap spaceport. The place looked like it was made out of a bunch of asteroids bolted together. But the last of us were toasting the ones who’d gone to fight, and nobody really knew what to do next.”
rows.translation: 她用一副不确定是否想继续说下去的神情看着你，随后叹息一声，点了点头。“对，差不多就在那之后，”她说。“旧船员最后停靠的是一座他妈破烂的垃圾堆太空港。那地方看起来就像用一堆小行星铆在一起。不过剩下的人都在举杯纪念那些前去战斗的人，而且没人真知道接下来该做什么。”
rows.raw: "She gives you a look like she’s not sure if she wants to keep talking, then sighs, and nods. “Pretty soon after that, yeah,” she says. “The old crew’s last port was this ragged-as-fuck junkheap spaceport. The place looked like it was made out of a bunch of asteroids bolted together. But the last of us were toasting the ones who’d gone to fight, and nobody really knew what to do next.”"

rows.original: Sounds about right for the end of a mercenary crew. One last drink before everyone goes their separate ways.
rows.translation: 这倒很像佣兵团的结局。在所有人分道扬镳前喝完最后一杯。
rows.raw: "\n\nSounds about right for the end of a mercenary crew. One last drink before everyone goes their separate ways."

rows.original: “It was supposed to be like that, but it was mostly us bitching about how badly we got fucked over,” Karrah says. “We were the corp’s suicide squad, and they sent us on shit missions that nobody else could do. Didn’t even give us bonuses for getting them done and coming back alive. So getting kicked in the cunt like that and then learning you’re supposed to be some rich asshole’s writeoff?” She smacks one fist into her open palm. “Makes you want to fuck someone up.”
rows.translation: “本来应该是那样，但我们主要都在抱怨自己被坑得多惨，”卡拉说道。“我们是公司的自杀小队，他们把其他人都做不了的狗屎任务扔给我们。完成任务活着回来，连奖金都不给。所以，被人朝阴户狠狠踹了一脚，然后又发现自己本该只是某个有钱混蛋的核销项目？”她一拳砸进摊开的掌心。“这会让你想狠狠干倒某个人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was supposed to be like that, but it was mostly us bitching about how badly we got fucked over,” Karrah says. “We were the corp’s suicide squad, and they sent us on shit missions that nobody else could do. Didn’t even give us bonuses for getting them done and coming back alive. So getting kicked in the cunt like that and then learning you’re supposed to be some rich asshole’s writeoff?” She smacks one fist into her open palm. “Makes you want to fuck someone up.”"

rows.original: A junky bar in the middle of space sounds like a good place to find a fight, though. Especially if she still had the rest of the crew with her.
rows.translation: 太空中央的一家垃圾酒吧听起来很容易找到架打。尤其是当她身边还有其余船员时。
rows.raw: "\n\nA junky bar in the middle of space sounds like a good place to find a fight, though. Especially if she still had the rest of the crew with her."

rows.original: “I fucking wish.” Karrah rolls her eyes. “They didn’t want to fight anymore. Just wanted to wallow in how much everything sucked. I was the only one actually talking about everything, and I know I sounded like I was looking to break shit. And then, Redd found me.”
rows.translation: “我他妈倒希望是。”卡拉翻了个白眼。“他们不想再打了。只想沉浸在一切都糟透了的情绪里。只有我真正在谈这些事，而且我知道自己听起来像是想砸东西。然后，雷德找到了我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I fucking wish.” Karrah rolls her eyes. “They didn’t want to fight anymore. Just wanted to wallow in how much everything sucked. I was the only one actually talking about everything, and I know I sounded like I was looking to break shit. And then, Redd found me.”"

rows.original: A genuine smile crosses the thraggen woman’s face, looking out of place there. “She was the first rahn I ever met, and she bought me a drink. When I went to her table, it was her and three other girls, and she said they were putting a crew together. It looked like I was the only one in the whole damn pack of ex-mercs who still had some fight in her, so they asked if I wanted to join up.”
rows.translation: 特拉根女子脸上浮现出真诚的笑容，与平常显得格格不入。“她是我见过的第一个拉恩，还请我喝了一杯。我走到她桌边时，那里有她和另外三个姑娘；她说她们正在组建一支船员队伍。整群前佣兵里，似乎只有我还留着些斗志，所以她们问我想不想加入。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA genuine smile crosses the thraggen woman’s face, looking out of place there. “She was the first rahn I ever met, and she bought me a drink. When I went to her table, it was her and three other girls, and she said they were putting a crew together. It looked like I was the only one in the whole damn pack of ex-mercs who still had some fight in her, so they asked if I wanted to join up.”"

rows.original: And that’s how she joined the crew, you guess. Sounds about right. There are probably a lot of successful pirate crews that got started around drinks at some spacer bar.
rows.translation: 你猜，她就是这样加入船员的。听起来很合理。大概有许多成功的海盗团，都是从太空酒吧的几杯酒开始。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd that’s how she joined the crew, you guess. Sounds about right. There are probably a lot of successful pirate crews that got started around drinks at some spacer bar."

rows.original: “It was a shitload better than anything else I was looking at,” Karrah says, and her laugh sounds kind of forced. “It’s still a hell of a thing. I had no idea what I was going to do, and then this curvy red thing made out of I didn’t even know what sends me a drink and says she wants me on her crew.”
rows.translation: “这他妈比我面对的其他选择好太多了，”卡拉说道，笑声听起来有些勉强。“这事直到现在都挺离奇。我根本不知道接下来该做什么，然后这个由某种我完全不认识的东西构成、曲线玲珑的红色女人给我送来一杯酒，说想让我加入她的船员。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was a shitload better than anything else I was looking at,” Karrah says, and her laugh sounds kind of forced. “It’s still a hell of a thing. I had no idea what I was going to do, and then this curvy red thing made out of I didn’t even know what sends me a drink and says she wants me on her crew.”"

rows.original: But she said yes.
rows.translation: 但她答应了。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut she said yes."

rows.original: “Of fucking course I said yes,” Karrah says, then rolls her eyes at you. “Do people still think big and strong means stupid on whatever planet you’re from? Give me a fucking break.” She grins. “But I’d been a merc since my mom squeezed me out. Everywhere we went, we did it on someone else’s word, and all the jobs came from someone who could pay for us. Running my own life with a pirate crew seemed... different, but after what happened with those corporate shitheads, I couldn’t say no.”
rows.translation: “我他妈当然答应了，”卡拉说着，朝你翻了个白眼。“你来自的那颗行星上，人们仍然觉得又大又壮就等于愚蠢吗？ 饶了我吧。”她咧嘴一笑。“但我从母亲把我挤出来起就是佣兵。我们无论去哪里，都听别人的命令，所有工作都来自付得起我们佣金的人。和海盗团一起掌控自己的人生似乎... 很不一样，但在那些企业混蛋做出那种事后，我无法拒绝。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of fucking course I said yes,” Karrah says, then rolls her eyes at you. “Do people still think big and strong means stupid on whatever planet you’re from? Give me a fucking break.” She grins. “But I’d been a merc since my mom squeezed me out. Everywhere we went, we did it on someone else’s word, and all the jobs came from someone who could pay for us. Running my own life with a pirate crew seemed... different, but after what happened with those corporate shitheads, I couldn’t say no.”"

rows.original: Karrah’s grin grows larger. “Especially when they told me what our first job was.”
rows.translation: 卡拉的笑容更加灿烂。“尤其是她们告诉我第一份工作是什么的时候。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah’s grin grows larger. “Especially when they told me what our first job was.”"

rows.original: And what was that?
rows.translation: 那是什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd what was that?"

rows.original: She laughs. “That’s one of the best stories. I’ll tell you later.”
rows.translation: 她大笑起来。“那是最精彩的故事之一。我以后再告诉你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe laughs. “That’s one of the best stories. I’ll tell you later.”"

rows.original: Looks like that’s all you’re going to get out of her for now. Maybe if you come back when the know you better around here, she’ll tell you the rest of the story.
rows.translation: 看来目前只能从她口中听到这些。也许等这里的人更了解你之后再来，她会把故事剩下的部分告诉你。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooks like that’s all you’re going to get out of her for now. Maybe if you come back when the know you better around here, she’ll tell you the rest of the story."

rows.original: She gives you a look like she’s not sure if she wants to keep talking, then sighs, and nods. “Pretty soon after that, yeah,” she says. “The old crew’s last port was this ragged-as-fuck junkheap spaceport. The place looked like it was made out of a bunch of asteroids bolted together. But the last of us were toasting the ones who’d gone to fight, and nobody really knew what to do next.”
rows.translation: 她用一副不确定是否想继续说下去的神情看着你，随后叹息一声，点了点头。“对，差不多就在那之后，”她说。“旧船员最后停靠的是一座他妈破烂的垃圾堆太空港。那地方看起来就像用一堆小行星铆在一起。不过剩下的人都在举杯纪念那些前去战斗的人，而且没人真知道接下来该做什么。”
rows.raw: "She gives you a look like she’s not sure if she wants to keep talking, then sighs, and nods. “Pretty soon after that, yeah,” she says. “The old crew’s last port was this ragged-as-fuck junkheap spaceport. The place looked like it was made out of a bunch of asteroids bolted together. But the last of us were toasting the ones who’d gone to fight, and nobody really knew what to do next.”"

rows.original: Sounds about right for the end of a mercenary crew. One last drink before everyone goes their separate ways.
rows.translation: 这倒很像佣兵团的结局。在所有人分道扬镳前喝完最后一杯。
rows.raw: "\n\nSounds about right for the end of a mercenary crew. One last drink before everyone goes their separate ways."

rows.original: “It was supposed to be like that, but it was mostly us bitching about how badly we got fucked over,” Karrah says. “We were the corp’s suicide squad, and they sent us on shit missions that nobody else could do. Didn’t even give us bonuses for getting them done and coming back alive. So getting kicked in the cunt like that and then learning you’re supposed to be some rich asshole’s writeoff?” She smacks one fist into her open palm. “Makes you want to fuck someone up.”
rows.translation: “本来应该是那样，但我们主要都在抱怨自己被坑得多惨，”卡拉说道。“我们是公司的自杀小队，他们把其他人都做不了的狗屎任务扔给我们。完成任务活着回来，连奖金都不给。所以，被人朝阴户狠狠踹了一脚，然后又发现自己本该只是某个有钱混蛋的核销项目？”她一拳砸进摊开的掌心。“这会让你想狠狠干倒某个人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was supposed to be like that, but it was mostly us bitching about how badly we got fucked over,” Karrah says. “We were the corp’s suicide squad, and they sent us on shit missions that nobody else could do. Didn’t even give us bonuses for getting them done and coming back alive. So getting kicked in the cunt like that and then learning you’re supposed to be some rich asshole’s writeoff?” She smacks one fist into her open palm. “Makes you want to fuck someone up.”"

rows.original: A junky bar in the middle of space sounds like a good place to find a fight, though. Especially if she still had the rest of the crew with her.
rows.translation: 太空中央的一家垃圾酒吧听起来很容易找到架打。尤其是当她身边还有其余船员时。
rows.raw: "\n\nA junky bar in the middle of space sounds like a good place to find a fight, though. Especially if she still had the rest of the crew with her."

rows.original: “I fucking wish.” Karrah rolls her eyes. “They didn’t want to fight anymore. Just wanted to wallow in how much everything sucked. I was the only one actually talking about everything, and I know I sounded like I was looking to break shit. And then, Redd found me.”
rows.translation: “我他妈倒希望是。”卡拉翻了个白眼。“他们不想再打了。只想沉浸在一切都糟透了的情绪里。只有我真正在谈这些事，而且我知道自己听起来像是想砸东西。然后，雷德找到了我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I fucking wish.” Karrah rolls her eyes. “They didn’t want to fight anymore. Just wanted to wallow in how much everything sucked. I was the only one actually talking about everything, and I know I sounded like I was looking to break shit. And then, Redd found me.”"

rows.original: A genuine smile crosses the thraggen woman’s face, looking out of place there. “She was the first rahn I ever met, and she bought me a drink. When I went to her table, it was her and three other girls, and she said they were putting a crew together. It looked like I was the only one in the whole damn pack of ex-mercs who still had some fight in her, so they asked if I wanted to join up.”
rows.translation: 特拉根女子脸上浮现出真诚的笑容，与平常显得格格不入。“她是我见过的第一个拉恩，还请我喝了一杯。我走到她桌边时，那里有她和另外三个姑娘；她说她们正在组建一支船员队伍。整群前佣兵里，似乎只有我还留着些斗志，所以她们问我想不想加入。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA genuine smile crosses the thraggen woman’s face, looking out of place there. “She was the first rahn I ever met, and she bought me a drink. When I went to her table, it was her and three other girls, and she said they were putting a crew together. It looked like I was the only one in the whole damn pack of ex-mercs who still had some fight in her, so they asked if I wanted to join up.”"

rows.original: And that’s how she joined the crew, you guess. Sounds about right. There are probably a lot of successful pirate crews that got started around drinks at some spacer bar.
rows.translation: 你猜，她就是这样加入船员的。听起来很合理。大概有许多成功的海盗团，都是从太空酒吧的几杯酒开始。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd that’s how she joined the crew, you guess. Sounds about right. There are probably a lot of successful pirate crews that got started around drinks at some spacer bar."

rows.original: “It was a shitload better than anything else I was looking at,” Karrah says, and her laugh sounds kind of forced. “It’s still a hell of a thing. I had no idea what I was going to do, and then this curvy red thing made out of I didn’t even know what sends me a drink and says she wants me on her crew.”
rows.translation: “比我当时看到的其他选择好他妈太多了，”卡拉说道，笑声听起来有些勉强。“但这仍然是件不得了的事。我当时根本不知道该怎么办，然后这个由某种我都认不出来的东西构成、身材曲线玲珑的红色家伙请了我一杯，还说想让我加入她的船员队伍。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was a shitload better than anything else I was looking at,” Karrah says, and her laugh sounds kind of forced. “It’s still a hell of a thing. I had no idea what I was going to do, and then this curvy red thing made out of I didn’t even know what sends me a drink and says she wants me on her crew.”"

rows.original: But she said yes.
rows.translation: 不过她答应了。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut she said yes."

rows.original: “Of fucking course I said yes,” Karrah says, then rolls her eyes at you. “Do people still think big and strong means stupid on whatever planet you’re from? Give me a fucking break.” She grins. “But I’d been a merc since my mom squeezed me out. Everywhere we went, we did it on someone else’s word, and all the jobs came from someone who could pay for us. Running my own life with a pirate crew seemed... different, but after what happened with those corporate shitheads, I couldn’t say no.”
rows.translation: “我他妈当然答应了，”卡拉说着，对你翻了个白眼。“你来的那颗星球上，人们还觉得高大强壮就等于愚蠢吗？饶了我吧。”她咧嘴一笑。“但我从老妈把我挤出来起就是个佣兵。无论我们去哪儿，都是听别人的话，所有活儿都来自付得起钱的人。跟着一群海盗掌控自己的人生似乎...不太一样，可经历过那帮公司混蛋的破事之后，我没法拒绝。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Of fucking course I said yes,” Karrah says, then rolls her eyes at you. “Do people still think big and strong means stupid on whatever planet you’re from? Give me a fucking break.” She grins. “But I’d been a merc since my mom squeezed me out. Everywhere we went, we did it on someone else’s word, and all the jobs came from someone who could pay for us. Running my own life with a pirate crew seemed... different, but after what happened with those corporate shitheads, I couldn’t say no.”"

rows.original: Karrah’s grin grows larger. “Especially when they told me what our first job was.”
rows.translation: 卡拉笑得更开了。“尤其是他们告诉我第一票要干什么的时候。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah’s grin grows larger. “Especially when they told me what our first job was.”"

rows.original: And what was that?
rows.translation: 那是要干什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd what was that?"

rows.original: “A crew needs a ship,” Karrah says, and pounds her fist into her palm again. “They were at that rock of a space station to steal one. All they needed was some muscle, and now they had me.”
rows.translation: “船员得有艘船，”卡拉说着，又一拳砸进掌心。“他们去那座破石头似的空间站就是为了偷一艘。他们只缺点武力，而现在他们有我了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A crew needs a ship,” Karrah says, and pounds her fist into her palm again. “They were at that rock of a space station to steal one. All they needed was some muscle, and now they had me.”"

rows.original: So the crew’s first mission together was to steal their spaceship. With everything you’ve seen of the people here, that’s no surprise at all.
rows.translation: 所以这群船员共同执行的第一个任务，就是偷来他们自己的飞船。看过这里这些人的种种表现后，你对此一点也不意外。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo the crew’s first mission together was to steal their spaceship. With everything you’ve seen of the people here, that’s no surprise at all."

rows.original: “What, you think a bunch of pirates are going to buy one? How the fuck would they call themselves pirates if they did that?” She shakes her head, but she’s still grinning. It’s clear this is one of her favorite stories.
rows.translation: “怎么，你以为一群海盗会花钱买船？真那么干了，他们还有什么脸自称海盗？”她摇摇头，却仍咧嘴笑着。显然，这是她最喜欢讲的故事之一。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What, you think a bunch of pirates are going to buy one? How the fuck would they call themselves pirates if they did that?” She shakes her head, but she’s still grinning. It’s clear this is one of her favorite stories."

rows.original: “There was a hauler crew that went to that station all the time,” Karrah continues. “The captains had contacts on that crew. So they knew when the ship was inbound and what it was carrying. And that day, it had some good shit. So there was no fucking way they’d pass it up.”
rows.translation: “有一群跑货运的总去那个空间站，”卡拉继续说道。“几位船长在那群人里有线人，所以知道那艘船什么时候进站，也知道它运了什么。那天，船上正好有些好东西。所以她们他妈绝不可能放过。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There was a hauler crew that went to that station all the time,” Karrah continues. “The captains had contacts on that crew. So they knew when the ship was inbound and what it was carrying. And that day, it had some good shit. So there was no fucking way they’d pass it up.”"

rows.original: That almost sounds too easy. It’s like they wanted the ship to be stolen.
rows.translation: 这听起来简直太容易了。就好像他们巴不得飞船被偷走似的。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat almost sounds too easy. It’s like they wanted the ship to be stolen."

rows.original: “The captains thought that too. Which is why they needed some muscle, in case things went bad.” Karrah flexes her bulging biceps at the memory. “It went bad. The ship’s crew were playing at being slavers. So they were inside and armed, and ready for my new friends. But they weren’t ready for me.” She barks a laugh. “Trust me, [pc.name], nobody keeps their shit together when a surprise thraggen barrels down on them. Nobody.”
rows.translation: “几位船长也是这么想的。所以她们需要点武力，以防事情搞砸。”卡拉回想起当时，绷起了隆起的肱二头肌。“事情确实搞砸了。那艘船的船员在玩奴隶贩子的把戏，所以他们待在里面，全副武装，等着我的新朋友。但他们没准备好对付我。”她放声大笑。“相信我，[pc.name]，看到一个意料之外的特拉根横冲直撞地冲过来，没人还能镇定自若。没人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The captains thought that too. Which is why they needed some muscle, in case things went bad.” Karrah flexes her bulging biceps at the memory. “It went bad. The ship’s crew were playing at being slavers. So they were inside and armed, and ready for my new friends. But they weren’t ready for me.” She barks a laugh. “Trust me, [pc.name], nobody keeps their shit together when a surprise thraggen barrels down on them. Nobody.”"

rows.original: You can believe that. And you’d almost feel sorry for the people on that ship, if they hadn’t meant to capture her and the others.
rows.translation: 这点你可以相信。要不是那艘船上的人本打算抓住她和其他人，你甚至差点会同情他们。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can believe that. And you’d almost feel sorry for the people on that ship, if they hadn’t meant to capture her and the others."

rows.original: “Yeah, they had a real bad day,” Karrah says, and runs the tip of her tongue over her tusks. “But once we tossed out what was left of them and took the ship, we were a real crew. We were on our own, together, and that was the start of everything.”
rows.translation: “对，他们那天过得可惨了，”卡拉说着，用舌尖舔过獠牙。“但等我们把剩下的家伙扔出去、夺下飞船，我们就成了一支真正的船员队伍。我们一起获得了自由，一切就是从那里开始的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, they had a real bad day,” Karrah says, and runs the tip of her tongue over her tusks. “But once we tossed out what was left of them and took the ship, we were a real crew. We were on our own, together, and that was the start of everything.”"

rows.original: That sounds like the start of some good years together. How long did she run with them before things went bad?
rows.translation: 听起来她们一起度过了好些年。情况恶化之前，她跟她们混了多久？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat sounds like the start of some good years together. How long did she run with them before things went bad?"

rows.original: “I don’t really know, at least seven or eight years,” Karrah says. “We mostly did smuggling, small hit jobs, stuff like that. We hit this big damn medical ship a few years ago, pulled a bunch of mods.” She gives herself a punch in one of her enormous tits, making them bounce and strain against her vest. “That’s where I picked up these babies.”
rows.translation: “我真不清楚，至少有七八年吧，”卡拉说。“我们主要干走私、小型袭击之类的活儿。几年前我们抢过一艘他妈很大的医疗船，弄到了一大堆改造品。”她朝自己一只硕大的乳房捶了一拳，令双乳弹跳起来，紧紧撑着背心。“这两个宝贝就是那时候弄来的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t really know, at least seven or eight years,” Karrah says. “We mostly did smuggling, small hit jobs, stuff like that. We hit this big damn medical ship a few years ago, pulled a bunch of mods.” She gives herself a punch in one of her enormous tits, making them bounce and strain against her vest. “That’s where I picked up these babies.”"

rows.original: Those came from a mod? Not that you’re surprised, as simple mods like that are available just about everywhere.
rows.translation: 那是改造品带来的？不过你也不意外，毕竟这种简单的改造品几乎到处都有卖。
rows.raw: "\n\nThose came from a mod? Not that you’re surprised, as simple mods like that are available just about everywhere."

rows.original: Karrah glances away, looking almost embarrassed. Her cheeks turn a darker shade of green. “Yeah, I used to be flat as a fucking table,” she admits. “But there was a whole damn crate of Boobswell in the loot from that medical job. I tried it once, because what the hell. And it was fucking awesome. So I slapped them on again, and again, and again. I swear, waking up half-crushed by your own tits? There’s nothing like it.”
rows.translation: 卡拉移开目光，看起来甚至有些难为情。她的面颊染上了更深的绿色。“对，我以前平得他妈像张桌子，”她承认道。“不过那次医疗船的战利品里有整整一箱丰乳贴。我试了一次，反正试试又没什么。结果他妈爽极了。所以我贴了一次又一次，再一次。我发誓，醒来时发现自己差点被乳房压扁？没有任何感觉能比得上。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah glances away, looking almost embarrassed. Her cheeks turn a darker shade of green. “Yeah, I used to be flat as a fucking table,” she admits. “But there was a whole damn crate of Boobswell in the loot from that medical job. I tried it once, because what the hell. And it was fucking awesome. So I slapped them on again, and again, and again. I swear, waking up half-crushed by your own tits? There’s nothing like it.”"

rows.original: You guess she had to stop eventually, though. A rack like that might make it hard to aim, or fight, or something else she’d need to do.
rows.translation: 不过你猜她最终还是不得不停下。那样的一对巨乳可能会妨碍瞄准、战斗，或是她需要做的其他事情。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou guess she had to stop eventually, though. A rack like that might make it hard to aim, or fight, or something else she’d need to do."

rows.original: “Monika talked to me about it, after they got almost this big,” Karrah says. “She said she couldn’t deal with an addict on the crew, even if it was something like that. I fought her, because of fucking course I did. I said I was fine. Then I was doing my weights routine, and I couldn’t do push-ups without my tits touching the ground the whole time. Kind of made me think. So I quit.”
rows.translation: “它们长到差不多这么大之后，莫妮卡找我谈过，”卡拉说。“她说船上不能留一个瘾君子，哪怕上瘾的是这种东西也不行。我跟她吵了，因为我他妈当然会吵。我说自己没问题。后来我照常举铁，却发现做俯卧撑时，乳房会一直贴着地面。确实让我想了想。所以我戒了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Monika talked to me about it, after they got almost this big,” Karrah says. “She said she couldn’t deal with an addict on the crew, even if it was something like that. I fought her, because of fucking course I did. I said I was fine. Then I was doing my weights routine, and I couldn’t do push-ups without my tits touching the ground the whole time. Kind of made me think. So I quit.”"

rows.original: After a moment, Karrah runs a hand over her mohawk, and shrugs at you. “That’s pretty much it,” she says. “Things were good with the crew for a long time, but it all went to shit. And now we’re here, all that’s left of us. Could be worse, I guess.”
rows.translation: 过了一会儿，卡拉用手抚过莫霍克发型，对你耸了耸肩。“大概就是这些，”她说。“很长时间里，跟大家一起的日子都很好，但后来一切都完蛋了。现在我们就在这里，成了仅剩的几个人。不过我猜事情还能更糟。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a moment, Karrah runs a hand over her mohawk, and shrugs at you. “That’s pretty much it,” she says. “Things were good with the crew for a long time, but it all went to shit. And now we’re here, all that’s left of us. Could be worse, I guess.”"

rows.original: You ask Karrah what she thinks about the crew here at the bar. Her immediate response is a grunt, and she looks away.
rows.translation: 你问卡拉，她怎么看待酒吧里的这群船员。她立刻哼了一声，移开了目光。
rows.raw: "You ask Karrah what she thinks about the crew here at the bar. Her immediate response is a grunt, and she looks away."

rows.original: “They’re the ones who stuck around,” she says, her voice low. “So they’re a shitload better than the ones who took off.”
rows.translation: “她们是留下来的人，”她压低声音说道。“所以比那些一走了之的家伙好他妈太多了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They’re the ones who stuck around,” she says, her voice low. “So they’re a shitload better than the ones who took off.”"

rows.original: That’s not what you expected, though it’s no surprise a former space pirate would feel loyal to her crew. Was it really that bad, when the crew broke up?
rows.translation: 这并不是你预想中的回答，不过一个前太空海盗会忠于自己的船员也不奇怪。船员队伍解散时，情况真的有那么糟吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s not what you expected, though it’s no surprise a former space pirate would feel loyal to her crew. Was it really that bad, when the crew broke up?"

rows.original: “Yeah,” she says. “I’d been running with Redd and the other captains for years, I don’t even know how long. When things went bad, I wanted everyone to hold it together. We’d been through worse shit than getting stuck on some planet we hardly knew about. But no. For most of them, that was it. They were done.”
rows.translation: “对，”她说。“我跟雷德和其他船长一起闯荡了很多年，久到我都记不清了。情况恶化时，我希望所有人都能团结下去。我们经历过比困在一颗几乎一无所知的星球上更糟的破事。但她们不愿意。对大多数人来说，到此为止了。她们不干了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah,” she says. “I’d been running with Redd and the other captains for years, I don’t even know how long. When things went bad, I wanted everyone to hold it together. We’d been through worse shit than getting stuck on some planet we hardly knew about. But no. For most of them, that was it. They were done.”"

rows.original: But enough of them stayed together, right? Or else they wouldn’t have the bar, and she wouldn’t be here. That’s better than nothing, isn’t it?
rows.translation: 但还是有足够多的人留在了一起，对吧？否则她们不会有这间酒吧，她也不会在这里。这总比什么都没有强，不是吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nBut enough of them stayed together, right? Or else they wouldn’t have the bar, and she wouldn’t be here. That’s better than nothing, isn’t it?"

rows.original: Karrah grunts. “I guess.” She leans back against the wall, folding her arms under her enormous chest. “I knew Josie was gonna stick around. She’s been good with everything that happened to her, ever since we picked her up on New Texas.” A small smile breaks through the thraggen woman’s glower. “I swear, the code to that place’s spaceport was the best thing we ever stole. And there’s nothing like heading out after three days of horsecock to find out you picked up a stray along the way.”
rows.translation: 卡拉哼了一声。“也许吧。”她向后靠在墙上，把双臂交叠在硕大的胸部下方。“我知道乔西肯定会留下。自从我们在新德克萨斯捡到她之后，无论她遭遇什么，都适应得很好。”这个特拉根女人阴沉的脸上露出一丝微笑。“我发誓，偷到那个地方的太空港代码，是我们这辈子偷过最好的东西。在那儿狠狠干了三天马鸡巴之后离开，却发现一路上还捡了个流浪儿，真是妙不可言。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah grunts. “I guess.” She leans back against the wall, folding her arms under her enormous chest. “I knew Josie was gonna stick around. She’s been good with everything that happened to her, ever since we picked her up on New Texas.” A small smile breaks through the thraggen woman’s glower. “I swear, the code to that place’s spaceport was the best thing we ever stole. And there’s nothing like heading out after three days of horsecock to find out you picked up a stray along the way.”"

rows.original: You’ve heard crazier stories. But you wouldn’t have expected to find a New Texan on a space pirate crew.
rows.translation: 你听过更离奇的故事。不过你确实没想到会在太空海盗的船员里发现一个新德克萨斯人。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve heard crazier stories. But you wouldn’t have expected to find a New Texan on a space pirate crew."

rows.original: “It’s not like she planned on it,” Karrah says. “I didn’t think she’d last. I figured she’d hop off wherever we dropped her, fuck her way into a new ship, and get back home somehow. But she really liked doing what we do.” She shakes her head. “The girl’s fucking useless in a fight, but holy shit, she could charm anyone when she was on comm duty. After a few times, we just let her do that all the time.”
rows.translation: “她又不是计划好了要上船，”卡拉说。“我没觉得她会待很久。我以为无论我们把她放在哪儿，她都会下船，靠一路操上另一艘船，再设法回家。但她真的很喜欢我们干的事。”她摇摇头。“这姑娘打起架来屁用没有，可他妈的，她值通讯班时能把任何人迷得神魂颠倒。试过几次之后，我们索性一直让她负责这个。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s not like she planned on it,” Karrah says. “I didn’t think she’d last. I figured she’d hop off wherever we dropped her, fuck her way into a new ship, and get back home somehow. But she really liked doing what we do.” She shakes her head. “The girl’s fucking useless in a fight, but holy shit, she could charm anyone when she was on comm duty. After a few times, we just let her do that all the time.”"

rows.original: So Josie was their honey trap. No surprise they’d get her to do that, and she probably enjoyed it.
rows.translation: 所以乔西是她们的美人计。她们会让她做这个毫不奇怪，而她大概也乐在其中。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo Josie was their honey trap. No surprise they’d get her to do that, and she probably enjoyed it."

rows.original: “It’s pretty fucking crazy how so many people lose their shit over a pretty face and some big damn titties,” Karrah says, and grins. “One time, we got a whole damn military transport to dock with us when she said she’d been kidnapped. Soon as they opened their airlock, we hacked their systems and gassed the fuck out of their ship, then ran like hell through the thing and cleaned it out before they woke up.” She barks a quick laugh. “Only got to pull that off once, but it was awesome.”
rows.translation: “一张漂亮脸蛋和一对他妈的大奶子，居然能让这么多人失去理智，实在太他妈离谱了，”卡拉说着咧嘴一笑。“有一次，她谎称自己被绑架了，我们竟骗得一整艘军用运输舰跟我们对接。他们一打开气闸，我们就黑进系统，往他们船里猛灌气体，然后在那东西里拼命狂奔，赶在他们醒来之前洗劫一空。”她短促地大笑一声。“这招只成功过一次，但真他妈痛快。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s pretty fucking crazy how so many people lose their shit over a pretty face and some big damn titties,” Karrah says, and grins. “One time, we got a whole damn military transport to dock with us when she said she’d been kidnapped. Soon as they opened their airlock, we hacked their systems and gassed the fuck out of their ship, then ran like hell through the thing and cleaned it out before they woke up.” She barks a quick laugh. “Only got to pull that off once, but it was awesome.”"

rows.original: It sounds like things worked out pretty well with her on board. What about the others who stuck around to run the bar?
rows.translation: 听起来有她在船上时，一切都进行得很顺利。那留下来经营酒吧的其他人呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt sounds like things worked out pretty well with her on board. What about the others who stuck around to run the bar?"

rows.original: Karrah starts to say something, then just grumbles. “Don’t know if I want to talk about that,” she says. “It’s just the four of us now. Never really thought it’d turn out like this. Not for us.”
rows.translation: 卡拉刚想说些什么，却只发出一声抱怨。“不知道我想不想谈这个，”她说。“现在只剩下我们四个。我从没想过事情会变成这样。至少没想过我们会这样。”
rows.raw: "Karrah starts to say something, then just grumbles. “Don’t know if I want to talk about that,” she says. “It’s just the four of us now. Never really thought it’d turn out like this. Not for us.”"

rows.original: It seems like you’ve hit a sore spot. Maybe if you ask her again later, Karrah will feel like talking about this some more.
rows.translation: 看来你戳到了她的痛处。也许以后再问一次，卡拉会愿意多谈谈这件事。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt seems like you’ve hit a sore spot. Maybe if you ask her again later, Karrah will feel like talking about this some more."

rows.original: Karrah glances down the hall, toward the bar and beyond. “No surprise Kiki stuck around,” she says. “There’s a ton of places a techie could work on this rock, but nowhere that’s not tied to one of the damn corps. Except here.”
rows.translation: 卡拉沿着走廊望向酒吧和更远的地方。“琪琪会留下来一点都不意外，”她说。“这块破石头上有一大堆地方能让技术员工作，可没有哪一处不跟某家公司绑在一起。除了这里。”
rows.raw: "Karrah glances down the hall, toward the bar and beyond. “No surprise Kiki stuck around,” she says. “There’s a ton of places a techie could work on this rock, but nowhere that’s not tied to one of the damn corps. Except here.”"

rows.original: So Kiki’s their tech expert. Why does Karrah think she stayed with the crew, aside from not wanting to work for one of the corps?
rows.translation: 所以琪琪是她们的技术专家。除了不想为某家公司工作以外，卡拉觉得她为什么会留下？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo Kiki’s their tech expert. Why does Karrah think she stayed with the crew, aside from not wanting to work for one of the corps?"

rows.original: “Kiki joined up when her life went shitty all at once, and she’s better at the pirate thing than she knows,” Karrah says, her voice low. She gives you a grin that’s more than a little feral. “You tell her I said that, I’ll bite your damn hand off.”
rows.translation: “琪琪是在生活一下子烂透的时候入伙的，而且她比自己以为的更擅长当海盗，”卡拉压低声音说道。她朝你咧嘴一笑，显得颇为凶悍。“你敢告诉她这是我说的，我就把你那只破手咬下来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Kiki joined up when her life went shitty all at once, and she’s better at the pirate thing than she knows,” Karrah says, her voice low. She gives you a grin that’s more than a little feral. “You tell her I said that, I’ll bite your damn hand off.”"

rows.original: Don’t worry, the secret’s safe with you. But it sounds like Karrah respects the other woman.
rows.translation: 别担心，你会保守秘密。不过听起来卡拉很尊重另一个女人。
rows.raw: "\n\nDon’t worry, the secret’s safe with you. But it sounds like Karrah respects the other woman."

rows.original: “Yeah, she’s earned it,” Karrah says. “She could fuck around with her wires and computers all day, but she actually learned how to survive with us, learned how to shoot and fight and not fuck around when we’re in trouble. Don’t think she ever liked the violent parts, but she handled herself. Not everyone can.”
rows.translation: “对，这是她应得的，”卡拉说。“她本可以整天摆弄电线和电脑，可她真正学会了怎么跟我们一起活下来，学会了怎么开枪、怎么战斗，也学会了遇上麻烦时别他妈瞎折腾。我觉得她从来都不喜欢暴力的部分，但她能应付自如。不是所有人都做得到。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, she’s earned it,” Karrah says. “She could fuck around with her wires and computers all day, but she actually learned how to survive with us, learned how to shoot and fight and not fuck around when we’re in trouble. Don’t think she ever liked the violent parts, but she handled herself. Not everyone can.”"

rows.original: Karrah pats the cannon on her shoulder, and taps the eyepiece she wears. “And Kiki made these, hacked them together from parts we had on the ship.” She looks proud. “This baby can tear a hole right through cheap armor and do some serious damage to the higher-grade stuff. All I have to do is give it a command, and boom, it shoots wherever I’m looking. I’d rather punch someone who’s giving me shit, but I damn sure wouldn’t want to lose this thing.”
rows.translation: 卡拉拍了拍肩上的炮，又敲了敲戴着的目镜。“这些也是琪琪做的，用船上现成的零件拼了出来。”她看起来很骄傲。“这个宝贝能把廉价护甲直接轰穿一个洞，对高级货也能造成相当严重的破坏。我只要下个命令，然后砰的一声，它就会朝我看到的地方开火。谁敢跟我找茬，我还是更喜欢亲手揍他，但我他妈绝不想失去这东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah pats the cannon on her shoulder, and taps the eyepiece she wears. “And Kiki made these, hacked them together from parts we had on the ship.” She looks proud. “This baby can tear a hole right through cheap armor and do some serious damage to the higher-grade stuff. All I have to do is give it a command, and boom, it shoots wherever I’m looking. I’d rather punch someone who’s giving me shit, but I damn sure wouldn’t want to lose this thing.”"

rows.original: That’s pretty impressive work, especially for something cobbled together. What else has Kiki done for the bar?
rows.translation: 这手艺相当了不起，尤其这还是东拼西凑做出来的。琪琪还为酒吧做了些什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s pretty impressive work, especially for something cobbled together. What else has Kiki done for the bar?"

rows.original: “She planned the whole place.” Karrah raps her knuckles on the metal-plated wall. “I had to carry most of the shit down here, but it’d look like a concrete box without her work. And she made me these.”
rows.translation: “整间酒吧都是她规划的。”卡拉用指关节敲了敲金属覆面的墙壁。“大部分破烂都是我搬下来的，可要没有她干的活，这里看起来只会像个混凝土盒子。她还给我做了这些。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“She planned the whole place.” Karrah raps her knuckles on the metal-plated wall. “I had to carry most of the shit down here, but it’d look like a concrete box without her work. And she made me these.”"

rows.original: Karrah flexes her arms, and the steel bands around her upper biceps twitch. Metal slides out of them, slithering down her arm in rings, until she’s covered from shoulders to fingertips in steel. She makes a fist, grinning at her armor.
rows.translation: 卡拉绷起双臂，上臂肱二头肌周围的钢环随之颤动。金属从中滑出，化作圆环沿她的手臂蜿蜒而下，直到钢铁从肩膀一路包裹到指尖。她握紧拳头，看着自己的护甲咧嘴一笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah flexes her arms, and the steel bands around her upper biceps twitch. Metal slides out of them, slithering down her arm in rings, until she’s covered from shoulders to fingertips in steel. She makes a fist, grinning at her armor."

rows.original: “Full armor’s a pain in the ass, never liked it,” Karrah says, admiring her steel. “But this? I can punch whatever the fuck I want and not break my hand. And that’s good shit.”
rows.translation: “全身甲麻烦得要命，我从来都不喜欢，”卡拉一边欣赏身上的钢铁一边说道。“但这个？我他妈想揍什么都行，还不会打断自己的手。这才叫好东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Full armor’s a pain in the ass, never liked it,” Karrah says, admiring her steel. “But this? I can punch whatever the fuck I want and not break my hand. And that’s good shit.”"

rows.original: You can see why she’s glad to have Kiki around. But she said only three others stuck with the crew. What about the last one?
rows.translation: 你能看出她为什么庆幸有琪琪在。但她说只有另外三个人留在船员队伍里。最后一个呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can see why she’s glad to have Kiki around. But she said only three others stuck with the crew. What about the last one?"

rows.original: Karrah chuckles. “If you don’t know the captain, that’s on you,” she says. “Maybe I’ll tell you about her later. Maybe not.” She twitches her arms again, and the metal rolls back into the armbands as she leans back against the wall.
rows.translation: 卡拉轻笑一声。“你要是不认识船长，那就是你自己的问题，”她说。“也许以后我会告诉你她的事。也许不会。”她再次抖动手臂，金属随即卷回臂环中，而她又靠回墙上。
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah chuckles. “If you don’t know the captain, that’s on you,” she says. “Maybe I’ll tell you about her later. Maybe not.” She twitches her arms again, and the metal rolls back into the armbands as she leans back against the wall."

rows.original: Looks like Karrah’s not going to talk about that now. If you ask about it again when she knows you better, she might be willing to say more.
rows.translation: 看来卡拉现在不打算谈这个。等她更熟悉你以后再问，她也许愿意多说一些。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooks like Karrah’s not going to talk about that now. If you ask about it again when she knows you better, she might be willing to say more."

rows.original: You can see why she’s glad to have Kiki around. But she said only three others stuck with the crew. What about the last one?
rows.translation: 你能看出她为什么庆幸有琪琪在。但她说只有另外三个人留在船员队伍里。最后一个呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can see why she’s glad to have Kiki around. But she said only three others stuck with the crew. What about the last one?"

rows.original: “The last one,” Karrah says, narrowing her eyes, “is Captain Monika. And she’s the only captain who actually tried to keep the crew together.”
rows.translation: “最后一个，”卡拉眯起眼睛说道，“是莫妮卡船长。她也是唯一真正试图维系船员队伍的船长。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The last one,” Karrah says, narrowing her eyes, “is Captain Monika. And she’s the only captain who actually tried to keep the crew together.”"

rows.original: The only captain? Was there more than one?
rows.translation: 唯一的船长？原来不止一个吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nThe only captain? Was there more than one?"

rows.original: Karrah nods once. “The crew always had three captains. They were the originals, the ones who started the crew. We were named for Redd, but she never ran the whole thing.” She glances away. “But Redd walked away when the shit went down, and I don’t think Monika ever forgave her for that. I know I don’t.”
rows.translation: 卡拉点了一下头。“船员队伍一直有三位船长。她们是最初的成员，也是组建这支队伍的人。我们以雷德命名，但她从来没有独揽大权。”她移开目光。“但破事发生时，雷德一走了之，而我觉得莫妮卡永远都不会原谅她。我知道我不会。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah nods once. “The crew always had three captains. They were the originals, the ones who started the crew. We were named for Redd, but she never ran the whole thing.” She glances away. “But Redd walked away when the shit went down, and I don’t think Monika ever forgave her for that. I know I don’t.”"

rows.original: What did Monika do, when things went bad? It sounds like Karrah really respects her.
rows.translation: 情况恶化时，莫妮卡做了什么？听起来卡拉真的很尊敬她。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat did Monika do, when things went bad? It sounds like Karrah really respects her."

rows.original: “You’re fucking right I do,” Karrah snarls. “We had the Black Void on us. We got them off us because of Monika’s idea. Everybody else thought we were done, finished, that it was the fucking end for all of us. Monika was the only one who thought we could keep going.”
rows.translation: “你他妈说得没错，我就是尊敬她，”卡拉低吼道。“黑色虚空盯上了我们。我们靠莫妮卡的主意才摆脱他们。其他所有人都觉得我们完蛋了，彻底完了，觉得我们所有人他妈都走到尽头了。只有莫妮卡认为我们还能继续。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re fucking right I do,” Karrah snarls. “We had the Black Void on us. We got them off us because of Monika’s idea. Everybody else thought we were done, finished, that it was the fucking end for all of us. Monika was the only one who thought we could keep going.”"

rows.original: Karrah looks away again, then says quietly, “Everybody else left, because they didn’t believe her.”
rows.translation: 卡拉又移开目光，随后轻声说道：“其他人都走了，因为她们不相信她。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah looks away again, then says quietly, “Everybody else left, because they didn’t believe her.”"

rows.original: Everybody except her, you point out, and the other two people at the bar. So it wasn’t like the crew completely broke up.
rows.translation: 你指出，除了她以外，酒吧里的另外两个人也没走。所以船员队伍并没有彻底解散。
rows.raw: "\n\nEverybody except her, you point out, and the other two people at the bar. So it wasn’t like the crew completely broke up."

rows.original: “You think I don’t know that?” Karrah snaps. “It pisses me off to think it all went to shit so fast. But when Monika saw we still wanted to be her crew, she took care of us, same as always. She and I kept the other girls safe when we were trying to figure out what to do here, when we couldn’t walk around without the damn gangs and corp goons and those fucking milk thieves trying to jump us. She said....”
rows.translation: “你以为我不知道吗？”卡拉厉声说道。“一想到所有事情这么快就全完蛋了，我就火大。不过莫妮卡看到我们仍想当她的船员后，就像往常一样照顾我们。我们还在设法弄清楚该怎么在这里生活的时候，走到哪儿都会有该死的帮派、公司打手和那些狗娘养的偷奶贼试图袭击我们，是她和我保护了其他姑娘。她说....”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You think I don’t know that?” Karrah snaps. “It pisses me off to think it all went to shit so fast. But when Monika saw we still wanted to be her crew, she took care of us, same as always. She and I kept the other girls safe when we were trying to figure out what to do here, when we couldn’t walk around without the damn gangs and corp goons and those fucking milk thieves trying to jump us. She said....”"

rows.original: It takes a moment for Karrah to continue, and when she does, her voice is lower than before. “She said we were still a crew, no matter what. That nobody could take that away from us. And that it was what mattered most.”
rows.translation: 卡拉过了一会儿才继续说下去，开口时声音比先前更低。“她说无论发生什么，我们仍是一支船员队伍。没人能从我们手中夺走这一点。而这才是最重要的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes a moment for Karrah to continue, and when she does, her voice is lower than before. “She said we were still a crew, no matter what. That nobody could take that away from us. And that it was what mattered most.”"

rows.original: A dedicated captain can do a lot for their crew. You’ve heard of some who inspire incredible levels of loyalty. It sounds like Monika had that going for her.
rows.translation: 一位尽职的船长能为船员做很多事。你听说过一些船长能够激发出难以置信的忠诚。听起来莫妮卡就有这种本事。
rows.raw: "\n\nA dedicated captain can do a lot for their crew. You’ve heard of some who inspire incredible levels of loyalty. It sounds like Monika had that going for her."

rows.original: “She still does,” Karrah says. “I keep guard out here, yeah, but Monika’s the one who keeps this place going. She’s got the connections, she keeps an eye on everyone in there, and she’s the one who makes the rules. This place wouldn’t have lasted a fucking week without her in charge.”
rows.translation: “她现在仍有，”卡拉说。“没错，我在外面守门，但维持这里运转的人是莫妮卡。她有人脉，会留意里面的每个人，也负责制定规矩。没有她主持大局，这地方他妈连一周都撑不过去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“She still does,” Karrah says. “I keep guard out here, yeah, but Monika’s the one who keeps this place going. She’s got the connections, she keeps an eye on everyone in there, and she’s the one who makes the rules. This place wouldn’t have lasted a fucking week without her in charge.”"

rows.original: Karrah gives you a stern look, then chuckles. “Anyone who keeps me from beating the fuck out of everyone who tries to give me shit when they want in must be someone special. Especially with how much I miss real fights.”
rows.translation: 卡拉严厉地看了你一眼，随后轻笑起来。“每当有人想进门却跟我找茬时，能阻止我把他们揍个半死的人，肯定很特别。尤其是我这么怀念真正的战斗。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah gives you a stern look, then chuckles. “Anyone who keeps me from beating the fuck out of everyone who tries to give me shit when they want in must be someone special. Especially with how much I miss real fights.”"

rows.original: It’s good to know they’ve got someone like that keeping the place running. It would be a shame to lose Dhaal’s best watering hole.
rows.translation: 很高兴知道有这样的人维持这里运转。要是失去达尔最棒的饮酒去处，那就太可惜了。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s good to know they’ve got someone like that keeping the place running. It would be a shame to lose Dhaal’s best watering hole."

rows.original: “Damn right,” Karrah says, and leaves it at that.
rows.translation: “可不是嘛，”卡拉说完便不再多言。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn right,” Karrah says, and leaves it at that."

rows.original: You ask Karrah how she feels about Dhaal. Before you can even finish asking, she rolls her eyes. So she doesn’t think much of the place?
rows.translation: 你问卡拉对达尔有什么感受。你甚至还没问完，她就翻了个白眼。所以她并不怎么看得上这里？
rows.raw: "You ask Karrah how she feels about Dhaal. Before you can even finish asking, she rolls her eyes. So she doesn’t think much of the place?"

rows.original: “I’ve been on worse rocks,” the thraggen woman says. “We looked at the Rush planets, and it’s not like we had a shitload of choices. The fuck were we supposed to do, head to some jungle planet full of who knows what? Or that one world where they’ve been at war for forever?”
rows.translation: “我去过更糟的破石头，”这个特拉根女人说。“我们考察过行星开拓潮里的那些星球，可我们根本他妈没多少选择。我们还能怎么办，去一颗满是天知道什么玩意儿的丛林星球？还是去那个永远都在打仗的世界？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ve been on worse rocks,” the thraggen woman says. “We looked at the Rush planets, and it’s not like we had a shitload of choices. The fuck were we supposed to do, head to some jungle planet full of who knows what? Or that one world where they’ve been at war for forever?”"

rows.original: She pauses, and shakes her head. “Okay, I would have liked that one. The rest of the crew said no. Dhaal was our best choice, which says a lot about how deep in the shit we were.”
rows.translation: 她顿了一下，摇摇头。“好吧，我倒是会喜欢那个地方。其他船员不同意。达尔是我们最好的选择，这足以说明我们当时陷得有多深。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pauses, and shakes her head. “Okay, I would have liked that one. The rest of the crew said no. Dhaal was our best choice, which says a lot about how deep in the shit we were.”"

rows.original: But it seems like she and the rest of the crew are doing pretty well here. They might not be flying around on their own ship anymore, but-
rows.translation: 不过她和其余船员在这里似乎过得相当不错。她们也许不能再驾驶自己的飞船四处航行，但-
rows.raw: "\n\nBut it seems like she and the rest of the crew are doing pretty well here. They might not be flying around on their own ship anymore, but-"

rows.original: “This place wouldn’t suck so much without the zaibatsu,” Karrah spits. “Fuckers have their hands in damn near everything, they rule this place almost as bad as the corps out in the rest of the galaxy. And the corps are even moving in on them, trying to take over. Been hearing about shit like that since we got here.”
rows.translation: “要是没有财阀，这地方就不会这么烂，”卡拉啐道。“那帮混蛋几乎插手所有事情，对这里的统治跟银河其他地方的公司一样糟糕。那些公司甚至还在向她们步步进逼，试图夺权。我们刚到这里时，我就一直听说这种破事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This place wouldn’t suck so much without the zaibatsu,” Karrah spits. “Fuckers have their hands in damn near everything, they rule this place almost as bad as the corps out in the rest of the galaxy. And the corps are even moving in on them, trying to take over. Been hearing about shit like that since we got here.”"

rows.original: Which explains a lot about why they’re hiding underground. But what about the people? The zaika seem interesting, and having them here can’t be all that bad.
rows.translation: 这充分解释了她们为什么躲在地下。但这里的人呢？扎伊卡人似乎很有意思，有她们在这里也不可能全是坏事。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhich explains a lot about why they’re hiding underground. But what about the people? The zaika seem interesting, and having them here can’t be all that bad."

rows.original: Karrah shrugs. “They’re spindly,” she says, then grunts. “Cute, but spindly. I always feel like I’m gonna break them, no matter who I’m with or what we’re doing. That’s not a bad thing when one of those jackasses in the city tries to jump us. They come after me, they get what they deserve.”
rows.translation: 卡拉耸耸肩。“她们细胳膊细腿的，”她说完又哼了一声。“很可爱，但太纤细了。不管跟谁在一起，也不管我们在做什么，我总觉得自己会把她们弄断。这座城市里的某个蠢货想袭击我们时，这倒不算坏事。她们冲着我来，就会得到应有的教训。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah shrugs. “They’re spindly,” she says, then grunts. “Cute, but spindly. I always feel like I’m gonna break them, no matter who I’m with or what we’re doing. That’s not a bad thing when one of those jackasses in the city tries to jump us. They come after me, they get what they deserve.”"

rows.original: Maybe, but you can see why they come after her, considering the zaika lust for milk.
rows.translation: 也许吧，但考虑到扎伊卡人对乳汁的渴望，你能理解她们为什么会袭击她。
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe, but you can see why they come after her, considering the zaika lust for milk."

rows.original: She gives you a deep chuckle, and thumps one of her enormous boobs, making it smack against the other. “They pick a fight and don’t even know I’m dry, so they lose twice,” she says. “And they never learn. But they don’t last long in a brawl. And fucking them... it’s just weird.”
rows.translation: 她低沉地笑起来，拍了拍一只硕大的乳房，让它啪的一声撞上另一只。“她们找我打架，却连我没奶都不知道，所以会输上两次，”她说。“而且她们从不吸取教训。不过她们打群架时撑不了多久。至于跟她们做爱...感觉就是很怪。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a deep chuckle, and thumps one of her enormous boobs, making it smack against the other. “They pick a fight and don’t even know I’m dry, so they lose twice,” she says. “And they never learn. But they don’t last long in a brawl. And fucking them... it’s just weird.”"

rows.raw: "\n\nWeird how? Your codex said something about how their genitals don’t work like most mammals’ do, same with their breasts. They seem pretty different from a lot of the species you’ve met."

And most of them, they got this hang-up about fucking pussy. Keep calling it my ‘egg-slit’ or some shit like that and acting like it’s taboo to stick their dick-tail up there.”"

rows.translation: 有意思。而且远不是你听说过最古怪的性执念。
rows.raw: "\n\nInteresting. And nowhere near the weirdest sexual hang-up you’ve heard of."

rows.original: “Most of them are good with putting it in my ass,” Karrah continues. “So we grind with that thing in me, and that’s a good time.” She shakes her head. “But it’s hard to go rough with a tail-cock. I can’t get a good pounding out of them. And seeing a girl’s tits shrink as she cums? Kind of kills the mood.”
rows.translation: “她们大多愿意把它塞进我屁股，”卡拉继续说道。“所以那东西插在我体内时，我们会互相磨蹭，感觉很不错。”她摇摇头。“可用尾巴鸡巴很难狠狠干。我没法从她们那里得到痛快的猛操。再说看着一个姑娘高潮时乳房缩小？实在败兴。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Most of them are good with putting it in my ass,” Karrah continues. “So we grind with that thing in me, and that’s a good time.” She shakes her head. “But it’s hard to go rough with a tail-cock. I can’t get a good pounding out of them. And seeing a girl’s tits shrink as she cums? Kind of kills the mood.”"

rows.original: Okay, so she’s not big on the natives. But there’s got to be something she likes about this place, right?
rows.translation: 好吧，看来她不太喜欢当地人。但这里总有些她喜欢的东西，对吧？
rows.raw: "\n\nOkay, so she’s not big on the natives. But there’s got to be something she likes about this place, right?"

rows.original: “Maybe,” she says with another grunt. “Maybe not.” she leans back against the wall and folds her arms under her chest, clearly done with the conversation.
rows.translation: “也许吧，”她又哼了一声。“也许没有。”她向后靠在墙上，把双臂交叠在胸部下方，显然已经不想再谈。
rows.raw: "“Maybe,” she says with another grunt. “Maybe not.” she leans back against the wall and folds her arms under her chest, clearly done with the conversation."

rows.original: It looks like Karrah doesn’t want to talk about this anymore. Maybe if you ask again when she knows you better, she’ll feel like saying more.
rows.translation: 看来卡拉不想再谈这件事了。也许等她更熟悉你以后再问，她会愿意多说一些。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt looks like Karrah doesn’t want to talk about this anymore. Maybe if you ask again when she knows you better, she’ll feel like saying more."

rows.original: “Maybe,” she says with another grunt. “It’s just... this place is so damn different from what I’m used to. No matter what crew I was part of, we never stuck around long enough to put down roots like this.”
rows.translation: “也许吧，”她又哼了一声。“只是...这个地方跟我习惯的一切太他妈不一样了。无论我属于哪支船员队伍，我们从来不会在一个地方待到像这样扎根。”
rows.raw: "“Maybe,” she says with another grunt. “It’s just... this place is so damn different from what I’m used to. No matter what crew I was part of, we never stuck around long enough to put down roots like this.”"

rows.original: That makes sense, if she spent years doing the space pirate thing. That’s not the kind of life that leads to sticking around anywhere for very long.
rows.translation: 如果她做了多年太空海盗，这很合理。那种生活不会让人在任何地方停留太久。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat makes sense, if she spent years doing the space pirate thing. That’s not the kind of life that leads to sticking around anywhere for very long."

rows.original: “And I’m good with that.” Karrah looks down the metal-plated hallway toward the bar. “I grew up on merc ships, and we never had a port we called home either. The ship was home, whatever ship that was.” She runs the tip of her tongue over one tusk, and grins a little. “We went through four different ships during my time with that crew. Can’t even blame me for losing any of them.”
rows.translation: “而且我喜欢那样。”卡拉沿着金属覆面的走廊望向酒吧。“我在佣兵船上长大，我们也从来没有一个称之为家的港口。船就是家，无论是哪一艘船。”她用舌尖舔过一根獠牙，微微咧嘴一笑。“跟那群人一起闯荡的时候，我们前后换过四艘船。没有一艘是因为我才丢的，你可怪不到我头上。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And I’m good with that.” Karrah looks down the metal-plated hallway toward the bar. “I grew up on merc ships, and we never had a port we called home either. The ship was home, whatever ship that was.” She runs the tip of her tongue over one tusk, and grins a little. “We went through four different ships during my time with that crew. Can’t even blame me for losing any of them.”"

rows.original: And how many ships did the pirate crew have? You can see what happened to their last one, as it clearly got made into the bar, but before that?
rows.translation: 那支海盗船员队伍有过多少艘船？你能看出最后一艘发生了什么，它显然被改成了这间酒吧，但更早以前呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd how many ships did the pirate crew have? You can see what happened to their last one, as it clearly got made into the bar, but before that?"

rows.original: “Just the one,” Karrah says, and smacks the back of her fist against the metal plating on the wall. “One was all we needed. That thing had been through hell and back and then back into hell again by the time we got to Dhaal. Even Kiki and our other mechie couldn’t get it running again. So we knew Dhaal was going to be our last stop.”
rows.translation: “就这一艘，”卡拉说着，用拳背砸了砸墙上的金属覆板。“我们只需要这一艘。等我们抵达达尔时，这东西已经下过地狱、回来了，然后又下了一趟地狱。就连琪琪和另一个机械师也没法让它重新运转。所以我们知道，达尔会是最后一站。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just the one,” Karrah says, and smacks the back of her fist against the metal plating on the wall. “One was all we needed. That thing had been through hell and back and then back into hell again by the time we got to Dhaal. Even Kiki and our other mechie couldn’t get it running again. So we knew Dhaal was going to be our last stop.”"

rows.original: Staying in one place for this long must be strange for her, if she’s used to always being on the move.
rows.translation: 如果她习惯了一直四处奔波，在同一个地方待这么久肯定感觉很奇怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nStaying in one place for this long must be strange for her, if she’s used to always being on the move."

rows.original: Karrah shrugs. “One of the mercs I used to run with said you can get used to most anything, especially when money’s involved. We’re making money here, and we’re surviving. Even if we’re all that’s left of the crew. Staying alive here is all that matters.”
rows.translation: 卡拉耸耸肩。“以前跟我一起干活的一个佣兵说过，人几乎什么都能习惯，尤其是牵扯到钱的时候。我们在这里赚钱，也活了下来。哪怕我们已经是船员队伍仅剩的人。在这里活下去才是最重要的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah shrugs. “One of the mercs I used to run with said you can get used to most anything, especially when money’s involved. We’re making money here, and we’re surviving. Even if we’re all that’s left of the crew. Staying alive here is all that matters.”"

rows.original: She thumps her hand on the wall again, still looking down the hall. “And fuck, things could be a lot worse. We got here alive. We didn’t all split up. And we’ve got what’s left of the ship, even if it’s in pieces.”
rows.translation: 她又用手拍了拍墙，仍然望着走廊另一端。“而且他妈的，事情本可能糟糕得多。我们活着抵达了这里。也没有彻底分道扬镳。飞船剩下的部分也还在，哪怕已经被拆得七零八落。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe thumps her hand on the wall again, still looking down the hall. “And fuck, things could be a lot worse. We got here alive. We didn’t all split up. And we’ve got what’s left of the ship, even if it’s in pieces.”"

rows.original: The thraggen woman grumbles under her breath. “I didn’t want to stop. And that’s all we’re doing here. Just stopped.”
rows.translation: 这个特拉根女人低声抱怨。“我不想停下。而我们在这里做的只有这件事。只是停了下来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe thraggen woman grumbles under her breath. “I didn’t want to stop. And that’s all we’re doing here. Just stopped.”"

rows.original: Does she think they’ll stay stopped here forever? Or will they eventually head off Dhaal, and get back to being pirates again?
rows.translation: 她觉得她们会永远停在这里吗？还是最终会离开达尔，重新当回海盗？
rows.raw: "\n\nDoes she think they’ll stay stopped here forever? Or will they eventually head off Dhaal, and get back to being pirates again?"

rows.original: Karrah snorts. “Fuck if I know,” she says. “Only idiots try to predict shit they can’t ever tell.” She falls silent.
rows.translation: 卡拉哼了一声。“我他妈哪知道，”她说。“只有蠢货才会试图预测那些永远无法确定的破事。”她陷入沉默。
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah snorts. “Fuck if I know,” she says. “Only idiots try to predict shit they can’t ever tell.” She falls silent."
