The ship was home, whatever ship that was.” She runs the tip of her tongue over one tusk, and grins a little. “We went through four different ships during my time with that crew. Can’t even blame me for losing any of them.”"

rows.original: And how many ships did the pirate crew have? You can see what happened to their last one, as it clearly got made into the bar, but before that?
rows.translation: 那支海盗船员队伍有过多少艘船？你能看出最后一艘发生了什么，它显然被改成了这间酒吧，但更早以前呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd how many ships did the pirate crew have? You can see what happened to their last one, as it clearly got made into the bar, but before that?"

rows.original: “Just the one,” Karrah says, and smacks the back of her fist against the metal plating on the wall. “One was all we needed. That thing had been through hell and back and then back into hell again by the time we got to Dhaal. Even Kiki and our other mechie couldn’t get it running again. So we knew Dhaal was going to be our last stop.”
rows.translation: “就这一艘，”卡拉说着，用拳背砸了砸墙上的金属覆板。“我们只需要这一艘。等我们抵达达尔时，这东西已经下过地狱、回来了，然后又下了一趟地狱。就连琪琪和另一个机械师也没法让它重新运转。所以我们知道，达尔会是最后一站。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just the one,” Karrah says, and smacks the back of her fist against the metal plating on the wall. “One was all we needed. That thing had been through hell and back and then back into hell again by the time we got to Dhaal. Even Kiki and our other mechie couldn’t get it running again. So we knew Dhaal was going to be our last stop.”"

rows.original: Staying in one place for this long must be strange for her, if she’s used to always being on the move.
rows.translation: 如果她习惯了一直四处奔波，在同一个地方待这么久肯定感觉很奇怪。
rows.raw: "\n\nStaying in one place for this long must be strange for her, if she’s used to always being on the move."

rows.original: Karrah shrugs. “One of the mercs I used to run with said you can get used to most anything, especially when money’s involved. We’re making money here, and we’re surviving. Even if we’re all that’s left of the crew. Staying alive here is all that matters.”
rows.translation: 卡拉耸耸肩。“以前跟我一起干活的一个佣兵说过，人几乎什么都能习惯，尤其是牵扯到钱的时候。我们在这里赚钱，也活了下来。哪怕我们已经是船员队伍仅剩的人。在这里活下去才是最重要的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah shrugs. “One of the mercs I used to run with said you can get used to most anything, especially when money’s involved. We’re making money here, and we’re surviving. Even if we’re all that’s left of the crew. Staying alive here is all that matters.”"

rows.original: She thumps her hand on the wall again, still looking down the hall. “And fuck, things could be a lot worse. We got here alive. We didn’t all split up. And we’ve got what’s left of the ship, even if it’s in pieces.”
rows.translation: 她又用手拍了拍墙，仍然望着走廊另一端。“而且他妈的，事情本可能糟糕得多。我们活着抵达了这里。也没有彻底分道扬镳。飞船剩下的部分也还在，哪怕已经被拆得七零八落。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe thumps her hand on the wall again, still looking down the hall. “And fuck, things could be a lot worse. We got here alive. We didn’t all split up. And we’ve got what’s left of the ship, even if it’s in pieces.”"

rows.original: The thraggen woman grumbles under her breath. “I didn’t want to stop. And that’s all we’re doing here. Just stopped.”
rows.translation: 这个特拉根女人低声抱怨。“我不想停下。而我们在这里做的只有这件事。只是停了下来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe thraggen woman grumbles under her breath. “I didn’t want to stop. And that’s all we’re doing here. Just stopped.”"

rows.original: Does she think they’ll stay stopped here forever? Or will they eventually head off Dhaal, and get back to being pirates again?
rows.translation: 她觉得她们会永远停在这里吗？还是最终会离开达尔，重新当回海盗？
rows.raw: "\n\nDoes she think they’ll stay stopped here forever? Or will they eventually head off Dhaal, and get back to being pirates again?"

rows.original: Karrah snorts. “[flags.MASTODON_END|Come on, you know this,|Fuck if I know,]” she says. “[flags.MASTODON_END|Not like I know when, ]I’m not stupid enough to predict something I’ve got no way of knowing. But I think about it sometimes.”
rows.translation: 卡拉哼了一声。“[flags.MASTODON_END|得了吧，你知道答案，|我他妈哪知道，]”她说。“[flags.MASTODON_END|我又不知道具体什么时候，]我还没蠢到去预测自己根本无从得知的事。但我有时会想这件事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah snorts. “[flags.MASTODON_END|Come on, you know this,|Fuck if I know,]” she says. “[flags.MASTODON_END|Not like I know when, ]I’m not stupid enough to predict something I’ve got no way of knowing. But I think about it sometimes.”"

rows.original: Okay, so what if it’s not a prediction? She’s been doing this for a while, and she clearly pays attention to what’s happening. [flags.MASTODON_END|They’re not going to stay down here, now that they’ve got a ship, but will they be ready to move on?|Does she think the crew will stay down here, or will they move on someday?]
rows.translation: 好吧，如果这不算预测呢？她已经干这行有段时间了，而且显然一直关注着局势。[flags.MASTODON_END|既然她们已经有了飞船，就不会一直待在这下面，可她们会准备好离开吗？|她觉得船员会一直待在这下面，还是总有一天会离开？]
rows.raw: "\n\nOkay, so what if it’s not a prediction? She’s been doing this for a while, and she clearly pays attention to what’s happening. [flags.MASTODON_END|They’re not going to stay down here, now that they’ve got a ship, but will they be ready to move on?|Does she think the crew will stay down here, or will they move on someday?]"

rows.original: “We’ve[flags.MASTODON_END|| only] been doing this [flags.MASTODON_END|long enough|a few months],” Karrah says. “But with the UGC moving in thanks to the Rush, it feels like some shit’s bound to go down.”
rows.translation: “我们[flags.MASTODON_END||才]干了[flags.MASTODON_END|这么久|几个月]，”卡拉说。“不过随着行星开拓潮让银河联合邦联介入，我觉得肯定会有某种破事发生。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’ve[flags.MASTODON_END|| only] been doing this [flags.MASTODON_END|long enough|a few months],” Karrah says. “But with the UGC moving in thanks to the Rush, it feels like some shit’s bound to go down.”"

rows.original: She starts to grin, and it’s not a friendly expression. “Those corporate motherfuckers are going to get what’s coming to them, someday. If there’s one thing the UGC’s good for, it’s sticking its tiny government dick in any cunt it can find. And the corps already have fingers in all those cunts. So that’s gonna start some problems. And once that goes bad, it’s gonna get worse, real quick.”
rows.translation: 她开始咧嘴而笑，那神情并不友善。“那些狗娘养的公司总有一天会得到报应。银河联合邦联要说有哪点做得好，就是会把自己那根小小的政府鸡巴塞进能找到的每个骚穴。而那些公司早已把手指插进了所有骚穴。所以肯定会闹出问题。一旦情况恶化，就会迅速变得更糟。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe starts to grin, and it’s not a friendly expression. “Those corporate motherfuckers are going to get what’s coming to them, someday. If there’s one thing the UGC’s good for, it’s sticking its tiny government dick in any cunt it can find. And the corps already have fingers in all those cunts. So that’s gonna start some problems. And once that goes bad, it’s gonna get worse, real quick.”"

rows.original: So much for not wanting to predict things. But she really thinks there’s going to be war between the corps and the UGC?
rows.translation: 看来她也不是完全不想预测事情。但她真的认为公司和银河联合邦联之间会爆发战争？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo much for not wanting to predict things. But she really thinks there’s going to be war between the corps and the UGC?"

rows.original: “Shit, yes,” she says, looking at you with wide eyes. “I hear people talk all the time. It’s already starting. The corps are doing whatever the fuck they can to make things better for themselves here, and they’re not gonna let go. So one way or another, the whole planet’s gonna get fucked hard.”
rows.translation: “他妈的，当然，”她睁大眼睛看着你说道。“我总能听见别人谈论这件事。事情已经开始了。那些公司正他妈不择手段地在这里为自己谋利，而且不会放手。所以无论如何，整颗星球都会被狠狠操烂。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shit, yes,” she says, looking at you with wide eyes. “I hear people talk all the time. It’s already starting. The corps are doing whatever the fuck they can to make things better for themselves here, and they’re not gonna let go. So one way or another, the whole planet’s gonna get fucked hard.”"

rows.original: She shakes her head. “Only real difference is if it’s gonna be the same old corporate dick or the UGC’s.”
rows.translation: 她摇摇头。“唯一真正的区别，就是操它的会是原来那根公司鸡巴，还是银河联合邦联的鸡巴。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe shakes her head. “Only real difference is if it’s gonna be the same old corporate dick or the UGC’s.”"

rows.original: It could happen. You’ve seen enough of the UGC’s work on other worlds to know they don’t always do the right thing, and if they have to fight the corporations to get anything done on Dhaal, that’s going to get ugly. Especially since there are already corporate goons on the streets. But what’s that going to mean for her and the rest of the crew, and for the bar?
rows.translation: 这确实可能发生。你在其他世界见过足够多银河联合邦联的所作所为，知道他们并非总会做正确的事；如果他们必须与公司交战，才能在达尔办成任何事，局面会变得很难看。尤其是街上已经有公司打手。但这对她、其余船员以及酒吧意味着什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt could happen. You’ve seen enough of the UGC’s work on other worlds to know they don’t always do the right thing, and if they have to fight the corporations to get anything done on Dhaal, that’s going to get ugly. Especially since there are already corporate goons on the streets. But what’s that going to mean for her and the rest of the crew, and for the bar?"

rows.original: “We’ve got plans,” Karrah says, sounding sure of herself. She nods back toward the bar and dance room. “Kiki’s got the place running off others’ power, so the only shit we gotta pay for is food and booze. [flags.MASTODON_END|All the work on the ship’s going first to getting it functional|We’ve got enough credits saved up to get off-world], in case something goes bad and we gotta run. Monika [flags.MASTODON_END|says we’ve got time, though, now that|wants to get us another ship someday, once] we don’t have to worry about the Void running us down.”
rows.translation: “我们有计划，”卡拉自信地说道。她朝身后的酒吧和舞厅点点头。“琪琪让这里一直偷用别人的电，所以我们只需要为食物和酒付钱。万一情况恶化，我们必须逃跑，[flags.MASTODON_END|飞船上的所有工作都会优先恢复它的基本功能|我们已经存够了离开这颗星球的信用点]。现在我们不必担心黑色虚空追杀我们，莫妮卡[flags.MASTODON_END|说我们还有时间，不过，毕竟|希望有一天再给我们弄艘船，只要]。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’ve got plans,” Karrah says, sounding sure of herself. She nods back toward the bar and dance room. “Kiki’s got the place running off others’ power, so the only shit we gotta pay for is food and booze. [flags.MASTODON_END|All the work on the ship’s going first to getting it functional|We’ve got enough credits saved up to get off-world], in case something goes bad and we gotta run. Monika [flags.MASTODON_END|says we’ve got time, though, now that|wants to get us another ship someday, once] we don’t have to worry about the Void running us down.”"

rows.original: It seems like it would take a long time to [flags.MASTODON_END|do so much repair work on their|save up for another] ship, what with them running an underground bar.
rows.translation: 考虑到她们在经营一家地下酒吧，要[flags.MASTODON_END|给她们的飞船做这么多维修|攒钱再买一艘飞船]，似乎得花很长时间。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt seems like it would take a long time to [flags.MASTODON_END|do so much repair work on their|save up for another] ship, what with them running an underground bar."

rows.original: Karrah smirks. “[flags.MASTODON_END|Don’t matter how long it takes. All the shit I haul to the port, every huge chunk of tech I have to hold up for someone to fit in, all of it will be fucking worth when we get off this rock.|Never said we were gonna buy it. But we’ll fly again someday. Maybe when things calm down and the Rush is over.]”
rows.translation: 卡拉得意地笑了。“[flags.MASTODON_END|花多久都无所谓。我搬去港口的每一堆破烂，为了让别人安装而托起的每一大块技术设备，等我们离开这块破石头时，这一切都他妈值得。|我可没说我们要花钱买。但我们总有一天会再次飞起来。也许是在局势平息、开拓潮结束以后。]”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah smirks. “[flags.MASTODON_END|Don’t matter how long it takes. All the shit I haul to the port, every huge chunk of tech I have to hold up for someone to fit in, all of it will be fucking worth when we get off this rock.|Never said we were gonna buy it. But we’ll fly again someday. Maybe when things calm down and the Rush is over.]”"

rows.original: She glances toward the bar’s heavy steel door, and gets a look in her eyes like she’s trying to see beyond it. “We’ll shut down the bar for the day, and that night, the door won’t open for anyone. And we’ll be gone. Flying again. Back out where we should be.”
rows.translation: 她望向酒吧厚重的钢门，眼神仿佛试图看穿门外。“我们会让酒吧停业一天，而到了那天晚上，这扇门不会为任何人打开。我们会离开。再次飞起来。回到我们该去的地方。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe glances toward the bar’s heavy steel door, and gets a look in her eyes like she’s trying to see beyond it. “We’ll shut down the bar for the day, and that night, the door won’t open for anyone. And we’ll be gone. Flying again. Back out where we should be.”"

rows.original: You ask Karrah how things have been going with the new ship. The thraggen woman pulls the armor over her hip aside, revealing a greenish-black bruise covering much of her right hip. “Fucking lighting panel fell on me a few days ago,” she grumbles. “Damn thing’s supposed to keep us alive out there, not try to kill us before we can even get it flying.” Ouch. But it’s worth it, isn’t it? To have a ship again? Karrah snorts, then grins at you, a kind of fierce glee in her expression. “You’re goddamn right it is, [pc.name]. That thing’s the difference between being stuck down here for the rest of our fucking lives and getting off this rock.” And it must be nice to have something to work on again. She talked about putting the bar together before, and it seemed like she liked doing that. She shrugs, then nods a little. “Yeah, kind of,” she says. “But we had to do that shit just to survive. Fixing the ship up? That gets us what we really want.” It seems like they’ve done pretty well here, not just survived. “I guess,” Karrah says, though it sounds like she doesn’t really want to admit it. “I got used to it, same as anything else. And I know things could have been much fucking worse for us. The net here always has some stories about girls who got picked up off the street — off-worlders, tourists or whatever, not locals — and then they show up at one of those damn corp milk bars, with torso-sized tits and drugged out of their fucking minds.” She shudders, her taut muscles twitching. “If someone tried that on us, when we first got here, we would have beat the shit out of them. But maybe that wouldn’t have been enough.” The thraggen woman takes a deep breath, making her boobs strain against her body armor, then lets it out slowly. “But we don’t have to worry about that shit anymore.” It’ll be a while before the ship’s done, right? Kiki talked about her repair plans when you dropped it off, and they were... extensive. “Oh, yeah. That thing’s nowhere near space-worthy yet.” Karrah starts counting off on her fingers. “We’re still waiting on stuff for both thrusters, plumbing, power, and there was this weird-as-fuck mold growing somewhere in life support.” She shudders. “I don’t know if it started growing faster once it was planet-side, but that shit was nasty.” That’s a new one. But who knows how many planets it had been to when Redd’s crew was using it. It could have picked up all kinds of things out there. “I know, but that stuff had fucking tentacles. It tried to grab me when I ripped it out.” Karrah shrugs. “Anyway, yeah, we’re still working hard on it.” She pats one of her biceps and the metal ring running around it. “Feels good to be sore from working on something again, not just from lifting or fucking. Haven’t been sore from fighting for a long time, but that’ll change once we’re out there again.” So the crew’s going back to piracy? It’s not like you expected any different, but after what happened before.... Karrah snorts. “We were fucking good pirates. You don’t stop doing something you’re good at just because one thing goes bad.” She looks past you, toward the door that leads out to the abandoned station. “Already got my eye on a couple of regulars who might make good crew. Monika needs to talk to them, but they’re tough and they seem smart. Long as they’re good in a fight, I’d say they’re in.” And you’re sure having an endless milk supply would make it easier to get a few zaika to join the new crew. “Can’t fucking hurt,” Karrah says with a chuckle. “Josie would be into it. Seems like she’s used to having her tits worshiped all the time now, maybe she doesn’t want to give it up.” She grunts. “And I want a steady stream of people to fuck who’ve got their parts in the right place.” You remember what she said before about wanting to leave. Having the ship makes it easier, though, right? Or does knowing they have so long before it’s done make it harder? “Being patient fucking sucks, but I can do it,” Karrah says, a low growl in the depths of her voice. “Getting parts to this rock ain’t easy or fast. Monika’s got a budget, probably the only way we’ll ever afford everything. Kiki’s got a parts list and some huge damn spreadsheet to show us when to do what, and Josie’s got... milk and a never-fucking-ending supply of smiles.” She barks a laugh. “And we need that shit too.” It sounds like they’ve got everything taken care of. All they need is time and parts. And credits, of course. Karrah holds up a hand. “We can’t take that,” she says. “Like Monika said, it’ll get the wrong attention if we suddenly start throwing around tons of credits.” The hardness in her eyes fades some, and she gives you a fang-baring smile. “You’ve done a lot for us already, [pc.name]. We’re used to handling things ourselves. So don’t worry. We can take care of the rest.”

rows.raw: "\n\nThen, you clench hard around Karrah’s hand, and start to push harder. She bares her teeth, and growls deep in her throat, but you manage to push her toward the table."

rows.original: With a roar, Karrah pushes hard back against you, but you brace for it and keep her hand from going anywhere. You keep shoving, forcing her arm down. Sweat breaks out on your brow as you strain against her, but somehow, you manage to shove her hand to the table.
rows.translation: 卡拉咆哮着朝你猛力反推，但你早有准备，让她的手无法移动半分。你不断发力，将她的手臂向下压。与她角力令你额头冒出汗珠，但不知怎的，你终于把她的手压到了桌面上。
rows.raw: "With a roar, Karrah pushes hard back against you, but you brace for it and keep her hand from going anywhere. You keep shoving, forcing her arm down. Sweat breaks out on your brow as you strain against her, but somehow, you manage to shove her hand to the table."

rows.original: Karrah howls as her knuckles strike steel, and the zaika gathered around you cheer. You let go of Karrah’s hand as soon as she’s down, then grin at her. So much for her being so sure she’d win.
rows.translation: 指关节撞上钢桌时，卡拉发出一声嚎叫，围在周围的扎伊卡人则欢呼起来。她的手一落下，你便立刻松开，随后冲她咧嘴一笑。看来她笃定自己会赢也不过如此。
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah howls as her knuckles strike steel, and the zaika gathered around you cheer. You let go of Karrah’s hand as soon as she’s down, then grin at her. So much for her being so sure she’d win."

rows.original: “Fuck,” Karrah spits, but she grins back at you a moment later. “You’re better than I thought.” She rubs at her hand for a moment, then cracks her knuckles and drops her elbow on the table again. “Next round!”
rows.translation: “操，”卡拉啐道，但片刻后也冲你咧嘴笑了。“你比我想象中更厉害。”她揉了揉手，随后掰响指关节，再次将手肘放到桌上。“下一局！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fuck,” Karrah spits, but she grins back at you a moment later. “You’re better than I thought.” She rubs at her hand for a moment, then cracks her knuckles and drops her elbow on the table again. “Next round!”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: With a roar, Karrah pushes hard back against you. You brace for it, but her sheer strength overcomes you, and she drives your hand back down toward the table. You keep shoving, trying to force her arm back up. Sweat breaks out on your brow as you strain against her, but despite your efforts, she shoves your hand to the table.
rows.translation: 卡拉咆哮着朝你猛力反推。你稳住手臂，但她纯粹的力量压倒了你，将你的手推回桌面。你继续发力，试图重新抬起她的手臂。与她角力令你额头冒出汗珠，但尽管竭尽全力，她还是把你的手压到了桌面上。
rows.raw: "With a roar, Karrah pushes hard back against you. You brace for it, but her sheer strength overcomes you, and she drives your hand back down toward the table. You keep shoving, trying to force her arm back up. Sweat breaks out on your brow as you strain against her, but despite your efforts, she shoves your hand to the table."

rows.original: Karrah howls as your knuckles strike steel, and the zaika gathered around you cheer. She lets go of your hand as soon as you’re down, then grins at you. You shake your hand out, soreness radiating from your shoulder to your fingertips.
rows.translation: 你的指关节撞上钢桌时，卡拉发出一声嚎叫，围在周围的扎伊卡人则欢呼起来。你的手一落下，她便立刻松开，随后冲你咧嘴一笑。你甩了甩手，从肩膀直到指尖都传来酸痛。
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah howls as your knuckles strike steel, and the zaika gathered around you cheer. She lets go of your hand as soon as you’re down, then grins at you. You shake your hand out, soreness radiating from your shoulder to your fingertips."

rows.original: “Told you,” Karrah says, but she grins at you a moment later. “You’re better than I thought, but not good enough.” She rubs at her hand for a moment, then cracks her knuckles and drops her elbow on the table again. “Next round!”
rows.translation: “早告诉你了，”卡拉说道，但片刻后也冲你咧嘴笑了。“你比我想象中更厉害，但还不够厉害。”她揉了揉手，随后掰响指关节，再次将手肘放到桌上。“下一局！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Told you,” Karrah says, but she grins at you a moment later. “You’re better than I thought, but not good enough.” She rubs at her hand for a moment, then cracks her knuckles and drops her elbow on the table again. “Next round!”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You did one round, you can definitely do another. You take hold of Karrah’s hand again, and wink at her as the two of you get lined up. She snarls back, but it doesn’t seem like she’s actually angry, just enjoying getting to flex her muscles like this.
rows.translation: 你已经比完一局，当然还能再来一局。你再次握住卡拉的手，在双方摆好姿势时朝她眨了眨眼。她冲你龇牙低吼，但似乎并未真的生气，只是在享受这样展示肌肉的机会。
rows.raw: "You did one round, you can definitely do another. You take hold of Karrah’s hand again, and wink at her as the two of you get lined up. She snarls back, but it doesn’t seem like she’s actually angry, just enjoying getting to flex her muscles like this."

rows.original: “You set?” Karrah asks, and you nod again. “Round two. Start in three... two... one!”
rows.translation: “准备好了吗？”卡拉问道，你再次点头。“第二局。倒数：三...二...一！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You set?” Karrah asks, and you nod again. “Round two. Start in three... two... one!”"

rows.original: Once again, Karrah shoves against your arm as soon as she starts, and you push back immediately. She doesn’t give any ground, her fingers clenching around your hand as the two of you struggle against each other. She glares at you from across the table, and you see beads of sweat start to drip down her forehead.
rows.translation: 和之前一样，卡拉一开始就猛力压向你的手臂，你也立刻推了回去。她寸步不让；你们相互角力时，她的手指紧紧扣住你的手。她隔着桌子怒视你，你看见汗珠开始沿她的额头滴落。
rows.raw: "\n\nOnce again, Karrah shoves against your arm as soon as she starts, and you push back immediately. She doesn’t give any ground, her fingers clenching around your hand as the two of you struggle against each other. She glares at you from across the table, and you see beads of sweat start to drip down her forehead."

rows.original: More zaika come over to watch, and they cheer as you and Karrah struggle. Some want you to win, others are rooting for her, still others just want to see someone win. At least one of them yells for you two to kiss.
rows.translation: 更多扎伊卡人过来围观，在你和卡拉角力时大声欢呼。有些人希望你赢，有些人为她加油，另一些只想看到有人获胜。至少有一个人在高喊让你们俩接吻。
rows.raw: "\n\nMore zaika come over to watch, and they cheer as you and Karrah struggle. Some want you to win, others are rooting for her, still others just want to see someone win. At least one of them yells for you two to kiss."

rows.original: Karrah snarls again, and her giant bicep flexes as she tries to force your hand down toward the table. You push against her, feeling your own muscles flex and tighten, and you grit your teeth as you fight the thraggen with everything you’ve got.
rows.translation: 卡拉再次龇牙低吼，试图将你的手压向桌面时，硕大的肱二头肌高高隆起。你顶住她，感受自己的肌肉绷紧鼓起，随后咬紧牙关，使出浑身解数与这个特拉根女人较量。
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah snarls again, and her giant bicep flexes as she tries to force your hand down toward the table. You push against her, feeling your own muscles flex and tighten, and you grit your teeth as you fight the thraggen with everything you’ve got."

rows.original: But no matter how hard Karrah pushes, you push back harder. It’s a long, slow struggle, but you start to force her arm down again. Her eyes go wide, like she can hardly believe you could beat her twice.
rows.translation: 然而不论卡拉使出多大力气，你都能以更大的力量推回去。这是一场漫长而缓慢的角力，但你开始再次将她的手臂向下压。她瞪大双眼，仿佛无法相信你竟能连续击败她两次。
rows.raw: "But no matter how hard Karrah pushes, you push back harder. It’s a long, slow struggle, but you start to force her arm down again. Her eyes go wide, like she can hardly believe you could beat her twice."

rows.original: “Not... this time, meat....” she gasps out, and roars as you force her arm farther down.
rows.translation: “这...次别想，小肉块....”她喘息着说道。你继续把她的手臂向下压时，她发出咆哮。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not... this time, meat....” she gasps out, and roars as you force her arm farther down."

rows.original: Your arm and shoulder muscles feel like they’re on fire, but you don’t let up for a second. Slowly, slowly, you push Karrah’s arm toward the table, until her knuckles touch the steel. Her arm goes limp all at once, and she howls again as the gathered zaika cheer.
rows.translation: 你的手臂与肩膀肌肉仿佛在燃烧，但一秒也没有松懈。你一点一点地将卡拉的手臂压向桌面，直到她的指关节触及钢铁。她的手臂突然彻底失去力气，在围观扎伊卡人的欢呼声中再次嚎叫起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour arm and shoulder muscles feel like they’re on fire, but you don’t let up for a second. Slowly, slowly, you push Karrah’s arm toward the table, until her knuckles touch the steel. Her arm goes limp all at once, and she howls again as the gathered zaika cheer."

rows.original: You stand up, thrusting both arms into the air, even though one of them hurts to move. The surrounding zaika slap you on the back and arms, a few of them brushing your [pc.legOrLegs] with their tails in some pretty obvious flirting. One of them calls for a round for you and Karrah, though she looks like she’s drunk off her ass so who knows if it’ll actually happen.
rows.translation: 你站起身，将双臂高举过头，尽管其中一条手臂动起来仍十分疼痛。周围的扎伊卡人拍打你的后背和手臂，其中几人用尾巴擦过你的[pc.legOrLegs]，调情意图明显得不能再明显。其中一人嚷着要请你和卡拉喝一轮，不过她看起来已经醉得不省人事，所以谁知道这话能不能兑现。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stand up, thrusting both arms into the air, even though one of them hurts to move. The surrounding zaika slap you on the back and arms, a few of them brushing your [pc.legOrLegs] with their tails in some pretty obvious flirting. One of them calls for a round for you and Karrah, though she looks like she’s drunk off her ass so who knows if it’ll actually happen."

rows.original: Karrah stands up with a grunt, and massages some life back into her arm, then holds her hand out for you to shake. “Not fucking bad, [pc.name],” she says, giving you a proud grin. “Didn’t think you had it in you.”
rows.translation: 卡拉哼了一声站起来，揉搓手臂让它恢复知觉，随后伸出手要与你相握。“真他妈不赖，[pc.name]，”她自豪地冲你咧嘴笑道。“没想到你真有这本事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah stands up with a grunt, and massages some life back into her arm, then holds her hand out for you to shake. “Not fucking bad, [pc.name],” she says, giving you a proud grin. “Didn’t think you had it in you.”"

rows.original: You tell her not to underestimate you, and she laughs, then cracks her knuckles again. “Thanks for the good time,” she says, then heads back to her post at the door.
rows.translation: 你告诉她别小看你，她笑了起来，又掰响指关节。“多谢让我玩得这么痛快，”她说道，随后返回门边的岗位。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her not to underestimate you, and she laughs, then cracks her knuckles again. “Thanks for the good time,” she says, then heads back to her post at the door."

rows.original: contests/karrah arm wrestle wins
rows.raw: "contests/karrah arm wrestle wins"

rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

Slowly, slowly, Karrah shoves your arm toward the table, until your knuckles touch the steel. Your arm goes limp all at once, and she raises her hands and howls as the gathered zaika cheer.
rows.translation: 你的手臂与肩膀肌肉仿佛在燃烧，只能竭力抵抗她。卡拉一点一点地将你的手臂压向桌面，直到指关节触及钢铁。你的手臂突然彻底失去力气，而她高举双手，在围观扎伊卡人的欢呼声中发出嚎叫。

Slowly, slowly, Karrah shoves your arm toward the table, until your knuckles touch the steel. Your arm goes limp all at once, and she raises her hands and howls as the gathered zaika cheer."

rows.original: You hold your arm to your chest, and try to massage some life back into it. Your wrist feels like it’s going to be sore for days. The surrounding zaika cheer and chatter, some of them taking bets on who’s going to win the final round, with promises of drinks and credits and sex. One of them calls for a round for whoever wins the last round, though she looks like she’s drunk off her ass so who knows if it’ll actually happen.
rows.translation: 你将手臂抱在胸前，试着揉搓它恢复知觉。手腕感觉要连续疼上好几天。周围的扎伊卡人欢呼议论着，有些人开始押注谁会赢下最终局，赌注包括酒、信用点和性爱。其中一人嚷着要请最后的胜者喝一轮，不过她看起来已经醉得不省人事，所以谁知道这话能不能兑现。

The surrounding zaika cheer and chatter, some of them taking bets on who’s going to win the final round, with promises of drinks and credits and sex. One of them calls for a round for whoever wins the last round, though she looks like she’s drunk off her ass so who knows if it’ll actually happen."

rows.original: Karrah shakes out her shoulders with a grunt, and punches her own arm a few times, then drops her elbow onto the table one last time. “Final round, meat,” she says, giving you a proud grin. “Unless you wanna back out now.”
rows.translation: 卡拉哼了一声，抖动肩膀，又朝自己的手臂捶了几拳，随后最后一次把手肘放上桌面。“最后一局，小肉块，”她自豪地冲你咧嘴笑道。“除非你想现在退出。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah shakes out her shoulders with a grunt, and punches her own arm a few times, then drops her elbow onto the table one last time. “Final round, meat,” she says, giving you a proud grin. “Unless you wanna back out now.”"

rows.original: You tell her there’s no chance of that. She laughs, then cracks her knuckles again. “Good,” she says, then holds her hand out for one last time.
rows.translation: 你告诉她绝不可能。她笑了起来，又掰响指关节。“很好，”她说道，随后最后一次伸出手。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her there’s no chance of that. She laughs, then cracks her knuckles again. “Good,” she says, then holds her hand out for one last time."

rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.translation: 卡拉哼了一声站起来，揉搓手臂让它恢复知觉，随后伸出手要与你相握。“真他妈不赖，[pc.name]，”她自豪地冲你咧嘴笑道。“没想到你真有这本事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah stands up with a grunt, and massages some life back into her arm, then holds her hand out for you to shake. “Not fucking bad, [pc.name],” she says, giving you a proud grin. “Didn’t think you had it in you.”"

rows.original: You tell her not to underestimate you, and she laughs, then cracks her knuckles again. “Good,” she says, then holds her hand out for one last time.
rows.translation: 你告诉她别小看你，她笑了起来，又掰响指关节。“很好，”她说道，随后最后一次伸出手。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her not to underestimate you, and she laughs, then cracks her knuckles again. “Good,” she says, then holds her hand out for one last time."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: But no matter how hard Karrah pushes, you push back harder. It’s a long, slow struggle, but you start to force her arm down again. Her eyes go wide, like she can hardly believe you could make a comeback.
rows.translation: 然而不论卡拉使出多大力气，你都能以更大的力量推回去。这是一场漫长而缓慢的角力，但你开始再次将她的手臂向下压。她瞪大双眼，仿佛无法相信你竟能扳回一城。
rows.raw: "But no matter how hard Karrah pushes, you push back harder. It’s a long, slow struggle, but you start to force her arm down again. Her eyes go wide, like she can hardly believe you could make a comeback."

rows.original: “Not... this time, meat....” she gasps out, and roars as she forces your arm back toward the table.
rows.translation: “这...次别想，小肉块....”她喘息着说道，随后咆哮着将你的手臂反推向桌面。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not... this time, meat....” she gasps out, and roars as she forces your arm back toward the table."

rows.original: Your arm and shoulder muscles feel like they’re on fire, and you struggle to push back against her. Slowly, slowly, Karrah shoves your arm toward the table, until your knuckles touch the steel. Your arm goes limp all at once, and she raises her hands and howls as the gathered zaika cheer.
rows.translation: 你的手臂与肩膀肌肉仿佛在燃烧，只能竭力抵抗她。卡拉一点一点地将你的手臂压向桌面，直到指关节触及钢铁。你的手臂突然彻底失去力气，而她高举双手，在围观扎伊卡人的欢呼声中发出嚎叫。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour arm and shoulder muscles feel like they’re on fire, and you struggle to push back against her. Slowly, slowly, Karrah shoves your arm toward the table, until your knuckles touch the steel. Your arm goes limp all at once, and she raises her hands and howls as the gathered zaika cheer."

rows.original: You hold your arm to your chest, and try to massage some life back into it. Your wrist feels like it’s going to be sore for days. The surrounding zaika slap Karrah on her back and arms, a few of them brushing her legs with their tails in some pretty obvious flirting. One of them calls for a round for you and Karrah, though she looks like she’s drunk off her ass so who knows if it’ll actually happen.
rows.translation: 你将手臂抱在胸前，试着揉搓它恢复知觉。手腕感觉要连续疼上好几天。周围的扎伊卡人拍打卡拉的后背和手臂，其中几人用尾巴擦过她的双腿，调情意图明显得不能再明显。其中一人嚷着要请你和卡拉喝一轮，不过她看起来已经醉得不省人事，所以谁知道这话能不能兑现。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou hold your arm to your chest, and try to massage some life back into it. Your wrist feels like it’s going to be sore for days. The surrounding zaika slap Karrah on her back and arms, a few of them brushing her legs with their tails in some pretty obvious flirting. One of them calls for a round for you and Karrah, though she looks like she’s drunk off her ass so who knows if it’ll actually happen."

rows.original: Karrah shakes out her shoulders with a grunt, and punches her own arm a few times, then stands up and grins at you. “Told you that’d happen, meat,” she says, then runs her tongue over her tusks.
rows.translation: 卡拉哼了一声，抖动肩膀，又朝自己的手臂捶了几拳，随后站起来冲你咧嘴一笑。“早告诉你会是这个结果了，小肉块，”她说着用舌头舔过獠牙。
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah shakes out her shoulders with a grunt, and punches her own arm a few times, then stands up and grins at you. “Told you that’d happen, meat,” she says, then runs her tongue over her tusks."

rows.original: “You ever want another beatdown, just say the word,” Karrah says, then strides out of the bar, leaving you to your soreness.
rows.translation: “以后还想再挨一次揍，尽管开口，”卡拉说完便大步走出酒吧，只留下浑身酸痛的你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You ever want another beatdown, just say the word,” Karrah says, then strides out of the bar, leaving you to your soreness."

rows.original: contests/karrah arm wrestle losses
rows.raw: "contests/karrah arm wrestle losses"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You take hold of Karrah’s hand, and stare at her across the table. She looks determined, baring her teeth, her brow furrowed beneath her mohawk. The zaika gathered around you two seem almost tense, waiting to see who comes out ahead in this last round.
rows.translation: 你握住卡拉的手，隔着桌子凝视她。她看起来意志坚定，露出牙齿，莫西干发型下的眉头紧紧皱起。围在你们身边的扎伊卡人似乎也紧张起来，等待看谁能赢下这最后一局。
rows.raw: "You take hold of Karrah’s hand, and stare at her across the table. She looks determined, baring her teeth, her brow furrowed beneath her mohawk. The zaika gathered around you two seem almost tense, waiting to see who comes out ahead in this last round."

rows.original: “You good?” Karrah asks, and you nod. “Finisher,” she snaps. “On three... two... one!”
rows.translation: “准备好了吗？”卡拉问道，你点点头。“决胜局，”她厉声说道。“倒数：三...二...一！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You good?” Karrah asks, and you nod. “Finisher,” she snaps. “On three... two... one!”"

rows.original: You shove your arm against hers as hard as you can once she finishes counting, and she fights right back. The two of you struggle against each other, neither able to move at all. Sweat drips onto the steel table as you each try to force the other down.
rows.translation: 她一数完，你便使尽全力将手臂压向她，她也立刻奋力反击。你们相互角力，谁都无法移动分毫。当双方都试图把对方压倒时，汗珠滴落在钢桌上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shove your arm against hers as hard as you can once she finishes counting, and she fights right back. The two of you struggle against each other, neither able to move at all. Sweat drips onto the steel table as you each try to force the other down."

rows.original: Karrah’s teeth are bared, her tusks on full display, her lips peeled back as she concentrates. The muscles in her neck stand out in thick cords, but her arm is steady as a rock, barely able to make you move and not giving an inch.
rows.translation: 卡拉露出牙齿，獠牙完全显露，集中精神时双唇向后咧开。她颈部的肌肉像粗绳一样凸起，但手臂依旧稳如磐石，既只能勉强让你移动，也绝不退让半分。
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah’s teeth are bared, her tusks on full display, her lips peeled back as she concentrates. The muscles in her neck stand out in thick cords, but her arm is steady as a rock, barely able to make you move and not giving an inch."

rows.original: Your hand feels like it’s about to break off. You take a deep breath, and keep fighting, all the muscles in your and arm straining to stay upright. No matter what, you’re not going to lose this one.
rows.translation: 你的手仿佛就要断掉。你深吸一口气，继续奋战，手臂上的每块肌肉都竭力维持直立。无论如何，你都不会输掉这一局。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour hand feels like it’s about to break off. You take a deep breath, and keep fighting, all the muscles in your and arm straining to stay upright. No matter what, you’re not going to lose this one."

rows.original: You fix your gaze on Karrah, and start to grin at her as you push. A strained laugh escapes you, and just for a second, you see confusion flicker across her green face. She doesn’t know why you’re laughing. You don’t either, but you push harder, willing to take the advantage.
rows.translation: 你紧盯卡拉，一边发力，一边开始冲她咧嘴笑。一声勉强的笑从你口中溢出；短短一瞬间，你看见困惑掠过她绿色的脸庞。她不知道你为什么在笑。你也不知道，但你进一步用力，决心抓住优势。
rows.raw: "You fix your gaze on Karrah, and start to grin at her as you push. A strained laugh escapes you, and just for a second, you see confusion flicker across her green face. She doesn’t know why you’re laughing. You don’t either, but you push harder, willing to take the advantage."

rows.original: “What’s... so funny,” Karrah grates out, the words barely fitting between her clenched teeth. She starts to struggle, and you realize you’ve broken her concentration.
rows.translation: “有...什么好笑的，”卡拉从紧咬的牙缝间艰难挤出这几个词。她开始动摇，你意识到自己已经打断了她的专注。
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s... so funny,” Karrah grates out, the words barely fitting between her clenched teeth. She starts to struggle, and you realize you’ve broken her concentration."

rows.original: You push down hard all at once, and Karrah’s hand moves an inch or two back. She gasps, and that’s all you need. You feel her try to redouble her efforts, but you have her now.
rows.translation: 你突然使出全力向下压，卡拉的手向后移动了一两英寸。她倒吸一口气，而你需要的正是这个。你感觉她试图加倍用力，但现在她已经逃不出你的掌控。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou push down hard all at once, and Karrah’s hand moves an inch or two back. She gasps, and that’s all you need. You feel her try to redouble her efforts, but you have her now."

rows.original: Slowly, slowly, you force her hand toward the table. She strains against you even harder as she gets closer, and your shoulder feels like it’s about to pop out of its socket, but finally, Karrah’s knuckles hit the steel.
rows.translation: 你一点一点地将她的手压向桌面。距离越近，她的抵抗就越猛烈，你的肩膀感觉几乎要从关节窝里脱出，但最终，卡拉的指关节还是撞上了钢铁。
rows.raw: "\n\nSlowly, slowly, you force her hand toward the table. She strains against you even harder as she gets closer, and your shoulder feels like it’s about to pop out of its socket, but finally, Karrah’s knuckles hit the steel."

rows.original: You let go of her, and she throws her head back and roars, sweat covering her face. The gathered zaika cheer for you, and someone slaps a mug of creme liquor down on the table in front of you. You grab the drink with the hand that didn’t just force down a thraggen, and down it all in one long gulp.
rows.translation: 你松开她，她仰头发出咆哮，脸上布满汗水。围在周围的扎伊卡人为你欢呼，有人将一大杯奶油利口酒重重放在你面前的桌上。你用刚才没有压倒特拉根人的那只手抓起酒杯，一口气全部灌了下去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou let go of her, and she throws her head back and roars, sweat covering her face. The gathered zaika cheer for you, and someone slaps a mug of creme liquor down on the table in front of you. You grab the drink with the hand that didn’t just force down a thraggen, and down it all in one long gulp."

rows.original: Karrah raises her hand, then reaches out and claps you on the shoulder. “That was a hell of a thing, [pc.name],” she says. “I didn’t think you had it in you, not for all three rounds.”
rows.translation: 卡拉抬起手，随后伸过来拍了拍你的肩膀。“真他妈精彩，[pc.name]，”她说道。“没想到你真有这本事，更没想到你三局都能撑下来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah raises her hand, then reaches out and claps you on the shoulder. “That was a hell of a thing, [pc.name],” she says. “I didn’t think you had it in you, not for all three rounds.”"

rows.original: All around you, the zaika cheer and clap, and you see credits and drinks exchanging hands. You tell Karrah that she shouldn’t underestimate you.
rows.translation: 周围的扎伊卡人都在欢呼鼓掌，你看见信用点和酒水在人群中易手。你告诉卡拉，她不该低估你。
rows.raw: "\n\nAll around you, the zaika cheer and clap, and you see credits and drinks exchanging hands. You tell Karrah that she shouldn’t underestimate you."

rows.original: “Damn right,” Karrah says, and gets to her feet. “I’ll get you next time, you bet your ass.” She rubs at her arm, then nods to you, and heads back to the bar’s door.
rows.translation: “说得他妈没错，”卡拉说着站起身。“下次我会赢回来，你就等着吧。”她揉了揉手臂，随后向你点头，返回酒吧门边。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn right,” Karrah says, and gets to her feet. “I’ll get you next time, you bet your ass.” She rubs at her arm, then nods to you, and heads back to the bar’s door."

rows.original: contests/karrah arm wrestle wins
rows.raw: "contests/karrah arm wrestle wins"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You fix your gaze on Karrah, and start to grin at her as you push. A strained laugh escapes you, and just for a second, you see confusion flicker across her green face. She doesn’t know why you’re laughing. You don’t either, but you push harder, willing to take the advantage.
rows.translation: 你紧盯卡拉，一边发力，一边开始冲她咧嘴笑。一声勉强的笑从你口中溢出；短短一瞬间，你看见困惑掠过她绿色的脸庞。她不知道你为什么在笑。你也不知道，但你进一步用力，决心抓住优势。
rows.raw: "You fix your gaze on Karrah, and start to grin at her as you push. A strained laugh escapes you, and just for a second, you see confusion flicker across her green face. She doesn’t know why you’re laughing. You don’t either, but you push harder, willing to take the advantage."

rows.original: “Nothing... funny... about getting your ass kicked,” Karrah grates out, the words barely fitting between her clenched teeth. She gives your hand a shove, and suddenly your concentration is broken.
rows.translation: “被痛揍一顿...可没...什么好笑的，”卡拉从紧咬的牙缝间艰难挤出这几个词。她猛推你的手，你的专注顿时被打断。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nothing... funny... about getting your ass kicked,” Karrah grates out, the words barely fitting between her clenched teeth. She gives your hand a shove, and suddenly your concentration is broken."

rows.original: You push back hard all at once, and Karrah’s hand still won’t move. She forces you down another inch or two, and that’s all she needs. You try to redouble your efforts, but she has you now.
rows.translation: 你突然使出全力反推，卡拉的手却依旧纹丝不动。她又将你的手向下压了一两英寸，而她需要的正是这个。你试图加倍用力，但现在你已经逃不出她的掌控。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou push back hard all at once, and Karrah’s hand still won’t move. She forces you down another inch or two, and that’s all she needs. You try to redouble your efforts, but she has you now."

rows.original: Slowly, slowly, the thraggen woman forces your hand toward the table. You strain against her even harder as she gets closer, and your shoulder feels like it’s about to pop out of its socket, but finally, your knuckles hit the steel.
rows.translation: 这个特拉根女人一点一点地将你的手压向桌面。距离越近，你的抵抗就越猛烈，肩膀感觉几乎要从关节窝里脱出，但最终，你的指关节还是撞上了钢铁。
rows.raw: "\n\nSlowly, slowly, the thraggen woman forces your hand toward the table. You strain against her even harder as she gets closer, and your shoulder feels like it’s about to pop out of its socket, but finally, your knuckles hit the steel."

rows.original: Karrah lets go of you, and throws her head back and roars in victory, sweat covering her face. The gathered zaika cheer for her, and someone slaps a mug of creme liquor down on the table in front of her. She grabs the drink with the hand that just forced yours down, and drains the whole thing in one long gulp.
rows.translation: 卡拉松开你，仰头发出胜利的咆哮，脸上布满汗水。围在周围的扎伊卡人为她欢呼，有人将一大杯奶油利口酒重重放在她面前的桌上。她用刚才压倒你的那只手抓起酒杯，一口气全部灌了下去。
rows.raw: "\n\nKarrah lets go of you, and throws her head back and roars in victory, sweat covering her face. The gathered zaika cheer for her, and someone slaps a mug of creme liquor down on the table in front of her. She grabs the drink with the hand that just forced yours down, and drains the whole thing in one long gulp."

rows.original: After waiting a moment for you to recover, Karrah raises her hand, then reaches out and claps you on the shoulder. “Not a fucking bad fight, [pc.name],” she says. “I didn’t think you had it in you to go all three rounds with me.”
rows.translation: 等了片刻，让你缓过来后，卡拉抬起手，随后伸过来拍了拍你的肩膀。“打得真他妈不赖，[pc.name]，”她说道。“没想到你真有本事和我打满三局。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter waiting a moment for you to recover, Karrah raises her hand, then reaches out and claps you on the shoulder. “Not a fucking bad fight, [pc.name],” she says. “I didn’t think you had it in you to go all three rounds with me.”"

rows.original: All around you, the zaika cheer and clap, and you see credits and drinks exchanging hands. You tell Karrah that she shouldn’t underestimate you, even if you did lose.
rows.translation: 周围的扎伊卡人都在欢呼鼓掌，你看见信用点和酒水在人群中易手。你告诉卡拉，就算你输了，她也不该低估你。
rows.raw: "\n\nAll around you, the zaika cheer and clap, and you see credits and drinks exchanging hands. You tell Karrah that she shouldn’t underestimate you, even if you did lose."

rows.original: “Damn right,” Karrah says, and gets to her feet. “You let me know whenever you want to go again.” She rubs at her arm, then nods to you, and heads back to the bar’s door.
rows.translation: “说得他妈没错，”卡拉说着站起身。“以后想再比一场，随时告诉我。”她揉了揉手臂，随后向你点头，返回酒吧门边。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn right,” Karrah says, and gets to her feet. “You let me know whenever you want to go again.” She rubs at her arm, then nods to you, and heads back to the bar’s door."

rows.original: contests/karrah arm wrestle losses
rows.raw: "contests/karrah arm wrestle losses"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You tell Karrah you’ll talk to her later. She gives you a grunt and a nod.
rows.translation: 你告诉卡拉以后再聊。她哼了一声，点点头。
rows.raw: "You tell Karrah you’ll talk to her later. She gives you a grunt and a nod."

rows.original: “Watch your ass out there,” she says.
rows.translation: “在外面小心你的屁股，”她说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Watch your ass out there,” she says."

rows.original: She then bares a fang as she grins at you. “Wouldn’t want anything to happen to an ass like yours”
rows.translation: 随后她露出一根獠牙，冲你咧嘴笑道。“可不能让你这么棒的屁股出什么事”
rows.raw: " She then bares a fang as she grins at you. “Wouldn’t want anything to happen to an ass like yours”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You walk over to the horseshoe-shaped bar, heading for the half that the purple-haired kaithrit woman is working. The bar itself looks like it was cobbled together from spare parts from a ship lounge, like someone hacked a dozen different pieces of furniture apart and somehow put it all together as one piece and made it work. The top of it is made of several tables cut into pieces and bolted together, and it’s splattered with dozens of small drops of various colors, along with rings of liquid where drinks once sat.
rows.translation: 你走向马蹄形吧台，来到那个紫发凯斯瑞特女人负责的一半。吧台本身看起来像是用飞船休息室的备用零件拼凑而成，仿佛有人拆散十几件不同的家具，又设法将它们组装成一个能够使用的整体。台面由几张桌子切割成块后栓接而成，上面溅着几十滴颜色各异的小液滴，还留着曾经摆放酒杯形成的一圈圈液体痕迹。
rows.raw: "You walk over to the horseshoe-shaped bar, heading for the half that the purple-haired kaithrit woman is working. The bar itself looks like it was cobbled together from spare parts from a ship lounge, like someone hacked a dozen different pieces of furniture apart and somehow put it all together as one piece and made it work. The top of it is made of several tables cut into pieces and bolted together, and it’s splattered with dozens of small drops of various colors, along with rings of liquid where drinks once sat."

rows.original: The woman looks up as you approach, and tilts her head, giving you an analytical gaze. She looks like she’s in her late twenties, maybe early thirties, fair-skinned and toned and clad in a sleeveless, high-necked gray top and some sturdy blue pants with red trim. Much like the bouncer, she’s well-armed; a wide belt slung around her curvy hips has a pistol and a longer gun hanging from it, and the metal band wrapped around her right hand looks like a stunner.
rows.translation: 你走近时，那个女人抬起头，歪着脑袋，用审视的目光打量你。她看起来接近三十岁，或许刚过三十，肤色白皙，身体健美，穿着无袖高领灰色上衣和带红边的结实蓝裤。她和门卫一样全副武装；一条宽腰带环在曲线玲珑的臀部，上面挂着一把手枪和一把较长的枪，右手缠着的金属带看起来像电击器。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman looks up as you approach, and tilts her head, giving you an analytical gaze. She looks like she’s in her late twenties, maybe early thirties, fair-skinned and toned and clad in a sleeveless, high-necked gray top and some sturdy blue pants with red trim. Much like the bouncer, she’s well-armed; a wide belt slung around her curvy hips has a pistol and a longer gun hanging from it, and the metal band wrapped around her right hand looks like a stunner."

rows.original: Her long purple hair is held back by a black and silver bandanna, and her right cheek is marred by a scar that reaches from her temple to her jawline. Above that scar is a cybernetic eye, bright blue and rimmed with steel, with a few horizontal metal lines leading from it to reach across her temple. Her other eye is natural and bright green, fixing you with a sharp stare. She’s got plenty of chest, if nowhere near as much as the cowgirl next to her, and there’s a bulge in her pants that’s wide enough to reach partway across her thighs.

rows.raw: "Monika points with her tails toward a green, triangle-shaped bottle on the top shelf. “Gel-ruun is good stuff, made by galotians. Not too strong, but good luck finding anything else that tastes like it. Only seventy-five credits, so it’s a popular one here.”"

rows.original: You tell Monika you’d like the Gel-ruun. She reaches back with her tails and snags the bottle off the shelf, then chuckles as she brings it around to the bar. “Funny story about this stuff,” she says as she grabs a short glass from beneath the bar. “From what I’ve heard, it’s hard to get most galotians to do much work on anything but sucking someone off. But there was someone who thought their gooey bodies would be good for brewing. Some chemist got it in their head that they could mix stuff like no barrel or keg ever could.” Monika pops the top off the bottle, and pours out a thick, syrupy liquid that has a kind of rainbow glaze to it, catching the bar’s lights and reflecting them back in dozens of colors. Once the glass is full, Monika swipes your credit chit and slides the glass over to you. “The way I heard it, it took some doing to get the galotians in on the idea, but once they got the hang of it, they turned out to be pretty good at it,” Monika says. “Though there’s lots of people who wonder just how much time the galotians spend mixing drinks and how much time they spend drinking the other people working there.” You down the drink. It’s smooth, and goes down easily, though you’re not sure how you’d describe the taste. It’s like a dozen different kinds of spices and sugars all at once, just short of being too sweet, without ever going overboard. The alcohol content’s not too heavy, but you can see why the locals like this stuff.
rows.translation: 你告诉莫妮卡想来一杯格尔-鲁恩。她用尾巴从架子上勾下酒瓶，随后将它转到吧台边时轻声笑了起来。 “关于这东西，还有个有趣的故事，”她说着从吧台下取出一只矮玻璃杯。“据我听说，除了给人吹箫以外，很难让大多数加洛提亚人认真做任何工作。不过有人认为，她们黏糊糊的身体很适合酿酒。某个化学家突然想到，她们能以任何酒桶都比不上的方式混合原料。” 莫妮卡弹开瓶盖，倒出一种浓稠如糖浆的液体，表面带着彩虹般的光泽；它捕捉酒吧灯光，又以数十种颜色将其反射回来。杯子倒满后，莫妮卡刷过你的信用芯片，将酒杯推到你面前。 “照我听到的说法，要让加洛提亚人接受这个主意费了不少功夫，但等她们掌握诀窍后，做得还真不错，”莫妮卡说道。“不过很多人都想知道，加洛提亚人究竟花多少时间调酒，又花多少时间把在那里工作的其他人喝进肚子。” 你一口喝下杯中酒。它口感顺滑，十分容易入口，尽管你不知道该如何形容它的味道。那感觉像十几种香料与糖同时交融，甜度几乎过头，却始终没有真正越界。酒精含量不算太高，但你明白本地人为何喜欢这种东西。

rows.original: Rex Pistol
rows.raw: "Rex Pistol"

rows.original: She then points toward a tall, red bottle with a gaudy label and a large sphere at the bottom, filled with something so pale it makes the glass look almost pink. A smirk crosses her face. “That’s the Rex Pistol. It’s ausar-made, and a favorite of mine. Hundred-fifty credits and worth every one.”
rows.translation: 随后，她指向一只高挑的红色酒瓶。瓶上贴着俗艳标签，底部还有一个大球体；里面装的东西颜色极淡，让玻璃看起来近乎粉红。她脸上掠过一丝坏笑。“那是雷克斯手枪。奥萨尔人酿的，也是我的最爱。一百五十信用点，每一点都花得值。”
rows.raw: "She then points toward a tall, red bottle with a gaudy label and a large sphere at the bottom, filled with something so pale it makes the glass look almost pink. A smirk crosses her face. “That’s the Rex Pistol. It’s ausar-made, and a favorite of mine. Hundred-fifty credits and worth every one.”"

rows.original: You order a Rex Pistol. Monika barks a laugh, then whips the bottle down with her tails. Once it’s on the bar, she sets it on its side and spins it, then grabs a tall, narrow glass from beneath the bar. She watches as the bottle’s pointed end goes around and around, then catches it and flips it over her hand, putting the rounded bottom down next to the glass. “I’m pretty sure I don’t need to explain why this one has its name,” she says, and smirks at you. “I swear, it feels like the ausar are playing a joke on the rest of the galaxy with stuff like this.” She leans in a little closer to you. “If you look close at the label, you can see where it says not to use the bottle for anything other than drinking out of it.” Monika pops the pointed top off of the red bottle, then pours the pale fluid inside into your glass, filling it slowly. It foams a little as she fills the glass, so there’s a bubbly head on top of the drink she slides over to you. She swipes your credit chit, then caps the bottle and runs her fingers over the rounded bottom while she waits for you to drink. You raise the glass to your lips. The drink has a faintly milky smell, though there’s something else about it that you can’t place. The scent of alcohol hits you hard, though, and that only grows stronger as you drink it. When you lower your glass, Monika smirks at you. “Was it good for you too?” she asks, then laughs as she returns the bottle to the shelf.
rows.translation: 你点了一杯雷克斯手枪。莫妮卡放声大笑，随后用尾巴猛地将酒瓶取下来。瓶子落到吧台上后，她让它侧躺着旋转，又从吧台下取出一只细长的高脚杯。她看着酒瓶尖锐的一端转了一圈又一圈，随后将其接住，从手掌上方翻转，让圆润的瓶底落在杯子旁边。 “我很确定，不用解释这酒为什么叫这个名字，”她说着冲你坏笑。“我发誓，奥萨尔人做出这种东西，简直是在拿银河系其他人开玩笑。”她朝你靠近了一点。“仔细看标签，你会发现上面写着，不得将酒瓶用于饮用之外的任何用途。” 莫妮卡弹开红色酒瓶尖锐的瓶盖，将里面浅色的液体倒进你的杯子，慢慢将其注满。倒酒时液体微微起泡，因此她推到你面前的饮料顶部浮着一层气泡。她刷过你的信用芯片，随后盖好瓶子；等你喝酒时，她用手指抚过圆润的瓶底。 你将酒杯举到唇边。饮料带着淡淡的乳香，但其中还有一种你分辨不出的味道。浓烈的酒精气味猛烈冲击着你，而且饮用时只会变得更加强烈。 你放下酒杯时，莫妮卡冲你坏笑。“你也觉得很爽吗？”她问道，随后笑着把酒瓶放回架子。

rows.original: Monika turns and holds her tails out toward a third bottle, dark brown and twisting, with a topper that looks like the round end of an old-fashioned key. “This stuff’s an acquired taste, but I’ve got some people who swear by it. It’s a dzaan drink, called Locket.” She shrugs one shoulder. “I think the name loses something in translation. I heard it’s supposed to be something about keeping someone close to you.” She gives you a serious look. “This stuff’s not easy to get, so that’ll run you two hundred credits, but it’s worth it.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡转过身，把尾巴伸向第三个瓶子。那只瓶子呈深棕色，瓶身扭曲，瓶塞看起来像老式钥匙圆润的尾端。“这东西得慢慢培养口味，不过有些人对它推崇备至。它是德赞人的酒，名叫‘心锁’。”她耸了耸一边肩膀。“我觉得这个名字翻译后失去了一些含义。听说它原本指的是把某个人留在自己身边。”她认真地看着你。“这东西不好弄，所以要收你两百信用点，不过物有所值。”
rows.raw: "Monika turns and holds her tails out toward a third bottle, dark brown and twisting, with a topper that looks like the round end of an old-fashioned key. “This stuff’s an acquired taste, but I’ve got some people who swear by it. It’s a dzaan drink, called Locket.” She shrugs one shoulder. “I think the name loses something in translation. I heard it’s supposed to be something about keeping someone close to you.” She gives you a serious look. “This stuff’s not easy to get, so that’ll run you two hundred credits, but it’s worth it.”"

rows.original: You tell Monika you’d like a Locket. She nods to you, her natural eye half-closed, then grabs the brown bottle from the shelf. “Never got to the dzaan homeworld,” she muses as she unscrews the key-shaped cap. “Can’t say if I’d ever want to go, either. Something about them always seemed a little off to me.” She pulls what looks like a short wineglass from beneath the bar, and slowly pours the Locket into it. The liquid is nearly as dark brown as the bottle, and the faint scents of caramel and cinnamon reach you as she pours. She swipes your credit chit, then gently hands the glass to you. “This is probably the fanciest stuff we have,” she says. “Don’t think I’ve ever seen a dzaan walk through my door, but I’d offer this if one did. Would be nice to make back more of what I paid for it.” She glances at the bottle’s label, which shows a tall dzaan woman with four or five shorter women around her, adoration clear on their faces. The background is a chain with a locket at the bottom. You tip up the glass and drink. The combination of caramel and cinnamon works surprisingly well, and the liquor slides down your throat with ease, smooth and strangely calming. You can see why people are willing to pay more for this drink, and it’s definitely finer than anything you expected to find here. “It is good stuff,” Monika says, then frowns a little. “Can’t help thinking it’s made by girls in someone’s harem, though, and I just hope they’re there because they want to be.” She puts the bottle away, a contemplative look on her face.
rows.translation: 你告诉莫妮卡，想来一杯心锁。她朝你点点头，天生的那只眼半闭着，随后从架上取下棕色瓶子。“我从没去过德赞母星，”她一边拧开钥匙形瓶盖，一边沉思道。“也说不好自己是否愿意去。她们总让我觉得有点不对劲。” 她从吧台下取出一个看起来像矮脚葡萄酒杯的杯子，慢慢倒入心锁。液体几乎与瓶身一样深棕，倒酒时，淡淡的焦糖和肉桂香飘到你鼻端。她刷过你的信用芯片，随后轻轻把酒杯递给你。 “这大概是我们这里最高档的东西，”她说。“我好像从没见过德赞人走进这扇门，不过要是真来了，我会给她推荐这个。能多收回一点本钱就好了。”她瞥了一眼瓶上标签：一名高大的德赞女人身边围着四五名较矮的女人，她们脸上满是爱慕。背景是一条链子，底端垂着一枚盒坠。 你仰起酒杯一饮而尽。焦糖与肉桂的组合意外协调，酒液轻松滑过喉咙，口感顺滑，令人莫名平静。你能理解人们为何愿意为这种酒多付钱；它确实比你预想中能在这里找到的任何东西都精致。 “确实是好东西，”莫妮卡说着，微微皱眉。“可我总忍不住觉得，它是某人后宫里的姑娘酿出来的。我只希望她们是自愿待在那里的。”她收起酒瓶，露出若有所思的神情。

rows.original: Wilson’s
rows.raw: "Wilson’s"

rows.original: Her tails shift down toward the bottom of the wall of booze, to a plain steel bottle with a label that’s nothing but words in a bold, generic font. “Or if you just want to get drunk, we’ve got Wilson’s,” she says. “Drink enough and it might start to taste like something. Fifty creds a pop.”
rows.translation: 她的尾巴移向酒墙底部一个朴素的钢瓶，标签上只有用粗体通用字体印出的文字。“如果你只想喝醉，我们还有威尔逊，”她说。“喝得够多，它说不定就开始有味道了。每杯五十信用点。”
rows.raw: "Her tails shift down toward the bottom of the wall of booze, to a plain steel bottle with a label that’s nothing but words in a bold, generic font. “Or if you just want to get drunk, we’ve got Wilson’s,” she says. “Drink enough and it might start to taste like something. Fifty creds a pop.”"

rows.original: You tell Monika you’d like the Wilson’s. She cracks a wry grin as she reaches for the bottle, then pulls out a shot glass from beneath the bar. “Cheap booze at an underground bar. Good to know you’re living the rusher life properly.” She chuckles at her joke, then unscrews the bottle’s cap and sloshes the pale liquid into the shot glass. “Trust me,” she says, “an actual glass of this will knock most people on their asses. But if you just want to get drunk and don’t care how bad the hangover is, you’ve got the right stuff.” She swipes your credit chit and slides the shot over to you, and you raise it and down it all at once. The booze has almost no taste, and while it goes down easy, the aftertaste is nothing but alcohol and you have to hold back a cough. You’ve drank worse, but you’ve definitely drank a lot better. “And that,” Monika says, still grinning, “is how we make sure nobody tries to start a drinking contest down here. Once I pull this stuff out, only the most hardcore wouldn’t walk away.” She pauses. “Not that the locals have ever tried to have a drinking contest, but you get the idea.”
rows.translation: 你告诉莫妮卡，想来一杯威尔逊。她坏笑着伸手去拿瓶子，又从吧台下取出一只烈酒杯。 “地下酒吧里的廉价酒。看来你很懂得如何过好开拓者生活。”她为自己的笑话轻笑，旋开瓶盖，把浅色液体倒进烈酒杯。“相信我，”她说，“正常喝上一杯，足以把大多数人放倒。但如果你只想灌醉自己，根本不在乎宿醉多难受，那就选对了。” 她刷过你的信用芯片，将酒杯滑给你。你举杯一口灌下。酒几乎没有味道，入口虽然轻松，余味却只有酒精，你不得不忍住咳嗽。你喝过更糟的，但也绝对喝过好得多的。 “这就是，”莫妮卡仍咧嘴笑着，“我们确保没人想在这里举行拼酒比赛的方法。一旦我拿出这种东西，除了最不要命的人，其他人都会转身离开。”她顿了顿。“倒不是本地人真的举行过拼酒比赛，不过你懂我的意思。”

Once I pull this stuff out, only the most hardcore wouldn’t walk away.” She pauses. “Not that the locals have ever tried to have a drinking contest, but you get the idea.”"

rows.translation: 信用点
rows.raw: " credits"

rows.translation: 你的信用点不够！
rows.raw: "You don’t have enough credits for this!"

rows.original: With her list complete, Monika turns to fully face you. “So what’ll it be, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: 介绍完清单后，莫妮卡转过身来完全面向你。“所以你要喝什么，[pc.name]？”
rows.raw: "With her list complete, Monika turns to fully face you. “So what’ll it be, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: Never Mind
rows.translation: 算了
rows.raw: "Never Mind"

rows.original: You tell Monika that you changed your mind, and you don’t feel like having a drink right now.
rows.translation: 你告诉莫妮卡自己改变主意，现在不想喝酒。
rows.raw: "You tell Monika that you changed your mind, and you don’t feel like having a drink right now."

rows.original: She only shrugs, and says, “Whatever you say. Let me know if you change your mind.”
rows.translation: 她只是耸耸肩，说道：“随你。改变主意时告诉我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe only shrugs, and says, “Whatever you say. Let me know if you change your mind.”"

rows.original: You tell Monika you’d like to talk to her. She gives you a doubtful look at first, then another slow smile.
rows.translation: 你告诉莫妮卡，想和她聊聊。起初她怀疑地看着你，随后又缓缓露出笑容。
rows.raw: "You tell Monika you’d like to talk to her. She gives you a doubtful look at first, then another slow smile."

rows.original: “Don’t get too many people here to chat with me,” she says, then pulls out a mug from beneath the bar and starts polishing it. “Not unless they think I know a supplier for something they want. Which, as far as you and everybody else knows, I don’t.”
rows.translation: “很少有人来这里和我聊天，”她说着，从吧台下拿出一个杯子开始擦拭。“除非他们以为我认识某种所需物品的供应商。至于这一点，在你和其他所有人看来，我可不认识。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t get too many people here to chat with me,” she says, then pulls out a mug from beneath the bar and starts polishing it. “Not unless they think I know a supplier for something they want. Which, as far as you and everybody else knows, I don’t.”"

rows.original: From the look she gives you, it’s hard to tell if she’s being serious or not. But surely some people drop by to chat up the bartender. That’s part of what being a bartender is all about.
rows.translation: 从她看你的神情，很难判断她是不是认真的。不过肯定会有人顺便和酒保聊聊天。这本来就是酒保工作的一部分。
rows.raw: "\n\nFrom the look she gives you, it’s hard to tell if she’s being serious or not. But surely some people drop by to chat up the bartender. That’s part of what being a bartender is all about."

rows.original: “And that’s how I can tell you’ve never been a bartender,” she says, doubt written all over her face. “Most people get a few drinks in them before they get too chatty. And the locals here, once they’ve had a few, don’t do a whole lot of talking. They just kind of sit around, or they go dance, or they stare at the lights. Sometimes they start making out, and we have to stop them before their tails get too tied up.”
rows.translation: “所以我能看出你从没当过酒保，”她满脸怀疑地说。“大多数人要先喝上几杯，才会变得健谈。这里的本地人喝过几杯后，根本说不了多少话。他们通常只是坐着，或去跳舞，或盯着灯光。有时他们会开始亲热，我们必须在他们的尾巴缠得太紧之前制止。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And that’s how I can tell you’ve never been a bartender,” she says, doubt written all over her face. “Most people get a few drinks in them before they get too chatty. And the locals here, once they’ve had a few, don’t do a whole lot of talking. They just kind of sit around, or they go dance, or they stare at the lights. Sometimes they start making out, and we have to stop them before their tails get too tied up.”"

rows.original: She puts the mug away, then flops the bar towel over her shoulder, and plants a hand on her curvy hip right above one of her guns. For a former space pirate, she sure has the old-style barkeep routine down to a science. “But I’ve always got time to talk with a rusher, seeing as I don’t get off-world these days.” She leans one elbow onto the bar, moving in closer to you. “So what can your friendly neighborhood bartender do for you?”
rows.translation: 她收起杯子，把吧台毛巾甩到肩上，一只手按在曲线玲珑的臀部，就在其中一把枪上方。作为前太空海盗，她对老派酒保的做派还真是驾轻就熟。“不过我一直有时间和开拓者聊天，毕竟这些天我已经不离开星球了。”她用一边手肘撑住吧台，向你靠近。“所以，你的友好邻家酒保能为你做些什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe puts the mug away, then flops the bar towel over her shoulder, and plants a hand on her curvy hip right above one of her guns. For a former space pirate, she sure has the old-style barkeep routine down to a science. “But I’ve always got time to talk with a rusher, seeing as I don’t get off-world these days.” She leans one elbow onto the bar, moving in closer to you. “So what can your friendly neighborhood bartender do for you?”"

rows.original: Herself
rows.translation: 她自己
rows.raw: "Herself"

rows.original: Herself
rows.translation: 她自己
rows.raw: "Herself"

rows.original: Piracy
rows.translation: 海盗生涯
rows.raw: "Piracy"

rows.original: Piracy
rows.translation: 海盗生涯
rows.raw: "Piracy"

rows.original: The Bar
rows.translation: 酒吧
rows.raw: "The Bar"

rows.original: The Bar
rows.translation: 酒吧
rows.raw: "The Bar"

rows.translation: 达尔
rows.raw: "Dhaal"

rows.translation: 达尔
rows.raw: "Dhaal"

rows.translation: 飞船

rows.original: Ship
rows.translation: 飞船
rows.raw: "Ship"

rows.original: Never Mind
rows.translation: 算了
rows.raw: "Never Mind"

rows.original: You ask Monika to tell you a little bit about herself. The look she gives you suggests she hears this all the time, but she doesn’t refuse.
rows.translation: 你请莫妮卡稍微讲讲她自己。她看你的眼神说明这话听过无数次，不过并未拒绝。
rows.raw: "You ask Monika to tell you a little bit about herself. The look she gives you suggests she hears this all the time, but she doesn’t refuse."

rows.original: “You know what most people around here ask me?” she asks, then says, “What my homeworld’s like. They want to know about Rosha.” She shrugs. “And I can’t tell them anything they can’t look up on the net.”
rows.translation: “你知道这里大多数人会问我什么吗？”她问道，随后说，“他们问我的母星是什么样子，想了解罗莎。”她耸耸肩。“而我讲不出任何他们无法在网络上查到的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know what most people around here ask me?” she asks, then says, “What my homeworld’s like. They want to know about Rosha.” She shrugs. “And I can’t tell them anything they can’t look up on the net.”"

rows.original: You’re not sure how connected most people on Dhaal are to have net access, but that’s beside the point. So she’s not from Rosha?
rows.translation: 你不知道达尔大多数人是否拥有足够的网络连接，但那不是重点。所以她不是来自罗莎？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure how connected most people on Dhaal are to have net access, but that’s beside the point. So she’s not from Rosha?"

rows.original: “Not unless you go way back,” Monika says. She looks away for a moment. “My family took off a long time ago, soon as they could after the UGC showed up. My parents were from the core worlds, and never said a thing about seeing the old homeworld.”
rows.translation: “除非追溯到很久以前，”莫妮卡说。她移开目光片刻。“我的家人很久以前就离开了，联合银河邦联一出现，他们一有机会就走。我的父母来自核心世界，也从没说过自己见过旧母星。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not unless you go way back,” Monika says. She looks away for a moment. “My family took off a long time ago, soon as they could after the UGC showed up. My parents were from the core worlds, and never said a thing about seeing the old homeworld.”"

rows.original: That’s not too big of a surprise. Lots of people who’ve been around the galaxy for a long time have never been to their peoples’ home world.
rows.translation: 这并不太令人意外。许多在银河中生活了很久的人，也从未去过自己族群的母星。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s not too big of a surprise. Lots of people who’ve been around the galaxy for a long time have never been to their peoples’ home world."

rows.original: “I get that,” Monika says, giving you an understanding look. She pulls out two glasses with her tails, and starts cleaning them, though they look pretty polished to you. “It’s just one of those things. I’m so used to traveling, it feels weird sometimes to know there’s a place I’ve never wanted to go.”
rows.translation: “我明白，”莫妮卡理解地看着你。她用尾巴取出两只玻璃杯，开始擦拭，尽管在你看来它们已经相当光亮。“就是这么回事。我太习惯旅行了，有时想到世上竟有个自己从未想去的地方，会觉得很奇怪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I get that,” Monika says, giving you an understanding look. She pulls out two glasses with her tails, and starts cleaning them, though they look pretty polished to you. “It’s just one of those things. I’m so used to traveling, it feels weird sometimes to know there’s a place I’ve never wanted to go.”"

rows.original: It sounds like this is bringing her down, so you try to change the subject. Did she grow up traveling, or is that because of the space pirate thing?
rows.translation: 这个话题似乎让她情绪低落，于是你试着改变话题。她从小就在旅行，还是说那是因为当太空海盗？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt sounds like this is bringing her down, so you try to change the subject. Did she grow up traveling, or is that because of the space pirate thing?"

rows.original: “Both.” Monika raises one of the glasses, peers close at it, then slips it back under the bar. “My parents were both in the UGC army, that’s how they met. So we ended up moving from world to world all the time when I was growing up. They went wherever they had to go, and I got dragged along.”
rows.translation: “两者都有。”莫妮卡举起一只杯子，凑近查看，随后塞回吧台下。“我的父母都在联合银河邦联军队服役，他们就是在那里认识的。所以我成长时，我们总在不同世界之间搬迁。他们必须去哪里，我就被拖去哪里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Both.” Monika raises one of the glasses, peers close at it, then slips it back under the bar. “My parents were both in the UGC army, that’s how they met. So we ended up moving from world to world all the time when I was growing up. They went wherever they had to go, and I got dragged along.”"

rows.original: So she was an army brat. Somehow, it makes sense that she’d go from that to being a pirate.
rows.translation: 所以她是个军人子弟。不知为何，从那样的生活变成海盗还挺合理。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo she was an army brat. Somehow, it makes sense that she’d go from that to being a pirate."

rows.original: Monika gives you a dour look, then smiles a little. “It’s not like there’s a straight line from one to the other,” she says. “I used to be-”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡阴沉地看着你，随后微微一笑。“这两件事之间又不是一条直线，”她说。“我以前是——”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika gives you a dour look, then smiles a little. “It’s not like there’s a straight line from one to the other,” she says. “I used to be-”"

rows.original: Suddenly, there’s a crash from across the bar. Monika’s ears snap up straight, and she turns to look, her eyes open wide. You glance over your shoulder, and see one of the zaika hanging half out of her booth, broken glass and spilled milk all over the floor. The other people in the booth are laughing at her, but Monika scowls.
rows.translation: 酒吧另一头突然传来一声碎响。莫妮卡的耳朵猛地竖直，她睁大双眼转头望去。你回头一看，只见一名扎伊卡半挂在卡座外，地板上满是碎玻璃和洒出的牛奶。同桌的人都在嘲笑她，莫妮卡却沉下脸。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, there’s a crash from across the bar. Monika’s ears snap up straight, and she turns to look, her eyes open wide. You glance over your shoulder, and see one of the zaika hanging half out of her booth, broken glass and spilled milk all over the floor. The other people in the booth are laughing at her, but Monika scowls."

rows.original: “Be right back, I have to check on this,” Monika says, her voice low. She vaults over the bar with ease, and storms over, looking more than a little pissed off.
rows.translation: “马上回来，我得过去看看，”莫妮卡低声说道。她轻松翻过吧台，怒气冲冲地走过去，看上去相当恼火。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Be right back, I have to check on this,” Monika says, her voice low. She vaults over the bar with ease, and storms over, looking more than a little pissed off."

rows.original: You watch as Monika berates the drunk customers, and two of the zaika head out, dragging the milk-drunk third between them. Monika taps something on her wrist, and a small drone flies over to clean up the mess. She shakes her head as she strides back behind the bar.
rows.translation: 你看着莫妮卡训斥醉酒顾客；两名扎伊卡拖着喝奶喝醉的第三人离开。莫妮卡在手腕上点了几下，一台小型无人机飞来清理残局。她摇着头，大步回到吧台后。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou watch as Monika berates the drunk customers, and two of the zaika head out, dragging the milk-drunk third between them. Monika taps something on her wrist, and a small drone flies over to clean up the mess. She shakes her head as she strides back behind the bar."

rows.original: It looks like that upset her kind of a lot. Monika doesn’t return to talk to you, but takes another drink order, so it seems this conversation is over. Maybe if you talk to her after she knows you a little better, she’ll have more to say.
rows.translation: 看来这件事让她相当难过。莫妮卡没有回来继续和你交谈，而是接下另一份酒水订单，看来这场对话已经结束。也许等她更熟悉你以后再来交谈，她会有更多话可说。
rows.raw: "It looks like that upset her kind of a lot. Monika doesn’t return to talk to you, but takes another drink order, so it seems this conversation is over. Maybe if you talk to her after she knows you a little better, she’ll have more to say."

rows.original: “I swear,” Monika says as she walks back to you, “I wanted to get those plex glasses they have at core world bars.” She shakes her head, her ears still sticking straight up. “We don’t have enough glasses to go around breaking them like that.” She sighs. “But plex is damn expensive to get out here, and I haven’t found anyone who can get me any on the cheap.”
rows.translation: “我发誓，”莫妮卡走回你身边时说道，“我原本想买核心世界酒吧里那种有机玻璃杯。”她摇摇头，耳朵仍笔直竖着。“我们的杯子不够多，不能像这样随便摔碎。”她叹了口气。“但这里弄有机玻璃贵得要命，我又找不到能便宜供货的人。”
rows.raw: "“I swear,” Monika says as she walks back to you, “I wanted to get those plex glasses they have at core world bars.” She shakes her head, her ears still sticking straight up. “We don’t have enough glasses to go around breaking them like that.” She sighs. “But plex is damn expensive to get out here, and I haven’t found anyone who can get me any on the cheap.”"

rows.original: Yet another problem with running an underground bar, you suppose. But she was telling you about her life when she was younger, if she wants to continue.
rows.translation: 你猜，这又是经营地下酒吧的一项难题。不过她刚才正说起自己年轻时的生活，如果愿意，可以继续讲下去。
rows.raw: "\n\nYet another problem with running an underground bar, you suppose. But she was telling you about her life when she was younger, if she wants to continue."

rows.original: “I was doing that, wasn’t I,” she says, half to herself. “So yeah, you’re not wrong about me being an army brat. That was life for us, around the core worlds. Both my parents served, and they pulled strings to make sure they got assigned together, so we hopped from one planet to another every year or two.”
rows.translation: “我刚才确实在讲，对吧，”她像是对自己说道。“所以没错，我确实是军人家的孩子。我们在核心世界就是这么生活的。我的父母都在服役，还托关系确保能被分配到一起，于是每隔一两年，我们就从一颗星球搬到另一颗。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was doing that, wasn’t I,” she says, half to herself. “So yeah, you’re not wrong about me being an army brat. That was life for us, around the core worlds. Both my parents served, and they pulled strings to make sure they got assigned together, so we hopped from one planet to another every year or two.”"

rows.original: That doesn’t sound like too bad of a life. Growing up in the core must have been interesting, even if she kept moving around.
rows.translation: 听起来这种生活并不太坏。即使总在搬家，在核心世界长大也一定很有意思。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat doesn’t sound like too bad of a life. Growing up in the core must have been interesting, even if she kept moving around."

rows.original: “It had its perks,” she says, then gestures to the bar. “Makes living life out here on the fringe seem real weird. But it was the only thing I knew. And my parents made army life sound good, I signed up soon as I was old enough.”
rows.translation: “确实有好处，”她说着，朝酒吧示意。“相比之下，在这种边缘地带生活显得非常奇怪。但那是我唯一熟悉的生活。父母把军旅生活说得很好，所以我一到年龄就报名了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It had its perks,” she says, then gestures to the bar. “Makes living life out here on the fringe seem real weird. But it was the only thing I knew. And my parents made army life sound good, I signed up soon as I was old enough.”"

rows.original: So she’s former military? That’s a little bit of a surprise. Though you bet lots of pirates start that way, then decide to be their own bosses once they’ve got the training and experience to handle that life.
rows.translation: 所以她以前是军人？这有点出乎意料。不过你敢说许多海盗都是这样起步的，接受足以应付那种生活的训练并积累经验后，便决定自己当老大。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo she’s former military? That’s a little bit of a surprise. Though you bet lots of pirates start that way, then decide to be their own bosses once they’ve got the training and experience to handle that life."

rows.original: “That happens, though mostly you get old soldiers sticking around way too long,” she says, then picks up a shot glass and starts toying with it. “But when I was younger, I thought it was the greatest thing ever. I must have been the only kid in boot camp who jumped right out of bed soon as the alarm went off, sleeping in boots that were already polished.” She grins, though it looks strained. “I was kind of a little shit, now that I look back at it.”
rows.translation: “这种事确实会发生，不过更多的是老兵留下太久，”她说着，拿起一只烈酒杯把玩。“但年轻时，我觉得那是世界上最棒的事。我大概是新兵营里唯一一个警报一响就立刻跳下床的孩子，甚至穿着已经擦亮的靴子睡觉。”她咧嘴笑了笑，神情却有些勉强。“现在回头看，我那时真是个小混蛋。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That happens, though mostly you get old soldiers sticking around way too long,” she says, then picks up a shot glass and starts toying with it. “But when I was younger, I thought it was the greatest thing ever. I must have been the only kid in boot camp who jumped right out of bed soon as the alarm went off, sleeping in boots that were already polished.” She grins, though it looks strained. “I was kind of a little shit, now that I look back at it.”"

rows.original: Growing up military, though, that makes sense. Especially if her parents made it seem like a great life.
rows.translation: 不过她在军人家庭长大，这也说得通。尤其是她父母把那种生活描述得如此美好。
rows.raw: "\n\nGrowing up military, though, that makes sense. Especially if her parents made it seem like a great life."

rows.original: “They did,” Monika says, “and I believed all of it. I wanted to serve the UGC, which acts like it’s the only real reason we’ve got a galactic civilization at all.” She spins the shot glass around two fingers, then makes it disappear. “I held onto that for a long time. Probably too long.”
rows.translation: “他们确实这么做了，”莫妮卡说，“而且我全都信了。我想为联合银河邦联效力；它表现得仿佛银河文明能存在全是它的功劳。”她让烈酒杯绕着两根手指旋转，随后使其消失。“这个信念我坚持了很久。大概太久了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They did,” Monika says, “and I believed all of it. I wanted to serve the UGC, which acts like it’s the only real reason we’ve got a galactic civilization at all.” She spins the shot glass around two fingers, then makes it disappear. “I held onto that for a long time. Probably too long.”"

rows.original: So she got disenchanted with the military. That happens to a lot of people, or so you’ve heard. And if she grew up with glory stories and saw how it really was, you can see how she’d come to change her mind.
rows.translation: 所以她对军队幻灭了。听说很多人都会如此。若她从小听着荣耀故事长大，后来又看见真实情况，你能理解她为何改变想法。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo she got disenchanted with the military. That happens to a lot of people, or so you’ve heard. And if she grew up with glory stories and saw how it really was, you can see how she’d come to change her mind."

rows.original: “You’re not wrong.” Monika makes the shot glass reappear, then stares into it for a moment before stowing it below the bar again. She looks at you, her expression unreadable. “But that’s a story for some other time.”
rows.translation: “你说得没错。”莫妮卡让烈酒杯重新出现，盯着杯子看了片刻，随后又把它收回吧台下。她望向你，表情难以解读。“不过那是以后再讲的故事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re not wrong.” Monika makes the shot glass reappear, then stares into it for a moment before stowing it below the bar again. She looks at you, her expression unreadable. “But that’s a story for some other time.”"

rows.original: Monika steps away to help a customer. It’s clear she’s done talking about this. If you ask her again when she knows you better, she might be willing to tell the rest of her story.
rows.translation: 莫妮卡走开去招呼一位顾客。她显然不想再谈这件事。等她更熟悉你以后再问，她也许愿意讲完自己的故事。
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika steps away to help a customer. It’s clear she’s done talking about this. If you ask her again when she knows you better, she might be willing to tell the rest of her story."
