rows.original: “That happens, though mostly you get old soldiers sticking around way too long,” she says, then picks up a shot glass and starts toying with it. “But when I was younger, I thought it was the greatest thing ever. I must have been the only kid in boot camp who jumped right out of bed soon as the alarm went off, sleeping in boots that were already polished.” She grins, though it looks strained. “I was kind of a little shit, now that I look back at it.”
rows.translation: “这种事确实会发生，不过更多的是老兵留下太久，”她说着，拿起一只烈酒杯把玩。“但年轻时，我觉得那是世界上最棒的事。我大概是新兵营里唯一一个警报一响就立刻跳下床的孩子，甚至穿着已经擦亮的靴子睡觉。”她咧嘴笑了笑，神情却有些勉强。“现在回头看，我那时真是个小混蛋。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That happens, though mostly you get old soldiers sticking around way too long,” she says, then picks up a shot glass and starts toying with it. “But when I was younger, I thought it was the greatest thing ever. I must have been the only kid in boot camp who jumped right out of bed soon as the alarm went off, sleeping in boots that were already polished.” She grins, though it looks strained. “I was kind of a little shit, now that I look back at it.”"

rows.original: Growing up military, though, that makes sense. Especially if her parents made it seem like a great life.
rows.translation: 不过她在军人家庭长大，这也说得通。尤其是她父母把那种生活描述得如此美好。
rows.raw: "\n\nGrowing up military, though, that makes sense. Especially if her parents made it seem like a great life."

rows.original: “They did,” Monika says, “and I believed all of it. I wanted to serve the UGC, which acts like it’s the only real reason we’ve got a galactic civilization at all.” She spins the shot glass around two fingers, then makes it disappear. “I held onto that for a long time. Probably too long.”
rows.translation: “他们确实这么做了，”莫妮卡说，“而且我全都信了。我想为联合银河邦联效力；它表现得仿佛银河文明能存在全是它的功劳。”她让烈酒杯绕着两根手指旋转，随后使其消失。“这个信念我坚持了很久。大概太久了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They did,” Monika says, “and I believed all of it. I wanted to serve the UGC, which acts like it’s the only real reason we’ve got a galactic civilization at all.” She spins the shot glass around two fingers, then makes it disappear. “I held onto that for a long time. Probably too long.”"

rows.original: So she got disenchanted with the military. That happens to a lot of people, or so you’ve heard. And if she grew up with glory stories and saw how it really was, you can see how she’d come to change her mind.
rows.translation: 所以她对军队幻灭了。听说很多人都会如此。若她从小听着荣耀故事长大，后来又看见真实情况，你能理解她为何改变想法。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo she got disenchanted with the military. That happens to a lot of people, or so you’ve heard. And if she grew up with glory stories and saw how it really was, you can see how she’d come to change her mind."

rows.original: “You’re not wrong.” Monika makes the shot glass reappear, then stares into it for a moment before stowing it below the bar again. She looks at you, her expression unreadable. “And I found out about that the hard way.”
rows.translation: “你说得没错。”莫妮卡让烈酒杯重新出现，盯着杯子看了片刻，随后又把它收回吧台下。她望向你，表情难以解读。“而我是吃了苦头才明白这一点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re not wrong.” Monika makes the shot glass reappear, then stares into it for a moment before stowing it below the bar again. She looks at you, her expression unreadable. “And I found out about that the hard way.”"

rows.original: Well, she’s still alive to tell it, so it couldn’t have been that bad. Could it?
rows.translation: 好吧，她至少还活着，能把这件事讲出来，所以应该没那么糟。对吧？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, she’s still alive to tell it, so it couldn’t have been that bad. Could it?"

rows.original: “Bad enough.” Monika leans one hip against the bar, moving in closer to you. When she speaks again, her voice is low.
rows.translation: “够糟的。”莫妮卡一侧臀部靠上吧台，向你挪近。再次开口时，她压低了声音。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bad enough.” Monika leans one hip against the bar, moving in closer to you. When she speaks again, her voice is low."

rows.original: “My parents never told me that most of the UGC’s job in the core worlds is keeping people from fighting back. They don’t have enough of an army for the whole damn galaxy, so a lot of worlds never see troops at all. I started to catch on when I realized I’d spent four years in a big, long lap around the galactic core.”
rows.translation: “我的父母从没告诉过我，联合银河邦联在核心世界的大部分工作，就是阻止人们反抗。他们没有足以覆盖整个该死银河系的军队，所以许多世界根本看不到部队。我意识到自己已经花了四年时间绕银河核心兜了一个大圈，才开始明白过来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My parents never told me that most of the UGC’s job in the core worlds is keeping people from fighting back. They don’t have enough of an army for the whole damn galaxy, so a lot of worlds never see troops at all. I started to catch on when I realized I’d spent four years in a big, long lap around the galactic core.”"

rows.original: If she was keeping people from fighting back, does that mean putting down rebellions, or dealing with protests, or what?
rows.translation: 如果她当时是在阻止人们反抗，那是指镇压叛乱、处理抗议，还是其他什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nIf she was keeping people from fighting back, does that mean putting down rebellions, or dealing with protests, or what?"

rows.original: “Both of those and more,” she says, her voice still low. “I thought I’d get to see strange new worlds and conquer them for the UGC, but most of our work was on people we never should have had to fight.” She looks away, and her ears lower, like she’s remembering something she’d rather keep buried. “I should have gotten out sooner. But I signed up for a five-year term, and there was no way I’d walk out of that. My parents would have disowned me.”
rows.translation: “两者都有，还不止这些，”她依然低声说道。“我原以为自己能见识陌生的新世界，为联合银河邦联征服它们，可我们大部分工作针对的都是本不该交战的人。”她移开目光，耳朵垂下，仿佛回忆起宁愿深埋心底的往事。“我应该更早退出。但我签的是五年服役期，不可能中途离开。我的父母会和我断绝关系。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Both of those and more,” she says, her voice still low. “I thought I’d get to see strange new worlds and conquer them for the UGC, but most of our work was on people we never should have had to fight.” She looks away, and her ears lower, like she’s remembering something she’d rather keep buried. “I should have gotten out sooner. But I signed up for a five-year term, and there was no way I’d walk out of that. My parents would have disowned me.”"

rows.original: You decide not to ask if her parents know she went space pirate, and simply wait for her to continue.
rows.translation: 你决定不问她父母是否知道她后来成了太空海盗，只是等待她继续。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou decide not to ask if her parents know she went space pirate, and simply wait for her to continue."

rows.original: “Turns out, I didn’t have to worry about that. I had about seven months left when I took a frag grenade to the back.” Her tails rub up against her back, and you’re not sure if she’s doing that on purpose or not. “Even armored, that wasn’t something I could walk away from. Woke up in the infirmary three days later, wrapped up shoulders to ass and lucky to be alive.”
rows.translation: “结果我根本不用担心这件事。服役期还剩大约七个月时，我背后挨了一枚破片手雷。”她的尾巴擦过后背，你不确定她是否有意这么做。“哪怕穿着护甲，那也不是能让我安然走开的伤。三天后我才在医务室醒来，从肩膀到屁股都被裹住，能活下来已经走运。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Turns out, I didn’t have to worry about that. I had about seven months left when I took a frag grenade to the back.” Her tails rub up against her back, and you’re not sure if she’s doing that on purpose or not. “Even armored, that wasn’t something I could walk away from. Woke up in the infirmary three days later, wrapped up shoulders to ass and lucky to be alive.”"

rows.original: That’s a hell of a thing.
rows.translation: 那可真够惨的。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s a hell of a thing."

rows.original: And that explains the scars all over her back.
rows.translation: 这也解释了她背上遍布的伤疤。
rows.raw: " And that explains the scars all over her back."

rows.original: You wait a moment, until the silence between you two becomes awkward, then ask what she did after that.
rows.translation: 你等待片刻，直到两人之间的沉默变得尴尬，随后询问她之后做了什么。
rows.raw: " You wait a moment, until the silence between you two becomes awkward, then ask what she did after that."

rows.original: “Two words: honorable discharge,” she says, and gives you a smile that doesn’t reach her eyes. “Not that it could have gone any other way. Someone made up a story about me diving in front of a bomb to save my squadron, but the truth is I just didn’t see it coming. I walked out of there with a shit paycheck and a ‘sorry about the scars’. Didn’t even serve long enough for a commendation I could use to get a job.”
rows.translation: “两个词：光荣退役，”她说道，露出一个没有到达眼底的笑容。“不过也不可能有别的结果。有人编了个故事，说我为了救小队而扑向炸弹；其实我只是没看见它飞来。我拿着少得可怜的薪水离开，只换来一句‘很遗憾留下了伤疤’。甚至连服役时间都不够，拿不到能用来找工作的嘉奖。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Two words: honorable discharge,” she says, and gives you a smile that doesn’t reach her eyes. “Not that it could have gone any other way. Someone made up a story about me diving in front of a bomb to save my squadron, but the truth is I just didn’t see it coming. I walked out of there with a shit paycheck and a ‘sorry about the scars’. Didn’t even serve long enough for a commendation I could use to get a job.”"

rows.original: That’s pretty brutal. She could have died, and they didn’t give her much when they let her go just because she hadn’t been there long enough?
rows.translation: 这也太残酷了。她差点丧命，他们却仅仅因为服役时间不够，在让她离开时没给多少补偿？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s pretty brutal. She could have died, and they didn’t give her much when they let her go just because she hadn’t been there long enough?"

rows.original: Monika shrugs. “That’s the UGC. But it worked out in the end.” She gestures to the bar again, then smiles, and it looks genuine this time. “There I was, fully trained and covered with scars, no future ahead of me and a past I wanted nothing to do with.” She smirks. “Seemed like a damn good time to become a pirate.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡耸耸肩。“联合银河邦联就是这样。不过最后结果还不错。”她再次朝酒吧示意，随后露出微笑；这次看起来是真心的。“那时的我训练有素、满身伤疤，前方没有未来，身后又是一段我不想再沾边的过去。”她坏笑道。“看来正是当海盗的绝佳时机。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika shrugs. “That’s the UGC. But it worked out in the end.” She gestures to the bar again, then smiles, and it looks genuine this time. “There I was, fully trained and covered with scars, no future ahead of me and a past I wanted nothing to do with.” She smirks. “Seemed like a damn good time to become a pirate.”"

rows.original: So she’s a former space pirate? That must come with a ton of stories. Does she feel like sharing any of them?
rows.translation: 所以她以前是太空海盗？那一定伴随着无数故事。她愿意分享一些吗？
rows.raw: "So she’s a former space pirate? That must come with a ton of stories. Does she feel like sharing any of them?"

rows.original: “Some of that’s classified,” Monika says, then smirks. “No, not really. Old habit. But if you’ve got time and you want to know, I can share.”
rows.translation: “有些内容是机密，”莫妮卡说道，随后坏笑。“不，其实不是。老习惯而已。如果你有时间又想知道，我可以讲讲。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Some of that’s classified,” Monika says, then smirks. “No, not really. Old habit. But if you’ve got time and you want to know, I can share.”"

rows.original: You did ask, and you’re not going anywhere at the moment. So you’re free to stay a while and listen.
rows.translation: 问题是你问的，而且现在也不急着离开。所以你可以留下来听一阵。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou did ask, and you’re not going anywhere at the moment. So you’re free to stay a while and listen."

rows.original: “So, to skip over a lot of other stuff,” Monika begins, “my first time as a pirate wasn’t with my old crew. It was with someone else’s old crew.” She leans in a little bit toward you. “A very old crew.”
rows.translation: “那么，跳过许多无关的事，”莫妮卡开口道，“我第一次当海盗时，不是在自己的老船员队伍里，而是在别人的老船员队伍里。”她略微向你靠近。“一支非常老的队伍。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, to skip over a lot of other stuff,” Monika begins, “my first time as a pirate wasn’t with my old crew. It was with someone else’s old crew.” She leans in a little bit toward you. “A very old crew.”"

rows.original: Had the crew been together for a long time, or were they all elderly, or...?
rows.translation: 是那群船员共事了很长时间，还是说他们全都年纪很大，或者...？
rows.raw: "\n\nHad the crew been together for a long time, or were they all elderly, or...?"

rows.original: “Little of both, [pc.name],” she says. “You don’t find many old space pirates. The job’s got a real habit of killing most of us.” She looks a little grim for a moment, then continues. “And when you do find the old ones, you learn they’ve lived that long for a reason.”
rows.translation: “两者都有一点，[pc.name]，”她说。“年老的太空海盗并不多见。这行很容易要了我们大多数人的命。”她的神情阴沉片刻，随后继续。“真遇到老海盗时，你会明白他们能活这么久是有原因的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Little of both, [pc.name],” she says. “You don’t find many old space pirates. The job’s got a real habit of killing most of us.” She looks a little grim for a moment, then continues. “And when you do find the old ones, you learn they’ve lived that long for a reason.”"

rows.original: Monika looks over your shoulder, peering around the bar, keeping an eye on everything. Faint light flickers in her cybernetic eye, making it look like it’s analyzing whatever she sees. Which seems like a safe guess.
rows.translation: 莫妮卡越过你的肩膀环视酒吧，留意着一切。她的义眼中闪烁着微光，看起来像是在分析所见之物。这个猜测应该很稳妥。
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika looks over your shoulder, peering around the bar, keeping an eye on everything. Faint light flickers in her cybernetic eye, making it look like it’s analyzing whatever she sees. Which seems like a safe guess."

rows.original: “That crew had probably been at the pirate thing for two or three decades. Most of them were greybeards, a bunch of men who got into the smuggling trade and never learned to do anything else. I thought I could learn something from them.”
rows.translation: “那群人从事海盗行当大概已有二三十年。大多数都是白胡子老头，一群投身走私、之后再没学过其他营生的男人。我以为自己能从他们身上学到东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That crew had probably been at the pirate thing for two or three decades. Most of them were greybeards, a bunch of men who got into the smuggling trade and never learned to do anything else. I thought I could learn something from them.”"

rows.original: That sounds reasonable, but also not like the sort of life most people want when they take up piracy. Did she learn anything from them?
rows.translation: 这听起来很合理，但似乎也不是大多数人投身海盗时想要的生活。她从他们那里学到了什么吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat sounds reasonable, but also not like the sort of life most people want when they take up piracy. Did she learn anything from them?"

rows.original: “All the basics,” Monika says. She pulls out another shot glass and starts twirling it around one finger, then makes it dance to another. “Sleight of hand, for one. It’s easier to make people sure you don’t have something if you make it disappear.” Sure enough, she flips her hand over, and the glass seems to disappear. “Basic hacking, how to tail someone and how to lose a tail, ways to read flight patterns and shipment records. I could go on.”
rows.translation: “所有基础本领，”莫妮卡说。她拿出另一只烈酒杯，让它绕着一根手指旋转，随后跳到另一根手指上。“比如手上功夫。让东西消失，更容易使别人确信你根本没拿。”果然，她翻转手掌，酒杯似乎消失了。“基础黑客技术、如何跟踪别人和甩掉尾巴、读取飞行路线与货运记录的方法。我还能一直列下去。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“All the basics,” Monika says. She pulls out another shot glass and starts twirling it around one finger, then makes it dance to another. “Sleight of hand, for one. It’s easier to make people sure you don’t have something if you make it disappear.” Sure enough, she flips her hand over, and the glass seems to disappear. “Basic hacking, how to tail someone and how to lose a tail, ways to read flight patterns and shipment records. I could go on.”"

rows.original: Monika spins her hand again, and sets the shot glass down on the bar, then gives you a hard look. “Real trouble was, those old men didn’t know how to roll with the changes, and still worked like it was thirty or forty years ago. So after a while, I knew I wasn’t going to get anywhere with them. And when-”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡再次转动手掌，把烈酒杯放回吧台，随后严肃地看着你。“真正的问题是，那些老头不懂得适应变化，做事还像三四十年前一样。所以过了一阵，我知道跟着他们不会有什么前途。而当——”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika spins her hand again, and sets the shot glass down on the bar, then gives you a hard look. “Real trouble was, those old men didn’t know how to roll with the changes, and still worked like it was thirty or forty years ago. So after a while, I knew I wasn’t going to get anywhere with them. And when-”"

rows.original: A zaika woman with one swollen boob hanging out of her top stumbles up to the bar, just short of crashing into your shoulder as she trips over a barstool. She catches herself with both hands, then leans in toward Monika. The look on her face makes it clear she’s well and truly gone, completely wasted on milk.
rows.translation: 一名扎伊卡女人跌跌撞撞地来到吧台，一只肿胀的乳房挂在上衣外；她被吧凳绊倒，险些撞上你的肩膀。她用双手撑住自己，随后向莫妮卡靠去。从她的表情就能看出，她已经彻底醉了，被牛奶灌得烂醉如泥。
rows.raw: "\n\nA zaika woman with one swollen boob hanging out of her top stumbles up to the bar, just short of crashing into your shoulder as she trips over a barstool. She catches herself with both hands, then leans in toward Monika. The look on her face makes it clear she’s well and truly gone, completely wasted on milk."

rows.original: “More,” the drunkard murmurs, holding a hand out toward Monika.
rows.translation: “还要，”醉鬼低声说道，朝莫妮卡伸出一只手。
rows.raw: "\n\n“More,” the drunkard murmurs, holding a hand out toward Monika."

rows.original: “Not a chance, girl,” Monika says, and folds her arms over her chest. “I cut you off two hours ago. If you’re still this gone, you’re not getting another shot.” She glances over to the cowgirl across the bar. “Josie! You heard that, right?”
rows.translation: “想都别想，姑娘，”莫妮卡说着，双臂交叉抱在胸前。“两小时前我就不再给你酒了。你到现在还醉成这样，一杯也别想再拿。”她瞥向酒吧另一边的牛仔姑娘。“乔西！你听见了，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not a chance, girl,” Monika says, and folds her arms over her chest. “I cut you off two hours ago. If you’re still this gone, you’re not getting another shot.” She glances over to the cowgirl across the bar. “Josie! You heard that, right?”"

rows.original: “Gotcha the first time,” Josie says, looking over her shoulder. “I haven’t given her anything since.”
rows.translation: “第一次就听到了，”乔西回头说道。“之后我什么也没给她。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gotcha the first time,” Josie says, looking over her shoulder. “I haven’t given her anything since.”"

rows.original: Monika nods, then glares at the wasted zaika. “Take off,” she says. “Or do you want me to call Karrah?”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡点点头，随后怒视烂醉的扎伊卡。“走开，”她说。“还是想让我叫卡拉来？”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika nods, then glares at the wasted zaika. “Take off,” she says. “Or do you want me to call Karrah?”"

rows.original: The zaika woman gives Monika a sullen look, which changes to the most pathetic attempt at puppy-eyes you’ve ever seen. In return, Monika only looks more stern. After a moment, the zaika mutters “Sorry,” and stumbles away. Monika watches her go, a frown on her face.
rows.translation: 扎伊卡女人不高兴地看着莫妮卡，随后摆出你见过最可怜的幼犬眼神。莫妮卡只变得更加严厉。片刻后，扎伊卡咕哝一声“抱歉，”踉跄离开。莫妮卡皱眉看着她走远。
rows.raw: "The zaika woman gives Monika a sullen look, which changes to the most pathetic attempt at puppy-eyes you’ve ever seen. In return, Monika only looks more stern. After a moment, the zaika mutters “Sorry,” and stumbles away. Monika watches her go, a frown on her face."

rows.original: The zaika woman lets out a long whine, and flails her hands at Monika, mumbling something about milk. Monika raises her hand, brandishing the stunner at the zaika. She doesn’t even have to use it before the zaika backs off with a burbling shriek, then falls on her ass as she tries to back away. She scrambles backward across the floor, somehow making it back to her table. Monika scowls, watching her go.
rows.translation: 扎伊卡女人拖长声音呜咽，双手朝莫妮卡乱挥，含混念叨着牛奶。莫妮卡抬起手，用电击枪指向扎伊卡。她甚至不必开枪，对方就咕噜尖叫着后退，结果倒退时一屁股摔在地上。她手脚并用地向后爬过地板，不知怎么竟回到了自己的桌旁。莫妮卡阴着脸看她离去。
rows.raw: "The zaika woman lets out a long whine, and flails her hands at Monika, mumbling something about milk. Monika raises her hand, brandishing the stunner at the zaika. She doesn’t even have to use it before the zaika backs off with a burbling shriek, then falls on her ass as she tries to back away. She scrambles backward across the floor, somehow making it back to her table. Monika scowls, watching her go."

rows.original: The zaika woman bares her teeth, and makes a lunge at Monika, catching herself on the bar. Monika leaps backward with ease, and says a single word that you don’t catch. A moment later, Karrah storms in through the bar’s entry and catches the zaika woman around the waist, then hauls her out of the room, kicking and screaming. Monika watches them go, a sullen look on her face.
rows.translation: 扎伊卡女人龇起牙齿，猛扑向莫妮卡，双手撑在吧台上。莫妮卡轻松向后跃开，说了一个你没听清的词。片刻后，卡拉怒气冲冲地从酒吧入口闯进来，拦腰抱住扎伊卡女人，随后在她又踢又叫时把人拖出房间。莫妮卡阴沉地看着她们离开。
rows.raw: "The zaika woman bares her teeth, and makes a lunge at Monika, catching herself on the bar. Monika leaps backward with ease, and says a single word that you don’t catch. A moment later, Karrah storms in through the bar’s entry and catches the zaika woman around the waist, then hauls her out of the room, kicking and screaming. Monika watches them go, a sullen look on her face."

rows.original: “Kind of sad when it gets that bad,” she says, her voice low.
rows.translation: “恶化到这种程度，确实有点可悲，”她低声说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Kind of sad when it gets that bad,” she says, her voice low."

rows.original: She shakes her head, and pulls another mug from below the bar, then starts polishing it.
rows.translation: 她摇摇头，从吧台下又拿出一只杯子，开始擦拭。
rows.raw: " She shakes her head, and pulls another mug from below the bar, then starts polishing it."

rows.original: You wait a moment for her to continue her story, but it looks like she’s done talking. Maybe if you ask her about this another time, she’ll feel like saying more.
rows.translation: 你等着她继续故事，可看来她已经不想再说。也许改天再问起这件事，她会愿意多讲一些。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wait a moment for her to continue her story, but it looks like she’s done talking. Maybe if you ask her about this another time, she’ll feel like saying more."

rows.original: Monika looks at you, and says, “Where was I?”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡看着你，说道：“我说到哪里了？”
rows.raw: "Monika looks at you, and says, “Where was I?”"

rows.original: She was telling you how she wasn’t getting anywhere working with the old man crew. Is that what got her started with the crew she had before coming to Dhaal?
rows.translation: 她刚才正说，跟着那群老头根本没有前途。这就是她后来加入达尔之前那支船员队伍的起点吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nShe was telling you how she wasn’t getting anywhere working with the old man crew. Is that what got her started with the crew she had before coming to Dhaal?"

rows.original: “It was,” Monika says, and the first hints of a smile creep onto her face. “The crew wasn’t all old men, but they were the ones in charge. And a few of us realized we weren’t getting what we wanted. It didn’t look like we had too many options, either.”
rows.translation: “是的，”莫妮卡说道，脸上开始浮现一丝笑意。“船员并不全是老头，但掌权的是他们。我们几个人意识到，自己得不到想要的东西。看起来也没有太多选择。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was,” Monika says, and the first hints of a smile creep onto her face. “The crew wasn’t all old men, but they were the ones in charge. And a few of us realized we weren’t getting what we wanted. It didn’t look like we had too many options, either.”"

rows.original: Well, they were pirates. Couldn’t they just mutiny?
rows.translation: 好吧，他们可是海盗。难道不能直接哗变？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, they were pirates. Couldn’t they just mutiny?"

rows.original: Monika fixes her gaze on you, both her organic and cybernetic eyes staring you down with equal intensity. After a moment, she laughs, just a little. “We could have,” she says. “But those old codgers, they were big on the whole ‘honor among thieves’ thing, and they made us want to work that way too. It’s probably why they’d been pirates for so long and never had a mutiny in the first place.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡凝视着你，天然眼与义眼同样锐利地盯住你。片刻后，她轻轻笑了。“当然可以，”她说。“可那些老家伙非常看重所谓的‘盗亦有道’，也让我们愿意按那套规矩做事。也许这正是他们当了那么多年海盗，却从未遭遇哗变的原因。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika fixes her gaze on you, both her organic and cybernetic eyes staring you down with equal intensity. After a moment, she laughs, just a little. “We could have,” she says. “But those old codgers, they were big on the whole ‘honor among thieves’ thing, and they made us want to work that way too. It’s probably why they’d been pirates for so long and never had a mutiny in the first place.”"

rows.original: Your experience with space pirates has varied a lot, but she’s got a point. Some of them are almost honorable, others are outright scum. But they’ve all got some kind of their own code.
rows.translation: 你遇到过形形色色的太空海盗，不过她说得有道理。有些人近乎光明磊落，有些则是不折不扣的人渣。但他们都有某种自己的规矩。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour experience with space pirates has varied a lot, but she’s got a point. Some of them are almost honorable, others are outright scum. But they’ve all got some kind of their own code."

rows.original: “There is a code,” Monika says with a nod, and it sounds like she believes it. “The old men taught us, and we stuck to it. So stabbing them in the back wasn’t on the table. Which meant a few of us girls had to form our own group if we wanted out. So we did.”
rows.translation: “确实有规矩，”莫妮卡点头说道，听起来真心相信这一点。“老头们教给我们，我们也一直遵守。所以背后捅刀不在考虑之列。也就是说，我们几个姑娘若想离开，只能组建自己的团体。于是我们就这么做了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There is a code,” Monika says with a nod, and it sounds like she believes it. “The old men taught us, and we stuck to it. So stabbing them in the back wasn’t on the table. Which meant a few of us girls had to form our own group if we wanted out. So we did.”"

rows.original: Monika pulls out a narrow glass and starts polishing it, then holds it up to the light. “It started with four of us. We had dozens of successful missions under our belts, and we knew we worked well together. And we’d seen how the old men worked, with a gang of five that led them, not just one captain. So we set ourselves up like that.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡拿出一只细长酒杯开始擦拭，随后举到灯光下。“最初有四个人。我们已经成功执行过几十次任务，知道彼此配合得很好。我们也见过老头们的运作方式：由五人团体共同领导，而不是只有一名船长。于是我们也采用了类似方式。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika pulls out a narrow glass and starts polishing it, then holds it up to the light. “It started with four of us. We had dozens of successful missions under our belts, and we knew we worked well together. And we’d seen how the old men worked, with a gang of five that led them, not just one captain. So we set ourselves up like that.”"

rows.original: She lowers the glass, and looks at you. “Three captains. A gryvain, a rahn, and me. The fourth woman was a human, hell of a pilot but she didn’t want to lead. She just wanted to fly her own ship, and we all understood that. We picked up Karrah right before our first job, which got us our ship and our muscle. And that’s how it all started.”
rows.translation: 她放低酒杯，看向你。“三名船长。一名格里文、一名拉恩，还有我。第四个女人是人类，是个厉害得要命的飞行员，但她不想领导。她只想驾驶自己的飞船，我们都理解。第一次行动前不久，我们招募了卡拉，这让我们得到飞船和肌肉。事情就这样开始了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe lowers the glass, and looks at you. “Three captains. A gryvain, a rahn, and me. The fourth woman was a human, hell of a pilot but she didn’t want to lead. She just wanted to fly her own ship, and we all understood that. We picked up Karrah right before our first job, which got us our ship and our muscle. And that’s how it all started.”"

rows.original: What did they call themselves? Pirates usually give themselves some kind of name. And she never mentioned the name of the old man crew either.
rows.translation: 她们怎么称呼自己？海盗通常都会给自己取个名号。而且她也从没提过那群老头的队伍叫什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat did they call themselves? Pirates usually give themselves some kind of name. And she never mentioned the name of the old man crew either."

rows.original: Monika shakes her head, lowering her eyes. “We don’t use the name anymore,” she says, any trace of mirth gone from her voice. “Not the old men’s name since we left, not the crew’s since we broke up. We left that all behind.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡低下眼睛，摇摇头。“我们已经不用那个名字了，”她说道，声音中最后一丝欢快也已消失。“离开后不用老头们的名号；队伍解散后，也不再用我们自己的名字。那一切都被留在过去了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika shakes her head, lowering her eyes. “We don’t use the name anymore,” she says, any trace of mirth gone from her voice. “Not the old men’s name since we left, not the crew’s since we broke up. We left that all behind.”"

rows.original: It sounds like she’s not happy that things ended. How did it all go bad?
rows.translation: 听起来她对事情的结局并不高兴。后来怎么会变得那么糟？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt sounds like she’s not happy that things ended. How did it all go bad?"

rows.original: She gives you a careful look, then slides the glass she’s holding back under the bar. “That’s a story for another time,” she says. “I try not to think about it too much, not if I want to stay in a good mood.”
rows.translation: 她谨慎地看你一眼，把手里的杯子滑回吧台下。“那是以后再讲的故事，”她说。“如果还想保持好心情，我就尽量不去想它。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a careful look, then slides the glass she’s holding back under the bar. “That’s a story for another time,” she says. “I try not to think about it too much, not if I want to stay in a good mood.”"

rows.original: It’s pretty clear she’s not going to continue that story right now. Maybe if you ask her about it again after they know you better at the bar, she’ll feel like telling you more.
rows.translation: 很明显，她现在不打算继续讲这个故事。也许等酒吧里的人更熟悉你以后再问，她会愿意多讲一些。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s pretty clear she’s not going to continue that story right now. Maybe if you ask her about it again after they know you better at the bar, she’ll feel like telling you more."

rows.translation: 莫妮卡看着你，说道：“我说到哪里了？”
