rows.original: It sounds like she’s not happy that things ended. How did it all go bad?
rows.translation: 听起来她对事情的结局并不高兴。后来怎么会变得那么糟？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt sounds like she’s not happy that things ended. How did it all go bad?"

rows.original: She takes a deep breath, then slides the glass she’s holding back under the bar. “Same way all good pirates go,” Monika says after a moment. “Get in too much trouble with someone who’s better.”
rows.translation: 她深吸一口气，把手里的杯子滑回吧台下。“所有优秀海盗最后都是这样，”片刻后莫妮卡说道。“惹上太大的麻烦，对手又比自己更强。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe takes a deep breath, then slides the glass she’s holding back under the bar. “Same way all good pirates go,” Monika says after a moment. “Get in too much trouble with someone who’s better.”"

rows.original: That doesn’t sound good. Must have been a lot of trouble for it to get the whole crew to break up.
rows.translation: 听起来可不妙。能让整支船员队伍解散，麻烦一定非常严重。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat doesn’t sound good. Must have been a lot of trouble for it to get the whole crew to break up."

rows.original: “It really was,” Monika says. She leans one curvy hip on the bar, and folds her arms over her stomach. Her natural eye falls half-closed as she looks at you. “We had it good for a long time. Crew came and went, but we had a core we could count on. I knew it wouldn’t last forever, but I didn’t think it would end so quickly. All it took was one bad job.”
rows.translation: “确实如此，”莫妮卡说。她一侧曲线玲珑的臀部靠在吧台上，双臂抱住腹部，天然眼半闭着望向你。“我们曾经顺风顺水了很久。船员来来去去，但始终有一群可以依靠的核心成员。我知道那不可能永远持续，却没想到结局来得如此突然。只需要一次糟糕的任务。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It really was,” Monika says. She leans one curvy hip on the bar, and folds her arms over her stomach. Her natural eye falls half-closed as she looks at you. “We had it good for a long time. Crew came and went, but we had a core we could count on. I knew it wouldn’t last forever, but I didn’t think it would end so quickly. All it took was one bad job.”"

rows.original: You’ve seen what happens when pirate work goes wrong. You’ve even made some pirates’ work go wrong during your time as a mercenary, though you don’t mention that part.
rows.translation: 你见过海盗行动出错时会发生什么。佣兵生涯中，你甚至亲手搞砸过某些海盗的行动，不过没有提起这一部分。
rows.raw: "You’ve seen what happens when pirate work goes wrong. You’ve even made some pirates’ work go wrong during your time as a mercenary, though you don’t mention that part."

rows.original: Anything can go wrong with one bad job. And you’ve worked enough tech to know how quickly things can go bad, and how much can go wrong before anyone can fix the problem.
rows.translation: 一次糟糕的任务中，任何事都可能出错。你处理过足够多的技术问题，知道局面恶化得有多快，也知道在任何人修好问题之前能坏掉多少东西。
rows.raw: "Anything can go wrong with one bad job. And you’ve worked enough tech to know how quickly things can go bad, and how much can go wrong before anyone can fix the problem."

rows.original: You definitely know what that’s like. During your time as a smuggler, you were on both ends of that, and it was never as fun as the stories make it out to be.
rows.translation: 你当然知道那是什么滋味。走私客生涯中，你曾站在事情的两边，而实际经历从不像故事里那么有趣。
rows.raw: " You definitely know what that’s like. During your time as a smuggler, you were on both ends of that, and it was never as fun as the stories make it out to be."

rows.original: You’ve been lucky enough to avoid that kind of experience first-hand, but you’ve seen it repeated a thousand times across media on the extranet. Tight crews have broken up over less.
rows.translation: 你很幸运，没有亲身遭遇过这种事，但在外网上的媒体作品中已经看过上千次。关系紧密的团队会为更小的事情分崩离析。
rows.raw: " You’ve been lucky enough to avoid that kind of experience first-hand, but you’ve seen it repeated a thousand times across media on the extranet. Tight crews have broken up over less."

rows.original: What happened that got the whole crew to break up?
rows.translation: 究竟发生了什么，才让整支船员队伍解散？
rows.raw: " What happened that got the whole crew to break up?"

rows.original: “Three words,” Monika says, and looks you in the eye. “The Black Void.”
rows.translation: “三个词，”莫妮卡直视你的眼睛说道。“黑暗虚空。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Three words,” Monika says, and looks you in the eye. “The Black Void.”"

rows.original: Shit. Yeah, they’ll ruin any crew’s day, if not their entire lives. Assuming the Void even lets anyone live.
rows.translation: 该死。是啊，碰上他们，任何团队一天的好心情都会被毁掉，甚至整个人生也会完蛋。前提是虚空还肯让人活着。
rows.raw: "\n\nShit. Yeah, they’ll ruin any crew’s day, if not their entire lives. Assuming the Void even lets anyone live."

rows.original: Monika nods. “We got lucky, and didn’t run into them directly,” she says. “But we took a hit job where we didn’t know it was their stuff. It was supposed to be simple – shoot, loot, and scoot, like Redd used to say. But all the goods had tracers and Black Void markers in the boxes. We saw those and knew we’d fucked up bad.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡点点头。“我们很走运，没有直接撞上他们，”她说。“可我们接了一单劫掠任务，不知道目标是他们的货。本该很简单——开枪、抢货、跑路，就像雷德以前常说的那样。但所有货物都有追踪器，箱子上还带着黑暗虚空标记。看见那些东西时，我们知道自己闯了大祸。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika nods. “We got lucky, and didn’t run into them directly,” she says. “But we took a hit job where we didn’t know it was their stuff. It was supposed to be simple – shoot, loot, and scoot, like Redd used to say. But all the goods had tracers and Black Void markers in the boxes. We saw those and knew we’d fucked up bad.”"

rows.original: And just ditching the goods probably wouldn’t work. Not if the Void knew who’d robbed them. They’d come looking for revenge.
rows.translation: 光把货丢掉大概也没用。如果虚空知道是谁抢了他们，就会找上门报复。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd just ditching the goods probably wouldn’t work. Not if the Void knew who’d robbed them. They’d come looking for revenge."

rows.original: “We knew that,” Monika says. “I came up with a plan that I thought would get us out safe. The Planet Rush had just started, so we’d ditch the goods on one of the Rush worlds, where there would be tons of people coming and going. We argued a lot about what to do and where to go, but I won out. We dropped the crates off in Myrellion’s spaceport, even left an apology along with the goods. Kind of a shame, we could have done well on that world. But the Void got to us before we could get out of the system.”
rows.translation: “我们知道，”莫妮卡说。“我想了个自认为能让大家安全脱身的计划。行星开拓刚刚开始，所以我们打算把货丢在某个开拓世界；那里人员进出频繁。我们为该怎么做、该去哪里争论了很久，最后是我的意见胜出。我们把箱子丢在米瑞利恩太空港，甚至随货留下了道歉信。可惜了，我们本来能在那个世界过得不错。但还没离开星系，虚空就追上了我们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We knew that,” Monika says. “I came up with a plan that I thought would get us out safe. The Planet Rush had just started, so we’d ditch the goods on one of the Rush worlds, where there would be tons of people coming and going. We argued a lot about what to do and where to go, but I won out. We dropped the crates off in Myrellion’s spaceport, even left an apology along with the goods. Kind of a shame, we could have done well on that world. But the Void got to us before we could get out of the system.”"

rows.original: That couldn’t have gone well. Did everyone get out alive?
rows.translation: 这不可能有什么好结果。所有人都活着逃出来了吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat couldn’t have gone well. Did everyone get out alive?"

rows.original: “Barely. We got to the warp gate, but the ship was hardly holding together. We knew she only had one more run in her, and Dhaal was the other planet we thought would be a good place to ditch the goods. So we made this our last port.” Monika looks away for a moment. “And that was too much for most of the crew.”
rows.translation: “勉强。我们抵达了跃迁门，可飞船几乎已经散架。我们知道她只能再飞最后一程，而达尔是另一个适合丢货的星球。所以这里成了我们的最后一站。”莫妮卡移开目光片刻。“而对大多数船员来说，这已经超过了承受极限。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Barely. We got to the warp gate, but the ship was hardly holding together. We knew she only had one more run in her, and Dhaal was the other planet we thought would be a good place to ditch the goods. So we made this our last port.” Monika looks away for a moment. “And that was too much for most of the crew.”"

rows.original: She gestures at the bar. “[flags.MASTODON_END|You know the rest of the story. But thanks to you, it looks like we’re not going to be stuck here forever.|So now we’re here, with what’s left of the crew and our ship, until we can figure out what to do next.]” Monika gives you a smile, [flags.MASTODON_END|a genuine one that reaches her organic eye|though it’s clearly forced, and doesn’t reach her eyes]. “Kind of [flags.MASTODON_END|looking forward to being a pirate again, you know what I mean?|makes you rethink being a pirate, doesn’t it?]”
rows.translation: 她朝酒吧示意。“[flags.MASTODON_END|后面的故事你都知道了。不过多亏你，我们看来不会永远困在这里。|所以现在我们就在这里，带着剩下的船员和飞船，直到想出下一步怎么办。]”莫妮卡朝你微笑，[flags.MASTODON_END|那是真诚的笑容，也映入她的天然眼|但显然十分勉强，根本没有到达眼底]。“这还真让人[flags.MASTODON_END|有点期待重新当海盗，你懂我的意思吧？|重新考虑当海盗值不值得，对吧？]”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gestures at the bar. “[flags.MASTODON_END|You know the rest of the story. But thanks to you, it looks like we’re not going to be stuck here forever.|So now we’re here, with what’s left of the crew and our ship, until we can figure out what to do next.]” Monika gives you a smile, [flags.MASTODON_END|a genuine one that reaches her organic eye|though it’s clearly forced, and doesn’t reach her eyes]. “Kind of [flags.MASTODON_END|looking forward to being a pirate again, you know what I mean?|makes you rethink being a pirate, doesn’t it?]”"

rows.original: You[flags.MASTODON_END| can see why she’s ready to get back to her old life|’ve got other plans for your future], that’s for sure. Especially after a hell of a story like that.
rows.translation: 你[flags.MASTODON_END|能理解她为何已经准备回归过去的生活|对自己的未来另有打算]，这一点很确定。尤其是在听过这样一个惊心动魄的故事后。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou[flags.MASTODON_END| can see why she’s ready to get back to her old life|’ve got other plans for your future], that’s for sure. Especially after a hell of a story like that."

rows.original: You ask Monika what she can tell you about the bar. It’s definitely an unusual place, and you’ve been to a lot of bars on your travels.
rows.translation: 你问莫妮卡能告诉你多少关于这间酒吧的事。这里确实很不寻常，而你旅途中去过的酒吧可不少。
rows.raw: "You ask Monika what she can tell you about the bar. It’s definitely an unusual place, and you’ve been to a lot of bars on your travels."

rows.original: Monika glances around, then gives you a wry smile. “I swear, [pc.name], I wake up here sometimes and I wonder how it happened,” she says, then laughs a little. “I don’t think this is what any of us thought we’d end up doing.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡环顾四周，随后朝你露出苦笑。“我发誓，[pc.name]，有时我在这里醒来，都想不明白事情怎么变成这样的，”她说着轻轻笑了。“我想我们谁都没料到自己最后会干这个。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika glances around, then gives you a wry smile. “I swear, [pc.name], I wake up here sometimes and I wonder how it happened,” she says, then laughs a little. “I don’t think this is what any of us thought we’d end up doing.”"

rows.original: You can see that. But it seems like they’re doing pretty well here, though getting it started must have had some problems.
rows.translation: 这一点你能理解。不过她们在这里似乎经营得相当不错，尽管刚起步时一定遇到过不少问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can see that. But it seems like they’re doing pretty well here, though getting it started must have had some problems."

rows.original: “That it did,” she says, and her smile fades. Her tails pull a few shot glasses out from under the bar, and she starts polishing them as she talks. “When we first got here, we didn’t have much. The ship was shot to hell, we were low on credits, and the rest of the crew... it’s better if I don’t go into that.” Her lips twitch as she goes quiet, and it looks like there’s something she’s trying not to say.
rows.translation: “确实如此，”她说道，笑容随之消失。她的尾巴从吧台下取出几只烈酒杯，一边说话一边擦拭。“刚到这里时，我们几乎一无所有。飞船被打得千疮百孔，信用点所剩无几，其他船员又...最好别谈这个。”她沉默下来，嘴唇微微抽动，仿佛正努力忍住某些话。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That it did,” she says, and her smile fades. Her tails pull a few shot glasses out from under the bar, and she starts polishing them as she talks. “When we first got here, we didn’t have much. The ship was shot to hell, we were low on credits, and the rest of the crew... it’s better if I don’t go into that.” Her lips twitch as she goes quiet, and it looks like there’s something she’s trying not to say."

rows.original: But they’re here now, and that has to count for something.
rows.translation: 但她们现在已经在这里立足，这总归算得上成就。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut they’re here now, and that has to count for something."

rows.original: Monika nods. “It’s something,” she says. “When we found the old rail station, we were looking for somewhere to crash. Living in hotels adds up real quick, same with eating in the city. So we needed something new, and we needed it fast.” She raises her gaze again, and gestures to the room around her. “And we found this place.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡点点头。“算吧，”她说。“发现旧火车站时，我们只是在找个落脚点。住旅馆的费用很快会累积起来，在城里吃饭也是。所以我们急需新的办法，而且越快越好。”她再次抬眼，示意周围的房间。“然后我们找到了这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika nods. “It’s something,” she says. “When we found the old rail station, we were looking for somewhere to crash. Living in hotels adds up real quick, same with eating in the city. So we needed something new, and we needed it fast.” She raises her gaze again, and gestures to the room around her. “And we found this place.”"

rows.original: All this empty space and nobody was using it? That seems unlikely in a city like this.
rows.translation: 这么大的空地竟然没人使用？在这样的城市里似乎不太可能。
rows.raw: "\n\nAll this empty space and nobody was using it? That seems unlikely in a city like this."

rows.original: “We thought so too, but it was bare as a newborn’s ass,” Monika says. “Locals told me later it was for a railway that never got finished, something about zaibatsu politics.” She shrugs, and rolls her organic eye. “But we figured we could make a home here. Then Kiki said we could fix it up with parts from the ship, if we could get them down here. And we knew how the locals were about milk, especially after those damn fools trying to jump us on the street.”
rows.translation: “我们也这么想，可这里光秃得像新生儿的屁股，”莫妮卡说。“后来本地人告诉我，这是为一条从未完工的铁路修建的，好像涉及财阀政治。”她耸耸肩，转了转天然眼。“不过我们觉得能在这里安家。接着琪琪说，如果能把飞船零件运下来，就可以用它们修缮这里。我们也知道本地人对牛奶是什么态度，尤其是那些该死的蠢货还曾在街上企图袭击我们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We thought so too, but it was bare as a newborn’s ass,” Monika says. “Locals told me later it was for a railway that never got finished, something about zaibatsu politics.” She shrugs, and rolls her organic eye. “But we figured we could make a home here. Then Kiki said we could fix it up with parts from the ship, if we could get them down here. And we knew how the locals were about milk, especially after those damn fools trying to jump us on the street.”"

rows.original: Monika looks upset, and stops herself before she breaks the shot glass she’s polishing. One of her tails returns it to under the bar while the other raises the glass it’s holding. “But then, we got the idea for the bar.” A smile creeps back onto her face as she looks toward the cowgirl on the other side of the bar. “Josie was all for being our milk supply, and we figured out the rest along the way. And look where we are now.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡显得有些难过，及时停手，才没捏碎正在擦拭的烈酒杯。一条尾巴把杯子放回吧台下，另一条则举起手里的杯子。“不过后来，我们想到了开酒吧。”她望向吧台另一边的牛仔姑娘，脸上重新浮现笑容。“乔西完全赞成当我们的牛奶来源，剩下的问题则一路慢慢解决。看看我们现在的样子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika looks upset, and stops herself before she breaks the shot glass she’s polishing. One of her tails returns it to under the bar while the other raises the glass it’s holding. “But then, we got the idea for the bar.” A smile creeps back onto her face as she looks toward the cowgirl on the other side of the bar. “Josie was all for being our milk supply, and we figured out the rest along the way. And look where we are now.”"

rows.original: Not a bad success story, especially in a city like this one. Before you can ask anything else, one of the local women walks up to the bar and asks Monika for another round of drinks. The two of them chat as Monika pours, and as the zaika woman walks away, Monika smirks at her.
rows.translation: 这成功故事相当不错，尤其是在这样的城市里。你还没来得及继续提问，一名本地女人就来到吧台，向莫妮卡再要一轮酒。莫妮卡倒酒时，两人闲聊起来；扎伊卡女人离开时，莫妮卡朝她坏笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nNot a bad success story, especially in a city like this one. Before you can ask anything else, one of the local women walks up to the bar and asks Monika for another round of drinks. The two of them chat as Monika pours, and as the zaika woman walks away, Monika smirks at her."

rows.original: “She’s a regular,” Monika says. “Feels a little weird to say that, but it’s nice to know we’ve got people around who like what we do and won’t try to shoot us if we step out of line.”
rows.translation: “她是常客，”莫妮卡说。“这么说感觉有点奇怪，不过知道附近有人喜欢我们做的事，而且不会因为我们稍微越界就开枪，确实很好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“She’s a regular,” Monika says. “Feels a little weird to say that, but it’s nice to know we’ve got people around who like what we do and won’t try to shoot us if we step out of line.”"

rows.original: With that, Monika leans over to help another customer, the conversation clearly over. Maybe if you ask her about this again when she knows you better, she’d be willing to continue.
rows.translation: 莫妮卡说完便俯身去招呼另一名顾客，对话显然结束了。也许等她更熟悉你以后再次问起，她会愿意继续。
rows.raw: "With that, Monika leans over to help another customer, the conversation clearly over. Maybe if you ask her about this again when she knows you better, she’d be willing to continue."

rows.original: That’s something you can say about working at a bar that you can’t about being a pirate. Unless you’re a really well-loved pirate, and even then, there’s always going to be someone who has it out for you. Does she feel like she’s got a good handle on running things here?
rows.translation: 这是酒吧工作胜过海盗生涯的一点。除非你是个极受爱戴的海盗；即便如此，也总会有人想要你的命。她觉得自己已经能很好地经营这里了吗？
rows.raw: "That’s something you can say about working at a bar that you can’t about being a pirate. Unless you’re a really well-loved pirate, and even then, there’s always going to be someone who has it out for you. Does she feel like she’s got a good handle on running things here?"

rows.original: Monika leans one curvy hip on the bar as her tail puts away the other shot glass, and thinks for a moment. “I do now,” she says. “But I tell you, it’s damn different from running a pirate crew. You ever try to run a business?”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡一边曲线玲珑的臀部靠在吧台上，尾巴收起另一只烈酒杯；她思考片刻。“现在可以了，”她说。“但我告诉你，这和领导海盗船员完全不同。你试过经营生意吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika leans one curvy hip on the bar as her tail puts away the other shot glass, and thinks for a moment. “I do now,” she says. “But I tell you, it’s damn different from running a pirate crew. You ever try to run a business?”"

rows.original: There are so many things you can’t say about that. This is definitely not the place to tell anyone you’re the soon-to-be head of a major industrial company and you’re on the Rush to earn your place there. That’s the kind of thing that could get you kidnapped or worse in this city. So you tell Monika that yes, you know a little about running a business, just things you’ve picked up along the way. She seems satisfied with that.
rows.translation: 关于这个问题，有太多事情不能说。这里显然不适合告诉任何人，你即将掌管一家大型工业公司，而参加开拓正是为了赢得那个位置。这种消息在城里可能让你遭到绑架，甚至更糟。所以你告诉莫妮卡，自己确实略懂经营，都是一路上学来的东西。她似乎接受了这个回答。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere are so many things you can’t say about that. This is definitely not the place to tell anyone you’re the soon-to-be head of a major industrial company and you’re on the Rush to earn your place there. That’s the kind of thing that could get you kidnapped or worse in this city. So you tell Monika that yes, you know a little about running a business, just things you’ve picked up along the way. She seems satisfied with that."

rows.original: “So you know some of what I had to deal with,” Monika says. She huffs out a breath. “And this place’s net isn’t the same as the rest of the galaxy’s, so I had to learn how they do everything around here. Never had to do so much stuff in person before, just because I didn’t know how the locals handled things.”
rows.translation: “那么你知道我必须应付哪些问题了，”莫妮卡说着呼出一口气。“这里的网络和银河其他地方不一样，所以我不得不学习本地人处理一切事务的方式。以前我从没亲自跑过这么多事情，就因为不了解本地规矩。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you know some of what I had to deal with,” Monika says. She huffs out a breath. “And this place’s net isn’t the same as the rest of the galaxy’s, so I had to learn how they do everything around here. Never had to do so much stuff in person before, just because I didn’t know how the locals handled things.”"

rows.original: That couldn’t have been too easy, especially since she must have been trying not to attract the zaibatsu’s attention.
rows.translation: 这肯定不容易，尤其是她还得尽量避免引起财阀注意。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat couldn’t have been too easy, especially since she must have been trying not to attract the zaibatsu’s attention."

rows.original: “Little bit, yeah,” Monika says, holding two fingers as far apart as she can. “I knew nothing good would come from having their eyes on us. Didn’t exactly make it easy for us to get started, knowing that anyone might be looking to sell us out for their corporate masters.” She snaps you a grin that disappears as quickly as it comes. “But I had two things that most people on this planet weren’t ready for.”
rows.translation: “是有那么一点，”莫妮卡说着，把两根手指尽量分开。“我知道被他们盯上绝不会有好结果。想到任何人都可能为了企业主子出卖我们，起步当然不轻松。”她朝你飞快一笑，笑容来得快去得也快。“但我拥有两样这个星球大多数人都没准备好面对的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Little bit, yeah,” Monika says, holding two fingers as far apart as she can. “I knew nothing good would come from having their eyes on us. Didn’t exactly make it easy for us to get started, knowing that anyone might be looking to sell us out for their corporate masters.” She snaps you a grin that disappears as quickly as it comes. “But I had two things that most people on this planet weren’t ready for.”"

rows.original: And those were?
rows.translation: 是什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd those were?"

rows.original: “Credits and connections.” Monika puts her hands together, then twists them around each other, and two credit chits appear between her fingers from out of nowhere. “Right after the Rush started up, everybody here wanted that new money. So when we needed some suppliers for the basic bar stuff, we could pay in credits, and that got us a lot farther than any money we made here would. And for people who didn’t want credits....”
rows.translation: “信用点和人脉。”莫妮卡双手合拢，再相互扭转，两枚信用芯片凭空出现在指间。“行星开拓刚开始时，这里的每个人都想要那种新货币。所以我们需要基础酒吧用品的供应商时，可以用信用点付款；这比我们在本地赚的钱好用得多。而对那些不想要信用点的人....”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Credits and connections.” Monika puts her hands together, then twists them around each other, and two credit chits appear between her fingers from out of nowhere. “Right after the Rush started up, everybody here wanted that new money. So when we needed some suppliers for the basic bar stuff, we could pay in credits, and that got us a lot farther than any money we made here would. And for people who didn’t want credits....”"

rows.original: Monika gestures to the display of cream liquor behind her, and her smile spreads across her face. “Bonus part of being a pirate is knowing people who can get anything, anywhere. So when you tell them you need all the cream booze they can get as fast as possible, they deliver. And a bottle of something the locals have never tasted... that opens all kinds of doors.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡示意身后陈列的奶油酒，笑容在脸上绽开。“当海盗的额外好处，就是认识能在任何地点弄到任何东西的人。所以只要告诉他们，你需要尽快弄来所有能找到的奶油酒，他们就会送到。一瓶本地人从未尝过的东西...能打开各种大门。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika gestures to the display of cream liquor behind her, and her smile spreads across her face. “Bonus part of being a pirate is knowing people who can get anything, anywhere. So when you tell them you need all the cream booze they can get as fast as possible, they deliver. And a bottle of something the locals have never tasted... that opens all kinds of doors.”"

rows.original: It sounds like things worked out pretty well for her. For a former pirate, she’s doing a damn good job running a business so far. Do the rest of her crew like it here?
rows.translation: 听起来事情发展得相当顺利。作为前海盗，她到目前为止把生意经营得非常出色。其余船员喜欢这里吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt sounds like things worked out pretty well for her. For a former pirate, she’s doing a damn good job running a business so far. Do the rest of her crew like it here?"

rows.original: Before Monika can answer, another customer walks up to the bar, waving back and forth where she stands. “I’ll get back to you on that,” Monika says, then turns to the zaika woman.
rows.translation: 莫妮卡还没回答，另一名顾客就摇摇晃晃地走到吧台。“等会儿再告诉你，”莫妮卡说完，转向扎伊卡女人。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore Monika can answer, another customer walks up to the bar, waving back and forth where she stands. “I’ll get back to you on that,” Monika says, then turns to the zaika woman."

rows.original: Looks like someone else has her attention for now. Maybe if you ask her about this again when you’ve spent more time at the bar, you’ll be able to talk more about this.
rows.translation: 看来暂时有人吸引了她的注意。也许等你在酒吧待得更久，再次问她这个问题时，就能继续交谈。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooks like someone else has her attention for now. Maybe if you ask her about this again when you’ve spent more time at the bar, you’ll be able to talk more about this."

rows.original: That’s something you can say about working at a bar that you can’t about being a pirate. Unless you’re a really well-loved pirate, and even then, there’s always going to be someone who has it out for you. Does she feel like she’s got a good handle on running things here?
rows.translation: 这是酒吧工作胜过海盗生涯的一点。除非你是个极受爱戴的海盗；即便如此，也总会有人想要你的命。她觉得自己已经能很好地经营这里了吗？
rows.raw: "That’s something you can say about working at a bar that you can’t about being a pirate. Unless you’re a really well-loved pirate, and even then, there’s always going to be someone who has it out for you. Does she feel like she’s got a good handle on running things here?"

rows.original: Monika leans one curvy hip on the bar as her tail puts away the other shot glass, and thinks for a moment. “I do now,” she says. “But I tell you, it’s damn different from running a pirate crew. You ever try to run a business?”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡一边曲线玲珑的臀部靠在吧台上，尾巴收起另一只烈酒杯；她思考片刻。“现在可以了，”她说。“但我告诉你，这和领导海盗船员完全不同。你试过经营生意吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika leans one curvy hip on the bar as her tail puts away the other shot glass, and thinks for a moment. “I do now,” she says. “But I tell you, it’s damn different from running a pirate crew. You ever try to run a business?”"

rows.original: There are so many things you can’t say about that. This is definitely not the place to tell anyone you’re the soon-to-be head of a major industrial company and you’re on the Rush to earn your place there. That’s the kind of thing that could get you kidnapped or worse in this city. So you tell Monika that yes, you know a little about running a business, just things you’ve picked up along the way. She seems satisfied with that.
rows.translation: 关于这个问题，有太多事情不能说。这里显然不适合告诉任何人，你即将掌管一家大型工业公司，而参加开拓正是为了赢得那个位置。这种消息在城里可能让你遭到绑架，甚至更糟。所以你告诉莫妮卡，自己确实略懂经营，都是一路上学来的东西。她似乎接受了这个回答。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere are so many things you can’t say about that. This is definitely not the place to tell anyone you’re the soon-to-be head of a major industrial company and you’re on the Rush to earn your place there. That’s the kind of thing that could get you kidnapped or worse in this city. So you tell Monika that yes, you know a little about running a business, just things you’ve picked up along the way. She seems satisfied with that."

rows.original: “So you know some of what I had to deal with,” Monika says. She huffs out a breath. “And this place’s net isn’t the same as the rest of the galaxy’s, so I had to learn how they do everything around here. Never had to do so much stuff in person before, just because I didn’t know how the locals handled things.”
rows.translation: “那么你知道我必须应付哪些问题了，”莫妮卡说着呼出一口气。“这里的网络和银河其他地方不一样，所以我不得不学习本地人处理一切事务的方式。以前我从没亲自跑过这么多事情，就因为不了解本地规矩。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you know some of what I had to deal with,” Monika says. She huffs out a breath. “And this place’s net isn’t the same as the rest of the galaxy’s, so I had to learn how they do everything around here. Never had to do so much stuff in person before, just because I didn’t know how the locals handled things.”"

rows.original: That couldn’t have been too easy, especially since she must have been trying not to attract the zaibatsu’s attention.
rows.translation: 这肯定不容易，尤其是她还得尽量避免引起财阀注意。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat couldn’t have been too easy, especially since she must have been trying not to attract the zaibatsu’s attention."

rows.original: “Little bit, yeah,” Monika says, holding two fingers as far apart as she can. “I knew nothing good would come from having their eyes on us. Didn’t exactly make it easy for us to get started, knowing that anyone might be looking to sell us out for their corporate masters.” She snaps you a grin that disappears as quickly as it comes. “But I had two things that most people on this planet weren’t ready for.”
rows.translation: “是有那么一点，”莫妮卡说着，把两根手指尽量分开。“我知道被他们盯上绝不会有好结果。想到任何人都可能为了企业主子出卖我们，起步当然不轻松。”她朝你飞快一笑，笑容来得快去得也快。“但我拥有两样这个星球大多数人都没准备好面对的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Little bit, yeah,” Monika says, holding two fingers as far apart as she can. “I knew nothing good would come from having their eyes on us. Didn’t exactly make it easy for us to get started, knowing that anyone might be looking to sell us out for their corporate masters.” She snaps you a grin that disappears as quickly as it comes. “But I had two things that most people on this planet weren’t ready for.”"

rows.original: And those were?
rows.translation: 是什么？
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd those were?"

rows.original: “Credits and connections.” Monika puts her hands together, then twists them around each other, and two credit chits appear between her fingers from out of nowhere. “Right after the Rush started up, everybody here wanted that new money. So when we needed some suppliers for the basic bar stuff, we could pay in credits, and that got us a lot farther than any money we made here would. And for people who didn’t want credits....”
rows.translation: “信用点和人脉。”莫妮卡双手合拢，再相互扭转，两枚信用芯片凭空出现在指间。“行星开拓刚开始时，这里的每个人都想要那种新货币。所以我们需要基础酒吧用品的供应商时，可以用信用点付款；这比我们在本地赚的钱好用得多。而对那些不想要信用点的人....”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Credits and connections.” Monika puts her hands together, then twists them around each other, and two credit chits appear between her fingers from out of nowhere. “Right after the Rush started up, everybody here wanted that new money. So when we needed some suppliers for the basic bar stuff, we could pay in credits, and that got us a lot farther than any money we made here would. And for people who didn’t want credits....”"

rows.original: Monika gestures to the display of cream liquor behind her, and her smile spreads across her face. “Bonus part of being a pirate is knowing people who can get anything, anywhere. So when you tell them you need all the cream booze they can get as fast as possible, they deliver. And a bottle of something the locals have never tasted... that opens all kinds of doors.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡示意身后陈列的奶油酒，笑容在脸上绽开。“当海盗的额外好处，就是认识能在任何地点弄到任何东西的人。所以只要告诉他们，你需要尽快弄来所有能找到的奶油酒，他们就会送到。一瓶本地人从未尝过的东西...能打开各种大门。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika gestures to the display of cream liquor behind her, and her smile spreads across her face. “Bonus part of being a pirate is knowing people who can get anything, anywhere. So when you tell them you need all the cream booze they can get as fast as possible, they deliver. And a bottle of something the locals have never tasted... that opens all kinds of doors.”"

rows.original: It sounds like things worked out pretty well for her. For a former pirate, she’s doing a damn good job running a business so far. Do the rest of her crew like it here?
rows.translation: 听起来事情发展得相当顺利。作为前海盗，她到目前为止把生意经营得非常出色。其余船员喜欢这里吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt sounds like things worked out pretty well for her. For a former pirate, she’s doing a damn good job running a business so far. Do the rest of her crew like it here?"

rows.original: Monika nods to the cowgirl on the other side of the bar, who has a row of shot glasses set up, and is filling them two at a time from her nipples, to the cheers of an adoring crowd. “I know Josie’s doing just fine,” she says with a small smile, “but she’s never had a single problem with anything we’ve been through. Must be nice,” she adds quietly, then gives the cowgirl a look you can’t quite read.
rows.translation: 莫妮卡朝吧台另一边的牛仔姑娘点头；后者面前摆着一排烈酒杯，正用乳头一次填满两杯，引得崇拜的人群欢呼。“我知道乔西过得很好，”她微笑着说，“但无论我们经历什么，她从没觉得有问题。一定很轻松吧，”她低声补充，随后以一种你读不懂的眼神望向牛仔姑娘。
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika nods to the cowgirl on the other side of the bar, who has a row of shot glasses set up, and is filling them two at a time from her nipples, to the cheers of an adoring crowd. “I know Josie’s doing just fine,” she says with a small smile, “but she’s never had a single problem with anything we’ve been through. Must be nice,” she adds quietly, then gives the cowgirl a look you can’t quite read."

rows.original: After a moment, Monika starts wiping down the bar with her towel, looking every bit the perfect old-fashioned bartender. “I think Karrah misses punching people, and being the bouncer really isn’t enough for her.” She leans in a little closer to you, and lowers her voice. “But I also know she cares more than she wants to let on. Keeping us all safe is the best thing she could be doing for this place, and I know she likes being good at it.”
rows.translation: 片刻后，莫妮卡开始用毛巾擦拭吧台，看起来完全是一名完美的老派酒保。“我觉得卡拉怀念揍人的日子，而单纯当保镖还无法满足她。”她稍微向你靠近，压低声音。“但我也知道，她比愿意表现出来的更加在乎我们。保障大家安全是她能为这里做的最好工作，而且她喜欢把事情做好。”
rows.raw: "\n\nAfter a moment, Monika starts wiping down the bar with her towel, looking every bit the perfect old-fashioned bartender. “I think Karrah misses punching people, and being the bouncer really isn’t enough for her.” She leans in a little closer to you, and lowers her voice. “But I also know she cares more than she wants to let on. Keeping us all safe is the best thing she could be doing for this place, and I know she likes being good at it.”"

rows.original: It does seem like a good role for the thraggen woman. And most people aren’t willing to pick a fight with someone that much larger than them.
rows.translation: 这似乎很适合那个特拉根女人。而且大多数人都不愿意和体型大自己那么多的人打架。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt does seem like a good role for the thraggen woman. And most people aren’t willing to pick a fight with someone that much larger than them."

rows.original: “Not down here, at least. The gangs and corps upstairs? That’s different.” She shrugs. “But we do all we can to keep them out. Some of that’s Kiki’s work, and I know she loves what we’ve got going on in here.”
rows.translation: “至少在下面不会。上面的帮派和公司？那就不同了。”她耸耸肩。“不过我们竭尽所能，不让他们进来。有些是琪琪的功劳，而且我知道她非常喜欢这里正在做的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not down here, at least. The gangs and corps upstairs? That’s different.” She shrugs. “But we do all we can to keep them out. Some of that’s Kiki’s work, and I know she loves what we’ve got going on in here.”"

rows.original: If she’s their techie, then she must have had a lot of work getting this place put together. Refitting an entire ship into a bar isn’t a normal kind of job for most people.
rows.translation: 如果她是团队里的技术专家，那么改造这里时一定做了大量工作。把整艘飞船改装成酒吧，对大多数人来说可不是普通工作。
rows.raw: "\n\nIf she’s their techie, then she must have had a lot of work getting this place put together. Refitting an entire ship into a bar isn’t a normal kind of job for most people."

rows.original: Monika gives you another small smile. “Never seen her so damn excited,” she says. “Putting together this place was probably the biggest thing she’s ever done, and I know it’s her pride and joy. I don’t know if you’ve talked much to her, but she can talk anyone’s ear off about what she did for the bar. Taking apart the ship was hardest for her, but I know it means a lot to Kiki to still have it around in a different way.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡又微微一笑。“从没见她这么兴奋过，”她说。“建造这里大概是她做过最大的项目，也是她的骄傲与珍宝。不知道你有没有和她深入聊过，不过她能抓住任何人，滔滔不绝地讲自己为酒吧做了什么。拆掉飞船对她来说最难，但我知道，能以另一种形式把它留在身边，对琪琪意义重大。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika gives you another small smile. “Never seen her so damn excited,” she says. “Putting together this place was probably the biggest thing she’s ever done, and I know it’s her pride and joy. I don’t know if you’ve talked much to her, but she can talk anyone’s ear off about what she did for the bar. Taking apart the ship was hardest for her, but I know it means a lot to Kiki to still have it around in a different way.”"

rows.original: That sounds about right. And what about her?
rows.translation: 听起来确实如此。那她自己呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat sounds about right. And what about her?"

rows.original: “Like I said, sometimes I wonder how this all happened,” Monika says, and slings her towel over her shoulder. “Other times, all I can do is look around and be damn glad it’s worked out so well.”
rows.translation: “就像我说的，有时我会想，这一切究竟是怎么发生的，”莫妮卡说着，把毛巾甩到肩上。“其他时候，我只能环顾四周，为事情如此顺利而庆幸。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like I said, sometimes I wonder how this all happened,” Monika says, and slings her towel over her shoulder. “Other times, all I can do is look around and be damn glad it’s worked out so well.”"

rows.original: She glances around the bar again. “Think about it. Here we are, in a city like nowhere else in the galaxy, on a planet most people hardly even know about. And we’ve got a bar that’s also like nowhere else, showing people who’ve never left their planet a little bit of what it’s like on other worlds.” She smirks. “And getting them drunk and taking their money at the same time.”
rows.translation: 她再次环顾酒吧。“想想看。我们身处银河独一无二的城市，待在一颗大多数人几乎一无所知的星球上。我们还有一家同样独一无二的酒吧，让这些从未离开过母星的人稍微了解其他世界是什么样子。”她坏笑道。“同时把他们灌醉，收走他们的钱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe glances around the bar again. “Think about it. Here we are, in a city like nowhere else in the galaxy, on a planet most people hardly even know about. And we’ve got a bar that’s also like nowhere else, showing people who’ve never left their planet a little bit of what it’s like on other worlds.” She smirks. “And getting them drunk and taking their money at the same time.”"

rows.original: So even if she and the rest of the crew are grounded, they haven’t completely given up being pirates. They’re just letting their marks come to them, instead of going after them.
rows.translation: 所以即使她和其余船员被困在地面，也没有彻底放弃当海盗。她们只是不再主动追逐目标，而是让猎物自己送上门。
rows.raw: "\n\nSo even if she and the rest of the crew are grounded, they haven’t completely given up being pirates. They’re just letting their marks come to them, instead of going after them."

rows.original: “That’s a little harsh,” Monika says, though she’s still smiling. “But I’m not saying you’re wrong.”
rows.translation: “这话有点刻薄，”莫妮卡说道，脸上仍带着笑容。“不过我也没说你错了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s a little harsh,” Monika says, though she’s still smiling. “But I’m not saying you’re wrong.”"

rows.original: You ask Monika what she thinks of Dhaal, now that she’s been here for a while and made a home for herself and the crew.
rows.translation: 你问莫妮卡，在达尔住了一段时间，还为自己和船员安家后，她对这里有什么看法。
rows.raw: "You ask Monika what she thinks of Dhaal, now that she’s been here for a while and made a home for herself and the crew."

rows.original: “Easy answer is it could have been a lot worse,” Monika says, then crosses her arms over her chest. “Long story short, we needed to get somewhere far away and a Rush world seemed like our best bet. There weren’t many places we could get to before the ship fell apart.” She shrugs. “Dhaal wouldn’t have been my first choice, but here we are.”
rows.translation: “最简单的回答是，情况本来可能糟得多，”莫妮卡说着，双臂抱在胸前。“长话短说，我们需要逃到很远的地方，而开拓世界似乎是最佳选择。在飞船散架之前，能抵达的地方并不多。”她耸耸肩。“达尔不会是我的首选，但我们现在就在这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Easy answer is it could have been a lot worse,” Monika says, then crosses her arms over her chest. “Long story short, we needed to get somewhere far away and a Rush world seemed like our best bet. There weren’t many places we could get to before the ship fell apart.” She shrugs. “Dhaal wouldn’t have been my first choice, but here we are.”"

rows.original: You’d bet a lot of rushers have stories like that. But what does she actually think of this world?
rows.translation: 你敢说许多开拓者都有类似故事。但她究竟怎么看这个世界？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’d bet a lot of rushers have stories like that. But what does she actually think of this world?"

rows.original: She pauses for a moment, then gives you a small smirk. “I think we got here at just the right time,” Monika says, sounding like she’s letting you in on a secret. “The trip here wasn’t great, but once we saw what was going on here, I knew we could make something of it.”
rows.translation: 她停顿片刻，随后朝你坏笑。“我觉得我们来得正是时候，”莫妮卡说，语气像是在向你透露秘密。“来这里的旅程并不愉快，可一看清这里的情况，我就知道我们能闯出点名堂。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pauses for a moment, then gives you a small smirk. “I think we got here at just the right time,” Monika says, sounding like she’s letting you in on a secret. “The trip here wasn’t great, but once we saw what was going on here, I knew we could make something of it.”"

rows.original: You’re not sure what she means. She and the others, like any non-natives, really stick out on this planet, and they’re literally living underground. So how was Dhaal the right world for them?
rows.translation: 你不明白她的意思。她和其他人同所有外来者一样，在这颗星球上非常显眼，而且她们确实住在地下。那么达尔怎么会是适合她们的世界？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not sure what she means. She and the others, like any non-natives, really stick out on this planet, and they’re literally living underground. So how was Dhaal the right world for them?"

rows.original: Monika chuckles. “Little secret of the trade, [pc.name],” she says, and leans in closer to you. “Every world’s got an underground. Doesn’t matter if it’s a crazy-rich core planet or a tiny mining colony on some forsaken rock. Everywhere you go, you can find someone who’s set up on the wrong side of the law.” She pauses. “And then there’s places like Zhèng Shi, where there’s nothing but the wrong side of the law. But you get the idea.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡轻笑。“行业里的小秘密，[pc.name]，”她说着向你靠近。“每个世界都有地下社会。无论是富得离谱的核心星球，还是荒凉岩石上的小型采矿殖民地。无论走到哪里，都能找到在法律另一边扎根的人。”她顿了顿。“还有郑石那种地方，那里除了违法的一边，什么都没有。不过你懂我的意思。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika chuckles. “Little secret of the trade, [pc.name],” she says, and leans in closer to you. “Every world’s got an underground. Doesn’t matter if it’s a crazy-rich core planet or a tiny mining colony on some forsaken rock. Everywhere you go, you can find someone who’s set up on the wrong side of the law.” She pauses. “And then there’s places like Zhèng Shi, where there’s nothing but the wrong side of the law. But you get the idea.”"

rows.original: That’s definitely true. Even in Myrellion, where most of the civilization is literally the underground.
rows.translation: 这当然没错。即使在米瑞利恩，大部分文明也确实位于地下。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s definitely true. Even in Myrellion, where most of the civilization is literally the underground."

rows.original: “I remember that,” Monika says with a nod. “We didn’t get to stay there long, but that’s a place that sticks with you.” She clears her throat. “But once we got a hold of what’s going on here on Dhaal, and how it works with the corps and all that, I knew we had a shot at slipping into this place’s underground. Dhaal works different from most places I’ve been, but... just look around.”
rows.translation: “我记得那里，”莫妮卡点头说道。“我们没能停留太久，但那地方让人难忘。”她清了清嗓子。“不过一旦弄清达尔的情况，明白它和公司之类的东西如何运转，我就知道我们有机会混进这里的地下社会。达尔和我去过的大多数地方都不一样，但是...看看周围。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I remember that,” Monika says with a nod. “We didn’t get to stay there long, but that’s a place that sticks with you.” She clears her throat. “But once we got a hold of what’s going on here on Dhaal, and how it works with the corps and all that, I knew we had a shot at slipping into this place’s underground. Dhaal works different from most places I’ve been, but... just look around.”"

rows.original: You glance around the bar, then look back at her, not sure what you’re supposed to be looking for. She and the others are running an illegal milk bar, you get that, but what does she mean?
rows.translation: 你环顾酒吧，随后看回她，不明白自己该看什么。她和其他人在经营非法牛奶酒吧，这一点你知道，但她究竟是什么意思？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou glance around the bar, then look back at her, not sure what you’re supposed to be looking for. She and the others are running an illegal milk bar, you get that, but what does she mean?"

rows.original: “I mean this place needs an underground,” she says with a sly smile. “These people live under the corps’ thumbs, even if they feel like they don’t. So they need somewhere to get away from that, someplace where they don’t have to worry about whatever’s going on up in the city. And we give them that.”
rows.translation: “我的意思是，这个地方需要地下社会，”她狡黠地笑道。“这些人活在公司的拇指下，哪怕自以为不是。所以他们需要一个逃离控制的地方，在那里不用担心城里上面发生的事。而我们把这个地方给了他们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I mean this place needs an underground,” she says with a sly smile. “These people live under the corps’ thumbs, even if they feel like they don’t. So they need somewhere to get away from that, someplace where they don’t have to worry about whatever’s going on up in the city. And we give them that.”"

rows.original: And they provide something that pretty much all the zaika want, which doesn’t hurt at all.
rows.translation: 而且她们还提供几乎所有扎伊卡都想要的东西，这当然大有帮助。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd they provide something that pretty much all the zaika want, which doesn’t hurt at all."

rows.original: Monika flashes you a grin. “Everybody’s got to eat,” she says, then nods over her shoulder to the cowgirl sharing the bar with her. “Not our fault one of us has what the zaika need. And lucky for us, they’re real eager to pay for it.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡朝你咧嘴一笑。“所有人都得吃东西，”她说着，朝身后同她一起守吧台的牛仔姑娘点头。“我们之中恰好有人拥有扎伊卡需要的东西，这又不是我们的错。幸运的是，她们非常愿意付钱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika flashes you a grin. “Everybody’s got to eat,” she says, then nods over her shoulder to the cowgirl sharing the bar with her. “Not our fault one of us has what the zaika need. And lucky for us, they’re real eager to pay for it.”"

rows.original: Before you can ask Monika anything more, she turns to a zaika couple as they walk up to the bar, and pulls out two glasses. Looks like she’s done talking about this for now, but she might say more when she knows you better.
rows.translation: 你还没来得及继续询问莫妮卡，她便转向走到吧台前的一对扎伊卡，拿出两只杯子。看来她暂时不想继续谈，不过等她更熟悉你以后，也许会再多说一些。
rows.raw: "Before you can ask Monika anything more, she turns to a zaika couple as they walk up to the bar, and pulls out two glasses. Looks like she’s done talking about this for now, but she might say more when she knows you better."

rows.original: Before you can ask Monika anything more, she turns to a zaika couple as they walk up to the bar. She holds up a hand for you to wait, then pulls out two glasses and takes their orders. After pouring from two of the fancy-looking bottles behind the bar, she swipes their credit chits, then turns back to you as they walk away.
rows.translation: 你还没来得及继续询问莫妮卡，一对扎伊卡便来到吧台，她转身招呼。她抬手示意你稍等，拿出两只杯子并记下订单。她从吧台后两只外观精致的瓶子里倒好酒，刷过两人的信用芯片；等他们离开后，她再次转向你。
rows.raw: "Before you can ask Monika anything more, she turns to a zaika couple as they walk up to the bar. She holds up a hand for you to wait, then pulls out two glasses and takes their orders. After pouring from two of the fancy-looking bottles behind the bar, she swipes their credit chits, then turns back to you as they walk away."

rows.original: “Like I was saying,” she says, “business is good. And those two?” She leans in closer, and lowers her voice. “They’re from two rival gangs up in the city.”
rows.translation: “就像我刚才说的，”她说道，“生意很好。至于那两个人？”她靠得更近，压低声音。“他们来自城里两个敌对帮派。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like I was saying,” she says, “business is good. And those two?” She leans in closer, and lowers her voice. “They’re from two rival gangs up in the city.”"

rows.original: You look over your shoulder at the two zaika as they return to their booth. Sure enough, the outfits they’re wearing match with two of the gangs you’ve seen in the city, and they’re definitely not in the same gang. But they seem fine with each other, friendly if not more. It doesn’t seem like that’s a common sight in the city.
rows.translation: 你回头看那两名扎伊卡返回卡座。果然，他们的服装分别符合你在城里见过的两个帮派，而且绝非同一帮派。不过两人相处得很好，态度友善，甚至可能不止如此。这在城里似乎并不常见。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look over your shoulder at the two zaika as they return to their booth. Sure enough, the outfits they’re wearing match with two of the gangs you’ve seen in the city, and they’re definitely not in the same gang. But they seem fine with each other, friendly if not more. It doesn’t seem like that’s a common sight in the city."

rows.original: When you turn back to Monika, she’s making the two credit chits dance back and forth across her fingers, flipping them from one side of her hand to the other. She realizes you’re looking at her, and flips her hand around, making the chits disappear.
rows.translation: 你转回莫妮卡时，她正让两枚信用芯片在指间来回舞动，从手掌一侧翻到另一侧。她发现你在看，便翻转手掌，让芯片消失。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you turn back to Monika, she’s making the two credit chits dance back and forth across her fingers, flipping them from one side of her hand to the other. She realizes you’re looking at her, and flips her hand around, making the chits disappear."

rows.original: “Every good pirate,” Monika begins, “knows you need neutral ground. You can’t fix everything by shooting it until it stops moving, though I’ve known lots of people who tried. But they know we’ll kick them out if they start shooting in here, so they don’t do it.”
rows.translation: “每个优秀海盗，”莫妮卡开口道，“都知道需要中立地带。不是所有问题都能靠开枪打到它不再动来解决，尽管我认识许多尝试过的人。不过他们知道，要是在这里开枪，我们会把人赶出去，所以没人这么做。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Every good pirate,” Monika begins, “knows you need neutral ground. You can’t fix everything by shooting it until it stops moving, though I’ve known lots of people who tried. But they know we’ll kick them out if they start shooting in here, so they don’t do it.”"

rows.original: That makes sense, though you guess it started out informally. Karrah didn’t disarm you when you came in, and you’re not the only one in here who’s fully armed, but you can see that nobody wants to get kicked out or banned from this place.
rows.translation: 这很合理，不过你猜最初只是非正式规矩。卡拉没有在你进门时解除你的武装，这里全副武装的也不止你一人；但你能看出，谁都不想被赶出去或遭到酒吧封禁。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat makes sense, though you guess it started out informally. Karrah didn’t disarm you when you came in, and you’re not the only one in here who’s fully armed, but you can see that nobody wants to get kicked out or banned from this place."

rows.original: “And that’s why it works,” Monika says, nodding. “If one of the gangs had a place like this, or somehow the corps started one up as a front, you couldn’t have things like that.” She gestures to where the two gang members are talking and drinking. “So milk’s not the only thing we can give them.”
rows.translation: “所以这套办法才有效，”莫妮卡点头说道。“如果这里属于某个帮派，或者是企业弄来当幌子的场所，就不会出现那样的景象。”她示意那两名正在交谈喝酒的帮派成员。“所以牛奶并不是我们唯一能提供的东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And that’s why it works,” Monika says, nodding. “If one of the gangs had a place like this, or somehow the corps started one up as a front, you couldn’t have things like that.” She gestures to where the two gang members are talking and drinking. “So milk’s not the only thing we can give them.”"

rows.original: Have any of the gangs talked to her about that? If the gangs work here like they do pretty much anywhere else, you could see why one or more of them might think they could take over the bar.
rows.translation: 有没有帮派就此找她谈过？如果这里的帮派和其他地方差不多，你能理解为何某个甚至多个帮派会认为自己可以接管酒吧。
rows.raw: "\n\nHave any of the gangs talked to her about that? If the gangs work here like they do pretty much anywhere else, you could see why one or more of them might think they could take over the bar."

rows.original: Monika frowns a little. “It’s kind of strange now that I think about it, but that’s never come up,” she says. “Maybe Karrah scares them off, maybe they don’t want to ruin a good thing, maybe they actually want the neutral ground.” She shrugs. “But I’m good with it either way. Would be nice if it meant they didn’t try to jump us whenever we head up to the city, but you can’t have everything.”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡微微皱眉。“现在想来有点奇怪，不过这种事从没发生过，”她说。“也许卡拉吓退了他们，也许他们不想毁掉一桩好事，也许他们确实想要中立地带。”她耸耸肩。“无论是哪种，我都满意。要是他们因此不再在我们去城里时伏击我们就更好了，不过人不能什么都要。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika frowns a little. “It’s kind of strange now that I think about it, but that’s never come up,” she says. “Maybe Karrah scares them off, maybe they don’t want to ruin a good thing, maybe they actually want the neutral ground.” She shrugs. “But I’m good with it either way. Would be nice if it meant they didn’t try to jump us whenever we head up to the city, but you can’t have everything.”"

rows.original: Maybe they’re just trying to keep up appearances. As popular as the bar seems, you’d think the gangs would leave them alone by now.
rows.translation: 也许他们只是在维持表面形象。酒吧似乎如此受欢迎，你原以为帮派现在应该已经不再找她们麻烦。
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe they’re just trying to keep up appearances. As popular as the bar seems, you’d think the gangs would leave them alone by now."

rows.original: “You might have noticed we’re not natives,” Monika says, then rolls her natural eye. “You know how it is out there. Just having nipples makes you a target.”
rows.translation: “你可能已经注意到，我们不是本地人，”莫妮卡说着转了转天然眼。“你知道外面是什么样。光是长着乳头就会成为目标。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You might have noticed we’re not natives,” Monika says, then rolls her natural eye. “You know how it is out there. Just having nipples makes you a target.”"

rows.original: Before you can say anything else, Monika looks over your shoulder and frowns again. “Speaking of targets,” she says. “There’s someone I need to talk to.” She steps out from behind the bar, and heads over to one of the tables, then returns a moment later and says nothing more.
rows.translation: 你还没来得及继续说话，莫妮卡越过你的肩膀看去，再次皱眉。“说到目标，”她说道，“有个人我得去谈谈。”她从吧台后走出，前往其中一张桌子；片刻后返回，却没再说什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you can say anything else, Monika looks over your shoulder and frowns again. “Speaking of targets,” she says. “There’s someone I need to talk to.” She steps out from behind the bar, and heads over to one of the tables, then returns a moment later and says nothing more."

rows.original: Looks like she’s done talking about that for now. If you ask her about this again when you’re better-known at the bar, she might have more to say.
rows.translation: 看来她暂时不想再谈这件事。等你在酒吧更加知名后再问，她也许会有更多话说。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooks like she’s done talking about that for now. If you ask her about this again when you’re better-known at the bar, she might have more to say."

rows.raw: "\n\n“You might have noticed we’re not natives,” Monika says, then rolls her natural eye. “You know how it is out there. Just having nipples makes you a target.”"

rows.original: That it does. Which makes you think of something else. Do she and the crew plan to stay on Dhaal for very long, or is this a temporary thing?
rows.translation: 确实如此。这让你想到另一件事。她和船员打算在达尔待很久，还是这里只是临时落脚点？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat it does. Which makes you think of something else. Do she and the crew plan to stay on Dhaal for very long, or is this a temporary thing?"

rows.original: Monika twists her mouth to one side as she [flags.MASTODON_END|smiles|thinks]. “[flags.MASTODON_END|Come on|Good question], [pc.name].[flags.MASTODON_END| You know the answer to that.] And [flags.MASTODON_END|it’s|I would have had] a real different answer [flags.MASTODON_END|than it was when we started|a few months ago].”
rows.translation: 莫妮卡[flags.MASTODON_END|微笑|思考]着，嘴角歪向一边。“[flags.MASTODON_END|得了吧|问得好]，[pc.name]。[flags.MASTODON_END| 你知道答案。]而且[flags.MASTODON_END|这个答案|如果是几个月前，我]会给出[flags.MASTODON_END|和最初相比|]截然不同的回答。”
rows.raw: "\n\nMonika twists her mouth to one side as she [flags.MASTODON_END|smiles|thinks]. “[flags.MASTODON_END|Come on|Good question], [pc.name].[flags.MASTODON_END| You know the answer to that.] And [flags.MASTODON_END|it’s|I would have had] a real different answer [flags.MASTODON_END|than it was when we started|a few months ago].”"

rows.original: How so? The bar’s been open long enough for them all to get comfortable with it, but did things start off rough?
rows.translation: 怎么说？酒吧开张得足够久，她们应该已经习惯，但刚开始时很艰难吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nHow so? The bar’s been open long enough for them all to get comfortable with it, but did things start off rough?"

rows.original: “You could say that,” Monika says. She stays quiet for a moment, and just as you’re wondering if she’s going to continue, she does. “Our first month was real hard. It’s not easy to find a way to advertise a place that you don’t want every single person to know about. I ended up having Kiki hack in some secret messages in the right places, to let people know there’s something down here.”
rows.translation: “可以这么说，”莫妮卡说道。她沉默片刻；就在你怀疑她是否会继续时，她开口了。“第一个月非常艰难。想宣传一个又不希望所有人都知道的地方，可不容易。最后我让琪琪在合适的地方黑入一些秘密消息，让人们知道下面有东西。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You could say that,” Monika says. She stays quiet for a moment, and just as you’re wondering if she’s going to continue, she does. “Our first month was real hard. It’s not easy to find a way to advertise a place that you don’t want every single person to know about. I ended up having Kiki hack in some secret messages in the right places, to let people know there’s something down here.”"

rows.original: That plus the graffiti outside clearly worked. The place wasn’t hard to find, but if you hadn’t been paying attention, you would have missed it.
rows.translation: 再加上外面的涂鸦，显然起了作用。这里不难找，但如果没有留心，很容易错过。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat plus the graffiti outside clearly worked. The place wasn’t hard to find, but if you hadn’t been paying attention, you would have missed it."

rows.original: “And that means we’re doing it right.” Monika’s smile slowly returns. “[flags.MASTODON_END|But this was never meant to be|I don’t know if this is] a long-term thing for us[flags.MASTODON_END|| or not]. The girls like it enough, and it beats the hell out of trying to find work on this planet. Most anything else we tried to do would get us under the zaibatsus’ thumb.” She fixes her gaze on you. “And that is not why I became a pirate.”
rows.translation: “这说明我们的做法正确。”莫妮卡的笑容缓缓回来。“[flags.MASTODON_END|但这里从来就不是|我不知道这里是不是]我们的长期归宿[flags.MASTODON_END||]。姑娘们还算喜欢，而且总比试图在这颗星球上找工作强得多。我们若做其他事情，多半会落到财阀控制之下。”她凝视着你。“我当海盗可不是为了这个。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And that means we’re doing it right.” Monika’s smile slowly returns. “[flags.MASTODON_END|But this was never meant to be|I don’t know if this is] a long-term thing for us[flags.MASTODON_END|| or not]. The girls like it enough, and it beats the hell out of trying to find work on this planet. Most anything else we tried to do would get us under the zaibatsus’ thumb.” She fixes her gaze on you. “And that is not why I became a pirate.”"

rows.original: Not at all. [flags.MASTODON_END|But there’s still plenty of work to be done on the ship, right? It wasn’t in great shape when you brought it back.|But does she think this place can go on for a long time? Does she, or the crew in general, have plans for something else?]
rows.translation: 当然不是。[flags.MASTODON_END|不过飞船上还有很多工作要做，对吧？你把它带回来时状态可不好。|但她认为这里能长期维持吗？她或整支船员队伍有没有别的计划？]
rows.raw: "\n\nNot at all. [flags.MASTODON_END|But there’s still plenty of work to be done on the ship, right? It wasn’t in great shape when you brought it back.|But does she think this place can go on for a long time? Does she, or the crew in general, have plans for something else?]"

rows.original: “We’ll stay here [flags.MASTODON_END|until the ship is ready to fly|as long as we need to],” Monika says. It sounds like this is something she’s thought about [flags.MASTODON_END|a lot|before]. “I can’t say I don’t like doing this. It’s nice to wake up in the same place every day, and to know I’m probably not going to get shot at when I’m just trying to make some credits. It’s not a life I’m used to, but it’s been good to me so far. But....”
rows.translation: “我们会留在这里，[flags.MASTODON_END|直到飞船准备好再次起航|想待多久就待多久]，”莫妮卡说。听起来她[flags.MASTODON_END|经常|以前]思考这件事。“我不能说自己不喜欢这份工作。每天在同一个地方醒来，知道自己赚信用点时大概不会挨枪子，感觉很好。这不是我习惯的生活，但到目前为止待我不薄。可是....”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’ll stay here [flags.MASTODON_END|until the ship is ready to fly|as long as we need to],” Monika says. It sounds like this is something she’s thought about [flags.MASTODON_END|a lot|before]. “I can’t say I don’t like doing this. It’s not a life I’m used to, but it’s been good to me so far. But....”"

rows.original: You wait for her to continue. Monika gets a faraway look in her eyes, then turns back to you with a smile.
rows.translation: 你等待她继续。莫妮卡眼神变得遥远，随后微笑着看回你。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wait for her to continue. Monika gets a faraway look in her eyes, then turns back to you with a smile."

rows.original: “I’ve been knocked down over and over, but I’ve never stayed down,” she says. “Someday, we’ll [flags.MASTODON_END|fly out of here|decide to get started again]. All we need is a pilot and a few more in the crew. Getting out of here won’t be hard, and I know some of these girls would love to see the rest of the galaxy.” She pauses. “Just so you don’t read me wrong, I’m not asking if you want to join up. I [flags.MASTODON_END|know|can tell] you’ve got way too much going on for that.”
rows.translation: “我一次次被打倒，却从没趴着不起来，”她说。“总有一天，我们会[flags.MASTODON_END|从这里飞出去|决定重新开始]。只需要一名飞行员，再补充几名船员。离开这里不会困难，而且我知道这些姑娘中有人很想看看银河其他地方。”她停顿片刻。“别误会，我不是在问你要不要加入。我[flags.MASTODON_END|知道|看得出]你手头的事情多得根本顾不上这个。”

Getting out of here won’t be hard, and I know some of these girls would love to see the rest of the galaxy.” She pauses. “Just so you don’t read me wrong, I’m not asking if you want to join up. I [flags.MASTODON_END|know|can tell] you’ve got way too much going on for that.”"

rows.original: She’s not wrong. But she still wants to become a pirate again?
rows.translation: 她说得没错。但她还是想再次成为海盗？
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’s not wrong. But she still wants to become a pirate again?"

rows.original: “I never stopped,” she says, grinning at you again. “None of us did. [flags.MASTODON_END|Once the ship is ready, we’ll gather up|Someday, we’ll grab a ship we want] and head out. New crew, new name, but back to the life we like the most. And that will be a good day for all of us.”
rows.translation: “我从没停止当海盗，”她再次朝你咧嘴笑道。“我们谁都没有。[flags.MASTODON_END|等飞船准备好，我们就召集人手|总有一天，我们会抢一艘想要的飞船]，然后出发。新的船员、新的名字，但回到我们最喜欢的生活。那会是属于所有人的好日子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I never stopped,” she says, grinning at you again. “None of us did. [flags.MASTODON_END|Once the ship is ready, we’ll gather up|Someday, we’ll grab a ship we want] and head out. New crew, new name, but back to the life we like the most. And that will be a good day for all of us.”"

rows.original: You ask Monika how things have been going with the new ship. The kaithrit woman leans one hip against the bar and takes a deep breath, then gives you a measured look. “About as well as I’d hoped,” she says. “So far, so good, and nothing’s gone wrong yet. We’re getting in parts when we can, and we spend a few days a week over at the spaceport working on it.” That’s good to hear, though she doesn’t sound very excited about it. Monika glances away, and sighs. Her ears tilt downward for just a moment before standing up straight again. “It’s the biggest thing we’ve had go right since we built this bar,” she says, her voice lower. “So it’s real easy to think about how things could go bad.” You can definitely understand that. With the zaibatsu control on this planet, it’s easy to picture someone looking a little too close at the ship under repairs and deciding to poke their nose where it doesn’t belong. And that could only lead to trouble. She nods, then picks up two shot glasses and starts spinning them around her fingers. “That’s it exactly. Kiki swears she has everything set up so nobody notices anything unusual, but....” Monika shakes her head. “I’ve been doing this too long and seen too much go bad to think we can get all this done quick and easy.” Is there any way to tell how much longer they need? Sooner is better, of course, but she mentioned that doing things too quickly might draw attention. “Only because it takes a lot of credits to get this kind of work done quickly,” Monika says. She spins one shot glass up into the air, makes the other disappear, then catches the first one. “We’ve got a slow stream of credits going into the shell company Kiki set up, so hopefully nobody notices anything.” She rubs at her shoulder and winces, then slips the shot glasses back under the bar counter. “It’s got me a little stressed,” she says, and the stern expression on her face relaxes a little. “Karrah’s been rubbing my shoulders and back to get the tension out. She’d growl at you if you mentioned it, but she’s actually real good at massage.” As strong as Karrah is, you don’t doubt that, though it’s no surprise she wouldn’t exactly advertise such a peaceful use of her muscles. Monika shakes her head, and chuckles a little. “We’ve been at this long enough,” she says. “We’ve all got our hard and soft sides, and we’ve seen them both on every one of us.” You glance down at Monika’s bulge at the mention of her hard side, and she gives you a confident smirk. You know that’s not what she meant, but.... “I know,” she says, then glances around the bar, her green eye sweeping back and forth over the crowd. “It’ll be good to move on from this place, someday,” she says. “But you know what’s going to be strange?” You shake your head. What? “Being the only captain.” Monika pulls up a slender glass and starts polishing it, though it looks perfectly clean. “Back with Redd and the others, there were three of us in charge. It was never about having one person in command. We did that on purpose, and I liked it that way.” Monika pauses, and the look on her face is difficult to read. “Redd was fine with being the face of the crew, so we used her name. Redd’s Ruthless.” She drops her hand, resting it above where the RR tattoo is on her hip, then shakes her head. “It feels weird to say that name again after what happened. But I saw the video Redd left.” She purses her lips. “Once we’re out there with a new ship, I’ll be the only captain. And that’s going to take some getting used to.” But she’s been leading this small crew for a while, here at the bar. That has to count for something, doesn’t it? She gives you a rueful smile. “Running an underground bar isn’t like being a ship’s captain, even if they both mean hiding from the law,” she says, a glint of humor in her organic eye. “Down here, we do what we need to survive, and as long as we stick to that, we can mostly be sure we’ll be okay.” You nod. That does seem like the case, mostly. “Once we’re back in the black again, it’ll be the usual state of anything goes, especially with the work we do,” Monika says. You hear some sternness in her voice again, the same as when she told you about the message from the Mastodon. “And if we pick up some more crew before we leave, they’ll be a new set of risks, people who don’t know how to handle their new lives. So as soon as we’re off-world, everything changes.” From all that you’ve seen of her, you’re sure she can handle it. If she’s held her crew together through a forced landing, a complete change of life, and now the preparations to take to the sky again, she can handle returning to piracy as the only captain. “I hope you’re right,” she says. “But thanks. I’m not sure what you’re flying these days, but if we meet again once we’re out there, we’ll try to take it easy on you if we have to rob you.” You hope she’s joking, though if she has Josie working their comms like the cowgirl has talked about, you’re sure you can talk them out of boarding you. But she’ll let you know when they leave, won’t she? “If I can,” Monika says with a nod. “We owe you that, at the very least, after all you did for us.” She gives you a sincere smile. “Hopefully we’ll get to tell you goodbye before we launch.” Monika looks around the bar, then nods, seemingly to herself. “But if you come down here someday and the door won’t open, and the ship’s gone from the spaceport, you know we finally got out of here. And when that happens, I hope we can meet you somewhere else, on a better world than this one.” She winks her green eye at you. “And when that happens, the drinks are on me.”
rows.translation: 你问莫妮卡，新飞船的工作进展如何。 凯斯里特女人单侧髋部靠着吧台，深吸一口气，随后冷静地望向你。“和我希望的差不多顺利，”她说道。“到目前为止一切都好，还没有出任何差错。能弄到零件时我们就弄，每周也会花几天时间去太空港那边干活。” 这是个好消息，尽管她听起来对此并没有多么兴奋。 莫妮卡把目光转开，叹了口气。她的耳朵短暂垂下，随后再次笔直竖起。“自从建起这间酒吧以来，这是我们遇到最大的一件顺利事，”她压低声音说道。“所以，也很容易想到事情可能怎样变糟。” 你完全能够理解。在这个财阀控制的星球，很容易想象有人过于仔细地观察维修中的飞船，决定把鼻子伸进不该管的地方。而那只会招来麻烦。 她点点头，随后拿起两个小酒杯，开始让它们绕手指旋转。“正是如此。琪琪发誓她已经安排好一切，不会让任何人注意到异常，可是...”莫妮卡摇摇头。“我干这行太久，也见过太多事情变糟，没法相信我们能又快又轻松地完成这一切。” 有没有办法看出她们还需要多久？当然越快越好，但她提过，动作太快也许会引起注意。 “那只是因为要想快速完成这种工作，就得花很多信用点，”莫妮卡说道。她把一个小酒杯旋上半空，让另一个消失，随后接住第一个。“我们正让信用点缓慢流进琪琪建立的空壳公司，希望没有人发现。” 她揉了揉肩膀，又疼得缩了一下，随后把小酒杯塞回吧台下。“这让我有点紧张，”她说道，脸上严厉的神情稍稍放松。“卡拉一直帮我揉肩捶背，缓解紧张。如果你提起这事，她肯定会朝你咆哮，不过她按摩确实很厉害。” 以卡拉的力量，你毫不怀疑这一点；不过，她不愿主动宣传肌肉还有这种和平用途，也丝毫不令人意外。 莫妮卡摇摇头，轻声笑了起来。“我们一起走过的时间已经够长了，”她说道。“每个人都有强硬和柔软的一面，而彼此身上的两面，我们全都见过。” 她提起自己强硬的一面时，你低头瞥向莫妮卡的隆起，而她回以自信坏笑。你知道她指的不是这个，不过... “我知道，”她说道，随后环顾酒吧，绿色眼睛来回扫过人群。“有朝一日离开这里会是件好事，”她说。“不过你知道什么会感觉很奇怪吗？” 你摇摇头。什么？ “成为唯一的舰长。”莫妮卡拿起一只细长玻璃杯，开始擦拭，尽管它看起来已经无比干净。“以前和瑞德以及其他人在一起时，我们有三个人共同负责。从来不是由一个人指挥一切。我们故意这样安排，而我喜欢那种方式。” 莫妮卡停下来，脸上的神色难以解读。“瑞德不介意充当船员的门面，所以我们用了她的名字。瑞德的无情号。”她放下一只手，搁在髋部RR纹身上方，随后摇摇头。“发生那件事以后，再说出这个名字感觉很奇怪。但我看过瑞德留下的视频。”她抿起嘴唇。“等我们坐着新飞船重返外面，我会是唯一的舰长。这需要一段时间适应。” 但她已经在这间酒吧领导这支小队有一阵了。这总该有点用处，对吧？ 她苦笑起来。“经营地下酒吧和当飞船舰长可不一样，哪怕两者都意味着躲避法律，”她说道，生物眼睛里闪过幽默光芒。“在这里，我们做自己生存所需的事情，只要坚持这一点，基本就能确定不会有事。” 你点点头。大体而言，情况似乎确实如此。 “等我们再次回到黑暗太空，一切都会恢复成无法无天的常态，尤其考虑到我们的工作，”莫妮卡说道。你再次从她的语气中听见严厉，和她向你讲起乳齿象号来信时一模一样。“而且，如果离开前又招募一些船员，他们会带来一整套新的风险，一群不知道该如何应对新生活的人。所以，只要一离开这个星球，一切都会改变。” 根据你见过的所有表现，你相信她能处理好。如果她能带领船员熬过迫降、彻底改变生活方式，以及如今重返天空的准备，就也能以唯一舰长的身份应对海盗生活。 “希望你说得对，”她说道。“不过，谢谢。我不知道你最近在驾驶什么，但等我们离开这里后再度相遇，如果不得不抢你，我们会尽量手下留情。” 你希望她是在开玩笑；不过，若乔茜真的像她提过的那样负责通讯，你相信自己能说服她们别登船。但她们离开时会通知你，对吧？ “如果能做到，”莫妮卡点头说道。“考虑到你为我们做的一切，我们至少欠你这一点。”她真诚地微笑。“希望起飞以前，我们能亲口向你告别。” 莫妮卡环顾酒吧，随后点点头，似乎在回应自己。“但如果有一天你来到这里，门却打不开，太空港里的飞船也已经消失，你就知道我们终于离开了。等那一刻发生，我希望能在其他地方与你见面，在一个比这里更好的世界。” 她朝你眨了眨绿色眼睛。“等到那时候，我请你喝酒。”

rows.original: Ship
rows.raw: "Ship"

rows.original: You ask Monika if she’s not too busy to duck off somewhere for a little action. She looks at you like she’s thinking about it, then shakes her head.
rows.translation: 你问莫妮卡是否忙得没空溜去某处玩一会儿。她像是在认真考虑般看着你，随后摇摇头。
rows.raw: "You ask Monika if she’s not too busy to duck off somewhere for a little action. She looks at you like she’s thinking about it, then shakes her head."

rows.original: “Nothing personal,” she says, sounding a little less friendly than usual, “but we’ve got rules in my bar. You’re still pretty new around here, and the rule is no heading off and fucking new people.”
rows.translation: “不是针对你，”她说，语气不如平常友善，“但我的酒吧有规矩。你来这里的时间还很短，规矩就是不能带着新人离开去做爱。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nothing personal,” she says, sounding a little less friendly than usual, “but we’ve got rules in my bar. You’re still pretty new around here, and the rule is no heading off and fucking new people.”"

rows.original: She raises a hand as you start to say something, and fixes her half-cybernetic gaze on you, waiting until it’s clear you’re not going to interrupt her before she continues.
rows.translation: 你正要开口，她便抬起手，用半机械的目光盯住你；等确定你不会打断，她才继续。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe raises a hand as you start to say something, and fixes her half-cybernetic gaze on you, waiting until it’s clear you’re not going to interrupt her before she continues."

rows.original: “You know how we’re working down here, [pc.name]. The last thing we need is some corporate goon or wanna-be bounty hunter or who the hell knows what else showing up and trying to start something by getting one of us alone.” Her stern gaze softens a little. “You don’t seem too bad. But you let us get to know you a little more, before you start trying to get some private time with anybody.”
rows.translation: “你知道我们在下面如何运作，[pc.name]。我们最不需要的，就是某个企业走狗、冒牌赏金猎人，或鬼知道什么家伙跑来，通过把我们中的某个人单独引开而挑事。”她严厉的目光稍微软化。“你看起来不坏。但先让我们多了解你一点，再去争取和谁独处。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You know how we’re working down here, [pc.name]. The last thing we need is some corporate goon or wanna-be bounty hunter or who the hell knows what else showing up and trying to start something by getting one of us alone.” Her stern gaze softens a little. “You don’t seem too bad. But you let us get to know you a little more, before you start trying to get some private time with anybody.”"

rows.original: The small smile she gives you is genuine, but her answer is clearly a no.
rows.translation: 她给你的微笑虽小却真诚，但答案显然是否定的。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe small smile she gives you is genuine, but her answer is clearly a no."

rows.raw: "\n\n“Something like that,” Josie says. “Best way to end a party ever, I can tell you that.”"

rows.original: For a moment, Josie looks like she has more to say, but after a moment, she just shrugs and smiles at you. Maybe if you spend more time at the bar, she’ll feel more like opening up to you.
rows.translation: 有那么一会儿，乔茜看起来还有话想说，但片刻后只是耸耸肩，朝你微笑。或许你在酒吧多待些日子以后，她会更愿意向你敞开心扉。

rows.translation: 乔茜顿了顿，却不像已经说完，于是你又追问了一点。在一艘已经离开故乡的飞船上醒来，肯定让她大吃一惊。

And the last girl I fucked was all kinds of sorry for banging me so hard I passed out. The captains said they could drop me off at a station where I could find a ship home, and they’d at least pay my way back. So I was thinking, yeah, that was the best idea. And then....”

rows.original: She gives you a small, warm smile. “Then I looked out at the stars.”
rows.translation: 她朝你露出温暖的浅笑。“然后我望向了群星。”

rows.original: Josie sighs. “I’d never really thought much about leaving home. I had a good job, good friends, all the sex I wanted, what more really was there? But it wasn’t until I was on that ship, who the fuck knows how far from New Texas, with a bunch of girls who had lives like I’d never known. And I asked myself, what if I didn’t go back? What if I just rolled with this, and did something new?”"

rows.translation: 第一次离开自己的星球，确实会让人产生这种想法。尤其是她此前从未认真考虑过离家。
rows.raw: "\n\nBeing off-world for the first time can do that. Especially if she’d never really thought about leaving home."

rows.original: “Ain’t like it was an easy decision,” she says. “I mean, I was standing there, naked and with nothing, sore as fuck from having Kiki’s dong all the way up my ass, and no easy way to get back home. So I thought, what the hell. I could be a space pirate too.”

And now, here I am on a planet most people haven’t even heard of.” She gives you another smile. “Joining up with the girls was probably the best decision I ever made.”

rows.translation: 你问乔茜对酒吧有什么看法。这里的人显然喜欢她，可她自己感觉如何？
rows.raw: "You ask Josie what she thinks about the bar. People clearly like her here, but how does she feel about it?"

rows.original: “The bar?” she asks, her blue eyes wide. “Oh, this place is great. I mean, it’s no Fucking Bronco, but it’s not like we’re going for that.” She looks out across the zaika filling up the place. “Not that I’d mind starting an orgy or two here, but Monika says I’m not allowed.”

Couple times, all I had to do was show some cleavage and we could reel in a ship to board and loot without much trouble.” She sighs. “Those were good days, but it wasn’t like that all the time. We had to take shit jobs sometimes, or big risks that maybe wouldn’t pay off, just to make sure we could eat.”

rows.original: You’ve heard of the big-name pirates, but you guess that there are a lot of smaller crews and ships out there trying to stay afloat. Must have been hard sometimes.
rows.translation: 你听说过那些声名显赫的海盗，不过想来宇宙中还有许多规模较小的船员和飞船，只为勉强维持生计。有时一定很艰难。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve heard of the big-name pirates, but you guess that there are a lot of smaller crews and ships out there trying to stay afloat. Must have been hard sometimes."

rows.original: “Yeah, it was,” Josie says. “Wasn’t great when we ended up stuck here and most of the crew took off, either.” Then, her bovine ears perk up. “But we’re here now, and I’ve still got some of the girls with me. That beats the hell out of everyone being split up.”
rows.translation: “是啊，确实如此，”乔茜说道。“后来我们被困在这里，大部分船员都离开了，那也不好受。”随后，她的牛耳竖了起来。“但我们现在还在这里，而且身边还有一些姑娘。这总比所有人分道扬镳强得多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, it was,” Josie says. “Wasn’t great when we ended up stuck here and most of the crew took off, either.” Then, her bovine ears perk up. “But we’re here now, and I’ve still got some of the girls with me. That beats the hell out of everyone being split up.”"

rows.original: She gives you a warm smile, but says no more.
rows.translation: 她朝你温暖一笑，却没有再说下去。
rows.raw: "She gives you a warm smile, but says no more."

rows.original: You get the feeling there’s more to this story that Josie’s holding back. Maybe if you spend more time at the bar, she’ll feel more like opening up to you.
rows.translation: 你感觉乔茜还隐瞒了更多故事。也许多来酒吧待些时间，她会更愿意向你敞开心扉。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou get the feeling there’s more to this story that Josie’s holding back. Maybe if you spend more time at the bar, she’ll feel more like opening up to you."

rows.original: She gives you a warm smile, and gestures to the bar around you. “And I think we made the best of it,” she continues. “We found this place pretty much on our own, and Kiki and Karrah took the old ship apart and put the whole bar together. I have no idea how they make it all work, but it works, so no worries.”
rows.translation: 她朝你温暖一笑，示意周围的酒吧。“而且我觉得我们已经做到了最好，”她继续说道。“我们基本靠自己找到了这里，琪琪和卡拉拆掉旧船，搭起了整间酒吧。我完全不知道她们怎么让一切运转起来，但确实能用，所以不用担心。”

I have no idea how they make it all work, but it works, so no worries.”"

rows.original: So this is where they call home now, if they don’t have a ship anymore. Does everyone live down here, or do they have places in the city?
rows.translation: 所以既然她们不再拥有飞船，这里便是如今的家。所有人都住在下面，还是在城里另有住处？
rows.raw: "\n\nSo this is where they call home now, if they don’t have a ship anymore. Does everyone live down here, or do they have places in the city?"

rows.original: “We live here,” Josie says. “Pretty expensive to live topside, and it ain’t like I can walk around up there without a bodyguard.” She winces a little. “You ask me, I’m safer down here, behind that door and Karrah’s guns, than anywhere up there.”
