rows.translation: 你走到台球桌旁。桌面由金属板制成，框架看起来东拼西凑，与酒吧其他大部分设施一样。桌子下方立着由各种机械部件组成的支柱，在不断移动的灯光下，你看不清具体是什么。两名扎伊卡正在其中一张桌上打球，显得非常专注。另一张桌子空着。当你走近时，
rows.raw: "You step over to the pool tables. Their tops are made of sheet metal, and the frames look cobbled-together, like most of the rest of the bar. Beneath the tables lie pillars of various mechanical parts that you can’t make out with the constantly moving lights. Two zaika are playing at one of the tables, looking very intent on their game. The other table is open, and as you walk up to it, "

joinAfter.expression:
void 0 !== flags.KIKI_MET
                    ? "Kiki"
                    : "the woman in the suit"

rows.original: Kiki
rows.translation: 琪琪
rows.raw: "Kiki"

rows.original: the woman in the suit
rows.translation: 那个穿西装的女人
rows.raw: "the woman in the suit"

rows.original: walks over to join you.
rows.translation: 走过来加入你。
rows.raw: " walks over to join you."

rows.original: “Need someone to play with, [pc.name]?” She grins at you.
rows.translation: “需要人陪你玩吗，[pc.name]？”她朝你咧嘴一笑。
rows.raw: "“Need someone to play with, [pc.name]?” She grins at you."

rows.original: “Welcome to the Crash Landing,” she says. “I’m Kiki, I run this room. Do you want to play pool?”
rows.translation: “欢迎来到坠落酒吧，”她说道。“我是琪琪，这个房间归我管。想打台球吗？”
rows.raw: "“Welcome to the Crash Landing,” she says. “I’m Kiki, I run this room. Do you want to play pool?”"

rows.original: You introduce yourself, and tell her that yes, you’re here to play pool.
rows.translation: 你做了自我介绍，告诉她没错，你就是来打台球的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou introduce yourself, and tell her that yes, you’re here to play pool."

rows.original: Kiki picks up one of the short handles hanging from the side of the table and hands it to you. Then, she takes up her own handle, and clicks it on. A hardlight pool cue extends from it.
rows.translation: 琪琪拿起挂在桌边的一个短柄，递给你。随后她拿起自己的手柄，按下开关，一根硬光台球杆从中延伸出来。
rows.raw: " Kiki picks up one of the short handles hanging from the side of the table and hands it to you. Then, she takes up her own handle, and clicks it on. A hardlight pool cue extends from it."

rows.original: Kiki flicks a switch on the side of the pool table. Sixteen small drones fly out from tiny ports, and align themselves in the middle. Spheres of hardlight flare to life around the drones, marking the fifteen regular balls and cue ball.
rows.translation: 琪琪拨动台球桌侧面的开关。十六台小型无人机从微型端口飞出，在桌子中央排列整齐。硬光球体在无人机周围亮起，形成十五颗普通球和一颗母球。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki flicks a switch on the side of the pool table. Sixteen small drones fly out from tiny ports, and align themselves in the middle. Spheres of hardlight flare to life around the drones, marking the fifteen regular balls and cue ball."

rows.original: “You can take the first shot,” Kiki says, then smirks. “Wouldn’t want you to spend the whole time watching me play.”
rows.translation: “你可以先来，”琪琪说道，随后坏笑。“总不能让你全程只看着我打。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You can take the first shot,” Kiki says, then smirks. “Wouldn’t want you to spend the whole time watching me play.”"

rows.original: Start
rows.translation: 开始
rows.raw: "Start"

rows.original: You line up the cue ball, and break. The collision is silent, but the hardlight balls go rolling all across the table, spinning over the steel. Nothing goes in, so you stand aside for Kiki to take her turn.
rows.translation: 你瞄准母球，开球。碰撞悄无声息，但硬光球全都滚向桌面各处，在钢板上旋转。没有任何球落袋，于是你退到一旁，让琪琪开始她的回合。
rows.raw: "You line up the cue ball, and break. The collision is silent, but the hardlight balls go rolling all across the table, spinning over the steel. Nothing goes in, so you stand aside for Kiki to take her turn."

rows.original: Kiki takes a turn around the table, looking over the angles, tapping her cue idly against the bands of metal winding around her hand. Finally, she bends over and leans in, takes a few practice strokes, then shoots. The ball she aimed for rolls into the corner pocket, and she gives you a grin. “First shot’s mine,” she says. “Let’s see if you can keep up.”
rows.translation: 琪琪绕着球桌走了一圈，观察各种角度，漫不经心地用球杆轻敲缠绕在手上的金属带。最后，她弯腰俯身，试着挥了几下杆，随后击球。目标球滚进角袋，她朝你咧嘴一笑。“第一球是我的，”她说道。“看看你能不能跟上。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki takes a turn around the table, looking over the angles, tapping her cue idly against the bands of metal winding around her hand. Finally, she bends over and leans in, takes a few practice strokes, then shoots. The ball she aimed for rolls into the corner pocket, and she gives you a grin. “First shot’s mine,” she says. “Let’s see if you can keep up.”"

rows.original: Her second shot goes wide, and she pouts. You step up for your shot, and take aim carefully.
rows.translation: 她的第二杆打偏了，她撅起嘴巴。你走上前准备击球，仔细瞄准。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer second shot goes wide, and she pouts. You step up for your shot, and take aim carefully."

rows.original: This shot’s a good one, sending the ball into the side pocket. The score is now one to one.
rows.translation: 这一杆打得很好，球进入侧袋。目前比分一比一。
rows.raw: "\n\nThis shot’s a good one, sending the ball into the side pocket. The score is now one to one."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The next shot is yours. You spot two balls with your numbers together in one corner, and grin, then move around to get a good angle on the shot.
rows.translation: 下一杆轮到你。你发现属于自己的两颗球在一个角落里挨在一起，咧嘴一笑，随后绕到合适角度准备击球。
rows.raw: "The next shot is yours. You spot two balls with your numbers together in one corner, and grin, then move around to get a good angle on the shot."

rows.original: Kiki realizes what you’re aiming at, and clenches her cue stick in both hands, clearly not happy about this. “Okay, you just got lucky with those two,” she says. “Stupid balls rolling around at random.”
rows.translation: 琪琪看出你的目标，双手紧握球杆，显然对此很不高兴。“好吧，刚才那两个球只是你运气好，”她说道。“蠢球到处乱滚而已。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki realizes what you’re aiming at, and clenches her cue stick in both hands, clearly not happy about this. “Okay, you just got lucky with those two,” she says. “Stupid balls rolling around at random.”"

rows.original: The shot’s easy enough, and the cue ball strikes true, sending both balls into the pocket. You give Kiki a smile as she glares at you.
rows.translation: 这一杆相当容易。母球准确命中，把两颗球都送入球袋。琪琪怒视着你，你则回以微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe shot’s easy enough, and the cue ball strikes true, sending both balls into the pocket. You give Kiki a smile as she glares at you."

rows.original: “And this is why we’re not allowed to bet against spacers,” she says, quirking her mouth to one side. “You’ve got more credits and more practice than us.”
rows.translation: “所以我们才不准和太空旅行者赌球，”她把嘴撇向一边说道。“你们的信用点比我们多，练习也比我们多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And this is why we’re not allowed to bet against spacers,” she says, quirking her mouth to one side. “You’ve got more credits and more practice than us.”"

rows.original: You can’t help being good. You set up another shot, but the ball knocks against the side next to the pocket, and doesn’t go in.
rows.translation: 球技好又不是你的错。你准备下一杆，可球撞上袋口旁的桌边，没有落袋。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help being good. You set up another shot, but the ball knocks against the side next to the pocket, and doesn’t go in."

rows.original: Kiki manages not to gloat as she takes her turn. Her first shot is a good one, sending in another ball, but her second one goes wide. It looks like she was distracted by someone on the dance floor, not that you can blame her.
rows.translation: 轮到琪琪时，她忍住了没有幸灾乐祸。第一杆打得很好，又送进一球，可第二杆却打偏了。她似乎被舞池里的某个人分散了注意力，这也不能怪她。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki manages not to gloat as she takes her turn. Her first shot is a good one, sending in another ball, but her second one goes wide. It looks like she was distracted by someone on the dance floor, not that you can blame her."

rows.original: You take aim again, and drop another ball in, setting the score at your four to Kiki’s two.
rows.translation: 你再次瞄准，又打进一球，比分变为你四比琪琪二。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take aim again, and drop another ball in, setting the score at your four to Kiki’s two."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The next shot is yours. You spot two balls with your numbers together in one corner, and grin, then move around to get a good angle on the shot.
rows.translation: 下一杆轮到你。你在一个角落发现两颗属于你的球挨在一起，咧嘴一笑，随后绕到合适角度准备击球。
rows.raw: "The next shot is yours. You spot two balls with your numbers together in one corner, and grin, then move around to get a good angle on the shot."

rows.original: Kiki realizes what you’re aiming at, and clenches her cue stick in both hands, clearly not happy about this. “Okay, you just got lucky with those two,” she says. “Stupid balls rolling around at random.”
rows.translation: 琪琪看出你的目标，双手紧握球杆，显然对此很不高兴。“好吧，刚才那两个球只是你运气好，”她说道。“蠢球到处乱滚而已。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki realizes what you’re aiming at, and clenches her cue stick in both hands, clearly not happy about this. “Okay, you just got lucky with those two,” she says. “Stupid balls rolling around at random.”"

rows.original: The shot should be easy enough, but the cue ball rolls wide, and smacks both balls away from the pocket. You give Kiki a glare as she smiles at you.
rows.translation: 这一杆本该相当容易，可母球却滚偏了，把两颗球都撞离袋口。琪琪朝你微笑，你则怒视着她。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe shot should be easy enough, but the cue ball rolls wide, and smacks both balls away from the pocket. You give Kiki a glare as she smiles at you."

rows.original: “You’re lucky we’re not allowed to bet against spacers,” she says, quirking her mouth to one side. “Usually you’ve got more credits and more practice than us. But I might be wrong about that second one.”
rows.translation: “你该庆幸我们不准和太空旅行者赌球，”她把嘴撇向一边说道。“通常你们的信用点比我们多，练习也比我们多。不过第二点也许是我想错了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re lucky we’re not allowed to bet against spacers,” she says, quirking her mouth to one side. “Usually you’ve got more credits and more practice than us. But I might be wrong about that second one.”"

rows.original: Nobody’s lucky all the time. You step aside as Kiki moves in.
rows.translation: 没有人能一直走运。琪琪走上前来，你则退到一旁。
rows.raw: "\n\nNobody’s lucky all the time. You step aside as Kiki moves in."

rows.original: Kiki sets up her shot. Her strike is a good one, sending the cue ball spinning across the table to knock in one ball and setting her up for another easy one. She makes the second shot with no trouble, and a third, but her fourth one goes wide. It looks like she was distracted by someone on the dance floor, not that you can blame her.
rows.translation: 琪琪准备击球。这一杆打得很好，母球旋转着掠过桌面，撞进一球，又为她留下另一个容易的目标。她轻松打进第二球，接着又打进第三球，可第四杆却打偏了。她似乎被舞池里的某个人分散了注意力，这也不能怪她。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki sets up her shot. Her strike is a good one, sending the cue ball spinning across the table to knock in one ball and setting her up for another easy one. She makes the second shot with no trouble, and a third, but her fourth one goes wide. It looks like she was distracted by someone on the dance floor, not that you can blame her."

rows.original: You take aim again, and manage to drop a ball in, setting the score at your two to Kiki’s four.
rows.translation: 你再次瞄准，成功打进一球，比分变为你二比琪琪四。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take aim again, and manage to drop a ball in, setting the score at your two to Kiki’s four."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The advantage is clearly yours, so you need to press it, to make sure Kiki can’t catch up. You walk a circle around the table, looking at it from every angle, until you find a shot that looks difficult. But if you can set it up right....
rows.translation: 优势显然在你这边，所以必须乘胜追击，确保琪琪无法赶上。你绕着球桌走了一圈，从各个角度观察，直到发现一杆看起来很难的球。不过只要准备得当....
rows.raw: "The advantage is clearly yours, so you need to press it, to make sure Kiki can’t catch up. You walk a circle around the table, looking at it from every angle, until you find a shot that looks difficult. But if you can set it up right...."

rows.original: Kiki realizes what you’re doing as soon as you bend over the table. “Oh, good luck,” she says, and stands exactly opposite you. She presses her cue stick up against herself, subtly pushing the glowing hardlight between her boobs.
rows.translation: 你刚俯身趴到球桌上，琪琪便看出你的意图。“噢，祝你好运，”她说道，站到你的正对面。她把球杆压在自己身上，暗中将发光的硬光杆推入乳房之间。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki realizes what you’re doing as soon as you bend over the table. “Oh, good luck,” she says, and stands exactly opposite you. She presses her cue stick up against herself, subtly pushing the glowing hardlight between her boobs."

rows.original: You manage to ignore the distraction and take your shot. The cue ball knocks one ball in and spins away, swerving across the table toward where you meant it to go – and it keeps going, knocking another ball into the corner pocket.
rows.translation: 你成功无视干扰，击出这一杆。母球撞进一球后旋转弹开，按你的计划横穿球桌，并继续滚动，把另一颗球撞进角袋。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou manage to ignore the distraction and take your shot. The cue ball knocks one ball in and spins away, swerving across the table toward where you meant it to go – and it keeps going, knocking another ball into the corner pocket."

rows.original: Kiki’s dark eyes go wide as you stand up. “What the hell,” she says. “Was that luck? Or are you just that good?”
rows.translation: 你直起身体时，琪琪深色的双眼睁得滚圆。“搞什么鬼，”她说道。“那是运气？还是你真的这么厉害？”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki’s dark eyes go wide as you stand up. “What the hell,” she says. “Was that luck? Or are you just that good?”"

rows.original: Maybe one, maybe both. You swing around the table and set up your last shot, and Kiki doesn’t try to distract you this time. Unfortunately, your hand slips just enough, and the cue ball misses by less than a finger’s width.
rows.translation: 也许是其中一种，也许两者都有。你绕到球桌另一侧，准备最后一杆，这次琪琪没有试图干扰你。遗憾的是，你的手还是稍稍打滑，母球以不到一指宽的距离擦过目标。
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe one, maybe both. You swing around the table and set up your last shot, and Kiki doesn’t try to distract you this time. Unfortunately, your hand slips just enough, and the cue ball misses by less than a finger’s width."

rows.original: “Scare me, why don’t you,” Kiki says, then giggles a little as she moves in. There’s a determined look in her eyes as she aims, and she makes a hard shot that knocks in one ball, then bounces off to knock another close to a side pocket. She makes her second shot with ease, then follows it up by bouncing a third off the wall to the opposing pocket.
rows.translation: “你可吓到我了，”琪琪说道，随后轻笑着走上前。她瞄准时眼神坚定，一记重击打进一球，母球又弹向另一颗球，把它撞到侧袋附近。她轻松完成第二杆，随后又让第三颗球撞上桌边，反弹进对面的球袋。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Scare me, why don’t you,” Kiki says, then giggles a little as she moves in. There’s a determined look in her eyes as she aims, and she makes a hard shot that knocks in one ball, then bounces off to knock another close to a side pocket. She makes her second shot with ease, then follows it up by bouncing a third off the wall to the opposing pocket."

rows.original: Three in a row is impressive, but you’ve still only got one ball on the table. Her last shot narrowly misses, and Kiki looks to you. She doesn’t seem very hopeful. “All yours,” she says, gesturing at the table.
rows.translation: 连续三球确实厉害，不过桌上属于你的球只剩一颗。她的最后一杆险些命中，琪琪看向你，似乎不抱太大希望。“全归你了，”她朝球桌示意。
rows.raw: "\n\nThree in a row is impressive, but you’ve still only got one ball on the table. Her last shot narrowly misses, and Kiki looks to you. She doesn’t seem very hopeful. “All yours,” she says, gesturing at the table."

rows.original: You take a moment to set up the shot correctly, to make sure you do it right. After taking a deep breath and making sure your hands aren’t shaking this time, you gently knock the cue ball toward your ball, sending it rolling right into the corner pocket.
rows.translation: 你花了一点时间正确准备这一杆，确保不会出错。你深吸一口气，确认双手这次没有颤抖，随后轻轻把母球推向目标，让那颗球径直滚进角袋。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a moment to set up the shot correctly, to make sure you do it right. After taking a deep breath and making sure your hands aren’t shaking this time, you gently knock the cue ball toward your ball, sending it rolling right into the corner pocket."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You know your next shot has to be a good one. After walking a few steps around the table, you find a shot at an odd angle. It’ll be a stretch, but you think you can make it.
rows.translation: 你知道下一杆必须打好。绕着球桌走了几步后，你发现一杆角度古怪的球。必须伸得很远，但你觉得自己能做到。
rows.raw: "You know your next shot has to be a good one. After walking a few steps around the table, you find a shot at an odd angle. It’ll be a stretch, but you think you can make it."

rows.original: Kiki watches you set it up, and tilts her head. “Weird aim, but okay,” she says.
rows.translation: 琪琪看着你准备，歪了歪头。“角度真怪，不过随你，”她说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki watches you set it up, and tilts her head. “Weird aim, but okay,” she says."

rows.original: You and Kiki trade shots back and forth for several rounds, making some and missing others, until both of you have two balls left on the table. She gives you a smirk as she stands opposite you, setting up yet another shot.
rows.translation: 你和琪琪轮流击球，持续了好几个回合，有时打进，有时失手，直到你们各自在桌上剩下两颗球。她站在你对面准备再度击球，朝你坏笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou and Kiki trade shots back and forth for several rounds, making some and missing others, until both of you have two balls left on the table. She gives you a smirk as she stands opposite you, setting up yet another shot."

rows.original: “All tied up,” she says. “Not how I really like to do things, but it happens.” She takes careful aim, then strikes hard, sending the cue ball smacking into one of her balls. The shot rockets into the corner pocket.
rows.translation: “打平了，”她说道。“虽然我通常不喜欢这样把人绑起来，不过偶尔也会发生。”她仔细瞄准，随后用力击球，让母球撞上属于自己的一颗球。目标球飞速滚进角袋。
rows.raw: "\n\n“All tied up,” she says. “Not how I really like to do things, but it happens.” She takes careful aim, then strikes hard, sending the cue ball smacking into one of her balls. The shot rockets into the corner pocket."

rows.original: Kiki cheers, then swiftly steps in to make her next shot. She strikes too quickly, and her cue skids across the table, barely touching the cue ball. “Damn!” She gives you a grumpy look. “Your turn.”
rows.translation: 琪琪欢呼一声，迅速上前准备下一杆。她出杆太急，球杆在桌面上滑过，几乎没碰到母球。“该死！”她不爽地看向你。“轮到你了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki cheers, then swiftly steps in to make her next shot. She strikes too quickly, and her cue skids across the table, barely touching the cue ball. “Damn!” She gives you a grumpy look. “Your turn.”"

rows.original: And it’s a turn you won’t waste. There’s a decent shot for you, if you can get the angle right, so you take your time to set it up. The music changes to something with a lot of screeching right as you’re about to take the shot, and you glance at Kiki, but her hands aren’t on her glasses. She gives you an innocent look.
rows.translation: 你绝不会浪费这一回合。只要角度合适，你就有一杆不错的球，于是耐心做好准备。就在你即将击球时，音乐换成了充满尖锐噪声的曲子。你瞥向琪琪，可她的手并没有放在眼镜上。她一脸无辜地看着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd it’s a turn you won’t waste. There’s a decent shot for you, if you can get the angle right, so you take your time to set it up. The music changes to something with a lot of screeching right as you’re about to take the shot, and you glance at Kiki, but her hands aren’t on her glasses. She gives you an innocent look."

rows.original: You make the shot, and it’s good. The ball rolls right on in, and you step around the table, to prepare your next shot. Only one ball remains on the table for each of you.
rows.translation: 你成功击球。目标球直接滚入袋中，你绕到球桌另一侧，准备下一杆。现在你们各自在桌上只剩一颗球。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou make the shot, and it’s good. The ball rolls right on in, and you step around the table, to prepare your next shot. Only one ball remains on the table for each of you."

rows.original: It doesn’t take you long to find a good angle. You lean in and take aim at your last ball, and strike true, sending it into the pocket. When you look over at Kiki, she’s frowning. It looks like she really wanted to win this one.
rows.translation: 你很快就找到了合适角度。你俯身瞄准最后一颗球，准确出杆，将它送入球袋。你看向琪琪时，她正皱着眉头。看来她真的很想赢下这一局。
rows.raw: "It doesn’t take you long to find a good angle. You lean in and take aim at your last ball, and strike true, sending it into the pocket. When you look over at Kiki, she’s frowning. It looks like she really wanted to win this one."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: It doesn’t take you long to find a good angle. You lean in and take aim at your last ball, but your hand slips, and the cue hits the top of the cue ball, sending it skidding to one side.
rows.translation: 你很快就找到了合适角度。你俯身瞄准最后一颗球，可手却打滑了。球杆击中母球上方，让它滑向一侧。
rows.raw: "It doesn’t take you long to find a good angle. You lean in and take aim at your last ball, but your hand slips, and the cue hits the top of the cue ball, sending it skidding to one side."

rows.original: Kiki chuckles, then slides over and sets up a behind-the-back shot, sending her ball straight into the corner pocket. She grins at you.
rows.translation: 琪琪轻声笑起来，随后滑步上前，摆出背对球桌的击球姿势，把自己的球径直送进角袋。她朝你咧嘴一笑。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki chuckles, then slides over and sets up a behind-the-back shot, sending her ball straight into the corner pocket. She grins at you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The advantage is clearly Kiki’s, but you know you can still catch up. You walk a circle around the table, looking at it from every angle, until you find a shot that looks difficult. But if you can set it up right....
rows.translation: 优势显然在琪琪那边，不过你知道自己仍能赶上。你绕着球桌走了一圈，从各个角度观察，直到发现一杆看起来很难的球。不过只要准备得当....
rows.raw: "The advantage is clearly Kiki’s, but you know you can still catch up. You walk a circle around the table, looking at it from every angle, until you find a shot that looks difficult. But if you can set it up right...."

rows.original: Kiki realizes what you’re doing as soon as you bend over the table. “Oh, good luck,” she says, and stands exactly opposite you. She presses her cue stick up against herself, subtly pushing the glowing hardlight rod between her boobs.
rows.translation: 你刚俯身趴到球桌上，琪琪便看出你的意图。“噢，祝你好运，”她说道，站到你的正对面。她把球杆压在自己身上，暗中将发光的硬光杆推入乳房之间。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki realizes what you’re doing as soon as you bend over the table. “Oh, good luck,” she says, and stands exactly opposite you. She presses her cue stick up against herself, subtly pushing the glowing hardlight rod between her boobs."

rows.original: You manage to ignore the distraction and take your shot. The cue ball knocks one ball in and spins away, swerving across the table toward where you meant it to go – and it keeps going, knocking another ball into the corner pocket.
rows.translation: 你成功无视干扰，击出这一杆。母球撞进一球后旋转弹开，按你的计划横穿球桌，并继续滚动，把另一颗球撞进角袋。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou manage to ignore the distraction and take your shot. The cue ball knocks one ball in and spins away, swerving across the table toward where you meant it to go – and it keeps going, knocking another ball into the corner pocket."

rows.original: Kiki’s eyes go wide as you stand up. “What the hell,” she says. “Was that luck? Or are you just that good?”
rows.translation: 你直起身体时，琪琪的双眼睁得滚圆。“搞什么鬼，”她说道。“那是运气？还是你真的这么厉害？”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki’s eyes go wide as you stand up. “What the hell,” she says. “Was that luck? Or are you just that good?”"

rows.original: Maybe either one, maybe both. You swing around the table and set up your last shot, and Kiki doesn’t try to distract you this time. Unfortunately, your hand slips just enough, and the cue ball missed by less than a finger’s width.
rows.translation: 也许是其中一种，也许两者都有。你绕到球桌另一侧，准备最后一杆，这次琪琪没有试图干扰你。遗憾的是，你的手还是稍稍打滑，母球以不到一指宽的距离擦过目标。
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe either one, maybe both. You swing around the table and set up your last shot, and Kiki doesn’t try to distract you this time. Unfortunately, your hand slips just enough, and the cue ball missed by less than a finger’s width."

rows.original: “I knew that was luck,” Kiki says, then giggles a little as she moves in. There’s a determined look in her eyes as she aims, and she makes a hard shot that knocks in one ball, then bounces off to knock another close to a side pocket. She makes her second shot with ease, then follows it up by bouncing a third off the wall to the opposing pocket.
rows.translation: “我就知道那是运气，”琪琪说道，随后轻笑着走上前。她瞄准时眼神坚定，一记重击打进一球，母球又弹向另一颗球，把它撞到侧袋附近。她轻松完成第二杆，随后又让第三颗球撞上桌边，反弹进对面的球袋。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I knew that was luck,” Kiki says, then giggles a little as she moves in. There’s a determined look in her eyes as she aims, and she makes a hard shot that knocks in one ball, then bounces off to knock another close to a side pocket. She makes her second shot with ease, then follows it up by bouncing a third off the wall to the opposing pocket."

rows.original: Three in a row. Ouch. There’s nothing left for her but the eight-ball, and you still have two balls on the table. Her last shot narrowly misses, and Kiki looks to you. She looks very pleased with herself. “All yours,” she says, gesturing at the table.
rows.translation: 连续三球。真惨。她只剩八号球，而你在桌上仍有两颗球。她的最后一杆险些命中，琪琪看向你，显得十分得意。“全归你了，”她朝球桌示意。
rows.raw: "\n\nThree in a row. Ouch. There’s nothing left for her but the eight-ball, and you still have two balls on the table. Her last shot narrowly misses, and Kiki looks to you. She looks very pleased with herself. “All yours,” she says, gesturing at the table."

rows.original: You take a moment to set up the shot correctly, to make sure you do it right. After taking a deep breath and making sure your hands aren’t shaking this time, you give the cue ball a hard tap. Your shot goes wide again, the cue ball knocking your ball away from the pocket.
rows.translation: 你花了一点时间正确准备这一杆，确保不会出错。你深吸一口气，确认双手这次没有颤抖，随后用力击打母球。这一杆再次打偏，母球把你的目标球撞离袋口。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou take a moment to set up the shot correctly, to make sure you do it right. After taking a deep breath and making sure your hands aren’t shaking this time, you give the cue ball a hard tap. Your shot goes wide again, the cue ball knocking your ball away from the pocket."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Only the eight-ball left, and the game is yours. Kiki strokes her hands up and down her cue, making it look like she’s trying to distract you again, but you won’t have it. You take the time to set up your shot carefully, then take a few practice swings, to make sure you’re not going to hit it too hard.
rows.translation: 只剩八号球，胜利便属于你。琪琪的双手在球杆上上下抚动，似乎又想让你分心，但你不会上当。你花时间仔细准备，随后试挥几下，确保自己不会打得太重。
rows.raw: "Only the eight-ball left, and the game is yours. Kiki strokes her hands up and down her cue, making it look like she’s trying to distract you again, but you won’t have it. You take the time to set up your shot carefully, then take a few practice swings, to make sure you’re not going to hit it too hard."

rows.original: As soon as you strike, you know it’s good. The cue ball rolls up to the eight-ball like it was made for it, and the eight-ball goes spinning right into a corner pocket, dropping in without a hitch.
rows.translation: 刚一出杆，你就知道这一杆稳了。母球仿佛天生就该击中八号球，径直滚到它面前；八号球旋转着落入角袋，毫无阻碍。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs soon as you strike, you know it’s good. The cue ball rolls up to the eight-ball like it was made for it, and the eight-ball goes spinning right into a corner pocket, dropping in without a hitch."

rows.original: Kiki grins as you look at her. “Nice shooting,” she says. “Is that how you survive the Planet Rush? Really good aim?”
rows.translation: 你看向琪琪时，她正咧嘴笑着。“打得漂亮，”她说道。“你就是靠这个在星球开拓潮中活下来的？枪法特别准？”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki grins as you look at her. “Nice shooting,” she says. “Is that how you survive the Planet Rush? Really good aim?”"

rows.original: You tell her that yes, there’s a reason you’re that damn good. She activates some drones to clean off the pool table, and the two of you turn off your cues and stash them. Not a bad game, not at all.
rows.translation: 你告诉她没错，自己这么厉害是有原因的。她启动无人机清理台球桌，你们则关闭球杆，将它们收好。这一局打得不赖，确实不赖。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that yes, there’s a reason you’re that damn good. She activates some drones to clean off the pool table, and the two of you turn off your cues and stash them. Not a bad game, not at all."

rows.original: contests/kiki pool wins
rows.raw: "contests/kiki pool wins"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Only the eight-ball left for Kiki, and there’s no way she’s going to miss that shot. Kiki strokes her hands up and down her cue, making it look like she’s trying to distract you as she lines it up, for whatever reason. She leans over the table, takes a few practice strikes, then smacks her cue into the cue ball and lets it fly.
rows.translation: 琪琪只剩八号球，这一杆绝无可能失手。她的双手在球杆上上下抚动，不知为何，在瞄准的同时还像是想让你分心。她俯身趴在桌上，试挥几下，随后让球杆撞上母球，将它击飞出去。
rows.raw: "Only the eight-ball left for Kiki, and there’s no way she’s going to miss that shot. Kiki strokes her hands up and down her cue, making it look like she’s trying to distract you as she lines it up, for whatever reason. She leans over the table, takes a few practice strikes, then smacks her cue into the cue ball and lets it fly."

rows.original: As soon as she strikes, you know it’s over. The cue ball rolls up to the eight-ball like it was made for it, and the eight-ball goes spinning right into a corner pocket, dropping in without a hitch.
rows.translation: 她刚一出杆，你就知道比赛结束了。母球仿佛天生就该击中八号球，径直滚到它面前；八号球旋转着落入角袋，毫无阻碍。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs soon as she strikes, you know it’s over. The cue ball rolls up to the eight-ball like it was made for it, and the eight-ball goes spinning right into a corner pocket, dropping in without a hitch."

rows.original: Kiki grins as you look at her. “Not bad,” she says. “We can go again anytime if you want. If you don’t mind getting humiliated, I mean.”
rows.translation: 你看向琪琪时，她正咧嘴笑着。“还不错，”她说道。“只要你愿意，我们随时可以再来一局。我的意思是，只要你不介意被羞辱。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki grins as you look at her. “Not bad,” she says. “We can go again anytime if you want. If you don’t mind getting humiliated, I mean.”"

rows.original: You tell her that yes, you’ll take her on again sometime. She activates some drones to clean off the pool table, and the two of you turn off your cues and stash them. Not a bad game, but you know you’ll do better next time.
rows.translation: 你告诉她没错，以后会再来挑战。她启动无人机清理台球桌，你们则关闭球杆，将它们收好。这一局打得不赖，不过你知道自己下次会做得更好。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that yes, you’ll take her on again sometime. She activates some drones to clean off the pool table, and the two of you turn off your cues and stash them. Not a bad game, but you know you’ll do better next time."

rows.original: contests/kiki pool losses
rows.raw: "contests/kiki pool losses"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You head over to the woman in the purple and white suit. She constantly looks back and forth over the room, and something about the way she’s standing makes her seem comfortable and in control, like she knows everything that’s happening here.
rows.translation: 你走向那个穿紫白西装的女人。她不断环顾整个房间，站姿中有种从容掌控的感觉，仿佛清楚这里正在发生的一切。
rows.raw: "You head over to the woman in the purple and white suit. She constantly looks back and forth over the room, and something about the way she’s standing makes her seem comfortable and in control, like she knows everything that’s happening here."

rows.original: Her gaze settles on you once you’re a few feet away. Her dark brown eyes give you a quick look up and down, and tiny lines of glowing blue text slide down her glasses’ round lens. She smiles with half her mouth, then straightens her vest and nods to you.
rows.translation: 等你走到几英尺外，她的视线落在你身上。深棕色双眼迅速上下打量你，微小的蓝色发光文字从圆形镜片上滑过。她歪着嘴角微笑，随后理了理背心，朝你点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer gaze settles on you once you’re a few feet away. Her dark brown eyes give you a quick look up and down, and tiny lines of glowing blue text slide down her glasses’ round lens. She smiles with half her mouth, then straightens her vest and nods to you."

rows.original: “Welcome to the Crash Landing,” she says once you’re close enough to talk. “I’m Kiki.
rows.translation: “欢迎来到坠落酒吧，”等你靠近到足以交谈时，她说道。“我是琪琪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Welcome to the Crash Landing,” she says once you’re close enough to talk. “I’m Kiki."

rows.original: This your first time here?
rows.translation: 这是你第一次来？
rows.raw: " This your first time here?"

rows.original: I’ve seen you here before, but I don’t think we’ve talked.
rows.translation: 我以前见过你，不过我们好像还没聊过。
rows.raw: " I’ve seen you here before, but I don’t think we’ve talked."

rows.original: She seems friendly, and a little bit excited, like someone who’d find something you’re both into and spend the night talking your ear off about it. You introduce yourself, and more lines of blue text flicker across her glasses. Her eyes dart to the side for just a second, and she shifts a little where she stands. Is she getting some info from her glasses, or trying not to look at you, or what?
rows.translation: 她看起来很友善，还有些兴奋，就像那种只要发现你们都喜欢的东西，就会整晚抓着你滔滔不绝的人。你做了自我介绍，更多蓝色文字在她的眼镜上闪过。她的目光迅速转向一旁，站姿也稍微变了变。她是在通过眼镜获取资料，还是在避免看你，或者另有原因？
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems friendly, and a little bit excited, like someone who’d find something you’re both into and spend the night talking your ear off about it. You introduce yourself, and more lines of blue text flicker across her glasses. Her eyes dart to the side for just a second, and she shifts a little where she stands. Is she getting some info from her glasses, or trying not to look at you, or what?"

rows.original: You ask Kiki what she does here, rather than just stand there staring at each other. She gestures to the pool tables and dance floor, then stands up straighter. “I work in here, handle the music and tech, that sort of thing,” she says, sounding upbeat. “I actually built the tables and set up the sound system, so this room’s all mine. And I can handle security from anywhere, just in case someone tries to start trouble.”
rows.translation: 你没有继续和琪琪站在那里互相凝视，而是问她在这里负责什么。她朝台球桌和舞池示意，随后站得更直。“我在这里工作，负责音乐和技术之类的东西，”她兴高采烈地说道。“其实桌子是我造的，音响系统也是我安装的，所以这间屋子全归我管。而且不管在哪里，我都能处理安保问题，以防有人想闹事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask Kiki what she does here, rather than just stand there staring at each other. She gestures to the pool tables and dance floor, then stands up straighter. “I work in here, handle the music and tech, that sort of thing,” she says, sounding upbeat. “I actually built the tables and set up the sound system, so this room’s all mine. And I can handle security from anywhere, just in case someone tries to start trouble.”"

rows.original: Does that sort of thing happen a lot at the bar? Your first impression of Dhaal involved a gang fight, and you know people get jumped in the streets. So an underground milk bar might not be the most peaceful place.
rows.translation: 酒吧经常发生那种事吗？你对达尔的第一印象就是帮派斗殴，而且也知道有人会在街上遭到袭击。所以，一间地下奶吧可能不是最太平的地方。
rows.raw: "\n\nDoes that sort of thing happen a lot at the bar? Your first impression of Dhaal involved a gang fight, and you know people get jumped in the streets. So an underground milk bar might not be the most peaceful place."

rows.original: “Not much,” Kiki says, her smile fading. “A few people have tried, but not more than once.” She snaps you a grin. “Karrah’s bigger than most of the zaika, stronger too, so she scares just about anybody who’d try to start a fight. But she’s had to throw a few people out.” She peers at you from behind her glasses. “You’re not here to start something, are you? Because Karrah should have told you about the stunners.”
rows.translation: “不太经常，”琪琪说道，笑容淡去。“有几个人试过，不过都没有第二次。”她咧嘴一笑。“卡拉比大多数扎伊卡都高大，也更强壮，所以基本能吓住任何想挑起斗殴的人。不过她确实把几个人扔出去过。”她从眼镜后面打量你。“你不是来闹事的，对吧？因为卡拉应该已经告诉过你那些电击器了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not much,” Kiki says, her smile fading. “A few people have tried, but not more than once.” She snaps you a grin. “Karrah’s bigger than most of the zaika, stronger too, so she scares just about anybody who’d try to start a fight. But she’s had to throw a few people out.” She peers at you from behind her glasses. “You’re not here to start something, are you? Because Karrah should have told you about the stunners.”"

rows.original: Of course not. You get into enough fights on your own, no reason to start one at a bar.
rows.translation: 当然不是。你自己碰上的架已经够多了，没理由在酒吧主动挑起一场。
rows.raw: "Of course not. You get into enough fights on your own, no reason to start one at a bar."

rows.original: Well, since she asked so nicely, you can put off starting a bar fight. For today. Probably.
rows.translation: 好吧，既然她问得这么客气，你可以推迟挑起酒吧斗殴的计划。仅限今天。大概吧。
rows.raw: "Well, since she asked so nicely, you can put off starting a bar fight. For today. Probably."

rows.original: If someone starts a fight, you’ll finish it, and you’ve been in enough bars to know that starting a fight can mean all kinds of things.
rows.translation: 要是有人挑起斗殴，你会负责结束。你去过的酒吧已经够多，知道所谓‘挑起斗殴’可能有各种不同含义。
rows.raw: "If someone starts a fight, you’ll finish it, and you’ve been in enough bars to know that starting a fight can mean all kinds of things."

rows.original: “I didn’t think you looked like the wrong kind of trouble,” Kiki says. “Good to know I’m right.” She twirls a few strands of blue hair around her fingers. You catch sight of some kind of metal on her hand, winding in twisting rings around her fingers and running down the back of her hand to form a ring around her wrist. “But you never know with some people. And you’re clearly from way, way off-world, so I don’t know if someone’s going to look at you and try to start a fight.
rows.translation: “我就觉得你不像那种不该招惹的麻烦，”琪琪说道。“很高兴知道自己没看错。”她用手指绕着几缕蓝发。你瞥见她手上似乎有某种金属，以扭曲的环状缠绕手指，沿手背向下延伸，最后在手腕周围形成一个环。“不过有些人真说不准。而且你显然来自非常、非常遥远的外星，所以我不知道会不会有人看见你，就想挑起斗殴。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I didn’t think you looked like the wrong kind of trouble,” Kiki says. “Good to know I’m right.” She twirls a few strands of blue hair around her fingers. You catch sight of some kind of metal on her hand, winding in twisting rings around her fingers and running down the back of her hand to form a ring around her wrist. “But you never know with some people. And you’re clearly from way, way off-world, so I don’t know if someone’s going to look at you and try to start a fight."

rows.original: Or if they’ll try to milk you.” She raises her eyebrows and gives you a serious look. “I swear, I’ve seen it happen!
rows.translation: 或者试着给你挤奶。”她扬起眉毛，一脸严肃地看着你。“说真的，我亲眼见过这种事！
rows.raw: " Or if they’ll try to milk you.” She raises her eyebrows and gives you a serious look. “I swear, I’ve seen it happen!"

rows.original: You tell her you can handle yourself. You’ve been on the Planet Rush for long enough that you should be able to deal with anything Dhaal has to throw at you. But what about her?
rows.translation: 你告诉她自己应付得来。你投身星球开拓潮已经够久，应该能处理达尔可能扔到面前的任何麻烦。不过她呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her you can handle yourself. You’ve been on the Planet Rush for long enough that you should be able to deal with anything Dhaal has to throw at you. But what about her?"

rows.original: “Me? I’m the crew’s techie, if you can really call us a crew anymore. The girls and I started this place when we got into a little too much trouble to keep being space pirates.” She shifts where she stands again, then quickly changes the subject. “But it’s fine, doing the bar thing. You said you’re part of the Planet Rush?”
rows.translation: “我？我是船员里的技术专家，虽然现在还能不能把我们叫作船员都很难说。我们惹上的麻烦太多，没法继续当太空海盗以后，我和姑娘们就开了这个地方。”她再次调整站姿，随后迅速改变话题。“不过经营酒吧也挺好。你刚才说自己参加了星球开拓潮？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Me? I’m the crew’s techie, if you can really call us a crew anymore. The girls and I started this place when we got into a little too much trouble to keep being space pirates.” She shifts where she stands again, then quickly changes the subject. “But it’s fine, doing the bar thing. You said you’re part of the Planet Rush?”"

rows.original: You are. You tell her a few things about the worlds you’ve visited, and ask her if she’s been to any of the other Rush planets.
rows.translation: 没错。你告诉她一些自己造访过的世界，并询问她是否去过其他开拓潮星球。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou are. You tell her a few things about the worlds you’ve visited, and ask her if she’s been to any of the other Rush planets."

rows.original: “Mostly just this one,” Kiki says. “Dhaal was kind of the last port of call for us.” She winces a little. “I’d like to see some of those other places, but we needed a place that wasn’t just a rock with a bunch of primitives.” She shrugs. “Could have been worse, though. You said you’ve been to Tarkus? I heard about that place. No way we could have gone there. I’m good, but I saw pics of the Novahome, and even I couldn’t get that heap running again.”
rows.translation: “基本只有这里，”琪琪说道。“达尔差不多是我们的最后一站。”她微微皱起脸。“我很想看看其他地方，不过我们需要的不能只是一块住着一群原始人的石头。”她耸了耸肩。“不过还有更糟的地方。你说自己去过塔库斯？我听说过那里。我们绝不可能去那儿。我很厉害，可我看过新星家园的照片，就连我也没法让那堆破烂重新运转。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mostly just this one,” Kiki says. “Dhaal was kind of the last port of call for us.” She winces a little. “I’d like to see some of those other places, but we needed a place that wasn’t just a rock with a bunch of primitives.” She shrugs. “Could have been worse, though. You said you’ve been to Tarkus? I heard about that place. No way we could have gone there. I’m good, but I saw pics of the Novahome, and even I couldn’t get that heap running again.”"

rows.original: Another line of blue text shimmers up the round lens of Kiki’s glasses, and she taps the rim as tiny images appear on the glass. A moment later, one of the images blinks, and the music slowly shifts into something with heavier bass and some twangy notes that fit the rhythm surprisingly well.
rows.translation: 另一行蓝色文字闪烁着划过琪琪眼镜的圆形镜片。微小图像出现在玻璃上，她轻敲镜框。片刻后，其中一幅图像闪动，音乐慢慢转为低音更重的曲子，其中还有一些意外合拍的拨弦音符。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother line of blue text shimmers up the round lens of Kiki’s glasses, and she taps the rim as tiny images appear on the glass. A moment later, one of the images blinks, and the music slowly shifts into something with heavier bass and some twangy notes that fit the rhythm surprisingly well."

rows.original: “Got to keep changing up the music,” Kiki says, sounding pleased with herself. “The girls here love anything from offworld. Hard to believe they’d be into some barnpunk from Josie’s collection, but you know what?” She gestures to the crowd, who never stops dancing even as things change, and smiles again. “They like it.”
rows.translation: “得不断更换音乐，”琪琪得意地说道。“这里的姑娘们喜欢一切外星东西。很难相信她们会喜欢乔茜收藏的乡村朋克，不过你猜怎么着？”她朝人群示意。即使音乐发生变化，众人也从未停止跳舞。她再次微笑。“她们喜欢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Got to keep changing up the music,” Kiki says, sounding pleased with herself. “The girls here love anything from offworld. Hard to believe they’d be into some barnpunk from Josie’s collection, but you know what?” She gestures to the crowd, who never stops dancing even as things change, and smiles again. “They like it.”"

rows.translation: “必须始终确保队列里有完整的一轮音乐，”琪琪说道。音乐逐渐淡出，换成另一种歌曲，她也露出微笑。“要是音乐停了，所有跳舞的姑娘都会突然瞪着我，那对任何人都不是愉快的体验。”

rows.original: “My story would probably be pretty boring to you,” she says, then tugs at the bottom of her vest. “I’ve been part of the crew for a few years, though I’ve always been their techie.” She grins. “I’m not much good at shooting people or breaking things. But before that....”
rows.translation: “我的故事对你来说大概很无聊，”她说道，随后拉了拉背心下摆。“我加入船员已经几年了，不过一直都是技术专家。”她咧嘴一笑。“我不太擅长射人或者砸东西。不过在那之前....”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My story would probably be pretty boring to you,” she says, then tugs at the bottom of her vest. “I’ve been part of the crew for a few years, though I’ve always been their techie.” She grins. “I’m not much good at shooting people or breaking things. But before that....”"

rows.original: Kiki presses her hands together in front of her mouth, and peers at you from behind her glasses. You get the impression she’s trying to figure out how much she wants to tell you. She shifts where she stands again, then glances at the people on the dance floor. Right as the silence is starting to get awkward, she drops her hands and starts talking.
rows.translation: 琪琪把双手合在嘴前，从眼镜后面打量你。你感觉她正在判断愿意告诉你多少。她再次调整站姿，随后瞥向舞池里的人。就在沉默开始变得尴尬时，她放下双手，开口说话。
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki presses her hands together in front of her mouth, and peers at you from behind her glasses. You get the impression she’s trying to figure out how much she wants to tell you. She shifts where she stands again, then glances at the people on the dance floor. Right as the silence is starting to get awkward, she drops her hands and starts talking."

rows.original: “Before that,” she says, “I was a university student. I was working on a degree in programming and cybernetics, big surprise. I’ve always been good with mechanical stuff, no matter what it was.” She smiles. “Monika says I’m better with machines than people, and she’s not really wrong.”
rows.translation: “在那之前，”她说道，“我是大学生，正在攻读编程和义体工程学位，完全不意外吧。不管是哪种机械，我一直都很擅长。”她微笑。“莫妮卡说我和机器打交道比和人更厉害，而她其实没说错。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Before that,” she says, “I was a university student. I was working on a degree in programming and cybernetics, big surprise. I’ve always been good with mechanical stuff, no matter what it was.” She smiles. “Monika says I’m better with machines than people, and she’s not really wrong.”"

rows.original: If cybernetics was her thing, that explains her glasses, and the metal on her hand. Were those things she made when she was working on her degree?
rows.translation: 如果义体工程是她的专长，那就能解释眼镜和手上的金属装置了。那些是她攻读学位时制造的吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nIf cybernetics was her thing, that explains her glasses, and the metal on her hand. Were those things she made when she was working on her degree?"

rows.original: Kiki nods. “The glasses were first,” she says quickly. “They’re a pretty common design, but I wanted to make my own to make sure I understood everything that went into them. That’s the best way to really know something, to make it yourself. I’ve modified them a lot over the years.”
rows.translation: 琪琪点点头。“先做的是眼镜，”她迅速说道。“这是相当常见的设计，不过我想亲手做一副，确保自己理解其中的每一项技术。真正掌握某种东西的最好方式，就是亲手把它造出来。这些年我改装过很多次。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki nods. “The glasses were first,” she says quickly. “They’re a pretty common design, but I wanted to make my own to make sure I understood everything that went into them. That’s the best way to really know something, to make it yourself. I’ve modified them a lot over the years.”"

rows.raw: "\n\n“Those came later,” she says, and gives you another grin. “They’re nothing special, just something I came up with on a dare back at the university. They don’t even really do much.”"

rows.original: It sounds like she’s been through a lot. But at least she got away from it. Was it the crew that helped her escape?

rows.raw: "\n\nIt sounds like she’s been through a lot. But at least she got away from it. Was it the crew that helped her escape?"

rows.original: “Yeah,” Kiki says, and gives you a smile. “The captains got word about the couple having something valuable stashed away where we were. rows.translation: “可船员袭击空间站以后，只找到大约二十几个女孩和一些非法医疗设施。她们带走并藏起所有非法物品，随后开始联系姑娘们的父母。她们拿到了大量赏金，还能显得像英雄。而我....”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But when the crew raided the station, all they found was about two dozen girls and some illegal medical facilities. They took all the illegal stuff and hid it, and started calling the girls’ parents. They got a ton of reward money and got to look like heroes. And I....”"

rows.translation: 这里没有地方可坐，只能靠上那张无人使用的台球桌。你倚着桌子，示意琪琪继续。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere isn’t anywhere to sit in here, so the pool table that nobody’s using will have to do. You lean up against it, and gesture for Kiki to continue."

rows.original: “So,” Kiki beings, raising a finger to tap at the rim of her glasses, “this place is totally my baby. It was an old rail station when we found it.”
rows.translation: “那么，”琪琪开口，抬起一根手指轻点眼镜边框，“这里完全就是我的宝贝。我们找到它时，这里是一座废弃轨道站。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So,” Kiki beings, raising a finger to tap at the rim of her glasses, “this place is totally my baby. It was an old rail station when we found it.”"

rows.original: A holographic projection springs out of the round lens of Kiki’s glasses, floating in the air between you two. It’s a diagram of the rooms that make up the bar, but it’s pretty bare-bones, nothing but empty spaces and blank walls. A few labels point out electric, water, and gas hookups, along with other technical details.
rows.translation: 一道全息投影从琪琪眼镜的圆形镜片中射出，悬浮在你们之间。那是组成酒吧的各个房间示意图，但十分简陋，只有空荡荡的空间与空白墙壁。几处标签标明电力、供水和燃气接口，此外还有其他技术细节。
rows.raw: "\n\nA holographic projection springs out of the round lens of Kiki’s glasses, floating in the air between you two. It’s a diagram of the rooms that make up the bar, but it’s pretty bare-bones, nothing but empty spaces and blank walls. A few labels point out electric, water, and gas hookups, along with other technical details."

rows.original: “I don’t know how long ago it got abandoned. One of the regulars told me the city wanted to have a full light rail, but some of the corps got in the way. They didn’t want people moving around under the city, acted like it would be more dangerous.” Kiki rolls her eyes. “More like they didn’t want people going anywhere they couldn’t throw up their stupid bars and shops and whatever else,” she says. “Though a rail line would have been a private audience for advertising, so who knows.”
rows.translation: “我不知道它废弃多久了。一名常客告诉我，市政府原本想修建完整的轻轨，却有几家企业从中作梗。他们不希望人们在城市地下四处移动，声称那样会更加危险。”琪琪翻了个白眼。“更像是他们不希望人们前往那些没法建起愚蠢酒吧、商店和其他东西的地方，”她说道。“不过轻轨会提供一群专门看广告的乘客，所以谁知道呢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I don’t know how long ago it got abandoned. One of the regulars told me the city wanted to have a full light rail, but some of the corps got in the way. They didn’t want people moving around under the city, acted like it would be more dangerous.” Kiki rolls her eyes. “More like they didn’t want people going anywhere they couldn’t throw up their stupid bars and shops and whatever else,” she says. “Though a rail line would have been a private audience for advertising, so who knows.”"

rows.original: The holo diagram rotates as Kiki gestures at it, and she starts pointing things out. “But the whole place was still fully functional. It was like they built it, got it ready, and then just left it behind. So all we had to do was move in and make it home.”
rows.translation: 琪琪一挥手，全息图随之转动，她开始指出其中细节。“不过整座设施仍然完全能够运转。感觉就像他们建好这里、准备妥当，随后直接扔下不管。所以我们只需要搬进来，把它变成家。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe holo diagram rotates as Kiki gestures at it, and she starts pointing things out. “But the whole place was still fully functional. It was like they built it, got it ready, and then just left it behind. So all we had to do was move in and make it home.”"

rows.original: It couldn’t have been that easy. There’s no way the city or whoever built it would have just left the place with water and electricity, or it would have been taken over a long time ago.
rows.translation: 事情不可能这么容易。市政府或建设方不可能留下仍有水有电的设施，否则早就有人占领这里了。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt couldn’t have been that easy. There’s no way the city or whoever built it would have just left the place with water and electricity, or it would have been taken over a long time ago."

rows.original: Kiki gives you a devious giggle. “You’re mostly right,” she says. “All the parts for power and everything were still in place, but not connected. I did some research, friendly hacker stuff on the net, you know how it is, and learned how to get everything set up.” She grins. “And I put it all together so we’re tapped into a bunch of sources, pulling a tiny bit from everyone we can reach. This place would be a huge drain on one source, but on twenty or so? Nobody notices a thing.”
rows.translation: 琪琪狡黠地咯咯一笑。“大体上说对了，”她说道。“电力等设施的所有零件都还在，只是没有接通。我做了些研究，在网上进行友善的黑客活动，你懂的，然后学会怎样把一切接好。”她咧嘴一笑。“我把系统接到许多来源上，从每个够得到的地方抽取一点点。整间酒吧如果只靠一个来源会造成巨大负担，但分摊到二十个左右呢？谁也察觉不到。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki gives you a devious giggle. “You’re mostly right,” she says. “All the parts for power and everything were still in place, but not connected. I did some research, friendly hacker stuff on the net, you know how it is, and learned how to get everything set up.” She grins. “And I put it all together so we’re tapped into a bunch of sources, pulling a tiny bit from everyone we can reach. This place would be a huge drain on one source, but on twenty or so? Nobody notices a thing.”"

rows.original: That explains a lot about how the bar goes unnoticed. But she learned all that from looking it up on the extranet?
rows.translation: 这解释了酒吧如何避开注意。不过这些全是她从外网上查来的吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat explains a lot about how the bar goes unnoticed. But she learned all that from looking it up on the extranet?"

rows.original: She blinks at you, seeming confused. “Everything’s on the extranet, if you know where to look,” she says. “And I’ve got friends there who could teach me-”
rows.translation: 她困惑地朝你眨眨眼。“只要知道去哪里找，外网上什么都有，”她说道。“而且我在那里还有些朋友可以教我-”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe blinks at you, seeming confused. “Everything’s on the extranet, if you know where to look,” she says. “And I’ve got friends there who could teach me-”"

rows.original: One of the zaika from the dance floor stumbles over to Kiki, interrupting her. The woman’s eyes are half-glazed, and she’s staring at Kiki’s chest. She mumbles, “...milk?” and pokes at Kiki’s boobs.
rows.translation: 舞池里的一名扎伊卡跌跌撞撞走向琪琪，打断了她。女人眼神半是迷离，直勾勾盯着琪琪的胸部。她喃喃说道：“...奶？”随后戳了戳琪琪的乳房。
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the zaika from the dance floor stumbles over to Kiki, interrupting her. The woman’s eyes are half-glazed, and she’s staring at Kiki’s chest. She mumbles, “...milk?” and pokes at Kiki’s boobs."

rows.original: Kiki spins to face the milk-drunk zaika, and holds up her right hand, the metal rings around her fingers gleaming in the spinning lights. “No milk here, girly,” she says, some hardness in her voice. It’s clear she’s had to fend off zaika like this before. “You go to the bar for that, if they didn’t cut you off.”
rows.translation: 琪琪转身面对这个奶醉的扎伊卡，抬起右手；旋转灯光下，她手指周围的金属环闪闪发亮。“这里没有奶，小妞，”她说道，声音中带着几分强硬。显然她以前也赶走过这样的扎伊卡。“想喝就去吧台，如果他们还没拒绝供应你。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki spins to face the milk-drunk zaika, and holds up her right hand, the metal rings around her fingers gleaming in the spinning lights. “No milk here, girly,” she says, some hardness in her voice. It’s clear she’s had to fend off zaika like this before. “You go to the bar for that, if they didn’t cut you off.”"

rows.original: “But... milk,” the zaika mumbles, and reaches for Kiki’s chest again.
rows.translation: “可是...奶，”扎伊卡喃喃说道，又伸手去抓琪琪的胸部。
rows.raw: "\n\n“But... milk,” the zaika mumbles, and reaches for Kiki’s chest again."

rows.original: Kiki steps around the zaika’s fumbling hands, steps around her, then grabs one of the zaika’s arms and holds it behind her back. The zaika struggles, and her tail bashes against Kiki’s legs, but she can’t get away.
rows.translation: 琪琪绕开扎伊卡胡乱摸索的双手，从她身边转过去，随后抓住扎伊卡的一条手臂，反扣在背后。扎伊卡奋力挣扎，尾巴不断撞击琪琪的双腿，却无法挣脱。
rows.raw: "Kiki steps around the zaika’s fumbling hands, steps around her, then grabs one of the zaika’s arms and holds it behind her back. The zaika struggles, and her tail bashes against Kiki’s legs, but she can’t get away."

rows.original: “I think you’ve had enough,” Kiki says. She shoots you an apologetic look, then marches the zaika woman out of the dance room. She returns a moment later, looking irate, and doesn’t pick up the conversation.
rows.translation: “我觉得你已经喝够了，”琪琪说道。她抱歉地看了你一眼，随后押着扎伊卡女人离开舞厅。片刻后她回来，神情恼火，也没有重新拾起话题。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think you’ve had enough,” Kiki says. She shoots you an apologetic look, then marches the zaika woman out of the dance room. She returns a moment later, looking irate, and doesn’t pick up the conversation."

rows.original: Looks like Kiki doesn’t feel like talking about this any more. Maybe if you spend more time at the bar, she’ll feel like talking to you some more.
rows.translation: 看来琪琪不想再谈这件事。也许多来酒吧待些时间，她会愿意再和你多聊聊。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooks like Kiki doesn’t feel like talking about this any more. Maybe if you spend more time at the bar, she’ll feel like talking to you some more."

rows.original: Kiki spreads her fingers out, and two tiny stun batons slide out from the metal on the back of her hand, sticking up between her fingers. Their sparkling lights get the zaika’s attention, and her eyes seem to clear up just a little. “Oh, that,” she whispers.
rows.translation: 琪琪张开手指，两根小型电击棍从手背金属结构中滑出，竖在指缝之间。闪烁光芒吸引了扎伊卡的注意，她的眼神似乎稍微清醒了一点。“哦，那个，”她低声说道。
rows.raw: "Kiki spreads her fingers out, and two tiny stun batons slide out from the metal on the back of her hand, sticking up between her fingers. Their sparkling lights get the zaika’s attention, and her eyes seem to clear up just a little. “Oh, that,” she whispers."

rows.original: “Yes,” Kiki says. “That. Are you going to walk yourself out, or do I have to prod you?” Her fingers twitch, making the lights at the end of the stun batons shake.
rows.translation: “没错，”琪琪说道。“就是那个。你要自己走出去，还是得让我戳你？”她动了动手指，令电击棍末端的光点随之摇晃。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes,” Kiki says. “That. Are you going to walk yourself out, or do I have to prod you?” Her fingers twitch, making the lights at the end of the stun batons shake."

rows.original: “I’ll... I’ll be good.” The zaika woman stumbles toward the dance room door, swaying as she walks.
rows.translation: “我会...我会乖的。”扎伊卡女人摇摇晃晃地走向舞厅门口。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ll... I’ll be good.” The zaika woman stumbles toward the dance room door, swaying as she walks."

rows.original: Kiki’s stunners slide back into the metal on her hand, and she taps the side of her glasses. “Monika? Kiki. Got a real milk-sot heading out. Tried to grope me. Might want to cut her off if she goes for Josie.” She pauses. “Yeah, welcome.” She lowers her hand and frowns at you. “Some people just can’t hold their milk. It’s kind of sad. Where was I?”
rows.translation: 琪琪的电击器滑回手上的金属结构，她轻点眼镜侧面。“莫妮卡？我是琪琪。有个彻底喝醉奶的家伙正往外走。刚才试图摸我。如果她去找乔茜，你们最好别再给她喝了。”她顿了顿。“嗯，不客气。”她放下手，皱眉看着你。“有些人就是喝不了奶。挺可悲的。我刚说到哪了？”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki’s stunners slide back into the metal on her hand, and she taps the side of her glasses. “Monika? Kiki. Got a real milk-sot heading out. Tried to grope me. Might want to cut her off if she goes for Josie.” She pauses. “Yeah, welcome.” She lowers her hand and frowns at you. “Some people just can’t hold their milk. It’s kind of sad. Where was I?”"

rows.original: She was telling you about how she hooked up the bar so they wouldn’t get caught stealing power and water. But that doesn’t explain how this place looks. Did they build it out of their old spaceship?
rows.translation: 她刚才正说如何连接酒吧设施，避免她们因偷窃水电而被发现。但这解释不了酒吧如今的样子。她们是用旧飞船建造这里的吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nShe was telling you about how she hooked up the bar so they wouldn’t get caught stealing power and water. But that doesn’t explain how this place looks. Did they build it out of their old spaceship?"

rows.original: “Damn right we did,” Kiki says, her low mood disappearing as she grins at you. “When everybody split up, the ship needed a lot more repairs than the four of us could handle. We weren’t sure what to do, but when we found this place, using the ship to make it our new home seemed like the best idea. It was kind of a pain in the ass to get everything down here, though.”
rows.translation: “我们当然这么干了，”琪琪说道，低落情绪一扫而空，朝你咧嘴一笑。“所有人分开后，飞船需要的维修远远超出我们四人的能力。我们不知道该怎么办，可找到这里后，用飞船把它变成新家似乎是最好的主意。不过把所有东西运到下面可真够麻烦。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn right we did,” Kiki says, her low mood disappearing as she grins at you. “When everybody split up, the ship needed a lot more repairs than the four of us could handle. We weren’t sure what to do, but when we found this place, using the ship to make it our new home seemed like the best idea. It was kind of a pain in the ass to get everything down here, though.”"

rows.original: You believe it. If the stairway and that narrow hall is the only way in, you can only imagine how long it took to haul everything into the old station. Especially if they had to break down the ship at the spaceport.
rows.translation: 你相信。如果楼梯和那条狭窄走廊是唯一入口，可想而知将一切运进旧车站花了多久。尤其是如果她们还得在太空港拆解飞船。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou believe it. If the stairway and that narrow hall is the only way in, you can only imagine how long it took to haul everything into the old station. Especially if they had to break down the ship at the spaceport."

rows.original: “Eh, yes and no,” Kiki says. “There are scrappers working at the spaceport, and they helped us take the ship apart.” She looks sad for a moment, then continues. “And Karrah and Monika could handle the heavy lifting. Mostly Karrah, but don’t tell Monika I said that. And it’s not like we needed the biggest pieces down here anyway. Selling the engines got us the funds to start this place.”
rows.translation: “呃，对也不全对，”琪琪说道。“太空港有些拆船工，是他们帮我们拆掉飞船。”她神情黯淡片刻，随后继续。“而且卡拉和莫妮卡能负责搬运重物。主要是卡拉，不过别告诉莫妮卡这是我说的。反正我们也不需要把最大零件带到下面。卖掉引擎换来的资金让我们开起了这里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Eh, yes and no,” Kiki says. “There are scrappers working at the spaceport, and they helped us take the ship apart.” She looks sad for a moment, then continues. “And Karrah and Monika could handle the heavy lifting. Mostly Karrah, but don’t tell Monika I said that. And it’s not like we needed the biggest pieces down here anyway. Selling the engines got us the funds to start this place.”"

rows.original: It was worth it, though. You’ve been to your share of unusual spacer bars during the Planet Rush, but none of them are like this.
rows.translation: 不过这一切很值得。星球淘金潮期间，你去过不少不同寻常的太空人酒吧，却没有一家像这里。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt was worth it, though. You’ve been to your share of unusual spacer bars during the Planet Rush, but none of them are like this."

rows.original: Kiki grins at you again. “Damn right. I knew I couldn’t rebuild the ship’s interior down here, so I tried to make it look as mechanical and armored as possible. We’ve got re-entry rated plating in the hallway, all the old lounge tables in the bar, and I did so much re-rigging on stuff here for hardlight display and sound production that I almost ran out of spare parts.”
rows.translation: 琪琪再次朝你咧嘴一笑。“当然。我知道没法在下面重建飞船内部，所以尽量让这里显得机械化、装甲化。走廊装了能承受重返大气层的装甲板，酒吧使用所有旧休息室桌子；为了硬光显示和声音播放，我改装了太多这里的设备，差点把备用零件用光。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki grins at you again. “Damn right. I knew I couldn’t rebuild the ship’s interior down here, so I tried to make it look as mechanical and armored as possible. We’ve got re-entry rated plating in the hallway, all the old lounge tables in the bar, and I did so much re-rigging on stuff here for hardlight display and sound production that I almost ran out of spare parts.”"

rows.original: She pauses. “Hard to believe I could run out of anything, with a whole ship to work with, but I had to fiddle with things to get the plumbing and life support going too. We still have to live down here and all that. But it all worked out better than I thought. I didn’t even know if I’d be able to rewire the bridge displays to make the hardlight cues for the pool tables.” She gives you a proud smile. “I made sure nothing got wasted. The old ship deserved that.”
rows.translation: 她顿了顿。“整艘飞船都能供我拆用，很难相信竟然还有东西会不够，不过为了让管道和生命维持系统运转，我也得摆弄各种设备。毕竟我们还得住在下面。但结果比预想中更好。我起初甚至不知道能否重新布线舰桥显示器，为台球桌制作硬光提示。”她朝你自豪一笑。“我确保没有任何东西遭到浪费。那艘旧船值得如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe pauses. “Hard to believe I could run out of anything, with a whole ship to work with, but I had to fiddle with things to get the plumbing and life support going too. We still have to live down here and all that. But it all worked out better than I thought. I didn’t even know if I’d be able to rewire the bridge displays to make the hardlight cues for the pool tables.” She gives you a proud smile. “I made sure nothing got wasted. The old ship deserved that.”"

rows.original: What kind of ship did they have? It must have been big enough for a whole pirate crew, but you don’t recognize anything from the parts you’ve seen.
rows.translation: 她们以前拥有哪种飞船？它肯定足够容纳整队海盗，可你认不出见过的零件来自什么型号。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat kind of ship did they have? It must have been big enough for a whole pirate crew, but you don’t recognize anything from the parts you’ve seen."

rows.original: Kiki starts to say something, then pauses. “I don’t know if I want to talk about it,” she says, her sad look returning. “I know we kind of still live in her, but I really miss that ship sometimes.”
rows.translation: 琪琪刚要说些什么，随后停住。“我不知道自己想不想谈这个，”她说道，脸上再次流露悲伤。“我知道我们某种程度上仍住在她体内，可有时我真的很想念那艘船。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKiki starts to say something, then pauses. “I don’t know if I want to talk about it,” she says, her sad look returning. “I know we kind of still live in her, but I really miss that ship sometimes.”"

rows.original: It’s clear that Kiki doesn’t want to say anything more about this. Maybe if you spend more time at the bar, she’ll feel like talking to you some more.
rows.translation: 琪琪显然不想再说这件事。也许多来酒吧待些时间，她会愿意再和你多聊聊。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s clear that Kiki doesn’t want to say anything more about this. Maybe if you spend more time at the bar, she’ll feel like talking to you some more."
