rows.original: in all its graphic glory for the world to see.
rows.translation: 让全世界看清其中每一个露骨的细节。
rows.raw: "in all its graphic glory for the world to see."

rows.original: as surreptitiously as possible as you hope no one else sees you.
rows.translation: 尽量偷偷摸摸地做，同时祈祷没有其他人看见你。
rows.raw: "as surreptitiously as possible as you hope no one else sees you."

rows.original: The realization of what you’re asking dawns on Evening gradually, and you see her eyes slowly widen into a visage of abject horror.
rows.translation: 伊芙宁渐渐意识到你在问什么，你看着她的双眼缓缓睁大，脸上浮现出彻底惊恐的神情。
rows.raw: " The realization of what you’re asking dawns on Evening gradually, and you see her eyes slowly widen into a visage of abject horror."

rows.original: “Done the devil’s tango... with one of your... you know, as long as it’s not loaded or-” you’re cut off by the sound of Evening choking on something, probably her own tongue. When she finally gathers her bearings, she’s fixing you with a stare of absolute horror.
rows.translation: “跟你的某把...你知道的...跳过魔鬼探戈，只要没上膛或者——”伊芙宁像是被什么噎住的声音打断了你，八成是她自己的舌头。等她终于恢复镇定，便以无比惊恐的眼神死死盯着你。
rows.raw: " “Done the devil’s tango... with one of your... you know, as long as it’s not loaded or-” you’re cut off by the sound of Evening choking on something, probably her own tongue. When she finally gathers her bearings, she’s fixing you with a stare of absolute horror."

rows.original: “Fucked your gun?” May as well get it out there right away. Evening, for her part, takes a little while to register the question. Her head cocks to the side, as if thinking she’d misheard you, but you quickly see her face turn to confusion and then horror as she realizes that no, she didn’t mishear you, and no, you weren’t kidding. She sputters with great indignity when she addresses you.
rows.translation: “操过你的枪？”不妨一开始就直说。伊芙宁花了一会儿才理解这个问题。她把头歪向一边，仿佛以为自己听错了；可你很快看见她的表情先变成困惑，继而化为惊恐，因为她意识到，不，她没有听错，而你也不是在开玩笑。她带着极大的难堪结结巴巴地回应你。
rows.raw: " “Fucked your gun?” May as well get it out there right away. Evening, for her part, takes a little while to register the question. Her head cocks to the side, as if thinking she’d misheard you, but you quickly see her face turn to confusion and then horror as she realizes that no, she didn’t mishear you, and no, you weren’t kidding. She sputters with great indignity when she addresses you."

rows.original: “Fucking no I haven’t! What’s wrong with you?!” she trills, having been deeply offended by your accusation. “That would be terrible for the gun, you sick fuck!”
rows.translation: “他妈的，不，我没有！你有毛病吗？！”她尖声叫道，显然被你的指控深深冒犯了。“那样对枪可是非常糟糕的，你这个变态！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fucking no I haven’t! What’s wrong with you?!” she trills, having been deeply offended by your accusation. “That would be terrible for the gun, you sick fuck!”"

rows.original: “That’s what you’re concerned about?” you ask incredulously. Now it’s your turn to be offended. Sick fuck indeed.
rows.translation: “你担心的是这个？”你难以置信地问道。现在轮到你感到被冒犯了。变态个鬼。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s what you’re concerned about?” you ask incredulously. Now it’s your turn to be offended. Sick fuck indeed."

rows.original: “Void,” Evening swears, rubbing her temples. She turns away as if unable to stomach the sight of you. “Cleaning the barrel alone would be such a bitch... ninety-nine percent of them wouldn’t be even remotely waterproof. I don’t even want to think about what would happen if the fluids gummed up the trigger or magazine release... how could I do that to any of my babies?”
rows.translation: “虚空在上，”伊芙宁咒骂着揉了揉太阳穴。她转过身去，仿佛连看你一眼都受不了。“光是清理枪管就他妈够麻烦了...百分之九十九的枪连最起码的防水都做不到。我甚至不敢想象，体液要是黏住扳机或弹匣释放钮会发生什么...我怎么能那样对待我的任何一个宝贝？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Void,” Evening swears, rubbing her temples. She turns away as if unable to stomach the sight of you. “Cleaning the barrel alone would be such a bitch... ninety-nine percent of them wouldn’t be even remotely waterproof. I don’t even want to think about what would happen if the fluids gummed up the trigger or magazine release... how could I do that to any of my babies?”"

rows.original: You apologize profusely and swear up and down that you asked purely out of curiosity.
rows.translation: 你连声道歉，再三发誓自己纯粹只是出于好奇才问。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou apologize profusely and swear up and down that you asked purely out of curiosity. "

rows.original: Uh, scientific curiosity.
rows.translation: 呃，出于科学好奇心。
rows.raw: "Uh, scientific curiosity."

rows.original: Just innocent curiosity.
rows.translation: 只是单纯好奇。
rows.raw: "Just innocent curiosity."

rows.original: Yes, that was definitely it. Evening eventually calms down, but the look in her eyes tells you that she will forever judge you for asking in the first place. It may be time to exit this conversation as gracefully as possible.
rows.translation: 没错，肯定就是这样。伊芙宁最终平静下来，可她眼里的神情告诉你，她永远都会因为你问过这个问题而评判你。也许该尽可能体面地结束这场谈话了。
rows.raw: " Yes, that was definitely it. Evening eventually calms down, but the look in her eyes tells you that she will forever judge you for asking in the first place. It may be time to exit this conversation as gracefully as possible."

rows.original: You try your damndest to pass it off as a joke, and though you eventually mollify her, there’s a look in Evening’s eyes that tells you that she’s still judging you hella hard. You surreptitiously slink off, while wondering whether this experience qualifies as kinkshaming.
rows.translation: 你拼命想把这说成一个玩笑，虽然最终安抚住了她，但伊芙宁的眼神表明她依旧在狠狠鄙视你。你悄悄溜走，同时琢磨这次经历算不算性癖羞辱。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try your damndest to pass it off as a joke, and though you eventually mollify her, there’s a look in Evening’s eyes that tells you that she’s still judging you hella hard. You surreptitiously slink off, while wondering whether this experience qualifies as kinkshaming."

rows.original: You give an exasperated sigh and try to play it off as no big deal. It was just a bad joke. Chalk it up to your inexperience with ranged weaponry. Or sex. Why not both, if she’ll believe it. Which she doesn’t. For a second. It’ll be awhile until she can make direct eye contact with you again. Yeah, maybe you should go.
rows.translation: 你无奈地叹了口气，试图装作这没什么大不了的。那只是个糟糕的玩笑。就归咎于你缺乏使用远程武器的经验吧。或者缺乏性爱经验。如果她肯信，何不两样都算上。她根本不信，一秒都没有。她恐怕得过好一阵子才能再次直视你的眼睛。是啊，也许你该走了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou give an exasperated sigh and try to play it off as no big deal. It was just a bad joke. Chalk it up to your inexperience with ranged weaponry. Or sex. Why not both, if she’ll believe it. Which she doesn’t. For a second. It’ll be awhile until she can make direct eye contact with you again. Yeah, maybe you should go."

rows.original: There’s no good way to pussyfoot around it. You ask her straight up if something happened to her family. Every time the subject’s come up between the two of you, she always closes off in a way that’s impossible to miss.
rows.translation: 这事没法拐弯抹角。你直截了当地问她，家人是不是出了什么事。每次你们谈到这个话题，她总会明显地封闭自己，让人不可能忽视。
rows.raw: "There’s no good way to pussyfoot around it. You ask her straight up if something happened to her family. Every time the subject’s come up between the two of you, she always closes off in a way that’s impossible to miss."

rows.original: “Did something happen to your family?” you blurt out in one go.
rows.translation: “你的家人出过什么事吗？”你一口气脱口而出。
rows.raw: "“Did something happen to your family?” you blurt out in one go."

rows.original: Before she can deflect or deny anything, you quickly add on,
rows.translation: 她还没来得及推脱或否认，你便迅速补充道：
rows.raw: " Before she can deflect or deny anything, you quickly add on, "

rows.original: “You said something when I told you about my dad that made me think you might have gone through something similar.” You raise an eyebrow at her. “Or was I wrong?”
rows.translation: “我跟你说起父亲时，你说了一些话，让我觉得你可能经历过类似的事情。”你朝她挑起眉毛。“还是我猜错了？”
rows.raw: "“You said something when I told you about my dad that made me think you might have gone through something similar.” You raise an eyebrow at her. “Or was I wrong?”"

rows.original: “I just thought because of what you said when I told you about my dad, that maybe it meant you went through something similar. I might be able to understand how you feel better than most other people.”
rows.translation: “我只是觉得，你听我讲起父亲时说的那些话，也许意味着你经历过类似的事情。我可能比大多数人更能理解你的感受。”
rows.raw: "“I just thought because of what you said when I told you about my dad, that maybe it meant you went through something similar. I might be able to understand how you feel better than most other people.”"

rows.original: A complicated array of emotions cross over the woman’s face, one after the other.

rows.original: Distress, apprehensiveness, pity, grief... You can’t tell whether she’s about to clam up or storm off completely.
rows.translation: 痛苦、忧虑、怜悯、悲伤...你无法判断她是准备闭口不谈，还是直接怒气冲冲地离开。
rows.raw: "Distress, apprehensiveness, pity, grief... You can’t tell whether she’s about to clam up or storm off completely."

rows.original: They pass by too rapidly for you to really make any of them out, but it doesn’t take an expert to tell that she’s not the happiest of campers about this.
rows.translation: 那些神情变化得太快，你根本来不及看清；但无需专家也看得出来，她对这件事绝对谈不上高兴。
rows.raw: " They pass by too rapidly for you to really make any of them out, but it doesn’t take an expert to tell that she’s not the happiest of campers about this."

rows.original: Eventually Evening takes a long, deep breath, and fixes you with a stare. It’s a little colder and harder than her usual looks. Underneath it, you can see her still half-deciding on what to do next.
rows.translation: 最终，伊芙宁深深吸了一口气，定定地盯着你。她的目光比平常冷了些，也更严厉了些。在那目光之下，你看得出她仍有一半心思在犹豫下一步该怎么办。
rows.raw: " Eventually Evening takes a long, deep breath, and fixes you with a stare. It’s a little colder and harder than her usual looks. Underneath it, you can see her still half-deciding on what to do next."

rows.original: A silence passes, one longer than what you’d deem comfortable, before Evening talks again. “I looked up your dad after you told me about him,” she finally says. “When you said your name was ‘Steele, [pc.name] Steele,’ I didn’t think you meant ‘Steele Tech Industries’ Steele. But lo and behold, it didn’t take a lot of digging to find an article about him. Victor Steele dead, survived by his only child.”
rows.translation: 沉默持续了许久，久到令你感到不适，伊芙宁才再次开口。“你告诉我你父亲的事之后，我查过他，”她终于说道。“你说自己叫‘斯蒂尔，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔’时，我没想到你指的是‘斯蒂尔科技工业’的那个斯蒂尔。可事实摆在眼前，没费多少功夫我就找到了一篇关于他的报道。维克托·斯蒂尔去世，身后留下唯一的孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA silence passes, one longer than what you’d deem comfortable, before Evening talks again. “I looked up your dad after you told me about him,” she finally says. “When you said your name was ‘Steele, [pc.name] Steele,’ I didn’t think you meant ‘Steele Tech Industries’ Steele. But lo and behold, it didn’t take a lot of digging to find an article about him. Victor Steele dead, survived by his only child.” "

rows.original: “Did it really say that?” you ask skeptically.
rows.translation: “上面真是这么写的？”你怀疑地问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Did it really say that?” you ask skeptically."

rows.original: Evening’s brow furrows. “Say what?”
rows.translation: 伊芙宁皱起眉。“写了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening’s brow furrows. “Say what?”"

rows.original: “That I was his only child.”
rows.translation: “说我是他唯一的孩子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That I was his only child.”"

rows.original: “Well...” Biting her lip, the woman struggles to explain through her discomfort. “You know-”
rows.translation: “这个...”女人咬着嘴唇，努力压下不适解释道。“你知道——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well...” Biting her lip, the woman struggles to explain through her discomfort. “You know-”"

rows.original: You slap a hand on her shoulder and stare Evening in the eyes. “Oh, trust me. I definitely know.”
rows.translation: 你一巴掌拍在她肩上，直视伊芙宁的双眼。“哦，相信我，我当然知道。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou slap a hand on her shoulder and stare Evening in the eyes. “Oh, trust me. I definitely know.” "

rows.original: The reassurance seems to hasten resolve. “Yeah, they dedicated a page or two to speculating how many bastards he had,” she confesses, shoulders sinking. “He sounded like a, uh, busy man.”
rows.translation: 这番安慰似乎坚定了她的决心。“是啊，他们用了整整一两页猜测他到底有多少私生子，”她坦白道，肩膀垮了下来。“听起来他是个，呃，大忙人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe reassurance seems to hasten resolve. “Yeah, they dedicated a page or two to speculating how many bastards he had,” she confesses, shoulders sinking. “He sounded like a, uh, busy man.”"

rows.original: “Well...” Biting her lip, the woman struggles to explain through her discomfort. “You know-” She sputters and wanes, but eventually sighs and confesses: “Yeah, they dedicated a page or two to speculating how many bastards he had. He sounded like a, uh, busy man.”
rows.translation: “这个嘛...”女人咬着嘴唇，在不适中艰难解释。“你知道——”她吞吞吐吐，声音渐弱，最后叹了口气坦白：“是啊，他们用了整整一两页猜测他到底有多少私生子。听起来他是个，呃，大忙人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well...” Biting her lip, the woman struggles to explain through her discomfort. “You know-” She sputters and wanes, but eventually sighs and confesses: “Yeah, they dedicated a page or two to speculating how many bastards he had. He sounded like a, uh, busy man.”"

rows.original: She chuckles, a little awkwardly, a little nervously, but soon her face settles into a more solemn visage once more. “Was he around much? What was he like when you were growing up?”
rows.translation: 她笑了笑，有些尴尬，也有些紧张，但很快又恢复了更加严肃的神情。“他经常陪着你吗？你小时候他是什么样的人？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe chuckles, a little awkwardly, a little nervously, but soon her face settles into a more solemn visage once more. “Was he around much? What was he like when you were growing up?”"

rows.original: You weren’t expecting to get asked about your life story tonight,
rows.translation: 你没想到今晚会被问起你自己的人生故事，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou weren’t expecting to get asked about your life story tonight, "

joinAfter.expression:
pc.isAss()
                          ? "but you figure if you don’t tell her anything, she might be liable to clam up about hers."
                          : "but you figure that it’s only fair, since you’d broached the subject of family in the first place."

rows.original: but you figure if you don’t tell her anything, she might be liable to clam up about hers.
rows.translation: 但你觉得，要是什么都不告诉她，她也许就会闭口不谈自己家的事。
rows.raw: "but you figure if you don’t tell her anything, she might be liable to clam up about hers."

rows.original: but you figure that it’s only fair, since you’d broached the subject of family in the first place.
rows.translation: 但你觉得既然是你先提起家庭这个话题，这样才算公平。
rows.raw: "but you figure that it’s only fair, since you’d broached the subject of family in the first place."

rows.original: You describe your childhood to Evening in broad strokes: about your mother, your father, and Briget, your robot caretaker. The robot nanny part takes the Terran by surprise, but she otherwise listens to you without saying a word.
rows.translation: 你向伊芙宁大致讲述了自己的童年：你的母亲、父亲，以及照顾你的机器人布丽姬特。机器人保姆这部分令这位泰拉人有些惊讶，不过除此之外，她始终一言不发地听着。
rows.raw: " You describe your childhood to Evening in broad strokes: about your mother, your father, and Briget, your robot caretaker. The robot nanny part takes the Terran by surprise, but she otherwise listens to you without saying a word."

rows.original: “Hmm.” When you finish, Evening moves away and gives your personal space some breathing room. “Well, you got to spend more time with your dad than I did. He died when I was young. It was my mother who got ruined by transformatives.”
rows.translation: “嗯。”你说完后，伊芙宁退开一步，给你的私人空间留出喘息余地。“好吧，你和父亲相处的时间比我多。我的父亲在我很小的时候就去世了。被转化物毁掉的是我母亲。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm.” When you finish, Evening moves away and gives your personal space some breathing room. “Well, you got to spend more time with your dad than I did. He died when I was young. It was my mother who got ruined by transformatives.”"

rows.original: Watching your resulting expression, she gives a dry, mirthless laugh. “Yeah, I don’t exactly hide my ‘dark and mysterious past’ very well. You probably figured part of it out before you even asked me; I technically already told you what happened to her. She got a Lip Tease from one of her friends as a birthday gift, and just... kept obsessing over it. Eventually she decided to get mods on her own. That did it.” Evening clicks her fingers. “It started off small. She would change her eye color or add a few inches to her height every few weeks. But those weeks became days, and those little changes got bigger. She started getting obsessed with mods and let go of everything else that should have mattered to her. Her house, her job, her kids. Eventually we were coming home to a whole new person every week. And unlike Victor, we didn’t have a fortune we could use to fix her resulting health problems or pay our bills.”
rows.translation: 看着你随之露出的表情，她发出一声干涩、毫无笑意的轻笑。“是啊，我确实不太会掩饰自己的‘黑暗神秘往事’。你大概在开口问之前就已经猜出了一部分；严格来说，我已经告诉过你她发生了什么。她生日时从一个朋友那里收到一份诱唇膏，然后就...一直对它念念不忘。最后，她决定自己接受改造。那一下就彻底失控了。”伊芙宁打了个响指。“一开始只是些小变化。她每隔几周会换换眼睛颜色，或者把身高增加几英寸。但几周渐渐变成几天，小变化也越来越大。她开始沉迷改造，放弃了其他本该重要的一切。她的房子、工作、孩子。后来我们每周回到家，看到的都像是一个全新的人。而且她不像维克托，我们没有一大笔钱来治疗她由此引发的健康问题，或支付账单。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWatching your resulting expression, she gives a dry, mirthless laugh. “Yeah, I don’t exactly hide my ‘dark and mysterious past’ very well. You probably figured part of it out before you even asked me; I technically already told you what happened to her. She got a Lip Tease from one of her friends as a birthday gift, and just... kept obsessing over it. Eventually she decided to get mods on her own. That did it.” Evening clicks her fingers. “It started off small. She would change her eye color or add a few inches to her height every few weeks. But those weeks became days, and those little changes got bigger. She started getting obsessed with mods and let go of everything else that should have mattered to her. Her house, her job, her kids. Eventually we were coming home to a whole new person every week. And unlike Victor, we didn’t have a fortune we could use to fix her resulting health problems or pay our bills.”"

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou"

rows.original: shrink
rows.translation: 瑟缩
rows.raw: " shrink"

rows.original: wince
rows.translation: 畏缩
rows.raw: " wince"

rows.original: bristle
rows.translation: 勃然不悦
rows.raw: " bristle"

rows.original: a bit under the weight of her unspoken accusation. “I’m sorry to hear that.”
rows.translation: ，她因那无声的责备而有些承受不住。“听到这件事我很难过。”
rows.raw: " a bit under the weight of her unspoken accusation. “I’m sorry to hear that.”"

rows.original: “Well, it’s not exactly fair to resent you for having money. But the reality was that my mother’s habit sunk us deep into debt. I had to get a job, which wasn’t easy at my age, while my sister had to drop out of university when she couldn’t afford the tuition. It got to the point where we were having trouble feeding ourselves. And then one day, poof. I came home from school and she wasn’t there. She didn’t come home that day at all. Or the next. Or the next. My siblings and I searched for her for days, but we couldn’t find any trace of her.”
rows.translation: “好吧，因为你有钱就怨恨你确实不太公平。但现实是，我母亲的习惯让我们深陷债务。我不得不找工作，以我当时的年纪并不容易；我姐姐则因为付不起学费，被迫从大学退学。后来我们甚至连填饱肚子都成了问题。然后有一天，砰，她消失了。我放学回家时她不在。那天她没有回家。第二天没有，第三天也没有。我和兄弟姐妹找了她好多天，却找不到任何踪迹。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, it’s not exactly fair to resent you for having money. But the reality was that my mother’s habit sunk us deep into debt. I had to get a job, which wasn’t easy at my age, while my sister had to drop out of university when she couldn’t afford the tuition. It got to the point where we were having trouble feeding ourselves. And then one day, poof. I came home from school and she wasn’t there. She didn’t come home that day at all. Or the next. Or the next. My siblings and I searched for her for days, but we couldn’t find any trace of her.”"

rows.original: “Siblings?” She hadn’t mentioned having more than one before.
rows.translation: “兄弟姐妹？”她之前没提过自己不止有一个。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Siblings?” She hadn’t mentioned having more than one before."

rows.original: “I have two brothers. Harry and James.” Her expression is still sour, even while half obscured by her raised drink. “We don’t talk anymore. They never forgave me for leaving Terra to go look for our mother. I’m the only one of us still searching for her. We all were at first, but the others have given up... told me that at this point she’s probably changed herself so much that we wouldn’t be able to recognize her even if we did find her. They’re not wrong,” she laments. “But I can’t just give up on her like that. Not when she’s my mother. Not when she has so much to answer for.”
rows.translation: “我有两个兄弟，哈里和詹姆斯。”即使半张脸被举起的酒杯遮住，她的神情依旧阴郁。“我们已经不来往了。他们始终无法原谅我离开泰拉去寻找母亲。我们之中只有我还在找她。起初大家都在找，可其他人都放弃了...他们告诉我，她如今大概已经把自己改得面目全非，就算真找到，我们也认不出她。他们没有说错，”她哀叹道。“可我不能就这样放弃她。她毕竟是我的母亲。更何况，她还有太多事情必须给出交代。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have two brothers. Harry and James.” Her expression is still sour, even while half obscured by her raised drink. “We don’t talk anymore. They never forgave me for leaving Terra to go look for our mother. I’m the only one of us still searching for her. We all were at first, but the others have given up... told me that at this point she’s probably changed herself so much that we wouldn’t be able to recognize her even if we did find her. They’re not wrong,” she laments. “But I can’t just give up on her like that. Not when she’s my mother. Not when she has so much to answer for.”"

rows.original: Evening smiles, but the expression doesn’t reach her eyes. “And here’s the kicker: addiction turned out to run in the family. So now my brothers are in and out of rehab for alcoholism, and my sister had to kick a drug habit when she got pregnant. Correction: I made her quit and threatened not to send her money otherwise. The ultimatum pisses her off to this day.”
rows.translation: 伊芙宁笑了，可笑意没有抵达眼底。“更绝的是：事实证明，成瘾会在家族中遗传。所以我两个兄弟如今因为酗酒反复进出戒瘾中心，我姐姐怀孕时也不得不戒掉毒瘾。纠正一下：是我逼她戒掉，还威胁说否则就不给她寄钱。直到今天，她还在为这份最后通牒生我的气。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening smiles, but the expression doesn’t reach her eyes. “And here’s the kicker: addiction turned out to run in the family. So now my brothers are in and out of rehab for alcoholism, and my sister had to kick a drug habit when she got pregnant. Correction: I made her quit and threatened not to send her money otherwise. The ultimatum pisses her off to this day.”"

rows.original: That explains the lack of niece and nephew pictures. “Is that why you don’t want to use mods?”
rows.translation: 这就解释了为什么没有侄女和侄子的照片。“这就是你不愿使用改造物的原因吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThat explains the lack of niece and nephew pictures. “Is that why you don’t want to use mods?”"

rows.original: “Oh, I told you plenty of other reasons why I don’t use mods.” Evening shakes her head. “But yes, that’s another one. I don’t want to take the risk of finding out I’m my mother’s daughter. Other than my sister’s kids, I’m the only one of my family whose future isn’t thoroughly fucked. So here I am!” She gestures grandly to absolutely no one in particular. “Lightyears from home and taking every two-bit mercenary assignment I can get my hands on to make sure the rest of them don’t starve to death.”
rows.translation: “哦，我告诉过你许多不接受改造的其他理由。”伊芙宁摇摇头。“不过没错，这也是其中之一。我不想冒险确认自己是否真是母亲的女儿。除了姐姐的孩子，我是家里唯一一个未来还没有彻底完蛋的人。所以我才会在这里！”她朝根本不存在的观众夸张地摊开双臂。“离家好几光年，什么不入流的佣兵委托都接，只为确保其他人不至于饿死。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, I told you plenty of other reasons why I don’t use mods.” Evening shakes her head. “But yes, that’s another one. I don’t want to take the risk of finding out I’m my mother’s daughter. Other than my sister’s kids, I’m the only one of my family whose future isn’t thoroughly fucked. So here I am!” She gestures grandly to absolutely no one in particular. “Lightyears from home and taking every two-bit mercenary assignment I can get my hands on to make sure the rest of them don’t starve to death.”"

rows.original: Sympathizing with her heavily, you give Evening what you hope is a comforting squeeze.
rows.translation: 你对她深感同情，轻轻捏了捏伊芙宁，希望能给她一点安慰。
rows.raw: "\n\nSympathizing with her heavily, you give Evening what you hope is a comforting squeeze."

rows.original: You try to give Evening a mirroring expression of sympathy.
rows.translation: 你试着摆出与伊芙宁相似的同情神情。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou try to give Evening a mirroring expression of sympathy."

rows.original: You have to admit, that’s a tough situation to be in.
rows.translation: 你不得不承认，这种处境确实很难熬。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou have to admit, that’s a tough situation to be in."

rows.original: <i>“If it’s any consolation, the rest of my family’s pretty complicated too.
rows.translation: <i>“如果这能算一点安慰，我家的情况也相当复杂。
rows.raw: " <i>“If it’s any consolation, the rest of my family’s pretty complicated too."

rows.original: Like, my cousin is tooootally trying to steal my inheritance. Isn’t that super unfair?”
rows.translation: 比如，我表亲是完——全在设法偷走我的遗产。是不是超级不公平？”
rows.raw: " Like, my cousin is tooootally trying to steal my inheritance. Isn’t that super unfair?”"

rows.original: And by complicated, I mean my shitpickle of a cousin is trying to jack my inheritance.
rows.translation: 所谓复杂，就是我那个混账表亲正想把我的遗产抢走。
rows.raw: " And by complicated, I mean my shitpickle of a cousin is trying to jack my inheritance."

rows.original: And by complicated, I mean my cousin [rival.name] is trying to steal my inheritance. Not cool.
rows.translation: 所谓复杂，就是我表亲[rival.name]正想偷走我的遗产。太过分了。
rows.raw: " And by complicated, I mean my cousin [rival.name] is trying to steal my inheritance. Not cool."

rows.original: The Terran snorts despite her darkened mood. “No way, really?”
rows.translation: 尽管心情阴沉，这名泰拉人还是哼笑了一声。“不会吧，真的？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Terran snorts despite her darkened mood. “No way, really?”"

rows.original: You tell her that yes
rows.translation: 你告诉她，没错，
rows.raw: "\n\nYou tell her that yes "

rows.translation: 老兄，
rows.raw: "bro,"

rows.original: way,
rows.translation: 当然，
rows.raw: "way,"

rows.original: that’s totally the case, and proceed to explain in thorough detail the various ways that [rival.name] has been
rows.translation: 事情确实如此，随后详尽解释了[rival.name]一直以来是如何
rows.raw: " that’s totally the case, and proceed to explain in thorough detail the various ways that [rival.name] has been"

rows.original: making your life just a little bit harder.
rows.translation: 让你的生活变得更难一点。
rows.raw: " making your life just a little bit harder."

rows.original: showing up where [rival.heShe] shouldn’t be.
rows.translation: 出现在[rival.heShe]不该出现的地方。
rows.raw: " showing up where [rival.heShe] shouldn’t be."

rows.original: a pain in your fucking ass.
rows.translation: 你他妈屁股上的一根刺。
rows.raw: " a pain in your fucking ass."

rows.original: “Damn. You’re right; that is pretty fucked up.” The mercenary sniggers. “You know just what to say to cheer me up, huh [pc.name]?” She gives your shoulder a firm squeeze. “That does make me feel a little better, actually. Thanks for listening to me. And.. for telling me about your family too. It’s nice to know I’m not the only one with messed up relatives.”
rows.translation: “妈的。你说得对；那确实挺糟糕。”佣兵窃笑起来。“你可真知道该说什么来让我高兴，对吧，[pc.name]？”她用力捏了捏你的肩膀。“这确实让我感觉好了一点。谢谢你听我说这些。还有..也谢谢你告诉我你家里的事。知道不是只有我有一群乱七八糟的亲戚，感觉挺好的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn. You’re right; that is pretty fucked up.” The mercenary sniggers. “You know just what to say to cheer me up, huh [pc.name]?” She gives your shoulder a firm squeeze. “That does make me feel a little better, actually. Thanks for listening to me. And.. for telling me about your family too. It’s nice to know I’m not the only one with messed up relatives.”"

rows.translation: 家庭
rows.raw: "Family"

rows.original: Family
rows.translation: 家庭
rows.raw: "Family"

rows.original: You have to admit, the curiosity is getting to you. It might be a touchy subject, but maybe Evening will spill the beans now that you’ve gotten to know each other...
rows.translation: 你不得不承认，好奇心正在折磨你。这个话题也许有些敏感，但既然你们已经相互熟悉，也许伊芙宁会愿意说出实情...
rows.raw: "You have to admit, the curiosity is getting to you. It might be a touchy subject, but maybe Evening will spill the beans now that you’ve gotten to know each other..."

rows.translation: 伊芙宁现在大概还不想谈这个。也许你应该先多陪她一段时间。
rows.raw: "Evening probably doesn’t want to talk about this just yet. Maybe you should spend some more time with her first."
