rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: You lean over to tell Evening over the din of the bar that there’s something you’ve been wanting to ask. She rests her chin over laced fingers and considers what you have to say.
rows.translation: 你探身越过酒吧里的喧嚣，告诉伊芙宁有件事一直想问。她把下巴搁在交扣的手指上，考虑着你的话。
rows.raw: "You lean over to tell Evening over the din of the bar that there’s something you’ve been wanting to ask. She rests her chin over laced fingers and considers what you have to say. "

rows.original: “Mmm, let me guess, you have a very particular set of questions, the answers to which I’ve acquired over a very long career? I think I can help with that.”
rows.translation: “嗯，让我猜猜，你有一套非常具体的问题，而我漫长职业生涯中积累的答案正好能解答它们？我想我能帮上忙。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm, let me guess, you have a very particular set of questions, the answers to which I’ve acquired over a very long career? I think I can help with that.”"

rows.original: “Sure; I’m always up for a good conversation. What would you like to know?”
rows.translation: “当然，我随时乐意好好聊聊。你想知道什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sure; I’m always up for a good conversation. What would you like to know?”"

rows.original: You chat a bit about Dhaal, the Zaika, and the strip, before you bring up the unconventional welcome you got when you touched down for the first time.
rows.translation: 你们先聊了聊达哈尔、扎伊卡人和这条街区，随后你提起自己第一次着陆时受到的非常规欢迎。
rows.raw: "You chat a bit about Dhaal, the Zaika, and the strip, before you bring up the unconventional welcome you got when you touched down for the first time."

rows.original: “You too, huh?” Evening swirls her drink about in her glass. “I had a bit of a rough landing myself.”
rows.translation: “你也是吗？”伊芙宁晃动杯中的酒。“我自己着陆时也不太顺利。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You too, huh?” Evening swirls her drink about in her glass. “I had a bit of a rough landing myself.”"

rows.original: “Rebels storm your shuttle too?”
rows.translation: “叛军也冲进你的穿梭机了？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Rebels storm your shuttle too?”"

rows.original: She waves the idea down. “Oh no, I meant the literal landing. My ship was in pretty bad shape when I first got here; I bet a hard knock on the hull would have collapsed it completely. I was lucky to land when I did, or else I might have been a goner.” The prospect doesn’t seem to perturb the woman too much, because she’s all smiles as she says this. “Don’t worry, I have a talent for making it by the skin of my teeth.”
rows.translation: 她摆手否定了这个说法。“不，我说的是字面意义上的着陆。我刚到这里时，飞船的状况相当糟糕；我敢说只要用力敲一下船壳，整艘船都会彻底塌掉。我很走运，在那时成功着陆了，不然可能已经没命。”这个可能性似乎丝毫没有令她不安，因为她说这些时满脸笑容。“别担心，我很擅长险中求生。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe waves the idea down. “Oh no, I meant the literal landing. My ship was in pretty bad shape when I first got here; I bet a hard knock on the hull would have collapsed it completely. I was lucky to land when I did, or else I might have been a goner.” The prospect doesn’t seem to perturb the woman too much, because she’s all smiles as she says this. “Don’t worry, I have a talent for making it by the skin of my teeth.”"

rows.original: You ask what could have possibly happened to damage her ship that badly.
rows.translation: 你问究竟发生了什么，才会把她的飞船损坏得那么严重。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask what could have possibly happened to damage her ship that badly."

rows.original: “Well,” Evening begins to explain. “A pirate ship accosted me on the way here.”
rows.translation: “这个嘛，”伊芙宁开始解释，“我来这里的路上遇到了一艘海盗船。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well,” Evening begins to explain. “A pirate ship accosted me on the way here.”"

rows.original: “Oof! Bad luck there.”
rows.translation: “哎哟！运气真差。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oof! Bad luck there.”"

rows.original: “That tracks. Those fuckers are everywhere, aren’t they?”
rows.translation: “这倒合理。那些混蛋到处都是，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That tracks. Those fuckers are everywhere, aren’t they?”"

rows.original: “As they do.”
rows.translation: “他们就是会干这种事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As they do.”"

rows.original: <i>“Right. And obviously, I opened fire, but my ship...
rows.translation: <i>“对。显然，我立刻开火了，可我的飞船...
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Right. And obviously, I opened fire, but my ship... "

joinAfter.expression:
void 0 !== flags.EVENING_SEXED
                    ? "Well, you’ve seen my ship. I love it, but it’s kind of a piece of junk."
                    : "It’s not the most robust in design. Or structural integrity. The Theseus has been with me through hell and high water, but by Void, it shows."

rows.original: Well, you’ve seen my ship. I love it, but it’s kind of a piece of junk.
rows.translation: 你也见过我的船。我很爱它，但它确实有点破。
rows.raw: "Well, you’ve seen my ship. I love it, but it’s kind of a piece of junk."

rows.original: It’s not the most robust in design. Or structural integrity. The Theseus has been with me through hell and high water, but by Void, it shows.
rows.translation: 它的设计不是特别结实，结构完整性也不怎么样。忒修斯号陪我上过刀山下过火海，而以虚空之名发誓，这些经历全都写在它身上。
rows.raw: "It’s not the most robust in design. Or structural integrity. The Theseus has been with me through hell and high water, but by Void, it shows."

rows.original: ” The mercenary sighs. “One day I’d like to give her a nice upgrade or two, maybe replace the wall with the giant hole I had to patch up, but that day isn’t coming any time soon. I’ve already spent the last couple of weeks fixing her back up to a livable state... thank Void for that pod hotel down the Gyre.”
rows.translation: ”佣兵叹了口气。“总有一天，我想给她好好升级一两次，也许把我不得不补起来的那个巨洞换成一面真正的墙，不过那一天短期内不会到来。我已经花了过去几个星期把她修复到勉强能住的状态...感谢虚空，环流区还有那家胶囊旅馆。”
rows.raw: "” The mercenary sighs. “One day I’d like to give her a nice upgrade or two, maybe replace the wall with the giant hole I had to patch up, but that day isn’t coming any time soon. I’ve already spent the last couple of weeks fixing her back up to a livable state... thank Void for that pod hotel down the Gyre.”"

rows.original: “So, the pirates?” You gently nudge her story back on track.
rows.translation: “所以，那些海盗呢？”你轻轻把她的故事拉回正题。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, the pirates?” You gently nudge her story back on track."

rows.original: “Oh, right. Well, they boarded the ship, and this was usually the part where they march in, demand your credits, or rob you for everything you’re worth, right? The problem was, I was really tight on credits, and I didn’t have much worth stealing. Except my gun collection.”
rows.translation: “哦，对。他们登上了飞船，通常这时候就会闯进来，索要信用点，或者把你洗劫一空，对吧？问题是，我当时手头特别紧，也没什么值钱东西可偷。除了我的枪械收藏。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, right. Well, they boarded the ship, and this was usually the part where they march in, demand your credits, or rob you for everything you’re worth, right? The problem was, I was really tight on credits, and I didn’t have much worth stealing. Except my gun collection.”"

rows.original: “How big is your collection?”
rows.translation: “你的收藏有多大规模？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How big is your collection?”"

rows.original: “Seventy-three pieces and counting, not including the extra scopes, grips, and other spare parts, etcetera.”
rows.translation: “七十三件，而且还在增加；额外的瞄准镜、握把和其他备件之类的还不算在内。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Seventy-three pieces and counting, not including the extra scopes, grips, and other spare parts, etcetera.”"

rows.original: “You don’t think that’s too-”
rows.translation: “你不觉得这也太——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You don’t think that’s too-”"

rows.original: “Nope,” Evening chirps. “I love each and every one of them, and I will die before I let a pirate lay his filthy pirating hands on a single one. So obviously getting robbed wasn’t an option for me.”
rows.translation: “当然不，”伊芙宁轻快地说。“我爱它们每一个，宁死也不会让海盗把肮脏的贼手碰到其中任何一把。所以显然，我不可能任他们抢劫。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nope,” Evening chirps. “I love each and every one of them, and I will die before I let a pirate lay his filthy pirating hands on a single one. So obviously getting robbed wasn’t an option for me.”"

rows.original: “So, let me guess,” you interject, leaning on the bar as you make your brilliant deduction. “The ship got damaged because you fought them off?”
rows.translation: “所以，让我猜猜。”你打断她，靠在吧台上，说出自己的高明推断。“飞船受损是因为你击退了他们？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, let me guess,” you interject, leaning on the bar as you make your brilliant deduction. “The ship got damaged because you fought them off?”"

rows.original: “You could say that.” The Terran’s brow crinkles, in a way that isn’t quite a frown. “More like, I scared them off.”
rows.translation: “也可以这么说。”这名泰拉人蹙起眉，却又不太像是在皱眉。“更准确地说，我吓跑了他们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You could say that.” The Terran’s brow crinkles, in a way that isn’t quite a frown. “More like, I scared them off.”"

rows.original: “How so?”
rows.translation: “怎么做到的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How so?”"

rows.original: “Well, I... may have mildly blown up The Theseus. Multiple times.”
rows.translation: “这个，我...可能只是稍微炸了几次忒修斯号。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, I... may have mildly blown up The Theseus. Multiple times.”"

rows.original: That’s not what you expected. At all. “Wh- How do you mildly blow up a spaceship?” you balk. The fact that she’s so nonchalant about this is a mind-boggling impossibility to you right now.
rows.translation: 这完全出乎你的预料。“什——你到底怎么才能把飞船只炸得稍微严重一点？”你惊愕地问。她对此如此若无其事，简直让你无法理解。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s not what you expected. At all. “Wh- How do you mildly blow up a spaceship?” you balk. The fact that she’s so nonchalant about this is a mind-boggling impossibility to you right now."

rows.original: “Well, if you want to get technical about it: very carefully,” the mercenary explains. “I blocked off the entrances to force them into a certain hallway, and set off a few small, mechanical explosions. You know, so nothing caught on fire. Then I would have really been fucked. I had a couple of smaller bombs left over from a job I did, so now seemed like as good a time as any to use them up. They tried to go into the rec room. Bomb. They opened a closet door. Bomb. They tried to break down a door I barricaded. By the time they got through, the room was already been laced with-”
rows.translation: “好吧，如果非要说得技术一点：非常小心，”佣兵解释道。“我封住入口，逼他们只能走某条走廊，然后引爆了几次小型机械爆炸。你懂的，这样就不会有东西着火。否则我可就真完蛋了。我之前做一份工作还剩下几枚小炸弹，眼下正是把它们用掉的好时机。他们想进娱乐室。炸。他们打开壁橱门。炸。他们试着撞开被我堵住的门。等他们终于闯进去时，房间早已布满了——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, if you want to get technical about it: very carefully,” the mercenary explains. “I blocked off the entrances to force them into a certain hallway, and set off a few small, mechanical explosions. You know, so nothing caught on fire. Then I would have really been fucked. I had a couple of smaller bombs left over from a job I did, so now seemed like as good a time as any to use them up. They tried to go into the rec room. Bomb. They opened a closet door. Bomb. They tried to break down a door I barricaded. By the time they got through, the room was already been laced with-”"

rows.original: “More bombs?”
rows.translation: “又是炸弹？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“More bombs?”"

rows.original: “You guessed it. And some mild tear gas, for extra fun.”
rows.translation: “猜对了。为了多添点乐趣，还加了点温和的催泪瓦斯。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You guessed it. And some mild tear gas, for extra fun.”"

rows.original: “You didn’t just shoot them?”
rows.translation: “你没有直接开枪打他们？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You didn’t just shoot them?” "

joinAfter.expression:
pc.isMischievous()
                    ? "You can’t believe you’re thinking this, but the"
                    : "The"

rows.original: You can’t believe you’re thinking this, but the
rows.translation: 你简直不敢相信自己会这么想，但
rows.raw: "You can’t believe you’re thinking this, but the"

rows.original: The
rows.translation: 那间
rows.raw: "The"

rows.original: relentless bombing of your enemies sounds like the tiniest bit of overkill.
rows.translation: 对敌人穷追猛炸，听起来多少有那么一点杀鸡用牛刀。
rows.raw: " relentless bombing of your enemies sounds like the tiniest bit of overkill."

rows.original: The mercenary shakes her head. “Explosives were okay because they had a certain radius of damage, and the ones I used weren’t actually that large. Think somewhere between a cherry bomb and a grenade. But bullets go far, and they ricochet. There’s too much of a risk of one bouncing around and piercing something integral. The pirates probably knew that too, because they didn’t fire any shots either. It was either that or the fact that I cut all the lights beforehand.”
rows.translation: 佣兵摇摇头。“炸药的破坏半径固定，所以还算安全，而且我用的那些实际威力并不大。大概介于摔炮和手榴弹之间。但子弹能飞得很远，还会跳弹。它们可能四处反弹，击穿某个关键部件，风险太高。海盗大概也清楚这一点，因为他们同样没有开枪。也可能是因为我事先切断了所有照明。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe mercenary shakes her head. “Explosives were okay because they had a certain radius of damage, and the ones I used weren’t actually that large. Think somewhere between a cherry bomb and a grenade. But bullets go far, and they ricochet. There’s too much of a risk of one bouncing around and piercing something integral. The pirates probably knew that too, because they didn’t fire any shots either. It was either that or the fact that I cut all the lights beforehand.”"

rows.original: “Wow,” you say with
rows.translation: “哇。”你说道，带着
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow,” you say with"

rows.original: mild shock.
rows.translation: 些许震惊。
rows.raw: " mild shock."

rows.original: begrudging admiration.
rows.translation: 勉强流露出的钦佩。
rows.raw: " begrudging admiration."

rows.original: barely hidden incredulity.
rows.translation: 几乎掩饰不住的难以置信。
rows.raw: " barely hidden incredulity."

rows.original: “You’d rather destroy your entire ship and risk getting jettisoned into space than let a couple of thieves touch your stuff?”
rows.translation: “你宁愿毁掉自己的整艘飞船，冒着被抛进太空的风险，也不愿让几个小偷碰你的东西？”
rows.raw: " “You’d rather destroy your entire ship and risk getting jettisoned into space than let a couple of thieves touch your stuff?”"

rows.original: “Hey now, it was very important stuff to me, so yes,” Evening tries to explain a little defensively. The expression on your face doesn’t exactly say you’ve been convinced, so she rubs the bridge of her nose and tries again. “Look, I’m not exactly what you would call ‘physically gifted’. Or ‘intellectually gifted’. Or even ‘above average’ in a lot of respects. Not compared to some other species. So when you’re facing off against an enemy who might have you trumped in one or both regards, your best options are to shoot them from far away or make them explode from far away. Or, if it’s dark and they’re in unfamiliar territory, sneak up on them and strangle them a bit from really close up. But that’s neither here nor there. And if you have to take a little risk for a high reward, I’m willing to take it. I have my priorities straight.”
rows.translation: “嘿，那些东西对我非常重要，所以没错，”伊芙宁略带防备地解释。你脸上的表情显然没有被说服，于是她揉了揉鼻梁，再试一次。“听着，我并不是你所谓的‘天赋异禀’。无论是‘身体天赋’，还是‘智力天赋’。许多方面甚至称不上‘高于平均水平’，至少与某些其他种族相比是这样。所以当你面对一个在这两方面之一、甚至两方面都胜过你的敌人时，最好的选择就是从远处射杀他们，或者从远处把他们炸飞。又或者，如果环境很黑，而他们不熟悉地形，就偷偷靠近，从非常近的地方勒上几下。不过那无关紧要。如果为了高回报必须承担一点风险，我愿意。我分得清轻重缓急。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey now, it was very important stuff to me, so yes,” Evening tries to explain a little defensively. The expression on your face doesn’t exactly say you’ve been convinced, so she rubs the bridge of her nose and tries again. “Look, I’m not exactly what you would call ‘physically gifted’. Or ‘intellectually gifted’. Or even ‘above average’ in a lot of respects. Not compared to some other species. So when you’re facing off against an enemy who might have you trumped in one or both regards, your best options are to shoot them from far away or make them explode from far away. Or, if it’s dark and they’re in unfamiliar territory, sneak up on them and strangle them a bit from really close up. But that’s neither here nor there. And if you have to take a little risk for a high reward, I’m willing to take it. I have my priorities straight.”"

rows.original: “I think we have very different definitions of ‘straight’.”
rows.translation: “我觉得我们对‘直线’的定义非常不一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think we have very different definitions of ‘straight’.”"

rows.original: This makes Evening chuckle. “The good thing for me was, I knew my ship. I was on it when I first left Terra, and I’ve been with it ever since. I know exactly how much abuse it can take, and where, before it gets compromised, and they didn’t. So when the walls started shaking and this hissing sound started coming through the pipes, they all packed up and got the fuck out, thinking they only had a few minutes until the entire craft was going to explode. Joke’s on them. It actually had two whole hours.” Evening throws back her drink and sighs a satisfied kind of sigh. “It was enough for me to set a course for the nearest civilised planet. And that’s how I landed on Dhaal for the first time.”
rows.translation: 这让伊芙宁笑了起来。“对我有利的是，我了解自己的飞船。我第一次离开泰拉时就在她上面，此后一直和她待在一起。我很清楚她在什么地方能承受多少破坏，超过什么程度才会真正失守，而他们不知道。所以当墙壁开始震动，管道里传出嘶嘶声时，他们全都收拾东西滚了出去，以为再过几分钟整艘船就会爆炸。笑话在他们身上。其实还有整整两个小时。”伊芙宁仰头喝干酒，满足地叹了口气。“这足够我设定航线，前往最近的文明行星。于是我第一次降落在了达尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThis makes Evening chuckle. “The good thing for me was, I knew my ship. I was on it when I first left Terra, and I’ve been with it ever since. I know exactly how much abuse it can take, and where, before it gets compromised, and they didn’t. So when the walls started shaking and this hissing sound started coming through the pipes, they all packed up and got the fuck out, thinking they only had a few minutes until the entire craft was going to explode. Joke’s on them. It actually had two whole hours.” Evening throws back her drink and sighs a satisfied kind of sigh. “It was enough for me to set a course for the nearest civilised planet. And that’s how I landed on Dhaal for the first time.”"

rows.original: “That was...” You pause and think of the words to say. “
rows.translation: “那真是...”你停下来斟酌措辞。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“That was...” You pause and think of the words to say. “"

rows.original: Very risky sounding. And you came out okay?
rows.translation: 听起来风险很大。你最后没事吗？
rows.raw: " Very risky sounding. And you came out okay?"

rows.original: Pretty epic. But I’m also still surprised you’re still alive.
rows.translation: 太壮举了。不过你居然还活着，我也依然很惊讶。
rows.raw: " Pretty epic. But I’m also still surprised you’re still alive."

rows.original: The most reckless thing I’ve heard in awhile. How are you still alive?
rows.translation: 这是我最近听过最鲁莽的事。你怎么还活着？
rows.raw: " The most reckless thing I’ve heard in awhile. How are you still alive?"

rows.original: The mercenary only shrugs. “Skin of my teeth, remember? Worked out for me so far.”
rows.translation: 佣兵只是耸耸肩。“记得吗，就差那么一点。不过到目前为止，我都挺过来了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe mercenary only shrugs. “Skin of my teeth, remember? Worked out for me so far.”"

rows.original: Several drinks later...
rows.translation: 几杯酒后...
rows.raw: "Several drinks later..."

rows.original: “So what do you know about planet races?” Evening asks you.
rows.translation: “所以，你对行星竞速了解多少？”伊芙宁问你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what do you know about planet races?” Evening asks you."

rows.original: Your brows crinkle as you consider the question. It sounds pretty obvious from the name, but you get the feeling that this is one of those things that don’t turn out to be anything like what they sound. “Is it a race between planets?” After all, it sounds pretty similar to a Planet Rush, and you definitely know what that is.
rows.translation: 你皱起眉头思考这个问题。从名字来看答案似乎很明显，可你觉得，这大概又是一种实际内容与名称听起来截然不同的东西。“是在行星之间竞速吗？”毕竟，它听起来很像行星开拓潮，而你当然知道那是什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour brows crinkle as you consider the question. It sounds pretty obvious from the name, but you get the feeling that this is one of those things that don’t turn out to be anything like what they sound. “Is it a race between planets?” After all, it sounds pretty similar to a Planet Rush, and you definitely know what that is."

rows.original: “Close,” the mercenary declares. “It’s a race on a planet. The idea is that you have to fly close enough that your spacecraft is affected by the planet’s atmosphere, and occasionally the odd landmark or two. Depending on how big a race, it can take place over multiple planets, where contestants get eliminated if they don’t place high or fast enough. Some of them are pretty serious, with huge prize pools and everything. They’re supposed to be tests of endurance and adaptability, but over the years a lot of them have devolved into opportunities to cheat your way to the top. Usually by murdering the competition.”
rows.translation: “很接近，”佣兵宣布。“是在行星上竞速。规则是，你必须飞得足够近，让飞船受到行星大气层影响，偶尔还得应付一两个地标障碍。根据比赛规模，有时会跨越多颗行星举行，排名或速度不够高的参赛者会被淘汰。有些赛事非常正式，奖金池也大得惊人。它们本应是对耐力和适应能力的考验，可这些年来，很多比赛已经堕落成了靠作弊登顶的机会。通常就是靠杀掉竞争对手。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Close,” the mercenary declares. “It’s a race on a planet. The idea is that you have to fly close enough that your spacecraft is affected by the planet’s atmosphere, and occasionally the odd landmark or two. Depending on how big a race, it can take place over multiple planets, where contestants get eliminated if they don’t place high or fast enough. Some of them are pretty serious, with huge prize pools and everything. They’re supposed to be tests of endurance and adaptability, but over the years a lot of them have devolved into opportunities to cheat your way to the top. Usually by murdering the competition.”"

rows.original: “Oh yeah, I think you mentioned that before,” you say with a nod.
rows.translation: “哦，对，我记得你以前提过。”你点头说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh yeah, I think you mentioned that before,” you say with a nod. "

rows.original: “And that’s where you come in?”
rows.translation: “然后就轮到你登场了？”
rows.raw: "“And that’s where you come in?”"

rows.original: “Yeah, that’s where I come in.” Evening smirks. “There was a small race held not too long ago, on a dusty, rocky planet called Cularia. I was hired by a couple – nice people, really into engineering. One was a pilot, the other was an engineer, and I was brought on to be a gunner. It was an easy job at first glance; as long as no one tried any funny business, I wouldn’t even have to do anything, just putter around the ship and not touch anything that looked important. We weren’t exactly what you would call big fish, so most likely we’d just finish the race somewhere between fifth and tenth place, and not have to deal with anyone trying to shoot us out of the sky while we did it.”
rows.translation: “是啊，这就是我登场的地方。”伊芙宁坏笑道。“不久前，一颗名叫库拉里亚的尘土飞扬的岩石行星举办了一场小型比赛。一对伴侣雇用了我，他们人很好，也非常痴迷工程。其中一个是驾驶员，另一个是工程师，而我受雇担任炮手。乍看之下是份轻松活；只要没人耍花招，我甚至什么都不用做，只需在船上闲逛，别碰任何看起来很重要的东西。我们算不上什么大人物，所以最可能的结果就是在第五到第十名之间完赛，也不会有人在途中试图把我们从天上轰下来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, that’s where I come in.” Evening smirks. “There was a small race held not too long ago, on a dusty, rocky planet called Cularia. I was hired by a couple – nice people, really into engineering. One was a pilot, the other was an engineer, and I was brought on to be a gunner. It was an easy job at first glance; as long as no one tried any funny business, I wouldn’t even have to do anything, just putter around the ship and not touch anything that looked important. We weren’t exactly what you would call big fish, so most likely we’d just finish the race somewhere between fifth and tenth place, and not have to deal with anyone trying to shoot us out of the sky while we did it.”"

rows.original: “Let me guess,” you interject. “It wasn’t that easy.”
rows.translation: “让我猜猜。”你插嘴道。“事情没那么简单。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let me guess,” you interject. “It wasn’t that easy.”"

rows.original: The woman snorts. “I wouldn’t be telling this story if it was. No, the good news for my clients was that the new engine they were testing out performed way beyond their expectations, so we actually started off in the lead. We had a real chance of actually winning this thing. The bad news was that this put us right on top of everyone’s shitlist. As soon as second place caught up to us, they started opening fire. If you’ve ever been in a fire fight-”
rows.translation: 女人哼了一声。“如果真是这样，我就不会讲这个故事了。对我的客户来说，好消息是他们测试的新引擎性能远超预期，所以我们一开始居然领先。我们真有机会赢下比赛。坏消息是，这让我们直接登上了所有人的黑名单。第二名刚追上来，就开始朝我们开火。如果你经历过交火——”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman snorts. “I wouldn’t be telling this story if it was. No, the good news for my clients was that the new engine they were testing out performed way beyond their expectations, so we actually started off in the lead. We had a real chance of actually winning this thing. The bad news was that this put us right on top of everyone’s shitlist. As soon as second place caught up to us, they started opening fire. If you’ve ever been in a fire fight-”"

rows.original: “Oh, I have,” you interject.
rows.translation: “哦，我确实遇到过。”你插嘴道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, I have,” you interject."

rows.original: “-then you know how this goes. I shoot, they shoot, eventually one of us goes down. I, being excellent at my job, manage to smoke their asses and send them nose-diving to ground level. But then...” She sighs at this, rubbing the back of her neck.
rows.translation: “-然后你也知道事情会怎么发展。我开枪，他们还击，最终总有一方倒下。凭我出色的身手，我成功打烂了他们的屁股，让他们一头栽向地面。但接着...”她说到这里叹了口气，揉着自己的后颈。
rows.raw: "\n\n“-then you know how this goes. I shoot, they shoot, eventually one of us goes down. I, being excellent at my job, manage to smoke their asses and send them nose-diving to ground level. But then...” She sighs at this, rubbing the back of her neck."

rows.original: You lean in. You know that’s not the end of it. “But?”
rows.translation: 你凑近了一点。你知道事情还没完。“但是？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean in. You know that’s not the end of it. “But?”"

rows.original: “But then they shot us down at the same time,” Evening finishes. Another second sigh escapes her. “Always another complication.”
rows.translation: “可他们同时也把我们击落了，”伊芙宁说完，又叹了一口气。“总会再冒出一个麻烦。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“But then they shot us down at the same time,” Evening finishes. Another second sigh escapes her. “Always another complication.” "

rows.original: You gasp, and tell her that she’s being awfully cavalier about crash landing on the surface of a strange planet.
rows.translation: 你倒抽一口气，告诉她，她对迫降在一颗陌生星球表面这件事也太满不在乎了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou gasp, and tell her that she’s being awfully cavalier about crash landing on the surface of a strange planet."

rows.original: “Ah, we landed okay enough, thanks to the pilot,” she says, waving off the supposed danger. “It was bumpy and hella loud, but everyone got strapped in in time for the impact so no one got hurt. The bigger problem was the fact that our competition had landed nearby. So while everyone else was zooming past way over our heads, the mechanic had to rush to fix the ship while our attackers could decide to bring the fight to ground level at any moment. Which they did, almost immediately, because they were dicks like that. One second, we’re trying to fix a hole in the hull, and the next, someone’s lobbed a grenade into said hole. It was very rude.”
rows.translation: “啊，多亏驾驶员，我们降落得还算顺利，”她挥挥手，仿佛那危险不值一提。“颠得厉害，声音也大得要命，不过大家都及时扣好安全带，所以撞击时没人受伤。更大的问题是，我们的竞争对手降落在附近。所有其他人都从头顶高速飞过时，工程师必须赶紧修船，而袭击者随时可能决定把战斗搬到地面。他们几乎立刻就这么做了，因为他们就是那么混蛋。前一秒我们还在努力修补船壳上的洞，下一秒就有人把一枚手榴弹扔进了那个洞。非常无礼。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, we landed okay enough, thanks to the pilot,” she says, waving off the supposed danger. “It was bumpy and hella loud, but everyone got strapped in in time for the impact so no one got hurt. The bigger problem was the fact that our competition had landed nearby. So while everyone else was zooming past way over our heads, the mechanic had to rush to fix the ship while our attackers could decide to bring the fight to ground level at any moment. Which they did, almost immediately, because they were dicks like that. One second, we’re trying to fix a hole in the hull, and the next, someone’s lobbed a grenade into said hole. It was very rude.”"

rows.original: You ask how she got out of that unscathed.
rows.translation: 你问她是怎么毫发无损地脱身的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask how she got out of that unscathed."

rows.original: “Grabbed the grenade, threw it back out, ducked. Didn’t have a lot of time to think, just act. It didn’t explode in my face, so thankfully I was fast enough, but I still had to deal with the unwelcome guests outside. The pilot and I ended up rushing outside to meet them, three big beefy fuckers with the meanest mugs you’d have ever seen. They fired shots, we fired shots. One of them charged at me with a sword, and I had to dodge sideways and knock him out before he could hit me or the hull again. We had to hold them all off and prevent them from attacking the ship at the same time. I used up more smoke grenades than I would have liked that day. And when that smoke cleared-” here Evening tuts between her teeth, and sighs a deep sigh. “The fuckers were down, but so was my pilot.”
rows.translation: “抓住手榴弹，扔回去，趴下。没时间多想，只能行动。它没在我脸上爆炸，幸好我够快，但我还是得解决外面的不速之客。驾驶员和我最后冲出去迎战他们，三个魁梧壮硕的混蛋，脸一个比一个凶。他们开枪，我们还击。其中一个挥着剑朝我冲来，我不得不侧身闪避，在他砍中我或再次击中船壳之前把他打昏。我们既要挡住他们，又要同时阻止他们攻击飞船。那天我用掉的烟雾弹多得超出预期。等烟雾散去——”伊芙宁咂了咂牙，深深叹气。“那些混蛋倒下了，可我的驾驶员也倒下了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Grabbed the grenade, threw it back out, ducked. Didn’t have a lot of time to think, just act. It didn’t explode in my face, so thankfully I was fast enough, but I still had to deal with the unwelcome guests outside. The pilot and I ended up rushing outside to meet them, three big beefy fuckers with the meanest mugs you’d have ever seen. They fired shots, we fired shots. One of them charged at me with a sword, and I had to dodge sideways and knock him out before he could hit me or the hull again. We had to hold them all off and prevent them from attacking the ship at the same time. I used up more smoke grenades than I would have liked that day. And when that smoke cleared-” here Evening tuts between her teeth, and sighs a deep sigh. “The fuckers were down, but so was my pilot.”"

rows.original: You gasp again. “You mean...”
rows.translation: 你再次倒抽一口气。“你是说...”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou gasp again. “You mean...”"

rows.original: “He wasn’t dead, but he definitely wasn’t in condition to fly,” she clarifies. “So I hoisted him back onto the ship and made a beeline for the other spacecraft. We didn’t have any medikits on board, so my only hope was snatching one off of the other team instead. Luckily for me, the three fucksterteers were the only hired muscle they had, so by the time I broke onto their ship, they didn’t have any defense against me and my multiple guns and explosives.”
rows.translation: “他没有死，但肯定已经无法驾驶，”她澄清道。“所以我把他扛回飞船，直奔另一艘飞船。我们船上没有医疗包，我唯一的希望就是从另一支队伍那里抢一个。幸好，那三个混蛋火枪手是他们仅有的雇佣武力，所以等我闯进他们的飞船时，已经没人能抵挡我以及我的一堆枪和炸药。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He wasn’t dead, but he definitely wasn’t in condition to fly,” she clarifies. “So I hoisted him back onto the ship and made a beeline for the other spacecraft. We didn’t have any medikits on board, so my only hope was snatching one off of the other team instead. Luckily for me, the three fucksterteers were the only hired muscle they had, so by the time I broke onto their ship, they didn’t have any defense against me and my multiple guns and explosives.”"

rows.original: “So what did you do to them?”
rows.translation: “那你对他们做了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So what did you do to them?”"

rows.original: “Not much. This was still a race, so I had to hurry. Just took some of their medical supplies, smacked them around a bit, and jammed a few grenades into their engine room. Probably blew up half their ship, and whatever equipment they had. Standard payback stuff.”
rows.translation: “没做多少。这毕竟还是场比赛，我得赶时间。只是拿了他们一些医疗用品，揍了他们几下，再往引擎舱里塞了几颗手榴弹。大概炸掉了半艘船，还有他们带的装备。标准的报复手段。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not much. This was still a race, so I had to hurry. Just took some of their medical supplies, smacked them around a bit, and jammed a few grenades into their engine room. Probably blew up half their ship, and whatever equipment they had. Standard payback stuff.”"

rows.original: “Sounds about right,” you say with a sagely nod.
rows.translation: “听起来合情合理。”你一脸睿智地点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds about right,” you say with a sagely nod."

rows.original: Being a mercenary yourself, you know the unspoken laws that come with work like that.
rows.translation: 你自己也是佣兵，知道这种工作伴随的那些不成文规矩。
rows.raw: " Being a mercenary yourself, you know the unspoken laws that come with work like that."

rows.original: It’s about what you would have done if you were in her shoes.
rows.translation: 如果身处她的位置，你大概也会这么做。
rows.raw: " It’s about what you would have done if you were in her shoes."

rows.original: After all, anyone who tries to fuck you over so blatantly deserves whatever comes to them, even if that whatever is you.
rows.translation: 毕竟，任何如此明目张胆地想坑你的人，都活该承受随后发生的一切，哪怕所谓的一切就是你本人。
rows.raw: " After all, anyone who tries to fuck you over so blatantly deserves whatever comes to them, even if that whatever is you."

rows.original: “So, what happened next?”
rows.translation: “那么，后来发生了什么？”
rows.raw: " “So, what happened next?”"

rows.original: You startle a bit. Payback or not, that sounds a little brutal. You try not to let on how unnerving you find the idea, but Evening catches on quickly enough. “Oh, don’t look at me like that,” she signs, morose but not moroseful. “Stuff like this happens all the time. You have to make hard choices, maybe even cruel ones, but going soft could make you lose anything from a contract to your life. I did what I had to do to fulfill the contract.”
rows.translation: 你微微一惊。无论是不是报复，这听起来都有些残忍。你尽量不表现出这个想法令自己多么不安，可伊芙宁很快就察觉了。“哦，别那样看着我，”她叹道，神情阴郁，却不显懊悔。“这种事一直都在发生。你必须做出艰难、甚至残酷的选择，可一旦心软，丢掉的可能是一份合同，也可能是自己的命。我只是做了必须做的事来履行合同。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou startle a bit. Payback or not, that sounds a little brutal. You try not to let on how unnerving you find the idea, but Evening catches on quickly enough. “Oh, don’t look at me like that,” she signs, morose but not moroseful. “Stuff like this happens all the time. You have to make hard choices, maybe even cruel ones, but going soft could make you lose anything from a contract to your life. I did what I had to do to fulfill the contract.”"

rows.original: “Did you... kill them?” you ask uneasily.
rows.translation: “你...杀了他们？”你不安地问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Did you... kill them?” you ask uneasily."

rows.original: Evening blinks at you before replying hastily, “well, no. I still have a line I won’t cross. I’m not about to commit genocide on a planet full of babies or anything. But if getting the job done requires a little blackmail, torture, arson, or... whatever the exploding version of arson is, then you gotta do what you gotta do.”
rows.translation: 伊芙宁眨了眨眼，随即匆忙回答：“呃，不。我仍有绝不会跨越的底线。我可不会对一颗住满婴儿的行星实施种族灭绝之类的事。但如果完成工作需要一点勒索、拷打、纵火，或者...管纵火的爆炸版本叫什么，那你就只能做该做的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening blinks at you before replying hastily, “well, no. I still have a line I won’t cross. I’m not about to commit genocide on a planet full of babies or anything. But if getting the job done requires a little blackmail, torture, arson, or... whatever the exploding version of arson is, then you gotta do what you gotta do.”"

rows.original: You relax slightly, though her affinity with apparently exploding her enemies is a bit alarming to hear about. “So, what happened next?”
rows.translation: 你稍稍放松下来，不过听说她似乎热衷于炸飞敌人，还是让你有些心惊。“所以，接下来发生了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou relax slightly, though her affinity with apparently exploding her enemies is a bit alarming to hear about. “So, what happened next?” "

rows.original: “Damn,” you say with a laugh, partly impressed but also partly unnerved. “That’s hardcore.”
rows.translation: “妈的。”你笑着说道，一半佩服，一半又有些不安。“真够狠的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn,” you say with a laugh, partly impressed but also partly unnerved. “That’s hardcore.”"

rows.original: Evening shrugs. “Comes with the territory of the job. If I’d let them go unscathed, they might have gone after us, and we’d have to do the same shit all over again. I was already down one crew member, and there were already only three of us to start with. Didn’t want anyone else almost dying on me.”
rows.translation: 伊芙宁耸耸肩。“这是这份工作的必然代价。如果我让他们毫发无伤地离开，他们可能会再次追来，我们就得把同样的破事全部再做一遍。我已经少了一个队员，而我们一开始总共也只有三个人。我不想再有其他人差点死在我眼前。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening shrugs. “Comes with the territory of the job. If I’d let them go unscathed, they might have gone after us, and we’d have to do the same shit all over again. I was already down one crew member, and there were already only three of us to start with. Didn’t want anyone else almost dying on me.”"

rows.original: “You didn’t... you know?” You slice a thumb across your neck in pantomime.
rows.translation: “你没有...你懂的吧？”你用拇指在脖子前比划着划了一下。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You didn’t... you know?” You slice a thumb across your neck in pantomime."

rows.original: Evening shakes her head. “Nah. The grenades wrecked their ship, but unless any of them tried to run towards the explosion, they should have been fine. And if they did, then at that point they’re just asking to die.”
rows.translation: 伊芙宁摇摇头。“没有。手榴弹毁了他们的船，但只要没人试图朝着爆炸的方向跑，应该都不会有事。要是真有人这么干，那他们根本就是自己找死。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening shakes her head. “Nah. The grenades wrecked their ship, but unless any of them tried to run towards the explosion, they should have been fine. And if they did, then at that point they’re just asking to die.”"

rows.original: You raise an eyebrow, but otherwise don’t say anything more on the matter. “Fair enough. So what happened next?”
rows.translation: 你挑起眉毛，但没有就此多说什么。“也对。那么后来发生了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise an eyebrow, but otherwise don’t say anything more on the matter. “Fair enough. So what happened next?”"

rows.original: “We didn’t win, for one thing,” the woman laments. “But we finished the race. The pilot survived. I got paid. It wasn’t the most successful of missions in my book, but you gotta learn to take the good with the bad, right? I will say, those guys taught me a thing or two about evasive maneuvers. Comes in handy when I run into the errant space pirate every so often.”
rows.translation: “首先，我们没赢，”女人哀叹道。“但我们完成了比赛。驾驶员活了下来。我拿到了报酬。按我的标准，这算不上最成功的任务，不过凡事总得接受好坏两面，对吧？不得不说，那些家伙确实教会了我一两招规避动作。偶尔撞上四处游荡的太空海盗时很管用。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We didn’t win, for one thing,” the woman laments. “But we finished the race. The pilot survived. I got paid. It wasn’t the most successful of missions in my book, but you gotta learn to take the good with the bad, right? I will say, those guys taught me a thing or two about evasive maneuvers. Comes in handy when I run into the errant space pirate every so often.”"

rows.original: Several drinks later...
rows.translation: 几杯酒后...
rows.raw: "Several drinks later..."

rows.original: The conversation eventually turns to Evening’s overstuffed utility belt.
rows.translation: 话题最终转到了伊芙宁塞得满满当当的工具腰带上。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe conversation eventually turns to Evening’s overstuffed utility belt."

rows.original: “What’s in there, anyways?” you ask. There are so many random compartments and objects hanging off of it that you
rows.translation: “话说，那里面到底装了什么？”你问道。上面挂着那么多杂乱的隔舱和物件，以至于
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’s in there, anyways?” you ask. There are so many random compartments and objects hanging off of it that you"

rows.original: admit you’re dying to know what at least a few of them are.
rows.translation: 承认自己非常想知道，其中至少几件到底是什么。
rows.raw: " admit you’re dying to know what at least a few of them are."

rows.original: can’t help but wonder what kinds of goodies she has hidden in there.
rows.translation: 不由得好奇，她究竟在里面藏了些什么好东西。
rows.raw: " can’t help but wonder what kinds of goodies she has hidden in there."

rows.original: have to wonder whether she actually uses half of the stuff on a regular basis, or if she’s just paranoid.
rows.translation: 不禁怀疑，她是否真的经常使用其中一半的东西，还是仅仅过于多疑。
rows.raw: " have to wonder whether she actually uses half of the stuff on a regular basis, or if she’s just paranoid."

rows.original: Evening taps her chin in thought. “Weeeeell, I’m not one to give up all my secrets, but I’ll tell you a few of them off of the top of my head,” she decides. After a few moments of pondering, she rattles off: “smoke grenades, flash grenades, gas grenades, sound grenades, EMP grenades, actual grenades, extra ammo, ear plugs, regelatin spray, immuno-boosters, grav cuffs, a mirror, a hardlight dagger, mag blinders, a grappling hook,
rows.translation: 伊芙宁若有所思地轻点下巴。“这——个嘛，我不是那种会把所有秘密和盘托出的人，不过我可以把眼下想到的几样告诉你，”她决定道。思索片刻后，她一口气报出：“烟雾弹、闪光弹、毒气弹、声爆弹、电磁脉冲手榴弹、真正的手榴弹、额外弹药、耳塞、再生凝胶喷雾、免疫增强剂、重力手铐、一面镜子、一把硬光匕首、磁力眼罩、一支抓钩，
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening taps her chin in thought. “Weeeeell, I’m not one to give up all my secrets, but I’ll tell you a few of them off of the top of my head,” she decides. After a few moments of pondering, she rattles off: “smoke grenades, flash grenades, gas grenades, sound grenades, EMP grenades, actual grenades, extra ammo, ear plugs, regelatin spray, immuno-boosters, grav cuffs, a mirror, a hardlight dagger, mag blinders, a grappling hook,"

rows.original: kryptonite, shark repellent, a whole-ass jetpack, a make-up kit, crayons, exotic butters,
rows.translation: 氪石、鲨鱼驱避剂、一整套喷气背包、化妆包、蜡笔、异域黄油，
rows.raw: " kryptonite, shark repellent, a whole-ass jetpack, a make-up kit, crayons, exotic butters,"

rows.original: and my guns, obviously. Oh, and string.”
rows.translation: 当然还有我的枪。哦，还有绳子。”
rows.raw: " and my guns, obviously. Oh, and string.”"

rows.original: “String?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“String?”"

rows.original: “String.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“String.”"

rows.original: “Just string?”
rows.translation: “只有绳子？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just string?”"

rows.original: “Very strong string.”
rows.translation: “非常结实的绳子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Very strong string.”"

rows.original: “Hmm.” You roll over the list in your head. “No aphrodisiac grenades?” They’d certainly round out her line-up of throwable exploding things.
rows.translation: “嗯。”你在脑中回顾这份清单。“没有催情手榴弹吗？”那肯定能让她这一整套投掷爆炸物更加齐全。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hmm.” You roll over the list in your head. “No aphrodisiac grenades?” They’d certainly round out her line-up of throwable exploding things."

rows.original: “Uh- well-” Evening splutters, put on the spot. Having suddenly lost the ability to look directly into your eyes, the Terran’s gaze starts sidling off into the distance as she wrings her hands. “I used to carry them around, but... there was an incident. And now it’s in my best interest not to use them anymore.” Her face is glowing a fascinating shade of red.
rows.translation: “呃- 好吧-”伊芙宁被当场问住，结结巴巴起来。她忽然失去了直视你双眼的能力，一边绞着双手，一边让视线悄悄飘向远方。“我以前确实会随身带着它们，但是...发生过一次事故。如今为了我自己着想，最好别再用了。”她的脸泛着一种相当迷人的红色。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh- well-” Evening splutters, put on the spot. Having suddenly lost the ability to look directly into your eyes, the Terran’s gaze starts sidling off into the distance as she wrings her hands. “I used to carry them around, but... there was an incident. And now it’s in my best interest not to use them anymore.” Her face is glowing a fascinating shade of red."

rows.original: Your eyes narrow. “So, what happened?”
rows.translation: 你眯起眼睛。“所以，发生什么事了？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes narrow. “So, what happened?”"

rows.original: The mercenary’s mouth opens and closes like a fish before she bites her lip and averts her eyes again. Her cheeks get progressively redder as your gaze burrows further into her, despite her hemming and hawing in an attempt to disinterest you in the subject. She doesn’t want to talk, but you’re too curious to let it drop, putting you at a stalemate.
rows.translation: 佣兵的嘴像鱼一样开开合合，随后咬住嘴唇，再次移开视线。尽管她不断支吾，试图让你对这个话题失去兴趣，你的目光越是追问，她的脸颊就变得越红。她不想说，可你好奇得不肯作罢，于是你们陷入僵局。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe mercenary’s mouth opens and closes like a fish before she bites her lip and averts her eyes again. Her cheeks get progressively redder as your gaze burrows further into her, despite her hemming and hawing in an attempt to disinterest you in the subject. She doesn’t want to talk, but you’re too curious to let it drop, putting you at a stalemate."

rows.original: Eventually her silence breaks. Kind of. “Yeah, I’m not nearly drunk enough to be able to-” Evening starts to say, before you immediately flag down
rows.translation: 最终，她打破了沉默。算是吧。“是啊，我还远远没醉到能把这事-”伊芙宁刚开口，你便立刻招呼
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually her silence breaks. Kind of. “Yeah, I’m not nearly drunk enough to be able to-” Evening starts to say, before you immediately flag down "

rows.original: Monika
rows.translation: 莫妮卡
rows.raw: "Monika"

rows.original: the bartender
rows.translation: 酒保
rows.raw: "the bartender"

rows.original: and order three Rex Pistols for her.
rows.translation: ，给她点了三杯雷克斯手枪。
rows.raw: " and order three Rex Pistols for her."

rows.original: Evening looks your way, picks up one of the tall, thin glasses, looks at you again, and deflates visibly with a sigh. “You’re not going to let me go until I talk, are you?”
rows.translation: 伊芙宁看向你，拿起一只细长高脚杯，又看了你一眼，随后叹着气明显泄了劲。“不等我开口，你就不打算放我走，是吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening looks your way, picks up one of the tall, thin glasses, looks at you again, and deflates visibly with a sigh. “You’re not going to let me go until I talk, are you?”"

rows.original: “Well, you don’t have to,” you say in the most saintly tone you can muster, “but it’d be the nice thing to do after getting all this free alcohol, right?”
rows.translation: “这个嘛，你也不是非说不可，”你用自己能装出的最圣洁语调说道，“不过喝了这么多免费酒水，讲讲故事才算厚道，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, you don’t have to,” you say in the most saintly tone you can muster, “but it’d be the nice thing to do after getting all this free alcohol, right?”"

rows.original: “Hell no,” you say with a cheerful grin. “So come on, dish! It can’t be that bad; we’ve all got some embarrassing stories to tell.”
rows.translation: “当然不，”你灿烂地笑着说。“所以快讲吧！事情不可能那么糟；谁还没几个难为情的故事呢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hell no,” you say with a cheerful grin. “So come on, dish! It can’t be that bad; we’ve all got some embarrassing stories to tell.”"

rows.original: “Nope,” you say tersely. “So you may as well spill the beans now.”
rows.translation: “不。”你简短地说。“所以你不如现在就把实情说出来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nope,” you say tersely. “So you may as well spill the beans now.”"

rows.original: Another sigh. “Okay, here goes nothing,” she mutters, before pouring the first of the pale, bubbly drinks down the hatch.
rows.translation: 又是一声叹息。“好吧，豁出去了，”她低声说道，随后将第一杯颜色浅淡、冒着气泡的饮料一口灌下。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother sigh. “Okay, here goes nothing,” she mutters, before pouring the first of the pale, bubbly drinks down the hatch."

rows.original: By the time she finishes the third glass, she’s definitely drunk enough to talk.
rows.translation: 等她喝完第三杯，她绝对已经醉得足以开口了。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time she finishes the third glass, she’s definitely drunk enough to talk."

rows.original: “Look,” the now very inebriated Terran ends up explaining while trying to slur her words as little as possible. “I’m a professional. And I know the definition of ‘professional’ varies greatly between planets, but for me it includes not fucking anyone in the middle of a job. Or for a job. I know it’s different for most people around these parts, ‘specially this far from the core; s’just how I feel personally. But there was this one guy...”
rows.translation: “听着，”如今已经醉得厉害的泰拉人最后解释起来，同时努力让自己的话听起来别太含糊。“我是个专业人士。我知道不同星球对‘专业’的定义差得很远，可对我而言，其中一条就是绝不在工作途中跟任何人上床。也不会为了工作跟人上床。我知道这一带大多数人的做法不一样，尤其离核心区这么远；这只是我个人的原则。但当时有那么一个男人...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look,” the now very inebriated Terran ends up explaining while trying to slur her words as little as possible. “I’m a professional. And I know the definition of ‘professional’ varies greatly between planets, but for me it includes not fucking anyone in the middle of a job. Or for a job. I know it’s different for most people around these parts, ‘specially this far from the core; s’just how I feel personally. But there was this one guy...”"

rows.original: “Go on.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Go on.” "

rows.original: The woman swallows hard before continuing. “His name was Sieg. Tall, muscular, could probably pick me up and snap me in half if he wanted. Scariest looking ausar I’ve ever seen, but luckily he was on my side because we had the same empli- empler- we were contracted by the same dude.”
rows.translation: 女人艰难地咽了口唾沫，才继续说道。“他叫西格。个子高，肌肉发达，只要愿意，大概能把我举起来折成两半。是我见过最吓人的奥萨尔，不过幸好他站在我这边，因为我们受雇于同一个雇、雇主- 我们跟同一个家伙签了合同。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman swallows hard before continuing. “His name was Sieg. Tall, muscular, could probably pick me up and snap me in half if he wanted. Scariest looking ausar I’ve ever seen, but luckily he was on my side because we had the same empli- empler- we were contracted by the same dude.”"

rows.original: You nod, not wanting to interrupt vocally.
rows.translation: 你点点头，不想出声打断她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, not wanting to interrupt vocally."

rows.original: “We were hired to get... uh...” Evening’s brow crinkles as she tries and fails to recall the details. “Something. From a pirate ship. I don’t remember. Anyways, it was supposed to be a stealth mission, but Sieg and his huge, hunky body ended up tripping an alarm. We couldn’t afford to get surrounded, so he picks me up and starts sprinting down the hallway, with, like, fifteen pirates on our tail. I still have my pistol so I’m picking them off while he carries me, and somehow we shake them off long enough to hide in one of their... I don’t know, closets? This... shed? We just ran into a room and shut the door behind us, but it turned out to be this small dead end so Sieg slammed me into the wall by accident. And it didn’t hurt that much, but one of the aphro grenades on my belt must have fallen off or gotten hit by the impact because it exploded, and the gas filled up the whole room and we had to breathe it all in and... and...”
rows.translation: “我们受雇去取回...呃...”伊芙宁皱起眉头，却怎么也想不起细节。“某个东西。从一艘海盗船上。我不记得了。总之，那本该是一次潜入任务，可西格和他那副魁梧健壮的身体触发了警报。我们不能被包围，于是他把我抱起来，沿走廊狂奔，后面大概有十五个海盗追着。我手里还拿着手枪，所以他抱着我跑时，我一路把他们逐个击倒。我们不知怎么甩开他们一阵子，躲进了他们的某个...我不知道，壁橱？这个...棚屋？我们只是冲进一间房，把身后的门关上，结果发现那是个狭小的死胡同，所以西格不小心把我撞到了墙上。其实没多疼，可我腰带上的一枚催情手榴弹肯定是掉了下来，或者在撞击时被磕到了，因为它爆炸了，气体充满整个房间，我们只能全吸进去，然后...然后...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We were hired to get... uh...” Evening’s brow crinkles as she tries and fails to recall the details. “Something. From a pirate ship. I don’t remember. Anyways, it was supposed to be a stealth mission, but Sieg and his huge, hunky body ended up tripping an alarm. We couldn’t afford to get surrounded, so he picks me up and starts sprinting down the hallway, with, like, fifteen pirates on our tail. I still have my pistol so I’m picking them off while he carries me, and somehow we shake them off long enough to hide in one of their... I don’t know, closets? This... shed? We just ran into a room and shut the door behind us, but it turned out to be this small dead end so Sieg slammed me into the wall by accident. And it didn’t hurt that much, but one of the aphro grenades on my belt must have fallen off or gotten hit by the impact because it exploded, and the gas filled up the whole room and we had to breathe it all in and... and...”"

rows.original: You finish the sentence for her. “You had sex.”
rows.translation: 你替她说完了这句话。“你们做爱了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou finish the sentence for her. “You had sex.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, we had sex, and it was really good sex but also a really bad idea because there were still a fuckload of pirates around and if we’d gotten caught we would have been in really deep shit,” Evening howls. “Thank fuck we snapped out of it in time, because another group of them came ‘round the corner right after.”
rows.translation: “对，我们上床了，而且是非常棒的性爱，可这同时也是个非常糟糕的主意，因为周围还有一大群海盗，要是被逮住，我们就真的会倒大霉，”伊芙宁哀号道。“谢天谢地，我们及时清醒过来，因为紧接着又有一群人绕过了拐角。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, we had sex, and it was really good sex but also a really bad idea because there were still a fuckload of pirates around and if we’d gotten caught we would have been in really deep shit,” Evening howls. “Thank fuck we snapped out of it in time, because another group of them came ‘round the corner right after.”"

rows.original: A smirk creeps onto your face. You can’t resist tormenting her a bit. “You think they knew?”
rows.translation: 你脸上浮现坏笑，忍不住想稍微捉弄她一下。“你觉得他们知道吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nA smirk creeps onto your face. You can’t resist tormenting her a bit. “You think they knew?”"

rows.original: “Probably,” she whimpers, burying her face in her hands. “We were so loud.”
rows.translation: “大概吧。”她呜咽着，把脸埋进双手。“我们实在太吵了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Probably,” she whimpers, burying her face in her hands. “We were so loud.”"

rows.original: You can’t help but
rows.translation: 你忍不住
rows.raw: "\n\nYou can’t help but"

rows.original: giggle discreetly at the idea, though not quite discreetly enough for Evening not to notice. “Did you at least make it out okay?” You try to sound as sympathetic as possible, even though just visualizing the situation makes you want to laugh again.
rows.translation: 想到那幅场景，你悄悄笑了起来，只是还不够悄，没能逃过伊芙宁的注意。“你至少平安逃出来了吧？”你努力让自己的声音显得尽可能同情，尽管光是想象当时的画面，就让你又想笑出来。
rows.raw: " giggle discreetly at the idea, though not quite discreetly enough for Evening not to notice. “Did you at least make it out okay?” You try to sound as sympathetic as possible, even though just visualizing the situation makes you want to laugh again."

rows.original: guffaw as conspicuously as possible, which only makes Evening’s face crumple harder in distress. “Hey, trust me when I say we’ve all been there. Trust me. And at least you made it out alive, right?” you say in an attempt to get her to see the bright side of things.
rows.translation: 尽可能显眼地放声大笑，这只让伊芙宁的脸因痛苦皱得更厉害。“嘿，相信我，我们都有过这种经历。真的。至少你们活着逃出来了，对吧？”你试着让她看到事情好的一面。
rows.raw: " guffaw as conspicuously as possible, which only makes Evening’s face crumple harder in distress. “Hey, trust me when I say we’ve all been there. Trust me. And at least you made it out alive, right?” you say in an attempt to get her to see the bright side of things."

rows.original: half scoff, half laugh at the idea. “Well, did you at least manage to unfuck your fuck-up?”
rows.translation: 对这个想法半是嗤笑、半是大笑。“好吧，那你至少把自己搞砸的事情挽救回来了吗？”
rows.raw: " half scoff, half laugh at the idea. “Well, did you at least manage to unfuck your fuck-up?”"

rows.original: “Yeah. I think.” The mercenary rakes her hands through her hair before slumping onto the bar. “I don’t even remember how. The next few minutes are kinda blurry. But we got the loot and got paid, so it worked out fine. Somehow.”
rows.translation: “对。我想是吧。”佣兵用双手梳过头发，随后瘫在吧台上。“我连怎么逃出来的都不记得了。接下来几分钟的记忆有点模糊。不过我们拿到了战利品，也收到了报酬，所以结果还算不错。不知怎么就成了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah. I think.” The mercenary rakes her hands through her hair before slumping onto the bar. “I don’t even remember how. The next few minutes are kinda blurry. But we got the loot and got paid, so it worked out fine. Somehow.”"

rows.original: “So, that was it?” You prod her side with your elbow as you
rows.translation: “所以，就这样结束了？”你用手肘戳了戳她的侧腰，同时
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, that was it?” You prod her side with your elbow as you "

joinAfter.expression:
pc.isAss()
                        ? "raise an eyebrow"
                        : "shoot a cheeky grin"

rows.original: raise an eyebrow
rows.translation: 挑起眉毛
rows.raw: "raise an eyebrow"

rows.original: shoot a cheeky grin
rows.translation: 露出顽皮的笑容
rows.raw: "shoot a cheeky grin"

rows.original: at her. “For you and Sieg.”
rows.translation: 看着她。“你和西格的事。”
rows.raw: " at her. “For you and Sieg.”"

rows.original: Cue the nervous laughter. “Hahaha, nooooo, we fucked five more times afterwards. Or six. I lost count.” The woman fidgets in her seat. “We actually teamed up a bunch more after that. Made a good pair. Good times.”
rows.translation: 紧张的笑声适时响起。“哈哈哈，才没有，我们后来又干了五次。也可能六次，我数不清了。”女人在座位上坐立不安。“之后我们其实又合作过很多次。配合得很不错。真是段好时光。”
rows.raw: "\n\nCue the nervous laughter. “Hahaha, nooooo, we fucked five more times afterwards. Or six. I lost count.” The woman fidgets in her seat. “We actually teamed up a bunch more after that. Made a good pair. Good times.” "

rows.original: “Where’s this Sieg now?”
rows.translation: “这个齐格现在在哪？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Where’s this Sieg now?”"

rows.original: you inquire, batting your eyelashes. If he’s as hunky as Evening makes him out to be, you definitely want to get an eyeful of him ASAP.
rows.translation: 你一边询问，一边眨动睫毛。要是他真像伊芙宁形容的那么健壮迷人，你绝对想尽快亲眼看看他。
rows.raw: " you inquire, batting your eyelashes. If he’s as hunky as Evening makes him out to be, you definitely want to get an eyeful of him ASAP."

rows.original: If he’s as buff as Evening makes him out to be, you definitely want to see how he stacks up.
rows.translation: 如果他真像伊芙宁说的那么健壮，你当然想看看他究竟有多厉害。
rows.raw: " If he’s as buff as Evening makes him out to be, you definitely want to see how he stacks up."

rows.original: The Terran shrugs. “Dunno. Elsewhere. We drifted apart after a bit. Haven’t been in contact in a while.” The question seems to have sobered her up a bit.
rows.translation: 这个泰伦人耸耸肩。“不知道。在别的地方吧。后来我们渐渐疏远了，已经有一阵子没联系。”这个问题似乎让她稍微清醒了一些。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Terran shrugs. “Dunno. Elsewhere. We drifted apart after a bit. Haven’t been in contact in a while.” The question seems to have sobered her up a bit."

rows.original: Several gulps of cream liquor later, Evening is tapping her chin, looking thoughtful. “Here’s a good one,” she says. “I was asked to bring in a guy who was just about to go on the run. White-collar jackass, corporate worker. You know the type.”
rows.translation: 又喝下几大口奶油酒后，伊芙宁托着下巴，若有所思。“这个故事不错，”她说道。“当时有人让我抓回一个正准备逃跑的家伙。白领混蛋，公司职员。你知道是哪种人。”
rows.raw: "Several gulps of cream liquor later, Evening is tapping her chin, looking thoughtful. “Here’s a good one,” she says. “I was asked to bring in a guy who was just about to go on the run. White-collar jackass, corporate worker. You know the type.”"

rows.original: “Ohhhh, what’d he do? Dish!”
rows.translation: “哦——，他做了什么？快说！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ohhhh, what’d he do? Dish!”"

rows.original: “Yep, totally know ‘em. So what’d he do?”
rows.translation: “对，当然认识。那么他做了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yep, totally know ‘em. So what’d he do?”"

rows.original: “What’d he do?”
rows.translation: “他做了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What’d he do?”"

rows.original: “You could say that. So what’d he do?”
rows.translation: “可以这么说。那么他做了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You could say that. So what’d he do?”"

rows.original: “Don’t remind me. What kind of shit did he pull?”
rows.translation: “别提醒我。他干了什么破事？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t remind me. What kind of shit did he pull?”"

rows.original: you ask.
rows.translation: 你问道。
rows.raw: " you ask."

rows.original: “Ehhhhh.” Apparently what he did wasn’t very important because Evening makes a vague gesture with her hand and doesn’t give much more information than that. “Something white-collar and involving the corporation he worked for. I’m a little fuzzy on the details. The moral of this story is that rich assholes can usually get away with a lot of stuff, but they’re screwed if they ever end up pissing off another-”
rows.translation: “呃——”显然，他做过的事没那么重要，因为伊芙宁只是含糊地挥挥手，没有提供更多信息。“某种跟他任职的公司有关的白领犯罪。细节我记不太清了。这个故事的寓意是，有钱的混蛋通常能逃脱很多罪责，可一旦他们惹火了另一个-”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ehhhhh.” Apparently what he did wasn’t very important because Evening makes a vague gesture with her hand and doesn’t give much more information than that. “Something white-collar and involving the corporation he worked for. I’m a little fuzzy on the details. The moral of this story is that rich assholes can usually get away with a lot of stuff, but they’re screwed if they ever end up pissing off another-”"

rows.original: “Rich asshole,” you both say in unison, to which Evening snaps her fingers. “Yeah, you got it.”
rows.translation: “有钱的混蛋。”你们异口同声地说，伊芙宁随即打了个响指。“对，就是这样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Rich asshole,” you both say in unison, to which Evening snaps her fingers. “Yeah, you got it.”"

rows.original: “Anyways.” She takes another sip of her drink and continues the story. “Whatever this guy did, the group that hired me was absolutely livid. Wanted me to take him in or take him down, whatever means necessary, no questions asked. Thing is, their noses weren’t much cleaner than his was, which is why they went to me instead of any law enforcement. I promised them I could get it done quietly. A demonstration of my particular skills helped seal the deal.” She mimes firing off a gun, a smirk on her face.
rows.translation: “总之。”她又喝了一口，继续讲故事。“不管那家伙做了什么，雇用我的集团都气疯了。他们要我把他带回来，或者直接放倒，不择手段，不问问题。问题在于，他们自己的鼻子也没比他干净多少，所以才会找上我，而不是任何执法机构。我答应可以悄无声息地办妥。一番展示我的特殊技能，也帮我敲定了这笔交易。”她模仿着开枪的动作，脸上带着坏笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Anyways.” She takes another sip of her drink and continues the story. “Whatever this guy did, the group that hired me was absolutely livid. Wanted me to take him in or take him down, whatever means necessary, no questions asked. Thing is, their noses weren’t much cleaner than his was, which is why they went to me instead of any law enforcement. I promised them I could get it done quietly. A demonstration of my particular skills helped seal the deal.” She mimes firing off a gun, a smirk on her face."

rows.original: “So how did you get him?”
rows.translation: “那你是怎么抓到他的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So how did you get him?”"

rows.original: “I did a little digging, and found out that whatever he did involved some data he stole. Whether he was going to exploit it or sell it off, I’m not sure, but I knew for a fact that some of it was still at his office. Whether he didn’t have enough time to get it all the first time, or he just missed it, I’m not sure. Either way, it was from a private network, so he had to be physically present to take it. ‘Return to the scene of the crime’, and all that jazz. I knew he would have to come during the night, so I camped in the office building to wait for him.”
rows.translation: “我稍微调查了一番，发现不管他做了什么，都涉及他偷走的一些数据。我不知道他打算利用还是转卖这些数据，但我确定其中一部分仍在他的办公室。他第一次是没时间全拿走，还是单纯漏掉了，我不清楚。不管怎样，数据来自私人网络，所以他必须亲自到场才能取走。所谓‘重返犯罪现场’之类的说法。我知道他只能在夜里过来，所以就在办公楼里扎营等他。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I did a little digging, and found out that whatever he did involved some data he stole. Whether he was going to exploit it or sell it off, I’m not sure, but I knew for a fact that some of it was still at his office. Whether he didn’t have enough time to get it all the first time, or he just missed it, I’m not sure. Either way, it was from a private network, so he had to be physically present to take it. ‘Return to the scene of the crime’, and all that jazz. I knew he would have to come during the night, so I camped in the office building to wait for him.”"

rows.original: “And he came?”
rows.translation: “然后他来了？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And he came?”"

rows.original: “Yup. Even used his old company badge to get in. I’m not sure if he was stupid or if he just had humongous balls. Either way, I was waiting for him in his office. Caught him with his pants down, metaphorically speaking. I got my gun trained on him and him dead to rights. My employers’ preferences were to bring him in alive, so I tried to talk him into coming quietly, but you know what he does?”
rows.translation: “没错。甚至还用自己的旧公司徽章进门。我不知道他是蠢，还是胆子大得离谱。不管怎样，我在他的办公室里等着。逮到他时，他正裤子脱到一半，当然是打个比方。我用枪稳稳瞄准他，把他抓了个正着。雇主希望尽量把他活着带回去，所以我试着劝他乖乖投降，可你猜他做了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yup. Even used his old company badge to get in. I’m not sure if he was stupid or if he just had humongous balls. Either way, I was waiting for him in his office. Caught him with his pants down, metaphorically speaking. I got my gun trained on him and him dead to rights. My employers’ preferences were to bring him in alive, so I tried to talk him into coming quietly, but you know what he does?”"

rows.original: You lean in forward, wanting to know. “What?”
rows.translation: 你探身向前，迫切想知道答案。“什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou lean in forward, wanting to know. “What?”"

rows.original: “He takes his shirt off.”
rows.translation: “他脱下了上衣。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“He takes his shirt off.”"

rows.original: “...” That’s not what you expected at all. “But why?”
rows.translation: “...”这完全出乎你的意料。“但为什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...” That’s not what you expected at all. “But why?”"

rows.original: “That’s what I was wondering! I had no fucking idea. Next thing I know he’s thrown the thing at my face, which was super gross, by the way, he was covered in sweat, and then he runs off. I get a little confused, because he didn’t exactly have a reason to get half naked, and he was also running towards the rooftop. And I know because I ended up chasing him there. Up every. Single. Staircase. If I’d known that’s where he was going in the first place, I would have taken the damn elevator. Which I didn’t get to do, because five floors from the top he beat me to it and took it instead.”
rows.translation: “我当时也在想这他妈算什么！我完全摸不着头脑。下一秒，他就把那东西朝我脸上，扔过来，顺便说一句，恶心死了，他浑身都被汗浸透了，然后拔腿就跑。我有点懵，因为他根本没理由脱掉一半衣服，而且还朝屋顶跑。我之所以知道，是因为最后一路追着他上去了。爬过每一层。每一段。楼梯。早知道他一开始就要去那里，我肯定会坐该死的电梯。可我没机会，因为离顶层还有五层时，他抢先一步，把电梯坐走了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s what I was wondering! I had no fucking idea. Next thing I know he’s thrown the thing at my face, which was super gross, by the way, he was covered in sweat, and then he runs off. I get a little confused, because he didn’t exactly have a reason to get half naked, and he was also running towards the rooftop. And I know because I ended up chasing him there. Up every. Single. Staircase. If I’d known that’s where he was going in the first place, I would have taken the damn elevator. Which I didn’t get to do, because five floors from the top he beat me to it and took it instead.”"

rows.original: “I know. Needless to say, I was pretty pissed by the time I got there. Hell, I get a little angry just thinking about it.” Her fingers curl inward, as if strangling an invisible neck. “But it didn’t matter anymore, because he was on the roof, and I was on the roof, and I had him cornered. Again. This time, I learned my lesson and didn’t stand close enough for him to throw his pants at me too.”
rows.translation: “我知道。不用说，等我抵达时已经火冒三丈。见鬼，光是想起来我都有点生气。”她的手指向内弯曲，仿佛正掐住一条看不见的脖子。“不过已经无所谓了，因为他在屋顶，我也在屋顶，而我把他逼进了死角。又一次。这回我吸取教训，没有站得近到让他也能把裤子扔到我脸上。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know. Needless to say, I was pretty pissed by the time I got there. Hell, I get a little angry just thinking about it.” Her fingers curl inward, as if strangling an invisible neck. “But it didn’t matter anymore, because he was on the roof, and I was on the roof, and I had him cornered. Again. This time, I learned my lesson and didn’t stand close enough for him to throw his pants at me too.”"

rows.original: You
rows.translation: 你
rows.raw: "\n\nYou "

rows.original: giggle
rows.translation: 咯咯笑
rows.raw: "giggle"

rows.original: guffaw
rows.translation: 放声大笑
rows.raw: "guffaw"

rows.original: laugh
rows.translation: 大笑
rows.raw: "laugh"

rows.original: at the image despite yourself. Evening’s face, on the other hand, only portrays pain.
rows.translation: 看着那幅画面，还是忍不住笑了出来。相比之下，伊芙宁脸上只有痛苦。
rows.raw: " at the image despite yourself. Evening’s face, on the other hand, only portrays pain."

rows.original: “At this point, I’m still trying to play good cop, because I’d figured he went up there to jump and I would have lost some bonus pay if he died. Did the whole ‘death isn’t worth it, you can still make amends’ spiel. But he doesn’t listen to me. He jumps,” Evening leans in, voice lowered to a conspiratorial whisper. “But he doesn’t fall.”
rows.translation: “这时候，我还在努力扮演好警察，因为我猜他跑上去是想跳楼，而他要是死了，我就会损失一笔额外报酬。我把那套‘死亡不值得，你还能弥补过错’的说辞全讲了一遍。可他根本不听。他跳了下去，”伊芙宁俯身靠近，压低声音，像是在分享秘密。“但他没有坠落。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“At this point, I’m still trying to play good cop, because I’d figured he went up there to jump and I would have lost some bonus pay if he died. Did the whole ‘death isn’t worth it, you can still make amends’ spiel. But he doesn’t listen to me. He jumps,” Evening leans in, voice lowered to a conspiratorial whisper. “But he doesn’t fall.”"

rows.original: Your eyes widen. “What do you mean?”
rows.translation: 你睁大双眼。“什么意思？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour eyes widen. “What do you mean?”"

rows.original: “I ran over to the edge, expecting to see him make a human-sized mess on the concrete, but instead I watched him sprout wings in mid-air. Ended up finding an empty tube of Dovebalm nearby.”
rows.translation: “我跑到边缘，本以为会看见他在人行道上摔成一团人形污渍，结果却亲眼看着他在半空中长出了翅膀。后来我在附近找到了一支空掉的鸽香膏。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I ran over to the edge, expecting to see him make a human-sized mess on the concrete, but instead I watched him sprout wings in mid-air. Ended up finding an empty tube of Dovebalm nearby.”"

rows.original: “So that’s why he took off his shirt.”
rows.translation: “原来这就是他脱掉上衣的原因。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So that’s why he took off his shirt.”"

rows.original: Your eyes get a little dreamy as you can’t help but wonder what he must have looked like. Maybe he had a lot of juicy muscles...
rows.translation: 你眼神有些迷离，忍不住想象他当时的模样。也许他身上长满了饱满多汁的肌肉...
rows.raw: " Your eyes get a little dreamy as you can’t help but wonder what he must have looked like. Maybe he had a lot of juicy muscles..."

rows.original: “I have to admit,” The mercenary says begrudgingly. “Brilliant bastard or just ballsy as fuck, it was a pretty smart move. I think that’s why he led me on a goosechase up those stairs, too, to give himself enough time for the Dovebalm to kick in.”
rows.translation: “我不得不承认，”佣兵不情愿地说道。“不管他是聪明绝顶，还是胆大包天，这一招都相当高明。我想他之所以领着我在楼梯间兜那么大一个圈子，也是为了给鸽翼香膏足够时间生效。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I have to admit,” The mercenary says begrudgingly. “Brilliant bastard or just ballsy as fuck, it was a pretty smart move. I think that’s why he led me on a goosechase up those stairs, too, to give himself enough time for the Dovebalm to kick in.”"

rows.original: That still leaves one question unanswered. “So what happened to him?”
rows.translation: 还有一个问题没有答案。“那么他后来怎么样了？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThat still leaves one question unanswered. “So what happened to him?”"

rows.original: “Did he get away?”
rows.translation: “他逃走了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Did he get away?”"

rows.original: Evening pauses, as if having to recollect how the rest of the story went. “Oh, I just shot him,” she says, entirely too nonchalant.
rows.translation: 伊芙宁停顿下来，似乎得回想故事后来是怎么发展的。“哦，我就开枪打了他，”她说道，语气轻描淡写得过了头。
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening pauses, as if having to recollect how the rest of the story went. “Oh, I just shot him,” she says, entirely too nonchalant."

rows.original: “...What? That’s it?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...What? That’s it?”"

rows.original: “Well, yeah. He gained the ability to fly, not deflect bullets. Or for that matter, turn invisible. It was a smart trick, but he didn’t quite think it through enough to pull off the entire escape. I guess he didn’t count on needing a shield that day. Oops.” The mercenary shrugs. “He broke both his legs in the fall, but I still got my bonus.”
rows.translation: “好吧，是啊。他获得了飞行能力，又不是挡子弹的能力。更没获得隐形能力。这把戏很聪明，可他显然没考虑周全到足以完成整个逃脱。我猜他没料到那天会需要护盾。哎呀。”佣兵耸耸肩。“他摔断了两条腿，不过我还是拿到了奖金。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, yeah. He gained the ability to fly, not deflect bullets. Or for that matter, turn invisible. It was a smart trick, but he didn’t quite think it through enough to pull off the entire escape. I guess he didn’t count on needing a shield that day. Oops.” The mercenary shrugs. “He broke both his legs in the fall, but I still got my bonus.”"

rows.original: Huh. A somewhat shocking, yet unsurprising ending to that story.
rows.translation: 呃。这个故事的结局有些令人震惊，却又毫不意外。
rows.raw: "\n\nHuh. A somewhat shocking, yet unsurprising ending to that story."

rows.original: A few drinks later...
rows.translation: 又喝了几杯后...
rows.raw: "A few drinks later..."

rows.original: “This story takes place many years ago in a galaxy far, far away.” Evening starts, waving her hands towards said unknown galaxy.
rows.translation: “这个故事发生在许多年前，一个非常、非常遥远的星系。”伊芙宁挥手指向那个未知星系，开始讲述。
rows.raw: "\n\n“This story takes place many years ago in a galaxy far, far away.” Evening starts, waving her hands towards said unknown galaxy."

rows.original: You squint at her in suspicion.
rows.translation: 你怀疑地眯眼看着她。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou squint at her in suspicion. "

rows.original: “Don’t fuck around.”
rows.translation: “别耍花样。”
rows.raw: "“Don’t fuck around.”"

rows.original: “Somehow I don’t believe you.”
rows.translation: “不知为何，我不相信你。”
rows.raw: "“Somehow I don’t believe you.”"

rows.original: “Okay, fine, it was six months ago and I was on Uveto.” The mercenary rolls her eyes, dropping the pretense immediately. “My ship needed repairs. That isn’t really new, because it could always use repairs, but I was nearby and figured I could hunt for a bit of treasure and make a quick buck. There are lots of hidden gems if you know where to look, quite literally. I thought it would be a cinch to make a few thousand credits and be on my merry way...” She shivers
rows.translation: “好吧，好吧，那是六个月前，我当时在乌维托。”佣兵翻了个白眼，立刻放弃伪装。“我的飞船需要维修。这不算什么新鲜事，因为她一直都需要维修，不过当时我就在附近，觉得可以顺便寻点宝，快速赚上一笔。只要知道去哪找，那里藏着很多宝石，完全是字面意义上的。我以为轻轻松松就能赚几千信用点，然后愉快上路...”她打了个寒战
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, fine, it was six months ago and I was on Uveto.” The mercenary rolls her eyes, dropping the pretense immediately. “My ship needed repairs. That isn’t really new, because it could always use repairs, but I was nearby and figured I could hunt for a bit of treasure and make a quick buck. There are lots of hidden gems if you know where to look, quite literally. I thought it would be a cinch to make a few thousand credits and be on my merry way...” She shivers"

rows.original: , as if feeling the cold Uveto breeze again despite being light years away
rows.translation: ，仿佛隔着数光年的距离，又一次感受到了乌维托的寒风
rows.raw: ", as if feeling the cold Uveto breeze again despite being light years away"

rows.original: . “I was very wrong.”
rows.translation: 。“我错得很离谱。”
rows.raw: ". “I was very wrong.”"

rows.original: “Why? Did you forget to buy a heat belt?” You remember what it was like
rows.translation: “为什么？你忘了买保温腰带？”你还记得
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why? Did you forget to buy a heat belt?” You remember what it was like "

rows.original: losing your HP every time you wanted to move one goddamn square without one.
rows.translation: 没有它时，每移动该死的一格就会掉生命值是什么滋味。
rows.raw: "losing your HP every time you wanted to move one goddamn square without one."

rows.original: freezing half to death walking on that planet’s surface.
rows.translation: 在那颗星球表面行走时差点冻死的滋味。
rows.raw: "freezing half to death walking on that planet’s surface."

rows.original: “Why? Is there something wrong with Uveto?”
rows.translation: “为什么？乌维托有什么问题吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why? Is there something wrong with Uveto?”"

rows.original: “It’s cold as balls is why,” Evening scoffs. “The entire planet is basically covered in one ongoing blizzard. And if you don’t go with the proper supplies on hand, you will freeze to death.”
rows.translation: “因为那里冷得要命，”伊芙宁嗤笑道。“整颗星球基本都笼罩在一场永不停歇的暴风雪中。要是手头没有合适的补给就过去，你一定会冻死。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s cold as balls is why,” Evening scoffs. “The entire planet is basically covered in one ongoing blizzard. And if you don’t go with the proper supplies on hand, you will freeze to death.”"

rows.original: “So, did you go there prepared?”
rows.translation: “所以，你去那里时做好准备了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, did you go there prepared?”"

rows.original: “Hey.” Evening’s eyes narrow. “I will have you know I came very prepared. I bought a heat belt. I got climbing gear. I wore pants that covered all of my legs. I made sure to put all the gems I found in a separate bag so the savicite didn’t touch my bare skin and downed a bunch of Chill Pills just in case.” She ticks off every item by the finger, one by one. “I did many things right, but sometimes no matter how much you do right, life can still decide to fuck you over. And in this case, it decided to fuck me over by sending a giant horde of milodan to ambush me.”
rows.translation: “嘿。”伊芙宁眯起眼睛。“我得让你知道，我准备得非常充分。我买了保温腰带，带了攀爬装备，穿了能盖住整条腿的裤子。我还确保把找到的所有宝石放进单独的袋子里，以免赛维矿接触裸露皮肤，并且以防万一，吞了一大把镇定丸。”她一件一件地屈指数着。“我做对了很多事，可有时候无论你做对多少，生活还是会决定狠狠干你一顿。而这一次，它选择派来一大群米洛丹伏击我。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey.” Evening’s eyes narrow. “I will have you know I came very prepared. I bought a heat belt. I got climbing gear. I wore pants that covered all of my legs. I made sure to put all the gems I found in a separate bag so the savicite didn’t touch my bare skin and downed a bunch of Chill Pills just in case.” She ticks off every item by the finger, one by one. “I did many things right, but sometimes no matter how much you do right, life can still decide to fuck you over. And in this case, it decided to fuck me over by sending a giant horde of milodan to ambush me.” "

rows.original: “That’s terrible! What happened next?”
rows.translation: “太惨了！后来发生了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s terrible! What happened next?”"

rows.original: “Oof. Bad luck.”
rows.translation: “哎哟。运气真差。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oof. Bad luck.”"

rows.original: “Wow, sounded like you were fucked.”
rows.translation: “哇，听起来你完蛋了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wow, sounded like you were fucked.”"

rows.original: “It was not looking good for me, I’ll give you that. There were at least six of them in total. One second I was minding my own business, trekking the Uveto tundra, exploiting it for my own gain, doing absolutely nothing wrong, and the next I see them hulking over the top of a snowbank.” The mercenary mimes the shape of the snowy hill. “It wouldn’t have been a problem if there weren’t so many of them. One or two, I could definitely handle. Hell, maybe even three. But by this point, I was running low on supplies, and even if I’d shot down the first half as quickly as possible, I was pretty sure the latter would have made me into mincemeat. I’m not proud to say this, but I just ran. Unfortunately, they all started running after me.”
rows.translation: “我承认，当时的形势对我很不利。他们总共有至少六个。前一秒我还在专心做自己的事，跋涉于乌维托苔原，为自己牟利，完全没做任何坏事；下一秒，就看见他们从一道雪堤后面探出魁梧的身影。”佣兵用手比画出雪丘的形状。“如果人数没那么多，本来不成问题。一两个，我肯定能应付。见鬼，也许三个都行。但当时我的补给已经不多，就算尽可能快地射倒前一半，我也很确定后面那些会把我剁成肉酱。说来并不光彩，可我只能逃跑。不幸的是，他们全都追了上来。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It was not looking good for me, I’ll give you that. There were at least six of them in total. One second I was minding my own business, trekking the Uveto tundra, exploiting it for my own gain, doing absolutely nothing wrong, and the next I see them hulking over the top of a snowbank.” The mercenary mimes the shape of the snowy hill. “It wouldn’t have been a problem if there weren’t so many of them. One or two, I could definitely handle. Hell, maybe even three. But by this point, I was running low on supplies, and even if I’d shot down the first half as quickly as possible, I was pretty sure the latter would have made me into mincemeat. I’m not proud to say this, but I just ran. Unfortunately, they all started running after me.” "

rows.original: You ask her how she got away. In response, Evening bites her lip and looks unexpectedly nervous.
rows.translation: 你问她是怎么逃脱的。伊芙宁咬住嘴唇，显得出乎意料地紧张。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou ask her how she got away. In response, Evening bites her lip and looks unexpectedly nervous."

rows.original: “Technically, I didn’t,” she confesses. “They were all hot on my tail and between the cold and ice, I was one slip away from tripping, eating shit, and then getting caught.” Her lips press together at the prospect. “I needed something that could distract them. By then, I was out of grenades, so I had to improvise.”
rows.translation: “严格来说，我没能甩掉，”她承认道。“他们全都紧追在我屁股后面，加上严寒和冰面，我只要脚下一滑，就会摔个狗吃屎，然后被他们抓住。”一想到这种可能，她抿紧嘴唇。“我需要什么东西分散他们的注意。当时手榴弹已经用光，只能临场发挥。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Technically, I didn’t,” she confesses. “They were all hot on my tail and between the cold and ice, I was one slip away from tripping, eating shit, and then getting caught.” Her lips press together at the prospect. “I needed something that could distract them. By then, I was out of grenades, so I had to improvise.”"

rows.original: “What did you do?”
rows.translation: “你做了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What did you do?”"

rows.original: “Well, I still had all the gems I’d collected with me at that point, and a lot of it was savicite. It was a shame to let it go, considering how valuable it is,” Evening laments, “but the group was wearing an awful lot of jewelry made of the stuff. I figured if I threw a chunk behind me every once in a while, the pack might have been inclined to pick it up long enough to get distracted. It half worked. I’m fairly sure I wouldn’t have been able to outrun them, but it caught their attention long enough that they never quite caught up to me. No, my next problem was that the way they’d been chasing me, the milodan had ended up cornering me into a cave. It was one way in, one way out. I was almost out of gems to throw, trapped in the dark, and all six of them were practically breathing down my neck. I was almost certain that I was fucked. And about to be fucked. Both kinds of fucked. Every kind of fucked. But no matter how long I waited for it to happen... it never did.”
rows.translation: “嗯，当时我身上还带着采集到的所有宝石，其中许多是赛维矿。考虑到它有多值钱，扔掉实在可惜，”伊芙宁哀叹道，“不过那群人戴着许多用这种东西制成的首饰。我想，如果每隔一阵就朝身后扔一块，他们或许会停下来捡，分心一会儿。这办法只成功了一半。我很确定自己本来跑不过他们，但这足以吸引注意，让他们始终没能真正追上。可下一个问题是，他们一路追赶，最后把我逼进了一座洞穴。那里只有一个出入口。我几乎没有宝石可扔了，被困在黑暗里，而他们六个简直都在朝我后颈喘气。我几乎确信自己完蛋了。还马上要被操。两种意义上的完蛋。所有意义上的完蛋。可不管我等了多久...事情始终没有发生。”

I figured if I threw a chunk behind me every once in a while, the pack might have been inclined to pick it up long enough to get distracted. It half worked.
