No, my next problem was that the way they’d been chasing me, the milodan had ended up cornering me into a cave. It was one way in, one way out. I was almost out of gems to throw, trapped in the dark, and all six of them were practically breathing down my neck. I was almost certain that I was fucked. And about to be fucked. Both kinds of fucked. Every kind of fucked. But no matter how long I waited for it to happen... it never did.”"

rows.original: You’re leaning forward before you’re realizing it, with only one question on your lips. “And what happened next?”
rows.translation: 等你回过神来时，已经探身向前，嘴里只有一个问题。“后来发生了什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re leaning forward before you’re realizing it, with only one question on your lips. “And what happened next?”"

rows.original: “After realizing that they weren’t coming after me, I started to make my way out of the cave again. Slowly, because I didn’t know how far in they were, and it was still pretty dark. They ended up still being near the mouth of the cave.” Evening giggles in an uncomfortable sort of way. “Having an orgy.”
rows.translation: “意识到他们没有追进来后，我开始重新朝洞外走。走得很慢，因为我不知道他们深入了多远，而且里面依旧很暗。结果他们还在洞口附近。”伊芙宁有些不自在地咯咯笑起来。“正在乱交。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“After realizing that they weren’t coming after me, I started to make my way out of the cave again. Slowly, because I didn’t know how far in they were, and it was still pretty dark. They ended up still being near the mouth of the cave.” Evening giggles in an uncomfortable sort of way. “Having an orgy.”"

rows.original: “...really?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“...really?”"

rows.original: The woman nods. “Yeah. Really. I knew I’d thrown a lot of savicite at them, but not that much. Maybe they got all pent up trying to chase me down. I had no idea, but I wasn’t about to question it. The good news was that I was safe, for the time being. The bad news was that they were blocking the only way to freedom.” Her expression falls. “So I had to wait it out. It ended up lasting... a very long time. A very long, long time.”
rows.translation: 女人点点头。“对。真的。我知道自己朝他们扔了很多赛维矿，可也没想到会多到那种程度。也许他们追赶我时憋得太狠了。我不知道，但也不打算追究。好消息是，我暂时安全了。坏消息是，他们堵住了唯一的出路。”她的神情垮了下来。“所以我只能等他们结束。最后持续了...非常久。非常、非常久。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman nods. “Yeah. Really. I knew I’d thrown a lot of savicite at them, but not that much. Maybe they got all pent up trying to chase me down. I had no idea, but I wasn’t about to question it. The good news was that I was safe, for the time being. The bad news was that they were blocking the only way to freedom.” Her expression falls. “So I had to wait it out. It ended up lasting... a very long time. A very long, long time.”"

rows.original: “You sure you couldn’t have just joined in and left while they were distracted?” You’re clearly joking, but that doesn’t stop Evening from grabbing you by the shoulders and giving you a very serious stare.
rows.translation: “你确定不能直接加入他们，等他们分心时再离开吗？”你显然只是在开玩笑，但伊芙宁还是抓住你的双肩，无比严肃地盯着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“You sure you couldn’t have just joined in and left while they were distracted?” You’re clearly joking, but that doesn’t stop Evening from grabbing you by the shoulders and giving you a very serious stare."

rows.original: “Oi,” she says. “I don’t know who you take me for, but I definitely don’t have the stamina to have sex with six people in a row. Or at the same time.
rows.translation: “喂，”她说道。“我不知道你把我当成什么人了，但我肯定没有体力连续和六个人做爱，更别说同时来了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oi,” she says. “I don’t know who you take me for, but I definitely don’t have the stamina to have sex with six people in a row. Or at the same time."

rows.original: I know this is a porn game, but seriously. No.
rows.translation: 我知道这是个色情游戏，但说真的，不行。
rows.raw: " I know this is a porn game, but seriously. No."

rows.original: My best bet of getting out of that alive was hiding, waiting until it was all over, and then sneaking away after they all fuckered each other out.” This does make her smile, but only after she lets loose a pun so terrible you can’t help but
rows.translation: 我能活着逃出去的最好办法就是躲起来，等一切结束，等他们互相干到精疲力尽后再偷偷溜走。”这确实让她露出笑容，不过那是在她抛出一个烂得让你忍不住
rows.raw: " My best bet of getting out of that alive was hiding, waiting until it was all over, and then sneaking away after they all fuckered each other out.” This does make her smile, but only after she lets loose a pun so terrible you can’t help but"

rows.original: wince.
rows.translation: 畏缩。
rows.raw: " wince."

rows.original: groan.
rows.translation: 呻吟。
rows.raw: " groan."

rows.original: hiss in disgust and flip her off for the transgression, at which Evening cackles mirthfully.
rows.translation: 厌恶地嘶了一声，又因她的冒犯向她竖起中指，引得伊芙宁欢快地大笑。
rows.raw: " hiss in disgust and flip her off for the transgression, at which Evening cackles mirthfully."

rows.original: “All’s well that ends well, at least. I still had enough gems left over to pay for my ship repairs and a few upgrades. And I learned that I’m not cut out for the great outdoors. At least, the Uveto outdoors.”
rows.translation: “至少结局还算圆满。我剩下的宝石仍然足够支付飞船维修费，还能做几项升级。而且我明白了，自己不适合野外生活。至少不适合乌维托的野外。”
rows.raw: " “All’s well that ends well, at least. I still had enough gems left over to pay for my ship repairs and a few upgrades. And I learned that I’m not cut out for the great outdoors. At least, the Uveto outdoors.”"

rows.original: Halfway into her first drink, Evening seems to be struggling for inspiration, but a change of song from the dance floor manages to jog her memory. The heavy bass shifts to something that sounds like bubblegum pop, but with a haunting, howling vocal part playing in the background. Even from the next room over, it pierces through the idle chatter of the bar.
rows.translation: 喝到第一杯的一半时，伊芙宁似乎仍在努力寻找灵感，可舞池里换了一首歌，成功唤醒了她的记忆。沉重低音转成某种泡泡糖流行乐，背景里却响着萦绕不散的嚎叫歌声。即使隔着旁边的房间，那声音依旧穿透了酒吧里闲散的交谈声。
rows.raw: "Halfway into her first drink, Evening seems to be struggling for inspiration, but a change of song from the dance floor manages to jog her memory. The heavy bass shifts to something that sounds like bubblegum pop, but with a haunting, howling vocal part playing in the background. Even from the next room over, it pierces through the idle chatter of the bar. "

rows.original: “Hey, have you ever heard of Zalinda?” the mercenary asks you. “She’s an indie musician. Suula hybrid, chrome skin, feather mohawk. She did a tour a few years back. I think her music style uses a lot of ‘scream-singing’? Whatever that is.”
rows.translation: “嘿，你听说过扎琳达吗？”佣兵问道。“她是个独立音乐人，苏拉混血，铬色皮肤，羽毛莫霍克发型。几年前办过一次巡演。我记得她的音乐风格大量采用某种‘尖叫式演唱’？管它是什么。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, have you ever heard of Zalinda?” the mercenary asks you. “She’s an indie musician. Suula hybrid, chrome skin, feather mohawk. She did a tour a few years back. I think her music style uses a lot of ‘scream-singing’? Whatever that is.”"

rows.original: You confess that the name doesn’t ring a bell. At least, if you’d ever heard of a musician like that, she would have been hard to forget.
rows.translation: 你承认这个名字没有唤起任何印象。至少，如果你以前听说过这样的音乐人，应该很难忘记她才对。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou confess that the name doesn’t ring a bell. At least, if you’d ever heard of a musician like that, she would have been hard to forget."

rows.original: The Terran shrugs. “That’s not a surprise. She isn’t that popular, so most people haven’t heard of her. Thing is, the fans she does have are devoted as all fuck. They’ve basically made up their own religion. I went to one of her concerts once, and I swear half of the audience fainted via orgasm by the time it was over.”
rows.translation: 泰拉人耸耸肩。“这不奇怪。她没那么出名，所以大多数人没听说过她。问题是，她拥有的那些粉丝全都狂热得要命。他们基本上自创了一套宗教。我去过她的一场演唱会，我敢发誓，结束时有一半观众都因为高潮昏过去了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Terran shrugs. “That’s not a surprise. She isn’t that popular, so most people haven’t heard of her. Thing is, the fans she does have are devoted as all fuck. They’ve basically made up their own religion. I went to one of her concerts once, and I swear half of the audience fainted via orgasm by the time it was over.”"

rows.original: “That’s... a lot,” you remark dumbly. In the back of your head, you remind yourself to look up this ‘Zalinda’ if the chance ever comes up.
rows.translation: “这也...太多了，”你呆呆地评价道。你在心里提醒自己，如果以后有机会，一定要查查这个‘扎琳达’。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s... a lot,” you remark dumbly. In the back of your head, you remind yourself to look up this ‘Zalinda’ if the chance ever comes up."

rows.original: The idea of a hands-free orgasm is really appealing to you.
rows.translation: 无需动手就能高潮的想法对你非常有吸引力。
rows.raw: " The idea of a hands-free orgasm is really appealing to you."

rows.original: Evening nods before continuing. “One of these fans was a little too into her, which was really saying something. She was an amateur musician who looked up to Zalinda, and for whatever reason she got it in her head to modify herself to try and look like her idol. And I mean exactly like her, chrome skin, feathers and all. Most of the videos she posted got scrubbed off the extranet, but if you know where to look you can find some of them and see all the changes she went through. She basically rebuilt herself from the skeleton out. Even modified her vocal cords and started to perform covers of Zalinda’s songs that were pretty damn close to the real deal. No one knows exactly when it happened, but at some point she started to convince herself that she was the real Zalinda. She started to send death threats to her ‘imposter’, saying she’d expose her for her deceit, take her rightful place on the stage, all sorts of crazy stuff. This was around the time Zalinda was doing her first tour, so her staff were worried that this fan – I wanna say her name was Sherry? Would cause problems.”
rows.translation: 伊芙宁点点头，继续说道。“这些粉丝里有一个对她过于痴迷，这本身就已经很说明问题了。她是个崇拜扎琳达的业余音乐人，不知怎么就产生了改造自己的念头，想变得像她的偶像。而且我是说，完全一样，铬色皮肤、羽毛，一样不少。她发布的大部分视频都被从外联网上清除了，可只要知道去哪里找，仍能翻出其中一些，看到她经历的所有变化。她基本上从骨架开始重塑了自己。甚至改造声带，开始翻唱扎琳达的歌曲，效果他妈的接近原版。没人知道具体从什么时候开始，可到某个阶段，她开始说服自己，认为她才是真正的扎琳达。她开始给那个‘冒牌货’发送死亡威胁，声称要揭穿对方的骗局，夺回舞台上的正当地位，诸如此类的疯话。当时扎琳达正在进行第一次巡演，所以她的团队担心这个粉丝，我想她叫雪莉？会惹出麻烦。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening nods before continuing. “One of these fans was a little too into her, which was really saying something. She was an amateur musician who looked up to Zalinda, and for whatever reason she got it in her head to modify herself to try and look like her idol. And I mean exactly like her, chrome skin, feathers and all. Most of the videos she posted got scrubbed off the extranet, but if you know where to look you can find some of them and see all the changes she went through. She basically rebuilt herself from the skeleton out. Even modified her vocal cords and started to perform covers of Zalinda’s songs that were pretty damn close to the real deal. No one knows exactly when it happened, but at some point she started to convince herself that she was the real Zalinda. She started to send death threats to her ‘imposter’, saying she’d expose her for her deceit, take her rightful place on the stage, all sorts of crazy stuff. This was around the time Zalinda was doing her first tour, so her staff were worried that this fan – I wanna say her name was Sherry? Would cause problems.”"

rows.original: “So you were hired to be part of her security team?”
rows.translation: “所以你受雇加入了她的安保团队？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you were hired to be part of her security team?”"

rows.original: “Actually,” Evening corrects you with a sheepish look on her face, “I was hired by the loan shark Sherry had borrowed thousands of credits from. Zalinda’s team did give me access to her and the concert venue to help out, but my job was to bring Sherry in so she could pay her loan back.”
rows.translation: “其实，”伊芙宁露出不好意思的神情纠正你，“雇用我的是借给雪莉数千信用点的高利贷。扎琳达的团队确实允许我接触她本人和演唱会场地，方便我行动，不过我的工作是把雪莉抓回去，让她偿还贷款。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Actually,” Evening corrects you with a sheepish look on her face, “I was hired by the loan shark Sherry had borrowed thousands of credits from. Zalinda’s team did give me access to her and the concert venue to help out, but my job was to bring Sherry in so she could pay her loan back.”"

rows.original: Oh.
rows.translation: 哦。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh."

rows.original: “From the emails she kept sending, we were pretty sure she’d try to pull something during one of Zalinda’s concerts, so I was supposed to keep an eye on the crowd. I don’t just people-watch for the fun of it; it’s a skill that comes in really handy in situations like these. You have to constantly watch for the slightest thing that might be off, or scan large areas as effectively and quickly as possible.”
rows.translation: “从她不断发送的邮件来看，我们相当确定她会在扎琳达的某场演唱会上搞事，所以我得盯着观众。我观察人群可不只是为了好玩；这种技能在此类场合非常有用。你必须不断留意最细微的异常，或者尽可能迅速而有效地扫视大片区域。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“From the emails she kept sending, we were pretty sure she’d try to pull something during one of Zalinda’s concerts, so I was supposed to keep an eye on the crowd. I don’t just people-watch for the fun of it; it’s a skill that comes in really handy in situations like these. You have to constantly watch for the slightest thing that might be off, or scan large areas as effectively and quickly as possible.”"

rows.original: “In other words, you got to attend a concert for free,” you rib her. “Lucky.”
rows.translation: “换句话说，你免费参加了一场演唱会。”你调侃她。“真走运。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“In other words, you got to attend a concert for free,” you rib her. “Lucky.”"

rows.original: “If you put it that way, sure,” Evening laughs. “It was a pretty strange concert, if it could even be called that. Everyone there was covered head-to-toe in Zalinda merch or even dressed like her. Sherry wasn’t the only one trying to imitate her; she just took it a step too far. When the singer finally entered the stage, the lights turned off, and the crowd was completely silent. Then she started singing, and everyone joined in. It was eerie. Zalinda’s definitely had some kind of work done herself; her song reverberated like there were two of her up there. It wasn’t something she could do with natural vocal cords. But the fans? They screamed along with practically the same voice. Just the same sustained notes, over and over again. I didn’t understand a word, but the concert-goers were hanging off every sound. Even some of the staff were caught up in it.”
rows.translation: “如果你非要这么说，那就算是吧，”伊芙宁笑道。“那场演唱会相当古怪，如果还能叫演唱会的话。到场的每个人都从头到脚穿戴着扎琳达的周边，甚至直接打扮成她。雪莉并不是唯一试图模仿她的人；她只是做得太过头。歌手终于登台时，灯光熄灭，全场鸦雀无声。随后她开始唱歌，所有人都加入进来。那场面诡异得很。扎琳达本人肯定也接受过某种改造；她的歌声回荡起来，像是台上有两个她。天然声带做不到这种效果。可那些粉丝呢？他们几乎用同样的声音尖叫着跟唱。只是一遍又一遍地维持同样的长音。我一个字也听不懂，可观众对每一个声音都如痴如醉。就连部分工作人员都沉浸其中。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“If you put it that way, sure,” Evening laughs. “It was a pretty strange concert, if it could even be called that. Everyone there was covered head-to-toe in Zalinda merch or even dressed like her. Sherry wasn’t the only one trying to imitate her; she just took it a step too far. When the singer finally entered the stage, the lights turned off, and the crowd was completely silent. Then she started singing, and everyone joined in. It was eerie. Zalinda’s definitely had some kind of work done herself; her song reverberated like there were two of her up there. It wasn’t something she could do with natural vocal cords. But the fans? They screamed along with practically the same voice. Just the same sustained notes, over and over again. I didn’t understand a word, but the concert-goers were hanging off every sound. Even some of the staff were caught up in it.”"

rows.original: With that surreal image in mind, the mercenary pauses to sip from her glass. “That’s where I came in. The team was worried about Sherry sneaking backstage while everyone was distracted and doing something dangerous. Worst case scenario was if she showed up looking indistinguishable from the real thing. She might have been able to trick the staff members into thinking she was actually Zalinda, so I was supposed to find her before she got near any staff-only areas. In the end, though, that didn’t turn out to be a problem.”
rows.translation: 脑海里浮现着那幅超现实画面，佣兵停下来喝了一口。“这就是我介入的地方。团队担心雪莉会趁所有人分心时溜进后台，做出危险的事。最糟的情况，是她以和本尊完全无法区分的模样出现。她也许能骗过工作人员，让他们以为她真是扎琳达，所以我得在她靠近任何员工专用区域前找到她。不过到头来，这并没有成为问题。”
rows.raw: "\n\nWith that surreal image in mind, the mercenary pauses to sip from her glass. “That’s where I came in. The team was worried about Sherry sneaking backstage while everyone was distracted and doing something dangerous. Worst case scenario was if she showed up looking indistinguishable from the real thing. She might have been able to trick the staff members into thinking she was actually Zalinda, so I was supposed to find her before she got near any staff-only areas. In the end, though, that didn’t turn out to be a problem.”"

rows.original: “Because you stopped her?”
rows.translation: “因为你阻止了她？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Because you stopped her?”"

rows.original: “Yeah, but that wasn’t the only thing. We were expecting a bonafide doppelganger to be sneaking in, but when I caught sight of her, Sherry was...” This is where Evening stops, her face souring. “Let’s just say ‘uncanny’ valley wasn’t enough to describe it. She looked like Zalinda, but everything about her was a little bit off. It was like looking at a melted wax version of her.”
rows.translation: “没错，但不只是这个。我们原以为会有一个货真价实的冒牌货偷偷潜入，可当我看见她时，雪莉却...”说到这里，伊芙宁停下来，脸色变得难看。“这么说吧，光用‘恐怖谷’都不足以形容。她看起来像扎琳达，可身上的一切都有那么一点不对。简直像在看一个融化的蜡像版扎琳达。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, but that wasn’t the only thing. We were expecting a bonafide doppelganger to be sneaking in, but when I caught sight of her, Sherry was...” This is where Evening stops, her face souring. “Let’s just say ‘uncanny’ valley wasn’t enough to describe it. She looked like Zalinda, but everything about her was a little bit off. It was like looking at a melted wax version of her.” "

rows.translation: 你

rows.translation: 适当地惊恐地倒抽一口气，并
rows.raw: " give a suitable gasp of horror and"

rows.original: ask her what she thinks happened to Sherry to make her look like that.
rows.translation: 问她觉得雪莉身上发生了什么，才会变成那副模样。
rows.raw: " ask her what she thinks happened to Sherry to make her look like that."

rows.original: “My guess is all the transformatives she took didn’t want to play nice with each other. Between the extensive changes her body went through and the debt, she probably dipped into the black market stuff too. Maybe she just tried a few, and didn’t intend to take it that far, but the Taint screwed with her head. Maybe she was messed up from the beginning.” The woman shakes her head.“
rows.translation: “我猜她服用的各种变形物彼此不太兼容。她的身体经历了那么广泛的变化，又欠了一屁股债，大概也碰过黑市货。也许她最初只想试几样，没打算走到那么远，可腐化把她的脑子搞坏了。也许她一开始就有问题。”女人摇摇头。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“My guess is all the transformatives she took didn’t want to play nice with each other. Between the extensive changes her body went through and the debt, she probably dipped into the black market stuff too. Maybe she just tried a few, and didn’t intend to take it that far, but the Taint screwed with her head. Maybe she was messed up from the beginning.” The woman shakes her head.“"

rows.original: I’d be lying if I said I didn’t want to know... but Sherry wasn’t in a position to answer my questions properly.
rows.translation: 要说我不想知道，那是在撒谎...但雪莉当时的状态没法好好回答我的问题。
rows.raw: " I’d be lying if I said I didn’t want to know... but Sherry wasn’t in a position to answer my questions properly."

rows.original: In the end, she wasn’t even that big of a threat; all she brought was a knife and a holocam. Seemed too out of it to even know how to use them either. I caught her trying to sneak backstage, disarmed her, and took her into custody. Didn’t even put up a fight.”
rows.translation: 最后，她甚至算不上多大威胁；带来的只有一把刀和一台全息摄像机。她神志恍惚得似乎连怎么使用它们都不知道。我抓到她试图溜进后台，缴了她的武器，把她拘捕起来。她甚至没有反抗。”
rows.raw: " In the end, she wasn’t even that big of a threat; all she brought was a knife and a holocam. Seemed too out of it to even know how to use them either. I caught her trying to sneak backstage, disarmed her, and took her into custody. Didn’t even put up a fight.”"

rows.original: “What happened to her next?”
rows.translation: “后来她怎么样了？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What happened to her next?”"

rows.original: “Well, she never actually committed any serious crimes, and Zalinda’s crew decided not to press charges. I feel like they wanted to keep it quiet.” Strange, since an odd scandal like this could have easily propelled the popularity of such an obscure singer. “So her creditors took custody of her. She wasn’t in any condition to work back her debt, so they put her in a rehabilitation center.” The mercenary gives a grim smile. “By the time she gets out, her balance owed will have at least doubled, if she ever does. I visited her once, out of curiosity. She looked like she was doing better; they reversed some of her mods and managed to restore some of her mental capacities. But she still couldn’t speak. Just sing. Like Zalinda did.”
rows.translation: “嗯，她其实从未犯下任何严重罪行，扎琳达的团队也决定不提起指控。我觉得他们想把这件事压下去。”真奇怪，这种离奇丑闻本来很容易让如此冷门的歌手一举成名。“所以债主接管了她。她的状况根本无法工作还债，于是他们把她送进康复中心。”佣兵露出冷峻的笑容。“等她出来时，欠款至少会翻一倍，前提是她还能出来。我出于好奇去看过她一次。她看起来好些了；他们逆转了部分改造，也设法恢复了她的一些心智能力。可她依然不会说话，只会唱歌。就像扎琳达那样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, she never actually committed any serious crimes, and Zalinda’s crew decided not to press charges. I feel like they wanted to keep it quiet.” Strange, since an odd scandal like this could have easily propelled the popularity of such an obscure singer. “So her creditors took custody of her. She wasn’t in any condition to work back her debt, so they put her in a rehabilitation center.” The mercenary gives a grim smile. “By the time she gets out, her balance owed will have at least doubled, if she ever does. I visited her once, out of curiosity. She looked like she was doing better; they reversed some of her mods and managed to restore some of her mental capacities. But she still couldn’t speak. Just sing. Like Zalinda did.”"

rows.original: “Spooky.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Spooky.”"

rows.original: “Spooky as shit, yeah. Maybe I’ll visit her again. I felt pretty sorry for her.”
rows.translation: “确实瘆人得要命。也许我还会再去看她。我当时挺可怜她的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Spooky as shit, yeah. Maybe I’ll visit her again. I felt pretty sorry for her.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 继续
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Okay, enough about me,” Evening decides, tipping her drink in your direction. “What have you been up to recently?”
rows.translation: “好了，我的事说够了。”伊芙宁做出决定，把酒杯朝你的方向一倾。“你最近都在忙些什么？”
rows.raw: "“Okay, enough about me,” Evening decides, tipping her drink in your direction. “What have you been up to recently?”"

rows.original: You spend the rest of the night recounting previous adventures, the two of you chortling and drinking throughout the night. Though you don’t quite remember how the “evening” concluded, you do wake up in your ship no worse for the wear.
rows.translation: 当晚剩余的时间里，你们一直讲述过去的冒险经历，两人整夜边喝边笑。尽管你已经记不清这场“夜晚”究竟如何收场，醒来时却发现自己安然无恙地回到了飞船上。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spend the rest of the night recounting previous adventures, the two of you chortling and drinking throughout the night. Though you don’t quite remember how the “evening” concluded, you do wake up in your ship no worse for the wear."

rows.original: EVENING_TRUST_COUNTER
rows.raw: "EVENING_TRUST_COUNTER"

rows.original: Choose A Gun
rows.translation: 选择枪械
rows.raw: "Choose A Gun"

rows.original: What gun will you show off to Evening?
rows.translation: 你要向伊芙宁展示哪把枪？
rows.raw: "What gun will you show off to Evening?"

rows.original: RESCUE KIRO FROM BLUEBALLS
rows.raw: "RESCUE KIRO FROM BLUEBALLS"

rows.original: “You had to do what,” Evening exclaims when you tell her what you did to get your Custom LP-17 Laser Pistol. “Well. Remind me not to let my balls grow so enormously large that I get stuck on my own ship.” She handles the gun somewhat gingerly when you show it to her.
rows.translation: “你竟然不得不做什么，”当你告诉伊芙宁自己如何得到定制LP-17激光手枪时，她惊呼起来。“好吧。提醒我别让自己的蛋蛋长到大得离谱，结果被困在自家飞船上。”你把枪展示给她时，她颇为小心地摆弄着。
rows.raw: "“You had to do what,” Evening exclaims when you tell her what you did to get your Custom LP-17 Laser Pistol. “Well. Remind me not to let my balls grow so enormously large that I get stuck on my own ship.” She handles the gun somewhat gingerly when you show it to her."

rows.original: “You answered a ship’s distress call and just ran off after looting it? That’s cold, my friend.” Despite the admonishment, Evening snickers. “But sometimes you have to be an opportunist to survive. I’d be lying if I said I’ve never nicked a piece or two off of someone. Usually for being a dick to me, but still.”
rows.translation: “你回应了一艘飞船的求救信号，洗劫完就直接跑了？这可真冷酷，我的朋友。”嘴上虽在责备，伊芙宁却窃笑起来。“但有时候想活下去，就必须抓住机会。我要是说自己从没顺走过别人一两件东西，那就是撒谎。通常是因为对方对我很混蛋，不过还是一样。”
rows.raw: "“You answered a ship’s distress call and just ran off after looting it? That’s cold, my friend.” Despite the admonishment, Evening snickers. “But sometimes you have to be an opportunist to survive. I’d be lying if I said I’ve never nicked a piece or two off of someone. Usually for being a dick to me, but still.”"

rows.original: Turning her attention to the actual pistol, she remarks, <i>“it’s nice, but I can tell it’s not meant to be used on its own. Light. Accurate. Doesn’t punch the biggest holes, even at close range. You’d probably want to pair this with something heavier if you’re going somewhere too dangerous... unless you’re a melee type of
rows.translation: 她把注意力转向手枪本身，评论道：<i>“挺不错，可我看得出它并不适合单独使用。轻便，精准。即使近距离也打不出最大的窟窿。要是准备去太危险的地方，你大概得给它搭配某种火力更重的武器...除非你是个近战型的
rows.raw: "\n\nTurning her attention to the actual pistol, she remarks, <i>“it’s nice, but I can tell it’s not meant to be used on its own. Light. Accurate. Doesn’t punch the biggest holes, even at close range. You’d probably want to pair this with something heavier if you’re going somewhere too dangerous... unless you’re a melee type of "

rows.original: guy
rows.raw: "guy"

rows.original: gal
rows.raw: "gal"

rows.original: “Oh shit, the safety’s been taken off this one’s capacitor,” Evening says immediately as you show her your Heavy Laser Pistol. “You’d... probably want to trade this in for something else. No offense.” The way she handles the pistol makes her appear as if she expects it to explode at any second. “It’s seriously overclocked, which is never a good sign. I think you can easily buy something in these parts with more firepower anyways. And better aim. And a lower chance of accidentally burning off a body part.”
rows.translation: “我操，这把枪电容器上的保险被拆掉了，”你向伊芙宁展示重型激光手枪时，她立刻说道。“你...最好把它换成别的东西。无意冒犯。”她摆弄手枪时的样子，仿佛觉得它随时都会爆炸。“它的超频程度相当严重，这绝不是好兆头。我想你在这附近很容易就能买到火力更强的东西。而且更准。还不那么容易意外烧掉身体部位。”
rows.raw: "“Oh shit, the safety’s been taken off this one’s capacitor,” Evening says immediately as you show her your Heavy Laser Pistol. “You’d... probably want to trade this in for something else. No offense.” The way she handles the pistol makes her appear as if she expects it to explode at any second. “It’s seriously overclocked, which is never a good sign. I think you can easily buy something in these parts with more firepower anyways. And better aim. And a lower chance of accidentally burning off a body part.”"

rows.original: She hands the gun back to you carefully. Very carefully.
rows.translation: 她小心翼翼地把枪还给你。非常小心。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hands the gun back to you carefully. Very carefully."

rows.original: You show Evening Dr. Khan’s hand cannon, telling her about how you’d pilfered it after defeating him.
rows.translation: 你向伊芙宁展示汗博士的手炮，告诉她自己在击败他之后顺手牵羊拿走了它。
rows.raw: "You show Evening Dr. Khan’s hand cannon, telling her about how you’d pilfered it after defeating him."

rows.original: “This is pretty powerful for a solely electric weapon,” she whistles. “When I see anything from ‘JoyCo’, I don’t usually think ‘instruments of death’. Looks like Dr. Khan combined this thing with a hovercar battery to boost its power. Doing that incorrectly can make the gun overheat easily, but it looks like he knew what he was doing. Still, this kind of improvisation speaks of someone who doesn’t primarily work with arms. At least, that’s the impression I get from it.”
rows.translation: “作为一把纯电能武器，这东西威力相当大，”她吹了声口哨。“看到任何来自‘欢乐公司’的东西时，我通常不会联想到‘杀人武器’。看来可汗博士把它和一块悬浮车电池结合，增强了威力。操作不当很容易让枪过热，不过看起来他知道自己在做什么。不过，这种改装方式说明动手的人主要工作并不是武器。至少它给我的印象如此。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“This is pretty powerful for a solely electric weapon,” she whistles. “When I see anything from ‘JoyCo’, I don’t usually think ‘instruments of death’. Looks like Dr. Khan combined this thing with a hovercar battery to boost its power. Doing that incorrectly can make the gun overheat easily, but it looks like he knew what he was doing. Still, this kind of improvisation speaks of someone who doesn’t primarily work with arms. At least, that’s the impression I get from it.”"

rows.original: You show Evening the Lash Cannon you got as a reward for taking down Petra, the Black Void slaver.
rows.translation: 你向伊芙宁展示自己击败黑色虚空奴隶贩子佩特拉后，作为奖励得到的鞭炮。
rows.raw: "You show Evening the Lash Cannon you got as a reward for taking down Petra, the Black Void slaver."

rows.original: “A multi-streamed energy weapon,” the woman observes after taking a look at the muzzle. “I tend not to be a fan of these since it’s hard to aim ‘precisely’. Even if you change the barrel directions to hit your target in the same spot, you’d have to readjust every time your distance changed. This is good when you just want to point and shoot, but it’s not exactly my cup of tea.”
rows.translation: “多束流能量武器，”女人查看枪口后评价道。“我一般不喜欢这种东西，因为很难‘精确’瞄准。即使调整各枪管的方向，让它们命中目标上的同一点，每次距离变化时仍得重新校准。只想举枪就射时，它很方便，但不太合我的口味。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A multi-streamed energy weapon,” the woman observes after taking a look at the muzzle. “I tend not to be a fan of these since it’s hard to aim ‘precisely’. Even if you change the barrel directions to hit your target in the same spot, you’d have to readjust every time your distance changed. This is good when you just want to point and shoot, but it’s not exactly my cup of tea.” "

rows.original: Her lips press together in thought as she hands the pistol back. <i>“Still, it’s the closest you can really get to shooting multiple guns at the same time. If my brain had the ability to line up more than one scope at once, I’d start packing double heat in a heartbeat. Then I’d be seriously tempted to give myself extra arms just to shoot more!
rows.translation: 她把手枪递回来时，若有所思地抿紧嘴唇。<i>“不过，这已经是最接近同时射击多把枪的体验了。如果我的大脑能同时校准不止一个瞄具，我肯定立刻开始带两份火力。到时候，我真的会忍不住给自己多装几条手臂，只为能开更多枪！
rows.raw: "\n\nHer lips press together in thought as she hands the pistol back. <i>“Still, it’s the closest you can really get to shooting multiple guns at the same time. If my brain had the ability to line up more than one scope at once, I’d start packing double heat in a heartbeat. Then I’d be seriously tempted to give myself extra arms just to shoot more!"

rows.original: And you know how I feel about mods.
rows.translation: 而且你也知道我对改造物是什么态度。
rows.raw: " And you know how I feel about mods."

rows.original: “Ohh, I know the feeling...” you say, trying not to bring up a certain four-armed ausar.
rows.translation: “哦，我明白那种感觉...”你说道，努力不提某个四臂奥萨人。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ohh, I know the feeling...” you say, trying not to bring up a certain four-armed ausar."

rows.original: You hand her your rifle while telling her about how you found it in the depths of No Myr’s Land.
rows.translation: 你把步枪递给她，同时讲述自己如何在无人米尔之地深处找到它。
rows.raw: "You hand her your rifle while telling her about how you found it in the depths of No Myr’s Land."

rows.original: “Myrellion, huh?” She traces a finger along the edge of the barrel where it had been sawed down. “That makes sense. Myr chitin is tough.
rows.translation: “迈瑞利恩，是吧？”她用手指沿着被锯短的枪管边缘划过。“这就说得通了。米尔人的甲壳可硬得很。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Myrellion, huh?” She traces a finger along the edge of the barrel where it had been sawed down. “That makes sense. Myr chitin is tough."

rows.original: Though I guess you know that from first hand experience?” Evening gestures to your armour. “
rows.translation: 不过我猜你已经亲身体验过了？”伊芙宁指向你的护甲。“
rows.raw: " Though I guess you know that from first hand experience?” Evening gestures to your armour. “"

rows.original: When you’re in a high-pressure situation like a war, you don’t have the time to make your modifications look pretty. The enemy’s surrounding you, and you have to work with what you’ve got. Sometimes these guns are quite literally shortened with a saw.” The mercenary hands the rifle back to you with care. “Thanks for showing me this. It reminded me of how lucky I am to have the luxury of freedom.”
rows.translation: 在战争这种高压环境中，你没有时间把改装做得漂亮。敌人正包围你，而你只能利用手头现有的东西。有时候这些枪真的是用锯子锯短的。”佣兵小心地把步枪还给你。“谢谢你让我看这个。它提醒我，自己能享有自由是多么幸运。”
rows.raw: " When you’re in a high-pressure situation like a war, you don’t have the time to make your modifications look pretty. The enemy’s surrounding you, and you have to work with what you’ve got. Sometimes these guns are quite literally shortened with a saw.” The mercenary hands the rifle back to you with care. “Thanks for showing me this. It reminded me of how lucky I am to have the luxury of freedom.”"

rows.original: You raise an eyebrow. “You think the opposite of war is freedom? Not peace?”
rows.translation: 你挑起眉毛。“你觉得战争的反面是自由？不是和平？”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou raise an eyebrow. “You think the opposite of war is freedom? Not peace?”"

rows.original: Evening smirks. “No. I think the opposite of war is fucking. I’m just glad to be able to choose what I mow down my enemies with.”
rows.translation: 伊芙宁坏笑道：“不。我觉得战争的反义词是做爱。我只庆幸自己能选择用什么来扫倒敌人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening smirks. “No. I think the opposite of war is fucking. I’m just glad to be able to choose what I mow down my enemies with.”"

rows.original: You decide to show her the gun you got during your adventure with Anno on Tarkus.
rows.translation: 你决定向她展示自己在塔库斯与安诺共同冒险时得到的枪。
rows.raw: "You decide to show her the gun you got during your adventure with Anno on Tarkus."

rows.original: “Whoa,” she says in awe as she runs her fingers across the satellite image embossed on the side. “I’ve never seen this logo before. This is practically an antique; I’m surprised it’s still in shooting form. Where did you get this?”
rows.translation: “哇哦，”她惊叹着说道，手指抚过侧面压印的卫星图案。“我从没见过这个标志。这简直是件古董；真没想到它居然还能开火。你从哪里弄到的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whoa,” she says in awe as she runs her fingers across the satellite image embossed on the side. “I’ve never seen this logo before. This is practically an antique; I’m surprised it’s still in shooting form. Where did you get this?”"

rows.original: As you recount your adventures on Novahome’s hidden deck, Evening chews her lip thoughtfully. The mercenary cradles the weapon with care, as if it were precious cargo. “Space travel was pretty different in those early days. Guns too. Back when humanity first started to explore space, they weren’t exactly sure of whether they’d bump into unpleasant company.” she exhales deeply, momentarily lost in thought. “Ha, look at me, getting all nostalgic. We weren’t even alive that long ago!”
rows.translation: 你讲述自己在诺瓦之家隐藏甲板上的冒险时，伊芙宁若有所思地咬着嘴唇。佣兵小心地把武器抱在怀里，仿佛那是什么珍贵货物。“早期年代的太空旅行与现在大不相同，枪也一样。人类刚开始探索太空时，根本不确定会不会碰上不友善的家伙。”她深深呼出一口气，短暂地沉浸在思绪中。“哈，瞧瞧我，居然怀起旧来。我们甚至都没活在那么久以前！”
rows.raw: "\n\nAs you recount your adventures on Novahome’s hidden deck, Evening chews her lip thoughtfully. The mercenary cradles the weapon with care, as if it were precious cargo. “Space travel was pretty different in those early days. Guns too. Back when humanity first started to explore space, they weren’t exactly sure of whether they’d bump into unpleasant company.” she exhales deeply, momentarily lost in thought. “Ha, look at me, getting all nostalgic. We weren’t even alive that long ago!”"

rows.original: “Look what I’ve got!”
rows.translation: “看看我有什么！”
rows.raw: "“Look what I’ve got!”"

rows.original: “Wanna see something cool?”
rows.translation: “想看点酷东西吗？”
rows.raw: "“Wanna see something cool?”"

rows.original: “Check this shit out.”
rows.translation: “看看这玩意儿。”
rows.raw: "“Check this shit out.”"

rows.original: You heft your beast of a railgun onto your shared table, and the ensuing impact practically makes Evening’s drink jump out of her glass, and her out of her clothes.
rows.translation: 你把那门巨兽般的磁轨炮重重放到共用桌面上，撞击的震动几乎让伊芙宁杯里的酒水跳出杯子，也差点让她从衣服里跳出来。
rows.raw: " You heft your beast of a railgun onto your shared table, and the ensuing impact practically makes Evening’s drink jump out of her glass, and her out of her clothes."

rows.original: “That’s. That’s a-” She stutters, almost at a loss for words. “Where in the galaxy did you get this?”
rows.translation: “这、这是——”她结结巴巴，几乎说不出话来。“你到底是从银河系的哪里弄到这东西的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s. That’s a-” She stutters, almost at a loss for words. “Where in the galaxy did you get this?”"

rows.original: You recount your ‘whirlwind romance’ with Chaurmine in brief, though you’re not sure whether Evening is listening or if she’s too busy experiencing a heart attack instead.
rows.translation: 你简要讲述了自己与乔敏那段‘旋风般的恋情’，不过你不确定伊芙宁有没有在听，还是已经忙着体验心脏病发作的感觉。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou recount your ‘whirlwind romance’ with Chaurmine in brief, though you’re not sure whether Evening is listening or if she’s too busy experiencing a heart attack instead."

rows.original: “This is a Saurmorian Railgun.” You already knew that, but apparently she needed to say it for herself. “I’ve never seen one this close up before. Shit, [pc.name], this Chaurmine must have really fucking fallen for you. Saurmorians treat these things like their own children.” The mercenary falls back in her seat in disbelief. “I’ve always wanted to use one of these... not that I could even if I got close to one. Pretty sure it would tear me apart. Literally.”
