rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman dons an expression of exaggerated insult. “Just eat your pancakes, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: You don’t have to be told twice. Mix or not, these are delicious. You gladly devour the rest of them before your lover gathers up your [pc.gear] and tosses it at your feet. “Up and at ‘em! Today’s a new day... technically.”
rows.translation: 你当然不用别人再说第二遍。不管是不是预拌粉，这些煎饼都美味极了。你欣然把剩下的全吃光，这时你的爱人收好你的[pc.gear]，扔到你脚边。“起来活动活动！今天又是新的一天...严格来说算是吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t have to be told twice. Mix or not, these are delicious. You gladly devour the rest of them before your lover gathers up your [pc.gear] and tosses it at your feet. “Up and at ‘em! Today’s a new day... technically.”"

rows.original: “How long was I asleep?”
rows.translation: “我睡了多久？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How long was I asleep?”"

rows.original: Evening shrugs. “A while,” she answers vaguely. And then, with a smirk: “It’s a shame you didn’t wake up earlier. I didn’t put my clothes back on until after I finished cooking.”
rows.translation: 伊芙宁耸耸肩。“有一阵子，”她含糊地回答。随后，她坏笑着补充：“可惜你没早点醒。我直到做完饭以后才把衣服穿回去。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening shrugs. “A while,” she answers vaguely. And then, with a smirk: “It’s a shame you didn’t wake up earlier. I didn’t put my clothes back on until after I finished cooking.”"

rows.original: Shit. You would have liked to see that. “I missed out.”
rows.translation: 该死。你确实很想看看。“我错过好戏了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShit. You would have liked to see that. “I missed out.”"

rows.original: “Better luck next time, friend.”
rows.translation: “下次走运点吧，朋友。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Better luck next time, friend.”"

rows.original: What was supposed to be a short rest turns out to become you being knocked out for the rest of the night. You sleep surprisingly deeply, even considering the drain on your stamina. One moment, you’re catching your breath next to a warm body, and the next you’re waking up tucked away in soft sheets.
rows.translation: 原本只打算小憩片刻，结果你却一觉睡到了夜晚结束。即使考虑到体力消耗之大，你仍睡得出奇地沉。前一刻，你还躺在温暖的身体旁喘息，下一刻醒来时，已经被柔软的床单裹得严严实实。
rows.raw: "What was supposed to be a short rest turns out to become you being knocked out for the rest of the night. You sleep surprisingly deeply, even considering the drain on your stamina. One moment, you’re catching your breath next to a warm body, and the next you’re waking up tucked away in soft sheets."

rows.original: Said warmth seems to be sadly missing by the time you wake up however, as you discover when you groggily reach for Evening only to find her gone. Wiping the sleep from your eyes, you scan the room to check for any signs of her. Her clothes are still here, albeit in a folded pile in the corner – you happen to find your [pc.gear] similarly arranged next to it. Shrugging on your things, you pad off into the hallway in search of your lover.
rows.translation: 然而等你醒来时，那份温暖却遗憾地消失了。你迷迷糊糊地伸手去摸伊芙宁，却发现她已经不在。你揉去眼中的睡意，环顾房间寻找她留下的踪迹。她的衣服还在，只是整齐叠放在角落里 -- 你的[pc.gear]也被同样整理好放在旁边。你套上装备，轻步走进走廊寻找爱人。
rows.raw: "\n\nSaid warmth seems to be sadly missing by the time you wake up however, as you discover when you groggily reach for Evening only to find her gone. Wiping the sleep from your eyes, you scan the room to check for any signs of her. Her clothes are still here, albeit in a folded pile in the corner – you happen to find your [pc.gear] similarly arranged next to it. Shrugging on your things, you pad off into the hallway in search of your lover."

rows.original: As soon as you step over the threshold, the sound and smell of something sizzling assaults your senses. Now what could that be?
rows.translation: 你刚跨过门槛，某种东西在煎烤的滋滋声与香味便扑面而来。那会是什么呢？
rows.raw: "\n\nAs soon as you step over the threshold, the sound and smell of something sizzling assaults your senses. Now what could that be?"

rows.original: Your question is quickly answered when you find the kitchen, and a familiar figure standing in front of what seems to be a very small stove. Evening is flipping pancakes, a plate of them already set to the side. She’s also wearing nothing but an apron. You can’t help but sneak up behind her, planting a kiss on her neck before slipping your hands under the fabric to knead her bare tits. The woman smirks before gently swatting your hands away. <i>“Morning,
rows.translation: 你很快便在厨房里找到了答案，一个熟悉的身影正站在一台看起来很小的炉灶前。伊芙宁正在翻煎饼，旁边已经摆好了一盘。她身上除了围裙什么也没穿。你忍不住悄悄绕到她身后，在她颈侧落下一吻，同时把双手探进布料下揉捏她裸露的乳房。女人坏笑着，随后轻轻拍开你的手。<i>“早上好，
rows.raw: "\n\nYour question is quickly answered when you find the kitchen, and a familiar figure standing in front of what seems to be a very small stove. Evening is flipping pancakes, a plate of them already set to the side. She’s also wearing nothing but an apron. You can’t help but sneak up behind her, planting a kiss on her neck before slipping your hands under the fabric to knead her bare tits. The woman smirks before gently swatting your hands away. <i>“Morning, "

rows.original: handsome
rows.translation: 帅气的
rows.raw: "handsome"

rows.original: beautiful
rows.translation: 漂亮的
rows.raw: "beautiful"

rows.original: .” She picks up her plate and turns towards you. “Want some pancakes?” You see a fresh stack of perfectly fluffy, still steaming, golden brown pancakes topped with what looks like a healthy dose of honey. It smells divine.
rows.translation: 。”她端起盘子转向你。“想吃点煎饼吗？”你看见一摞刚出炉、蓬松完美的金棕色煎饼，上面浇着分量十足的蜂蜜。闻起来香极了。
rows.raw: ".” She picks up her plate and turns towards you. “Want some pancakes?” You see a fresh stack of perfectly fluffy, still steaming, golden brown pancakes topped with what looks like a healthy dose of honey. It smells divine. "

rows.original: Claiming the plate for yourself, you dig in with gusto, cutting off a piece of pancake and swabbing it in honey before popping it into your mouth. It might be because it’s the first thing you’ve eaten today, but tasting it is almost better than sex. Almost. “Did you make this?” you ask around your mouthful of sweet golden goodness.
rows.translation: 你接过盘子，兴致勃勃地开吃，切下一块煎饼，在蜂蜜里蘸了蘸后送入口中。也许是因为这是你今天吃的第一口东西，但它尝起来几乎比性爱还美妙。几乎。“这是你做的吗？”你满嘴香甜金黄的美味，含混地问道。
rows.raw: "\n\nClaiming the plate for yourself, you dig in with gusto, cutting off a piece of pancake and swabbing it in honey before popping it into your mouth. It might be because it’s the first thing you’ve eaten today, but tasting it is almost better than sex. Almost. “Did you make this?” you ask around your mouthful of sweet golden goodness."

rows.original: “Mmm, yes and no.” Evening plops down in the seat next to you. The way she leans forward almost exposes one of her nipples. Almost. “Dhaal doesn’t have much by way of fresh produce, so I didn’t exactly have many ingredients to work with. What I did have was pancake mix.” She laughs. “That and some Zil honey. It keeps pretty well for long trips.” Not to be left out, the woman grabs her own fork back to join in on the meal. “Tastes like home,” the Terran ruminates.
rows.translation: “嗯，算是，也不全是。”伊芙宁在你旁边的座位坐下。她前倾的姿势几乎露出一只乳头。几乎。“达尔没什么新鲜农产品，所以我手头实在没有多少材料。倒是有煎饼预拌粉。”她笑了起来。“还有一些兹尔蜂蜜。很适合长途旅行时保存。”女人拿回自己的叉子，也加入这顿饭。“有家乡的味道，”这位泰拉人若有所思地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Mmm, yes and no.” Evening plops down in the seat next to you. The way she leans forward almost exposes one of her nipples. Almost. “Dhaal doesn’t have much by way of fresh produce, so I didn’t exactly have many ingredients to work with. What I did have was pancake mix.” She laughs. “That and some Zil honey. It keeps pretty well for long trips.” Not to be left out, the woman grabs her own fork back to join in on the meal. “Tastes like home,” the Terran ruminates."

rows.original: “You got this from Terra?” Now that you think about, you haven’t been back since the Planet Rush started. The idea makes you slightly nostalgic, even though it couldn’t have been that long... could it?
rows.translation: “这是你从地球带来的？”仔细想来，自从星球淘金潮开始，你就再也没回去过。这个念头让你略感怀念，尽管时间应该没有过去太久...对吧？
rows.raw: "\n\n“You got this from Terra?” Now that you think about, you haven’t been back since the Planet Rush started. The idea makes you slightly nostalgic, even though it couldn’t have been that long... could it?"

rows.original: Then again, maybe it could...
rows.translation: 不过话说回来，也许真的过了很久...
rows.raw: " Then again, maybe it could..."

rows.original: Evening nods. “I did. I go back there every once in a while, just to... check on things. I stock up on non-perishables while I’m there, too. On any planet, really. Other than learning about how they fight and how they fuck, I think learning about a planet’s food is the best way to get to know its residents.” She gestures to the Mhen’ga product on her plate. “Case in point.”
rows.translation: 伊芙宁点点头。“去过。我偶尔会回去，只是为了...看看情况。我也会趁机补充些不易腐坏的食物。其实去任何星球都一样。除了了解当地人怎么战斗、怎么做爱之外，我觉得了解一颗星球的食物，是认识那里居民最好的办法。”她指了指盘中的门加产品。“这就是个例子。”
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening nods. “I did. I go back there every once in a while, just to... check on things. I stock up on non-perishables while I’m there, too. On any planet, really. Other than learning about how they fight and how they fuck, I think learning about a planet’s food is the best way to get to know its residents.” She gestures to the Mhen’ga product on her plate. “Case in point.”"

rows.original: Wait, so that means... “You travel across the galaxy and could take any food you want with you, but you choose pancake mix from Terra?” You shoot her a quizzical look.
rows.translation: 等等，这意味着...“你在银河系各处旅行，想带什么食物都行，却偏偏选择了地球产的煎饼粉？”你疑惑地看着她。
rows.raw: "\n\nWait, so that means... “You travel across the galaxy and could take any food you want with you, but you choose pancake mix from Terra?” You shoot her a quizzical look."

rows.original: Evening flushes ever so slightly as she struggles to answer. “Well, not always. I’m allowed to eat more than one thing! Besides, I always miss the food from there, even if I can find similar stuff on other planets. Is that weird?”
rows.translation: 伊芙宁脸颊微微泛红，一时不知该如何回答。“嗯，也不是总是这样。我又不是只能吃一种东西！再说了，就算在其他星球能找到类似的食物，我还是会想念那里的味道。这很奇怪吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening flushes ever so slightly as she struggles to answer. “Well, not always. I’m allowed to eat more than one thing! Besides, I always miss the food from there, even if I can find similar stuff on other planets. Is that weird?”"

rows.original: “A little.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A little.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, kinda.”
rows.translation: “嗯，算是吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, kinda.”"

rows.original: “Very.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Very.”"

rows.original: The woman dons an expression of exaggerated insult. “Just eat your pancakes, [pc.name].”
rows.translation: 女人摆出一副受到极大冒犯的夸张表情。“吃你的煎饼吧，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman dons an expression of exaggerated insult. “Just eat your pancakes, [pc.name].”"

rows.original: All too soon you find yourself fully clothed
rows.translation: 没过多久，你便发现自己已经穿戴整齐
rows.raw: "\n\nAll too soon you find yourself fully clothed"

rows.original: , at least as much as you can be
rows.translation: ，至少是能穿多少就穿了多少
rows.raw: ", at least as much as you can be"

rows.original: , fully fed, and standing at the airlock of The Theseus. Evening plants one last kiss on your [pc.lipsChaste] before seeing you off. “Don’t be a stranger, [pc.name]. You know where to find me.” You find yourself seriously contemplating the offer as you step out of her ship, the airlock closing behind you with a hiss. The hangar somehow feels bigger and emptier than usual.
rows.translation: ，吃得饱饱的，站在忒修斯号的气闸前。伊芙宁最后一次吻上你的[pc.lipsChaste]，随后目送你离开。“别当陌生人，[pc.name]。你知道去哪里找我。”你走出她的飞船，身后的气闸嘶嘶关闭，心里认真考虑起她的提议。机库不知为何显得比平常更大、更空旷。
rows.raw: ", fully fed, and standing at the airlock of The Theseus. Evening plants one last kiss on your [pc.lipsChaste] before seeing you off. “Don’t be a stranger, [pc.name]. You know where to find me.” You find yourself seriously contemplating the offer as you step out of her ship, the airlock closing behind you with a hiss. The hangar somehow feels bigger and emptier than usual."

rows.original: EVENING_TRUST_COUNTER
rows.raw: "EVENING_TRUST_COUNTER"

rows.original: EVENING_SEXED
rows.raw: "EVENING_SEXED"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You decide to choose something simple and challenge Evening to a game of Terran darts.
rows.translation: 你决定选个简单项目，向伊芙宁发起一局地球飞镖的挑战。
rows.raw: "You decide to choose something simple and challenge Evening to a game of Terran darts. "

rows.original: She smiles, perhaps a bit too gleefully. “You’re on!”
rows.translation: 她笑了起来，或许笑得有点过于开心。“来就来！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smiles, perhaps a bit too gleefully. “You’re on!”"

rows.original: The darts fly by just like the time. Despite Evening’s confidence, you manage to keep up with her score until the bitter end. Every time she pulls ahead in points, you close the gap with a well-placed shot. The stiff competition seems to wear her down, and every so often she starts to slip up, missing a throw by a millimeter or two. You take full advantage of this, carving out a lead of your own, but sensing her possible defeat, the Terran fights back with a tenacity that manages to let her eek out a near-tie.
rows.translation: 飞镖与时间一同飞逝。尽管伊芙宁信心十足，你的得分依旧一路紧咬，直到最后一刻。每当她拉开分差，你都会用一次精准投掷追上。激烈竞争似乎逐渐消磨了她的状态，她偶尔开始失手，投掷只偏上一两毫米。你充分抓住机会，建立起自己的领先优势，但察觉到可能落败后，这位泰拉人以顽强斗志发起反击，最终把比分追到几乎平手。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe darts fly by just like the time. Despite Evening’s confidence, you manage to keep up with her score until the bitter end. Every time she pulls ahead in points, you close the gap with a well-placed shot. The stiff competition seems to wear her down, and every so often she starts to slip up, missing a throw by a millimeter or two. You take full advantage of this, carving out a lead of your own, but sensing her possible defeat, the Terran fights back with a tenacity that manages to let her eek out a near-tie."

rows.original: By the time the last shot of the game rolls around, you’re one good score away from cinching the win. It’s just you, your dart, and the board. And Evening breathing a hurricane down your neck. She refuses to say anything, but the look on her face betrays the barest hint of stress at the possibility of you winning. More than that, the sheer anxiety rolling off of her seems to envelop you like a cold cloud, imparting a prickling sensation on your skin.
rows.translation: 等到比赛最后一镖时，你只要拿下一个好分数就能锁定胜局。只剩下你、手里的飞镖，以及靶盘。还有在你颈后呼出飓风般气息的伊芙宁。她一句话也不肯说，但脸上的神情仍泄露出一丝对你可能获胜的紧张。更甚的是，从她身上翻涌而来的焦虑仿佛冰冷云雾般笼罩着你，令皮肤泛起阵阵刺痒。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time the last shot of the game rolls around, you’re one good score away from cinching the win. It’s just you, your dart, and the board. And Evening breathing a hurricane down your neck. She refuses to say anything, but the look on her face betrays the barest hint of stress at the possibility of you winning. More than that, the sheer anxiety rolling off of her seems to envelop you like a cold cloud, imparting a prickling sensation on your skin."

rows.original: Luckily for you, you’re the one in control here. With a few practice dips, you launch your last dart and let it go...
rows.translation: 幸运的是，现在由你掌控局面。经过几次练习性的起伏动作后，你掷出最后一支飞镖，松手让它飞去...
rows.raw: "\n\nLuckily for you, you’re the one in control here. With a few practice dips, you launch your last dart and let it go..."

rows.original: Right into a bullseye.
rows.translation: 正中靶心。
rows.raw: "\n\nRight into a bullseye."

rows.original: Your opponent groans quietly, visibly deflating. “Weeeellll, shiiiieet,” Evening bemoans. “And here I thought I’d be making easy money.” A deep exhale escapes her lips while she makes the preparations to wire you your prize. “But fair’s fair. You’re pretty fucking good, Steele. Not every day I lose at darts. Guess I should think twice before challenging you so confidently, huh?” The woman laughs, then sighs, then lightly slaps the back of your shoulder. “Now if you don’t mind, I’m going to go nurse a drink. And my wounded ego.”
rows.translation: 你的对手低声呻吟，整个人明显泄了气。“好——吧，真——见鬼，”伊芙宁哀叹道。“我还以为这钱能轻松到手呢。”她深深吐出一口气，一边准备把奖金转给你。“不过愿赌服输。你飞镖玩得真他妈不错，斯蒂尔。可不是每天都有人能赢我。看来以后这么自信地挑战你之前，我得三思了，对吧？”女人笑了一声，又叹了口气，随后轻轻拍了拍你的肩背。“现在要是你不介意，我得去喝一杯，照顾一下我受伤的自尊。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour opponent groans quietly, visibly deflating. “Weeeellll, shiiiieet,” Evening bemoans. “And here I thought I’d be making easy money.” A deep exhale escapes her lips while she makes the preparations to wire you your prize. “But fair’s fair. You’re pretty fucking good, Steele. Not every day I lose at darts. Guess I should think twice before challenging you so confidently, huh?” The woman laughs, then sighs, then lightly slaps the back of your shoulder. “Now if you don’t mind, I’m going to go nurse a drink. And my wounded ego.”"

rows.original: The darts fly by just like the time. While you don’t put up too bad a fight, Evening’s score seems just out of reach round after round, and her cheshire grin grows all the wider with each passing shot. While she never outstrips you by too much, the possibility of you catching up gradually starts to diminish as the game wears on.
rows.translation: 飞镖与时间一同飞逝。你的表现虽然不算太差，但伊芙宁的分数一轮又一轮始终遥不可及，她那猫一般的笑容也随着每次投掷变得越发灿烂。她从未把你甩开太远，可随着比赛推进，你追上的可能性还是渐渐消失。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe darts fly by just like the time. While you don’t put up too bad a fight, Evening’s score seems just out of reach round after round, and her cheshire grin grows all the wider with each passing shot. While she never outstrips you by too much, the possibility of you catching up gradually starts to diminish as the game wears on."

rows.original: Maybe you shouldn’t have picked this game knowing how good her aim was already...
rows.translation: 也许你早知道她枪法这么好，就不该选择这个游戏...
rows.raw: " Maybe you shouldn’t have picked this game knowing how good her aim was already..."

rows.original: Eventually, the last shot of the game rolls around. It’s Evening’s turn, and although it’s pretty obvious she’s won already, the woman tries to conceal her smugness while she hits one last bullseye. It doesn’t quite work, but at least she attempted to hide it.
rows.translation: 最终，比赛来到最后一镖。轮到伊芙宁出手，虽然她显然已经赢了，女人还是试图掩饰得意，随后再次正中靶心。她掩饰得不太成功，不过至少努力过了。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, the last shot of the game rolls around. It’s Evening’s turn, and although it’s pretty obvious she’s won already, the woman tries to conceal her smugness while she hits one last bullseye. It doesn’t quite work, but at least she attempted to hide it."

rows.original: “Chin up, [pc.name]!” she chirps when you deflate at your loss. “You put on a pretty good show considering it was me you were up against.
rows.translation: “振作点，[pc.name]！”你因落败而泄气时，她轻快地说道。“考虑到你的对手是我，你的表现已经很不错了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Chin up, [pc.name]!” she chirps when you deflate at your loss. “You put on a pretty good show considering it was me you were up against."

rows.original: Hell, it was pretty brave to go toe to toe with me in the first place.
rows.translation: 能一开始就敢跟我正面对决，已经非常勇敢了。
rows.raw: " Hell, it was pretty brave to go toe to toe with me in the first place."

rows.original: Who knows, maybe you’ll get lucky next time? If there is a next time. Until then...”
rows.translation: 谁知道呢，也许下次你会走运？如果真有下次的话。在那之前...”
rows.raw: " Who knows, maybe you’ll get lucky next time? If there is a next time. Until then...”"

rows.original: Her grin doesn’t falter, however, and Evening is soon rubbing her fingers together in a universal gesture for currency. You wire her the amount, albeit glumly.
rows.translation: 不过她脸上的笑容丝毫未减，很快便搓起手指，做出全宇宙通用的要钱手势。你闷闷不乐地把相应数额转给了她。
rows.raw: "\n\nHer grin doesn’t falter, however, and Evening is soon rubbing her fingers together in a universal gesture for currency. You wire her the amount, albeit glumly."

rows.original: “Thaaaaank you,” the victor coos. “Now if you don’t mind me, I have some drinking money to spend!” She shoots you a devilish smile. “Come by, if you want. I’ll buy you a shot.”
rows.translation: “谢——谢你，”胜利者柔声说道。“现在要是你不介意，我要去花掉新到手的酒钱了！”她朝你露出恶魔般的笑容。“想来的话就过来。我请你喝一杯。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thaaaaank you,” the victor coos. “Now if you don’t mind me, I have some drinking money to spend!” She shoots you a devilish smile. “Come by, if you want. I’ll buy you a shot.”"

rows.original: The darts fly by just like the time. While Evening hits bullseye after bullseye, your throwing game is not quite so impeccable. There are certain areas you’re supposed to hit to score more points, like the center of the dartboard... or even any part of the dartboard itself, but somehow your hand-eye coordination isn’t getting the message. After your fifth, perhaps sixth miss in a row, Evening looks over to you with poorly concealed concern. “You uh, okay there, [pc.name]? Didn’t have too much to drink, did you?”
rows.translation: 飞镖与时间一同飞逝。伊芙宁一镖接一镖命中靶心，你的投掷却远没有那么精准。有些位置能拿到更高分，比如靶盘中心...或者哪怕靶盘上的任何地方，可你的手眼协调显然没收到消息。在你连续第五次、也许第六次脱靶后，伊芙宁看向你，脸上勉强掩饰着担忧。“你，呃，还好吗，[pc.name]？没喝太多吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe darts fly by just like the time. While Evening hits bullseye after bullseye, your throwing game is not quite so impeccable. There are certain areas you’re supposed to hit to score more points, like the center of the dartboard... or even any part of the dartboard itself, but somehow your hand-eye coordination isn’t getting the message. After your fifth, perhaps sixth miss in a row, Evening looks over to you with poorly concealed concern. “You uh, okay there, [pc.name]? Didn’t have too much to drink, did you?”"

rows.original: Oh, come on. You can’t be doing that badly... You check the hardlight projected scoreboard.
rows.translation: 拜托。你不可能表现得那么糟吧...你看向硬光投射出的计分板。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh, come on. You can’t be doing that badly... You check the hardlight projected scoreboard. "

rows.original: Oh. You are doing that badly.
rows.translation: 哦。你确实表现得那么糟。
rows.raw: "\n\nOh. You are doing that badly."

rows.original: “Hey, hey, timeout,” Evening proposes, arms crossed in the universal sign for surrender. “How about we forget the game, and I just give you some pointers? I... really don’t feel too good about taking credits from you this way..” She smiles at you, albeit sheepishly.
rows.translation: “嘿，嘿，暂停，”伊芙宁提议道，双臂交叉，摆出全宇宙通用的投降手势。“要不我们别比了，我直接教你几招？我...用这种方式赢走你的信用点，心里实在过意不去..”她有些不好意思地朝你笑笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, hey, timeout,” Evening proposes, arms crossed in the universal sign for surrender. “How about we forget the game, and I just give you some pointers? I... really don’t feel too good about taking credits from you this way..” She smiles at you, albeit sheepishly."

rows.original: Well, it’s a bit humiliating, but you don’t exactly have an excuse to say no.
rows.translation: 好吧，虽然有点丢脸，但你确实找不到拒绝的理由。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, it’s a bit humiliating, but you don’t exactly have an excuse to say no."

rows.original: Several helpful dart tips later...
rows.translation: 在获得几条实用的飞镖技巧之后...
rows.raw: "\n\nSeveral helpful dart tips later..."

rows.original: You wish Evening a good... evening, as she wanders off to get a drink. “Come by later; I’ll treat you,” she promises. Your ego is more than a little bruised, but at least you feel like your aim has improved somewhat.
rows.translation: 你祝伊芙宁度过一个愉快的...夜晚，看着她晃悠着去找酒喝。“晚点过来，我请客，”她保证道。你的自尊受了不小的打击，但至少感觉自己的准头多少有所提升。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wish Evening a good... evening, as she wanders off to get a drink. “Come by later; I’ll treat you,” she promises. Your ego is more than a little bruised, but at least you feel like your aim has improved somewhat."

rows.original: aim
rows.raw: "aim"

rows.original: CL_DARTS_PLAYED
rows.raw: "CL_DARTS_PLAYED"

rows.original: EVENING_PLAYED_DARTS
rows.raw: "EVENING_PLAYED_DARTS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You decide to choose something a bit more mentally stimulating and challenge Evening to a game of Gryvain darts. She winces ever so slightly, though she doesn’t back down. “Ooh. I gotta admit, this one is a bit tough for me,” the woman confesses. “But I’m not one to back down from a challenge. Bring it on, [pc.name]!”
rows.translation: 你决定选一种更考验脑力的玩法，向伊芙宁发起格里文飞镖挑战。她微微缩了缩，却没有退让。“哦。得承认，这个对我来说有点难，”女人坦白道。“不过我可不会临阵退缩。放马过来吧，[pc.name]！”
rows.raw: "You decide to choose something a bit more mentally stimulating and challenge Evening to a game of Gryvain darts. She winces ever so slightly, though she doesn’t back down. “Ooh. I gotta admit, this one is a bit tough for me,” the woman confesses. “But I’m not one to back down from a challenge. Bring it on, [pc.name]!”"

rows.original: What happens next is a flurry of darts and lights. You and Evening start off slow, carefully sussing out angles and trajectories, but as the time constraints tighten and your scores both climb higher, the game quickly devolves into a frenzy of throwing and shouting.
rows.translation: 接下来是一阵飞镖与灯光的狂舞。你和伊芙宁起初动作缓慢，小心判断角度和轨迹，但随着时间限制收紧、双方得分不断上升，比赛很快演变成疯狂的投掷与叫喊。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat happens next is a flurry of darts and lights. You and Evening start off slow, carefully sussing out angles and trajectories, but as the time constraints tighten and your scores both climb higher, the game quickly devolves into a frenzy of throwing and shouting."

rows.original: While you manage to keep track of your shots with ease, Evening is not so lucky, and more than once she ends up throwing a dart out of bounds. Or into a bargoer’s drink.
rows.translation: 你轻松记住了自己的每次投掷，伊芙宁却没那么走运；她不止一次把飞镖扔出界外，或者扎进某位酒客的饮料里。
rows.raw: " While you manage to keep track of your shots with ease, Evening is not so lucky, and more than once she ends up throwing a dart out of bounds. Or into a bargoer’s drink."

rows.original: You struggle to keep up with your score and your shots, but Evening doesn’t seem to be doing much better than you. Multiple times you mistake your own dart for hers, and vice versa.
rows.translation: 你勉强兼顾自己的分数和投掷，但伊芙宁看起来也没比你好多少。你有好几次把自己的飞镖错认成她的，反之亦然。
rows.raw: " You struggle to keep up with your score and your shots, but Evening doesn’t seem to be doing much better than you. Multiple times you mistake your own dart for hers, and vice versa."

rows.original: There’s no way to pussyfoot around it: it turns into a shitshow. Keeping up with that many targets and scores gets the best of you, and Evening only does marginally better. At one point, you see a glass get thrown. You’re not sure if you’re the one who threw it or her.
rows.translation: 这事没法委婉形容：场面彻底乱成了一锅粥。要同时盯住那么多目标和分数，让你焦头烂额，伊芙宁也只比你稍好一点。有一刻，你甚至看见一只玻璃杯飞了出去。你不确定那是自己扔的，还是她扔的。
rows.raw: " There’s no way to pussyfoot around it: it turns into a shitshow. Keeping up with that many targets and scores gets the best of you, and Evening only does marginally better. At one point, you see a glass get thrown. You’re not sure if you’re the one who threw it or her."

rows.original: Eventually, the metaphorical dust clears. With the both of you out of darts, you both whip your head in unison to read out the final scores.
rows.translation: 最终，比喻意义上的尘埃落定。你们两人的飞镖都已用尽，于是不约而同地猛然转头查看最终分数。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, the metaphorical dust clears. With the both of you out of darts, you both whip your head in unison to read out the final scores."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: It’s your win.
rows.translation: 是你赢了。
rows.raw: "It’s your win."

rows.original: “Ffffffffffffffuck.” Evening groans, deep and low. Her hand rubs the back of her neck in the posture of defeat. “I should have known letting you pick would be a bad idea. I’m not the greatest with physics on the fly. Or trigonometry. Or adding numbers.”
rows.translation: “操————————。”伊芙宁发出低沉而深长的呻吟。她以落败的姿态揉着后颈。“早该知道让你选准没好事。我真的不擅长临场算物理。三角学也不行。加法也不行。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ffffffffffffffuck.” Evening groans, deep and low. Her hand rubs the back of her neck in the posture of defeat. “I should have known letting you pick would be a bad idea. I’m not the greatest with physics on the fly. Or trigonometry. Or adding numbers.”"

rows.original: A deep exhale escapes her lips while she makes the preparations to wire you your prize. “But fair’s fair. Guess I should think twice before challenging you so confidently, huh? At the very least, maybe I shouldn’t let you choose!” The woman laughs, then sighs, then lightly slaps the back of your shoulder. “Now if you don’t mind, I’m going to go nurse a drink and my wounded ego.”
rows.translation: 她深深吐出一口气，一边准备把奖金转给你。“不过愿赌服输。看来下次这么自信地挑战你之前，我得三思了，对吧？至少，也许不该再让你选！”女人笑了一声，又叹了口气，随后轻轻拍了拍你的肩背。“现在要是你不介意，我得去喝一杯，照顾一下我受伤的自尊。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA deep exhale escapes her lips while she makes the preparations to wire you your prize. “But fair’s fair. Guess I should think twice before challenging you so confidently, huh? At the very least, maybe I shouldn’t let you choose!” The woman laughs, then sighs, then lightly slaps the back of your shoulder. “Now if you don’t mind, I’m going to go nurse a drink and my wounded ego.”"

rows.original: It’s Evening’s win.
rows.translation: 是伊芙宁赢了。
rows.raw: "It’s Evening’s win."

rows.original: “Oooooh.” She almost seems surprised to discover her victory. “I’m gonna be honest, I wasn’t sure if I was going to win. This game is not my forte. I guess I really am that good,” the woman laughs, half boasting and half unconvinced that she didn’t just get lucky.
rows.translation: “哦——。”她似乎连自己获胜都感到意外。“老实说，我之前真不确定能不能赢。这个游戏不是我的强项。看来我确实厉害，”女人笑道，一半是在吹嘘，一半仍不相信自己不是纯靠运气。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oooooh.” She almost seems surprised to discover her victory. “I’m gonna be honest, I wasn’t sure if I was going to win. This game is not my forte. I guess I really am that good,” the woman laughs, half boasting and half unconvinced that she didn’t just get lucky."

rows.original: You congratulate her, although somewhat dismally, before wiring her the promised credits. “Chin up, [pc.name]!” she tries to console you. “Come over and see me at the bar. I’ll buy you a drink.”
rows.translation: 你多少有些沮丧地向她道贺，随后把答应的信用点转了过去。“振作点，[pc.name]！”她试着安慰你。“来酒吧找我吧。我请你喝一杯。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou congratulate her, although somewhat dismally, before wiring her the promised credits. “Chin up, [pc.name]!” she tries to console you. “Come over and see me at the bar. I’ll buy you a drink.”"

rows.original: CL_DARTS_PLAYED
rows.raw: "CL_DARTS_PLAYED"

rows.original: EVENING_PLAYED_DARTS
rows.raw: "EVENING_PLAYED_DARTS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You decide to choose something a bit more exciting and challenge Evening to a game of Zaika darts. Her eyebrows raise. “Haven’t played this one a lot,” she confesses. “But it looks like fun. You’re on, [pc.name]!”
rows.translation: 你决定选一种更刺激的玩法，向伊芙宁发起扎伊卡飞镖挑战。她扬起眉毛。“这个我没玩过几次，”她坦白道。“不过看着挺有意思。来吧，[pc.name]！”
rows.raw: "You decide to choose something a bit more exciting and challenge Evening to a game of Zaika darts. Her eyebrows raise. “Haven’t played this one a lot,” she confesses. “But it looks like fun. You’re on, [pc.name]!”"

rows.original: What follows is a high-octane race against time and each other. Your single shared target quickly multiplies to two, then three, then four. While the targets start off changing shape and color every few seconds, the speed at which they cycle through their forms quickly accelerates. Eventually, they begin to change so quickly your eyes can barely keep up with them. Some are projected front and center, while others crop up to your left or right.
rows.translation: 接下来是一场你们相互竞争、也与时间赛跑的高速竞赛。唯一的共享目标很快变成两个、三个、四个。起初，目标每隔几秒才改变一次形状和颜色，但变换速度迅速加快。最终，它们快得让你的眼睛几乎跟不上。有些投影在正前方，有些则突然出现在左右两侧。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhat follows is a high-octane race against time and each other. Your single shared target quickly multiplies to two, then three, then four. While the targets start off changing shape and color every few seconds, the speed at which they cycle through their forms quickly accelerates. Eventually, they begin to change so quickly your eyes can barely keep up with them. Some are projected front and center, while others crop up to your left or right."

rows.original: You and Evening start off timing each shot with care, only for the game to devolve into the two of you whipping dart after dart at the targets in a frenzy. It’s no longer a game: it is a war. Not necessarily against each other, but against the projector as it taunts you both with its increasingly smaller windows of opportunity. The blue targets begin to shrink, while the red ones start to inflate to cartoonishly large proportions.
rows.translation: 你和伊芙宁起初还小心把握每次出手的时机，随后游戏便演变成两人疯狂地朝目标一镖接一镖投去。它已经不再是游戏，而是战争。未必是彼此之间的战争，而是你们共同对抗投影仪，因为它不断缩短机会窗口，肆意嘲弄你们。蓝色目标开始缩小，红色目标却膨胀到卡通般夸张的尺寸。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou and Evening start off timing each shot with care, only for the game to devolve into the two of you whipping dart after dart at the targets in a frenzy. It’s no longer a game: it is a war. Not necessarily against each other, but against the projector as it taunts you both with its increasingly smaller windows of opportunity. The blue targets begin to shrink, while the red ones start to inflate to cartoonishly large proportions."

rows.original: You’re so focused you don’t even glance at the scoreboard until you throw a dart, only to realize that your hand is already empty. Evening, panting beside you, is also fresh out of ammo. Your eyes slide across the many materialized boards, now littered with projectiles, before looking at the scoreboard.
rows.translation: 你全神贯注，直到投出一镖、却发现手里早已空空如也时，甚至都没看一眼计分板。身旁气喘吁吁的伊芙宁也把飞镖用光了。你的视线扫过众多已经实体化、如今插满飞镖的靶盘，最后望向计分板。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re so focused you don’t even glance at the scoreboard until you throw a dart, only to realize that your hand is already empty. Evening, panting beside you, is also fresh out of ammo. Your eyes slide across the many materialized boards, now littered with projectiles, before looking at the scoreboard."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You’ve eked out Evening’s score by an inch.
rows.translation: 你以微弱优势险胜伊芙宁。
rows.raw: "You’ve eked out Evening’s score by an inch."

rows.original: “Damn,” your opponent swears as you whoop in adrenaline-fueled victory. “You gave me a run for my money, Steele!” While she rubs the back of her neck in a posture of defeat, the smile on her face is undeniably genuine. “Shit, a loss is a loss, but I haven’t had that much fun getting my ass beat in ages.” The woman laughs as she wires you your hard-earned spoils. “Don’t spend it all in one place, okay? Or course, if you want to treat me to a drink to celebrate, I wouldn’t say no.”
rows.translation: “该死，”你的对手骂道，而你则在肾上腺素驱动的胜利中欢呼。“你真让我费了好大劲，斯蒂尔！”她以落败的姿态揉着后颈，但脸上的笑容无疑十分真诚。“妈的，输了就是输了，不过我已经好多年没被人揍得这么开心了。”女人笑着把你辛苦赢来的奖金转给你。“别一次全花光，好吗？当然，要是你想请我喝一杯庆祝，我可不会拒绝。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Damn,” your opponent swears as you whoop in adrenaline-fueled victory. “You gave me a run for my money, Steele!” While she rubs the back of her neck in a posture of defeat, the smile on her face is undeniably genuine. “Shit, a loss is a loss, but I haven’t had that much fun getting my ass beat in ages.” The woman laughs as she wires you your hard-earned spoils. “Don’t spend it all in one place, okay? Or course, if you want to treat me to a drink to celebrate, I wouldn’t say no.”"

rows.original: Evening’s score is just a few points higher than yours. So close!
rows.translation: 伊芙宁只比你高了几分。真可惜！
rows.raw: "Evening’s score is just a few points higher than yours. So close!"

rows.original: Your opponent whoops in adrenaline-fueled glee before slapping you on the back of the shoulder. “Shit, that was close!” she says breathlessly. “You gave me a run for my money there! I mean, technically I, gave you a run for your money,” she says with a smirk, rubbing her fingers together in a universal gesture for currency, “but that was pretty fucking fun either way.”
rows.translation: 你的对手在肾上腺素驱动的兴奋中欢呼，随后拍了拍你的肩背。“妈的，真险！”她上气不接下气地说道。“你可让我费了好大劲！我是说，严格来讲，是我让你花了好大一笔钱，”她坏笑着搓搓手指，做出全宇宙通用的金钱手势，“但不管怎么说，这都真他妈好玩。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour opponent whoops in adrenaline-fueled glee before slapping you on the back of the shoulder. “Shit, that was close!” she says breathlessly. “You gave me a run for my money there! I mean, technically I, gave you a run for your money,” she says with a smirk, rubbing her fingers together in a universal gesture for currency, “but that was pretty fucking fun either way.”"

rows.original: Equally exalted, you wire her the credits but don’t feel particularly torn up about the loss. Evening is right. That was pretty fun.
rows.translation: 你同样兴致高昂地把信用点转给她，对这次失败倒没有多难过。伊芙宁说得对，这确实很好玩。
rows.raw: "\n\nEqually exalted, you wire her the credits but don’t feel particularly torn up about the loss. Evening is right. That was pretty fun."

rows.original: “Whelp. I’m off to spend my newfound drinking money!” The woman shoots you a cheshire grin. “Come over if you want. I’ll buy you a drink! Least I can do for the best game I’ve had in ages.”
rows.translation: “好啦，我要去花新赚到的酒钱了！”女人朝你露出猫一般的笑容。“想来的话就过来。我请你喝一杯！这是我好多年来玩得最好的一局，至少也该这么谢你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whelp. I’m off to spend my newfound drinking money!” The woman shoots you a cheshire grin. “Come over if you want. I’ll buy you a drink! Least I can do for the best game I’ve had in ages.”"

rows.original: CL_DARTS_PLAYED
rows.raw: "CL_DARTS_PLAYED"

rows.original: EVENING_PLAYED_DARTS
rows.raw: "EVENING_PLAYED_DARTS"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “I think I want to hold onto my winning streak for now,” you ultimately decide.
rows.translation: “我想暂时保住自己的连胜纪录，”你最终决定。
rows.raw: "“I think I want to hold onto my winning streak for now,” you ultimately decide."

rows.original: “Fffffffffffffine,” Evening relents with a pout. “But come back if you change your mind, okay?” The competitive spirit in her hasn’t died down yet, and she clearly thrums with the energy of someone itching for a rematch. You leave her behind nonetheless, returning to the bar area.
rows.translation: “好————吧，”伊芙宁撅着嘴让步了。“不过要是改变主意，一定回来，好吗？”她的好胜心显然还没熄灭，整个人都因渴望再战而充满活力。尽管如此，你还是把她留在原地，回到了酒吧区域。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fffffffffffffine,” Evening relents with a pout. “But come back if you change your mind, okay?” The competitive spirit in her hasn’t died down yet, and she clearly thrums with the energy of someone itching for a rematch. You leave her behind nonetheless, returning to the bar area."

rows.original: “I think I’ll leave getting my ass whooped again for another day,” you ultimately decide.
rows.translation: “我想还是改天再来挨一次痛打吧，”你最终决定。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I think I’ll leave getting my ass whooped again for another day,” you ultimately decide."

rows.original: “Pity,” Evening sighs in practiced disappointment. “Come back if you change your mind, okay?” With no opponent, she wanders off dejectedly.
rows.translation: “真可惜，”伊芙宁用熟练的失望语气叹道。“改变主意就回来，好吗？”没了对手，她沮丧地走开了。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Pity,” Evening sighs in practiced disappointment. “Come back if you change your mind, okay?” With no opponent, she wanders off dejectedly."

rows.original: You confess to Evening that you’ve changed your mind; you don’t feel like playing right now.
rows.translation: 你向伊芙宁坦白自己改了主意，现在不想玩。
rows.raw: "You confess to Evening that you’ve changed your mind; you don’t feel like playing right now."

rows.original: “Really? Bummer,” she sighs in practiced disappointment. “Come back if you change your mind, okay?”
rows.translation: “真的？真扫兴，”她用熟练的失望语气叹道。“改变主意就回来，好吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Really? Bummer,” she sighs in practiced disappointment. “Come back if you change your mind, okay?”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: A human woman sits in the corner of the bar nursing a glass of cream liquor. Her eyes sift over the rest of the occupants in a slightly suspicious manner. She locks eyes with you, just for half a second, before looking away.
rows.translation: 一名黑发人类女子坐在酒吧角落，慢慢啜饮着一杯奶油利口酒。她略带怀疑地扫视着其他客人。她与你目光相接，只有短短半秒，随后便移开视线。
rows.raw: "\n\nA human woman sits in the corner of the bar nursing a glass of cream liquor. Her eyes sift over the rest of the occupants in a slightly suspicious manner. She locks eyes with you, just for half a second, before looking away."

rows.original: Evening is reclining against the bar at her usual spot, lazily resuming her people-watching.
rows.translation: 伊芙宁像往常一样斜倚在吧台边，懒洋洋地继续观察人群。
rows.raw: "\n\nEvening is reclining against the bar at her usual spot, lazily resuming her people-watching."

rows.original: You make a beeline for the woman with the shifty eyes. With the way she’d been surveilling the place, it doesn’t take long for her to notice your approach. The instant she does, her gaze locks onto you, a sly smile slipping onto her lips. Despite her interest in the rest of the room, it seems you now have her full attention.
rows.translation: 你径直走向那个眼神躲闪的女人。她一直在监视整个地方，自然很快便注意到你在靠近。发现你的那一刻，她的目光立刻锁定在你身上，嘴角浮现出狡黠笑容。尽管她先前一直关注房间里的其他人，现在看来，你已经占据了她全部注意力。
rows.raw: "You make a beeline for the woman with the shifty eyes. With the way she’d been surveilling the place, it doesn’t take long for her to notice your approach. The instant she does, her gaze locks onto you, a sly smile slipping onto her lips. Despite her interest in the rest of the room, it seems you now have her full attention."

rows.original: “Sorry, I didn’t creep you out or anything, did I?” She definitely noticed you noticing her. “I like to people-watch. Didn’t mean to raise any alarms. Usually no one even realizes I’m doing it.” Her voice is a little more girlish and higher-pitched than you expected, sounding a bit too innocent for someone who initially looked so suspect.
rows.translation: “抱歉，我没吓到你什么的吧？”她显然发现你注意到了她。“我喜欢观察别人。不是故意让你警觉。通常根本没人发现我在这么做。”她的声音比你预想得更少女、更尖细，对于一个最初看起来如此可疑的人而言，显得过于天真。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sorry, I didn’t creep you out or anything, did I?” She definitely noticed you noticing her. “I like to people-watch. Didn’t mean to raise any alarms. Usually no one even realizes I’m doing it.” Her voice is a little more girlish and higher-pitched than you expected, sounding a bit too innocent for someone who initially looked so suspect."

rows.original: You wave the issue away, already forgotten. No harm done.
rows.translation: 你挥挥手表示不必在意，早已把这件事抛在脑后。没造成伤害就好。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wave the issue away, already forgotten. No harm done."

rows.original: You pretend to think about it for a second before shrugging. It doesn’t sound like she’s doing any harm.
rows.translation: 你假装思考了一会儿，随后耸耸肩。听起来她并没有造成什么伤害。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pretend to think about it for a second before shrugging. It doesn’t sound like she’s doing any harm."

rows.original: You decide not to broach the subject further for now, but still narrow your eyes at her. You’ll be on the lookout for any funny business.
rows.translation: 你决定暂时不再追问，但仍眯起眼睛盯着她。你会留意她有没有搞什么鬼。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou decide not to broach the subject further for now, but still narrow your eyes at her. You’ll be on the lookout for any funny business."

rows.original: “So, what’s your name? I promise, I tend to gawk at people a little less when I can put a name to a face.”
rows.translation: “所以，你叫什么名字？我保证，只要能把名字和脸对上，我盯着别人看的次数通常会少一点。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So, what’s your name? I promise, I tend to gawk at people a little less when I can put a name to a face.”"

rows.original: “It’s Steele. [pc.name] Steele.”
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔。[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s Steele. [pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: The woman nods. “Evening.”
rows.translation: 女人点点头。“伊芙宁。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman nods. “Evening.”"

rows.original: You nod back, though it’s strange that she said that just now. “Good evening?” After all, in this city it always feels like the same time of day.
rows.translation: 你也点头回应，不过她现在才这么说有点奇怪。“晚上好？”毕竟在这座城市里，感觉永远都是同一个时刻。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod back, though it’s strange that she said that just now. “Good evening?” After all, in this city it always feels like the same time of day."

rows.original: The woman giggles in response. “No, that’s my name. Evening Everly, at your service.” Evening leans forward as far as she can go in her seat in a half-bow. “Was there something you wanted? A hire? A drinking buddy? I hope you didn’t just come over because you were worried that I was some kind of lunatic planning to kidnap you and sell you off as a milk slave.” She cocks her head to the side. “Which I’m not.”
rows.translation: 女人咯咯笑着回应。“不，那就是我的名字。伊芙宁·埃弗莉，愿为你效劳。”伊芙宁坐在椅子上尽可能前倾，半鞠了一躬。“你有什么需要吗？想雇人？找酒友？希望你不是因为担心我是某种疯子，正计划绑架你、把你卖去当产奶奴隶，才特意过来的。”她歪了歪头。“我不是。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman giggles in response. “No, that’s my name. Evening Everly, at your service.” Evening leans forward as far as she can go in her seat in a half-bow. “Was there something you wanted? A hire? A drinking buddy? I hope you didn’t just come over because you were worried that I was some kind of lunatic planning to kidnap you and sell you off as a milk slave.” She cocks her head to the side. “Which I’m not.”"

rows.original: That was one questionably long pause...
rows.translation: 这段停顿长得很可疑...
rows.raw: "\n\nThat was one questionably long pause..."

rows.original: “I’m not!”
rows.translation: “我才没有！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’m not!”"

rows.original: You head right for Evening’s seat, and she flashes a toothy grin at you as you slide into the spot next to her. “Back for more, huh?” The woman chuckles, her eyes glinting. “Not that I blame you. I am an exceedingly interesting person.”
rows.translation: 你径直走向伊芙宁的座位，在你滑进她旁边的位置时，她朝你咧嘴露出一口牙。“又来找我了，嗯？”女人轻笑着，眼中闪着光。“不过也不能怪你。我这个人确实非常有趣。”
rows.raw: "You head right for Evening’s seat, and she flashes a toothy grin at you as you slide into the spot next to her. “Back for more, huh?” The woman chuckles, her eyes glinting. “Not that I blame you. I am an exceedingly interesting person.”"

rows.original: You head right for Evening’s seat, and her eyebrows raise as she looks you up and down. “You look a little different, [pc.name]... did you change your hair?” The woman laughs, not taking her bad joke very seriously. “So, back for more, huh? Not that I blame you. I am an exceedingly interesting person.”
rows.translation: 你径直走向伊芙宁的座位，她上下打量着你，扬起眉毛。“你看起来有点不一样，[pc.name]...换发型了？”女人笑了起来，显然没把这个烂笑话当真。“所以，又来找我了？不过也不能怪你。我这个人确实非常有趣。”
rows.raw: "You head right for Evening’s seat, and her eyebrows raise as she looks you up and down. “You look a little different, [pc.name]... did you change your hair?” The woman laughs, not taking her bad joke very seriously. “So, back for more, huh? Not that I blame you. I am an exceedingly interesting person.”"

rows.original: You head right for Evening’s seat, only to see her expression falter as she quickly catches on to the fact that something’s different about you. She’s definitely noticed that you’ve made some changes. Extensive ones. Knowing her, she wouldn’t approve... but the Terran says nothing about the subject, and quickly turns to you with a friendly, if pensive smile. “So, back for more, huh? Not that I blame you. I am an exceedingly interesting person.”
rows.translation: 你径直走向伊芙宁的座位，却看见她的表情微微一僵，很快便察觉你身上有什么不同。她显然注意到你做出了一些改变，而且改得很彻底。以她的性格，她不会赞同...但这位泰拉人对此只字不提，很快转向你，露出友好却若有所思的笑容。“所以，又来找我了？不过也不能怪你。我这个人确实非常有趣。”
rows.raw: "You head right for Evening’s seat, only to see her expression falter as she quickly catches on to the fact that something’s different about you. She’s definitely noticed that you’ve made some changes. Extensive ones. Knowing her, she wouldn’t approve... but the Terran says nothing about the subject, and quickly turns to you with a friendly, if pensive smile. “So, back for more, huh? Not that I blame you. I am an exceedingly interesting person.”"

rows.original: “Came to get that drink you promised me,” you reply.
rows.translation: “来喝你答应请我的那杯酒，”你回答。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Came to get that drink you promised me,” you reply."

rows.original: The woman raises her eyebrows. “So you did.” She quickly flags down
rows.translation: 女人扬起眉毛。“还真是。”她迅速招呼来
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman raises her eyebrows. “So you did.” She quickly flags down "

rows.original: Monika
rows.translation: 莫妮卡
rows.raw: "Monika"

rows.original: the bartender
rows.translation: 酒保
rows.raw: "the bartender"

rows.original: and orders you a shot. “Cheers!”
rows.translation: ，给你点了一杯烈酒。“干杯！”
rows.raw: " and orders you a shot. “Cheers!” "

rows.original: You clink glasses in a celebratory motion. As you gulp the alcohol down, Evening props her chin up on her hands to look at you. “So, what else can I do you for? Surely you didn’t come over just for the free drink.”
rows.translation: 你们举杯相碰庆祝。你一口喝下酒时，伊芙宁双手托着下巴看向你。“那么，我还能为你做些什么？你肯定不是只为了这杯免费酒才来的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou clink glasses in a celebratory motion. As you gulp the alcohol down, Evening props her chin up on her hands to look at you. “So, what else can I do you for? Surely you didn’t come over just for the free drink.”"

rows.original: Appearance
rows.translation: 外貌
rows.raw: "Appearance"

rows.original: Talk
rows.translation: 交谈
rows.raw: "Talk"

rows.original: Stories
rows.translation: 故事
rows.raw: "Stories"

rows.original: You’re in the mood to have a good time, no strings attached. Ordering a drink for yourself and Evening, you ask the mercenary if she has any fun stories to tell you, and if she wants to get roaring drunk in the process.
rows.translation: 你想痛痛快快玩一场，不附带任何条件。你给自己和伊芙宁各点了一杯酒，问这位佣兵有没有什么有趣的故事愿意讲，也问她想不想边讲边喝个酩酊大醉。
rows.raw: "You’re in the mood to have a good time, no strings attached. Ordering a drink for yourself and Evening, you ask the mercenary if she has any fun stories to tell you, and if she wants to get roaring drunk in the process."

rows.original: The prospect lights her eyes up in delight. “Hell yeah! I thought you’d never ask.”
rows.translation: 这个提议让她喜上眉梢。“太好了！我还以为你永远不会问呢。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe prospect lights her eyes up in delight. “Hell yeah! I thought you’d never ask.”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一个
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Drinking Stories
rows.translation: 酒桌故事
rows.raw: "Drinking Stories"

rows.original: Ask Evening if she knows any good stories, preferably ones that pair well with alcohol.
rows.translation: 问问伊芙宁是否知道什么好故事，最好是适合配酒听的。
rows.raw: "Ask Evening if she knows any good stories, preferably ones that pair well with alcohol."

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: You’ll need some equipment to even ask...
rows.translation: 要开这个口，你还得有些装备...
rows.raw: "You’ll need some equipment to even ask..."

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: You lean in close to Evening and
rows.translation: 你凑近伊芙宁，
rows.raw: "You lean in close to Evening and"

rows.original: drunkenly admit that you want sum fuk. Who says the direct approach never works? Not you; you’re hella drunk.
rows.translation: 醉醺醺地承认自己想来一炮。谁说直来直去不管用？反正你没说；你已经醉得不行了。
rows.raw: " drunkenly admit that you want sum fuk. Who says the direct approach never works? Not you; you’re hella drunk."

rows.original: ask if she wants to do something a little more fun than darts or dancing.
rows.translation: 问她想不想做点比飞镖或跳舞更有趣的事。
rows.raw: " ask if she wants to do something a little more fun than darts or dancing."

rows.original: Immediately, she purses her lips and puts both hands on your shoulders, an apologetic look on her face. Not a good sign. <i>“Friend, I don’t know how to tell you this gently... but I don’t fuck
rows.translation: 她立刻抿起嘴唇，双手按在你肩上，脸上满是歉意。不是好兆头。<i>“朋友，我不知道该怎么委婉地告诉你...但我不和
rows.raw: "\n\nImmediately, she purses her lips and puts both hands on your shoulders, an apologetic look on her face. Not a good sign. <i>“Friend, I don’t know how to tell you this gently... but I don’t fuck"

rows.original: horse
rows.translation: 马
rows.raw: " horse"

rows.original: snake
rows.translation: 蛇形生物
rows.raw: " snake"

rows.original: goo
rows.translation: 胶质
rows.raw: " goo"

rows.original: people.”
rows.translation: 人做爱。”
rows.raw: " people.”"

rows.original: “Even though we’ve already-”
rows.translation: “可我们明明已经——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Even though we’ve already-”"

rows.original: “Yyyyup.” She doesn’t even let you finish your sentence.
rows.translation: “对啊。”她根本没让你把话说完。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yyyyup.” She doesn’t even let you finish your sentence."

rows.original: Ouch. She’s right; that wasn’t gentle at all. For her part, Evening gives you a gentle pat of consolation before shooting you a sheepish smile.
rows.translation: 嘶。她说得没错；这可一点都不委婉。伊芙宁倒是轻轻拍了拍你以示安慰，随后露出一个略显尴尬的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nOuch. She’s right; that wasn’t gentle at all. For her part, Evening gives you a gentle pat of consolation before shooting you a sheepish smile."

rows.original: Well, that didn’t work. But at least she’s still willing to hang around in case there was something else you wanted to ask her.
rows.translation: 好吧，没成功。不过她至少还愿意留下来，看看你是不是还有别的事情想问她。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that didn’t work. But at least she’s still willing to hang around in case there was something else you wanted to ask her."

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: Giving you a once-over, Evening sizes you up
rows.translation: 伊芙宁将你从头到脚打量了一遍
rows.raw: "\n\nGiving you a once-over, Evening sizes you up"

rows.original: like before
rows.translation: ，和之前一样
rows.raw: " like before"

rows.original: , but to your disappointment she doesn’t seem to like what she sees and shakes her head. “Gonna have to pass, friend; now’s... not the right time. Sorry.” For her part, she gives you a gentle pat of consolation before shooting you a sheepish smile.
rows.translation: ，但令你失望的是，她似乎并不满意自己看到的东西，于是摇了摇头。“这次就算了，朋友；现在...时机不太对。抱歉。”说完，她轻轻拍了拍你以示安慰，随后露出一个略显尴尬的笑容。
rows.raw: ", but to your disappointment she doesn’t seem to like what she sees and shakes her head. “Gonna have to pass, friend; now’s... not the right time. Sorry.” For her part, she gives you a gentle pat of consolation before shooting you a sheepish smile."

rows.original: Well, that didn’t work. And was incredibly vague. But at least she’s still willing to hang around in case there was something else you wanted to ask her.
rows.translation: 好吧，没成功。而且她说得含糊得要命。不过她至少还愿意留下来，看看你是不是还有别的事情想问她。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that didn’t work. And was incredibly vague. But at least she’s still willing to hang around in case there was something else you wanted to ask her."

rows.original: Sex
rows.translation: 性爱
rows.raw: "Sex"

rows.original: Giving you a once-over, Evening sizes you up
rows.translation: 伊芙宁将你从头到脚打量了一遍
rows.raw: "\n\nGiving you a once-over, Evening sizes you up"

rows.original: like before
rows.translation: ，和之前一样
rows.raw: " like before"

rows.original: . She swivels on her bar stool in idle thought, considering the proposal with a casual air. Eventually the Terran gives you a smile, crooked and mischievous, but doesn’t immediately agree. “Depends, what did you have in mind? I’d rather not have to make the trip to the hangar if I can help it. Nothing kills the mood like getting chased by muggers and milk thieves for a dozen blocks straight.”
rows.translation: 。她坐在吧台凳上转了转，漫不经心地考虑着你的提议。最后，这位地球人露出一抹狡黠的歪笑，却没有立刻答应。“那得看你想做什么。我可不想非得跑一趟机库。没有什么比连续十几个街区都被劫匪和偷奶贼追着跑更扫兴的了。”
rows.raw: ". She swivels on her bar stool in idle thought, considering the proposal with a casual air. Eventually the Terran gives you a smile, crooked and mischievous, but doesn’t immediately agree. “Depends, what did you have in mind? I’d rather not have to make the trip to the hangar if I can help it. Nothing kills the mood like getting chased by muggers and milk thieves for a dozen blocks straight.”"

rows.original: You promise to make it worth it if she’d be willing to brave the trek for you.
rows.translation: 你向她保证，只要她愿意为你冒险走这一趟，一切都会物有所值。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou promise to make it worth it if she’d be willing to brave the trek for you."

rows.original: Her eyes narrow, as if she doesn’t quite believe you, but the smile doesn’t leave her face either. “Okay,” the woman decides, “But I’ll hold you to that. And we’re going to my ship.”
rows.translation: 她眯起眼睛，似乎不太相信你，但脸上的笑容也没有消失。“好吧，”她作出决定，“但你可得说到做到。而且我们要去的是我的飞船。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer eyes narrow, as if she doesn’t quite believe you, but the smile doesn’t leave her face either. “Okay,” the woman decides, “But I’ll hold you to that. And we’re going to my ship.”"

rows.original: “Fine by me.”
rows.translation: “我没意见。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fine by me.”"

rows.original: She grabs your hand and starts to swiftly stride in her chosen direction. Despite this being your suggestion, it looks like she’s taking the lead.
rows.translation: 她抓住你的手，迅速朝自己选定的方向大步走去。明明是你提的建议，现在看来却是她在领路。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe grabs your hand and starts to swiftly stride in her chosen direction. Despite this being your suggestion, it looks like she’s taking the lead."

rows.original: Hand in hand, Evening threads her way through the mean streets of Dhaal, through alleys, past skyscrapers, and behind the backs of any other passersby. Her gait is casual and unassuming, if not for the fact that she has you trailing behind her like a puppy
rows.translation: 伊芙宁与你手牵着手穿过达尔的险恶街道，钻过小巷，绕过摩天大楼，也避开其他行人的视线。她走得随意又自然，只是你像条小狗似的被她牵在身后
rows.raw: "\n\nHand in hand, Evening threads her way through the mean streets of Dhaal, through alleys, past skyscrapers, and behind the backs of any other passersby. Her gait is casual and unassuming, if not for the fact that she has you trailing behind her like a puppy"

rows.original: , though that doesn’t feel too far from the truth at this point.
rows.translation: ，不过事到如今，这感觉离事实也不算太远。
rows.raw: ", though that doesn’t feel too far from the truth at this point."

rows.original: The woman makes a show of sneaking around; as a group of zaika migrate down the street, she pauses just before entering their line of sight, only resuming her walk when they pass by. She takes care to scan the skyline and then some, and whatever she sees, it’s enough to let you avoid getting ambushed by anyone. You’re suddenly in a game of stealth, except Evening’s monopolized the controls and you’re the player two brought along for the ride. Still, you have to admit it’s a fun game, lurking around like a teenager sneaking their first beer
rows.translation: 她煞有介事地潜行起来；一群扎伊卡人沿街走来时，她恰好在进入对方视野前停步，直到他们走过才继续前进。她仔细扫视天际线以及更远处，而无论看到了什么，都足以带你避开所有伏击。你突然置身于一场潜行游戏，只不过控制权全被伊芙宁一人包揽，你只是被带来同行的二号玩家。尽管如此，你不得不承认，这游戏确实很有趣，像个偷喝第一瓶啤酒的青少年那样鬼鬼祟祟
rows.raw: "\n\nThe woman makes a show of sneaking around; as a group of zaika migrate down the street, she pauses just before entering their line of sight, only resuming her walk when they pass by. She takes care to scan the skyline and then some, and whatever she sees, it’s enough to let you avoid getting ambushed by anyone. You’re suddenly in a game of stealth, except Evening’s monopolized the controls and you’re the player two brought along for the ride. Still, you have to admit it’s a fun game, lurking around like a teenager sneaking their first beer"

rows.original: , and the possibility that you might get caught only adds to the thrill
rows.translation: ，而随时可能被人发现的风险更添了几分刺激
rows.raw: ", and the possibility that you might get caught only adds to the thrill"

rows.original: . The grip on your hand gradually tightens, but nothing else about your companion gives anything away about what her plans for you are.
rows.translation: 。她握着你的手渐渐收紧，但除此之外，你的同伴没有流露出任何关于她打算对你做什么的线索。
rows.raw: ". The grip on your hand gradually tightens, but nothing else about your companion gives anything away about what her plans for you are."

rows.original: The two of you successfully slip away to the attention of absolutely no one, and Evening shoots you a triumphant grin as she presents to you a junker, just big enough for one. It’s mostly a dark olive green, but several parts and patches of metal seem to have been soldered on after previous damages, leaving it with a patchworked look. “Is this your ship?”
rows.translation: 你们成功溜走，完全没有引起任何人的注意。伊芙宁得意地咧嘴一笑，向你展示一艘勉强够一个人使用的破旧飞船。船体大部分呈深橄榄绿色，但显然在历次受损后焊补过不少零件和金属板，看起来东拼西凑。“这是你的飞船？”

rows.original: A woman with dark hair and what looks to be a very souped-up utility belt saunters over to you. “Looking for an opponent?” She wastes no time in propositioning you, jerking her head towards the dartboard projectors. “Technically, you could play alone, but if you ask me these things are more fun with some friendly competition.” Her grin is a little wolfish in nature, but not predatory. “I’m Evening, by the way.”

rows.original: You tell her that you haven’t. “No problem; I can run through them real quick,” Evening says genially. She flips through the settings one by one. “First one’s just a Terran dartboard, nothing fancy. You throw, you score, and you try to score higher than your opponent. Second one,” she says as she switches to the setting with the multiple boards, “is a lot trickier. I think the Gryvain made this one up. Your darts bounce off the green boards; they only stick to the blue one. You have to bounce your dart off a certain number of boards each round before it can land.” And then the third one, with the changing shapes. “This one, I think the Zaika thought of. Hit the blue things. Don’t hit the red ones. Beware of moving objects or changing shapes.” She smiles. “Got all that?”

So, what do you want to talk about with your local arms merchant?” he asks, chuckling a little.

rows.original: “You wanna know more about me? Well, sure, I know some people don’t like talking about themselves, but I don’t mind. Have you ever been on Tarkus?” he asks. You tell him that you have been there. “Right, so you know that it’s a fucking shitty ball of sand and rusted shit floating in space, and that us raskvel are native to Tarkus. I was born there before the Rush, and when the first rushers landed there, I got aboard a rusher’s ship faster than an ausar knotting a bitch in heat,” he says, chuckling a little at his own dumb joke. “Why did you hate it there so much to risk it going, well, anywhere? You’re lucky you didn’t end up enslaved.” “Perhaps, but I was young, and real stupid. I mean, I was even denser back then than I am today. As for why I got out of there in such a hurry, I hated it there. It was a glorified scrapyard, and it was either sand, or rust, or some fucked up natural hazard. They’re not stupid, so when they have to choose between a rask with an overclocked laser pistol, or a rask with some old, barely functioning pistol, or even unarmed, who do you think they’re going to go for?” You don’t even need to respond, it’s obvious enough. “I always had a knack for maintaining weapons, and they gave me a good excuse to keep getting better. rows.original: “So, how exactly did you end up on Dhaal? I remember you saying you hitched a ride from some rushers, but there’s gotta be more to it than that.” “Well, when I heard that there were ships coming from off world, I got to the ship port as fast as I could. I was basically standing around with a sign saying take me anywhere but here. Eventually a captain of a rusher crew approached me, and after talking to her for a bit, and mentioning that I can maintain their weapons, she agreed to take me off world. I’m not sure if it was exactly legal, but I’m not complaining,” he says with a little grin. “The first night aboard the ship, I learned that you rushers can have libidos to outmatch even the thirstiest rask. Hell, they’re probably part of the reason why I’m such a horny little bastard. What the captain hadn’t mentioned was that her crew consisted of nothing but buff herms, so while my official duty aboard the ship was armorer, I spent more time with girl cock in my ass than fixing guns. I mean, I didn’t dislike it, but there’s only so much I can get of my prostate being demolished before I get bored of it.” “So, what happened to the crew?” “We landed on Dhaal, and that’s the last I saw of them. Don’t know why, maybe they became milk slaves to the zaika, or maybe they were fucking around for long enough that I left the ship. Took a bunch of guns with me as well, they haven’t come asking for ‘em, so...” he shrugs. “But I do hope they’re safe, I hold no ill will towards them, even if my ass did for a week after seeing them for the last time.” “Now that you mention it, Dhaal isn’t the safest place, not that Tarkus was particularly safe either. But, how are you liking Dhaal so far?” “Well, it has some good, and some bad. As an upside, I don’t live in a scrapyard, and I actually have a bed, and a rather nice one at that. I have all the credits I could ever want, the women, the drugs. Anything I could want, I can get, and sure, it’s dangerous, but I live in the back of my shop, and this place is a god-damn bunker, so I’m as safe as you can be on Dhaal without being a zaibatsu. Not that Dhaal’s perfect, far from that. If I didn’t work for Paragon, this shop would be illegal, and I have no interest in being made into one of their security slaves. But since I work for them, a lot of the worst of their problems don’t affect me. Hell, if I were to get robbed, they’d actually might care since I provide them with money and arms I get from rushers. It’s a weird, protection racket, partnership, and supplier mix. I pay them, but they provide me with stock.” “So, what’s working for Paragon like?” “Honestly, I don’t even really notice it most of the time. But that’s probably because I’m closer to a contractor for them. They want their share bi-weekly, and it’s quite a hefty cut as well, but they provide me with the stock so, I can’t complain. But, if things get bad, they certainly don’t help, they often make things worse, don’t care what happened, payments must be made on the day, no excuses. I’ve been late only once on the payment, and that was before I had upgraded the security and someone tried to rob me. I didn’t have the machine guns in the ceiling yet, had to resort to taking them out myself. Thankfully, I’m always packing heat,” he says with a grin, pointing out his fingers like that of a pistol, revealing a concealed barrel inside his finger. “It’s not much, but when people don’t expect it, it makes all the difference.” He shakes his head and chuckles a little, “Sorry, I got caught talking about myself again. After the attempted robbery I had to install the new security, so the place was closed for a while, meaning no customers, which naturally meant no credits coming in. They slapped a fine on me for that, which I managed to thankfully pay off, so they didn’t manage to bullshit me into debt slavery. So yeah, Dhaal’s got a fuck ton of problems, but I still can’t bring myself to hate it like I do the tetanus central called Tarkus.
rows.translation: “所以，你究竟是怎么来到达尔的？我记得你说过搭了某些淘金者的顺风船，但事情肯定不只这样。” “嗯，我听说有飞船从外星来的时候，就以最快速度赶到了太空港。我基本就站在那里举着牌子，上面写着‘随便带我去哪，只要别留在这里’。后来，一支淘金队的船长来找我。我们聊了一会儿，我又提到自己能保养他们的武器，她便答应带我离开塔克斯。我不确定那到底合不合法，不过我可不会抱怨，”他咧嘴一笑。“登船的第一晚，我就见识到你们淘金者的性欲甚至能胜过最饥渴的拉斯克。见鬼，我会变成现在这个淫荡的小混蛋，她们大概也有一份功劳。船长之前没提过，她的船员全是肌肉发达的双性人。所以，虽然我在船上的正式职务是军械师，但屁股里塞着姑娘鸡巴的时间，比修枪还长。我是说，我并不讨厌，可前列腺被蹂躏得再爽，次数多了也会腻。” “那船员们后来怎么样了？” “我们在达尔着陆，之后我就再也没见过她们。不知道为什么。也许她们成了扎伊卡人的乳奴，也可能是一直胡搞，等我离船都没发现。我还顺走了一大堆枪，反正她们一直没来找我要，所以……”他耸耸肩。“不过我确实希望她们平安。我并不恨她们，哪怕最后一次见面后，我的屁股足足恨了她们一星期。” “既然你提到了，达尔也算不上最安全的地方，当然塔克斯同样不怎么安全。不过，你目前还喜欢达尔吗？” “嗯，有好也有坏。好处是我不住在废料场了，而且真有一张床，还是相当舒服的床。我有花不完的信用点，有女人，有毒品。想要什么都能弄到。这里确实危险，但我住在店铺后面，而这地方就是一座该死的堡垒。所以，只要不是财阀成员，我在达尔已经算安全到顶了。倒不是说达尔完美无缺，差得远呢。要是我不为典范工作，这家店就是非法的，而我可不想被他们改造成安保奴隶。不过，既然替他们办事，他们最糟糕的那些问题就很少影响到我。见鬼，要是店被抢了，他们说不定真会在乎，毕竟我能给他们赚钱，还能提供从淘金者手里收来的武器。这是一种古怪的保护费、合作关系和供货关系的混合体。我向他们交钱，他们则给我货源。” “那么，为典范工作是什么感觉？” “说真的，大多数时候我甚至感觉不到。不过这大概是因为我更像他们的承包商。他们每两周都要分成，而且抽得相当狠，但他们给我供货，所以我没法抱怨。可要是出了麻烦，他们绝对不会帮忙，反而往往让事情更糟。他们根本不管发生了什么，付款必须当天到账，没有任何借口。我只迟交过一次，那还是在我升级安保之前，有人试图抢劫我。那时天花板里还没装机枪，我只能亲自解决他们。好在我一直带着武器，”他咧嘴一笑，伸出手指摆成手枪姿势，露出藏在指头里的枪管。“威力不算大，但出其不意时，效果完全不一样。” 他摇摇头，轻笑一声。“抱歉，我又只顾着谈自己了。那次抢劫未遂后，我不得不安装新的安保系统，店铺因此关了一阵子。没有客人，自然也没有信用点进账。他们为此罚了我一笔钱，谢天谢地我设法还清了，所以没让他们用那些狗屁把我骗进债务奴役。总之，达尔的问题多得要命，可我依然无法像憎恨那个叫作塔克斯的破伤风中心一样憎恨这里。

rows.original: “Can you tell me a bit more about the guns on sale?” “Sure, the guns we have in stock are a variety of elemental-based arms, using either corrosive, thermal, or cryotic. Ballistic weapons tend to get somewhat shunned here —much to my dismay— since it’s easier to paint out scorch marks than to fix golf ball sized holes. Also, since the technology developed on Dhaal was originally designed for mining on both sides of the planet, the technology is more thermally focused to melt the ice on the frozen side, and the opposite on the other side.” “So weapons on Dhaal are refurbished mining equipment?” “Well, not quite, they used to be, but the tech has advanced enough that they’re a separate branch now. Paragon’s got their own R&D lab where they come up with these puppies. Of course, I check the quality of each piece I sell; I won’t be caught dead selling a broken weapon. Also fine-tuning them, polishing lenses, cleaning coils, that sort of thing.” “Huh, you really take pride in your craft, huh?” “Yeah, I even got a couple of pieces I made myself in the back. Designed them back on Tarkus. Back then they were just a pipe dream, but here I can actually get the parts needed. Spend most of my time tweaking with them, but they still need a lot more work before they’re ready for test firing. Don’t know what I’ll do with them once I’m happy with them. Don’t think I’ll sell, would rather have someone who knows how to put ‘em to good use.” You can’t help but to laugh a little, “You really love your guns, huh.” He grins, rubbing the back of his neck. “Well, yeah, I guess you could say that. I do like guns, sleek and elegant, and so much power,” he raises one finger up, looking at you seriously, “but they also demand respect. They’re tools like any other, but they’re among the deadliest tools there are. You treat them wrong, you’re going to pay for it.” He clenches his robotic hand before splaying out his fingers. “Learned that the hard way.” You can’t help but to ask what happened. “I’ll spare you the details, but I was overcharging a loaded weapon, and it blew up on me,” he says, making you reflexively grimace. “But I promise that no weapon I sell you is going to blow up on you, you have my word on it. You bend over to pick up your [pc.gear], only to yelp as he lightly smacks your rear. “Sorry, couldn’t resist,” he says with a wink as he puts his own clothes on. He sits down behind the counter and unlocks the door for you. “Don’t be a stranger,” he says as you’re about to leave. “Keep that ass warmed up for me,” you call back over your shoulder before stepping outside.
rows.translation: 你不需要药物，身旁这个可爱的拉斯克就已经足够。你侧过身，将他拉到[pc.chest]前，安顿下来与他依偎。 你在他身旁放松下来，呼吸逐渐平稳，药效也慢慢消退。你闭上双眼，聆听心脏沉稳的跳动。 与此同时，你能感觉到他的呼吸拂过[pc.chest]。你很想继续抱着他依偎下去，但也必须回到外面，继续自己的旅程。你站起身伸展双臂；尽管并没有真正睡着，这动作仍让自己清醒过来。低头一看，你才发现他已经睡着了。你不愿吵醒他，却也不想让他在店门敞开时继续熟睡，于是俯身将他摇醒。他坐起来打了个哈欠，随后从床上起身。“抱歉，我好像不小心睡着了。”他低声说道，你只是伸手揉乱他的头发，惹得他不满地哼了一声。 你弯腰去捡[pc.gear]，他却轻轻拍了一下你的屁股，惊得你叫出声。“抱歉，实在忍不住。”他眨眨眼说道，同时穿回自己的衣服。他在柜台后坐下，替你打开门锁。“别变成陌生人。”你即将离开时，他说道。 “把那只屁股给我暖好。”你回头喊道，随后迈步走到外面。
rows.raw: "You don’t need drugs, the cute rask next to you is all you need, turning to your side and pulling him against your [pc.chest], You settle down to cuddle with him. As you relax next to him, your breathing steadies and you come down from your high. You close your eyes, listening to the calm thudding of your heart. At the same time, you feel his breathing against your [pc.chest]. As much as you’d want to keep snuggling and cuddling with him, you do have to get back out there and resume your journey. You get up and stretch your arms, waking yourself despite not actually sleeping. Glancing down, you realize that he’s fallen asleep. You’d rather not wake him up, but you don’t want to leave him sleeping with his doors open either. So you reach down and shake him awake. He sits up and yawns, getting up from bed, “Sorry, I guess I dozed off,” he murmurs, but you only reach forward and ruffle his hair, making him huff. You bend over to pick up your [pc.gear], only to yelp as he lightly smacks your rear. “Sorry, couldn’t resist,” he says with a wink as he puts his own clothes on. He sits down behind the counter and unlocks the door for you. “Don’t be a stranger,” he says as you’re about to leave. “Keep that ass warmed up for me,” you call back over your shoulder before stepping outside. rows.original: Minding your own business on Dhaal you notice two kaithrit carrying a large crate into one of the buildings. The box bears the symbol of Utopian Skies. As they disappear inside the building, you see the door trying to close, but it’s broken, and it jams in place. You remember what Malai told you: that he’d be willing to buy any weapons of either Utopian Skies or Bright Water manufacture and design. But do you want to risk making an enemy of one of the controlling corporations on Dhaal? Still, they probably won’t come down on you with full force just for stealing some guns, and that’s only if you get caught. A kaithrit wearing the same uniform as the other two walks out of the building. He stops outside the broken door and scans the people walking past the building. A second armed feline joins him, and as he leans against the wall you can hear them talking. “How long are we going to be trafficking guns through here?” “Dunno, as long as the bosses think one of the others could fuck them over, I guess.” A kui-tan steps out and smacks both of them. “Get back inside, and keep your fucking mouths shut when you’re outside, we don’t want anyone catching wind of our operation.” “What does it matter, we got plenty of security inside,” the shortest of the pair protests, earning himself another quick smack. You can’t hear anything else they say as the kui-tan drags them back inside. You’re not surprised they have security inside, but it’s good to know.

rows.original: As the last of the kaithrit falls, you lower your weapon, still keeping it at ready. “Mistress is going to take care of you,” one of the cat boys grumbles, [var0|holding his injured shoulder|covering his tenting crotch]. Ignoring him, you take a step forward, only to jump back in time to avoid a burst of lasers landing where you were just standing, leaving several singe marks on the floor. A kui-tan walks towards you, holding a laser SMG in one hand and a baton in the other. “Hands off my boys,” she scowls. She’s rather tall for a kui-tan, standing roughly 5' 8". Her red hair is tied back in a tight ponytail. A few small piercings decorate her small round ears, and the bridge of her muzzle has a ladder of similar glinting studs. As is so common on Dhaal, her right arm has been replaced by a cybernetic one, enhancing her combat potential. She’s wearing a dark, urban camo, armored suit, the skintight outfit covering her vitals but still leaving her considerable D cup breasts visible, as well as the blatant bulge between her legs. “It doesn’t matter who you are, you’re trespassing on Utopian Skies property, and I won’t let you go unpunished.” She points her baton at you before assuming a combat ready posture. “I suggest you fight for your life, otherwise I’ll turn you over to the zaibatsu.” Looks like you’re not going to talk your way out of this one. It’s a fight!
rows.translation: 最后一个凯斯里特倒下后，你放低武器，但仍保持戒备。“女主人会收拾你的，”其中一个猫男孩嘟囔道，[var0|捂着受伤的肩膀|遮着支起帐篷的裆部]。你没理他，向前迈出一步，却及时向后跃开，躲过一阵落在刚才所站之处的激光，在地板上留下数道焦痕。一个奎坦朝你走来，一手握着激光冲锋枪，另一手拿着警棍。“离我的男孩们远点，”她怒斥道。 以奎坦而言，她相当高挑，身高约5英尺8英寸。红发紧紧扎成马尾。小巧的圆耳上装饰着几枚小穿钉，口鼻梁上也排列着一列闪闪发亮的类似饰钉。 正如达尔上常见的那样，她的右臂已被义肢取代，增强了战斗能力。她身穿深色都市迷彩装甲服，紧身服保护着要害，却依然将她丰满的D罩杯乳房和双腿之间明显的隆起展露无遗。 “不管你是谁，你都擅闯了乌托邦天际的财产，我不会让你不受惩罚地离开。”她用警棍指着你，随后摆出战斗架势。“我建议你为自己的小命拼尽全力，否则我会把你交给财阀。” 看来这次没法靠嘴皮子脱身了。开战！

rows.original: You glance around to make sure that nobody is paying too much attention. “I got the thing you wanted,” you tell him. He looks puzzled for a moment before realizing what you mean. “Damn, really? I didn’t expect you to actually get your hands on anything.” He reaches below his desk and locks the doors to his shop before letting you behind the counter. “Alright, show me,” he says, sounding anxious. You pull the weapon parts out and lay them out for him. “Hmm, I wasn’t expecting this,” he says as he picks a part up and examines it. “Where did you get these?” he asks. You explain that you found a warehouse full of what you assume were Utopian Skies weapons, and that you got into a fight with a kui-tan and a handful of kaithrit before managing to steal this. “Stockpiling weapons huh? Well, that’s certainly something Paragon would like to know,” he muses to himself, rubbing his chin. “I’d need to examine this thing in more detail to know for sure, but it seems to be some kind of mind weapon, temporarily dazing or stunning the target. On a more powerful setting, it might even permanently alter one’s mind. Paragon will be able to prepare countermeasures with this, so they’ll pay handsomely.” He puts the weapon part back into the case and closes it. “But I’m getting ahead of myself, you still need your payment for this. I think we agreed on a permanent discount?” He picks up a credit chip and hands it to you. “Here, you’ve earned a little extra,” he pauses and licks his lips looking at you up and down, “and well, while you were gone I got a couple of ideas we could try if you’re up for it.” It doesn’t take a genius to understand what the horny little raskvel has in mind. “What if I want to top you?” you wonder, poking at the possibility now that you’ve done such a sizable favor for him. He blushes and looks thoughtful for a moment. “Well... You did me a huge favor, so, I guess you could occasionally do so,” he mutters, looking away from you. The normally confident femboy turning a lot more shy suddenly. “Pleasure doing business with you,” you say, grinning as you tuck the credit chit away. He opens the doors after making sure to hide the package you’ve given him, letting you out from his shop.

Usually I’m just making my own stuff, but every so often, one of the gabs who live around here needs repairs when a replacement won’t do. Some whirlygig un-sprung or widget respooled. Most of ‘em don’t have the patience for fine, detailed repair work, so I’ve got a little side-hustle.”
rows.translation: 这个矮小伙子双臂抱在胸前。“嗯...严格来说，我只能销售典范公司批准的武器，”他咧嘴一笑，压低声音，“不过只要你不说，我也不会说。平时我主要做自己的东西，但偶尔住在附近的加比拉尼也会有不能直接换新的东西需要维修。可能是某个旋转玩意的弹簧脱了，或者某个小装置得重新绕线。他们大多没耐心做精细的维修活，所以我也顺便做点副业。”
