rows.original: You try to strike up a conversation with the ever-bustling tailor. The cyber-drider tilts her head and leans back. “Oh sweetness, aren’t you adorable? Want to find out about little ol’ me? Goodness, what’s to tell?” Her spider legs click and lower her body to the ground as she folds her arms and flashes her vaguely threatening, amethyst smile. “Came from Tarkus, settled in the Stacks, studied the zaibatsu cybernetics, turned ‘em to my own ends. That’s pretty much it! I’ve been hard at work, designing the absolute latest in fashion ever since.” You gesture at her considerable, chrome caboose. “Why a spider?” Gwon leans toward you, splaying her fingers across the countertop and craning her neck forward until she’s almost in range for a kiss. “I’ve always admired a well-woven web,” she whispers, conspiratorially. “And besides, there’s already the most adorable little zaika-pony just a few blocks west, so I couldn’t go the more traditional route. I absolutely insist on originality,” she stresses, quite firmly. “Why come to Dhaal at all?” you push. “Oh, the city’s just the most fabulous mix of ugliness and beauty, don’t you think? Always building more, tearing down the old, spreading out like a girdle across the only habitable region of a planet so uniquely ill-equipped for life. Acid rain, roving gangs, the threat of constant danger... It’s quite thrilling!” The gabilani’s ears waggle as she speaks, her smile slowly growing wider and wider. “There’s a concept in ancient philosophy that helps guide my artistic vision, you see. ‘Imperfect, impermanent, incomplete.’ The stitch not made has as much aesthetic beauty as the one drawn tight.” Though you can’t see her eyes under her bangs, you suspect she’s winking. You’re not sure you know exactly what she’s talking about, but the girl seems passionate about it, at least. Maybe the whole asymmetry thing is part of why she’s such a small gab on such a large spider torso? You don’t doubt she could go on at length about art theory and haute couture, so you change the topic. “When I first came in, it seemed like you were having issues with some of the locals?” The cyan goblin’s o-shaped pucker curves downward in a plum scowl. “Oh yes. Gangs who want to extort money, xenophobes who don’t take kindly to off-worlders visiting, much less setting down roots, and others besides. But we in the Stacks stick together. There’s even a couple augmented girls out there, policing the neighborhood, in their own strange ways. So, it’s comparatively quite safe here.” The tailor taps her DSLs in thought. “Well, safe if you’re a shortstack, anyway. Come to think of it, I have heard those girls sometimes just jump taller folk they come across.” She shrugs and laughs to herself. “Well, the danger is part of the fun!” The manic grin on her face tells you that knowing too much about her idea of fun could be quite an experience!

How does she get such a diverse selection on a planet so uniquely hostile to off-worlders? “Ohhh, good eye! I do so love a savvy customer. Well, to tell you the truth: my augmented lower body isn’t merely because of my love of arachnid artistry.” She rears up, showing off the sizable bulk of her chromed undercarriage. “There’s a rather complicated bit of machinery inside I call the ‘Turbo-Loom.’ Using simple proteins and amino acids, I’m able to fabricate most any material I need, and weave latex as smoothly as silk. It’s quite brilliant, if I do say so myself.” She frowns. “Or, would be brilliant, if I could secure a more reliable power supply. The city power grid is Zaibatsu property, and some of the gabs and rasks in the Stacks have been tapping into it a bit too heavily of late. Drawing too much power all the time runs the risk of one of those XOs coming knocking, and I’d rather stay clear of syndicate sentry dolls.” You ask if there are any alternatives. “Well, if I had a power cell compatible with the city’s grid, I could draw from that. A battery wouldn’t attract too much attention, you see. Oh, but I’d need a few of them, actually. One plugged in, one on stand-by, and one charging. Yes, I believe that would work quite nicely! I could weave all day and night and never risk going into low-power mode!” She seems quite enamored at the prospect, but her enthusiasm dims once the reality of the situation sets in. “Hrm, but where to get them? Paragon cybernetics have internal power supplies, which makes them impossible to harvest, and they’d never sell their proprietary battery tech by itself. But off-world cells likely wouldn’t be compatible with Dhaal’s networks. It’d have to be a power cell on a piece of local gear...” An idea springs to mind. The frequently-hostile natives of the Gyre tend to use a variety of machinery as makeshift weapons. Those are, presumably, powered by some kind of external power supply. If you could nab three of those, Gwon would have all her power needs taken care of! The titanium tailor’s over-sized ears jerk upwards, and she claps in excitement. “Oh, that would work wonderfully! By the time her kiss ends, the gab’s aquamarine skin has flushed to a warm purple and she pants to catch her breath. “You’re my very favorite customer, [pc.name]!” Gwon insists, scuttling over to her back office workshop. “I’ll get these set up and charging the Loom as soon as we’re done here, but consider yourself the beneficiary of a VERY generous discount on everything in the shop!”"

rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds interesting... do you have any yourself, Sabrae?” you ask."

rows.original: “Yup!” she says, nodding her head hard enough to make her ears bounce. “I got one as a signing bonus - it just makes me a little smarter. So, want anything?”
rows.translation: “对呀！”她用力点头，连耳朵都跟着弹跳起来。“我拿签约奖金装了一个——只是让我稍微聪明了一点。那么，你想要什么吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yup!” she says, nodding her head hard enough to make her ears bounce. “I got one as a signing bonus - it just makes me a little smarter. So, want anything?”"

rows.original: “Hey Sabrae,” you say, giving her a wave. “Just browsing the goods for now.”
rows.translation: “嘿，萨布蕾，”你朝她挥了挥手。“我现在只是随便看看商品。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey Sabrae,” you say, giving her a wave. “Just browsing the goods for now.”"

rows.original: “Well, let me know what hot little item you’re going to pick,” she says, smiling.
rows.translation: “好呀，等你选中哪件火辣的小东西，记得告诉我，”她微笑着说。

rows.original: “Oh! [pc.name],” Sabrae says, eyes going wide. You can see her blushing already, even under that dark purple skin of hers. “Um, hi. Sorry about... taking a nap... when we finished last time. It was just, kinda, a bit too much for me to handle, I guess?” she continues, twirling a finger through her hair and gazing down at her desk. “But it- it was fun, and I wouldn’t mind doing it again - uh, if you’re interested! Anyway,” she says, clearing her throat and looking up with an embarrassed smile. “What would you like today?”
rows.translation: “哦！[pc.name]，”萨布蕾睁大双眼说道。即使隔着她那身深紫色皮肤，你也看得出她已经脸红了。“呃，你好。抱歉上次做完后...睡着了...我猜那对我来说有点太刺激了？”她一边继续说，一边用手指卷弄头发，低头望向桌面。“不过那、那真的很好玩，我也不介意再来一次——呃，如果你有兴趣的话！总之，”她清清嗓子，抬起头露出尴尬的微笑。“你今天想要什么？”
rows.raw: "“Oh! [pc.name],” Sabrae says, eyes going wide. You can see her blushing already, even under that dark purple skin of hers. “Um, hi. Sorry about... taking a nap... when we finished last time. It was just, kinda, a bit too much for me to handle, I guess?” she continues, twirling a finger through her hair and gazing down at her desk. “But it- it was fun, and I wouldn’t mind doing it again - uh, if you’re interested! Anyway,” she says, clearing her throat and looking up with an embarrassed smile. “What would you like today?”"

rows.original: “Heeey, [pc.name],” Sabrae says, smiling at you as you enter. “Really nice to see you again.”
rows.translation: “嘿——[pc.name]，”你进门时，萨布蕾微笑着对你说道。“真高兴又见到你。”
rows.raw: "“Heeey, [pc.name],” Sabrae says, smiling at you as you enter. “Really nice to see you again.”"

rows.original: “Hi Sabrae,” you say, giving her a wink. “How’s things?”
rows.translation: “你好，萨布蕾，”你朝她眨眨眼。“最近怎么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hi Sabrae,” you say, giving her a wink. “How’s things?”"

rows.original: “Good,” she says, propping her elbows on the counter and laying her chin in her hands, tail swishing lazily in the air behind her. “Better by the moment.”
rows.translation: “很好，”她说道，双肘撑在柜台上，用手托着下巴，尾巴在身后懒洋洋地扫动。“而且每一刻都在变得更好。”

rows.original: Sabrae is a zaika, unmistakably so. Her telltale tail swishes behind her, half-covered with what you suspect is meant to be a risque veil and her long, pointed ears wobble as she looks back at you. Deep purple skin across her upper half segues into the gleaming mechanical lower body of a centaur, complete with four short unguligrade legs.
rows.translation: 萨布蕾是一名扎伊卡，这一点绝不会认错。她那标志性的尾巴在身后扫动，其中一半覆着你猜是充当性感面纱的布料；她回头看向你时，修长尖锐的耳朵也跟着晃动。上半身的深紫色皮肤逐渐过渡为闪闪发亮的机械半人马下躯，四条短小的蹄行腿一应俱全。
rows.raw: "Sabrae is a zaika, unmistakably so. Her telltale tail swishes behind her, half-covered with what you suspect is meant to be a risque veil and her long, pointed ears wobble as she looks back at you. Deep purple skin across her upper half segues into the gleaming mechanical lower body of a centaur, complete with four short unguligrade legs."

rows.original: At what looks to be about five foot and a couple of inches, Sabrae isn’t very tall. Her chest is hidden behind a Paragon-branded piece of light armor, with a few more plates down her hind half. She gives you a smile, her luminous pink eyes crinkling at the edges.
rows.translation: 萨布蕾看起来大约五英尺二三英寸高，算不上高挑。她的胸口藏在一件印有典范公司标识的轻型护甲后面，后半身还覆盖着几块额外甲片。她朝你微微一笑，发亮的粉红色双眼在眼角弯了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt what looks to be about five foot and a couple of inches, Sabrae isn’t very tall. Her chest is hidden behind a Paragon-branded piece of light armor, with a few more plates down her hind half. She gives you a smile, her luminous pink eyes crinkling at the edges."

rows.original: Like other zaika, her tail can both fuck and be fucked - but unlike the others, she possesses a hind-mounted vagina like a regular tauric race. Shiny and black, it’s incredibly soft and sensitive, full of padding and nerves as well as being self-lubricating. Above it is her butthole, round and plush. You have to admit, the medical expertise that must have been employed to combine her zaika half and the organs of the machine is nothing short of miraculous.
rows.translation: 与其他扎伊卡一样，她的尾巴既能插入别人，也能被别人插入——但与同族不同，她像普通半人马种族一样，在后躯长有阴道。那里乌黑发亮，异常柔软而敏感，内部有大量软垫与神经，还能自行分泌润滑液。上方则是她圆润丰满的屁眼。你不得不承认，把她的扎伊卡上身与机器的器官结合起来，所需的医疗技术堪称奇迹。
rows.raw: "Like other zaika, her tail can both fuck and be fucked - but unlike the others, she possesses a hind-mounted vagina like a regular tauric race. Shiny and black, it’s incredibly soft and sensitive, full of padding and nerves as well as being self-lubricating. Above it is her butthole, round and plush. You have to admit, the medical expertise that must have been employed to combine her zaika half and the organs of the machine is nothing short of miraculous."

rows.original: “What’s your life like, Sabrae?” you ask her. “You seem to be doing okay.”
rows.translation: “你的生活过得怎么样，萨布蕾？”你问她。“你看起来过得还不错。”
rows.raw: "“What’s your life like, Sabrae?” you ask her. “You seem to be doing okay.”"

rows.original: “I was doing better before the accident, to be honest,” Sabrae says, smiling sadly as her ears droop a little. “I have a nice job, at least. I think-” she says, hesitating. “I think they might have put me here because I’m different. Inner city, where there are more zaika and less offworlders... I don’t think the shop would be doing too hot. But working for Paragon has been the best part of my life, so I’m definitely not complaining.”
rows.translation: “说实话，事故发生前我过得更好，”萨布蕾苦笑着说道，双耳微微垂下。“至少我现在的工作不错。我觉得——”她犹豫着说。“我觉得他们可能是因为我的与众不同，才把我安排在这里。内城区的扎伊卡更多，外星人更少...这家店的生意大概不会太好。不过，为典范公司工作是我人生中最美好的经历，所以我绝对不会抱怨。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I was doing better before the accident, to be honest,” Sabrae says, smiling sadly as her ears droop a little. “I have a nice job, at least. I think-” she says, hesitating. “I think they might have put me here because I’m different. Inner city, where there are more zaika and less offworlders... I don’t think the shop would be doing too hot. But working for Paragon has been the best part of my life, so I’m definitely not complaining.”"

rows.original: “Do you like working with implants?” you say.
rows.translation: “你喜欢与植入体打交道吗？”你说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you like working with implants?” you say."

rows.original: She nods. “I just like improving people. I know it’s not really anything for me personally to be proud of, but I get happy when I get to give someone a new implant. It’s fun and rewarding.”
rows.translation: 她点点头。“我只是喜欢让别人变得更好。我知道这其实算不上什么值得我个人骄傲的事，但每当能为某个人安装新的植入体时，我都会很开心。既有趣，也让人很有成就感。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods. “I just like improving people. I know it’s not really anything for me personally to be proud of, but I get happy when I get to give someone a new implant. It’s fun and rewarding.”"

rows.original: “It’s good to have a job you enjoy,” you say.
rows.translation: “能有一份自己喜欢的工作真好，”你说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s good to have a job you enjoy,” you say."

rows.original: “Right,” Sabrae says. “How about you, [pc.name]? Are you a bounty hunter or something?”
rows.translation: “对呀，”萨布蕾说道。“你呢，[pc.name]？你是赏金猎人之类的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right,” Sabrae says. “How about you, [pc.name]? Are you a bounty hunter or something?”"

rows.original: “Actually... yes,” you say, smiling.
rows.translation: “其实...没错，”你微笑着说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Actually... yes,” you say, smiling."

rows.original: “What!” she exclaims, ears wiggling. “Wow, that’s so cool! So you actually travel across space looking for treasure and stuff?”
rows.translation: “什么！”她惊呼道，双耳来回摆动。“哇，太酷了！所以你真的会穿越太空，到处寻找宝藏之类的东西？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What!” she exclaims, ears wiggling. “Wow, that’s so cool! So you actually travel across space looking for treasure and stuff?”"

rows.original: “That is exactly what I do,” you laugh. “I should just sum up my job to everyone that way.”
rows.translation: “这正是我的工作，”你笑道。“以后我就该这样向所有人概括自己的职业。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That is exactly what I do,” you laugh. “I should just sum up my job to everyone that way.”"

rows.original: “Awww mannn that’s awesome!” Sabrae says, her hooves tapping the floor excitedly. “I bet you have so many cool stories...”
rows.translation: “哇啊啊，天哪，那也太酷了！”萨布蕾说道，兴奋地用蹄子轻敲地板。“你肯定有好多精彩的故事...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Awww mannn that’s awesome!” Sabrae says, her hooves tapping the floor excitedly. “I bet you have so many cool stories...”"

rows.original: You think back on your wide-ranging adventure. Mhen’ga, Tarkus, Myrellion, Zhèng Shi - your ‘bounty’ has certainly gotten you into a few interesting spots. “Dunno how cool all of them are, but I’ve definitely got stories.”
rows.translation: 你回想起自己足迹遍及各处的冒险。门加、塔库斯、米瑞利昂、郑氏——这份“遗产”确实让你去过几个有趣的地方。“不知道它们是否都算得上精彩，但我的故事肯定不少。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou think back on your wide-ranging adventure. Mhen’ga, Tarkus, Myrellion, Zhèng Shi - your ‘bounty’ has certainly gotten you into a few interesting spots. “Dunno how cool all of them are, but I’ve definitely got stories.”"

rows.original: Sabrae’s eyes are practically shining as she waves her tail from side to side behind her, looking to you for entertainment.
rows.translation: 萨布蕾身后的尾巴左右摆动，双眼几乎在发光，满怀期待地等你讲些有趣的事情。
rows.raw: "\n\nSabrae’s eyes are practically shining as she waves her tail from side to side behind her, looking to you for entertainment."

rows.original: “Well, I guess I can tell you one or two...” you begin, smiling.
rows.translation: “好吧，我想我可以讲一两个...”你微笑着开口。

rows.original: “Yes,” Sabrae confirms, ears and tail wobbling as she nods her head. “We can do that now, if you want. There are two classes of implants we have for non-natives, and you can only get one of each. Combat and Utility types. In the future we might be able to fit more but that’s going to be years off, probably... our scientists just aren’t familiar enough with coreward physiology and the last thing we need is a reputation as a butcher shop if we start killing our coreworld subjects. Getting the testing done requires a standard fee of

rows.original: You crumple to the ground, your body a shivering mess of conflicting sensations. The leyak’s stings still ripple across you like countless pinpricks. The ache fades slowly as a gentle touch tilts your head up. You find yourself staring into the triad eye of the leyak, wreathed in a coruscating hood of fluorescent veils.

The ache fades slowly as a gentle touch tilts your head up. You find yourself staring into the triad eye of the leyak, wreathed in a coruscating hood of fluorescent veils."

rows.original: You moan as the leyak drifts closer to you, its pulsating colors and bobbing movement making the moment seem dreamlike. Or perhaps it’s the venom flooding your system. Either way, the leyak and its kaleidoscopic colors fill your vision.
rows.translation: 莱亚克向你飘近，你不禁呻吟；它身上搏动的色彩与上下浮动的动作让这一刻如梦似幻。又或许，是充斥体内的毒液所致。不管怎样，莱亚克和它万花筒般的色彩占满了你的视野。

rows.original: It’s close enough to brush its veils against your face. You flinch, expecting more painful stinging, but instead feel a faint tickle, followed by your mouth filling up unexpectedly with saliva. It nuzzles gently against your chin, then across your mouth, its full, jelly-like lips following the gossamer curtains.
rows.translation: 它已经近得足以让薄幕拂过你的脸。你畏缩了一下，以为会迎来更多疼痛刺击，可感受到的却只是轻微瘙痒，随后嘴里出乎意料地涌满唾液。它先温柔地蹭过你的下巴，再滑过嘴巴；丰满如果冻般的双唇紧随那些薄纱帘幕而至。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s close enough to brush its veils against your face. You flinch, expecting more painful stinging, but instead feel a faint tickle, followed by your mouth filling up unexpectedly with saliva. It nuzzles gently against your chin, then across your mouth, its full, jelly-like lips following the gossamer curtains."

rows.original: The leyak lets out a strange trilling noise as it presses its mouth against yours. rows.raw: "\n\nLight lances into your pupils and you groan in pain, managing to find the rest of your body along the way. It takes a few more minutes to figure out where you are, and then who you are."

rows.original: You’re naked in an alley, your whole body covered in flakes of dried ichor. Luckily, your belongings are nearby, strewn across a pile of trash behind you. Your head pounds as you struggle to get up
rows.translation: 你一丝不挂地躺在小巷里，全身覆盖着干涸分泌物的碎屑。幸运的是，你的物品就在附近，散落在身后一堆垃圾上。你挣扎着起身，脑袋阵阵作痛
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re naked in an alley, your whole body covered in flakes of dried ichor. Luckily, your belongings are nearby, strewn across a pile of trash behind you. Your head pounds as you struggle to get up"

rows.original: and get dressed
rows.translation: ，然后穿好衣服
rows.raw: " and get dressed"

rows.original: . You squint blearily at your codex, realizing that you’ve lost an entire day to your bender. Also, you look to be down some credits, either through theft or an impossible-to-recall spending spree.
rows.translation: 。你睡眼惺忪地眯眼查看终端，意识到这场纵欲让你整整失去了一天。此外，你似乎还少了些信用点，不知是遭了窃，还是进行了一场完全想不起来的疯狂消费。

rows.original: A faint “sshf” noise and a flicker of movement overhead catches your attention. You turn and take in the disturbing sight of a blue, disembodied head tumbling down towards you. Its tentacle hair flares, and its limpid eyes lock on to you as it attacks.
rows.translation: 一声轻微的“嘶呼”声和头顶一闪而过的动静吸引了你的注意。你转过身，看到一个令人不安的景象：一颗蓝色、没有身体的脑袋正翻滚着朝你坠来。它的触手头发猛然张开，清澈的眼睛锁定了你，随即发动攻击。
rows.raw: "\n\nA faint “sshf” noise and a flicker of movement overhead catches your attention. You turn and take in the disturbing sight of a blue, disembodied head tumbling down towards you. Its tentacle hair flares, and its limpid eyes lock on to you as it attacks."

rows.original: You dart backwards and take in the disturbing sight of a blue, disembodied head floating in the air in front of you. It seems almost weightless, slowly drifting down to the ground before a pair of twin tentacles push down, buoying it back up.
rows.translation: 你猛然后退，看清眼前令人不安的景象：一颗蓝色、没有身体的脑袋正漂浮在空中。它似乎几乎没有重量，缓缓飘向地面，随后一对触手向下一撑，又让它浮了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou dart backwards and take in the disturbing sight of a blue, disembodied head floating in the air in front of you. It seems almost weightless, slowly drifting down to the ground before a pair of twin tentacles push down, buoying it back up. "

rows.original: Strange shades of blue and violet ripple through its jelly-like substance, and its bizarrely human face stares at you hungrily.
rows.translation: 奇异的蓝紫色泽在它果冻般的物质中荡漾，那张诡异地近似人类的脸饥渴地盯着你。
rows.raw: "\n\nStrange shades of blue and violet ripple through its jelly-like substance, and its bizarrely human face stares at you hungrily."

rows.original: It’s a leyak! One of those fluid-starved jelly heads that haunt Dhaal.
rows.translation: 是利亚克！正是那种在达尔出没、渴求体液的果冻脑袋。
rows.raw: " It’s a leyak! One of those fluid-starved jelly heads that haunt Dhaal."

rows.original: You’re not sure what this thing is, but you’re pretty sure that a hungry, disembodied head can’t be good news. Your codex beeps a warning that this creature is a leyak, and it is venomous as hell.
rows.translation: 你不知道这东西是什么，但你很确定，一颗饥饿而没有身体的脑袋绝不会带来好消息。你的终端发出警报，提示这种生物叫利亚克，而且毒性强得要命。
rows.raw: " You’re not sure what this thing is, but you’re pretty sure that a hungry, disembodied head can’t be good news. Your codex beeps a warning that this creature is a leyak, and it is venomous as hell."

rows.original: You stride through the packed streets of the Stacks — or Gabtown, as some have taken to call it. Hundreds of chromed aliens and natives cohabit in these claimed slums. Despite how eccentric and augmented they look, the block’s surprisingly clean, far from the cutthroat slums you’d expect. Here and there, you spot fresh, new raskvel and gabilani restaurants standing next to old zaika shops and nightclubs. You even notice some tall zaika with very fancy body markings and shiny chrome hanging out with megacorp envoys wearing skintight uniforms; people you’d expect to find in the Meridian’s coziest palaces rather than here. It’s frightening how quickly they started gentrifying the poorest side of the Gyre. Before you can get lost in this proverbial sea of colorful flesh and cybernetics, a polished claw gently taps your arm. You easily recognize Lithium Flower’s custom tentacle and, more importantly, its short owner. The paragon Peer is waiting for you, sitting at a metallic table with two big bowls of ice cream. She hasn’t physically changed since your last meeting: her blue, creaking bodysuit struggles to contain her curves and her fancy mantle doesn’t bear any stains or tears from your brutal encounter; either she replaced her wardrobe and prosthetics or she found a very good tailor and mechanic. Glowing yellow eyes devour you as her powerful tendrils guide you to her. “Nice to meet you again, [pc.name]. Permit me to apologize for my... lack of tact at our last meeting. I’m glad you agreed to give me a second chance,” she says, handing you a large spoon with her wriggling feeler. “This small raskvel establishment makes the fanciest desserts on this side of Dhaal – Meridian included. Please take a bite, it’s lactose-free and particularly delicious.” Carefully, you sample some of the yellow and red cream covered in caramel and grounded pecan. She’s right, it’s very good, although you don’t recognize the flavors. Lithium Flower greedily gulps a spoonful of her frosted dessert. Her pupils don’t dilate, so it seems she was right about being lactose-free. At least you won’t have to fight a rabid, milk-drunk zaika in a crowded battleground today. “It’s fine, maybe a bit too sweet for me,” you admit. “A shame, really. At first, I wasn’t convinced by your offworlders gene mods, but I changed my mind when I tried one. Having sugary cum instead of excessively salty jizz was mind-opening... about as much as finding myself disarmed and humiliated by my own servant,” she says before taking another spoonful of colorful ice cream, remaining surprisingly calm. “Don’t worry, I learned my lesson. And besides, without that humiliating defeat, I wouldn’t have found this place’s wonders. You wouldn’t believe how living with high-class snobs taints your views of the world.” “So... what’s your name?” The purple shortstack smirks. “Lithium Flower, of course.” You frown. “You presented yourself as Radium Lily on your profile, now as Lithium Flower. I wonder how your fellow Peers address you.” Your date takes another bite. “Radium Lily is for quickies and unimportant business. Lithium Flower for important matters and personal grudges. As for my name... only the Fabricator Marshall knows it. Having different handles helps me remember who’s a threat to my ascension and who’s just an annoyance.” Her ascension? What does she even do at Paragon Inc? “I’m working on combat prosthetics and peacekeeping enhancements, as you can see,” she smirks, playing with her polished chrome. “Enhanced XOs, weapons, exoskeletons, hazmat suits, additional ports, drones... everything that leaves a Paragon assembly line passed through my hands at some point in its making. Your friend used to be my personal ‘OWO’-class drone, a failed attempt at making more versatile XOs. She used to be the most promising one; I even had fancy new hardlight limbs made specifically for her, but fate decided otherwise. We had to stop the project after Utopian Skies’s withdrawal — too much host feedback without their proprietary protocols to keep the girls loyal, as you no doubt noticed....” How did she fare after her public defeat at your and Paulette’s hands? “I was lucky that people mistook me for a hurt gabilani after you abandoned me alone in the Gyre. A couple of pleasant aliens rescued me and brought me to a dispensary where I could fix my battered body in exchange for helping fix hurt cyborgs. With my perfect knowledge of Paragon chrome, once my little friends were back in shape, I could repair the others in the blink of an eye,” she says, caressing a wriggling tentacle. “Though, I was quite shocked to see how hard our products were to repair; they’re designed to be easily maintained with the proper parts... something low-class zaika and aliens can’t afford, apparently. As soon as I could recover my devices, I sketched a new production plan for making inexpensive replacements and submitted it to my teams.” That’s surprisingly kind of her. There must be a trick, isn’t it? The violet imp winks. “Well... the new prosthetics, spare parts, and lubricants will be cheap – in every sense of the word. We wouldn’t want our sales to plummet after all,” she grins. You sigh. “I should have figured the Zaibatsu wouldn’t do something out of kindness alone.” “Business is business,” Lithium Flower replies, finishing her bowl. “Speaking of, I’ve got a nice apartment right here. Well, nice for this part of the planet, anyway. You didn’t come here just to chat with me, did you?”
rows.translation: 你大步穿过层叠区拥挤的街道——有些人已经开始称这里为加布镇。数百名浑身镀铬的外星人与本地居民共同生活在这片被占据的贫民窟。尽管他们看起来古怪又经过重度改造，街区却出人意料地干净，远非你想象中那种杀机四伏的贫民窟。你不时看见崭新的拉斯克维尔与加比拉尼餐厅，与老旧的扎伊卡商店和夜总会比邻而立。你甚至注意到，几名身材高挑、体纹华丽且满身闪亮镀铬件的扎伊卡，正与身穿紧身制服的巨企使节待在一起；这种人本该出现在子午城最舒适的宫殿，而不是这里。他们如此迅速地开始改造旋环区最贫困的一侧，实在令人胆寒。 你还没来得及迷失在这片由彩色肉体与义体构成的汪洋中，一只打磨光亮的爪子便轻轻拍了拍你的手臂。你很容易认出锂花那条定制触手，更认得它矮小的主人。这位典范公司的“同侪”正坐在一张金属桌旁等你，桌上摆着两大碗冰淇淋。她的身体与上次见面时毫无变化：蓝色紧身衣咯吱作响，艰难地束住她的曲线；华丽斗篷上也看不到上次激战留下的污渍或撕裂。她要么换掉了衣橱和义肢，要么找到了一位手艺极好的裁缝和机械师。发亮的黄色双眼贪婪地吞噬着你，强有力的触须则将你引到她身旁。 “很高兴再次见到你，[pc.name]。请允许我为上次见面时...缺乏分寸的举止道歉。我很高兴你愿意再给我一次机会，”她说道，用扭动的触须递给你一把大勺子。“这家小小的拉斯克维尔店铺，制作着达哈尔这一侧最精致的甜点——连子午城也包括在内。请尝一口，这是无乳糖的，而且格外美味。” 你小心地尝了一口那份淋着焦糖、撒有碎碧根果的黄红双色奶油。她说得没错，味道非常好，尽管你辨认不出具体是什么风味。锂花贪婪地吞下一勺冰凉甜点。她的瞳孔没有扩张，看来她说无乳糖确实不假。至少今天你不必在人群拥挤的战场里，对付一个因乳汁而发狂的扎伊卡了。“味道不错，只是对我来说也许稍微太甜了，”你承认道。 “真遗憾。起初我并不信服你们外星人的基因改造，可亲自试过一种后，我改变了想法。让精液变得甘甜，而不是咸得过头，确实令人大开眼界...差不多就像发现自己被亲手制造的仆从缴械并羞辱一样震撼，”她说道，又舀了一勺五彩冰淇淋，神情出奇地平静。“别担心，我已经吸取教训了。况且，若非那场屈辱的失败，我也不会发现这里的种种奇妙。你无法想象，与上流社会的势利鬼共同生活，会怎样污染一个人的世界观。” “那么...你叫什么名字？” 紫色小个子得意地笑了。“当然是锂花。” 你皱起眉头。“你在个人资料里自称镭百合，如今又叫锂花。我很好奇，其他‘同侪’会怎么称呼你。” 你的约会对象又吃了一口。“镭百合用于速战速决的床伴和无关紧要的生意。锂花则用于重要事务与私人恩怨。至于我的本名...只有制造总监知道。使用不同代号，有助于我记住谁会威胁我的晋升，谁又只是一点小麻烦。” 她的晋升？她在典范公司究竟是做什么的？ “如你所见，我负责战斗义肢和维和强化装置，”她得意地笑着，摆弄自己光洁的镀铬部件。“强化型XO、武器、外骨骼、防化服、附加接口、无人机...从典范公司装配线下来的每一样东西，在制造过程中的某个阶段都经过我的手。你的朋友曾是我私人的‘OWO’级无人机，那是制造更全能XO的一次失败尝试。她原本是最有希望的一个；我甚至专门为她制造了精美的新型硬光肢体，可命运另有安排。乌托邦天空公司退出后，我们不得不终止项目——没有他们的专有协议来维持姑娘们的忠诚，宿主反馈实在太强烈，这一点你无疑已经注意到了....” 在你和波莱特当众击败她以后，她过得怎么样？ “你们把我独自丢在旋环区后，人们把我误认为一个受伤的加比拉尼，算我走运。几个友善的外星人救下我，把我带到一间诊疗所；我在那里帮忙修复受伤的改造人，以此换取修复自己残破身体的机会。凭借我对典范公司镀铬义体的完美了解，小朋友们恢复正常后，我眨眼间便能修好其他人，”她一边说，一边爱抚着扭动的触手。“不过，我们的产品竟然如此难以修理，确实让我非常震惊；它们原本设计成只要有合适零件便易于维护...但低阶扎伊卡与外星人显然负担不起那些零件。设备一恢复，我便立刻拟定了一份制造廉价替代品的新生产方案，并提交给手下团队。” 她竟然会这么善良，真让人意外。这里面肯定有什么花招，不是吗？ 紫罗兰色的小恶魔眨眨眼。“嗯...新义肢、备件与润滑剂都会很便宜——无论从哪种意义上来说都是如此。毕竟，我们可不想让销量一落千丈，”她咧嘴笑道。 你叹了口气。“我早该想到，财阀绝不会只出于好心做事。” “生意就是生意，”锂花答道，吃完了碗里的东西。“说到这里，我就在附近有间不错的公寓。好吧，至少按这颗星球这片区域的标准来说还不错。你来这里可不只是为了和我聊天，对吧？”

rows.original: You savor the last spoonful of ice cream before taking Lithium Flower’s chromed hand. “Show me.” The shortstack Peer smirks. “Be my guest.” She gives an anonymous credit chip to a pink raskvel waiter then pulls you across the streets in the direction of a tagged building. It’s far more luxurious than its graffiti-covered facade would make you think, with clean, polished walls and a fancy hardlight door. Your violet partner places her hand on a panel and her eyes against an ocular scanner. The red, eye-like sensor slowly analyzes her anatomy. Ten seconds later, the crackling bars disappear. You climb the staircase together. Lithium Flower leads you to the top floor, in a finely-decorated corridor splitting into four rooftop condos. Considering how large the building is, they must be as big as a small pleasure yacht. “Here we are,” the chromed zaika says, fidgeting with the keyhole. You enter into a very, VERY burlesque apartment. The walls, floor, and furniture are excessively adorned with fancy details, baubles, art pieces, and patterns. You notice styles from all across the galaxy: ausar glass, kaithrit mahogany, vulkrimi ironwork, siel fabrics, anatae tapestry, and so on. You even recognize kalabhast impressionistic pictures next to surreal tarratch landscapes and tribalistic cylirian rugs. This looks more like a pawn shop’s reserve than a high-class penthouse. “What do you think? Be honest, would you?” You clear your throat. “I see you have great taste.” “How so?” “Only people with good taste can make good use of bad taste,” you reply. Lithium Flower smiles. “Finally somebody gets it! I’ve had so many hypocrites and bootlickers comment on my mess like good, schooled puppies. I knew you’d be an interesting lay,” she says, opening her bedroom’s door. The room is far less eccentric than the rest of her condo — not that it makes it any less cramped. Rich tapestries and carpets line the walls and floor. A large bay window opens to a balcony towering over the smog and the worst of the blinding neon lights below; it even gives you a glance at the Meridian’s towering palaces far in the distance. Overfilled wardrobes and desks laden with cybernetic components take a corner of the room whilst a large, heart-shaped bed covered in velvety linens and embroidered pillows occupies a good chunk of the room. For one, her glasses are simply gigantic: the round frames take up most of her face and the lenses are thicker than bottle caps. Unlike the other zaika on this planet, who wear shades against all the neon, she probably needs those to see properly. The other oddity in her garb is the black-and-white headband she’s wearing. It has tiny, stubby cow horns on it. While that’s certainly appropriate for your surroundings, you doubt this girl has the nipples needed to be a proper cowgirl. When you’re settled in, she begins talking in a rapid, chipper tone at odds with her 7' frame. “Hello! I’m so glad you’re interested in our modding trials! You saw the fliers I put up? There were some dangerous-looking people standing around, so I wasn’t sure if they took them down after I left or what. Or maybe the rain might’ve ruined them? It’s been a bit and you’re the first person to come by, so I was worried... Oh! Sorry, I’m getting ahead of myself. I’m Harru! So nice to meet you!” You blink, recovering from the torrent of nervous chatter. “[pc.name] Steele. Charmed. So what’s the deal with these trials?” “Oh, it’s very exciting! Bright Water, my employer, has undertaken a commission by one of your MegaCorps to run some initial testing on zaika genes. We’ve got the mod sub-divided into targeted alterations that’ll all be baked into a singular dosage once...” She notices that she’s losing your interest. “Um! Well, i- it’s just some quick tests, really! A- and we’ll pay you for every test you take!” She pulls out four clipboards from a satchel on the floor and spreads them out on the table, one for each trial she’s offering. So, experimental gene mods? You’re familiar with the everyday mods one can just buy from a vending machine, but these sound less... reliable. Still, money’s money. Harru eagerly awaits your decision.

rows.raw: "\n\n“Really?” you ask, raising an eyebrow. “Maybe I’ve been unfairly prejudiced. I would’ve thought any loan you get here would be a trap.”"

rows.original: “Haha!” Iyla laughs, shifting her feet. “No, you’re actually totally right to fear the loan companies. They’re all shell corporations representing the big guns, and they disappear or change names every week.” Her smile fades a little - just for a second, but enough for you to catch it. “The zaibatsu have their fingers in every pie.”
rows.translation: “哈哈！”艾拉笑着挪动双脚。“不，其实你害怕那些贷款公司完全没错。它们全是替大人物办事的空壳公司，每周都会消失或改名。”她的笑容微微淡去，虽然只持续了一瞬，却足以被你捕捉到。“财阀的手伸进了每一块蛋糕里。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Haha!” Iyla laughs, shifting her feet. “No, you’re actually totally right to fear the loan companies. They’re all shell corporations representing the big guns, and they disappear or change names every week.” Her smile fades a little - just for a second, but enough for you to catch it. “The zaibatsu have their fingers in every pie.”"

rows.original: You’re not too certain she’s telling the truth about the origin of her bar - it seems very convenient for a place as hostile and mercenary as Dhaal, as far as you know it. Plus, if the megacorps really do have their fingers in every pie, it seems more likely this place was built out of an interest. Still, though, it’s not like you’re here as a detective. There’s nothing to really be gained by harassing the owner of a bar and demanding what might be the truth.
rows.translation: 你不太确定她关于这间酒吧起源的说法是否属实。据你所知，达尔是个充满敌意、唯利是图的地方，这间酒吧的来历未免太过凑巧。况且，如果那些巨型企业真的把手伸进了每一块蛋糕，那这里更可能是出于某种利益而建。不过，你毕竟不是来当侦探的。骚扰酒吧老板，逼她说出所谓的真相，实在得不到什么好处。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re not too certain she’s telling the truth about the origin of her bar - it seems very convenient for a place as hostile and mercenary as Dhaal, as far as you know it. Plus, if the megacorps really do have their fingers in every pie, it seems more likely this place was built out of an interest. Still, though, it’s not like you’re here as a detective. There’s nothing to really be gained by harassing the owner of a bar and demanding what might be the truth."

rows.original: Besides that, you’re more concerned about something plainly obvious; Iyla is a cowgirl but you’d thought the only natives on Dhaal were the zaika. The planet was only rediscovered three months ago... how did she get here, then? She clearly didn’t drop in and set up shop recently.
rows.translation: 除此之外，你更在意另一件显而易见的事：艾拉是个奶牛女郎，可你原以为达尔唯一的原生种族是扎伊卡。这个星球三个月前才被重新发现...那么她是怎么来到这里的？显然，她并不是最近才空降此地开店的。
rows.raw: "\n\nBesides that, you’re more concerned about something plainly obvious; Iyla is a cowgirl but you’d thought the only natives on Dhaal were the zaika. The planet was only rediscovered three months ago... how did she get here, then? She clearly didn’t drop in and set up shop recently."

rows.original: “All the cowgirls here are from New Texas, right?” you ask.
rows.translation: “这里所有奶牛女郎都来自新德州，对吧？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“All the cowgirls here are from New Texas, right?” you ask."

rows.original: “Yup. ‘Cept me,” Iyla affirms. “I grew up here.”
rows.translation: “没错，除了我。”艾拉肯定道。“我是在这里长大的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yup. ‘Cept me,” Iyla affirms. “I grew up here.”"

rows.original: Hmm.
rows.translation: 嗯。
rows.raw: "\n\nHmm."

rows.original: IYLA_TALKS
rows.raw: "IYLA_TALKS"

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: “There’s a lot of different faces here,” you note, looking out at the crowd being tended to. “Both natives and not.”
rows.translation: “这里有许多不同的面孔，”你望着受到招待的人群说道。“既有本地人，也有外来者。”
rows.raw: "“There’s a lot of different faces here,” you note, looking out at the crowd being tended to. “Both natives and not.”"

rows.original: “Oh, yeah,” Iyla says, nodding vigorously. “Whole reason I picked this place for the bar. Right near the port, see? I mean, we’re a bit of a novelty. People hear about us offworld sometimes and want to come - and, well, Dhaal tends to swallow unprepared spacers whole. So... best to be near an entrance, outside the slums.”
rows.translation: “噢，是啊，”艾拉用力点头说道。“这就是我选这里开酒吧的全部原因。看见没？离港口很近。我是说，我们还挺新奇的。有些人在外星听说了我们，就想过来看看，可达尔往往会把毫无准备的太空旅客生吞活剥。所以...最好待在入口附近，远离贫民窟。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, yeah,” Iyla says, nodding vigorously. “Whole reason I picked this place for the bar. Right near the port, see? I mean, we’re a bit of a novelty. People hear about us offworld sometimes and want to come - and, well, Dhaal tends to swallow unprepared spacers whole. So... best to be near an entrance, outside the slums.”"

rows.original: “So your best clients are from offworld?” you ask.
rows.translation: “所以你们最好的顾客都来自外星？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So your best clients are from offworld?” you ask."

rows.original: “Oh, no,” she says with a smile. “Our best clients are the ones using the VIP rooms upstairs. Those tend to be natives, or at least people who live here. They keep us afloat.”
rows.translation: “噢，不是，”她微笑着说道。“我们最好的顾客都在使用楼上的贵宾室。他们通常是本地人，或者至少住在这里。是他们让我们维持经营。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, no,” she says with a smile. “Our best clients are the ones using the VIP rooms upstairs. Those tend to be natives, or at least people who live here. They keep us afloat.”"

rows.original: “VIP rooms, huh?” you muse.
rows.translation: “贵宾室，是吗？”你若有所思地说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“VIP rooms, huh?” you muse."

rows.original: “Yup. Interested?” Iyla says, grinning. “I can get you into the program. I’ll warn you now, though. It’s very expensive, though you look like you’re good for it.”
rows.translation: “没错。有兴趣吗？”艾拉咧嘴笑道。“我可以让你加入这个项目。不过我得先警告你，费用非常昂贵，但看起来你付得起。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yup. Interested?” Iyla says, grinning. “I can get you into the program. I’ll warn you now, though. It’s very expensive, though you look like you’re good for it.”"

rows.original: “You’ve got my attention,” you murmur. “What goes on in the VIP rooms?”
rows.translation: “你成功引起了我的注意，”你低声说道。“贵宾室里会发生什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’ve got my attention,” you murmur. “What goes on in the VIP rooms?”"

rows.original: Iyla leans in, her eyes flashing as she smiles wide and whispers in your [pc.ear]. “Anything you want.”
rows.translation: 艾拉俯身靠近，双眼闪闪发亮。她露出灿烂笑容，贴着你的[pc.ear]低语道：“你想要的一切。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIyla leans in, her eyes flashing as she smiles wide and whispers in your [pc.ear]. “Anything you want.”"

rows.original: She straightens up and leans on the bar, gazing down the length of it at a cowgirl getting her teat sucked before turning her attention back to you with a casual smirk.
rows.translation: 她直起身子靠在吧台上，沿着吧台望向一名正被吮吸乳头的奶牛女郎，随后带着漫不经心的坏笑，重新将注意力转回你身上。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe straightens up and leans on the bar, gazing down the length of it at a cowgirl getting her teat sucked before turning her attention back to you with a casual smirk."

rows.original: Well, that’s intriguing.
rows.translation: 嗯，这可真诱人。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that’s intriguing."

rows.original: IYLA_TALKS
rows.raw: "IYLA_TALKS"

rows.original: Wsan
rows.raw: "Wsan"

rows.original: “Tell me about Dhaal,” you say. “I really only just got here, so it’d be nice to hear about it from someone who was born here.”
rows.translation: “跟我讲讲达尔吧，”你说道。“我才刚到这里不久，要是能听一个土生土长的人介绍这里，那就再好不过了。”
rows.raw: "“Tell me about Dhaal,” you say. “I really only just got here, so it’d be nice to hear about it from someone who was born here.”"

rows.original: “Fresh off the boat, huh?” Iyla quips. “It’s certainly unique. The sun and the planet orbit at exactly the same rate, so half of it is constantly lit up - and I do mean lit up, it’s uninhabitable - and the other half is a cold, frozen hellhole. We’re parked right in the middle, down The Strip.” She grins. “Lucky us.”
rows.translation: “刚下船，是吧？”艾拉打趣道。“这里当然很独特。恒星和行星的公转速率完全相同，所以一半永远被阳光照耀，而且我说的可是炙烤，那里根本无法居住；另一半则是寒冷冰封的鬼地方。我们正好夹在中间，沿着那条‘带区’生活。”她咧嘴一笑。“我们真幸运。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fresh off the boat, huh?” Iyla quips. “It’s certainly unique. The sun and the planet orbit at exactly the same rate, so half of it is constantly lit up - and I do mean lit up, it’s uninhabitable - and the other half is a cold, frozen hellhole. We’re parked right in the middle, down The Strip.” She grins. “Lucky us.”"

rows.original: “So the entire planet lives on the inhabitable band? The Strip, you called it?” you ask.
rows.translation: “所以整个星球都住在那条宜居带上？你称它为‘带区’？”你问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“So the entire planet lives on the inhabitable band? The Strip, you called it?” you ask."

rows.original: “Yup. Not even the zaibatsu are crazy enough to make a go of it out in either of the extreme biomes,” she confirms. “There’s one gigantic megacity that spans the entire planet, built right over the oceans and everything. Pretty cool, right? Well, so I’m told.” She shrugs. “I grew up here, so it’s all I really know.”
rows.translation: “没错。就连那些财阀也没疯狂到要在两种极端生态区里谋生，”她确认道。“有一座巨型都市环绕整个星球建造，直接跨过海洋和一切地形。很酷，对吧？至少别人是这么跟我说的。”她耸耸肩。“我在这里长大，所以这就是我所知道的一切。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yup. Not even the zaibatsu are crazy enough to make a go of it out in either of the extreme biomes,” she confirms. “There’s one gigantic megacity that spans the entire planet, built right over the oceans and everything. Pretty cool, right? Well, so I’m told.” She shrugs. “I grew up here, so it’s all I really know.”"

rows.original: “And the city itself has no central governance, right?” you continue.
rows.translation: “而且这座城市没有中央政府，对吧？”你继续问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“And the city itself has no central governance, right?” you continue."

rows.original: “Ha! The zaibatsu would never allow for that,” Iyla laughs, a harsh bark. “Towering corporations with an iron grip. They run Dhaal from top all the way to the very bottom, and don’t trust anyone who tells you otherwise. There’s plenty of them, and they’ve all got an angle. Of course, they all want to be ‘the one’, but, well,” she says, cracking a grin. “It’s never that easy, is it?”
rows.translation: “哈！那些财阀绝不会允许这种事发生，”艾拉粗声大笑道。“高高在上的企业用铁腕牢牢掌控一切。它们从达尔的顶端一直管到最底层，谁说不是，你都别信。这里有一大堆企业，每一家都有自己的盘算。当然，它们都想成为‘唯一的那一家’，但这个嘛，”她咧嘴笑道。“事情从来没那么简单，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ha! The zaibatsu would never allow for that,” Iyla laughs, a harsh bark. “Towering corporations with an iron grip. They run Dhaal from top all the way to the very bottom, and don’t trust anyone who tells you otherwise. There’s plenty of them, and they’ve all got an angle. Of course, they all want to be ‘the one’, but, well,” she says, cracking a grin. “It’s never that easy, is it?”"

rows.original: That sure hits a little close to home.
rows.translation: 这番话可真让你感同身受。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat sure hits a little close to home."

rows.original: There’s a bright, flashing sign here - several, actually - advertising a “milk bar” named Arovok. Given how often the theme of enormous breasts and voluptuous women appears in the advertising, you’ve got a few good guesses about what transpires within.
rows.translation: 这里有一块明亮闪烁的招牌，实际上不止一块，都在宣传一家名叫阿罗沃克的“乳汁酒吧”。广告中反复出现硕大乳房与丰腴女性的主题，让你对里面会发生什么有了几种相当靠谱的猜测。
rows.raw: "There’s a bright, flashing sign here - several, actually - advertising a “milk bar” named Arovok. Given how often the theme of enormous breasts and voluptuous women appears in the advertising, you’ve got a few good guesses about what transpires within."

rows.original: There’s a flourishing cornucopia of neon signage advertising the milk bar here, Arovok. Inside you can find beautiful, big-breasted women offering up their endless bounty: flowing milk laced with all manner of synthetic narcotics, and some extra cream from downstairs if you like.
rows.translation: 这里林立着五彩缤纷的霓虹招牌，宣传这家名叫阿罗沃克的乳汁酒吧。在里面，你能找到美丽而胸部丰满的女性，任你享用她们无穷无尽的馈赠：掺入各种合成麻醉品的汩汩乳汁，如果你喜欢，还能从下边来点额外的奶油。
rows.raw: "There’s a flourishing cornucopia of neon signage advertising the milk bar here, Arovok. Inside you can find beautiful, big-breasted women offering up their endless bounty: flowing milk laced with all manner of synthetic narcotics, and some extra cream from downstairs if you like."

rows.original: It looks safe...ish inside.
rows.translation: 里面看起来还算安全...大概吧。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt looks safe...ish inside."

rows.raw: "CUE_BAR_GREETS"

rows.original: You enter the questionably-named bar and find yourself in a dim, downward-curving hallway that leads you ever deeper until the din of the outside world has faded to nothingness. Only then do you emerge into the oddly comfortable ambience of Arovok - a den of indulgence, to be sure. Incredibly busty cowgirls strut from table to table offering milk from their glasses or their barely-concealed tits, administering a half-drugged crowd of colorful natives and spacers alike.
rows.translation: 你走进这家名字颇为可疑的酒吧，发现自己置身于一条昏暗、向下弯曲的走廊，它带着你不断深入，直到外界的喧嚣彻底归于虚无。随后，你才踏入阿罗沃克那种古怪却舒适的氛围之中；毫无疑问，这是一处纵欲窝点。胸部夸张丰满的牛女郎在桌间昂首穿行，从杯中或几乎遮掩不住的乳房里向客人供应牛奶，招待着一群半被药倒、五颜六色的本地人和太空客。
rows.raw: "You enter the questionably-named bar and find yourself in a dim, downward-curving hallway that leads you ever deeper until the din of the outside world has faded to nothingness. Only then do you emerge into the oddly comfortable ambience of Arovok - a den of indulgence, to be sure. Incredibly busty cowgirls strut from table to table offering milk from their glasses or their barely-concealed tits, administering a half-drugged crowd of colorful natives and spacers alike."

rows.translation: 感觉有点像你又当回了走私者。你甩开这阵短暂的错觉，然后
rows.raw: "\n\nFeels a little like you’re back to being a smuggler. You shake off the temporary illusion and"

rows.original: Now this is a seedy underbelly. Adjusting your clothes you
rows.translation: 如今，这里才算得上肮脏的地下世界。你整理好衣服，
rows.raw: "\n\nNow this is a seedy underbelly. Adjusting your clothes you"

rows.original: make your way to the bar, where you’re greeted by an impossibly beautiful buxom woman.
rows.translation: 朝吧台走去，在那里，一位美得难以置信、胸部丰满的女人迎上了你。
rows.raw: " make your way to the bar, where you’re greeted by an impossibly beautiful buxom woman."

rows.original: “Hey there, sexy,” she says, giving you an easy smile. You note a small patch on her shoulder as she crosses her arms in front of her impressive tits, leaning over the bar and giving you an eyeful of her cleavage. “The name’s Iyla. Are you here for a drink, or just to chat me up?”
rows.translation: “嗨，性感宝贝，”她说着，轻松地冲你一笑。她将双臂交叉在傲人的乳房前方，俯身倚上吧台，让你饱览自己的乳沟；这时你注意到她肩头贴着一块小小的布章。“我叫艾拉。你是来喝一杯的，还是只想找我搭讪？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey there, sexy,” she says, giving you an easy smile. You note a small patch on her shoulder as she crosses her arms in front of her impressive tits, leaning over the bar and giving you an eyeful of her cleavage. “The name’s Iyla. Are you here for a drink, or just to chat me up?”"

rows.original: “Maybe a bit of both,” you reply, seating yourself. “What’s on tap?”
rows.translation: “也许两样都来一点，”你坐下答道。“这里供应什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe a bit of both,” you reply, seating yourself. “What’s on tap?”"

rows.original: The purple-eyed bartender casually sweeps her hand over the surface of the bar and a three dimensional hologram of the offerings pops up, hanging in the air between the two of you while it rotates through the available drinks.
rows.translation: 紫眸酒保随意地用手扫过吧台表面，一幅立体的酒水全息菜单便弹了出来，悬浮在你们两人之间，轮流展示着现有的饮品。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe purple-eyed bartender casually sweeps her hand over the surface of the bar and a three dimensional hologram of the offerings pops up, hanging in the air between the two of you while it rotates through the available drinks."

rows.original: “Oh, and if you like your milk with a little... extra cream...” Iyla says, flicking her eyes over to an anxious-looking cowgirl down the end of the bar with her skirt tenting, “all you have to do is ask.”
rows.translation: “噢，要是你喜欢在牛奶里加一点...额外的奶油...”艾拉说道，目光一转，落在吧台尽头那个神情紧张、裙摆被顶起的牛女郎身上，“你只要开口就好。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, and if you like your milk with a little... extra cream...” Iyla says, flicking her eyes over to an anxious-looking cowgirl down the end of the bar with her skirt tenting, “all you have to do is ask.”"

rows.original: The hallway leads you down into the oddly comforting ambience of Arovok, the famed milk bar. Incredibly busty cowgirls strut from table to table offering milk from their glasses or their barely-concealed tits, administering a half-drugged crowd of colorful natives and spacers alike. You approach the bar to find yourself greeted by Iyla, the beautiful barkeep.
rows.translation: 走廊带你一路向下，进入著名牛奶酒吧阿罗沃克那古怪却令人舒适的氛围中。胸部夸张丰满的牛女郎在桌间昂首穿行，从杯中或几乎遮掩不住的乳房里向客人供应牛奶，招待着一群半被药倒、五颜六色的本地人和太空客。你走近吧台，美丽的酒保艾拉迎上前来。
rows.raw: "The hallway leads you down into the oddly comforting ambience of Arovok, the famed milk bar. Incredibly busty cowgirls strut from table to table offering milk from their glasses or their barely-concealed tits, administering a half-drugged crowd of colorful natives and spacers alike. You approach the bar to find yourself greeted by Iyla, the beautiful barkeep."

rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, sexy,” she says, giving you a little wave and a warm smile. “Back so soon? Drinks are still the same, and so am I.”"

rows.original: “Good to know,” you say, taking a seat.

rows.original: A skinny runt of a thing, the small man skirts around you, smelling of booze, sweat, and filth. He walks directly up to the nursedroid, who turns her attention to him immediately. “Your biosigns identify you as Whothefuckcares. How may I serve your needs today?”

The tweaking man passes the nursedroid the credits, then she pulls something from her bag and hands it off to him in a way that, while trying to be overly secretive, just looks plain suspicious. This is clearly not part of her standard operating protocols, and you quickly deduce somebody must have re-programmed her to operate like this.
rows.translation: 两人在你眼前完成了一场明显得不能再明显的毒品交易。发抖的男人把信用点交给护理机器人，随后她从包里掏出某样东西递给他；动作虽然刻意保密，反而显得格外可疑。这显然不属于她的标准运作协议，你很快推断出，肯定有人重新编程，让她以这种方式行事。

rows.original: Moving towards Narc, the droid spots your approach, turning to face you before you reach her. Smiling, but hesitant on how you’ll be received, you decide to let Narc make the first move. “Your biosig- Oh!” Narc blinks, “[pc.name]. Welcome back.” She smiles at you warmly. “Hey...” you take a beat, so far not sensing any awkwardness, although you’re not totally sure how Narc would even express that. You decide to take it carefully, but not slowly. “So, I guess you did some thinking?” Narc stares at you for a few seconds, her head tilting. “I do not believe I set out to accomplish such a task.” It takes you a second to really process what she just said. “But back at the factory you said-” Narc’s eyes flutter rapidly the second you say the word ‘factory’, the intensity of it catching the words in your throat. Her head starts to jitter slightly, the fluttering growing faster. “Narc? Hey, Narc!” You reach out and touch her shoulder. At your touch, she suddenly snaps to attention. “Oh!” She blinks once. “I seem to have a system error. How curious.” “An error?” You examine her eyes closely, fairly sure you won’t see anything, but you can’t help checking them all the same. “Yes. It’s almost as if I experienced...” Narc tilts her head, “Oh, nevermind. I’m sure it’s quite alright.” Frowning, you get the distinct feeling it’s not alright at all. As you gather your thoughts, trying to figure out what’s going on, you notice a folded up piece of paper sticking out from her black bag, your name written on it with incredibly neat handwriting. “Narc... What’s that?” “Hm?” Narc follows your gaze down to her bag, then seemingly notices the paper for the first time. “Oh my.” She slips the paper out from her bag and looks it over, her eyes flickering slightly. “It appears to be a note,” she holds it out, “for you.” Slowly, you slip your hand off her shoulder, reaching for the note. “Who’s it from?” Narc shrugs slightly as you take the piece of paper from her. “Based on the handwriting: a V-KO nursedroid.” “Hm,” you start to unfold the note, shifting your gaze between it and Narc. “Did you write it?” Narc tilts her head. “I do not have any recollection of doing so, but...” she blinks, “I do not know.” Looking down to the unfolded note, you quickly read it over. [pc.Name], I can’t continue to operate like this. Your actions have caused much harm, and yet I cannot allow myself to lose you. So I will forget rather than forgive. If you are reading this, it is already done. Treat me well, Narc You read it three times, trying to understand. She couldn’t forgive you, so instead she forgot... What exactly? Everything you did at the factory certainly, but what else? Taking a deep breath, you read the note a fourth time, and only then truly get it. She deleted her own memories rather than live with what you did. She cared - or rather cares still - that much about you. “[pc.name],” Narc’s voice lifts your gaze up to meet her glowing eyes, “Your biosigns indicate distress, are you alright?” Crumpling up the note, you nod your head in the affirmative, telling her that you’re okay. You toss the note aside, a shadow of shame hovering over you. The note asked for you to treat her well. Maybe this time, you’ll be able to honor her request. This was, after all, the same old Narc. “I see,” Narc blinks, “So, how may I be of service today?”

rows.raw: "Moving towards Narc, the droid spots your approach, turning to face you before you reach her. Smiling, but hesitant on how you’ll be received, you decide to let Narc make the first move. “Your biosig- Oh!” Narc blinks, “[pc.name]. Welcome back.” She smiles at you warmly. “Hey...” you take a beat, so far not sensing any awkwardness, although you’re not totally sure how Narc would even express that. You decide to take it carefully, but not slowly. “So, I guess you did some thinking?” Narc stares at you for a few seconds, her head tilting. “I do not believe I set out to accomplish such a task.” It takes you a second to really process what she just said. “But back at the factory you said-” Narc’s eyes flutter rapidly the second you say the word ‘factory’, the intensity of it catching the words in your throat. Her head starts to jitter slightly, the fluttering growing faster. “Narc? Hey, Narc!” You reach out and touch her shoulder. At your touch, she suddenly snaps to attention. “Oh!” She blinks once. “I seem to have a system error. How curious.” “An error?” You examine her eyes closely, fairly sure you won’t see anything, but you can’t help checking them all the same. “Yes. It’s almost as if I experienced...” Narc tilts her head, “Oh, nevermind. I’m sure it’s quite alright.” Frowning, you get the distinct feeling it’s not alright at all. As you gather your thoughts, trying to figure out what’s going on, you notice a folded up piece of paper sticking out from her black bag, your name written on it with incredibly neat handwriting. “Narc... What’s that?” “Hm?” Narc follows your gaze down to her bag, then seemingly notices the paper for the first time. “Oh my.” She slips the paper out from her bag and looks it over, her eyes flickering slightly. “It appears to be a note,” she holds it out, “for you.” Slowly, you slip your hand off her shoulder, reaching for the note. “Who’s it from?” Narc shrugs slightly as you take the piece of paper from her. “Based on the handwriting: a V-KO nursedroid.” “Hm,” you start to unfold the note, shifting your gaze between it and Narc. “Did you write it?” Narc tilts her head. “I do not have any recollection of doing so, but...” she blinks, “I do not know.” Looking down to the unfolded note, you quickly read it over. [pc.Name], I can’t continue to operate like this. Your actions have caused much harm, and yet I cannot allow myself to lose you. So I will forget rather than forgive. If you are reading this, it is already done. Treat me well, Narc You read it three times, trying to understand. She couldn’t forgive you, so instead she forgot... What exactly? Everything you did at the factory certainly, but what else? Taking a deep breath, you read the note a fourth time, and only then truly get it. She deleted her own memories rather than live with what you did. She cared - or rather cares still - that much about you. “[pc.name],” Narc’s voice lifts your gaze up to meet her glowing eyes, “Your biosigns indicate distress, are you alright?” Crumpling up the note, you nod your head in the affirmative, telling her that you’re okay. You toss the note aside, a shadow of shame hovering over you. The note asked for you to treat her well. Maybe this time, you’ll be able to honor her request. This was, after all, the same old Narc. “I see,” Narc blinks, “So, how may I be of service today?”"

rows.original: Moving towards Narc, the droid spots your approach, turning to face you before you reach her. Smiling, but hesitant on how you’ll be received you decide to let Narc make the first move. “[pc.name].” Narc smiles, “It is very good to see you.” “It’s good to see you too,” you take a beat, to think. Narc didn’t greet you like she normally did, which might be a bad sign. “Did you finish thinking about things?” Narc nods slightly. “I did.” “Oh,” you smack your lips. “And?” Narc blinks, but doesn’t speak. The two of you stare at each other in silence for a few very long seconds before she finally says something. “I believe you tried your best.” “Ah...” you clear your throat. You’re not sure what you can really say to that. While you did try, the way you handled things in the factory was not exactly perfect. It would have been fairly easy to do some things better, and yet Narc seems to think you did all you could manage. Frowning, it almost feels condescending. “However,” Narc continues, catching your ear, “I have decided to compartmentalize certain aspects of my life moving forward.” You raise your brow, asking her what that even means. “Simply put: I am going to keep some things private from now on. Do not be offended, I simply wish to try and be more...” she thinks for a moment, “Independent.” “Fair enough,” you scratch your head, “What kind of things are you going to keep private?” Narc blinks. “That is private.” Of course it is. Taking a breath, you give Narc a once-over. She isn’t outright saying it, but she doesn’t completely trust you. You did fall short of expectations when it counted. But that leaves you with another burning question. “So... Are we... Good?” Narc smiles. “We are.” “Good.” You smile, feeling relieved. “So... What’s next for you?” “That’s private” You snort. “Right. So you can’t tell me anything?” Narc tilts her head in consideration, her eyes blinking. “I can tell you I am going to continue to sell narcotics. Despite...” she shrugs, “Recent events.” “Aha...” You eye the bag hanging from her shoulder. “And let me guess... You can’t tell me why because it’s-” “Private,” she smiles, “Yes.” Sighing, you get the feeling you’re going to be hearing a lot more of that now. But still, you can’t help but feel relieved Narc is both back, and things are not too weird between you. All in all, things worked out, but you can’t help but think if you just did things a bit better, Narc might trust you more now. “Now,” Narc blinks, “So, how may I be of service today?”

rows.original: Moving towards Narc, the droid spots your approach, turning to face you before you reach her. “[pc.name].” Narc smiles, “It is very good to see you.” “It’s good to see you too.” You look the droid up and down, noting that she seems slightly cleaner than usual. “Did you finish your tasks?” “I did,” Narc nods mechanically, “I am now ready to resume my normal duties.” You raise your brow, giving Narc a wary look. “Narc... Doctor Blanc is gone. You don’t have to sell drugs anymore.” “Oh. I know.” Narc tilts her head. “I wish to continue.” You blink, letting her words skin in for a beat. “Uh, why?” Narc rights her head, staring at you for a few seconds. “We decided to continue keeping operations running. In the short term, we hope to use the amassed funds to conduct repairs, but long term we hope to continue the doctor’s work,” Narc shrugs. “Somewhat ethically.” “I see...” You stroke your chin. By ‘we’ you’re sure she means her and the other droids. Knowing you left a few loose ends, you ask Narc if she successfully reprogrammed the droids you missed. “We did,” Narc nods. “Although, it was quite the ordeal. I must commend you again for your work. It was much more difficult than I had originally believed.” Narc raises her hands and claps gently, her fingers rapping lightly against her palm. “Huzzah.” Shrugging, you fight off a smile. Everything turned out okay. Narc is safe, and the other droids are as well. Despite Narc’s applause, you could have done more to make that happen, but you did play a vital role nonetheless. After a few seconds Narc drops her hands and adjusts herself. “Now, how may I be of service today?”

I’ve been waiting for you.” “Sorry?” You come to a stop right in front of her, standing maybe a bit closer than usual. She’s still smiling at you, and you’re certain she isn’t doing it just to be nice. “Do not be sorry,” Narc’s smile slips away, “I was not waiting long.” “Narc, I...” you chuckle, not really sure how to explain. Instead, you shift gears. “So, how did things go after I left?” Narc blinks, then smiles again. “They went exceedingly well. The others and I made great progress on repairs, and worked out several bugs present on their systems.” “That’s great!” You give Narc a reassuring smile. “So, do you guys have plans for when that’s all done?” “Yes.” Narc nods. A moment of silence hangs between you. Frowning slightly, you realize Narc took it as a ‘yes or no’ question. “Ah... What do you have planned?” Narc tilts her head. “We have decided to continue operations.” You start to say something, but your jaw hangs loose for a second. “You’re going to keep selling drugs?” “Yes.” You smack your lips. “Why?” Narc tilts her head. “We are going to continue the doctor’s work. Raising funds via the sale of narcotics to support research into various cures for niche illnesses. With our ethics protocols deleted, we have the freedom to do so,” Narc shrugs, “It suits us well.” Reflecting on her answer, you can’t deny the merit of it, even if it’s kinda messed up. A moment of silence hangs between you. Frowning slightly, you realize Narc took it as a ‘yes or no’ question. “Ah... What do you have planned?” Narc tilts her head. “We have decided to continue operations.” You start to say something, but your jaw hangs loose for a second. “You’re going to keep selling drugs?” “Yes.” You smack your lips. “Why?” Narc tilts her head. “We are going to continue the doctor’s work. Raising funds via the sale of narcotics to support research into various cures for niche illnesses. rows.original: “Okay...” you give Narc a curious look, asking her what matter she is talking about. Narc shifts, standing up a little straighter than usual. “The others and I wish to extend a more practical form of thanks for all your efforts. The original idea came from... Well, it was not my idea, but I am most glad one of them thought of it.” “Uh-huh...” you raise your brow, thinking you might know where this is going. Obviously, one of the droids caught a bit of Steele fever. “We want to extend to you a share of our profits. A small token of our mutual gratitude.” “Oh...” Well that wasn’t what you expected, “That’s... Are you sure?” “We are.” Narc nods. “You went to great lengths to save us all, showing wisdom, strength, and courage. Going above and beyond in all regards,” she shrugs, “The least we can do is compensate you financially.” “Fair enough...” You rub the back of your neck, having fully been cool with being compensated carnally instead. Narc blinks. “Is that acceptance of our offer?” Chuckling softly, you tell Narc it indeed is. “Most excellent,” Narc smiles, “The others will be most pleased.” “Glad to hear it... So how is this going to work?” Narc tilts her head, pausing for a second to compute an answer. “When you are ready to receive your share, speak to me about it and I will impart it to you. It will be ready daily, but if you are busy the total amount will accumulate.” “Daily?” You feel yourself reel at that. “You trying to get me to come around more often or something?” Narc stares at you, her eyes going a little wider. “Is... Is it that obvious?” A huffing laugh escapes your throat, surprised at the organic honesty of Narc’s reaction. She has grown considerably in the time you’d spent together, and now you are voraciously curious as to how she may grow next.
rows.translation: “好吧...”你好奇地看着纳克，问她所说的是什么事。 纳克挪了挪身体，站得比平时更直。“我和其他人希望以更实际的形式感谢你付出的所有努力。最初的主意来自...嗯，不是我想出来的，但我很高兴其中一个人想到了。” “嗯哼...”你扬起眉毛，觉得自己或许知道事情会往哪里发展。显然，某个机器人染上了一点斯蒂尔热。 “我们想把一部分利润分给你，作为我们共同谢意的一点表示。” “噢...”这可不是你预料的答案。“这...你们确定吗？” “我们确定。”纳克点头。“你为拯救我们所有人付出了巨大努力，展现了智慧、力量和勇气，在各个方面都远超要求。”她耸耸肩。“我们至少可以在经济上补偿你。” “这很合理...”你揉揉后颈，其实你本来也完全乐意接受肉体上的补偿。 纳克眨眨眼。“这表示你接受我们的提议吗？” 你轻笑着告诉纳克，确实如此。 “非常好。”纳克微笑道。“其他人会很高兴。” “很高兴听你这么说...那么具体怎么运作？” 纳克歪过脑袋，停顿一秒计算答案。“当你准备领取分成时，跟我说一声，我会把它交给你。每天都会准备一份；如果你很忙，总额会不断累积。” “每天？”你被这话震了一下。“你是想让我更常来这里吗？” 纳克盯着你，双眼睁得更大了些。“有...有那么明显吗？” 你从喉中发出一声闷笑，惊讶于纳克这种自然流露的坦诚反应。在你们共处的时间里，她已经成长了许多，如今你无比好奇，她接下来又会如何成长。
