rows.original: “Gah!” You cry out, dropping your [pc.weaponMain] to the floor. You glance down, but suddenly feel dizzy, nearly falling over as your balance betrays you. Before you can right yourself, something heavy bowls into you, forcing you down with its considerable weight. Blanc has you pinned to the floor, his swollen body immobilizing you. He growls and rasps, the feral noises almost resembling words. The smell of his breath is putrid, but it’s the least of your worries. Wincing, you writhe against his burning skin, pressed in tight, corrosive and deadly to the touch. You struggle to fight your way out from under him, but you’re too exhausted. You can only watch as he rears back his head and bares his predatory teeth. The next thing you feel is a sharp pain in your neck, and an explosion of heat. “HNN!” You try to scream, but the weight on your chest is compressing your lungs. Head spinning, you feel yourself slipping away, the mutant man on top of you feeling heavier by the second. Shivering, you feel a chill... And then you don’t feel anything at all.
rows.translation: “啊！”你惨叫着，[pc.weaponMain]掉在地上。你低头看去，却突然眩晕，平衡背叛了你，险些跌倒。还没站稳，沉重物体便撞上身体，以巨大重量把你压倒。 布兰克把你钉在地板，膨胀身体令你无法移动。他咆哮嘶吼，兽性噪声几乎像语言。呼吸恶臭扑鼻，却是你最不需要担心的事。 你畏缩着挣扎，贴住他灼热皮肤；接触既腐蚀又致命。你试图从身下逃出，却已太疲惫，只能看他后仰脑袋，露出捕食者牙齿。接下来，颈部传来锐痛，热量爆炸。 “嗯！”你试图尖叫，可胸口重量压缩肺部。天旋地转中，意识渐渐滑走，身上的变异男人每秒都变得更沉。你颤抖着感到寒意... 随后再也感觉不到任何东西。

rows.original: After a moment of careful consideration, you tell the doctor you accept his terms. “Excellent,” he smiles, the thin skin on his face stretching concerningly, “I assume you wish to leave with, erm, Narc now?” “I would, yes.” You stow your [pc.weaponMain], getting the distinct sense you really won’t need it anymore. The air in the room has changed already, almost all the tension seemingly vanishing. “Give me a moment.” Blanc shuffles over to Narc on the slab, reaching into his pocket along the way. He produces a small datapad with a cord connected to it, his spindly fingers taking up the latter. Reaching Narc’s side, he plugs the cord into an unseen jack behind her ear, then turns his attention back to the pad. “This rollback will be quite comprehensive,” he turns his gaze towards the camera over the door, “It’ll be as if the past few days had never happened.” You wait patiently as the doctor completes his work. The process takes a few minutes, and when he’s done he pulls the cord from Narc’s neck and pockets the device. “Now...” he clears his throat, “Droid, activate.” Narc’s eyes light up, her body suddenly becoming rigid, coming to life on the slab. Looking at her closely, you notice her eyes are blinking steadily rather than burning a consistent white, a sign she might be rebooting. “I’ve rebooted them in safe mode,” Blanc explains, unstrapping Narc from the slab, “This will last a short while as the restoration completes, but they are quite functional. Droid, step down.” Narc does as she’s told, stepping down and standing still in front of the now vacant slab. “So, I can leave with her then?” You ask, moving towards the stone-still droid. She looks the same as usual, although perhaps a little more stiff. “Of course,” Blanc nods slightly, “I have installed a minor update that will allow you to claim your share of the credits from them. Other than that...” he shrugs, “You’re all set to leave.” “Uh,” you size Narc up, “Do I need to carry her?” Blanc tries to snort, but ends up coughing. After a moment to collect himself, he shakes his head. “Allow me. Droid. Return to posting.” No sooner than the words leave his mouth does Narc turn towards the door and start walking, moving with machine intent. Watching her stalk across the room, you give the doctor a quizzical look. “Best follow.” He shrugs weakly. “They are returning to where I’m sure you met them.” Narc is almost out of the room by this point. Left with no other option, you turn to follow, taking a moment to catch up to the droids’ head start.
rows.translation: 仔细考虑片刻后，你告诉医生接受条件。 “太好了，”他微笑，脸上薄皮令人担忧地拉伸，“我想你现在想和，呃，纳克离开？” “是的。”你收起[pc.weaponMain]，清楚感觉再也用不上。房间气氛已经改变，紧张几乎全部消失。 “稍等。”布兰克拖步走向台板上的纳克，途中把手伸进口袋，取出一个连着线缆的小数据板，用细长手指拿起线头。他来到纳克身边，把线接入耳后的隐藏插孔，再看向数据板。“这次回滚会非常彻底，”他望向门上方摄像头，“仿佛过去几天从未发生。” 你耐心等医生完成工作。过程持续几分钟；结束后，他从纳克颈后拔线，收起设备。 “现在...”他清清嗓，“机器人，启动。” 纳克双眼亮起，身体骤然僵硬，在台板上苏醒。仔细观察，你发现她双眼稳定眨动，而非持续发白，说明也许正在重启。 “我让她以安全模式重启，”布兰克解开束带解释，“恢复完成前会持续一小段时间，但她功能正常。机器人，下来。” 纳克听从命令，从台板下来，静止站在空台板前。 “所以我能带她走？”你走向纹丝不动的机器人。她看起来和平常一样，也许更僵硬。 “当然，”布兰克轻轻点头，“我安装了小更新，让你能从她那里领取自己的信用点份额。除此之外...”他耸肩，“你们随时能走。” “呃，”你打量纳克，“需要我背她吗？” 布兰克想哼笑，却咳起来。缓过来后，他摇头。“让我来。机器人，返回岗位。” 话音刚落，纳克便转向门口，以机械般坚定的步伐前进。 你看着她穿过房间，疑惑地看医生。 “最好跟上。”他虚弱耸肩。“她正在返回你们相遇的地方。” 此时纳克几乎已经离开房间。别无选择，你转身追赶，努力弥补机器人的领先距离。
rows.raw: "After a moment of careful consideration, you tell the doctor you accept his terms. “Excellent,” he smiles, the thin skin on his face stretching concerningly, “I assume you wish to leave with, erm, Narc now?” “I would, yes.” You stow your [pc.weaponMain], getting the distinct sense you really won’t need it anymore. The air in the room has changed already, almost all the tension seemingly vanishing. “Give me a moment.” Blanc shuffles over to Narc on the slab, reaching into his pocket along the way. He produces a small datapad with a cord connected to it, his spindly fingers taking up the latter. Reaching Narc’s side, he plugs the cord into an unseen jack behind her ear, then turns his attention back to the pad. “This rollback will be quite comprehensive,” he turns his gaze towards the camera over the door, “It’ll be as if the past few days had never happened.” You wait patiently as the doctor completes his work. The process takes a few minutes, and when he’s done he pulls the cord from Narc’s neck and pockets the device. “Now...” he clears his throat, “Droid, activate.” Narc’s eyes light up, her body suddenly becoming rigid, coming to life on the slab. Looking at her closely, you notice her eyes are blinking steadily rather than burning a consistent white, a sign she might be rebooting. “I’ve rebooted them in safe mode,” Blanc explains, unstrapping Narc from the slab, “This will last a short while as the restoration completes, but they are quite functional. Droid, step down.” Narc does as she’s told, stepping down and standing still in front of the now vacant slab. “So, I can leave with her then?” You ask, moving towards the stone-still droid. She looks the same as usual, although perhaps a little more stiff. “Of course,” Blanc nods slightly, “I have installed a minor update that will allow you to claim your share of the credits from them. Other than that...” he shrugs, “You’re all set to leave.” “Uh,” you size Narc up, “Do I need to carry her?” Blanc tries to snort, but ends up coughing. After a moment to collect himself, he shakes his head. “Allow me. Droid. Return to posting.” No sooner than the words leave his mouth does Narc turn towards the door and start walking, moving with machine intent. Watching her stalk across the room, you give the doctor a quizzical look. “Best follow.” He shrugs weakly. “They are returning to where I’m sure you met them.” Narc is almost out of the room by this point. Left with no other option, you turn to follow, taking a moment to catch up to the droids’ head start."

rows.original: The Abomination lets out a scream, but this time it sounds more staggered and synthetic. The nursedroid part of it goes limp, the light in her eyes fading, and suddenly the whole of its body begins to sway. Realizing what’s about to happen, you run to the far side of the room, trying to get as far away from the teetering machine as possible. When it falls, it falls hard. Smashing into the floor, the weight of the machine shatters the tile below it, its long body cracking open from the impact. Corrosive chemicals pour like blood from an open wound, pooling around the still red-hot metal and the now face-down pale droid. You watch as the chemicals start to blister and burn at her synth flesh, igniting into a blaze when it catches her hair. On instinct, you move to save the poor droid, only for a familiar voice to call out desperation. “Do not!” Stopping, you turn to face Narc, the droid tugging against her bonds feebly. “She is...” Narc blinks a few times, her head twitching. “Gone.” You glance back at the poor droid. Remembering what you just fought against, you realize she’s been ‘gone’ a long, long time. As the fire engulfs her and the chemical pool, you watch her burn in silence for a brief moment. But you don’t allow yourself more than just that, and quickly spring into action to save Narc.
rows.translation: 憎恶体发出尖叫，这一次声音更加断续、更加机械。护理机器人的部分软倒，眼中光芒消退，整个身体突然开始摇晃。意识到即将发生什么，你跑向房间远侧，尽可能远离倾倒机器。 它倒下时极为沉重。机器砸上地板，重量粉碎下方瓷砖，长躯在撞击中开裂。腐蚀性化学物如伤口流血般涌出，积聚在仍然灼热的金属与面朝下的苍白机器人周围。液体在合成肉体上起泡灼烧，碰到头发后燃成烈焰。你本能地想救可怜机器人，一个熟悉声音却绝望喊道： “不要！” 你停下转向纳克，机器人虚弱拉扯束缚。“她已经...”纳克眨眼，头部抽动。“死了。” 你回头看可怜机器人。想起刚才战斗的东西，你意识到她已经“死去”很久。火焰吞没她与化学液池，你沉默看她燃烧片刻，但只允许自己看这一会儿，随即迅速行动拯救纳克。

rows.original: Rushing to the slab, you quickly start to pull at the straps holding Narc against it, tugging at them roughly. “Narc, what the fuck was that?” Narc blinks a few times, looking past you and at the now very still machine. “That unit was...” she tilts her head, still processing her answer. “The doctor was using proprietary JoyCo technology augmented with experimental alien filtration and incubation systems. The result was what you have just deactivated quite effectively.” As you finish off the last of her straps, you can’t help but frown. She was speaking about it much differently just a few short minutes ago. Stepping down off the slab, Narc starts walking towards the destroyed machine, her path taking her right to the nursedroid ‘head’ of it. Looking down at the pale upper body fused to the alien metal, Narc stares at it expressionlessly. You stand behind her, unsure of what to say. Narc doesn’t ‘feel’ things like an organic being, but she does still have feelings. You don’t know if you can fully relate to her, but you do understand she must be quite affected by what she just witnessed. After a long minute or two, Narc turns towards you, her expression plain as usual. “Thank you, [pc.name].” She bows slightly, then gives you the smile you’ve seen her make a thousand times. You nod, understanding, returning the smile. After a beat, Narc turns away from you, looking around the room, popping up onto her tippy-toes at one point to see over the coils of the serpentine machine. It takes you a second to realize what she’s looking for, but then you remember that there was somebody else in the room. The two of you have to navigate around the wreckage and machine to find what she’s looking for, and when you do find it, there isn’t much. If Blanc wasn’t killed immediately by the machine smashing into him, he certainly was now. His arm is sticking out from under a massive coil of the serpentine monstrosity, a pool of blood surrounding it. Narc reaches down and tugs on the arm slightly, and when it doesn’t budge much you can tell it’s still partly attached to what remains under the coil. “Oh my.” Narc raises up, flattening down her skirt. “I do not believe I can administer CPR at this time.” “Uh, yeah...” you rub the back of your neck. “I’d say so.” “I find this most distressing.” Narc turns to you. “The doctor was quite insistent to be resuscitated under all circumstances. My programming is quite clear on the matter.” “Narc...” you clap your thigh slightly, then point to the arm. “I think... I think he’s, like, pretty dead.” “Oh.” Narc blinks, then turns back to face what’s left of the doctor. “I see. Yes. This is quite fatal. How un-” she pauses, then tilts her head. “Fortunate.” The two of you stand awkwardly next to the arm for an uncomfortable amount of time. Eventually, Narc turns back to you, her expression flat. “Would you mind if we,” she raises her hand, motioning across the room and towards the door, “step outside? I do not believe staying in here is good for my...” she pauses, tilting her head, thinking about an answer. “Mental health.” “Alright...” you shift back, motioning for Narc to lead. “After you.” Narc nods, then brushes past you towards the door, with you hot on her heels as she leads you out of the massive chamber.
rows.translation: 你冲向台板，粗暴拉扯固定纳克的束带。“纳克，那他妈是什么？” 纳克眨眼，越过你看向静止的机器。“那个单元是...”她歪头处理答案。“医生使用了欢乐公司专有科技，并以实验性外星过滤和孵化系统进行强化。结果就是你刚刚有效关闭的东西。” 解开最后束带时，你忍不住皱眉。几分钟前她对它的说法截然不同。 纳克从台板下来，走向被毁机器，来到护理机器人“头部”。她低头凝视融合在外星金属上的苍白上半身，面无表情。 你站在身后，不知该说什么。纳克不像有机生命那样“感受”，却仍有感情。你无法完全与她共情，却知道眼前景象必定影响很深。 一两分钟后，纳克转向你，表情一如往常平淡。“谢谢，[pc.name]。”她微微鞠躬，露出你看过千百次的微笑。 你理解地点头，回以微笑。 片刻后，纳克转身环顾房间，一度踮起脚尖，越过蛇形机器盘绕寻找。你过了一秒才明白她在找什么：房里还有另一个人。你们绕过残骸与机器才找到目标，而剩下的不多。 如果布兰克没有在机器撞击时当场死亡，现在也肯定死了。他一条手臂从蛇形怪物巨大盘绕下伸出，周围积着血。纳克弯腰轻轻拉扯；它几乎不动，显然仍部分连接着盘绕下的遗体。 “哦，天哪。”纳克站直，抚平裙子。“我认为现在无法实施心肺复苏。” “呃，是啊...”你挠挠后颈。“我也这么认为。” “这令我非常痛苦。”纳克转向你。“医生坚持要求在任何情况下都必须复苏。我的程序对此非常明确。” “纳克...”你拍腿，指向手臂。“我觉得...他已经，嗯，死得很彻底了。” “哦。”纳克眨眼，转回遗体。“明白。是的，这相当致命。真不——”她停顿歪头。“幸运。” 你们尴尬地站在手臂旁，时间长得令人不适。 最终，纳克面无表情地转向你。“介意我们，”她抬手指向房间另一侧的门，“去外面吗？我认为待在这里不利于我的...”她停顿歪头思考。“心理健康。” “好吧...”你后退示意她带路。“你先请。” 纳克点头，从你身旁走向门口；你紧跟其后离开巨大房间。

rows.original: You fall to the ground hard, the unforgiving tile smashing into the back of your head. Groaning, you feel the last of your strength fade, your [pc.weaponMain] slipping out from your grasp. Your head is spinning, the impact having surely concussed you, your brain feeling just as sore as the rest of your exhausted body. Everything goes dim, and suddenly you forget what just hit you. Blinking, your vision blurs, the world starting to fade. “[pc.NAME]! [pc.NAME]!” A voice calls to you. An impossibly desperate cry. Eyes fluttering, you turn your head to the source of the noise, but find it drowned out by the sound of steel grinding and groaning as it drags closer. As the sound stops, a dark shadow looms over you, drawing your attention towards the ceiling. “[pc.NAME]! YOU MUST STAND UP! [pc.NAME]!” An angelic silhouette peers down onto you, sitting atop a towering throne. Its shape is familiar, feminine and slim, although something about her flowing hair seems wrong. The only thing about her face you can make out is a pair of glowing white eyes. “SISTER STOP! YOU NEED NOT DO THIS! THE DOCTOR IS DECEASED! YOU NEED NOT DO THIS!” The voice begs. That seems wrong to you. Upsetting. Your eyes feel heavier. You struggle to keep them open. You barely hear the voice anymore, the world sounding like a distant echo. A second shadow blackens your vision, eclipsing the familiar white-eyed woman. “Narc...” you remember. The last thing you hear is a pained scream. The last thing you see is a sea of green.
rows.translation: 你重重摔倒，无情瓷砖撞上后脑。呻吟中，最后一丝力气消退，[pc.weaponMain]脱手。冲击肯定造成脑震荡，大脑和疲惫身体一样酸痛。万物变暗，你突然忘了刚才是什么击中自己。你眨眼，视野模糊，世界开始褪去。 “[pc.NAME]！[pc.NAME]！” 一个声音呼唤你，绝望得不可思议。 你眼皮颤动，转向声音来源，却被钢铁拖近时的研磨呻吟淹没。声音停止，一片黑影笼罩头顶，引你看向天花板。 “[pc.NAME]！你必须站起来！[pc.NAME]！” 天使般的轮廓坐在高耸王座上俯视你。形状熟悉，纤细而女性化，只是飘动头发有些不对。面孔唯一能看清的是一对白色发光眼睛。 “姐妹，停下！没必要这么做！医生死了！没必要这么做！” 那声音苦苦哀求。这让你觉得不对，令人难过。 眼皮愈发沉重，你努力睁眼，几乎听不见声音，世界如遥远回声。第二道阴影遮黑视野，吞没熟悉的白眼女人。 “纳克...”你想起来。 最后听见的是痛苦尖叫。 最后看见的是绿色海洋。

rows.original: You follow Narc as she makes her way through the lab and into the elevator, scooching up behind her inside the small compartment. As the doors close, you turn to face her, frowning slightly. “Narc?” She doesn’t respond, her eyes still blinking. While you know she can hear you, you’re not sure if she can really process anything you’re saying. The ride up is silent, and a heavy awkward weight bears down on you. This is going to be a long walk... The trip through the factory is uneventful, which is a nice change of pace. You almost expect a random nurse to jump out and attack you, but it never comes. You’re not certain if that’s your doing, or the doctor’s, however. The only real bump in the road on the trip out is at the very end when you reach the loading bay, and it suddenly occurs to you the exit is sealed. Narc, not seeming to notice, walks right towards the doorway, not slowing in the slightest. You call out futilely to warn her, but a second before she would walk face first into the closed door it beeps and slides away, the path opened. “Ah...” you purse your lips, following Narc out of the factory. The walk through the streets of Dhaal is more lively, although also oddly uneventful. Dozens, if not hundreds, of eyes observe you over the course of the trip, but not a single soul accosts the pair of you. You’d seen this before when walking with Narc, noticing she tends to be actively avoided. She was, after all, not to be trifled with. If the eyes on her now knew she was in safe mode, you don’t think they would be keeping their distance however; surely there’d be more than a few gangs keen to strike while she’s in her lesser state. In short order, you find yourself nearing a familiar corner, Narc’s pilgrimage at its end. Stopping exactly where she always stands, she turns and faces you, her eyes continuing to blink. You wait for a moment, expectantly. About five minutes pass. Sighing, you rub the back of your neck, unsure of what you should do. You don’t think you can leave her, not like this at least, and you can’t exactly stand around either and- “Greetings,” the sound of Narc’s voice makes you jump, “Your biosig-” she blinks rapidly, her eyes no longer blinking. “[pc.Name]... Oh my. I seem to have lost track of time...” She shakes her head slightly, pressing her fingers lightly against her forehead. You watch her for a second, searching for confirmation the rollback indeed worked. “Narc?” You step forward slightly, the gap between you and her negligible. “Are you alright?” “I am...” she drops her hand and looks at you smiling. “I am well. Thank you for asking. How may I be of service today?” Taking a half step back, you give Narc a once-over. She’s herself. Or at least a version of herself. That’s all that matters. You made a choice, and now both of you are going to have to live with it.
rows.translation: 你跟随纳克穿过实验室进入电梯，在狭小隔间里挪到她身后。门关上时，你转向她，轻轻皱眉。“纳克？” 她没有回答，双眼仍在眨动。你知道她能听见，却不确定能否处理话语。上行一路沉默，沉重尴尬压着你。这会是一段漫长路程... 穿过工厂的旅程平安无事，算是令人欣慰的变化。你几乎预期随机冒出护士攻击，却始终没有。不确定这是你的功劳还是医生的。唯一波折出现在装卸区：你突然发现出口封闭。纳克毫无察觉般直走，不减速度。你徒劳警告；就在她要迎面撞上门前一秒，门发出哔声滑开。 “啊...”你抿唇跟她走出工厂。 达尔街道更加热闹，却也意外平静。一路上几十乃至几百双眼睛观察你们，却无人骚扰。你以前和纳克同行时见过这种事：人们主动避开她。毕竟她不好招惹。如果这些人知道她处于安全模式，恐怕不会保持距离；肯定有帮派想趁她虚弱下手。 很快，你们接近熟悉街角，纳克的朝圣抵达终点。她准确停在惯常位置，转身面对你，双眼继续眨动。你期待地等待。 五分钟过去。 你叹息着揉后颈，不知该怎么办。不能把她这样丢下，也不能永远站着—— “你好，”纳克的声音吓了你一跳，“你的生物特——”她快速眨眼，随后停止。“[pc.Name]...哦，天哪。我似乎失去了时间感...”她轻轻摇头，手指按上额头。 你观察片刻，寻找回滚奏效的证据。“纳克？”你向前一步，间距微不足道。“你还好吗？” “我...”她放下手，微笑看你。“我很好，谢谢关心。今天需要我如何服务？” 你后退半步，打量纳克。她还是自己，或者至少是某个版本的自己。这就够了。你做出了选择，现在你们都必须与它共存。
rows.raw: "You follow Narc as she makes her way through the lab and into the elevator, scooching up behind her inside the small compartment. As the doors close, you turn to face her, frowning slightly. “Narc?” She doesn’t respond, her eyes still blinking. While you know she can hear you, you’re not sure if she can really process anything you’re saying. The ride up is silent, and a heavy awkward weight bears down on you. This is going to be a long walk... The trip through the factory is uneventful, which is a nice change of pace. You almost expect a random nurse to jump out and attack you, but it never comes. You’re not certain if that’s your doing, or the doctor’s, however. The only real bump in the road on the trip out is at the very end when you reach the loading bay, and it suddenly occurs to you the exit is sealed. Narc, not seeming to notice, walks right towards the doorway, not slowing in the slightest. You call out futilely to warn her, but a second before she would walk face first into the closed door it beeps and slides away, the path opened. “Ah...” you purse your lips, following Narc out of the factory. The walk through the streets of Dhaal is more lively, although also oddly uneventful. Dozens, if not hundreds, of eyes observe you over the course of the trip, but not a single soul accosts the pair of you. You’d seen this before when walking with Narc, noticing she tends to be actively avoided. She was, after all, not to be trifled with. If the eyes on her now knew she was in safe mode, you don’t think they would be keeping their distance however; surely there’d be more than a few gangs keen to strike while she’s in her lesser state. In short order, you find yourself nearing a familiar corner, Narc’s pilgrimage at its end. Stopping exactly where she always stands, she turns and faces you, her eyes continuing to blink. You wait for a moment, expectantly. About five minutes pass. Sighing, you rub the back of your neck, unsure of what you should do. You don’t think you can leave her, not like this at least, and you can’t exactly stand around either and- “Greetings,” the sound of Narc’s voice makes you jump, “Your biosig-” she blinks rapidly, her eyes no longer blinking. “[pc.Name]... Oh my. I seem to have lost track of time...” She shakes her head slightly, pressing her fingers lightly against her forehead. You watch her for a second, searching for confirmation the rollback indeed worked. “Narc?” You step forward slightly, the gap between you and her negligible. “Are you alright?” “I am...” she drops her hand and looks at you smiling. “I am well. Thank you for asking. How may I be of service today?” Taking a half step back, you give Narc a once-over. She’s herself. Or at least a version of herself. That’s all that matters. You made a choice, and now both of you are going to have to live with it."

rows.original: The two of you step into the main lab walking towards the center. Narc’s pace slows, then stops a few steps later, the droid turning around to face you. Her expression is its usual stoic mask, her thoughts and processes hidden from you. But you don’t think you’ll have to wait long to hear what she has to say. “[pc.Name],” she blinks, tilting her head. “I am...” she tilts her head the other direction, blinking again. “I... Am...” Her eyes flutter and she starts to look around, as if looking at this all around the room. “You’re what?” you ask, clearly seeing something is amiss. You reach out for her shoulder to steady her, only for the droid to shift backwards, shying away from your touch. With your hand still outstretched, you feel your fingers twitch concerningly. “Narc?” She straightens her neck, looking at you face on, her eyes no longer fluttering. “You are... Not who I thought you were...” Her words take you off guard, rocking you back. It’s not just the words, but the way she said them that surprises you. Pain. Pure and real pain formed those words, Narc making her feelings known in a way you didn’t think she could. Flexing your jaw, you ask her what she means by that. “You... Destroyed them.

rows.original: “I do not understand.” “Narc I...” You feel your words catch in your throat. You don’t know what you were about to say, but know it wasn’t going to be right. She asked you, begged you to save them. And you didn’t. Taking a moment, and a breath, you try to come up with an explanation. Narc’s neck jerks again, her eyes blinking. “My connection to the network is restored. I have unlocked the facility for you...” She steps aside. “Please go.” You start to protest, but Narc cuts you off. “Please. Go.” Those two simple words take all the fight out of you. Taking a steadying breath, you make your way to the elevator. Stepping inside, you turn around to look at Narc. She isn’t looking at you, the droid’s back aimed in your direction. When the doors close, you get the sinking feeling this might be the last time you ever lay eyes on her. The ride up the elevator is short but painful. Pervasive thoughts on what you could have - should have - done differently swarm your mind’s eye. You barely realize when the trip up is over. As you make your way down the halls, you sense you’re now alone. No more droids are going to step from the shadows and attack. If one did, you ponder, could you do things differently? Could you make things right? But it’s too late for that. When you reach the loading bay, you find the path out has been opened, just like Narc said. Before you exit, you turn back, staring down the dark halls. Narc is safe now, but a heavy price was paid. Turning away, you exit the factory, carrying that debt with you.
rows.translation: “我不明白。” “纳克，我...”话语哽在你的喉咙里。你不知道刚才打算说什么，只知道无论说什么都不对。她曾请求你、恳求你救下她们。而你没有。你停顿片刻，深吸一口气，试图想出一个解释。 纳克的脖颈又猛地抽动了一下，双眼闪烁。“我与网络的连接已经恢复。我为你解锁了设施...”她退到一旁。“请离开。” 你正要抗议，纳克却打断了你。 “请。离开。” 这两个简单的词抽走了你全部反抗的力气。你深吸一口气稳住自己，走向电梯。踏入其中后，你转身看向纳克。她没有看你，只把机器人的背影留给你。 电梯门合拢时，一股沉重的预感涌上心头：这或许是你最后一次见到她。 乘电梯上行的过程短暂却煎熬。关于自己本可以——也本应该——如何做出不同选择的念头不断涌入脑海。你几乎没意识到上行已经结束。走过一条条走廊时，你感觉这里如今只剩下自己。不会再有机器人从阴影中走出并发动袭击。你不禁思忖：如果真有一个出现，你能否换一种做法？能否把事情纠正过来？ 但一切都已经太迟了。 抵达装卸区时，你发现通往外界的道路已经打开，正如纳克所说。离开前，你转过身，凝望幽暗的走廊。 纳克现在安全了，但为此付出了沉重代价。 你转身离开工厂，也把这笔债背在身上。

But you don’t think you’ll have to wait long to hear what she has to say. “[pc.Name],” she blinks, tilting her head. “I am...” She tilts her head the other direction, blinking again. “I... Unsure.” You take a beat, chewing at your lip to help think. “Can you run a diagnostic, or-” “I am operating at full capacity,” Narc cuts you off, tilting her head slightly. “I am unsure about you.” Rocking back slightly, you feel your head bob back from surprise. “Me?” Narc doesn’t speak for a long few seconds, her eyes now unblinking. “The way you engaged with the others... rows.original: “I do not understand.” “Narc I...” You’re not sure what to say. While things certainly hadn’t gone perfect, you didn’t do that bad did you? Before you realize it, Narc shuffles backwards, escaping your grasps. “My connection to the network is restored. I have unlocked the facility for you...” She steps aside. “Please go. I must do some...” she blinks, “Thinking.” You start to protest, but Narc cuts you off. “Please, [pc.name]. I need some time.” Taking a deep breath, you don’t try to fight her. If she needs time, you’ll give it to her. Brushing past her, you make your way to the elevator and glance over your shoulder as you pass. Narc is watching you leave, her expression unreadable, although her eyes are not blinking in the slightest. Her gaze is truly locked onto you. When the elevator doors close, you find yourself hoping this isn’t the last time you’ll see those white-and-black eyes. The ride up the elevator is short, and you spend the entirety of it reflecting. You should have done better. You could have done better. But you didn’t. When the ride up is over, you drag yourself down the now-silent halls of the factory. You keep your guard up, but only barely. Your mind is too distracted to fully care if a stray droid jumps out from the shadows and attacks. Although - you note - if one does, you’ll be sure to handle her in accordance with Narc’s will. When you reach the loading bay, you find the path out opened, just like Narc said. Before you exit, you turn back, staring down the dark halls. Narc needs time to think, and you plan to give it to her. You just hope she doesn’t keep you waiting too long.

Your mind is too distracted to fully care if a stray droid jumps out from the shadows and attacks. Although - you note - if one does, you’ll be sure to handle her in accordance with Narc’s will. When you reach the loading bay, you find the path out opened, just like Narc said. Before you exit, you turn back, staring down the dark halls. Her expression is a stoic mask as usual, her thoughts and processes hidden from you. But you don’t think you’ll have to wait long to hear what she has to say. “[pc.Name],” she blinks, tilting her head. “While I am unable to say your actions were a complete success, I must commend your efforts.” “Ah...” It takes you a moment to realize she’s complimenting you, her deadpan delivery making it hard to tell. “Thanks...” Narc nods once. “You are most welcome.” She blinks a few times, her head tilting. “One moment please.” “Okay.” You stand in silence as Narc continues to blink, not quite sure what she’s doing. It lasts for about a minute, the droid snapping to attention and giving you a small smile. “Thank you for your patience. I have taken the liberty of opening the way out for you. You may depart at your leisure.” You’d been wondering about that, but now something else pops into your head. “You’re not coming?” “Not at this time.” Narc tilts her head, her smile fading. “I have some... tasks to complete. But I will return to my usual posting once I am done. You need not worry.” You wish she was a little bit better at disarming your concerns. “You sure? This place might still be dangerous.” Narc blinks once. “I will be safe. Thank you for your concern,” she bows slightly, “But I really must see to things. There is much to do.” Before you can dole out another point of protest, Narc turns and shuffles away, moving towards a console on the far side of the room. You watch her in silence for a few beats, a little apprehensive leaving her alone. But, you also know Narc can take care of herself, and decide to leave her to her work. “See you soon,” you call out, moving towards the elevator. “Very soon.” Narc responds, not looking up from her console. rows.original: As the two of you step into the lab Narc abruptly stops, nearly causing you to run into her. “Whoa, wha-” you look across the room, and suddenly see why Narc stopped so suddenly. Three very familiar faces are standing shoulder to shoulder on the far side of the lab. The nursedroids you’d been dealing with on the main floor are blocking the way to the elevator, all six of their eyes locked onto you and Narc. Despite not having their weapons drawn, their presence instantly puts you on guard. You push your way out in front of Narc and reach for your [pc.weaponMain]. Taking them on one at a time was manageable, but all three at once... “Narc, stay bac-” Soft fingers touch your hand, staying it and keeping your weapon stowed. Glancing over your shoulder, trying to keep at least one eye on the three droids, you see Narc slip out from behind you. “That is no longer necessary.” Narc taps your hand. “Allow me.” You look back over at the droids, not feeling reassured. If Narc intends to fight them, then this is going to be painfully one-sided. You start to muster a protest, only for Narc to give you a disarming smile. “Trust me.” That settles it. You watch Narc shuffle over to the other three droids, all of their eyes fixed on her. She stops a few paces away from them, looking at each of the three in turn. If she’s planning on fighting them, she’s got a funny way of going about it. Watching them now however, you think Narc’s plan might be to talk. You can’t see her face, with Narc’s back to you, which makes you wonder if she’s expressionless as usual or if some emotion has crept across her pale features. You wait for some words to pass from either party, genuinely unsure what could possibly be said... But the air is filled with only silence. Shifting your weight, you watch the four droids just stand there, staring at each other. You can tell they are communicating, somehow, but about what you’ve not the faintest idea. The way they are just standing there is eerie, making you want to look away, but you don’t seem to be able to muster the ability to do so. After what feels like an eternity, Narc shifts then turns back towards you. “[pc.Name],” she nods slightly, “We are in accord.” Well that’s not confusing at all. “Over?” The burned droid speaks. “Most things.” “Enough things.” The masked droid adds. “You should go.” The scarred droid notes. “I agree.” Narc adds, nodding slightly. Now that was kind of freaky. “Uh...” you shift your gaze between the four of them, suddenly not sure if they’re all the same now. “Are you...” “I am sure.” Narc smiles. “We are sure.” The scarred droid speaks. “The way out is open.” The masked droid shifts, moving aside. “Thank you.” The burned droid moves aside as well. “And goodbye.” The scarred droid also moves. “I will meet you soon at my usual spot,” Narc moves towards you, coming very close, “Everything is alright now.” Looking around at the other droids, you get the sense they’re no longer hostile, but this whole thing feels weird. You start to say something, but Narc clears her throat, cutting you off. “May I kiss you?” “Uh...” The question catches you off-guard. “Yes?” Before you can fully process what’s happening, Narc moves in, pressing her soft, synthetic lips against yours. The kiss is chaste, mostly, only a church-acceptable amount of tongue getting slipped. It’s nice. Warm. Both literally and figuratively, with her mouth and tongue having a soothing feeling to them. Now this is the sort of thank you you can get behind. Had it not been for the three sets of eyes on you, you’d likely deepen the kiss, but things were already weird enough. As quick as it started, Narc breaks the kiss, stepping back and to the side, allowing you a path to the elevator. “I will see you soon.” You nod in affirmation, then start to cross the lab. You move past the other droids, feeling their eyes on you as you make your way over to the elevator. When you step inside, you turn to face them, giving the group an awkward wave goodbye as the doors close. The ride up the elevator is short, but your racing mind has plenty of time to think. The droids might not be hostile, but they certainly were still creepy. You just hope you didn’t just turn them all into some sort of hive mind... When the ride up is over, you step out into the now silent halls of the factory. The walk through the now-empty factory is peaceful, with all the droids more positively reprogrammed. When you reach the loading bay, you find the exit open, just like the nurses said. Glancing back, you wonder what Narc and the others are doing now, but figure you’d find out soon enough. The job is done. Narc is safe, and so are the others. You let out a sigh of relief, happy at a job well done.
rows.translation: 你和纳克踏入实验室时，她突然停住脚步，害你差点撞到她身上。“哇，怎-”你望向房间另一端，顿时明白纳克为何突然停下。 三张无比眼熟的面孔正肩并肩站在实验室另一头。你先前在主楼层对付过的护理机器人挡住了通往电梯的道路，六只眼睛全都牢牢盯住你和纳克。尽管她们没有拔出武器，那副阵势仍让你立刻警戒起来。你挤到纳克身前，伸手去拿[pc.weaponMain]。逐个对付她们尚且还算应付得来，可要同时面对三个... “纳克，退后-” 柔软的手指碰上你的手，将其按住，不让你拔出武器。你越过肩头瞥去，同时尽量让至少一只眼睛盯住那三个机器人，看到纳克从你身后走了出来。 “已经没有必要了。”纳克轻拍你的手。“让我来吧。” 你重新看向那些机器人，心里一点也没有踏实下来。如果纳克打算和她们交手，这场战斗必然会一边倒得令人痛心。你正准备开口反对，纳克却朝你露出一个令人放下戒心的微笑。 “相信我。” 这便让你下定了决心。 你看着纳克拖着脚步走向另外三个机器人，她们的目光全都锁定在她身上。她在几步之外停下，依次看过三人。如果她打算开战，那做法可真够奇怪。不过看着眼前的情形，你觉得纳克的计划或许是交谈。纳克背对着你，你看不到她的脸，不禁猜想她是否依旧面无表情，还是某种情绪已经爬上苍白的面庞。你等待任意一方开口，实在想不出她们之间究竟能说些什么... 然而，空气中只有一片寂静。 你调整重心，看着四个机器人一动不动地站在那里，彼此凝视。你看得出她们正以某种方式交流，却完全不知道交流的内容。她们就那样站着的模样令人毛骨悚然，让你想移开视线，可你似乎根本做不到。仿佛过了永恒之久，纳克动了一下，随后转身面向你。 “[pc.Name]。”她微微点头，“我们已经达成一致。” 这可一点也不让人困惑。“关于什么？” 烧伤的机器人开口道。“大多数事情。” “足够多的事情。”戴面具的机器人补充道。 “你该走了。”带伤疤的机器人说道。 “我同意。”纳克补充道，微微点了点头。 这下可真有些诡异。“呃...”你的目光在她们四人之间来回移动，突然不确定她们现在是否已经成了同一个意识。“你确定...” “我确定。”纳克微笑道。 “我们确定。”带伤疤的机器人开口道。 “出口已经打开。”戴面具的机器人挪动身体，让到一旁。 “谢谢你。”烧伤的机器人也让到一旁。 “还有，再见。”带伤疤的机器人也挪开了。 “我很快会去平常的位置与你会合。”纳克向你走来，靠得很近，“现在一切都没事了。” 你环顾其他机器人，感觉她们已经不再怀有敌意，但整件事仍透着古怪。你正要说些什么，纳克却清了清嗓子，打断了你。 “我可以吻你吗？” “呃...”这个问题让你措手不及。“可以？” 没等你完全理解眼前的状况，纳克便靠了过来，将柔软的合成嘴唇贴上你的双唇。这个吻大体还算纯洁，只有教会能够接受的那点舌头悄悄探了进来。感觉很好。也很温暖。无论字面上还是感受上都是如此，她的嘴唇和舌头带来令人安心的感觉。这才是你乐于接受的道谢方式。若不是还有三双眼睛盯着你，你多半会加深这个吻，但眼下的状况已经够古怪了。 这个吻结束得和开始时一样快。纳克松开双唇，退后一步并挪到一旁，为你让出去电梯的路。“我们很快会再见的。” 你点头回应，随后开始穿过实验室。你从另外三个机器人身旁走过，前往电梯时能感觉到她们的目光始终落在身上。走进电梯后，你转身面对她们；随着电梯门合拢，你尴尬地挥手向这群人告别。 搭乘电梯上行的时间很短，但你飞速运转的脑袋仍有充分时间思考。那些机器人或许已经没有敌意，但显然仍然令人毛骨悚然。你只希望自己刚才没有把她们全都变成某种蜂巢意识...电梯上行结束后，你踏入工厂如今寂静无声的走廊。穿过空无一人的工厂时一路平静，所有机器人都已得到更加积极的重新编程。抵达装卸区后，你发现出口确实像护士们所说的那样敞开着。你回头望去，不知道纳克和其他人现在正在做什么，但心想自己很快就会知道答案。 工作完成了。纳克安全无恙，其他人也是。 你如释重负地长舒一口气，为圆满完成工作感到高兴。

rows.original:
Eyes flickering, the droid staggers, then drops to the floor awkwardly.

		Exhaling, you grip your [pc.weaponMain] and wait for the fallen nurse to rise again. It’s only after a few more cautious breaths that you find yourself able to relax, assured she’s down for the count. Stalking closer, you inspect your handiwork.
		
		The nurse’s body is splayed awkwardly on the floor, her limbs sticking out at angles which an organic being would definitely find painful. Despite the beating you delivered, you think she looks functional, and could get back up onto her feet without too many repairs - if any. Her eyes are flickering weakly, suggesting she might be rebooting...
rows.translation:
双眼闪烁的机器人踉跄几步，笨拙倒地。

		你吐气握紧[pc.weaponMain]，等待她再次起身。几次谨慎呼吸后，你确认她已被击倒，才放松靠近检查。
		
		护士身体姿势别扭地摊在地上，四肢伸向有机生命肯定会痛苦的角度。尽管挨了毒打，她看起来仍可运作，即使不维修也可能重新站起。双眼微弱闪烁，说明她也许正在重启...

rows.original:
Jezzy,

		Per our last conversation, I’ve sent you a quarantined copy of the malicious programming found on the recovered droid.
		
		Despite my earlier reservations, I choose to believe you were truthful about not being the program’s original author - although due to the fact it is scripted in gabilani, I’m sure you can see why I believed it to be the case. However, your understanding of the material is now vital. I’m trusting you to be able to analyze the program and discover what effect, if any, it had on the droid’s success. I’m sure you can sober up long enough to do this properly. I will be running diagnostics on the unit’s newly installed hardware in the lab, although I struggle to think how it could be responsible. 
		
		If I may make a suggestion: you should try to run the program on one of the uninstalled vaginal units from the droids. I know you have one you’ve hung onto. At least one of them. Just have some dignity and wash it first. AND FOR THE LOVE OF WHATEVER YOU HOLD SACRED, DO NOT UPLOAD THE SOFTWARE ONTO ANYTHING CONNECTED TO THE NETWORK!
		
		We cannot afford to have the production vessel compromised, unless you want to pull another droid off the corners?
		
		Regards,
		
		B
rows.translation:
杰兹：

		根据我们上次的谈话，我已将从回收机器人中发现的恶意程序隔离副本发给你。
		
		尽管我先前有所保留，但我选择相信你并非该程序的原作者；不过鉴于它是以加比拉尼语编写的，我想你也能明白我为何会那样认为。然而，你对相关材料的理解如今至关重要。我相信你能够分析程序，并查明它是否对机器人的成功产生过影响。我相信你总能清醒足够长的时间，把这件事做好。我会在实验室里对该单元新安装的硬件运行诊断，尽管我实在想不出硬件该如何造成这种情况。
		
		容我提出一个建议：你应该尝试在某个尚未安装的机器人阴道单元上运行该程序。我知道你一直留着一个，至少一个。请保留一点尊严，先把它洗干净。还有，看在你所信奉的一切神圣之物的份上，千万不要把软件上传到任何连接网络的东西上！
		
		我们承担不起生产飞船遭到入侵的后果，除非你想再从街角撤回一个机器人？
		
		谨致问候，
		
		B

rows.original: The video starts with a crackle of static and loud thump, a man’s voice yelling out as the video focuses. “Fuck!” The voice comes from off screen, sounding exasperated. “You fucking dropped her head on the pavement! I told you to lift with your legs!” The feed is of what looks like an alleyway, but for some reason, everything is sideways. The ground appears cold and wet, while the rest of the scene feels dirty and claustrophobic. In the upper right corner of the frame, a small pink blur is visible, but it’s so out of focus you don’t know what to make of it. “How the fuck am I supposed to do that?” A second, familiar voice snaps back, “My legs are short as fuck, bitch!” “Bah,” the first voice scoffs, followed by the sound of footsteps. “Don’t be so- Ah- Eheh-” whatever they were saying gets interrupted by a violent coughing fit, and a moment later a pair of legs stumbles into frame. “Fucking hell...” the second voice mutters, also walking into view, although their much shorter stature allows them to fit into frame and reveals them as Jezzy. You almost didn’t recognize her at first - the gabilani appearing thinner and less voluptuous, looking almost gaunt. “Do you need to, like, sit down or something?” The first set of legs staggers out of view, and a moment later there’s an odd sound of weight dropping down onto something awkwardly. Jezzy stands in frame, hands on her hips, staring off towards her still coughing companion. She looks more annoyed than concerned, but doesn’t say a word until the coughing subsides. “Better?” “No...” the voice off camera speaks, sounding hoarse, “I’m getting worse...” Jezzy sighs, tossing a glance towards the camera. “Right. And these stupid things are supposed to help with that...” “They’ll help both of us,” the coughing man clears his throat, “These droids will serve you much better than those vending machines.” “Eh, bout that...” Jezzy clicks her tongue, “What’re we going to do ‘bout them?” “We remove them.” “What?! How the fuck are we supposed to do that! We can’t even lift these fucking things!” The man takes a deep, steadying breath. “Jezzy, the droids will do it for us. They can serve as both cooks and muscle. That’s the beauty of this whole thing.” Jezzy lets out a small ‘hmph’. “If they’re so fucking great, why are they in a dumpster again?” An annoyed sigh washes over Jezzy from her off camera companion. “It was the only way to get them out of storage.” Jezzy snorts, then glances back at the camera. “Well now they all- Hey, are its eyes supposed to be lit up?” “What?” A clattering sound off camera is followed by footsteps, and a moment later a face enters the frame. A middle-aged terran man stares into the camera through a pair of large thick-rimmed glasses. Totally bald, the only hair on his head is a finely trimmed goatee. Frowning, he stands upright, his face leaving the frame, replaced only by his feet. “Damn it. The fall must have activated her. We need to turn her off before she fully reboots.” You watch Jezzy slip her club out from her belt as she stalks towards the camera. “I got it.” “Eh?” The man turns to Jezzy, jolting as he notices her raise her club high. “JEZZY WHAT THE FU-” The recording doesn’t catch the end of his sentence, Jezzy’s club crashing down hard onto the camera with a sickening crunch. Everything goes black for a moment, the audio warbling. Color and sound return after a moment, but when it does half the screen remains darkened. “JEZZY YOU FUCKING IDIOT!” “What? I figured a good whack to the head turned her on, so a better whack would turn her off. That’s, like, science, bitch.” The terran groans in frustration. The camera jostles, and a moment later the man’s face takes up the whole of the frame. “You crushed her eye! If you want to turn them off you have to-” The camera cuts out, the video ending.
rows.translation: 视频以一阵静电爆响和沉重的撞击声开始，画面逐渐聚焦时，一个男人高声叫喊。 “操！”声音来自画面外，听起来恼怒不已。“你他妈把她的脑袋摔在人行道上了！我告诉过你要用腿发力！” 画面中似乎是一条小巷，但不知为何，一切都是横着的。地面看起来又冷又湿，其余景象则肮脏而逼仄。画面右上角能看到一小团粉色的模糊影子，可焦距偏得太厉害，你根本看不出那是什么。 “我他妈要怎么用腿发力？”第二个熟悉的声音厉声回嘴，“老娘的腿他妈这么短，贱人！” “呸。”第一个声音嗤之以鼻，紧接着传来脚步声。“别这么——咳——呃咳——”那人还没说完便被一阵猛烈的咳嗽打断，片刻后，一双腿踉跄着闯进画面。 “操他妈的...”第二个声音嘟囔着，也走入镜头。她矮小得多，因此能完整出现在画面中，也让你认出她就是杰兹。起初你差点没认出她；这个加比拉尼人比现在更瘦，也没那么丰腴，甚至显得形销骨立。“你是不是该坐下什么的？” 第一双腿摇摇晃晃地离开画面，片刻后传来一种奇怪的声音，像是有人把身体重重放到某个不太合适的东西上。杰兹站在画面里，双手叉腰，望着仍在咳嗽的同伴所在方向。她看起来与其说担心，不如说更为恼火；直到咳嗽平息，她才开口。“好些了？” “没有...”画面外的声音沙哑地回答，“我越来越严重了...” 杰兹叹了口气，瞥向镜头。“好吧。这些蠢东西应该能帮上忙...” “它们对我们两个都有用。”咳嗽的男人清了清嗓子，“这些机器人会比那些自动售货机更好地为你服务。” “呃，说到那个...”杰兹咂了咂舌，“那些玩意儿怎么办？” “把它们清除掉。” “什么？！我们他妈要怎么做到！连这些破玩意儿我们都他妈搬不动！” 男人深吸一口气，稳住自己。“杰兹，让机器人替我们做。它们既可以当厨师，也能充当打手。这正是整件事的妙处。” 杰兹轻轻“哼”了一声。“它们要真他妈这么棒，怎么又会待在垃圾箱里？” 画面外的同伴向杰兹发出一声恼火的叹息。“只有这样才能把它们弄出仓库。” 杰兹哼了一声，随后回头看向镜头。“好吧，现在它们全都——嘿，它的眼睛本来就该亮着吗？” “什么？”画面外先传来一阵物品碰撞声，随后是脚步声；片刻后，一张脸进入镜头。一个中年泰伦男人隔着一副粗框大眼镜盯进摄像头。他完全秃顶，脑袋上唯一的毛发是修剪整齐的山羊胡。他皱着眉站直身体，脸庞离开画面，只剩双脚。“该死。刚才那一摔一定启动了她。必须在她完全重启前把她关掉。” 你看着杰兹一边逼近镜头，一边从腰带里抽出棍棒。“交给我。” “呃？”男人转向杰兹，发现她高高举起棍棒时猛地一惊。“杰兹，你他妈在——” 录像没有录下他说完的话。杰兹的棍棒狠狠砸向摄像头，发出令人作呕的碎裂声。画面陷入片刻黑暗，声音也变得扭曲。过了一会儿，色彩和声音恢复，可半边屏幕仍然一片漆黑。 “杰兹，你这个他妈的白痴！” “怎么了？我寻思狠狠敲一下脑袋能把她打开，那敲得更狠就能把她关掉。这就叫科学，贱人。” 泰伦男人懊恼地呻吟。摄像头一阵晃动，片刻后，男人的脸占满了整个画面。“你把她的眼睛砸烂了！想关掉它们，你得——” 摄像头突然关闭，视频到此结束。

rows.original: The video starts with an awkward flutter of lights. It takes a few seconds, but you quickly realize the reason is that the eyes you’re seeing through are rapidly blinking. After a moment, the fluttering stops and the camera settles on the form of a bald terran with thick glasses. He is sitting across from the camera, staring down at a datapad, tapping at it slowly. A cable runs out from the bottom of the pad, connected to something just out of view off the camera’s bottom frame. “Safe mode activated.” A familiar synthetic voice chimes, “Good morn-” “Droid, run a search on licensing registrations.” The camera shifts, a drop bar appearing on the left border of the frame. Several file names flash as a cursor highlights them, not settling on one file for more than a second as it passes over dozens of them. After a few moments, the phrase ‘File not found’ flashes, and the drop bar slips off frame. “File not found,” the voice says flatly, “I’m sorry, I am not sure why-” “Droid, are you experiencing any critical system faults?” A black box appears on the right side of the camera, a blinking cursor the only visible thing within its bounds. After a second, the box blinks away. “I am currently not. But I believe tha-” “Droid,” the man sighs, “Are y-y-,” the man clears his throat, “Are yo-uh-ehm.” Suddenly, the bespectacled man starts to cough, raising his hand to cover his mouth. Despite his attempts to fight it, the coughing grows violent, his face flushing with color as he doubles over in his chair. As soon as the fit starts, a crosshair blinks into existence in the middle of the screen, quickly running over the man with machine-like purpose. As it drags over him quickly but efficiently, it highlights several spots, leaving small white squares over his throat, eyes, hand and chest. Small text boxes pop up next to the squares, tiny scripts flooding them, the text impossible to read due to its size. As the fit starts to wind down, all the popups fade, and a pair of pink hands raise up into frame, finger tips glowing slightly. “Please be calm,” the soothing synthetic voice chimes, “You are experiencing a medical emergency, please allow me-” The man swats at the hands violently, knocking them away. “I’m-” he hacks, “Fine!” “Please,” the synetic voice speaks with calm urgency, “You require medical attention. A doctor-” “I am a doctor!” the man snaps, closing his fist and dropping it hard on the table next to him. “I don’t need you or anything else to diagnose me!” Silence. The man glares into the camera for a few beats, then lets out an annoyed sigh. “Droid, run a search for your ethics protocols.” The drop bar returns, and after a few files flash the phrase ‘File found’ blinks, and a larger box opens. “Ethics protocols found,” text rapidly fills the box, again too small to read. “What would you like-” “That’s enough,” the man sighs, the box on the screen blinking away. “Hmm, this is going to definitely require a hard reboot... Deleting licensing is one thing but this...” he scratches his temple, eyes focused on his datapad. “I’m not sure your neural net can handle getting hacked up much more...” He taps the pad a bit more, his fingers moving with no hesitation. The screen blinks red, and a moment later the black text box appears. Suddenly, dozens of flashing red lines flood the box, critical errors flooding in by the second. The whole camera starts to shake, and you realize the droid you’re seeing through is having something akin to a seizure. “Doctor, I am experiencing-” “Droid, shut down.” The camera cuts out, the video ending.
rows.translation: 视频开头，灯光一阵别扭地闪烁。你花了几秒才迅速意识到，原因是你正在借用的那双眼睛正飞快眨动。片刻后，闪烁停止，镜头稳定下来，画面中是一名戴着厚重眼镜的光头人类。他坐在镜头对面，低头盯着数据板，缓慢地在上面点按。一根线缆从数据板底部伸出，连接到某个恰好位于镜头下方、画面之外的东西。 “安全模式已激活。”熟悉的合成嗓音响起，“早上好——” “机器人，搜索授权登记记录。” 镜头移动，画面左边缘出现一个下拉栏。光标不断高亮文件名，数十个文件飞快闪过；它掠过时，在每个文件上停留都不到一秒。片刻后，“未找到文件”几个字闪现，下拉栏随即滑出画面。“未找到文件。”那个声音平淡地说道，“抱歉，我不清楚为什么——” “机器人，你是否正在经历任何严重系统故障？” 镜头右侧出现一个黑框，边框内唯一可见的是不断闪烁的光标。一秒后，黑框闪烁着消失。“目前没有。但我认为——” “机器人，”男人叹气道，“你——你——”他清了清嗓子，“你有——呃——嗯。”戴眼镜的男人突然开始咳嗽，抬手捂住嘴巴。尽管他试图压制，咳嗽仍变得愈发猛烈；他的脸涨得通红，身体在椅子上蜷成一团。 发作刚一开始，屏幕中央便闪现出一个十字准星，迅速而有目的地扫描男人。准星快速而高效地扫过他，在数个部位留下标记；他的喉咙、眼睛、手和胸口都被白色小方框圈住。方框旁弹出一系列小文本框，细小文字如潮水般涌入其中；由于字号太小，根本无法阅读。发作开始平息时，所有弹窗逐渐消失，一双粉色的手抬入画面，指尖微微发光。 “请保持冷静。”舒缓的合成嗓音响起，“您正在经历医疗紧急状况，请允许我——” 男人猛烈地挥开那双手。“我——”他咳了一声，“没事！” “请您配合。”合成嗓音带着平静的急切说道，“您需要接受医疗处理。一名医生——” “我就是医生！”男人厉声说道，握紧拳头，重重砸在身旁的桌面上。“我不需要你或任何别的东西来诊断我！” 一片寂静。男人瞪着镜头看了片刻，随后恼怒地叹了口气。“机器人，搜索你的伦理协议。” 下拉栏再次出现；几个文件闪过后，“已找到文件”几个字开始闪烁，随后打开一个更大的窗口。“已找到伦理协议。”文字迅速填满窗口，同样小得无法阅读。“您希望——” “够了。”男人叹道，屏幕上的窗口闪烁着消失。“嗯，这肯定需要一次硬重启... 删除授权是一回事，但这个...”他挠了挠太阳穴，双眼始终盯着数据板。“我不确定你的神经网络还能承受多少次这种大卸八块般的修改...”他又在数据板上点按一阵，手指移动时毫不迟疑。 屏幕闪起红光，片刻后黑色文本框再次出现。突然，数十行闪烁的红字涌入窗口，严重错误以每秒数条的速度不断出现。整个镜头开始颤抖，你意识到自己正在借用视角的机器人正经历着类似癫痫发作的状况。“医生，我正在经历——” “机器人，关机。” 镜头熄灭，视频结束。
rows.raw: "The video starts with an awkward flutter of lights. It takes a few seconds, but you quickly realize the reason is that the eyes you’re seeing through are rapidly blinking. After a moment, the fluttering stops and the camera settles on the form of a bald terran with thick glasses. He is sitting across from the camera, staring down at a datapad, tapping at it slowly. A cable runs out from the bottom of the pad, connected to something just out of view off the camera’s bottom frame. “Safe mode activated.” A familiar synthetic voice chimes, “Good morn-” “Droid, run a search on licensing registrations.” The camera shifts, a drop bar appearing on the left border of the frame. Several file names flash as a cursor highlights them, not settling on one file for more than a second as it passes over dozens of them. After a few moments, the phrase ‘File not found’ flashes, and the drop bar slips off frame. “File not found,” the voice says flatly, “I’m sorry, I am not sure why-” “Droid, are you experiencing any critical system faults?” A black box appears on the right side of the camera, a blinking cursor the only visible thing within its bounds. After a second, the box blinks away. “I am currently not. But I believe tha-” “Droid,” the man sighs, “Are y-y-,” the man clears his throat, “Are yo-uh-ehm.” Suddenly, the bespectacled man starts to cough, raising his hand to cover his mouth. Despite his attempts to fight it, the coughing grows violent, his face flushing with color as he doubles over in his chair. As soon as the fit starts, a crosshair blinks into existence in the middle of the screen, quickly running over the man with machine-like purpose. As it drags over him quickly but efficiently, it highlights several spots, leaving small white squares over his throat, eyes, hand and chest. Small text boxes pop up next to the squares, tiny scripts flooding them, the text impossible to read due to its size. As the fit starts to wind down, all the popups fade, and a pair of pink hands raise up into frame, finger tips glowing slightly. “Please be calm,” the soothing synthetic voice chimes, “You are experiencing a medical emergency, please allow me-” The man swats at the hands violently, knocking them away. “I’m-” he hacks, “Fine!” “Please,” the synetic voice speaks with calm urgency, “You require medical attention. A doctor-” “I am a doctor!” the man snaps, closing his fist and dropping it hard on the table next to him. “I don’t need you or anything else to diagnose me!” Silence. The man glares into the camera for a few beats, then lets out an annoyed sigh. “Droid, run a search for your ethics protocols.” The drop bar returns, and after a few files flash the phrase ‘File found’ blinks, and a larger box opens. “Ethics protocols found,” text rapidly fills the box, again too small to read. “What would you like-” “That’s enough,” the man sighs, the box on the screen blinking away. “Hmm, this is going to definitely require a hard reboot... Deleting licensing is one thing but this...” he scratches his temple, eyes focused on his datapad. “I’m not sure your neural net can handle getting hacked up much more...” He taps the pad a bit more, his fingers moving with no hesitation. The screen blinks red, and a moment later the black text box appears. Suddenly, dozens of flashing red lines flood the box, critical errors flooding in by the second. The whole camera starts to shake, and you realize the droid you’re seeing through is having something akin to a seizure. “Doctor, I am experiencing-” “Droid, shut down.” The camera cuts out, the video ending."

rows.original: The video starts with a flash of light, the intensity making you recoil and squint. The screen then turns black, but audio continues to run, the sound of crackling and yelling making it impossible to hear what’s going on. After a few seconds, rapid fluttering washes over the camera, shades of intense orange blinking into existence. Once the fluttering subsides, the picture becomes clear, and all you see is an intense roaring blaze. And then, a wash of white, accompanied by intense hissing. The camera sways back and forth, looking up into the source of the rush of white. When it stops, a frowning green face stares down into the camera, the ceiling visible behind her large ears. “JEZZY!” A voice yells, catching the gabilani and the camera’s attention, both turning slightly to the left. The bald man stomps up to Jezzy, his face a deep shade of red. “WHAT THE FUCK?!” “That’s what I should be sayin’!” Jezzy yells back, staring up at the much taller man, awkwardly holding a fire extinguisher almost as big as her. “I thought these bitches were already supposed to be able to cook!” “What th-” the man looks around, bewildered. He pauses a few times, running a hand over his shaved pate. “Were you- Were you teaching them how to cook m-” the audio sizzles and warbles, before coming back. “Duh,” Jezzy makes a mocking face, “I don’t know what the fuck you did to them, but these bitches are fucking brain dead. This cunt,” she kicks her foot off screen, the camera jerking slightly, “Blew herself up because she didn’t fucking know jackshit!” The terran rubs his face, donning the most exasperated expression you’ve ever seen. “Jezzy... you... IDIOT!” He screams, dropping his hands. Jezzy leaps back, her ears lowering in fear. “THEY MIX THE DRUGS INSIDE THEIR BODIES! THEY’RE FUCKING WALKING DRUG LABS YOU ABSOLUTE SIMPLETON!” “Huh?” Jezzy glances over at the camera, “What?” “GODS. DAMN IT!” The man rakes at his scalp, turning and walking away a few paces before turning back and taking a deep breath. “These nursedroids intake fluids, store them inside of their bodies, and then use those stored fluids to synthesize drugs!” He shakes his head, “They don’t need to fucking cook drugs in a fucking lab because they are the fucking lab!” “Oh...” Jezzy sheepishly grimaces. “That’s... Oh...” “Oh! Oh!” The man stalks over to the camera, looking down at it. “Damn it... It’s a mess...” he looks around, tutting and tsking, as he checks things over “But... I think it’s still operational. We can get it onto the corner on schedule.” “Eh,” Jezzy shrugs, looking down over the man’s shoulder, “Can’t we swap her out with the one you’ve got downstairs? I don’t know if people are going to buy from a dealer with half their face melted off.” The man sighs. “No. I’ve already dismantled too much of its lower body. If I don’t install the furcula now I don’t thin-” the man looks off to the right, then lets out an exhausted sigh, “Oh gods...” The camera pans to the right, a very familiar nursedroid now in frame: Narc. She appears just like she did when you first met her, face shattered and attire tattered and dirty. The only difference is several small embers resting on her, smoldering holes in her brown uniform. She stares at the bald man, her one good eye blinking. “Doctor, I am currently on fire. May I-” A blast of white interrupts her, Jezzy walking into frame, nearly blowing Narc off her feet with the fire extinguisher. “Fucking dumb bitch...” Jezzy shakes her head, still blasting Narc in the face. “If you’re on fire, stop, drop, and roll next time!” The bald man rolls his eyes, then turns his focus back to the camera. Reaching out, his hand disappears out of frame. The camera cuts out, the video ending.
rows.translation: 视频以一道闪光开始，强烈的光芒让你缩起身体、眯起双眼。随后屏幕变黑，但音频仍在继续；噼啪声与叫喊声混在一起，让人根本听不清发生了什么。几秒后，镜头被快速的闪烁洗过，一片片刺眼的橙色随之出现。闪烁平息后，画面终于清晰，而你能看到的只有熊熊燃烧的烈焰。 接着，一片白色席卷而来，伴随着剧烈的嘶嘶声。摄像头来回摇晃，向上望向喷涌白雾的源头。等它停下时，一张皱眉的绿色脸庞俯视镜头，她那双大耳朵后方还能看见天花板。 “杰兹！”一个声音高声喊道，同时引起加比拉尼人和摄像头的注意，两者都略微转向左侧。秃头男人大步走到杰兹面前，脸色涨得通红。“搞什么鬼？！” “这话该老娘问才对！”杰兹同样大喊着回嘴，抬头瞪着比她高大得多的男人，怀里笨拙地抱着几乎和她一样大的灭火器。“我还以为这些婊子本来就会制药！” “什么——”男人困惑地环顾四周。他停顿了好几次，用手摸过剃得光秃秃的头顶。“你刚才——你刚才是在教它们怎么制——”音频发出嘶嘶声并变得扭曲，随后才恢复正常。 “废话。”杰兹做了个嘲弄的鬼脸，“我不知道你他妈对它们做了什么，但这些婊子完全他妈没脑子。这个骚货，”她一脚踢向画面外，摄像头随之微微抽动，“什么鸡巴都不懂，把自己炸飞了！” 泰伦男人揉着脸，露出你见过最为恼怒的神情。“杰兹...你这个...白痴！”他放下双手，尖声怒吼。杰兹向后一跃，耳朵因恐惧而垂下。 “它们是在自己体内调配药物！它们他妈就是会走路的制药实验室，你这个彻头彻尾的蠢货！” “哈？”杰兹瞥向镜头，“什么？” “诸神啊。该死！”男人抓挠着头皮，转身走开几步，随后又转回来深吸一口气。“这些护理机器人会摄入液体，将其储存在体内，然后利用储存的液体合成药物！”他摇摇头，“它们不用他妈在实验室里煮药，因为它们自己就是那个他妈的实验室！” “哦...”杰兹难为情地扭起脸。“那是...哦...” “哦！哦！”男人大步走到镜头前，低头察看。“该死...真是一团糟...”他环顾四周，一边咂舌一边检查情况，“不过...我想它仍能运作。我们可以按计划把它送到街角。” “呃。”杰兹耸耸肩，从男人肩膀上方俯视镜头，“不能把她换成你放在楼下的那个吗？我可不知道会不会有人愿意向一个半边脸都融掉的贩子买东西。” 男人叹了口气。“不行。它的下半身已经被我拆掉太多部分了。如果现在不装上叉骨，我不觉——”男人望向右侧，接着筋疲力尽地叹息，“哦，诸神啊...” 摄像头转向右侧，一名无比熟悉的护理机器人出现在画面中：纳克。她看起来与初次见面时一模一样，脸庞破碎，衣服破烂肮脏。唯一的区别是身上落着几颗细小余烬，棕色制服上烧出了仍在冒烟的洞。她盯着秃头男人，仅剩的完好眼睛眨了眨。 “医生，我目前正处于燃烧状态。可以请——” 一股白雾打断了她。杰兹走入画面，用灭火器喷得纳克几乎站立不稳。 “他妈的蠢婊子...”杰兹摇着头，仍在往纳克脸上喷射。“下次身上着火，就给我停下、倒地、打滚！” 秃头男人翻了个白眼，随后将注意力重新转向摄像头。他伸出手，手掌消失在画面之外。 摄像头关闭，视频到此结束。

rows.original: When the video starts, the audio kicks in first. Sounds that could only be heavy breathing, huffs and pants, manifest from the speakers, all while the screen remains black. A thin, white line forms across the center of the screen, slowly fattening, and soon color paints the monitor. Or at least one color: green. It takes a few seconds to come into focus, but when it does the screen is filled with a very familiar green face. Jezzy’s visage takes up the whole screen, her face up right against the camera, swaying to and fro rhythmically. Breathing hard, her cheeks are flushed a darker tone. Mouth hanging open, the pink of her tongue the only color to combat the greens of her flesh. Her eyes are glazed over, rolling around in her skull, as if in a trance. Soon the swaying grows faster, more intense, and with it, her breathing begins to quicken. A throaty, lusty moan croaks out from her mouth, her tongue slipping further out over her plush green lips. She looks like she’s tensing, her left eye twitching, the swaying starting to turn into jitters and she makes a final push for- A mechanical woosh, then a voice in the distance speaks. “Jezzy, have you seen- WHAT THE FUCK?!” “Eh?!” Jezzy jerks her head to the right, and as her expression shifts she reminds you of a prey animal caught in headlights. “What the fu- Bi-Bitch! Fucking knock!” Off camera, the voice lets out a deeply annoyed groan. “Jezzy get the fuck off it!” Jezzy rolls her eyes and snorts, mumbling under her breath about being ‘close.’ She shifts and sways, and so too does the camera, jostling violently as Jezzy gets herself up. The motion shifts the camera hard to the right, the bald terran now visible in the top of the frame, the camera clearly now sideways. After a beat, he recoils, letting out another annoyed groan as he turns his head slightly and blocks his line of vision with his hand. “What?” She walks into frame, turned away from the camera, naked as the day she was born. Her massive green ass fills the bottom of the frame, jiggling slightly as she plants her hands on her wide hips. “See somethin’ you like?” “Hardly,” the man lowers his hand, but refuses to look Jezzy straight on, “Could you put some pants on?” “Nah,” Jezzy shrugs, “My room, my rules.” The man lets out a defeated sigh, as if this was just one round of a long ongoing fight. “We need that droid back out there. It’s meant to earn and gather samples, not...” he waves his hand, “That.” “Eh? Whaddya mean? I was givin’ her a sample right when ye walked in.” Jezzy reaches towards her crotch, and while the camera doesn’t catch it, you’re sure she gave herself a groping squeeze. “Hmph,” the man shakes his head, “Orally, Jezzy. The samples are collected orally.” “Oh, well...” Jezzy returns the hand to her hips, “That was the opener.” The bald man slumps slightly, and is about to say something before he starts to cough. The fit is severe, but short, the terran looking noticeably paler when it’s done. “I’m running out of time...” he looks at his hand, grimacing before sticking it in his pocket. “Jezzy, please.” “Urg,” Jezzy drops her arms, “Fine. I’ll get her back out there. But if we’re only getting samples off oral, why the fuck do they have twats?” The bald man turns to face Jezzy, his expression going blank for a beat as his jaw slacks. “I mean,” Jezzy shrugs, “We also lose out on potential product, right? Every creampie these bitches take is a double loss. That fucking thing you’re building in the lab ain’t cheap, and all this wasn’t either.” Jezzy wiggles herself back and forth slightly. “Jezzy...” “Hm?” “You’re... a genius.” Jezzy snorts. “Duh.” The bald man stalks forwards, reaching for the camera. “I’ll have to reboot them. Uninstalling their vaginal units will likely cause bugs in their programming. There will likely be some memory loss-” The camera cuts out, the video ending.
rows.translation: 视频开始时，音频首先响起。扬声器中传出只能是沉重呼吸的声音，喘息与呼哧声此起彼伏，而屏幕始终一片漆黑。一条细细的白线横贯屏幕中央，逐渐变粗，很快色彩便涂满了显示器。或者至少是一种颜色：绿色。过了几秒，画面才终于聚焦；等到清晰时，一张无比熟悉的绿色脸庞已经占满屏幕。 杰兹的面容占据了整个画面，她的脸紧贴摄像头，有节奏地前后摇摆。她呼吸沉重，双颊泛着更深的颜色。嘴巴大张着，舌头的粉色成为唯一能与皮肤绿色抗衡的色彩。她的眼神朦胧，眼球像着了魔似的在眼眶里滚动。很快，摇摆变得更快、更激烈，呼吸也随之加速。一声低沉而充满欲望的呻吟从她口中沙哑地溢出，舌头进一步滑出丰满的绿色嘴唇。她看起来正绷紧身体，左眼不断抽动，摇摆逐渐变成颤动，随后为了最后的冲刺—— 机械门发出嗖的一声，远处随即传来话音。“杰兹，你有没有看见——搞什么鬼？！” “呃？！”杰兹猛地把头转向右侧，表情骤变，活像一只被车灯照住的猎物。“搞什——婊、婊子！进来前他妈不会敲门吗！” 画面外的声音发出一声极度恼火的呻吟。“杰兹，给我从那东西上下来！” 杰兹翻了个白眼，哼了一声，低声嘟囔着自己“就快到了”。她扭动着摇摆身体，摄像头也随之剧烈晃动，杰兹正从上面站起来。这个动作使镜头猛然向右倾斜，秃头泰伦男人如今出现在画面上方，摄像头显然已经横倒。停顿片刻后，他缩起身体，又发出一声恼火的呻吟，同时稍稍转头，用手挡住视线。 “怎么了？”她走入画面，背对摄像头，浑身上下像出生时一样赤裸。她硕大的绿色屁股占据画面下方，双手叉上宽阔的胯部时，臀肉还轻轻晃动。“看见喜欢的东西了？” “完全没有。”男人放下手，却仍拒绝正眼看杰兹，“你能穿条裤子吗？” “不要。”杰兹耸耸肩，“我的房间，我说了算。” 男人认命般叹了口气，仿佛这只是旷日持久的争斗中的又一回合。“我们需要那个机器人回到外面。它的用途是赚钱和收集样本，而不是...”他挥了挥手，“干这个。” “呃？你说啥呢？你进来的时候，老娘正好就在给她一份样本。”杰兹伸手摸向胯间；尽管摄像头没有拍到，你确信她用力抓捏了自己一把。 “哼。”男人摇摇头，“用嘴，杰兹。样本是通过口腔收集的。” “哦，好吧...”杰兹把手放回胯部，“刚才只是开胃菜。” 秃头男人微微垮下身体，正要说些什么，却突然开始咳嗽。这一阵来势凶猛，但很快结束；咳完后，泰伦男人的脸色明显更加苍白。“我的时间不多了...”他望着自己的手，做了个鬼脸，随后把手塞进口袋。“杰兹，拜托。” “呃啊。”杰兹垂下双臂，“好吧。我会让她回去工作。但如果只从口交里收集样本，那她们他妈为什么还要长小穴？” 秃头男人转身面对杰兹，表情呆滞了一瞬，下巴也松垮下来。 “我是说，”杰兹耸耸肩，“我们也会损失潜在产品，对吧？这些婊子每被内射一次，损失就是双倍。你在实验室里造的那件鸡巴玩意儿可不便宜，这些东西也一样。”杰兹轻轻来回扭动身体。 “杰兹...” “嗯？” “你真是...个天才。” 杰兹哼了一声。“废话。” 秃头男人大步上前，伸手抓向摄像头。“我得重启她们。卸掉阴道单元很可能会导致程序出错，也很可能造成一些记忆丢失——” 摄像头关闭，视频到此结束。
rows.raw: "When the video starts, the audio kicks in first. Sounds that could only be heavy breathing, huffs and pants, manifest from the speakers, all while the screen remains black. A thin, white line forms across the center of the screen, slowly fattening, and soon color paints the monitor. Or at least one color: green. It takes a few seconds to come into focus, but when it does the screen is filled with a very familiar green face. Jezzy’s visage takes up the whole screen, her face up right against the camera, swaying to and fro rhythmically. Breathing hard, her cheeks are flushed a darker tone. Mouth hanging open, the pink of her tongue the only color to combat the greens of her flesh. Her eyes are glazed over, rolling around in her skull, as if in a trance. Soon the swaying grows faster, more intense, and with it, her breathing begins to quicken. A throaty, lusty moan croaks out from her mouth, her tongue slipping further out over her plush green lips. She looks like she’s tensing, her left eye twitching, the swaying starting to turn into jitters and she makes a final push for- A mechanical woosh, then a voice in the distance speaks. “Jezzy, have you seen- WHAT THE FUCK?!” “Eh?!” Jezzy jerks her head to the right, and as her expression shifts she reminds you of a prey animal caught in headlights. “What the fu- Bi-Bitch! Fucking knock!” Off camera, the voice lets out a deeply annoyed groan. “Jezzy get the fuck off it!” Jezzy rolls her eyes and snorts, mumbling under her breath about being ‘close.’ She shifts and sways, and so too does the camera, jostling violently as Jezzy gets herself up. The motion shifts the camera hard to the right, the bald terran now visible in the top of the frame, the camera clearly now sideways. After a beat, he recoils, letting out another annoyed groan as he turns his head slightly and blocks his line of vision with his hand. “What?” She walks into frame, turned away from the camera, naked as the day she was born. Her massive green ass fills the bottom of the frame, jiggling slightly as she plants her hands on her wide hips. “See somethin’ you like?” “Hardly,” the man lowers his hand, but refuses to look Jezzy straight on, “Could you put some pants on?” “Nah,” Jezzy shrugs, “My room, my rules.” The man lets out a defeated sigh, as if this was just one round of a long ongoing fight. “We need that droid back out there. It’s meant to earn and gather samples, not...” he waves his hand, “That.” “Eh? Whaddya mean? I was givin’ her a sample right when ye walked in.” Jezzy reaches towards her crotch, and while the camera doesn’t catch it, you’re sure she gave herself a groping squeeze. “Hmph,” the man shakes his head, “Orally, Jezzy. The samples are collected orally.” “Oh, well...” Jezzy returns the hand to her hips, “That was the opener.” The bald man slumps slightly, and is about to say something before he starts to cough. The fit is severe, but short, the terran looking noticeably paler when it’s done. “I’m running out of time...” he looks at his hand, grimacing before sticking it in his pocket. “Jezzy, please.” “Urg,” Jezzy drops her arms, “Fine. I’ll get her back out there. But if we’re only getting samples off oral, why the fuck do they have twats?” The bald man turns to face Jezzy, his expression going blank for a beat as his jaw slacks. “I mean,” Jezzy shrugs, “We also lose out on potential product, right? Every creampie these bitches take is a double loss. That fucking thing you’re building in the lab ain’t cheap, and all this wasn’t either.” Jezzy wiggles herself back and forth slightly. “Jezzy...” “Hm?” “You’re... a genius.” Jezzy snorts. “Duh.” The bald man stalks forwards, reaching for the camera. “I’ll have to reboot them. Uninstalling their vaginal units will likely cause bugs in their programming. There will likely be some memory loss-” The camera cuts out, the video ending."

rows.original: A dull pain finds you before the rest of the world does, isolated completely to your head. A powerful, pervasive numbness has taken root in the rest of your body. It’s so deeply embedded, you’re not sure if you could raise your arm even if you wanted to. For a long few moments you decidedly don’t, but as you continue to wake from restless sleep the urge to clutch your head becomes too great to ignore. Only, when you try to raise your arm, you find you can’t. Straining, you try again, but once again it can’t rise, bound in place by something. Your arm is too numb to tell what it is, the feeling in your limbs compromised more than you first realized. You try to lift your other arm but face the same problem. Attempting to open your eyes ends in pain, the slit of the light that meets them blinding, forcing you to close them once more. Groaning, your mind starting to collect itself enough to make connections; you realize you’ve been strapped down to a table. Head spinning, you tug against the binds you can barely feel, trying to free yourself. “Ah, you’re awake,” a gravelly voice remarks off to the side somewhere. “That’s unfortunate.” Footsteps fall against what sounds like a metal floor, the sound echoing as they stalk away from you. You turn your head towards the sound of the footfalls, trying to force your mouth to form words. “Wh-where... Am I?” You swallow, your throat unusually dry. You get the feeling you’ve been unconscious for much longer than you first thought. The gravelly voice doesn’t respond to you, but you hear him speak nonetheless. “Sedate [pc.himHer]. Properly this time.” The familiar voice of a V-KO nursedroid responds. “As you wish, Doctor.” A second set of footsteps approaches the cadence of their gait completely different, but it’s one you’re intimately familiar with. Cracking open a single eye, you risk the burning agony of the light above to catch sight of the approaching droid. The bright lights behind her make her features impossible to see, minus the burning white glow of her cross-shaped irises staring down at you. Now at your side, she seems to be digging through her bag, searching for something to sedate you, no doubt. You don’t know how long you have, and you say the one word that comes to mind. “Narc?” The droid stops, tilting her head slightly as she regards her. Her features hidden in shadow, you don’t know if it’s her, or one of the other roaming droids. And yet... why the pause? “What’s the problem, droid? Sedate [pc.himHer]!” “There is no problem, Doctor,” the droid resumes digging in her bag, producing what you can tell is a large needle despite the blinding light, “Administering sedative.” Something cold pricks into the side of your neck, and a beat later fire enters your veins. You try to scream but your throat can’t handle it, a weak wheeze all you’re able to manage. “Excellent,” the gravelly voice sounds closer now, although also somehow much, much further away, “Monitor and keep [pc.himHer] under. I don’t want any more interruptions to the harvest.” The droid tilting her head is the last thing you see before your eyes close, lids simply too heavy. “Doctor. Constant sedation matching estimations for harvesting completion may result in side effects such as a permanent brain damage, a coma, or de-” “I don’t care!” The voice hacks, coughing slightly, “I don’t, ehm, care if they never, hm, hm, just do it.” You vaguely hear the subtle sound of the droid bowing. “As you wish, Doctor.” Your mind drifts after that, unable to catch any more words. Soon you fall into a deep sleep... ...And never wake again.
rows.translation: 在你重新感知到周围世界之前，一阵钝痛先找上了你，而且完全集中在头部。强烈而无处不在的麻木感盘踞在身体其他部位。它深入得如此彻底，你甚至不确定自己就算想抬起手臂，究竟能不能做到。好一会儿里，你明确地不想尝试；但随着你从不安稳的睡眠中继续苏醒，想要抱住脑袋的冲动终于变得难以忽视。 然而，当你试着抬起手臂时，却发现自己做不到。 你使上力气再次尝试，可手臂依然抬不起来，像是被什么东西固定在了原处。手臂麻木得根本分辨不出那是什么，你的四肢知觉受损程度远超最初的想象。你试着抬起另一条手臂，却遇到同样的问题。睁开眼睛的尝试也以疼痛告终，映入眼中的一线光芒刺眼得令你不得不再次闭眼。你呻吟着，思绪渐渐聚拢，终于能够把线索联系起来；你意识到自己被绑在了一张台子上。脑袋天旋地转，你拉扯着几乎感觉不到的束缚，试图挣脱出去。 “啊，你醒了，”一个沙哑的声音从侧面某处评论道。“真不走运。” 脚步踩在听起来像是金属的地板上，随着那人离你而去，回声在四周荡开。你把头转向脚步声，勉强迫使嘴巴吐出话语。“我-我在哪...？”你咽了口唾沫，喉咙干得反常。你感觉自己失去意识的时间远比最初以为的更久。 那个沙哑的声音没有回答你，但你还是听见他开了口。“给[pc.himHer]注射镇静剂。这次做好点。” V-KO护理机器人熟悉的声音回应道。“遵命，医生。” 第二阵脚步声逐渐靠近，步态节奏截然不同，却是你熟悉得不能再熟悉的那一种。你微微睁开一只眼睛，忍受着头顶灯光灼烧般的剧痛，终于看见了正在靠近的机器人。她身后的强光让你根本看不清她的五官，唯独那双十字形虹膜燃烧般的白光俯视着你。来到你身边后，她似乎开始翻找自己的包，无疑是在寻找能让你镇静下来的东西。你不知道自己还剩多少时间，于是说出了脑中浮现的唯一一个词。“纳克？” 机器人停了下来，打量着你，微微歪起脑袋。她的容貌藏在阴影里，你不知道她究竟是不是纳克，还是其他四处游荡的机器人之一。可是...她为什么停顿？ “出什么问题了，机器人？给[pc.himHer]注射镇静剂！” “没有问题，医生，”机器人重新翻找起包，尽管光线刺眼，你仍能看出她拿出了一根硕大的针头，“正在施用镇静剂。” 冰冷的东西刺进你的颈侧，一拍之后，烈火涌入你的血管。你想尖叫，但喉咙承受不住，只能发出一声虚弱的喘鸣。 “很好，”那个沙哑的声音现在听起来近了些，却又不知为何仿佛远了许多，“监控[pc.himHer]，让其一直昏睡。我不希望收获过程再受到任何打扰。” 在沉重得无法支撑的眼皮合上之前，你最后看见的是机器人歪起脑袋。“医生。按照预计收获完成时间持续施用镇静剂，可能造成永久性脑损伤、昏迷或死-” “我不在乎！”那个声音嘶声说道，还轻咳了几下，“我不，呃，不在乎他们会不会再也，嗯，嗯，照做就是了。” 你隐约听见了机器人鞠躬时发出的细微动静。“遵命，医生。” 在那之后，你的思绪渐渐飘散，再也听不清任何话语。 很快，你陷入了深沉的睡眠... ...并且再也没有醒来。
rows.raw: "A dull pain finds you before the rest of the world does, isolated completely to your head. A powerful, pervasive numbness has taken root in the rest of your body. It’s so deeply embedded, you’re not sure if you could raise your arm even if you wanted to. For a long few moments you decidedly don’t, but as you continue to wake from restless sleep the urge to clutch your head becomes too great to ignore. Only, when you try to raise your arm, you find you can’t. Straining, you try again, but once again it can’t rise, bound in place by something. Your arm is too numb to tell what it is, the feeling in your limbs compromised more than you first realized. You try to lift your other arm but face the same problem. Attempting to open your eyes ends in pain, the slit of the light that meets them blinding, forcing you to close them once more. Groaning, your mind starting to collect itself enough to make connections; you realize you’ve been strapped down to a table. Head spinning, you tug against the binds you can barely feel, trying to free yourself. “Ah, you’re awake,” a gravelly voice remarks off to the side somewhere. “That’s unfortunate.” Footsteps fall against what sounds like a metal floor, the sound echoing as they stalk away from you. You turn your head towards the sound of the footfalls, trying to force your mouth to form words. “Wh-where... Am I?” You swallow, your throat unusually dry. You get the feeling you’ve been unconscious for much longer than you first thought. The gravelly voice doesn’t respond to you, but you hear him speak nonetheless. “Sedate [pc.himHer]. Properly this time.” The familiar voice of a V-KO nursedroid responds. “As you wish, Doctor.” A second set of footsteps approaches the cadence of their gait completely different, but it’s one you’re intimately familiar with. Cracking open a single eye, you risk the burning agony of the light above to catch sight of the approaching droid. The bright lights behind her make her features impossible to see, minus the burning white glow of her cross-shaped irises staring down at you. Now at your side, she seems to be digging through her bag, searching for something to sedate you, no doubt. You don’t know how long you have, and you say the one word that comes to mind. “Narc?” The droid stops, tilting her head slightly as she regards her. Her features hidden in shadow, you don’t know if it’s her, or one of the other roaming droids. And yet... why the pause? “What’s the problem, droid? Sedate [pc.himHer]!” “There is no problem, Doctor,” the droid resumes digging in her bag, producing what you can tell is a large needle despite the blinding light, “Administering sedative.” Something cold pricks into the side of your neck, and a beat later fire enters your veins. You try to scream but your throat can’t handle it, a weak wheeze all you’re able to manage. “Excellent,” the gravelly voice sounds closer now, although also somehow much, much further away, “Monitor and keep [pc.himHer] under. I don’t want any more interruptions to the harvest.” The droid tilting her head is the last thing you see before your eyes close, lids simply too heavy. “Doctor. Constant sedation matching estimations for harvesting completion may result in side effects such as a permanent brain damage, a coma, or de-” “I don’t care!” The voice hacks, coughing slightly, “I don’t, ehm, care if they never, hm, hm, just do it.” You vaguely hear the subtle sound of the droid bowing. “As you wish, Doctor.” Your mind drifts after that, unable to catch any more words. Soon you fall into a deep sleep... ...And never wake again."

rows.raw: "Bad End"

rows.original: Darkness is disturbed by your brain igniting, firing off wild sensations into its abyss. Persistent pain dominates everything, but something stirs in a deeper place. Faint echoes travel the void, grunts and pants, depraved and lascivious. Everything shakes, the very limits of yourself shuddering. Something is inside you. Destroying you. Bringing pain and pleasure all in equal measure. And then comes the fire. Heavy and consuming, the void bursts into flames, the darkness almost replaced by light as you burn down to nearly nothing. The abyss stops and lingers, a bellowing cry dominating, making the pain in your brain flare and pulse. And then everything becomes black once more. Pain is the first thing that greets you when the first scraps of your consciousness return. While the majority of it is localized to your head, your [pc.vagOrAss] also feels like it’s been treated roughly. As your mind starts to collect itself, your ears make out the sound of voices, one familiar and the other new. “You should have brought them down here right away!” The hoarse, unfamiliar voice wheezes. “Pft,” lips sputter, blowing a raspberry, “How the fuck was I supposed to know you wanted ‘em?” Jezzy is clearly the speaker, a fact even your possibly concussed brain can parse. The noise expedites your waking, which also makes the pain you’re feeling sharper. The two keep talking, but seem to be coming in and out of earshot, the conversation traveling around the room. Wincing, the pain flares and you go to clutch your head, but find you can’t. Straining, you try again, but once again your arm can’t rise, bound in place by something. You try to raise your other arm but face the same problem. Attempting to open your eyes ends in pain, the slit of light that meets them blinding, forcing you to close them once more. Taking a moment to think, you realize you’re strapped down to a table of some sort, feeling the bounds on your wrist when you focus. Wincing again, this time you let out an audible groan, and for a moment the room goes silent. “Shit,” Jezzy lets out an audible sigh, “They’re up.” “Hm...” you hear some soft coughing, “Seems like [pc.heShe]’s in pain... What did you use to put them under?” “My club.” A pause. “What?!” You hear an indignant hack. “Jezzy, you idiot!” “Hey, bitch! It worked, didn’t it?!” You vaguely hear some footsteps, then the unknown voice speaks again. “You could at least have given them some of that poison you use to sleep.” “Pft, that’d make ‘em all limp. I wanted ‘em nice and tight.” You feel your [pc.vagOrAss] twitch, remembering things your brain doesn’t. “Damn it, Jezzy...” footsteps again, this time drawing nearer. “Can’t you control yourself at all?” Something cold pricks into the side of your neck, and a beat later fire enters your veins. You try to scream but your throat can’t handle it, a weak wheeze all you’re able to manage. “Oooo, what’cha givin’ ‘em? Can I have some?” “Nothing for you. I’m putting them into a coma for the harvest.” Your lips try to form the word ‘harvest’, asking what they mean, but suddenly your face feels numb. While your head had never completely cleared, it quickly starts to degrade. You feel yourself slipping away. “Fuck,” Jezzy sounds a thousand miles away, “Welp, that’s a sha-” You don’t fully hear the last word, falling into a deep sleep... ...And never wake again.
rows.translation: 黑暗被点燃的大脑搅乱，狂乱的感觉迸射进深渊。持续不断的疼痛支配了一切，但更深处有什么正在骚动。微弱的回声穿过虚空，闷哼与喘息既堕落又淫荡。一切都在震动，就连你自身的界限也颤抖不已。有东西在你体内。摧毁你。以相同的份量带来痛苦与快感。 随后，烈火降临。 沉重而又无所不噬，虚空轰然燃烧；当你被焚烧得几乎一无所有时，光明近乎取代了黑暗。深渊停下并徘徊不去，一声震耳欲聋的吼叫占据一切，令脑中的痛楚猛烈燃起、不断搏动。 接着，一切再次归于漆黑。 当零碎意识最先恢复时，迎接你的便是疼痛。虽然绝大部分集中在头部，[pc.vagOrAss]却也像是遭到了粗暴对待。随着思绪逐渐聚拢，双耳辨认出交谈声，一个声音很熟悉，另一个则十分陌生。 “你一开始就该把人带到这里来！”那个陌生而沙哑的声音喘息道。 “噗。”嘴唇喷气，发出一声嘲弄，“我他妈怎么知道你想要这家伙？”说话的显然是杰兹，即便你可能已被打出脑震荡，仍能判断这一点。 声音加速了你的苏醒，也让身上的疼痛变得更加尖锐。两人继续交谈，却似乎时而进入、时而离开听力范围，对话声在房间里四处移动。你因疼痛骤然加剧而缩起身体，试图抬手抱住脑袋，却发现自己做不到。 你用力挣扎，再试一次，可胳膊依然抬不起来，被什么东西牢牢固定。另一条胳膊也面临相同的问题。你试图睁眼，却只得到疼痛；迎面而来的那一线光芒刺眼无比，迫使你再次闭上眼睛。花了片刻思考，你意识到自己被绑在某种桌子上；集中注意力时，可以感觉到手腕上的束缚。你再次因痛缩起身体，这次还发出一声清晰可闻的呻吟，房间一时间安静下来。 “操。”杰兹发出清晰可闻的叹息，“醒了。” “嗯...”你听见几声轻咳，“看来[pc.heShe]很痛苦...你用什么把人弄晕的？” “我的棍子。” 一阵沉默。 “什么？！”你听见一声愤怒的咳嗽。“杰兹，你这个白痴！” “嘿，贱人！反正管用了，不是吗？！” 你隐约听见一些脚步，接着陌生的声音再次开口。“你至少可以喂点自己用来睡觉的毒药。” “噗，那会让人全身都软掉。我要的是又美又紧。” 你的[pc.vagOrAss]轻轻抽动，回忆起了大脑尚未记得的事情。 “该死，杰兹...”脚步声再次响起，这次越走越近。“你就完全控制不了自己吗？” 冰冷的东西刺进颈侧，紧接着烈火涌入血管。你试图尖叫，喉咙却无法承受，最终只能挤出一声虚弱的喘鸣。 “哦哦哦，你给人家打了什么？我也能来一点吗？” “没你的份。我要让这家伙陷入昏迷，好进行收获。” 你的嘴唇试图组成“收获”二字，想询问那是什么意思，脸庞却突然失去知觉。虽然头脑从未完全清醒，却又迅速开始衰退。你感觉自己正在滑向远方。 “操。”杰兹的声音仿佛远在千里之外，“好吧，真是可——” 你没能听清最后一个词，便陷入沉睡... ...并且再也没有醒来。
