rows.original: Loading Bay
rows.raw: "Loading Bay"

rows.original: Walking along the narrow passage, you notice a larger opening up ahead. Minding your step, you make your way towards it, keeping your weapon at the ready. Soon enough, you pass into a much larger space, looking around to get a better sense of the area. It appears you’ve entered a loading bay of some sort. Large metal doors are off to the side, clearly intended for vehicles of some sort to pull up to so cargo can be unloaded. Or loaded, you think, looking about some more. This building must have been a factory, so it makes sense that whatever they produced was shipped out from here. Moving forward, you keep looking around, trying to get a sense of why you were led here. The place seems abandoned, the air stale and quiet... ...Which makes it so much easier to hear the sound of oncoming footsteps. Turning, you keep your weapon at the ready, the sound of the footfalls drawing closer, although the way they echo makes you believe they are still far, far away. Breathing deep, you steady yourself, wondering if this is who called you here, or somebody else entirely. Experience tells you not to let your guard down and the offputting scenery not helping you relax, either. Eventually, a shadow starts to take shape among the darkness, a silhouette you know all too well. “Narc?” You lower your weapons lightly, recognizing the shape of a JoyCo nursedroid. But barely a beat later you notice something is wrong. The droid steps out from the darkness, light washing over her, revealing a familiar but unknown and scarred face. It’s not Narc. A nursedroid you’ve never seen before moves towards you, her walk slow and measured. She’s wearing an identical uniform to the one Narc once wore, although hers is defaced and ruined. Bright neon paint is scrawled over her, both graffiti and slurs present, with words like ‘whore’ and ‘slut’ catching your eye. Her long hair is a loose mop, hanging down past her waist, with quite a bit of the weirdly glowing paint coloring it an array of luminous hues. But what really catches your eye is the scar snaking across her face. A rough, jagged line, it cuts across the length of her pale visage, running through her lip, nose and over her eye. The wound looks horrible, although you can tell an attempt was made to repair it, her synth-flesh appearing to have been properly lined up before it was sealed. You wonder to yourself if the cause of her wound is the same as the other droids, but quickly dismiss the notion. You’re fairly certain that wherever this droid has been tasked to sell must be a particularly rough corner - or perhaps some dark back alley. It would also explain the graffiti painted all over her, a clear sign somebody has been fucking with her in a way Narc and the masked droid have not been. Suddenly the droid stops, her white and black eyes gleaming. She’s only just noticed your presence. Seems it was just bad luck you ran into her on her way out. “Intruder detected.” her voice chimes, exactly the same as Narc’s. “Lock down engaged.” Suddenly her eyes flicker, and behind you, the sound of metal starts to scrape against itself. Glancing back over your shoulder, you see a sliding shutter door grinding downward over the passage you entered through, and before you can react, the way is sealed shut. Wheeling back around to face the droid again, you regrip your [pc.weaponMain], your mind racing. What’s going on? Why is another nursedroid here? Is Narc here? Was she the one who emailed you? All those questions whirl through your head as the scarred droid slips a hand into a black bag impossibly similar to Narc’s, producing a long, menacing knife. “Engaging.” Seems like you don’t have time to think.
rows.translation: 沿着狭窄的通道前行时，你注意到前方有一处更加开阔的入口。你留意着脚下，握紧武器戒备，朝那里走去。没过多久，你便进入了一片宽敞得多的空间，环顾四周，试图弄清这片区域的情况。 这里似乎是某种装卸区。侧面排列着几扇巨大的金属门，显然是供某类车辆靠近，以便卸下货物。又或者装上货物，你一边继续观察一边想到。这栋建筑以前一定是一座工厂，那么它们生产出来的东西从这里运走也很合理。 你继续向前，同时不断环顾四周，试图弄明白自己为何会被引到这里。这里似乎已经废弃，空气浑浊而寂静... ...这也让逐渐逼近的脚步声变得格外清晰。 你转过身，仍将武器保持在随时可用的位置。脚步声越来越近，但回音的方式让你觉得对方依然远在另一头。你深吸一口气稳住自己，猜想着来者究竟是把你叫到这里的人，还是完全不相干的某个人。经验告诉你绝不能放松警惕，而周围令人不安的景象也丝毫无助于缓解紧张。终于，一片阴影开始在黑暗中显出轮廓，化作一个你再熟悉不过的身影。 “纳克？”你稍稍放低武器，认出了欢乐公司护理机器人的体形。然而仅仅一瞬之后，你便察觉到情况不对。 机器人从黑暗中走出，灯光洒在她身上，显露出一张熟悉却又陌生、伤痕累累的脸。 她不是纳克。 一台你从未见过的护理机器人朝你走来，步伐缓慢而沉稳。她身上的制服与纳克曾经穿过的那套完全相同，但她这一套已经遭到涂污，破烂不堪。鲜亮的霓虹颜料潦草涂满她的身体，既有涂鸦，也有侮辱性的字眼；其中“婊子”和“荡妇”之类的词尤其惹眼。她的长发像一团松散的拖布，一直垂过腰际；不少诡异发光的颜料也染在发丝上，令其呈现出一片片明亮刺目的色彩。 但真正吸引你目光的，是那道蜿蜒横过她面庞的伤疤。那是一条粗糙而参差不齐的线，贯穿她苍白脸庞的整个长度，割过嘴唇和鼻子，又从眼睛上方延伸过去。伤口看起来十分骇人，不过你看得出有人曾尝试修复；合成皮肉在封合前似乎被仔细地对齐过。你暗自猜想，她受伤的原因是否与其他机器人相同，但很快便否定了这个念头。你相当确信，这台机器人受命前去营业的地方一定是个格外混乱的角落，或许甚至是某条阴暗的后巷。这也能解释她身上为何遍布涂鸦，那显然表明有人曾以纳克和蒙面机器人都未遭遇过的方式肆意凌辱她。 机器人忽然停下，黑白相间的双眼闪烁着光芒。她刚刚才注意到你的存在。看来你只是不走运，恰好在她离开的路上撞见了她。 “检测到入侵者。”她的声音响起，与纳克一模一样。“启动封锁。” 她的双眼突然闪动起来，你身后也随之传来金属相互刮擦的声音。你越过肩头回望，只见一扇滑动卷门正伴着刺耳的摩擦声，在你进入的通道前缓缓降下；还没等你作出反应，退路便已被彻底封死。你迅速转身，再次面对机器人，重新握紧[pc.weaponMain]，思绪飞速运转。 这是怎么回事？为什么这里还有另一台护理机器人？纳克也在这里吗？给你发邮件的人是她吗？ 所有问题都在脑海中飞旋，而那台伤疤累累的机器人把手伸进一个与纳克所用款式相似到不可思议的黑色包袋，抽出一把修长而危险的刀。 “开始交战。” 看来你已经没有时间思考了。
rows.raw: "Walking along the narrow passage, you notice a larger opening up ahead. Minding your step, you make your way towards it, keeping your weapon at the ready. Soon enough, you pass into a much larger space, looking around to get a better sense of the area. It appears you’ve entered a loading bay of some sort. Large metal doors are off to the side, clearly intended for vehicles of some sort to pull up to so cargo can be unloaded. Or loaded, you think, looking about some more. This building must have been a factory, so it makes sense that whatever they produced was shipped out from here. Moving forward, you keep looking around, trying to get a sense of why you were led here. The place seems abandoned, the air stale and quiet... ...Which makes it so much easier to hear the sound of oncoming footsteps. Turning, you keep your weapon at the ready, the sound of the footfalls drawing closer, although the way they echo makes you believe they are still far, far away. Breathing deep, you steady yourself, wondering if this is who called you here, or somebody else entirely. Experience tells you not to let your guard down and the offputting scenery not helping you relax, either. Eventually, a shadow starts to take shape among the darkness, a silhouette you know all too well. “Narc?” You lower your weapons lightly, recognizing the shape of a JoyCo nursedroid. But barely a beat later you notice something is wrong. The droid steps out from the darkness, light washing over her, revealing a familiar but unknown and scarred face. It’s not Narc. A nursedroid you’ve never seen before moves towards you, her walk slow and measured. She’s wearing an identical uniform to the one Narc once wore, although hers is defaced and ruined. Bright neon paint is scrawled over her, both graffiti and slurs present, with words like ‘whore’ and ‘slut’ catching your eye. Her long hair is a loose mop, hanging down past her waist, with quite a bit of the weirdly glowing paint coloring it an array of luminous hues. But what really catches your eye is the scar snaking across her face. A rough, jagged line, it cuts across the length of her pale visage, running through her lip, nose and over her eye. The wound looks horrible, although you can tell an attempt was made to repair it, her synth-flesh appearing to have been properly lined up before it was sealed. You wonder to yourself if the cause of her wound is the same as the other droids, but quickly dismiss the notion. You’re fairly certain that wherever this droid has been tasked to sell must be a particularly rough corner - or perhaps some dark back alley. It would also explain the graffiti painted all over her, a clear sign somebody has been fucking with her in a way Narc and the masked droid have not been. Suddenly the droid stops, her white and black eyes gleaming. She’s only just noticed your presence. Seems it was just bad luck you ran into her on her way out. “Intruder detected.” her voice chimes, exactly the same as Narc’s. “Lock down engaged.” Suddenly her eyes flicker, and behind you, the sound of metal starts to scrape against itself. Glancing back over your shoulder, you see a sliding shutter door grinding downward over the passage you entered through, and before you can react, the way is sealed shut. Wheeling back around to face the droid again, you regrip your [pc.weaponMain], your mind racing. What’s going on? Why is another nursedroid here? Is Narc here? Was she the one who emailed you? All those questions whirl through your head as the scarred droid slips a hand into a black bag impossibly similar to Narc’s, producing a long, menacing knife. “Engaging.” Seems like you don’t have time to think."

rows.original: Examining the controls, you quickly realize you have no idea what you’re doing. You hem and haw over it for a few minutes, trying to parse out what each button is for. Eventually, you think you’ve figured out how to get the crane to go up, thanks to a very handy picture of a tiny arrow pointing upward. Sure of yourself, you give the button a push... ... and immediately watch the console let out a blue crackle of light as power surges through it! Leaping back, your arm jittering, you hear a loud and powerful mechanical sound off on the far side of the floor. Looking over, you see the crane jolting to life, rising up faster than you would have thought possible. Maybe too fast, you panic, wondering if the rapidly rising machine might go straight through the ceiling, as it doesn’t betray any hint of slowing. Holding your breath, waiting for it to crash, you watch it suddenly and violently jerk to a halt, its hoisted payload swaying with so much force you think it could punch a hole in the wall. Wincing, you now hope the sudden stop doesn’t cause it to topple over, but after a minute the swaying slows, although the groaning creak of the metal makes you think it’s not wise to try and use it again. Although, looking at the console, that might be impossible. The surge seems to have fried it, leaving it totally dead. Looking across the way, you notice that with the crate lifted up, a previously blocked doorway has now been revealed!
rows.translation: 检查控制台后，你很快便意识到自己根本不知道该怎么操作。你对着它支支吾吾地琢磨了几分钟，试图弄清每个按钮的用途。最后，多亏一幅非常实用的向上小箭头图案，你觉得自己已经找到了让起重机升起来的方法。你信心十足地按下按钮... ...紧接着便看到电力猛然涌过控制台，迸出一阵蓝色电光！ 你向后一跃，胳膊不断抽动，同时听见楼层远端传来巨大而强劲的机械声。你转头望去，只见起重机猛然启动，以超出想象的速度向上升起。也许太快了；你惊慌起来，担心这台飞速上升的机器会直接冲破天花板，因为它丝毫没有减速的迹象。你屏住呼吸，等着它撞上去，却看见它突然猛烈地停住；吊起的货物剧烈摇摆，力道大得仿佛能在墙上砸出一个洞。 你缩起身体，如今只希望骤停不会令起重机倾倒。不过一分钟后，摇摆逐渐平息，尽管金属发出的呻吟与嘎吱声让你觉得再次使用它并不明智。不过，看看控制台，这件事也许已经不可能了。电涌似乎烧毁了设备，让它彻底失去反应。 你望向对面，发现随着箱子被吊起，先前受到阻挡的一扇门如今已经显露出来！

rows.original:
Inspecting the belt, you decide you can use the extra resources.

		Taking up the baton, you try to turn it on, immediately being met with failure. Inspecting it closer, you notice it doesn’t have a powercell, and with a sigh you throw it over your shoulder. Turning your attention to the heavy flashlight, you see that the second you disturbed it, acidic fluid started oozing down its length. Seems like its powercell went and ruptured, making it even more useless. You toss it aside like the baton, letting out a resigned sigh.
		
		You’re just about to walk off when you notice something else hanging from the belt you missed on first glance: a keycard. Unclipping it, you inspect the card, noticing it’s an access card to the building. You decide to keep it, happy that you at least were able to scavenge something useful.
rows.translation:
检查过那条腰带后，你觉得这些额外物资应该能派上用场。

		你拿起警棍，试着将它启动，却立刻以失败告终。仔细检查后，你发现里面根本没有能量电池，只得叹着气把它扔到身后。你又把注意力转向那支沉重的手电筒，却看到它从被你碰动的那一刻起，就有酸性液体顺着筒身往下渗。看来它的能量电池已经破裂，让这东西变得更加没用。你像扔掉警棍一样把它丢到一旁，无奈地叹了口气。
		
		就在你准备离开时，你注意到腰带上还挂着一样初看时漏掉的东西：一张钥匙卡。你把它解下来检查，发现这是这栋建筑的门禁卡。你决定把它留下，至少总算搜刮到了一件有用的东西，这让你颇感欣慰。

rows.original: As soon as you step into the unlocked room, you’re assaulted by a high pitched voice screeching from inside. “Oh, for fucks sake!” Quickly getting your bearings, eyes darting around, you try to assess the situation. The room is an office, or was one rather, seemingly having been claimed by some sort of a squatter. The place is a mess, with garbage, clothes, and empty containers for both food and drink thrown about without rhyme or reason. Most of the office furniture has been pushed to the side, making way for a large couch in the center of the room, where the shrill voice came from. As your eyes focus on the shape seated on the dirty brown thing, the voice howls again. “Fuckin’ knock, bi-” it bites itself off as a set of green eyes lock onto your face. “Who the fuck are you?” A pause allows you a moment to process what you’re looking at. You’re staring at a gabilani, although it takes a second to process their sex, considering they’re boasting both a massive set of tits and a cock big enough to use as a third leg. The latter is exposed, and based on the position of the gabilani’s hand and the familiar bottle on the couch next to them, you think you’ve caught them in the middle of a bout of self love. Growling, the gabilani pops up to their feet, scowling like a predator. “You fuckin’ deaf, dumbass? I asked you who the fuck you are!” Female, you note, getting a better look at her. The cock is a modded-on addition surely, considering it’s vaguely horse-like shape, but the rest of her has all the fleshy and sinful curves that are a dead giveaway to her sex. Aside from being pantless, she’s dressed like some sort of punk-kid, sporting a loose fitting toque, and a hoodie draped over her ass more than her shoulders. Around her waist, you notice a rather dangerous looking belt, several weapons and other curiosities hanging from it. As you eye it, the gabilani draws her blaster, the act of aggression forcing you to raise your own [pc.weaponMain]. “Last chance, bitch!” “Steele.” You answer, not in submission, but rather to get her talking. “Who the fuck are you?” “Eh?” The gabilani’s ears twitch. “Well now...” she grins, “Name’s Jezzy. And you just walked into my fuckin’ crib, asshat!” “Jezzy...” you say the name aloud, tasting it on your tongue, “Are you the doctor?” The green woman scoffs, rolling her eyes so hard they turn white. “Do I look like a bald bitch to you?” You’re not sure how to answer that question, so you opt not to. “Where is the doctor?” You adjust your grip on your weapon, keeping it fixed on the shortstack. “Why do you-” a look of realization crosses her face, her eyes going wide, “Ooooo, you’re the one who fixed up ol’ one eye!” You feel a knot in your throat form. She must mean Narc. Swallowing it down, a tinge of urgency slips into your voice. “Where is she?” The woman chuckles, her smile widening. “Awwww, what’s this? Did you fall in love with a fucking drug-dealing robot?” She’s baiting you. Trying to throw you off your game. You can see the tactic a mile away, and are not willing to let it get under your [pc.skinFurScales]. “You think giving her a pretty new dress and a little patch job made her love you back?” She pouts mockingly. “She can’t love you. She’s not fucking real. She doesn’t give two shits about a mark like you. She’s a fucking whore, bitch.” “Where is she?” You state flatly, not letting her win. Jezzy’s grin wavers for a second, but quickly returns. “Well, if I had to guess... Ol’ baldy is probably taking her for one last ride before he pulls her apart piece-by-piece. And hell,” she shrugs, “I don’t blame him. I’ve fucked her too! More times than I can count!” Emotion wells up inside of you. The time for words is over.
rows.translation: 你刚踏进这间已经解锁的房间，里面便传来一道尖厉的嗓音，刺得你耳朵生疼。“哦，真他妈的！” 你迅速站稳脚步，视线四下扫动，试图判断眼前的状况。这是一间办公室，或者说以前是；如今这里似乎被某个擅自占据此处的人据为己有。房间里乱得一塌糊涂，垃圾、衣服以及空掉的食品与饮料容器毫无规律地扔得到处都是。大部分办公家具都被推到了边上，给房间中央的一张大沙发腾出了位置，那道刺耳的声音正是从那里传来的。你的目光聚焦在坐于那张肮脏棕色沙发上的身影时，那声音又一次嚎叫起来。 “他妈的进来前先敲门，贱-”一双绿色眼睛锁定你的脸，令她硬生生把后半句话咽了回去。“你他妈是谁？” 这片刻的停顿让你有时间看清眼前究竟是什么人。 你正盯着一名加比拉尼人，不过你花了一秒才分辨出对方的性别，因为她既有一对硕大无比的乳房，又有一根大到足以充当第三条腿的鸡巴。后者正裸露在外；结合加比拉尼人的手所放的位置，以及她身旁沙发上那个熟悉的瓶子来看，你觉得自己撞见了她自慰到一半的场面。 加比拉尼人低吼一声，一跃站起，像捕食者般怒目而视。“你他妈聋了吗，蠢货？老娘问你他妈是谁！” 是女性，你看得更清楚后确认道。那根鸡巴显然是后来改装上去的，毕竟形状隐约像马，而她身体其余部位那一身丰腴又淫荡的曲线则明白无误地暴露了她的性别。除了下身没穿裤子以外，她打扮得像某种朋克小鬼：戴着一顶宽松的毛线帽，连帽衫与其说披在肩上，不如说搭在屁股上。你注意到她腰间系着一条颇为危险的腰带，上面挂着好几件武器和其他稀奇古怪的东西。就在你打量腰带时，加比拉尼人拔出了爆能枪；这个充满敌意的举动迫使你也举起自己的[pc.weaponMain]。 “最后一次机会，贱人！” “斯蒂尔。”你回答，并非表示屈服，而是想让她开口说下去。“你他妈又是谁？” “嗯？”加比拉尼人的耳朵抽动了一下。“这可真是...”她咧嘴一笑，“老娘叫杰兹。你刚刚闯进了老娘他妈的窝，白痴！” “杰兹...”你念出这个名字，让它在舌尖转了一圈，“你就是那名医生吗？” 绿皮女人嗤笑一声，狠狠翻了个白眼，眼珠几乎只剩眼白。“老娘看起来像个秃头贱货吗？” 你不知道该怎么回答这个问题，于是选择不回答。“医生在哪里？”你调整握住武器的姿势，枪口始终对准这个矮个子女人。 “你为什么要-”恍然大悟的神色掠过她的脸，双眼也随之睁大，“哦哦哦，你就是修好那个独眼老家伙的人！” 你感觉喉咙里像打了个结。她说的一定是纳克。你把那团堵塞感咽下去，声音里也染上了一丝急切。“她在哪里？” 女人轻笑起来，笑容越咧越大。“噢噢，怎么回事？你爱上了一台他妈的贩毒机器人吗？” 她是在诱你上钩，想打乱你的阵脚。你一眼就看穿了这种伎俩，也绝不会让这些话钻进你的[pc.skinFurScales]之下。 “你以为送她一条漂亮的新裙子，再稍微修补一下，她就会反过来爱上你？”她故作嘲弄地撅起嘴。“她不可能爱你。她根本不是真的。她才不在乎你这种冤大头。她就是个他妈的婊子，贱人。” “她在哪里？”你语气平淡地说道，不让她得逞。 杰兹的笑容动摇了一瞬，却很快又恢复原状。“唔，要我猜的话...那个秃头老家伙大概正赶在把她一块块拆掉以前，最后再骑她一次。再说了，”她耸耸肩，“老娘不怪他。我也操过她！次数多得数都数不清！” 情绪在你体内翻涌而起。 言语交锋的时间结束了。

The room is an office, or was one rather, seemingly having been claimed by some sort of a squatter. The place is a mess, with garbage, clothes, and empty containers for both food and drink thrown about without rhyme or reason. Most of the office furniture has been pushed to the side, making way for a large couch in the center of the room, where the shrill voice came from. As your eyes focus on the shape seated on the dirty brown thing, the voice howls again. “Fuckin’ knock, bi-” it bites itself off as a set of green eyes lock onto your face. “Who the fuck are you?” A pause allows you a moment to process what you’re looking at. You’re staring at a gabilani, although it takes a second to process their sex, considering they’re boasting both a massive set of tits and a cock big enough to use as a third leg. The latter is exposed, and based on the position of the gabilani’s hand and the familiar bottle on the couch next to them, you think you’ve caught them in the middle of a bout of self love. Growling, the gabilani pops up to their feet, scowling like a predator. “You fuckin’ deaf, dumbass? I asked you who the fuck you are!” Female, you note, getting a better look at her. The cock is a modded-on addition surely, considering it’s vaguely horse-like shape, but the rest of her has all the fleshy and sinful curves that are a dead giveaway to her sex. Aside from being pantless, she’s dressed like some sort of punk-kid, sporting a loose fitting toque, and a hoodie draped over her ass more than her shoulders. Around her waist, you notice a rather dangerous looking belt, several weapons and other curiosities hanging from it. As you eye it, the gabilani draws her blaster, the act of aggression forcing you to raise your own [pc.weaponMain]. “Last chance, bitch!” “Steele.” You answer, not in submission, but rather to get her talking. “Who the fuck are you?” “Eh?” The gabilani’s ears twitch. “Well now...” she grins, “Name’s Jezzy. And you just walked into my fuckin’ crib, asshat!” “Jezzy...” you say the name aloud, tasting it on your tongue, “Are you the doctor?” The green woman scoffs, rolling her eyes so hard they turn white. “Do I look like a bald bitch to you?” You’re not sure how to answer that question, so you opt not to. “Where is the doctor?” You adjust your grip on your weapon, keeping it fixed on the shortstack. “Why do you-” a look of realization crosses her face, her eyes going wide, “Ooooo, you’re the one who fixed up ol’ one eye!” You feel a knot in your throat form. She must mean Narc. Swallowing it down, a tinge of urgency slips into your voice. “Where is she?” The woman chuckles, her smile widening. “Awwww, what’s this? Did you fall in love with a fucking drug-dealing robot?” She’s baiting you. Trying to throw you off your game. You can see the tactic a mile away, and are not willing to let it get under your [pc.skinFurScales]. “You think giving her a pretty new dress and a little patch job made her love you back?” She pouts mockingly. “She can’t love you. She’s not fucking real. She doesn’t give two shits about a mark like you. She’s a fucking whore, bitch.” “Where is she?” You state flatly, not letting her win. Jezzy’s grin wavers for a second, but quickly returns. “Well, if I had to guess... Ol’ baldy is probably taking her for one last ride before he pulls her apart piece-by-piece. And hell,” she shrugs, “I don’t blame him. I’ve fucked her too! More times than I can count!” Emotion wells up inside of you. The time for words is over."

Seems she’s offline. “What did you do to Narc?” “Hm?” He glances at you. “Oh, right...” the doctor frowns, turning his attention back to Narc, who’s still a fair distance away. “That is what the locals call this unit... Well, it’s better than ‘Trap Queen’ I suppose...” “I asked you a question.” You make it clear that you expect an answer. The withered man frowns. “Your concern for this unit is misplaced,

rows.original: “V-KO nursedroids are - and this is quite reductive - walking laboratories.” He lifts a hand and points at Narc, his finger aimed straight at her chest. “They can synthesize almost any chemical compound from collected raw materials, and if given ample time and data, create new compounds all on their own.” “Uh-huh...” This was common knowledge, even without Narc having told you about it before. V-KO droid’s could brew up almost anything on their own remotely. But you think you know what he’s getting at. “So, you leveraged that... and turned them into drug dealers?” Blanc turns to you and frowns again, the skin on his face stretching paper thin. “Hm. Yes, well, that was to earn credits.” He waves his hand towards the lab behind you. “Progress isn’t cheap, so I did what I had to do.” You eye the man, feeling a number of questions all competing to be asked at once.
rows.translation: “V-KO护理机器人可以说是行走的实验室，尽管这种说法相当简化。”他抬起一只手指向纳克，手指笔直对准她的胸口。“它们可以用收集来的原材料合成几乎任何化合物；只要拥有充足的时间与数据，甚至能完全自行创造新的化合物。” “嗯哼...”这属于常识，即使纳克以前没有向你提过也一样。V-KO机器人完全可以远程自行调配出几乎任何东西。不过你想自己已经明白他想说什么。“所以，你利用了这一点...把她们变成毒贩？” 布兰克转向你，再次皱起眉头，脸上的皮肤绷得薄如纸张。“嗯。是的，好吧，那是为了赚取信用点。”他朝你身后的实验室挥手。“进步并不便宜，所以我只能做必须做的事。” 你打量着这个男人，感觉许多个问题都在争抢着要最先问出口。

rows.original: Credits?
rows.translation: 信用点？
rows.raw: "Credits?"

rows.original: “And why would you need credits? If you’re a doctor, you should be pretty set.” The man stares at you for a long few seconds, his tired face not revealing any truths. “I’m dying.” You didn’t really need him to say it out loud, having already pieced that together on your own. He looks more like a corpse than a man. In fact, if that bed at the back of the room was as good as it looked, it likely jolted him alive on more than one occasion. “So... You needed credits because you’re dying?” The man’s nostrils flare slightly. “I needed credits to fund my research.” He clears his throat, fighting off a cough. “To find a cure.” “Aha...” Now that you understand. “So, what do you have?” Blanc shrugs weakly, his shoulders barely lifting an inch. “There is no name for what I have, not really at least...” he turns to Narc giving her a pensive look, “Every Rush in history has brought with it some malady or plague. Whatever I have is just the next chapter in that dark book. I’d like to think they’ll name it after me...” You consider what he just said for a beat. “You’re a Rusher?” You eye the man, seeing him in a slightly new light. Not exactly a more favorable one, but it’s definitely a new wrinkle. “Of sorts.” He turns back to you, coughing slightly. “Frontier medicine was not my calling, but here we are.”
rows.translation: “那你为什么会需要信用点？如果你是医生，经济状况应该相当不错才对。” 男人久久凝视着你，疲惫的脸上没有显露任何真相。“我快死了。” 其实不需要他亲口说出来，你自己早已拼凑出了这个结论。与其说他像个活人，不如说更像一具尸体。事实上，如果房间后方那张床真有看起来那么好用，它多半已经不止一次把他从死亡边缘强行唤醒。 “所以...你是因为快死了才需要信用点？” 男人的鼻翼微微翕动。“我需要信用点来资助我的研究。”他清了清嗓子，强忍住咳嗽。“为了找到治愈方法。” “啊哈...”这下你明白了。“所以，你得的是什么病？” 布兰克无力地耸耸肩，肩膀几乎连一英寸都没抬起来。“我所患的病并没有名字，至少还没有真正的名字...”他转向纳克，若有所思地看着她，“历史上的每一场星球热潮都伴随着某种疾病或瘟疫。无论我患上的究竟是什么，它都只是那本黑暗篇章中的下一页。我倒希望他们会用我的名字来命名它...” 你思索了片刻他刚才说的话。“你是行星开拓者？”你打量着男人，以稍微不同的眼光重新审视他。倒也谈不上更有好感，但这无疑给他的经历增添了一层新的意味。 “算是吧。”他转回来看着你，轻咳一声。“边疆医疗原本并非我的志向，可事情最终还是变成了这样。”

rows.original: Jezzy?
rows.translation: 杰兹？
rows.raw: "Jezzy?"

rows.original: Your mind turns to his so-called gabilani partner. “So, how did you end up working with small, green, and horny?” “Hm.” The doctor sighs. “Jezzy. She, well... I needed somebody with experience in drug trafficking.” He shrugs. “And she needed somebody to help provide quality products. We both had solutions to the other person’s shortcomings. It was a logical arrangement.” You give the doctor a skeptical look. “And she was the best you could do?” The old man almost smiles, his lips twitching slightly. “I needed someone small enough to agree to a partnership with someone as, uhm, under-qualified as myself. Jezzy and I were previously acquainted, so the ice was already broken as it were.” “You already knew her?” You give him a skeptical look, finding it hard to believe. “How?” The doctor hesitates a second, then shrugs. “That is a story I don’t think I have the breath for...” Frowning, you think he’s hiding something, but don’t feel like pressing.
rows.translation: 你的思绪转向他所谓的加比拉尼搭档。“所以，你怎么会和那个又矮、又绿、又饥渴的家伙合作？” “嗯。”医生叹了口气。“杰兹。她，嗯...我需要一个拥有贩毒经验的人。”他耸耸肩。“而她需要有人帮助提供优质产品。我们各自都拥有弥补对方短处的办法。这是合理的合作安排。” 你怀疑地看着医生。“她就是你能找到的最佳人选？” 老人几乎露出笑容，嘴唇轻轻抽动。“我需要一个不太有分量的人，这样才会愿意与像我这样，呃，资历不足的人合作。杰兹和我以前就认识，所以可以说，隔阂早就已经打破了。” “你早就认识她？”你怀疑地看着他，觉得难以置信。“怎么认识的？” 医生犹豫片刻，随后耸耸肩。“这个故事太长，我想自己的气力不足以讲完...” 你皱起眉，觉得他在隐瞒什么，却不想继续追问。

rows.original: You ask the ailing doctor what his story is. “Me?” The thin man shrugs. “There isn’t much to tell. Earth born. Europa educated. Married once, but that is a digression at best... Prior to my illness, I was a researcher with JoyCo, but I was let go quite abruptly. The company didn’t approve of my use of company resources to try and treat myself.” You don’t find that surprising in the least. “So you stole a bunch of company droids on the way out and became a drug dealer?” “Please,” Blanc frowns, rolling his eyes, “I gave the company thirty years of my life. The value of the five units is a drop in the bucket compared to the credits they made off of my work. Not to mention they were all flagged to be decommissioned. If anything, I gave them a new purpose rather than allow them to be wasted in storage.” Doing a quick count in your head, you note you’ve only come across four different units, including Narc. The fifth must be out on a corner somewhere you think...
rows.translation: 你询问这位病重的医生，他究竟有着怎样的经历。 “我？”瘦削的男人耸耸肩。“没什么可讲的。出生于地球，在木卫二接受教育。结过一次婚，不过那充其量只是题外话...患病以前，我曾是欢乐公司的一名研究员，但后来相当突然地被解雇了。公司不赞同我使用公司资源尝试治疗自己。” 你对此一点也不觉得意外。“所以你离开时偷走了一群公司的机器人，然后当起了毒贩？” “得了吧，”布兰克皱起眉头，翻了个白眼，“我把三十年的人生奉献给了公司。与我的工作替他们赚取的信用点相比，这五台机器人的价值不过是九牛一毛。更不用说她们全都已经被标记为等待退役。如果一定要说的话，我是赋予了她们新的用途，而不是任由她们在仓库里白白荒废。” 你在心里迅速数了一遍，发现包括纳克在内，自己只遇见过四台不同的机器人。你心想，第五台一定正在某个街角营业...

rows.raw: "Who exactly is he?"

rows.original: Dhaal?
rows.translation: 达尔？
rows.raw: "Dhaal?"

rows.original: “So, why Dhaal? There’s got to be better places to set up shop.” The man coughs slightly into his fist. “Jezzy suggested it. As I’m sure you noticed, there is a growing gabilani presence here.” You think back to the neighborhood up above. “I’ve noticed...” Lowering his hand, the doctor smiles faintly. “She suggested we capitalize on it, and I agreed. Although I felt Dhaal was a good place to do my research, regardless of her suggesting it. Zaika medical science is quite fascinating, and incorporating their technology into my research proved quite vital.” Not entirely sure what he means by that, you press the doctor for more. He smiles, glancing slightly towards the ceiling. “A cure is close. And Dhaal was a vital piece to solving the puzzle.” Well that was vague.
rows.translation: “所以，为什么选择达尔？肯定还有更适合开张的地方。” 男人用拳头抵着嘴轻咳一声。“是杰兹提议的。相信你也已经注意到，这里的加比拉尼人越来越多。” 你回想起上方的街区。“我注意到了...” 医生放下手，淡淡一笑。“她建议我们利用这一点，我同意了。不过，即使没有她的提议，我也认为达尔很适合开展研究。扎伊卡人的医学科技相当迷人，而把她们的技术融入我的研究也被证明至关重要。” 你不太确定他是什么意思，于是继续追问医生。 他微笑着，目光略微转向天花板。“治愈方法已经近在咫尺，而达尔是解开谜题不可或缺的一块拼图。” 这回答可真够含糊。
rows.raw: "“So, why Dhaal? There’s got to be better places to set up shop.” The man coughs slightly into his fist. “Jezzy suggested it. As I’m sure you noticed, there is a growing gabilani presence here.” You think back to the neighborhood up above. “I’ve noticed...” Lowering his hand, the doctor smiles faintly. “She suggested we capitalize on it, and I agreed. Although I felt Dhaal was a good place to do my research, regardless of her suggesting it. Zaika medical science is quite fascinating, and incorporating their technology into my research proved quite vital.” Not entirely sure what he means by that, you press the doctor for more. He smiles, glancing slightly towards the ceiling. “A cure is close. And Dhaal was a vital piece to solving the puzzle.” Well that was vague."

rows.original: Why is he on Dhaal?
rows.translation: 他为什么会在达尔？
rows.raw: "Why is he on Dhaal?"

rows.original: Narc?
rows.translation: 纳克？
rows.raw: "Narc?"

rows.original: You get back to the core issue. “So with all that in mind... What are you doing to Narc?” The doctor takes a deep wheezing breath, his mouth curling into a smile. “They did it.” You stare at the man for a beat. “Did what?” Blanc chuckles softly, “Found the key to the cure.” You toss a slightly bewildered glance at Narc. “How?” “That is what I’ve been trying to figure out...” he turns back to Narc, his smile wavering, “Harvesting bio-materials when they can, I’ve had all the droids trying thousands of formulas for many cycles now. None of them had even come close to synthesizing a promising base out in the field... And then this unit,” he points, his smile returning, “Somehow did it.” Narc remains limp on the slab, oblivious to the declaration. Blanc turns to you, his smile breaking once again into a frown. “Naturally, I tried to replicate their findings in the lab, but it failed miserably. That’s when I discovered this unit had been modified...” “Ah...” For the first time since the conversation started, you feel yourself shrink back slightly. “At first, I thought this was the culprit,” he points at Narc’s crotch, giving you an accusing glare, “But as it happens, this perverse module you’ve installed had little to do with it... Rather it was some interesting code you installed to run it.” Your mind flashes back to the gabilani’s chip you gave to Narc. She did spit it out, finding the code ‘disgusting’, but it had gotten her module working... Did it really do something else? Blanc continues. “Whatever you installed into its head changed quite a bit of her system data, including, it seems, synthesizing protocols...” He gives you a stern look, the thin skin on his face stretching tight. “And it also made them a security threat.” “A threat?” You glance over at Narc. “How?” The doctor huffs, the sound coming out raspy. “When I connected them to the network, their consciousness began to... Expand... They were getting into hardware they shouldn’t have, so I had to shut them down before running a full diagnostic... But...” He glances up above the door you entered from. You follow his gaze, noticing him looking at a small black spot. It takes you a moment, but you recognize it as a security camera. Turning back to the man, he continues. Blanc smirks slightly, almost impressed. “Part of them is still in the network. I’ve quarantined them to the camera feed, which I considered trivial, until I realized they had nested in it,” he tilts his head, “to monitor you.” You breathe out a shuddering exhale. Narc had been watching you the whole time through the cameras. That’s what she meant before in her message. Despite being voiceless, she had been with you every step of the way... “Which brings me to the final piece of the puzzle,” the doctor continues, not giving the revelation time to breath. “You.” “Me?” You turn to the doctor, suddenly back in reality. “The gabilani code was part of their success, but you provided them something else even more valuable.” He tries to chuckle, but instead just wheezes. “Your beautiful genetic material.” Your heart sinks. He means your cum, which of course carries your modified DNA. Narc had been collecting some every time you had sex with her, so of course she would be using it when trying to produce a cure. You turn your gaze to Narc’s chest, realizing for the first time it’s shrunk down to her default size. Whatever amount of it she had stored was all gone. “Whatever you’re made out of, the gabilani code was able to make use of it, and with their JoyCo body produced a viable base for my cure...” The doctor turns his attention to the hanging metal machine next to Narc. “I’ve already introduced the necessary elements of the code and your DNA to the prototype unit. This Bright Water chemical synthesizer,” he motions to the structure, “I’ve modified with JoyCo tech is currently cooking what I believe will be my perfect cure now.” You stare at the machine, your eyes following it up and along the wall and into the abyss of the darkness above. You still can’t see it properly, but it’s massive... Dropping your gaze to the doctor you take a deep breath. He just dumped a lot on you all of a sudden, and you’re still parsing through it: A former JoyCo researcher, sick with an unknown illness, turned to dealing drugs to fund experiments to cure himself, allying with a sex-charged gabilani, and using stolen JoyCo droids and Dhaalian tech to do it... And he might just have pulled it off. Yup, you think you’ve got it. “So, now...” Blanc turns to you, his face stoic, “A proposition.”
rows.translation: 你把话题拉回核心问题。“考虑到这一切...你究竟在对纳克做什么？” 医生发出呼哧声，深吸了一口气，嘴角勾起笑容。“她们成功了。” 你盯着男人看了片刻。“成功做了什么？” 布兰克轻声笑道：“找到了治愈方法的关键。” 你略感困惑地瞥向纳克。“怎么做到的？” “这正是我一直试图弄清的问题...”他转回去看着纳克，笑容有些动摇，“在有条件时采集生物材料；许多个周期以来，我一直让所有机器人尝试数千种配方。她们在外面工作时，没有一个能合成哪怕稍有希望的基础物质...可这台机器，”他指向纳克，笑容再度浮现，“不知怎么就成功了。” 纳克仍软绵绵地躺在台板上，对这番宣告毫无知觉。 布兰克转向你，笑容又一次化为皱眉。“自然，我曾尝试在实验室里复现她们的成果，但失败得一塌糊涂。就在那时，我发现这台机器经过了改装...” “啊...”自从谈话开始以来，你第一次感觉自己微微向后缩了一下。 “一开始，我以为罪魁祸首是这个，”他指向纳克的胯部，以责备的目光瞪着你，“但事实证明，你安装的这个淫秽模块与此关系不大...真正起作用的，反而是你为了运行它而安装的一段有趣代码。” 你的思绪闪回到自己交给纳克的那枚加比拉尼芯片。她确实把它吐了出来，认为其中的代码“令人作呕”，但它也确实让她的模块运转起来了...难道它真的还做了别的事情？ 布兰克继续说道：“无论你往她脑袋里安装了什么，那东西都改变了她相当多的系统数据，其中似乎也包括合成协议...”他严厉地看着你，脸上薄薄的皮肤绷得紧紧的。“而且还让她们成了安全威胁。” “威胁？”你瞥向纳克。“怎么会？” 医生粗声吐气，声音嘶哑。“我把她们连接到网络时，她们的意识开始...扩张...她们正在进入本不该接触的硬件，所以我必须先关闭她们，再运行完整诊断...但是...”他抬眼望向你进来那扇门的上方。 你循着他的视线望去，发现他正盯着一个小黑点。你花了一会儿才认出那是一台安保摄像头。你转回去面对男人，他继续说道。 布兰克微微一笑，近乎显得有些佩服。“她们的一部分仍留在网络中。我把她们隔离在摄像头画面里，起初觉得这无关紧要，直到我意识到她们已经在其中筑了巢，”他歪过头，“为了监视你。” 你颤抖着呼出一口气。纳克一直在通过摄像头看着你。这就是她先前在消息中所表达的意思。尽管无法说话，她却始终陪着你走过每一步... “这也把我带到了谜题的最后一块，”医生继续说，不给你时间消化这个发现。“你。” “我？”你转向医生，意识猛然回到现实。 “加比拉尼代码是她们成功的一部分，但你还为她们提供了另一种更加宝贵的东西。”他试图轻笑，最终却只发出一阵喘鸣。“你那美妙的遗传物质。” 你的心猛地一沉。他指的是你的精液，其中当然携带着你经过改造的DNA。每次你与纳克做爱，她都会收集一些；因此，她在尝试制作治愈药物时使用它也理所当然。你把目光移到纳克的胸口，第一次意识到她的乳房已经缩回默认尺寸。她曾经储存的精液无论有多少，现在都已经用光了。 “无论构成你的究竟是什么，加比拉尼代码都能加以利用，并借助她们欢乐公司的躯体，为我的治愈药物制造出可用的基础物质...”医生把注意力转向纳克旁边悬挂着的金属机器。“我已经把代码和你的DNA中必要的部分导入原型机。这台明水公司的化学合成器，”他朝那座结构示意，“经我用欢乐公司技术改装后，此刻正在制造我认为会是完美治愈药物的东西。” 你盯着机器，目光沿着它向上移动，再顺着墙壁延伸到上方漆黑的深渊。你仍无法看清全貌，但它实在庞大...你把视线落回医生身上，深吸一口气。他突然间把大量信息一股脑全塞给了你，而你仍在逐一梳理：一名欢乐公司的前研究员身患不知名疾病，为筹集实验经费、治愈自己而开始贩毒，与一个性欲旺盛的加比拉尼人结盟，还利用偷来的欢乐公司机器人和达尔技术进行研究...而且他或许真的成功了。 对，你觉得自己已经理解了。 “那么，现在...”布兰克转向你，脸上毫无表情，“我有一个提议。”

rows.original: Huh?
rows.translation: 啊？
rows.raw: "Huh?"

rows.original: “I have nearly all I need,” Blanc glances up at the ceiling, “I have your DNA and I have the gabilani code. Soon the cure will be complete, and I will be able to focus my attention on matters other than survival. That said, I plan to continue running this operation of mine.” “That so?” You toss a glance over at Narc, wondering where he’s going with this. “This unit, Narc as you call it, I still have need of them, but I understand you have grown...” he hesitates, searching for the right word. “Fond of them.” You eye the man cautiously. “I would like operations to resume. The droids continuing to produce and distribute their wares. Instead of trying to cure myself, our collective efforts will be spent curing other ailments. This machine,” he motions towards the hanging pillar of metal, “Can do a lot of good.” “Uh-huh...” you frown, “I haven’t heard a proposal yet...” “Hm,” Blanc takes a deep, wheezing breath, “My proposal is this: you allow this all to continue, and in return, I cut you in.” You pause for a moment to consider what he just said. “And why would you do a thing like that?” “Well, aside from that,” he motions towards your [pc.weaponMain], “I’m hoping you can see the potential good we can accomplish, and sweetening the deal with quite a few credits.” Glancing over at Narc, you ask a very important question. “And what about Narc?” “Well...” the doctor shrugs, “Things go back to how they were.” As your face twists up in confusion, the doctor elaborates. “It’s simple, really. I’ll perform a rollback on them, and they go back to how they were right before I called them in. Obviously, I will have to prune some of the rough edges off their code, so they don’t get back into the network’s systems, but they will be exactly as they were when you last saw them. Which is ideal,” he gives you a knowing look, “More of your DNA would be necessary, you see. I’m sure having Narc here collect it the way you are accustomed would be preferable to any alternative I could come up with, yes?” Frowning, you suddenly are reminded the two of you are not really alone. You feel Narc’s gaze on you from the camera over the door. “And the other droids?” “Oh well,” the doctor scoffs, “Anything you’ve done to them, I can fix. Given time, of course. The operation will be back up to full strength in no time. Oh, and don’t worry about Jezzy. I can smooth things over with her.” Taking a moment, you consider the offer. Take the deal, and you get brought into the operation. That means you get a cut of the credits, you get Narc back just as she was, and this whole thing is over. Not to mention, you’d be doing some good, if Blanc can be trusted. All you’d really need to do is provide Narc with more DNA, which was easy enough. But... Taking the deal means Narc would have to be rolled back. Whatever progress she’s made, or whatever is happening to her, would be lost and she would never progress that far again. Her and the other droids would continue to sling drugs and collect raw material, for as long as they are operational. So what do you do?
rows.translation: “我所需要的东西几乎都已到手。”布兰克抬头望向天花板，“我有你的DNA，也有加比拉尼人的遗传编码。治愈方法很快就会完成，届时我便能把注意力放到生存之外的事情上。话虽如此，我打算继续经营这项业务。” “是吗？”你瞥向纳克，想知道他究竟想说什么。 “这个单元，也就是你所说的纳克，我仍然需要，但我明白你已经变得...”他迟疑着寻找合适的词。“很喜欢她们。” 你谨慎地打量着这个男人。 “我希望业务恢复运作，让机器人继续生产并分销商品。我们的集体力量不再用于治愈我自己，而是投入治疗其他疾病。这台机器，”他朝悬挂着的金属柱示意，“可以成就许多善事。” “嗯哼...”你皱起眉，“我还没听到你的提议...” “嗯。”布兰克深深吸进一口带着喘鸣的气，“我的提议是：你允许这一切继续，而作为回报，我分给你一份。” 你停顿片刻，思考他刚才所说的话。“你为什么要这么做？” “嗯，除了那个以外，”他朝你的[pc.weaponMain]示意，“我希望你能看见我们有可能成就的善事，再用相当多的信用点让条件变得更诱人。” 你瞥向纳克，问出一个非常重要的问题。“那纳克呢？” “嗯...”医生耸耸肩，“一切恢复原状。” 你的脸因困惑而扭曲，医生于是进一步解释。“其实很简单。我会对她们执行回滚，让她们恢复到我召回之前的状态。显然，我得修剪掉她们代码里的一些毛刺，免得她们再次进入网络系统；但她们会和你上次见到时完全一样。这正合适。”他意味深长地看着你，“你瞧，我还需要更多你的DNA。我相信，让这里的纳克以你习惯的方式收集，总会比我能想出的其他办法更可取，对吗？” 你皱起眉，突然想起这里并非真的只有你们两个人。门上方的摄像头里传来纳克的目光。“那其他机器人呢？” “哦，好吧。”医生嗤之以鼻，“无论你对她们做过什么，我都能修好。当然，这需要一点时间。业务很快就会恢复全部实力。哦，还有，不用担心杰兹。我可以跟她把事情说开。” 你花了片刻考虑这个提议。 接受交易，你就能加入这项业务。这意味着你可以分到一份信用点，让纳克原样回到身边，而且整件事就此结束。更不用说，如果布兰克值得信任，你还会促成一些好事。真正需要做的只有向纳克提供更多DNA，而那再容易不过。但是... 接受交易也意味着纳克必须被回滚。无论她取得了怎样的进展，又或者她身上正在发生什么，都将彻底丢失，而且永远无法再次发展到那么远。只要还能运行，她和其他机器人就会继续贩卖药物并收集原材料。 那么，你要怎么做？

rows.original: As you pass through the ominous door you quickly realize you’re stepping into a very different sort of room. It’s larger, almost cavernous, a slight echo filling your ears as you move forward. It’s dimly lit, so it’s hard to tell, but at first glance you don’t see all that much aside from vague shadows. One of the few sources of light pulls your attention to the left. It’s a massive power relay, dominating a whole wall. Cables as thick as your arm are channeled into it, sticking out from the building haphazardly. You assume this must be where the power has been rerouted to, but now you can’t help but wonder why... Examining the relay closer, you notice several outgoing cables snaking upward towards the ceiling, and you crane back your neck to see where they lead. The ceiling is high and out of sight, and the dim lighting of the room makes it impossible to tell what exactly is going on up there. But you can, vaguely, see something looming in the abyss. Some massive machine is cloaked in the shadows, the shape and form of it impossible to parse. Whatever it is though, you can see it’s not all up above. Tracing it with your eye, you follow a long, serpentine-like section of it that reaches down to the opposite side of the room, low enough to see, but something else catches your eye. “NARC!” You call out on reflex spotting your synthetic friend strapped to a slab against the eastern wall, the large hanging mass of metal from the ceiling next to her. When she doesn’t immediately respond you start towards her, only for a sudden, wheezing voice to stall you in place. “That’s far enough,

rows.original: Bald and emaciated, the noticeably weak man shuffles towards you. Wearing slippers and lab coat, he doesn’t look even remotely prepared for combat, which relaxes you slightly. While he isn’t young by any means, the terran looks like he could keel over at any second, a strong breeze more than enough to get him into the grave. That relaxes you even more. “I apologize for the lights...” the man waves his hand weakly. “I wasn’t trying to be dramatic, I was just resting.” You frown, more than a little skeptical, until you look past the man. A rather expensive-looking medical bed, the same model as the one in the lab, sits on the far wall behind him. From the state of it, you can tell it’s recently been slept in. You also notice several IV’s next to the bed, the contents of them glowing slightly. Shifting your gaze back to the man, you take a steady breath. “Who are you?” “Hm.” The man frowns, “I assumed my reputation would proceed me... Oh well...” he shrugs, “I am Doctor Valter Blanc. Welcome to my home away from home.” You glance around again. The ceiling is still obscured in shadows, but other than that you can see the space clearly now. “Not exactly the most homey space, Doc.” The doctor smiles, his withered face stretching slightly. “Indeed. Now, are you going to keep pointing your weapon at me, or can we have a civilized conversation?”
rows.translation: 这个光头、骨瘦如柴且明显无比虚弱的男人拖着脚步走向你。他穿着拖鞋和实验室大褂，看起来丝毫没有为战斗做准备，这让你稍稍放松。这个泰伦男人绝对算不上年轻，看起来随时都可能一头栽倒，一阵强风便足以把他送进坟墓。这让你更加放松。 “很抱歉关了灯...”男人虚弱地挥挥手。“我不是想故弄玄虚，只是在休息。” 你皱起眉头，怀疑之意远不止一星半点，直到越过男人望向后方。远处墙边摆着一张看起来颇为昂贵的医疗床，与实验室里的那张型号相同。从它的状态来看，你能判断最近有人睡过。你还注意到床边放着几组静脉输液袋，其中的液体散发着微光。你把目光移回男人身上，稳稳吸了一口气。“你是谁？” “嗯。”男人皱起眉，“我还以为自己的名声会先我一步到来...算了...”他耸耸肩，“我是瓦尔特·布兰克医生。欢迎来到我家外之家。” 你再次环顾四周。天花板仍隐没在阴影之中，但除此之外，如今已经能清楚看见整个空间。“这里可不怎么像个温馨的家，医生。” 医生微笑起来，枯瘦的脸庞随之轻轻拉伸。“确实如此。那么，你打算继续用武器指着我，还是我们可以进行一场文明的交谈？”

rows.original:
As you approach the table, you feel yourself growing tense, fearing the worst. Has Narc already been disassembled? Did you let her down? As you come to a stop next to the table, you look down and let out a deep, shuddering exhale.

			A sigh of relief.
			
			It’s not Narc.
			
			Despite the fact it is indeed the lower half of a JoyCo nursedroid, there is obvious evidence it’s not her. The droid’s original boots are still on the feet, while Narc had long since switched to heels to match her updated attire. The slight tone of the synth flesh is different as well, paler and more pristine, the droid having not seen much sun before being taken apart. You even notice the faintest hint of dust, telling you the droid was disassembled some time ago.
			
			But the biggest hint is the vaginal unit. 
			
			Narc is equipped with a locally sourced prototype, but the one on the table is a standard issue unit. Although, what gives you a moment’s pause is that the unit doesn’t seem to be the droid’s original. That mystery however seems meaningless compared to the relief you feel, although you’re certain Narc is still far from safe.
rows.translation:
当你走近桌子时，身体不由得紧绷起来，生怕见到最坏的结果。纳克已经被拆解了吗？你辜负她了吗？你在桌边停下，低头望去，深深吐出一口颤抖的气息。

			一声如释重负的叹息。
			
			这不是纳克。
			
			尽管这的确是一台欢乐公司护士机器人的下半身，但有明显证据表明她并非纳克。机器人的原装靴子仍穿在脚上，而纳克早已换成高跟鞋，以搭配她更新后的装束。合成肌肤的浅淡色调也不一样，更加苍白无瑕；这台机器人在被拆开前显然没怎么晒过太阳。你甚至注意到一层极淡的灰尘，说明它早在一段时间前就被拆解了。
			
			但最大的线索是阴道单元。 
			
			纳克装备的是本地生产的原型机，但桌上的是制式单元。不过，令你短暂停顿的是，这个单元似乎也并非这台机器人原装的。可与如释重负的心情相比，这个谜团似乎无关紧要，尽管你确信纳克仍远未脱离危险。

rows.original: Anno just giggles and grabs another drink from a passing server, linking her other arm through yours and falling into step. “I like this planet,” she muses. “It’s nice to finally find part of the Rush that’s not too primitive to be interesting... or so advanced that they already blew themselves back to the industrial age before we showed up. They actually have culture, and technology! Their cyber-tech is at least as advanced as it is core-ward, and the way they’ve structured their corporate government... it’s all veeeeery familiar. I think they’ll fit in just fine.”
rows.translation: 安诺只是咯咯笑着，从路过的侍者那里又拿了一杯酒，另一只手挽住你的胳膊，与你并肩而行。“我喜欢这个星球，”她沉吟道。“终于在开拓区找到一个不至于原始到无聊...也没有先进到在我们到来前就把自己炸回工业时代的地方，真不错。他们确实有文化，还有科技！他们的赛博技术至少和核心区一样先进，而且他们构建企业政府的方式...全都非——常熟悉。我觉得他们会融入得很好的。”

They actually have culture, and technology! Their cyber-tech is at least as advanced as it is core-ward, and the way they’ve structured their corporate government... it’s all veeeeery familiar. I think they’ll fit in just fine.”"

rows.original: “How’d you end up here anyway?” you ask her. “Was everyone from the company here on-world invited?”
rows.translation: “话说你怎么会来这里？”你问她。“公司里所有在这个星球上的人都受到邀请了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“How’d you end up here anyway?” you ask her. “Was everyone from the company here on-world invited?”"

rows.original: “Company?” Anno blinks, thinking. You glance down her black-and-gold jumpsuit, to the long silk skirt she’s buckled on over the waist and the Ausaril-blue sash she’s wearing over her shoulder. “Ohhh, that’s right. Honestly I’ve felt more like a royal ambassador since I’ve gotten here... nobody’s asked me dick about Vic-Tech, all they want to know about is where I come from and if there’s a bunch more of me. Didja know the Zaikas’ tails are their dicks and pussies, though? They can’t get over how mine’s just for pettin’... but that means they really know their stuff. Mmmmm!”
rows.translation: “公司？”安诺眨眨眼，思索起来。你的目光扫过她黑金相间的连身服、扣在腰间的丝质长裙，以及搭在肩上的奥萨里尔蓝色饰带。“哦——，对哦。老实说，自从来到这里，我更像一名皇室大使...根本没人问我维克科技的破事，他们只想知道我来自哪里，还有没有更多像我这样的。你知道扎伊卡的尾巴既是肉棒又是小穴吗？他们完全无法理解我的尾巴只是用来给人摸的...不过这也意味着他们真的很会摸。嗯——！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Company?” Anno blinks, thinking. You glance down her black-and-gold jumpsuit, to the long silk skirt she’s buckled on over the waist and the Ausaril-blue sash she’s wearing over her shoulder. “Ohhh, that’s right. Honestly I’ve felt more like a royal ambassador since I’ve gotten here... nobody’s asked me dick about Vic-Tech, all they want to know about is where I come from and if there’s a bunch more of me. Didja know the Zaikas’ tails are their dicks and pussies, though? They can’t get over how mine’s just for pettin’... but that means they really know their stuff. Mmmmm!”"

rows.original: She suppresses a little shiver and sips down the rest of her glass. “I dunno what this stuff is but I think it makes ausar a little loopy. I feel high. Like I’m flooooating on the clouds. Do I feel high to you, [pc.name]?”
rows.translation: 她压下一阵轻颤，把杯中剩下的酒一饮而尽。“我不知道这是什么，但我觉得它会让奥萨尔有点晕乎乎的。我感觉飘了。像漂——浮在云端。[pc.name]，你觉得我是不是嗨了？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe suppresses a little shiver and sips down the rest of her glass. “I dunno what this stuff is but I think it makes ausar a little loopy. I feel high. Like I’m flooooating on the clouds. Do I feel high to you, [pc.name]?”"

rows.original: “Just a bit,” you admit, watching her eyes dilate over and over again.
rows.translation: “有一点，”你承认道，看着她的瞳孔一次又一次放大。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just a bit,” you admit, watching her eyes dilate over and over again."

rows.original: “Yeeeeeee haw,” she giggles, swaying against you. “I found a couple of their Peers that said they wanna be my brushy-slaves forever. I gotta... gotta find them and see if I can introduce them to the idea of a pupper-sammich. See ya back home, cutie butt!”
rows.translation: “咿——哈，”她咯咯笑着，靠在你身上摇晃。“我找到了几个同侪，他们说想永远当我的梳毛奴。我得...得找到他们，看看能不能给他们介绍一下什么叫小狗三明治。家里见啦，小翘臀！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeeeeeee haw,” she giggles, swaying against you. “I found a couple of their Peers that said they wanna be my brushy-slaves forever. I gotta... gotta find them and see if I can introduce them to the idea of a pupper-sammich. See ya back home, cutie butt!”"

rows.original: She plants a peck on your cheek and bounces off, wagging that tail of hers so hard that a server nearly gets her tray knocked out of her hands.
rows.translation: 她在你脸颊上轻啄一下，蹦蹦跳跳地离开了；尾巴摇得如此猛烈，差点把一名侍者手中的托盘撞飞。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe plants a peck on your cheek and bounces off, wagging that tail of hers so hard that a server nearly gets her tray knocked out of her hands."

rows.original: “Ah, if it isn’t Captain Steele.”
rows.translation: “啊，这不是斯蒂尔船长吗。”
rows.raw: "“Ah, if it isn’t Captain Steele.”"

rows.original: The voice, silky sweet and dripping with husky innuendo, is instantly familiar. You turn to find the unmistakable, nearly-naked curves of Bethany Carver standing behind you, attended by a pair of collared zaikas in leather bondage suits, arms trapped behind them. She favors you with the faintest hint of a smile, though your eyes are hardly affixed to her face when all that pale, voluptuous flesh is on display. Alien and zaika alike have dressed up like nobility for this gala, but Carver’s barely deigned to cover her loins and breasts, leaving nearly every inch of her fertile curves uncovered.
rows.translation: 这道声音柔滑甜美，浸满沙哑的挑逗意味，你瞬间便认了出来。你转过身，看到贝瑟妮·卡弗那无可错认、几近赤裸的曲线站在身后，身旁跟着两名戴项圈、身穿皮革束缚装的扎伊卡，双臂被固定在背后。她向你露出一丝若有若无的微笑，然而在大片苍白丰腴的肉体尽数展露之际，你的目光几乎无法停留在她脸上。异星人与扎伊卡都为这场盛会穿得如同贵族，卡弗却几乎懒得遮掩胯间与乳房，肥沃曲线上的每一寸肌肤近乎一览无余。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe voice, silky sweet and dripping with husky innuendo, is instantly familiar. You turn to find the unmistakable, nearly-naked curves of Bethany Carver standing behind you, attended by a pair of collared zaikas in leather bondage suits, arms trapped behind them. She favors you with the faintest hint of a smile, though your eyes are hardly affixed to her face when all that pale, voluptuous flesh is on display. Alien and zaika alike have dressed up like nobility for this gala, but Carver’s barely deigned to cover her loins and breasts, leaving nearly every inch of her fertile curves uncovered."

rows.original: “Beth,” you say, giving the slave mistress a nod. “Didn’t expect to see you all the way out here.”
rows.translation: “贝丝，”你说着，朝这位奴隶女主人点点头。“没想到会在这么遥远的地方见到你。”
rows.raw: "“Beth,” you say, giving the slave mistress a nod. “Didn’t expect to see you all the way out here.”"

rows.original: “Well if it isn’t Beth in the flesh. All of it,” you grin.
rows.translation: “哎呀，这不是活生生的贝丝吗。从头到脚都是，”你笑道。
rows.raw: "“Well if it isn’t Beth in the flesh. All of it,” you grin."

rows.original: “Beth Carver? What are you doing here?”
rows.translation: “贝丝·卡弗？你在这里做什么？”
rows.raw: "“Beth Carver? What are you doing here?”"

rows.original: “That’s Mistress Carver to you. Especially in public,” she shoots back with a wry smirk. “My presence on Dhaal should hardly come as a surprise... and you’ll be seeing my name far more across this planet soon. Come, sit with me.”
rows.translation: “你该叫我卡弗女主人。尤其是在公共场合，”她讥诮地笑着回道。“我出现在达尔应该一点也不令人意外...而且很快，你会在这个星球更多地方看到我的名字。来，陪我坐坐。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s Mistress Carver to you. Especially in public,” she shoots back with a wry smirk. “My presence on Dhaal should hardly come as a surprise... and you’ll be seeing my name far more across this planet soon. Come, sit with me.”"

rows.original: She gestures to a nearby table, well out of the way of the party’s busiest and loudest crowds. Her collared slaves follow dutifully at her heels, falling to their knees at either side of her when she sits.
rows.translation: 她示意附近的一张桌子，那里远离派对最繁忙喧闹的人群。她戴着项圈的奴隶尽职地跟在脚后；她坐下后，两人便分别跪在她两侧。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gestures to a nearby table, well out of the way of the party’s busiest and loudest crowds. Her collared slaves follow dutifully at her heels, falling to their knees at either side of her when she sits."

rows.original: You take a chair opposite the slaver-queen, keenly aware of how dangerous she is... and how alluring her shameless display of bare flesh is. It’s a constant reminder of her limitless confidence, her smooth domination of anyone and anything she so chooses without restraint.
rows.translation: 你在奴隶女王对面坐下，清楚意识到她有多危险...也清楚她毫不羞耻地展露赤裸肉体有多么诱人。那不断提醒着你，她拥有无限的自信，能够从容而毫无顾忌地支配自己选中的任何人、任何事。
rows.raw: " You take a chair opposite the slaver-queen, keenly aware of how dangerous she is... and how alluring her shameless display of bare flesh is. It’s a constant reminder of her limitless confidence, her smooth domination of anyone and anything she so chooses without restraint."

rows.original: You assume your rightful place in the slaver-queen’s lap, facing down those bare bosoms as they rise and fall with her breath. Beth snorts back a little laugh, running a hand up and down your flank. “Awfully familiar, aren’t you? Acting like you belong there...”
rows.translation: 你坐上奴隶女王的大腿，占据理所当然的位置，直面那对随呼吸起伏的赤裸乳房。贝丝轻哼一声笑了出来，一只手沿你的侧腹上下抚摸。“还真是不见外，对吧？表现得好像那里本来就属于你...”
rows.raw: " You assume your rightful place in the slaver-queen’s lap, facing down those bare bosoms as they rise and fall with her breath. Beth snorts back a little laugh, running a hand up and down your flank. “Awfully familiar, aren’t you? Acting like you belong there...”"

rows.original: “Do I not?”
rows.translation: “难道不是吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do I not?”"

rows.original: “... What charming confidence.”
rows.translation: “...多么迷人的自信。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“... What charming confidence.”"

rows.original: She’d be intimidating if you weren’t, well, you, and even then it’s not any kind of physical power that makes Beth Carver so imposing. No, it’s something much more ephemeral, the air surrounding her. When she gently reminds you that “My eyes are up here, if you want to talk, that is,” you comply with the implicit request without hesitation, staring deep into those emerald depths.
rows.translation: 如果你不是——呃——你自己的话，她肯定会令人胆寒；即便如此，让贝丝·卡弗如此有压迫感的也不是任何肉体力量。不，那是某种更加虚无缥缈的东西，是环绕她周身的气场。当她温柔地提醒你“我的眼睛在上面——如果你想聊天的话，”你毫不犹豫地服从了隐含的要求，深深凝视那对翡翠般的眼眸。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe’d be intimidating if you weren’t, well, you, and even then it’s not any kind of physical power that makes Beth Carver so imposing. No, it’s something much more ephemeral, the air surrounding her. When she gently reminds you that “My eyes are up here, if you want to talk, that is,” you comply with the implicit request without hesitation, staring deep into those emerald depths."

rows.original: “Carver Consolidated stands to make monumental gains on this planet,” she says slowly, looking at the zaika party-goers over your shoulder. “So many worthless wastes of flesh. Contributing nothing. Directionless. You’ve seen the slums below us? I’ve been swept into their upper society since I landed, and as below, so above. These zaibatsu are little more than up-jumped street gangs, squabbling for power over their little band of twilight like ignorant children. And all of them are so eager to invite we hornets into their hives.”
rows.translation: “卡弗联合公司将在这个星球获得巨大的收益，”她缓缓说道，越过你的肩膀望向扎伊卡宾客。“这么多毫无价值的肉体废物。毫无贡献。漫无目标。你见过我们脚下的贫民窟吗？我一落地就被卷入他们的上层社会，而上层与下层并无不同。这些财阀不过是一步登天的街头帮派，像无知孩童一样争抢暮光带里那一小片权力。而他们每一个都急着邀请我们这些黄蜂钻进自己的蜂巢。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Carver Consolidated stands to make monumental gains on this planet,” she says slowly, looking at the zaika party-goers over your shoulder. “So many worthless wastes of flesh. Contributing nothing. Directionless. You’ve seen the slums below us? I’ve been swept into their upper society since I landed, and as below, so above. These zaibatsu are little more than up-jumped street gangs, squabbling for power over their little band of twilight like ignorant children. And all of them are so eager to invite we hornets into their hives.”"

rows.original: “You don’t have a very high opinion of this world, huh?”
rows.translation: “你对这个世界的评价不怎么高，是吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You don’t have a very high opinion of this world, huh?”"

rows.original: Beth shakes her head. “So much wasted potential. So many wasted lives. It would be a shame to let Dhaal continue its self-destructive spiral.”
rows.translation: 贝丝摇摇头。“如此多被浪费的潜能。如此多被浪费的生命。若让达尔继续沿着自我毁灭的螺旋滑落，未免太可惜了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nBeth shakes her head. “So much wasted potential. So many wasted lives. It would be a shame to let Dhaal continue its self-destructive spiral.”"

rows.original: “Sounds like you have a plan.”
rows.translation: “听起来你已经有计划了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Sounds like you have a plan.”"

rows.original: The slaver-queen’s rosy lips twitch in something that might just be a smile. “Always. One of the native corporations, Paragon, has invited my company to... consult... with them over their latest project. A way to reduce the wastage in this city.”
rows.translation: 奴隶女王玫瑰色的嘴唇微微一动，似乎露出了笑容。“一向如此。本地一家名为典范的企业邀请我的公司与他们...商议...最新项目。那是一种减少这座城市中浪费的方法。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe slaver-queen’s rosy lips twitch in something that might just be a smile. “Always. One of the native corporations, Paragon, has invited my company to... consult... with them over their latest project. A way to reduce the wastage in this city.”"

rows.original: Knowing her, there’s only one kind of waste she’s going to be cleaning up. “I’m sure the zaika will be a big draw for your cat-houses.”
rows.translation: 以你对她的了解，她只可能清理一种“废物”。“我相信扎伊卡会给你的妓院带来极大的吸引力。”
rows.raw: "\n\nKnowing her, there’s only one kind of waste she’s going to be cleaning up. “I’m sure the zaika will be a big draw for your cat-houses.”"

rows.original: “The ones with submissive souls, begging to be broken, anyway. Any new-Rush species is grossly popular meat for the core worlds. The aggressive ones... well, I shouldn’t spoil things surrounded by so many attentive ears. But you’ll soon see the product of our labors out on the street. It’s a first for the company, but I have a feeling you’ll appreciate what we’re doing.”
rows.translation: “至少那些灵魂顺从、渴望被驯服的家伙会如此。任何开拓区新种族在核心世界都是极受欢迎的鲜肉。至于那些好斗的...嗯，在这么多专心聆听的耳朵旁边，我可不该提前剧透。不过你很快就会在街头看到我们的劳动成果。这对公司来说是第一次，但我有预感你会欣赏我们正在做的事。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The ones with submissive souls, begging to be broken, anyway. Any new-Rush species is grossly popular meat for the core worlds. The aggressive ones... well, I shouldn’t spoil things surrounded by so many attentive ears. But you’ll soon see the product of our labors out on the street. It’s a first for the company, but I have a feeling you’ll appreciate what we’re doing.”"

rows.original: There’s a lot to appreciate about Beth, it’s true. Shame you can’t drag a little more info out of her, but her lips seem sealed on the matter for now.
rows.translation: 贝丝身上确实有许多值得欣赏之处。可惜你无法从她嘴里套出更多信息；至少眼下，她似乎对此守口如瓶。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a lot to appreciate about Beth, it’s true. Shame you can’t drag a little more info out of her, but her lips seem sealed on the matter for now. "

rows.original: So instead you lean in, using your queen’s tits as a warm, pillowy respite from the clamor and commotion of the party. She doesn’t mind a bit; her body was sculpted for just such use, no doubt.
rows.translation: 于是你转而靠近，把女王的乳房当作温暖柔软的枕垫，暂时躲避派对的嘈杂喧嚣。她丝毫不介意；毫无疑问，她的身体正是为这种用途塑造的。
rows.raw: "So instead you lean in, using your queen’s tits as a warm, pillowy respite from the clamor and commotion of the party. She doesn’t mind a bit; her body was sculpted for just such use, no doubt. "

rows.original: A few moments later, though, and one of her employees comes up, bows, and whispers something into Beth’s ear.
rows.translation: 然而片刻后，她的一名雇员走上前，鞠了一躬，在贝丝耳边低声说了些什么。
rows.raw: "A few moments later, though, and one of her employees comes up, bows, and whispers something into Beth’s ear."

rows.original: “Ah, you’ll excuse me, [pc.name]. Urgent business.”
rows.translation: “啊，请原谅我，[pc.name]。有急事要处理。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, you’ll excuse me, [pc.name]. Urgent business.”"

rows.original: Of course. You hate to see her leave, but love to watch her go...
rows.translation: 当然。你不愿看她离去，却又很爱欣赏她离去时的背影...
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course. You hate to see her leave, but love to watch her go..."
