rows.original: A zaika in a long red dress, approaches you with a charming smile and an outstretched hand that’s synthetic all the way to the elbow. The chrome’s been painted a deep red, emblazoned with the Utopian Skies logo on the palm, and her dress has both a plunging neckline down past her navel and cuts that run all the way up both thighs. The look screams high-class courtesan more than wealthy Peer, but who are you to judge?
rows.translation: 一名身穿红色长裙的扎伊卡带着迷人笑容走近你，伸出的手从指尖到手肘都是合成义肢。铬金属被漆成深红色，掌心印着“乌托邦天空”的标志；她的裙装领口一路低开至肚脐之下，两侧开衩则直抵大腿根部。这副打扮与其说像富有的同侪，不如说更像高级交际花，不过你又有什么资格评判呢？
rows.raw: "A zaika in a long red dress, approaches you with a charming smile and an outstretched hand that’s synthetic all the way to the elbow. The chrome’s been painted a deep red, emblazoned with the Utopian Skies logo on the palm, and her dress has both a plunging neckline down past her navel and cuts that run all the way up both thighs. The look screams high-class courtesan more than wealthy Peer, but who are you to judge?"

rows.original: “Hello!” the young woman chirps, “You must be Captain Steele! We’ve heard so much about you and your adventures. Do you have a few minutes to talk to my boss? She’d loooove to meet you!”
rows.translation: “你好！”年轻女子欢快地说道，“你一定是斯蒂尔船长！我们听过好多关于你和你冒险经历的事。你能抽几分钟去见见我的老板吗？她可太——想见你了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hello!” the young woman chirps, “You must be Captain Steele! We’ve heard so much about you and your adventures. Do you have a few minutes to talk to my boss? She’d loooove to meet you!”"

rows.original: “Your boss?”
rows.translation: “你的老板？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Your boss?”"

rows.original: The women titters. “The executress, duh! C’mon!”
rows.translation: 女人窃笑起来。“当然是执行官啦！快来！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe women titters. “The executress, duh! C’mon!”"

rows.original: She doesn’t release your hand, instead dragging you towards a lounge near one of the glass pyramid’s corners. A pair of semi-circular couches are wedged together around a table on which sits a red cube of a computer. Bundles of wires run tentacle-like from its ports to the dozen or so zaika sprawled out on the couches, all wearing VR-masks over their eyes. Their tails are all intertwined, undulating in response to virtual stimuli, but judging by how wide-open and moist several tail-bulbs are, their digital worlds are anything but chaste.
rows.translation: 她没有松开你的手，而是拉着你走向玻璃金字塔一角附近的休息区。两张半圆形沙发围着一张桌子拼在一起，桌上放着一台红色立方体电脑。成束导线如触手般从接口延伸出去，连接到横七竖八躺在沙发上的十来名扎伊卡身上；她们眼前全都戴着虚拟现实面罩。她们的尾巴纠缠在一起，响应虚拟刺激而不断起伏，但从好几只尾球张得如此之大、湿得如此明显来看，她们的数字世界绝对谈不上贞洁。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe doesn’t release your hand, instead dragging you towards a lounge near one of the glass pyramid’s corners. A pair of semi-circular couches are wedged together around a table on which sits a red cube of a computer. Bundles of wires run tentacle-like from its ports to the dozen or so zaika sprawled out on the couches, all wearing VR-masks over their eyes. Their tails are all intertwined, undulating in response to virtual stimuli, but judging by how wide-open and moist several tail-bulbs are, their digital worlds are anything but chaste."

rows.original: “Executress?” your escort says, peering at the group. “There’s someone here to seeeee yooooouuuu.”
rows.translation: “执行官？”带你来的女人望向众人说道。“有人来见——你——啦。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Executress?” your escort says, peering at the group. “There’s someone here to seeeee yooooouuuu.”"

rows.original: None of the aliens respond, too caught up in their games. The woman in the red dress gives you an apologetic smile and reaches down to one of the other women, seemingly at random, and gives her bare shoulder a light shake. “It’s Captain Steele, ma’am.”
rows.translation: 没有一个异星人回应，她们全都沉浸在游戏里。红裙女人向你露出歉意的微笑，随意俯身碰了碰其中一名女子，轻轻摇晃她裸露的肩膀。“是斯蒂尔船长，女士。”
rows.raw: "\n\nNone of the aliens respond, too caught up in their games. The woman in the red dress gives you an apologetic smile and reaches down to one of the other women, seemingly at random, and gives her bare shoulder a light shake. “It’s Captain Steele, ma’am.”"

rows.original: That seems to snap her out of it. The reclining woman pulls her goggles off, revealing a kind face painted white and black, with an intricate braid of silver hair framing it around her tapered ears. Compared to the other zaika you’ve seen at the party, you can’t see any trace of obvious cybernetics on her... and there’s a lot of her on display, now that you look: she’s wearing a dress that has more in common with a loose bathrobe than a ball gown, baring her breasts almost completely and hanging loosely from her shoulders. The executress places her hands on your contact’s cheeks and gives her a kiss on the forehead. “Why didn’t you say so? Here, plug in, you deserve it!”
rows.translation: 这似乎终于让她回过神来。斜倚着的女人摘下护目镜，露出一张涂成黑白两色的和善面孔，精心编织的银发环绕着她尖细的耳朵。与派对上其他扎伊卡相比，你看不出她身上有任何明显的赛博改造痕迹...而仔细一看，她裸露在外的身体还真不少：她穿的裙子与其说是舞会礼服，不如说更像宽松浴袍，乳房几乎完全外露，衣料松垮地挂在肩上。执行官双手捧住联络人的脸颊，在她额头上吻了一口。“怎么不早说？来，接进去吧，这是你应得的！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThat seems to snap her out of it. The reclining woman pulls her goggles off, revealing a kind face painted white and black, with an intricate braid of silver hair framing it around her tapered ears. Compared to the other zaika you’ve seen at the party, you can’t see any trace of obvious cybernetics on her... and there’s a lot of her on display, now that you look: she’s wearing a dress that has more in common with a loose bathrobe than a ball gown, baring her breasts almost completely and hanging loosely from her shoulders. The executress places her hands on your contact’s cheeks and gives her a kiss on the forehead. “Why didn’t you say so? Here, plug in, you deserve it!”"

rows.original: The white-faced executress hands her VR set over and rises to her feet, smoothing out the front of her deeply revealing dress. While the younger woman plugs in, you’re presented with a dainty purple hand
rows.translation: 白脸执行官把自己的虚拟现实设备递给她，随后站起身，抚平深度暴露的裙装前襟。年轻女子接入设备时，一只纤细的紫色手伸到你面前，
rows.raw: "\n\nThe white-faced executress hands her VR set over and rises to her feet, smoothing out the front of her deeply revealing dress. While the younger woman plugs in, you’re presented with a dainty purple hand "

rows.original: which you deftly kiss
rows.translation: 你熟练地吻了吻那只手
rows.raw: "which you deftly kiss"

rows.original: to shake
rows.translation: 供你握手
rows.raw: "to shake"

rows.original: . “It’s such a pleasure to finally meet you!” she smiles, “You’ve really made such a splash in the Peer scene already. Even for an alien, you’re making an impression that I think most of the other xeno-corps would be jealous of.”
rows.translation: 。“终于见到你，实在太荣幸了！”她微笑道，“你已经在同侪圈子里掀起了这么大的波澜。即便作为异星人，你留下的印象也足以让大多数其他外星企业嫉妒。”
rows.raw: ". “It’s such a pleasure to finally meet you!” she smiles, “You’ve really made such a splash in the Peer scene already. Even for an alien, you’re making an impression that I think most of the other xeno-corps would be jealous of.”"

rows.original: High praise all of a sudden. <i>“
rows.translation: 突如其来的高度赞誉。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nHigh praise all of a sudden. <i>“"

rows.original: And you are?
rows.translation: 请问你是？
rows.raw: "And you are?"

rows.original: You seem to have me at a disadvantage, miss...?
rows.translation: 你好像占尽了先机，女士...你是？
rows.raw: "You seem to have me at a disadvantage, miss...?"

rows.original: “Oh, twist my tail, where’ve my manners gone?” she giggles. “It’s just so unusual to meet someone that doesn’t know my face! You may call me Corellah Dova, prime Executress of Utopian Skies. Which is our way of saying C.E.O. - the head honcho, the woman on the throne. From what I hear, you’ll be in similar shoes soon. Well, maybe not quite so fashionable, but still.”
rows.translation: “哎呀，扭我的尾巴，我的礼貌都去哪儿了？”她咯咯笑道。“遇到不认识我这张脸的人实在太少见了！你可以叫我科蕾拉·多瓦，乌托邦天空的首席执行官。用你们的话说，就是首席执行官——掌舵人、王座上的女人。听说你很快也会处于类似的位置。嗯，也许没这么时髦，但差不多。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, twist my tail, where’ve my manners gone?” she giggles. “It’s just so unusual to meet someone that doesn’t know my face! You may call me Corellah Dova, prime Executress of Utopian Skies. Which is our way of saying C.E.O. - the head honcho, the woman on the throne. From what I hear, you’ll be in similar shoes soon. Well, maybe not quite so fashionable, but still.”"

rows.original: You glance down at her neon-laced sparkling high heels, staring at the garish things just long enough to make Corellah laugh. “Come, sit with me, let’s get to know each other!”
rows.translation: 你低头看向她那双缀有霓虹灯、闪闪发亮的高跟鞋，盯着这浮夸玩意儿的时间长到足以让科蕾拉笑起来。“来，陪我坐坐，让我们互相了解一下！”
rows.raw: "\n\nYou glance down at her neon-laced sparkling high heels, staring at the garish things just long enough to make Corellah laugh. “Come, sit with me, let’s get to know each other!”"

rows.original: She leads you by the arm a few paces past the impromptu virtual lounge, to a couch tucked into one of the pyramid’s glass corners surrounded almost completely by six-foot potted plants. A thick vapor hangs around them, sprayed by a device hanging off the back of the couch that makes it feel particularly swampy. The executress slips onto the couch beside you, pressing her hip in against your own and putting an arm around your shoulders, closer than a total stranger has any right to be.
rows.translation: 她挽着你的手臂，领你走过临时虚拟休息区，在金字塔一处玻璃墙角找到一张沙发；周围几乎完全被六英尺高的盆栽包围。沙发背后挂着一个装置，不断喷出浓厚水雾笼罩植物，让这里显得格外潮湿闷热。执行官在你身旁坐上沙发，臀部紧贴你的髋部，一只手臂揽住你的肩膀，亲密得远超陌生人应有的程度。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leads you by the arm a few paces past the impromptu virtual lounge, to a couch tucked into one of the pyramid’s glass corners surrounded almost completely by six-foot potted plants. A thick vapor hangs around them, sprayed by a device hanging off the back of the couch that makes it feel particularly swampy. The executress slips onto the couch beside you, pressing her hip in against your own and putting an arm around your shoulders, closer than a total stranger has any right to be."

rows.original: “So!” she drawls, all friendly-like. “Why don’t we have a talk about space, you and I? I’m dying of curiosity, the stories other aliens have shared are so terribly frightening! That there are worse things than monsters out among the stars: pirates and slavers and all kinds of nasty people. I’m sure you’ve had all kinds of run-ins with them. Tell me all about it.”
rows.translation: “那么！”她用友好的口吻拖长声音说道。“你我何不聊聊太空？我好奇得快死了，其他异星人分享的故事全都吓人得不得了！据说群星之间有比怪物更加可怕的东西：海盗、奴隶贩子，还有各种恶棍。你肯定和他们发生过各种冲突。全都讲给我听吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So!” she drawls, all friendly-like. “Why don’t we have a talk about space, you and I? I’m dying of curiosity, the stories other aliens have shared are so terribly frightening! That there are worse things than monsters out among the stars: pirates and slavers and all kinds of nasty people. I’m sure you’ve had all kinds of run-ins with them. Tell me all about it.”"

rows.original: Okay
rows.translation: 好吧
rows.raw: "Okay"

rows.original: Okay
rows.translation: 好吧
rows.raw: "Okay"

rows.original: Tell the executress about your encounters with the galaxy’s pirates and slavers.
rows.translation: 向执行官讲述你遭遇银河海盗和奴隶贩子的经历。
rows.raw: "Tell the executress about your encounters with the galaxy’s pirates and slavers."

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: No
rows.translation: 否
rows.raw: "No"

rows.original: You don’t really want to tell the story of your adventures to this over-friendly space elf.
rows.translation: 你并不怎么想把自己的冒险故事讲给这个过分友好的太空精灵听。
rows.raw: "You don’t really want to tell the story of your adventures to this over-friendly space elf."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You catch sight of a couple familiar figures marching through the crowd of close-pressed party-goers: the armored goons that gave you a hard time outside on the landing pad. While the Peers are tall and willowy, these girls are jacked up with cyberware and heavy armor that practically glows with Paragon’s crosshair logo; they have no trouble looking over their noble overlords... and right to you. Ah, shit.
rows.translation: 你瞥见几个熟悉的身影正从拥挤的派对宾客中穿行而来：正是在外面停机坪上刁难过你的装甲打手。同侪们身材高挑纤细，这些姑娘却用赛博部件和重型装甲把自己武装得魁梧壮硕，身上几乎闪耀着典范公司的准星标志；她们毫不费力便能越过贵族主人的头顶张望...目光径直落在你身上。啊，见鬼。
rows.raw: "You catch sight of a couple familiar figures marching through the crowd of close-pressed party-goers: the armored goons that gave you a hard time outside on the landing pad. While the Peers are tall and willowy, these girls are jacked up with cyberware and heavy armor that practically glows with Paragon’s crosshair logo; they have no trouble looking over their noble overlords... and right to you. Ah, shit."

rows.original: “Captain Steele,” one of them says as they get within arm’s reach. It’s not a question, but she waits until you nod in confirmation anyway before continuing: “The Fabricator-Marshal wants words with you. Follow us.”
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔船长，”其中一人在走到一臂之遥时说道。这并不是疑问，但她仍等你点头确认后才继续：“制造总监要找你谈话。跟我们走。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Captain Steele,” one of them says as they get within arm’s reach. It’s not a question, but she waits until you nod in confirmation anyway before continuing: “The Fabricator-Marshal wants words with you. Follow us.”"

rows.original: “The who?” you ask, falling in behind the guards. Must be somebody important!
rows.translation: “谁？”你问道，跟在守卫身后。肯定是什么重要人物！
rows.raw: "“The who?” you ask, falling in behind the guards. Must be somebody important!"

rows.original: You’re not entirely sure you have a choice in the matter, but either way, you suppose you came to this party to network... right?
rows.translation: 你并不完全确定自己是否有选择余地，但无论如何，你来到这场派对不就是为了拓展人脉...对吧？
rows.raw: "You’re not entirely sure you have a choice in the matter, but either way, you suppose you came to this party to network... right?"

rows.original: The two Paragon strongwomen march you to one of the pyramid’s slanting walls and up a set of stairs, to a pair of glass doors leading out onto a terrace. Below you is the vast depths of the alleys between the skyscrapers, a fathomless drop so deep that you cannot see the streets for the clouds below. Hovercraft zip by at breakneck speeds, kicking up howling winds that would knock
rows.translation: 两名典范公司的壮硕女人带着你走到金字塔一面倾斜的墙壁旁，登上一段楼梯，来到一对通往露台的玻璃门前。下方是摩天楼之间深不见底的巷道，落差之大，连街道都被下面的云层遮蔽。悬浮载具以惊人速度呼啸而过，掀起的狂风足以把
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two Paragon strongwomen march you to one of the pyramid’s slanting walls and up a set of stairs, to a pair of glass doors leading out onto a terrace. Below you is the vast depths of the alleys between the skyscrapers, a fathomless drop so deep that you cannot see the streets for the clouds below. Hovercraft zip by at breakneck speeds, kicking up howling winds that would knock "

rows.original: a lesser
rows.translation: 一个弱小得多的
rows.raw: "a lesser "

rows.original: wo
rows.translation: 女
rows.raw: "wo"

rows.original: man right off
rows.translation: 人直接吹下去
rows.raw: "man right off"

rows.original: you right off
rows.translation: 你直接吹下去
rows.raw: "you right off"

rows.original: if it wasn’t for chest-high guardrails adorned with ribbons depicting all three zaibatsu logos.
rows.translation: ——若非胸口高度的护栏上挂着印有三家财阀标志的彩带。
rows.raw: " if it wasn’t for chest-high guardrails adorned with ribbons depicting all three zaibatsu logos."

rows.original: But there’s only one company up here, at the top of the world: Paragon. The lone zaika woman standing out on the balcony when you arrive is even more heavily augmented than her guards, with her sleeveless vest showing off cyber-lined arms covered in winding serpent tatts and bulging muscles. A beret-like cap sits atop her head, flanked by long ears and a hip-length white ponytail. Whisps of smoke trail from a long cigarette clenched between two black-painted lips as she turns to acknowledge you.
rows.translation: 但世界之巅只有一家公司：典范。你到达时，阳台上独自站着的扎伊卡女子甚至比她的守卫改造得更加彻底；无袖背心露出遍布赛博线路的双臂，上面覆盖蜿蜒的蛇形纹身与鼓胀肌肉。一顶类似贝雷帽的帽子戴在头上，两侧伸出长耳朵，长及臀部的白色马尾垂在身后。她转身打量你时，黑色嘴唇间叼着的长香烟逸出缕缕烟雾。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut there’s only one company up here, at the top of the world: Paragon. The lone zaika woman standing out on the balcony when you arrive is even more heavily augmented than her guards, with her sleeveless vest showing off cyber-lined arms covered in winding serpent tatts and bulging muscles. A beret-like cap sits atop her head, flanked by long ears and a hip-length white ponytail. Whisps of smoke trail from a long cigarette clenched between two black-painted lips as she turns to acknowledge you."

rows.original: “You are Captain Steele?” she asks, looking you up and down. “I expected you would be more... imposing.”
rows.translation: “你就是斯蒂尔船长？”她上下打量着你问道。“我还以为你会更加...有压迫感。”
rows.raw: "“You are Captain Steele?” she asks, looking you up and down. “I expected you would be more... imposing.”"

rows.original: “You must be Captain Steele,” she says, looking you up and down.
rows.translation: “你一定就是斯蒂尔船长，”她上下打量着你说道。
rows.raw: "“You must be Captain Steele,” she says, looking you up and down."

rows.original: Large hands plant themselves on willowy hips. “Well, your reputation precedes you, captain. You’ve certainly got those pampered hags whispering.”
rows.translation: 大手叉上纤细的腰肢。“嗯，你果然名声在外，船长。你确实让那群养尊处优的老妖婆议论纷纷。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLarge hands plant themselves on willowy hips. “Well, your reputation precedes you, captain. You’ve certainly got those pampered hags whispering.”"

rows.original: “And you are?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And you are?”"

rows.original: The cyborg takes a deep drag of her cigarette. “I’m Rizzon Zau. Fabricator-Marshal.”
rows.translation: 赛博格深吸了一口香烟。“我是里松·扎乌。制造总监。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe cyborg takes a deep drag of her cigarette. “I’m Rizzon Zau. Fabricator-Marshal.”"

rows.original: She nods and turns back towards the end of the balcony, and given the sudden dead air, you step up and join her at the guard rails. You suppose if she wants to huck you over the edge, the two guards sticking by the door are just as capable as she is.
rows.translation: 她点点头，重新转向阳台尽头；突如其来的冷场让你走上前，与她并肩站在护栏旁。你猜想，如果她想把你扔下去，那两个守在门边的护卫和她一样有这个本事。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe nods and turns back towards the end of the balcony, and given the sudden dead air, you step up and join her at the guard rails. You suppose if she wants to huck you over the edge, the two guards sticking by the door are just as capable as she is."

rows.original: “From what I hear, you’re a [pc.manWoman] of action,” she says evenly. “
rows.translation: “据我听说，你是个行动派的[pc.manWoman]，”她平静地说道。“
rows.raw: "\n\n“From what I hear, you’re a [pc.manWoman] of action,” she says evenly. “"

rows.original: A soldier of fortune. I can respect that.
rows.translation: 一名佣兵。我尊重这一点。
rows.raw: "A soldier of fortune. I can respect that."

rows.original: That you moved goods nobody else would. Or could.
rows.translation: 你运送别人不愿——或不能——碰的货物。
rows.raw: "That you moved goods nobody else would. Or could."

rows.original: That you handle future-tech like we primitives can’t imagine.
rows.translation: 你驾驭的未来科技，是我们这些原始人难以想象的。
rows.raw: "That you handle future-tech like we primitives can’t imagine."

rows.original: That your mind is as razor sharp as any weapon
rows.translation: 你的头脑如任何武器一般锋利
rows.raw: "That your mind is as razor sharp as any weapon"

rows.original: ... at times
rows.translation: ...至少有时候
rows.raw: "... at times"

rows.original: And that you’re an heir
rows.translation: 而且你还是一名继承人
rows.raw: " And that you’re an heir"

rows.original: ess
rows.raw: "ess"

rows.original: on top of all that, gonna be a bigger dick in the galaxy than the zaibatsu ever will be. Must be hell down there, being fawned over like a freak show exhibit.”
rows.translation: ；再加上这一切，你日后在银河系里会成为比那些财阀更了不得的大人物。待在下面肯定糟透了吧，像个怪胎展品一样被人围着献媚。”
rows.raw: " on top of all that, gonna be a bigger dick in the galaxy than the zaibatsu ever will be. Must be hell down there, being fawned over like a freak show exhibit.”"

rows.original: “Is that why you’re out here?”
rows.translation: “所以你才待在这里？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is that why you’re out here?”"

rows.original: Rizzon’s dark-painted lips curl into something that might be a smirk, showing over cybernetic trace-lines across her chiseled face. “Something like that, yeah. Was never much for crowds. One full of backstabbing influence-mongers? Can’t get my hackles down. Need to let off some steam.”
rows.translation: 里松涂黑的嘴唇弯起，似乎露出一抹讥笑，让线条分明的脸上那些赛博线路更加醒目。“差不多吧，是啊。我从来不怎么喜欢人群。至于一群热衷背刺、争权夺势的家伙？根本放松不了。得找个地方泄泄火。”
rows.raw: "\n\nRizzon’s dark-painted lips curl into something that might be a smirk, showing over cybernetic trace-lines across her chiseled face. “Something like that, yeah. Was never much for crowds. One full of backstabbing influence-mongers? Can’t get my hackles down. Need to let off some steam.”"

rows.original: She reaches into her vest and draws a pistol: a compact, sleek little chrome-plated piece that’s as much battery as barrel. She checks its power setting with a two-finger press of the slide and then offers the gun grip-first to you. “Want to see how Paragon steel compares to yours, captain?”
rows.translation: 她伸手探入背心，拔出一把手枪：一件小巧流畅的镀铬武器，电池和枪管几乎一样大。她用两根手指按压套筒，检查功率设置，随后将枪柄朝向你递了过来。“想看看典范公司的钢铁和你的比起来如何吗，船长？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe reaches into her vest and draws a pistol: a compact, sleek little chrome-plated piece that’s as much battery as barrel. She checks its power setting with a two-finger press of the slide and then offers the gun grip-first to you. “Want to see how Paragon steel compares to yours, captain?”"

rows.original: Sure
rows.translation: 当然
rows.raw: "Sure"

rows.original: Sure
rows.translation: 当然
rows.raw: "Sure"

rows.original: You don’t know what Rizzon is planning, but you’re always interested in seeing new boomsticks.
rows.translation: 你不知道里松打算做什么，但你向来有兴趣见识新式枪械。
rows.raw: "You don’t know what Rizzon is planning, but you’re always interested in seeing new boomsticks."

rows.original: You Keep It
rows.translation: 你留着吧
rows.raw: "You Keep It"

rows.original: You Keep It
rows.translation: 你留着吧
rows.raw: "You Keep It"

rows.original: You don’t really want to play gun-nerds with a chromed-up alien commando here.
rows.translation: 你不太想在这里和一个全身镀铬的外星突击队员钻研枪械。
rows.raw: "You don’t really want to play gun-nerds with a chromed-up alien commando here."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: A pair of zaika approach you, both wearing dresses that look like somebody decided a lab coat needed to be churched up to Victorian standards, with frills and wide skirts and everything stretched out of white latex. Both of them have the green logo of Utopian Skies woven across their breasts, plunging down into their ample cleavage. Cybernetic eyes gleam at you, and you can almost feel scans running over you from toe to tip.
rows.translation: 两名扎伊卡朝你走来，身上的裙装活像有人觉得实验服还不够庄严，于是把它提升到维多利亚时代标准，白色乳胶制成的宽裙摆上满是褶边。两人的胸前都织着乌托邦天空公司的绿色标志，标志一路探入丰满的乳沟。电子眼朝你闪烁着光，你几乎能感觉到扫描正在从脚到头掠过全身。
rows.raw: "A pair of zaika approach you, both wearing dresses that look like somebody decided a lab coat needed to be churched up to Victorian standards, with frills and wide skirts and everything stretched out of white latex. Both of them have the green logo of Utopian Skies woven across their breasts, plunging down into their ample cleavage. Cybernetic eyes gleam at you, and you can almost feel scans running over you from toe to tip."

rows.original: Then the two women part, and a third approaches you. Tall, slender, wiry of build and dressed in a much less flamboyant lab coat. Her snowy hair is done up to leave none of her face’s heavy cyberization to the imagination - there’s more metal than flesh to her face now, completely replacing her eyes and lower jaw, and all the way down her neck out of sight. Her arms are synthetic, too, now that you look, or at least what of her hands are visible.
rows.translation: 接着，两名女子向两侧分开，第三人走到你面前。她身材高挑、纤细精悍，穿着一件远没有那么华丽的实验服。雪白头发束起，将脸上严重的义体改造毫无遮掩地展现出来，她脸上的金属已经多过血肉，双眼和下颌都被完全替换，改造还沿着脖颈向下延伸，隐没在视线之外。仔细看去，她的双臂也是人造的，至少露在外面的双手如此。
rows.raw: "\n\nThen the two women part, and a third approaches you. Tall, slender, wiry of build and dressed in a much less flamboyant lab coat. Her snowy hair is done up to leave none of her face’s heavy cyberization to the imagination - there’s more metal than flesh to her face now, completely replacing her eyes and lower jaw, and all the way down her neck out of sight. Her arms are synthetic, too, now that you look, or at least what of her hands are visible."

rows.original: “My, you’re a specimen,” the woman trills, leaning in and extending the lenses of her eyes towards you. “Captain Steele! The one and only. My, my, you’ve made quite the impression on... on just about everyone here. Now I can see why.”
rows.translation: “哎呀，你可真是个非同寻常的标本，”女人用颤音说道，一边凑近，一边将双眼的镜片朝你伸来。“斯蒂尔船长！独一无二的那一位。哎呀呀，你给...给这里几乎所有人都留下了相当深刻的印象。现在我明白原因了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My, you’re a specimen,” the woman trills, leaning in and extending the lenses of her eyes towards you. “Captain Steele! The one and only. My, my, you’ve made quite the impression on... on just about everyone here. Now I can see why.”"

rows.original: She leans in,
rows.translation: 她倾身凑近，
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leans in, "

rows.original: directly violating your personal space. You just push your chest out and let her look: you’ve got nothing to fear here.
rows.translation: 径直侵入你的私人空间。你只是挺起胸膛任她打量：在这里，你没什么好怕的。
rows.raw: "directly violating your personal space. You just push your chest out and let her look: you’ve got nothing to fear here."

rows.original: close enough to make you lean back away from her.
rows.translation: 近得让你不得不向后仰身躲开她。
rows.raw: "close enough to make you lean back away from her."

rows.original: “As for me, though, I know appearances can be deceiving. Body, persona, it’s all just art. Beautiful art, in your case, but little more than a painting on the wall. Yet your deeds... I’ve heard that Captain Steele has exploits all across the stars, defeating pirates and warlords, breaking them before your will. Tell me, captain, is this true? Are you the adventuring hero my sources claim?”
rows.translation: “至于我嘛，我知道外表往往会骗人。躯体、人格，都不过是艺术。以你而言，是件美丽的艺术品，但也不过是墙上的一幅画。可你的事迹...我听说斯蒂尔船长的功绩遍布群星，击败过海盗与军阀，令他们屈服于你的意志。告诉我，船长，这些都是真的吗？你真是我的消息来源所说的那位冒险英雄吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“As for me, though, I know appearances can be deceiving. Body, persona, it’s all just art. Beautiful art, in your case, but little more than a painting on the wall. Yet your deeds... I’ve heard that Captain Steele has exploits all across the stars, defeating pirates and warlords, breaking them before your will. Tell me, captain, is this true? Are you the adventuring hero my sources claim?”"

rows.original: Maybe, maybe not. Before you answer any questions, you’d like to know who’s asking them.
rows.translation: 或许是，或许不是。在回答任何问题之前，你想先知道提问的人是谁。
rows.raw: "\n\nMaybe, maybe not. Before you answer any questions, you’d like to know who’s asking them."

rows.original: She chuckles, a grating, synthetic sound from deep in her throat. “Ah, of course, how could we expect you to know. How could you? I am the Maven of Bright Water, Jaqui Fassbin. What you aliens would call the Chief Executive Officer.”
rows.translation: 她轻声笑了起来，喉咙深处传出刺耳的合成音。“啊，当然了，我们怎么能指望你知道呢。你又怎么可能知道？我是澄水的巨匠，杰奎·法斯宾。用你们外星人的话来说，就是首席执行官。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe chuckles, a grating, synthetic sound from deep in her throat. “Ah, of course, how could we expect you to know. How could you? I am the Maven of Bright Water, Jaqui Fassbin. What you aliens would call the Chief Executive Officer.”"

rows.original: Rather than extending a hand, as is custom, the maven takes a facemask dangling from an apparatus over her shoulders and presses it to her half-synthetic mouth, taking a deep huff of some black mist that makes her lengthy ears twitch uncontrollably. “Ahhh! So, [pc.name], let’s sit. Tell me the story of your conquests!”
rows.translation: 这位巨匠没有按照惯例伸手致意，而是取下悬在肩上装置的一副面罩，将其按在半机械化的嘴上，深深吸了一口某种黑雾，令她修长的耳朵不受控制地抽动起来。“啊哈！那么，[pc.name]，我们坐下吧。给我讲讲你的征服故事！”
rows.raw: "\n\nRather than extending a hand, as is custom, the maven takes a facemask dangling from an apparatus over her shoulders and presses it to her half-synthetic mouth, taking a deep huff of some black mist that makes her lengthy ears twitch uncontrollably. “Ahhh! So, [pc.name], let’s sit. Tell me the story of your conquests!”"

rows.original: Okay
rows.translation: 好吧
rows.raw: "Okay"

rows.original: Okay
rows.translation: 好吧
rows.raw: "Okay"

rows.original: Sure, why not?
rows.translation: 当然，有何不可？
rows.raw: "Sure, why not?"

rows.original: No Way
rows.translation: 免谈
rows.raw: "No Way"

rows.original: No Way
rows.translation: 免谈
rows.raw: "No Way"

rows.original: You don’t really want to spill all these beans to a powerful alien oligarch.
rows.translation: 你实在不想把这些事全盘透露给一位权势滔天的外星寡头。
rows.raw: "You don’t really want to spill all these beans to a powerful alien oligarch."

rows.original: Bright Water LLC.
rows.raw: "Bright Water LLC."

rows.original: Paragon Inc.
rows.raw: "Paragon Inc."

rows.original: Utopian Skies
rows.raw: "Utopian Skies"

rows.original: Faction
rows.translation: 派系
rows.raw: "Faction"

rows.original: Favor
rows.translation: 人情
rows.raw: "Favor"

rows.original: text-label
rows.raw: "text-label"

rows.original: text-right nowrap
rows.raw: "text-right nowrap"

rows.original: Affiliation
rows.translation: 关系
rows.raw: "Affiliation"

rows.original: Your current standing with each zaibatsu.
rows.translation: 你目前与各家财阀的关系。
rows.raw: "Your current standing with each zaibatsu."

rows.original: DARIUS
rows.raw: "DARIUS"

rows.original: Darius
rows.translation: 达里厄斯
rows.raw: "Darius"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “These Zaibatsu... what can you tell me about them?”
rows.translation: “这些财阀...你能跟我说说他们吗？”
rows.raw: "“These Zaibatsu... what can you tell me about them?”"

rows.original: “There’re three major ones, controlling damn near everything on this planet. Any smaller company - probably half the gangs and mercs, too - belong to one of the Zaibatsu in fact if not on paper. In the context of Dhaal, they’re even more powerful than the largest mega-corp back coreward. Just about anything you see on this planet, you can trace back to one of them.”
rows.translation: “主要的有三家，几乎控制着这颗星球上的一切。任何规模较小的公司，还有大概一半的帮派和佣兵，即便名义上不是，实际上也都隶属于其中一家财阀。在达尔的环境下，他们甚至比核心星域最大的巨型企业还要强大。你在这颗星球上看到的几乎任何东西，都能追溯到其中一家。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“There’re three major ones, controlling damn near everything on this planet. Any smaller company - probably half the gangs and mercs, too - belong to one of the Zaibatsu in fact if not on paper. In the context of Dhaal, they’re even more powerful than the largest mega-corp back coreward. Just about anything you see on this planet, you can trace back to one of them.”"

rows.original: One of his guards preens, “The highest quality will always be from Paragon.”
rows.translation: 他的一名护卫得意地说道：“品质最高的永远是典范公司的产品。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of his guards preens, “The highest quality will always be from Paragon.”"

rows.original: Darius nods along. “Sure, yeah. Let’s start with them. Paragon’s like Reaper back home: they’re all about guns and armor for us off-worlders, but they’ve diversified too: combat stims, food, implants... everything you need to keep a body rolling. Between security forces and cheap nutri-paste, they’re the ones keeping the peace here in the Gyre. Well, as close as it gets anyway.”
rows.translation: 达里厄斯随之点头。“没错，是啊。就从他们说起吧。典范公司就像咱们那边的死神工业：主要面向我们这些外星人经营枪械和护甲，但也开展了多元业务，包括战斗兴奋剂、食品、植入体...凡是维持一副身体运转所需的东西，应有尽有。从安保部队到廉价营养糊，正是他们维持着环城这里的秩序。嗯，反正已经是最接近秩序的状态了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nDarius nods along. “Sure, yeah. Let’s start with them. Paragon’s like Reaper back home: they’re all about guns and armor for us off-worlders, but they’ve diversified too: combat stims, food, implants... everything you need to keep a body rolling. Between security forces and cheap nutri-paste, they’re the ones keeping the peace here in the Gyre. Well, as close as it gets anyway.”"

rows.original: Yeah...
rows.translation: 是啊...
rows.raw: "\n\nYeah..."

rows.original: “Speaking of drugs and other fun times, the next of the bunch is Bright Water. They give me some real Xenogen vibes: they’re all into chemicals, body modification, recreational drugs, medical stuff, you get the idea. Probably the only reason the people on Dhaal don’t all have super-cancer from all the sludge in the air. We, uh, should probably introduce these folks to microsurgeons soon as we can, come to think of it.”
rows.translation: “说到药物和其他找乐子的东西，下一家就是澄水。他们给我的感觉特别像异源生物科技：热衷于化学品、身体改造、娱乐性药物、医疗方面的玩意儿，你懂的。达尔人没有因为空气里的这些污泥全都患上超级癌症，大概全靠他们了。仔细想想，我们，呃，或许该尽快把显微外科机器人介绍给这些人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Speaking of drugs and other fun times, the next of the bunch is Bright Water. They give me some real Xenogen vibes: they’re all into chemicals, body modification, recreational drugs, medical stuff, you get the idea. Probably the only reason the people on Dhaal don’t all have super-cancer from all the sludge in the air. We, uh, should probably introduce these folks to microsurgeons soon as we can, come to think of it.”"

rows.original: “And last,” Darius says, rubbing his hands, “but certainly not least: Utopian Skies. What a name! They’ve got the pleasure districts under their thumb, entertainment both digital and carnal. You find yourself in a gaming parlor, a virtual lounge, or a cat house... chances are it’s gonna be a Utopia! Haha. I don’t know what they manufacture, if anything, but their focus on keepin’ folks placid and happy reeks of Tamani. I’d bet any money the goblin’s here trying to get her tentacles in ‘em.”
rows.translation: “最后一家，”达里厄斯搓着双手说道，“但绝对不是最不重要的：乌托邦天空公司。多漂亮的名字！他们把欢愉区牢牢攥在手里，数字娱乐和肉体享受一应俱全。只要你走进游戏厅、虚拟休息室或妓院...那里十有八九就是一座‘乌托邦’！哈哈。我不知道他们到底生产什么，甚至不知道他们是否生产东西，不过他们一心让人们安分又快乐的做派，浑身都是塔玛妮的味道。我敢赌多少钱都行，那个哥布林肯定正在这里想办法把触手伸进他们当中。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And last,” Darius says, rubbing his hands, “but certainly not least: Utopian Skies. What a name! They’ve got the pleasure districts under their thumb, entertainment both digital and carnal. You find yourself in a gaming parlor, a virtual lounge, or a cat house... chances are it’s gonna be a Utopia! Haha. I don’t know what they manufacture, if anything, but their focus on keepin’ folks placid and happy reeks of Tamani. I’d bet any money the goblin’s here trying to get her tentacles in ‘em.”"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “So tell me about the company’s presence here.”
rows.translation: “那就跟我说说公司在这里的布局吧。”
rows.raw: "“So tell me about the company’s presence here.”"

rows.original: “Ah, well, like I said, this planet’s rich in raw resources the rest of the galaxy needs. Problem is, most of it’s hidden away beneath either a burning inferno on one side or a frigid wasteland on the other. The Zaika have mined up some of it, of course, but anything particularly deep is just too difficult for them to extract... but not for Steele Tech. A couple of our subsidiaries are ready to move in and start mining, and we’ll be here to refine and process it, but we can’t really get underway just yet. Not without at least one of the Zaibatsu on our side to pave the way.”
rows.translation: “啊，这个嘛，就像我说的，这颗星球富含银河系其他地方所需的原始资源。问题是，其中大部分都埋藏在一侧的熊熊炼狱或另一侧的冰封荒原之下。扎伊卡人当然已经开采出了一些，但凡埋得特别深的资源，他们就实在太难开采了...不过这难不倒斯蒂尔科技。我们的几家子公司已经准备好进驻并开始采矿，我们也会在这里进行精炼加工，可目前还没法真正开工。至少得有一家财阀站在我们这边，为我们铺平道路才行。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, well, like I said, this planet’s rich in raw resources the rest of the galaxy needs. Problem is, most of it’s hidden away beneath either a burning inferno on one side or a frigid wasteland on the other. The Zaika have mined up some of it, of course, but anything particularly deep is just too difficult for them to extract... but not for Steele Tech. A couple of our subsidiaries are ready to move in and start mining, and we’ll be here to refine and process it, but we can’t really get underway just yet. Not without at least one of the Zaibatsu on our side to pave the way.”"

rows.original: “So you’re here to negotiate?”
rows.translation: “所以你是来谈判的？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you’re here to negotiate?”"

rows.original: Darius nods. “Yeah, yeah basically. The Board is trying to figure out which of the three we want to deal with, but the problem is, whichever we pick’ll cause bad blood with the other two. That’s why the rest of the mega-corps have held back too, I’d guess: there’s a delicate balance of power we all risk upsetting, and that’d mean everyone loses out. Maybe these Zaibatsu can all merge, or pick one of themselves for all of us to deal with... would make things a lot easier. And safer, too. As you’ve probably seen for yourself, the streets of Dhaal are pretty mean without us rooting around. You wanna guess how bad it’s going to get if a power struggle breaks out?”
rows.translation: 达里厄斯点点头。“对，对，基本就是这样。董事会正试图弄清楚我们该跟三家中的哪一家打交道，可问题是，无论选谁，都会招致另外两家的敌意。我猜这也是其他巨型企业迟迟没有行动的原因：这里存在着微妙的权力平衡，我们都有可能将其打破，而那样一来谁都捞不到好处。或许这些财阀可以全部合并，或者从中选出一家，代表他们跟我们所有人打交道...那会让事情简单得多，也安全得多。你大概已经亲眼见识过了，即便没有我们插手，达尔的街头也够凶险的。要是爆发权力斗争，你想猜猜这里会变得多糟吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nDarius nods. “Yeah, yeah basically. The Board is trying to figure out which of the three we want to deal with, but the problem is, whichever we pick’ll cause bad blood with the other two. That’s why the rest of the mega-corps have held back too, I’d guess: there’s a delicate balance of power we all risk upsetting, and that’d mean everyone loses out. Maybe these Zaibatsu can all merge, or pick one of themselves for all of us to deal with... would make things a lot easier. And safer, too. As you’ve probably seen for yourself, the streets of Dhaal are pretty mean without us rooting around. You wanna guess how bad it’s going to get if a power struggle breaks out?”"

rows.original: Meaning it’s going to be hard for everyone if all three Zaibatsu are vying for power with the Confederate corporations. Considering your adventures so far, you just might be able to influence where the chips fall... you’re starting to see where Darius is heading with this.
rows.translation: 也就是说，如果三家财阀都开始同邦联企业争夺权力，所有人的日子都会不好过。想想你迄今为止的冒险经历，你或许真能影响最终的局势...你开始明白达里厄斯绕这么大一圈到底想说什么了。
rows.raw: "\n\nMeaning it’s going to be hard for everyone if all three Zaibatsu are vying for power with the Confederate corporations. Considering your adventures so far, you just might be able to influence where the chips fall... you’re starting to see where Darius is heading with this."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “So what’s the deal with this party?”
rows.translation: “所以这场宴会究竟是怎么回事？”
rows.raw: "“So what’s the deal with this party?”"

rows.original: “It’s a meeting of the who’s-who on Dhaal. Exciting stuff!” Darius explains. “Big black-tie event hosted up in the terraces, so high up the clouds are gonna be jealous. Reps from just about every corp will be there, plus all three Zaibatsu bosses. It’s a big opportunity for everyone, native and off-worlder alike.”
rows.translation: “那是达尔各路大人物的聚会。精彩得很！”达里厄斯解释道。“一场在阶台区举办的盛大正式晚宴，位置高得连云层都要眼红。几乎每家公司都会派代表参加，三家财阀的老板也都会到场。对所有人来说都是难得的机会，无论本地人还是外星人都一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s a meeting of the who’s-who on Dhaal. Exciting stuff!” Darius explains. “Big black-tie event hosted up in the terraces, so high up the clouds are gonna be jealous. Reps from just about every corp will be there, plus all three Zaibatsu bosses. It’s a big opportunity for everyone, native and off-worlder alike.”"

rows.original: “Steele Tech is the biggest sponsor at the event,” he adds proudly. “In honor of a large mineral deposit we’ve discovered from our research ship in orbit. It’s a huge payload, enough to excite not just Steele Tech but several other companies all looking to get in on a Dhaal Rush. Finding an advanced civilization on a Planet Rush is rare, but one on a nearly-untapped planet? Anyhow, Xenogen’s especially interested in the drugs and chems running rampant on the streets here, and Tamani’s got her eyes on all the pleasure-tech the locals have been investing in. I’ve even heard Beth Carver, that technically-legal collar-dealer, might be in attendance. Even a couple of planetary ambassadors, including a group from Tarkus and the Gryvain Republic are supposedly invited.”
rows.translation: “斯蒂尔科技是这场活动最大的赞助商，”他自豪地补充道。“这是为了庆祝我们的轨道研究船发现了一处大型矿藏。储量相当惊人，不仅足以让斯蒂尔科技兴奋不已，另外几家公司也都想在达尔开拓潮中分一杯羹。在行星开拓潮中发现先进文明本就罕见，可要是在一颗几乎尚未开发的星球上发现呢？总之，异源生物科技尤其看中这里街头泛滥的药物和化学品，塔玛妮则盯上了本地人一直在投资的各种欢愉科技。我甚至听说，就连那个在法律边缘做项圈生意的贝丝·卡弗也可能出席。据说还有几位行星大使获邀，其中包括来自塔克斯和格里文共和国的代表团。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Steele Tech is the biggest sponsor at the event,” he adds proudly. “In honor of a large mineral deposit we’ve discovered from our research ship in orbit. It’s a huge payload, enough to excite not just Steele Tech but several other companies all looking to get in on a Dhaal Rush. Finding an advanced civilization on a Planet Rush is rare, but one on a nearly-untapped planet? Anyhow, Xenogen’s especially interested in the drugs and chems running rampant on the streets here, and Tamani’s got her eyes on all the pleasure-tech the locals have been investing in. I’ve even heard Beth Carver, that technically-legal collar-dealer, might be in attendance. Even a couple of planetary ambassadors, including a group from Tarkus and the Gryvain Republic are supposedly invited.”"

rows.original: In short: a collection of the planet’s most powerful, and some of the more influential from the galaxy at large, too. Talk about networking opportunities.
rows.translation: 简而言之：这颗星球上最有权势的人会齐聚一堂，银河各地的一些显要人物也会到场。真是拓展人脉的大好机会。
rows.raw: "\n\nIn short: a collection of the planet’s most powerful, and some of the more influential from the galaxy at large, too. Talk about networking opportunities."

rows.original: “Just make sure you wear something nice, smile, and rep the brand, [pc.name]. The company needs all the help it can get in this Rush. We’re doing what we can without a leader, but...”
rows.translation: “只要记得穿得体面些，面带微笑，再替咱们的品牌撑撑场面，[pc.name]。公司需要一切能得到的帮助，才能在这场开拓潮中立足。我们在没有领袖的情况下已经尽力了，可是...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Just make sure you wear something nice, smile, and rep the brand, [pc.name]. The company needs all the help it can get in this Rush. We’re doing what we can without a leader, but...”"

rows.original: Yeah, you know.
rows.translation: 是啊，你明白的。
rows.raw: "\n\nYeah, you know."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “So what’s your role in all this anyway?”
rows.translation: “话说回来，你在这件事里究竟负责什么？”
rows.raw: "“So what’s your role in all this anyway?”"

rows.original: “Me?” Darius asks back, looking behind himself as if there’s someone back there you’d rather be questioning. “Ah, well, I’m what you’d call a risk assessment specialist. I’m down here surveying the worst this planet has to offer, to make sure it’s nothing we can’t handle - and to make sure we’re ready for whatever the planet has to throw at us. That’s why I’ve got these beauties with me, cuz I’m surveying the worst of the worst.”
rows.translation: “我？”达里厄斯反问道，还回头看了看，仿佛他身后有个你更想询问的人。“啊，这个嘛，我就是你们所说的风险评估专家。我在下面调查这颗星球最糟糕的一面，确认没有什么是我们应付不了的，也确保无论这颗星球使出什么手段，我们都做好了准备。所以我才带着这几位美人，因为我调查的可是最危险的地方。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Me?” Darius asks back, looking behind himself as if there’s someone back there you’d rather be questioning. “Ah, well, I’m what you’d call a risk assessment specialist. I’m down here surveying the worst this planet has to offer, to make sure it’s nothing we can’t handle - and to make sure we’re ready for whatever the planet has to throw at us. That’s why I’ve got these beauties with me, cuz I’m surveying the worst of the worst.”"

rows.original: “Seems strange a risk assessor would have this invite,” you say, indicating the card.
rows.translation: “风险评估员会拿到这种邀请函，似乎有些奇怪，”你指着卡片说道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Seems strange a risk assessor would have this invite,” you say, indicating the card."

rows.original: Darius shrugs noncommittally. <i>“It’s Steele Tech. Everybody’s like family... especially on a small mission like ours. It’s mostly drones and ‘bots, maybe twenty organics like me bundled up on the ship in orbit. At least until we get permission to start setting up shop. I’m practically the only guy down here, so of course the captain set me up. But I’d much rather see the future top dog
rows.translation: 达里厄斯不置可否地耸耸肩。<i>“这里可是斯蒂尔科技。大家都像一家人...尤其是在我们这种小规模任务中。轨道上的飞船里大多是无人机和机器人，像我这样的有机体大概只有二十个。至少在我们获准落地开展业务之前是这样。我几乎是唯一待在下面的人，所以船长当然就把邀请函交给我了。不过比起我自己，我更希望未来的掌权者
rows.raw: "\n\nDarius shrugs noncommittally. <i>“It’s Steele Tech. Everybody’s like family... especially on a small mission like ours. It’s mostly drones and ‘bots, maybe twenty organics like me bundled up on the ship in orbit. At least until we get permission to start setting up shop. I’m practically the only guy down here, so of course the captain set me up. But I’d much rather see the future top dog"

rows.original: “Thanks,” you say, pocketing the invite card. “I guess I’ll have to check it out.”
rows.translation: “谢谢，”你说着把邀请卡装进口袋。“看来我得去瞧瞧了。”
rows.raw: "“Thanks,” you say, pocketing the invite card. “I guess I’ll have to check it out.”"

rows.original: “Great! That’s great,” Darius grins. “The party’s starting soon, so find yourself some fancy threads and get a ride on up there. Just tell any driver you want to go to the party and they’ll know. It’s gonna be big, [pc.name]!”
rows.translation: “太好了！这可太好了，”达里厄斯咧嘴笑道。“宴会很快就要开始了，去给自己找身体面的衣服，再搭车上去吧。随便告诉哪个司机你要去参加宴会，他们都会知道地方。这场面肯定小不了，[pc.name]！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Great! That’s great,” Darius grins. “The party’s starting soon, so find yourself some fancy threads and get a ride on up there. Just tell any driver you want to go to the party and they’ll know. It’s gonna be big, [pc.name]!”"

rows.original: “Meanwhile,” he continues, glancing past you, “I’ve got about a thousand pages of reports and ten times as many holo-vids to take back to the ship. Have fun at the shindig!”
rows.translation: “至于我嘛，”他越过你朝后望了一眼，继续说道，“还有大约一千页报告和十倍于此的全息录像要带回飞船。祝你在宴会上玩得开心！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Meanwhile,” he continues, glancing past you, “I’ve got about a thousand pages of reports and ten times as many holo-vids to take back to the ship. Have fun at the shindig!”"

rows.original: One of his guards sighs, “Are we finally leaving?”
rows.translation: 他的一名护卫叹了口气。“我们终于能走了吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of his guards sighs, “Are we finally leaving?”"

rows.original: The other hefts her heavy gun onto her shoulder and stamps out a sweet-smelling cigar she’d just lit a moment past. “Aw, I was liking the eye candy.”
rows.translation: 另一名护卫将重枪扛上肩头，踩灭了片刻前才点燃的香甜雪茄。“啊，我还挺喜欢这养眼的美人呢。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe other hefts her heavy gun onto her shoulder and stamps out a sweet-smelling cigar she’d just lit a moment past. “Aw, I was liking the eye candy.”"

rows.original: “Ladies, please,” Darius says, starting to walk past you. “Let’s leave Captain Steele to [pc.hisHer] preparations. It’s going to be a wild enough time without us!”
rows.translation: “女士们，别这样，”达里厄斯说着开始从你身旁走过。“让斯蒂尔船长自行做好[pc.hisHer]准备吧。即便没有我们，那边也肯定会热闹非凡！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ladies, please,” Darius says, starting to walk past you. “Let’s leave Captain Steele to [pc.hisHer] preparations. It’s going to be a wild enough time without us!”"

rows.translation: 两个扎伊卡打手叹了口气，跟在他身后，很快便消失在街道的阴影中。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zaika thugs sigh and follow on behind, and they quickly fade from view in the shadows of the streets."

rows.original: A trio of large zaika wearing polished, tastefully-branded zaibatsu armor - one for each of the three - approach you with courteous smiles. “Invitation?” one of them challenges, while the other two glance disdainfully at the taxi you just came out of. The danger-senses you’ve hard-won by now over the last several planets in the Rush leaves you with the uneasy sensation that if you don’t produce, you’re going to end up thrown off the edge of this platform. So many rich and famous folks gathered in one place demands ruthless security, right?
rows.translation: 三名身材高大的扎伊卡人身穿锃亮的财阀护甲，上面的品牌标识雅致得体，三人恰好各代表一家财阀。她们带着礼貌的微笑向你走来。“邀请函？”其中一人用质问的口气说道，另外两人则鄙夷地瞥向你刚刚下来的出租车。经历过行星开拓潮中的好几颗星球后，你好不容易磨炼出的危险直觉让你产生一种不安的感觉：要是拿不出邀请函，你恐怕会被直接扔下这座平台的边缘。这么多富豪名流齐聚一堂，安保当然得冷酷无情，对吧？
rows.raw: "A trio of large zaika wearing polished, tastefully-branded zaibatsu armor - one for each of the three - approach you with courteous smiles. “Invitation?” one of them challenges, while the other two glance disdainfully at the taxi you just came out of. The danger-senses you’ve hard-won by now over the last several planets in the Rush leaves you with the uneasy sensation that if you don’t produce, you’re going to end up thrown off the edge of this platform. So many rich and famous folks gathered in one place demands ruthless security, right?"

rows.original: Lucky you, you’ve got the invitation Darius gave you, and you flash it for the three big security goons. The leader gives it an incredulous look-over, passing it under a scanning device before snorting under her breath and handing it back. “Welcome to the party of the century, Captain Steele. Go right inside.”
rows.translation: 幸好达里厄斯给你的邀请函就在身上，你将它亮给三个高大的安保打手。为首者难以置信地来回打量了一番，又把邀请函放到扫描设备下扫过，随后低声哼了一下，将它还给你。“欢迎参加这场世纪宴会，斯蒂尔船长。请直接进去吧。”
rows.raw: "\n\nLucky you, you’ve got the invitation Darius gave you, and you flash it for the three big security goons. The leader gives it an incredulous look-over, passing it under a scanning device before snorting under her breath and handing it back. “Welcome to the party of the century, Captain Steele. Go right inside.”"

rows.original: The leader says something into her wrist as the group withdraws, leaving you to your own devices. By the time you’ve walked the length of the landing strip to the vaulted doors leading into the pyramid, a loudspeaker announces your arrival: “Announcing Captain [pc.name] Steele, heir apparent to Steele Industrial Technology and Production!”
rows.translation: 这群人退开、任你自行行动时，为首者对着手腕说了些什么。等你走过整条着陆带，来到通往金字塔内部的拱形大门前，扩音器宣布了你的到来：“有请斯蒂尔工业科技与生产公司的法定继承人，[pc.name]·斯蒂尔船长！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe leader says something into her wrist as the group withdraws, leaving you to your own devices. By the time you’ve walked the length of the landing strip to the vaulted doors leading into the pyramid, a loudspeaker announces your arrival: “Announcing Captain [pc.name] Steele, heir apparent to Steele Industrial Technology and Production!”"

rows.original: You stride through the doors and into a wide-open chamber, bigger than most stadiums and decorated just as luxuriously as any quadrillionaire’s estate. A huge crystal chandelier hangs from the very peak of the pyramid, casting a thousand, rotating rays of light across the floor. Vast tables of unidentifiable local delicacies are set up around the edges, catered to by a legion of black-dressed servants. A fountain has been set up in the very center of the pyramid, displaying a holographic Zaika wearing what you assume to be a skin-tight astronaut’s suit, bowl-helmet held under one arm and a badge on her shoulder that flickers through the logos of all three Zaibatsu in uniform increments. Dozens of representatives from every zaika-owned company mingle around in semi-homogenous groups, accompanied by several recognizable aliens and mega-corporate uniforms, including several black-and-gold Steele Tech suits.
rows.translation: 你大步穿过门扉，进入一座开阔无比的大厅。这里比大多数体育场还要宽广，装潢的奢华程度丝毫不逊于任何千万亿富豪的庄园。一盏巨大的水晶吊灯悬挂在金字塔尖顶，向地面投下上千道不断旋转的光芒。大厅四周摆着巨大的长桌，上面陈列着你认不出的本地珍馐，由一大群身穿黑衣的仆从负责侍应。金字塔正中央设有一座喷泉，展示着一名扎伊卡人的全息影像。她穿着一套你猜是紧身宇航服的服装，一只手臂夹着圆钵形头盔，肩头徽章则以相等的间隔轮流闪现三家财阀的标志。数十名扎伊卡人旗下各家公司的代表聚成成分大致相同的小群体，在大厅里彼此交际；其间还能看到几个你认得出的外星种族和巨型企业制服，其中包括好几套斯蒂尔科技的黑金制服。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou stride through the doors and into a wide-open chamber, bigger than most stadiums and decorated just as luxuriously as any quadrillionaire’s estate. A huge crystal chandelier hangs from the very peak of the pyramid, casting a thousand, rotating rays of light across the floor. Vast tables of unidentifiable local delicacies are set up around the edges, catered to by a legion of black-dressed servants. A fountain has been set up in the very center of the pyramid, displaying a holographic Zaika wearing what you assume to be a skin-tight astronaut’s suit, bowl-helmet held under one arm and a badge on her shoulder that flickers through the logos of all three Zaibatsu in uniform increments. Dozens of representatives from every zaika-owned company mingle around in semi-homogenous groups, accompanied by several recognizable aliens and mega-corporate uniforms, including several black-and-gold Steele Tech suits."

rows.original: And if your eyes don’t deceive you, you’re pretty sure you see Anno out there, wagging her tail as a pair of tall, lanky zaika rub all over her ears and tail. Already making friends, it seems!
rows.translation: 要是你没有看错，你还相当确定自己在人群里看到了安诺。她正摇着尾巴，任由两个高挑修长的扎伊卡人把她的耳朵和尾巴摸了个遍。看来她已经交上新朋友了！
rows.raw: " And if your eyes don’t deceive you, you’re pretty sure you see Anno out there, wagging her tail as a pair of tall, lanky zaika rub all over her ears and tail. Already making friends, it seems!"

rows.original: Upon your announcement, several interested individuals glance up to see who this so-called heir-apparent is, the heretofore-unknown variable that’s just waltzed into the shindig.
rows.translation: 听到对你的介绍，几个感兴趣的人抬眼望来，想看看这位所谓的法定继承人究竟是谁。这个此前不为人知的变数就这么大摇大摆地闯进了宴会。
rows.raw: "\n\nUpon your announcement, several interested individuals glance up to see who this so-called heir-apparent is, the heretofore-unknown variable that’s just waltzed into the shindig."

The other zaika is much more extravagantly dressed, with huge ruffles and a skirt that’s near as wide around as her arm’s reach, and she’s also clearly had a few drinks.

rows.original: drawls, jabbing a finger at the ausar’s broad chest. “I have invested hundreds of thousands of your - what do you call them, credits? - into that habitation block. Maybe it’s a microbe in the dish to you, but that’s a big investment for me! And now these damn gangers have moved in, and what am I to do? If I pay them to leave, they’ll just come back again, or someone worse will!”
rows.translation: 拖长声音说道，一根手指戳向奥萨尔人宽阔的胸膛。“我往那栋住宅楼里投了几十万你们所谓的那种东西，那东西叫什么来着，信用点？这点钱对你们来说或许只是培养皿里的一颗微生物，可对我而言却是一大笔投资！现在这些该死的帮派分子搬进去了，你让我怎么办？要是我付钱让他们离开，他们肯定还会再回来，不然就是有更糟的人过来！”
rows.raw: " drawls, jabbing a finger at the ausar’s broad chest. “I have invested hundreds of thousands of your - what do you call them, credits? - into that habitation block. Maybe it’s a microbe in the dish to you, but that’s a big investment for me! And now these damn gangers have moved in, and what am I to do? If I pay them to leave, they’ll just come back again, or someone worse will!”"

rows.original: The other elfin woman chortles, shaking her head. “That’s why I’m telling you: you have to turn them from violent squatters into paying customers! Turn some of those apartments into a brothel and a games house and watch these idiot plebs pay for themselves and then some. Just take out a loan from Utopian Skies, and we’ll set you up with everything you need...”
rows.translation: 另一个精灵般的女人摇着头咯咯笑道。“所以我才告诉你：你得把他们从暴力占屋者变成掏钱的顾客！把其中一些公寓改成妓院和游艺场，然后看着这帮白痴贱民不但自己养活自己，还能给你赚上一笔。只要向乌托邦天空公司贷一笔款，我们就会替你备齐所需的一切...”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe other elfin woman chortles, shaking her head. “That’s why I’m telling you: you have to turn them from violent squatters into paying customers! Turn some of those apartments into a brothel and a games house and watch these idiot plebs pay for themselves and then some. Just take out a loan from Utopian Skies, and we’ll set you up with everything you need...”"

rows.translation: 第一个扎伊卡人哼了一声，皱起脸来。“我不知道。我只想把这些人赶走！”

rows.raw: "Squatters’ Rights?"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “You shouldn’t let a bunch of squatters ruin the property,” you tell her reassuringly. “Force is the only thing they’ll understand.”
rows.translation: “你不该任由一群占屋者糟蹋你的房产，”你用安抚的口吻告诉她。“他们只听得懂武力。”
rows.raw: "“You shouldn’t let a bunch of squatters ruin the property,” you tell her reassuringly. “Force is the only thing they’ll understand.”"

rows.original: “See!” the woman says, grabbing your shoulder and giving it a light shake. “This alien knows how to deal with scum. I bet [pc.heShe]’s seen the Gyre first hand!”
rows.translation: “看吧！”女人一把抓住你的肩膀，轻轻晃了晃。“这个外星人知道该怎么对付人渣。我敢说[pc.heShe]肯定亲眼见识过环城！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“See!” the woman says, grabbing your shoulder and giving it a light shake. “This alien knows how to deal with scum. I bet [pc.heShe]’s seen the Gyre first hand!”"

rows.original: The Utopian Skies apologist curls up her nose. “That’s hardly a compliment. Well, do what you want. It’s your money to lose, darling.” She gives her TamaniCorp pup a tug on the arm and leads him off towards another pack of socialites.
rows.translation: 那个替乌托邦天空公司说话的女人皱起鼻子。“这可算不上恭维。好吧，随你便。亲爱的，反正要赔的是你的钱。”她扯了扯塔玛妮公司那条小狗的手臂，领着他朝另一群社会名流走去。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Utopian Skies apologist curls up her nose. “That’s hardly a compliment. Well, do what you want. It’s your money to lose, darling.” She gives her TamaniCorp pup a tug on the arm and leads him off towards another pack of socialites."

rows.original: <i>“Thanks,
rows.translation: <i>“谢谢你，
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Thanks, "

rows.original: handsome
rows.translation: 帅哥
rows.raw: "handsome"

rows.original: beautiful
rows.translation: 美女
rows.raw: "beautiful"

rows.original: ,” the land-owner beams, “I’ll go and get in touch with Paragon, have them send some XOs my way. Maybe I’ll get in touch with - what was it? - Steele Tech? Get in touch with them, see if they’d like a very nice deal on advertising space in my habitation block!”
rows.translation: ，”业主眉开眼笑地说道，“我会去联系典范公司，让他们派几个XO过来。或许我还会联系，叫什么来着？斯蒂尔科技？跟他们谈谈，看他们是否愿意以非常优惠的价格购买我那栋住宅楼里的广告位！”
rows.raw: ",” the land-owner beams, “I’ll go and get in touch with Paragon, have them send some XOs my way. Maybe I’ll get in touch with - what was it? - Steele Tech? Get in touch with them, see if they’d like a very nice deal on advertising space in my habitation block!”"

rows.original: Well, that’s a nice bonus.
rows.translation: 嗯，这倒是个不错的额外收获。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, that’s a nice bonus."

rows.raw: "PARAGON_PP"

rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: PEER_GREEN
rows.raw: "PEER_GREEN"

rows.original: Green Dress Zaika
rows.translation: 绿裙扎伊卡人
rows.raw: "Green Dress Zaika"

rows.original: Squatters’ Rights?
rows.translation: 占屋者的权利？
rows.raw: "Squatters’ Rights?"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “She’s right, you know,” you tell the property owner. “Why try and cause trouble with the gangers when you could be taking their money?”
rows.translation: “其实她说得对，”你告诉那名业主。“既然可以赚走这些帮派分子的钱，何必非要跟他们闹出冲突呢？”
rows.raw: "“She’s right, you know,” you tell the property owner. “Why try and cause trouble with the gangers when you could be taking their money?”"

rows.original: The zaika sighs and knocks back the last of her champagne. “Oh. I suppose you’re right... the damage I could do to the block is way worse than whatever a bunch of gang scum will do. I’ll send out notices when I get back to my estate, have the work crews start converting apartment units into an entertainment plex. I’m sure whoever’s living there would be just as happy turning tricks in a Utopian brothel, after all. What does it matter to a menial what job she has?”
rows.translation: 扎伊卡人叹了口气，一饮而尽杯中剩下的香槟。“哦。我想你说得对...我可能对那栋楼造成的破坏，远比一群帮派人渣能造成的严重。回到庄园后我就发出通知，让施工队开始把公寓单元改造成娱乐中心。反正我相信，住在那里的人去乌托邦的妓院接客也会一样开心。对一个底层劳工来说，做什么工作又有什么区别？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zaika sighs and knocks back the last of her champagne. “Oh. I suppose you’re right... the damage I could do to the block is way worse than whatever a bunch of gang scum will do. I’ll send out notices when I get back to my estate, have the work crews start converting apartment units into an entertainment plex. I’m sure whoever’s living there would be just as happy turning tricks in a Utopian brothel, after all. What does it matter to a menial what job she has?”"

rows.original: “That’s the spirit!” the apologist laughs, patting her new best friend’s shoulder. “Tell you what, sweet-tail, I’ll pull some strings for you, get you a real good deal from the company...”
rows.translation: “就该这样！”那个替公司说话的女人笑道，拍了拍新结识的挚友的肩膀。“这么办吧，甜尾巴，我替你疏通一下关系，从公司那里给你争取一笔真正划算的交易...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s the spirit!” the apologist laughs, patting her new best friend’s shoulder. “Tell you what, sweet-tail, I’ll pull some strings for you, get you a real good deal from the company...”"

rows.original: The apartment-owner turns to you “Thanks for helping me overcome my stubborn streak. I’ll be sure to tell the madame to give any Steele Tech folks that wander in a big friendly discount... the first time!”
rows.translation: 公寓业主转向你。“谢谢你帮我改掉这股顽固劲。我一定会吩咐老鸨，只要有斯蒂尔科技的人走进店里，就给他们一个厚道的超值折扣...仅限第一次！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe apartment-owner turns to you “Thanks for helping me overcome my stubborn streak. I’ll be sure to tell the madame to give any Steele Tech folks that wander in a big friendly discount... the first time!”"

rows.original: Well, you’re sure the company’s staff will appreciate that.
rows.translation: 嗯，你相信公司的员工一定会很感激她的好意。
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you’re sure the company’s staff will appreciate that."

rows.original: UTOPIAN_PP
rows.raw: "UTOPIAN_PP"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: PEER_BLUE
rows.raw: "PEER_BLUE"

rows.original: Blue Dress Zaika
rows.translation: 蓝裙扎伊卡人
rows.raw: "Blue Dress Zaika"

rows.original: Adventures? Adventures!
rows.translation: 冒险？冒险！
rows.raw: "Adventures? Adventures!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: A group of excited-looking zaika approach you, giggling and prodding at each other as they come. They’re younger than most of the other attendees, perhaps daughters of some of the wealthy and powerful, and the way they’re staring wide-eyed at you, it’s not a stretch to think that you’re the first alien they’ve ever seen up close.
rows.translation: 一群神色兴奋的扎伊卡人向你走来，一路咯咯笑着，彼此推搡。她们比大多数其他来宾年轻，或许是某些权贵人家的女儿。看她们睁大眼睛盯着你的样子，完全有理由相信你是她们第一次近距离见到的外星人。
rows.raw: "A group of excited-looking zaika approach you, giggling and prodding at each other as they come. They’re younger than most of the other attendees, perhaps daughters of some of the wealthy and powerful, and the way they’re staring wide-eyed at you, it’s not a stretch to think that you’re the first alien they’ve ever seen up close."

rows.original: Finally, one of them works up the courage to actually speak directly to you: <i>“You’re [pc.name], aren’t you?
rows.translation: 终于，其中一人鼓起勇气，直接开口同你说话：<i>“你就是[pc.name]，对吧？
rows.raw: "\n\nFinally, one of them works up the courage to actually speak directly to you: <i>“You’re [pc.name], aren’t you?"

rows.original: The one that saved that alien planet from space pirates?
rows.translation: 就是从太空海盗手中拯救了那颗外星星球的人？
rows.raw: " The one that saved that alien planet from space pirates?"

rows.original: Are they talking about Tarkus? You didn’t think that story had gotten out, much less to another Rush world.
rows.translation: 她们说的是塔克斯吗？你都没想到那件事已经传开，更别说传到另一颗开拓潮星球上了。
rows.raw: "\n\nAre they talking about Tarkus? You didn’t think that story had gotten out, much less to another Rush world."

rows.original: The one that defeated the bug-people queen in single combat!”
rows.translation: 就是那个在单挑中击败虫人女王的人！”
rows.raw: " The one that defeated the bug-people queen in single combat!”"

rows.original: They mean Taivra? How in the world did that story get out, much less to Dhaal of all places?
rows.translation: 她们指的是泰芙拉？那件事究竟是怎么传出去的，更别说偏偏还传到了达尔？
rows.raw: "\n\nThey mean Taivra? How in the world did that story get out, much less to Dhaal of all places?"

rows.original: “One of my moms is in deep negotiations with Steele Tech,” another of the girls chimes in. “Your zaibatsu is so proud of you!”
rows.translation: “我的一位妈妈正在跟斯蒂尔科技进行深入谈判，”另一个姑娘插嘴道。“你们财阀可为你骄傲了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“One of my moms is in deep negotiations with Steele Tech,” another of the girls chimes in. “Your zaibatsu is so proud of you!”"

rows.original: “They don’t call them zaibatsu,” another insists. “They’re corporations.”
rows.translation: “他们不把那些叫作财阀，”另一个姑娘坚持纠正道。“那叫公司。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“They don’t call them zaibatsu,” another insists. “They’re corporations.”"

rows.original: “Ugh, what’s the difference?”
rows.translation: “呃，有什么区别？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ugh, what’s the difference?”"

rows.original: You aren’t sure yourself. Is there one? The idea seems to be the same: extremely powerful corporate entities whose tendrils reach into all kinds of subsidiaries and different businesses.
rows.translation: 你自己也说不准。真的有区别吗？概念似乎完全一样：权势滔天的企业实体将触手伸进各类子公司和不同业务之中。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou aren’t sure yourself. Is there one? The idea seems to be the same: extremely powerful corporate entities whose tendrils reach into all kinds of subsidiaries and different businesses."

rows.original: The zaika girls giggle. “Yeah, that’s it. See, we’re all basically the same.”
rows.translation: 扎伊卡姑娘们咯咯笑了起来。“对，就是这样。看吧，我们基本上都一样。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zaika girls giggle. “Yeah, that’s it. See, we’re all basically the same.”"

rows.original: “That’s so cool!”
rows.translation: “这太酷了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s so cool!”"

rows.original: “You’re cool! Tell us about your adventures, huh?” one of them pleads, grabbing a pair of drinks off a server’s tray. “We want to hear what it’s like beyond the stars.”
rows.translation: “你才酷呢！给我们讲讲你的冒险，好不好？”其中一人央求道，同时从侍者的托盘上取下两杯饮料。“我们想听听群星之外是什么样子。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You’re cool! Tell us about your adventures, huh?” one of them pleads, grabbing a pair of drinks off a server’s tray. “We want to hear what it’s like beyond the stars.”"

rows.original: Well, you are here to make an impression, after all. What kind of stories do you want to tell them, though?
rows.translation: 好吧，毕竟你来这里就是为了给人留下印象。不过，你想给她们讲哪一类故事？
rows.raw: "\n\nWell, you are here to make an impression, after all. What kind of stories do you want to tell them, though?"

rows.original: Sexy
rows.translation: 性感
rows.raw: "Sexy"

rows.original: Sexy
rows.translation: 性感
rows.raw: "Sexy"

rows.original: Tell these girls about all the encounters you’ve had with the sexy species of the 14th Rush.
rows.translation: 给这些姑娘讲讲你与第十四次开拓潮中那些性感种族的种种艳遇。
rows.raw: "Tell these girls about all the encounters you’ve had with the sexy species of the 14th Rush."

rows.original: Violent
rows.translation: 暴力冒险
rows.raw: "Violent"

rows.original: Violent
rows.translation: 暴力冒险
rows.raw: "Violent"

rows.original: Tell them about your swashbuckling adventures across the frontier.
rows.translation: 给她们讲讲你在边疆各地那些刀光剑影的豪侠冒险。
rows.raw: "Tell them about your swashbuckling adventures across the frontier."

rows.original: Party
rows.translation: 派对
rows.raw: "Party"

rows.original: Party
rows.translation: 派对
rows.raw: "Party"

rows.original: You’ve come across all kinds of transformations and body mods. The galaxy seems like a drug-fueled TF-bender.
rows.translation: 你见识过各种各样的变形和身体改造。整个银河简直像一场由药物催动、以变形为主题的疯狂狂欢。
rows.raw: "You’ve come across all kinds of transformations and body mods. The galaxy seems like a drug-fueled TF-bender."

rows.raw: "PEER_BLUE"

rows.original: Blue Dress Zaika
rows.translation: 蓝裙扎伊卡人
rows.raw: "Blue Dress Zaika"

rows.original: Adventures? Adventures!
rows.translation: 冒险？冒险！
rows.raw: "Adventures? Adventures!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You give the girls a saucy smirk and settle in to tell them about the weirdest and most wonderful fucks in the galaxy - from the plant-women half buried in the Mhen’gan soil to the sex-fueled goos of Tarkus and the warring ant-amazons of Myrellion.
rows.translation: 你向姑娘们露出一个放荡的坏笑，安下心来，开始讲述银河中最古怪也最美妙的性爱经历，从半埋在门加土壤里的植物女人，到塔库斯那些以性爱为动力的黏液生物，再到米瑞利昂彼此交战的蚁族女战士。
rows.raw: "You give the girls a saucy smirk and settle in to tell them about the weirdest and most wonderful fucks in the galaxy - from the plant-women half buried in the Mhen’gan soil to the sex-fueled goos of Tarkus and the warring ant-amazons of Myrellion. "

rows.original: Korgonne
rows.raw: "Korgonne"

rows.original: Milodan
rows.raw: "Milodan"

rows.original: Of course, you can’t count out the thick-set dogs and cats all over the snow-swept plains of Uveto.
rows.translation: 当然，也不能漏掉乌维托风雪平原上随处可见的健壮犬族和猫族。
rows.raw: " Of course, you can’t count out the thick-set dogs and cats all over the snow-swept plains of Uveto."

rows.original: You don’t know if you’d call Zhèng Shi a world, but it certainly contained more than its share of exotic beauties as well.
rows.translation: 你不知道是否该把郑石称作一个世界，但那里奇异美人的数量也绝对远超应有的份额。
rows.raw: " You don’t know if you’d call Zhèng Shi a world, but it certainly contained more than its share of exotic beauties as well."

rows.original: And then there’s the taur-heavy world of Vesperia...
rows.translation: 还有那个遍布兽身人的世界，维斯佩里亚...
rows.raw: " And then there’s the taur-heavy world of Vesperia..."

rows.original: By the time you’re done explaining the lurid wonders of the galaxy, several of the zaika have expanded their chests, swelling with seed, and a couple are rubbing their tail-crowns on their thighs.
rows.translation: 等你讲完银河中这些淫靡奇观，几个扎伊卡人的胸膛已经因精种充盈而膨胀起来，还有两人正用尾冠摩擦自己的大腿。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time you’re done explaining the lurid wonders of the galaxy, several of the zaika have expanded their chests, swelling with seed, and a couple are rubbing their tail-crowns on their thighs."

rows.original: “The galaxy sure sounds like fun!” one of them titters.
rows.translation: “银河听起来可真有意思！”其中一人窃笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“The galaxy sure sounds like fun!” one of them titters."

rows.original: Another pushes herself up close to you, coiling her tail around your waist. “But our world’s plenty fun, too, you know...”
rows.translation: 另一个姑娘紧贴着挤到你身旁，将尾巴缠上你的腰。“不过你知道，我们的世界也很好玩哦...”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother pushes herself up close to you, coiling her tail around your waist. “But our world’s plenty fun, too, you know...”"

rows.original: The rest of her gaggle drag her off, thanking you for the imagination-fuel as they depart in search of more booze.
rows.translation: 她那群同伴把她拖走了，临行前还感谢你为她们的幻想添了把火，随后便去寻找更多酒水。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe rest of her gaggle drag her off, thanking you for the imagination-fuel as they depart in search of more booze."

rows.original: Adventures? Adventures!
rows.translation: 冒险？冒险！
rows.raw: "Adventures? Adventures!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: It’s been a series of fights to the death (or to the little death, more often than not) ever since you joined the Planet Rush, so you choose to tell the zaika girls all about your swashbuckling interstellar adventures: from ducking your cousin’s gunship on Mhen’ga, to fighting the pirate crew in the heart of Tarkus, to assaulting Queen Taivra’s palace deep below Myrellion and the pirate fortress of Zhèng Shi. The latter two are particularly thrilling to the pointy-eared debutantes, who cling to your every word.
rows.translation: 自从加入行星开拓潮，你便经历了一连串生死搏斗（不过更多时候是性高潮意义上的‘小死’），于是你决定给扎伊卡姑娘们讲述自己那些英勇潇洒的星际冒险：从在门加躲避表亲的炮艇，到在塔库斯腹地迎战海盗船员，再到突袭米瑞利昂地下深处的泰芙拉女王宫殿，以及郑石的海盗堡垒。后两段经历尤其令这些尖耳朵的初入社交场少女兴奋，她们全神贯注地听着你的每一句话。
rows.raw: "It’s been a series of fights to the death (or to the little death, more often than not) ever since you joined the Planet Rush, so you choose to tell the zaika girls all about your swashbuckling interstellar adventures: from ducking your cousin’s gunship on Mhen’ga, to fighting the pirate crew in the heart of Tarkus, to assaulting Queen Taivra’s palace deep below Myrellion and the pirate fortress of Zhèng Shi. The latter two are particularly thrilling to the pointy-eared debutantes, who cling to your every word."

rows.original: Plus there’s your heroic rescue of the korgonne stronghold from the milodan conquerors.
rows.translation: 此外，你还英勇地从米洛丹征服者手中拯救了科尔贡要塞。
rows.raw: " Plus there’s your heroic rescue of the korgonne stronghold from the milodan conquerors."

rows.original: And how could you forget your daring rescue of a beautiful bitch-kitty from deadly pirates?
rows.translation: 还有，你怎么可能忘记自己从致命海盗手中勇救一位美丽犬猫姑娘的壮举？
rows.raw: " And how could you forget your daring rescue of a beautiful bitch-kitty from deadly pirates?"

rows.original: Your rooftop battle with Dread Lord Amara, of course, was the stuff of legends as well!
rows.translation: 当然，你与恐怖领主阿玛拉在屋顶上的决战同样堪称传奇！
rows.raw: " Your rooftop battle with Dread Lord Amara, of course, was the stuff of legends as well!"

rows.original: Before you’re done, you feel like you’re some ancient bard, recounting tales of glory to a captive audience.
rows.translation: 还没讲完，你便觉得自己仿佛成了古代吟游诗人，正向一群听得入迷的观众讲述荣耀传说。
rows.raw: "\n\nBefore you’re done, you feel like you’re some ancient bard, recounting tales of glory to a captive audience."

rows.original: “Woah, you space-folk are more badass than the Paragon Paragons!”
rows.translation: “哇，你们这些太空人比典范公司的典范英雄还厉害！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Woah, you space-folk are more badass than the Paragon Paragons!”"

rows.original: “And they’re made up!” another adds helpfully. “But [pc.name] Steele is the real deal!”
rows.translation: “而且他们还是虚构的！”另一个姑娘好心补充道。“可[pc.name]·斯蒂尔是真正的英雄！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And they’re made up!” another adds helpfully. “But [pc.name] Steele is the real deal!”"

rows.original: A third purrs, “You’re so brave and tough. It’s very sexy...”
rows.translation: 第三个姑娘娇声说道：“你又勇敢又强悍。实在太性感了...”
rows.raw: "\n\nA third purrs, “You’re so brave and tough. It’s very sexy...”"

rows.original: “Behave!” her companions tease, pulling her away.
rows.translation: “矜持点！”她的同伴们一边取笑，一边把她拉走。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Behave!” her companions tease, pulling her away."

rows.original: “Thanks for the stories. Maybe I’ll get my mom to make a movie out of one!”
rows.translation: “谢谢你讲这些故事。说不定我会让妈妈挑一个拍成电影！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Thanks for the stories. Maybe I’ll get my mom to make a movie out of one!”"

rows.original: Wonder if they’ll get a zaika to play you?
rows.translation: 不知道她们会不会找个扎伊卡人来扮演你？
rows.raw: "\n\nWonder if they’ll get a zaika to play you?"

rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: There’s been a non-stop cavalcade of sexy creatures and ultraviolence since you set off on this Planet Rush, but what’s really burned itself into your mind - at least as far as you want to tell a bunch of debutantes - has been the drugs and partying. The way they giggle and nod, you know they know what you’re talking about. The girls grab a couple more drinks and push one that smells delightfully fruity into your hand, pleading for you to tell them about how “you aliens” do drugs and drink. This planet has its share of cosmetic cybernetics, but even the upper crust haven’t been quite so exposed to the at-will, bargain-basement personal gene-mods that have become so pedestrian in the Confederacy. Back where you’re from, all it takes is a little syringe or a pill (or even some candy or fruit) and you can become almost any race that’s ever been encountered, and even some that are just made up. Your own dad was basically a pioneer in the art of turning himself into all sorts of things, spending time in every combination of race and gender to experience all the galaxy has to offer.
rows.translation: 自从踏上这次行星开拓潮，你便接连不断地遇到性感生物与极端暴力，不过真正烙印在你脑海里的经历，至少是你愿意讲给一群初入社交场的少女听的部分，还是那些药物和狂欢。从她们咯咯发笑、连连点头的样子来看，你知道她们很明白你在说什么。姑娘们又拿了几杯饮料，还把一杯散发着诱人果香的饮品塞进你手里，央求你讲讲“你们外星人”如何嗑药喝酒。这颗星球也有不少美容义体，但即便是上流阶层，也没怎么接触过邦联里已经司空见惯、可以随意使用又便宜到不值一提的个人基因改造。在你的家乡，只需一支小小的注射器或一颗药丸（甚至一块糖或一枚水果），便能变成几乎任何一种曾被发现的种族，乃至一些纯属虚构的种族。你的父亲基本算是将自己变成各种事物这门艺术的先驱，他曾以各种种族与性别组合生活，以此体验银河所能提供的一切。
rows.raw: "There’s been a non-stop cavalcade of sexy creatures and ultraviolence since you set off on this Planet Rush, but what’s really burned itself into your mind - at least as far as you want to tell a bunch of debutantes - has been the drugs and partying. The way they giggle and nod, you know they know what you’re talking about. The girls grab a couple more drinks and push one that smells delightfully fruity into your hand, pleading for you to tell them about how “you aliens” do drugs and drink. This planet has its share of cosmetic cybernetics, but even the upper crust haven’t been quite so exposed to the at-will, bargain-basement personal gene-mods that have become so pedestrian in the Confederacy. Back where you’re from, all it takes is a little syringe or a pill (or even some candy or fruit) and you can become almost any race that’s ever been encountered, and even some that are just made up. Your own dad was basically a pioneer in the art of turning himself into all sorts of things, spending time in every combination of race and gender to experience all the galaxy has to offer."

rows.original: “Ohh, we were offered some of those ‘gene-mods’ by the Xenogen Corporation,” one of the zaika muses. “Maybe we should take them after all.”
rows.translation: “哦，异源生物科技公司给我们提供过一些那种‘基因改造剂’，”其中一个扎伊卡人若有所思地说道。“或许我们终究应该接受。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ohh, we were offered some of those ‘gene-mods’ by the Xenogen Corporation,” one of the zaika muses. “Maybe we should take them after all.”"

rows.original: “Xenogen?” another giggles. “It was one of the diplomatic aids for me. Wanted to give me something called ‘Throbb’ so he could watch me fill my own tail!”
rows.translation: “异源生物科技？”另一个姑娘咯咯笑道。“找我的是一名外交助理。他想给我一种叫‘悸动剂’的东西，好亲眼看我把自己的尾巴灌满！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Xenogen?” another giggles. “It was one of the diplomatic aids for me. Wanted to give me something called ‘Throbb’ so he could watch me fill my own tail!”"

rows.original: A couple of the others gasp and complain about her language, but all of them end up giggling.
rows.translation: 另外两人倒吸一口气，埋怨她说话粗俗，可最后所有人都咯咯笑了起来。
rows.raw: "\n\nA couple of the others gasp and complain about her language, but all of them end up giggling."

rows.original: “I heard some aliens drooling over something called ‘Gush’ and how it made their genitals wetter than water. Maybe I should dump some down my tail...”
rows.translation: “我听见几个外星人垂涎一种叫‘喷涌’的东西，说它能让生殖器湿得比水还厉害。或许我该往尾巴里倒一点...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I heard some aliens drooling over something called ‘Gush’ and how it made their genitals wetter than water. Maybe I should dump some down my tail...”"

rows.original: “And there was something called Equinum! What’s an Equine though?”
rows.translation: “还有一种东西叫‘马化素’！不过‘马化’是什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And there was something called Equinum! What’s an Equine though?”"

rows.original: As the zaika descend into discussing the merits of various transformations they’ve half-understood, you can’t help wondering what kind of cosseted chimeras will be fucking their way through the planet’s high society tomorrow.
rows.translation: 扎伊卡姑娘们开始讨论自己只理解了一半的各种变形改造有什么优点，你不禁好奇，明天会有怎样一群娇生惯养的嵌合怪物一路操进这颗星球的上流社会。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs the zaika descend into discussing the merits of various transformations they’ve half-understood, you can’t help wondering what kind of cosseted chimeras will be fucking their way through the planet’s high society tomorrow."
