rows.original: You feel a gentle tap on your shoulder, and when you turn around, you’re greeted by the sight of a woman much larger and more imposing than any of the zaika you’ve seen thus far. She’s a gryvain, well over seven feet tall before you account for her rack of horns and quartet of draconic wings. Jewels and chains hang from her frilled ears and horns, creating a web-like crown around her brow that catches the light in hypnotic ways.
rows.translation: 你感觉有人轻轻拍了拍自己的肩膀。转过身后，映入眼帘的是一个比你迄今见过的任何扎伊卡人都更加高大、更具威势的女人。她是格里文人，即便不算头顶的一簇犄角和四扇龙翼，身高也远超七英尺。珠宝与链饰悬挂在她带褶边的耳朵和犄角上，在额头周围交织成网状冠冕，以令人迷醉的方式捕捉着光芒。
rows.raw: "You feel a gentle tap on your shoulder, and when you turn around, you’re greeted by the sight of a woman much larger and more imposing than any of the zaika you’ve seen thus far. She’s a gryvain, well over seven feet tall before you account for her rack of horns and quartet of draconic wings. Jewels and chains hang from her frilled ears and horns, creating a web-like crown around her brow that catches the light in hypnotic ways."

rows.original: There’s a genial smile on her dark green lips, accompanied by a shallow bow. “Peace upon you, Captain Steele. I bring you greetings in the name of the Gryvain Heartland Republic.”
rows.translation: 她深绿色的嘴唇挂着亲切的微笑，同时微微鞠了一躬。“愿和平与你同在，斯蒂尔船长。我谨代表格里文腹地共和国向你致以问候。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a genial smile on her dark green lips, accompanied by a shallow bow. “Peace upon you, Captain Steele. I bring you greetings in the name of the Gryvain Heartland Republic.”"

rows.original: half-gryvain
rows.raw: "half-gryvain"

rows.original: “Serenity surround you,” you answer back, just as your mother taught you. The woman’s smile spreads, just a touch, before she rises.
rows.translation: “愿安宁环绕着你，”你按照母亲教过的方式回应。女人的笑容稍稍舒展开来，随后直起身子。
rows.raw: "“Serenity surround you,” you answer back, just as your mother taught you. The woman’s smile spreads, just a touch, before she rises."

rows.original: “Uh, peace to you too, miss,” you grin, watching her rise.
rows.translation: “呃，也愿和平与你同在，女士，”你咧嘴笑着，看她直起身子。
rows.raw: "“Uh, peace to you too, miss,” you grin, watching her rise."

rows.original: “Hello,” you answer back awkwardly. You get the feeling this woman is important and powerful. A little chuckle breaks her grin as she rises.
rows.translation: “你好，”你尴尬地回应。你感觉这个女人既重要又有权势。她直起身子时，脸上的笑容化作一声轻笑。
rows.raw: "“Hello,” you answer back awkwardly. You get the feeling this woman is important and powerful. A little chuckle breaks her grin as she rises."

rows.original: “I am Ambassador Elyrrin,” she says, smoothing out the front of the black dress draping down from her shoulders. It’s belted at the waist so that her large breasts don’t leave it hanging off her, and like her horns, her clothes are richly adorned with precious stones and golden chains hanging down past her knees. “It’s a pleasure to see you again.”
rows.translation: “我是埃莉琳大使，”她一边说，一边抚平从肩头垂下的黑色长裙前襟。裙子在腰间束紧，以免被她丰满的乳房撑得悬在身前；她的衣服和犄角一样缀满宝石与金链，华贵的链饰一直垂过膝盖。“很高兴再次见到你。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am Ambassador Elyrrin,” she says, smoothing out the front of the black dress draping down from her shoulders. It’s belted at the waist so that her large breasts don’t leave it hanging off her, and like her horns, her clothes are richly adorned with precious stones and golden chains hanging down past her knees. “It’s a pleasure to see you again.”"

rows.original: “Again?” you ask, racking your brain.
rows.translation: “再次？”你绞尽脑汁地回想起来。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Again?” you ask, racking your brain."

rows.original: She chuckles softly. “Indeed! Don’t fret, I can hardly expect you to remember someone you met in passing as a small child. Dhaal is not the first time I’ve had the pleasure of working alongside Steele Tech on terraforming projects; your company invested heavily in a Republic world called Oruun, gaining exclusive mining rights while financing the introduction of atmospheric processors. It made a truly beautiful, lush world habitable for both our peoples. I’m glad to say I still own an estate there to this day.”
rows.translation: 她轻声笑了笑。“确实如此！别担心，我也不能指望你记得幼年时匆匆见过的一个人。达尔并不是我第一次有幸与斯蒂尔科技合作行星改造项目；贵公司曾大举投资共和国一个名叫奥鲁恩的世界，在出资引进大气处理器的同时取得了独家采矿权。这项工程让一个真正美丽而葱郁的世界变得适合我们双方的人民居住。很高兴地说，直到今天，我在那里仍有一座庄园。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe chuckles softly. “Indeed! Don’t fret, I can hardly expect you to remember someone you met in passing as a small child. Dhaal is not the first time I’ve had the pleasure of working alongside Steele Tech on terraforming projects; your company invested heavily in a Republic world called Oruun, gaining exclusive mining rights while financing the introduction of atmospheric processors. It made a truly beautiful, lush world habitable for both our peoples. I’m glad to say I still own an estate there to this day.”"

rows.original: “Oh, of course.” You can’t place the curvey dragon-woman for the life of you, but the planet name’s familiar at least. “You said you’re terraforming Dhaal, too?”
rows.translation: “哦，当然。”你无论如何也想不起这位曲线丰盈的龙女是谁，不过至少对那颗行星的名字有些印象。“你刚才说，你们也在改造达尔？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, of course.” You can’t place the curvey dragon-woman for the life of you, but the planet name’s familiar at least. “You said you’re terraforming Dhaal, too?”"

rows.original: “The Republic is exploring the possibility. Tidally locked worlds are a unique challenge, due to the extremes of the polar and solar regions, but one of the Zaibatsu has given us an invitation to begin surveying. Unfortunately, there’s no unified government on Dhaal for us to communicate with, which makes moving forward with any potential world-spanning project... problematic. My friends at Steele Tech have mentioned much the same roadblock confronting their mining operations. it is my sincere hope that, as the Dhaal situation progresses, the Republic and Steele Tech can move forward together for our mutual benefit.”
rows.translation: “共和国正在探索这种可能性。由于背阳区与向阳区的极端环境，潮汐锁定的世界会带来独特挑战，不过其中一家财阀已经邀请我们开始勘测。遗憾的是，达尔没有统一政府可供我们交涉，这使得任何可能遍及全球的项目都很难推进...问题重重。我在斯蒂尔科技的朋友提到，他们的采矿业务也面临着几乎相同的障碍。我衷心希望，随着达尔局势发展，共和国和斯蒂尔科技能够携手前进，实现互惠互利。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The Republic is exploring the possibility. Tidally locked worlds are a unique challenge, due to the extremes of the polar and solar regions, but one of the Zaibatsu has given us an invitation to begin surveying. Unfortunately, there’s no unified government on Dhaal for us to communicate with, which makes moving forward with any potential world-spanning project... problematic. My friends at Steele Tech have mentioned much the same roadblock confronting their mining operations. it is my sincere hope that, as the Dhaal situation progresses, the Republic and Steele Tech can move forward together for our mutual benefit.”"

rows.original: Hey, making Dhaal more habitable would be in everyone’s best interest, wouldn’t it? Though you have to ask: “What does the Republic get out of terraforming a place like this?”
rows.translation: 嘿，让达尔更适宜居住符合所有人的最大利益，对吧？不过你还是得问一句：“共和国改造这种地方，能从中得到什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHey, making Dhaal more habitable would be in everyone’s best interest, wouldn’t it? Though you have to ask: “What does the Republic get out of terraforming a place like this?”"

rows.original: “A good question,” Elyrrin says, taking a pair of wine glasses from a passing serving-girl and passing one off to you. “The short answer is that the Republic is always interested in colonial space. While we are a member state of the Confederacy, we are also a self-interested nation. We gryvain reproduce quickly and live long lives, and we developed our terraforming speciality so that we needn’t compete against anyone for living space. We make our own. The Republic is exploring an agreement with one of the Dhaal zaibatsu - Bright Water - to colonize one half of the planet and leave the other half for their own settlement. Only too late, we discovered that the other two corporations won’t speak to us while we’re in negotiations with the Bright Water leadership. It’s most troublesome.”
rows.translation: “问得好，”埃莉琳说道，从路过的侍女那里取来两杯葡萄酒，将其中一杯递给你。“简单来说，共和国始终对殖民空间感兴趣。虽然我们是邦联的成员国，但也是一个追求自身利益的国家。我们格里文人繁衍迅速而且寿命漫长，发展行星改造专长，正是为了不必同任何人争夺生存空间。我们会自己创造空间。共和国正在考虑同达尔的一家财阀，也就是澄水，达成协议，由我们殖民星球的一半，另一半留给他们建立自己的聚居地。可惜我们直到太晚才发现，只要还在与澄水高层谈判，另外两家公司就拒绝与我们交流。实在令人头疼。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A good question,” Elyrrin says, taking a pair of wine glasses from a passing serving-girl and passing one off to you. “The short answer is that the Republic is always interested in colonial space. While we are a member state of the Confederacy, we are also a self-interested nation. We gryvain reproduce quickly and live long lives, and we developed our terraforming speciality so that we needn’t compete against anyone for living space. We make our own. The Republic is exploring an agreement with one of the Dhaal zaibatsu - Bright Water - to colonize one half of the planet and leave the other half for their own settlement. Only too late, we discovered that the other two corporations won’t speak to us while we’re in negotiations with the Bright Water leadership. It’s most troublesome.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, they don’t seem to be too friendly.”
rows.translation: “是啊，他们看起来确实不太友善。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, they don’t seem to be too friendly.”"

rows.original: The ambassador shakes her head sadly. “No, they do not. But I will refrain from speaking ill of any of our hosts, as they’re very new to the idea of aliens on their homeworld. I have been a representative of my people among the frontier worlds for over a century; they’ve hardly known we even exist for half a year. Compared to some worlds, they’re doing quite well, don’t you think?”
rows.translation: 大使难过地摇了摇头。“没错，确实不太友善。不过我不会说任何东道主的坏话，毕竟他们才刚刚开始接受母星上出现外星人这个概念。我作为族人的代表，在各个边疆世界间活动已有一个多世纪；而他们知道我们的存在还不到半年。同某些世界相比，他们的表现已经相当不错了，你不觉得吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe ambassador shakes her head sadly. “No, they do not. But I will refrain from speaking ill of any of our hosts, as they’re very new to the idea of aliens on their homeworld. I have been a representative of my people among the frontier worlds for over a century; they’ve hardly known we even exist for half a year. Compared to some worlds, they’re doing quite well, don’t you think?”"

rows.original: You got shot at more than once on your way here, but sure, it’s not as bad as Mhen’ga you guess. At least some of the natives seem happy to see interstellar visitors. That’s why you’re here, after all.
rows.translation: 你来这里的路上不止一次遭到枪击，不过你想，至少还没门加那么糟。至少有些本地人似乎很高兴见到星际访客。毕竟这正是你来到这里的原因。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou got shot at more than once on your way here, but sure, it’s not as bad as Mhen’ga you guess. At least some of the natives seem happy to see interstellar visitors. That’s why you’re here, after all."

rows.original: “I’ll drink to that,” Elyrrin laughs, tipping back her wine glass. When she sets it aside, the dragon-woman sighs and leans back against one of the pyramid’s glass walls, spreading her wings out to support her large frame. “So, Captain, tell me... and given the good relations between the Republic and your future company, you’ll forgive me if I’m overstepping... but has Steele Tech given any thought to what kind of future you want for Dhaal? If we were to combine our forces in support of a single market sector, the other, weaker companies would have no choice but to cooperate with whoever we make the leader, or risk being left in the dust. We’re all wasting valuable resources - and time, for those of you less long-lived than the gryvain - waiting for one of the local elites to emerge on top naturally...”
rows.translation: “这话值得干一杯，”埃莉琳笑道，仰头喝下一口葡萄酒。她把酒杯放到一旁后叹了口气，向后倚在金字塔的一面玻璃墙上，同时展开双翼支撑自己高大的身躯。“那么，船长，请告诉我...鉴于共和国与你未来执掌的公司关系良好，若我有所冒犯，还请见谅...不过斯蒂尔科技是否考虑过，你们希望达尔迎来怎样的未来？如果我们能够联手支持单一市场领域，其他实力较弱的公司就只能同我们推举的领导者合作，否则便会被远远甩在后面。我们都在浪费宝贵的资源，也在浪费时间，尤其是对你们这些寿命不及格里文人的种族而言，只为了等待某个本地精英自然而然胜出...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I’ll drink to that,” Elyrrin laughs, tipping back her wine glass. When she sets it aside, the dragon-woman sighs and leans back against one of the pyramid’s glass walls, spreading her wings out to support her large frame. “So, Captain, tell me... and given the good relations between the Republic and your future company, you’ll forgive me if I’m overstepping... but has Steele Tech given any thought to what kind of future you want for Dhaal? If we were to combine our forces in support of a single market sector, the other, weaker companies would have no choice but to cooperate with whoever we make the leader, or risk being left in the dust. We’re all wasting valuable resources - and time, for those of you less long-lived than the gryvain - waiting for one of the local elites to emerge on top naturally...”"

rows.original: There’s no denying that the ambassador is a big, curvaceous beauty, and you’ve found your eyes wandering all over her ample chest, egg-bearing hips, and long, scaled legs while she speaks. That single thin layer of silk she calls a dress leaves precious little to the imagination, cut like it is. rows.translation: 蛇形女主人伸出一只手。你刚握住，她便猛地拉近身体，贴得如此之近，害你险些向后摔倒；她的男宠们为了跟上她，慌乱得差点绊作一团。她深深吸了一口充满你气味的空气，舌头在你的[pc.ear]近旁甩动，近得让你能感到她身上涌来的热气。<i>“
rows.raw: "\n\nThe serpentine domina extends a hand, and when you take it, she surges closer - pulling herself so close that you nearly tumble back - and her boys trip over themselves trying to keep up with her. She draws in a deep breath full of your scent, lashing her tongue around so close to your [pc.ear] that you can feel the heat billowing off her. <i>“"

rows.original: That’s... certainly one way to compliment your appearance. Or maybe your accomplishments? Or your social status, even. Really there’s a lot about you she seems to be drinking in, and whatever it is she sees in you, she doesn’t seem intent on leaving your personal space on her own. The two fuckboys behind her give you apologetic looks, but are quickly distracted by seeing their mistress bent over right in front of them. You can hear leather creaking.
rows.translation: 这...确实也算一种称赞你外表的方式。又或者她称赞的是你的成就？甚至是你的社会地位？她似乎正如饥似渴地品味着你身上的许多特质。不管她看中了什么，显然都不打算主动退出你的私人空间。她身后的两个男宠向你投来歉意的目光，却很快被女主人弯腰俯在他们面前的景象吸引。你甚至能听见皮革绷紧时的吱嘎声。
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s... certainly one way to compliment your appearance. Or maybe your accomplishments? Or your social status, even. Really there’s a lot about you she seems to be drinking in, and whatever it is she sees in you, she doesn’t seem intent on leaving your personal space on her own. The two fuckboys behind her give you apologetic looks, but are quickly distracted by seeing their mistress bent over right in front of them. You can hear leather creaking."

rows.original: “Ssssorry, captain, where are my manners?” the snake purrs, swishing her tail. It slaps one of the boys on the ass, making him gasp - but any shame-reaction seems completely absent. “I represent Carver Con... Consooolidated here on Dhaal. There is sssuch a rich market for flesh on this world, so overflowing with poor, directionlesss soulsss that my mistress could not overlook it.”
rows.translation: “抱歉嘶嘶，船长，我的礼貌都去哪儿了？”蛇女娇声说道，同时甩动尾巴。尾巴拍在其中一个男孩的屁股上，令他喘了一声，却完全没有任何羞耻反应。“我在达尔代表卡弗联...联合公司。这个世界的肉体市场如此嘶嘶丰富，到处都是可怜而迷失方向的灵魂嘶嘶，我的女主人绝不可能视而不见。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ssssorry, captain, where are my manners?” the snake purrs, swishing her tail. It slaps one of the boys on the ass, making him gasp - but any shame-reaction seems completely absent. “I represent Carver Con... Consooolidated here on Dhaal. There is sssuch a rich market for flesh on this world, so overflowing with poor, directionlesss soulsss that my mistress could not overlook it.”"

rows.original: “So you’re here looking for slaves?”
rows.translation: “所以你来这里是为了寻找奴隶？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So you’re here looking for slaves?”"

rows.original: She hisses, less genially this time. “Slave is such a... sssstrong word. I prefer to see it as giving purpose to wasted flessssh. Look at these two, captain.”
rows.translation: 她发出嘶声，这次就没那么和善了。“奴隶这个词...实在太重了。我更愿意将其视作赋予被浪费的肉体嘶嘶一个用途。看看这两个人吧，船长。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe hisses, less genially this time. “Slave is such a... sssstrong word. I prefer to see it as giving purpose to wasted flessssh. Look at these two, captain.”"

rows.original: She tugs her leashes, bringing the near-naked twinks up for your inspection. They both bite their lower lips and twiddle their fingers, slowly gyrating their hips - it might be seductive, if it wasn’t eerie watching the two of them behave in exactly the same way, like they’re two V.I.s given the same programming. “This one was a thief, sssstealing credits from medical robots on vulnerable worlds. And the other? A drug dealer, peddling illegal narcotics in the slums, taking advantage of the desperate and the downtrodden. Their lives were less than nothing. Parasssites on sssociety. But now they serve a purpose, can atone for their sssssins. They proved incapable of making good choices on their own... and so we take choice away from them, remold useless parasites into objects of pleasssure. They come to thank us in time. Isn’t it luxurious to be in a collar, unburdened, your every action determined by your mistress?”
rows.translation: 她扯动牵绳，将两个近乎赤裸的纤弱美少年拉到你面前供你检视。两人都咬着下唇，摆弄着手指，缓缓扭动臀部。若不是亲眼看着他们做出完全相同的动作，诡异得仿佛两个接受了同一套程序的虚拟智能，这幅景象或许还颇具诱惑。“这个曾是个小偷，在脆弱世界里从医疗机器人身上偷取信用点。另一个呢？是个毒贩，在贫民窟贩卖非法毒品，利用绝望困苦的人。他们的生命毫无价值，是社会的寄生虫嘶嘶。但现在他们有了用途，可以为自己的罪孽赎罪。他们已经证明自己无法独立做出正确选择...所以我们剥夺他们的选择，将无用的寄生虫重塑为取悦他人的物品。迟早有一天，他们会感谢我们。戴上项圈，卸下一切负担，每个行动都由女主人决定，难道不是一种奢华享受吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe tugs her leashes, bringing the near-naked twinks up for your inspection. They both bite their lower lips and twiddle their fingers, slowly gyrating their hips - it might be seductive, if it wasn’t eerie watching the two of them behave in exactly the same way, like they’re two V.I.s given the same programming. “This one was a thief, sssstealing credits from medical robots on vulnerable worlds. And the other? A drug dealer, peddling illegal narcotics in the slums, taking advantage of the desperate and the downtrodden. Their lives were less than nothing. Parasssites on sssociety. But now they serve a purpose, can atone for their sssssins. They proved incapable of making good choices on their own... and so we take choice away from them, remold useless parasites into objects of pleasssure. They come to thank us in time. Isn’t it luxurious to be in a collar, unburdened, your every action determined by your mistress?”"

rows.original: “Yes!” the twinks both moan, pressing in on either side of the snake woman. One of them adds, “I was so naughty, but now I’ve found my true calling.”
rows.translation: “是的！”两个纤弱美少年一同呻吟，从两侧贴紧蛇女。其中一人又说道：“我以前太淘气了，但现在我找到了真正的使命。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yes!” the twinks both moan, pressing in on either side of the snake woman. One of them adds, “I was so naughty, but now I’ve found my true calling.”"

rows.original: “Life’s so much better as mistress’s cum pump,” the other husks, running his hands around the slyveren’s corset. “I don’t have to think anymore...”
rows.translation: “成为女主人的精液泵以后，生活好太多了，”另一个男孩用沙哑的声音说道，双手沿着斯莱弗伦人的束腰游走。“我再也不必思考了...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Life’s so much better as mistress’s cum pump,” the other husks, running his hands around the slyveren’s corset. “I don’t have to think anymore...”"

rows.original: Their owner smiles, putting her arms around her pet fuckboys. “See, captain. It’s not so bad, for the ssstrong to own the weak, hmm? And more importantly, they serve as a warning to all other criminals: shape up, or be collared.”
rows.translation: 他们的主人微笑着搂住两个宠物男奴。“看吧，船长。强者拥有弱者也没那么糟，对吗？更重要的是，他们能警告所有其他罪犯：改过自新，否则就戴上项圈。”
rows.raw: "\n\nTheir owner smiles, putting her arms around her pet fuckboys. “See, captain. It’s not so bad, for the ssstrong to own the weak, hmm? And more importantly, they serve as a warning to all other criminals: shape up, or be collared.”"

rows.original: There’s got to be better ways to keep a population from descending into anarchy than slavery! Some kind of work-release program, or in the case of the zaika, even something digital to keep the dangerous ones off the street.
rows.translation: 要防止民众陷入无政府状态，肯定有比奴隶制更好的办法！比如某种劳动释放计划；对扎伊卡人而言，甚至可以采用某种数字手段，让危险分子无法流落街头。
rows.raw: "There’s got to be better ways to keep a population from descending into anarchy than slavery! Some kind of work-release program, or in the case of the zaika, even something digital to keep the dangerous ones off the street."

rows.original: You can definitely understand the appeal. Carver’s getting dangerous or deleterious people off the street, and after your trek through the Gyre, you can see why they’re so interested in Dhaal. There’s a lot of rampant crime, and with proper law enforcement, the jails would be overflowing.
rows.translation: 你完全能理解其中的吸引力。卡弗公司让危险或有害的人消失在街头，而在你穿越环城之后，你也能明白他们为什么会对达尔如此感兴趣。这里犯罪猖獗，一旦建立起妥善执法体系，监狱肯定会人满为患。
rows.raw: "You can definitely understand the appeal. Carver’s getting dangerous or deleterious people off the street, and after your trek through the Gyre, you can see why they’re so interested in Dhaal. There’s a lot of rampant crime, and with proper law enforcement, the jails would be overflowing."

rows.original: The serpent smiles. “I’m so glad you seeee things our way! If Sssteele Tech intends to build on Dhaal, I’m sure our companies can help each other...”
rows.translation: 蛇女笑了。“我真高兴你认同我们的看法嘶嘶！如果斯嘶蒂尔科技打算在达尔开展建设，我相信我们的公司可以互相帮助...”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe serpent smiles. “I’m so glad you seeee things our way! If Sssteele Tech intends to build on Dhaal, I’m sure our companies can help each other...”"

rows.original: A source of slave labor for the company’s mining operation, she means. That would certainly make working on the hellish sun-side or the frigid sunless side of the planet much more practical for the company. And of course, hard labor’s not the only thing slaves can be good for... she’s managing two ample evidence of their many uses.
rows.translation: 她指的是为公司的采矿业务提供奴隶劳动力。那无疑会让公司在炼狱般的向阳面或严寒的背阳面开展作业实际得多。当然，苦役并非奴隶唯一能派上用场的地方...她正牵着的两份充分证据就展示了奴隶的多种用途。
rows.raw: "\n\nA source of slave labor for the company’s mining operation, she means. That would certainly make working on the hellish sun-side or the frigid sunless side of the planet much more practical for the company. And of course, hard labor’s not the only thing slaves can be good for... she’s managing two ample evidence of their many uses."

rows.original: “I know Miss Carver will be happy to hear,” she continues, stroking her twinks’ hair, “that someone so powerful and influential understands... if she did not already know. If you’ll excuse me.”
rows.translation: “卡弗小姐听到如此有权有势的人能够理解我们...一定会很高兴，”她继续说道，同时抚摸着男宠们的头发，“当然，前提是她还不知道。请容我失陪。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I know Miss Carver will be happy to hear,” she continues, stroking her twinks’ hair, “that someone so powerful and influential understands... if she did not already know. If you’ll excuse me.”"

rows.original: No, that’s... that’s monstrous. There has to be a better way to keep people in line than the threat of slavery. Nobody deserves to have their free will so completely stripped away like her slave-boys have.
rows.translation: 不，那实在...实在太残忍了。要让人们遵守规矩，肯定有比用奴隶制威胁更好的办法。没有人活该像她的男奴那样被彻底剥夺自由意志。
rows.raw: "No, that’s... that’s monstrous. There has to be a better way to keep people in line than the threat of slavery. Nobody deserves to have their free will so completely stripped away like her slave-boys have."

rows.original: “Oh?” the snake-woman huffs, “Then what would you suggessst we do with all these worthless wretches? Should we kill them instead, or perhaps you mean we should... let anarchy reign?”
rows.translation: “哦？”蛇女哼了一声，“那么你建议嘶嘶我们如何处置这些毫无价值的可怜虫？难道应该杀掉他们，还是说你认为我们应该...任由无政府状态横行？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh?” the snake-woman huffs, “Then what would you suggessst we do with all these worthless wretches? Should we kill them instead, or perhaps you mean we should... let anarchy reign?”"

rows.original: That’s not it at all! You know there’s another way: to give the people hope and happiness. They need education, medicine, food - and ways to get it without breaking their backs. And those who stray need ways to be truly rehabilitated, not to just be broken down body and soul like her slaves have been. If she thinks they never contributed anything to society before, how will they ever do so in the future?
rows.translation: 根本不是这样！你知道还有另一条路：给予人们希望与幸福。他们需要教育、医疗和食物，还需要无需累断脊梁就能获得这些东西的途径。误入歧途的人需要真正得到改造的办法，而不是像她的奴隶那样从肉体到灵魂都被彻底摧毁。如果她认为这些人过去从未对社会做出贡献，那么这样处理之后，他们未来又怎么可能做出贡献？
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s not it at all! You know there’s another way: to give the people hope and happiness. They need education, medicine, food - and ways to get it without breaking their backs. And those who stray need ways to be truly rehabilitated, not to just be broken down body and soul like her slaves have been. If she thinks they never contributed anything to society before, how will they ever do so in the future?"

rows.original: A city-world like Dhaal may be overrun with crime on the surface, but there’s ways to solve the problem without resorting to authoritarianism. Rehabilitation!
rows.translation: 达尔这样的都市世界表面上或许犯罪横行，但不诉诸威权主义也有办法解决问题。改造教育！
rows.raw: "\n\nA city-world like Dhaal may be overrun with crime on the surface, but there’s ways to solve the problem without resorting to authoritarianism. Rehabilitation!"

rows.original: The serpent-woman curls up her nose and flattens her hood; you can’t tell if it’s in disgust for your naivety or disbelief at being talked back at for once in what’s probably a very long time. Finally, her snout curls into a scowl and she turns away. “Perhapsssss, or perhaps you are naive and bleeding-hearted. We shall sssssee whose visssion for Dhaal reigns supreme one day.”
rows.translation: 蛇女皱起鼻子，收平颈罩；你分辨不出她是在厌恶你的天真，还是不敢相信大概许久以来终于有人敢顶撞她。最后，她的吻部扭成怒容，转过身去。“也许吧嘶嘶，也许你只是天真又心软。终有一天，我们会看清嘶嘶谁为达尔描绘的愿景将占据上风。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe serpent-woman curls up her nose and flattens her hood; you can’t tell if it’s in disgust for your naivety or disbelief at being talked back at for once in what’s probably a very long time. Finally, her snout curls into a scowl and she turns away. “Perhapsssss, or perhaps you are naive and bleeding-hearted. We shall sssssee whose visssion for Dhaal reigns supreme one day.”"

rows.translation: 她扯动男宠们的项圈，转身离去。然而她的男孩们却迟疑了片刻，在被主人拖走之前望了你一眼，目光中满是他们可能许久没有问过的问题。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe tugs on the twinks’ collars and walks away. Her boys hesitate, though, glancing at you with eyes full of questions they likely haven’t asked in a very long time before they’re dragged off after their owner."

rows.original: You catch sight of the familiar black-and-gold of the Steele Tech uniform rising high above the crowd, topped by a pair of purple-scaled rabbit ears. A leithan woman rocking the company colors is surrounded by about a dozen brightly-dressed zaika, and as you draw closer, you can start to imagine why - for the egg-laying elfin natives, a gravidly pregnant woman must be something of a novelty, especially when the front of her humanoid-half’s jumpsuit is zipped down to reveal a maternity bra underneath that’s nearly stained through. The leithan girl is blushing furiously as the zaika fawn over her large chest, and her rosy cheeks only darken when she sees you approaching.
rows.translation: 你一眼看到人群上方高高耸立着熟悉的斯蒂尔科技黑金制服，顶端还有一对覆着紫色鳞片的兔耳。一名身披公司配色的莱坦女人被十几个衣着鲜艳的扎伊卡人团团围住。走近之后，你开始能够想象其中原因：对这些产卵的精灵般本地人而言，怀胎深重的女人想必颇为新奇，尤其是她人形上半身的连体服前襟已经拉开，露出下面几乎被乳汁浸透的孕妇胸罩。扎伊卡人围着她丰满的胸脯大献殷勤，令这个莱坦姑娘羞得满脸通红；看到你走近后，她绯红的双颊更是又深了几分。
rows.raw: "You catch sight of the familiar black-and-gold of the Steele Tech uniform rising high above the crowd, topped by a pair of purple-scaled rabbit ears. A leithan woman rocking the company colors is surrounded by about a dozen brightly-dressed zaika, and as you draw closer, you can start to imagine why - for the egg-laying elfin natives, a gravidly pregnant woman must be something of a novelty, especially when the front of her humanoid-half’s jumpsuit is zipped down to reveal a maternity bra underneath that’s nearly stained through. The leithan girl is blushing furiously as the zaika fawn over her large chest, and her rosy cheeks only darken when she sees you approaching."

rows.original: “O-oh, he- hi Captain Steele,” she stammers, tugging on the canvas caparison laying over her hind end. “I don’t think I’m repping the company very well right now. Sorry!”
rows.translation: “哦，哦，你，你好，斯蒂尔船长，”她结结巴巴地说道，拉扯着铺在后半身上的帆布披饰。“我觉得自己现在没能好好代表公司。对不起！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“O-oh, he- hi Captain Steele,” she stammers, tugging on the canvas caparison laying over her hind end. “I don’t think I’m repping the company very well right now. Sorry!”"

rows.original: “Noooooonsense!” one of the zaika slurs drunkenly between sips from a champagne glass filled with something thicker, and whiter, than the normal liqueur. “You’re the life of the party, dear! Positively intoxicating!”
rows.translation: “胡闹闹闹闹闹！”其中一个扎伊卡人醉醺醺地含混说道，其间还不时啜饮香槟杯中某种比普通利口酒更浓稠、更洁白的饮品。“亲爱的，你可是宴会的灵魂人物！简直让人沉醉！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Noooooonsense!” one of the zaika slurs drunkenly between sips from a champagne glass filled with something thicker, and whiter, than the normal liqueur. “You’re the life of the party, dear! Positively intoxicating!”"

rows.original: The other native party-goers nod in agreement, and a glance around shows that they’re all drinking the same thing. The smell of sweet alcohol permeates the air around the bashful ‘tauress, and this particular gaggle of zaika seems much more... socially lubricated... than the rest of the party. Several of them are barely keeping their balance, and the others are having a hard time keeping their hands to themselves.
rows.translation: 其他本地宾客纷纷点头赞同。你环顾四周，发现她们都在喝同一种东西。羞怯的兽身姑娘周围弥漫着香甜的酒味，这一小群扎伊卡人显然比宴会上的其他人更加...善于借酒交际...其中几个勉强才能保持平衡，其他人则很难管住自己四处乱摸的手。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe other native party-goers nod in agreement, and a glance around shows that they’re all drinking the same thing. The smell of sweet alcohol permeates the air around the bashful ‘tauress, and this particular gaggle of zaika seems much more... socially lubricated... than the rest of the party. Several of them are barely keeping their balance, and the others are having a hard time keeping their hands to themselves."

rows.original: “Nobody told me the zaika, uh, reacted like this,” the leithan woman giggles. “But they didn’t really get what was going on with my undercarriage, much less my chest, and... oh One I can’t believe I got talked into doing this...”
rows.translation: “没人告诉我扎伊卡人，呃，会有这种反应，”莱坦女人咯咯笑道。“不过她们根本搞不懂我的下半身是怎么回事，更不用说我的胸部了，而且...哦，唯一神啊，我真不敢相信自己居然被说动来做这种事...”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Nobody told me the zaika, uh, reacted like this,” the leithan woman giggles. “But they didn’t really get what was going on with my undercarriage, much less my chest, and... oh One I can’t believe I got talked into doing this...”"

The milky ‘taur gives you a bashful smile before turning her attention fully to the zaika.
rows.translation: 她缓缓解开染有乳渍的孕妇胸罩，那件胸罩几乎兜不住负担过重的硕大乳房。扎伊卡女人们立刻醉醺醺地蜂拥而上，为争夺她胸前的位置相互推挤。毕竟总共只有两颗乳头可供分享，香槟杯（还有几张嘴）很快便被飞溅的乳汁弄得一片狼藉。乳香四溢的兽身姑娘羞怯地朝你笑了笑，随后将注意力完全转向扎伊卡人。

rows.original: The sounds of raised voices draws your attention over to a circular group of party-goers - aliens and zaika alike - gathered around two individuals that you immediately recognize as bodyguards, even before your keen eyes spot the hidden handguns and batons secreted on their muscle-bound figures. One of them is a thraggen, a male of some eight feet in height and so massively shredded that you’re not sure he could swing that beatstick of his if he wanted to. He looks like he belongs in a Mister Confederacy contest. The polished bull-horns on his brow and long bovine tail sticking out of his pants tell you all you need to know about where he got all that mass. His dress shirt’s barely hanging in there, straining around his biceps and abs.
rows.translation: 逐渐升高的争吵声吸引了你的注意。一群参加宴会的人围成一圈，其中既有外星人，也有扎伊卡人，中心站着两个人。甚至在你敏锐的双眼发现他们肌肉虬结的身体上藏着手枪和警棍之前，你便立刻认出两人都是保镖。其中一人是特拉根男性，身高约八英尺，浑身肌肉发达得夸张，你甚至怀疑就算他想挥动警棍，手臂也未必弯得过来。他看起来完全应该参加‘邦联先生’大赛。额头上锃亮的牛角以及从裤子里伸出的细长牛尾，已经充分说明那一身块头从何而来。他的正装衬衫勉强维持完整，在肱二头肌和腹肌周围绷得死紧。
rows.raw: "The sounds of raised voices draws your attention over to a circular group of party-goers - aliens and zaika alike - gathered around two individuals that you immediately recognize as bodyguards, even before your keen eyes spot the hidden handguns and batons secreted on their muscle-bound figures. One of them is a thraggen, a male of some eight feet in height and so massively shredded that you’re not sure he could swing that beatstick of his if he wanted to. He looks like he belongs in a Mister Confederacy contest. The polished bull-horns on his brow and long bovine tail sticking out of his pants tell you all you need to know about where he got all that mass. His dress shirt’s barely hanging in there, straining around his biceps and abs."

rows.original: The other figure in the middle is equally buff, though it’s clear the Treatment isn’t responsible for her power. Both her arms are cybernetic, particularly thick around her biceps and with hands that look like they could crush a man’s skull with ease. Hydraulic systems are tensed all the way up to her elbows, ready to put all the force she needs to bear. Her ears and one eye are also synthetic, and though you can’t see her legs under her skirt, the slight lean in her gait would indicate at least one leg is also chrome.
rows.translation: 中央的另一个身影同样魁梧，不过显然，她的力量并非来自改造疗程。她的双臂都是义体，肱二头肌部位尤其粗壮，双手看起来能轻易捏碎男人的头骨。液压系统一直延伸到肘部，蓄势待发，随时可以施加她所需的全部力量。她的耳朵和一只眼睛也是人造的。虽然裙子挡住了双腿，但从步态中轻微的偏斜判断，她至少有一条腿同样是金属义体。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe other figure in the middle is equally buff, though it’s clear the Treatment isn’t responsible for her power. Both her arms are cybernetic, particularly thick around her biceps and with hands that look like they could crush a man’s skull with ease. Hydraulic systems are tensed all the way up to her elbows, ready to put all the force she needs to bear. Her ears and one eye are also synthetic, and though you can’t see her legs under her skirt, the slight lean in her gait would indicate at least one leg is also chrome."

rows.original: “You didn’t earn one fiber of those muscles,” the zaika snaps, jabbing a finger at the huge green giant. “Ya just jabbed a pen in your tailhole and yanked your meat for a week. I saw the adverts that planet sent my boss, y’know!”
rows.translation: “你那身肌肉没有哪怕一根纤维是自己练来的，”扎伊卡人厉声说道，一根手指戳向绿色巨汉。“你不过是往尾巴眼里插了支笔，再撸上一个星期。我看过那颗星球发给我老板的广告，懂吗！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You didn’t earn one fiber of those muscles,” the zaika snaps, jabbing a finger at the huge green giant. “Ya just jabbed a pen in your tailhole and yanked your meat for a week. I saw the adverts that planet sent my boss, y’know!”"

rows.original: “Oh that’s rich!” he growls back, thrusting his barrel-like chest out. “You don’t even got muscles, you bitchy fuck nugget. That’s all machine! Toss an EMP grenade at you and what’s left? Your heart even pumping on its own still?”
rows.translation: “哈，你还真有脸说！”他咆哮着回敬，挺起木桶般的胸膛。“你压根就没有肌肉，你这满嘴喷粪的贱货。那全是机器！朝你扔颗电磁脉冲手雷，还能剩下什么？你的心脏现在还会自己跳吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh that’s rich!” he growls back, thrusting his barrel-like chest out. “You don’t even got muscles, you bitchy fuck nugget. That’s all machine! Toss an EMP grenade at you and what’s left? Your heart even pumping on its own still?”"

rows.original: The zaika sneers. “You disgusting animal! I earned this chrome in battle! My zaibatsu awarded me these for years of flawless service.”
rows.translation: 扎伊卡人冷笑一声。“你这恶心的畜生！这些金属义体是我在战斗中赢来的！我为财阀无可挑剔地效力多年，他们才把这些赐给我。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zaika sneers. “You disgusting animal! I earned this chrome in battle! My zaibatsu awarded me these for years of flawless service.”"

rows.original: While they bicker, a few of the Peers in the back of the group near you look your way. “Say, you’re an alien too,” one of them drawls. “Are all of your vegetable-people like this?”
rows.translation: 两人争吵时，人群后方几个靠近你的权贵朝你看来。“喂，你也是外星人，”其中一人拖长声音说道。“你们那边的蔬菜人都这样吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile they bicker, a few of the Peers in the back of the group near you look your way. “Say, you’re an alien too,” one of them drawls. “Are all of your vegetable-people like this?”"

rows.original: “Haha, yeah, pretty much,” you laugh.
rows.translation: “哈哈，对，差不多吧，”你笑道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Haha, yeah, pretty much,” you laugh."

rows.original: It takes you a moment to realize she’s mistaken the thraggen’s jade skin for some sort of plant. “Well... yeah,” you chuckle. “The ones I’ve met anyway.”
rows.translation: 你过了片刻才意识到，她把特拉根人的翡翠色皮肤误认成了某种植物。“这个...对，”你轻笑道。“至少我见过的那些是这样。”
rows.raw: "\n\nIt takes you a moment to realize she’s mistaken the thraggen’s jade skin for some sort of plant. “Well... yeah,” you chuckle. “The ones I’ve met anyway.”"

rows.original: Another leans in and says “Do you people not have cybernetics back where you come from? Why does the veggie-man work so hard to get what his corporation could just give him? Is he undeserving of augmentation, or is there some... stigma attached to it?”
rows.translation: 另一个权贵凑近说道：“你们的家乡没有义体吗？为什么那个蔬菜人如此辛苦地锻炼，才得到他的公司本可以直接赐给他的东西？是他不配接受强化，还是说...义体背负着某种污名？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother leans in and says “Do you people not have cybernetics back where you come from? Why does the veggie-man work so hard to get what his corporation could just give him? Is he undeserving of augmentation, or is there some... stigma attached to it?”"

rows.original: The zaika asking glances at you through a pair of crimson-hued cyber-eyes. You’ve seen plenty of augmented natives already... the idea that cybernetics are looked down on is probably a very real fear, now that you think about it. That’s not really the case, though cybernetics have been pushed out of the mainstream as transformative drugs have become cheaper and more commonplace. Though they don’t necessarily need to know that...
rows.translation: 提问的扎伊卡人透过一双绯红色义眼望着你。你已经见过许多接受过强化的本地人...现在仔细想来，担心义体遭人鄙视，对她而言恐怕是非常真实的恐惧。事实并非如此，不过随着变形药物变得更加廉价普及，义体的确已经被挤出主流。当然，她们不一定非得知道这些...
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zaika asking glances at you through a pair of crimson-hued cyber-eyes. You’ve seen plenty of augmented natives already... the idea that cybernetics are looked down on is probably a very real fear, now that you think about it. That’s not really the case, though cybernetics have been pushed out of the mainstream as transformative drugs have become cheaper and more commonplace. Though they don’t necessarily need to know that..."

rows.translation: 义体霸凌

rows.original: Tell the curious zaika that cybernetics are extremely gauche in Confederate space. They need to be ditching the chrome for gene mods, ASAP!
rows.translation: 告诉好奇的扎伊卡人，义体在邦联太空中俗不可耐。她们需要尽快抛弃金属义体，改用基因改造！
rows.raw: "Tell the curious zaika that cybernetics are extremely gauche in Confederate space. They need to be ditching the chrome for gene mods, ASAP!"

rows.original: It’s Fine!
rows.translation: 没问题！
rows.raw: "It’s Fine!"

rows.original: It’s Fine!
rows.translation: 没问题！
rows.raw: "It’s Fine!"

rows.original: Nobody minds cybernetics. They aren’t in fashion as much anymore, but it’s not a big deal.
rows.translation: 没人介意义体。它们如今没那么时髦了，但也不是什么大事。
rows.raw: "Nobody minds cybernetics. They aren’t in fashion as much anymore, but it’s not a big deal."

rows.original: Cyber Bullying
rows.translation: 义体霸凌
rows.raw: "Cyber Bullying"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Oh, yes,” you tell them, “We advanced civilizations have moved far beyond replacing our bodies with metal. Why would we, when we can reshape ourselves into whatever we want to be with a pill or a needle?”
rows.translation: “哦，没错，”你告诉她们，“我们这些先进文明早已越过了用金属替换身体的阶段。既然一颗药丸或一针就能把自己重塑成任何想要的模样，我们为什么还要那么做？”
rows.raw: "“Oh, yes,” you tell them, “We advanced civilizations have moved far beyond replacing our bodies with metal. Why would we, when we can reshape ourselves into whatever we want to be with a pill or a needle?”"

rows.original: The Peers gathered around glance between you and the burly thraggen, rippling with so much muscle he could probably rip those cyber-arms right off their bodyguard.
rows.translation: 围在周围的权贵们来回看着你和那个魁梧的特拉根人。他浑身肌肉滚动，看起来大概能直接从她们的保镖身上扯下那双义臂。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Peers gathered around glance between you and the burly thraggen, rippling with so much muscle he could probably rip those cyber-arms right off their bodyguard."

rows.original: “Do you all really look down on us so?” one of them laments. “We must seem barbaric, sawing off parts of ourselves for-”
rows.translation: “你们真的如此瞧不起我们吗？”其中一人哀叹道。“我们锯掉自己身体的一部分，只为了-”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Do you all really look down on us so?” one of them laments. “We must seem barbaric, sawing off parts of ourselves for-”"

rows.original: Another jabs her in the arm with a metal finger, spray-painted in Paragon blue. “Nonsense! Chrome is our culture! Whatever these aliens have instead is... it’s equal, but different!”
rows.translation: 另一个人用喷成典范蓝的金属手指戳了戳她的手臂。“胡说！金属义体是我们的文化！不管这些外星人用什么代替...那都和义体平等，只是有所不同！”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother jabs her in the arm with a metal finger, spray-painted in Paragon blue. “Nonsense! Chrome is our culture! Whatever these aliens have instead is... it’s equal, but different!”"

rows.original: “Bah, just tell yourself that!” a third grumbles. “You just wanted to type faster, so you chopped off your hands. My sister replaced her eyes so she could see better in the daylight... and my work carries me down to the Gyre, so I upgraded my lungs. But imagine if we could have all that and more without making such drastic alterations! These aliens really are lightyears ahead of us!”
rows.translation: “呸，你就这么自我安慰吧！”第三个人抱怨道。“你只是想打字更快，所以砍掉了自己的手。我姐姐换了眼睛，好让自己在日光下看得更清楚...我的工作经常要去环城，所以强化了肺部。可想象一下，如果无需做出如此激烈的改造，我们便能获得这一切，甚至更多！这些外星人真的领先我们好几光年！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Bah, just tell yourself that!” a third grumbles. “You just wanted to type faster, so you chopped off your hands. My sister replaced her eyes so she could see better in the daylight... and my work carries me down to the Gyre, so I upgraded my lungs. But imagine if we could have all that and more without making such drastic alterations! These aliens really are lightyears ahead of us!”"

rows.original: Damn right,
rows.translation: 没错，
rows.raw: "\n\nDamn right, "

rows.original: primitive screwheads
rows.translation: 你们这些原始的蠢货
rows.raw: "primitive screwheads"

rows.original: you are
rows.translation: 你已经
rows.raw: "you are"

rows.original: . And the zaika can have what you have so easily. It won’t be long before it’s safe for transformatives to work on them, and limb-regrowth treatments. Of course, if they want to skip the wait, you’ve got no doubt the Peers have the resources to get custom work done...
rows.translation: 。而且扎伊卡人可以如此轻易地拥有你已有的一切。不久之后，变形药剂和肢体再生疗法就能安全地用于她们。当然，如果她们不想等，你毫不怀疑这些权贵有足够的资源委托定制改造...
rows.raw: ". And the zaika can have what you have so easily. It won’t be long before it’s safe for transformatives to work on them, and limb-regrowth treatments. Of course, if they want to skip the wait, you’ve got no doubt the Peers have the resources to get custom work done..."

rows.original: “[pc.HeShe]’s right,” one announces, yanking a wire out of the back of her neck. “All this cumbersome metal can burn! I’m getting my ears back!”
rows.translation: “[pc.HeShe]说得对，”其中一人宣布道，同时从颈后拔出一根电线。“让这些笨重的金属统统见鬼去吧！我要把耳朵长回来！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.HeShe]’s right,” one announces, yanking a wire out of the back of her neck. “All this cumbersome metal can burn! I’m getting my ears back!”"

rows.original: There’s a general murmur of agreement, interrupted as the armored security goons from out front push past, drawing shock truncheons and threatening to break up the escalating tension between the bodyguards with force. Time for you to get a little distance before a fight breaks out.
rows.translation: 众人纷纷低声赞同，却被从前面挤过来的装甲安保打手打断。她们抽出电击警棍，威胁要用武力平息保镖之间不断升级的紧张局势。在打斗爆发前，你该稍微离远一点了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThere’s a general murmur of agreement, interrupted as the armored security goons from out front push past, drawing shock truncheons and threatening to break up the escalating tension between the bodyguards with force. Time for you to get a little distance before a fight breaks out."

rows.original: BRIGHTWATER_PP
rows.raw: "BRIGHTWATER_PP"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Cybernetics!
rows.translation: 义体万岁！
rows.raw: "Cybernetics!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Nah, nobody minds chrome back home,” you tell the pensive zaika. “You’ll all fit in just fine.”
rows.translation: “不会，我们家乡没人介意金属义体，”你告诉若有所思的扎伊卡人。“你们全都能很好地融入其中。”
rows.raw: "“Nah, nobody minds chrome back home,” you tell the pensive zaika. “You’ll all fit in just fine.”"

rows.original: “Well that’s a relief!” one of them sighs, rubbing at her brow with a hand made of spray-painted steel. “Ever since first contact, we’ve all noticed how few aliens have augmentation... a lot of us have been concerned that you look down on us because of our chrome.”
rows.translation: “那我就放心了！”其中一人叹道，用喷漆钢铁制成的手揉了揉眉头。“自从第一次接触以来，我们都注意到接受过强化的外星人少之又少...很多人一直担心，你们会因为我们的金属义体而瞧不起我们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well that’s a relief!” one of them sighs, rubbing at her brow with a hand made of spray-painted steel. “Ever since first contact, we’ve all noticed how few aliens have augmentation... a lot of us have been concerned that you look down on us because of our chrome.”"

rows.original: Another adds, “Or that you’ve all evolved so far past it that we look like barbarians!”
rows.translation: 另一个人补充道：“或者你们早已进化到远远超越义体的程度，显得我们像一群野蛮人！”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother adds, “Or that you’ve all evolved so far past it that we look like barbarians!”"

rows.original: No, no, it’s nothing like that.
rows.translation: 不，不，完全不是那么回事。
rows.raw: "\n\nNo, no, it’s nothing like that. "

rows.original: SAEN MET AT THE BAR
rows.raw: "SAEN MET AT THE BAR"

rows.original: Indeed, you know a couple beautiful ladies that have cybernetics even today.
rows.translation: 事实上，即使在今天，你也认识几位装有义体的美丽女士。
rows.raw: "Indeed, you know a couple beautiful ladies that have cybernetics even today. "

rows.original: Not everyone back in the core can afford the procedures to regrow lost limbs, and even if they can, some prefer the superhuman augmentation that cybernetics provide. You’ve got no doubt that the zaika will fit right into galactic society, flesh and metal alike.
rows.translation: 核心星域也不是每个人都负担得起断肢再生手术；即便负担得起，有些人也更偏爱义体提供的超人强化。你毫不怀疑，无论血肉之躯还是金属之身，扎伊卡人都能顺利融入银河社会。
rows.raw: "Not everyone back in the core can afford the procedures to regrow lost limbs, and even if they can, some prefer the superhuman augmentation that cybernetics provide. You’ve got no doubt that the zaika will fit right into galactic society, flesh and metal alike."

rows.original: The metal-handed woman smiles, tail wagging happily behind her. “You’ve no idea how relieved I am to hear that! I didn’t want to be left behind here on Dhaal just because I wanted to type a little faster...”
rows.translation: 装着金属手掌的女人笑了，尾巴在身后开心地摇摆。“你根本不知道，听到这话让我多么安心！我可不想仅仅因为希望打字快一点，就被抛下留在达尔...”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe metal-handed woman smiles, tail wagging happily behind her. “You’ve no idea how relieved I am to hear that! I didn’t want to be left behind here on Dhaal just because I wanted to type a little faster...”"

rows.original: “Should have gotten a data port, dear,” another of the Peers jokes. “Much easier to hide. But I’m glad we don’t need to worry about it.”
rows.translation: “亲爱的，你应该装个数据端口，”另一个权贵开玩笑道。“那东西更容易藏起来。不过很高兴我们不必担心了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Should have gotten a data port, dear,” another of the Peers jokes. “Much easier to hide. But I’m glad we don’t need to worry about it.”"

rows.original: “Perhaps we’ll see a renaissance of cybernetics across the galaxy!” a third chimes in. “I’m sure we can export our technology... there’s something we have expertise in that aliens don’t!”
rows.translation: “或许我们会见证义体在全银河的复兴！”第三个人插话道。“我们肯定可以出口自己的技术...终于有一件事是我们擅长，而外星人不擅长的了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Perhaps we’ll see a renaissance of cybernetics across the galaxy!” a third chimes in. “I’m sure we can export our technology... there’s something we have expertise in that aliens don’t!”"

rows.original: The armored security goons from out front push through your group mid-conversation, drawing shock truncheons and threatening to break up the escalating tension between bodyguards with force. Time for you to get a little distance before a fight breaks out.
rows.translation: 交谈正进行到一半，前面的装甲安保打手便从你们中间挤过。她们抽出电击警棍，威胁要用武力平息保镖之间不断升级的紧张局势。在打斗爆发前，你该稍微离远一点了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe armored security goons from out front push through your group mid-conversation, drawing shock truncheons and threatening to break up the escalating tension between bodyguards with force. Time for you to get a little distance before a fight breaks out."

rows.original: PARAGON_PP
rows.raw: "PARAGON_PP"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: PARTY
rows.raw: "PARTY"

rows.original: Is That...?
rows.raw: "Is That...?"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: A pair of willowy zaika Peers approach you with uncharacteristically warm smiles, sashaying over in dresses that drag behind them like royal capes across the floor. Their tails, wrapped in elegant corporate-colored socks, sway excitedly.
rows.translation: 两个身姿纤细的扎伊卡权贵带着一反常态的热情笑容向你走来。她们摇曳生姿，长裙拖在身后，宛如王室披风掠过地面；尾巴裹着优雅的企业配色长袜，兴奋地左右摇摆。
rows.raw: "A pair of willowy zaika Peers approach you with uncharacteristically warm smiles, sashaying over in dresses that drag behind them like royal capes across the floor. Their tails, wrapped in elegant corporate-colored socks, sway excitedly."

rows.original: And they walk right past you, parting around your shoulders and going to fawn over another alien standing behind you - a single-tailed kaithrit, dressed in traditional server’s wear of a white button-up shirt and black slacks, carrying a tray full of snacks. The Peers seem less interested in what [rival.heShe]’s carrying so much as the kitty’s blonde ears and poofy tail, eagerly rubbing all that golden fur. The kitty-cat bristles, trying to keep a professional air while [rival.heShe]’s man-handled by the Peers. Probably not for the first time of the night. Though...
rows.translation: 然而她们径直从你身旁走过，自你双肩两侧分开，转而围住站在你身后的另一个外星人大献殷勤。那是个单尾凯斯瑞特人，身穿传统侍者服装，也就是白色纽扣衬衫与黑色长裤，手里端着装满点心的托盘。权贵们似乎不太关心[rival.heShe]端着什么，更感兴趣的是猫咪的金色耳朵和蓬松尾巴，迫不及待地抚摸着满身金色软毛。猫咪浑身毛发竖起，在[rival.heShe]被权贵们上下其手时竭力维持专业姿态。这大概不是今晚第一次了。不过...
rows.raw: "\n\nAnd they walk right past you, parting around your shoulders and going to fawn over another alien standing behind you - a single-tailed kaithrit, dressed in traditional server’s wear of a white button-up shirt and black slacks, carrying a tray full of snacks. The Peers seem less interested in what [rival.heShe]’s carrying so much as the kitty’s blonde ears and poofy tail, eagerly rubbing all that golden fur. The kitty-cat bristles, trying to keep a professional air while [rival.heShe]’s man-handled by the Peers. Probably not for the first time of the night. Though..."

rows.original: Though that kitty looks awfully familiar, now that you think about it.
rows.translation: 不过仔细想来，那只猫咪看起来实在眼熟。
rows.raw: "\n\nThough that kitty looks awfully familiar, now that you think about it."

rows.original: So familiar in fact that, when [rival.heShe] finally looks your way, your jaw just about hits the floor. It can’t be-
rows.translation: 事实上，[rival.heShe]终于朝你看来时，那张脸熟悉得让你下巴都快掉到地上。不可能是——
rows.raw: "\n\nSo familiar in fact that, when [rival.heShe] finally looks your way, your jaw just about hits the floor. It can’t be-"

rows.original: “Cousin [pc.name]!” [rival.name] shouts.
rows.translation: “[pc.name]表亲！”[rival.name]大喊道。
rows.raw: "“Cousin [pc.name]!” [rival.name] shouts."

rows.original: “Oh, I was sure the loudspeaker glitched announcing you,” your cousin sneers.
rows.translation: “哦，我还以为广播报出你的名字是出了故障呢。”你的表亲讥讽道。
rows.raw: "“Oh, I was sure the loudspeaker glitched announcing you,” your cousin sneers."

rows.original: “How did you get invited to a high class party like this? Shouldn’t you be buried up to the eyes in streetwalker tail or something?”
rows.translation: “你是怎么混进这种上流派对的？你不该一头扎在街妓的尾巴堆里吗？”
rows.raw: " “How did you get invited to a high class party like this? Shouldn’t you be buried up to the eyes in streetwalker tail or something?”"

rows.original: <i>“Big talking coming from the bitch in the
rows.translation: <i>“穿着
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Big talking coming from the bitch in the "

rows.original: waiter
rows.translation: 男侍者
rows.raw: "waiter"

rows.original: waitress
rows.translation: 女侍者
rows.raw: "waitress"

rows.original: uniform,” you scowl.
rows.translation: 制服的贱人，口气倒挺大。”你怒视道。
rows.raw: " uniform,” you scowl."

rows.original: “Haha, very funny.” You put your hands on your hips.
rows.translation: “哈哈，真好笑。”你双手叉腰。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Haha, very funny.” You put your hands on your hips."

rows.original: <i>“What’re you doing sneaking around dressed like that... and what’s with the cat getup?
rows.translation: <i>“你穿成这样鬼鬼祟祟地干什么...还有这身猫咪装扮又是怎么回事？
rows.raw: " <i>“What’re you doing sneaking around dressed like that... and what’s with the cat getup?"

rows.original: canine
rows.raw: "canine"

rows.original: Of course you’d choose a stupid cat disguise. Pffthaha!
rows.translation: 你当然会选这种蠢猫伪装。噗哈哈！
rows.raw: " Of course you’d choose a stupid cat disguise. Pffthaha!"

rows.original: “It’s not a getup!” [rival.heShe] protests. “And what do you think I’m doing here, huh? Staying one step ahead of you, of course! All the planet’s rich and powerful are here, so of course somebody knew where the next probe was. They’ll extort you for it, no doubt, but nobody cares if the staff overhear a secret or two.”
rows.translation: “这才不是装扮！”[rival.heShe]抗议道。“不然你以为我来这里干什么，嗯？当然是为了抢先你一步！整个星球的权贵都在这里，所以肯定有人知道下一枚探针在哪里。他们毫无疑问会借此敲诈你，可没人会在意工作人员偶然听见一两个秘密。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s not a getup!” [rival.heShe] protests. “And what do you think I’m doing here, huh? Staying one step ahead of you, of course! All the planet’s rich and powerful are here, so of course somebody knew where the next probe was. They’ll extort you for it, no doubt, but nobody cares if the staff overhear a secret or two.”"

rows.original: Of course. Spying comes second nature to [rival.name] after all. So much so that, as you look [rival.himHer] over, you can see that [rival.heShe] really did get mod work done for this disguise. It’s a kaithrit look, for sure, but it’s clearly custom: you recognize pointy black-tipped lynx ears, a slender tail with a lion-like plume at the end, and even [rival.hisHer] eyes have become slitted... and one of them’s gold now, lion-like, while the other is still its sapphire-blue. The look’s strangely familiar... the same as the figurehead painted on the nose of [rival.hisHer] gunship, all the way back on Mhen’ga?
rows.translation: 当然。毕竟，刺探情报对[rival.name]来说就像本能一样。你仔细打量[rival.himHer]，发现[rival.heShe]为了这身伪装确实做过身体改造。整体无疑是凯斯瑞特风格，但显然经过特别定制：你认出一对尖尖的黑梢猞猁耳朵，一条末端长着狮子般尾穗的纤细尾巴，甚至连[rival.hisHer]眼睛都变成了竖瞳...其中一只如今呈狮子般的金色，另一只仍是宝石蓝。这副模样出奇地眼熟...不正像早在门加时就画在[rival.hisHer]炮艇舰首上的船首像吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nOf course. Spying comes second nature to [rival.name] after all. So much so that, as you look [rival.himHer] over, you can see that [rival.heShe] really did get mod work done for this disguise. It’s a kaithrit look, for sure, but it’s clearly custom: you recognize pointy black-tipped lynx ears, a slender tail with a lion-like plume at the end, and even [rival.hisHer] eyes have become slitted... and one of them’s gold now, lion-like, while the other is still its sapphire-blue. The look’s strangely familiar... the same as the figurehead painted on the nose of [rival.hisHer] gunship, all the way back on Mhen’ga?"

rows.original: A Good Look
rows.translation: 挺适合你
rows.raw: "A Good Look"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “That’s a good look for you, [rival.name],” you grin, looking your cousin’s leonine figure up and down. “A real improvement.”
rows.translation: “这副样子很适合你，[rival.name]。”你咧嘴笑着，上下打量表亲那狮子般的身形。“真是大有长进。”
rows.raw: "“That’s a good look for you, [rival.name],” you grin, looking your cousin’s leonine figure up and down. “A real improvement.”"

rows.original: [rival.name] sputters in protest. “D-don’t you make fun of me!” [rival.heShe] growls, oh-so-very lion-like for just a moment there, even though [rival.hisHer] now-expressive tail starts wiggling between [rival.hisHer] legs. [rival.name] bares some newly-grown
rows.translation: [rival.name]气急败坏地抗议。“不、不许取笑我！”[rival.heShe]低吼道，那一瞬间还真有几分狮子的样子，尽管[rival.hisHer]如今会表露情绪的尾巴已经开始在[rival.hisHer]双腿间不安扭动。[rival.name]朝你亮出新长出的
rows.raw: "\n\n[rival.name] sputters in protest. “D-don’t you make fun of me!” [rival.heShe] growls, oh-so-very lion-like for just a moment there, even though [rival.hisHer] now-expressive tail starts wiggling between [rival.hisHer] legs. [rival.name] bares some newly-grown "

rows.original: and painted
rows.translation: 且涂了颜色的
rows.raw: "and painted "

rows.original: claws at you, even as you’re insisting that you’re serious - the lion-lynx-kaithrit thing really does work for [rival.himHer]!
rows.translation: 利爪，哪怕你一再强调自己是认真的，这副狮子、猞猁与凯斯瑞特结合的形象确实很适合[rival.himHer]！
rows.raw: "claws at you, even as you’re insisting that you’re serious - the lion-lynx-kaithrit thing really does work for [rival.himHer]!"

rows.original: “Like I’d trust anything you say,” [rival.heShe] hisses. “Anyway, what are you still talking to me for? You’ve got a lot of tail-dick to suck your way through if you’re gonna find out who’s got the probe. I’ll be blasting off this twilit rock before you even figure out which of the zaibatsu have it!”
rows.translation: “我才不会相信你说的任何话。”[rival.heShe]嘶声道。“话说回来，你还跟我废什么话？你要想找出谁拿着探针，还有一大堆长着尾巴的鸡巴等你去舔呢。等你弄明白是哪家财阀拿着它，我早就飞离这颗暮色笼罩的破星球了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like I’d trust anything you say,” [rival.heShe] hisses. “Anyway, what are you still talking to me for? You’ve got a lot of tail-dick to suck your way through if you’re gonna find out who’s got the probe. I’ll be blasting off this twilit rock before you even figure out which of the zaibatsu have it!”"

rows.original: “Good to know it’s one of them,” you muse. You’ll just have to get in cozy with them to find out the truth of the matter.
rows.translation: “很高兴知道探针就在他们其中一家手里。”你沉吟道。你只需要想办法和他们套近乎，就能查明真相。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good to know it’s one of them,” you muse. You’ll just have to get in cozy with them to find out the truth of the matter."

rows.original: A momentary fluster passes over [rival.name]’s face. Maybe [rival.heShe] gave away a little more than [rival.heShe] intended. Oops! Your cousin’s about to give you another piece of [rival.hisHer] mind, but is interrupted by a crackle from the loudspeakers overhead, accompanied by a sudden cut in the muzak that’s been playing over them since you arrived.
rows.translation: [rival.name]脸上一时闪过窘迫。也许[rival.heShe]透露的情报比[rival.heShe]原本打算的多了一点。哎呀！你的表亲正要再把[rival.hisHer]一番意见说给你听，却被头顶扬声器突然传来的电流声打断；从你抵达时起就一直播放的背景音乐也骤然停止。
rows.raw: "\n\nA momentary fluster passes over [rival.name]’s face. Maybe [rival.heShe] gave away a little more than [rival.heShe] intended. Oops! Your cousin’s about to give you another piece of [rival.hisHer] mind, but is interrupted by a crackle from the loudspeakers overhead, accompanied by a sudden cut in the muzak that’s been playing over them since you arrived."

rows.original: “Alright, party-goers,” a sensual voice drawls, marred by just a little too much bass-boost. “The band’s finally set up and ready to go. So who’s ready for the first dance of the night - sponsored by Utopian Skies, bringing you closer to the clouds one tango at a time. Now lock tails with a partner everyone!”
rows.translation: “好了，各位派对来宾。”一个性感的声音拖着长腔说道，只是过度增强的低音略微破坏了效果。“乐队终于准备完毕，可以登台了。那么，谁准备好跳今晚的第一支舞？本舞曲由乌托邦天空公司赞助，每一曲探戈都让你离云端更近一步。现在，各位都和舞伴缠上尾巴吧！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Alright, party-goers,” a sensual voice drawls, marred by just a little too much bass-boost. “The band’s finally set up and ready to go. So who’s ready for the first dance of the night - sponsored by Utopian Skies, bringing you closer to the clouds one tango at a time. Now lock tails with a partner everyone!”"

rows.original: [rival.name] sneers. “Well, go on, find some floozie to cling to already! I’ve got to go find a probe!”
rows.translation: [rival.name]冷笑道。“行了，快去找个荡妇黏在一起吧！我还得去找探针呢！”
rows.raw: "\n\n[rival.name] sneers. “Well, go on, find some floozie to cling to already! I’ve got to go find a probe!”"

rows.original: Ask [rival.name]
rows.translation: 邀请[rival.name]
rows.raw: "Ask [rival.name]"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “I already found one,” you grin, grabbing [rival.name]’s wrist and giving [rival.himHer] a yank towards the heart of the party.
rows.translation: “我已经找到一个了。”你咧嘴笑着，抓住[rival.name]的手腕，将[rival.himHer]一把拽向派对中央。
rows.raw: "“I already found one,” you grin, grabbing [rival.name]’s wrist and giving [rival.himHer] a yank towards the heart of the party."

rows.original: “Wh-what are you doing, let go of me!” [rival.heShe] stammers, tail thrashing. But any resistance is fleeting at best, a token struggle until you’re out in the middle of the dance floor, surrounded by colorfully-dressed zaika all entwining tails with each other. “You can’t be serious!”
rows.translation: “你、你干什么，放开我！”[rival.heShe]结结巴巴地说，尾巴胡乱甩动。但那点抵抗充其量只是做做样子，没一会儿你们就来到了舞池中央，周围是一群衣着缤纷、彼此缠绕着尾巴的扎伊卡。“你不是认真的吧！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wh-what are you doing, let go of me!” [rival.heShe] stammers, tail thrashing. But any resistance is fleeting at best, a token struggle until you’re out in the middle of the dance floor, surrounded by colorfully-dressed zaika all entwining tails with each other. “You can’t be serious!”"

rows.original: You smirk, already starting to dance. Of course you can be. All this time you’ve been chasing each other and never had a real chance to get to know each other. What’s the harm, anyway? It’s not like either of you are getting an advantage, or losing it, by taking a break. And besides, [rival.heShe] is here on Carver Catering’s dime - they wouldn’t be happy if [rival.heShe] got all pissy with a guest, huh?
rows.translation: 你坏笑着，已经开始起舞。当然是认真的。你们一直以来都在互相追逐，却从未真正有机会了解彼此。况且，休息一下又有什么坏处？这既不会让你们任何一方取得优势，也不会丧失优势。再说，[rival.heShe]是拿卡弗餐饮公司的钱来这里的，要是[rival.heShe]对客人大发脾气，他们可不会高兴，对吧？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou smirk, already starting to dance. Of course you can be. All this time you’ve been chasing each other and never had a real chance to get to know each other. What’s the harm, anyway? It’s not like either of you are getting an advantage, or losing it, by taking a break. And besides, [rival.heShe] is here on Carver Catering’s dime - they wouldn’t be happy if [rival.heShe] got all pissy with a guest, huh?"

rows.original: [rival.name] huffs indignantly, but doesn’t pull away while you start to sway with [rival.himHer] to the beat. The alien instruments are surprisingly smooth, pleasant to the ears, but the tempo is strange compared to Terran music - clearly made for people with a tail to steady themselves.
rows.translation: [rival.name]不满地哼了一声，但在你开始搂着[rival.himHer]随节拍摇摆时并未挣开。外星乐器奏出的旋律出奇地流畅悦耳，只是与地球音乐相比，节拍有些古怪——显然是为那些能用尾巴稳住身体的人编排的。
rows.raw: "\n\n[rival.name] huffs indignantly, but doesn’t pull away while you start to sway with [rival.himHer] to the beat. The alien instruments are surprisingly smooth, pleasant to the ears, but the tempo is strange compared to Terran music - clearly made for people with a tail to steady themselves. "

rows.original: Luckily, you and your cousin are both more than able to make do
rows.translation: 好在你和表亲都完全能够应付
rows.raw: "Luckily, you and your cousin are both more than able to make do"

rows.original: At least your cousin is able to make do, even if you’re a little unsteady with the rapid movements the dance demands
rows.translation: 至少你的表亲还能应付自如，哪怕舞蹈要求的快速动作让你有些站不稳
rows.raw: "At least your cousin is able to make do, even if you’re a little unsteady with the rapid movements the dance demands"

rows.original: . The two of you must make something of a sight, drawing the eyes of all the natives - and a fair few off-worlders paired with natives, too - around you. [rival.name]’s cheeks are flushed red, trying to hide [rival.hisHer] face in your chest. A Carver manager working the refreshments table near the dance floor scowls at [rival.hisHer] back, saying a few harsh words into an earpiece. Fuck him, though - you’re going to steal as much time away with [rival.name] as you can. There’s an entire childhood of lost time you have to make up for, and yet...
rows.translation: 。你们俩想必构成了一道奇景，引得周围所有本地人侧目，就连不少与本地人结伴的外来者也看了过来。[rival.name]双颊涨得通红，竭力把[rival.hisHer]脸藏在你胸前。舞池附近饮料桌旁的一名卡弗公司经理怒视着[rival.hisHer]后背，对耳机厉声说了几句。去他的——你要尽可能多地从他手里抢走时间，陪在[rival.name]身边。你们失去了整整一个童年，得把那些时光补回来，可是...
rows.raw: ". The two of you must make something of a sight, drawing the eyes of all the natives - and a fair few off-worlders paired with natives, too - around you. [rival.name]’s cheeks are flushed red, trying to hide [rival.hisHer] face in your chest. A Carver manager working the refreshments table near the dance floor scowls at [rival.hisHer] back, saying a few harsh words into an earpiece. Fuck him, though - you’re going to steal as much time away with [rival.name] as you can. There’s an entire childhood of lost time you have to make up for, and yet..."

rows.original: The dance ends far too early, coming to a climactic tempo and then... then nothing. The zaika all step back to the edges of the dance floor and slap their tails on the ground, creating a wet cacophony that nearly drowns out the voice trying to speak over the PA. There’s a general bustle of bodies searching for new dance partners, pushing and pulling at you, the oh-so-desirable alien heir
rows.translation: 舞曲结束得实在太早，节奏攀至高潮，随后...便戛然而止。扎伊卡人纷纷退到舞池边缘，以尾巴拍击地面，制造出一片湿漉漉的嘈杂声，几乎盖过了公共广播中试图讲话的声音。人群一阵骚动，四处寻找新的舞伴，推搡拉扯着你这位炙手可热的外星继承人
rows.raw: "\n\nThe dance ends far too early, coming to a climactic tempo and then... then nothing. The zaika all step back to the edges of the dance floor and slap their tails on the ground, creating a wet cacophony that nearly drowns out the voice trying to speak over the PA. There’s a general bustle of bodies searching for new dance partners, pushing and pulling at you, the oh-so-desirable alien heir"

rows.original: ess
rows.raw: "ess"

rows.original: ... and then all of a sudden, [rival.name]’s hand is ripped away from you. By the time you’re able to turn around, [rival.heShe]’s long gone. Damn.
rows.translation: ...可就在转眼间，[rival.name]的手被人从你手中猛地扯走。等你终于转过身时，[rival.heShe]早已不见踪影。该死。
rows.raw: "... and then all of a sudden, [rival.name]’s hand is ripped away from you. By the time you’re able to turn around, [rival.heShe]’s long gone. Damn."

rows.original: You step back from the dance floor. Better find those executives somehow...
rows.translation: 你退出舞池。最好想办法找到那些高管...
rows.raw: "\n\nYou step back from the dance floor. Better find those executives somehow..."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Ask [rival.name]
rows.translation: 询问[rival.name]
rows.raw: "Ask [rival.name]"

rows.original: [rival.name]’s head start isn’t getting any bigger, right?
rows.translation: [rival.name]抢到的领先优势总不会继续扩大吧？
rows.raw: "[rival.name]’s head start isn’t getting any bigger, right?"

rows.original: See Ya!
rows.translation: 再见！
rows.raw: "See Ya!"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You march away from your cousin as the zaika all around the two of you start mingling, tails entwining in an alien dance. You’ve got to find your way to somebody important here - before [rival.name] gets too much of a head start!
rows.translation: 当周围的扎伊卡人开始交际、尾巴在异族舞蹈中彼此缠绕时，你迈步离开了表亲。你必须设法找到这里的某个重要人物——赶在[rival.name]取得太多领先优势之前！
rows.raw: "You march away from your cousin as the zaika all around the two of you start mingling, tails entwining in an alien dance. You’ve got to find your way to somebody important here - before [rival.name] gets too much of a head start!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: See Ya
rows.translation: 再见
rows.raw: "See Ya"

rows.original: Smell ya later!
rows.translation: 回头再闻！
rows.raw: "Smell ya later!"

rows.original: You’ve got a probe to find, too! Just a step behind [rival.himHer], that’s all!
rows.translation: 你也得找到探针！你只是落后[rival.himHer]一步而已！
rows.raw: "You’ve got a probe to find, too! Just a step behind [rival.himHer], that’s all!"

rows.original: A Good Look
rows.translation: 仔细端详
rows.raw: "A Good Look"

rows.original: That’s a good look on you, cousin! Real cute.
rows.translation: 表亲，这造型真适合你！可爱极了。
rows.raw: "That’s a good look on you, cousin! Real cute."

rows.original: Make Fun
rows.translation: 取笑
rows.raw: "Make Fun"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: <i>“Wow you really are letting your
rows.translation: <i>“哇，你还真把自己的
rows.raw: "<i>“Wow you really are letting your "

rows.original: fursona
rows.translation: 兽设
rows.raw: "fursona"

rows.original: furry self
rows.translation: 毛茸茸的一面
rows.raw: "furry self"

rows.original: out and proud, huh?” you snicker, tweaking one of your cousin’s feline ears. “Loser.”
rows.translation: 展现得淋漓尽致啊？”你窃笑着，捏了捏表亲的一只猫耳。“逊毙了。”
rows.raw: " out and proud, huh?” you snicker, tweaking one of your cousin’s feline ears. “Loser.”"

rows.original: [rival.name] balls [rival.hisHer] fists, huffing and puffing in indignation. “You’re one to talk you stupid mongrel!” [rival.heShe] finally snaps back, yanking away from you.
rows.translation: [rival.name]攥紧[rival.hisHer]拳头，气恼得呼哧直喘。“你这条蠢杂种还有脸说我！”[rival.heShe]终于厉声反击，一把挣开了你。
rows.raw: "\n\n[rival.name] balls [rival.hisHer] fists, huffing and puffing in indignation. “You’re one to talk you stupid mongrel!” [rival.heShe] finally snaps back, yanking away from you."

rows.original: [rival.name] sputters in protest. “D-don’t you make fun of me!”
rows.translation: [rival.name]结结巴巴地抗议。“不、不许取笑我！”
rows.raw: "\n\n[rival.name] sputters in protest. “D-don’t you make fun of me!”"

rows.original: [rival.heShe] growls, oh-so-very lion-like for just a moment there, and [rival.name] bares some newly-grown
rows.translation: [rival.heShe]低吼起来，那一瞬间简直像极了狮子；[rival.name]龇出几颗新长出的
rows.raw: " [rival.heShe] growls, oh-so-very lion-like for just a moment there, and [rival.name] bares some newly-grown "

rows.original: and painted
rows.translation: 以及涂了色的
rows.raw: "and painted "

rows.original: claws at you
rows.translation: 朝你抓来
rows.raw: "claws at you"

rows.original: “Douche! And what are you still talking to me for anyway? You’ve got a lot of tail-dick to suck your way through if you’re gonna find out who’s got the probe. I’ll be blasting off this twilit rock before you even figure out which of the zaibatsu have it!”
rows.translation: “蠢货！再说了，你还跟我废什么话？要想查出探针在谁手里，你可得一路吸遍数不清的尾巴鸡巴。我还没等你弄清是哪家财阀拿着它，就已经从这颗暮色笼罩的破星球上飞走了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Douche! And what are you still talking to me for anyway? You’ve got a lot of tail-dick to suck your way through if you’re gonna find out who’s got the probe. I’ll be blasting off this twilit rock before you even figure out which of the zaibatsu have it!”"

rows.original: “Good to know it’s one of them,” you muse. You’ll just have to get cozy with them and find out the truth...
rows.translation: “知道是在他们之中就好，”你思忖道。看来只需设法亲近他们，再查明真相就行了...
rows.raw: "\n\n“Good to know it’s one of them,” you muse. You’ll just have to get cozy with them and find out the truth..."

rows.original: A momentary fluster passes over [rival.name]’s face. Maybe [rival.heShe] gave away a little more than [rival.heShe] intended. Oops!
rows.translation: [rival.name]脸上掠过一瞬慌乱。也许[rival.heShe]透露的东西比[rival.heShe]原本打算说的多了一点。哎呀！
rows.raw: "\n\nA momentary fluster passes over [rival.name]’s face. Maybe [rival.heShe] gave away a little more than [rival.heShe] intended. Oops!"

rows.original: Shame there’s all these people around... Ah well. You flip [rival.name] the bird and get back to the job at hand. Now you’ve got a clue at least: you’ve got to find a way to meet the zaibatsu leadership!
rows.translation: 可惜周围有这么多人...算了。你朝[rival.name]竖起中指，转身继续手头的任务。至少现在有了一条线索：你得想办法见到各大财阀的领导层！
rows.raw: "\n\nShame there’s all these people around... Ah well. You flip [rival.name] the bird and get back to the job at hand. Now you’ve got a clue at least: you’ve got to find a way to meet the zaibatsu leadership!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Make Fun
rows.translation: 嘲笑
rows.raw: "Make Fun"

rows.original: Haha what a loser.
rows.translation: 哈哈，真是个废物。
rows.raw: "Haha what a loser."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Alright, if that’s what she wants - you can doubtless make some time for the Maven of one of the three zaibatsu. Plus, the opportunity to recount all the villains you’ve laid low is always fun.
rows.translation: 好吧，既然她想听，你当然能抽出时间陪陪三大财阀之一的贤者。再说，细数那些被你击败的恶棍向来都很有趣。
rows.raw: "Alright, if that’s what she wants - you can doubtless make some time for the Maven of one of the three zaibatsu. Plus, the opportunity to recount all the villains you’ve laid low is always fun."

rows.original: The Bright Water attendants smile and guide you over to a sitting space in one of the pyramid’s corners, surrounded by company Peers. The way they’re arranged, it’s almost like they’re screening you and the Maven from the rest of the party with their bodies. The two of you sit face to face, served wine and snacks as you’re encouraged to begin retelling your adventures from the day you first landed on Mhen’ga to your encounters when Captain Khorgan’s crew, from Myrellion’s trenches to Zhèng Shi’s trappy pirate lord - and everything in between.
rows.translation: 澄水的侍从面带微笑，引着你来到金字塔一角的休息区，周围簇拥着公司的同侪。他们的站位简直像是用身体把你和贤者同聚会中的其他人隔开。你们面对面坐下，侍从送上葡萄酒和点心，鼓励你从初次登陆门加那天讲起，讲到与科尔甘船长一伙人的遭遇，从米瑞利昂的战壕讲到郑氏那位阴柔的海盗领主，以及其间发生的一切。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Bright Water attendants smile and guide you over to a sitting space in one of the pyramid’s corners, surrounded by company Peers. The way they’re arranged, it’s almost like they’re screening you and the Maven from the rest of the party with their bodies. The two of you sit face to face, served wine and snacks as you’re encouraged to begin retelling your adventures from the day you first landed on Mhen’ga to your encounters when Captain Khorgan’s crew, from Myrellion’s trenches to Zhèng Shi’s trappy pirate lord - and everything in between."

rows.original: Maven Fassbin nods her head eagerly along with the beats of your story, occasionally taking hits off of her breath mask or sipping down glasses of wine that are always quickly refilled. When you’ve finished, she has a particularly ghoulish smile stretched across her cybernetic face.
rows.translation: 法斯宾贤者随着故事的节奏兴奋地点头，不时从呼吸面罩中吸上一口，或抿下总会迅速续满的葡萄酒。等你讲完时，她那张义体面孔上已经挂起格外瘆人的笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nMaven Fassbin nods her head eagerly along with the beats of your story, occasionally taking hits off of her breath mask or sipping down glasses of wine that are always quickly refilled. When you’ve finished, she has a particularly ghoulish smile stretched across her cybernetic face."

rows.original: “Marvelous! Truly exceptional!” she claps. “These villains you’ve defeated, what fools! Their plans and defenses were so obviously flawed, and your own strength - so overpowering!
rows.translation: “精彩！实在非同凡响！”她拍手称赞。“被你击败的那些恶棍真是一群蠢货！他们的计划和防御显然漏洞百出，而你自身的力量又如此压倒性地强大！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Marvelous! Truly exceptional!” she claps. “These villains you’ve defeated, what fools! Their plans and defenses were so obviously flawed, and your own strength - so overpowering! "

rows.original: Especially the ‘badger’ creature! What a twisted mind... so obsessed with her own fetishes that she couldn’t see the threat you posed.
rows.translation: 尤其是那个‘獾’生物！多么扭曲的心灵...她对自己的性癖执迷不悟，竟然完全看不见你构成的威胁。
rows.raw: "Especially the ‘badger’ creature! What a twisted mind... so obsessed with her own fetishes that she couldn’t see the threat you posed."

rows.original: And that cybernetic reconditioning specialist... Po? Truly admirable work she did. But kidnapping the friends of an accomplished avenger like yourself? Tsk! Even a tower of intellect like her must still do her research.
rows.translation: 还有那位义体再调教专家...波？她的成果确实令人钦佩。但居然绑架像你这样成就斐然的复仇者的朋友？啧！即使她拥有高塔般的智慧，也依然得先做好调查。
rows.raw: "And that cybernetic reconditioning specialist... Po? Truly admirable work she did. But kidnapping the friends of an accomplished avenger like yourself? Tsk! Even a tower of intellect like her must still do her research."

rows.original: The Maven chuckles to herself, crossing a leg. “Speaking of research, perhaps you could enlighten me, captain. One of your mega-corporations, Xenogen. I’ve heard good things about them, about their plans for Dhaal. Imagine, accomplishing with genetic engineering what we’ve belabored with cybernetics!”
rows.translation: 贤者独自轻笑，翘起一条腿。“说到调查，也许你能替我解惑，船长。你们有一家巨型企业，叫异源生物科技。我听过不少关于他们的好话，也听说了他们对达尔的计划。想象一下，他们竟能用基因工程完成我们靠义体技术辛苦实现的一切！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Maven chuckles to herself, crossing a leg. “Speaking of research, perhaps you could enlighten me, captain. One of your mega-corporations, Xenogen. I’ve heard good things about them, about their plans for Dhaal. Imagine, accomplishing with genetic engineering what we’ve belabored with cybernetics!”"

rows.original: Her ears twitch, and a robotic hand rubs a black thumb across her chin. “So? Are the stories true?”
rows.translation: 她的耳朵抖了抖，一只机械手用黑色拇指摩挲着下巴。“那么？那些传闻是真的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer ears twitch, and a robotic hand rubs a black thumb across her chin. “So? Are the stories true?”"

rows.original: Xenogen Good
rows.translation: 异源很好
rows.raw: "Xenogen Good"

rows.original: Xenogen Good

rows.original: You’ve had no bad experiences with Xenogen...
rows.translation: 你和异源打交道时从没碰上什么坏事...
