rows.original: Oh no, Xenogen’s pretty bad.
rows.translation: 不，异源其实相当糟糕。
rows.raw: "Oh no, Xenogen’s pretty bad."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You shake your head, earning a sneer from the Maven.
rows.translation: 你摇了摇头，惹得贤者露出冷笑。
rows.raw: "You shake your head, earning a sneer from the Maven."

rows.original: <i>“Ah, the kind that leave [pc.hisHer] PR to the rumor mill. For your sake, then, let us hope that public opinion is already kind.
rows.translation: <i>“啊，原来你是那种把[pc.hisHer]公关交给流言蜚语的人。既然如此，为了你自己着想，就让我们希望公众现在已经对你抱有好感。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Ah, the kind that leave [pc.hisHer] PR to the rumor mill. For your sake, then, let us hope that public opinion is already kind. "

rows.original: Though the things I have heard already... I am not so sure that’s likely. We can only hope Dhaal survives your visit, captain.
rows.translation: 不过就我已经听说的那些事来看...我可不太确定这有多大可能。我们只能祈祷达尔能在你的到访中幸存下来，船长。
rows.raw: "Though the things I have heard already... I am not so sure that’s likely. We can only hope Dhaal survives your visit, captain."

rows.original: At least you haven’t destroyed any planets... yet. I suppose we ought to all be thankful of that.
rows.translation: 至少你还没有摧毁任何星球...暂时没有。我想我们所有人都该为此心怀感激。
rows.raw: "At least you haven’t destroyed any planets... yet. I suppose we ought to all be thankful of that."

rows.original: The Maven tuts, even while reaching for her breath mask. She takes a deep hit of her chemical cocktail, taking the opportunity to look you up and down with those ghoulish green cyber-eyes. “So, perhaps then you can tell me something else about the galaxy at large, if not your own adventures: One of your mega-corporations, Xenogen. I’ve heard good things about them, about their plans for Dhaal. Imagine, accomplishing with genetic engineering what we’ve belabored with cybernetics!”
rows.translation: 贤者一边咂嘴，一边伸手去拿呼吸面罩。她深深吸了一口化学混合物，趁机用那双鬼魅般的绿色义眼把你从头到脚打量了一遍。“那么，既然你不愿谈自己的冒险经历，或许可以告诉我一些关于银河系整体情况的事：比如你们的一家巨型企业，异源生物科技。我听说过不少关于他们的好话，也听说了他们对达尔的规划。想象一下，用基因工程做到我们耗费无数心血才以义体技术实现的事情！”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Maven tuts, even while reaching for her breath mask. She takes a deep hit of her chemical cocktail, taking the opportunity to look you up and down with those ghoulish green cyber-eyes. “So, perhaps then you can tell me something else about the galaxy at large, if not your own adventures: One of your mega-corporations, Xenogen. I’ve heard good things about them, about their plans for Dhaal. Imagine, accomplishing with genetic engineering what we’ve belabored with cybernetics!”"

rows.original: Her ears twitch, and a robotic hand rubs a black thumb across her chin. “So? Are the stories true?”
rows.translation: 她的耳朵抽动了一下，一只机械手用黑色拇指摩挲着下巴。“所以呢？那些传闻是真的吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nHer ears twitch, and a robotic hand rubs a black thumb across her chin. “So? Are the stories true?”"

rows.original: BRIGHTWATER_PP
rows.raw: "BRIGHTWATER_PP"

rows.translation: 异源生物科技不错
rows.raw: "Xenogen Good"

rows.raw: "Oh no, Xenogen’s pretty bad."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Nothing but good experiences with them,” you tell the Maven. Being a mega-corporation, you can’t have escaped interacting with them and their products, from cosmetics to medicine, since you were just a kid. Your dad wasn’t such a brand stickler that he’d insist on you using nothing but Steele product after all. And since joining the Rush, it’s hard not to see their influence spreading across the galaxy... all in all, you approve of what they’re been getting up to. Though of course, it’s nowhere near as good as Steele Tech. Obviously.
rows.translation: “我和他们打交道时，体验一直都很好，”你告诉贤者。毕竟那是一家巨型企业，自你还是个孩子起，就不可能完全避开他们和他们的产品，从化妆品到药品，应有尽有。你的父亲还没执着品牌到坚持让你只用斯蒂尔产品的地步。自从投身开拓潮以来，你也很难不看到他们的影响力正在整个银河系扩张...总的来说，你赞同他们一直以来的作为。当然，异源生物科技远远比不上斯蒂尔科技。显而易见。
rows.raw: "“Nothing but good experiences with them,” you tell the Maven. Being a mega-corporation, you can’t have escaped interacting with them and their products, from cosmetics to medicine, since you were just a kid. Your dad wasn’t such a brand stickler that he’d insist on you using nothing but Steele product after all. And since joining the Rush, it’s hard not to see their influence spreading across the galaxy... all in all, you approve of what they’re been getting up to. Though of course, it’s nowhere near as good as Steele Tech. Obviously."

rows.original: “Obviously,” the Maven chuckles. “But thank you. I appreciate your candor... as does Bright Water. Indeed, I’d like to give you a gift, captain. A sign of the respect you’ve earned tonight.”
rows.translation: “显而易见，”贤者轻笑道。“不过还是谢谢你。我很欣赏你的坦率...澄水也一样。事实上，我想送你一份礼物，船长。这是你今晚赢得我们尊重的象征。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Obviously,” the Maven chuckles. “But thank you. I appreciate your candor... as does Bright Water. Indeed, I’d like to give you a gift, captain. A sign of the respect you’ve earned tonight.”"

rows.original: She gestures to one of her followers, who approaches with a briefcase, which she sets on a chair next to you. A great green Bright Water logo is pressed into its silvery exterior, glowing faintly with neon light.
rows.translation: 她朝一名追随者示意，那人拎着一只公文箱走过来，将它放在你旁边的一张椅子上。银色箱体表面压印着一个巨大的绿色澄水标志，泛着微弱的霓虹光。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gestures to one of her followers, who approaches with a briefcase, which she sets on a chair next to you. A great green Bright Water logo is pressed into its silvery exterior, glowing faintly with neon light."

rows.original: “We will be watching your career on Dhaal with great interest, captain. Have a pleasant evening.”
rows.translation: “我们会怀着浓厚兴趣关注你在达尔的事业，船长。祝你今晚过得愉快。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We will be watching your career on Dhaal with great interest, captain. Have a pleasant evening.”"

rows.original: Taking a final huff of her chemical supply, the Maven motions to her followers and withdraws towards another gathering of the rich and famous of the twilit world.
rows.translation: 最后吸了一口化学制剂后，贤者向追随者们示意，随后退向暮色世界另一群富豪名流聚集之处。
rows.raw: "\n\nTaking a final huff of her chemical supply, the Maven motions to her followers and withdraws towards another gathering of the rich and famous of the twilit world."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Oh, no,” you caution the Maven, “Xenogen’s just the worst.
rows.translation: “噢，不，”你提醒贤者，“异源生物科技简直糟透了。
rows.raw: "“Oh, no,” you caution the Maven, “Xenogen’s just the worst. "

rows.original: They contracted me to do some naaaaasty shit back on Mhen’ga. Aside from that?
rows.translation: 他们曾雇我在门加做过一些非——常肮脏的事。除此之外？
rows.raw: "They contracted me to do some naaaaasty shit back on Mhen’ga. Aside from that? "

rows.original: You can’t go anywhere on the extranet and not read about their shady dealings.”
rows.translation: 你在外网上随便逛到哪儿，都能看到他们那些见不得光的勾当。”
rows.raw: "You can’t go anywhere on the extranet and not read about their shady dealings.”"

rows.original: You spend a few minutes going over the common rumors about Xenogen, about their unethical research and how they all but enslave natives.
rows.translation: 你花了几分钟讲述关于异源生物科技的常见传闻，包括他们不道德的研究，以及他们实际上如何奴役原住民。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou spend a few minutes going over the common rumors about Xenogen, about their unethical research and how they all but enslave natives. "

rows.original: Not to mention playing both sides of the Myr war against each other for future profit.
rows.translation: 更别提他们为了未来的利益，在米尔战争中同时玩弄交战双方。
rows.raw: "Not to mention playing both sides of the Myr war against each other for future profit. "

rows.original: Really, you can’t say much of anything good about the corporation... and they definitely don’t have any good intentions when it comes to Dhaal.
rows.translation: 说真的，这家公司几乎没有任何优点可言...而且他们对达尔也绝对没安什么好心。
rows.raw: "Really, you can’t say much of anything good about the corporation... and they definitely don’t have any good intentions when it comes to Dhaal."

rows.original: The Maven rubs her chin in consternation as you speak, clearly unhappy with the news. When you’re finished, she thumbs her chin and motions to one of her associates, whispering something in her elfin ear. You’re half-sure you hear Xenogen’s name, but over the steady din of the party’s background noise, it’s hard to say. When the Bright Water agent moves away, the Maven returns her attention to you.
rows.translation: 听你讲述时，贤者忧心忡忡地摩挲着下巴，显然对这个消息很不高兴。等你说完，她用拇指蹭了蹭下巴，随后向一名同伴打了个手势，在对方精灵般的耳边低声说了些什么。你隐约觉得自己听到了异源生物科技的名字，但派对上持续不断的背景喧闹让你无法确定。澄水特工离开后，贤者重新把注意力转回你身上。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Maven rubs her chin in consternation as you speak, clearly unhappy with the news. When you’re finished, she thumbs her chin and motions to one of her associates, whispering something in her elfin ear. You’re half-sure you hear Xenogen’s name, but over the steady din of the party’s background noise, it’s hard to say. When the Bright Water agent moves away, the Maven returns her attention to you."

rows.original: “That is... disheartening. Well, thank you for your time, captain. I will let you get back to the partying. Have a pleasant evening.”
rows.translation: “这真是...令人沮丧。好吧，谢谢你抽出时间，船长。我就不打扰你继续参加派对了。祝你今晚过得愉快。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“That is... disheartening. Well, thank you for your time, captain. I will let you get back to the partying. Have a pleasant evening.”"

rows.original: Taking a final huff of her chemical supply, the Maven motions to her followers and withdraws towards another gathering of the rich and famous of the twilit world.
rows.translation: 最后吸了一口化学制剂后，贤者向追随者们示意，随后退向暮色世界另一群富豪名流聚集之处。
rows.raw: "\n\nTaking a final huff of her chemical supply, the Maven motions to her followers and withdraws towards another gathering of the rich and famous of the twilit world."

rows.raw: "BRIGHTWATER_PP"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You shake your head, leaning back away from the all-too-forward alien. Recounting stories of slavers and pirates for some high-rise executive doesn’t sound like your version of a good time, and more importantly, the big huff she gives you is worth the inevitable social price you’re going to pay for it. Corellah’s cheeks puff up and her lips scrunch as she crosses her arms, as if she’s shocked that she’s been told no for once.
rows.translation: 你摇摇头，向后靠去，避开这个过于主动的外星人。为了某个高楼里的高管讲述奴隶贩子与海盗的故事，可不算你心目中的乐事；更重要的是，她气鼓鼓地长叹一声，那副模样完全值得你为此付出不可避免的社交代价。科蕾拉双颊鼓起，嘴唇紧抿，交叉双臂，仿佛她这辈子第一次被人拒绝，震惊得不知所措。
rows.raw: "You shake your head, leaning back away from the all-too-forward alien. Recounting stories of slavers and pirates for some high-rise executive doesn’t sound like your version of a good time, and more importantly, the big huff she gives you is worth the inevitable social price you’re going to pay for it. Corellah’s cheeks puff up and her lips scrunch as she crosses her arms, as if she’s shocked that she’s been told no for once."

rows.original: “Well! Keep your secrets then, captain. I understand you aliens don’t wish to overwhelm we pathetic, squabbling primitives. Or perhaps, you don’t wish to scare us off with talk of the dangers up above? Either way, at the very least, you can sate my curiosity on something more grounded, can’t you?”
rows.translation: “好吧！那就保守你的秘密吧，船长。我明白，你们这些外星人不想让我们这些可悲又纷争不断的原始种族承受太多信息。又或者，你是不想谈论天外的危险，以免吓跑我们？不管怎样，至少你可以满足我对某些更贴近生活之事的好奇心，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well! Keep your secrets then, captain. I understand you aliens don’t wish to overwhelm we pathetic, squabbling primitives. Or perhaps, you don’t wish to scare us off with talk of the dangers up above? Either way, at the very least, you can sate my curiosity on something more grounded, can’t you?”"

rows.original: “Let’s talk about something more fun, hmm,” Corellah purrs. “Let’s talk fun stuff! I’ve been hearing all sorts of things about the mega-corporations in the greater galaxy. Steele Tech, Xenogen, Carver... and Tamani. So, which would you say is the most fun, the one that can give a girl the best time?”
rows.translation: “我们聊点更有趣的事情，好吗？”科蕾拉娇声说道。“聊聊好玩的东西！我听说过不少关于更广阔银河系里那些巨型企业的事情。斯蒂尔科技、异源生物科技、卡弗...还有塔玛妮。那么，你觉得哪一家最好玩，最能让姑娘享受到最棒的时光？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Let’s talk about something more fun, hmm,” Corellah purrs. “Let’s talk fun stuff! I’ve been hearing all sorts of things about the mega-corporations in the greater galaxy. Steele Tech, Xenogen, Carver... and Tamani. So, which would you say is the most fun, the one that can give a girl the best time?”"

rows.original: Those are certainly some loaded options...
rows.translation: 这些选项还真是各有深意...
rows.raw: "\n\nThose are certainly some loaded options..."

rows.raw: "UTOPIAN_PP"

rows.raw: "Steele Tech"

rows.translation: 异源生物科技
rows.raw: "Xenogen"

rows.original: Xenogen
rows.translation: 异源生物科技
rows.raw: "Xenogen"

rows.original: What’s more fun than a bunch of weird alien transformations, huh?
rows.translation: 还有什么能比一堆稀奇古怪的外星变形更有趣，嗯？
rows.raw: "What’s more fun than a bunch of weird alien transformations, huh?"

rows.translation: 卡佛
rows.raw: "Carver"

rows.original: Carver
rows.translation: 卡佛
rows.raw: "Carver"

rows.original: Expertly-molded courtesans, hand-crafted in mind and body? What could be better?
rows.translation: 从身心两方面精心塑造、手工打造的交际花？还有什么能比这更棒？
rows.raw: "Expertly-molded courtesans, hand-crafted in mind and body? What could be better?"

rows.original: TamaniCorp
rows.translation: 塔玛妮公司
rows.raw: "TamaniCorp"

rows.original: TamaniCorp
rows.translation: 塔玛妮公司
rows.raw: "TamaniCorp"

rows.original: What’s more fun than sex, drugs, and rock & roll? Well, mostly the sex and drugs anyway.
rows.translation: 还有什么能比性爱、毒品和摇滚乐更有趣？好吧，主要还是性爱和毒品。
rows.raw: "What’s more fun than sex, drugs, and rock & roll? Well, mostly the sex and drugs anyway."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “Alright,” you say, collecting your thoughts. You’ve certainly have had more than your fair share of encounters with the scum of the galaxy since setting off on your journey. Perhaps the most dramatic was your confrontation with Captain Khorgan’s band of pirates in the heart of Tarkus, as they took the whole planet hostage with a huge bomb! Of course even after your encounters with that eccentric crew, you’ve more recently had to fight your way through the bowels of the pirate-and-slaver-infested asteroid station of Zhèng Shi. You ended up going head to head against several different gangs of pirates, and even toppling their king - such as he was.
rows.translation: “好吧，”你整理了一下思绪。自踏上旅程以来，你遇见的银河渣滓肯定已经远超自己应有的份额。也许其中最惊心动魄的一次，就是你在塔库斯腹地与科尔根船长的海盗团伙对峙，当时他们用一枚巨型炸弹劫持了整颗星球！当然，即便经历过与那群古怪家伙的交锋，最近你还不得不一路杀穿海盗与奴隶贩子盘踞的小行星空间站郑石内部。你最终正面迎战了好几个不同的海盗帮派，甚至还推翻了他们的海盗王 - 姑且算是王吧。
rows.raw: "“Alright,” you say, collecting your thoughts. You’ve certainly have had more than your fair share of encounters with the scum of the galaxy since setting off on your journey. Perhaps the most dramatic was your confrontation with Captain Khorgan’s band of pirates in the heart of Tarkus, as they took the whole planet hostage with a huge bomb! Of course even after your encounters with that eccentric crew, you’ve more recently had to fight your way through the bowels of the pirate-and-slaver-infested asteroid station of Zhèng Shi. You ended up going head to head against several different gangs of pirates, and even toppling their king - such as he was."

rows.original: FALL OF THE PHOENIX STATUS
rows.raw: "FALL OF THE PHOENIX STATUS"

rows.original: FALL OF THE PHOENIX STATUS
rows.raw: "FALL OF THE PHOENIX STATUS"

rows.original: Of course, you can’t forget your encounters with the Black Void alongside Saendra, saving the beautiful bitch-kitty from their relentless hunt.
rows.translation: 当然，你也不能忘记与桑德拉并肩对抗黑暗虚空的经历，从他们无休止的追捕中救下了那位美丽的猫咪辣妹。
rows.raw: "Of course, you can’t forget your encounters with the Black Void alongside Saendra, saving the beautiful bitch-kitty from their relentless hunt. "

rows.original: And you can’t forget your encounters with the mysterious thief Kara, intent on dismantling the Void at any cost. The two of you took down an entire pirate base together, despite being basically a military fortress.
rows.translation: 你也不能忘记与神秘盗贼卡拉相遇的经历，她不惜一切代价也要瓦解虚空。尽管那里基本就是一座军事要塞，你们俩还是联手端掉了整座海盗基地。
rows.raw: " And you can’t forget your encounters with the mysterious thief Kara, intent on dismantling the Void at any cost. The two of you took down an entire pirate base together, despite being basically a military fortress."

rows.original: “My, my, how heroic,” Corellah purrs. “Such a cruel and dangerous galaxy out there, isn’t it. I had so hoped that worlds of light might surround us, but it seems every bit as cruel and self-centered as our own planet. Tsk!”
rows.translation: “哎呀呀，多么英勇，”科蕾拉柔声说道。“外面的银河真是残酷又危险，不是吗？我原本多么希望环绕我们的会是一个个光明的世界，可那里似乎与我们自己的星球一样残忍、一样自私。啧！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“My, my, how heroic,” Corellah purrs. “Such a cruel and dangerous galaxy out there, isn’t it. I had so hoped that worlds of light might surround us, but it seems every bit as cruel and self-centered as our own planet. Tsk!”"

rows.original: Something sad passes over her expression, just for a moment, before turning into an artificial smile. “So let’s talk about something more fun, hmm? Let’s talk fun stuff huh? I’ve been hearing all sorts of things about the mega-corporations in the greater galaxy. Steele Tech, Xenogen, Carver... and Tamani. So, which would you say is the most fun, the one that can give a girl the best time?”
rows.translation: 一丝悲伤掠过她的神情，虽只有短短一瞬，随后便化为做作的笑容。“所以我们来聊点更有趣的，好吗？聊聊好玩的东西，怎么样？我听说了大银河里各种各样的巨型企业。斯蒂尔科技、异源生物科技、卡佛...还有塔玛妮。那么，你觉得哪一家最有趣，哪一家最能让女孩子玩得尽兴？”
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething sad passes over her expression, just for a moment, before turning into an artificial smile. “So let’s talk about something more fun, hmm? Let’s talk fun stuff huh? I’ve been hearing all sorts of things about the mega-corporations in the greater galaxy. Steele Tech, Xenogen, Carver... and Tamani. So, which would you say is the most fun, the one that can give a girl the best time?”"

rows.translation: 这些选项还真是各有深意...
rows.raw: "\n\nThose are certainly some loaded options..."

rows.original: You tell the executress that Steele Tech has everything she could want, right here.
rows.translation: 你告诉那位女执行官，斯蒂尔科技能满足她的一切需求，就在这里。
rows.raw: "You tell the executress that Steele Tech has everything she could want, right here."

rows.original: She gives you a playful little smile and leans in, close enough that one of her nearly-bare breasts presses against your [pc.arm]. “Oh, really? You’ve very charming, Captain Steele. So full of confidence... perhaps we can work together, you and I, some day soon. There’s worlds of opportunity here on Dhaal, if you only know where to look.”
rows.translation: 她冲你露出一抹俏皮的微笑，倾身凑近，近得一只几乎全裸的乳房都贴上了你的[pc.arm]。“哦，真的吗？你很迷人，斯蒂尔船长。还如此自信...也许不久之后，我们确实可以合作一番，你和我。只要知道该往哪里看，达尔遍地都是机遇。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe gives you a playful little smile and leans in, close enough that one of her nearly-bare breasts presses against your [pc.arm]. “Oh, really? You’ve very charming, Captain Steele. So full of confidence... perhaps we can work together, you and I, some day soon. There’s worlds of opportunity here on Dhaal, if you only know where to look.”"

rows.original: Corellah gives you a wink and slips back off the couch. One of the Utopian underlings appears behind her carrying a silver briefcase, which she sets on the table in front of you. “A gift,” the executress says, bowing out behind her minion. “I hope you get some enjoyment out of it. In the meantime... enjoy the rest of the party.”
rows.translation: 科蕾拉朝你眨眨眼，从沙发上起身离开。乌托邦天空的一名下属出现在她身后，手中提着一个银色手提箱，并将其放在你面前的桌上。“一份礼物，”女执行官说道，跟在手下身后欠身退场。“希望你能从中得到些乐趣。与此同时...好好享受派对剩下的时光吧。”

One of the Utopian underlings appears behind her carrying a silver briefcase, which she sets on the table in front of you. “A gift,” the executress says, bowing out behind her minion. “I hope you get some enjoyment out of it. In the meantime... enjoy the rest of the party.”"

rows.original: The other Zaika bows as well, leaving the briefcase for you before following her mistress back towards the VR lounge.
rows.translation: 另一名扎伊卡也鞠了一躬，留下手提箱，随后跟着自己的女主人返回虚拟现实休息室。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe other Zaika bows as well, leaving the briefcase for you before following her mistress back towards the VR lounge."

rows.original: You suggest that if Corellah wants some fun, Xenogen’s transformative drugs are a gateway to all sorts of experiences.
rows.translation: 你提议，如果科蕾拉想找点乐子，异源生物科技的变形药物便是通往各式各样体验的门户。
rows.raw: "You suggest that if Corellah wants some fun, Xenogen’s transformative drugs are a gateway to all sorts of experiences."

rows.original: “Changing your body?” the executress huffs, rolling her eyes. “How pedestrian. Why change your body when you can be anything, or anyone, in a virtual world? Hmm, no, I think I’ll stick to my games. But thanks for the chat, captain. It’s always interesting getting the perspective of you aliens. We’ll chat again sometime, hmm?”
rows.translation: “改变自己的身体？”女执行官嗤之以鼻，翻了翻眼睛。“多么俗气。既然在虚拟世界里可以成为任何事物、任何人，又何必改变自己的身体？嗯，不了，我想我还是继续玩我的游戏吧。不过谢谢你陪我聊天，船长。了解你们这些外星人的看法总是很有意思。我们改天再聊，嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Changing your body?” the executress huffs, rolling her eyes. “How pedestrian. Why change your body when you can be anything, or anyone, in a virtual world? Hmm, no, I think I’ll stick to my games. But thanks for the chat, captain. It’s always interesting getting the perspective of you aliens. We’ll chat again sometime, hmm?”"

rows.original: She slips off the couch and blows you a kiss, sauntering back towards the VR lounge and leaving you all alone once again.
rows.translation: 她从沙发上起身，向你送来一个飞吻，闲庭信步地返回虚拟现实休息室，再次留下你孤身一人。

rows.original: “Beth Carver and her company have everything you could want,” you suggest. No matter what Corellah’s fetish is, the slave mistress’s brothels doubtless have exactly the kind of “fun” she’s interested in.
rows.translation: “贝丝·卡弗和她的公司能满足你的一切需求，”你提议道。无论科蕾拉有什么性癖，那位奴隶女主人的妓院无疑都有她感兴趣的那种“乐子”。

rows.original: The executress curls her nose up at the very proposition, leaning back so far she just about takes herself out of the couch. “Those poor creatures. I’ve seen them, captain, and I know what Carver is all about. She is no better than those pirates and slavers you’ve fought, a blight of darkness on among the stars. Thank you, captain, but I think I will abstain. Farewell.”
rows.translation: 女执行官听到这个提议便厌恶地皱起鼻子，身子向后仰得几乎要从沙发上翻下去。“那些可怜的生物。我见过她们，船长，也知道卡弗究竟是怎样的人。她和你打败过的那些海盗、奴隶贩子没有任何区别，都是群星之间的一抹黑暗毒瘤。谢谢你，船长，但我想我还是免了。再会。”

I’ve seen them, captain, and I know what Carver is all about. She is no better than those pirates and slavers you’ve fought, a blight of darkness on among the stars. Thank you, captain, but I think I will abstain. Farewell.”"

rows.translation: 她冷淡地向你鞠了一躬，随后返回虚拟现实休息室，再次留下你孤身一人。

rows.original: After having seen the executress’s desire for escapism in virtual reality, you know which mega-corporation is probably her style: the one that radiates sex and drugs and rock and roll at full blast: Tamani.
rows.translation: 亲眼见识过女执行官想在虚拟现实中逃避现实的欲望后，你知道哪家巨型企业大概最合她的口味：那家将性爱、毒品和摇滚乐的气息开到最大、肆意向外辐射的公司：塔玛妮。
rows.raw: "After having seen the executress’s desire for escapism in virtual reality, you know which mega-corporation is probably her style: the one that radiates sex and drugs and rock and roll at full blast: Tamani."

rows.original: Corellah gives you a playful little smile and leans in, close enough that one of her nearly-bare breasts presses against your [pc.arm]. “That is exactly what I wanted to hear. And not shilling your own company, too! It’s so... refreshing, to meet someone not contractually bound to put their own faction above all other considerations. Most of the brainwashed whores here, they’d try and sell you an installment plan for a product their company doesn’t even make rather than send you next door where it’s filling the shelves. It’s enough to make a girl want to lose herself in the digital world just to get away from it all. But you! You’re a different beast, aren’t you?”
rows.translation: 科蕾拉冲你露出一抹俏皮的微笑，倾身凑近，近得一只几乎全裸的乳房都贴上了你的[pc.arm]。“这正是我想听到的答案。而且你还没有推销自己的公司！能遇见一个没有受合同约束、不会把自家派系凌驾于所有考量之上的人，实在...令人耳目一新。这里大多数被洗脑的婊子，宁愿向你推销一套自家公司压根不生产的产品分期付款方案，也不肯把你介绍到隔壁那家货架上摆满它的店。这足以让一个姑娘只想沉浸在数字世界里，好逃离这一切。但你！你是头与众不同的野兽，不是吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nCorellah gives you a playful little smile and leans in, close enough that one of her nearly-bare breasts presses against your [pc.arm]. “That is exactly what I wanted to hear. rows.original: You shake your head. “You keep it.”
rows.translation: 你摇了摇头。“你自己留着吧。”
rows.raw: "You shake your head. “You keep it.”"

rows.original: Rizzon scowsl, whirling the pistol back into her vest. “Don’t tell me you’re shy about guns,” she smirks. “Or maybe you just don’t want to give me an excuse, hmm? Bahhh, don’t be so stiff. If anybody with real power on this planet wants you dead, alien, you’ll never know it until a sniper’s cracked your skull open. But that’s not really how we do business on Dhaal. Even Paragon. No, we don’t waste good meat.”
rows.translation: 里兹昂怒目而视，将手枪旋回背心之中。“别告诉我你怕枪，”她坏笑道。“又或者，你只是不想给我一个借口，嗯？呸，别这么拘谨。如果这颗星球上有哪个真正掌权的人想要你死，外星人，你直到狙击手打爆你的脑袋前都不会知道。不过我们在达尔做生意其实不太来这一套，哪怕典范公司也是如此。不，我们可不会浪费好肉。”
rows.raw: "\n\nRizzon scowsl, whirling the pistol back into her vest. “Don’t tell me you’re shy about guns,” she smirks. “Or maybe you just don’t want to give me an excuse, hmm? Bahhh, don’t be so stiff. If anybody with real power on this planet wants you dead, alien, you’ll never know it until a sniper’s cracked your skull open. But that’s not really how we do business on Dhaal. Even Paragon. No, we don’t waste good meat.”"

rows.original: She leans in against the railing, folding her cybered-up arms over each other. “Answer a question for me, captain. I hope you’re good with words, if you hesitate with the gun. You know, Carver has been whispering in my ear, telling me about the galaxy out there... I wonder if it’s full of people like you. Folk strong enough to make their way in a hostile world, to reach out and seize what they want and damn anything that gets in their way!”
rows.translation: 她靠在栏杆上，将两条经过义体改造的手臂交叠起来。“回答我一个问题，船长。既然你面对枪时会犹豫，希望你嘴上功夫够好。你知道，卡弗一直在我耳边低语，向我讲述外面的银河...我想知道，那里是不是到处都是你这样的人。强大到足以在敌意重重的世界里闯出一条路，伸手夺取自己想要的一切，并诅咒所有挡路之物的人！”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leans in against the railing, folding her cybered-up arms over each other. “Answer a question for me, captain. I hope you’re good with words, if you hesitate with the gun. You know, Carver has been whispering in my ear, telling me about the galaxy out there... I wonder if it’s full of people like you. Folk strong enough to make their way in a hostile world, to reach out and seize what they want and damn anything that gets in their way!”"

rows.original: Rizzon smirks, adding that “Out there... you damn the weak to be nothing but broken drones, whether they’re laboring menials or a planet-owning tycoon’s fuckpets. Tell me, is that true? Is it really a winner-take-all world out there, too?”
rows.translation: 里兹昂坏笑着补充道：“在那里...你们会诅咒弱者，让他们沦为残破的工具，不管是辛苦劳作的贱役，还是拥有整颗星球的大亨的泄欲玩物。告诉我，这是真的吗？外面的世界也真是赢家通吃吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nRizzon smirks, adding that “Out there... you damn the weak to be nothing but broken drones, whether they’re laboring menials or a planet-owning tycoon’s fuckpets. Tell me, is that true? Is it really a winner-take-all world out there, too?”"

rows.translation: 没错，银河就是强者统治的地方。弱者和蠢货只会遭殃。

rows.original: No, it’s not that bad out there! Sure, there’s a lot of people who take advantage of the weak, like Carver, but most people are civilized and believe in liberty and justice...
rows.translation: 不，外面的情况没那么糟！当然，确实有很多人会像卡弗那样欺凌弱者，但大多数人都很文明，也相信自由与正义...
rows.raw: "No, it’s not that bad out there! Sure, there’s a lot of people who take advantage of the weak, like Carver, but most people are civilized and believe in liberty and justice..."

rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: You take the weapon from her, taking a moment to get a feel for its weight and handling; there’s plenty of open sky to safely point it at up here, at least. Rizzon watches you with a mild interest, leaning against the railing and puffing on her cigarette. “You do know how to handle a weapon, at least. More than the last alien I spoke to can say for himself. Let’s give you something to shoot at.”
rows.translation: 你从她手里接过武器，花了点时间感受它的重量和操控性；至少在这高处有大片开阔天空，可以安全地把枪口对准那里。里松略感兴趣地看着你，倚在栏杆上吞云吐雾。“至少你懂得怎么摆弄武器。上一个跟我交谈的外星人可没资格这么说。给你找点靶子吧。”
rows.raw: "You take the weapon from her, taking a moment to get a feel for its weight and handling; there’s plenty of open sky to safely point it at up here, at least. Rizzon watches you with a mild interest, leaning against the railing and puffing on her cigarette. “You do know how to handle a weapon, at least. More than the last alien I spoke to can say for himself. Let’s give you something to shoot at.”"

rows.original: She turns and taps the tip of a purple ear. “This is Paragon Actual to Overwatch. Send the package.”
rows.translation: 她转过身，轻点紫色耳尖。“这里是典范实际呼叫监视组。投放包裹。”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe turns and taps the tip of a purple ear. “This is Paragon Actual to Overwatch. Send the package.”"

rows.original: A moment later and a Paragon-branded hovercar zips past with its side doors open, leaving behind a trail of puttering plate-sized drones belching steam from cheap gas engines. Sputtering neon holograms flicker to life on the drones’ faces, presenting with you cartoonish crosshairs in the shape of the Paragon logo. Stylish.
rows.translation: 片刻之后，一辆印有典范标志的悬浮车敞着侧门疾驰而过，身后留下一串盘子大小、噗噗作响的无人机，廉价燃气引擎不断喷出蒸汽。无人机正面的霓虹全息影像闪烁着亮起，向你展示出典范标志形状的卡通准星。挺时髦。
rows.raw: "\n\nA moment later and a Paragon-branded hovercar zips past with its side doors open, leaving behind a trail of puttering plate-sized drones belching steam from cheap gas engines. Sputtering neon holograms flicker to life on the drones’ faces, presenting with you cartoonish crosshairs in the shape of the Paragon logo. Stylish."

rows.original: The game’s clear enough. You raise the chrome hand cannon, watching a holographic sight pop up in answer to your tightening grip. It’s almost too easy lining up your reticle with the first drone target and squeeze the trigger. It breaks with just the slightest tap of your finger, shooting a split-second lance of blue light straight into the front of the target drone. It explodes with almost comical pomp, erupting in a shower of sparks and flame. You shield your eyes as the thing goes up like a firework, illuminating the dark sky. As soon as you’ve recovered your vision, you quickly follow up with a series of shots in quick succession, detonating the drones one after the other. You imagine it must be quite a show back in the pyramid, watching all these surprise explosions through the glass.
rows.translation: 玩法已经再清楚不过。你举起镀铬手炮，紧握枪柄时，一道全息瞄具随之弹出。把准星对准第一架靶机、扣下扳机，简直容易得过分。手指只需轻轻一点，扳机便应声而动，一道转瞬即逝的蓝色光矛笔直射进靶机正面。它以近乎滑稽的隆重场面炸开，迸出漫天火花与烈焰。那东西像烟花一样升腾爆裂，照亮昏暗天空，你连忙遮住双眼。视野刚一恢复，你便迅速连续开火，接二连三地引爆无人机。你想，从金字塔内部透过玻璃观看这一连串突如其来的爆炸，想必相当壮观。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe game’s clear enough. You raise the chrome hand cannon, watching a holographic sight pop up in answer to your tightening grip. It’s almost too easy lining up your reticle with the first drone target and squeeze the trigger. It breaks with just the slightest tap of your finger, shooting a split-second lance of blue light straight into the front of the target drone. It explodes with almost comical pomp, erupting in a shower of sparks and flame. You shield your eyes as the thing goes up like a firework, illuminating the dark sky. As soon as you’ve recovered your vision, you quickly follow up with a series of shots in quick succession, detonating the drones one after the other. You imagine it must be quite a show back in the pyramid, watching all these surprise explosions through the glass."

rows.original: When the last of the showy blasts fades, leaving your ears ringing ever so slightly, you turn to see the Fabricator-Marshal grinning down at you. “Well? How does Paragon firepower stack up to what you aliens sling around? About as advanced as black powder, or...?”
rows.translation: 最后一场华丽爆炸消散后，双耳仍在微微嗡鸣的你转过身，看见制造元帅正低头朝你咧嘴而笑。“怎么样？典范的火力跟你们外星人的家伙比起来如何？大概只有黑火药那种水平，还是说...？”
rows.raw: " When the last of the showy blasts fades, leaving your ears ringing ever so slightly, you turn to see the Fabricator-Marshal grinning down at you. “Well? How does Paragon firepower stack up to what you aliens sling around? About as advanced as black powder, or...?” "

rows.original: Well... she showed you hers, so you ought to at least tell her about yours, right?
rows.translation: 这个嘛...她都给你看过她的家伙了，你至少也该说说自己的，对吧？
rows.raw: "Well... she showed you hers, so you ought to at least tell her about yours, right? "

rows.original: Honestly, it’s not bad. Feels comparable to a custom Confederate-made laser pistol in terms of power, though maybe a little more battery-hungry, but the holographic sight is a nice touch. And that trigger is match-grade! It’s a perfect weapon for pinpoint shooting, but small enough to be concealed under a shirt or jacket.
rows.translation: 说实话，还不错。就威力而言，感觉能与邦联定制的激光手枪相提并论，尽管耗电量可能稍大一些，但全息瞄具是个不错的点缀。还有那个扳机，绝对是竞赛级的！它很适合精确射击，又小巧到足以藏在衬衫或外套下面。
rows.raw: "Honestly, it’s not bad. Feels comparable to a custom Confederate-made laser pistol in terms of power, though maybe a little more battery-hungry, but the holographic sight is a nice touch. And that trigger is match-grade! It’s a perfect weapon for pinpoint shooting, but small enough to be concealed under a shirt or jacket."

rows.original: A hint of genuine smile plays out over the Fabricator-Marshal’s face. “Is that right? Well, Paragon’s pride lives to fight another day. Speaking of pride, though...”
rows.translation: 制造元帅脸上浮现出一丝真切的笑意。“是吗？很好，典范的骄傲又能再战一天。不过说到骄傲...”
rows.raw: "\n\nA hint of genuine smile plays out over the Fabricator-Marshal’s face. “Is that right? Well, Paragon’s pride lives to fight another day. Speaking of pride, though...”"

rows.original: She leans into the railing, spitting her cigarette over the edge. It falls out of sight in the blink of an eye, vanishing into the smog. “You understand that the strong rule here, don’t you? That the weak are crushed underfoot, used like meat the way we that rule want. You’ve seen it downstairs, with that Carver woman and her slaves. She tells me it’s the same among the stars: that those too foolish or weak to make their way in the world end up in some form of bondage. Shackled to a meaningless menial job, or broken in by lash and chain. Does Carver have the right of things in your greater galaxy?”
rows.translation: 她探身靠上栏杆，把香烟吐向边缘之外。烟头转眼便坠出视线，消失在烟霾之中。“你明白这里由强者统治，对吧？弱者会被踩在脚下，像肉一样任由我们这些统治者使用。你在楼下已经看见了，那个卡弗女人和她的奴隶。她告诉我，群星之间也一样：那些太愚蠢或太软弱、无法在世上闯出道路的人，最终都会受到某种奴役。不是被毫无意义的低贱工作牢牢束缚，就是被鞭子与锁链彻底驯服。在你们广阔的银河里，卡弗说的才是真相吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe leans into the railing, spitting her cigarette over the edge. It falls out of sight in the blink of an eye, vanishing into the smog. “You understand that the strong rule here, don’t you? That the weak are crushed underfoot, used like meat the way we that rule want. You’ve seen it downstairs, with that Carver woman and her slaves. She tells me it’s the same among the stars: that those too foolish or weak to make their way in the world end up in some form of bondage. Shackled to a meaningless menial job, or broken in by lash and chain. Does Carver have the right of things in your greater galaxy?”"

rows.original: Yeah
rows.translation: 对
rows.raw: "Yeah"

rows.original: Yeah
rows.translation: 对
rows.raw: "Yeah"

rows.original: Yeah, the galaxy is a place where the strong rule. Woe to the weak and the foolish.
rows.translation: 对，银河就是个由强者统治的地方。软弱又愚蠢的人活该倒霉。
rows.raw: "Yeah, the galaxy is a place where the strong rule. Woe to the weak and the foolish."

rows.original: Not That Bad...
rows.translation: 没那么糟...
rows.raw: "Not That Bad..."

rows.original: Not That Bad...
rows.translation: 没那么糟...
rows.raw: "Not That Bad..."

rows.original: No, it’s not that bad out there! Sure, there’s a lot of people who take advantage of the weak, like Carver, but most people are civilized and believe in liberty and justice...
rows.translation: 不，外面的情况没那么糟！当然，确实有很多人会像卡弗那样欺凌弱者，但大多数人都很文明，也相信自由与正义...
rows.raw: "No, it’s not that bad out there! Sure, there’s a lot of people who take advantage of the weak, like Carver, but most people are civilized and believe in liberty and justice..."

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: Carver has a certain brutal insight into the human(oid) condition, you suppose. The most infamous slave-mistress on the frontier ought to. The galaxy at large belongs to the corporations, no matter what the spineless Confederacy or any planetary governments might like to say otherwise, and there are so many traps from employment to addiction to just being born into corporate servitude... it’s not as widespread as Rizzon makes it out to be, at least not that you’ve seen, but hopeless people being controlled in mind and body by those stronger and more powerful than themselves is nothing unique to Dhaal.
rows.translation: 你想，卡弗对于人类（以及类人生物）的处境确实有种残酷的洞察力。边疆上最臭名昭著的奴隶女主人理应如此。无论软弱无能的邦联或任何行星政府多么想粉饰事实，整个银河终究属于各大公司；而从受雇工作到上瘾成瘾，再到一出生便沦为公司的奴仆，世上存在着太多陷阱...至少根据你的见闻，情况还没有里松形容得那么普遍，但绝望之人的身心被比他们更强、更有权势者掌控，这种事绝非达尔独有。
rows.raw: "Carver has a certain brutal insight into the human(oid) condition, you suppose. The most infamous slave-mistress on the frontier ought to. The galaxy at large belongs to the corporations, no matter what the spineless Confederacy or any planetary governments might like to say otherwise, and there are so many traps from employment to addiction to just being born into corporate servitude... it’s not as widespread as Rizzon makes it out to be, at least not that you’ve seen, but hopeless people being controlled in mind and body by those stronger and more powerful than themselves is nothing unique to Dhaal."

rows.original: Rizzon nods along as you speak, watching the cars zip along between the skyscrapers. “So the rest of you are no better than we are, huh? Or maybe that’s the wrong way to look at it: that we’re just as savage as all of you!”
rows.translation: 你说话时，里松一边点头，一边看着车辆在摩天大楼之间疾驰。“所以你们其他人也没比我们好到哪里去，是吧？或者不该这么看：我们只不过跟你们所有人一样野蛮！”
rows.raw: "\n\nRizzon nods along as you speak, watching the cars zip along between the skyscrapers. “So the rest of you are no better than we are, huh? Or maybe that’s the wrong way to look at it: that we’re just as savage as all of you!”"

rows.original: She snarls, standing up to her full, augmented height. “Good! It’s the way it should be - the only way it can be. We’re all savages in the end, aren’t we?”
rows.translation: 她低吼一声，挺直经过强化的高大身躯。“很好！事情本就该如此，这是唯一可能的样子。说到底，我们全都是野蛮人，不是吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nShe snarls, standing up to her full, augmented height. “Good! It’s the way it should be - the only way it can be. We’re all savages in the end, aren’t we?”"

rows.original: For whatever dark reason, the thought seems to genuinely excite the Fabricator-Marshal. She pushes herself off the railing and turns to her goons still standing by the door. <i>“Come on, ladies. One of you track down Carver, I need words with her. And captain... good talk.
rows.translation: 不知出于何种阴暗的缘由，这个想法似乎真让制造元帅兴奋起来。她推开栏杆，转向仍守在门边的手下。<i>“走吧，姑娘们。你们中一个去找卡弗，我得跟她谈谈。还有，船长...聊得不错。
rows.raw: "\n\nFor whatever dark reason, the thought seems to genuinely excite the Fabricator-Marshal. She pushes herself off the railing and turns to her goons still standing by the door. <i>“Come on, ladies. One of you track down Carver, I need words with her. And captain... good talk."

rows.original: Keep the gun, from one savage to another.
rows.translation: 枪留着吧，这是一个野蛮人送给另一个野蛮人的。
rows.raw: " Keep the gun, from one savage to another."

rows.original: They leave you alone out on the balcony, wondering just how broken Paragon’s marshal is under all that cyberware.
rows.translation: 他们把你独自留在阳台上，你不禁猜想，在那一身义体之下，典范的元帅究竟已经扭曲到了何种地步。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey leave you alone out on the balcony, wondering just how broken Paragon’s marshal is under all that cyberware."

rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “It’s not as bad as you think!” you tell the cyborg supersoldier, trying to find the right words to describe the galaxy at large. Sure, there’s suffering and deprivation in Confederacy - sometimes as bad or worse than what you’d seen on Dhaal - but that’s the exception, not the rule. You’ve seen all kinds of beautiful people living free on the frontiers, working hard on newfound colonies to make lives for themselves.
rows.translation: “事情没你想的那么糟！”你告诉这名义体超级士兵，努力寻找合适的词语来描述整个银河。诚然，邦联境内也存在苦难与贫困，有时甚至与自己在达尔见过的一样糟，乃至更加恶劣，但那只是例外，而非常态。你见过形形色色的美好人们在边疆自由生活，在新发现的殖民地上辛勤劳作，为自己开创人生。
rows.raw: "“It’s not as bad as you think!” you tell the cyborg supersoldier, trying to find the right words to describe the galaxy at large. Sure, there’s suffering and deprivation in Confederacy - sometimes as bad or worse than what you’d seen on Dhaal - but that’s the exception, not the rule. You’ve seen all kinds of beautiful people living free on the frontiers, working hard on newfound colonies to make lives for themselves."

rows.original: Rizzon listens to you intently, nodding along, but she doesn’t seem heartened by your impassioned speech about the good-natured heart of galactic society. Her dark-painted lips draw into a deepening scowl, until finally she pushes herself off the railing. “I’ve heard enough,” she growls, lighting a new cigarette with a flick of her metal-tipped thumb. “The rest of the galaxy... you think you’re better than us, don’t you? That you’re building some kind of Utopia? Hrmph! I wonder how many people in your galaxy have known hardship like you and I have... how it feels to risk everything for the chance to seize power! I guess it’ll be up to Paragon to show you aliens what it means to be alive again.”
rows.translation: 里松专注地听着你说话，不时点头，却似乎并未因你对银河社会善良本质的慷慨陈词而受到鼓舞。她涂着深色唇彩的嘴唇越抿越紧，最终从栏杆上直起身来。“我听够了，”她咆哮着，用金属指尖一弹，点燃一根新烟。“银河里的其他地方...你们觉得自己比我们高尚，是吗？觉得自己正在建立某种乌托邦？哼！真不知道你们银河里有多少人经历过你我这样的磨难...有多少人知道，为了夺取权力的机会押上一切是什么滋味！看来得由典范来教教你们这些外星人，什么才叫重新活过来了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nRizzon listens to you intently, nodding along, but she doesn’t seem heartened by your impassioned speech about the good-natured heart of galactic society. Her dark-painted lips draw into a deepening scowl, until finally she pushes herself off the railing. “I’ve heard enough,” she growls, lighting a new cigarette with a flick of her metal-tipped thumb. “The rest of the galaxy... you think you’re better than us, don’t you? That you’re building some kind of Utopia? Hrmph! I wonder how many people in your galaxy have known hardship like you and I have... how it feels to risk everything for the chance to seize power! I guess it’ll be up to Paragon to show you aliens what it means to be alive again.”"

rows.original: She snorts and turns back to her guards, starting to march away. <i>“Come on, ladies. One of you track down Carver, I need words with her. And captain... good talk.
rows.translation: 她哼了一声，转身走回卫兵身边，开始迈步离去。<i>“走吧，女士们。你们中一个去把卡弗找出来，我有话要跟她说。还有，船长...聊得不错。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe snorts and turns back to her guards, starting to march away. <i>“Come on, ladies. One of you track down Carver, I need words with her. And captain... good talk."

rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: As you’re meandering through the Gyre, you catch sight of another transit hub, much like the one that first brought you down to this dangerous level of the city. Is there another layer you’re going to have to fight through?
rows.translation: 当你在漩涡区里漫无目的地走着时，又看见了一处交通枢纽，和最初把你送到这座城市危险层区的那一处很相似。难道还有另一层要让你一路打过去吗？
rows.raw: "As you’re meandering through the Gyre, you catch sight of another transit hub, much like the one that first brought you down to this dangerous level of the city. Is there another layer you’re going to have to fight through?"

rows.original: It looks like somebody’s got the same idea - you’re not the only one here, and this man’s brought some serious backup. Though the ever-present shadows cast by the neon adverts overhead are as dense as anywhere at the station, you can see three figures clearly: one’s a man with dark skin, long hair, and a body-tight suit; the others are slender zaika women in heavy armor in deep blues and grays, packing machine guns slung on their shoulders and shock batons on their hips. They see you approaching and reach for their weapons, but the man they’re presumably guarding stays their hands.
rows.translation: 看来有人也打着同样的主意——这里不只有你，而那个男人还带了相当强悍的后援。头顶霓虹广告投下的阴影一如空间站其他各处般浓重，但你仍能清楚看见三道人影：一个是皮肤黝黑、留着长发、身穿紧身衣的男人；另外两个则是身披深蓝与灰色重甲、身材纤细的扎伊卡女人，肩上挎着机枪，腰间挂着电击棍。她们见你走近便伸手摸向武器，但那个大概由她们负责保护的男人抬手制止了她们。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt looks like somebody’s got the same idea - you’re not the only one here, and this man’s brought some serious backup. Though the ever-present shadows cast by the neon adverts overhead are as dense as anywhere at the station, you can see three figures clearly: one’s a man with dark skin, long hair, and a body-tight suit; the others are slender zaika women in heavy armor in deep blues and grays, packing machine guns slung on their shoulders and shock batons on their hips. They see you approaching and reach for their weapons, but the man they’re presumably guarding stays their hands."

rows.original: “Well I’ll be!” the man says, flashing you a toothy smile. “I’d heard you’d landed in my neck of the iron jungle, but I didn’t believe it till I saw it with my own cyber-eyes!”
rows.translation: “嘿，真没想到！”男人说道，冲你露出满口牙齿的笑容。“我听说你落脚到我这片钢铁丛林来了，但直到亲眼——或者说亲义眼——见到你，我才相信！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well I’ll be!” the man says, flashing you a toothy smile. “I’d heard you’d landed in my neck of the iron jungle, but I didn’t believe it till I saw it with my own cyber-eyes!”"

rows.original: He swaggers forward, revealing that suit of his is in Steele Tech colors, and that his eyes are indeed clearly synthetic - but still full of mirth. He’s an older fellow, maybe fifty, broad-shouldered and muscular enough to leave you wondering why he needs those guards at all.
rows.translation: 他大摇大摆地走上前来，让你看清他那身制服采用了斯蒂尔科技的配色，而且他的双眼确实显然是人造的——却依旧充满笑意。他年纪不小，大概五十岁，肩膀宽阔、肌肉结实得让你不禁怀疑，他究竟为什么还需要那些卫兵。
rows.raw: "\n\nHe swaggers forward, revealing that suit of his is in Steele Tech colors, and that his eyes are indeed clearly synthetic - but still full of mirth. He’s an older fellow, maybe fifty, broad-shouldered and muscular enough to leave you wondering why he needs those guards at all."

rows.original: “You don’t know me, but I know you,” he grins. “I’m Darius, the Steele Tech rep for this beautiful strip of twilight. And you... you are [pc.name]!”
rows.translation: “你不认识我，但我认识你，”他咧嘴笑道。“我是达里厄斯，斯蒂尔科技派驻这片美丽暮光地带的代表。而你...你就是[pc.name]！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You don’t know me, but I know you,” he grins. “I’m Darius, the Steele Tech rep for this beautiful strip of twilight. And you... you are [pc.name]!”"

rows.original: That’s you alright. “Damn but it’s good to see a friendly face down here in the heart of the Gyre. But what’s Steele Tech doing here?”
rows.translation: 确实是你没错。“该死，在漩涡区中心见到一张友善的面孔可真好。不过斯蒂尔科技在这里做什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s you alright. “Damn but it’s good to see a friendly face down here in the heart of the Gyre. But what’s Steele Tech doing here?”"

rows.original: Darius shrugs. “What do we always do? This planet’s way more resource-rich than you’d think... there’s a lot of untapped potential - I mean a lot - out past the twilight ring. The zaika don’t have the tech to really harvest it, so we’re trying to... make the connections we need among the ruling class. The, uh, what’re they called again?”
rows.translation: 达里厄斯耸耸肩。“我们还能做什么？这颗星球的资源比你想象的丰富得多...暮光环外有许多尚未开发的潜力——我是说，非常多。扎伊卡人的技术还不足以真正开采那些资源，所以我们正试着...和统治阶层建立必要的联系。他们，呃，又叫什么来着？”
rows.raw: "\n\nDarius shrugs. “What do we always do? This planet’s way more resource-rich than you’d think... there’s a lot of untapped potential - I mean a lot - out past the twilight ring. The zaika don’t have the tech to really harvest it, so we’re trying to... make the connections we need among the ruling class. The, uh, what’re they called again?”"

rows.original: “The Zaibatsu,” one of his guards answers. “Of which Paragon Inc. is the strongest by far.”
rows.translation: “财阀，”他的一名卫兵答道。“其中典范公司遥遥领先，实力最强。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The Zaibatsu,” one of his guards answers. “Of which Paragon Inc. is the strongest by far.”"

rows.original: “Uh, yeah, sure,” Darius laughs. “Anyway, the company’s trying to find the right partner to help us get a foothold, start bringing up metals and gems that’ve been sitting too deep for the Zaibatsu folks to get at. And hey, what do you know, that’s jogged the old noggin: I’ve got something you might be interested in [pc.name].”
rows.translation: “呃，对，没错，”达里厄斯笑道。“总之，公司正努力寻找合适的合作伙伴，好帮我们站稳脚跟，开始开采埋得太深、财阀的人根本够不到的金属和宝石。嘿，你瞧，说到这儿倒让我这颗老脑袋想起来了：[pc.name]，我有样东西你或许会感兴趣。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Uh, yeah, sure,” Darius laughs. “Anyway, the company’s trying to find the right partner to help us get a foothold, start bringing up metals and gems that’ve been sitting too deep for the Zaibatsu folks to get at. And hey, what do you know, that’s jogged the old noggin: I’ve got something you might be interested in [pc.name].”"

rows.original: He reaches into one of the pockets on his uniform’s hips and withdraws a little plastic card, stripped with neon that glows around where his fingers grip it. Darius thrusts the card out to you. “It’s an invitation. There’s a big shindig going down - or going up, I should say - in the fancy part of town, way high in the clouds. The bosses of all three Zaibatsu are going to be in attendance, and plenty of other officials from Confederate-space corporations all vying for their slice of the pie.”
rows.translation: 他把手伸进制服腰侧的一个口袋，取出一张小小的塑料卡片。卡片上带着霓虹条纹，在他手指握住的位置周围发出光芒。达里厄斯把卡片递到你面前。“这是邀请函。城里的高级区域要举办一场盛会——准确地说，是在上面，高高的云层之中。三家财阀的老板都会出席，还有许多来自邦联太空企业的其他官员，每个人都在争夺自己那一份蛋糕。”
rows.raw: "\n\nHe reaches into one of the pockets on his uniform’s hips and withdraws a little plastic card, stripped with neon that glows around where his fingers grip it. Darius thrusts the card out to you. “It’s an invitation. There’s a big shindig going down - or going up, I should say - in the fancy part of town, way high in the clouds. The bosses of all three Zaibatsu are going to be in attendance, and plenty of other officials from Confederate-space corporations all vying for their slice of the pie.”"

rows.original: One of his bodyguards snorts, earning an elbow from the other. “Hush. We need the offworlders. You know our planet’s drowning in the smog.”
rows.translation: 他的一名保镖哼了一声，立刻被另一名保镖用手肘撞了一下。“安静。我们需要这些外星人。你知道我们的星球正淹没在烟霾里。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of his bodyguards snorts, earning an elbow from the other. “Hush. We need the offworlders. You know our planet’s drowning in the smog.”"

rows.original: The offending warrioress scowls, but doesn’t contradict her comrade. The noxious fumes of the city are ever-present, a constant and often-uncomfortable reminder of the vigorous industry all around you.
rows.translation: 那名出言不逊的女战士皱起眉头，却没有反驳同伴。城里的有毒烟气无处不在，不断以令人不适的方式提醒着你，周围的工业活动有多么旺盛。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe offending warrioress scowls, but doesn’t contradict her comrade. The noxious fumes of the city are ever-present, a constant and often-uncomfortable reminder of the vigorous industry all around you."

rows.original: “Why’re you giving me this,” you finally ask Darius, taking the card. “I’ve got a probe to find.”
rows.translation: “你为什么要把这个给我？”你接过卡片，终于向达里厄斯问道。“我还得去找探针。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Why’re you giving me this,” you finally ask Darius, taking the card. “I’ve got a probe to find.”"

rows.original: He chuckles. “Yeah, well, what about when you do? You’re gonna be in charge of all this business we’re setting up. You ought to meet the native leaders, make a good first impression. Besides, maybe one of them could help you find Tricky Vic’s old probe. I know I’m not allowed to... even if I knew where it was. Which I don’t.”
rows.translation: 他轻笑一声。“是啊，可等你找到以后呢？我们正在建立的这一摊生意都要由你负责。你应该去见见当地的领袖，给她们留下一个好印象。再说了，也许她们中有人能帮你找到老狡猾维克的探针。我可不能帮你...就算我知道它在哪里也不行。当然，我并不知道。”

Besides, maybe one of them could help you find Tricky Vic’s old probe. I know I’m not allowed to... even if I knew where it was. Which I don’t.”"

rows.original: When you tell her you’re going to “the party,” the purple-hued driver turns to you with an arched brow, like she’s seeing you for the first time. “Woah, you’re really an alien, huh? And you’re goin’ up to rub tails with the Peers, huh?”
rows.translation: 你告诉她自己要去“那场派对”时，紫色皮肤的司机挑起眉毛转头看你，仿佛这才第一次真正注意到你。“哇，你还真是外星人啊？而且要上去跟同侪们攀交情，是吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nWhen you tell her you’re going to “the party,” the purple-hued driver turns to you with an arched brow, like she’s seeing you for the first time. “Woah, you’re really an alien, huh? And you’re goin’ up to rub tails with the Peers, huh?”"

rows.original: “The Peers?”
rows.raw: "\n\n“The Peers?”"

rows.original: “Y’know, the ones that run the show! Executive types. Everyone knows there’s a big party goin’ on tonight... I didn’t know aliens were invited, though! I hope the Peers have their heads on straight, if they’re gonna start making deals with you all. Everybody down here’s been so hyped up about you all arriving, like something out of a holo-novel mom used to watch. Never thought I’d live to see the day space ships came down from the clouds. Even from my apartment I can see the flares.”
rows.translation: “你知道的，就是那些掌权的人！高管之类的。今晚有场大派对，人人都知道...不过我倒不知道外星人也受邀了！他们要开始跟你们做生意的话，我只希望那些同侪脑子还清醒。你们到来以后，下面所有人都兴奋得不得了，就像我妈以前看的全息小说成真了一样。我从没想过有生之年真能看到飞船从云层里降下来。连我家公寓都能看见那些光焰。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Y’know, the ones that run the show! Executive types. Everyone knows there’s a big party goin’ on tonight... I didn’t know aliens were invited, though! I hope the Peers have their heads on straight, if they’re gonna start making deals with you all. Everybody down here’s been so hyped up about you all arriving, like something out of a holo-novel mom used to watch. Never thought I’d live to see the day space ships came down from the clouds. Even from my apartment I can see the flares.”"

rows.original: It’s always nice to actually feel welcomed on these new Rush-worlds, even if the trip to get here was rather dangerous. Though at least that danger isn’t directed at you just because you’re an offworlder. These Peers don’t seem to be too keen on keeping the peace on their planet.
rows.translation: 能在这些新开拓的世界真正感受到欢迎总是件好事，哪怕来这里的旅途相当危险。至少那种危险并非仅仅因为你是外星人就冲你而来。看来这些同侪并不怎么热衷于维护这颗星球的和平。
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s always nice to actually feel welcomed on these new Rush-worlds, even if the trip to get here was rather dangerous. Though at least that danger isn’t directed at you just because you’re an offworlder. These Peers don’t seem to be too keen on keeping the peace on their planet."

rows.original: “Is it always so dangerous down there?” you ask, gesturing back whence you came.
rows.translation: “下面一直都这么危险吗？”你指着来时的方向问道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is it always so dangerous down there?” you ask, gesturing back whence you came."

rows.original: “Yeah, since before I was born. Don’t worry, it ain’t gotten worse cuz of you... some folks say things are about to get a lot better. That’s why I hope the Peers can work something out with your kind- bring some law and order to the Gyre. Or at least some new jobs to keep those damn gangers off the streets.”
rows.translation: “是啊，我出生前就这样了。别担心，不是因为你们才变得更糟...有人说情况很快就会好很多。所以我才希望同侪能跟你们这些人谈出点结果，给旋环区带来些法律和秩序。或者至少弄些新工作，好让那些该死的帮派分子别再街上晃荡。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, since before I was born. Don’t worry, it ain’t gotten worse cuz of you... some folks say things are about to get a lot better. That’s why I hope the Peers can work something out with your kind- bring some law and order to the Gyre. Or at least some new jobs to keep those damn gangers off the streets.”"

rows.original: That’s a problem that’ll be solved long after you’ve moved on, unfortunately. “So everyone knows about this party, huh?”
rows.translation: 可惜，这个问题要等你离开很久以后才能解决。“所以人人都知道这场派对，是吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThat’s a problem that’ll be solved long after you’ve moved on, unfortunately. “So everyone knows about this party, huh?”"

rows.original: “It’s been all over the zaibatsus’ newsfeeds. Everyone who’s anyone is gonna be there... which I guess makes you somebody, huh? Even if you gotta take a taxi around. Heee, never thought I’d get a chance to go all the way up to the Meridian today. I wonder how long they’ll let me stay parked, enjoy the fresh air up there?”
rows.translation: “各大财阀的新闻源里铺天盖地都是这事。所有有头有脸的人都会到场...所以你也算个人物了，对吧？哪怕还得坐出租车过去。嘿嘿，没想到今天竟有机会一路开到子午城。我不知道他们会让我在那里停多久，好享受一下上面的新鲜空气？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s been all over the zaibatsus’ newsfeeds. Everyone who’s anyone is gonna be there... which I guess makes you somebody, huh? Even if you gotta take a taxi around. Heee, never thought I’d get a chance to go all the way up to the Meridian today. I wonder how long they’ll let me stay parked, enjoy the fresh air up there?”"

rows.original: You’d been starting to wonder if Dhaal had fresh air, but as your driver cruises higher and higher through the skies, the cab finally breaks through the heavy haze of black smog hanging over the city, and breaches into a clear twilit day. The intense light of the sun blinds you for a moment, until the cab’s windows tint down to nearly opaque. Even through that, you’re still able to see a near-endless stream of towering glass skyscrapers reaching to the clouds. Rainbows of neon play across their faces, blaring down upon the Gyre below you, but atop the structures you see carefully cultivated gardens sprawling over their rooftops, along with private pools and landing strips tiered below and around them.
rows.translation: 你都开始怀疑达尔究竟有没有新鲜空气了，可随着司机载你不断升入高空，出租车终于冲破笼罩城市的浓重黑色烟霾，进入清澈的暮色白昼。强烈的阳光一时晃得你睁不开眼，直到车窗变暗，几乎彻底不透光。即便隔着这样的车窗，你仍能看见仿佛无穷无尽的玻璃摩天大楼直插云端。彩虹般的霓虹在楼面上流转，向你下方的旋环区轰然播送广告；而在高楼顶端，你看见精心培育的花园铺满屋顶，周围和下方的层台上还设有私人泳池与起降坪。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’d been starting to wonder if Dhaal had fresh air, but as your driver cruises higher and higher through the skies, the cab finally breaks through the heavy haze of black smog hanging over the city, and breaches into a clear twilit day. The intense light of the sun blinds you for a moment, until the cab’s windows tint down to nearly opaque. Even through that, you’re still able to see a near-endless stream of towering glass skyscrapers reaching to the clouds. Rainbows of neon play across their faces, blaring down upon the Gyre below you, but atop the structures you see carefully cultivated gardens sprawling over their rooftops, along with private pools and landing strips tiered below and around them."

rows.original: It’s... genuinely beautiful, an almost impossible contrast to the darkness and filth back down in the alleys beneath. What opulence these Peers live in!
rows.translation: 这里...真的很美，与下方巷道里的黑暗污秽形成几乎令人难以置信的反差。这些同侪过的是何等奢华的生活！
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s... genuinely beautiful, an almost impossible contrast to the darkness and filth back down in the alleys beneath. What opulence these Peers live in!"

rows.original: Your driver cruises between the artificial peaks, banking through clouds and into a long stream of polished hover-limos heading towards a towering pyramid of glass and neon lights suspended between four skyscrapers at each of its corners. A lengthy landing pad stretches out in the air, held up by cables covered with holoprojectors advertising the various companies in attendance - both alien and native. A stadium-sized Steele Tech banner flies proudly over the entrance, with the unmistakable outline of your old man’s face beside the company logo and a promise that “Steele Tech Brings a Brighter Tomorrow.” A big ask for a planet caught in perpetual twilight... but the marketing team probably figured that’d play well with the natives down in the eternal dark of the Gyre.
rows.translation: 司机驾车穿梭于人造峰峦之间，侧倾着冲过云层，汇入一条由锃亮悬浮豪华轿车组成的长龙。车流驶向一座高耸的玻璃与霓虹金字塔，它悬在四座摩天大楼之间，四角分别与高楼相连。一条长长的起降平台伸入空中，由覆满全息投影仪的缆索托住；投影仪正为到场的各家公司播放广告，其中既有外星企业，也有本土公司。一面体育场般巨大的斯蒂尔科技横幅骄傲地飘扬在入口上方，公司标志旁是你老爸一眼就能认出的脸部轮廓，下面还承诺“斯蒂尔科技带来更光明的明天。”对一颗困在永恒暮色中的星球而言，这口号可真敢说...不过营销团队多半觉得，它很对下方旋环区永恒黑暗中的本地人胃口。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour driver cruises between the artificial peaks, banking through clouds and into a long stream of polished hover-limos heading towards a towering pyramid of glass and neon lights suspended between four skyscrapers at each of its corners. A lengthy landing pad stretches out in the air, held up by cables covered with holoprojectors advertising the various companies in attendance - both alien and native. rows.original:
The alley’s tightness leaves little room for stepping back, but eventually you manage to get a good angle from the side, and the illusion is unraveled: the strokes depict a pile of guns on a background of fire. Duly impressed, you decide to snap a pic with your Codex. As you adjust the zoom, something jumps at you: at the bottom, there’s a sequence of small zaika characters written vertically that your Codex automatically translates as numbers.

You suppose it’s the artist’s signature?
rows.translation:
小巷十分狭窄，几乎没有后退的空间，不过你最终还是设法从侧面找到了一个好角度，幻象也随之解开：那些笔触描绘的是烈火背景中的一堆枪械。你颇感惊叹，决定用终端拍张照片。调整缩放时，有样东西忽然映入眼帘：底部竖着写有一串细小的扎伊卡字符，终端自动将其翻译成了数字。

你猜那是画家的签名？

rows.original: Scrolling through the graffiti pictures in your Codex, you notice there is a certain stylistic similarity between them and decide to zoom in to check if the artist(s) left their name. Strangely, those pieces are all signed with different number sequences. Wait, doesn’t that sound a lot like something you learned in school?
rows.translation: 你翻看终端里的涂鸦照片，注意到它们在风格上颇为相似，于是放大图像，看看画家是否留下了姓名。奇怪的是，这些作品的签名全是不同的数字序列。等等，这听起来是不是很像你在学校里学过的某样东西？
rows.raw: "\n\nScrolling through the graffiti pictures in your Codex, you notice there is a certain stylistic similarity between them and decide to zoom in to check if the artist(s) left their name. Strangely, those pieces are all signed with different number sequences. Wait, doesn’t that sound a lot like something you learned in school?"

rows.original: That teacher was hot...
rows.translation: 那个老师可真辣...
rows.raw: " That teacher was hot..."

rows.original: Suddenly, it hits you – those are geographic coordinates! Inputting them in your Codex, you mark the place on your map. It’s a wild guess, but who knows, maybe you could get to meet this graffiti artist.
rows.translation: 你突然恍然大悟——这些是地理坐标！你把它们输入终端，在地图上标出了那个地点。这只是个大胆的猜测，但谁知道呢，也许你真能见到这位涂鸦画家。
rows.raw: "\n\nSuddenly, it hits you – those are geographic coordinates! Inputting them in your Codex, you mark the place on your map. It’s a wild guess, but who knows, maybe you could get to meet this graffiti artist."

rows.original: Following the coordinates from the graffiti clues, you wade through alley after alley.
rows.translation: 你循着涂鸦线索中的坐标，穿过一条又一条小巷。
rows.raw: "Following the coordinates from the graffiti clues, you wade through alley after alley."

rows.original: The planet’s natural illumination – or what little remains after passing through the smog-filled sky – is blotched out by the impossibly tall, dilapidated buildings that surround you on all sides. And yet, despite the oppressive atmosphere, the alley you presently find yourself in is brimming with noisy, chaotic life, brightly lit by a sea of storefronts that shine with neon letters, competing for attention.
rows.translation: 行星的自然光线——或者说穿过烟雾弥漫的天空后所剩无几的那一点——被四面环绕着你的、不可思议地高耸而破败的建筑遮得严严实实。然而，尽管气氛压抑，你此刻所在的小巷却充斥着喧闹而混乱的生机；一片店面招牌以霓虹文字闪耀，争相吸引目光，把这里照得通明。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe planet’s natural illumination – or what little remains after passing through the smog-filled sky – is blotched out by the impossibly tall, dilapidated buildings that surround you on all sides. And yet, despite the oppressive atmosphere, the alley you presently find yourself in is brimming with noisy, chaotic life, brightly lit by a sea of storefronts that shine with neon letters, competing for attention."

rows.original: The denizens of this place, almost exclusively zaika, don’t seem particularly bothered by your presence – unlike the mob that attacked your transport car when you first arrived in Dhaal. Still, many cast opportunistic glances or treacherous smiles in your direction, inviting you to drop your guard just long enough for them to descend on you like vultures. Were you to disappear in a place like this, probably no-one would be able to find you.
rows.translation: 这里的居民几乎全是扎伊卡人，他们似乎并不特别介意你的存在——这和你初到达尔时袭击运输车的暴民截然不同。尽管如此，仍有许多人朝你投来伺机而动的目光或不怀好意的笑容，诱使你放松警惕，好让他们像秃鹫般一拥而上。要是你在这种地方失踪，恐怕根本没人能找到你。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe denizens of this place, almost exclusively zaika, don’t seem particularly bothered by your presence – unlike the mob that attacked your transport car when you first arrived in Dhaal. Still, many cast opportunistic glances or treacherous smiles in your direction, inviting you to drop your guard just long enough for them to descend on you like vultures. Were you to disappear in a place like this, probably no-one would be able to find you."

rows.original: Eventually, you manage to locate the goal: a tiny set of downward stairs squeezed between the ‘smiling hydra’ and the ‘purple haze’, both of which figured in the graffiti art. The storefront – if it can be called that – consists of a nondescript metal door with no nameplate or other form of identification.
rows.translation: 你最终成功找到了目的地：一小段向下延伸的楼梯，挤在涂鸦中都曾出现的“微笑九头蛇”和“紫色迷雾”之间。所谓的店面——如果这也能叫店面的话——只是一扇毫不起眼的金属门，既没有名牌，也没有任何其他标识。
rows.raw: "\n\nEventually, you manage to locate the goal: a tiny set of downward stairs squeezed between the ‘smiling hydra’ and the ‘purple haze’, both of which figured in the graffiti art. The storefront – if it can be called that – consists of a nondescript metal door with no nameplate or other form of identification."

rows.original: Inspecting the door, you find a simple buzzer and ring it. A long moment passes, and you have a distinct feeling that someone is spying on you through a hidden camera, but can’t seem to find anything like that. Then, the door unlocks with a metallic clack, and dim light shows that the narrow stair continues downward, bending around a corner.
rows.translation: 你检查了一下门，找到一个简易门铃并按了下去。漫长的一刻过去，你清楚地感觉到有人正通过隐藏摄像头监视自己，却怎么也找不到类似的东西。随后，门锁发出一声金属脆响，昏暗灯光照出狭窄楼梯仍在向下延伸，并在一处拐角后消失。
rows.raw: "\n\nInspecting the door, you find a simple buzzer and ring it. A long moment passes, and you have a distinct feeling that someone is spying on you through a hidden camera, but can’t seem to find anything like that. Then, the door unlocks with a metallic clack, and dim light shows that the narrow stair continues downward, bending around a corner."

rows.original: You’ve barely taken three steps when you hear the clack of the door closing automatically behind you. For lack of options, you go down and soon reach what should be the store proper: a slightly wider space with a counter. That’s all. No shelves, displays, nothing, though you’re sure that can’t be the case. At least the place has proper illumination.
rows.translation: 你才走了三步，就听见身后的门咔嗒一声自动关上。既然别无选择，你只好继续下楼，很快便来到应该算是正式店面的地方：一处稍宽敞些、设有柜台的空间。仅此而已。没有货架，没有陈列品，什么都没有，尽管你确信实际情况不可能如此。至少这里照明充足。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve barely taken three steps when you hear the clack of the door closing automatically behind you. For lack of options, you go down and soon reach what should be the store proper: a slightly wider space with a counter. That’s all. No shelves, displays, nothing, though you’re sure that can’t be the case. At least the place has proper illumination."

The stranger, whom you suppose runs the place, has dark violet skin, a raspberry-pink mohawk and eyes of the same color. Her features toe the line of androgyny, with angular cheekbones, a delicate nose and a very toned build whose muscular curves complement her DD-cups beautifully.

Her lower half is clad in dark trousers and military boots. The latex-like material of her pants molds closely to her form, delineating generous hips and thick legs that promise to be just as strong as the rest of her."

rows.raw: "\n\nYou notice an almost invisible zipper at the side of her trousers, tempting you to just reach for it and pull it down. Meanwhile, the trademark tail of her species sways to and fro, though its genital ending is holographically disguised to look like a tapered tip."

rows.original: She smirks, “I must say I was surprised when I saw an offworlder outside. You spoiled scaredy-cats don’t usually come to the wild parts of town, at least not without an armed escort. Though, judging from your gear, I suppose you’re not just any offworlder,” she adds, her gaze sweeping you from head to toe.
rows.translation: 她得意地笑了笑，“我得说，在外面看到一个外星人时，我还挺惊讶的。你们这些养尊处优的胆小鬼通常不会来城里的蛮荒地带，至少在没有武装护卫时不会。不过，看你的装备，我猜你也不是一般的外星人，”她补充道，目光从头到脚扫过你的身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe smirks, “I must say I was surprised when I saw an offworlder outside. You spoiled scaredy-cats don’t usually come to the wild parts of town, at least not without an armed escort. Though, judging from your gear, I suppose you’re not just any offworlder,” she adds, her gaze sweeping you from head to toe."

rows.original: You confirm that you’re not just any traveler, you’re a rusher.
rows.translation: 你确认自己并非普通旅人，而是一名冲袭者。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou confirm that you’re not just any traveler, you’re a rusher."

rows.original: “A rusher? I’ve heard about your type – adventurers who brave the dangers of unexplored areas in search for riches and opportunity. I suppose you would need a place to acquire good gear and do business without having to worry about zaibatsu surveillance, am I right?”
rows.translation: “冲袭者？我听说过你们这种人 – 为了寻找财富与机遇，敢于直面未探索区域种种危险的冒险者。我猜你需要一个地方，既能买到好装备、做生意，又不用担心财阀的监视，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“A rusher? I’ve heard about your type – adventurers who brave the dangers of unexplored areas in search for riches and opportunity. I suppose you would need a place to acquire good gear and do business without having to worry about zaibatsu surveillance, am I right?”"

rows.original: You nod, and her eyes scrutinize you for an uncomfortably long moment. When her pink eyes return to your [pc.eyeColor] ones, you notice the hint of an appreciative smile on her lips. “How did you find out about this place anyway?” she asks.
rows.translation: 你点点头，她的双眼则审视了你好一阵，久得令人不适。当那双粉色眼眸重新对上你[pc.eyeColor]色的眼睛时，你注意到她唇边隐约浮现出欣赏的笑意。“话说回来，你是怎么发现这个地方的？”她问道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou nod, and her eyes scrutinize you for an uncomfortably long moment. When her pink eyes return to your [pc.eyeColor] ones, you notice the hint of an appreciative smile on her lips. “How did you find out about this place anyway?” she asks."

rows.original: The amazon nods in appreciation – almost as if you’ve just passed a secret test. “Well, in that case...” she presses a button on her belt, and several sections of the wall slide open to reveal shelves with all sorts of gear. Some are easily recognizable, like guns, body armor and grenades. Others, not so much.
rows.translation: 这位亚马逊女战士赞许地点点头 – 仿佛你刚刚通过了某种秘密考验。“好吧，既然如此...”她按下腰带上的一个按钮，墙壁的几个部分随即滑开，露出摆满各种装备的架子。有些一眼就能认出，比如枪械、护甲和手榴弹。另一些则没那么容易辨认。

Some are easily recognizable, like guns, body armor and grenades. Others, not so much."

rows.original: Rivet is a tall, imposing zaika who boasts a mix of feminine and masculine beauty. While her body is powerfully built, her proud face is marked by prominent cheekbones, a delicate nose and full lips that habitually hint at a confident smile. Her hair, a raspberry-pink mohawk, shares the hue of her eyes, creating a vibrant first impression. The zaika’s right ear bears a number of piercings, while the left one has been almost entirely replaced with cybernetics.
