rows.raw: " “Hard up for dates, girls? Or just tired of boning each other? Well, lucky for you, I just so happen to be something of an expert at fuckin’. So let’s see what you got.”"

rows.original: <i>“Yeah, alright. It’ll take all four of you to do it, I don’t doubt, but let’s go. We’ll see what the big, bad
rows.translation: <i>“好吧，好吧。毫无疑问，这得你们四个一起上才行，不过来吧。让我看看大名鼎鼎的
rows.raw: " <i>“Yeah, alright. It’ll take all four of you to do it, I don’t doubt, but let’s go. We’ll see what the big, bad "

rows.original: have to offer.”
rows.translation: 能拿出什么本事。”
rows.raw: " have to offer.”"

rows.original: The gang seems amused by your response.
rows.translation: 帮派成员似乎被你的回答逗乐了。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gang seems amused by your response."

rows.original: “Real firecracker, this one.”
rows.translation: “这家伙真是个小爆竹。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Real firecracker, this one.”"

rows.original: “Maybe a little too pushy, though.”
rows.translation: “不过可能有点太强势了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe a little too pushy, though.”"

rows.original: “S’true. Doesn’t appreciate the favor we’re doing for ‘em.”
rows.translation: “没错。根本不领我们给他们的情。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“S’true. Doesn’t appreciate the favor we’re doing for ‘em.”"

rows.original: “More like flavor”
rows.translation: “更像是不领我们的滋味。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“More like flavor”"

rows.original: “Maybe a gentle reminder whose planet they’re on, huh?”
rows.translation: “也许该温柔地提醒一下他们这是在谁的星球上，嗯？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Maybe a gentle reminder whose planet they’re on, huh?”"

rows.original: One of the zaika around you lashes out with their tail, thwacking the fat bulb of their cloacal organ against the side of your face. Lights bloom in front of your eyes and you have to blink back the momentary daze. Did she just cock-slap you?
rows.translation: 围住你的一名扎伊卡甩动尾巴，用泄殖器官肥厚的球茎抽在你脸侧。眼前光芒爆闪，你不得不眨眼摆脱短暂眩晕。她刚才是用肉棒抽了你一耳光吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the zaika around you lashes out with their tail, thwacking the fat bulb of their cloacal organ against the side of your face. Lights bloom in front of your eyes and you have to blink back the momentary daze. Did she just cock-slap you?"

rows.original: You rub your cheek, catching the cloying scent of her aromatic tail covering. There’s something perfumy about her tip, though you’re not sure if the aroma is artificial, or the result of her leaking lust. The musk fills your nostrils all the same, leaving you almost as light-headed from the savory scent as from the unexpected impact.
rows.translation: 你揉着脸颊，闻到她芬芳尾套散发的甜腻气息。她的尖端带着某种香水味，但你无法确定那是人工香味，还是她泄漏的欲液所致。无论如何，麝香都灌满了你的鼻孔；馥郁的气味与意外撞击一样，让你头昏脑涨。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou rub your cheek, catching the cloying scent of her aromatic tail covering. There’s something perfumy about her tip, though you’re not sure if the aroma is artificial, or the result of her leaking lust. The musk fills your nostrils all the same, leaving you almost as light-headed from the savory scent as from the unexpected impact."

rows.original: Another of the gangers strikes out, adding her unique bouquet to the olfactory assault and another mushroom stamp to your stinging cheeks. Before you know it, all four are going at it, buffeting your head in tail-lashing strokes that leave your vision swimming. Every impact sends your neck spinning and your [pc.hair] whipping back and forth, all while the amorous odor of alien excitement floods your dizzy forebrain.
rows.translation: 另一个帮派成员也挥尾抽来，将她独特的芳香加入嗅觉攻势，又把一枚蘑菇印盖在你火辣辣的脸颊上。转眼间，四人全都动起手，接连用尾巴抽打你的脑袋，令你视野摇晃。每次撞击都把你的脖子甩向一边，让[pc.hair]来回飞舞；与此同时，异星人兴奋时散发的多情气味淹没你晕眩的前脑。
rows.raw: "\n\nAnother of the gangers strikes out, adding her unique bouquet to the olfactory assault and another mushroom stamp to your stinging cheeks. Before you know it, all four are going at it, buffeting your head in tail-lashing strokes that leave your vision swimming. Every impact sends your neck spinning and your [pc.hair] whipping back and forth, all while the amorous odor of alien excitement floods your dizzy forebrain."

rows.original: By the time they’re done, your face is flushed, your eyes are unfocused, and your [pc.tongue] is hanging limping from your mouth. They’ve got one hell of an idea on what counts as ‘foreplay’ in this city!
rows.translation: 等她们结束时，你满脸涨红，眼神涣散，[pc.tongue]无力地垂在嘴外。她们对这座城市里什么才算“前戏”，还真有一套离谱的见解！
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time they’re done, your face is flushed, your eyes are unfocused, and your [pc.tongue] is hanging limping from your mouth. They’ve got one hell of an idea on what counts as ‘foreplay’ in this city!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You fork up the dosh and pay off the street toughs. “Aw, thanks for respectin’ local customs an’ shit.”
rows.translation: 你掏钱打发了这些街头混混。“哦，多谢你尊重本地习俗什么的。”
rows.raw: "You fork up the dosh and pay off the street toughs. “Aw, thanks for respectin’ local customs an’ shit.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, Dhaal’s lousy with local customs.”
rows.translation: “对，达尔到处都是本地习俗。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, Dhaal’s lousy with local customs.”"

rows.original: “Especially for yer kind.”
rows.translation: “尤其是给你这种人的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Especially for yer kind.”"

rows.original: “Don’t worry, we’ll leave ya alone and spread the word. Nobody’s to fuck with you for a full day.”
rows.translation: “别担心，我们会放过你，也会把话传出去。整整一天都没人会找你麻烦。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Don’t worry, we’ll leave ya alone and spread the word. Nobody’s to fuck with you for a full day.”"

rows.original: “Course, we ain’t got night and day here.”
rows.translation: “当然，我们这里没有昼夜。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Course, we ain’t got night and day here.”"

rows.original: “So might not be exactly a full day.”
rows.translation: “所以可能不完全是整整一天。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“So might not be exactly a full day.”"

rows.original: “Ain’t got watches, see?”
rows.translation: “你看，我们又没有手表。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ain’t got watches, see?”"

rows.original: They laugh and walk off, out to harass somebody else. Well at least you should be good for a LITTLE while.
rows.translation: 她们笑着离去，转而骚扰别人。好吧，至少你应该能清静一小会儿。
rows.raw: "\n\nThey laugh and walk off, out to harass somebody else. Well at least you should be good for a LITTLE while."

rows.original: (-1000 credits!)
Ganger Cooldown
rows.raw: "Ganger Cooldown"

rows.original: Ganger Cooldown
rows.raw: "Ganger Cooldown"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Hey! Stop!”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey! Stop!”"

rows.original: You pause, turning around to find a quartet of zaika running at you, their faces darkened and weapons in their hands.
rows.translation: 你停下脚步转过身，发现四名扎伊卡正朝你跑来，脸色阴沉，手里拿着武器。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou pause, turning around to find a quartet of zaika running at you, their faces darkened and weapons in their hands."

rows.original: “Is this [pc.himHer]?” one asks her friend.
rows.translation: “是[pc.himHer]吗？”其中一个问朋友。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is this [pc.himHer]?” one asks her friend."

rows.original: The shortest of the natives is covered in bruises and cuts, her clothing even more torn and disheveled than typical for a Gyre resident. “I... I think so?”
rows.translation: 最矮的本地人浑身青肿和伤口，衣服甚至比环流区居民通常的打扮更加破烂凌乱。“我...我想是吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe shortest of the natives is covered in bruises and cuts, her clothing even more torn and disheveled than typical for a Gyre resident. “I... I think so?”"

rows.original: “Hey! You’re the rusher that thought you could just knock around anybody you want to? Well guess what, alien dirtbag: we defend our own, down here.”
rows.translation: “嘿！就是你这个冲锋者，以为什么人都能随便欺负？猜猜怎么着，外星杂种：在这里，我们会保护自己人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey! You’re the rusher that thought you could just knock around anybody you want to? Well guess what, alien dirtbag: we defend our own, down here.”"

rows.original: Not Me
rows.translation: 不是我
rows.raw: "Not Me"

rows.original: Not Me
rows.translation: 不是我
rows.raw: "Not Me"

rows.original: You’re pretty sure you’ve never seen these girls before and have no idea what’s happening.
rows.translation: 你很确定自己从没见过这些女孩，完全不知道发生了什么。
rows.raw: "You’re pretty sure you’ve never seen these girls before and have no idea what’s happening."

rows.original: Fight
rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.original: “Woah, hang on,” you interrupt, holding your palms up to show you mean no harm. “I’m not the rusher who hurt you.”
rows.translation: “哇，等等，”你打断她们，举起双手表示没有恶意。“伤害你的冲锋者不是我。”
rows.raw: "“Woah, hang on,” you interrupt, holding your palms up to show you mean no harm. “I’m not the rusher who hurt you.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, act big when you’re picking on a girl by herself, but then lie out your teeth when reinforcements show up, is that it?”
rows.translation: “对，欺负落单女孩时就装得很厉害，增援来了就满嘴谎话，是吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, act big when you’re picking on a girl by herself, but then lie out your teeth when reinforcements show up, is that it?”"

rows.original: “No, no. Look: what did the rusher look like?”
rows.translation: “不，不。听着：那个冲锋者长什么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, no. Look: what did the rusher look like?”"

rows.original: “Like, I don’t know... you? Not a zaika. An alien.” She seems uncertain and flustered.
rows.translation: “就像，我不知道...像你？不是扎伊卡，是个外星人。”她显得既不确定又慌乱。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Like, I don’t know... you? Not a zaika. An alien.” She seems uncertain and flustered."

rows.original: “Okay, but there are tons of aliens. They don’t all look alike, do they?”
rows.translation: “好吧，但外星人多得是。他们总不可能全长得一样，对吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, but there are tons of aliens. They don’t all look alike, do they?”"

rows.original: The four glance between themselves letting your question hang in the air.
rows.translation: 四人彼此交换眼神，任由你的问题悬在空中。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe four glance between themselves letting your question hang in the air."

rows.original: “Right. So, now, what did this person look like?”
rows.translation: “对。所以现在说说，这个人长什么样？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Right. So, now, what did this person look like?”"

rows.original: “Well, they had [pc.skinFurScales] and [pc.hair].”
rows.translation: “嗯，那个人有[pc.skinFurScales]和[pc.hair]。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Well, they had [pc.skinFurScales] and [pc.hair].”"

rows.original: “Okay, well I see the resemblance, but what else?”
rows.translation: “好吧，确实有点像，但还有呢？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Okay, well I see the resemblance, but what else?”"

rows.original: “I maybe don’t recall everything but I remember them having [pc.hips],” she notes, blushing with deeper embarrassment. “And, um, [pc.chest].”
rows.translation: “我可能记不清全部，但我记得那个人有[pc.hips]，”她说道，因更加尴尬而涨红了脸。“还有，呃，[pc.chest]。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I maybe don’t recall everything but I remember them having [pc.hips],” she notes, blushing with deeper embarrassment. “And, um, [pc.chest].”"

rows.original: You shift awkwardly as four sets of eyes harden at the increasingly familiar description.
rows.translation: 四双眼睛随着这段越来越熟悉的描述变得严厉，你不自在地挪了挪身体。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shift awkwardly as four sets of eyes harden at the increasingly familiar description."

rows.original: A thought strikes you. “What kind of weapon were they using?”
rows.translation: 你突然想到一点。“那个人用的是什么武器？”
rows.raw: "\n\nA thought strikes you. “What kind of weapon were they using?”"

rows.original: “Oh, no weapon. Just their fists. All four of them.”
rows.translation: “哦，没有武器。只用拳头。四只拳头。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, no weapon. Just their fists. All four of them.”"

rows.original: The girl’s companions look at her, then back to you. “I don’t think this is who we’re looking for.”
rows.translation: 女孩的同伴看看她，又看看你。“我觉得这不是我们要找的人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe girl’s companions look at her, then back to you. “I don’t think this is who we’re looking for.”"

rows.original: “Yeah, probably not. Unless...” one girl circles around you, checking for extra hands. “Nope. This ain’t the one.”
rows.translation: “对，可能不是。除非...”一个女孩绕着你转了一圈，检查有没有多余的手。“没有。这不是那个人。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Yeah, probably not. Unless...” one girl circles around you, checking for extra hands. “Nope. This ain’t the one.”"

rows.original: The girls apologize and head off, looking for the responsible party. You have to say, it’s a bit worrying, knowing that there’s a four-arm doppelganger of you out there somewhere!
rows.translation: 女孩们道歉后离开，继续寻找肇事者。不得不说，知道某处有个长着四条手臂的你的分身，实在有点令人担忧！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe girls apologize and head off, looking for the responsible party. You have to say, it’s a bit worrying, knowing that there’s a four-arm doppelganger of you out there somewhere!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Enough! Take your beating and be thankful for it! We’ll teach these aliens to show a little respect!”
rows.translation: “够了！乖乖挨打，还该心怀感激！我们要教会这些外星人尊重别人！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Enough! Take your beating and be thankful for it! We’ll teach these aliens to show a little respect!”"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: A high, keening siren wails over the noise of the city, drawing your attention to an XO. on a swoop bike careening over the heads of the people on the street. You watch the zaika-manufactured enforcer go by only to find a small cadre of locals have interposed themselves in your way.
rows.translation: 一阵高亢尖锐的警报声压过城市噪音，引起了你的注意：一台XO.骑着俯冲摩托，从街上行人的头顶呼啸掠过。你目送这个扎伊卡制造的执法单位离开，却发现一小群本地人已经挡在你面前。
rows.raw: "\n\nA high, keening siren wails over the noise of the city, drawing your attention to an XO. on a swoop bike careening over the heads of the people on the street. You watch the zaika-manufactured enforcer go by only to find a small cadre of locals have interposed themselves in your way."

rows.original: “Watching your friends go by?” one asks with a sneer.
rows.translation: “看着你的朋友们经过？”其中一人冷笑着问。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Watching your friends go by?” one asks with a sneer."

rows.original: You don’t have the faintest idea what she’s talking about.
rows.translation: 你完全不知道她在说什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou don’t have the faintest idea what she’s talking about."

rows.original: “Fancy offworlder like you? Walking around like you own the whole city? Don’t try to tell me you’re not with the zaibatsu.”
rows.translation: “像你这么光鲜的外星人？走起路来仿佛整座城市都是你的？别想告诉我你和财阀没关系。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Fancy offworlder like you? Walking around like you own the whole city? Don’t try to tell me you’re not with the zaibatsu.”"

rows.original: You assure the gang you’ve got nothing to do with the jackboot corporations that run their world.
rows.translation: 你向帮派保证，自己和统治她们世界的铁腕公司毫无关系。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assure the gang you’ve got nothing to do with the jackboot corporations that run their world."

rows.original: “Then one of the alien businesses that deal with them. May as well be the same thing. Every credit you shovel into their pockets is another nightstick to club in the skulls of those who can’t pay for protection.”
rows.translation: “那就是跟他们做生意的外星企业。反正都一样。你塞进他们口袋的每一枚信用点，都会变成一根警棍，砸向那些付不起保护费之人的头骨。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Then one of the alien businesses that deal with them. May as well be the same thing. Every credit you shovel into their pockets is another nightstick to club in the skulls of those who can’t pay for protection.”"

rows.original: Though you ARE part of a fairly big corporation, there’s really no need for these girls to know that. You ask how you can prove you’re not a crony for the zaibatsu.
rows.translation: 虽然你确实属于一家规模不小的公司，但没必要让这些女孩知道。你问要怎样才能证明自己不是财阀的走狗。
rows.raw: "\n\nThough you ARE part of a fairly big corporation, there’s really no need for these girls to know that. You ask how you can prove you’re not a crony for the zaibatsu."

rows.original: They look amongst themselves and point out a storefront on the other side of the street. “The woman who runs that shop just made friends with some zaibatsu bitches. Now, she charges extra for everything she sells. Anytime somebody complains, they wind up with a boot on their throat. Put a trash can through her shop window and we’ll know you’re not with them.”
rows.translation: 她们彼此看了看，指向街对面的一间店铺。“经营那家店的女人刚跟几个财阀贱人交上朋友。现在她卖什么都加价。有人抱怨，就会被靴子踩住喉咙。把垃圾桶砸进她的橱窗，我们就知道你不是跟她们一伙的。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThey look amongst themselves and point out a storefront on the other side of the street. “The woman who runs that shop just made friends with some zaibatsu bitches. Now, she charges extra for everything she sells. Anytime somebody complains, they wind up with a boot on their throat. Put a trash can through her shop window and we’ll know you’re not with them.”"

rows.original: “And if not, don’t think you’re going to get out of here without a few love taps to show what we think about your masters.”
rows.translation: “要是不干，别以为你能毫发无伤地离开。我们会用几下爱的轻拍，让你知道我们对你主子的看法。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And if not, don’t think you’re going to get out of here without a few love taps to show what we think about your masters.”"

rows.original: Great. Property damage or street brawling. What a choice!
rows.translation: 太棒了。破坏财物或者街头斗殴。真是好选择！
rows.raw: "\n\nGreat. Property damage or street brawling. What a choice!"

rows.original: Wreck It
rows.translation: 砸烂它
rows.raw: "Wreck It"

rows.original: Wreck It
rows.translation: 砸烂它
rows.raw: "Wreck It"

rows.original: It doesn’t seem like there’s a peaceful way out. You’re going to have to cause a lotta damage!
rows.translation: 看来没有和平脱身的方法。你得大肆破坏一番！
rows.raw: "It doesn’t seem like there’s a peaceful way out. You’re going to have to cause a lotta damage!"

rows.original: Fight
rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.original: You look down the street for any sign of actual zaibatsu agents, though to be honest, you’re not sure what exactly you’re looking for. Crossing the street with a swift, steady pace, you grab hold of the ill-used trash can on the corner and wheel it over to the offending shop. A few of the passersby stare at you curiously, but make no motion to stop you. Several zaika lurking in nearby alleys step out to get a better look.
rows.translation: 你沿街寻找真正的财阀特工踪影，不过老实说，你也不知道自己究竟在找什么。你步伐迅速而平稳地穿过街道，抓住街角那个饱经摧残的垃圾桶，把它推到那家讨人厌的店铺前。一些路人好奇地盯着你，却没人试图阻止。几个潜伏在附近小巷的扎伊卡也走出来看得更清楚。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou look down the street for any sign of actual zaibatsu agents, though to be honest, you’re not sure what exactly you’re looking for. Crossing the street with a swift, steady pace, you grab hold of the ill-used trash can on the corner and wheel it over to the offending shop. A few of the passersby stare at you curiously, but make no motion to stop you. Several zaika lurking in nearby alleys step out to get a better look."

rows.original: With a grunt of effort, you drag the bin in a circle around you, building up momentum before letting it fly right into the storefront. The window erupts all around you in a brief but violent cacophony of crunching glass and shrieking sheet metal.
rows.translation: 你使劲低吼一声，拖着垃圾桶绕身体转圈，积蓄动量后让它径直飞向店面。橱窗在你四周爆裂，碎玻璃与尖叫的金属板发出短促而猛烈的喧嚣。
rows.raw: "\n\nWith a grunt of effort, you drag the bin in a circle around you, building up momentum before letting it fly right into the storefront. The window erupts all around you in a brief but violent cacophony of crunching glass and shrieking sheet metal."

rows.original: A ragged cheer rises from the onlookers as a tall, well-dressed woman rushes outside, apoplectic with rage. “WHO?!?” Is all she’s able to spit out, as she looks all around before settling on you. “A Rusher?! Oh, are you in for it! They’re not even going to bother making an excuse when they grab you up. My friends in-”
rows.translation: 围观者发出零乱的欢呼，一个衣着考究的高个女人怒不可遏地冲出门。“谁干的？！？”她只能挤出这句话，环顾四周后将目光锁定在你身上。“一个开拓者？！噢，你这下有麻烦了！他们来抓你时甚至都懒得找借口。我的朋友在——”
rows.raw: "\n\nA ragged cheer rises from the onlookers as a tall, well-dressed woman rushes outside, apoplectic with rage. “WHO?!?” Is all she’s able to spit out, as she looks all around before settling on you. “A Rusher?! Oh, are you in for it! They’re not even going to bother making an excuse when they grab you up. My friends in-”"

rows.original: The threat is cut short as a dull green bottle topped with a flickering red flower arcs over your head and through the gaping hole in the storefront. Thinking quickly, you grab the shopkeeper and hit the pavement, dropping low just as the makeshift firebomb smashes inside. A thunderous boom blows out the last of the glass and sucks the air out of your lungs.
rows.translation: 威胁戛然而止，一个顶端插着闪烁红花的暗绿色瓶子越过你头顶，穿过店面敞开的破洞。你反应迅速，一把抓住店主扑倒在地；就在你们伏低的瞬间，简易燃烧弹在店内砸碎。一声雷鸣般的爆炸震碎最后的玻璃，也抽空了你肺里的空气。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe threat is cut short as a dull green bottle topped with a flickering red flower arcs over your head and through the gaping hole in the storefront. Thinking quickly, you grab the shopkeeper and hit the pavement, dropping low just as the makeshift firebomb smashes inside. A thunderous boom blows out the last of the glass and sucks the air out of your lungs."

rows.original: As the store goes up in flames, the zaika on the street scatter in all directions, no one wanting to be around when authorities show up. You stand slowly, helping the shop owner to her feet as her shop burns.
rows.translation: 店铺燃起大火，街上的扎伊卡四散奔逃，谁也不想在当局赶来时留在附近。你慢慢站起，扶着店主起身，她的店则在一旁熊熊燃烧。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs the store goes up in flames, the zaika on the street scatter in all directions, no one wanting to be around when authorities show up. You stand slowly, helping the shop owner to her feet as her shop burns."

rows.original: She seems withered, all the fight drained out of her. You try to speak to her, but she’s numb to it and doesn’t seem to hear. You... should probably get going. You can feel the city’s tensions boiling and it’d be best if you didn’t find yourself in the middle when things escalate.
rows.translation: 她看起来已经枯萎，所有斗志都被抽空。你试图跟她说话，她却麻木得仿佛听不见。你……大概该走了。你能感觉到城市的紧张局势正在沸腾，事情升级时最好别让自己被卷进正中。
rows.raw: "\n\nShe seems withered, all the fight drained out of her. You try to speak to her, but she’s numb to it and doesn’t seem to hear. You... should probably get going. You can feel the city’s tensions boiling and it’d be best if you didn’t find yourself in the middle when things escalate."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Your progress through the luridly lit streets of Dhaal is arrested by a quartet of tails wrapping themselves around your arms in unison. You look at your sides to find a gang of zaika keeping their gaze forward and matching your stride. “Be cool and just duck into the next alley,” one whispers under the din of the city’s constant babble.
rows.translation: 你穿行在达尔霓虹绚烂街道上的脚步，被四条同时缠住手臂的尾巴拦下。你看向两侧，发现一群扎伊卡目视前方、与你保持同样步伐。“冷静点，直接钻进下一条巷子，”其中一人在城市持续不断的嘈杂声下低语。
rows.raw: "\n\nYour progress through the luridly lit streets of Dhaal is arrested by a quartet of tails wrapping themselves around your arms in unison. You look at your sides to find a gang of zaika keeping their gaze forward and matching your stride. “Be cool and just duck into the next alley,” one whispers under the din of the city’s constant babble."

rows.original: The muscled tendrils loosen their grasp as the five of you turn the corner and get out from the glare of buzzing neon. You tighten your shoulders and look over the unfamiliar women.
rows.translation: 当你们五个转过街角、离开嗡嗡作响的霓虹灯光时，肌肉发达的卷须松开了束缚。你绷紧肩膀，打量这些陌生女人。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe muscled tendrils loosen their grasp as the five of you turn the corner and get out from the glare of buzzing neon. You tighten your shoulders and look over the unfamiliar women. "

rows.original: “Oooh, escorts who actually escort you! Neato!”
rows.translation: “噢，护送者真的会护送你！真酷！”
rows.raw: "“Oooh, escorts who actually escort you! Neato!”"

rows.original: “Can I... help you?”
rows.translation: “我能...帮你们吗？”
rows.raw: "“Can I... help you?”"

rows.original: “I’m not sure you ladies have an appointment, but I could pencil something in.”
rows.translation: “我不记得几位女士有预约，不过可以替你们挤出个时间。”
rows.raw: "“I’m not sure you ladies have an appointment, but I could pencil something in.”"

rows.original: “This had better be worth my time. I don’t appreciate strangers taking liberties.”
rows.translation: “最好值得我花时间。我不喜欢陌生人擅自乱来。”
rows.raw: "“This had better be worth my time. I don’t appreciate strangers taking liberties.”"

rows.original: The gangers mutter among themselves as they check you out. “Is this [pc.himHer]?”
rows.translation: 帮派成员一边打量你，一边彼此低声议论。“是[pc.himHer]吗？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gangers mutter among themselves as they check you out. “Is this [pc.himHer]?”"

rows.original: “Gotta be.”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Gotta be.”"

rows.original: One of them clears her throat and produces a cred chip. <i>“We’re the
rows.translation: 其中一人清了清嗓子，拿出一枚信用芯片。<i>“我们是
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of them clears her throat and produces a cred chip. <i>“We’re the "

rows.original: . We’ve got the cash if you’ve got the goods.”
rows.translation: 。你有货，我们就有钱。”
rows.raw: ". We’ve got the cash if you’ve got the goods.”"

rows.original: “Excuse me?”
rows.translation: “你说什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Excuse me?”"

rows.original: They exchange another look. <i>“The gun! Your star tech. We agreed to
rows.translation: 她们再次交换眼神。<i>“枪！你的星际科技。我们谈好的是
rows.raw: "\n\nThey exchange another look. <i>“The gun! Your star tech. We agreed to "

rows.original: and you’re not getting a cred more than that.”
rows.translation: ，多一个信用点都不会给。”
rows.raw: " and you’re not getting a cred more than that.”"

rows.original: It appears one of the numerous local factions has mistaken you for an arms dealer. Given the crime-riddled flavor of the planet-spanning mega city, it’s probably a pretty reasonable mistake to make. It should be easy enough to tell them you’re not the heavily armed alien they’re looking for. Or, would you be willing to part with your sidearm?
rows.translation: 看来当地众多派系中的某一支把你误认成武器商人。考虑到这个覆盖整颗星球的巨型都市犯罪横行，这大概是个相当合理的误会。告诉她们你不是她们要找的那个全副武装外星人，应该并不困难。又或者，你愿意卖掉随身枪械吗？
rows.raw: "\n\nIt appears one of the numerous local factions has mistaken you for an arms dealer. Given the crime-riddled flavor of the planet-spanning mega city, it’s probably a pretty reasonable mistake to make. It should be easy enough to tell them you’re not the heavily armed alien they’re looking for. Or, would you be willing to part with your sidearm?"

rows.original: Mistake
rows.translation: 搞错了
rows.raw: "Mistake"

rows.original: Mistake
rows.translation: 搞错了
rows.raw: "Mistake"

rows.original: What a hilarious misunderstanding! Best to correct them and be on your way.
rows.translation: 真是个滑稽的误会！最好纠正她们，然后继续赶路。
rows.raw: "What a hilarious misunderstanding! Best to correct them and be on your way."

rows.original: Sell
rows.translation: 出售
rows.raw: "Sell"

rows.original: Sell
rows.translation: 出售
rows.raw: "Sell"

rows.original: You’re good with giving up your gun, right? You can always buy another.
rows.translation: 你不介意交出枪，对吧？反正总能再买一把。
rows.raw: "You’re good with giving up your gun, right? You can always buy another."

rows.original: Haggle
rows.translation: 讨价还价
rows.raw: "Haggle"

rows.original: Haggle
rows.translation: 讨价还价
rows.raw: "Haggle"

rows.original: If they think you’re some big time arms dealer, you might be able to get more out of them.
rows.translation: 既然她们以为你是某个大军火商，你也许能从她们身上多捞一点。
rows.raw: "If they think you’re some big time arms dealer, you might be able to get more out of them."

rows.original: Are you sure you want to sell your [pc.rangedWeapon] for
rows.translation: 你确定要出售[pc.rangedWeapon]，价格为
rows.raw: "Are you sure you want to sell your [pc.rangedWeapon] for "

rows.original: credits?
rows.translation: 信用点吗？
rows.raw: " credits?"

rows.original: Sell
rows.translation: 出售
rows.raw: "Sell"

rows.original: Sell
rows.translation: 出售
rows.raw: "Sell"

rows.original: You’re good with giving up your gun, right? You can always buy another.
rows.translation: 你不介意交出枪，对吧？反正总能再买一把。
rows.raw: "You’re good with giving up your gun, right? You can always buy another."

rows.original: Back
rows.translation: 返回
rows.raw: "Back"

rows.original: You offer a shrug and a grin. “Sorry ladies, you’ve got the wrong off-worlder.”
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩咧嘴一笑。“抱歉，女士们，你们找错外星人了。”
rows.raw: "You offer a shrug and a grin. “Sorry ladies, you’ve got the wrong off-worlder.”"

rows.original: The four look amongst one another and you can almost see the surprise turn to embarrassment. “You’re not Lyn Cognita?”
rows.translation: 四人互相看了看，你几乎能看到她们的惊讶转变为尴尬。“你不是琳·科格尼塔？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe four look amongst one another and you can almost see the surprise turn to embarrassment. “You’re not Lyn Cognita?”"

rows.original: “Afraid not. [pc.name] Steele.”
rows.translation: “恐怕不是。我是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Afraid not. [pc.name] Steele.”"

rows.original: “Shit-damn! We must’ve missed the meeting!”
rows.translation: “该死！我们肯定错过会面了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Shit-damn! We must’ve missed the meeting!”"

rows.original: “Wait, what day is it?”
rows.translation: “等等，今天几号？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wait, what day is it?”"

rows.original: “How did we lose so much time!?” the tall one wails.
rows.translation: “我们怎么会浪费掉这么多时间！？”高个子哀号道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“How did we lose so much time!?” the tall one wails."

rows.original: “I TOLD you we shouldn’t have gone to the milk bar first!”
rows.translation: “我早就告诉过你们不该先去乳吧！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I TOLD you we shouldn’t have gone to the milk bar first!”"

rows.original: “Oh, like you weren’t two nipples deep.”
rows.translation: “哦，说得好像你当时没有整张脸埋在两颗乳头之间。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, like you weren’t two nipples deep.”"

rows.original: “I never!”
rows.translation: “我才没有！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I never!”"

rows.original: While they bicker about whose fault it was, you back out of the alley and get back to your affairs. Seems like these ladies are a gun shy and a day late for whatever they were planning.
rows.translation: 趁她们争论这到底是谁的错，你退出小巷，继续办自己的事。看来这些女士既没拿到枪，也迟到了整整一天，什么计划都泡汤了。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile they bicker about whose fault it was, you back out of the alley and get back to your affairs. Seems like these ladies are a gun shy and a day late for whatever they were planning."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Ten thousand? Yeah, you’ll take that. Trying not to come off as over-eager, you produce your [pc.weaponRanged] and motion for them to hand you the money.
rows.translation: 一万？好，你接受。为了不显得过于急切，你拿出[pc.weaponRanged]，示意她们把钱交过来。
rows.raw: "Ten thousand? Yeah, you’ll take that. Trying not to come off as over-eager, you produce your [pc.weaponRanged] and motion for them to hand you the money."

rows.original: “Is that... is that it?” one of the gangers asks, her face screwed into an expression of disappointment. “That doesn’t look like much.”
rows.translation: “那是...就是这个？”其中一个帮派成员问道，脸上满是失望。“看起来没什么特别的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Is that... is that it?” one of the gangers asks, her face screwed into an expression of disappointment. “That doesn’t look like much.”"

rows.original: Uh oh. You shoot her a look of annoyance to deflect the question and begin slowly putting it away, as if ready to walk away from the deal.
rows.translation: 糟糕。你恼怒地瞪她一眼以回避问题，随后慢慢把武器收起来，仿佛准备放弃交易。
rows.raw: "\n\nUh oh. You shoot her a look of annoyance to deflect the question and begin slowly putting it away, as if ready to walk away from the deal."

rows.original: “No, no. That’s definitely it,” the smallest girl confirms hopefully. “Alien tech, right? Makes sense it’d look weird.”
rows.translation: “不，不。这绝对就是，”最矮的女孩满怀希望地确认。“外星科技，对吧？看起来古怪才合理。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“No, no. That’s definitely it,” the smallest girl confirms hopefully. “Alien tech, right? Makes sense it’d look weird.”"

rows.original: The gangers hand over the money and you hand off their weapon. Giving them a silent nod, you turn in place and walk away. You have to force yourself to go slowly so they don’t detect the spring in your step.
rows.translation: 帮派成员交出钱，你也交出她们的武器。你默默点头，转身离去。你不得不强迫自己放慢脚步，以免她们察觉你步履中的雀跃。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gangers hand over the money and you hand off their weapon. Giving them a silent nod, you turn in place and walk away. You have to force yourself to go slowly so they don’t detect the spring in your step. "

rows.original: credits for that? You could get used to this ‘arms dealer’ thing.
rows.translation: 信用点就换来那东西？你或许会喜欢上这种“武器商人”生意。
rows.raw: " credits for that? You could get used to this ‘arms dealer’ thing."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “Yeah, I’ve got the gun,” you remark with a cool neutrality. “But I want more.”
rows.translation: “对，枪在我这里，”你冷淡平静地说道。“但我要更多。”
rows.raw: "“Yeah, I’ve got the gun,” you remark with a cool neutrality. “But I want more.”"

rows.original: “What?! We had an agreement!”
rows.translation: “什么？！我们说好了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“What?! We had an agreement!”"

rows.original: “I am altering the deal. Pray I do not alter it any further.”
rows.translation: “我改变了交易条件。祈祷我不会进一步改变它。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I am altering the deal. Pray I do not alter it any further.”"

rows.original: “I got a lot of requests from other interested parties. Supply and demand.”
rows.translation: “还有很多其他感兴趣的人找过我。供求关系。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“I got a lot of requests from other interested parties. Supply and demand.”"

rows.original: You glance upward and smile. “Double.”
rows.translation: 你抬头一笑。“双倍。”
rows.raw: " You glance upward and smile. “Double.”"

rows.original: credits?! You’re insane!”
rows.translation: 信用点？！你疯了！”
rows.raw: " credits?! You’re insane!”"

rows.original: “I thought I was dealing with professionals here. I can see you just aren’t serious about this.” You move to step away.
rows.translation: “我还以为是在和专业人士交易。看来你们根本不认真。”你转身欲走。
rows.raw: "\n\n“I thought I was dealing with professionals here. I can see you just aren’t serious about this.” You move to step away."

rows.original: <i>“Wait, wait! Look, double’s not fair, but we could get you more. What about
rows.translation: <i>“等等，等等！听着，翻倍确实不公平，但我们可以再加一点。
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Wait, wait! Look, double’s not fair, but we could get you more. What about "

rows.translation: 怎么样？”

rows.original: <i>“Even giving you my Friends-and-Family discount would only take it to
rows.translation: <i>“就算给你们我的亲友优惠价，也只能降到
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Even giving you my Friends-and-Family discount would only take it to "

rows.original: .” you push.
rows.translation: 。”你继续施压。
rows.raw: ".” you push."

rows.original: <i>“Look, I’ve got
rows.translation: <i>“你看，我身上有
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Look, I’ve got "

rows.original: on me,” another girl adds, producing her own chip. “
rows.translation: 点数，”另一个女孩补充道，并拿出自己的信用筹码。“
rows.raw: " on me,” another girl adds, producing her own chip. “"

rows.original: is a lot!”
rows.translation: 已经很多了！”
rows.raw: " is a lot!”"

rows.original: <i>“Oh, if you got that much, you could get more, I’m sure. Let’s say...
rows.translation: <i>“哦，既然你有这么多，肯定还能拿出更多。那就...
rows.raw: "\n\n<i>“Oh, if you got that much, you could get more, I’m sure. Let’s say... "

rows.original: ? And that’s just breaking even for me.”
rows.translation: ？而且这对我来说也只是刚好回本。”
rows.raw: "? And that’s just breaking even for me.”"

rows.original: The gangers fall into a circle and furiously discuss your offer before turning back. “We’ve agreed. We’ll get you the fifteen. But we need to get the extra from a girl we’ve got waiting across the street. Come with us.”
rows.translation: 帮派分子围成一圈，激烈讨论你的提议，随后转过身来。“我们同意了。十五个会给你，但多出来的得去找一个在街对面等着的姑娘拿。跟我们来。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gangers fall into a circle and furiously discuss your offer before turning back. “We’ve agreed. We’ll get you the fifteen. But we need to get the extra from a girl we’ve got waiting across the street. Come with us.”"

rows.original: You follow the four zaika back into the main street, but have a creeping feeling at the back of your neck. Your fingertips tingle at the way they move and the sudden silence that’s overtaken the four. You may have pushed your luck a bit too far.
rows.translation: 你跟着四个扎伊卡回到主街，后颈却渐渐泛起不祥预感。她们行进的方式以及突然笼罩四人的沉默，让你的指尖微微发麻。或许你确实有点得寸进尺了。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou follow the four zaika back into the main street, but have a creeping feeling at the back of your neck. Your fingertips tingle at the way they move and the sudden silence that’s overtaken the four. You may have pushed your luck a bit too far."

rows.original: Sure enough, the girls spring at you, grabbing for your weapon. You avoid the press of purple flesh, and prepare to defend yourself!
rows.translation: 果然，女孩们扑上来抢你的武器。你避开紫色肉体的围堵，准备自卫！
rows.raw: "\n\nSure enough, the girls spring at you, grabbing for your weapon. You avoid the press of purple flesh, and prepare to defend yourself!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The density of the city is easy to get lost in, but not, apparently, for off-worlders.
rows.translation: 这座城市密集得很容易迷路，但外星人显然不会被漏掉。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe density of the city is easy to get lost in, but not, apparently, for off-worlders."

rows.original: “Hey! Hey you! Alien shitheel! Get back to where you came from!” The shout comes from a cadre of natives who are leaning up against a nearby building.
rows.translation: “嘿！你！外星蠢货！滚回老家！”喊声来自一群靠在附近建筑上的本地人。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey! Hey you! Alien shitheel! Get back to where you came from!” The shout comes from a cadre of natives who are leaning up against a nearby building."

rows.original: “In a hurry to go fuck yourself?” another adds
rows.translation: “急着滚回去操自己吗？”另一个补充道
rows.raw: "\n\n“In a hurry to go fuck yourself?” another adds"

rows.original: You walk on, but the gangers detach themselves from their perches and match your pace, flinging insults as they go.
rows.translation: 你继续走，但帮派成员离开倚靠处，跟上你的步伐，一路辱骂。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou walk on, but the gangers detach themselves from their perches and match your pace, flinging insults as they go."

rows.original: “Look at this trespassing slut, just walking like [pc.armor] owns the place.”
rows.translation: “看看这个擅闯的骚货，穿着[pc.armor]走得好像这地方归自己所有。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Look at this trespassing slut, just walking like [pc.armor] owns the place.”"

rows.original: “Who you tryin’ to impress with those clothes, slut?”
rows.translation: “骚货，穿这身衣服想取悦谁？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Who you tryin’ to impress with those clothes, slut?”"

rows.original: Of all the people wandering the Gyre today, these four seem to have chosen you for their quarry. They hurl a bevy of insults, each cheering on the others to top the last nasty barb.
rows.translation: 今天游荡在旋环区的这么多人里，这四个偏偏选中了你作为猎物。她们接连抛出一大串辱骂，每个人都起哄让同伴说出比上一句更恶毒的话。
rows.raw: "\n\nOf all the people wandering the Gyre today, these four seem to have chosen you for their quarry. They hurl a bevy of insults, each cheering on the others to top the last nasty barb."

rows.original: Despite it all, though, they seem content to keep their assault purely verbal. You could just walk on and let them shout themselves hoarse, if you wanted to take the high road. Or, you could knock some skulls together and teach these punks a little respect.
rows.translation: 不过即使如此，她们似乎也满足于只用言语攻击。若想采取宽容的做法，你大可以继续走，让她们自己喊到嗓子哑；或者，你也可以把几个脑袋撞在一起，教教这些混混什么叫尊重。
rows.raw: "\n\nDespite it all, though, they seem content to keep their assault purely verbal. You could just walk on and let them shout themselves hoarse, if you wanted to take the high road. Or, you could knock some skulls together and teach these punks a little respect."

rows.original: Fight
rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: You’ve had just about enough of that. You’re [pc.name] Motherfucking STEELE. You’re not about to take this kind of abuse from some puffed-up street toughs. You turn on your heels, head full of righteous indignation. The locals seem pleased that their verbal assault has provoked you and they move in for a tussle. It’s a fight!

rows.raw: "You offer the girl a chit which she gratefully accepts. “Oh, thank you! You’re so generous!” She takes a step away before thinking about something and turning back to you with a mixed expression on her face."
