rows.translation: “那个太小了，”你喊道。“把她放回去，换条更大的猎物。”扎伊卡们饶有兴趣地转向你。
rows.raw: "“That one’s too small,” you call out. “Throw her back and try for a bigger catch.” The zaika turn to you and with amusement."

rows.original: “Lllllllllladies,” you call, rolling the L from behind your most infuriating grin. They turn and you wiggle your eyebrows at them.
rows.translation: “女女女女女士们，”你拖着L音喊道，脸上挂着最令人恼火的笑容。她们转过来，你朝她们挑动眉毛。
rows.raw: "“Lllllllllladies,” you call, rolling the L from behind your most infuriating grin. They turn and you wiggle your eyebrows at them."

rows.original: “Get away from her, you bitches,” you hiss from your clenched teeth. Their tails shoot up in alarm and turn out like spooked cats.
rows.translation: “离她远点，你们这些婊子，”你咬牙嘶声说道。她们的尾巴受惊般竖起，像被吓到的猫一样转身。
rows.raw: "“Get away from her, you bitches,” you hiss from your clenched teeth. Their tails shoot up in alarm and turn out like spooked cats."

rows.original: With the focus off the cybernetic girl, she takes off running, shooting you an appreciative look as she goes. You’ve gotten the gang’s attention. Now it’s time to teach them some manners.
rows.translation: 义体女孩不再是注意力焦点，立刻转身逃跑，临走时向你投来感激的一眼。你已经成功吸引帮派的注意，现在该教教她们礼貌了。
rows.raw: " With the focus off the cybernetic girl, she takes off running, shooting you an appreciative look as she goes. You’ve gotten the gang’s attention. Now it’s time to teach them some manners."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The perpetual dusk of Dhaal’s neon-lit streets has been growing sharper these last few minutes. It’s not until you hear a dull, rolling rumble from the smog-stained sky that you realize why. The clouds overhead have grown darker and thicker, blotting out the ambient light of Dhaal’s skyscraper-shielded sun. Though the shrill buzz of halogen pushes back any true night, you can sense an increased urgency in the ebb and flow of foot traffic even as the first splattering drops of rain fall just in front of you.
rows.translation: 过去几分钟里，达尔霓虹街道上永恒的暮色变得愈发鲜明。直到烟雾污染的天空传来沉闷滚雷，你才明白原因。头顶云层变得更黑更厚，遮住被摩天楼屏蔽的达尔太阳所散发的环境光。卤素灯尖锐的嗡鸣虽阻挡了真正的黑夜，但第一批零散雨滴落在面前时，你仍能感受到人流来去间更强烈的急迫。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe perpetual dusk of Dhaal’s neon-lit streets has been growing sharper these last few minutes. It’s not until you hear a dull, rolling rumble from the smog-stained sky that you realize why. The clouds overhead have grown darker and thicker, blotting out the ambient light of Dhaal’s skyscraper-shielded sun. Though the shrill buzz of halogen pushes back any true night, you can sense an increased urgency in the ebb and flow of foot traffic even as the first splattering drops of rain fall just in front of you."

rows.original: The street hisses at the raindrop, bubbling liquid eating away at the concrete. The natives around you find reasons to push their way into various buildings or take off at a sprint to find shelter. Some more prepared zaika produce translucent ponchos, donning the glass-like plastic and drawing up the hood as the distant thunder grows more pronounced. A few hoist up whatever’s close at hand to shield themselves from the rain as they duck into side alleys or hail transits.
rows.translation: 雨滴落在街上嘶嘶作响，冒泡液体腐蚀着混凝土。周围本地人纷纷挤进各栋建筑，或拔腿狂奔寻找避难处。准备更充分的扎伊卡取出半透明雨披，穿上玻璃般的塑料并拉起兜帽，远处雷声也愈发响亮。还有人举起手边任何东西遮挡雨水，同时钻进侧巷或招呼交通工具。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe street hisses at the raindrop, bubbling liquid eating away at the concrete. The natives around you find reasons to push their way into various buildings or take off at a sprint to find shelter. Some more prepared zaika produce translucent ponchos, donning the glass-like plastic and drawing up the hood as the distant thunder grows more pronounced. A few hoist up whatever’s close at hand to shield themselves from the rain as they duck into side alleys or hail transits."

rows.original: Luckily for you, your [pc.armor] is well shielded from adverse conditions, and acid rain certainly qualifies! As the storm breaks overhead and the dancing rush of the corrosive shower fizzes on your suit, you can’t help but marvel at the suddenly vacant streets. What was bustling moments ago, has become a ghost town almost by reflex. The natives seem to have grown accustomed to the sky spitting the products of the zaibatsu’s unchecked industrial pollution. Makes one wonder what else they’ve grown accustomed to.
rows.translation: 幸运的是，你的[pc.armor]对恶劣环境防护良好，酸雨当然也算一种！风暴在头顶爆发，腐蚀性雨幕跳动着落在套装上嘶嘶作响；你不由惊叹街道竟突然空无一人。片刻前还熙熙攘攘的地方，几乎条件反射般变成鬼城。本地人似乎已习惯天空吐下财阀不受约束的工业污染产物，不禁让人好奇她们还习惯了什么。
rows.raw: "\n\nLuckily for you, your [pc.armor] is well shielded from adverse conditions, and acid rain certainly qualifies! As the storm breaks overhead and the dancing rush of the corrosive shower fizzes on your suit, you can’t help but marvel at the suddenly vacant streets. What was bustling moments ago, has become a ghost town almost by reflex. The natives seem to have grown accustomed to the sky spitting the products of the zaibatsu’s unchecked industrial pollution. Makes one wonder what else they’ve grown accustomed to."

rows.original: You’re in no particular hurry, so you could find somewhere to shelter if you wanted, or just trust your [pc.armor] to keep dry and unmelted until the storm passes.
rows.translation: 你不赶时间，可以找地方避雨，也可以相信[pc.armor]能让你在暴风雨过去前保持干燥、不被融化。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’re in no particular hurry, so you could find somewhere to shelter if you wanted, or just trust your [pc.armor] to keep dry and unmelted until the storm passes."

rows.original: Shelter
rows.translation: 避雨
rows.raw: "Shelter"

rows.original: Shelter
rows.translation: 避雨
rows.raw: "Shelter"

rows.original: Wait it out.
rows.translation: 等雨停。
rows.raw: "Wait it out."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: As much as you normally enjoy walking about without a stitch of clothing on, the imminent acid rain suggests that you’ll probably want to do as the natives and find somewhere to hunker down till the storm has passed.
rows.translation: 尽管你通常很享受不着寸缕地四处走动，迫近的酸雨却表明，最好还是效仿本地人，找个地方躲到风暴过去。
rows.raw: "\n\nAs much as you normally enjoy walking about without a stitch of clothing on, the imminent acid rain suggests that you’ll probably want to do as the natives and find somewhere to hunker down till the storm has passed."

rows.original: You weigh your odds at getting back to familiar territory before the rain comes and decide they’re not great. Unless you want your [pc.clothes] melted right off your body, you’re going to need to find somewhere to weather the storm.
rows.translation: 你权衡在雨落下前赶回熟悉区域的可能性，认为希望不大。除非想让[pc.clothes]直接从身上融化，否则你必须找个地方熬过风暴。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou weigh your odds at getting back to familiar territory before the rain comes and decide they’re not great. Unless you want your [pc.clothes] melted right off your body, you’re going to need to find somewhere to weather the storm."

rows.original: Shelter
rows.translation: 避雨
rows.raw: "Shelter"

rows.original: Shelter
rows.translation: 避雨
rows.raw: "Shelter"

rows.original: Wait it out.
rows.translation: 等雨停。
rows.raw: "Wait it out."

rows.original: Fortunately enough, you find a broad backstreet close at hand. Unlike many of the city’s side alleys, this detour enjoys the benefits of a covered skywalk between two looming buildings. The damp darkness makes it feel almost like a street-level tunnel, but it’s broad enough to keep you dry when the acidic shower breaks. Pollution-tainted water cascades into the streets, scouring the stone and steel in a corrosive spree.
rows.translation: 幸运的是，附近正好有条宽阔后街。与城里许多侧巷不同，这条绕道享有两栋高耸建筑之间有顶空中步道的庇护。湿润黑暗让它看起来几乎像地面隧道，但足够宽敞，能在酸性骤雨降下时让你保持干燥。被污染的雨水倾泻到街上，带着腐蚀性疯狂冲刷石头与钢铁。
rows.raw: "Fortunately enough, you find a broad backstreet close at hand. Unlike many of the city’s side alleys, this detour enjoys the benefits of a covered skywalk between two looming buildings. The damp darkness makes it feel almost like a street-level tunnel, but it’s broad enough to keep you dry when the acidic shower breaks. Pollution-tainted water cascades into the streets, scouring the stone and steel in a corrosive spree."

rows.original: The thunder and rainfall are noisy enough that you don’t notice that you’ve got company until they’re practically on top of you. You turn to find a group of zaika studying you with amusement.
rows.translation: 雷声与雨声太过嘈杂，直到对方几乎贴到身边，你才发现自己并非独处。转身后，你看见一群扎伊卡正饶有兴致地打量你。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe thunder and rainfall are noisy enough that you don’t notice that you’ve got company until they’re practically on top of you. You turn to find a group of zaika studying you with amusement."

rows.original: “Tunnel Snakes rule!” you insist, pumping your fist and hoping you guessed their gang name.
rows.translation: “隧道蛇帮万岁！”你挥着拳坚持道，希望自己猜对了帮派名字。
rows.raw: " “Tunnel Snakes rule!” you insist, pumping your fist and hoping you guessed their gang name."

rows.original: “First rainstorm?” one asks, folding her arms under her bare bust. “Guess you didn’t know this was
rows.translation: “第一次遇上暴雨？”其中一人问道，双臂交叉托在裸露胸部下方。“看来你不知道这里是
rows.raw: "\n\n“First rainstorm?” one asks, folding her arms under her bare bust. “Guess you didn’t know this was "

rows.original: territory, huh?”
rows.translation: 的地盘，是吧？”
rows.raw: " territory, huh?”"

rows.original: You gesture at the steady, sizzling storm at your back. “Just keeping dry,” you offer, noncommittally.
rows.translation: 你指向身后持续嘶嘶作响的暴雨。“只是来避雨，”你含糊说道。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou gesture at the steady, sizzling storm at your back. “Just keeping dry,” you offer, noncommittally."

rows.original: “We can appreciate that,” another girl replies, eyes trained on the acrid squall blowing through the main thoroughfare. “Don’t worry - we keep the Cloudburst Peace ‘round here. Everything’s neutral ground when the storms start.”
rows.translation: “这我们理解，”另一个女孩盯着席卷主干道的刺鼻暴雨回答。“别担心，我们这里遵守‘云暴和平’。风暴一开始，所有地方都是中立区。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We can appreciate that,” another girl replies, eyes trained on the acrid squall blowing through the main thoroughfare. “Don’t worry - we keep the Cloudburst Peace ‘round here. Everything’s neutral ground when the storms start.”"

rows.original: “[pc.HeShe] ain’t even from around here,” the shortest girl mutters. Her compatriots elbow her quiet, but the de facto leader of the group gives you a narrow-eyed look.
rows.translation: “[pc.HeShe]根本不是本地人，”最矮的女孩嘟囔。同伴用肘让她闭嘴，但这群人的实际首领眯眼看着你。
rows.raw: "\n\n“[pc.HeShe] ain’t even from around here,” the shortest girl mutters. Her compatriots elbow her quiet, but the de facto leader of the group gives you a narrow-eyed look."

rows.original: “That’s true. You here for trouble?” She looks you up and down. “Or...?” Four tails rise up as one, swaying at the prospect of some sport to pass the time.
rows.translation: “确实。你是来找麻烦的吗？”她上下打量你。“还是说...？”四条尾巴齐刷刷地竖起，想到能找点乐子打发时间便来回摇摆。
rows.raw: "\n\n“That’s true. You here for trouble?” She looks you up and down. “Or...?” Four tails rise up as one, swaying at the prospect of some sport to pass the time."

rows.original: Trouble
rows.translation: 找麻烦
rows.raw: "Trouble"

rows.original: Trouble
rows.translation: 找麻烦
rows.raw: "Trouble"

rows.original: You don’t trust these gang members one bit.
rows.translation: 你一点也不信任这些帮派成员。
rows.raw: "You don’t trust these gang members one bit."

rows.translation: 还是说...？
还是说...？

rows.original: Pass the time by getting to know the locals more intimately.
rows.translation: 更亲密地了解当地人，借此打发时间。
rows.raw: "Pass the time by getting to know the locals more intimately."

rows.translation: 还是说...？
还是说...？

rows.original:
You are not libidinous enough for this.

(Libido 15+ required.)
rows.translation:
你的性欲还没旺盛到愿意这么做。

（需要性欲达到15以上。）
rows.raw: "You are not libidinous enough for this.\n\n(Libido 15+ required.)"

rows.original: Neither
rows.translation: 都不选
rows.raw: "Neither"

rows.original: Neither
rows.translation: 都不选
rows.raw: "Neither"

rows.original: Just keep your head down and get through the acid rain in one piece.
rows.translation: 低下头，安然熬过这场酸雨。
rows.raw: "Just keep your head down and get through the acid rain in one piece."

rows.original: Sizing up the girls in your tunnel, you decide to be more proactive. If you’re going to be ambushed, you’d rather start the fight on your own terms. “I don’t know about the local customs, but I’m not going out into the rain and I’m pretty thin on trust.” They glance at one another and nod. Off-worlders are just as savage as they thought.
rows.translation: 你审视着隧道里的女孩们，决定先发制人。既然免不了遭到伏击，不如按自己的方式开战。“我不懂本地习俗，但我不会走进雨里，而且我不太信任你们。”她们互相看了一眼，点点头。外星人果然和她们想的一样野蛮。
rows.raw: "Sizing up the girls in your tunnel, you decide to be more proactive. If you’re going to be ambushed, you’d rather start the fight on your own terms. “I don’t know about the local customs, but I’m not going out into the rain and I’m pretty thin on trust.” They glance at one another and nod. Off-worlders are just as savage as they thought."

rows.original: The rain slows and stops, but the fight’s just beginning!
rows.translation: 雨势渐缓并停了下来，但战斗才刚刚开始！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe rain slows and stops, but the fight’s just beginning!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “I was thinking ‘pleasure,’ actually. Any local traditions about fucking during a rainstorm?”
rows.translation: “其实我想的是‘寻欢’。这里有没有暴雨天做爱的传统？”
rows.raw: "“I was thinking ‘pleasure,’ actually. Any local traditions about fucking during a rainstorm?”"

rows.original: The four girls look between themselves. One of them shrugs, her lips curling into a slight smile. “Oh what the hell. If an alien asks you to fuck, who am I to turn ‘em down?”
rows.translation: 四个女孩互相看了看。其中一个耸耸肩，嘴角微微扬起。“管他的。外星人都开口求操了，我凭什么拒绝？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe four girls look between themselves. One of them shrugs, her lips curling into a slight smile. “Oh what the hell. If an alien asks you to fuck, who am I to turn ‘em down?”"

rows.original: The others, apparently all too familiar with their slutty friend’s predilections, head deeper into the alley and leave the two of you alone. She raises an eyebrow and swings her tail in long arcs behind her. “So... what’s on the menu?”
rows.translation: 其他人显然很熟悉这位淫荡朋友的癖好，纷纷走向小巷深处，把你们俩单独留下。她扬起眉毛，尾巴在身后大幅摆动。“那么...菜单上有什么？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe others, apparently all too familiar with their slutty friend’s predilections, head deeper into the alley and leave the two of you alone. She raises an eyebrow and swings her tail in long arcs behind her. “So... what’s on the menu?”"

rows.original: “Just keeping dry, huh? Well, that’s disappointing.” The gangers huddle up for warmth but otherwise leave you unmolested to wait out the storm. It feels like hours but eventually the thunder softens and the rain relents. One by one, doors open across the city and the zaika poke out their heads. In no time, they’ve flooded back into the streets, returning to their myriad tasks.
rows.translation: “只是来避雨的，是吧？真扫兴。”帮派成员挤成一团取暖，除此之外没有骚扰你，任你等待暴雨过去。感觉像是过了几个小时，但雷声终于减弱，雨也停了。城里各处的门一扇接一扇打开，扎伊卡们探出脑袋。没过多久，她们便重新涌上街头，继续各自形形色色的工作。
rows.raw: "“Just keeping dry, huh? Well, that’s disappointing.” The gangers huddle up for warmth but otherwise leave you unmolested to wait out the storm. It feels like hours but eventually the thunder softens and the rain relents. One by one, doors open across the city and the zaika poke out their heads. In no time, they’ve flooded back into the streets, returning to their myriad tasks."

rows.original: The girls you sheltered with give you predatory looks, as if considering jumping you now that the showers are over. You’d just as soon get back to your own affairs, and leave the covered alley before your hosts can turn inhospitable.
rows.translation: 和你一起避雨的女孩们露出捕食者般的目光，仿佛正考虑趁雨停后扑向你。你也想尽快回去办自己的事，于是在这些东道主变得不友好之前离开了有遮蔽的小巷。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe girls you sheltered with give you predatory looks, as if considering jumping you now that the showers are over. You’d just as soon get back to your own affairs, and leave the covered alley before your hosts can turn inhospitable."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: Amid the chaotic flashes of endless neon advertisements and the dull roar of tightly congested city noise, one sensation cuts through the rest to draw your attention. The scent of freshly fried food fills your nostrils with mouth-watering temptations. A grumble in your stomach turns your heels toward the source of the aroma and before long you locate a semi-circular food cart.
rows.translation: 无穷无尽的霓虹广告混乱闪烁，拥挤城市的噪声低沉轰鸣，一种感觉却穿透了这一切，吸引了你的注意。新鲜油炸食物的香味钻入鼻孔，令人垂涎。肚子咕噜一响，你转身朝香气来源走去，不久便找到一辆半圆形餐车。
rows.raw: "\n\nAmid the chaotic flashes of endless neon advertisements and the dull roar of tightly congested city noise, one sensation cuts through the rest to draw your attention. The scent of freshly fried food fills your nostrils with mouth-watering temptations. A grumble in your stomach turns your heels toward the source of the aroma and before long you locate a semi-circular food cart."

rows.original: The cart has all the typical advertising eye-catches you’ve come to expect from this place, but the real attraction is its proprietor. The zaika manning the station is one of the plumpest you’ve seen. She’s wearing a Paragon-blue vest and blocky shades, but little else. With her vest open, you can see she’s got a big, jiggly tummy and hefty tits. Between the jelly rolls, hips twice the size of her shoulders, and a rounded, full-cheeked face, she has an extremely well-fed appearance. Especially compared to the other, malnourished denizens of the Gyre.
rows.translation: 餐车上有着你已经习惯的各种典型醒目广告，但真正引人注目的是摊主。经营摊位的扎伊卡是你见过最丰满的一个。她穿着一件典范蓝马甲和方方正正的墨镜，除此之外几乎什么也没穿。敞开的马甲露出圆润颤动的大肚子和沉甸甸的乳房。层层赘肉、宽达肩膀两倍的臀部以及双颊饱满的圆脸，让她显得营养极为充足，尤其是和环城区其他营养不良的居民相比。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe cart has all the typical advertising eye-catches you’ve come to expect from this place, but the real attraction is its proprietor. The zaika manning the station is one of the plumpest you’ve seen. She’s wearing a Paragon-blue vest and blocky shades, but little else. With her vest open, you can see she’s got a big, jiggly tummy and hefty tits. Between the jelly rolls, hips twice the size of her shoulders, and a rounded, full-cheeked face, she has an extremely well-fed appearance. Especially compared to the other, malnourished denizens of the Gyre."

rows.original: Perhaps it’s her relative thickness that has attracted the ire of a local gang. Her cart is surrounded by much thinner, irate citizens who are causing quite a ruckus.
rows.translation: 或许正是她相对丰腴的身材招来了本地帮派的敌意。餐车周围站满了瘦得多、怒气冲冲的市民，正在大吵大闹。
rows.raw: "\n\nPerhaps it’s her relative thickness that has attracted the ire of a local gang. Her cart is surrounded by much thinner, irate citizens who are causing quite a ruckus."

rows.original: “Take your alien garbage out of here, lard-ass!”
rows.translation: “把你的外星垃圾弄走，肥婆！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Take your alien garbage out of here, lard-ass!”"

rows.original: “We don’t need that fried, off-world trash around here!”
rows.translation: “我们这里不需要那种油炸的外星垃圾！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We don’t need that fried, off-world trash around here!”"

rows.original: “You can hardly fit behind that cart!”
rows.translation: “你连餐车后面都快塞不下了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You can hardly fit behind that cart!”"

rows.original: The last girl actually has a point. The wheeled semi-circle frier is so tight around the girl’s thighs that her chub muffin-tops over the lip. Despite the naked hostility, the street vendor has a wide, jolly smile on her lips. She pulls her glasses down and squints against the neon, looking over the gang.
rows.translation: 最后一个女孩说得还真有点道理。装着轮子的半圆形炸锅紧紧箍住女孩的大腿，她的赘肉都从边缘溢了出来。面对赤裸裸的敌意，街头摊贩脸上依然挂着开朗的大笑。她拉低墨镜，在霓虹灯下眯起眼睛，扫视这群帮派成员。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe last girl actually has a point. The wheeled semi-circle frier is so tight around the girl’s thighs that her chub muffin-tops over the lip. Despite the naked hostility, the street vendor has a wide, jolly smile on her lips. She pulls her glasses down and squints against the neon, looking over the gang."

rows.original: “Oh, it’s nothin’ like thaaaat,” she laughs, waving off their accusations. “This is all honest-to-goodness Paragon treats! Chemically grown, like mom used to make! We just took some Rusher flavors and added them to the menu! You don’t have to get thoooooose sauces. All your favorites are still here!”
rows.translation: “哦，才不是那样啦——”她笑着挥手否认她们的指控。“这些可都是货真价实的典范美食！化学培育，就像妈妈以前做的一样！我们只是把一些冲锋者风味加入了菜单！你们不必选那些酱料。所有老口味都还在！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, it’s nothin’ like thaaaat,” she laughs, waving off their accusations. “This is all honest-to-goodness Paragon treats! Chemically grown, like mom used to make! We just took some Rusher flavors and added them to the menu! You don’t have to get thoooooose sauces. All your favorites are still here!”"

rows.original: The unflappable cheerfulness appears to be stoking the gangers’ anger. “Oh, a good zaibatsu girl, are ya? Happy to toe the line while they push their heels down on our throats a little more each day?”
rows.translation: 她雷打不动的开朗似乎越发激怒了帮派成员。“哦，你还真是财阀的乖女孩，是吧？他们每天都把鞋跟更深地踩在我们喉咙上，你还乐呵呵地循规蹈矩？”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe unflappable cheerfulness appears to be stoking the gangers’ anger. “Oh, a good zaibatsu girl, are ya? Happy to toe the line while they push their heels down on our throats a little more each day?”"

rows.original: The thick food service girl shrugs apologetically. “Ha hah, but...” She seems confused. “But, Paragon makes all our food. This is no different.”
rows.translation: 丰满的餐饮女孩满怀歉意地耸耸肩。“哈、哈哈，可是...”她看起来很困惑。“可是我们的食物本来就全是典范生产的。这并没有什么区别。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe thick food service girl shrugs apologetically. “Ha hah, but...” She seems confused. “But, Paragon makes all our food. This is no different.”"

rows.original: “This fat bitch is really startin’ to piss me off,” one of the troublemakers hisses. It looks like things might get violent if somebody doesn’t step in to do something.
rows.translation: “这个肥婆真他妈越来越让我火大了，”其中一个闹事者低声说道。要是没人出面做点什么，事情恐怕会演变成暴力冲突。
rows.raw: "\n\n“This fat bitch is really startin’ to piss me off,” one of the troublemakers hisses. It looks like things might get violent if somebody doesn’t step in to do something."

rows.original: Help
rows.translation: 帮忙
rows.raw: "Help"

rows.original: Help
rows.translation: 帮忙
rows.raw: "Help"

rows.original: You’re just a helpful [pc.guyGirl].
rows.translation: 你只是个乐于助人的[pc.guyGirl]。
rows.raw: "You’re just a helpful [pc.guyGirl]."

rows.original: Do Nothing
rows.translation: 什么也不做
rows.raw: "Do Nothing"

rows.original: Do Nothing
rows.translation: 什么也不做
rows.raw: "Do Nothing"

rows.original: No need to get involved...
rows.translation: 没必要掺和...
rows.raw: "No need to get involved..."

rows.original: You move forward, raising your voice to draw all eyes away from the working girl.
rows.translation: 你走上前，提高声音，把所有人的注意力从正在工作的女孩身上引开。
rows.raw: "You move forward, raising your voice to draw all eyes away from the working girl. "

rows.original: “Hey now! You leave that lady alone! She’s got really great tiddies and deserves your, like, respect! Besides, that food smells GOOD!”
rows.translation: “喂！别欺负那位女士！她的奶子真的很棒，值得你们那个，尊重！而且这食物闻起来真香！”
rows.raw: "“Hey now! You leave that lady alone! She’s got really great tiddies and deserves your, like, respect! Besides, that food smells GOOD!”"

rows.original: “Hey, she’s just doing her job. Whatever problems you have with her employer aren’t going to get solved by hassling one food cart.”
rows.translation: “嘿，她只是在做自己的工作。你们和她雇主之间有什么矛盾，骚扰一辆餐车也解决不了。”
rows.raw: "“Hey, she’s just doing her job. Whatever problems you have with her employer aren’t going to get solved by hassling one food cart.”"

rows.original: “Haven’t you heard about picking on somebody your own size? I think this girl’s a bit out of your weight class, gals. Let’s you and me dance instead.”
rows.translation: “没听说过要挑和自己体量相当的人吗？姑娘们，我觉得这女孩和你们不在一个重量级。不如换成你们和我来跳一曲。”
rows.raw: "“Haven’t you heard about picking on somebody your own size? I think this girl’s a bit out of your weight class, gals. Let’s you and me dance instead.”"

rows.original: “Twiggy-ass sluts rolling up to a full figured woman with envy dripping from every pore? I think you ladies are just mad because you’re hungry. Luckily, I’m serving up poundings all day.”
rows.translation: “一群细竹竿似的骚货围住一个丰满女人，浑身每个毛孔都在冒嫉妒？我看各位只是饿疯了。幸好我一整天都能免费供应痛打。”
rows.raw: "“Twiggy-ass sluts rolling up to a full figured woman with envy dripping from every pore? I think you ladies are just mad because you’re hungry. Luckily, I’m serving up poundings all day.”"

rows.original: “Oh my!” the curvy cook exclaims, squinting in your direction. “A real Rusher? That’s so cooooooool!” She claps her gloved hands together so vigorously that rippling waves run through her width.
rows.translation: “我的天！”曲线丰腴的厨娘眯眼望向你，惊呼道。“真正的冲锋者？太酷啦——”她戴着手套的双手用力拍在一起，浑身宽厚的肉都泛起阵阵波浪。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh my!” the curvy cook exclaims, squinting in your direction. “A real Rusher? That’s so cooooooool!” She claps her gloved hands together so vigorously that rippling waves run through her width."

rows.original: The gangers are drawing weapons, so you wave the girl away. “Get clear while I take care of these four. I’ll have to take a rain check on the food.”
rows.translation: 帮派成员开始拔出武器，于是你挥手示意女孩离开。“我来收拾这四个，你快躲远点。食物只能改天再尝了。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gangers are drawing weapons, so you wave the girl away. “Get clear while I take care of these four. I’ll have to take a rain check on the food.”"

rows.original: She blushes and gives you the biggest smile you’ve seen from anybody on this planet. <i>“Good luck,
rows.translation: 她红着脸，露出你在这颗星球上见过最灿烂的笑容。<i>“祝你好运，冲锋者
rows.raw: "\n\nShe blushes and gives you the biggest smile you’ve seen from anybody on this planet. <i>“Good luck, "

rows.original: Mr
rows.translation: 先生
rows.raw: "Mr"

rows.original: Mrs
rows.translation: 女士
rows.raw: "Mrs"

rows.original: Rusher!” The food vendor scoots her cart off to sell on some other street while you prepare for a fight.
rows.translation: ！”餐车摊主推着车赶往别的街道做生意，你则准备迎战。
rows.raw: " Rusher!” The food vendor scoots her cart off to sell on some other street while you prepare for a fight."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You’d rather not get involved, so you stand by as the gangers harass the food vendor. They yell, point, mock, and pester the curvy cook, but all the bystanders just watch mutely. Nobody else is doing anything, so it must not be that important. And besides, if one zaika said something, the gang might turn their animosity on them instead. It’s just better to keep out of it.
rows.translation: 你不想掺和，于是站在一旁，看着帮派成员骚扰餐车摊主。她们叫骂、指点、嘲弄，不停纠缠那位丰腴的厨娘，所有旁观者却只是一声不吭地看着。既然别人都没有行动，这事想必没那么重要。更何况，要是有哪个扎伊卡开口，帮派说不定会把敌意转向她。还是置身事外比较好。
rows.raw: "You’d rather not get involved, so you stand by as the gangers harass the food vendor. They yell, point, mock, and pester the curvy cook, but all the bystanders just watch mutely. Nobody else is doing anything, so it must not be that important. And besides, if one zaika said something, the gang might turn their animosity on them instead. It’s just better to keep out of it."

rows.original: The bullying continues, with one ganger snatching the sunglasses from the vendor’s head and pitching them down a side alley. Another grabs a pot of sauce from the cart and upends it onto the street. The others, meanwhile, grab handfuls of uncooked food and throw it at the chubby girl, inviting her to eat her fill.
rows.translation: 欺凌仍在继续，一个帮派成员从摊主头上抢走墨镜，扔进旁边的小巷。另一个从餐车上拿起一锅酱汁，全倒在街上。与此同时，其他人抓起一把把尚未烹饪的食物砸向胖女孩，叫她尽管吃个够。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe bullying continues, with one ganger snatching the sunglasses from the vendor’s head and pitching them down a side alley. Another grabs a pot of sauce from the cart and upends it onto the street. The others, meanwhile, grab handfuls of uncooked food and throw it at the chubby girl, inviting her to eat her fill."

rows.original: By the time they’ve sated their mean streaks, the food cart’s a mess, the plump girl’s covered in splotches of sauce, and most of her stock is on the pavement. She’s still smiling, but it’s a thin, fragile thing. She’s trying to stay positive, cleaning herself off and putting things back the way they were, more or less.
rows.translation: 等她们发泄完恶意，餐车已经一片狼藉，丰满的女孩身上沾满块块酱汁，大部分存货也散落在人行道上。她还在微笑，但那笑容单薄而脆弱。她努力保持乐观，擦净身体，勉强把一切恢复原状。
rows.raw: "\n\nBy the time they’ve sated their mean streaks, the food cart’s a mess, the plump girl’s covered in splotches of sauce, and most of her stock is on the pavement. She’s still smiling, but it’s a thin, fragile thing. She’s trying to stay positive, cleaning herself off and putting things back the way they were, more or less."

rows.original: The inhabitants of Dhaal’s Gyre district seem all too eager to tear one another down. It’s a cruel planet, but then, it’s like that all over, so perhaps this place isn’t so different from the core worlds.
rows.translation: 达尔环城区的居民似乎格外热衷于互相打压。这是颗残酷的星球，但到处都是如此，所以这里或许也没有比核心世界特别多少。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe inhabitants of Dhaal’s Gyre district seem all too eager to tear one another down. It’s a cruel planet, but then, it’s like that all over, so perhaps this place isn’t so different from the core worlds."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: While most of the zaika on the streets keep to themselves, you’ve caught enough of the locals giving Rushers a leering look to recognize trouble. In this case, however, it’s not you that’s drawn their attention. Instead, a pair of wide-eyed, twitching zaika are in the middle of the group, their voices loud enough to carry over the holographic advertisements, yells of street vendors, and even the motoring drone of swoop bikes and taxi shuttles floating overhead.
rows.translation: 街上的大部分扎伊卡都只顾自己，但你已经注意到足够多的本地人色眯眯地盯着冲锋者，足以认出麻烦的征兆。不过这次吸引她们注意的并不是你。人群中央站着两个睁大眼睛、浑身抽动的扎伊卡，她们的声音响得盖过全息广告、街头摊贩的叫卖，甚至盖过头顶掠行摩托和出租穿梭机的引擎嗡鸣。
rows.raw: "\n\nWhile most of the zaika on the streets keep to themselves, you’ve caught enough of the locals giving Rushers a leering look to recognize trouble. In this case, however, it’s not you that’s drawn their attention. Instead, a pair of wide-eyed, twitching zaika are in the middle of the group, their voices loud enough to carry over the holographic advertisements, yells of street vendors, and even the motoring drone of swoop bikes and taxi shuttles floating overhead."

rows.original: “An I SAID I don’t WANT the old stuff!” one complains, her tail practically vibrating.
rows.translation: “我都说了，我不要那些旧货！”其中一个抱怨道，尾巴几乎在震动。
rows.raw: "\n\n“An I SAID I don’t WANT the old stuff!” one complains, her tail practically vibrating."

rows.original: “Whaddya mean? We got the purest shit around! Fuckin’, even Bright Water ain’t got our purity. We’re doin’ you a favor at that price.”
rows.translation: “你什么意思？我们这里的货最纯！他妈的，连澄水区都没我们这么纯。这个价卖给你们是在帮你们。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Whaddya mean? We got the purest shit around! Fuckin’, even Bright Water ain’t got our purity. We’re doin’ you a favor at that price.”"

rows.original: “We don’t want it at any price,” another tweaker insists, a distant, blissed-out look on her face. “We’re on milk now.”
rows.translation: “什么价我们都不要，”另一个瘾君子坚持道，脸上是一副恍惚而陶醉的神情。“我们现在喝奶。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We don’t want it at any price,” another tweaker insists, a distant, blissed-out look on her face. “We’re on milk now.”"

rows.original: The locals passing by the commotion look at the group, some with shock, some with disapproval, and but most with a longing that starts as a dry gulp in their throats and moves into a blush spreading across their faces.
rows.translation: 路过骚动现场的本地人看着这群人，有些震惊，有些不以为然，但大多数人都露出渴望：先是喉咙干涩地吞咽，随后红晕扩散到脸上。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe locals passing by the commotion look at the group, some with shock, some with disapproval, and but most with a longing that starts as a dry gulp in their throats and moves into a blush spreading across their faces."

rows.original: One of the gangers swears under her breath while the others push in closer to box in their former customers. “Nah, I must’ve heard you wrong. Off-world shit? For you two? No way.”
rows.translation: 其中一个帮派成员低声咒骂，其他人则逼近，把过去的顾客围在中间。“不，我肯定听错了。外星货？给你们两个？不可能。”
rows.raw: "\n\nOne of the gangers swears under her breath while the others push in closer to box in their former customers. “Nah, I must’ve heard you wrong. Off-world shit? For you two? No way.”"

rows.original: “It’s fuckin’ goooooooood,” the euphoric druggy sighs, apparently unaware of her growing danger.
rows.translation: “那玩意他妈的好——爽，”神魂颠倒的瘾君子叹道，显然没有意识到危险正在逼近。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s fuckin’ goooooooood,” the euphoric druggy sighs, apparently unaware of her growing danger."

rows.original: “It’s FUCKIN’... ALIEN... TRASH!” one of the dealers sceams.
rows.translation: “那是他妈的...外星...垃圾！”其中一个毒贩尖叫道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s FUCKIN’... ALIEN... TRASH!” one of the dealers sceams."

rows.original: “Probably full of mind-control shit,” another opines.
rows.translation: “里面说不定加满了精神控制药物，”另一个发表意见。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Probably full of mind-control shit,” another opines."

rows.original: “Definitely bad for you,” the third insists.
rows.translation: “肯定对身体有害，”第三个坚持道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Definitely bad for you,” the third insists."

rows.original: “Or, at least, it WILL be bad for you,” the original pusher growls.
rows.translation: “或者至少，马上就会对你们有害，”最先开口的毒贩低吼道。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Or, at least, it WILL be bad for you,” the original pusher growls."

rows.original: Looks like the Planet Rush has really thrown a wrench in the local drug dealer economy. If you walk away, the addicts are going to find themselves in a pretty tight spot.
rows.translation: 看来星球大冲锋确实严重扰乱了本地毒贩的生意。要是你转身离开，那两个瘾君子的处境就会相当不妙。
rows.raw: "\n\nLooks like the Planet Rush has really thrown a wrench in the local drug dealer economy. If you walk away, the addicts are going to find themselves in a pretty tight spot."

rows.original: You’ve been wandering around the Gyre enough to spot a drug deal a block away. Though you don’t recognize the gang, you can clearly see they’re having just as much trouble peddling their wares as all the rest. The locals are all about the Milk Bars and the gangs don’t seem to trust off-worlders enough to try pushing into the new demographic.
rows.translation: 你在环城区逛得够久了，隔着一个街区也能认出毒品交易。虽然你不认识这个帮派，但显然看得出，她们和其他帮派一样很难卖掉手里的货。本地人如今全都迷上了牛奶吧，而帮派似乎不够信任外星人，不敢打入这个新兴客群。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou’ve been wandering around the Gyre enough to spot a drug deal a block away. Though you don’t recognize the gang, you can clearly see they’re having just as much trouble peddling their wares as all the rest. The locals are all about the Milk Bars and the gangs don’t seem to trust off-worlders enough to try pushing into the new demographic."

rows.original: The current gang has a pair of natives surrounded and are trying to get them back on the old stuff. Luckily, you know exactly how to handle this kind of situation.
rows.translation: 眼前的帮派围住了两个本地人，正试图让她们重新吸食旧货。幸好你恰好知道该怎么处理这种局面。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe current gang has a pair of natives surrounded and are trying to get them back on the old stuff. Luckily, you know exactly how to handle this kind of situation."

rows.original: ZAIKA_GANGER_NEW_DRUG_EVENTS
rows.raw: "ZAIKA_GANGER_NEW_DRUG_EVENTS"

rows.original: Offer Milk
rows.translation: 提供乳汁
rows.raw: "Offer Milk"

rows.original: Offer Milk
rows.translation: 提供乳汁
rows.raw: "Offer Milk"

rows.original: Why not calm everyone down with a little milk? Free of charge, of course!
rows.translation: 何不用一点牛奶让所有人冷静下来？当然，完全免费！
rows.raw: "Why not calm everyone down with a little milk? Free of charge, of course!"

rows.original: Offer Milk
rows.translation: 提供乳汁
rows.raw: "Offer Milk"

rows.original: Offer Milk
rows.translation: 提供乳汁
rows.raw: "Offer Milk"

rows.original: You don’t have the requisite juices on tap right now.
rows.translation: 你现在没有现成的必要汁液。
rows.raw: "You don’t have the requisite juices on tap right now."

rows.original: You need bigger udders for this anyway.
rows.translation: 而且你得有更大的乳房才能这么做。
rows.raw: " You need bigger udders for this anyway."

rows.original: Fight
rows.translation: 战斗
rows.raw: "Fight"

rows.original: Buy Drugs
rows.translation: 购买毒品
rows.raw: "Buy Drugs"

rows.original: Buy Drugs
rows.translation: 购买毒品
rows.raw: "Buy Drugs"

rows.original: MegaCorps have put most drug dealers out of business back home, so this might be your only chance to get a taste of some authentic alien narcotics.
rows.translation: 在你的家乡，巨型企业已经让大多数毒贩失业了，所以这可能是你品尝正宗外星毒品的唯一机会。
rows.raw: "MegaCorps have put most drug dealers out of business back home, so this might be your only chance to get a taste of some authentic alien narcotics."

rows.original: Leave
rows.translation: 离开
rows.raw: "Leave"

rows.original: You stride up to the bickering zaika, sticking out your [pc.breasts] with the self-satisfied pride of a New Texan heifer. “Excuse me, but I might be able to help.”
rows.translation: 你大步走向争吵的扎伊卡，像新德州母牛一样得意地挺起[pc.breasts]。“打扰一下，我或许能帮忙。”
rows.raw: "You stride up to the bickering zaika, sticking out your [pc.breasts] with the self-satisfied pride of a New Texan heifer. “Excuse me, but I might be able to help.”"

rows.original: All six sets of glowing eyes turn to you.
rows.translation: 六双发光的眼睛全都转向你。
rows.raw: "\n\nAll six sets of glowing eyes turn to you."

rows.original: “You see, I happen to be-”
rows.translation: “你们看，我正好是——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“You see, I happen to be-”"

rows.original: “Oh shit,” one of the drug dealers interrupts, pointing at your chest. “It’s one of those alien cows! Probably full of milk!” The two junkies lick their lips and begin to approach
rows.translation: “我靠，”一个毒贩打断你，指着你的胸口。“是那种外星奶牛！里面肯定全是奶！”两个瘾君子舔着嘴唇，开始靠近
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh shit,” one of the drug dealers interrupts, pointing at your chest. “It’s one of those alien cows! Probably full of milk!” The two junkies lick their lips and begin to approach"

rows.original: “Not exactly,” you correct. “That is, I’m not from New Texas. But I do have milk if you’d like to-”
rows.translation: “不完全是，”你纠正道。“我是说，我不是来自新德州。不过我确实有奶，你们要是想——”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not exactly,” you correct. “That is, I’m not from New Texas. But I do have milk if you’d like to-”"

rows.original: “Hey, alien bitch,” one of the drug dealers interrupts. “We’re havin’ a business deal right now. Piss off.”
rows.translation: “喂，外星婊子，”一个毒贩打断你。“我们正在谈生意。滚开。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hey, alien bitch,” one of the drug dealers interrupts. “We’re havin’ a business deal right now. Piss off.”"

rows.original: Annoyed, you heft your [pc.breasts] and get closer. “I’m trying to be nice here and-”
rows.translation: 你恼火地托起[pc.breasts]，走得更近。“我只是想好心帮忙，而且——”
rows.raw: "\n\nAnnoyed, you heft your [pc.breasts] and get closer. “I’m trying to be nice here and-”"

rows.original: The two milk junkie girls go in for a taste, infuriating the pushers even further.
rows.translation: 两个牛奶瘾君子凑上来想尝一口，进一步激怒了毒贩。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe two milk junkie girls go in for a taste, infuriating the pushers even further."

rows.original: “Oh, that’s it! Not enough that you Rushers are in with the zaibatsu, but you gotta sling your new drugs on MY street corner? Hell nah!”
rows.translation: “哦，够了！你们冲锋者和财阀勾结还不够，还要在我的街角兜售新毒品？想都别想！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh, that’s it! Not enough that you Rushers are in with the zaibatsu, but you gotta sling your new drugs on MY street corner? Hell nah!”"

rows.original: Weapons come out and the addicts disperse, their throats sadly unquenched. Looks like you’ve invited yourself into a micro drug war.
rows.translation: 武器纷纷亮出，瘾君子们四散逃开，喉咙可惜仍未得到满足。看来你主动卷入了一场小型毒品战争。
rows.raw: "\n\nWeapons come out and the addicts disperse, their throats sadly unquenched. Looks like you’ve invited yourself into a micro drug war."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: “I’ll take some.”
rows.translation: “给我来一点。”
rows.raw: "“I’ll take some.”"

rows.original: All six zaika turn toward you, each more confused than the last. “You fuckin’ with us, off-worlder?”
rows.translation: 六个扎伊卡全都转向你，一个比一个困惑。“你他妈在耍我们吗，外星人？”
rows.raw: "\n\nAll six zaika turn toward you, each more confused than the last. “You fuckin’ with us, off-worlder?”"

rows.original: “We’re not in the mood for jokes.”
rows.translation: “我们没心情听笑话。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’re not in the mood for jokes.”"

rows.original: You assure them that you’re not joking. You came to Dhaal for something else, but while you’re here, you’re going to at least try some of the local delicacies. And what’s better than testing out the finest the city has to offer?
rows.translation: 你向她们保证自己不是在开玩笑。你来达尔另有目的，但既然到了这里，至少也要尝尝本地特产。还有什么比试试城里最上等的货更合适？
rows.raw: "\n\nYou assure them that you’re not joking. You came to Dhaal for something else, but while you’re here, you’re going to at least try some of the local delicacies. And what’s better than testing out the finest the city has to offer?"

rows.original: The tweakers look at each other. “But... why? Your kind can just, like, GET milk.”
rows.translation: 两个瘾君子互相看了一眼。“可是...为什么？你们这种人不是随便就能得到牛奶吗。”
rows.raw: "\n\nThe tweakers look at each other. “But... why? Your kind can just, like, GET milk.”"

rows.original: “Not all of them,” the other hazards. “Only, like, some of them? And only at certain times? I think they gotta have horns or something.”
rows.translation: “也不是所有人都行，”另一个大胆猜测。“好像只有一部分人？而且只能在某些时候？我想她们还得长角什么的。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Not all of them,” the other hazards. “Only, like, some of them? And only at certain times? I think they gotta have horns or something.”"

rows.original: The gangers push the arguing junies aside and turn to you, their arms full of unmarked packages. “Oh, we got the finest around,” the leader assures you. “You’re gonna be seeing all those stars of yours in no time. 50 credits per hit. Try ‘em all now, ‘cause they’re goin’ fast,” she lies.
rows.translation: 帮派成员推开争论不休的瘾君子，转向你，怀里抱满没有标记的包装。“哦，我们这儿有最好的货，”首领向你保证。“用不了多久，你就能看见属于你的满天星星。一针五十信用点。现在全都试一遍吧，因为很快就要卖光了，”她撒谎道。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe gangers push the arguing junies aside and turn to you, their arms full of unmarked packages. “Oh, we got the finest around,” the leader assures you. “You’re gonna be seeing all those stars of yours in no time. 50 credits per hit. Try ‘em all now, ‘cause they’re goin’ fast,” she lies."

rows.original: Something about that promise leaves you suspicious, but it might be worth a try.
rows.translation: 这番保证让你有些怀疑，但或许值得一试。
rows.raw: "\n\nSomething about that promise leaves you suspicious, but it might be worth a try."

rows.original: Ruby
rows.raw: "Ruby"

rows.original: The pusher produces a small syringe filled with a curiously thick, crimson liquid. “That’s what I like to hear! Got a hot date? Or just going clubbing and you wanna be ready for anything? Either way, you’re about to get a whole lot hotter. Turn around and let’s see that ass.”
rows.translation: 毒贩拿出一支小注射器，里面装着格外黏稠的深红液体。“这才对嘛！有火辣约会？还是只想去夜店玩，顺便为一切情况做好准备？无论是哪种，你马上都会变得火热得多。转过去，让我看看你的屁股。”
rows.raw: "The pusher produces a small syringe filled with a curiously thick, crimson liquid. “That’s what I like to hear! Got a hot date? Or just going clubbing and you wanna be ready for anything? Either way, you’re about to get a whole lot hotter. Turn around and let’s see that ass.”"

rows.original: You shrug. Yeah, that sounds about right. You comply, shifting your [pc.gear] to better present your [pc.ass] to the street pharmacist.
rows.translation: 你耸耸肩。是啊，听起来差不多。你照做，挪动[pc.gear]，让街头药剂师更方便地看到[pc.ass]。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou shrug. Yeah, that sounds about right. You comply, shifting your [pc.gear] to better present your [pc.ass] to the street pharmacist."

rows.original: The violet girl slams the needle home, sending a sharp, pinching sensation through your backside. You shoot her a dirty look, rubbing your cheek to help soothe the sting. As you do, however, your fingertips begin tingling. Your rump feels... warm. REALLY warm! You crane your head back but don’t notice any physical changes.
rows.translation: 紫罗兰色的女孩猛地扎下针头，尖锐的刺痛传遍你的臀部。你恶狠狠地瞪她一眼，揉着臀瓣缓解刺痛。然而就在这时，你的指尖开始发麻。臀部感觉...很热。真的很热！你扭头看去，却没有发现任何身体变化。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe violet girl slams the needle home, sending a sharp, pinching sensation through your backside. You shoot her a dirty look, rubbing your cheek to help soothe the sting. As you do, however, your fingertips begin tingling. Your rump feels... warm. REALLY warm! You crane your head back but don’t notice any physical changes."

rows.original: But there’s no denying you’ve got SOMETHING shooting through your veins. Your heart races, your [pc.groin] throbs, and you can’t stop salivating. Even just the bodyheat of the nearby zaika sends a tremor of arousal shooting through your hips. Your dealer gives you a grin and nods her head, knowingly.
rows.translation: 但毫无疑问，有某种东西正在你的血管里奔涌。心跳加速，[pc.groin]悸动不止，你也控制不住地流口水。就连附近扎伊卡的体温也让一阵情欲震颤窜过你的臀部。毒贩朝你咧嘴一笑，心领神会地点点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut there’s no denying you’ve got SOMETHING shooting through your veins. Your heart races, your [pc.groin] throbs, and you can’t stop salivating. Even just the bodyheat of the nearby zaika sends a tremor of arousal shooting through your hips. Your dealer gives you a grin and nods her head, knowingly."

rows.original: “Hell of a rush, huh? Those milk bars put this in their Xanose, but nothing beats the real deal.” With your heart pounding in your chest a million miles per hour, you’d have to agree! It feels like you’ll be fuck-ready for hours.
rows.translation: “劲头很猛，对吧？那些牛奶吧会把这玩意加进萨诺斯，但什么也比不上纯货。”你的心脏在胸腔里以百万英里的时速狂跳，不得不同意！感觉接下来几个小时你都会随时想做爱。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hell of a rush, huh? Those milk bars put this in their Xanose, but nothing beats the real deal.” With your heart pounding in your chest a million miles per hour, you’d have to agree! It feels like you’ll be fuck-ready for hours."

rows.original: Ruby
rows.raw: "Ruby"

rows.original: Nothing revs your engine like a hit of Ruby!
rows.translation: 没有什么比一针红宝石更能发动你的引擎！
rows.raw: "Nothing revs your engine like a hit of Ruby!"

rows.original: Vibe
rows.raw: "Vibe"

rows.original: The local medicine woman offers you a jelly capsule containing a golden payload. “These babies make the whole world move in slow mo. You’re gonna dig it,” she promises, her luminous eyes twinkling.
rows.translation: 本地女药师递给你一颗装着金色药物的胶囊。“这些宝贝能让整个世界像慢动作一样。你会喜欢的，”她保证道，发光的眼睛闪闪发亮。
rows.raw: "The local medicine woman offers you a jelly capsule containing a golden payload. “These babies make the whole world move in slow mo. You’re gonna dig it,” she promises, her luminous eyes twinkling."

rows.original: Sounds like a fun time! Down the hatch! You pop the capsule past your [pc.lips] and gulp. You blink. You shift in place. You fold your arms and tap your fingers on your [pc.skinFurScales]. There are no immediate effects, leading you to wonder if you’ve just been given a sugar pill or something.
rows.translation: 听起来很有趣！吞下去！你把胶囊弹过[pc.lips]，咽了下去。你眨眨眼，换了换站姿，抱起双臂，用手指轻敲[pc.skinFurScales]。没有任何即时效果，让你怀疑自己是不是只吃到了一颗糖丸之类的东西。
rows.raw: "\n\nSounds like a fun time! Down the hatch! You pop the capsule past your [pc.lips] and gulp. You blink. You shift in place. You fold your arms and tap your fingers on your [pc.skinFurScales]. There are no immediate effects, leading you to wonder if you’ve just been given a sugar pill or something."

rows.original: “Are... you... feeling... it...?” the zaika asks in a dull tone, moving her lips at a snail’s pace. You turn to look at the street and sure enough: where everybody had been rushing before, now they seem to be leisurely strolling along.
rows.translation: “你感...觉...到...了...吗？”扎伊卡语调迟钝地问，嘴唇以蜗牛般的速度移动。你转头看向街道，果然：刚才还行色匆匆的每个人，现在看起来都在悠闲漫步。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Are... you... feeling... it...?” the zaika asks in a dull tone, moving her lips at a snail’s pace. You turn to look at the street and sure enough: where everybody had been rushing before, now they seem to be leisurely strolling along."

rows.original: “Milk... fuckers... watered... it... down... to... make... Vipris...” the drug dealer explains at an excruciating pace. You don’t care about that. You’ve got stuff to do!
rows.translation: “那些...喝奶的...混蛋...把...它...稀释...制成...维普里斯...”毒贩以令人痛苦的缓慢速度解释。你才不在乎。你还有事要做！
rows.raw: "\n\n“Milk... fuckers... watered... it... down... to... make... Vipris...” the drug dealer explains at an excruciating pace. You don’t care about that. You’ve got stuff to do!"

rows.original: Vibe
rows.raw: "Vibe"

rows.original: “If you’re not popping a couple Vibes before you get on a Swoop bike, are you even racing?”
rows.translation: “骑掠行摩托前要是不先来几颗跃动，那还算是在赛车吗？”
rows.raw: "“If you’re not popping a couple Vibes before you get on a Swoop bike, are you even racing?”"

rows.original: Muze
rows.raw: "Muze"

rows.original: Your back alley broker produces a small, plastic-coated square around the size of your thumbnail. There’s a tiny, circular sticker on the paper that looks like a pearl. “You just peel the sticker off and place it on your tongue,” the zaika explains.
rows.translation: 你的后巷掮客拿出一张拇指甲大小、表面覆塑的小方纸。纸上有一枚看起来像珍珠的圆形小贴片。“把贴片撕下来，放到舌头上就行，”扎伊卡解释道。
rows.raw: "Your back alley broker produces a small, plastic-coated square around the size of your thumbnail. There’s a tiny, circular sticker on the paper that looks like a pearl. “You just peel the sticker off and place it on your tongue,” the zaika explains."

rows.original: “It’s like taking the limits off on your senses,” another zaika adds with a far away, dreamy expression.
rows.translation: “就像解除了感官的限制，”另一个扎伊卡补充道，神情恍惚而陶醉。
rows.raw: "\n\n“It’s like taking the limits off on your senses,” another zaika adds with a far away, dreamy expression."

rows.original: Unspooling your [pc.tongue], you peel the sticker from the paper and place the pearl firmly onto the tip of your tongue. Right as it touches your taste buds, the neon glow from the streets gets brighter. So bright you find yourself wishing you had a pair of the natives’ conspicuous tinted glasses. You squint and find that the sounds of the city have grown sharper - you can make out conversations that would normally be lost to the din.
rows.translation: 你伸出[pc.tongue]，从纸上揭下贴片，把珍珠牢牢贴在舌尖。它刚一碰到味蕾，街上的霓虹光芒就变得更加明亮。亮得让你希望自己也有一副本地人那种显眼的染色眼镜。你眯起眼睛，发现城市的声音也变得更加清晰——平时会被喧嚣淹没的谈话，如今都能分辨出来。
rows.raw: "\n\nUnspooling your [pc.tongue], you peel the sticker from the paper and place the pearl firmly onto the tip of your tongue. Right as it touches your taste buds, the neon glow from the streets gets brighter. So bright you find yourself wishing you had a pair of the natives’ conspicuous tinted glasses. You squint and find that the sounds of the city have grown sharper - you can make out conversations that would normally be lost to the din."

rows.original: But that’s not all. Your sense of smell is so amped up, you can almost taste the city with a single sniff. The salty perspiration of the local women puffing as they try to keep their busts from growing to unmanageable levels. The sweet tang of tail bulbs squeezing back the continual flow of lust when girls speak in furtive whispers to one another. Even the cloying, perfumed hair dyes some zaika wear to turn the blank canvas of their pale tresses into vibrant shocks of color.
rows.translation: 还不止如此。你的嗅觉被强化到极致，几乎只要吸一口气就能尝到整座城市。本地女人努力防止乳房膨胀到无法控制时喘息流出的咸涩汗水；女孩们彼此窃窃私语时，尾球挤压并阻挡持续涌出的情欲，那股甜酸气味；甚至有些扎伊卡为了把苍白发丝这张空白画布染成鲜艳色块而使用的甜腻香氛染发剂。
rows.raw: "\n\nBut that’s not all. Your sense of smell is so amped up, you can almost taste the city with a single sniff. The salty perspiration of the local women puffing as they try to keep their busts from growing to unmanageable levels. The sweet tang of tail bulbs squeezing back the continual flow of lust when girls speak in furtive whispers to one another. Even the cloying, perfumed hair dyes some zaika wear to turn the blank canvas of their pale tresses into vibrant shocks of color."

rows.original: “Hell of a rush, ain’t it? They put this stuff in the Sinthine milk, but it ain’t the same,” the dreamy zaika points out.
rows.translation: “真他妈刺激，对吧？他们把这东西加进辛西恩乳饮里，但效果可不一样，”恍惚的扎伊卡指出。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hell of a rush, ain’t it? They put this stuff in the Sinthine milk, but it ain’t the same,” the dreamy zaika points out."

rows.original: Muze
rows.raw: "Muze"

rows.original: “Feeling lost in all the noise of life? One lick and everything gets so much clearer.”
rows.translation: “迷失在生活的嘈杂里？舔一口，一切都会清晰许多。”
rows.raw: "“Feeling lost in all the noise of life? One lick and everything gets so much clearer.”"

rows.original: Soot
rows.raw: "Soot"

rows.original: Crowding in close, your curbside chemist produces a small silk bag and motions for you lean forward. “Take a big sniff, but be careful not to huff it with your mouth. Soot in the nose is the best battle stim you’re gonna get around here. Soot in the mouth will lay ya out like a brick to the back of your head.”
rows.translation: 路边药贩紧贴过来，拿出一个小丝袋，示意你向前倾。“用力吸一大口，不过小心别用嘴把它吸进去。烟灰进鼻子，是这附近能弄到的最好战斗兴奋剂；烟灰进嘴里，会把你放倒得像后脑挨了一砖。”
rows.raw: "Crowding in close, your curbside chemist produces a small silk bag and motions for you lean forward. “Take a big sniff, but be careful not to huff it with your mouth. Soot in the nose is the best battle stim you’re gonna get around here. Soot in the mouth will lay ya out like a brick to the back of your head.”"

rows.original: Glad for the warning, you keep your mouth shut as you lean in and take a long snort of the black, dusty chemical filling the satchel. Your lungs lurch at the concoction, but you hold back a sneeze and pinch your [pc.nose] until the electric tingling cascading through your body calms down.
rows.translation: 幸好得到提醒，你闭紧嘴巴俯身，长长吸入袋中黑色粉尘状化学品。肺部因混合物猛然抽搐，但你忍住喷嚏，捏住[pc.nose]，直到流遍全身的电流般刺麻平静下来。
rows.raw: "\n\nGlad for the warning, you keep your mouth shut as you lean in and take a long snort of the black, dusty chemical filling the satchel. Your lungs lurch at the concoction, but you hold back a sneeze and pinch your [pc.nose] until the electric tingling cascading through your body calms down."

rows.original: You wince, your muscles aching as if you’d just finished a couple hours of intensive training. But rather than exhaustion, the ache brings a taut strength practically begging to be used. Your sinews feel swollen with untapped potential, like there’s nothing you can’t do. You’re not sure if you want to fight off an army like an angry Thraggen or fuck everyone in the streets... also like an angry Thraggen, now that you think about it.
rows.translation: 你皱紧脸，肌肉酸痛得像刚完成数小时高强度训练。然而，这股酸痛带来的不是疲惫，而是紧绷力量，几乎在乞求你使用。筋腱仿佛因尚未释放的潜能而膨胀，让你觉得无所不能。你不确定自己是想像愤怒的斯拉根一样击退一支军队，还是想把街上所有人都操一遍...仔细想想，那也像愤怒的斯拉根会做的事。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou wince, your muscles aching as if you’d just finished a couple hours of intensive training. But rather than exhaustion, the ache brings a taut strength practically begging to be used. Your sinews feel swollen with untapped potential, like there’s nothing you can’t do. You’re not sure if you want to fight off an army like an angry Thraggen or fuck everyone in the streets... also like an angry Thraggen, now that you think about it."

rows.original: Your dealer takes a step back, to give you enough space to twitch through your high. “Can you believe they put this in Cromesc like it was some new thing? Shit, we’ve been usin’ Soot for ages. Sneaky zaibatsu fucks.”
rows.translation: 药贩退后一步，给你足够空间在药劲中抽动。“能相信他们把这东西加进克罗梅斯克，还说成什么新玩意吗？妈的，我们用烟灰都多少年了。那些狡猾的财阀混蛋。”
rows.raw: "\n\nYour dealer takes a step back, to give you enough space to twitch through your high. “Can you believe they put this in Cromesc like it was some new thing? Shit, we’ve been usin’ Soot for ages. Sneaky zaibatsu fucks.”"

rows.translation: “街上很危险。来点烟灰，你就什么都能应付。”
rows.raw: "“The streets are dangerous. Take some Soot and you’ll be ready for anything.”"

rows.translation: “搞什么鬼，混蛋。你明明说过要来。”
rows.raw: "“What the fuck, asshole. You said you were down.”"

rows.original: “Wasting our fuckin’ time.”
rows.translation: “浪费我们他妈的时间。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Wasting our fuckin’ time.”"

rows.original: “And the junkies wandered off without buyin’ anything, too!”
rows.translation: “那些瘾君子也没买东西就走了！”
rows.raw: "\n\n“And the junkies wandered off without buyin’ anything, too!”"

rows.original: “We’ll just have to get the cash from your pockets after we roll your off-world ass.”
rows.translation: “只能等把你这个外星混蛋放倒后，从口袋里拿钱了。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“We’ll just have to get the cash from your pockets after we roll your off-world ass.”"

rows.original: It’s a fight!
rows.translation: 战斗开始！
rows.raw: "\n\nIt’s a fight!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: You try to step away, but the whole world is alive with motion. Everything around you is radiating such intense, unfathomable bliss that if feels like your personal gravity has turned itself up to eleven. The drug dealers around you smirk and swish their tails as they watch you stumble and stagger.
rows.translation: 你试图走开，可整个世界都充满了运动。周围一切都散发着强烈而难以理解的极乐，感觉仿佛你的个人重力被直接调到了十一档。身边药贩看着你踉跄摇晃，坏笑着甩动尾巴。
rows.raw: "You try to step away, but the whole world is alive with motion. Everything around you is radiating such intense, unfathomable bliss that if feels like your personal gravity has turned itself up to eleven. The drug dealers around you smirk and swish their tails as they watch you stumble and stagger."

rows.original: “Hell yeah, now it’s a party.” The girls move in, their nimble fingers going for your pockets, no doubt to protect you from all those credits weighing you down.
rows.translation: “太他妈对了，现在才像场派对。”女孩们逼近，灵巧手指伸向你的口袋，无疑是想保护你，不让那些信用点继续压得你那么沉。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Hell yeah, now it’s a party.” The girls move in, their nimble fingers going for your pockets, no doubt to protect you from all those credits weighing you down."

rows.translation: 对外星人来说还挺可爱的。行，就这么办。”话音刚落，她们便一拥而上。
rows.raw: "’s pretty cute, for an alien. Alright. Let’s do this.” And then, they’re upon you."

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: The black market doxies wave you goodbye with the full knowledge you’ll be back to see them before too long. After all, with drugs like this at your disposal, there’d be no stopping you!
rows.translation: 黑市娼妓们挥手向你道别，心知你过不了多久就会回来找她们。毕竟，有这种药物任你使用，还有什么能拦得住你！
rows.raw: "The black market doxies wave you goodbye with the full knowledge you’ll be back to see them before too long. After all, with drugs like this at your disposal, there’d be no stopping you!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: A distant voice cuts through the city’s din, sharp and tight. “We don’t like your kind around here.”
rows.translation: 远处一道尖锐而紧绷的声音刺破城市喧嚣。“我们不欢迎你们这种人。”
rows.raw: "\n\nA distant voice cuts through the city’s din, sharp and tight. “We don’t like your kind around here.”"

rows.original: You scan through the slowly parting crowd to find four, fuming locals surrounding a pair of zaika. One of the duo is a woman of uncommon elegance and beauty. At over seven feet tall, she towers over the 5' gangers. Thin and fey, the statuesque woman’s dark lilac skin is unblemished by the white freckles common to the denizens of the Gyre, and her long, pale white tresses are untouched by ink or dye. She’s clad in imported silks that fully cover her chest, unlike the majority of the zaika around you, whose brazen toplessness is so particular to Dhaal. There’s no doubt that this is a Peer - one of the elite whose connections to the Zaibatsu has elevated her above the common masses.
rows.translation: 你扫视缓缓分开的人群，发现四名怒气冲冲的本地人正围住两名扎伊卡。其中一人是位优雅美丽得不同寻常的女人。她身高超过七英尺，在那些五英尺高的帮派分子面前宛如高塔。这个高挑女人身形纤细、气质如精灵般超凡；深丁香色肌肤上没有旋环区居民常见的白色雀斑，浅白色长发也未经墨水或染料沾染。她穿着进口丝绸，胸部遮得严严实实，与周围大多数扎伊卡截然不同；达尔特有的坦胸露乳风气在她身上毫无踪影。毫无疑问，她是一位同侪，是凭借与财阀的关系凌驾于普通大众之上的精英。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou scan through the slowly parting crowd to find four, fuming locals surrounding a pair of zaika. One of the duo is a woman of uncommon elegance and beauty. At over seven feet tall, she towers over the 5' gangers. Thin and fey, the statuesque woman’s dark lilac skin is unblemished by the white freckles common to the denizens of the Gyre, and her long, pale white tresses are untouched by ink or dye. She’s clad in imported silks that fully cover her chest, unlike the majority of the zaika around you, whose brazen toplessness is so particular to Dhaal. There’s no doubt that this is a Peer - one of the elite whose connections to the Zaibatsu has elevated her above the common masses."

rows.original: At her side, a girl perches on the balls of her two-toed feet, lean and alert. The leotard-styled body armor, face-masking helmet, and cybernetic weaponry strapped to her arms suggests this one’s a bodyguard. She’s so kitted up that all you can make out of her body are her thick, toned thighs and her even thicker, o-ring of a pucker. Though her eyes are hidden by the rounded silver mask, the tall, glowing ears at its side shift and angle themselves at every slight movement the gang makes.
rows.translation: 她身旁有个女孩踮着两趾脚掌，身体前倾，瘦削而警觉。紧身衣式护甲、遮住脸庞的头盔，以及绑在双臂上的机械武器，都表明她是一名保镖。她全身装备严密，你只能看见粗壮结实的大腿，以及更加粗厚、圆环般噘起的肛门。尽管圆润的银色面罩遮住了眼睛，面罩两侧高耸发光的耳朵仍会随着帮派的每一个细微动作而转动、调整角度。
rows.raw: "\n\nAt her side, a girl perches on the balls of her two-toed feet, lean and alert. The leotard-styled body armor, face-masking helmet, and cybernetic weaponry strapped to her arms suggests this one’s a bodyguard. She’s so kitted up that all you can make out of her body are her thick, toned thighs and her even thicker, o-ring of a pucker. Though her eyes are hidden by the rounded silver mask, the tall, glowing ears at its side shift and angle themselves at every slight movement the gang makes."

rows.original: “Can’t hear us up there?” another of the ragged locals taunts, circling. “You might own the planet, but this street? This is
rows.translation: “站那么高就听不见我们说话了？”另一个衣衫褴褛的本地人绕着她们嘲弄道。“你们也许拥有这颗星球，但这条街？这是
rows.raw: "\n\n“Can’t hear us up there?” another of the ragged locals taunts, circling. “You might own the planet, but this street? This is "

rows.original: turf. This is OURS.” A low rumble of agreement comes from the crowd who are keeping back from the gang all the same.
rows.translation: 的地盘。这是我们的地盘。”仍与帮派保持距离的人群中传来一阵低沉的赞同声。
rows.raw: " turf. This is OURS.” A low rumble of agreement comes from the crowd who are keeping back from the gang all the same."

rows.original: “Oh dear me,” the peer sighs, running her fingers across the shorter bodyguard’s helmet like an affectionate pet owner. “Surely even gutter trash must know that the street is ON the planet?”
rows.translation: “哎呀呀，”同侪叹息道，手指像宠爱动物的主人般抚过较矮保镖的头盔。“就连阴沟里的垃圾，也该知道这条街就在这颗星球上吧？”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Oh dear me,” the peer sighs, running her fingers across the shorter bodyguard’s helmet like an affectionate pet owner. “Surely even gutter trash must know that the street is ON the planet?”"

rows.original: The shortest of the four growls and reaches for her sidearm. The cybernetic soldier reacts immediately. Swinging to confront her, the faceless girl’s leg shoots up like a spring-loaded wrecking ball while her huge, mechanized fist clenches with hydraulic tension. Even her tail, bound in some bladed sheath, weaves like a viper ready to strike.
rows.translation: 四人中个子最矮的那个低吼一声，伸手去摸腰间武器。机械士兵立即作出反应。无脸女孩转身迎敌，腿如装有弹簧的破城锤般猛然抬起，巨大的机械拳也在液压张力下紧握。甚至连套在某种刃鞘里的尾巴，也像蓄势待发的毒蛇般游摆。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe shortest of the four growls and reaches for her sidearm. The cybernetic soldier reacts immediately. Swinging to confront her, the faceless girl’s leg shoots up like a spring-loaded wrecking ball while her huge, mechanized fist clenches with hydraulic tension. Even her tail, bound in some bladed sheath, weaves like a viper ready to strike."

rows.original: The Peer seems unimpressed. She makes a slight gesture and the guard slowly relaxes from her combat-ready stance. She raises her voice and looks out over the neon-lit audience with a bemused smirk. “Isn’t there a brave, heroic individual who will stand up to these thugs?” The crowd hushes, their eyes turned down to avoid meeting the woman’s gaze.
rows.translation: 同侪似乎毫不在意。她轻轻做了个手势，护卫便慢慢从备战姿态放松下来。她提高声音，带着饶有兴味的微笑望向霓虹灯照亮的观众。“难道就没有一位勇敢无畏的英雄，愿意挺身对付这些暴徒吗？”人群安静下来，纷纷垂下视线，避免与她对视。
rows.raw: "\n\nThe Peer seems unimpressed. She makes a slight gesture and the guard slowly relaxes from her combat-ready stance. She raises her voice and looks out over the neon-lit audience with a bemused smirk. “Isn’t there a brave, heroic individual who will stand up to these thugs?” The crowd hushes, their eyes turned down to avoid meeting the woman’s gaze."

rows.original: Help
rows.translation: 帮忙
rows.raw: "Help"

rows.original: Help
rows.translation: 帮忙
rows.raw: "Help"

rows.original: Just because she’s rich doesn’t mean this woman should be hassled by gangs.
rows.translation: 她有钱并不意味着就该受帮派骚扰。
rows.raw: "Just because she’s rich doesn’t mean this woman should be hassled by gangs."

rows.original: Watch
rows.translation: 观看
rows.raw: "Watch"

rows.original: Watch
rows.translation: 观看
rows.raw: "Watch"

rows.original: You’d rather not get involved. Just let the scene play itself out.
rows.translation: 你不想卷进去。让事态自行发展吧。
rows.raw: "You’d rather not get involved. Just let the scene play itself out."

rows.original: PEER_GREEN
rows.raw: "PEER_GREEN"

rows.original: XO
rows.raw: "XO"

rows.original: XO
rows.raw: "XO"

rows.original: XO
rows.raw: "XO"

rows.original: You catch the lofty zaika’s eye and push your way through the natives.
rows.translation: 你与那名高挑扎伊卡目光相接，挤过本地人群。
rows.raw: "You catch the lofty zaika’s eye and push your way through the natives. "

rows.original: “Don’t worry, miss! These gang bangers won’t hurt you while I’m around. I’ve NEVER backed down from a gangbang,” you proudly announce. “And I’m not gonna start today!”
rows.translation: “别担心，女士！有我在，这些帮派混混伤不了你。我从来不会在群交面前退缩，”你骄傲地宣布，“今天也不会例外！”
rows.raw: "“Don’t worry, miss! These gang bangers won’t hurt you while I’m around. I’ve NEVER backed down from a gangbang,” you proudly announce. “And I’m not gonna start today!”"

rows.original: “Now, now,” you try to soothe the gangers. “Everybody just chill out. I’m sure this woman is on her way somewhere and she’ll be off
rows.translation: “好了，好了，”你试着安抚这些帮派分子。“大家都冷静点。我相信这位女士只是要去某个地方，只要你们别再挡路，她很快就会离开
rows.raw: "“Now, now,” you try to soothe the gangers. “Everybody just chill out. I’m sure this woman is on her way somewhere and she’ll be off "

rows.original: turf just as soon as you stop blocking her way. It doesn’t have to come to violence.”
rows.translation: 的地盘。没必要闹到动手的地步。”
rows.raw: " turf just as soon as you stop blocking her way. It doesn’t have to come to violence.”"

rows.original: “Hey, tall lady!” You wave your arms and jump in place. “There a reward for coming to your rescue? I don’t suppose you’re, like, a princess or something? I’d take half the planet if money’s tight.”
rows.translation: “嘿，高个子女士！”你挥舞双臂，原地跳了起来。“救你有报酬吗？你该不会是什么公主之类的人吧？要是手头紧，我拿半颗星球也行。”
rows.raw: "“Hey, tall lady!” You wave your arms and jump in place. “There a reward for coming to your rescue? I don’t suppose you’re, like, a princess or something? I’d take half the planet if money’s tight.”"

rows.original: You size up the quartet of troublemakers and jerk your chin at the Peer. “Don’t want to risk dinging up the help? Or just don’t want to pay for her fuel? Either way, I’m not doing this for free.”
rows.translation: 你打量着四个惹事者，朝那位同侪扬了扬下巴。“是不想冒险刮伤这位佣人，还是不想付她的燃料钱？不管怎样，我可不会白干。”
rows.raw: "You size up the quartet of troublemakers and jerk your chin at the Peer. “Don’t want to risk dinging up the help? Or just don’t want to pay for her fuel? Either way, I’m not doing this for free.”"

rows.original: A slow smile spreads across the refined woman’s amethyst face.
rows.translation: 精致女人的紫水晶色脸庞上缓缓绽开笑容。
rows.raw: "\n\nA slow smile spreads across the refined woman’s amethyst face. "

rows.original: “My word, is that [pc.name] Steele? I’d thought I recognized you. We spoke briefly in better circumstances than these.” She looks around at the graffiti-covered streets with unconcealed disdain. “But regardless, it is oh-so-lovely to see you again. Please excuse the riff raff our city has to deal with. Once your Corporations and our Zaibatsu reach a deal, we’ll get these streets safe to walk once more.”
rows.translation: “天哪，这不是[pc.name]·斯蒂尔吗？我就觉得认出了你。我们曾在比这里好得多的场合短暂交谈过。”她环顾涂满涂鸦的街道，毫不掩饰嫌恶。“不过无论如何，再次见到你真是太令人高兴了。请原谅我们城市不得不应付的这些乌合之众。等你们的企业与我们的财阀达成协议，我们就会让这些街道重新变得可以安全通行。”
rows.raw: "“My word, is that [pc.name] Steele? I’d thought I recognized you. We spoke briefly in better circumstances than these.” She looks around at the graffiti-covered streets with unconcealed disdain. “But regardless, it is oh-so-lovely to see you again. Please excuse the riff raff our city has to deal with. Once your Corporations and our Zaibatsu reach a deal, we’ll get these streets safe to walk once more.”"

rows.original: “Ah, a Rusher. How wonderful.” She switches from imperial tones to cloyingly flattery with a diplomat’s ease. “Our saviors from the stars. Be a dear and teach these ladies just what’s waiting for them in the vastness of space, won’t you?”
rows.translation: “啊，一位行星开拓者。真是太好了。”她以外交官般的娴熟，从高高在上的语调切换成甜得发腻的奉承。“来自群星的救星。行行好，教教这些女士，浩瀚太空里究竟有什么在等着她们，好吗？”
rows.raw: "“Ah, a Rusher. How wonderful.” She switches from imperial tones to cloyingly flattery with a diplomat’s ease. “Our saviors from the stars. Be a dear and teach these ladies just what’s waiting for them in the vastness of space, won’t you?”"

rows.original: You harden your expression and nod.
rows.translation: 你神情一肃，点了点头。
rows.raw: "\n\nYou harden your expression and nod."

rows.original: “My thanks,” she purrs. The blueblood produces a credit chit and hands it off to her bodyguard. The cybernetic woman flicks the narrow disc up, over the intervening bodies and right into your palm with remarkable precision. The gangers’ eyes instinctively follow the money before settling reluctantly on you. They grab for their weapons and the crowd around you scatters just as quickly.
rows.translation: “多谢，”她轻声娇吟。这名蓝血贵族取出一枚信用点筹码，递给自己的保镖。机械女人以惊人精度将狭长圆片弹起，越过中间的人群，正好落入你的掌心。帮派分子的目光本能地追随着钱，随后才不情愿地落到你身上。她们纷纷伸手拿武器，周围人群也以同样快的速度四散而逃。
rows.raw: "\n\n“My thanks,” she purrs. The blueblood produces a credit chit and hands it off to her bodyguard. The cybernetic woman flicks the narrow disc up, over the intervening bodies and right into your palm with remarkable precision. The gangers’ eyes instinctively follow the money before settling reluctantly on you. They grab for their weapons and the crowd around you scatters just as quickly."

rows.original: “Rushers! Just a buncha lapdogs for the zaibatsu!” they curse
rows.translation: “行星开拓者！不过是一群给财阀当走狗的家伙！”她们咒骂道
rows.raw: "\n\n“Rushers! Just a buncha lapdogs for the zaibatsu!” they curse"

rows.original: The four women move to take you down while the Peer and her bodyguard stride off about their business. Well, at least you got paid in advance!
rows.translation: 四名女子朝你围攻过来，而那名对等体和她的保镖则大步离开，继续去办自己的事。好吧，至少你已经提前拿到报酬了！
rows.raw: "\n\nThe four women move to take you down while the Peer and her bodyguard stride off about their business. Well, at least you got paid in advance!"

rows.original: Next
rows.translation: 下一步
rows.raw: "Next"

rows.original: nude
rows.raw: "nude"

rows.original: You’re just going to hang back and let the locals deal with their own problems for once. It seems like everybody else has the same idea, because nobody speaks up or makes a move. The public shunning seems to bother the wealthy woman who narrows her eyes and crinkles her nose.
rows.translation: 这一次你只想退到一旁，让当地人自行解决自己的问题。其他人似乎也抱着同样的想法，因为没有谁出声或采取行动。遭到众人公然冷落似乎惹恼了那名富有的女人，她眯起双眼，皱了皱鼻子。
rows.raw: "You’re just going to hang back and let the locals deal with their own problems for once. It seems like everybody else has the same idea, because nobody speaks up or makes a move. The public shunning seems to bother the wealthy woman who narrows her eyes and crinkles her nose."

rows.original: “Vermin sticking together? I shouldn’t be surprised.” She huffs and adjusts her narrow holo spectacles before waving to her bodyguard. “XO, deal with the troublemakers. Don’t worry about collateral.”
rows.translation: “害虫抱团取暖？我早该料到的。”她冷哼一声，扶正狭窄的全息眼镜，随后朝保镖挥了挥手。“XO，处理掉这些闹事者。不必担心附带损害。”
rows.raw: "\n\n“Vermin sticking together? I shouldn’t be surprised.” She huffs and adjusts her narrow holo spectacles before waving to her bodyguard. “XO, deal with the troublemakers. Don’t worry about collateral.”"

rows.original: The zaika doll’s cybernetic ears jolt upright, their glowing lights pulsing bright red. The girls of
rows.translation: 扎伊卡人偶的机械耳朵猛然竖起，耳上的灯光闪烁着鲜红色的脉冲。而
rows.raw: "\n\nThe zaika doll’s cybernetic ears jolt upright, their glowing lights pulsing bright red. The girls of "

rows.original: don’t even have their weapons out before the silver-helmed woman is among them, propelled by muscled thighs thicker than her waist. The bodyguard flicks her leg out in a scissor kick that lifts one of the street toughs from her feet and leans back in the same motion to snatch a gun from one of the others. The roboticized soldier’s torso-sized cybernetic limb crushes the firearm into so much twisted metal as she rights herself to evade a carbon chain that whips out where her neck had been.
rows.translation: 的女孩们甚至还没来得及拔出武器，那个戴着银色头盔的女人便靠着比腰还粗的肌肉大腿冲进了她们之间。保镖甩腿使出剪刀踢，把一名街头恶徒踢得双脚离地，同时顺势向后一仰，从另一个人手中夺过枪。这个改造士兵那条足有躯干大小的机械义肢把枪械捏成一团扭曲的金属；随后她挺直身子，躲开一条抽向她刚才颈部位置的碳纤维锁链。
rows.raw: " don’t even have their weapons out before the silver-helmed woman is among them, propelled by muscled thighs thicker than her waist. The bodyguard flicks her leg out in a scissor kick that lifts one of the street toughs from her feet and leans back in the same motion to snatch a gun from one of the others. The roboticized soldier’s torso-sized cybernetic limb crushes the firearm into so much twisted metal as she rights herself to evade a carbon chain that whips out where her neck had been."

rows.original: Spinning in place, the XO’s bladed tail lashes out to slice a protective arc around her as the cyborg clears space, slashing several onlookers who got too close in the process. One of the gangers hoists a grenade, but the motion draws the semiautomatic woman’s attention instantly. Her tail darts forward and wraps around the girl’s wrist. She dives forward into a roll with such force that it hauls the ganger up into the air, throwing her and the grenade a safe distance away. Zaika scatter and a few seconds later the grenade goes off, blasting the facade of a local business to rubble.
rows.translation: XO原地旋身，带刃的尾巴猛然挥出，在周围划出一道防护弧线，为自己清出空间；期间还割伤了几个靠得太近的围观者。一名帮派成员举起手榴弹，但这个动作立刻引起了半自动战士的注意。她的尾巴疾射而出，缠住女孩的手腕。她猛地向前翻滚，力道之大直接把那名帮派成员拽到半空，将她和手榴弹一起甩到安全距离之外。扎伊卡们四散逃开，几秒钟后手榴弹轰然爆炸，把附近一家店铺的外墙炸成了瓦砾。
rows.raw: "\n\nSpinning in place, the XO’s bladed tail lashes out to slice a protective arc around her as the cyborg clears space, slashing several onlookers who got too close in the process. One of the gangers hoists a grenade, but the motion draws the semiautomatic woman’s attention instantly. Her tail darts forward and wraps around the girl’s wrist. She dives forward into a roll with such force that it hauls the ganger up into the air, throwing her and the grenade a safe distance away. Zaika scatter and a few seconds later the grenade goes off, blasting the facade of a local business to rubble."

rows.original: Leaping back onto her feet, the bodyguard produces a buzzing electric baton from her belt and cracks the onyx tool across one of the girls’ skulls, dropping her instantly. The other two rush in with a grapple that manages to pin the giant, metal fist at her side. She notes the struggling women with machine-like dispassion and lifts one leg 180 degrees into the air like a professional pole dancer. The street toughs recognize the maneuver and dive away as the armored foot hits the pavement they’d been standing on and shatters the stone under her heel.
rows.translation: 保镖一跃而起，从腰带上抽出一根嗡嗡作响的电击棍，用这件乌黑的武器猛击其中一个女孩的头骨，当场将她放倒。另外两人扑上来擒抱，成功把那只巨大的金属拳头压制在她身侧。她以机器般的冷漠注视着苦苦用力的女人们，接着像专业钢管舞者一样把一条腿抬高整整一百八十度。街头恶徒们认出了这一招，纷纷飞扑躲开；装甲足掌随即砸中她们刚才站立的路面，脚跟下的石板顿时粉碎。
rows.raw: "\n\nLeaping back onto her feet, the bodyguard produces a buzzing electric baton from her belt and cracks the onyx tool across one of the girls’ skulls, dropping her instantly. The other two rush in with a grapple that manages to pin the giant, metal fist at her side. She notes the struggling women with machine-like dispassion and lifts one leg 180 degrees into the air like a professional pole dancer. The street toughs recognize the maneuver and dive away as the armored foot hits the pavement they’d been standing on and shatters the stone under her heel."

rows.original: The commoners aren’t out yet, though, as they flank the superior armed and armored woman, splitting her attention. rows.raw: "Maven Fassbin raises a finger. “One second, reconfiguring available biomass to support continued combat...” Something gurgles deep inside her. Behind her, one tail wobbles, then dangles bonelessly. It flattens out by the second, like a tube of toothpaste being emptied, before finally drawing itself up, into her back, and into nonexistence. Maven Jaqui Fassbin has healed herself at the cost of an extra tail!"

rows.translation: 她摇了摇头，低声说了些什么，听起来像是…… “这些该死的被污染的药物……” 她试图再次摆出战斗准备姿势，但动作显得有些笨拙。她的双腿总是分得太开……
rows.raw: " She shakes her head, mutters something under her breath that sounds like, “Fuckin’ tainted meds...” and tries to get in a combat-ready pose once more, though her movements are more awkward. Her legs keep drifting too far apart..."

rows.original: Panting now, the cocky spy gives up on words and simply yanks out yet another vial. She hammers it into her own asscheek with a grunt of pain-turned-pleasure. While her wounds knit, a little drool leaks out of her mouth.
rows.translation: 趾高气扬的间谍如今已气喘吁吁，放弃说话，直接又拔出一支药瓶。她将药瓶猛扎进自己的臀瓣，痛苦的闷哼逐渐转为快感。伤口愈合时，一缕口水从她嘴角漏下。
rows.raw: "Panting now, the cocky spy gives up on words and simply yanks out yet another vial. She hammers it into her own asscheek with a grunt of pain-turned-pleasure. While her wounds knit, a little drool leaks out of her mouth."

rows.raw: "Healing Stimmed"

rows.original: “Now now, don’t think you’ve beaten me.” The spy produces a smuggled vial from somewhere in her skin-tight bodysuit. “Stimulant? Healing stim?” Her smile stretches Cheshire and self-satisfied. “Why not both?” She jabs the needle into her leg, and her injuries close up as if by magic - or the hard work of millions of microscopic robots. Whichever.
rows.translation: “别以为你已经打败我啦。”间谍从她那紧身连体衣的某个部位取出了偷带过来的小瓶子。“兴奋剂？还是治愈剂？”她的笑容灿烂而充满得意。“为什么不两者都用呢？”她将针头刺入自己的腿部，她的伤势立刻就像被施了魔法一样愈合了——或者说是得益于数百万微小机器人的辛勤工作。不管怎样，效果确实显著。
rows.raw: "“Now now, don’t think you’ve beaten me.” The spy produces a smuggled vial from somewhere in her skin-tight bodysuit. “Stimulant? Healing stim?” Her smile stretches Cheshire and self-satisfied. “Why not both?” She jabs the needle into her leg, and her injuries close up as if by magic - or the hard work of millions of microscopic robots. Whichever."

rows.original: XOs make up the cybernetically augmented core of Dhaal’s police forces, but this one takes body modification to the extreme. Decked out from head to toe in metallic mods, she is a walking tornado of destruction just waiting to descend upon you, restrain you, and punish you to the fullest extent of Dhaal’s brutal penal codes. She watches you from behind the metal of her visor with impassive determination. Her tail lashes back and forth behind, tipped with a gleaming blade.
rows.translation: XO们构成了达尔警察部队中那些经过电子机械改造的核心力量，但这名成员将身体改造推向了极致。她从头到脚都穿戴着金属制成的改造装置，整个人就像一场随时会降临、将你制服并按照达尔严苛的惩罚法则对你进行严厉惩罚的破坏性旋风。她透过面甲上的金属板，以一种冷漠而坚定的目光注视着你。她的尾巴在身后来回摆动，尾端还装着一柄闪闪发光的利刃。
rows.raw: "XOs make up the cybernetically augmented core of Dhaal’s police forces, but this one takes body modification to the extreme. She watches you from behind the metal of her visor with impassive determination. Her tail lashes back and forth behind, tipped with a gleaming blade."
