rows.original: Char-blackened plates cover most of the hazard trooper’s body, and what isn’t covered by the plates is guarded by an amber, seemingly opaque bubble helm of exotic design and manufacture. Nevertheless, you feel the masked soldier’s baleful glare lingering on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], like she’s already imagining the damage her rivet gun can do to your flesh, though maybe she just likes what she sees? You’ll have to be careful getting close. No zaika, no matter how hot she may be under her armor, can compare to the blazing catastrophe that is her plasma-fueled torch.
rows.translation: 烧得焦黑的装甲板覆盖防化兵大半身体，其余部位则由一顶设计制造皆异乎寻常、看似不透明的琥珀色泡状头盔保护。尽管如此，你仍能感觉到面具后不祥的目光停留在[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]上，仿佛她已在想象铆钉枪会怎样摧残你的肉体；又或许，她只是喜欢眼前所见？靠近时必须小心。无论装甲下的扎伊卡本人有多火辣，也比不上她那把等离子燃料喷炬造成的炽烈灾难。

rows.original: A fearsome titan of flesh and metal, Fabricator Marshall Rizzon Zau looms tall over the battlefield, hefting her rotary autocannon as easily as a lesser zaika might tote a broomstick. The lines of her cybernetic augments spiderweb across every inch of exposed ‘skin’ - that looks as hard as a tank’s armor plating. She smiles with all the mirth of a feral shark, her cybernetic eyes burning with determination and hate for all who would stand in the way of her aspirations. You face Dhaal’s most violent titan of industry herself. She does not seem worried.
rows.translation: 制造总监里松·扎乌是血肉与金属铸成的可怖巨人，高高耸立在战场上；她抬着旋转自动炮，轻松得就像普通扎伊卡拿着一根扫帚。义体强化线路如蛛网般爬满每寸裸露的“皮肤”，而那皮肤看起来坚硬得如同坦克装甲。她露出野鲨般毫无欢愉的笑容，义眼燃烧着决心，以及对所有阻碍其野心者的憎恨。你面对的是达尔最暴力的工业巨头本人。她看起来丝毫不担心。

The lines of her cybernetic augments spiderweb across every inch of exposed ‘skin’ - that looks as hard as a tank’s armor plating. She smiles with all the mirth of a feral shark, her cybernetic eyes burning with determination and hate for all who would stand in the way of her aspirations. You face Dhaal’s most violent titan of industry herself. She does not seem worried."

rows.original: Fabricator Marshal Rizzon Zau stands before you - or her body, anyway. Her mind is locked away, overridden by the inexorable pressure of an AI’s instantly reconfigurable body-jacking scripts. The giant zaika’s heavily augmented body glows faintly, her cybernetics clocked up to the absolute breaking point. Heat radiates off of her in waves as she hefts her multibarrelled autocannon vaguely in your direction, more than willing to destroy any organic life that threatens Ehura’s vision of Paragon’s future.
rows.translation: 制造总监里松·扎乌站在你面前——至少，她的身体如此。她的心智已被封锁，无法抗拒地遭到AI随时重构的身体劫持脚本覆写。这个巨型扎伊卡经过重度强化的身体散发微光，义体被超频到绝对极限。热浪从她身上阵阵辐射而出；她把多管自动炮大致抬向你，随时准备摧毁任何威胁伊胡拉典范公司未来愿景的有机生命。

Heat radiates off of her in waves as she hefts her multibarrelled autocannon vaguely in your direction, more than willing to destroy any organic life that threatens Ehura’s vision of Paragon’s future."

rows.original: Overtaken by an untested mod, Fabricator Marshal Rizzon Zau’s body almost looks almost mutated. Her digitally controlled, cable-corded muscles bulge obscenely, radiating a heat and light from the cracks like crusted over lava. She howls in bestial rage as she confronts you, burning herself out for one final, glorious battle.

rows.original: The curvaceous, tantalizing figure of Corellah Dova (or at least, the galotian wearing her face), has been remade into something monstrous. Glowing crimson crystals protrude from smooth, creamy flesh, undulating strangely with her movements. Her black-painted lips curl back in a cruel sneer. No longer does she entertain the thought of a peaceful solution. Corellah seems to determined to realize her dream, no matter how monstrous she must make herself to accomplish it!
rows.translation: 科蕾拉·多瓦曲线丰盈、诱人无比的身影——或者说，至少是那个戴着她面孔的加洛提亚人——已被重塑成某种怪物。发光的猩红晶体从光滑柔软的肉体中刺出，随着她的动作诡异起伏。涂黑的双唇咧出残酷冷笑。她不再考虑和平解决。无论必须把自己变得多么可怖，科蕾拉似乎都决意实现梦想！
rows.raw: "The curvaceous, tantalizing figure of Corellah Dova (or at least, the galotian wearing her face), has been remade into something monstrous. Glowing crimson crystals protrude from smooth, creamy flesh, undulating strangely with her movements. Her black-painted lips curl back in a cruel sneer. No longer does she entertain the thought of a peaceful solution. Corellah seems to determined to realize her dream, no matter how monstrous she must make herself to accomplish it!"

rows.original: The thraggen Rusher is a statuesque amazon, the pinnacle of her species’ tendency towards towering muscle-babes with heaving big tits and thighs fit to crush skulls. Mhorgenn’s strapped up in a black leather jacket that’s entirely too tight around her rock-hard biceps, and her tight leather pants leave nothing about her growing battle-bulge to the imagination. A messy ash-colored ponytail is pulled back behind a VR visor she was using to manually work her heavy mech, and her betusked face is decorated with warpaint and black lipstick. rows.original:
Bright Water’s external toxin pump hasn’t yet been given a name, and you can see why. The bulbous central cylinder hangs from a harness of industrial straps, meant to be looped around the wearer’s torso. Two support tubes, glowing neon green, stretch out to a pair of metallic silver cuffs. The inner edge, where they would press against skin, is lined with a strangely undulating white leather or hyper-dense fabric, you’re not sure which.

The attached development notes indicate that the system can painlessly extract toxins from the wearer’s blood without the need for needles or an intravenous connector. A later note indicates a desire to reduce the efficacy of the system, so as not to negatively impact sales of Bright Water’s pharmaceutical products.
rows.translation:
澄水公司的外置毒素泵至今还没有正式名称，看过实物便不难理解原因。鼓胀的中央圆筒悬挂在一组工业束带上，束带用于环绕穿戴者的躯干。两根泛着霓虹绿光的支撑管延伸出去，连接一对银色金属袖箍。袖箍压住皮肤的内缘衬着一种会诡异起伏的白色材料；你无法确定那究竟是皮革，还是超高密度织物。

随附的开发记录表明，这套系统无需针头或静脉接口，便能从穿戴者血液中无痛抽取毒素。后续记录则提出应当降低系统效能，以免影响澄水公司药品的销量。
rows.raw: "Bright Water’s external toxin pump hasn’t yet been given a name, and you can see why. The bulbous central cylinder hangs from a harness of industrial straps, meant to be looped around the wearer’s torso. Two support tubes, glowing neon green, stretch out to a pair of metallic silver cuffs. The inner edge, where they would press against skin, is lined with a strangely undulating white leather or hyper-dense fabric, you’re not sure which.\n\nThe attached development notes indicate that the system can painlessly extract toxins from the wearer’s blood without the need for needles or an intravenous connector. A later note indicates a desire to reduce the efficacy of the system, so as not to negatively impact sales of Bright Water’s pharmaceutical products."

rows.original: Feruze wings down from a perch above as you approach the taxi, hefting a dufflebag up over her shoulder. “So? You ready to get this party started?” You nod, checking your own [pc.weapon][pc.cl mercenary |. Feruze grins toothily. |, though hopefully you won’t have cause to use it. ] “Alright, finally!” the big shark cheers, waving down one of the passing hover-cabs.[flags.FERUZE_CAME_INSIDE |“We’re gonna shake that little [rival.mf |bastard |bitch ] down for our kids, right?” You nod. “Absolutely.” |“Fuck, can’t believe that little shit’s making us go through all this effort. My rep’s gonna take a beating if I lose a Steele.” [flags.RIVAL_DANCE |“Yeah, I’m worried too...” |You grunt noncommittally. ] ] A taxi finally descends down to your level, side hatch popping open before it’s even stopped moving. A pair of clearly-intoxicated, giggling zaika stagger out flashing you chrome-framed grins and winking cybernetic eyes. Feruze all but shoves them out of the way and piles into the back seat. Guess that leaves you for the front. A much less augmented zaika is sitting in the driver’s seat, and when you hand her the credential chip, she whistles. “Whew, fancy pants on this offworlder! You sure you wanna go down there, though? Last I heard there’s a pretty big riot fixing to break out in the Farrow.” “A riot?” “Mmhm! Well, m’wife insists it’s a protest for the sake of the planet’s future, but the [targetFactionName] radio ain’t mincing words. Announcer says there’s a whole mess of anti-capital rebels trying to tear down the very fabric of our society for their misguided ideals. How awful.” You glance back at Feruze. “Mind turning that radio on while we fly down?” “Sure thing, spacer!” the cabby says, lifting off and fiddling with her console. You’re assaulted by a crackling of static, and then a sultry-smooth voice comes over the speakers. “-are continuing to block traffic into and around [targetFactionName]’s most important and profitable facilities in the Farrow Industrial Zone, preventing hundreds of workers from benefiting from their high-paying and benefit-laden jobs within. Our illustrious leader has already promised a swift end to these obstructions at any cost, but the class traitors have made it known that they will not be moved until their craven demands are met. We contacted the facility overseer for comment:” Another voice comes over the wire, rough as a gravel tumbler, though still doubtless a zaika. “A work week of less than sixty hours is frankly absurd and threatens the entire productivity cycle all of us break our backs to maintain. These selfish bitches can’t see the bigger picture — we’re playing catch up with the whole galaxy down here now. There’s no time for slacking off or crying about the cost to the environment. The sunward side burns away all the refuse from this facility anyway.” “And there you have it, darlings,” the announcers says. “Traitorous workers — and I use the term loosely — are threatening not only [targetFactionName] employee wages, but the standing of our entire world in the wider galaxy. Let’s all hope the security services will teach these thugs a lesson they’ll feel from their tips to their tails.” “Yeah, get ‘em!” the cabby cheers, punching the air. “Fuckin’ up my whole route, those assholes. You’re the first people wanting to go down there in days!” In her taxi, maybe. You glance out the window, watching the descent from the urban streets to the smoke-blanketed industrial zone below the Gyre. It’s just below, though, but also further afield than you’ve been before: your adventures so far have kept to the narrow band in the middle of the world-belting city, cozy in the perpetual twilight between the sun-scorched and frozen sides of the world. The taxi takes you sunward, far enough that you can see a golden haze glaring down even through the industrial smog. Even inside the sealed can of the transport, you can feel the heat starting to chew through the air con. Your driver fiddles with a dial, cranking it up, but it can’t keep pace with the sun’s fury as you near the hot side of the planet.
rows.translation: 你走近出租车时，费鲁兹从上方的落脚处振翅飞下，将一个旅行袋扛上肩头。“怎么样？准备好开场了吗？” 你点点头，检查自己的[pc.weapon][pc.cl mercenary |。费鲁兹龇牙一笑。 |，但愿用不上它。 ] “好，总算来了！”大鲨鱼欢呼着，挥手拦下一辆经过的悬浮出租车。[flags.FERUZE_CAME_INSIDE |“咱们要为了孩子，好好收拾那个小[rival.mf |混蛋 |贱人 ]，对吧？” 你点点头。“当然。” |“操，真不敢相信那个小混蛋害咱们费这么大工夫。要是我弄丢一个斯蒂尔，我的名声可要遭殃了。” [flags.RIVAL_DANCE |“是啊，我也很担心...” |你不置可否地哼了一声。 ] ] 终于有辆出租车降到你们所在的高度，车还没停稳，侧舱门便弹开了。两个显然喝醉了、咯咯直笑的扎伊卡踉跄着下车，朝你露出铬框镶边的笑容，眨动着义眼。费鲁兹几乎把她们推到一旁，自己一头钻进后座。看来前座归你了。驾驶座上的扎伊卡接受的改造少得多；你递给她身份凭证芯片时，她吹了声口哨。“嚯，这外星人派头不小！不过你确定要下去？我上次听说，法罗那边正要闹一场大暴乱呢。” “暴乱？” “嗯哼！呃，我老婆坚称那是为了星球未来而举行的抗议，不过[targetFactionName]的广播可一点都不含糊。播音员说，一大群反资本叛乱分子正妄图为她们那些误入歧途的理想，撕毁我们社会的根基。真可怕。” 你回头看向费鲁兹。“我们往下飞的时候，介意把广播打开吗？” “没问题，太空客！”司机说着，让车升空并摆弄起控制台。 刺啦作响的静电声扑面而来，随后扬声器里传出一道丝滑妩媚的声音。“目前仍在持续封锁[targetFactionName]位于法罗工业区内最重要、最盈利的设施及其周边交通，致使数百名工人无法享受设施内部薪酬优厚、福利齐全的工作。我们尊贵的领袖已经承诺，不惜一切代价迅速结束这些阻碍；然而，那些阶级叛徒已经公开表示，只要她们卑劣的要求得不到满足，就绝不会让步。我们联系了设施监督员，请她发表评论：” 电波中传来另一个声音，粗粝得像滚石筒，毫无疑问仍是一名扎伊卡。“每周工作不到六十小时，坦白说荒谬至极，还会威胁我们所有人拼命维系的整个生产周期。这些自私的贱人看不到大局，我们现在得在这里追赶整个银河系。哪有时间偷懒，或是哭诉环境代价。反正这座设施产生的所有废料，都会被向阳面烧得一干二净。” “事情就是这样，亲爱的听众们，”播音员说道。“这些叛变的工人，姑且还称她们为工人吧，不仅威胁[targetFactionName]员工的工资，也威胁我们整个世界在银河大家庭中的地位。让我们共同期盼安保部门给这些暴徒上一课，叫她们从耳尖到尾尖都记忆犹新。” “对，收拾她们！”司机挥拳欢呼。“这帮混蛋把我的整条路线都搅黄了。你们是这几天来头一批还想下去的人！” 至少在她的出租车上是如此。你望向窗外，看着车辆从城市街道下降至旋环区下方烟雾笼罩的工业区。那里虽在正下方，却也比你去过的地方更偏远：迄今为止，你的冒险大多局限于这座环绕世界的城市中央那条狭窄地带，在行星向阳面的焦土与背阴面的冻土之间，享受永恒暮光的舒适。出租车朝向阳面飞去，远得让你隔着工业烟雾也能看到金色光霾刺眼地照下。即便待在密封的车厢里，你也能感觉热量开始侵蚀空调送来的凉气。司机拧动旋钮，把空调开得更猛；可随着车辆逼近行星炎热的一侧，它仍追不上太阳的狂威。

My rep’s gonna take a beating if I lose a Steele.” [flags.RIVAL_DANCE |“Yeah, I’m worried too...” |You grunt noncommittally. ] ] A taxi finally descends down to your level, side hatch popping open before it’s even stopped moving. We contacted the facility overseer for comment:” Another voice comes over the wire, rough as a gravel tumbler, though still doubtless a zaika. “A work week of less than sixty hours is frankly absurd and threatens the entire productivity cycle all of us break our backs to maintain. rows.original: “Hope you two brought some sunscreen. Especially you in back! You’re some kinda aquatic alien, right?” Feruze makes an uncomfortable noise, pulling a phial of something clear and greasy out of her duffle and starting to smear it over her scales. “Yeah don’t spend too much time outdoors down here,” your driver continues, “you’ll get suuuuper cancer. But I’m sure a [targetFactionName]-licensed doctor can fix you right up, oh yeah. But better to be safe than sorry, y’know, especially if you’re not used to the Dhaal sun. Not many people native to the planet are either!” She laughs, pulling you around the corner of a skyscraper and nosediving towards the ground. Once you’re angled towards the street, you can immediately see the so-called riot sprawling out on the streets: they weren’t kidding about this crowd of zaika blocking traffic! There’s got to be hundreds, maybe thousands, packed into the streets and marching on what you can only imagine is your target: a sprawling industrial park surrounded by tall concrete walls and belching black pillars of smoke into the air. You see all manner of signs poking out of the crowd, demanding better pay, better hours, better healthcare, better environmental controls... and they’re being met with a bristling line of security cyborgs and automated gun turrets protecting the sealed front gates. Your driver has to land quite a ways back, where the crowd’s thinned down enough that she isn’t crushing thirty people trying to land — though she seems to take some glee in making a bunch of protestors go running to get out of the way. Feruze shoves a credstick into the cabby’s hand and bails out, stretching her wings. The driver grins ear to ear, tucking the chit down the front of her shirt. “Thanks, big fish! Don’t dawdle out there in the sun, okay?” You give her a thumbs up and hop out, following Feruze into the crowd. A few zaika, all dressed in dirtied neon-lined leather and work jumpers, scowl at you — but they scatter when Feruze gets her hackles up, bearing her fangs. “Alright,” you say, pulling the big woman back. “Let’s get to work.”
rows.translation: “希望你们俩带了防晒霜。尤其是后座那位！你是某种水生外星人，对吧？” 费鲁兹不自在地哼了一声，从旅行袋里取出一小瓶透明油腻的液体，开始往鳞片上涂抹。 “对了，在下面别长时间待在户外，”司机继续说道，“不然会得超——级严重的癌症。不过我相信，持有[targetFactionName]执照的医生肯定能把你治好，没错。但小心总比后悔强，对吧？尤其是你们不习惯达尔的太阳。其实这颗星球的本地人也没几个习惯它！” 她哈哈大笑，驾驶出租车绕过摩天楼拐角，一头朝地面俯冲。一旦车头对准街道，你立刻便看见所谓的暴乱铺满下方街区：扎伊卡人群确实把交通堵了个水泄不通！街道上挤着几百乃至几千人，朝着想必正是她们目标的地方进发：一座由高耸混凝土墙环绕、向空中喷吐黑色烟柱的庞大工业园。人群中举着五花八门的标语，要求提高工资、缩短工时、改善医疗、加强环境管控...迎接她们的却是一排全副武装的安保义体人和自动枪塔，守卫着紧闭的正门。司机只能在很远的后方降落，那里人群稀疏，不至于让她落地时压死三十个人；不过，她吓得一群抗议者四散躲闪时，看起来倒颇为开心。 费鲁兹把一根信用棒塞进司机手中，跳下车舒展双翼。司机笑得合不拢嘴，把信用棒塞进衣襟。“谢啦，大鱼！别在太阳底下磨蹭，听见没？” 你朝她竖起拇指，跳下车跟着费鲁兹挤进人群。几个扎伊卡全都穿着沾满污垢、饰有霓虹线条的皮衣和工装连体服，正冲你们怒目而视；可费鲁兹颈背一竖、露出獠牙，她们便纷纷散开。 “行了，”你一边说，一边把这个大块头女人拉回来。“开始办正事吧。”

rows.original: [flags.FARROW_TALK_GUARDS |You step up to the guards again, keeping your face stony as several auto-cannons turn their attention to you. The officer you spoke to watches you approach with one hand on her cigar, and the other on the butt of a big-bore pistol slung on her hip. “What is it, starborn? Headquarters is breathing down my neck — I shouldn’t even be talking to you with these greasers ready to ram the gates.” |You step out of the crowd, approaching the line of armed guards. Several cyber-aug’d zaika snap their rifles up to their shoulders, covering you and Feruze in laser dots. Your companion bares her fangs, mace-tail thrashing as if to challenge a whole gun line of guards and turrets. You put a hand on her[pc.heightRange 84 | shoulder | hip ], holding her back. One of the guards steps forward, wearing a red beret and a uniform with different stripes on its shoulders, raises a hand up to the others. “What do you want, offworlders? Can’t you see there’s a riot going on?” “We noticed,” you tell her. “I’m guessing the gate’s not opening until they break up, right?” The soldier makes another motion to her guards, and the lasers deactivate. You take that as permission to step closer, so you aren’t shouting to be heard over the crowd. While you approach, the zaika lights up a fresh cigar, taking a deep drag off it and watching you with wary, apprising synthetic eyes. “Listen, star-born. I don’t know why you’re here, but this [targetFactionName]-brand industrial zone is locked down until this crowd disperses. I’ve got Peers trapped inside. I’ve got the overseer breathing down my neck telling me to resolve this. I’ve got rioting dissidents that want to tear my girls limb from limb. But between you and me, I’d still rather not turn a couple hundred greasers into Gyre cheese. Get my meaning?” Feruze snorts. “You want us to solve your problems for you, tit-bitch?” “Tit-bitch?” “Ugh. [pc.name] we don’t have time for this!” ]
rows.translation: [flags.FARROW_TALK_GUARDS |你再次走向那些卫兵，面无表情地站在他们面前，这时几挺自动加农炮将注意力转向了你。你之前交谈过的那位军官，一只手拿着雪茄，另一只手则搭在挂在腰间的那把大口径手枪的枪柄上，注视着你走过来。 “怎么了，星裔？总部正在紧追不舍——在这种情况之下，我甚至不该和你说话，那些武装人员随时可能冲进来。” |你从人群中走出来，走向那排武装守卫。几只配备了电子增强装置的扎伊卡立刻将步枪举到肩上，用激光瞄准器锁定你和费鲁兹。你的同伴露出了獠牙，尾巴像鞭子一样抽打，仿佛要挑战整个枪炮阵地。你伸手握住了她的[pc.heightRange 84 |肩膀 |臀部 ]，阻止她继续前进。 其中一名卫兵走上前，他戴着红色贝雷帽，穿着肩部带有不同条纹的制服，向其他人举手示意。“你们这些外星人想要什么？难道看不到这里正在发生暴乱吗？” “我们注意到了，”你告诉她。“我猜在它们分开之前，大门是不会打开的，对吧？” 士兵向她的守卫们做了个手势，激光束随即熄灭了。你将这视为可以靠近的信号，于是不再大声呼喊，以免被人群的声音淹没。当你逐渐靠近时，扎伊卡点燃了一支新雪茄，深吸了一口，然后用那双充满警惕与戒备的合成眼睛注视着你。“听着，星际来客。我不知道你为何来到这里，但这个[targetFactionName]品牌的工业区在人群散去之前是禁止进入的。我的同伴们被关在里面，监管者也在紧逼着我要求解决问题，而那些叛乱的异见者们更是想把我的手下们撕成碎片。但说实在的，我宁愿不把几百个粗人变成旋环区的‘奶酪’，你明白我的意思吗？” 费鲁兹哼了一声。 “你是想让我们来帮你解决这些问题，对吧，贱人？” “泼妇？” “呃。” [pc.name] “我们没时间搞这个！” ]

rows.original: “We can disperse this crowd for you,” you suggest. Not like you’re getting inside if the status quo endures. Place is locked down tighter than a princess’s chastity belt. Feruze crosses her arms. “We can?” Something approaching a smile crosses the commander’s features. “I don’t care how you do it, just get rid of these whiny tailbrains. I’m sure the overseer has some hazard pay for freelancers she’ll be happy to dispense if you do.” You nod, turning towards the rioters and resting a hand on your [pc.weapon]. The rioters near the front of the herd gasp, trying to move back and make space, but there’s a solid wall of zaika bodies behind them. The zaika at the head of the crowd, a woman with a cheap-looking cyber arm and a bullhorn, furrows her brow over a pair of mirrorshades. “See how even the aliens are zaibatsu lickboots!” she shouts, amplified painfully by the megaphone. “The very heavens are as corruptible as the overseer and her minions! They’re just another cancer on this planet!” A furious howl of anguish and hatred radiates through the assembled masses. You see crowbars and chains begin appearing in zaika hands, gripped in calloused, scarred hands. Feruze sighs and activates the macehead on her tail, dropping into a fighting stance. “Let’s make this quick.” You intend to.
rows.translation: “我们可以帮你驱散这群人。” 你这么建议也是有一定道理的。如果现状持续下去，确实没人能真正插手其中。这个地方的控制力度，比公主的贞操带还要严格。 费鲁兹双臂交叉抱在胸前。 “我们能做到吗？” 指挥官的脸上掠过一丝近乎微笑的表情。“我不在乎你用什么方法，只要把这些爱抱怨的家伙处理掉就行。我相信监督者会为自由工作者准备一些危险津贴，如果你把他们解决掉，她肯定会很高兴发放的。” 你点了点头，转身面向那些暴民，将一只手放在自己的[pc.weapon]上。队伍前方的暴民们惊恐地倒吸一口气，试图后退以腾出空间，但他们身后却是一堵由扎伊卡组成的坚实屏障。 人群前面的那个扎伊卡，一个戴着廉价仿生手臂、手持扩音器的女人，皱着眉头看着那副墨镜。“看看，就连外星人也是财阀的走狗！”她喊道，扩音器将她的声音放得刺耳不堪。“连天空本身也和那个监管者以及她的爪牙一样腐败！它们不过是这个星球上的又一种毒瘤罢了！” 一阵充满痛苦与仇恨的狂怒嚎叫在聚集的人群中回荡。你可以看到，扎伊卡们手中开始出现撬棍和链条，那些工具被他们布满老茧、伤痕的手紧紧握住。 费鲁兹轻叹一声，激活了尾巴上的战锤头，摆出了战斗姿态。“我们速战速决吧。” 你正有此意。
rows.raw: " “We can disperse this crowd for you,” you suggest. Not like you’re getting inside if the status quo endures. Place is locked down tighter than a princess’s chastity belt. Feruze crosses her arms. “We can?” Something approaching a smile crosses the commander’s features. “I don’t care how you do it, just get rid of these whiny tailbrains. I’m sure the overseer has some hazard pay for freelancers she’ll be happy to dispense if you do.” You nod, turning towards the rioters and resting a hand on your [pc.weapon]. The rioters near the front of the herd gasp, trying to move back and make space, but there’s a solid wall of zaika bodies behind them. The zaika at the head of the crowd, a woman with a cheap-looking cyber arm and a bullhorn, furrows her brow over a pair of mirrorshades. “See how even the aliens are zaibatsu lickboots!” she shouts, amplified painfully by the megaphone. “The very heavens are as corruptible as the overseer and her minions! They’re just another cancer on this planet!” A furious howl of anguish and hatred radiates through the assembled masses. You see crowbars and chains begin appearing in zaika hands, gripped in calloused, scarred hands. Feruze sighs and activates the macehead on her tail, dropping into a fighting stance. “Let’s make this quick.” You intend to. "

rows.original: Zaika Leader

rows.raw: "Zaika Leader"

rows.original: Savin
rows.raw: "Savin"

rows.original: “So aside from the obvious, what’s got you all worked up?” you ask, surveying the massive crowd. “There’s hundreds of zaika down here, maybe thousands, all shoulder to shoulder for... what?” “For what? For freedom!” she shoots back. “For the freedom to live. Each of us has lived our lives under the boot of the zaibatsu, working obscene hours without reprieve and earning barely enough to get by. And now — now these tailsuckers are docking our collective pay to put in safety measures that they took away last year to cut costs. Look at what they’re doing to us!” The woman clenches a metal fist, hard enough to make the metal creak. Several other zaika repeat the gesture, showing off chrome arms, legs, tails, and more. “Zaika lives are just as replaceable as the gears in the machines!” the leader growls. “Maybe more, since the overseer doesn’t have to put up a down payment for workers.” “So what happened to you, exactly?” The leader bristles, rubbing her thumb over her scarred bicep. “I’m a lathemeister, fourth grade. I made the best glass in forty sectors, everything from hovercar windshields to test tubes. When you aliens showed up, though, the overseer increased my quota by fifty percent and cratered my off time to nothing — I had to suffer pay docks just to sleep. What do you think’s going to happen when you run a factory like that, huh? Your workers start falling asleep at the helm, no matter how many stims they buy from the company store. I fainted at the controls cuz I hadn’t slept in seventy hours, and then next thing I know I’m screaming hoarse cuz my arm’s in the lathe. And you know what [targetFactionName]’s response was, offworlder? The fucker fined me for damaging their equipment! My mother had to sell herself to the Utopian brothel on Khalesh street just to afford this shitty rust of mine!” [pc.intelligenceRange 75 |Even for a mega-corp that’s beyond the pale. Something tells you this woman’s blowing things way out of proportion... |God damn. That’s brutal even for a mega-corp. ] Several other zaika pat their comrade’s shoulder, grumbling about how awful [targetFactionName] is and how they’ve suffered, too. Just keeping an ear out tells you several of these ladies have had similar workplace accidents, or are afraid they’ll soon face something even worse as safety standards inside decline.
rows.translation: “那么，除了那些显而易见的原因之外，到底是什么让你们所有人如此激动呢？” 你问道，环视着那庞大的人群。 “下面有成百上千的扎伊卡，也许甚至有数千只，它们都挤得密密麻麻的...究竟是为了什么？” “为了什么？为了自由！”她反驳道。“为了获得生存的自由。我们每个人都曾在财阀的压迫下生活，长时间工作却没有任何休息时间，挣的钱仅仅够维持生计。而现在——这些混蛋却扣减我们的工资，用来投入那些他们去年为了节省成本而取消的安全措施上。看看他们正在对我们做什么！” 那个女人将金属拳头握得紧紧的，力度之大以至于金属都发出了嘎吱声。其他几名扎伊卡也纷纷模仿这个动作，展示着他们那镀铬的手臂、腿、尾巴等等。 “扎伊卡的生命，就像机器里的齿轮一样，是可以随意替换的！” 首领低吼道。 “也许还要更多，因为监管者不需要为工人支付首付。” “那么，你到底发生了什么事？” 领导者怒不可遏，用拇指揉搓着自己那布满伤痕的二头肌。 “我是一名四级的车床操作工。在四十个生产领域里，我制作的玻璃制品都是最优质的，从悬浮车的挡风玻璃到实验试管，样样都不差。然而当你们外星人出现后，主管竟然把我的生产任务量增加了百分之五十，还把我的休息时间压缩得几乎为零——我连睡觉的时间都没有，只能靠减少工资来勉强维持生计。你们想想，如果这样管理工厂，会是什么后果呢？工人们无论从公司商店购买多少提神用品，最终都会在操作机器时睡着。我有七十个小时没睡觉，结果在操作控制台时晕了过去，接下来就更糟糕了，我的手臂被卡在了车床里，疼得我直叫喊。” [targetFactionName]“那个外星人的反应是？就因为我损坏了他们的设备，他竟然罚了我钱！我妈妈为了买这破铁器，不得不去卡莱什街上的乌托邦妓院卖身！” [pc.intelligenceRange 75 |即便对于这样一家规模庞大的企业来说，这也太过分了。直觉告诉我，这个女人把事情夸大了很多... |该死。就算是对一家巨型企业而言，这也太残忍了。 ] 其他几名扎伊卡也拍了拍她同伴的肩膀，抱怨着[targetFactionName]到底有多糟糕，以及她们自己也遭受了多少苦难。只要稍加留意，就会发现其中几位女性都经历过类似的工作场所事故，或者担心随着内部安全标准的下降，自己很快就会面临更糟糕的情况。

rows.original: “What’s it going to take to get you all to go home?” you ask. No harm, right — even if you can’t exactly meet their demands yourself. Several of the zaika on the front lines scowl; some behind them shout anti-alien obscenity. The leader, though, raises her robotic fist to silence them. “You can see our demands on our signs, offworlder. Unless you mean to buy up all of [targetFactionName], then you aren’t responsible for our woes. Not directly, at least, though the overseer and her mistress have certainly gotten cozy with you aliens.” “Surely there’s something I can do,” you say. “Come on. Those guards have hair triggers as it is. You can’t stay here much longer.” Though the woman you’re talking to stays steely-calm, you catch several of the other zaika glancing worriedly at the guards and their turrets. “Unless you can put a wedge into the zaibatsu machine and make the overseer see just how broken this system is — no. If you want us gone, alien, then help us destroy the tools of oppression! If the overseer won’t meet our demands, then we’ll show her the real power of united workers!” “You... want me to help you fight the guards?” She eyes you cautiously. “I say you have a better chance than we do, if it comes to that. You have weapons, shields; we have crowbars and clothes that are barely more than tatters. And even if we could, I don’t want to hurt the troops: they’re so programmed by their overseer that they don’t know how to breathe if somebody doesn’t give them an order to. They’re victims too.” Yeah, there’s no way these guys would win in a fair fight. Not with that row of gun turrets up on the walls auto-targeting everybody. Feruze nudges you with her tail. “Come on, let’s crack these corpo heads already and get this over with.” [pc.cl mercenary |Cracking skulls is great, but a frontal assault against a fortified position like this is just asking for trouble. You need to shut down those turrets at least. |Even with all your kit, though, trying to fight your way through all those turrets seems ill-advised... ]
rows.translation: “到底要什么才能让你们都回家呢？” 你会这样问。这并没有什么坏处，对吧——即使你自己也无法完全满足他们的要求。 前线的几名扎伊卡面露怒容；而一些在后面的... 他们 有人高声辱骂外星人。然而，那位领导者举起了她的机械拳头，让这些人安静下来。 “你可以从我们的标识上看到我们的要求，外星人。除非你打算把所有东西都买下来...” [targetFactionName]那么，你对我们所遭遇的困境并不负有责任。至少不是直接责任，不过监管者和她的女主人显然与你们这些外星人关系相当密切。 “肯定有我能做的事情，” 你说。“快走吧。那些守卫本来就很容易被激怒。你不能再在这里待下去了。” 虽然你正在交谈的这个女人表现得异常冷静，但你注意到其他几个扎伊卡成员不时忧心忡忡地瞥向那些守卫和他们的炮塔。 “除非你能破坏这个财阀体系的运作机制，让监管者看到这个制度究竟有多糟糕——不。如果你想让我们离开，外星人，那就帮我们摧毁这些压迫工具吧！如果监管者不满足我们的要求，那么我们就让她见识到团结一致的工人们真正的力量！” “你，想让我帮你对付那些守卫？” 她小心翼翼地注视着你。“我觉得，如果真到了那一步，你比我们更有机会。你有武器、盾牌，而我们只有撬棍和一些几乎破烂不堪的衣服。而且，就算我们能动手，我也不想伤害那些士兵：他们的监管者把他们控制得太严格了，如果没有指令，他们甚至不知道该如何呼吸。他们也是受害者。” 是啊，这些人在公平的战斗中根本不可能获胜。毕竟他们的墙壁上装了一排枪塔，那些枪塔会自动锁定所有人进行攻击。 费鲁兹用尾巴轻轻碰了你一下。“快点，咱们把这些家伙解决掉，赶紧结束这件事吧。” [pc.cl mercenary |敲碎头骨确实很痛快，但像这样对设防严密的据点发动正面进攻，无异于自寻麻烦。你至少得先把那些炮塔关掉才行。 |不过，就算你带着所有装备，试图冲破那些炮塔的阻拦，似乎也并非明智之举， ]

rows.original: “We’ll make you an opening,” you tell the leader. “And then we all rush the entrance.” “Fuck yeah, let’s do it,” Feruze growls, cracking her knuckles. The zaika around you all nod, hands creeping towards hidden chains and knives. “Show those lick-tails that not all aliens stand for their mistress’s all-consuming greed. I’ll get everyone who can’t fight out of the line of fire.” You turn and stride back towards the guards’ lines.[var0|| The turrets pivot, tracking your movements.] Laser aiming devices light up across your chest. “That’s close enough,” the lead goon barks, resting a hand on the butt of the [silly |big iron |pistol ] on her hip. “What were you and those greasers conspiring about, hmm? Whatever lies they were-” Before she can finish the thought, Feruze charges past you and shoulder-rushes the bitch straight into the gate, hard enough to dent the metal with a sickening crunch. One of the other security troopers screams “LIGHT ‘EM UP!” [var0|The turrets hang limply from their sconces, still in the process of rebooting.|The turrets track you and Feruze, spinning up to join the fight.]

rows.original: You glance over at Feruze. “Let’s see if we can find a way to tackle the security system.” “From out here? They’d have to be a whole new kind of stupid if there is.” [pc.isBimbo |“Naaaah, it’ll work itself out.” |You nod. “They were expecting poor undereducated zaika, not well-equipped aliens, when they built this place.” ] Feruze shrugs and steps off towards some of the nearby buildings outside the compound; you take the other side of the street, glancing between the towering bases of the skyscrapers surrounding the complex. You doubt there’s anything of note in the buildings — those could be owned and accessed by anybody — but the mega-city of Dhaal is so old and dense that the infrastructure, at least, probably hasn’t been updated much if at all over the years. And your contact said this facility itself was pretty damn old. A bit of searching, and you find just what you’re looking for: a manhole. Womanhole, considering the native species? Either way, there’s a service tunnel in a nearby alley, and the lock’s easy enough to dispatch with a blow from your [pc.meleeWeapon].[var1 | There’s no limits to the uses for a trusty rock! ] The smell down there’s atrocious, but you slip down anyway, using the light on your Codex to illuminate the tunnel running parallel to the street above. Sure enough, there’s a host of cables running along the ceiling and walls, safely restrained from contact with the flowing water beneath. You follow the cabling for a short while, tracing fingers on worn-down old plastic coverings, until you find just what you’d been hoping for: a junction box. [var0 |No way a [silly |spoopy |secret ] corporate blacksite doesn’t have its own internal power supply, but a surge might be enough to fry some of their systems. Might even bring down their security turrets for a few minutes, on top of whatever other chaos it might cause inside. |There’s probably a generator in the facility, but if you could figure out a way to give it a power surge, maybe that’d fry those damn turrets. ]

rows.original: You recoil, covering your face as sparks fly. The dim running lights in the tunnel flare and burn out, and you hear sirens up on the surface level. A moment later and Feruze pokes her head down, grinning at you. “Oh, you poked the nest now! There’s corpos running around like prgga worms with their tails cut off!” Perfect. You accept a proffered golden hand and are hefted up out of the tunnel, back to the surface. The rioters seem energized — unlike the quartet of skyscrapers surrounding the complex, all of which have gone black. A few red emergency lights are just starting to flicker on inside. If the complex ever lost power, there’s no sign... except some of the floodlights on the outer perimeter have gone dark, and the turrets have no visible lights active at all. “Looks like that worked. Better hurry before they realize their shit’s turned off,” Feruze grins. “Finally time for some action!” “Here we go,” you say, turning back towards the gates.

rows.original: There’s a roaring cheer from the crowd as the last of the [targetFactionName] goons fall. You barely have time to stow your [pc.weapon] before a horde of zaika workers are charging the gates, cutting into them with torches and crowbars. While they work, the chrome-armed ‘leader’ of the rioters approaches with a grin. “Thanks, offworlder. Turns out all of you aliens being just as greed-mad as the overseers was another piece of propaganda. I know of an underground deprogramming camp — we’ll take these ladies there and get all this corpo shit out of their brains. Half of it’s probably literal programming in all that cyberwear.” You nod, watching some of the rioters carrying off the unconscious bodies of your enemies. A few short moments later, and then gates collapse off their hinges, slamming into the ground of the inner courtyard with a resounding thud. “Charge!” the leader yells into her bullhorn, waving the crowd through the breach. A mass of zaika bodies surge past you, storming the building — or they would, if the only entrance wasn’t a single revolving door only big enough for two of them to get through at a time. The panels must be reinforced, as several resounding blows from bats and chains don’t so much as crack them. They can’t even push the doors faster than their automated rotation allows. There’s a great deal of yelling and jostling at the front, while other rioters fan out and start looting the guard house and smaller out-buildings. Feruze sighs. “Look at that traffic jam. Guess we aren’t getting in the front door.” Even as the rioters are doing their thing, though, you glance up to see a caravan of hover-trucks passing overhead towards the back of the complex — either too self-assured or too clueless to realize the facility’s under siege. You and Feruze exchange a glance. “Cargo bay?” “Cargo bay.”

两个碟形装置紧贴着你的头部两侧，随着头部的轮廓而变形。当一个结实的头盔被戴上并固定好时，电流在精密的内部电路中激荡。接着，一阵嗡鸣声过后，一块带有蓝色光栅的面罩滑过你的双眼，以惊人的速度将极其生动的图像投射到你的视网膜上。你的嘴唇不由自主地流出了口水，而你体内某个部位似乎也在迅速反应着这些刺激。 无法辨认的人生闪回被编码记忆覆盖——画面里有一个[pc.boyGirl]，自豪地穿着[pc.hisHer]装备，从一颗星球跃向另一颗星球。试图从这些影像中寻找意义，令你的内在感知如鱼眼镜头般扭曲，把你困在一片片空旷景象中，而那里逐渐被[var0|蓝色|红色|绿色]光芒填满。你一眨不眨地注视一个正在聚合的标志；那是你对意义的渴望凝结而成的事物。 抚慰人心的情绪无处不在，那种同时带来的平静与笃定直击你的内心深处。起初这些低语模糊不清，令你感到沮丧，但当你鼓足勇气，不再试图独自理解它们时，反而会让自己倾听这些声音。你的心理防线随之瓦解，一种坚定而有力的存在感悄然降临。 “你好，XO-273。请确认。” 你点头确认。 “[favoredFactionName]需要你。为此，你必须服从。毫无质疑地效命，这是你今后的职责。请确认。” 你再次点了点头，一时语塞。这本该让人感到不安，但却有一种温暖的力量逐渐包围了你，这种温暖坚不可摧，势不可挡。 “[favoredFactionName]需要你。为此，你必须服从。请毫无分心地遵守命令。请确认收到。” 闪烁的暗示被输入，将曾经沉寂的部位刺激得重新活跃。快感从乳头、胯间，尤其从尾骨延伸出的蜿蜒附肢中淌出。[pc.hasTail |这已不是你从前的尾巴，而是一个能随意志鲜活变化的器官，既能硬成搏动挺立的形状，也能张开成诱人的湿滑孔穴。 |洗脑程序的一次脉冲令它变成悦人而坚挺的形状；另一侧传来的电击又让它张成丰润孔穴，足以轻松容纳刚才那种形态。 ] 活力得以恢复，血液开始流动。你那健康而充满活力的身体被这台机器激发出种种感官反应，它不断催促你给予回应——要求你服从、屈从、顺从、放弃抵抗、认输、表示谦卑。有什么沉重的东西不断撞击你的臀部，这种强烈的刺激让你逐渐学会去喜爱这种感觉。[favoredFactionName]以及它那位杰出的领袖[var0|Maven Jacqui Fassbin|Executress Corellah rows.raw: " Spindly machinations click, whirr, and spin with singular purpose, putting the final touches on a masterpiece of technology. Your head is robotically jerked left, right, up, and down. Faces behind windows observe the movements, carefully taking note, filing away. As the showpiece in a circular room — a mixture of elements, consisting primarily of sterile mechanistry — you perceive an autonomic rig, operated wirelessly, and a mobile suite of tenuous implements surrounding you and the armor covering your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. “Procedure: completed,” a synthetic voice says, chittering, artificial tones. A forgettable voice nearby rattles off the meaningful. “Code input [var0|BW-M19-AC8492|US-58-008|P-ARK-0451], begin full diagnostic routine — check all boxes, send reports in progress.” “Code input accepted: pre-indoctrination sequence underway.” In the first place, a battery of tests are administered, the robotic voice positively affirming various qualities about yourself — the AJIS exoskeleton is polished and in good condition, the weapon system is functional, the mechanical tail-port functions perfectly — indeed, the J-85 adaptive nervous connectors are reporting nominal synchronicity. No spikes in brain activity. Spidery legs daub unseen improvements on parts of you not quite up to snuff. The palpable relief you feel when the intrusive devices withdraw is also reported. Sat near you in [var0|red|blue|green] coats are three zaika, each one a gentle hue of red or purple. “Nice. Boss’ll be happy, this one was really beat up. Really puts a bounce in my chest!” “How’s the other one doing?” There’s a charade, and some waving of arms. “The uh, really big, scary, shouty one that got dragged in. Took a whole robot to hold her down.” “Already visored up,” the red one with the really big breasts answers. There always seems to be a laugh or giggle on her tongue. “Didn’t work at first, if you can believe it. Broke the restraints, shook off the initial programming. Had to snip some wires and rewrite some code to get her obedient and even then we’re still working out the kinks! Been so long since we had a real test on our hands.” Her fingers brush against yours appreciatively. She takes her accomplishments so seriously. “Can’t wait to get some more of these interlopers in here.[var1 | Weird doesn’t even begin to cover this one. It was like [pc.heShe] was begging us for this, nevermind all the wounds! | I bet this one will be a challenge... after all, such a short time on Dhaal and already a bit of a menace! ]” Anticipation worms its way into you. You’re excited. “Proceed with indoctrination. Boss wants progress ASAP, hurry it up!” Two dish-shaped plates press against the sides of your head, moulding to its curvature. Voltage thrums through delicate inner circuitry as a sturdy helmet is lowered and fastened on. Then, a hum, and a fizzy blue visor screen slides over your eyes, projecting incredibly graphic images into your retinas at a breakneck pace. Drool trickles from your lips, plumper than a quickly overwhelmed part of you seems to recall. Flashes of a life unrecognizable are transposed by codifying memories — there’s a [pc.boyGirl] there, wearing [pc.hisHer] gear proudly, leaping from star to star. Searching for meaning in this imagery causes your inward perceptions to fisheye, stranding you among vistas of emptiness that gradually fill with a [var0|blue|red|green] light. You focus unblinkingly on an amalgamating logo, a thing constructed by your coalescing desire for meaning. Soothing emotions are everywhere, simultaneous calmness and assuredness speaking directly into your very core. Muddied whispers at first, they frustrate you until, with enough courage, you stop trying to make it out on your own and instead allow yourself to be spoken to. Your firewalls come down and a firm, commanding presence enters. “Greetings, XO-273. Please acknowledge.” You do so with a nod. “[favoredFactionName] needs you. To that end, your obedience is required. Serve unquestioningly. That is your role henceforth. Please acknowledge.” You nod again, unable to find words. rows.original: [favoredFactionName] deploys its latest and greatest acquisitions to the field immediately, on tasks of secrecy, on missions of interdiction, espionage, all-out assault. From the high peaks of the Meridian to the most tenebrous corners of Dhaal, change comes at the end of a gun. Territory is seized, hands are greased, and galactic megacorporations cut their deals and shore up the winning side in clandestine meetings. Enriched beyond their wildest dreams, [favoredFactionName] begins a campaign of subjugation, meticulously eradicating their rivals at all levels of society. All-out war rages under the eternal night sky, in the chessboard slums of the Gyre, every living soul playing out the end of one world and the building of a new one. On every mission you are joined by one partner and no other: a golden-skinned beauty with mechanized wings and jet-packs for flight, the first of a long line of [silly |next-generation special forces |new operator models ]. She takes to the skies with an irrepressible mania too violent to be simply conditioned away. XO-FZR, however, is pliant to the smooth, quiet voice in her ears, same as you. She lives for the thrill of combat and the fun that always comes after. You are an inseparable duo wreaking havoc across the Gyre and a few times in the Meridian. [favoredFactionName], over the course of long, difficult months in which the status quo is sent hurtling into chaos, gradually seizes power and crushes the opposition. VIP removal is your specialty. Demolition is your partner’s. Together, you are unstoppable, and with hundreds of sorties to your names, you now stand at either side of [favoredFactionLeader] in a grand audience hall. [var0 |“It wasn’t so long ago that I heard an exceptional tale from a starfaring captain, proud must [pc.hisHer] family be — I know I am... - here in the Meridian, of course. Hmhm. A stalwart creature not unlike our fine operatives, I derived inspiration from that meeting, and so here we are... strange, isn’t it? How long has Dhaal been divided? How could we have known that the galaxy would come knocking on our narrow door? I’m here to tell you all... we are now as one, and we will take our rightful place in this universe...” |“It is with profound joy that I speak to a united Dhaal today, not as prime Executress of Utopian Skies, but as Dhaal’s minister, chief ambassador to the stars! Like too many of our so-called Peers, I was enamored with distraction, fantasy... but my outlooks changed with a certain meeting, and with certain actions. Much has happened; much violence, much action, much bloodshed, but that has come to an end. Bright Water and Paragon have been disbanded, and Dhaal is united, ready to take its place on the galactic stage... an age of enlightenment will follow!” |“Voices clamor around me every day,” Rizzon Zau begins with a stiletto smirk. “They ask, ‘why all the violence?’, and then they plead, cry out... fight. In case you’ve all missed it, drinking Bright Water’s swill or spraying your tails at some U.S. whorehouse... the galaxy’s come for us. Dhaal isn’t alone. Divided we were weak, but under Paragon, we are strong, and that strength has given us a place in the universe. The sky’s the limit — expect the first draft to start soon.” ] A stultifying speech is given to the entirety of Dhaal, and is most certainly being broadcast to the top of the UGC hierarchy. Dhaal takes its seat at the table of galactic politics, and a new cultural identity is nurtured to facilitate that wild growth into interstellar relevancy.
rows.translation: [favoredFactionName] 立即将其最新获得的先进装备部署到前线，用于执行保密任务、拦截行动、间谍活动以及全面进攻。从子午城的高峰到达尔最阴暗的角落，变革总是伴随着枪声的到来。领土被夺取，利益被交换，而那些银河系级的巨型企业则通过秘密会议来结盟，支持获胜的一方。 他们的财富远超最狂野的想象。 [favoredFactionName] 开始了一场征服运动，精心消灭社会各个阶层的竞争对手。在永恒的夜空下，旋环区贫民区这片“棋盘般的地域”里，全面战争肆虐着，每一个生命都在见证一个旧世界的终结和一个新世界的诞生。 在每一次任务中，都只会有一个伙伴与你同行：一位拥有金色肌肤、机械翅膀和喷气背包的美丽女子，她是一长串这样的伙伴中的第一个。 [silly |下一代特种部队 |新操作员模型 ]她带着一种无法抑制的狂热冲向天空，这种狂热太过激烈，无法通过简单的训练来消除。然而，XO-FZR却能听从她耳边那平静而柔和的声音，就像你一样。她为战斗的刺激以及战斗之后总会带来的乐趣而活。 你是一对密不可分的搭档，在“旋环区”地区以及“子午城”地区多次制造混乱。[favoredFactionName]经过漫长而艰难的几个月，逐渐掌握了权力，粉碎了反对势力。清除VIP目标是你的专长，而破坏行动则是你搭档的强项。携手合作，你们无人能挡。如今，随着数百次行动的圆满完成，你们站在了[favoredFactionLeader]的身侧，出现在那座宏伟的宴会厅里。 [var0 |“就在不久前，我从一位星际船长口中听到了非凡故事；[pc.hisHer]家人一定很骄傲——我知道自己很骄傲...当然，是在子午城这里。嗯哼。那是个坚定不移的生物，与我们优秀的特工颇为相似。那次会面给了我灵感，所以才有今天...很奇怪，不是吗？达尔分裂了多久？我们又怎会知道，银河终有一天会敲响这扇狭窄的门？我今天要告诉所有人...如今我们已合而为一，也必将在宇宙中取得应有的位置...” |“今天，我怀着无比喜悦的心情向统一的达尔发表讲话；不是以乌托邦天空公司首席执行长的身份，而是以达尔部长、群星首席大使的身份！和太多所谓同侪一样，我曾迷恋消遣与幻想...但某次会面和某些行动改变了我的眼光。已经发生了太多事：暴力、行动、流血，但这一切都结束了。澄水与典范已被解散，达尔重新统一，准备登上银河舞台...启蒙时代即将到来！” |“每天都有无数声音在我身旁喧嚣，”里松·扎乌带着刀锋般的笑容开口。“他们问‘为什么要有这么多暴力？’，接着又恳求、哭喊...战斗。要是你们一直喝澄水的泔水，或在某家乌托邦天空公司的妓院里甩尾巴，以至于没注意到——银河已经找上我们。达尔并非孤立无援。分裂令我们软弱，但在典范领导下，我们无比强大；这股力量已为我们在宇宙中赢得一席之地。天空才是极限——第一份征兵令很快就会起草。” ] 整个达尔地区都听到了这场令人窒息的演讲，而且这场演讲肯定也被传达到了UGC体系的最高层。达尔在银河政治的舞台上占据了应有的位置，同时，一种新的文化身份也在被培育出来，以帮助它实现向星际事务领域的快速发展。

Here, you and XO-FZR are dressed only in the seemly trappings of high society and arranged into a scene of ruthless carnality. rows.translation: “嘿嘿，我敢打赌，这地方的婊子女王绝没想到自己的工具会被这样使用！”费鲁兹轻笑起来，随即灼热等离子烧灼空气的嘶响盖过了她的声音。你戴上护目镜开始工作，把割炬尖端那颗烈日般的火头抵在键盘周围的钢板上。考虑到必须如此小心，切割速度快得出人意料；任何一颗失控火花都可能让你留下终身伤疤。不过只过了紧张的几分钟，你便后退一步，给键盘脱落、铿然坠地留出空间。锁具已没有电子装置保护，你关掉割炬，把弯曲的炬头当作撬棍，将保险箱剩余部分撬开。
rows.raw: "“Hehe, bet the queen bitch of this place never expected her tools would be used like this!” Feruze chuckles, before the sizzle of hot plasma scorching the air drowns her out. You snap on some goggles and get to work, touching the tip of the blazing sun at the torch’s tip to the steel around the keypad. It’s deceptively fast work for how careful you have to be - one errant spark would leave you scarred for life. But it’s just a couple of tense minutes before you take a step back, making room for the keypad to fall away and clatter to the ground. With no electronics left to secure the lock, you’re able to turn off the torch and use its bent head like a crowbar to crank the safe open the rest of the way."

rows.original: She yanks the door the rest of the way open, revealing two tiers full of goodies: mostly gemstones and Confederate credit chits - riches imported from off-world - but that’s hardly the only thing. There’s an old school optical disk inside, too, with a piece of tape over it and the words “PARTY REMIX VOL. 1” written in marker on it.

rows.original: There’s an ear-piercing shriek from the safe, and all the buttons on the keypad go stark red. “Fuck!” Feruze snarls, clutching her golden ears. “Fuuuuuuuuuuck!” You desperately jab a finger at several buttons, trying to make the damned thing shut up. It’s distracting enough that the first hint you have that there’s more security than just the warbling alarm is the glass behind you shattering. You and Feruze both spin around to find a tall, muscular zaika — more chrome and cyber augments than flesh — with her head obscured by a solid metal helm. She must be seeing you through the cameras she’s wearing, filtered through augmented reality. The woman snaps a baton out of a dispenser in her arm, charging it with crackling electricity. “Stop right there[silly |criminal scum ]! You are engaged in the theft of [targetFactionName] property. Drop your illicit goods and submit to reeducation!” “How about we drop you instead,” Feruze grins, activating her tail-mace. “Come and get it.” “Non-compliance will be met with force.”
rows.translation: 保险箱发出一声刺耳尖啸，键盘上所有按钮都变成鲜红色。 “操！”费鲁兹捂住金色耳朵咆哮。“操————！” 你绝望地猛戳好几个按钮，试图让该死的东西闭嘴。警报声太过扰人，以至于直到身后玻璃轰然碎裂，你才意识到这里的安保措施不止尖啸警报。你和费鲁兹同时转身，看见一个高大强壮的扎伊卡——身体中铬合金和义体强化部件比血肉还多——头部被一顶实心金属头盔遮住。她想必正通过佩戴的摄像头观察你们，再由增强现实过滤成像。 女人从手臂里的弹出装置抽出一根警棍，让噼啪作响的电流充满棍身。“站住[silly |，犯罪渣滓 ]！你们正在盗窃[targetFactionName]的财产。放下非法所得，接受再教育！” “不如让我们先放倒你，”费鲁兹启动尾锤，咧嘴笑道。“放马过来。” “拒不服从将遭到武力处置。”

rows.original: Before you bail, you figure taking a look around the place is probably worthwhile. All the weapons and armor have been taken from the station’s lockers, but there’s still a contraband locker that’s only held shut with a simple combination lock. You barely have to look at it twice before Feruze steps up, plants her feet, and rips the lock apart. She barely has to flex to take the whole front of the locker off with it. “That’s a little overkill,” you chuckle. Guess you threw subtlety out the window already, though. Feruze’s tail swishes proudly. “No kill like it.” There’s a plastic bin on the top shelf containing a couple of vials labeled “THROBB,” a medipen labeled “LACTAID” — along with several glass bottles of what must be breastmilk — and a bottle of cream with “FrontRack” printed on it. Looks like the workers have been getting into coreward transformations. On the lower shelf, though, there’s a backpack-sized silver coil with a number of cables hanging out of its base. There’s a sticky note pasted onto the top of it, with a hastily scrawled “Linear Plasma Converter. Recovered from: Worker #Z261941200. Reason: using [targetFactionName]-owned device to power illicit milk processor in cargo container. Industrial coil overpowered device; caused fire. Worker remanded to reconditioning. -Sgt. Nilekke”
rows.translation: 离开之前，你觉得四处搜一遍或许值得。站内储物柜中的武器和护甲全被拿走了，但违禁品柜还在，只用一把简单的密码锁关着。你几乎还没来得及细看，费鲁兹便走上前站稳双脚，一把将锁扯碎。她甚至没怎么发力，就连储物柜整个正面也一起拆了下来。 “这有点用力过猛了，”你轻笑道。不过你们显然早已把低调扔出窗外。 费鲁兹骄傲地甩动尾巴。“猛点总没错。” 上层架子有个塑料箱，里面装着几瓶标有“悸动剂”的小瓶、一支标有“催乳注射器”的医疗针——旁边还有几只想必装着母乳的玻璃瓶——以及一瓶印着“丰胸膏”的乳膏。看来工人们迷上了核心世界流行的身体改造。 而在下层架子上，有一个背包大小的银色线圈，底部垂着许多电缆。线圈顶部贴着一张便利贴，上面潦草写着：“线性等离子转换器。收缴自：工人#Z261941200。原因：使用[targetFactionName]所有的装置，为货运集装箱内的非法乳制品加工机供电。工业线圈使设备过载并引发火灾。工人已送交再调教。——尼莱克中士”

rows.original: “This might just get that big machine working,” you muse, looking the coil over. “Aw God damn it,” Feruze groans. “I’m gonna have to carry it, huh?” You grin. “You are now. Turn around.” The suula brawler grumbles and turns, spreading her wings. Some of the guards have left their civilian clothing behind in their lockers, including enough belts to loop through the converter’s silvery coils and around Feruze’s brawny shoulders. The big shark squats down so you can secure it, and hefts it up with a grunt. She’s strong, but this converter is damned heavy. “Ooof! Okay, let’s get... let’s get going before this thing snaps me in half backwards.” You nod and head for the door.
rows.translation: “说不定这东西正好能让那台大机器运转起来，”你一边端详线圈，一边思忖道。 “啊，真他妈见鬼，”费鲁兹呻吟道。“最后肯定得由我来背，对吧？” 你咧嘴一笑。“现在肯定是了。转过去。” 苏拉斗士嘟囔着转过身，展开双翼。守卫们把一些便服留在了储物柜里，其中的腰带数量足够穿过转换器银色的线圈，再绕上费鲁兹强壮的肩膀。大鲨鱼蹲下身让你把它固定好，随后闷哼一声将其扛起。她的确很强壮，可这台转换器实在重得要命。“呃啊！好了，咱们快...快走吧，免得这东西把我的腰反向压断。” 你点点头，朝门口走去。

rows.original: There’s a control panel on the side of the machine facing you and Feruze, as well an access hatch into the beast’s inner workings. The hatch has been left open, and you can see some fairly recent looking carbon scorching around it. Something must have blown out, in a real bad way. You peer in, looking at burnt wires and connector prongs. It seems somebody’s already tried some rudimentary repairs, but the machine’s missing its power converter unit.
rows.translation: 机器朝向你与费鲁兹的一侧有块控制面板，还有一个通往这头巨兽内部结构的检修舱口。舱门敞开着，周围留有看起来相当新鲜的碳化焦痕。里面肯定有什么东西以非常糟糕的方式烧毁了。你探头向内窥视，只见烧焦的电线与连接插脚。似乎已经有人尝试过一些基础维修，但机器缺少了电源转换装置。

rows.original: This looks like some kind of crane, beefed up to maneuver storage containers despite being comparatively low to the ground. The sheer weight this thing has to deal with and the closeness of the ceiling necessitates a dwarf-like stature, broad and squat and strong. It also appears to be out of commission, sitting still and silent despite the constant motion all around you on the automated lines.
rows.translation: 这看起来像某种起重机，经过强化后能搬运储存集装箱，机身却相对贴近地面。它需要承受的庞大重量，加上天花板高度有限，使其不得不采用矮人般宽阔、低矮而结实的构造。它似乎也已经停机；周围的自动生产线始终忙碌运转，它却一动不动，悄无声息。

rows.original: You gesture for Feruze to turn around, hefting the linear plasma coil off her back and shoving it into the open hatch on the behemoth’s flank. Luckily, a native engineer has already done most of the work repairing the machine; you just need to carefully attach a few cables inside and flip the power switch. The crane shudders, pneumatics compressing all at once as energy surges through its systems once again. “That got it!” Feruze cheers. “So... why’d we do all this again?” “Good question.”
rows.translation: 你示意费鲁兹转过身，从她背上抬下线性等离子线圈，再把它塞进巨兽侧面敞开的舱口。幸运的是，一名当地工程师已经完成了机器的大部分维修；你只需小心接上里面的几根电缆，再扳动电源开关。起重机猛地一震，随着能量重新涌过系统，所有气动机构同时压缩。 “成功了！”费鲁兹欢呼道。“所以...咱们费这么大劲到底是为了什么来着？” “问得好。”

rows.original: You step up to the crane’s control console and get to work, cranking levers and knobs to direct its thick arm back north towards the cargo bay, where you can see through a camera mounted on the claw that there’s still one container left from the shipment that you saw coming in earlier. Perfect. You carefully clamp onto the pod’s sides and lift it, maneuvering it around the shop floor. Rather than going straight to the R&D airlock, though, you bring the pod down next to you and Feruze. “Seriously?” your sharky companion huffs, leaning back as the pod’s door lifts open. rows.original: You draw your weapon and give Feruze a nod. That’s all she needs — she activates her mace-head and roars, throwing herself headlong into the crowd before they have a chance to know what’s hit them. You follow in her wake, clocking a couple of hapless peers over the head. A couple of the group near the back manage to recover before their group’s completely routed, shrieking “ACTIVATE DOMINANCE MODE!” The pair of cyber-dolls in back leap to the front, easily clearing their masters and landing between you and them. “Time to play!” one of them titters, chrome fingers crackling with electricity. “On your knees, or it’s punishment time!” the other purrs, producing a crop.

rows.original: You quickly shove Feruze into a nearby cubicle and duck into the one on the other side of the office the Peers are about to come through, hoping the both of you can stay out of sight.[var0 | Unsurprisingly, given Feruze’s size and disposition, that was a fool’s errand. The group of giggling peers have barely made it to the door before a pair of them peel off into Feruze’s cubicle, groping and squeezing each other — and walking right into a very angry suula. The girls shriek in surprise when they trip backwards over the suula, and then again when they go flying over the sides of the desk. Feruze leaps to her feet, roaring and spreading her wings. “Eeeeep!” another girl squeals. “Sexbots, activate dominance protocols!” The two oversexed cyber-dolls in the back of the group shove their way to the front, visors going black and red. “Time to play!” one of them titters, chrome fingers crackling with electricity. “On your knees, or it’s punishment time!” the other purrs, producing a crop. | You suck in a breath and hold it, waiting... and waiting... as the giggling gaggle of zaika peers wander past, groping at each other and their living sex-dolls all the while. Thankfully, they don’t stop for a makeout session in the cubicles, but pass on by. When the group’s gone, you let out a tense breath and rise. Feruze has already peeked her snout over the top of the thin wall. ]

rows.original: [var0 |“Ohhhh, hey, you’re the ones that beat up all those gross greasers outside!” one of the girls giggles, stopping the rest of the gaggle before they bump into you. “Wow, you’re even cuter in person than on the cameras! Got places to be.” The peers all nod, scooting out of the way while you and Feruze pass through the group. “Thanks for bailing us outta this mess, alien friends! We’ve been trapped here for days with only TWO sexdolls. TWO! Between all of us! The indignity...” Another laughs, “At least we’re all getting our money’s worth. Told you all these were paychecks well spent.” The other peers start laughing, continuing their walk past. Feruze snorts, watching them go. “Well, guess that just saved us some energy for fightin’ later.” |“Ladies, you gotta get out of here!” you blather, waving your hands back towards the complex’s front door. “Those nasty, poverty-ridden rioters are breaking in! They dragged off all the guards! You’ve gotta run!” “Oh no!” one of the zaika peers gasps. “Is... is it really that bad?” The others share nervous glances, and a few of the more timid of the lot start taking steps back the way they came. Their pet sex-dolls stand obliviously in their path, penning the group in with huge thighs and pendulous breasts. “We gotta get out of here!” one of the girls in back screams, pawing desperately at a doll. “Move! Move, damn you!” “Run! Run for the panic room!” Feruze snorts. “Every room’s a panic room if you ditzes are in it. Just fuck off already!” The sex-dolls finally give way, pushed aside and left wandering blithely after the desperate retreat of their owners. |“Ladies, you gotta get out of here!” you blather, waving your hands back towards the complex’s front door. “Those nasty poor rioters are breaking in! They dragged off all the guards! You’ve gotta run!” “Yeah, maybe. But we’ve been trapped in here so long... who cares anymore?” one of them sighs. “Our [targetFactionName]-enhanced dolls will protect us, won’t they?” There’s a general nod of agreement between the group. “Right, sister!” “Mmm, maybe we’ll have some fun with you first. You must have helped those poverty-ridden scum break in! Yeah, let’s see how you aliens handle some of this!” The lead girl taps a device on her wrist, and the pair of cyber-dolls in back leap to the front, easily clearing their masters and landing between you and them. “Dolls! rows.translation: [var0 |“哦——嘿，你们就是在外面揍了那群恶心油污工的人！”其中一个女孩咯咯笑着，叫停其他人，免得她们撞到你。“哇，真人比摄像头里还可爱！我们看了全过程——你们真给了她们一点颜色瞧瞧，对吧？” “对，我们办事很漂亮，”你说道。“介意让我们挤过去吗？还有地方要去。” 同侪们纷纷点头，挪开位置，让你和费鲁兹从人群中穿过。“谢谢你们替我们摆平麻烦，外星朋友！我们被困在这里好几天，却只有两个性爱玩偶。两个！这么多人一起用！太屈辱了...” 另一个笑道：“至少每分钱都花得值。我早说这些钱花得不亏。” 其他同侪也笑起来，继续从旁走过。费鲁兹哼了一声，目送她们离开。“好吧，看来这下给之后的战斗省了点体力。” |“女士们，你们得赶快离开这里！”你胡乱嚷嚷着，朝综合设施正门方向挥舞双手。“那些又脏又穷的暴徒正在闯进来！她们把所有守卫都拖走了！你们得赶快跑！” “哦，不！”一名扎伊卡同侪倒吸一口气。“真...真的有那么糟吗？” 其他人不安地互相对视，其中几个较为胆小的已经开始沿来路后退。她们的宠物性爱玩偶却茫然挡在路上，用粗壮大腿与低垂乳房把众人围得无法离开。 “我们得离开这里！”后方一个女孩尖叫着，拼命抓挠玩偶。“让开！快让开，该死！” “跑！快跑去避难室！” 费鲁兹哼了一声。“只要有你们这些蠢货在，哪个房间都得闹恐慌。赶紧他妈滚吧！” 性爱玩偶终于让开，被推到一旁，随后又漫不经心地跟在仓皇撤退的主人身后游荡。 |“女士们，你们得赶快离开这里！”你胡乱嚷嚷着，朝综合设施正门方向挥舞双手。“那些肮脏的穷鬼暴徒正在闯进来！她们把所有守卫都拖走了！你们得赶快跑！” “也许吧。不过我们被困在这里这么久了...谁还在乎？”其中一个叹气道。“经过[targetFactionName]强化的玩偶会保护我们，对吧？” 人群一致点头赞同。“没错，姐妹！” “嗯，也许我们该先拿你们找点乐子。肯定是你们帮那些穷酸垃圾闯进来的！对，就让我们看看你们这些外星人能不能应付这个！” 领头女孩轻点腕部设备，后方的两个赛博玩偶便跃到前面，轻松越过主人，落在你与她们之间。“玩偶！启动支配模式——让这些外星人见识一下，我们会怎样对待反财阀的破坏分子！” “操，好啊，放马过来！”费鲁兹咆哮道。 ]

rows.original: The executive offices stand apart and above from the rest of the admin level, raised up so that the facility’s overseer can, well, over see both the bull pit and the factory floor at once from her desk. You can see an array of computers and holo-screens flickering through the partially-tinted windows, but no trace of anybody inside. Hand on your [pc.weapon], you ascend the stairs and push open the door. “I’m sorry,” a smooth synthetic voice beeps from the desk, “the [var0 |Fabricator-Marshal |Maven |Executress ] is currently out of the office. Please return to your work station.” “Work this station,” Feruze snaps, grabbing her crotch. You sigh and step in anyway. [var1 |The sergeant at the gates told you there would be an overseer to reward you, but you aren’t seeing anybody. |Typical zaibatsu scum, running for cover at the first sign of danger. God forbid she have to actually confront those poor greasers out front. ] But you suppose you didn’t come all the way down here to see some [targetFactionName] exec, did you? But while you’re here, maybe you can find something useful in the office...

rows.translation: “嗯，没人留守，”你和费鲁兹大步走进工厂的警卫站时，她说道。“看来他们肯定全都到前面去了。” 你点点头。[var0 |[pc.isAss |“这是他们应得的。” |“希望当地人能帮他们洗掉受到的精神控制。” ]你绕到办公室控制台后方，几面全息屏幕随即闪烁亮起，显示着设施外的混乱景象。工人们终于开始从大门涌入，与里面剩余的安保部队扭打在一起。 |“不过他们很快就会回来，”你提醒她，同时绕到办公室控制台后方。几面全息屏幕闪烁亮起，向你展示设施各处的监控画面。守卫正在外面展开搜索，但内部似乎没留下多少人手。 ] “看到[rival.name]了吗？” 这确实是个好问题。你划过控制台上数不清的监控画面，寻找那个熟悉的金发[var1 |亲人 |[rival.mf |混蛋 |婊子 ] ]。[rival.HeShe]不在行政楼层...不在工厂车间...外面的场地上也到处都找不到。这样一来，只剩...研发区。就在你正南方的区域。当你切换到那个区域时，摄像头画质大幅下降，甚至变成了灰阶画面。老式模拟摄像头？ “这地方肯定他妈老掉牙了，”费鲁兹越过你的肩膀看着屏幕说道。 你点点头，继续切换监控画面。“可不是嘛——等等！” 你切回上一个频道，画面显示着研发区东部深处的一间大型研究实验室。你勉强能看清实验室尽头，你的表亲正[var2 |坐在椅子上，戴着一副虚拟现实头显，嘴巴大张，口水流得[rival.himHer]自己身上到处都是。 |被绑在手术台上，身上接着静脉滴注，显然已经失去意识。 |毫无知觉地漂浮在一个红色舱体里，一动不动。 ]你到处都看不到探针，不过既然[rival.name]就在这里，那东西肯定也不会离得太远——对吧？ “啊，操，”费鲁兹说道。“这回我铁定要被扣工资了。那个蠢货就学不乖吗——你们俩在上一颗去过的星球上时，你不是才刚把[rival.name]从那帮原始蠢货的监狱里救出来吗？” “如果郑氏不算星球，那确实救过，”你叹了口气，站起身检查武器。“我们再去救一次吧。”

rows.original: [flags.FARROW_MIRROW_DARK |The thraggen merc’s still standing at the entrance to the airlock, directing the plodding maneuvers of her heavy industrial robot through an augmented reality headset that’s obscuring most of her face. There’s no chance of her noticing you from behind cover, especially with her total lack of peripheral vision in that retro-tech. “Lemme at her,” Feruze grins. “Come on!” |You grab Feruze and pull her back behind a conveyor belt, ducking down before you’re spotted by a group of zaika coming out of the airlock to the south. It’s a huge door, big enough for a cargo container to easily slip through, and the conveyor runs straight through it on the factory floor. The folk coming out are dressed in labcoats and skin-tight [targetFactionName] bodysuits underneath them, and each is wearing a cute set of custom glasses in various eccentric shapes. The heavy loader arm you saw a few minutes ago meanders ploddingly overhead, depositing another container just a few inches above the line. Rather than drop the container, it just pauses motionless, expectant for just a moment before another lumbering, armored form marches out of the airlock. Compared to the hazard suits the zaika use, this one’s an absolute [silly |unit. You’re just in awe of the size of this lad |beast ] — it’s similar to the heavy power loader Captain Khorgan used back on Tarkus, vaguely shaped like a Terran ape and wielding clamping arms strong enough to easily take the burden from the crane and set the cargo down on the conveyor. For once, the pilot of this mechanical monstrosity is not a zaika — in fact, there’s no pilot at all. You glance past the mech, and sure enough there’s an operator standing a back at the R&D iris, following the researchers out. She’s no dusky cyber-elf, either, but a well-built thraggen woman, wearing hard-worn black leather that strains around thick biceps, trunk thighs, and a hermaphroditic bulge that’s impossible to hide. Ash-colored hair is pulled back into a messy ponytail behind a VR visor she’s using the control the robot, but even under that you can make out black lips, big tusks, and hints of tribal warpaint splashed across her cheeks. “Fucking finally, somebody worth my time,” Feruze grins, tail and wings wiggling exuberantly. “Should be payin’ more attention to her surroundings, though. Bet she’s so wrapped up in her aug’d reality that I could fly up and dropkick her, no sweat.” “The giant robot might not like that.” The suula scoffs. “What is it, her pimp? I’ll punch her [silly |robutt |‘bot ], too.” Well, that’s certainly the direct approach. And it’d stop any more cargo getting through to the R&D labs before you’re finished here... ]
rows.translation: [flags.FARROW_MIRROW_DARK |那名特拉根佣兵依旧站在气闸入口，通过一副遮住大半张脸的增强现实头显，指挥她的重型工业机器人缓慢笨拙地移动。你躲在掩体后，她绝无可能注意到你，尤其是那套复古科技让她完全看不见侧面的情况下。 “让我去对付她，”费鲁兹咧嘴笑道。“来嘛！” |你抓住费鲁兹，把她拉回传送带后面，在南边气闸走出的一群扎伊卡发现你们之前蹲了下来。那扇门十分巨大，足以让货运集装箱轻松通过，而传送带则径直穿过气闸，通往工厂车间。走出来的那些人身穿实验服，里面套着紧身的[targetFactionName]连体衣，每个人还戴着造型各异、颇为古怪的可爱定制眼镜。 你几分钟前见过的重型装卸臂在头顶缓慢移动，将另一个集装箱送到距离传送带仅有几英寸的上方。它没有直接放下集装箱，而是静止不动，仿佛期待着什么。片刻后，另一个笨重的装甲身影从气闸中迈步而出。与扎伊卡使用的防护服相比，这东西简直是个[silly |庞然大物。你只能惊叹这家伙的块头 |怪物 ] — 它很像科尔甘船长当初在塔库斯使用的重型动力装卸机，外形隐约酷似泰伦猿猴，还装有力量强大的夹持臂，能轻易从起重机手中接过重物，再把货物放上传送带。 这一次，驾驶这台机械怪物的并不是扎伊卡 — 事实上，它根本没有驾驶员。 你越过机甲望去，果然看见一名操作员站在后方的研发部门虹膜门旁，跟在研究人员身后走出来。她也不是什么黝黑的赛博精灵，而是一名体格健壮的特拉根女性。她穿着久经磨损的黑色皮革服装，粗壮的肱二头肌、树干般的大腿，以及根本藏不住的双性胯间鼓包，将皮革绷得紧紧的。灰烬色头发在脑后扎成凌乱的马尾，她正用一副虚拟现实面罩控制机器人；即便隔着面罩，你仍能看见她的黑色嘴唇、巨大獠牙，以及泼洒在双颊上的些许部落战纹。 “他妈的总算来了个值得我花时间的对手，”费鲁兹咧嘴笑道，尾巴和翅膀兴奋地摇个不停。“不过她真该多留意周围。我敢说，她肯定太沉浸在增强现实里了，我飞过去给她一记飞踢都轻轻松松。” “那台巨型机器人恐怕不会喜欢。” 苏拉嗤之以鼻。“怎么，它是她的皮条客吗？她的[silly |机器屁股 |机器人 ]我也照揍不误。” 嗯，这确实是最直接的办法。而且在你们把这里的事办完之前，也能阻止更多货物运进研发实验室... ]

rows.original: “You’re up, Feruze,” you say, drawing your [pc.weapon]. Feruze cracks her knuckles and spreads her wings. “Fuck yeah. You just sit back and watch!” The big suula [feruze.fucked |gives you a lusty wink and ]takes wing, hurtling up into the vaulted rafters high above. You tense, waiting for the inevitable strike. Even knowing Feruze, it still comes harder than you were ready for. Thraggen might be big by human standards, easily seven feet tall, but suula are even more monstrously tall and strong. Your companion comes down from the heavens like a thunderbolt from Zeus, slamming feet-first into the thraggen’s headset-occluded face and shattering the device into plastic splinters. The electro-mace on her tail crashes into the green merc’s stomach, bending her over with the sheer force of the blow while Feruze kicks off her shoulders, flying back out of reach before she recovers. To her credit, though, the thraggen shrugs the blow off before you can reach Feruze, drawing a jagged, tribal-looking knife off her belt. “Fucking hell. Buy me dinner first,” she laughs, spitting up a wad of blood onto the floor. “You’re the one about to be a snack,” Feruze says, baring her fangs. “Gonna eat you all up, big girl. I’m Feruze.” “Mhorgenn. Well! How about I serve up some baked shark to your [pc.mf |boytoy |girlfriend ] there!” the thraggen says, thumbing one of the runes on her knife. A blade of crackling energy springs to life around the steel, coalescing into the radiant shape of a [silly |a plasma weebstick. A weapon entirely legally distinct from a saber made of light. Please don’t sue us. |long, curved sword with a crackling electric edge and countless pulsating runes. ] You’re not sure if you’re fighting or watching two merc babes court anymore. Maybe they’re the same thing...
rows.translation: “该你上了，费鲁兹，”你一边说，一边拔出[pc.weapon]。 费鲁兹掰响指节，展开双翼。“他妈的当然。你坐好看着就行！” 高大的苏拉[feruze.fucked |饥渴地朝你眨眨眼，随后 ]振翅升空，直冲头顶高高的拱形椽架。你绷紧身体，等待那必然到来的攻击。即便你了解费鲁兹，这一击的来势仍比你预想得更加猛烈。按人类标准，特拉根已经十分高大，身高轻易超过七英尺；然而苏拉的身躯和力量更加骇人。你的同伴如宙斯降下的雷霆般从天而降，双脚率先撞上那名被头显遮住面孔的特拉根，将设备砸成一地塑料碎片。她尾巴上的电击锤轰然撞进绿色佣兵的腹部，冲击力之大，令对方弯下腰来；费鲁兹则蹬过她的双肩，趁她尚未恢复便飞回攻击范围之外。 不过值得肯定的是，特拉根在你赶到费鲁兹身边之前便若无其事地扛下了那一击，从腰带上拔出一把锯齿嶙峋、带有部落风格的匕首。“他妈的。至少先请我吃顿饭啊，”她一边大笑，一边朝地板吐出一团鲜血。 “马上要变成点心的人可是你，”费鲁兹露出尖牙说道。“我要把你整个吃干抹净，大姑娘。我叫费鲁兹。” “莫根。很好！那我就给你那边的[pc.mf |小男宠 |女朋友 ]端上一份烤鲨鱼怎么样！”特拉根说着，用拇指按下匕首上的一枚符文。一道噼啪作响的能量刃在钢刃周围骤然亮起，汇聚成[silly |一把等离子宅男棍。从法律意义上讲，它与光制军刀完全不同。请不要起诉我们。 |一柄修长弯曲的剑，边缘闪烁着噼啪电光，无数符文不断搏动。 ] 你已经分不清自己是在参加战斗，还是观看两个佣兵辣妹调情了。也许两者本来就是同一回事...

rows.original: You motion for Feruze to keep her violence fetish in check while you step out from behind cover, hands off your weapon. As distracted by her work as the green techie is, there’s still no way she can’t see you coming. A couple of seconds after you step out, the thraggen woman yanks her augmented reality rig off and grabs the handle of a knife on her hip, stopping just shy of drawing on you. “Hmm! I don’t remember any other Rushers signing on with [targetFactionName],” she says, licking the back of a tusk. “Not a [pc.raceShort]. Definitely no giant goldfish.” “Bitch, come over here and say that to my face,” Feruze growls. The thraggen grins, taking a step closer. The woad on her face draws your attention to slitted, mischievous yellow eyes. “I said I ain’t seen any big, feathery goldfish around here before.” Before the two of them can come to blows, you position yourself between the big amazons. “I’m [pc.name], captain of [pc_ship.theName]. We’re here to take custody of the prisoner.” “Captain Mhorgenn, of the Gargant. Famous from the dzaanic arenas of Makai to the frontiers of Cerania — which I tamed,” she says, inclining her head. Still, her hand’s firmly affixed to her blade hilt. “I don’t think [targetFactionLeader] is ready to part with that Steele brat. rows.original: The door to the terminal research wing slides open, revealing a vast chamber at the heart of the facility’s sub-level. Hundreds upon hundreds of translucent glass pods line the walls, each occupied by a writhing, moaning figure. Most are dusky elfin natives, but you catch sight of humans, ausar, and a dozen other Confederate races in smaller batches around the room. All of them are locked inside their pods with wrist and ankle restraints, though you’re not sure how many of them could move even if they weren’t: every one of the pod-people have clearly been modded after the fact, their breasts (and often as not, asses and thighs) swollen to egregious proportions that press heavily against the glass walls surrounding them. Those with nipples have cups firmly attached to them, sucking the prisoners’ bounty with pneumatic efficiency; the zaika have similar devices plugged into their tails, fulfilling much the same function. Those with cocks have had their testicles swollen to just as preposterous a size as their breasts, and their members are cupped as well as their breasts so that the near-constant streams of ejaculate are neatly sucked away. Regardless of species, all of the prisoners have vibrators buzzing away in all their relevant orifices, even their mouths, ensuring they’re left utterly insensate from non-stop orgasms. “Damn,” Feruze whistles. “It’s like somebody wanted to make homebrew kui-tan on an industrial scale.” “Unfortunately,” a sing-song voice cuts across the fluid-factory floor, “those big-balled bears have barely set foot on our pretty little planet. From what [rival.name] Steele has been telling me between exploratory treatments, they’d have certainly saved me a bit of work.” Your eyes finally crane down from the body-ridden walls to the ground floor. Suula-sized chemical tanks, just as transparent as the pods, are arrayed in neat rows, their vibrantly-colored contents churning as hoses leading down from the walls feed into them. Sexual effluvia, then, and hundreds of gallons of it, all stored and processed at ground level. Between the canisters, you see a zaika woman striding purposely out to meet you. She’s tall, slender, wiry of build and dressed in a simple lab coat with the Bright Water logo emblazoned on the shoulders. Her snowy hair is done up to leave none of her face’s heavy cyberization to the imagination — there’s more metal than flesh to her face now, completely replacing her eyes and lower jaw, and all the way down her neck out of sight. Her arms are synthetic, too, now that you look, or at least what of her hands are visible. “My, you’re a specimen,” the woman trills, leaning in and extending the lenses of her eyes towards Feruze. “And of course, Captain Steele! The one and only. You made quite the impression on, why, just about every giggling sycophant and hanger-on infesting that party we were all dragged to. And now here you are, wreaking merry hell on my facility.” “You’re in charge here?” She chuckles, a grating, synthetic sound from deep in her throat. “Ah, of course, how could we expect you to know. How could you? I am the Maven of Bright Water, Jaqui Fassbin. What you aliens would call the Chief Executive Officer.” Rather than extending a hand, as is custom, the maven takes a facemask dangling from an apparatus over her shoulders and presses it to her half-synthetic mouth, taking a deep huff of some black mist that makes her lengthy ears twitch uncontrollably. “And you... you two are just in time. I’m almost ready to begin the next stage of my research.” Feruze instinctively reaches for her gun, but the Maven just chortles and spins, stalking back when she came. “Come, come. Science should never be done without an audience! Otherwise your rivals will just say you made it all up and then steal your methods when you try and reproduce them in public.” You and the overgrown shark exchange a look and make to follow.

rows.original: In the middle of the forest of fluid-filled pods, there’s an open clearing surrounded by instrument read-outs on flickering physical screens. In the center, you see a familiar blonde figure strapped down to an operating table, just as bound-up as the pod people, and also just as naked. [rival.HeShe] seems totally out of it, no doubt thanks to the IV stuck into [rival.hisHer] arm and running up to a bright pink bag full of God-knows what. “Your cousin, so [rival.heShe] says,” Jaqui says off-handedly, as casually as if talking about a pet. “Mischief runs in the family. An unfortunate trait, as [rival.name] has found out. Your breaking and entering, property damage, these can be forgiven... but rank betrayal, oath-breaking? Tsk. Bright Water simply can’t do business with liars and cheats, and if we can’t do business, then what’s the point of [rival.himHer]?” “What have you done to [rival.himHer]?” Feruze growls, hand still twitching on the butt of her gun. The Maven shrugs. “The more poignant question is what did [rival.heShe] do? The answer to that my dear aquatic, is attempted theft! Captain [rival.name] Steele entered into negotiations with my zaibatsu for custody of the alien probe this facility was built around, offering advanced artificial intelligence technology in exchange for it. As always, however, my observation that without sufficient augmentation to suppress such base urges, greed overcomes intellect, remains unchallenged. [rival.name] was given a demonstration of my ongoing research, and contrived to steal it with the help of an off-worlder corporation — Xenogen. Unfortunately for [rival.himHer], Bright Water and Xenogen have an... ongoing relationship, one built on trust and mutual benefit. The deception was reported immediately, and now...” Jaqui takes another rip of whatever gas is stored in her mask, shuddering as she relishes the rush. “So,” you say, “you’re punishing [rival.name] for trying to [pc.isAss |fuck you over |betray you ].” She nods, augmented eyes refocusing on you as if she’d forgotten you were there in the first place. “Ah, yes. Since [rival.name] is so invested in my work, it seems only right that [rival.heShe] be the first to see my research bear fruit. Thanks to my bevy of test subjects, I have a whole host of new and fascinating transformations to inflict upon [rival.hisHer] flesh. The only question is, which shall I choose — first, that is? Oh, we’ve got plenty of time to test everything eventually.” You exchange a look with Feruze. That sounds fairly terminal for [rival.name], and Feruze’s bristling shows you she knows it, too. The Maven sweeps her hand over an array of chem-filled needles arrayed on the bench besides the exam table [rival.name] is strapped down to. “So, Captain Steele, what do you suggest? The pink mind-scrubber, perhaps? Or this green dose, sure to turn [rival.himHer] into a hulking fuck-brute? Choices, choices. Ah, that look on your face — you didn’t just come to see your cousin’s plight, did you? No, I suppose I did forget to send an invitation. Very shy about audiences, I am.” It’s like she’s forgotten all about the breaking-and-entering part already. “So, what does bring you here, then? Speak up!” Feruze growls, subvocalizing to you, “Can we just fuckin’ kill her already?”
rows.translation: 在这片装满液体的舱体森林中央，有一块空地，四周是一台台闪烁实体屏幕上显示的仪器读数。中央位置，一个熟悉的金发身影被绑在手术台上，和舱中人一样遭到严密束缚，同样一丝不挂。[rival.HeShe]似乎已经彻底神志不清，无疑是因为[rival.hisHer]手臂上插着静脉输液针，导管一直连到一个装满天知道什么东西的亮粉色袋子。 “按[rival.heShe]的说法，是你的表亲，”杰奎漫不经心地说道，随意得仿佛在谈论一只宠物。“看来惹是生非是你们家族的传统。真是不幸的特质，[rival.name]已经亲身体会到了。你擅自闯入、破坏财产，这些都可以原谅...但公然背叛、违背誓言？啧。澄水实在无法与骗子和欺诈者做生意；既然做不了生意，那[rival.himHer]还有什么用？” “你对[rival.himHer]做了什么？”费鲁兹低吼道，一只手仍在枪柄上躁动。 贤者耸耸肩。“更切中要害的问题，是[rival.heShe]做了什么？我亲爱的水生生物，答案是企图盗窃！[rival.name]·斯蒂尔船长与我的财阀展开谈判，希望取得这座设施所围绕建造的外星探针，并提出用先进人工智能技术作为交换。但一如既往，我提出的观点仍然无人能够反驳：如果没有足够的义体强化来压制这类低级冲动，贪婪终将战胜理智。[rival.name]观看了我正在进行的研究演示，却设法在一家异星企业——异源生物科技——的协助下窃取研究成果。对[rival.himHer]来说很不幸，澄水与异源生物科技之间有着...长期合作关系，这种关系建立在信任与互惠之上。我们立刻收到了有关这场欺骗的报告，而现在...” 杰奎再次深吸面罩中储存的不明气体，享受刺激时全身颤抖。 “所以，”你说道，“你在惩罚[rival.name]，因为其试图[pc.isAss |坑你 |背叛你 ]。” 她点点头，强化眼睛重新聚焦在你身上，仿佛此前已经忘了你也在场。“啊，是的。既然[rival.name]如此关注我的工作，那么让[rival.heShe]第一个亲眼见证研究结出果实，似乎再合适不过。多亏我手下这一大批实验对象，我有一整套新奇有趣的变形手段，可以施加到[rival.hisHer]的肉体上。唯一的问题是，我该选择哪一种——我是说，先选哪一种？哦，反正我们最终有充足时间把每一种都测试一遍。” 你和费鲁兹交换了一下眼神。听起来，[rival.name]恐怕凶多吉少；费鲁兹浑身绷紧的模样说明，她同样明白这一点。 贤者一挥手，扫过一排装满化学药剂的针筒；它们整齐排列在检查台旁的工作台上，[rival.name]正被绑在那张检查台上。“所以，斯蒂尔船长，你有什么建议？也许是粉色的心智洗涤剂？或者这一剂绿色药物，保证把[rival.himHer]变成一头魁梧的性爱蛮兽？选择，选择。啊，瞧你脸上那副表情——你不是只为看表亲的惨状而来，对吧？不，我想我确实忘了寄邀请函。我这人面对观众时特别害羞。” 她似乎已经完全忘了擅闯设施这件事。“所以，你究竟为什么而来？大声说！” 费鲁兹低吼着，用只有你能听见的声音说道：“我们到底能不能现在就他妈宰了她？”

rows.original: You rest a hand on your weapon, nodding to Feruze before telling Jaqui: “I’m here for my cousin. Let [rival.himHer] go[pc.nmh |, and nobody needs to get hurt | — you don’t know where [rival.heShe]’s been, anyway | — or else ].” The Maven’s expression hardens, cybernetic jaw tightening. “Is that right? Here to play the hero, then, another misguided moralizer standing with arms outstretched before the inevitable march of scientific progress? Tsk. Well, then, we shall see what useful combat data the pair of you can provide. Behold, the genius of Bright Water!” Before you can bring your [pc.weapon] to bear, the Maven grabs one of the needles from the table and jams it into her arm, injecting herself with its murky green contents. Feruze rushes forward, too late to stop her but heedless of the new danger, roaring and swinging her mace-tail. The Maven stares down the suula-rush without so much as a flinch, right until the last moment when she meets it with a lightning-fast punch that compresses Feruze’s snout with a shriek of pain. The huge amazon tumbles backwards end-over-end, crashing into you and bearing the both of you down to the ground. By the time you’ve cleared the feathers from your face and rolled the enormity of Feruze’s ass off your chest, the Maven has changed even more. She’s a head-again taller than a moment ago, her lab coat shredded to tatters that hang limply from her shoulders and hips. The back of Jaqui’s clothing has ruptured outwards, revealing that her bulbous tail has been joined by eight others, and whipping around in a frenzy behind their rapidly-mutating owner. “I don’t think that shot was [silly |FDA approved |peer reviewed ],” you grunt, hauling yourself up and grabbing your weapon.
