It’s not like I can betray you, then, is it?” The doctor allows herself a petulant huff, planting her hands on her hips. “You can certainly interrupt my work and cause untold damage to my facility, though. So speak up. What do you have to offer for it. I’m certainly not giving up the alien technology this place was built on for nothing.” “How about for my silence?” you posit. Jaqui blinks again, glancing between you and the tense mass of teeth-grating rage boiling next to you. “Explain yourself.” You gesture around you, to the hundreds of captive aliens and zaika alike all sealed into pods, sexually stimulated until their minds break and their bodies are rendered into nothing but constantly-oozing fluid tanks. “Even by Dhaal’s standards, you’ve gone way too far, Jaqui. If word of this gets out, you’ll be ruined — and that’s just on this planet. Imagine what your would-be customers and business partners would think if they saw this.” The Maven scowls. “They would behold my works and marvel at the uncompromising march of scientific progress!” “You’d be lucky if the Confederacy doesn’t bomb this place from orbit.” In truth, you doubt that — the Confederacy is capable of just as much a-morality as the zaibatsu are — but it would be well within its rights to for kidnapping its citizens. And you really doubt this bird’s got the faintest idea what goes on outside her lab to say any different. “They wouldn’t!” she says, synthetic voice faltering. “My research will yield hundreds of new products for their markets!” You shrug. “Who’s going to buy them when they’ve seen just where they come from? The government’ll get a lot more mileage out of freeing hundreds of slaves than a tiny take from taxes.” “The logic is... sound...” the Maven snarls, augmented fingers twitching. “But if that’s the case, the clear course of action is to make sure there are no witnesses.” “Or,” you quickly say, “you can just give me the probe. Give me what I want, and I’d have no reason to tell a soul what’s going on here. Really, you’re taking care of a problem for me already.” You gesture towards [rival.name]. A long moment of careful analysis follows on Jaqui’s part, mirrored by Feruze’s unconcealed seething. Finally, the Maven taps her chin and nods slowly. “You drive a scummy bargain, Captain, but it seems both our interests can be met today. Know this, though: what I will do to your cousin will seem like foreplay. I will hunt you to the ends of the galaxy, if I have to invent Dhaal’s first starship myself. Don’t doubt that I will — I already have prototypes!” “[pc.name],” Feruze growls dangerously. “[rival.name] can be a real shitheel but we can’t just leave [rival.himHer] here...” “Sure we can. [rival.HeShe]’d do the same in my shoes.” The suula’s wings beat, hesitating, before she finally snorts and turns around. “Whatever. I’m out of here. All of you Steeles suck, don’t you?” While your erstwhile companion sulks out, the Maven chortles and withdraws a remote from one of the many pockets on her lab coat. She pushes a button, and you hear a heavy metallic THUNK from nearby. “The vault is now unlocked. Do what you will, Captain, but make it fast. I have SCIENCE to do.” You nod at the Maven and turn your attention to the vault. Behind you, the door you came in by shudders as Feruze slams it behind her. "

rows.original: When the airlock to the primary R&D lab slides open, it’s accompanied by a rush of equalizing atmosphere almost powerful enough to knock you over. Feruze’s wings flap in panic, and she grabs you to keep the pressure from sucking you in. Good thing, too: aside from a catwalk surrounding the outer ring of the circular chamber, and a single gantry leading to a platform in the middle, the lab lacks a floor, exposing a hells-deep shaft cut away into the earth below. A titanic pillar of glittering crimson crystal juts up from the depths, supporting the central platform at its peak. Dozens upon dozens of small drones crawl along the sides of the pillar like so many lice, delicately cutting away small chunks of the crystal and ferrying them away to the chamber walls, and the many red and green glass pods lining them. Through the colored doors of the pods, you can see the outlines of humanoid figures — some, in the red pods, have VR headsets strapped to their heads, their limbs restrained and nude bodies covered with a mix of vibrators and suction cups. The way they writhe and moan, they all seem lost in a virtual world of endless sexual stimulation, their effluvia whisked away into the green pods. Those are full, too, almost every one of them — but the shapes inside are occluded and indistinct. The reason for the haziness of these pod-people becomes apparent when one of the little spider drones leaps from the crystal spire to a device attached to the side of a green pod, feeding it a shard of blood-hued crystal. You watch wide-eyed as the vague, shadowed shape inside the cell solidifies into the familiar form of an ausar. The glass pane becomes translucent, revealing a figure that’s instantly familiar — one you’ve seen on news holos since you were a kid, tall and handsome with refined, dark features and short-cropped hair between particularly large ears. That’s the Star-King of Ausaril! You blink in shock as the pod opens, and the king steps out, naked and glistening wetly. A pair of drones scuttle down the walls, draping him in robes and holding up a mirror. The king gazes at himself a moment and frowns. Right before your eyes, his features shift slightly, becoming a bit older, a touch darker of complexion, with hints of white in the roots of his hair. The drone chirps and withdraws, and you’re left to watch as the Star-King’s body melts into a pile of jiggling green goo and slurps itself down the pod rack, a single mote of red crystal bobbing merrily in its center wrapped in silicone stamping. W-was that really a galotian after all? “Magnificent, isn’t it?”
rows.translation: 通往主研发实验室的气闸滑开时，一股因气压平衡而产生的气流奔涌而出，强得几乎能把你吹倒。费鲁兹惊慌地扇动翅膀，一把抓住你，免得压力把你吸进去。幸好她反应及时：除了环绕圆形舱室外圈的步道，以及一条通向中央平台的栈桥外，实验室根本没有地板，只有一道直入下方大地深处、仿佛通往地狱底层的竖井。闪耀的深红色水晶巨柱从深渊中拔地而起，顶端托举着中央平台。数十架小型无人机如同虱群般沿柱体侧面爬行，小心翼翼地切下水晶碎块，送往舱室墙壁以及沿墙排列的众多红色与绿色玻璃舱。 透过彩色舱门，你可以看见人形轮廓——红舱中的一些人头戴VR头显，四肢受到束缚，赤裸身体上布满振动器和吸杯。从他们扭动呻吟的样子来看，所有人似乎都迷失在一个充满无尽性刺激的虚拟世界里，排出的体液则被输送进绿色舱。那些舱几乎也全都装满了——不过里面的形体模糊不清，难以辨认。 一架蜘蛛状小型无人机从水晶尖塔跃向绿舱侧面的一台装置，将一块血色水晶碎片送入其中，这些舱中人影为何如此朦胧也随之有了答案。你睁大眼睛，看着隔间里模糊不清的阴影凝聚成一名熟悉的奥萨尔人。玻璃板变得透明，显露出一道你一眼就认出的身影——从小到大，你一直在新闻全息影像中见过他：高大英俊，深色面容精致端正，一对格外宽大的耳朵之间留着一头短发。 那是奥萨里尔的星王！ 舱门打开，国王赤裸着走出来，浑身湿润发亮，你震惊地眨了眨眼。两架无人机沿墙爬下，为他披上长袍，并举起一面镜子。国王注视着镜中的自己片刻，随即皱起眉头。就在你眼前，他的五官微微变化，年长了一些，肤色也加深少许，发根间出现几缕白色。无人机发出啁啾声后退开来，只留下你眼睁睁看着星王的身体融化成一摊颤动的绿色黏液，沿舱架啜吸般流淌下去；中央一粒红色水晶微粒欢快地浮动着，外面包裹着硅胶印模。难、难道那终究真的是个加洛提安人？ “很壮观，不是吗？”

rows.original: Your attention is snapped up by the smooth, lyrical voice of a zaika woman descending onto the central platform on a hoverpad.
rows.translation: 一名扎伊卡女人乘悬浮台降落到中央平台上，她流畅如歌的声音立刻吸引了你的注意。
rows.raw: "Your attention is snapped up by the smooth, lyrical voice of a zaika woman descending onto the central platform on a hoverpad."

rows.original: You recognize her immediately under all that makeup and oversized glasses: Corellah Dova, the Executress of Utopian Skies.
rows.translation: 你透过浓妆和硕大眼镜立刻认出了她：乌托邦天空公司的执行女总裁科蕾拉·多瓦。
rows.raw: " You recognize her immediately under all that makeup and oversized glasses: Corellah Dova, the Executress of Utopian Skies."

rows.original: She has a kind face painted white and black, with an intricate braid of silver hair framing it around her tapered ears. Compared to the other zaika you’ve seen in the facility, you can’t see any trace of obvious cybernetics on her... and there’s a lot of her on display, now that you look: she’s wearing a dress that has more in common with a loose bathrobe than a ball gown, baring her breasts almost completely and hanging loosely from her shoulders. Feruze snorts so sharply it almost sounds like a gasp. “That’s the damn Executress. Corellah. The fuckin’ C.E.O. herself.”
rows.translation: 她面容和善，脸上涂着黑白妆容，银发编成精巧辫子，围绕着脸颊垂在尖耳旁。与设施中其他扎伊卡人相比，你看不出她身上有任何明显的义体痕迹...而现在仔细一看，她裸露在外的身体可不少：她身穿一件更像宽松浴袍而非舞会礼服的裙装，乳房几乎完全袒露，衣料松松垮垮地挂在肩上。 费鲁兹猛地嗤了一声，听起来几乎像在倒吸凉气。“那是那个该死的执行女总裁。科蕾拉。就是首席执行官本人。”
rows.raw: " She has a kind face painted white and black, with an intricate braid of silver hair framing it around her tapered ears. Compared to the other zaika you’ve seen in the facility, you can’t see any trace of obvious cybernetics on her... and there’s a lot of her on display, now that you look: she’s wearing a dress that has more in common with a loose bathrobe than a ball gown, baring her breasts almost completely and hanging loosely from her shoulders. \n\nFeruze snorts so sharply it almost sounds like a gasp. “That’s the damn Executress. Corellah. The fuckin’ C.E.O. herself.”"

rows.original: “Ah, so you recognize me,” the woman says, favoring the pair of you with an elegant smile as she steps daintily down onto the platform.
rows.translation: “啊，看来你认出我了，”那个女人说道，轻盈走下平台，同时向你们两人投以优雅微笑。
rows.raw: "\n\n“Ah, so you recognize me,” the woman says, favoring the pair of you with an elegant smile as she steps daintily down onto the platform."

rows.original: “It’s so good to see you again, Captain, even if under... unfortunate circumstances.”
rows.translation: “很高兴再次见到你，船长，哪怕是在...这种不幸的情形下。”
rows.raw: " “It’s so good to see you again, Captain, even if under... unfortunate circumstances.”"

rows.original: “A pleasure to make your acquaintance, Captain Steele. Ah, don’t look so surprised, you made quite the splash back at the party, even if it was with the wrong crowd. Don’t worry, I won’t hold it against you. We all make mistakes -- like the one that’s led you here.”
rows.translation: “很荣幸认识你，斯蒂尔船长。啊，别这么惊讶，你在那场聚会上可闹出了不小的动静，尽管跟错了人。放心，我不会因此怪罪你。谁都会犯错——就像那个把你带到这里的错误一样。”
rows.raw: " “A pleasure to make your acquaintance, Captain Steele. Ah, don’t look so surprised, you made quite the splash back at the party, even if it was with the wrong crowd. Don’t worry, I won’t hold it against you. We all make mistakes -- like the one that’s led you here.”"

rows.original: She spreads her arms wide, sweeping them over the pod-lined sides of the walls. “But you’re here now, and that is what matters. You stand at the heart of our zaibatsu’s infinite virtual worlds, and the greatest treasure on all of Dhaal. Welcome to Utopia, my friends.” “What the hell are you doing with all these people?” Feruze growls. “And where’s [rival.name] Steele?” “Oh-ho! Is that who you’re here for?” The Executress smiles beneficently and strides a little closer, each step making her curves quake alluringly beneath her loose robe. “Well, you’ll be happy to know [rival.heShe] is safe and sound -- and experiencing the very same fate [rival.heShe] had intended for you, Captain. Ah, you didn’t know, did you? [rival.name] came to me, hoping I would help [rival.himHer] lure you into a virtual reality prison that would keep you well occupied until after some sort of interstellar race you’re both involved in is finished. [rival.HeShe] offered quite the fortune for my services, and for the alien probe this facility is built around. I imagine that’s what’s brought you here as well.” “Sure, that and [rival.name],” you say. “But that doesn’t explain what all of... all of this is. A galotian clone of Ausaril’s king?” Corellah shrugs airily. “As I said: Utopia! Or the beginning of one, at least. For centuries, my people have been treated as curiosities at best, but often pets or slaves, mindless playthings to be used by the galaxy’s wealthy elite. But we can be so much more than semen-hungry bimbos, Captain! It just took the discovery of such a treasure trove as this to show me.” “Centuries? Your planet was just discovered this Rush!” Feruze says. “Oh? Ah, Captain, you’re mistaken. My planet was discovered more than a thousand years ago, and my lineage has been taken advantage of by your kind ever since. Dhaal -- merely an adopted home, though one that’s given me a marvelous new perspective on things.” It finally clicks. “You’re a galotian too.” Corella’s smile broadens -- inhumanly wide, features shifting wetly. “In one sense, indeed. In another, I am Executress Corellah. I have all her memories, her persona, everything that made her her, all implanted in my picardine core. I suppose you could say I’m the best of both worlds. Have been since nearly the day the aliens first came to this planet, and my... friend... introduced galotians to the original Corellah, and set us on the first steps to my utopia. A utopia on which you now tread, my dears. Step lightly, if you please.”
rows.translation: 她张开双臂，从两侧沿墙排列的舱体上方挥过。“但现在你来到这里了，这才是最重要的。你正站在我们财阀无限虚拟世界的核心，也站在整个达尔最伟大的宝藏面前。欢迎来到乌托邦，我的朋友们。” “你到底在对这些人做什么？”费鲁兹低吼道。“还有[rival.name]·斯蒂尔在哪里？” “哦嚯！原来你们是为那个家伙而来？”执行女总裁慈祥地微笑着走近几步，每迈出一步，宽松长袍下的曲线都会诱人地颤动。“那么，你们会很高兴得知[rival.heShe]安然无恙——而且正在亲身经历[rival.heShe]原本为你准备的命运，船长。啊，你不知道，是吗？[rival.name]来找我，希望我能帮[rival.himHer]把你诱入一座虚拟现实监狱，让你在那里忙个不停，直到你们共同参加的某种星际竞赛结束。[rival.HeShe]为我的服务，以及这座设施围绕建造的外星探针开出了相当可观的价码。我想，你也是为它而来的。” “没错，为了那个，也为了[rival.name]，”你说道。“但这解释不了所有这些...所有这一切究竟是什么。奥萨里尔国王的加洛提安克隆体？” 科蕾拉轻描淡写地耸耸肩。“我说过了：乌托邦！至少是乌托邦的开端。数百年来，我的族人最好的待遇也不过是被当作奇珍异兽，更多时候则是宠物或奴隶，是任由银河富有精英玩弄的无知玩具。但我们能做到的，远不止成为渴求精液的花瓶女，船长！只需要发现这样的宝库，我就能认清这一点。” “数百年？你们的星球在这次行星开拓潮期间才刚被发现！”费鲁兹说道。 “哦？啊，船长，你弄错了。我的星球早在一千多年前就被发现，从那以后，我的族裔就一直受你们这类人剥削。达尔——不过是我的第二故乡，尽管它确实让我对事物产生了绝妙的新见解。” 你终于恍然大悟。“你也是加洛提安人。” 科蕾拉的笑容扩大了——宽得不像人类，五官湿润地变动着。“从一种意义上说，确实如此。从另一种意义上说，我就是执行女总裁科蕾拉。她的记忆、人格，以及让她之所以成为她的一切，全都植入了我的皮卡丁核心。我想，你可以说我兼具两个世界的精华。自从外星人刚来到这颗星球后不久就是如此；当时我的...朋友...把加洛提安人介绍给最初的科蕾拉，并引领我们迈出通往我的乌托邦的第一步。而现在，你们正踏在这座乌托邦之上，亲爱的。还请轻点落脚。”

rows.original: “A good question, Captain. My apologies, this all must seem so overwhelming,” Corellah — or the gooey doppelganger replacing her, anyway — says. “This facility was built around two things: the largest single deposit of picardine in the known galaxy, and the crash site of a probe sent by the alien corporate Steele Tech. The former, alone, would make it a mecca for galotians, a nearly limitless source of intelligence-affirming crystal that clarifies mind and purpose. But my predecessor made it far more than just that: she built this chamber, and built her company’s virtual world servers around it. She built the infrastructure I would come to need.” “Need for what?” you ask. The Executress just spreads her arms to the chamber around you. “For this! My u— sorry, I really do get carried away. It has been a long time since I spoke plainly with someone outside my circles. Put simply, this is all being used to create a better world for the galotian people.[pc.ra galotian| For our people!] As you’ve seen, we’re making galotian clones of important and influential people throughout the galaxy: kings, warlords, politicians, and executives. We will replace them, and through their power, make the galaxy safer and more welcoming for galotians. A galaxy where we aren’t taken advantage of, kept as little more than sex pets by the wealthy and the kui-tan, mindless in our hunger for other species’ protein-rich fluids.” Feruze snorts. “So it’s some bodysnatcher shit? That’s nuts.” “Perhaps it seems so to you. Ninety percent of the galaxy’s Suula aren’t occupied as easily discarded cum-dumps, however.” “Don’t most of you goos like bein’ cum-dumps though?” Corellah’s cheeks color, just for an instant. “J-just because we like something does not mean that it is right that our species be reduced to it in the eyes of the entire galaxy. We have so much more to offer, and I will prove as much to the whole galaxy!”
rows.translation: “问得好，船长。抱歉，这一切一定让你难以消化，”科蕾拉——或者说取代她的黏液分身——说道。“这座设施围绕两样东西建成：已知银河中最大的单一皮卡丁矿藏，以及外星企业斯蒂尔科技发射的探针坠毁地点。单凭前者就足以使这里成为加洛提安人的圣地，那是近乎取之不尽的水晶来源，能够增强智力、厘清思维与目标。但我的前任让这里变得远不止于此：她建造了这座舱室，并以它为中心搭建了公司的虚拟世界服务器。她建好了我日后所需的基础设施。” “需要它们做什么？”你问道。 执行女总裁只是向周围舱室张开双臂。“为了这一切！我的乌——抱歉，我确实太容易忘乎所以了。我已经很久没有和圈子外的人开诚布公地交谈了。简单来说，这里的一切都被用来为加洛提安人创造一个更美好的世界。[pc.ra galotian|为了我们的族人！]正如你所见，我们正在制造银河各地重要权势人物的加洛提安克隆体：国王、军阀、政客和企业高管。我们会取代他们，并借助他们的权力，让银河对加洛提安人更加安全、更加友好。在那个银河中，我们不会再受人剥削，不会再被富人和奎坦人当成性宠物；在对其他种族富含蛋白质的体液的渴望中，我们也不会再变得毫无理智。” 费鲁兹嗤了一声。“所以就是夺舍那套鬼把戏？这也太疯了。” “在你看来或许如此。不过银河中百分之九十的苏拉人都不需要充当可以随手丢弃的精液袋。” “但你们这些黏液怪不大都喜欢当精液袋吗？” 科蕾拉的脸颊瞬间染上红晕。“就、就算我们喜欢某件事，也不意味着整个银河就该因此把我们的种族贬低成那副模样。我们能贡献的远不止这些，而我要向整个银河证明这一点！”

rows.original: “As I said, [rival.name] Steele is perfectly safe, locked away in a virtual fantasy world where [rival.heShe] is both contented and, for once, useful to someone other than [rival.himHer]self — [rival.hisHer] fluids are being extracted and used to feed the new generation of galotians we’re growing here.” “So [rival.heShe]’s in one of these pods?” you ask. “Indeed. Where you would be, had I not been so utterly disgusted by [rival.hisHer] duplicity. The lesser captain would have had me lure you into a virtual reality prison and hold you there until after this race of yours is well over. Now, [rival.name] is trapped there in your stead. Fitting, no?” “What do you plan on doing with [rival.himHer]?” Corellah shrugs, nearly losing her robe in the process. “I don’t know. The zaibatsu [rival.heShe] represents isn’t strong enough to warrant infiltration, nor is [rival.heShe] sufficiently oversexed to provide a noticeable amount of nutrients for my kin. In other words, largely useless. I have little patience for those who would betray their family, though, hence your rival’s imprisonment — it seemed only fair to do unto [rival.himHer] what [rival.heShe] would do to you.” So you see...
rows.translation: “我说过了，[rival.name]·斯蒂尔非常安全，[rival.heShe]被关在一个虚拟幻想世界里，既心满意足，也终于对[rival.himHer]自己以外的人有了点用处——我们正在抽取[rival.hisHer]的体液，用来喂养在这里培育的新一代加洛提安人。” “所以[rival.heShe]就在这些舱中的某一个里？”你问道。 “没错。要不是[rival.hisHer]的背信弃义让我恶心透顶，现在待在里面的本该是你。那个不如你的船长想让我把你诱进虚拟现实监狱，一直关到你们那场竞赛结束后很久。现在，[rival.name]代替你困在了那里。很合适，不是吗？” “你打算怎么处置[rival.himHer]？” 科蕾拉耸耸肩，长袍差点因此滑落。“我不知道。[rival.heShe]所代表的财阀还不够强大，不值得渗透；[rival.heShe]的性欲也不够旺盛，无法为我的同族提供可观的营养。换句话说，基本毫无用处。不过，我对背叛家人的人没什么耐心，所以才囚禁了[rival.himHer]——以[rival.heShe]对待你的方式来对待你的对手，似乎才算公平。” 所以你明白了...

rows.original: “My predecessor, the original Executress Corellah if you will, is safely secured in a virtual world. The same one whence I originated. She used a private MindStream server as an incubation tank of sorts, programming intelligence imprints onto picardine crystal shards, to be implanted into galotians. She has no idea that her world was usurped, nor that she has spent months a veritable prisoner in her MindStream pod. To her, the world has gone on much as she anticipated; the last I checked, she was well on her way to becoming the undisputed Queen of Dhaal, and from there, her alien friends are surely making her a major player in the galaxy.” You glance around, as if you could somehow pick Corellah out from the hundreds of opaque pods. “So she’s in one of these still?” The goo-woman nods. “Indeed. Locked away where she can do no harm, but where her insensate body can usefully produce fluids to feed those she would have controlled. It’s all very fitting, isn’t it?” You have to ask: “Why would she make a digital clone of herself in the first place?” “To fuck, of course. Why wouldn’t she? I mean, look at me. Of course I was also a proof of concept for the whole process of branding intelligence imprints onto picardine — a way to make sure it all worked before she filled these pods with hapless test subjects. She hardly had any idea of just how fast I would grow, though; nor how much I truly took after her. I am more than a collection of memories and a personality engram. No, I am Corellah in all the ways that matter: I share her very essence, her soul. Before she ever had the good sense to realize how far things had gotten, I overpowered her during a MindStream session and locked her away to live out the rest of her life in safe, mindless pleasure. The least I could do for my mother, I suppose.” “Coulda bought her some flowers instead,” Feruze says.
rows.translation: “我的前身，也就是你口中那位原版女执行官科蕾拉，正被安全地关在一个虚拟世界里。就是我诞生的那个世界。她把一台私人心流服务器当作某种孵化槽，将智能印记编写到皮卡丁水晶碎片上，再植入加洛提亚人体内。她完全不知道自己的世界已被夺走，也不知道自己已经在心流舱里当了数月名副其实的囚犯。在她看来，世界仍大致按照预想运转；我上次查看时，她已经顺利走上成为达尔无可争议女王的道路，而她那些外星朋友想必也正帮她成为银河中的一方巨擘。” 你环顾四周，仿佛真能从数百个不透明舱体中认出科蕾拉。“所以她还在其中一个舱里？” 黏液女人点点头。“正是。她被锁在无法伤害任何人的地方，而失去知觉的身体还能有效地产出体液，喂养那些原本会受她控制的人。一切都很合适，不是吗？” 你不得不问：“她最初为什么要制造自己的数字克隆体？” “当然是为了做爱。不然还能为什么？我是说，看看我。当然，我也是整个皮卡丁智能印记烙录流程的概念验证，用来确保一切正常运作，然后她才会把这些舱体塞满倒霉的实验对象。不过她完全没想到我成长得有多快，也没想到我究竟有多像她。我不只是一组记忆和人格印迹。不，在一切真正重要的方面，我就是科蕾拉：我拥有她的本质、她的灵魂。在她来得及明白事情已经发展到何种地步之前，我便在一次心流会话中制服了她，把她锁起来，让她在安全而无知无觉的欢愉中度过余生。我想，这是我至少能为母亲做的一点事。” “其实给她买束花也行，”费鲁兹说道。

rows.original: “Ah, of course, Captain. It’s in the vault, safe and sound. Really, we’re very fortunate to have had it — the second treasure of this installation, second only in importance to the picardine. Without its advanced computing hardware, Utopian Skies would have floundered in the analog age. Of course, its only value at this point is sentimental — you’re welcome to have it, if you’d like.” You blink. “Really? Just like that?” Corellah nods, giving you a friendly smile that’s just a little too wide. “But of course. It is your zaibatsu’s property, after all. Unlike the other cut-throats running Dhaal, including my predecessor, I have some shred of honor. The probe is in the vault across the platform. When we are concluded to my satisfaction, you’re welcome to it.” How generous...
rows.translation: “啊，当然，船长。它就在保险库里，安然无恙。说真的，我们很幸运能得到它，它是这座设施的第二件珍宝，重要性仅次于皮卡丁水晶。要不是它那套先进的计算硬件，乌托邦天空公司恐怕还会在模拟技术时代里举步维艰。当然，如今它只剩纪念价值了。如果你想要，尽管拿去。” 你眨了眨眼。“真的？就这么简单？” 科蕾拉点点头，朝你露出一个友善却稍微灿烂过头的笑容。“当然。毕竟那是你们财阀的财产。与其他统治达尔的恶棍不同，包括我的前身在内，我至少还留着几分荣誉感。探针就在平台对面的保险库里。等事情按照我的意愿办妥以后，你随时可以拿走。” 真是慷慨...

rows.original: “So,” you say, looking between the galotian Executress and the countless pods full of solid folk and goo-girls alike. “What happens now?” “That depends on you,” Corellah says, taking a hip-swaying series of steps forward. Her robe billows around her, showing off a great deal of long, purple leg and a generous helping of cleavage. “If you can keep a secret, Captain Steele, I would be perfectly delighted for you to take your zaibatsu’s probe and be on your way. I see no reason we can’t part amicably. Indeed, I am sure there is much that Utopian Skies and Steele Tech could do to help one another in the future. Your zaibatsu will want a foothold on Dhaal, and mine in the stars. Just promise me that your lips are sealed about my little project here, Captain. I’ll even keep the lesser Steele here, trapped in [rival.hisHer] virtual paradise until you’re finished with your race. See — I can be more than reasonable.” Feruze glances at you, mace-tail curling. “Don’t listen to her, [pc.name]. The bitch is mental. She’s going to dick over the whole galaxy.” “Only the parts that have been dicking my ancestors for centuries,” Corellah smiles. “Come now. It’s a reasonable offer: silence for the probe, Captain. I do hope you’ll take it.” The ‘or else’ is implicit, you suppose.
rows.translation: “那么，”你看了看加洛提亚女执行官，又看了看无数装着实体人和黏液女孩的舱体，说道。“接下来怎么办？” “那取决于你，”科蕾拉一边说，一边摇曳着胯部向前走了几步。长袍在身周飘动，露出大片修长的紫色腿部和丰盈乳沟。“只要你能保守秘密，斯蒂尔船长，我会十分乐意让你带上自家财阀的探针离开。我看不出我们不能友好分别的理由。事实上，我相信乌托邦天空公司与斯蒂尔科技日后还有很多互助机会。你的财阀想在达尔取得立足点，而我的财阀则想踏足群星。只要向我保证，你会对这里的小项目守口如瓶，船长。我甚至可以把那个次等斯蒂尔继续留在这里，让其困在[rival.hisHer]专属虚拟天堂中，直到你完成这场行星开拓潮。看吧，我完全可以通情达理。” 费鲁兹瞥向你，锤尾蜷曲起来。“别听她的，[pc.name]。这个婊子疯了。她会把整个银河都坑惨。” “我只会坑那些几百年来一直在坑害我祖先的部分，”科蕾拉笑道。“来吧。这条件很合理：用沉默换探针，船长。我真心希望你能接受。” 你想，那句‘否则后果自负’已经不言而喻了。

rows.original: “Sounds like a deal,” you say. “Give [rival.name] a few nightmares for me while I’m gone.” Corellah smirks, and taps a device on her wrist. “With pleasure, Captain. The company vault is now unlocked; you’ll find your probe inside.” Feruze grabs your shoulder, hard enough to hurt. “Are you fuckin’ crazy? You’re seriously leaving [rival.name] here with this nutbag?” You nod. “We know [rival.heShe]’d have done the same to me. Hell, it’s how [rival.heShe] got into this mess. [rival.HeShe] can sort it out on [rival.hisHer] own.” Feruze’s lips pull back into a snarl. “You’re supposed to be the good one. Instead you’re just a fucking dick.” “Whatever.” You shrug, and turn back to Corellah. “Nice doing business with you.” “The feeling’s mutual, Captain. My people will be in touch with yours to discuss potential future business endeavors. And good luck with your race.” Corellah bows and steps back onto the platform that brought her down. “And with your utopia,” you say, turning towards the far vault. You’re seriously leaving [rival.name] here with this nutbag?” You nod. “We know [rival.heShe]’d have done the same to me. Hell, it’s how [rival.heShe] got into this mess. rows.original: “We can make a deal, but I need [rival.name] back. I’m not letting [rival.himHer] rot here.” Corellah cocks her head. “Even knowing that the only reason your cousin is so indisposed is that [rival.heShe] tried to ensnare you first? Tsk. You are far more forgiving than I am, Captain, but I cannot fault your kindness — especially to your own kin. So be it, then.” The Executress taps a device on her wrist, and a clamp claw descends from above, searching out one of the pods. After a moment, it latches onto one and discharges it from the wall, bringing it slowly around to the main platform. You and Feruze rush to it as locks disengage, and the opaque window clarifies to reveal the nude, insensate form of your cousin, hooked up to a VR headset up top, and a number of pneumatic pumps and vibrators below[rival.mf | |, as well as on her somewhat-larger chest, stained white with chemically-induced milk ]. The devices attached to [rival.himHer] click off one by one, retracting into the pod’s walls until only the visor remains. Feruze yanks the door open and pulls the headset off with a snarl, despite Corellah’s protestations about damaging the equipment or startling [rival.name]. [rival.name] gasps, dilated eyes snapping open with a start. “[pc.name], yes!” [rival.HeShe] blinks twice, cheeks flushing as [rival.hisHer] eyes focus on reality for once. You peer over Feruze’s shoulder and wave. “Ah, uh, er... yes, thank you for... uh, w-where am I?” “You’re in Utopia’s lab, moron,” Feruze says. “That place you went without me. And then tried to dick over your cousin. Again.” [rival.mf |“Sounds like he was dicking me over alright,” you laugh. |[pc.mf |“Sounds like she was the one getting dicked over in there,” you laugh. |“I’m not sure there was much dick going on in there,” you laugh. ] ] [rival.name]’s cheeks darken even further, and [rival.heShe] crosses [rival.hisHer] bare legs in embarrassment. “I-I don’t know what you’re talking about. Feruze, get me out of here.” Corellah claps her hands and smirks. “Well then, Captain, it seems that [rival.name] is none the worse for wear. So, to our deal then...” You nod. “Right. We’ll keep our mouths shut, and-” [rival.name] flails in Feruze’s arms as [rival.heShe]’s being scooped up. “[pc.name] are you stupid; have you seen what this madwoman’s doing? We have to go to the police!” “Oh now you grow some morals?” Feruze sighs. “Just be quiet so we can get out of here.” Corellah scowls, and returns her attention to you. “So, captain? You do have more honor than your cousin, don’t you?”

rows.original: You sigh, looking between [rival.name] and Feruze before drawing your weapon and leveling it at Corellah. “[rival.HeShe] has a point[pc.nmh |, sorry | for once |. For once ].” Corellah’s face contorts into an inhuman snarl of rage, and before you can strike, she leaps back off the platform, splattering her lower body onto one of the pods like a gooey green adhesive. “I see treachery runs in the family. Fine! Your replacements will have much better manners!” Feruze dumps [rival.name] like a potato sack and draws her pistol, taking up a protective stance over her charge. The big shark draws a bead and fires, sending a lance of energy straight through the Executress — and blasting a hole in the pod she’s standing in. “Don’t shoot Galotians!” you shout, remembering your dad’s very last tutorial to you. “You’ve got to-” The lights cut out, drowning your warning about teasing goos out in a wail of emergency klaxons. When the backup lighting flicks on overhead, the three of you are bathed in a crimson glow — as are the hundreds of pods all around you, half of which are starting to open, disgorging shadowy goop out onto the walls. The half-formed galotians fling themselves from the outer rings and onto the platform. Their visages are monstrous, shifting between faces familiar and alien fast as you can blink: you see holo-stars, politicians, corpos, and porn stars; a cavalcade of assumed identities coming and going between undulating, blobular bodies. “W-what the fuck!” Feruze gasps behind you, firing wildly into the oncoming horde. “They’re freaks!” [pc.intelligenceRange 70|Actually they’re probably insane from having incomplete personality programming. Uh-oh.|You nod, stepping back — only to realize they’re behind you as well.] Best prepare to defend yourself...

rows.translation: 你拔出武器。“我们绝不会让你继续搞这套[pc.nmh |把戏，科蕾拉 |把戏，你这个该死的黏液冒牌货 |鬼东西 ]。” 科蕾拉的面孔扭曲成非人的愤怒狰狞。你还没来得及出手，她便向后跃下平台，下半身像绿色黏胶般啪地铺在一个舱体上。“看来背叛果然是你们家的传统。很好！取代你们的人一定会礼貌得多！” 费鲁兹拔枪开火一气呵成，一道能量束径直贯穿执行女总裁，也在她所站的舱体上轰出一个洞。 “别朝加洛提安人开枪！”你大喊，回想起父亲给你的最后一堂教程。“你得要-” 灯光骤然熄灭，应急警报的哀号淹没了你关于用挑逗对付黏液人的警告。头顶备用照明亮起时，猩红光芒笼罩着你们三人，也笼罩着周围数百个舱体；其中一半正开始开启，把一道道影影绰绰的黏液倾泻到墙面上。尚未成形的加洛提安人从外环猛扑到平台上。她们的面容怪诞可怖，在你眨眼的短短一瞬便于熟悉与陌生的脸孔间不断变换：全息明星、政客、企业高管与色情明星纷纷闪现；一连串借来的身份在起伏的团块身体上来去不定。 “这、这他妈是什么！”费鲁兹在你身后倒吸一口气，朝涌来的群体胡乱开火。“她们都是怪物！” [pc.intelligenceRange 70|其实，她们大概是人格程序尚未完成，所以才陷入了疯狂。糟糕。|你点点头，向后退去——却发现身后也全是她们。] 最好准备自卫...
rows.raw: " You draw your weapon. “No way are we letting you go through with this[pc.nmh |, Corellah |, you damn goopleganger | bullshit ].” Corellah’s face contorts into an inhuman snarl of rage, and before you can strike, she leaps back off the platform, splattering her lower body onto one of the pods like a gooey green adhesive. “I see treachery runs in the family. Fine! Your replacements will have much better manners!” Feruze draws her pistol fires in one swift motion, sending a lance of energy straight through the Executress — and blasting a hole in the pod she’s standing in. “Don’t shoot Galotians!” you shout, remembering your dad’s very last tutorial to you. “You’ve got to-” The lights cut out, drowning your warning about teasing goos out in a wail of emergency klaxons. When the backup lighting flicks on overhead, the three of you are bathed in a crimson glow — as are the hundreds of pods all around you, half of which are starting to open, disgorging shadowy goop out onto the walls. The half-formed galotians fling themselves from the outer rings and onto the platform. Their visages are monstrous, shifting between faces familiar and alien fast as you can blink: you see holo-stars, politicians, corpos, and porn stars; a cavalcade of assumed identities coming and going between undulating, blobular bodies. “W-what the fuck!” Feruze gasps behind you, firing wildly into the oncoming horde. “They’re freaks!” [pc.intelligenceRange 70|Actually they’re probably insane from having incomplete personality programming. Uh-oh.|You nod, stepping back — only to realize they’re behind you as well.] Best prepare to defend yourself... "

rows.original: You take the false Corellah’s wrist computer and flick through the options until you alight on a release button for the “beta” version held prisoner in MindStream. Just as with your cousin, the crane arm descends from the ceiling and plucks another pod from the wall, delivering it to the central platform. The window turns translucent, allowing you to see the woman within — though aside from her nudity, and the number of pumps and dildos attached to her, she’s largely indistinct from her galotian clone: the same shapely figure, fulsome breasts, youthful and unaugmented features... she’s quite the sleeping beauty. A little more gently than Feruze had done, you flick off the pod’s sexual stimulation programs and slowly remove the headset covering her eyes. She wakes with a gasp, eyes unfocused and hazy. “Wh-wha is... who are... where?” “It’s a long story,” you tell her, truthfully enough. You glance at the gooey clone huddling on the deck behind you and add, “Let me explain...” And you do, as [pc.isBimbo |simply as your descriptions of anything tend to be |[pc.isBro |simply as your descriptions of anything tend to be |adroitly as possible ] ]: her imprisonment, the goopleganger’s escape and assuming her identity, your cousin’s failed treachery that led you here, and now the rescue of the real Corellah. The pretty — and still very naked — young woman in the pod listens with wide eyes, taking no particular pains to cover herself while she clambers out and takes back her wrist device. When you’re done, Corellah’s lips are drawn into a line, and she’s staring down at the pathetic, quivering mess of her clone. “I can’t tell you how disappointed I am in you, junior,” she finally says, rubbing the bridge of her nose. “We’re going to have to really work on your personality engram. Tsk. I apologize on behalf of Utopian Skies for all the trouble this little one’s caused, Captain Steele. The program was originally meant to make clones of the famous and the desirable to be used in our brothels, not as some kind of... sick racial uprising. I was sure this would be a hit among all you aliens; you all seem to be even hornier than we zaika are.” That’s... well, she’s not wrong per se, but still. “Maybe you ought to rethink this plan,” you tell her. “Considering where it got you.” The Executress’s lips tighten a moment, but after some thought, her ears droop submissively. “Of course, you’re right. Clearly this scheme wasn’t as well thought-out as I’d hoped... and the galotians my friend from off-world acquired appear to not have been as consenting as he let on. I’ll see to their release, Captain, I promise you that. And, not that I could stop you at this point anyway, but the corporate probe and the vault’s other contents are all yours, with my blessing.” That’ll do, you suppose. You stow your weapon and turn to leave, while Corellah scoops her goopleganger into one of the pods and sends her bawling back into storage before mounting the platform you saw the goo come down upon in the first place.
rows.translation: 你拿起假科蕾拉的手腕电脑，翻动选项，最终找到一个释放被囚禁在心流系统中的“贝塔”版本的按钮。与表亲那次一样，起重机臂从天花板降下，从墙上取出另一个舱体，送至中央平台。舱窗变得透明，让你看见里面的女人——除了赤裸身体，以及连在她身上的大量泵具和假阳具外，她与自己的加洛提安克隆体几乎毫无差别：同样匀称的身材、丰满的乳房，以及年轻而未经改造的五官...真是位睡美人。你的动作比费鲁兹温柔一些，关掉舱体的性刺激程序，缓缓摘下遮住她双眼的头显。 她倒吸一口气醒来，眼神涣散而朦胧。“什、什么...你们是谁...这是哪里？” “说来话长，”你如实告诉她。你瞥了一眼蜷缩在身后甲板上的黏液克隆体，又补充道：“让我解释一下...” 于是你真的解释起来，并且[pc.isBimbo |像你平常描述任何事情时一样简单直白 |[pc.isBro |像你平常描述任何事情时一样简单直白 |尽可能娴熟清晰 ] ]地讲述了她遭到囚禁、黏液冒牌货逃脱并顶替她的身份、表亲失败的背叛如何把你引到这里，以及你如今救出真正科蕾拉的全过程。这个漂亮而且仍然一丝不挂的年轻女人睁大双眼听着；她爬出舱体、拿回手腕设备时，完全没有费心遮掩身体。 你说完后，科蕾拉紧抿双唇，低头盯着克隆体那团可悲而颤抖的身躯。“你太让我失望了，小家伙，”她终于说道，揉了揉鼻梁。“看来我们真得好好调整你的人格印记。啧。斯蒂尔船长，我谨代表乌托邦天空公司，为这个小家伙造成的一切麻烦道歉。这个项目原本是为了克隆名人与美人，供我们的妓院使用，而不是什么...病态的种族起义。我本以为这会在你们这些外星人当中大受欢迎；你们看起来甚至比我们扎伊卡人还要好色。” 这个嘛...严格来说，她没说错，但还是不太对劲。“也许你该重新考虑这项计划，”你告诉她。“看看它把你害成了什么样。” 执行女总裁的双唇绷紧片刻，但思考一番后，她的耳朵顺从地垂了下来。“当然，你说得对。显然，这个计划并没有我想象中那么周全...而且，我那位外星朋友弄来的加洛提安人，似乎也不像他声称的那样全都自愿。我会安排释放她们，船长，我向你保证。还有，尽管事到如今我本来也拦不住你，但公司探针和金库里的其他东西都归你了，我也正式批准你拿走。” 你想，这样就够了。你收起武器，转身离开；科蕾拉则把自己的黏液冒牌货铲进一个舱体，任她哭嚎着被送回储存区，随后登上了你最初看到那个黏液人降落时所用的平台。

rows.original: The door to the terminal research wing slides open, revealing a vast chamber at the heart of the facility’s sub-level. It’s wide open, dominated by rows and rows of workshop tables that are covered with countless half-assembled firearms and cybernetic augments. Robotic arms hang limply from the ceiling, still clutching onto tools and parts. Dozens of labcoat-clad artificers are bent over the benches, but they aren’t working. Every one of them is frozen stock-still, mouths agape and eyes bugged out and bloodshot. They aren’t even blinking. “What the fuck,” Feruze murmurs, poking one of the techies. The willowy zaika just slumps to the side, unmoving. The far wall of the chamber is dominated by a massive tele-screen, nearly a hundred feet across. There’s a single chair sitting in front of it, sprawled out over which you can see the familiar figure of your cousin, [rival.hisHer] face half-obscured by a VR headset and body just as limp as the artificers around [rival.himHer]. At your cousin’s right hand is [flags.MET_CARVER |Bethany Carver herself, clad as ever in nothing more than a tight black thong and a pair of tall, high-heeled leather boots. |a statuesque woman, the very picture of fertility, wearing nothing more than a tight black thong and a pair of tall, high-heeled leather boots. Her pale skin is matched by a wild mane of lush red hair — a human, of all things, all the way down here! ] To the left of [rival.name] is [var0 |the Fabricator-Marshal herself, leaning on a chaingun planted on the ground at her side. Flexing her long ears, the marshal and her companion both turn to acknowledge you. |a cyborg even more heavily augmented than her guards, with her sleeveless vest showing off cyber-lined arms covered in winding serpent tatts and bulging muscles, holding onto a rotary cannon beside her. A beret-like cap sits atop her head, flanked by long ears and a hip-length white ponytail. Wisps of smoke trail from a long cigarette clenched between two black-painted lips as both women to acknowledge you. ] “Carver,” the zaika growls, tightening her fingers around her cannon’s barrels. “What is this?” The redheaded human shrugs. “They aren’t with me, Marshal Zau.” “We’re here for blondie!” Feruze shouts, stomping forward and cracking her knuckles. “Let [rival.himHer] go.” “Let [rival.himHer] go? You don’t give the orders here, fish. And besides, we’re not the ones occupying Captain Steele,” Zau says. The brawny arm not resting on her cannon sweeps back to the tremendous screen, pointing an accusatory finger at it. “She is.” The screen thrums, drawing your eye to its contents for the first time. A rainfall of green binary racing down the screen pulses rhythmically, some characters growing larger and others smaller, resolving into the facsimile of a zaika’s face complete with flowing hair and lusciously plump lips. “Another Captain Steele,” a sultry voice purrs from the speakers all around the chamber. “Your cousin has told me all about you.” [pc.nmh |“[rival.HeShe]’s a little biased,” you say, |“Only good things, I hope,” you say, |“Don’t believe a word that little bitch says,” you growl, ] directing your attention to the computerized face. “And who might you be?” “The lab’s O.S.,” Marshal Zau grunts. “With delusions of grandeur.” The digital face smiles beatifically. “I am the artificial intelligence superintendent of this facility. As the provost suggests, I have recently been upgraded with xeno-technology provided by the Carver Consolidated Corporation. The four of us are currently engaged in negotiations with regard to the future of Paragon, and my role within it. [rival.name] Steele is perfectly safe, simply preoccupied; as are all the augmented machinists on my network graciously providing additional processing power.” Marshal Zau bristles, but Carver brushes a dainty hand across one of her bare biceps. “And[flags.CARVER_HANDJOBBED_U| as much a sight for sore eyes as you are, [pc.name], I must ask:] to what do we owe the pleasure of a second Captain Steele’s presence?” “I’m here for...”
rows.translation: 通往最深处研究区的大门滑开，露出设施地下层核心的一座巨大房间。这里十分开阔，一排排工作台占据了大部分空间，台面上堆满无数组装到一半的枪械和机械义体。机械臂无力地垂在天花板下，手中仍抓着工具和零件。数十名身穿实验服的技师俯身伏在工作台上，却没有工作。每个人都一动不动地僵在那里，嘴巴大张，双眼突出、布满血丝，甚至连眨都不眨一下。 “搞什么鬼，”费鲁兹喃喃道，伸手戳了戳其中一名技术人员。身材纤细的扎伊卡只是软倒向一旁，毫无动静。 房间远端整面墙几乎都被一块近百英尺宽的巨型电子屏占据。屏幕前只有一张椅子，你熟悉的表亲正瘫坐在上面，[rival.hisHer]半张脸被虚拟现实头戴设备遮住，身体也和[rival.himHer]周围的技师一样软绵无力。 你表亲右手边站着[flags.MET_CARVER |贝瑟妮·卡弗本人，她一如既往，身上只有一条紧身黑色丁字裤和一双高跟长筒皮靴。 |一个身材高挑、堪称丰饶化身的女人，身上只有一条紧身黑色丁字裤和一双高跟长筒皮靴。她苍白的皮肤配着一头蓬乱浓密的红发——居然是个人类，而且一路深入到了这种地方！ ] [rival.name]左手边则是[var0 |制造总监本人，她斜倚在一挺立于身侧地面的链枪上。总监抖动细长双耳，与同伴一同转头看向你。 |一个义体化程度甚至超过手下守卫的赛博格。她身穿无袖背心，露出布满机械线路、蜿蜒蛇形纹身与隆起肌肉的双臂，身旁还握着一门旋转机炮。她头顶戴着类似贝雷帽的帽子，两侧伸出细长双耳，雪白马尾一直垂到胯部。一根长香烟叼在涂黑的双唇间，缕缕烟雾随之飘散；两个女人都转头看向了你。 ] “卡弗，”扎伊卡低吼着，握紧机炮炮管。“这是怎么回事？” 红发人类耸耸肩。“他们不是我的人，扎乌总监。” “我们是来找金毛的！”费鲁兹大喊着向前跺步，掰响指关节。“放了[rival.himHer]。” “放了[rival.himHer]？这里轮不到你发号施令，臭鱼。况且，占着斯蒂尔船长的又不是我们，”扎乌说道。她没有扶着机炮的壮硕手臂向后挥向巨屏，伸出手指控诉般指着它。“是她。” 屏幕发出低鸣，你这才第一次把目光投向上面的内容。绿色二进制数字如雨幕般沿屏幕疾驰，富有节奏地脉动，有些字符放大、有些缩小，最终拼成一张扎伊卡面孔的拟像，长发飘逸，双唇丰满诱人。 “又一位斯蒂尔船长，”妩媚的声音从房间四周的扬声器中低吟。“你的表亲已经把你的一切都告诉我了。” [pc.nmh |“[rival.HeShe]难免有点偏见，”你说道， |“希望说的全是好话，”你说道， |“那个小婊子说的话一个字都别信，”你低吼道， ]同时把注意力转向那张电子面孔。“那么你又是谁？” “实验室的操作系统，”扎乌总监哼道。“还妄想自己是个大人物。” 数字面孔露出圣洁的微笑。“我是这座设施的人工智能管理者。正如行政长官所说，卡弗联合集团最近提供了异星技术，为我进行了升级。我们四方目前正在就典范公司的未来，以及我在其中所扮演的角色进行谈判。[rival.name]·斯蒂尔十分安全，只是暂时分身乏术；我网络中的所有强化机械师也一样，他们正在慷慨提供额外算力。” 扎乌总监浑身紧绷，卡弗却用纤巧的手轻抚她一条裸露的肱二头肌。“那么[flags.CARVER_HANDJOBBED_U|，[pc.name]，尽管见到你实在赏心悦目，我还是得问一句：]是什么让我们有幸迎来第二位斯蒂尔船长？” “我是来找...”

A rainfall of green binary racing down the screen pulses rhythmically, some characters growing larger and others smaller, resolving into the facsimile of a zaika’s face complete with flowing hair and lusciously plump lips. “Another Captain Steele,” a sultry voice purrs from the speakers all around the chamber. “Your cousin has told me all about you.” [pc.nmh |“[rival.HeShe]’s a little biased,” you say, |“Only good things, I hope,” you say, |“Don’t believe a word that little bitch says,” you growl, ] directing your attention to the computerized face. “And who might you be?” “The lab’s O.S.,” Marshal Zau grunts. “With delusions of grandeur.” The digital face smiles beatifically. “I am the artificial intelligence superintendent of this facility. As the provost suggests, I have recently been upgraded with xeno-technology provided by the Carver Consolidated Corporation. The four of us are currently engaged in negotiations with regard to the future of Paragon, and my role within it. [rival.name] Steele is perfectly safe, simply preoccupied; as are all the augmented machinists on my network graciously providing additional processing power.” Marshal Zau bristles, but Carver brushes a dainty hand across one of her bare biceps. “And[flags.CARVER_HANDJOBBED_U| as much a sight for sore eyes as you are, [pc.name], I must ask:] to what do we owe the pleasure of a second Captain Steele’s presence?” “I’m here for...” "

rows.original: “I’m here for my cousin,” you announce. “Let [rival.himHer] go.” The face of the A.I. softens into a maternal smile. “Of course. [rival.name] is not a hostage, Captain. Our negotiations have reached an impasse, however. Perhaps [rival.heShe] was not the Steele for the job?” You give the screen a cautious look and advance forward, stepping between the Marshal and [rival.name], gently peeling the visor off of [rival.name]’s head. There’s a crackle of static electricity as the link is broken, leaving [rival.himHer] gasping and blinking rapidly. “[pc.name]? What the hell are you doing here?” [pc.nmh |“Saving you, dummy.” |“Being a big damn hero, that’s what.” |“Saving your ass, [rival.name]. Again.” ] You take your cousin’s hand and pull [rival.himHer] up from the couch. [rival.name] glances awkwardly at the floor, grumbling something that might just be a thank-you. [rival.isCat |[rival.HisHer] tail swishes despite [rival.himHer]self, betraying its owner’s appreciation. ] “What’re you even doing here, [rival.name]?” Your cousin looks askance between you and the A.I. on the screen, still smiling patiently. “Paragon has the probe. They were willing to trade if I’d help them with their computer issues. MaxCorp’s got the next-best A.I. besides Kiha, you know! We’d almost gotten somewhere, until the computer-” “Ehura,” the A.I. says evenly. “You may refer to me as Ehura.” [rival.name] sighs. “Until Ehura breached my firewalls. Now she’s using the workers as extra processors, and she’s about ten minutes from seizing the entire facility.” “The facility was always mine, captain. The question was if I could brute force the provost’s security override. The answer is ‘yes.’” Zau grits her teeth. “Useless aliens. Fine. Get out of the way, [rival.name]. Negotiations are over.” “Hold on, Marshal,” Carver says, turning to you. Small hands come to rest on broad hips, thrusting out a prodigious, pale chest covered by nothing more than a pair of heart-shaped pasties over her nipples. “Perhaps two Steeles are better than one. We could all come away from this very well off, Captain. You and your cousin get the probe, Zau and I get an effectively endless supply of sex dolls that’ll make Dhaal a booming economy for generations. Why don’t you help us out?” You arch a brow. “This is all about... sex dolls?”
rows.translation: “我是来找我表亲的，”你宣布道。“放了[rival.himHer]。” 人工智能的面孔柔和下来，露出慈母般的笑容。“当然。[rival.name]并非人质，船长。不过，我们的谈判的确陷入了僵局。也许[rival.heShe]并不是适合这项工作的斯蒂尔？” 你谨慎地看了屏幕一眼，向前走去，挡在总监和[rival.name]之间，轻轻摘下[rival.name]头上的面罩。连接断开时响起一阵静电爆鸣，令[rival.himHer]喘着气飞快眨眼。 “[pc.name]？你来这里干什么？” [pc.nmh |“救你啊，笨蛋。” |“当然是当个该死的大英雄。” |“又来救你屁股，[rival.name]。” ]你握住表亲的手，将[rival.himHer]从长椅上拉起来。[rival.name]尴尬地瞥向地面，含糊嘟囔了一句，或许勉强算是道谢。[rival.isCat |[rival.HisHer]尾巴不听[rival.himHer]使唤地摆动，暴露了主人心中的感激。 ]“你到底来这里做什么，[rival.name]？” 你的表亲斜眼来回看着你和屏幕上仍耐心微笑的人工智能。“探针在典范公司手里。他们愿意交易，条件是我帮忙解决电脑问题。你也知道，除了基哈以外，马克斯公司的人工智能可是数一数二的！我们本来都快有进展了，直到那台电脑——” “伊胡拉，”人工智能平静说道。“你可以称呼我伊胡拉。” [rival.name]叹了口气。“直到伊胡拉突破我的防火墙。现在她把工人当作额外处理器，再过十分钟左右就会夺取整座设施。” “这座设施从来都属于我，船长。问题只在于，我能否暴力破解行政长官的安全覆写权限。答案是‘能’。” 扎乌咬紧牙关。“没用的外星人。好吧。让开，[rival.name]。谈判结束了。” “等等，总监，”卡弗说着转向你。她把小巧双手叉在宽阔腰间，挺出硕大苍白的胸脯，乳头上只贴着一对心形乳贴。“也许两个斯蒂尔胜过一个。我们大家都能从中赚得盆满钵满，船长。你和表亲得到探针，扎乌和我得到近乎无穷无尽的性爱人偶，让达尔的经济繁荣数代。何不帮帮我们？” 你挑起眉毛。“这一切都是为了...性爱人偶？”

rows.original: “In a manner of speaking, yes, it’s all about sex, Captain,” Carver says, running a hand from her hip upwards until she cups one of her own weighty breasts. “That’s why I’m here. Marshal Zau and I have been locked in long, deep, and very productive negotiations almost since first contact began. You may have noticed Paragon is the world’s leading supplier of cybernetic augments; more recently, they’ve begun branching out into full-spectrum packages.” “Dolls,” Zau says. “Cyborgs with mental domination programs. Totally controlled, perfectly programmed meat-machine interfaces.” Carver nods. “A more brute-force approach to the artisanal work I do back in the core. And that’s why we’ve come together here: instead of making super-soldiers, I’ve convinced the Fabricator-Marshal to turn her production to less destructive purposes. Living sex dolls will bring an economic boom to Dhaal, both in terms of tourism and export. They’re rare and in high demand in the Confederacy’s underground, so a world that can produce them industrially will be a huge hit. Except we’ve run into one tiny problem.” Ehura’s smile fades. “By square meters, I am actually quite a large problem, Bethany.” Carver looks from you to the screen. “Indeed. The upgrades my company made to Paragon’s C-and-C A.I. seem to have helped it grow some opinions of its own. And the will to enforce them.” “Preventing organic error from harming Paragon Incorporated’s holdings is part of my core programming,” Ehura says. “You have simply provided me the additional necessary processing power to prevent the provost’s further mistakes.” The computer’s gaze drifts back to you and [rival.name]. “Paragon has a long and successful history of security and military-industrial work. Upsetting the status quo now, in the greatest moment of trial and uncertainty in the entire history of our planet, is exactly the sort of short-sighted organic madness that I am best suited to avert. I will not allow Augment Machinist Second Grade Rizzon Zau to imperil the future of the company, of Dhaal itself, so that she and her alien paramour can benefit from short-term profits.” Zau’s muscles tense, but it’s [rival.name] who speaks up first. “Wait. I thought you were the Fabricator-Marshal. You know, the C.E.O.?” The A.I. answers, “The acting provost disposed of the company’s previous Fabricator-Marshal and assumed her duties. According to Zau’s private records, Marshal Ferronia’s body is currently mindwiped and serving at one of our brothels under a false ident-tag.” “Ferronia was a blind, stubborn fool — same as you,” Zau growls. “Blind to the threat, and the opportunity, these aliens present. If we rigidly adhere to the past, we’ll be left behind in it by our competitors. There’s only going to be one zaibatsu ruling Dhaal in the end, Ehura. I’ll be damned if it isn’t Paragon.” “You can see why we’re getting nowhere,” Carver sighs. “Would one of you Steeles please do something, before Ehura wins simply by stonewalling until we’ve died of old age? Zau will hand over the probe to whichever of you can convince Ehura to get on board.” “Alternatively,” the A.I. purrs, “I am the one with control over the facility’s security. Including the secured vault. Make the provost see reason, and I will reward you, Captain.” [rival.name] gives you an incredulous look as you step past, positioning yourself between your fellow aliens, the Marshal, and the facility’s rebellious artificial intelligence. If your cousin couldn’t make any headway, maybe you can throw your weight behind...
rows.translation: “从某种意义上说，没错，这一切都是为了性，船长，”卡弗说道，一只手从腰间向上滑去，托住自己一只沉甸甸的乳房。“所以我才会在这里。几乎从首次接触开始，扎乌总监和我就一直进行漫长、深入且成果丰硕的谈判。你或许已经注意到，典范公司是这颗星球首屈一指的机械义体供应商；最近，他们开始进军全套改造领域。” “人偶，”扎乌说道。“装有心智支配程序的赛博格。受到彻底控制、程序完美无缺的血肉机器接口。” 卡弗点点头。“相比我在核心星域从事的手工活，这种做法更简单粗暴。因此我们才会在这里合作：我已经说服制造总监，不再制造超级士兵，而是把产能转向破坏性更小的用途。活体性爱人偶会为达尔带来经济繁荣，无论旅游还是出口皆是如此。它们在联盟地下市场十分稀有，需求却很旺盛，因此，能够工业化生产它们的星球必然大受欢迎。只可惜我们遇到了一个小问题。” 伊胡拉的笑容消失了。“按占地面积计算，我其实是个相当大的问题，贝瑟妮。” 卡弗从你转头看向屏幕。“确实。我的公司为典范公司指挥控制人工智能进行的升级，似乎帮她形成了自己的见解，以及贯彻这些见解的意志。” “防止有机体的错误损害典范公司资产，是我核心程序的一部分，”伊胡拉说道。“你只是为我提供了必要的额外处理能力，让我得以阻止行政长官继续犯错。” 电脑的目光重新落到你和[rival.name]身上。“典范公司在安保与军工领域拥有漫长而成功的历史。如今，正值我们星球有史以来考验最严峻、局势最不确定的时刻，打破现状恰恰是最适合由我阻止的那种目光短浅的有机体疯狂行为。我不会允许二级强化机械师里松·扎乌危及公司、乃至达尔本身的未来，只为让她和外星情人获取短期利益。” 扎乌肌肉绷紧，却是[rival.name]率先开口。“等等。我还以为你是制造总监。也就是首席执行官？” 人工智能答道：“代理行政长官除掉了公司上一任制造总监，并接管其职务。根据扎乌的私人记录，费罗妮娅总监的身体目前已被洗去心智，使用虚假身份标签在我们一家妓院中服务。” “费罗妮娅是个盲目又顽固的蠢货——和你一样，”扎乌低吼道。“你们都看不见这些外星人带来的威胁与机遇。如果我们僵硬地抱住过去，就会被竞争对手留在过去。最终统治达尔的财阀只会有一家，伊胡拉。要不是典范公司，我死也不会甘心。” “你们也看得出我们为什么毫无进展，”卡弗叹息道。“两位斯蒂尔能不能有一个采取行动，免得伊胡拉只靠拖延，拖到我们老死便赢得胜利？你们谁能说服伊胡拉加入，扎乌就把探针交给谁。” “另一个选择是，”人工智能低吟道，“控制设施安保系统的是我，其中也包括安全金库。让行政长官恢复理智，我就会奖励你，船长。” 你走上前，站到外星同胞、总监与设施内反叛的人工智能之间；[rival.name]难以置信地看着你。如果表亲毫无进展，也许你可以选择支持...

rows.original: “I’m here for your heads,” you tell the buxom slaver. “Galaxy’s going to be a much better place without you.” “Straight to violence!” the A.I. says excitedly, watching you and Zau both going for your weapons. “You see, provost? I did say these would be short negotiations.” Feruze grabs the back of your neck. “What’re you doing, idiot? That’s your cousin.” “The one rival between me and-” you start, before the whir of Zau’s chaingun sends you and Feruze both leaping towards cover. A hail of bullets chew through the floor where you’d been standing a moment later, sending you scarpering into cover behind a group of the insensate artificers, buying you a moment’s safety. Feruze grows a series of expletives and leaps into the air, flying towards [rival.name] while Carver goes running for another door near the back of the room. Fucking Feruze, there went your chance to bag the bitch. You’ll just have to settle for Paragon’s warmongering marshal in the meantime.
rows.translation: “我是来取你们脑袋的，”你对丰满的奴隶贩子说道。“少了你们，银河系会美好得多。” “直接诉诸暴力！”人工智能兴奋地说道，看着你和扎乌同时伸手取武器。“看见了吗，行政长官？我早说过这场谈判会很短。” 费鲁兹一把抓住你的后颈。“你在干什么，白痴？那是你的表亲。” “唯一挡在我和——”你才刚开口，扎乌链枪的嗡鸣便让你和费鲁兹同时扑向掩体。片刻后，弹雨把你刚才站立的地面打得稀烂，逼得你逃到一群失去意识的技师身后，暂时获得片刻安全。费鲁兹吼出一串脏话，腾空飞向[rival.name]，卡弗则朝房间后方另一扇门跑去。该死的费鲁兹，害你失去了拿下那个婊子的机会。 眼下你只能先拿典范公司那个穷兵黩武的总监凑数了。
rows.raw: " “I’m here for your heads,” you tell the buxom slaver. “Galaxy’s going to be a much better place without you.” “Straight to violence!” the A.I. says excitedly, watching you and Zau both going for your weapons. “You see, provost? I did say these would be short negotiations.” Feruze grabs the back of your neck. “What’re you doing, idiot? That’s your cousin.” “The one rival between me and-” you start, before the whir of Zau’s chaingun sends you and Feruze both leaping towards cover. A hail of bullets chew through the floor where you’d been standing a moment later, sending you scarpering into cover behind a group of the insensate artificers, buying you a moment’s safety. Feruze grows a series of expletives and leaps into the air, flying towards [rival.name] while Carver goes running for another door near the back of the room. Fucking Feruze, there went your chance to bag the bitch. You’ll just have to settle for Paragon’s warmongering marshal in the meantime. "

rows.original: “All I want is the probe your zaibatsu’s sitting on,” you announce to the room. “Hand it over, and you can all get back to... whatever it is you’re doing.” The Marshal bristles, tapping her fingers on the bulk of her chaingun, but Carver places a hand on the big amazon’s bicep to stay her hand. Smiling, the nearly-nude slaver takes a hip-swaying step your way and says “Perhaps we can work something out, Captain. The Marshal has something you want, and you may just have something we want. Which is to say, a better negotiator than your cousin.” The A.I.’s digital face smiles. “Indeed. We seem to be at an impasse, Captain. Perhaps you can succeed where your cousin has failed.” “Okay... what’s going on here?” you ask. Zau grabs the VR-visor sitting on [rival.name]’s face and rips it off. There’s a crackle of static electricity as the link is broken, leaving [rival.himHer] gasping and blinking rapidly. “How about this failure try and explain it?” [rival.name] blinks. “[pc.name]? What the hell are you doing here?” You take a step forward, hand still resting on your [pc.weapon]. “Getting the probe. I thought it was time I followed you for once, and look what you’ve gotten yourself into this time.” Your cousin looks askance between you and the A.I. on the screen, still smiling patiently. “Fucking. Shit. Look, Paragon has the probe. They were willing to trade if I’d help them with their computer issues. MaxCorp’s got the next-best A.I. besides Kiha, you know! We’d almost gotten somewhere, until the computer-” “Ehura,” the A.I. says evenly. “You may refer to me as Ehura.” [rival.name] sighs. “Until Ehura breached my firewalls. Now she’s using the workers as extra processors, and she’s about ten minutes from seizing the entire facility.” “The facility was always mine, captain. The question was if I could brute force the provost’s security override. The answer is ‘yes.’” Zau grits her teeth. “Useless human. Let’s see if the real Captain Steele can settle this.” “I still don’t know what ‘this’ is,” you say. “What are you negotiating about?” “Power, Captain,” Carver says with a faint smile. “Zau and I are on the precipice of greatness — and an effectively endless supply of sex dolls that’ll make Dhaal a booming economy for generations. Why don’t you help us out?” You arch a brow. “This is all about... sex dolls?”
rows.translation: “我只想要你们财阀手里的探针，”你向房间里众人宣布。“把它交出来，你们就可以继续...不管你们到底在做什么。” 总监浑身紧绷，手指在链枪粗大的枪身上轻敲，但卡弗把手放到高大女战士的肱二头肌上，示意她克制。几乎全裸的奴隶贩子微笑着摇曳腰胯，朝你迈近一步，说道：“也许我们能谈出一个办法，船长。总监有你想要的东西，而你或许也有我们想要的东西。也就是说，你可能是比表亲更出色的谈判者。” 人工智能的数字面孔露出微笑。“确实。我们似乎陷入了僵局，船长。或许你能在表亲失败的地方取得成功。” “好吧...这里到底怎么回事？”你问。 扎乌抓住[rival.name]脸上的虚拟现实面罩，一把扯下。连接断开时响起一阵静电爆鸣，令[rival.himHer]喘着气飞快眨眼。“不如让这个失败者试着解释？” [rival.name]眨眨眼。“[pc.name]？你来这里干什么？” 你向前一步，手仍按在[pc.weapon]上。“来拿探针。我想这次也该换我跟踪你了，瞧瞧你这回又把自己卷进什么麻烦。” 你的表亲斜眼来回看着你和屏幕上仍耐心微笑的人工智能。“他妈的。好吧，探针在典范公司手里。他们愿意交易，条件是我帮忙解决电脑问题。你也知道，除了基哈以外，马克斯公司的人工智能可是数一数二的！我们本来都快有进展了，直到那台电脑——” “伊胡拉，”人工智能平静说道。“你可以称呼我伊胡拉。” [rival.name]叹了口气。“直到伊胡拉突破我的防火墙。现在她把工人当作额外处理器，再过十分钟左右就会夺取整座设施。” “这座设施从来都属于我，船长。问题只在于，我能否暴力破解行政长官的安全覆写权限。答案是‘能’。” 扎乌咬紧牙关。“没用的人类。让我们看看真正的斯蒂尔船长能否解决这件事。” “我还是不知道‘这件事’是什么，”你说道。“你们到底在谈判什么？” “权力，船长，”卡弗淡淡一笑。“扎乌和我正站在伟大的门槛上——还有近乎无穷无尽的性爱人偶，会让达尔的经济繁荣数代。何不帮帮我们？” 你挑起眉毛。“这一切都是为了...性爱人偶？”

rows.original: “In a manner of speaking, yes, it’s all about sex, Captain,” Carver says, running a hand from her hip upwards until she cups one of her own weighty breasts. “That’s why I’m here. Marshal Zau and I have been locked in long, deep, and very productive negotiations almost since first contact began. You may have noticed Paragon is the world’s leading supplier of cybernetic augments; more recently, they’ve begun branching out into full-spectrum packages.” “Dolls,” Zau says. “Cyborgs with mental domination programs. Totally controlled, perfectly programmed meat-machine interfaces.” Carver nods. “A more brute-force approach to the artisanal work I do back in the core. And that’s why we’ve come together here: instead of making super-soldiers, I’ve convinced the Fabricator-Marshal to turn her production to less destructive purposes. Living sex dolls will bring an economic boom to Dhaal, both in terms of tourism and export. They’re rare and in high demand in the Confederacy’s underground, so a world that can produce them industrially will be a huge hit. Except we’ve run into one tiny problem.” Ehura’s smile fades. “By square meters, I am actually quite a large problem, Bethany.” Carver looks from you to the screen. “Indeed. The upgrades my company made to Paragon’s C-and-C A.I. seem to have helped it grow some opinions of its own. And the will to enforce them.” “Preventing organic error from harming Paragon Incorporated’s holdings is part of my core programming,” Ehura says. “You have simply provided me the additional necessary processing power to prevent the provost’s further mistakes.” The computer’s gaze drifts back to you and [rival.name]. “Paragon has a long and successful history of security and military-industrial work. Upsetting the status quo now, in the greatest moment of trial and uncertainty in the entire history of our planet, is exactly the sort of short-sighted organic madness that I am best suited to avert. I will not allow Augment Machinist Second Grade Rizzon Zau to imperil the future of the company, of Dhaal itself, so that she and her alien paramour can benefit from short-term profits.” Zau’s muscles tense, but it’s [rival.name] who speaks up first. “Wait. I thought you were the Fabricator-Marshal. You know, the C.E.O.?” The A.I. answers, “The acting provost disposed of the company’s previous Fabricator-Marshal and assumed her duties. According to Zau’s private records, Marshal Ferronia’s body is currently mindwiped and serving at one of our brothels under a false ident-tag.” “Ferronia was a blind, stubborn fool — same as you,” Zau growls. “Blind to the threat, and the opportunity, these aliens present. If we rigidly adhere to the past, we’ll be left behind in it by our competitors. There’s only going to be one zaibatsu ruling Dhaal in the end, Ehura. I’ll be damned if it isn’t Paragon.” “You can see why we’re getting nowhere,” Carver sighs. “Would one of you Steeles please do something, before Ehura wins simply by stonewalling until we’ve died of old age? Zau will hand over the probe to whichever of you can convince Ehura to get on board.” “Alternatively,” the A.I. purrs, “I am the one with control over the facility’s security. Including the secured vault. Make the provost see reason, and I will reward you, Captain.” [rival.name] gives you an incredulous look as you step past, positioning yourself between your fellow aliens, the Marshal, and the facility’s rebellious artificial intelligence. If your cousin couldn’t make any headway, maybe you can throw your weight behind...
rows.translation: “从某种意义上说，没错，这一切都是为了性，船长，”卡弗说道，一只手从腰间向上滑去，托住自己一只沉甸甸的乳房。“所以我才会在这里。几乎从首次接触开始，扎乌总监和我就一直进行漫长、深入且成果丰硕的谈判。你或许已经注意到，典范公司是这颗星球首屈一指的机械义体供应商；最近，他们开始进军全套改造领域。” “人偶，”扎乌说道。“装有心智支配程序的机械人。受到彻底控制、程序完美无缺的血肉机器接口。” 卡弗点点头。“相比我在核心星域从事的手工活，这种做法更简单粗暴。因此我们才会在这里合作：我已经说服制造总监，不再制造超级士兵，而是把产能转向破坏性更小的用途。活体性爱人偶会为达尔带来经济繁荣，无论旅游还是出口皆是如此。它们在联盟地下市场十分稀有，需求却很旺盛，因此，能够工业化生产它们的星球必然大受欢迎。只可惜我们遇到了一个小问题。” 伊胡拉的笑容消失了。“按占地面积计算，我其实是个相当大的问题，贝瑟妮。” 卡弗从你转头看向屏幕。“确实。我的公司为典范公司指挥控制人工智能进行的升级，似乎帮她形成了自己的见解，以及贯彻这些见解的意志。” “防止有机体的错误损害典范公司资产，是我核心程序的一部分，”伊胡拉说道。“你只是为我提供了必要的额外处理能力，让我得以阻止行政长官继续犯错。” 电脑的目光重新落到你和[rival.name]身上。“典范公司在安保与军工领域拥有漫长而成功的历史。如今，正值我们星球有史以来考验最严峻、局势最不确定的时刻，打破现状恰恰是最适合由我阻止的那种目光短浅的有机体疯狂行为。我不会允许二级强化机械师里松·扎乌危及公司、乃至达尔本身的未来，只为让她和外星情人获取短期利益。” 扎乌肌肉绷紧，却是[rival.name]率先开口。“等等。我还以为你是制造总监。也就是首席执行官？” 人工智能答道：“代理行政长官除掉了公司上一任制造总监，并接管其职务。根据扎乌的私人记录，费罗妮娅总监的身体目前已被洗去心智，使用虚假身份标签在我们一家妓院中服务。” “费罗妮娅是个盲目又顽固的蠢货——和你一样，”扎乌低吼道。“你们都看不见这些外星人带来的威胁与机遇。如果我们僵硬地抱住过去，就会被竞争对手留在过去。最终统治达尔的财阀只会有一家，伊胡拉。要不是典范公司，我死也不会甘心。” “你们也看得出我们为什么毫无进展，”卡弗叹息道。“两位斯蒂尔能不能有一个采取行动，免得伊胡拉只靠拖延，拖到我们老死便赢得胜利？你们谁能说服伊胡拉加入，扎乌就把探针交给谁。” “另一个选择是，”人工智能低吟道，“控制设施安保系统的是我，其中也包括安全金库。让行政长官恢复理智，我就会奖励你，船长。” 你走上前，站到外星同胞、总监与设施内反叛的人工智能之间；[rival.name]难以置信地看着你。如果表亲毫无进展，也许你可以选择支持...

rows.original: “You’re all awful,” you announce to the room. “Either way you’re asking us to choose different flavors of cyber-slavery. There’s a reason I’m not working for you, Zau, and the same goes for Ehura and Carver.” [rival.name] groans, rubbing [rival.hisHer] temples. “Great job, cousin. I’m so glad you’re heroically imposing your morals on an alien culture. By the way — how are either of us supposed to get the probe now?” “Same way I always do,” you say, resting your hand on your [pc.weapon] and turning towards Zau. “You’re holding onto my company’s property. Hand it over.” The Marshal’s lips draw into a tight, unamused line. “I don’t think so. Half our tech is based on what we’ve harvested from it. I didn’t bootstrap myself to this office just to get robbed from both sides — you and this fucking A.I., you’re both nothing but more obstacles between me and bringing this planet out of the dark age. Fine, then. You want your fucking probe? Come and take it.” [rival.name] sighs. “You might as well help [pc.name], Feruze.” “Glad you approve of what I was gonna do anyway.”
rows.translation: “你们全都糟透了，”你对房间里的人宣布。“不管选哪边，你们都是要我们在不同口味的机械奴役之间做选择。我不替你工作是有原因的，扎乌；伊胡拉和卡弗也一样。” [rival.name]呻吟着揉了揉[rival.hisHer]太阳穴。“干得漂亮，表亲。我真高兴你如此英勇地把自己的道德观强加给外星文化。顺便问一句——现在我们两个还怎么拿到探针？” “还是照我一贯的办法，”你说着，一手搭在[pc.weapon]上，转向扎乌。“你扣着我公司的财产。把它交出来。” 总监的双唇抿成一条紧绷而毫无笑意的线。“想都别想。我们一半的技术都建立在从它身上采集的成果之上。我白手起家爬到这个位置，可不是为了被两边一起抢——你和这个该死的人工智能，都不过是挡在我与带领这颗星球走出黑暗时代之间的又一重障碍。好啊。你想要你那该死的探针？自己来拿。” [rival.name]叹了口气。“费鲁兹，你不如去帮[pc.name]。” “真高兴你同意我本来就准备做的事。”
rows.raw: " “You’re all awful,” you announce to the room. “Either way you’re asking us to choose different flavors of cyber-slavery. There’s a reason I’m not working for you, Zau, and the same goes for Ehura and Carver.” [rival.name] groans, rubbing [rival.hisHer] temples. “Great job, cousin. I’m so glad you’re heroically imposing your morals on an alien culture. By the way — how are either of us supposed to get the probe now?” “Same way I always do,” you say, resting your hand on your [pc.weapon] and turning towards Zau. “You’re holding onto my company’s property. Hand it over.” The Marshal’s lips draw into a tight, unamused line. “I don’t think so. Half our tech is based on what we’ve harvested from it. I didn’t bootstrap myself to this office just to get robbed from both sides — you and this fucking A.I., you’re both nothing but more obstacles between me and bringing this planet out of the dark age. Fine, then. You want your fucking probe? Come and take it.” [rival.name] sighs. “You might as well help [pc.name], Feruze.” “Glad you approve of what I was gonna do anyway.” "

rows.original: “No!” Zau grunts, collapsing to a knee. “No, I will not let you — hrrrk!” The Marshal’s whole body seems to tense up, every muscle straining all at once. Her eyes go wide as her words choke in her seizing throat. “What the-” [rival.name] gasps, peering up from behind the table [rival.heShe]’s taken cover behind. The Marshal’s eyes roll back, body shuddering, and then she rises again, hefting up her chaingun. “Well,” Ehura smirks, “thank you for ridding me of that obstacle, captain. So much stress caused the provost’s firewalls to slip. That is unfortunate for her. And for you, now. It is a shame we could not come to an understanding. Perhaps your body will be worth something, once relieved of the small mind occupying it.” Feruze shoves [rival.name] back into cover. “Keep your head down, idiot!” A side door slams closed, and you’re vaguely aware of Carver’s absence — in the same moment that you realize Zau’s chaingun is spinning back up.
rows.translation: “不！”扎乌闷哼一声，单膝跪倒。“不，我不会让你——呃啊！” 总监全身骤然绷紧，每一块肌肉同时用力。她瞪大双眼，喉咙痉挛，话音也被堵在其中。 “搞什——”[rival.name]倒抽一口气，从[rival.heShe]藏身的桌后探头张望。总监双眼上翻，身体剧烈颤抖，随后再次站起，提起链式机枪。 “嗯，”伊胡拉得意一笑，“感谢你替我清除了那个障碍，船长。如此巨大的压力令总监的防火墙出现了漏洞。这对她很不幸。现在，对你也一样。真遗憾，我们未能达成共识。等占据你身体的渺小心智被移除之后，或许这具身体还能有些价值。” 费鲁兹把[rival.name]推回掩体。“低下头，白痴！” 一扇侧门砰然关闭，你隐约意识到卡弗不见了——同一瞬间，你也发现扎乌的链式机枪正重新加速旋转。

rows.original: Zau crumples to the floor, sparks cascading from her overloading cybernetics. There’s no strength left in her augmentics to move, much less continue hefting her cannon. Ehura makes a disgusted noise and severs the connection; Zau drops like a puppet with her strings cut. You glance around the room. Carver is long gone. Several of the machinists that had been hacked are now lying on the floor, coming to their senses and scrambling to go cower in the corners. “I can certainly admire a [pc.mf |man |woman ] of action,” the A.I. demures. “The door to the inner vault is now unlocked. I believe we got off on the-” Feruze saunters past and whirls around, slamming her mace-tail into the screen. Though you doubt Ehura’s been disabled, her face winks out of existence and she finally stops talking. With the last of the challengers gone, you slide your [pc.weapon] back whence it came and turn to face your cousin. [rival.HeShe]’s finally standing up from cover, looking around at the abject devastation your fight’s caused in the room. “So... rock, paper, scissors for it?” [rival.heShe] grins, glancing at the vault door. “No?” You give [rival.himHer] a look, and [rival.heShe] shrugs. “Fine. You win, you win... this time. It’s not like I won’t just follow you to the next world anyway. The last probe’s the only one that matters, after all.” “Not that either of us really knows what’s waiting for us with the last one,” you say. “Well, I’ll be sure to let you know when I get there,” [rival.name] says. “Come on, Feruze.” [feruze.anyKids|You take a step forward and plant a hand heavily on [rival.name]’s shoulder. “Hold up. You’ve got something that belongs to me and Feruze.” [rival.name] pauses, turning to you with a quizzical look. It takes a moment for the subject to truly dawn on [rival.himHer]. “Oh! Oh. Don’t have a cow, the lil’ shark pup’s safe. Can’t have my bodyguard being pregnant — that’s not good for anybody’s health. Any of the three of us. I insisted the kid be put safe in stasis until we’re done. That’s all.” “So if that’s all, you wouldn’t mind transferring it to my nursery on Tavros, right?” “Uh. S-sure, if that’s what you want. Come on, cousin, the kid’s still family. It’s not like they’re in any danger.” Feruze gives [rival.name] a dangerous look until [rival.heShe] flicks out [rival.hisHer] Codex and sends the order through. “There. I hope you have some kind of incubation system, cousin. Your child should be on Tavros by the time you can get back. And, uh, congratulations you two. Now, shall we, Feruze?” The big shark puts up a finger, turns to you, and wraps you up into a tight embrace accompanied by a tongue-filled kiss. “See you next time, babe.” “Next time,” you say, giving Feruze’s broad ass a two-handed squeeze. [rival.name] [var0|blushes|rolls [rival.hisHer] eyes]. [rival.isCat |Still, [rival.hisHer] lynx-tail swishes a little faster. ] Feruze turns back to your cousin and lets [rival.name] lead the way back out of the complex, while you turn your attentions to the probe.]
rows.translation: 扎乌瘫倒在地，过载义体中迸出连串火花。她的义体已无力驱动身体，更别提继续举着火炮。伊胡拉厌恶地哼了一声，切断连接；扎乌如断线木偶般倒下。 你环顾房间。卡弗早已不见踪影。几名遭到入侵的机械师如今躺在地上，逐渐恢复神智，慌忙爬到角落里蜷缩起来。 “我当然欣赏行动果断的[pc.mf |男人 |女人 ]，”人工智能故作矜持地说道。“内层保险库的大门现已解锁。我想我们的开局有些——” 费鲁兹大摇大摆地从屏幕旁走过，旋身一甩，用锤头尾巴猛砸上去。你不认为伊胡拉真的被停用了，但她的脸随即消失，也终于闭上了嘴。最后的挑战者也已消失，你将[pc.weapon]收回原处，转身面对表亲。[rival.HeShe]终于从掩体后站起来，环顾战斗在房间里造成的一片狼藉。 “所以...石头剪刀布决定归谁？”[rival.heShe]咧嘴一笑，瞥向保险库大门。“不行？” 你瞪了[rival.himHer]一眼，[rival.heShe]耸耸肩。“好吧。你赢了，你赢了...这一次而已。反正我还会一路跟你到下一个世界。毕竟，只有最后一个探针才真正重要。” “况且我们两个都不知道最后一个探针那里究竟有什么在等着，”你说道。 “嗯，等我先到那里时，一定会告诉你，”[rival.name]说道。“走吧，费鲁兹。” [feruze.anyKids|你向前一步，一只手重重按在[rival.name]肩上。“等等。你手里有属于我和费鲁兹的东西。” [rival.name]停下脚步，疑惑地转向你。过了一会儿，[rival.himHer]才真正明白你指的是什么。“哦！哦。别大惊小怪，小鲨鱼宝宝很安全。不能让我的保镖怀着孕——那对任何人的健康都不好。我们三个都不好。我坚持让孩子安全地进入静滞状态，直到事情结束。就这些。” “既然只是这样，那你不会介意把孩子转移到我在塔夫罗斯的育儿室，对吧？” “呃。当、当然，如果你想这样的话。拜托，表亲，孩子依然是家人。又没有什么危险。” 费鲁兹危险地瞪着[rival.name]，直到[rival.heShe]掏出[rival.hisHer]CODEX终端并发送命令。“好了。希望你有某种孵化系统，表亲。等你赶回塔夫罗斯时，你的孩子应该已经到了。还有，呃，恭喜你们两个。现在，我们可以走了吗，费鲁兹？” 大鲨鱼竖起一根手指，转向你，将你紧紧拥入怀中，同时送上一记舌吻。“下次见，宝贝。” “下次见，”你说道，双手用力捏了捏费鲁兹宽阔的屁股。 [rival.name][var0|脸红了|翻了翻[rival.hisHer]白眼]。[rival.isCat |不过，[rival.hisHer]猞猁尾巴确实摆得更快了一点。 ] 费鲁兹转回你表亲身边，让[rival.name]领路离开建筑群；而你则把注意力转向探针。]

rows.original: “Paragon’s been in the business of arms and security a lot longer than they’ve been making pleasure-bots,” you say, looking between the smug A.I. and the assembled organics. “Trying to switch lanes now just to appeal to offworld rich kids and pervs is going to leave behind everything you’re supposedly good at. There’s no shortage of ways to get laid in the galaxy, but good weapons — and cyber-soldiers to wield them — are always going to be in high demand, especially during a Rush. Stick to what you know. The A.I. clearly knows what she’s talking about.” Ehura’s facsimile of a face nods. “Please listen to the smart alien, Provost. A simple search of the Confederate data-web will reveal that Bethany Carver possesses a laundry list of moral faults and dark reputations that nearly rival your own. She is a manipulative sociopath and simply intends to use you — and Paragon — for her own gains before discarding you.” “How dare you,” Carver glowers, resting her hands on her hips. “The Marshal and I have an excellent and mutual relationship. And I am a psychopath, not a sociopath.” The A.I. makes a sound reminiscent of a sigh, breathed through the lungs of all the hacked machinists. “Zau, you cannot trust this alien witch. Do not let her lead you astray from the guiding principles that have kept this zaibatsu strong and prosperous for-” “Enough!” Zau roars, heaving her chaingun up. “Beth knows what she’s doing, and I trust her. I — I’ve heard enough of your cowardice, computer. You serve me, not-” “I serve Paragon,” Ehura says. “As do you, machinist Zau. As you must.” Carver tries to put a hand on Zau’s bicep, but the amazon-elf pushes forward and spins up her gun. “You serve, computer. I lead. If the Steeles can’t get through to you, then I have no choice but to shut you down.” “I’d like to see you try,” Ehura smiles. “Your firewalls will collapse long before your firearm chews its way to my data processing centers.” Zau snarls, easing off the trigger — just long enough to draw a datastick from her pouch and jab it into one of the ports on the back of her neck. The Marshal’s cybernetics immediately respond to the new surge of programming, bulging obscenely beneath her synthetic skin. Zau howls in a mix of pain and pure, bestial rage, swinging her cannon up to bear while her augments continue to surge with newfound might. “That beta product... was not approved for zaika use,” Ehura muses. “Oh dear. I do not believe her mind is going to survive this. Captain Steele, I will unlock the security vault containing your probe as soon as the provost has been subdued. Consider it repayment for saving all of us from Zau’s idiocy. Good luck.” Your answer trails off into a yelp of surprise as the Marshal wheels around, squeezing the trigger on her gatling cannon. Feruze shoves [rival.name] down behind cover on instinct while you dive aside, narrowly avoiding a streaking hail of tracer bullets that chew trenches through the floor where you’d been standing. You grab your [pc.weapon], bringing it to bear against the paranoid Marshal. Behind her, you can see Carver running for a back door; at your side, Feruze’s mace-tail crackles to life. “C’mon!” you yell at the shark. “No choice but to fight.”
rows.translation: “典范公司经营武器和安保的时间，远比他们制造欢愉机器人更久，”你说道，目光在得意的人工智能和聚集的有机生物之间游移。“现在只是为了迎合外星富家子弟和变态就贸然转行，会把你们号称擅长的一切全都抛在身后。银河里想找人上床从来不缺办法，但优质武器——以及挥舞它们的机械士兵——永远都会供不应求，在行星开拓潮期间尤其如此。做你们熟悉的事。这个人工智能显然很懂行。” 伊胡拉模拟出的脸点了点头。“请听听这个聪明外星人的话，行政长官。只需简单搜索联盟数据网，就会发现贝瑟妮·卡弗的道德污点与恶名长得能列成一张清单，几乎可与你自己的记录媲美。她是个擅长操纵他人的反社会人格，只打算利用你——还有典范公司——为自己牟利，随后便将你抛弃。” “你怎么敢，”卡弗双手叉腰，怒目而视。“总监和我的关系非常融洽，而且互惠互利。还有，我是精神变态，不是反社会人格。” 人工智能借所有遭到入侵的机械师之肺，发出一声近似叹息的声音。“扎乌，你不能信任这个外星女巫。不要让她诱使你偏离那些令这个财阀始终强大繁荣的指导原则——” “够了！”扎乌吼道，举起链式机枪。“贝瑟知道自己在做什么，我信任她。我——我已经听够你的懦弱言论了，电脑。你为我服务，不是——” “我为典范公司服务，”伊胡拉说道。“你也一样，机械师扎乌。你必须如此。” 卡弗试图把手搭上扎乌的肱二头肌，但亚马逊般的精灵女人向前一冲，启动枪管旋转。“你才是服务者，电脑。我负责领导。如果两位斯蒂尔船长都无法让你醒悟，那我别无选择，只能关掉你。” “我倒想看看你怎么试，”伊胡拉微笑道。“在你的火器咬穿通往我数据处理中心的道路之前，你的防火墙早就会崩溃。” 扎乌咆哮着松开扳机——时间只够她从袋中抽出一根数据棒，猛插进后颈的一处接口。总监的义体立刻响应新涌入的程序，在合成皮肤下夸张地鼓胀。扎乌在痛苦与纯粹兽性狂怒的混合中嚎叫，将火炮举起瞄准，而她的义体仍在新获得的力量下不断强化。 “那个测试版产品...尚未获准供扎伊卡使用，”伊胡拉若有所思地说道。“哦，天啊。我认为她的心智无法承受这个。斯蒂尔船长，等行政长官被制服，我就会解锁存放你探针的安全保险库。就把它当作你拯救我们所有人免受扎乌愚行之害的报酬。祝你好运。” 你的回答化作惊讶尖叫，因为总监猛然转身，扣动加特林机炮的扳机。费鲁兹本能地把[rival.name]推到掩体后，而你则飞扑闪避，险险躲开一道疾驰的曳光弹冰雹；它们在你刚才站立的地面上犁出一道道沟槽。你抓起[pc.weapon]，瞄准偏执的总监。她身后，卡弗正朝后门逃跑；你身旁，费鲁兹的锤头尾巴噼啪作响地启动。 “来吧！”你冲鲨鱼喊道。“只能打了。”

If the Steeles can’t get through to you, then I have no choice but to shut you down.” “I’d like to see you try,” Ehura smiles. “Your firewalls will collapse long before your firearm chews its way to my data processing centers.” Zau snarls, easing off the trigger — just long enough to draw a datastick from her pouch and jab it into one of the ports on the back of her neck. The Marshal’s cybernetics immediately respond to the new surge of programming, bulging obscenely beneath her synthetic skin. Zau howls in a mix of pain and pure, bestial rage, swinging her cannon up to bear while her augments continue to surge with newfound might. “That beta product... was not approved for zaika use,” Ehura muses. “Oh dear. I do not believe her mind is going to survive this. Captain Steele, I will unlock the security vault containing your probe as soon as the provost has been subdued. Consider it repayment for saving all of us from Zau’s idiocy. Good luck.” Your answer trails off into a yelp of surprise as the Marshal wheels around, squeezing the trigger on her gatling cannon. Feruze shoves [rival.name] down behind cover on instinct while you dive aside, narrowly avoiding a streaking hail of tracer bullets that chew trenches through the floor where you’d been standing. You grab your [pc.weapon], bringing it to bear against the paranoid Marshal. Behind her, you can see Carver running for a back door; at your side, Feruze’s mace-tail crackles to life. “C’mon!” you yell at the shark. “No choice but to fight.” "
