rows.original: You’re free from the Suula for all of a minute before a tall, elegant Peer struts toward you with a sultry smile across her glossy lips. “Goodness,” she murmurs, tail gracefully sweeping from one hip to the other, “what fortune. I am Dame Xhanni, of [favoredFactionCorp]. We met rather briefly at the party, though I don’t believe we were ever formally introduced.” It’s... possible you met here? Things were a little hectic, meeting all those new bigwigs. And, frankly, you’re still a little shaken from your brush with Feruze. “Well, you see, I was planning a... private party of my own. Very intimate. For friends of [favoredFactionCorp].” It’s plain to see this woman is a far more senior Peer than a lot of the giggling girls who were fawning over you before. She has some smooth, integrated augments, a gossamer dress that screams money, and the confident poise of someone who knows what she wants and has the means to get it. You’re about to ask her why she thinks you have anything to do with her Zaibatsu, but she reads the question on your face before you articulate it. “Oh, come. Nobody meets with our CEO without the whole syndicate noticing it. You’re quite favored, you know? And I would be a fool to let an opportunity like that slip through my fingers. Especially such an intriguing specimen as yourself,” she purrs with half-lidded eyes. “But please,” she continues, “don’t mistake my intentions. While I certainly see the obvious opportunity for advancement a person with your connections might offer, I’m far more interested in showing you what WE have to offer.” She draws back and moves toward a private shuttle docked nearby. “I will understand if you’re too busy for a little personal time, so I will leave my steward here.” The Peer gestures to the XO standing attentively next to a two-seater swoop bike. You’re a little nervous, considering your recent brush with an XO, but this one doesn’t seem interested in any police actions. She’s simply waiting, patiently, for you. “Should you wish to take up my offer, please just let her know and she’ll spirit you off to my... personal... chambers in the Meridian.” Dame Xhanni climbs into the shuttle and she’s gone before you even have time to process what just happened. One moment, it seems like everyone on this planet wants to kill you, the next they’re inviting you to fancy gatherings. At least this time it doesn’t seem like you’re expected to dress all fancy! If you wanted to go with the cyborg, she could have you off to the private party in no time. It seems like Feruze was going to need some time to do some investigation anyway, so this might be a fun way to pass the time. If you’re not interested, you could instead just cool your heels for a couple of days, till she finds something.

She’s carrying vials filled with pitch black goop and colorful garments in one hand, and colorful, rabbit-like bionics in the other. Certainly your inmate’s new makeover. “ABOUT DAMN TIME!” The mad rask leaves his desk, abandoning diagrams and simulations that seem to be running aimlessly. He takes a bowl filled with caramel-coated flan and a spoon on the way to you. He greedily slurps the wobbly dessert, almost orgasming from eating this simple treat. On the way, he grabs a clear visor from a pile of scrap and plugs a datacard into it. The dead device comes back to life in a flick of neon pink energy, almost blinding you with bubblegum flares. rows.original: “Me? Scheme? I would never.” She glances about before bringing her lips to your ear. “I’ll come clean. My... benefactor and I want to listen in on the party. “If you were to wear a wire... that would make my job a whole lot simpler.” A beat passes as she studies you in silence, her face inscrutable. “Look, you’ve seen how the Peers run this planet. Their victims are everywhere: a sea of worn, haggard faces kept in line by the lash of poverty. Can you turn a blind eye to that sort of thing?” Do you want to be the same type of person as your uncle Maximilian? Help me screw them over, [pc.name]. Wearing a wire would be a small step towards something great.”

rows.original: Velika leans in to capture your lips with her own as soon as you answer in the affirmative. Her ample bosom presses firmly against your [pc.chestSimple] as she wraps an arm around your waist, drawing you in closer. You lean into the embrace, your tongue slipping out to dance and twine with hers as you lose yourselves in the shared depths of your desires.”After a long, breathless moment, Velika breaks the kiss, her gaze shimmering with pure admiration. “Mhmm, I never get tired of doing that,” She clasps her hand around yours. “Now then... let’s go get your new outfit.” The cyborg walks beside you with a certain swagger, her head held high and her eyes scanning the shadows for hidden threats. She leads you inside of her ship, humming softly to herself as she flits through the hangers of her closet. Her prosthetic fingers linger on an impressive suit and she holds it up to your frame, her eyes roaming over you with a critical gaze. Velika nods, a wicked grin spreading across her face as she appraises the fit. “Yes... this will do nicely. It just needs a few alterations...” The cyborg fusses over the fit and the placement of the covert listening device for a long while before finally letting you go with your new threads, her prosthetic eyes raking over you hungrily as you leave.
rows.translation: 你刚给出肯定答复，维莉卡便俯身用双唇吻住你。她用一条手臂环住你的腰，将你拉近，丰满胸脯紧紧压在[pc.chestSimple]上。你投入这个拥抱，舌头滑出，与她的舌头起舞纠缠，双双迷失于共享欲望的深处。”漫长得令人喘不过气的一刻之后，维莉卡结束亲吻，眼中闪烁着纯粹的欣赏。“嗯哼，这件事我永远不会厌倦，”她用手握紧你的手。“那么...我们去取你的新衣服吧。” 半机械人昂首走在你身旁，步伐中带着某种神气，双眼扫视阴影，寻找隐藏的威胁。她领你进入飞船，一边轻声哼唱，一边在衣柜的一排排衣架间穿梭。义肢手指停在一套令人印象深刻的西装上；她将其举到你身前，目光挑剔地上下审视。维莉卡点点头，评估着尺寸，脸上绽开邪恶笑容。“对...这会很合适。只需要稍作修改...” 半机械人花了很长时间调整合身程度与隐蔽监听装置的位置，最后才让你带着新衣服离开；你走时，她的义眼仍饥渴地扫视着你。

Still...” She wrinkles her nose. “Dhaal is a goddamn cesspool, a bordello crammed with every kind of lowlife, scumbag and innie tourist you can imagine. And don’t even get me started on their dietary preferences.” She sighs, fishing a pack of Gryvain filters from her pocket and lighting one with practiced ease. “You know, [var0 |Dhaal is a lot like how Myrellion was before...” her face darkens, a muscle in her jaw twitching involuntarily. “Megacorps are looking to bleed the planet dry and the ruling elite will just stand by and let it happen. rows.original: “Her taste in guns makes me sick,” the cyborg replies, drumming her fingers against her prosthetic arms. “Like most Ts, she doesn’t understand that a true pistol is an art form; something to master not merely to fire. An Eagle Industries handgun might be fine for civilians or police patrolmen who only fire 50 rounds a year but at the end of the day they’re bricks given plastic and tool steel form. Compare that to one of my flechetters: when I raise it to my eye, it lines up naturally and it emits such a strong round it could kill a saurmorian. They’re elegant weapons.” “Uh-huh,” you reply,

rows.original: “The Vorician Salvation Army,” the cyborg replies, her tone one of studied indifference. “Look [pc.name]...” She removes a stick from a crumpled package of cigarettes and places it between her lips. As she lights it, she takes a leisurely drag before resuming to speak. “I can’t tell you. Literally.” She gestures towards the sockets clustered on the back of her neck. “And believe me when I say that you’re better off not knowing.” Velika pauses for a moment, her eyes fixed intently on her face. “I know that’s not the answer you’re looking for... but I hope you believe me when I say that I love you and I don’t desert my own.” She moves a prosthetic hand up to cradle your cheek, her touch surprisingly gentle. You change your line of inquiry, asking Velika what the intentions of her shadowy employers are towards yourself. The blonde tilts her head to the side slightly, her prosthetic eyes bright with calculation. “I imagine they feel... surprised by your willingness to overlook my... transgressions. And that they hope I can act as a go-between you and them in the future.” “So you’re saying they’ll contact me in the future?” you ask, cocking an eyebrow. “What exactly do they want from me?” “Your... cooperation,” Velika taps some ash off her cigarette before continuing. “Megacorps have lots of enemies. And many of Steele Tech’s enemies happen to be our enemies.” She pauses, searching your face for agreement. “I can’t offer anything concrete right now. But give it some thought... we’d be unstoppable working together, don’t you think?”
rows.translation: “沃里西亚救世军，”赛博格回答道，语气刻意显得漠不关心。“听着，[pc.name]……”她从皱巴巴的烟盒里抽出一根烟，叼在唇间。点燃后，她悠闲地吸了一口，才继续开口。“我不能告诉你。字面意义上的不能。”她朝聚集在后颈的接口示意。“相信我，你不知道反而更好。”维莉卡停顿片刻，双眼紧盯着你的脸。“我知道这不是你想要的答案……但我希望你能相信，我爱你，而且绝不会背弃自己人。”她抬起一只义手托住你的脸颊，触碰出人意料地温柔。 你换了个询问方向，问维莉卡，她那些神秘雇主对你究竟有何打算。 金发女人微微歪头，义眼闪烁着算计的光芒。“我猜……你愿意不计较我的……过错，这令她们很意外。她们也希望将来我能在你和她们之间充当中间人。” “也就是说，她们以后会联系我？”你挑眉问道。“她们究竟想从我这里得到什么？” “你的……合作。”维莉卡弹掉香烟上的些许灰烬，随后继续说道。“巨型企业有很多敌人，而斯蒂尔科技的许多敌人恰好也是我们的敌人。”她停下来，从你脸上寻找认同。“我现在无法给出任何具体承诺。不过好好想想吧……我们联手便无人能挡，不是吗？”

rows.original: “Oh? Sure you wanna talk about them again, innie?” Velika presses herself up against you, her hand slipping under your [pc.upperGarmentOuter], moving her fingers in slow, tantalizing circles against your [pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple]. “Well if you must know, my relationship with the reds was one of convenience. They were desperate to cultivate foreign connections of their own after the Gilden Republic started courting Xenogen and the like. My benefactors and I simply couldn’t let such a... golden opportunity go to waste. A few shipments of ‘humanitarian’ aid were all that was needed for us to gain a valuable foothold on Myrellion.” She cocks her head, studying your face. “The plain yet hard truth is that the myr aren’t in control of their planet anymore. Their affairs will be directed by suits in air-conditioned boardrooms halfway across the galaxy long after the warfleet circling over their heads is gone.”
rows.translation: “哦？你确定还想再谈她们吗，内圈人？”维莉卡将身体贴上你，一只手滑进你的[pc.upperGarmentOuter]下方，手指在你的[pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple]上缓慢画着诱人的圆圈。“既然你非知道不可，我和红米尔人的关系只是各取所需。吉尔登共和国开始拉拢异源生物科技等企业后，她们迫切想要培养自己的外部关系。我的资助者和我自然不能让如此……千载难逢的机会白白溜走。只要运送几批‘人道主义’援助，我们就能在米瑞利昂取得宝贵的立足点。”她歪着头研究你的表情。“朴素而残酷的事实是，米尔人已经无法掌控自己的星球了。即使盘旋在她们头顶的舰队早已离去，她们的事务仍会由远在半个银河之外、坐在空调会议室里的西装人士操纵。”

rows.original: She takes your hand in hers, bringing it to her lips to press a tender, reverent kiss to your palm. “I’m used to being alone... but I don’t want to be alone anymore. I want to be with you.” She stares up at you for a long moment before crossing her arms over her chest. “Alright, that’s enough mushy stuff. I’m glad we’re... together... but don’t expect me to start acting like a simpering teenage girl. I have a reputation to maintain.” You tell Velika you’d never expect that from her, prompting her to grin. “Good.” She leans forward, her hands sliding down your body to grip your [pc.ass]. “Don’t expect me to be gentle either. I’m rough, demanding and I expect my [pc.man] to keep up with me.” ]

rows.original: Velika grabs your [pc.hair] roughly, yanking your head back to force you to look at her as she stares down at you with a fierce, almost warning glare. “You don’t seem to understand what that entails so let me spell it out for you: being with me will ruin your life. You’ll have to give up everything and I mean everything. No more palling around with the galaxy’s super rich, no more fancy dinners on Terra and no more Steele Tech...” She leans in closer, her face mere inches from yours, her breath hot and heavy against your skin. “Do you think you can live with that? Do you think you can endure being a galactic pariah? Don’t be an idiot, [pc.name]. Don’t throw away your entire life for me.”
rows.translation: 维莉卡粗暴地抓住你的[pc.hair]，猛然向后拉扯你的脑袋，逼你与她对视。她从上方盯着你，目光凶狠，近乎带着警告。“你似乎不明白这意味着什么，所以我给你说清楚：和我在一起会毁掉你的人生。你必须放弃一切，我指的是所有东西。不准再和银河系的超级富豪混在一起，不准再去泰拉享用奢华晚餐，也不再拥有斯蒂尔科技……”她进一步靠近，脸与你相隔不过几英寸，滚烫沉重的呼吸扑在你的皮肤上。“你觉得自己能忍受这些吗？你觉得自己能承受成为银河弃民吗？别犯傻，[pc.name]。别为了我抛弃整个人生。”

rows.original: Without warning, Velika lashes out and with a swift strike at your jaw, knocking you flat onto your back. The other patrons fall silent, watching the scene unfold with a mix of fear and morbid curiosity. “You’re an idiot, [pc.name]. A stubborn, insane idiot.” She straddles your hips and reaches out, roughly grabbing your chin. “And you’re mine. No matter what happens, that’ll never change.” The blonde leans in, capturing your mouth in a searing kiss, pouring all of her hunger into it. “I love you, innie. Stars help me, but I do.” she murmurs against your lips. “And together, we will face whatever comes our way...”
rows.translation: 毫无预警地，维莉卡突然出手，迅速击中你的下巴，将你打得仰面倒地。其他顾客鸦雀无声，既恐惧又带着病态好奇，注视事态发展。“你是个白痴，[pc.name]。一个顽固又疯狂的白痴。”她跨坐在你胯上，伸手粗暴地抓住下巴。“而且你属于我。无论发生什么，这一点永远不会改变。”金发女子俯身，用灼热的吻封住你的嘴，将所有饥渴倾注其中。“我爱你，内圈人。星辰保佑我，可我的确爱你。”她贴着你的双唇低语。“无论前路有什么，我们都会共同面对……”

rows.original: “Hello, comrades!” “Hello, Comrade Marshal!” “I congratulate you on the four hundredth and seventh anniversary of Independence Day!” “Hurraaaa!” Velika looks down on your joined hands, a soft smile playing at the corners of her lips as soldiers decked out in wave-green uniforms and ceremonial phrygian caps march past your shared viewing platform. Your elopement with Velika and subsequent defection to the Icarian Commonwealth did indeed cost you everything. Your friends, acquaintances and the galaxy at large can’t fathom why you’d willingly give up any chance of becoming CEO of Steele Tech in favor of throwing your lot in with the “hermit kingdom of the outer rim.” But as your cyborg lover gives your fingers a gentle squeeze, any lingering doubts you might have had are swept away by a tidal wave of raw, unbridled love and contentment. Let others waste their lives committing mammonistic crimes and tyrannizing their fellow man. This is where you belong. The future is bright. The future is red.
rows.translation: “同志们好！” “元帅同志好！” “祝贺独立日四百零七周年！” “乌拉——！” 身穿海绿色制服、头戴仪式用弗里吉亚帽的士兵从你们共用的观礼台前列队走过；维莉卡低头望向你们交握的双手，唇角浮现柔和笑意。你与维莉卡私奔，随后叛逃至伊卡里亚共同体，这的确令你失去了一切。朋友、熟人乃至整个银河都无法理解，为何你会自愿放弃成为斯蒂尔科技首席执行官的一切机会，转而把命运投向“外环的隐士王国”。然而，当赛博格爱人轻轻握紧你的手指时，心中可能残留的任何疑虑都被一股原始、毫无束缚的爱意与满足所形成的浪潮一扫而空。就让别人浪费生命，犯下拜金主义的罪行，压迫自己的同胞吧。这里才是你的归宿。未来光明灿烂。未来一片赤红。

rows.original: As you navigate the neon-dappled streets of Dhaal, the air thick with smog and distant sounds of revelry, you suddenly feel the bite of cold metal pressed up against your [pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple]. “Hey there, lover [pc.boy]. We have unfinished business.” You crane your head, confirming without a doubt who exactly has accosted you. “Velika? What the hell are you doing?” The cyborg chuckles darkly. “What does it look like I’m doing, innie? I’m tying up a loose end.” You hear the mechanical click of a hammer being cocked. “You should have known better than to... relax I’m just fucking with you.” She retracts the metal from your spine, much to your relief. “It’s good to see you again, [pc.name].” She turns you about, pressing her forehead against yours, her blonde hair falling around you like a curtain. “I missed you. And as much as I’d love to drag you to a dark corner somewhere and... catch up, I’ve got a few things to knock off my to-do list while I’m on this rock. Come and find me at the Crash Landing later. I promise I’ll make it worth your while.” She wraps her arms around you, drawing you into a brief hug before heading off into the distance.
rows.translation: 你穿行于达尔霓虹斑驳的街道，空气中充满浓烟与远处狂欢的声音，忽然感觉冰冷金属抵上[pc.skinFurScalesNounSimple]，带来刺痛。 “嗨，情郎[pc.boy]。我们还有笔账没算完。” 你扭过头，毫无疑问地确认了袭击者的身份。“维莉卡？你他妈在干什么？” 赛博格阴沉地轻笑。“看起来像在做什么，内圈人？我正在解决一个遗留问题。”你听见击锤扳动的机械咔哒声。“你早该知道不应当……放松，我只是在耍你。”她收回抵着你脊柱的金属，让你大大松了口气。“很高兴再次见到你，[pc.name]。”她将你转过来，额头抵住你的额头，金发如帘幕般垂落在你们周围。“我想你了。虽然我很想把你拖进某个黑暗角落……叙叙旧，但我在这块石头上还有几件待办事项需要处理。晚点来迫降找我。我保证会让你不虚此行。”她环抱你，短暂拥抱过后便走向远方。

rows.original:
Zero Plus is a curvy zaika slightly over 7' tall. Her long, tapered ears surface from cascades of stringy locks that frame her head. She’s got bright, bubbly eyes burning with naive curiosity — like a small child’s. Small, round glasses rest on her nose. Considering how little light they filter, she must have either very good diurnal vision for a zaika or her eyes are so full of stars that she doesn’t mind the strong daylight. She’s got [silly
		|Dick-Sucking Lips
		|plush lips
	] glistening with glittery lipstick. [pc.isBimbo
		|Gosh, you bet kissing her feels like smooching stars!
	]
	
	Her body is heavily-modded. Unlike her fellow zaika, her skin is a milky, pearl white. She’s wearing a long, hooded coat over a revealing bodysuit that struggles to contain her fat, sloshing tits and bubble butt, a pair of short gloves, and thigh high socks — all branded with red crosses. The inside of the coat glows in the dark, ensuring that she’s visible at all times. Dr. Ovvi [silly
		|Positorii
		|Hellitrix
	] modified her chest and tail so that it could store and inject microsurgeon-laced mixtures into unlucky test subjects or willing patients. 
	
	When she’s aroused, her syringe-like bulb opens to reveal a more conventional zaika tail tip, but nothing stops her from using her narrow end to pump someone full of highly-pressurized medicinal spunk. Two large handlebars frame her hips, highlighting her waspish waist and providing you with support if you ever want to bring her to pound town.
rows.translation:
泽罗·普拉斯是一名身材曲线丰满、略高于七英尺的扎伊卡人。她细长渐尖的双耳从一缕缕瀑布般的长发间探出，那些发丝衬托着她的脑袋。明亮活泼的双眼燃烧着天真的好奇心——就像小孩子一样。一副小巧的圆眼镜架在鼻梁上。考虑到镜片几乎挡不住多少光线，她要么拥有扎伊卡人中格外出色的日间视力，要么眼中装满了星星，根本不在意强烈日光。她有一双涂着闪亮唇膏、亮晶晶的[silly
		|吸屌嘴唇
		|丰润嘴唇
	]。[pc.isBimbo
		|天哪，你敢肯定，亲她就像亲吻星星一样！
	]
	
	她的身体经过了重度改造。与扎伊卡同胞不同，她的皮肤呈乳白珍珠色。她在暴露的紧身衣外套着一件带兜帽的长外套；紧身衣几乎包不住肥硕晃荡的乳房与圆润翘臀，此外还有一双短手套和过膝袜——上面全都印着红十字。外套内侧会在黑暗中发光，确保她始终清晰可见。奥薇医生[silly
		|·波西托里
		|·赫利特里克斯
	]改造了她的胸部与尾巴，使其能够储存含有微型外科机器人的混合物，并将其注射进倒霉的实验对象或自愿患者体内。 
	
	她兴奋时，注射器般的球茎会张开，露出更加传统的扎伊卡尾尖；不过，没有任何东西能阻止她用狭窄的末端，把高压药用精液泵满别人。两根巨大的把手位于髋部两侧，既突出蜂腰，也能在你想把她带去狠狠干上一场时为你提供支撑。

rows.original: Zero Plus giggles. “Whatcha wanna know about me, sweetie?” Does she remember her name? Her age? If she had a family, or friends? The bimbo nurse frowns. She focuses deeply, scouring her memories one neuron at a time. “Gosh, thinking’s so hard! Hum... I guess my name’s Zero Plus. Zaika don’t have hair, boobies, and frecklies before being grown ups, so I must be at least a teenager!” Considering her milfy frame, you’d say that’s an understatement. She’s doing great though. Where did she learn her med skills? Was she a doctor before her dollification? “I’m... not sure. Like, my arms know exactly what to do to heal bruises and repair bionicsies. I can run dia- dagni- tests with my flashy glasses if you need a quick checky-uppy. They’re so tiny but so full of tricks! Like, I can see your heartbeat, taint levels, and geni- gena- personal stuff in real time! Oh! Heartbeat pace and sweating rising! Someone’s scared,” she teases. “Dontcha worry, I’m a very kind doctor. I really don’t know how I learnt all that big brainies knowledge about [silly |w ]hormones, bonies, skin c[silly |um |on ]ditions, and muscles.” Her body instinctively knows how to cure people? Either they have excellent mindwashing programs or she was a practician before. Zero Plus blinks. “I’m the bestest! Look no further, I’m the one you need to handle your booboos. If you are a good [pc.mf |boy |girl ], I’ll get you a lil’ treatie!” [pc.isBimbo |Like, for realsies? Gosh, you hope it’s a big sweet lollipop! |A little treat? Something like bubblegum? ] “All I can say is that it’s super tasty and healthy!” Zero Plus giggles. Right. Does she remember her past? Did she remember being a Peer, or the Meridian? “The Marry Diane? Sorta? There were like, big flashy buildings everywhere — a city of gold and marble! Gosh, meteor showers looked so pretty from atop the clouds!” It must be a sight to behold. The curvaceous zaika nods. “Yip Yup! You need like, extra-tinted glasses to see it without hurting your eyesies, but it’s so worth it. The sky becomes all orange-red with fiery rockies and then they crumble into millions of glittery sparkles. I loved seeing them with my cousin. She loved them lots more than I did.” She had a cousin? Who was she? “I... she had a big smile, long blonde hair, and loved wearing blue! She wanted to be a techie at Paragon because then she’d be all blue all day! She was the bestest at fixing stuff and making cool machines and robots. Our Mamas wanted us to be Utopian Skies high-dolls but we promised each other to do everything to become zaibatsu maven.” High-dolls? Does she mean an idol? Zero Plus nods. “That’s it! Gosh, you’re so smart! We were so cute with our frilly dresses and ribbons all over our hair. Leylla had an angel’s voice.” Leylla? That’s her name? The dollified doctor suddenly frowns. “Yes, that’s it! She... had a brainie disease, something that made you all weak and noodly all of a sudden. I... promised her that I’d fulfill our lil’ dreamy and spread zaika wonders all across the stars.” [var0 |And now there’s zaika threading the galaxy. In a way, she achieved her cousin’s dream. |Looking at the E.G.G and all the tech designed here, they were close to doing so. Unfortunately, their creative vision was hijacked by Dr. Ovvi [silly |Positorii |Hellitrix ]. ] “I chased Leylla’s dream, became a super smart nurse, and worked with the bestest scientists to reach the stars and meet new space friendos — and then y’all found us! I hope you like us. We are tall and dark but deep down we’re soft and cuddly.” She’s fine and all, but her pointy tail is a bit worrisome. Zero Plus smiles. “Afraid of a lil’ jabby? Don’t worry sweetie, I won’t sting you — unless you want to play doctor with me!”
rows.translation: 泽罗·普拉斯咯咯笑道。“亲爱的，你想知道我的什么事呀？” 她还记得自己的名字吗？年龄呢？她以前有没有家人或朋友？ 花瓶女护士皱起眉头。她高度集中精神，一个神经元接一个神经元地搜寻记忆。“天哪，思考好难哦！嗯...我猜我的名字是泽罗·普拉斯。扎伊卡人长大以前不会有头发、奶奶和小雀斑，所以我至少肯定是个青少年！”考虑到她那成熟母性的身材，你觉得这绝对说轻了。 不过，她现在表现得很棒。她从哪里学到这些医疗技能？玩偶化以前就是医生吗？ “我...不确定。就像，我的手臂完全知道该怎么治好瘀伤、修复仿生部件。你要是想快速检个查，我还能用闪闪眼镜做诊、诊断、测试。它们那么小，却有好多好多花样！比如，我能实时看见你的心跳、腐化程度，还有生、生殖、私人玩意儿！哦！心率和出汗量正在上升！有人害怕了，”她调侃道。“别担心，我是个非常温柔的医生。我真不知道自己怎么学会那些有关[silly |小 ]荷尔蒙、骨头、皮肤[silly |精液 |状 ]况和肌肉的大脑袋知识。” 她的身体本能地知道如何治疗别人？要么他们有极其出色的洗脑程序，要么她以前就是一名医务人员。 泽罗·普拉斯眨眨眼。“我是最棒哒！别再找啦，你的小伤痛全都该交给我。你要是个听话的[pc.mf |男孩 |女孩 ]，我还会给你一份小奖励哦！” [pc.isBimbo |就，真的嘛？天哪，你希望是根又大又甜的棒棒糖！ |一份小奖励？比如泡泡糖吗？ ] “我只能告诉你，它超级好吃又健康！”泽罗·普拉斯咯咯笑道。 好吧。她还记得自己的过去吗？记得曾是同侪，或住在子午城吗？ “结婚的黛安？好像有点印象？那里就像，到处都是高大闪亮的建筑——一座由黄金和大理石建成的城市！天哪，从云层上面看流星雨可漂亮了！” 那肯定是一幅值得亲眼见证的景象。 曲线丰满的扎伊卡人点点头。“对哒对哒！得戴上额外加深的眼镜才不会弄疼眼睛，但绝对值得。天空会被燃烧的石头染得橙红，然后它们碎成数百万颗闪闪亮亮的火花。我以前喜欢和表姐一起看。她比我还喜欢好多好多。” 她还有个表姐？是谁？ “我...她笑得很灿烂，留着金色长发，还喜欢穿蓝色！她想去典范公司当技术员，因为那样就能一整天都是蓝色的！她最擅长修东西，还会造很酷的机器和机器人。我们的妈妈想让我们成为乌托邦天空公司的高级偶像，可我们彼此约定，一定要竭尽全力成为财阀贤者。” 高级玩偶？她是想说偶像吗？ 泽罗·普拉斯点点头。“就是那个！天哪，你好聪明！我们穿着带褶边的小裙子，头发上系满丝带，可爱极了。莱拉有天使般的嗓音。” 莱拉？那是她的名字吗？ 被玩偶化的医生突然皱起眉头。“对，就是这个！她...得了一种脑袋疾病，会让人突然变得全身无力、软趴趴的。我...答应她会实现我们的小梦想，把扎伊卡人的奇迹传遍群星。” [var0 |如今，扎伊卡人已经遍布银河。某种意义上，她实现了表姐的梦想。 |从E.G.G.和这里设计的所有科技来看，她们已经非常接近目标。可惜，她们的创造愿景被奥薇医生[silly |·波西托里 |·赫利特里克斯 ]劫持了。 ] “我追逐莱拉的梦想，变成一名超级聪明的护士，和最棒的科学家们一起努力飞向星空、结识新的太空朋友——然后你们就找到我们啦！我希望你们喜欢我们。我们又高又黑，但内心深处柔软又好抱。” 她本人没什么问题，但尖尖的尾巴还是有点令人担忧。 泽罗·普拉斯笑了。“害怕被轻轻扎一下？别担心，亲爱的，我不会蛰你的——除非你想和我玩医生游戏！”

Then we can all be swolley leaky! I’m sure Paullie Pally won’t mind being lovey dovey with you, and me[silly |... and her | - simultaneous loving, baby ]!”
rows.translation: “波莱特好朋友和达比宝贝是最棒哒！她又高大又强壮，他又小巧又甜美。我能一整天都抱着他们！” [pc.isBimbo |他们当然是！波莱特的奶奶又软又暖——你都能和自己的乳房好朋友一起过夜啦！ |确实如此。你很高兴他们相处得很好。 ] 泽罗·普拉斯用深情的眼睛望着你。“为、为什么他们会不喜欢我？我就像，超级超级温柔又可爱呀。” 问题不在她，而在奥薇对她、以及对波莱特做过的那些事。 “哎呀。她不用担心。我就像，[silly |完整的我 |完全没事 ]。我不知道女主人对波莱特做了什么，不过我知道她对我做了什么，”她咯咯笑着，用尾巴缠绕乳沟，把晃荡的乳房托得更加丰满。“想摸奶奶吗？难过的时候很管用。等等！也许波莱特需要摸奶奶！对！我简直是个天才！” 你嘱咐这名白化扎伊卡人，在扑向另一个赛博格之前，先问问她愿不愿意。她的肢体疼痛时，脾气会非常暴躁。 花瓶女护士倒吸一口气。“她愿意的话，我可以帮她修好！我就像，也知道一些技术知识。女主人还在改造GU姐妹时，我修好过她们中的好多。就算是外星玩意儿，我也能修好，再校、校准、让它们像鸡巴一样正常运转！” “是像钟表一样，”你纠正她。 “对，没错。我真想知道赛博肺和杰达尼姆骨头是什么感觉。天哪，她肯定好重！” 据你观察，她似乎并不讨厌？不过为了她自己好，最好别说波莱特很胖或很重。她的腹肌能拿来擦奶酪，尾巴也能掰弯金属。 泽罗·普拉斯兴奋地说道。“哇！那好酷！波莱特好朋友果然是最棒哒！达比宝贝也不差。他看起来那么柔软、晃晃悠悠——我好想啃他的帆帆和面条手臂。我肯定它们吃起来像梦一样！” 你很确定，它们吃起来像莱亚克毒液。味道不坏，不过会产生一些...[silly |奶油般 |梦幻般 ]的副作用。 “就尝一小口。我不会做任何蠢事，保证。” 如果她想让乳房肿胀并不停喷涌，那就是她自己的事了。你已经警告过她。 花瓶女护士撅起嘴。“可我只是想和达比宝贝玩！等等哦...要是我们一起玩呢？这样就会，就像，把他的东西分摊在我们三个身上，对吧？那我们就能一起肿肿漏漏啦！我相信波莱特好朋友不会介意和你、和我亲亲爱爱[silly |...还有和她 |——同步相爱，宝贝 ]！”

rows.original: “Sabbidoo? She’s like, the cutest robot pony ever! Gosh, what I’d give to get ridies privileges,” she gushes. “Yeah, she’s a fine lass. Do you get on well?” Zero Plus nods. “Yip Yup! She’s always so stern and serious with work antics but when custo- custi- chromey cuties leave, she opens up like a big sweet flowie. She loves to chat, especially when I polish her shiny bitsies.” “Do you, well...” “Do stuff together? No,” she replies, a hint of disappointment in her otherwise bubbly voice. “Not even a quickie. I don’t think I’m her type. Maybe if I were a tougher cookie, but then she’d break her teeth on me,” she giggles. Sounds unlikely. Sabrae’s tougher than she looks, and she looks gorgeous. Do they work together a lot or do they have separate surgery rooms? “Depends. When there’s just little fixies or calib- calu- rigging to do, we work on our own. However, when there’s a big cutie to operate with lotsa bionics to install, then we work together and don’t split until our robot guest leaves. She doesn’t have many good doctors that are also good mechanics here, so I’m very valu- vali- cool to have around! You wouldn’t believe how often they install stuff too high or push organs too much to fit the shiny stuff in.” Doesn’t that endanger patients? The bimbo nurse tilts her head. “Not usually. Zaika sometimes almost feel like they have hollow bones, it’s so extra difficult to give ‘em a new arm or a new leg because it’s a lot much heavier and bulkier than the rest of their body! The hardest to work with are hydras.” Because of their extra organs? Zero Plus shakes her head. “Nope! Because they’re so horny and needy! I need double the dose of sleepy syrup to make them nap, and then they are all huggy and lively when they wake up, as if they never went to the medical block. It’s so weird! Fortunately, I’ve got lotsa Good Girl lollipops for brave cuties.” Did she think about modifying herself? “Sabrae told me I could have a free implant if I wanted, but I don’t know which one to take. There’s like, so much cool stuff I could have and my body’s already so full of custom parts. I wonder if I can have angel wingies? Gosh, imagine how bright and sparkly I’d be,” she gushes. “A big, bouncy angel,” you reply. “Darn right! I’m gonna fly higher than Paullie Pally!” “Just be careful not to push things around with them. Wings are very... cumbersome in cramped spaces.” The dollified doctor gasps. “Gosh, you’re right! Stars, it’s so hard to choose.” [zp.isCrew |Since she’s onboard, she’s got all the time she needs to think about it. This way, she’ll be ready when she visits Sabrae. “Yeah! I can’t wait to tell Sabbidoo about our adventures.” |The tauric zaika slowly trot next to you. “Take all the time you need. What matters to me is that you are happy,” she says, ruffling her coworker’s locks. “Thanksies Sabbidoo! Can I ride you today?” The other zaika giggles. “Zero Plus! Not in front of customers,” she teases. ]
rows.translation: “萨布宝贝？她就像，史上最可爱的机器人小马！天哪，为了获得骑乘许可，我什么都愿意做，”她兴奋地说道。 “对，她是个不错的姑娘。你们相处得好吗？” 泽罗·普拉斯点点头。“对哒对哒！工作搞事情时，她总是那么严肃认真，可等顾、顾客、闪亮亮的可爱鬼离开，她就会像一朵又大又甜的花花一样敞开心扉。她喜欢聊天，尤其是我为她擦亮闪闪部件的时候。” “你们有没有，那个...” “一起做那种事？没有，”她回答，平时活泼的声音中透出一丝失望。“连快速来一发都没有。我觉得自己不是她喜欢的类型。也许我得变成一块更硬的饼干，可那样她会把牙齿咬断，”她咯咯笑道。 听起来不太可能。萨布蕾比看上去更加坚韧，而且看起来美极了。她们经常合作，还是各有独立的手术室？ “看情况。只有小修理或校、校准、调整要做时，我们各自工作。不过，要是有个装了好多仿生部件的大可爱需要手术，我们就会一起工作，直到机器人客人离开才分开。她这里既是好医生又是好机械师的人不多，所以有我在身边非、非常、酷！你都想象不到，他们安装东西时有多少次会装得太高，或者为了把闪亮部件塞进去，把器官挤得太厉害。” 那不会危及患者吗？ 花瓶女护士歪起脑袋。“一般不会。扎伊卡人有时感觉就像骨头是空心的，给他们换新手臂或新腿格外困难，因为新部件比身体其他地方重好多、也大好多！最难处理的是九头蛇。” 因为他们有额外器官？ 泽罗·普拉斯摇摇头。“不是！因为他们太饥渴、太黏人了！我得用双倍睡觉糖浆才能让他们睡着，醒来后他们又抱来抱去、活力十足，就像从来没进过医疗区一样。太奇怪了！幸好我有好多给勇敢可爱鬼的乖女孩棒棒糖。” 她有没有考虑改造自己？ “萨布蕾说我愿意的话，可以免费植入一件东西，但我不知道该选哪个。就像，有好多酷东西可以装，而我的身体已经塞满定制部件了。我能不能装一对天使翅膀？天哪，想象一下我会多么明亮闪耀，”她兴奋地说道。 “一位又大又弹的天使，”你回答。 “当然啦！我要飞得比波莱特好朋友还高！” “只要小心，别用翅膀把周围的东西推开。狭小空间里，翅膀非常...碍事。” 被玩偶化的医生倒吸一口气。“天哪，你说得对！老天，真的好难选。” [zp.isCrew |既然她已经上船，就有充足时间慢慢考虑。这样，下次拜访萨布蕾时她就能准备好了。 “对呀！我已经等不及要把我们的冒险告诉萨布宝贝了。” |半人马形态的扎伊卡人缓缓小跑到你身旁。“慢慢想，不用着急。对我来说，最重要的是你开心，”她一边说，一边揉乱同事的长发。 “谢谢萨布宝贝！今天我可以骑你吗？” 另一个扎伊卡人咯咯笑道。“泽罗·普拉斯！别在顾客面前说这个，”她调侃道。 ]

rows.original: “I’ve got room for a nurse on my ship. Do you want to come?” The dollified doctor gasps. “Really? Gosh, that’d be so cool! Lemme just grab my stuff and say goodbye to Sabbydoo. I’m gonna miss her lots.” Zero Plus quickly gathers her gear before bouncing toward the cybertaur. Sabrae chats with her a moment before giving her a warm hug. The two zaika stay close for long seconds, tails entwined and chests smooshed together. The creamy bimbo blows her a kiss before joining you outside. “Alrighty, let’s go!” You take her by the hand and guide her to the taxi then across the spaceport. She gasps in awe at the sight of the [pc_ship.short]. “Wooooah! It’s so big and shiny!” “And you haven’t seen how it is on the inside,” you tease. The gushing bimbo gawks as you pass the bulkhead and guide her through the ship’s arteries. You show her the helm, the kitchen, the meeting room, and the cargo bay before bringing her to her quarters. “Is that all for me?” she asks, entering the wide room. “Yes. You can arrange and furnish it however you want.” Without a warning, the bimbo nurse jumps on the bed and bounces on top of it like a young kid. “That’s sooooo cool! Wanna join me?” [paulette.isCrew |“What’s with all that noise?” Paulette asks, half-awake. Her hair loosely cascades down her shoulders, hiding her bare boobs. Zero Plus giggles. “Heyo Paullie Pally! Wait! Are we gonna be roommates?!” The former XO yawns. “Sorta? I don’t know, let me finish my nap first.” “Can I nap with you? Will Dabbidoo join us? Can I have a special pillow?” “Maybe?” The albino doll squeals. She leaps off the bed and reaches for Paulette’s hand. “See ya later, [pc.name]! I’m gonna have a lil’ sleepover with Paullie Pally! You can come if you want,” she giggles, tugging the sleepy cyborg to her room. Well... Zero Plus is settling in pretty quickly. She’ll be a handful to manage, but you don’t doubt that she’ll be invaluable to your adventures. |[pc.isBimbo |Heck yeah! You join her on the bed and hop together, making the mattress creak as you bounce on it like little kids. Stars, it’s gonna be so fun to have her onboard with you! |“Maybe later,” you chuckle. “Have fun sweetie.” “Will do!” she squeals, making the mattress creak with daring bounces. Looks like Zero Plus will settle in pretty quickly. She’ll be a handful to manage, but you don’t doubt that she’ll be invaluable to your adventures. ] ]

Dozens of thin green tendrils wiggle in front of the astonished zaika, beckoning her to come in. “H-Heyo! I’m Zero Plus, nice to meet yah! Gosh, you guys look sooooo dry and thirsty – well, even more than my sensors are telling me. So... how about I give you some warm, creamy cummies? CANNONBALL!!!!!”

rows.original: The camera turns back on in the middle of the Gyre’s packed streets. Cerulleyan is as splendid as she was before — no smog or rain can ruin her makeup or stain her eerie clothes. The resplendent zaika smiles, occupying the left side of the screen. In the background, you spot a big, fuming food cart manned by a plump zaika. The obese lady quickly goes from the counter to the grill, taking orders between batches of fat-dripping meat. “This, my sweets, is one of, if not the best ambulant restaurant on Dhaal: Rikki’s Meaty Balls! Are you eager to taste Rikki’s meat balls with me? They smell gorgeous; I’m salivating already.” Cerulleyan casually flutters toward the food stall. A handful of patrons watch her pass by, not believing their own eyes. By their look and low-quality chrome, they must be workers on their break. Only a handful of trays and skewer remain — the service will soon be over. They’ll be fortunate if they can grab any leftovers! “I-Is she?” “Cerulleyan?” “She looks bigger than on TV.” The busty fairy rests her boobs on the countertop and blows a kiss to the chef. “Dear holoviewers, let me present to you the most delicious bean on Dhaal: Rikki!” The pudgy cook bounces on her feet, clearly surprised by the sudden visit. The big zaika wears nothing but a stained apron. Her stunning blue eyes quickly go from Cerulleyan to the camera, then to Cerulleyan again. “H-Hello? W-What c-can I-” Cerulleyan puts a finger on Rikki’s lips. “Don’t be afraid. I, Cerulleyan, Breeder of Worlds, heard of your cooking prowess. Tell me, my dear, what’s your most delicious, belly bursting recipe?” Rikki sweats. Her entire body shivers, making her plump belly and juicy thighs wobble enticingly. “M-M-My homemade m-m-meat b-balls with extra sauce?” “I’ll take two,” Cerulleyan answers. “Wouldn’t want my cute camerawoman to starve after all,” she adds, winking at the camera. “Y-Your Highness – you don’t need t-” “Nonsense! What pathetic idol would I be if I let my most devoted servant starve?” She turns her eyes on Rikki. “Ms. Rikki, would you please grace our taste buds with your divine cuisine?” The chubby zaika nods. She quickly jolts toward the grill with two large bowls, making her exposed ass wobble with every step. She kindles her stove’s flames then places a dozen meat balls onto the grill. They look so big and fatty, especially after being glazed with spicy oil. Rikki puts two long lard-wrapped skewers over the fire before filling the tray with her homemade sauce. Just looking at it makes you salivate. “So, tell me Rikki, did you always want to be an ambulant food vendor?” Rikki gulps. “Y-Yes! Since I was a hatchling! I always loved food — even protein bars and nutritive gruel. I started working at canteens, started experimenting with flavors and seasonings. One day, a delegation of Peers accidentally headed for the workers’ side and tasted our cooking. They were absolutely in love with our stuff. Long story short, we were all promised a great career.” The fairy zaika smiles. “I don’t understand. If you were so skilled, how did you end up here, in the Gyre’s streets, rather than in the Meridian’s gilded kitchens?” Her plump comrade flips the gushing balls and skewers before giving them another round of seasoning. “I didn’t become a chef to be famous, I did it to give smiles to others – smiles and big, plump tummies,” she teases, tapping her obese middle. “Nothing makes me happier than a girl with a round, healthy belly.” The interviewer loosens her ephemerobe a little, revealing just how pregnant and full she is. Rikki does her best to hide her blush at the sight of the tv host’s fecund figure. “Do you manage to make a living?” “S-Surprisingly, yes! Even with the Paragon loan and my Bright Water mods to pay, I still make quite a lot of money. Two more months and I’ll be able to buy myself two more grills to make three times the goods!” Cerulleyan cocks an eyebrow. “Mods? What did Bright Water give you? Heightened endurance? Enhanced senses? Magic eyes that tell you exactly what your customers like?” Rikki blushes. “I... something more exotic,” she mumbles, pulling her apron over her extra-juicy thighs. “A-Anyway. Here’s your order! Two homemade meat balls with extra sauce and skewered lard,” she proudly says, placing glistening balls into the bowls. She then plants the skewer in the middle like a mast before adding more sauce on top. “Gosh! It smells gorgeous! Look how soft and glossy they are!” Cerulleyan gushes. “Oh stars, there’s so much sauce!” Natty muses. Cerulleyan takes a skewer, picks up an extra-big ball with it, then feeds it to her screenshooter. “Come on sweetie, don’t be shy.” The camera shakes a little. You can hear her muffled complaints and distant chewing noises. “By the stars, it’s like eating a cloud! A big, juicy cloud!” “Leave the metaphors to me, please,” Cerulleyan replies before taking a bite. She eats slowly, sampling one piece of meat at a time. She then plunges a full ball into the sauce, soaking it in the extra thic[silly |c |k ] mixture before drenching her lips with fat. “It melts on the tongue! It’s so tender, so sweet – as if salted caramel had a baby with [silly |krabby patty |grounded patty ]! Honey, salt, pepper, cumin, and a hint of tomato sauce, all mixed into a generous sauce that keeps everything warm and delicious.” “Glad you like it. 瑟露莉安若无其事地朝餐车飘去。几位顾客难以置信地看着她经过。从他们的外表和劣质镀铬件来看，应该都是趁休息时间来吃饭的工人。托盘和肉串只剩下寥寥几份——营业很快就要结束了。他们要是还能抢到一点残羹剩饭，那可真算走运！ “她、她是？” “瑟露莉安？” “她看起来比电视上更大只。” 丰满的仙子把奶子搁在柜台上，朝厨师送去一个飞吻。“亲爱的全息观众们，请容本宫向各位介绍达尔最美味的小可爱：瑞琪！” 胖乎乎的厨师踮着脚弹了一下，显然被这场突然造访吓了一跳。高大的扎伊卡身上除了一条染满污渍的围裙外一丝不挂。她那双迷人的蓝眼睛迅速从瑟露莉安转向镜头，又转回瑟露莉安。“你、你好？我、我能为您——” 瑟露莉安将一根手指按在瑞琪唇上。“不必害怕。本宫瑟露莉安，世界的繁育者，听闻了你高超的厨艺。告诉本宫，亲爱的，你最美味、最能把肚子撑得满满当当的菜肴是什么？” 瑞琪开始冒汗。她全身颤抖，让丰满的肚腩与多汁的大腿诱人地晃动起来。“我、我、我自制的加、加、加量酱汁肉、肉丸？” “本宫要两份，”瑟露莉安答道。“毕竟本宫可不愿可爱的摄影师饿肚子，”她又补充一句，朝镜头眨了眨眼。 “殿、殿下——您不必——” “胡说！要是让最忠诚的仆从挨饿，本宫岂不是成了可悲的偶像？”她把视线转向瑞琪。“瑞琪女士，能否请你用神圣的佳肴恩赐我们的味蕾？” 胖乎乎的扎伊卡点点头。她拿着两个大碗迅速冲向烤架，裸露的屁股随每一步来回摇晃。她点燃炉火，把十几颗肉丸放到烤架上。那些肉丸看起来又大又肥，尤其是在刷上辛辣油汁之后。瑞琪把两根裹着长条肥肉的肉串架到火上，接着在托盘里倒满自制酱汁。光是看着就让你口水直流。 “那么，告诉本宫吧，瑞琪，你一直都想成为流动餐贩吗？” 她丰满的同胞翻动着滋滋冒汁的肉丸与肉串，又给它们撒上一轮调料。“我当厨师不是为了出名，而是为了给别人带来笑容——笑容，还有圆滚滚的大肚子，”她调笑着，拍了拍自己肥硕的腹部。“没有什么比一个肚子圆润又健康的女孩更能让我开心了。” 采访者稍微松开幻生袍，显露出自己怀得有多深、肚子有多满。瑞琪看到电视主持人那副丰饶的身材，竭力掩饰脸上的红晕。“你能靠这个维持生计吗？” 瑞琪红了脸。“我...是更有异域风情的东西，”她含糊地说着，将围裙拉到格外丰润的大腿上。“总、总之。您的餐点好了！两份加量酱汁自制肉丸，还有肥肉串，”她自豪地说道，把油亮的肉丸放进碗里。随后又像竖起桅杆般将肉串插在中央，最后往上面浇了更多酱汁。 “天哪！闻起来太美妙了！瞧瞧它们有多柔软、多有光泽！”瑟露莉安赞叹道。 “星星啊，这酱汁也太多了吧！”纳蒂惊叹道。 瑟露莉安拿起一根肉串，用它叉起一颗特大号肉丸，然后喂给自己的摄影师。“来嘛，甜心，别害羞。” 镜头轻轻晃动。你能听到她含混的抱怨，以及远处传来的咀嚼声。“星星在上，就像在吃云朵！一大团多汁的云朵！” “比喻还是请交给本宫吧，”瑟露莉安回答，随后咬了一口。她吃得很慢，一次品尝一小块肉。接着，她把整颗肉丸浸入酱汁，让它在格外浓稠的[silly |稠 |厚 rows.original: Cerulleyan smiles. “Well, my sweet Natty – today, your Peer buds will taste one of the raskvels’ most divine delicacies. Follow me below the clouds, where aliens and zaika create wonders from scratch!” Without warning, the fairy zaika deploys her wings and dives through the dark clouds. “Cerulleyan! Don’t leave me alone!” Natty whines before the camera cuts. The camera comes back on after a bright flash of light. Cerulleyan flutters in front of a brightly-colored estate with signs in zaika, raskvel, and gabilani language. You can see a very busy zaika and her raskvel companion preparing dozens of meat-filled buns served with falafels and piping hot tea. The place is almost bursting with customers — how will they even grab their meal? “Stars, it smells gorgeous,” the fancy fairy gushes, tits slowly filling up. “Cuties, contemplate Donna’s Raskvel Doners, the culmination of zaika craft and raskvel refinement! Imagine the best of both worlds, tied together by true love and popular, tummy-stuffing cuisine. Don’t you wanna try it out, Natty?” The screenshooter nods with the camera. “I do... but there’s so many people here. How will we even reach the counter?” Her scantily-clad host smirks. “Simple, we’ll wait in the queue.” A dramatic music plays before the holoscreen cuts to the inside the building. “See? It wasn’t that hard. Everyone can wait in line, especially when there’s a juicy reward at the end. Aren’t you hungry? Don’t you want to order absolutely everything after patiently waiting for your turn?” “Y-You signed autographs and took holopics with everyone. That’s the opposite of waiting patiently,” the camerawoman shyly retorts. “Anyway, time to order! Hello cuties, you must be Donna,” Cerulleyan asks the busty zaika chef. She’s rather tall for a non-Peer, and her cybernetic bunny legs certainly add to this. She’s wearing a strange uniform: a shiny bunny girl suit under a pristine apron. She modded her ears to be long and floppy, just like a rabbit — and just like her companion. He’s a lot shorter than her — not taller than four feet — but the black-scaled raskvel easily hops around the small, open kitchen to stuff freshly-cut slabs of meat, salad, onions, tomatoes, fries, and a purple mayonnaise into sliced, toasted buns. The rask takes notice of the camera. “Donna? You invited TV without telling me? At least they sent the winged lady you like.” The bunny zaika shakes her head. “B-Bryyon... I haven’t invited anyone. Cerulleyan... she’s just here, in OUR restaurant!” “It is I indeed, Cerulleyan, the Ethereal Wind, Breeder of Worlds, Splendor of Uond Ephine, and my delicate palate yearns to savor your stuffed buns. So tell me, Donna, Bryyon, what’s your specialty? The recipe that you are the most proud of? The soul of your estate?” “Well... it’s our extra-large doner served with tarkusian sauce, raskvel-style falafels, and rust-root tea,” Donna proudly answers. Cerulleyan smirks. “We’ll take two with extra spice and extra sauce.” Bryyon, the raskvel chef, nods. “As long as you don’t dance on the countertop. Two extra-large doner with extra sauce, falafels, and tea coming right up!” “The producers won’t be happy when they see the bill,” Natty murmurs. In the blink of an eye, the dark-scaled cook slices a big bun in two. It’s still fuming, right off the oven, and yet he casually opens the steamy bread wide and pour sauce and salads inside. He then heads toward the large loaf of meat spinning in the rotisserie armed with a repurposed vibrolass. Meanwhile, Donna thinly slices dried orange root into a fancy teamaker with bergamot and duskdaisy petals. She then plunges violet falafels into the fryer’s sizzling oil. “Look how the meat cascades directly into Bryyon’s plate. The knife doesn’t cut the slab, it caresses it, scraping small roasted pieces out while the heater’s still on, ensuring that the food stays warm, safe, and extra tender. Look how it shines: there’s barely any grease dripping from it and yet it looks so soft and juicy. And the smell – no word can describe how delicious, how appetizing, how mouth-watering his spicy meat is. The brewing tea and mellowed sweets mediate the atmosphere a little, but it doesn’t make this place less alien at all. It’s like being on another planet.” Natty turns the camera around, showing you the restaurant’s dining room. Colorful curtains, carpets, and tablecloths hide the cold, industrial walls and polished floors. Dimmed lights and raskvel music give an exotic touch to the alien fast food. Cerulleyan impatiently flutters, batting her translucent wings fast enough to hover above the other customers, giving everyone a close up of her bouncy tits, fecund belly, and flared hips. Donna blushes behind the counter, trying and failing to keep her eyes on the frying food and fuming teamaker. Bryyon stuffs the buns to the brim with meat and sauce before wrapping everything in aluminum foil to keep it warm. “Don’t forget the falafels, Donna!” The bunny zaika gasps, snapping out of her reverie. She quickly removes the crusty balls from the oil, shaking the extra fat off before splitting them between two large bowls. She then pours the piping hot tea into two big mugs and places everything on a service tray. “Two extra-large doner with tarkusian sauce, rasvel-style falafels, and rust-root tea!” “Do oh oh! I can almost savor them,” Cerulleyan gloats. She takes the tray from her hopping comrade before claiming a table for herself. The camerawoman sits across the zaika fairy and greedily reaches for her plate. “Oh my! I didn’t know you were so hungry!” “I-I’m sorry Ms. Cerulleyan. I skipped breakfast today.” The regal zaika smirks. “Why don’t you take a bite? Put the camera down and enjoy this meal with me.” Without further ado, Natty places the camera on a small tripod and adjusts the focus on the splendid host. Once she’s done, Cerulleyan slowly unwraps the foil from her sandwich and slowly breathes in. “Exquisite. The bread’s warm and crusty in spite of all the juice and sauce. The outside is pleasantly hot and easy to hold — exactly what you are looking for in a hot sandwich. Everything looks so creamy and delicious, no wonder this place is always full.” Cerulleyan eagerly takes a bite, splattering her lips with purple mayonnaise. She slowly chews the bread, salad, and meat, enjoying all flavors before giving her opinion on the alien food. “Woah! It’s so good! You’d expect the bread to be soggy but the sauce actually ties all ingredients together, exulting all the flavors with each bite. This is nothing like anything you could find on Dhaal before the planet rush. It’s sour, but in a sweet way. The meat is very spicy but the raw vegetables and the bread foil the burning spice into a hot but enjoyable moment. I could eat this all day,” she says, caressing her pregnant belly with her free hand. “D-Did you try the tea and falafels your Highness?” Donna asks. “I did!” Natty replies, “they are to die for!” The magnificent host squeals. “If you find them good, they must be divine. Let’s see,” Cerruleyan whispers before reaching for her mug. She slowly sips the deep orange infusion before sampling the soft, violet balls. “The rust-root tea’s very refreshing: the smoky scent and the mellowed taste reminds me of licorice. The fruity aftertaste is very mild but it suffices to open the stomach for more delicious stuff – like the raskvel-style falafels. Usually, deep fried stuff isn’t my cup of tea but these delicious, doughy balls charmed my superior tongue. They pop in my mouth, liberating salty tastes by the hundred — it’s an explosion of delight, a heavenly treat you can eat anytime, anyplace – hot or cold, with or without sauce, it doesn’t matter because either way it will be absolutely gorgeous.” “You are such a wordsmith. I wish I was this inventive,” the camerawoman says from the sides. Cerulleyan takes a very big bite, all but devouring her meat-stuffed bun before answering. “When I get my hands on delicious goods, words just start flowing like a river... a river with many arms, smooth and fast, but never rough or mean. Stars, I can’t get enough of raskvel cuisine. I just wanna eat, and eat, and eat, until my belly’s fuller than full! I even ate the raw tomatoes for crying out loud! Donna and Bryyon are magicians, food magicians – they put a spell on my tongue that turns everything I eat into a godly feast! It’s a shame that they don’t have an extra-extra-large size because I’d take it all!” Behind her, you can see Donna and Bryyon actively preparing the last orders before the end of the service. The small raskvel prepares meaty buns at the speed of light, cutting pounds and pounds of hot, juicy meat before roughly stuffing it in freshly-toasted bread. With his strong arms, he carries huge slabs of meat and effortlessly slices them up into thin morsels that he then skewers before placing them in the rotisserie in preparation for the next shift. By his side, Donna happily bakes almond biscuits and creates new tea mixes for her afternoon customers. Her lavender boobs, juicy thighs, and fat buns bounce in her bunny suit, stretching the fabric to its limits whenever she leans down to put more things in her oven. The camera slowly zooms in, giving you a splendid close-up to her cleavage and piping hot goods. Stars, they look so soft and warm – they must be to die for! With a last, satiated gulp, Cerulleyan finishes her extra-large doner, chewing the last mouthful slowly before washing her mouth with sweet, rust-root tea. Bryyon and Donna join them a moment later, eager to know what their guest thought of their cooking. “How was your meal Ms. Cerulleyan?” “It wasn’t too spicy for your alien tastes, was it?” The fairy zaika caresses her round belly. “Stars above, I’m so full. You perfectly adapted raskvel cuisine to zaika tastes. I’d eat here all day if I could.” “T-The pleasure was all mine,” the greasy lovebirds reply in perfect unison. Cerulleyan joins Donna and Bryyon, taking place between them and smiling for the camera. “If you want to spend a nice afternoon in a cozy restaurant and tea salon, look no further! Donna’s Raskvel Doner is right up your alley! Their hot, meaty buns are to die for!” “We are open from 11am to 9pm nonstop, so don’t hesitate to stop by for a cup of tea,” Donna happily smiles. “And if you are very hungry, order one of our extra-large doner. You’ll never see meatier buns anywhere else!” Bryyon playfully adds. “Thank you all for staying with us. We hope you enjoyed our culinary cruise as much as we did,” the elegant fairy says. “Stay tuned for a very cosy interview with Donna and Bryyon and delightful bonuses that’ll leave you gushing for more! Maybe they’ll show us how they do their delicious sandwiches!”
rows.translation: 瑟露莉安微笑道。“好啦，我亲爱的纳蒂，今天，你的同侪朋友们将品尝拉斯克维尔人最神圣的美味之一。跟我一起深入云层下方，看看外星人与扎伊卡人如何从零开始创造奇迹！” 毫无预兆地，仙女般的扎伊卡张开双翼，俯冲穿过黑暗云层。“瑟露莉安！别把我一个人丢下！”纳蒂呜咽着，随后画面切断。 一阵耀眼闪光后，摄影机重新启动。瑟露莉安在一座色彩鲜艳的餐馆前拍打翅膀，招牌上分别写着扎伊卡语、拉斯克维尔语和加比拉尼语。你能看见一位忙碌不堪的扎伊卡人与她的拉斯克维尔同伴，正准备几十个装满肉的面包，搭配炸豆丸子和滚烫热茶。店里顾客多得几乎要挤爆，他们究竟要怎样才能拿到餐点？ “天啊，闻起来太美妙了，”华贵的仙女惊叹道，乳房缓缓充盈。“小可爱们，请看唐娜的拉斯克维尔旋转烤肉，这正是扎伊卡工艺与拉斯克维尔精制技法的结晶！想象一下两个世界最美好的事物，由真爱与广受欢迎、填饱肚子的美食结合在一起。纳蒂，你不想尝尝吗？” 摄影师用镜头点了点头。“我想...可这里有这么多人。我们要怎么才能到柜台？” 衣着暴露的主持人坏笑。“很简单，我们排队等候。” 一段戏剧性的音乐响起，接着全息屏幕切换至建筑内部。“看吧？一点都不难。谁都可以排队，尤其当终点有多汁的奖赏时。你不饿吗？耐心等到自己以后，难道不想把所有东西都点上一遍？” “你、你给每个人签名，还和他们拍全息照片。这正好与耐心等待相反，”女摄影师害羞地反驳。 “总之，该点餐了！你们好，小可爱。你一定就是唐娜吧，”瑟露莉安向丰满的扎伊卡厨师问道。以非同侪而言，她相当高挑，赛博兔腿无疑更添身高。她穿着一套奇怪制服：洁白围裙下是一件闪亮兔女郎装。她将耳朵改造成修长下垂的样子，宛如兔子，也与同伴完全一样。他比她矮得多，身高不超过四英尺；不过这个黑鳞拉斯克维尔人仍能轻松跳跃于狭小开放式厨房，将新鲜切下的肉片、沙拉、洋葱、番茄、薯条和紫色蛋黄酱塞进切开烤脆的面包。 这个拉斯克维尔人注意到摄影机。“唐娜？你请了电视台来，却没告诉我？至少他们派来了你喜欢的那位有翅膀女士。” 兔女郎扎伊卡摇摇头。“布、布里昂...我没有邀请任何人。瑟露莉安...她就这样出现在我们的餐馆里！” “正是本人，瑟露莉安，空灵之风，世界繁育者，乌昂德·艾芬之华彩；我娇贵的味蕾渴望品尝你们夹满馅料的面包。那么告诉我，唐娜、布里昂，你们的招牌是什么？哪道食谱最令你们自豪？这家店的灵魂又是什么？” “这个嘛...是我们的超大号旋转烤肉，配塔库斯酱、拉斯克维尔风味炸豆丸子和锈根茶，”唐娜自豪地回答。 瑟露莉安坏笑。“我们要两份，多加辣、多加酱。” 拉斯克维尔厨师布里昂点头。“只要你别在柜台上跳舞。两份超大号旋转烤肉，多加酱，附炸豆丸子和茶，马上就好！” “制片人看到账单时肯定不会开心，”纳蒂低声说道。 眨眼之间，暗色鳞片的厨师便将一个大面包切成两半。面包刚出炉，仍在冒着热气，他却随意将蒸腾的面包掰开，倒入酱汁与沙拉。随后，他手持一把改装振动剑，走向烤架上不断旋转的大块肉柱。与此同时，唐娜将干燥橙色根茎切成薄片，和佛手柑及暮雏菊花瓣一同放入精美茶壶。接着，她将紫色炸豆丸子投入炸锅中滋滋作响的热油。 “看，肉片如何直接如瀑布般落进布里昂的盘子。刀刃没有切割肉柱，而是在爱抚它，在加热器仍开启时轻轻刮下烤熟的小片，确保食物温热、安全又格外柔嫩。看看它的光泽：几乎没有油脂滴下，却看起来如此柔软多汁。还有那气味，任何言语都无法形容他的香辣肉食有多美味、多诱人、多令人垂涎。冲泡的茶与柔和甜点稍稍调和了气氛，却丝毫未减这里的异星感，仿佛置身另一颗星球。” 纳蒂转动摄影机，向你展示餐馆用餐区。色彩鲜艳的窗帘、地毯与桌布遮住冰冷的工业墙壁和抛光地面。昏暗灯光与拉斯克维尔音乐为异星快餐增添异域情调。瑟露莉安不耐烦地拍动翅膀，透明双翼快到足以让她悬浮在其他顾客上方，令所有人都能近距离欣赏她弹跳的乳房、丰饶腹部和外扩臀部。唐娜在柜台后脸红，努力却徒劳地想把目光放回油炸食物与蒸腾茶壶。 布里昂将肉和酱汁塞满面包，再用铝箔将一切包好保温。“别忘了炸豆丸子，唐娜！” 兔女郎扎伊卡猛吸一口气，从恍惚中回神。她迅速从油里捞出酥脆丸子，抖掉多余油脂，再分别装进两个大碗。随后，她将滚烫热茶倒进两只大杯，把所有东西放上托盘。“两份超大号旋转烤肉，配塔库斯酱、拉斯克维尔风味炸豆丸子和锈根茶！” “噢噢噢！我几乎已经尝到它们了，”瑟露莉安得意地说。她从蹦跳的同伴手中接过托盘，找了一张桌子坐下。女摄影师坐到扎伊卡仙女对面，贪婪地伸向餐盘。“哎呀！我都不知道你这么饿！” “对、对不起，瑟露莉安女士。我今天没吃早饭。” 高贵的扎伊卡坏笑。“不如咬一口？把摄影机放下，陪我一起享用这顿饭。” 纳蒂不再耽搁，将摄影机放在小三脚架上，调整焦点对准华美主持人。完成后，瑟露莉安缓缓拆开三明治外的铝箔，深深吸气。“精美绝伦。尽管有这么多汁液与酱料，面包依然温热酥脆。外层温度宜人，方便拿握，正是热三明治应有的样子。一切看起来如此浓郁美味，难怪这里总是座无虚席。” 瑟露莉安迫不及待地咬下一口，紫色蛋黄酱溅满双唇。她缓缓咀嚼面包、沙拉与肉，品味所有滋味，随后对异星食物发表评价。“哇！太好吃了！本以为面包会被泡软，可酱汁实际上将所有配料连接起来，每咬一口都令各种风味更加突出。这与行星开拓以前达尔能找到的任何食物都完全不同。它带着酸味，却是甜美的酸。肉非常辛辣，生蔬菜与面包却能中和灼烧般的辣意，将其变成火热却愉快的体验。我可以吃上一整天，”她一边说，一边用空闲的手抚摸孕肚。 “殿、殿下尝过茶和炸豆丸子了吗？”唐娜问道。 “我尝了！”纳蒂回答，“简直好吃到死！” 华美主持人尖叫起来。“既然你觉得好吃，那它们一定无比神圣。让我尝尝，”瑟露莉安低声说道，伸手拿起杯子。她缓缓啜饮深橙色浸泡饮品，随后品尝柔软紫色丸子。“锈根茶非常清爽：烟熏香气与柔和滋味令我想起甘草。水果余味很淡，却足以打开胃口，让人想吃更多美味，例如拉斯克维尔风味炸豆丸子。通常，油炸食品不合我的口味，可这些美味的面团丸子征服了我高贵的舌头。它们在嘴里炸开，释放出数百种咸鲜滋味，这是一场快乐爆炸，是随时随地都能享用的天堂美食，无论冷热、有无酱汁都不重要，因为无论哪种方式都会绝对美妙。” “你真会遣词造句。真希望我也有这么丰富的创造力，”女摄影师在一旁说道。 瑟露莉安咬下一大口，几乎吞掉整只夹满肉的面包，随后才回答。“每当我拿到美味东西，词语就会如河流般自然涌出...一条拥有许多支流、平滑迅疾却永不粗暴刻薄的河流。天啊，拉斯克维尔料理真让我吃不够。我只想吃、吃、继续吃，直到肚子饱得不能再饱！老天，我甚至把生番茄也吃掉了！唐娜与布里昂简直是魔法师，食物魔法师；她们对我的舌头施了咒语，让吃下的每样东西都变成神圣盛宴！可惜这里没有特超大号，否则我一定全要！” 在她身后，你能看见唐娜与布里昂正在积极准备营业结束前最后几份订单。小个子拉斯克维尔人以光速制作肉馅面包，切下成磅成磅炽热多汁的肉，再粗暴地塞进新鲜烤脆的面包。他用强健双臂搬起巨大肉块，毫不费力地切成薄片，串到烤叉上放入旋转烤架，为下一班次做好准备。唐娜则在旁边开心烤制杏仁饼干，为下午的顾客调配新茶饮。淡紫乳房、多汁大腿和肥厚臀部在兔女郎装里弹跳，每当她弯腰向烤箱放入更多东西，布料都会被撑到极限。摄影机缓缓拉近，让你近距离欣赏她的乳沟与滚烫美食。天啊，它们看起来如此柔软温暖，一定好吃到死！ rows.translation: 瑟露莉安微笑道。“好啦，我亲爱的纳蒂，今天，你的同侪朋友们将品尝新德克萨斯的乡村美食。跟我一起深入云层下方，看看外星人与扎伊卡人如何从零开始创造奇迹！” 毫无预兆地，仙女般的扎伊卡展开双翼，俯冲穿过黑暗云层。“哦不，怎么又来！”纳蒂倒吸一口气，随后画面切断。 摄影机重新启动，镜头前出现了你所见过最具新德克萨斯风情的建筑。一间巨型牛排馆，里面摆着质朴的木制家具、机械公牛、马蹄铁游戏和乡村舞蹈舞台。瑟露莉安在画面中拍打翅膀，笑容灿烂。“欢迎大家来到嫩腰肉餐厅！这间典型的新德克萨斯店铺几周前在旋环区的生态中找到了自己的位置，在扎伊卡人之间越来越受欢迎。我已经等不及要尝尝牛仔女郎美食了。” “你、你觉得这里会供应乳制品吗？”女摄影师问。 仙女扎伊卡咯咯笑道。“你很希望有，对吧？我们一起进去看看。” “星辰在上！这期节目播完以后，我们绝对不会再有下一期了。” 她若无其事地走进拥挤餐厅，向一位高挑的紫色牛仔女郎挥手。接受改造的女孩缓缓走近，竭尽全力控制狂乱甩动的尾巴和喷涌乳汁的巨型乳房。她在嘴前戴着牛纹面罩，保护脸庞免受疯狂喷射的尾巴波及。“欢迎来到嫩腰肉餐厅。两位需要一张桌子吗？” “当然，”瑟露莉安回答。“可以的话，请安排在舞池附近。” 丰满女士鞠了一躬。她们穿过用餐区、走向现场舞台前方的宽阔开放空间时，她的蹄子踏得木地板嗒嗒作响。一群接受改造的公牛演奏着乡村音乐，一群微醺扎伊卡人则努力跟上欢快节奏。考虑到坐满的桌数和顾客流转速度，现在肯定已经是第二或第三轮服务。瑟露莉安迅速在铺着红垫的椅子上坐好，伸手拿起菜单。 “星辰在上，每样东西看起来都好诱人。我不知道该点什么！” “要不要先喝点什么？我们有美味鸡尾酒和甜味软饮，”女服务员害羞地说。 瑟露莉安思考了几秒。“我要一大杯根汁汽水。请问，你们的招牌菜是什么？” “好选择！我们最引以为傲的是四分之一磅汉堡，搭配自制薯条和培根条。甜点则是上面挤着鲜奶油的苹果派。” 有翼扎伊卡惊叹道。“请给我一个汉堡和一块派。纳蒂，你呢？” “我...要一份配烧烤酱、薯条和豆子的T骨牛排，一大杯上面加鲜奶油、焦糖和碧根果的冰淇淋，一份芝士蛋糕，还有母乳，我是说母奶，我是说...” 接受改造的女服务员微笑。“非常好的选择，女士。感谢两位约会时选择嫩腰肉餐厅。” “我、我们不是在约会，”纳蒂反驳。 “你真有这么确定吗？”瑟露莉安顽皮地调侃。“观众们怎么想？这是约会吗？订阅我们的社交账号，把你对节目的想法告诉我们！” 从那说不出话的结巴声来看，纳蒂真幸运自己没有出现在镜头里，否则她肯定已经化成一摊水了，好吧，比现在这副融化模样还要更像一摊水。她不仅点了扎伊卡人有史以来奶油含量最高的一餐，还当着偶像的面点了出来，对方正是衣着暴露的舞者瑟露莉安，乌昂德·艾芬之华彩。她还能把摄影机摆正，简直是个奇迹。
rows.raw: " Cerulleyan smiles. “Well, my sweet Natty – today, your Peer buds will taste New Texas’ rustic treats. Follow me below the clouds, where aliens and zaika create wonders from scratch!” Without warning, the fairy zaika deploys her wings and dives through the dark clouds. “Oh no, not again!” Natty gasps before the camera cuts. The camera turns back on in front of the most New Texan building you’ve ever seen. A giant steakhouse with wooden, rustic furniture, mechanical bulls, horseshoe games, and a country dance stage. Cerulleyan flutters on screen, smiling broadly. “Welcome to Tender Loins everyone! This typical New Texan outlet found its place in the Gyre’s ecosystem a few weeks ago, becoming more and more popular among the zaika people. I can’t wait to try out some cowgirl food.” “D-Do you think they serve dairy products?” the camerawoman asks. The fairy zaika giggles. “You’d like that, wouldn’t you? Let’s find out together.” “Stars! There’s no way we get another episode after this one.” She casually enters the crowded restaurant and waves at a tall, purple cowgirl. The modded girl slowly approaches, doing her best to keep her flailing tail and titanic, milk-gushing tits under control. She wears a cowprint mask in front of her mouth, protecting her face from her wildly-splurting tail. “Welcome to Tender Loins. Would you like a table for two?” “Gladly,” Cerulleyan replies. “Close to the dancefloor, if you will.” The busty lady bows. Her hooves tap on the wooden floor as they cross the dining room in the direction of the large, open space in front of a live stage. A group of treated bulls play country music while a crowd of slightly drunk zaika try to follow the upbeat rhythm. It must be the second or third service, considering how many tables are taken and how much customer turnover there is. Cerulleyan swiftly takes her place on a red-cushioned chair and reaches for the menu. “Stars above, everything looks gorgeous. I don’t know what to order!” “Maybe take a drink? We have delicious cocktails and sweet softs,” the waitress shyly says. Cerulleyan thinks for a couple of seconds. “I’ll take a large root beer. If I may, what’s your specialty?” “Good choice! We are very proud of our quarter pound burger, served with homemade fries and bacon strips. And for dessert, a piece of apple pie with whipped cream on top.” The winged zaika gushes. “I’ll take one burger and one piece of pie please. What about you, Natty?” “I... a T-bone with BBQ sauce, fries and beans, a mega cup of ice cream with whipped cream, caramel, and pecans on top, a cheesecake, and breast milk- I mean breastmilk- I mean...” The modded waitress smiles. “Very good choice, miss. Thank you for choosing Tender Loins for your date.” “W-We aren’t on a date,” Natty retorts. “Are you so sure about that?” Cerulleyan impishly teases. “What do you think, viewers? Is this a date? Subscribe on our socials and give us your thoughts on the show!” Judging by the speechless sputtering, Natty’s lucky to be off screen, else she’d be a melting puddle – well, more of a melty puddle than she already is. Not only did she order the most cream-heavy meal a zaika ever ordered, but she did it in front of her idol, the scantily-clad dancer Cerulleyan, the Splendor of Uond Ephine. It’s a miracle she can set the camera right. "

rows.original: Cerulleyan sways rhythmically on her chair, following the swingy music like a busty metronome. Her body looks like it aches with need, yearning to swirl and twirl for hundreds, thousands of fans — or dozens of customers and amateur dancers. “Natty sweetie?” “Yes, Mistress Cerulleyan?” “Do you see how my slender legs shiver, how my elegant bosom rises, how my eyes shine?” The camerawoman nods with the camera. “You look as tense and needy as before your performance at the Utopian Skies Tesseract Theater – I know what you are thinking and I must say no. You must take it easy and relax. Think about your egg!” With a flap of diaphanous wings, Cerulleyan surges from her seat and flutters toward the scene. “I’m sorry Natty, it’s in my nature! I need to dance!” “Shoot! I knew she wouldn’t resist catchy new texan music,” Natty groans, fidgeting with the camera. “Alright, let’s see if this Paragon tracker drone works.” A second later, the image lifts off in a humming of antigrave motors. The remote machine closely follows the fairy lady, reaching her just before she sets foot on the dancefloor. Cerulleyan slides on the wooden planks, swaying through the mottled crowd like a violet mist. Her curvaceous body moves in a blur; a fluid, purple blur that spins and hops with regal grace between dancing zaika and aliens. The Ethereal Wind manifests in the middle of hat-wearing customers, standing in front of the scene a few feet away from the cowish band. The bull leader chuckles, glaring at the pregnant performer. “Looks like we have a star with us! Everyone make some noise for Ms. Cerulleyan!” Thunderous applause fills the room. “Will you grace us with one of your dances?” The faux cow violinist asks, leaning oh-so-close to the bull’s sweaty pecs. Cerulleyan giggles. “No need for such wondrous praises, but it’s appreciated. Would you kindly play your favorite song, please? I would like to have fun like new texans do!” “If that’s what you want, here we go!” the proud bull cowboy shouts, grabbing his femboy bassist by the hip. “New Texas has many cheerful songs, songs that make you smile and dance till you don’t feel your legs anymore, but there’s one song, one music that unites us all!” With that, everyone around starts shouting “Milky Molly! Milky Molly!” “MILKY MOLLY! HEEEEEEERE WE GOOOOOOOOO!” Violin, banjoes, and drums fill the restaurant with a fast-paced beat as the dancers line up, tapping the planks with their heeled boots. Cerulleyan flawlessly copies the seasoned artists. Her ephemerobe shines with alien colors while she bounces in place, surrounded by two go’rahn wearing revealing latex chaps and see-through tops. The gooey holsteins wobble in tune, eyeing the purple fairy next to them with barely-concealed wanton. Milk-white droplets gush from their perky nips, showering their surroundings with sweet, sweat-laced cream for the surrounding zaika’s pleasure. “ONE! TWO! THREE! FOUR! MILKY MOLLY’S UDDERS ARE SORE!” the bull sings. “MILKY MOLLY’S UDDERS ARE SORE!” the audience happily replies. “MILKY MOLLY’S UDDERS ARE SORE! BUT SHE CAN’T STOP MOOING FOR MORE!” “BUT SHE CAN’T STOP MOOING FOR MORE!” The faux cow reaches for the mic. “SHE BROKE TEN MILKERS AND HER BREEDING MOUNT TOO!” “SHE BROKE TEN MILKERS AND HER BREEDING MOUNT TOO!” “AND NOW SHE’S COMING FOR YOU!” “AND NOW SHE’S COMING FOR YOU!” When the verse ends, the dancers switch positions, twirling with the one in front of them for a handful of seconds before going back to their line. Cerulleyan shakes her sublime breasts and fecund belly oh-so-close to a deeply-blushing sheep-modded girl. She teases the shy girl with her shimmering curves, seducing her with smooth moves before blowing a kiss to the drone camera, granting her viewer a particularly deep close-up to her steamy cleavage. She gives her wooly partner a minx wave on her way back to her spot, sliding barefoot on the wooden planks. Cerulleyan’s movements look so eerie, so light, like a cloudy being as fluid as water and as smooth as a zaika’s chest. She imitates her fellow dancers flawlessly, hopping on one foot then another like a true new texan, and yet her body feels out of place: too agile and deft to sway and twirl like this, especially with a big, ostrich-sized bun in her oven. One of her rahn partners hands her a spotted cowgirl hat before the other gives her a cowbell collar. The winged host giggles, redoubling her efforts to give a good show. Her new accessory chimes cheerfully with each jerk, with each turn, with each bounce of her alluring udders, sinking into her lavender softness for a handful of seconds before pouncing back between her large, violet cleavage, adding its clear chime to the sweet banjo and violin tunes. “MILKY MOLLY’S THE FAIREST OF THEM ALL!” the singers roar. “MILKY MOLLY’S THE FAIREST OF THEM ALL!” The femboy violinist giggles. “ONE BY ONE SHE BRANDED THEIR HOLES!” “ONE BY ONE SHE BRANDED THEIR HOLES!” the crowd replies. “FROM DAWN TILL DUSK SHE HAPPPILY PLOWS!” “FROM DAWN TILL DUSK SHE HAPPPILY PLOWS!” “UNTIL THE HILLS ARE AS WHITE AS SNOW!” the band members sing in unison. “UNTIL THE HILLS ARE AS WHITE AS SNOW!” Cerulleyan swings one side to the other, not bothered by the quickly increasing rhythm nor by the saucy lyrics. She’s having lots of fun — she happily smiles and shouts along. Her heavy breasts wildly sway left and right, up and down, raining sweaty droplets on her gooey neighbors while her silky ephemerobe flies like a shimmering ghost around her delicious body, revealing her supple thighs, wide hips, fecund belly, hefty boobs, and graceful arms one at a time, always keeping some of her juicy skin hidden behind her opulent veils. She’s a divine being, a magical creature, an Ethereal Wind blowing through the dancefloor, invigorating her partners with a deeply artistic fever, a creative heat that no censor can hope to ever quench. Natty’s Paragon drone flies oh-so-close to the winged lady, hovering a few inches away from her wobbling cleavage and pillowy thighs. It’s a miracle it didn’t crash into the fairy’s gorgeous plushness and that it could capture so many pictures of her big, juicy naturals. After another minute of frenzied banjo riffs, the music finally slows down with the last verse. “MILKY MOLLY’S HAPPILY MOOS!” “MILKY MOLLY’S HAPPILY MOOS!” “SHE SHARED HER CREAM WITH ALL HER CREW!” “SHE SHARED HER CREAM WITH ALL HER CREW!” The faux cow plays two more cords, nailing down the last step with a strong, melodious riff. The country tune fades, releasing the dancers from its sultry spell. A few groups form here and there, ready to continue the show in a more private place as the bull singer puts his hat back into place between his polished horns. “You were amazing tonight, especially you Ms. Cerulleyan. We’ll be right back after a short break, so enjoy your drinks and food everyone!” The purple fairy makes a curtsy, bowing as low as her pregnant belly lets her before throwing her hat onto stage. She blows a kiss to the camera and to her sheep partner before offering her the cowbell she received, turning the poor, shy thing into a melty puddle. “Thank you everyone! You were all beautiful! I had such an amazing day with y’all. I may be thirsty, but if anyone wants an autograph, I’ll happily sign whatever you want.” “Can you autograph my hat?” one of the go’rahn asks. “And my belt?” the other one demands. “And my tits?” a blushing laquine questions. Cerulleyan smiles. “Of course! Gosh, if you’re as good and sweet as my order, I’m gonna burst from all the love!”
rows.translation: 瑟露莉安坐在椅子上随着摇摆乐的节奏晃动，宛如一只丰乳节拍器。她浑身难耐，渴望为数百、数千名粉丝旋舞翻飞——或者为几十名顾客和业余舞者表演。“纳蒂宝贝？” “怎么了，瑟露莉安女士？” “你看到我纤细的双腿如何颤抖、优雅的胸脯如何起伏、双眼如何闪耀了吗？” 女摄影师用摄影机点了点头。“你看起来就像在乌托邦天空公司超立方体剧院演出前一样紧张难耐——我知道你在想什么，我必须说不。你必须放慢脚步，好好休息。想想你的蛋！” 瑟露莉安拍动薄如蝉翼的翅膀，从座位上一跃而起，朝舞台翩然飞去。“对不起，纳蒂，这是我的天性！我必须跳舞！” “糟糕！我就知道她抗拒不了新德州动听的音乐，”纳蒂一边摆弄摄影机，一边呻吟道。“好吧，看看典范公司的追踪无人机好不好用。” 一秒后，画面伴随反重力马达的嗡鸣声升上空中。遥控机器紧紧跟随仙女般的女士，正好在她踏上舞池前追上她。瑟露莉安滑上木板地面，如一片紫色薄雾般摇曳着穿过斑驳人群。她曲线玲珑的身体化作一道残影，一道流畅的紫色残影，以高贵优雅的姿态在起舞的扎伊卡人与异星人之间旋转跳跃。空灵之风现身于戴帽子的顾客中央，站在离牛族乐队仅几英尺远的舞台前。公牛领队咯咯笑着，目不转睛地盯着这位怀孕的表演者。 “看来今晚有位明星来到现场！大家为瑟露莉安女士欢呼吧！” 雷鸣般的掌声充满整个房间。 “能否有幸请您为我们献上一支舞？”假乳牛小提琴手问道，身子几乎贴上公牛汗津津的胸肌。 瑟露莉安咯咯轻笑。“不必如此盛赞，不过我很感激。请演奏你们最喜欢的歌曲，好吗？我想像新德州人一样尽情享乐！” “既然这是你的愿望，那就开始吧！”骄傲的公牛牛仔一把搂住伪娘贝斯手的腰，大声喊道。“新德州有许多欢快的歌，能让你面带笑容、纵情起舞，直到双腿失去知觉；但有一首歌、一支曲子能将我们所有人团结起来！” 话音刚落，周围所有人都开始高喊：“奶牛莫莉！奶牛莫莉！” “奶牛莫莉！我们这就开场啦啊啊啊啊啊啊！” 小提琴、班卓琴和鼓声以快节奏充满餐厅，舞者们列成一排，用带跟长靴踩踏木板。瑟露莉安完美模仿着经验丰富的舞者。她原地蹦跳时，幻影袍闪耀着异星色彩，身旁围着两名身穿暴露乳胶皮套裤与透视上衣的戈·拉恩。黏糊糊的荷斯坦女郎随节奏晃荡，望着身旁紫色仙女的目光中几乎掩饰不住淫欲。乳白液滴从她们挺翘的乳头喷涌而出，把混着香甜汗味的乳液洒向四周，供周围的扎伊卡人享用。 “一！二！三！四！奶牛莫莉的乳房酸痛难熬！”公牛唱道。 “奶牛莫莉的乳房酸痛难熬！”观众开心地回应。 “奶牛莫莉的乳房酸痛难熬！可她仍哞哞叫着想要更多！” “可她仍哞哞叫着想要更多！” 假乳牛伸手拿起麦克风。“她弄坏了十台挤奶器，连配种架也没能幸免！” “她弄坏了十台挤奶器，连配种架也没能幸免！” “现在她要来找你！” “现在她要来找你！” 一节唱完，舞者们交换位置，与面前的人旋舞片刻，随后回到各自队列。瑟露莉安将非凡的乳房和丰饶孕肚贴近一名羞得满脸通红的绵羊改造女孩，不住摇晃。她用闪耀的曲线挑逗腼腆女孩，以流畅舞姿勾引对方，接着向无人机摄影机送出飞吻，让观众得以格外近距离地欣赏她热气腾腾的乳沟。返回自己位置时，她朝毛茸茸的舞伴妖媚地挥手，赤脚滑过木板。 瑟露莉安的动作如此空灵轻盈，仿佛云雾凝成的生灵，既像水般流畅，又像扎伊卡人的胸膛般光滑。她完美模仿着其他舞者，像真正的新德州人一样左右单脚轮流跳跃，可她的身体却显得格格不入：她实在太灵巧敏捷，不该能这样摇曳旋舞，尤其烤箱里还揣着一个鸵鸟大小的大面包。 一名拉恩舞伴递给她一顶斑点牛仔帽，另一人则为她戴上牛铃项圈。有翼主持人咯咯笑着，更加卖力地献上精彩表演。每次猛动、每次转身、每次诱人乳房弹跳，新饰品都会欢快作响；它先陷入淡紫色柔软肌肤片刻，再弹回硕大的紫罗兰色乳沟之间，将清脆铃声融入悦耳的班卓琴与小提琴乐声。 “奶牛莫莉是世间最美丽的姑娘！”歌手们高声吼道。 “奶牛莫莉是世间最美丽的姑娘！” 伪娘小提琴手咯咯笑道。“她把她们的洞一个接一个烙上印记！” “她把她们的洞一个接一个烙上印记！”人群回应道。 “从黎明到黄昏，她都快乐地耕耘！” “从黎明到黄昏，她都快乐地耕耘！” “直到群山洁白如雪！”乐队成员齐声唱道。 “直到群山洁白如雪！” 瑟露莉安左右摇摆，丝毫不受飞快加速的节奏与色情歌词影响。她玩得不亦乐乎，开心地微笑着随众人高喊。沉甸甸的乳房上下左右狂烈摇晃，将汗珠洒向黏糊糊的邻伴；丝滑幻影袍则如闪耀幽灵般绕着她美味的身体飞舞，柔嫩大腿、宽阔臀部、丰饶孕肚、硕大乳房和优雅双臂依次显露，却总有一部分多汁肌肤藏在华丽面纱后。她是神圣的存在、魔法生灵，是吹过舞池的空灵之风，以深沉的艺术狂热鼓舞舞伴；那股创意热潮，是任何审查者都休想扑灭的。 纳蒂的典范公司无人机几乎贴着有翼女士飞行，在她摇晃的乳沟与柔软大腿前几英寸处悬停。它没有撞上仙女华美的柔软肉体，还能拍下如此多她那硕大多汁天然乳房的照片，简直是个奇迹。 狂乱的班卓琴即兴乐句又持续一分钟后，音乐终于随最后一节放缓。 “奶牛莫莉快乐地哞哞叫！” “奶牛莫莉快乐地哞哞叫！” “她与所有伙伴分享自己的乳汁！” “她与所有伙伴分享自己的乳汁！” 假乳牛又弹出两个和弦，以强劲悦耳的即兴乐句为最后一个舞步收尾。乡村曲调渐渐淡去，舞者们从淫靡的魔咒中解脱。这里那里组成几个小团体，准备在更私密的地方继续表演，而公牛歌手将帽子重新戴正，置于抛光的牛角之间。“你们今晚的表现太棒了，尤其是你，瑟露莉安女士。短暂休息后我们马上回来，各位好好享用饮料和食物吧！” 紫色仙女行了个屈膝礼，在孕肚允许的范围内尽量深深鞠躬，随后将帽子扔上舞台。她向摄影机与绵羊舞伴送出飞吻，又把收到的牛铃赠给后者，令那可怜腼腆的女孩融化成一摊。“谢谢大家！你们都美极了！今天和大家一起度过的时光真是美妙。虽然我口渴了，但如果有人想要签名，我很乐意在你们想要的任何地方签字。” “能在我的帽子上签名吗？”一名戈·拉恩问道。 “还有我的腰带？”另一人要求道。 “还有我的奶子？”一名脸红的拉奎因人问道。 瑟露莉安微笑道。“当然可以！天啊，如果你们和我点的餐一样又棒又甜，我都要被这满满的爱撑爆了！”
rows.raw: " Cerulleyan sways rhythmically on her chair, following the swingy music like a busty metronome. Her body looks like it aches with need, yearning to swirl and twirl for hundreds, thousands of fans — or dozens of customers and amateur dancers. “Natty sweetie?” “Yes, Mistress Cerulleyan?” “Do you see how my slender legs shiver, how my elegant bosom rises, how my eyes shine?” The camerawoman nods with the camera. “You look as tense and needy as before your performance at the Utopian Skies Tesseract Theater – I know what you are thinking and I must say no. You must take it easy and relax. Think about your egg!” With a flap of diaphanous wings, Cerulleyan surges from her seat and flutters toward the scene. “I’m sorry Natty, it’s in my nature! I need to dance!” “Shoot! I knew she wouldn’t resist catchy new texan music,” Natty groans, fidgeting with the camera. “Alright, let’s see if this Paragon tracker drone works.” A second later, the image lifts off in a humming of antigrave motors. The remote machine closely follows the fairy lady, reaching her just before she sets foot on the dancefloor. Cerulleyan slides on the wooden planks, swaying through the mottled crowd like a violet mist. Her curvaceous body moves in a blur; a fluid, purple blur that spins and hops with regal grace between dancing zaika and aliens. The Ethereal Wind manifests in the middle of hat-wearing customers, standing in front of the scene a few feet away from the cowish band. The bull leader chuckles, glaring at the pregnant performer. “Looks like we have a star with us! Everyone make some noise for Ms. Cerulleyan!” Thunderous applause fills the room. “Will you grace us with one of your dances?” The faux cow violinist asks, leaning oh-so-close to the bull’s sweaty pecs. Cerulleyan giggles. “No need for such wondrous praises, but it’s appreciated. Would you kindly play your favorite song, please? I would like to have fun like new texans do!” “If that’s what you want, here we go!” the proud bull cowboy shouts, grabbing his femboy bassist by the hip. “New Texas has many cheerful songs, songs that make you smile and dance till you don’t feel your legs anymore, but there’s one song, one music that unites us all!” With that, everyone around starts shouting “Milky Molly! Milky Molly!” “MILKY MOLLY! HEEEEEEERE WE GOOOOOOOOO!” Violin, banjoes, and drums fill the restaurant with a fast-paced beat as the dancers line up, tapping the planks with their heeled boots. Cerulleyan flawlessly copies the seasoned artists. Her ephemerobe shines with alien colors while she bounces in place, surrounded by two go’rahn wearing revealing latex chaps and see-through tops. The gooey holsteins wobble in tune, eyeing the purple fairy next to them with barely-concealed wanton. Milk-white droplets gush from their perky nips, showering their surroundings with sweet, sweat-laced cream for the surrounding zaika’s pleasure. “ONE! TWO! THREE! FOUR! MILKY MOLLY’S UDDERS ARE SORE!” the bull sings. “MILKY MOLLY’S UDDERS ARE SORE!” the audience happily replies. “MILKY MOLLY’S UDDERS ARE SORE! BUT SHE CAN’T STOP MOOING FOR MORE!” “BUT SHE CAN’T STOP MOOING FOR MORE!” The faux cow reaches for the mic. “SHE BROKE TEN MILKERS AND HER BREEDING MOUNT TOO!” “SHE BROKE TEN MILKERS AND HER BREEDING MOUNT TOO!” “AND NOW SHE’S COMING FOR YOU!” “AND NOW SHE’S COMING FOR YOU!” When the verse ends, the dancers switch positions, twirling with the one in front of them for a handful of seconds before going back to their line. Cerulleyan shakes her sublime breasts and fecund belly oh-so-close to a deeply-blushing sheep-modded girl. She teases the shy girl with her shimmering curves, seducing her with smooth moves before blowing a kiss to the drone camera, granting her viewer a particularly deep close-up to her steamy cleavage. She gives her wooly partner a minx wave on her way back to her spot, sliding barefoot on the wooden planks. Cerulleyan’s movements look so eerie, so light, like a cloudy being as fluid as water and as smooth as a zaika’s chest. She imitates her fellow dancers flawlessly, hopping on one foot then another like a true new texan, and yet her body feels out of place: too agile and deft to sway and twirl like this, especially with a big, ostrich-sized bun in her oven. One of her rahn partners hands her a spotted cowgirl hat before the other gives her a cowbell collar. The winged host giggles, redoubling her efforts to give a good show. Her new accessory chimes cheerfully with each jerk, with each turn, with each bounce of her alluring udders, sinking into her lavender softness for a handful of seconds before pouncing back between her large, violet cleavage, adding its clear chime to the sweet banjo and violin tunes. “MILKY MOLLY’S THE FAIREST OF THEM ALL!” the singers roar. “MILKY MOLLY’S THE FAIREST OF THEM ALL!” The femboy violinist giggles. “ONE BY ONE SHE BRANDED THEIR HOLES!” “ONE BY ONE SHE BRANDED THEIR HOLES!” the crowd replies. “FROM DAWN TILL DUSK SHE HAPPPILY PLOWS!” “FROM DAWN TILL DUSK SHE HAPPPILY PLOWS!” “UNTIL THE HILLS ARE AS WHITE AS SNOW!” the band members sing in unison. “UNTIL THE HILLS ARE AS WHITE AS SNOW!” Cerulleyan swings one side to the other, not bothered by the quickly increasing rhythm nor by the saucy lyrics. She’s having lots of fun — she happily smiles and shouts along. Her heavy breasts wildly sway left and right, up and down, raining sweaty droplets on her gooey neighbors while her silky ephemerobe flies like a shimmering ghost around her delicious body, revealing her supple thighs, wide hips, fecund belly, hefty boobs, and graceful arms one at a time, always keeping some of her juicy skin hidden behind her opulent veils. She’s a divine being, a magical creature, an Ethereal Wind blowing through the dancefloor, invigorating her partners with a deeply artistic fever, a creative heat that no censor can hope to ever quench. Natty’s Paragon drone flies oh-so-close to the winged lady, hovering a few inches away from her wobbling cleavage and pillowy thighs. It’s a miracle it didn’t crash into the fairy’s gorgeous plushness and that it could capture so many pictures of her big, juicy naturals. After another minute of frenzied banjo riffs, the music finally slows down with the last verse. “MILKY MOLLY’S HAPPILY MOOS!” “MILKY MOLLY’S HAPPILY MOOS!” “SHE SHARED HER CREAM WITH ALL HER CREW!” “SHE SHARED HER CREAM WITH ALL HER CREW!” The faux cow plays two more cords, nailing down the last step with a strong, melodious riff. The country tune fades, releasing the dancers from its sultry spell. A few groups form here and there, ready to continue the show in a more private place as the bull singer puts his hat back into place between his polished horns. “You were amazing tonight, especially you Ms. Cerulleyan. We’ll be right back after a short break, so enjoy your drinks and food everyone!” The purple fairy makes a curtsy, bowing as low as her pregnant belly lets her before throwing her hat onto stage. She blows a kiss to the camera and to her sheep partner before offering her the cowbell she received, turning the poor, shy thing into a melty puddle. “Thank you everyone! You were all beautiful! I had such an amazing day with y’all. I may be thirsty, but if anyone wants an autograph, I’ll happily sign whatever you want.” “Can you autograph my hat?” one of the go’rahn asks. “And my belt?” the other one demands. “And my tits?” a blushing laquine questions. Cerulleyan smiles. “Of course! Gosh, if you’re as good and sweet as my order, I’m gonna burst from all the love!” "
