rows.original: The camera cuts to a few minutes later. Cerulleyan is back to her table, a little less sweaty than before but still glimmering in the room’s pleasant light. “One large root beer and one homemade, strawberry milkshake,” the [silly |zaikow |zaika-modded ] cowgirl announces, placing two pint-sized glasses in front of the screen. Her breasts and tail leak creamy droplets on the table, making the camerawoman all the more tense. “Thank you — It looks delicious.” Cerulleyan plays with her drink a little, gazing at the bubbles as they join the fizzy on top of the glass. She slowly turns her crystal glasses on the waitress’s bucking assets. “Having troubles with your tail?” “I... I only got mine recently. I don’t know how to control it,” the purple cow confesses. “Turn around, I’ll help you,” the winged zaika says before looking at the camera. “Zoom in. I’ll show how you pacify an unruly tail.” The busty cowgirl slowly turns around, giving you a prime view at her bubble butt and juicy thighs. She’s got white freckles all over her tush, like a holstein cow — so cute! Without warning, Cerulleyan rubs her thumb down her spine, just above the tailbone. The waitress nearly jumps, startled and surprised by the sudden contact, but remains in place. “W-What are you doing?” “No wonder you can’t control your tail, the nervous connections are all tense! There’s so many knots! It’s a miracle you aren’t blowing loads with each step,” the native zaika comments, carefully avoiding the white drops raining down the waitress’ breasts. The cowgirl coos and [silly |moos |moans ] with each stroke, shivering from head to hoove as Cerulleyan relaxes her alien member. After a dozen rubs, her vigorous tail slowly flops backward, splurting one last rope before calming down for good. “I can’t believe it! My tail- it does what I want again! Thank you! Thank you so much!” “Glad to be of service. My magic fingers numbed your nervous system but you’ll need some training and a lot more time and massages to control it. Try moving it up and down or left to right — nothing fancy at the beginning — to accustom yourself to it. Give it two or three weeks and you’ll be as swift and graceful as I am.” The cowgirl nods. “W-Will do. Sorry for the trouble, miss. I’ll fetch your order right away!” “No worries. Hopefully, this educational segment will help more than one offworlder. And besides, we’ve got something big and sweet to savor,” Cerulleyan remarks, eyeing her pint-sized glass. “Cheers!” the zaika say before trying out their respective drinks. You can’t see the camerawoman sampling hers off screen, but you can clearly see the ravished awe on Cerulleyan’s face. “By the chillcatrixes’ spines, this is delicious! Very sweet but cloudy. The fizz dulls the bitter aftertaste lovingly, making you want to sip more of it with each gulp. It dances on the tongue, stimulating all your taste buds before smoothly sliding down to your belly. Reminds me of Bright Water’s soda, but less liquorous and bubbly. I would take one to compare but that’d be too much sugar for my little princess,” she says, rubbing her rotund belly. “How’s your milkshake, Natty?” The camera shakes a little. “It’s... good, creamy, fruity. From aaaafar, it tastes like dhaaalian cherries. You can feel the thickness in the cream. Gosh, my tummy’s so warm and fuzzy right now. Didja think she milked it herself?” “I’m sure she did. Drink it slow, you’ve got a lot more dairy to take on.” With that, the purple waitress comes back with two extra-stuffed plates. “Here we go! One quarter pound burger with fries and bacon strips for the Breeder of Worlds, and a T-bone with BBQ sauce, fries, and beans for the cute camerawoman,” she announces, placing the overflowing plates in front of the camera’s lens. “Have a great meal” “I will,” the zaika answer in perfect unison. The camera zooms out, showing just how shiny and plump the meat is. Natty’s T-bone is medium rare, glazed with BBQ sauce, fuming slightly as more sauce trickles down the homemade fries. They look soft and full — they were certainly parboiled. Surprisingly, the chef put a lot of beans to go with the meat, beans full of sauce, glistening in the room’s rustic lighting. As for Cerulleyan’s burger, it looks absolutely massive! Lettuce, bacon, tomatoes, a quarter pound patty, shallots, and sesame buns glazed with homemade ketchup and mayo sauce. A big pile of fries and two grilled bacon strips occupy the rest of the plate. Just looking at it makes you salivate from across the holoscreen. “It’s so big. I don’t know if it can fit in my mouth,” Cerulleyan murmurs. “Hey- I’ve heard that before,” Natty drunkenly teases. The big fairy winks before taking it in both hands. Some salad and sauce drips on her fingers but she doesn’t care, only the juicy meat and grilled buns matter to her brilliant eyes. She takes a big bite, filling her mouth with liberal amounts of lettuce, tomatoes, bread, and, most importantly, extra-tender meat. The zaika chews slowly, licking juices and sauce off her lips before taking another slab. “It’s delicious! Belly-bursting delicious! Sublime even. The meat is seasoned just right, and the ketchup-mayo sauce adds a lot of flavors to buns. The toppings give extra texture and soak in the juices. I don’t even mind the tomatoes,” she says before taking some fries and a piece of bacon. “The fries are crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside. I like that they used dhaalian potatoes — they are a bit hard to peel but their golden skin and spongy inside make them perfect for frying. As for the bacon... it’s good but it’d be better in the burger,” she remarks. She removes the top bun and places the strips on top of the meat before taking another bite. “Now it’s perfect.” “M’Lady, you’ve got lettuce on your nose!” Cerulleyan giggles. “Thank you Natty. I’m usually a lot less messy but New Texan food makes me do things, crazy things. How’s your T-bone by the way?” “Itshh shoooh good! Like, look at this,” she says, showing her knife and fork on screen. The camerawoman effortlessly cuts a tender slab of meat out of the enormous T-bone. “It’s soooooo soft! It’s like cutting butter. I tried it out with the beans and stars! The sauce, the meat, the beans, everything tastes so good! It’s so good I’m gonna cry,” she whimpers, washing the taste with more strawberry goodness. “Daww, don’t cry Natty. The tears will ruin the seasoning,” Cerulleyan playfully says between sips of root beer. “The meat’s shiny and tender, well-seasoned, accompanied with exquisite homemade sauce and fresh toppings. I don’t know what more to say – it’s very simple but expertly executed, which is exactly what one looks for in the Gyre. There’s lots of choice and the menu specifies what contains dairy products in case you come with zaika who can’t hold their milk. Clearly not the cheapest outlet, but the plates are big and full to justify the price. There’s so much to eat, I don’t know if we’ll have room for dessert.”
rows.translation: 镜头切换到几分钟后。瑟露莉安已经回到桌边，身上的汗比之前少了些，但在室内宜人的灯光下依旧闪闪发亮。“一大杯根汁汽水，还有一杯自制草莓奶昔，”这位[silly |扎伊卡牛 |改造成扎伊卡的 ]牛仔女郎宣布道，把两个品脱大小的玻璃杯摆到镜头前。她的乳房和尾巴把奶油般的液滴漏在桌上，让摄影师变得更加紧张。 “谢谢——看起来很美味。” 瑟露莉安稍微拨弄着饮料，看气泡升起并加入杯顶的泡沫。她缓缓转动水晶眼镜，对准女服务员不断抽动的身体。“你的尾巴不听使唤吗？” “我...我最近才装上它。我不知道该怎么控制，”紫色乳牛坦白道。 “转过身来，我帮你，”长着翅膀的扎伊卡人说道，随后望向镜头。“拉近一点。我来展示该怎样安抚不听话的尾巴。” 丰满的牛仔女郎缓缓转身，让你能从最佳角度欣赏圆润翘臀与多汁大腿。她臀部到处都是白色斑点，就像一头荷斯坦乳牛——太可爱了！瑟露莉安毫无预警地用拇指沿她脊柱向下揉去，就在尾骨上方。突如其来的接触把女服务员吓得几乎跳起来，但她仍留在原地。“你、你在做什么？” “难怪你控制不了尾巴，神经连接全都绷紧了！这里有好多结！你没走一步就喷上一股，简直是奇迹，”本地扎伊卡人评论道，小心避开从服务员乳房落下的白色液滴。瑟露莉安每揉一下，牛仔女郎就会咕哝并[silly |哞叫 |呻吟 ]，从头到蹄浑身颤抖，任她放松这根外星器官。揉过十几次后，充满活力的尾巴终于缓缓向后垂落，最后喷出一股液体，继而彻底平静。 “真不敢相信！我的尾、尾巴又肯听我的话了！谢谢！太感谢你了！” “很高兴能帮上忙。我的魔法手指麻痹了你的神经系统，但要真正控制它，你还需要训练、更多时间和大量按摩。一开始不要做什么复杂动作，只试着上下或左右摆动，让自己慢慢习惯。给它两三周时间，你就会变得像我一样迅捷优雅。” 牛仔女郎点点头。“我、我会的。给您添麻烦了，女士。我马上去取您的餐点！” “别担心。希望这段教学能帮助不止一位星外人。再说了，我们还有又大又甜的东西要品尝，”瑟露莉安望着品脱大小的玻璃杯说道。 “干杯！”两个扎伊卡人说道，随后各自品尝饮料。你看不到镜头外的摄影师在喝她那杯，却能清楚看到瑟露莉安脸上那副饱受冲击的惊叹神情。 “以寒晶蛇的脊刺起誓，这太好喝了！非常甜，却又浑厚。气泡温柔地削弱苦涩回味，让你每咽下一口都更想继续啜饮。它在舌尖起舞，刺激所有味蕾，随后顺滑地流进肚子。让我想到澄水公司的汽水，但酒味更淡、气泡也更少。我本想拿一杯来比较，可那样会让我的小公主摄入太多糖，”她揉着圆鼓鼓的肚子说道。“你的奶昔怎么样，纳蒂？” 镜头轻轻摇晃。“很...好喝，有奶油味，又有水果味。从好——远的地方尝起来像达——尔樱桃。奶油的浓厚口感非常明显。天哪，我的肚肚现在又暖又酥。你觉得是她自己挤的奶吗？” “我肯定是。慢慢喝，你后面还得吞下更多乳制品。” 说到这里，紫色女服务员端着两个装得格外丰盛的盘子回来。“来啦！给‘世界繁育者’的四分之一磅汉堡、薯条和培根条，还有给可爱摄影师的丁骨牛排配烧烤酱、薯条和豆子，”她宣布道，把满溢的盘子摆到摄像镜头前。“祝你们用餐愉快” “一定会的，”两个扎伊卡人异口同声地回答。 镜头拉远，展示肉食究竟多么油亮丰满。纳蒂的丁骨牛排是三分熟，表面裹着烧烤酱，微微冒着热气，更多酱汁正顺着自制薯条流下。薯条看起来柔软饱满——肯定事先煮过。令人惊讶的是，厨师在肉旁放了许多豆子；它们吸满酱汁，在室内质朴灯光下闪闪发亮。至于瑟露莉安的汉堡，看起来简直大得惊人！生菜、培根、番茄、四分之一磅肉饼、红葱头，还有涂着自制番茄酱与蛋黄酱混合酱汁的芝麻面包。盘子剩余空间堆满一大堆薯条和两条烤培根。隔着全息屏幕看一眼都让你口水直流。 “实在太大了。不知道我的嘴能不能装下，”瑟露莉安低声说道。 “嘿——这话我以前听过，”纳蒂醉醺醺地调侃道。 高大的仙女眨眨眼，随后双手捧起汉堡。一些沙拉和酱汁滴上手指，可她毫不在意；明亮眼眸中只有多汁肉食与烤面包。她大咬一口，让大量生菜、番茄、面包以及最重要的格外鲜嫩肉食塞满嘴巴。扎伊卡人缓慢咀嚼，舔掉唇边肉汁与酱汁，随后又咬下一大块。“太好吃了！好吃得能把肚皮撑破！甚至称得上绝妙。肉的调味恰到好处，番茄蛋黄酱也为面包增添许多风味。配料带来额外口感，还吸收了肉汁。我甚至不介意里面有番茄，”她说着又拿起几根薯条和一块培根。“薯条外脆内软。我喜欢他们使用达尔土豆——虽然削皮有点困难，但金色外皮和海绵般的内部非常适合油炸。至于培根...很好吃，不过放进汉堡会更好，”她评价道。她掀开上层面包，把培根条放到肉上，又咬了一口。“现在完美了。” “女士，您的鼻子上沾着生菜！” 瑟露莉安咯咯笑道。“谢谢你，纳蒂。平时我可没这么邋遢，但新德克萨斯食物总会让我做些事情，疯狂的事情。顺便问问，你的丁骨牛排怎么样？” “太、太好次啦！就像，看看这个，”她一边说，一边在屏幕上展示刀叉。摄影师毫不费力地从巨大丁骨牛排上切下一块鲜嫩肉食。“软————到不行！就像在切黄油。我试着和豆子一起吃，然后，老天！酱汁、肉、豆子，所有东西都太好吃了！好吃得我都要哭了，”她呜咽着，又喝下更多草莓美味冲淡口中滋味。 “哎呀，别哭，纳蒂。眼泪会毁掉调味的，”瑟露莉安在啜饮根汁汽水的间隙顽皮说道。“肉油亮鲜嫩，调味得当，还配有精致的自制酱汁和新鲜配菜。我不知道还能说些什么——它非常简单，执行却十分专业，正是人们在旋环区寻找的那种餐点。这里选择很多，菜单还会注明哪些东西含有乳制品，以防你带了无法控制乳汁的扎伊卡同伴。显然不是最便宜的店，但盘子又大又满，对得起这个价钱。要吃的实在太多，我不知道肚子还能不能装下甜点。”
rows.raw: " The camera cuts to a few minutes later. Cerulleyan is back to her table, a little less sweaty than before but still glimmering in the room’s pleasant light. “One large root beer and one homemade, strawberry milkshake,” the [silly |zaikow |zaika-modded ] cowgirl announces, placing two pint-sized glasses in front of the screen. Her breasts and tail leak creamy droplets on the table, making the camerawoman all the more tense. “Thank you — It looks delicious.” Cerulleyan plays with her drink a little, gazing at the bubbles as they join the fizzy on top of the glass. She slowly turns her crystal glasses on the waitress’s bucking assets. “Having troubles with your tail?” “I... I only got mine recently. I don’t know how to control it,” the purple cow confesses. “Turn around, I’ll help you,” the winged zaika says before looking at the camera. “Zoom in. I’ll show how you pacify an unruly tail.” The busty cowgirl slowly turns around, giving you a prime view at her bubble butt and juicy thighs. She’s got white freckles all over her tush, like a holstein cow — so cute! Without warning, Cerulleyan rubs her thumb down her spine, just above the tailbone. The waitress nearly jumps, startled and surprised by the sudden contact, but remains in place. “W-What are you doing?” “No wonder you can’t control your tail, the nervous connections are all tense! There’s so many knots! It’s a miracle you aren’t blowing loads with each step,” the native zaika comments, carefully avoiding the white drops raining down the waitress’ breasts. The cowgirl coos and [silly |moos |moans ] with each stroke, shivering from head to hoove as Cerulleyan relaxes her alien member. After a dozen rubs, her vigorous tail slowly flops backward, splurting one last rope before calming down for good. “I can’t believe it! My tail- it does what I want again! Thank you! Thank you so much!” “Glad to be of service. My magic fingers numbed your nervous system but you’ll need some training and a lot more time and massages to control it. Try moving it up and down or left to right — nothing fancy at the beginning — to accustom yourself to it. Give it two or three weeks and you’ll be as swift and graceful as I am.” The cowgirl nods. “W-Will do. Sorry for the trouble, miss. I’ll fetch your order right away!” “No worries. Hopefully, this educational segment will help more than one offworlder. And besides, we’ve got something big and sweet to savor,” Cerulleyan remarks, eyeing her pint-sized glass. “Cheers!” the zaika say before trying out their respective drinks. You can’t see the camerawoman sampling hers off screen, but you can clearly see the ravished awe on Cerulleyan’s face. “By the chillcatrixes’ spines, this is delicious! Very sweet but cloudy. The fizz dulls the bitter aftertaste lovingly, making you want to sip more of it with each gulp. It dances on the tongue, stimulating all your taste buds before smoothly sliding down to your belly. Reminds me of Bright Water’s soda, but less liquorous and bubbly. I would take one to compare but that’d be too much sugar for my little princess,” she says, rubbing her rotund belly. “How’s your milkshake, Natty?” The camera shakes a little. “It’s... good, creamy, fruity. From aaaafar, it tastes like dhaaalian cherries. You can feel the thickness in the cream. Gosh, my tummy’s so warm and fuzzy right now. Didja think she milked it herself?” “I’m sure she did. Drink it slow, you’ve got a lot more dairy to take on.” With that, the purple waitress comes back with two extra-stuffed plates. “Here we go! One quarter pound burger with fries and bacon strips for the Breeder of Worlds, and a T-bone with BBQ sauce, fries, and beans for the cute camerawoman,” she announces, placing the overflowing plates in front of the camera’s lens. “Have a great meal” “I will,” the zaika answer in perfect unison. The camera zooms out, showing just how shiny and plump the meat is. Natty’s T-bone is medium rare, glazed with BBQ sauce, fuming slightly as more sauce trickles down the homemade fries. They look soft and full — they were certainly parboiled. Surprisingly, the chef put a lot of beans to go with the meat, beans full of sauce, glistening in the room’s rustic lighting. As for Cerulleyan’s burger, it looks absolutely massive! Lettuce, bacon, tomatoes, a quarter pound patty, shallots, and sesame buns glazed with homemade ketchup and mayo sauce. A big pile of fries and two grilled bacon strips occupy the rest of the plate. Just looking at it makes you salivate from across the holoscreen. “It’s so big. I don’t know if it can fit in my mouth,” Cerulleyan murmurs. “Hey- I’ve heard that before,” Natty drunkenly teases. The big fairy winks before taking it in both hands. Some salad and sauce drips on her fingers but she doesn’t care, only the juicy meat and grilled buns matter to her brilliant eyes. She takes a big bite, filling her mouth with liberal amounts of lettuce, tomatoes, bread, and, most importantly, extra-tender meat. The zaika chews slowly, licking juices and sauce off her lips before taking another slab. “It’s delicious! Belly-bursting delicious! Sublime even. The meat is seasoned just right, and the ketchup-mayo sauce adds a lot of flavors to buns. The toppings give extra texture and soak in the juices. I don’t even mind the tomatoes,” she says before taking some fries and a piece of bacon. “The fries are crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside. I like that they used dhaalian potatoes — they are a bit hard to peel but their golden skin and spongy inside make them perfect for frying. As for the bacon... it’s good but it’d be better in the burger,” she remarks. She removes the top bun and places the strips on top of the meat before taking another bite. “Now it’s perfect.” “M’Lady, you’ve got lettuce on your nose!” Cerulleyan giggles. “Thank you Natty. I’m usually a lot less messy but New Texan food makes me do things, crazy things. How’s your T-bone by the way?” “Itshh shoooh good! Like, look at this,” she says, showing her knife and fork on screen. The camerawoman effortlessly cuts a tender slab of meat out of the enormous T-bone. “It’s soooooo soft! It’s like cutting butter. I tried it out with the beans and stars! The sauce, the meat, the beans, everything tastes so good! It’s so good I’m gonna cry,” she whimpers, washing the taste with more strawberry goodness. “Daww, don’t cry Natty. The tears will ruin the seasoning,” Cerulleyan playfully says between sips of root beer. “The meat’s shiny and tender, well-seasoned, accompanied with exquisite homemade sauce and fresh toppings. I don’t know what more to say – it’s very simple but expertly executed, which is exactly what one looks for in the Gyre. There’s lots of choice and the menu specifies what contains dairy products in case you come with zaika who can’t hold their milk. Clearly not the cheapest outlet, but the plates are big and full to justify the price. There’s so much to eat, I don’t know if we’ll have room for dessert.” "

rows.original: After a short commercial for Bright Water’s cola, the episode restarts as the waitress comes back with an apple pie fresh out of the oven, a cheesecake, and a giant cup of ice cream. “Oh my! You ate everything!” Cerulleyan smiles, rubbing her pregnant belly. “I have a really hungry princess, so I had to eat for two. The quarter pound burger was absolutely gorgeous.” “I’ll be sure to tell the chef. Here’s your apple pie with whipped cream, and the cheesecake and ice cream for the hard-working techie,” the [silly |zaikow |zaika-modded cowgirl ] announces, placing the desserts in front of the camera. The cake and ice cream doesn’t look any different from what you have in the rest of the galaxy, but to a native of Dhaal, this must be the latest fancy. Stars shine in the fairy zaika’s eyes, though that may just be from watching the waitress’s bouncy tits and bubble butt. They’re definitely for something! “Enjoy your dessert.” “We will,” Cerulleyan replies, her spoon already in hand. The fairy zaika takes a sizable piece of pie. She contemplates the alien fruit and the pristine whipped cream for long, pregnant seconds before stuffing it past her juicy lips. She chews slowly, enjoying how the flavors dance on her tongue. “It’s sweet with a mild sour aftertaste. The crust crumbles delightfully and mixes heavenly with the cream. I expected that it’d feel dry, but it’s actually pretty soft. The apple slices were lightly-caramelized, giving a golden shine to the pie. Dear viewers, I must be honest with you. Eating this apple pie feels like biting a cloud, a very sweet cloud,” she says before taking a big sip of root beer. “Natty sweetie, how’s your cheesecake and ice cream?” “It’s soooooooo goooood! Like, for realsies! I never, ever, had sumthin’ schoooo nice! Itsch yummi, schweet, and so full of flavi- flavu- good tasties! Gosh, I luv dairy schtuff soooo much!” Cerulleyan chuckles. “Yes you do. It’s fortunate that I’m an otherworldly creature from outer space, else I would be gushing like you. Their whipped cream is to die for, don’t you think so, little princess?” she whispers, rubbing her expecting belly. The camerawoman doesn’t appear on screen, but you can clearly see how fast she slurps on her milkshake and how quickly her cheesecake and ice cream diminish. “Gosh, I luv choco-late, vaneella, koh-fee, and pista-chiao ice cream! The cheesecake’s so yummi too! It’s like eating a dream!” “And I thought I was a wordsmith,” the zaika queen playfully teases. Cerulleyan finishes her dessert with a big bite, obliterating the crusty treat before washing her mouth with root beer. Natty struggles to finish her cheesecake, but no amount of creamy goodness can stop her milk-drunk mind and greedy lips. The cute [silly |zaikow |cowgirl ] waitress slowly comes a moment later to gather the empty plates. “How was your meal, Ms. Cerulleyan?” The fairy zaika caresses her round belly. “Stars above, I’m so full. Everything was delicious: the fizzy soda, the fries, the bacon, the burger, the dessert – it was perfection from beginning to end.” “C-Can I have moooore milkies Ms. Moo? Pwetty please?” the camerawoman babbles, chin soaked in vanilla ice cream. “I-I’m afraid the personnel isn’t part of the menu,” the modded new texan shyly answers. “My sisters will be very happy to know that a pop star adored her cooking.” Cerulleyan gasps dramatically. “Sisters? So you are all from the same family?” The waitress shakes her head. “Sorta. We aren’t linked by blood but we’re like a real family. When Bright Water offered us a zaika makeover and a grant to open an exotic restaurant, we jumped right in. Dhaal’s so different from our world, so crude and imposing, and yet we found the friendliest folks in the galaxy here,” she says, inadvertently squeezing more milk from her opulent taps. You can almost feel the tension in the camerawoman’s body through the camera... how eager she is to taste more New Texan goodness. It’s a miracle she didn’t jump the stacked server already! “Oh! My family is the same. I, Cerulleyan, the Ethereal Wind, Splendor of Uond Ephine, was adopted by a zaika family too. Would you kindly introduce us to your lovely family?” “I... sure! Just give us a minute. We still have a few drinks to serve.” The purple waitress shyly bows before heading to the kitchen. The camera keeps running, filming the polished wooden furniture, the dancing patrons, recording the mechanical bull rider’s dethroning, the kind of stuff you could come across on New Texas. It’s almost frightening how much this place duplicates the New Texan pastoral experience. About two minutes later, the waitress comes back with four more [silly |zaikow |cowgirls ] in different hues of blue and violet. The camera focuses on them, capturing just how big and fat their milky tits and cowish hips are. You could sink into their lavender softness, drown in their cushioned asses, suffocate between their motherly mounds. Their modded tails wildly sway behind them, showering the ground with pearl-white droplets. The zaika in the room needily stare at the spilled milk, fighting a losing battle against their feral needs. If it weren’t for the camera, they’d certainly riot for the chance to taste it. The stacked staff members proudly pump their chests up, making their shiny assets ripple enticingly. “Here we are. Fran, Trysh, Betty, Vess, Winnie, and I, Poppy!” “I can’t believe she’s the real Cerulleyan!” Trysh gushes. “Calm down. We’re on TV,” Winnie murmurs. The fairy zaika giggles. “Aren’t you all lovely? Your cooking was exquisite, fabulous, fantastabulous!” “Sheelly Cery, fantastabulous isn’t a reel word,” Natty babbles between hiccups. “We put our heart into our food,” Fran says. “Not just our hearts — we gave it our all,” Betty playfully adds. She takes her chef’s hat off and makes an improvised cutesy, inadvertently giving you the most delicious close up in the galaxy. Cerulleyan smiles. “Aren’t you the cutest thing in the universe? Will you let me take a picture with y’all? To forever remember the nice time I had in your company?” Poppy winks. “Of course! Can Trysh have your autograph?” “Sure thing, lovelies.” Without further teasing, Cerulleyan takes place with the cowgirls and poses for the camera. “If you want to spend all night in a wonderful saloon, look no further! Tender Loins is waiting for you! Their hot, juicy meat and creamy goods will ravish your senses and subjugate your mind!” “We are open from 5pm to 2am, so don’t hesitate to join us for a line dance, play farm games, or enjoy the legendary New Texan hospitality,” the [silly |zaikows |modded cowgirls ] cheerfully add. “Thank you all for staying with us. We hope you enjoyed our culinary cruise as much as we did,” the elegant fairy says. “Stay tuned for a very cosy interview with our New Texan friends, featuring delightful bonuses that’ll leave you gushing for more! Maybe they’ll show us how they make their creamy shakes!”
rows.translation: 澄水可乐的一小段广告结束后，节目重新开始。女服务员端着刚出炉的苹果派、芝士蛋糕和一大杯冰淇淋回来。“天哪！你们全都吃光了！” 瑟露莉安微笑着揉了揉孕肚。“本宫肚子里有个特别饥饿的小公主，所以得吃双人份。那块四分之一磅汉堡简直美味极了。” “我一定会转告厨师。这是您的苹果派配鲜奶油，还有给辛勤技师的芝士蛋糕和冰淇淋，”这位[silly |扎伊奶牛 |接受扎伊卡改造的牛仔女郎 ]宣布道，将甜点摆到镜头前。蛋糕与冰淇淋看上去和银河其他地方的并无区别，但对达尔本地人而言，这肯定是最新潮的美食。仙女扎伊卡的眼中闪烁着星光，不过也可能只是因为她正看着女服务员弹跳的奶子与圆润翘臀。它们肯定别有用途！ “请享用甜点。” “我们会的，”瑟露莉安回答，手里已经拿起勺子。 仙女扎伊卡切下一大块派。她盯着异星水果与洁白鲜奶油，沉思了漫长而充满期待的几秒，随后将其塞过多汁双唇。她缓缓咀嚼，享受各种风味在舌尖起舞。“很甜，回味略带酸味。酥皮碎得恰到好处，与奶油混合起来宛如天堂。本宫原以为口感会很干，实际上却相当柔软。苹果片经过轻微焦糖化，让整块派泛着金色光泽。亲爱的观众们，本宫必须坦诚相告。吃这块苹果派就像在啃一朵云，一朵非常甜美的云，”她说完，喝了一大口根汁汽水。“亲爱的纳蒂，你的芝士蛋糕和冰淇淋怎么样？” “太————好吃啦！真的，真的！我从来、从来没吃过这么————棒的东西！又好次、又甜甜，还有好多味-味-好吃的味道！天哪，我超————喜欢奶制品！” 瑟露莉安轻声笑了。“你确实喜欢。幸好本宫是来自外太空的异世生灵，否则也会像你一样湿得一塌糊涂。他们的鲜奶油好吃得让人愿意为之赴死，你也这样觉得吧，小公主？”她低声说道，揉了揉怀着宝宝的肚子。 女摄影师没有出现在画面中，但你能清楚看到她吸食奶昔的速度有多快，芝士蛋糕与冰淇淋消失得有多迅速。“天哪，我喜欢巧克力、香草、咖啡，还有开心果冰淇淋！芝士蛋糕也好好次！就像在吃一场梦！” “本宫还以为自己才是语言大师呢，”扎伊卡女王戏谑道。 瑟露莉安大口吃完甜点，彻底消灭酥脆美食，又用根汁汽水清了清口。纳蒂费力地对付芝士蛋糕，但再多香浓美味也阻挡不了她因乳汁而醉的头脑与贪婪双唇。片刻后，可爱的[silly |扎伊奶牛 |牛仔女郎 ]服务员缓缓过来收走空盘。“瑟露莉安女士，您吃得怎么样？” 仙女扎伊卡爱抚圆滚滚的肚子。“星辰在上，本宫撑得太饱了。所有东西都美味极了：气泡汽水、薯条、培根、汉堡、甜点，从头到尾都堪称完美。” “哞哞女士，我、我能再来点奶奶吗？求求你啦？”女摄影师含糊地说道，下巴上沾满香草冰淇淋。 “恐、恐怕工作人员不在菜单里，”接受改造的新德克萨斯人羞怯地回答。“我的姐妹们知道一位流行明星如此喜爱她做的菜，一定会非常高兴。” 瑟露莉安夸张地倒吸一口气。“姐妹？所以你们都来自同一个家庭？” 女服务员摇了摇头。“算是吧。我们没有血缘关系，但就像真正的一家人。澄水公司提出为我们进行扎伊卡改造，还资助我们开一家异域餐厅，我们立刻就答应了。达尔和我们的世界截然不同，这里粗犷又压抑，可我们却在这里遇见了银河中最友善的人，”她说道，无意间从丰硕乳房中挤出更多乳汁。隔着镜头，你都几乎能感受到女摄影师身体里的紧张...她是多么渴望品尝更多新德克萨斯的美味。她居然还没扑向这位身材丰满的服务员，简直是个奇迹！ “噢！本宫的家庭也是如此。本宫瑟露莉安，空灵之风、乌昂德·艾芬之华彩，也被一个扎伊卡家庭收养。能否劳烦你将我们介绍给可爱的家人？” “我...当然！请给我们一点时间。我们还有几杯饮料要送。” 紫色女服务员羞怯地鞠了一躬，随后走向厨房。摄影机继续运转，拍下光洁的木制家具、起舞的顾客，还有机械公牛骑手被甩下王座的瞬间；这些景象全都能在新德克萨斯见到。这里对新德克萨斯田园体验的复刻程度高得几乎令人害怕。 大约两分钟后，女服务员带着另外四名深浅不一的蓝色与紫罗兰色[silly |扎伊奶牛 |牛仔女郎 ]回来。镜头对准她们，清楚捕捉那对产奶巨乳与奶牛般的胯部究竟有多么丰硕肥厚。你可以陷进她们薰衣草色的柔软身躯，淹没在垫子般的屁股里，窒息于母性乳峰之间。经过改造的尾巴在身后疯狂摆动，将珍珠白的液滴洒向地面。房间里的扎伊卡饥渴地盯着洒出的乳汁，与原始需求展开一场注定失败的战斗。要不是有摄影机在场，他们肯定会为了品尝乳汁的机会掀起暴动。 It’s so good I’m crying!!” “Oww, don’t cry sweetie. If you cry, I’m gonna cry too,” Cerulleyan whines between mouthfuls. She can’t stop herself from eating — her body moves by itself, guiding her fork and knife between the plate and her lips, staining her [silly |plump dickpillows |shiny smackers ] with grease and sauce with each bite. She’s hypnotized by her meal, charmed by her green-coated lover, unable to speak, breathe, or walk as it comes closer and closer to her, conquering every ounce of her flawless skin without once staining her voluptuous cleavage or membranous silks. Her breasts wobble with each gulp, growing larger and larger as bacon, potatoes, eggs, and waffle make love to her oversensitive tongue. This is beyond anything you’ve seen before — a zaika getting off of eating; dairy-free stuff, no less! She eats it all, not sparing a crumb from her ravenous mouth. She looks exhausted, breathless, and relieved, although her breasts are still the size of watermelons. Cerulleyan slowly licks her lips, staring at the camera with intoxicated eyes. “Stars, I’m so full. It took one waffle, just one gabilani waffle with spicy sauce, to leave butterflies in my stomach.” “You sure it’s not your egg moving?” Natty teases. Cerulleyan gently rubs her belly, parting her ephemerobe’s see-through fabric with manicured fingers. She looks gravid, about to burst, and not just because of her advanced pregnancy. “Enjoy the meal, little blossom. You’ll soon bloom into this world and deploy your wings,” the fey host distantly whispers. “Looks like you had fun,” the waitress comments as she comes to gather the empty plates. “Your cooking is divine. My compliments to the chef.” The busty shortstack giggles. “I’ll be sure to let them know. I hope you still have room for dessert.” Cerulleyan sips her Nova Cola. “My regal palate yearns for more sweet, gabilani sweets.”
rows.translation: 瑟露莉安微笑道。“好了，我亲爱的纳蒂——今天，你那些同侪朋友将品尝加比拉尼最神圣的美味佳肴。跟我一起去云层之下吧，异星人与扎伊卡在那里从无到有地创造奇迹！” 仙子般的扎伊卡毫无预警地展开双翼，一头扎进黑云。“她不能每次都这样逃掉！”纳蒂撅嘴抱怨，随后镜头中断。 镜头在一片极其炎热的工业区重新开启，此处肯定靠近旋环区的向阳边缘。几辆载具停在一家有着宽阔玻璃窗、形似餐馆的店面前。瑟露莉安头顶上，工厂的阴影中闪烁着一块亮黄色的加布屋招牌。经过镀铬和改造的加比拉尼匆忙为顾客端上一盘盘堆得满满的食物；尽管这个街区相对平静，他们的感官依然保持警戒。真奇怪... “欢迎来到加布屋，甜心们！这里即便不是整个达尔最棒的煎饼餐厅，也是旋环区数一数二的！闻起来太香了——我们还没进门，我就已经开始流口水了。亲爱的纳蒂，你不饿吗？” 画面微微颤动。“我...也许吧？希望他们有不含乳制品的食物。” “肯定有。乌托邦天空公司允许你跟我一起吃，对吧？” “这么说吧，嫩腰肉那一集播出以后，他们就放弃了所有限制。不知道为什么呢？” 高贵的仙子咯咯一笑。“也许他们终于明白，美食的真正意义就是与亲朋好友一起分享美妙而充实的时光。好了，一秒钟也别再浪费。我的舌头渴望配得上我神圣味蕾的甜点！” “等等，她刚才说我是家人吗？”纳蒂嘟囔着，跟随那位奇幻仙女走进矮个子们的店铺。瑟露莉安推开门时，一只小铃铛亲昵地叮当作响，让她的登场显得更加戏剧化。这一幕近乎超现实：来自儿童童话、身形高大的紫色生物，与一群身高只有她一半、正在制作华夫饼的加比拉尼相遇！她的幻影袍与珠宝在这家餐馆里显得如此异域，就像她在前往公主舞会的途中迷了路，误入一个由矮小而快乐的人民组成的王国。这里的异星员工早已习惯古怪顾客，可眼前这一位仍超出了他们以往的所有见闻。 “是、是电视上的那个姑娘，”一名臀部丰满的男服务员对粉发同事低声说道。 “我知道。别把气氛弄得很怪。”她咬着牙回答，尴尬地向瑟露莉安挥手。她挺起胸膛，让黄色围裙绷紧在颤悠悠的硕乳上。“欢迎来到加布屋！希望各位喜欢又大又浓[silly |稠 |厚 ]的！” 一名朋克风女服务员叹了口气。“真不敢相信他们批准了这句宣传语。” 高贵的表演者优雅地向这群身穿乳胶衣的员工行了个屈膝礼。华贵的幻影袍与奢华珠宝反射、折射出耀眼色彩，充满整个房间。“[silly |愿和平与繁荣与你们同在 |向各位致意 ]。我，瑟露莉安，空灵之风、乌昂德·艾芬之华彩，渴望品尝你们的可口佳肴。我们可以在这间迷人的餐厅用餐吗？” “当、当然，”粉发女服务员微笑着，竭力保持镇定。“二、二位想坐在吧台附近，还是离入口远一点？” “靠近吧台就好，”电视主持人简洁地回答。 慌乱的加比拉尼把她们领到一个仿佛直接取自旧式泰伦餐馆的卡座，四周是抛光金属与红色软垫。纳蒂在瑟露莉安对面落座时，画面微微摇晃，镜头拉近她丰盈的乳沟。主持人的乳房也化了妆，巧妙遮住扎伊卡本该长有的雀斑，同时令本就华美的胸脯显得更加壮观。若非她的裙装由闪烁光芒构成，单凭那对巨乳，她不是会被勒得喘不过气，就是已经处在撑裂缝线的边缘。她身旁的矮个子女服务员相比之下显得娇小，尽管她也足以填满F罩杯文胸——而蓝色乳胶紧身衣与黄色围裙丝毫没让那对乳房显小。 “今天的特别优惠是：点一份银河拼盘，至尊加布半价！” 瑟露莉安歪起脑袋。“那是什么？” “至尊加布是我们自制的XXL华夫饼，淋满利亚舒果酱、融化巧克力和咸焦糖，再以碧根果点缀。银河加布则是在一块XL华夫饼上放塔库斯薯饼、培根条与煎蛋，再淋满主厨特制的辣酱。” “这、这些不含乳制品吗？”摄影师羞怯地问道。 “我们的食谱对扎伊卡很友好，”身穿橡胶衣的加比拉尼眨眼说道。 “饮料呢？”瑟露莉安问。 “我们有气泡汽水、咖啡、柠檬水和清水。” 丰满的主持人端详精美菜单片刻，随后将水晶眼镜对准满怀期待的矮个子服务员。“我要一份银河加布、一份至尊加布，再来一杯新星可乐。你呢，纳蒂？” “嗯...一样，不过饮料换成大杯爱恋柠檬水，多加糖浆。” “非常棒的选择。感谢二位选择加布屋作为约会地点。你们点的餐马上就来！” 镜头晃了一下。“这、这不是约——” “亲爱的观众们，你们怎么看？到我们的社交平台留言，告诉大家这究竟算不算约会，”瑟露莉安顽皮地调侃道。“这里有种新复古未来主义风格，同时显得崭新又古老，就像离家一段时间后回来，发现母亲换掉了所有装饰和家具——既熟悉又陌生，既舒适又充满挑战，既简洁又优雅。” “瑟露莉安女主人，您真是既聪慧又有教养。” 仙子表演者微笑道。“当你穿越时空寻找新的奇迹，自然能学到不少关于美学与风格的东西。在横跨群星的旅途中，我发现了成千上万的物种、文化、食物、艺术品、风景、奇观，以及许许多多极其令人愉悦的事物，”她目光灼灼地盯着镜头说道。 “当、当然...您说是就是，”纳蒂含混地回答，竭力让手中的镜头保持稳定。她缓缓转动镜头，展示宽敞的新复古未来主义大厅，以及在吧台和烤炉间工作的十几名加比拉尼。他们站在硬光平台上，借此够到远高于矮小身体的工具和物品。三名圆滚滚的厨师在巨型平底锅里飞快烹制土豆、肉与奶酪，另一名全身高度镀铬的酒保则用额外的手臂一次调制六杯鸡尾酒。他们同步行动，仿佛受一只无形之手指挥，总会出现在最需要他们的地方，无论烤炉后、吧台旁还是顾客身边。这群经过强化的男女完美演绎着自己的舞步，既不洒出一滴饮料，也不犯下任何错误。巨大的华夫饼在馅饼大小的烤盘间缓缓膨起，在喷吐火焰的炉头旁轻声滋滋作响。气味一定美妙极了，难怪瑟露莉安会表现得如此跃跃欲试！ “好——了，饮料来啦！美丽仙子的新星可乐，还有她辛勤朋友的甜蜜爱恋柠檬水，”粉发女服务员一边说，一边把XXL玻璃杯放到瑟露莉安面前。气泡汽水看起来甜美又充满泡沫，就像丰满的主持人一样。她拿起褐色饮料，冰块碰撞，如同焦糖海洋里的冰山；纳蒂则害羞地伸手去拿粉色柠檬水。“你们点的餐最多两分钟就好！” 瑟露莉安向她送出一个飞吻。“谢谢你，亲爱的。敬全新的风味！”她宣布着，将杯子举向嘴唇。 “好、好。敬全新的风味，”摄影师从屏幕后伸手拿起饮料，回答道。两位紫色女士各喝了两大口，恰好足以唤醒她们对加比拉尼美食的欲望。你能从仙子表演者眼中看出来：她需要——不！她渴望华夫饼，渴望让油腻面团与煎炸食物塞满嘴巴，直到怀孕的肚子胀到本就惊人尺寸的两倍！ “尝起来就像胜利，”她舔着亮泽双唇说道。 “胜、胜利？”纳蒂问。 “甜得出奇，就像你一样，”她调侃道。“你的爱情魔药怎么样，甜心？” 画面晃动了好几秒。“很、很好喝。你、你真、真的能在柠、柠檬水酸——酸涩的怀抱里尝到石、石榴萃取物和荔枝。” “你说话越来越像真正的评论家了。也许你该到镜头前和我一起出镜。” 你可以想象纳蒂的脸颊现在有多红。“可、可是那样的话，还有谁来突显您高贵的美貌呢，女、女士？” 瑟露莉安还没来得及回答，那名嗓音尖细的加比拉尼女服务员便端着堆得满满的餐盘回来了。仍冒着热气的金色华夫饼占据餐盘的一大片空间，几乎没给大块培根、堆得高高的薯饼，以及两枚撒满细碎细香葱的大煎蛋留下位置。糖浆般的酱汁缓缓从华夫饼上滴落——你不知道他们是怎么做到的，但即使浸满自制酱汁，它看起来也丝毫没有泡软！ “天哪！闻起来好香！你们为了我们真是超常发挥了。” 身穿乳胶衣的女服务员眨眨眼。“我们可爱的顾客只配享用最好的。幸运的是，今天看起来不会发生斗殴。” “斗、斗殴？”摄影师真心忧虑地问道。 “别担心。不知为什么，本地帮派常在这里晃荡，像乳臭未干的烤锈鬼一样到处寻衅滋事。加布屋也因此恶名远扬，而我们则凭借控制骚乱的本领声名远播。没人能伤害你们——我向你们保证。请慢慢享用，需要什么尽管告诉我们。小心，食物非常烫。” “我就喜欢这么烫的，”瑟露莉安回答，手中已经拿起刀叉。她毫不客气地切开超大华夫饼，绿色酱汁顿时漫过餐盘，而她随即吃下第一口。她缓慢咀嚼，让滚烫面团与翡翠色蜜汁在舌尖共舞，随后才咽下。“好辣！就像在吃一朵云——一朵满是胡椒火花与水果雨滴的云。现在来尝尝配菜。” 高贵的主持人切下一块培根、一片煎蛋和一份薯饼，每吃一口都慢慢品味调味、油润口感与自制酱汁。她涂着唇彩的嘴唇很快便像某些员工一样变得碧绿湿润。逐一品尝完毕后，她用叉子叉起每样食物的一小块，一口全部吃下。她显然极其喜爱这道菜，闭着眼睛咀嚼，品味每一种撼动精致味蕾的滋味。“我已经无话可说。简直完美。培根滚烫酥脆；薯饼的盐放得恰到好处，既赋予风味，又不会变得干硬松散；煎蛋正是它应有的模样；尽管多孔面团浸满了滚烫、令喉咙愉悦的酱汁，华夫饼却一点也不软塌——这简直是魔法！食物魔法。厨艺法术？在我——瑟露莉安，空灵之风、乌昂德·艾芬之华彩——造访过的所有餐厅里，这里或许是最棒的一家——而我们甚至还没吃甜点！”她宣布着，喝了一口新星可乐。“老天啊，就连汽水都和这道菜相得益彰！” “等等，真的吗？”纳蒂问。你听见她在画面外喝了几秒粉色汽水，随后传来玻璃触碰金属的声音。“星辰在上，您说得对！我、我是在哭吗？好吃得让我哭出来了！！” “噢，别哭啊，甜心。你要是哭，我也会哭的，”瑟露莉安在大口进食的间隙呜咽道。她根本无法停下——身体自行行动，引导刀叉往返于餐盘与嘴唇，每一口都让油脂与酱汁沾上她的[silly |丰润肉棒软垫 |闪亮双唇 ]。她被食物催眠，为裹满绿色酱汁的爱人所迷，随着它越来越接近，她既无法说话，也无法呼吸或行走；它征服她完美肌肤的每一寸，却从未弄脏丰腴乳沟或薄膜般的丝衣。每次吞咽，她的乳房都会摇晃，并随着培根、土豆、煎蛋和华夫饼同她过度敏感的舌头做爱而变得越来越大。这超出了你以往的一切见闻——一个扎伊卡竟会因进食而获得快感；而且吃的还是不含乳制品的东西！ 她把食物吃得一干二净，贪婪的嘴巴连一粒碎屑也没放过。她看起来筋疲力尽、气喘吁吁，却又如释重负，尽管乳房依旧有西瓜那么大。瑟露莉安缓缓舔着嘴唇，以迷醉的眼神凝视镜头。“星辰啊，我吃得好饱。只用一块华夫饼，仅仅一块淋着辣酱的加比拉尼华夫饼，就让我心里小鹿乱撞。” “你确定不是肚子里的卵在动吗？”纳蒂调侃道。 瑟露莉安用精心修饰的手指拨开幻影袍的透明织料，轻柔地抚摸肚子。她腹部隆起，仿佛即将撑裂，而原因不仅是她已进入孕晚期。“好好享用这顿饭吧，小花苞。你很快就会绽放到这个世界，展开自己的翅膀，”仙子主持人心不在焉地低声说道。 “看来你吃得很开心，”女服务员走来收拾空盘时评论道。 “你们的厨艺神乎其神。请替我向主厨致意。” 丰满的矮个子咯咯笑道。“我一定转告他们。希望你的肚子还装得下甜点。” 瑟露莉安抿了一口新星可乐。“我高贵的味蕾还渴望更多加比拉尼甜点。”
rows.raw: " Cerulleyan smiles. “Well, my sweet Natty – today, your Peer buds will taste the gabilanis’ most divine delicacies. Follow me below the clouds, where aliens and zaika create wonders from scratch!” Without warning, the fairy zaika deploys her wings and dives through the dark clouds. “She can’t keep getting away like this!” Natty pouts before the camera cuts. The camera turns back on in a very hot industrial area, certainly near the sunward edge of the Gyre. A handful of vehicles are parked in front of a diner-like outlet with wide window bays. Above Cerulleyan, a bright yellow Gabble House sign flickers in the factories’ shadow. Chromed and modded gabilani hurriedly serve overflowing plates to their customers, senses on alert in spite of the relative calmness of the neighborhood. Weird... “Welcome to Gabble House, sweeties! One of, if not the best pancake restaurant in the Gyre, if not all of Dhaal itself! It smells so good — we haven’t entered the place and I’m already salivating. Natty, dear, aren’t you hungry?” The screen shivers slightly. “I... maybe? I hope they’ve got milk-free stuff.” “I’m sure they do. Utopian Skies granted you permission to share my meal, right?” “Let’s just say that they gave up on all restrictions after the Tender Loins episode aired. I wonder why?” The regal fairy giggles. “Maybe they saw what gastronomy is really about: sharing a wonderful, fulfilling time together with your friends and family. Alright, let’s not waste another second. My tongue desires sweets worthy of my divine palate!” “Wait, did she say I’m family?” Natty mumbles, following the fanciful fey into the shortstack outlet. A little bell lovingly tingles when Cerulleyan opens the door, making her entrance even more theatrical. It’s almost surreal: a big, purple creature from a children’s fairy tale meeting a clan of waffle-making gabilani half her size! Her ephemerobe and jewelry look so alien in this diner, it’s like she lost herself on her way to the princess’s ball and entered a kingdom of short but cheerful people. The alien workers are accustomed to weird customers, but this is beyond anything they have seen before. “I-It’s the girl from TV,” a caked-up waiter whispers to his pink-haired coworker. “I know. Don’t make it weird,” she replies between her teeth, awkwardly waving at Cerulleyan. She pumps her chest up, stretching her yellow apron over her jiggly melons. “Welcome to Gabble House! We hope you like ‘em big and thic[silly |c |k ]!” A punkish waitress sighs. “I can’t believe they approved this slogan.” The regal performer makes an elegant cutsy to the latex-clad personnel. Lustrous colors fill the room, reflected and diffracted by her opulent ephemerobe and rich jewelry. “[silly |Peace and prosper |Greetings ]. I, Cerulleyan, the Ethereal Wind, Splendor of Ueond Ephine, yearn to savor your delicious delicacies. May we dine in your charming establishment?” “S-Sure,” the pink-haired waitress smiles, trying her best to stay chill. “W-Would you like a table near the bar or further away from the entrance?” “Close to the bar will do,” the tv host simply answers. The flustered gabilani leads them to a booth straight out of old-style terran diners, with polished metal and red cushions. The image shakes a little as Natty takes her place across Cerulleyan, zooming in on her abundant cleavage. The host’s breasts are made up too, skillfully hiding freckles where a zaika’s should be and increasing her already opulent bosom. If her dress wasn’t made of shimmering light, she’d either be choking or on the verge of bursting its seams with her sheer boobage. Next to her, the shortstack waitress looks small in comparison even though she’d easily fill a F-cup bra — and her blue latex bodysuit and yellow apron don’t make them look any smaller. “Our special deal of the day is 50% off our Supreme Gabble if you order a Galaxy Plate!” Cerulleyan tilts her head. “What’s this?” “The Supreme Gabble is our homemade XXL waffle smothered with liashu jam, melted chocolate, salted caramel, and topped with pecan. The Galaxy Gabble consists of tarkusian hashbrowns, bacon strips, and pan-fried eggs served atop an XL waffle, smothered with the chef’s spicy sauce.” “I-Is this dairy free?” the camerawoman shyly asks. “Our recipes are zaika friendly,” the rubber-clad gabilani winks. “And the drinks?” Cerulleyan asks. “We have fizzy soda, coffee, lemonade, and water.” The busty host looks at the fancy menu for a moment before setting her crystal glasses on the expecting shortstack. “I’ll take a Galaxy Gabble, a Supreme Gabble, and a Nova Cola. And you, Natty?” “Hum... same but with a large Love Lemon with extra syrup.” “Very good choice. Thank you for choosing Gabble House for your date. Your order will be coming right up!” The camera shakes a little. “I-It’s not a d-” “What do you think, dear spectators? Tell us if you think it’s a date or not on our socials,” Cerulleyan playfully teases. “This place has such a neo-retro futuristic look. It looks new and old at the same time, like returning back home to see that your mother changed all the decorations and furniture while you were away — familiar yet odd, comfy and challenging, simple yet elegant.” “You are so clever and cultured Mistress Cerulleyan.” The fairy performer smiles. “When you travel space and time in search of new wonders, you learn a thing or three about aesthetics and style. Through my trip across the stars, I discovered thousands and thousands of species, cultures, food, art pieces, landscapes, wonders, and many more extremely enjoyable things,” she says, intensely staring at the camera. “S-Sure... if you say so,” Natty babbles, struggling to keep her grasp on the camera steady. She slowly rotates it, showing the large, retro-futuristic room and the dozen gabilani working the bar and grills. They stand on hardlight platforms that allow them to reach tools and stuff high above their short bodies. A trio of rotund chefs swiftly cook potatoes, meat, and cheese in huge pans while a heavily-chromed bartender prepares six cocktails at a time with his extra arms. They all move in sync, conducted by an invisible hand that places them where they are most wanted, be it behind the grill, at the bar, or with customers. The augmented lads and ladies execute their choreography perfectly, not spilling a drink or even making a single mistake. Huge waffles slowly rise between pie-sized grills, sizzling softly near the flaring burners. The smell must be gorgeous, no wonder Cerulleyan acts so adventurous! “Aaaaaand here we go! A Nova Cola for the beautiful fairy and a sweet love lemon for her hard-working friend,” the pink-haired waitress says, placing XXL glasses in front of Cerulleyan. The fizzy soda looks so sweet and bubbly, just like the busty host. She takes the brownish beverage, making the ice cubes clash like icebergs in a caramel sea while Natty shyly reaches for her pink-colored lemonade. “Your order will be ready in two minutes, tops!” Cerulleyan blows her a kiss. “Thank you dear. To new flavors!” she proclaims, raising her glass to her lips. “Y-Yeah. To new flavours,” the camerawoman replies, reaching for her drink from behind the screen. The purple ladies take two gulps, just enough to activate their lust for gabilani treats. You can see it in the fey performer’s eyes: she needs – no! She yearns for waffles, to fill her mouth full of greasy dough and fried food until her pregnant belly is twice its impressive size! “It tastes like victory,” she says, licking her glossy lips. “V-Victory?” Natty asks. “Extra sweet, just like you,” she teases. “How’s your love potion, sweetie?” The image shakes for a handful of seconds. “I-It’s good. Y-You re- really feel the gr- grenade extract and litchi between t-the lemonade’s ssss-sour embrace.” “You’re starting to talk like a real critic. Maybe you should join me in front of the camera.” You can imagine how bright Natty’s cheeks must be. “B-But who else’s gonna highlight your regal beauty, M’Lady?” Before Cerulleyan can answer, the squeaky gabilani waitress comes back with overflowing plates. Golden waffles, still steaming, take a large part of the dishes, leaving close to no place for large bacon strips, a huge pile of hashbrowns, and two big eggs covered in thinly-diced chives. A syrupy sauce slowly drips from the waffle – you don’t know how they did it, but it doesn’t look soggy at all, even smothered in homemade sauce! “Oh my! It smells so good! You outdid yourselves for us.” The latex waitress winks. “Only the best for our lovely customers. Luckily, it looks like we won’t have any brawls today.” “B-Brawls?” the camerawoman asks, sincerely worried. “Don’t worry about it. Local gangs hang around here for some reason, looking to pick fights like young rust roasters. Gabble House became infamous for it, and we became renowned for our riot control skills. Nobody will hurt you – you have my word. Please, enjoy your meal and let us know if you need anything. Be careful, it’s super hot.” “Just how I like them,” Cerulleyan replies, fork and knife in hand. She unceremoniously slices her plus-sized waffle, flooding the plate with green sauce as she takes the first bite. She chews slowly, letting the piping hot dough and emerald nectar dance on her tongue before swallowing. “Spicy! It’s like eating a cloud — a cloud full of peppery sparks and fruity raindrops. Now let’s see the topping.” The regal host cuts a piece of bacon, then a slice of egg, and a portion of hashbrowns, taking her time between bites to enjoy the seasoning, the greasy texture, and the homemade sauce. Her painted lips soon become as green and juicy as some staff members. When she’s done sampling everything, she puts a bit of everything on her fork and eats it all at once. She clearly loves the dish, chewing with eyes closed to appreciate each and every flavor rocking her exquisite palate. “I have no words. It’s just perfect. The bacon’s hot and crispy, the hashbrowns salted just enough to give them flavor without making them dry and crumbly, the eggs are right how they should be, the waffle isn’t soggy in spite of all the hot, throat-pleasing sauce drenching its porous dough – it’s just magic! Food magic. Cookmancy? Of all the restaurants that I, Cerulleyan, the Ethereal Wind, Splendor of Ueond Ephine, have visited, this might be the best of them all — and we haven’t had dessert yet!” she declares before taking a sip of Nova Cola. “Even the soda goes with the dish, for crying out loud!” “Wait, really?” Natty asks. You can hear her drink her pink soda off screen for a couple of seconds and the sound of glass touching metal. “Stars above, you are right! A-Am I crying? It’s so good I’m crying!!” “Oww, don’t cry sweetie. If you cry, I’m gonna cry too,” Cerulleyan whines between mouthfuls. She can’t stop herself from eating — her body moves by itself, guiding her fork and knife between the plate and her lips, staining her [silly |plump dickpillows |shiny smackers ] with grease and sauce with each bite. She’s hypnotized by her meal, charmed by her green-coated lover, unable to speak, breathe, or walk as it comes closer and closer to her, conquering every ounce of her flawless skin without once staining her voluptuous cleavage or membranous silks. Her breasts wobble with each gulp, growing larger and larger as bacon, potatoes, eggs, and waffle make love to her oversensitive tongue. This is beyond anything you’ve seen before — a zaika getting off of eating; dairy-free stuff, no less! She eats it all, not sparing a crumb from her ravenous mouth. She looks exhausted, breathless, and relieved, although her breasts are still the size of watermelons. Cerulleyan slowly licks her lips, staring at the camera with intoxicated eyes. “Stars, I’m so full. It took one waffle, just one gabilani waffle with spicy sauce, to leave butterflies in my stomach.” “You sure it’s not your egg moving?” Natty teases. Cerulleyan gently rubs her belly, parting her ephemerobe’s see-through fabric with manicured fingers. She looks gravid, about to burst, and not just because of her advanced pregnancy. “Enjoy the meal, little blossom. You’ll soon bloom into this world and deploy your wings,” the fey host distantly whispers. “Looks like you had fun,” the waitress comments as she comes to gather the empty plates. “Your cooking is divine. My compliments to the chef.” The busty shortstack giggles. “I’ll be sure to let them know. I hope you still have room for dessert.” Cerulleyan sips her Nova Cola. “My regal palate yearns for more sweet, gabilani sweets.” "

rows.translation: 一段简短广告后，摄影机重新开启，特写镜头中，一个蓝色加比拉尼人正把巧克力酱淋在绿色的XXL华夫饼上，饼已经浸满果酱与咸焦糖。热气腾腾的甜点如此光亮、饱满、美味，你几乎能隔着屏幕摸到它，感受甜面团在舌尖的滋味。你需要一份，而这么想的人不止你一个！ “星辰在上，我好饱，”瑟露莉安喘息着，舔掉唇边酱汁。她的餐点什么也没剩，连一块零落的土豆、一抹酱汁都没有。她看起来如释重负，却并未满足。双眼想要更多，嘴巴想要更多，圆润肚子也想要更多；全身每个细胞都渴望华夫饼：又大又厚[silly |得很 |实 ]的加比拉尼华夫饼，格外光亮多汁，浸满甜咸黏浆。 “我也一样，”女摄影师害羞地低语，竭力不让不断膨胀的乳房进入镜头。“吃完这些，我觉得自己承受不了至尊加布饼了。” 仙女主持人坏笑。“那我可以多吃点。” 片刻后，丰满女服务员开心地蹦跳过来，每一步都让紧身裤绷到极限。“看来你们很喜欢银河加布饼，”她顽皮地调侃，小手收走餐盘。“夜晚还早，吃甜点前应该再点一点东西。” “恐怕我们必须拒绝。我的味蕾是精密工具，不是贪吃巨口。不过，我们非常欣赏你们的厨艺，也很期待品尝至尊加布饼，”瑟露莉安说。 “没错。你们的东西太好吃了，”纳蒂补充。 “准备好让人生永远改变吧，”粉发加比拉尼人回答，随后返回柜台。她那几乎撑破裤子的臀部刚消失在吧台后，门铃便叮当作响。摄影机缓缓转向入口，十几个拉斯克维尔人走进房间。一场由新复古未来服装与各色各样闪亮造型羽毛组成的嘉年华狂欢涌入加布屋，只为寻找一样东西：肥腻油润的食物。她们的首领是个紫色飞机头、满身尖刺的赛博格，他懒洋洋地靠在柜台上，招呼纤瘦酒保。 “布雷特，我快饿死了！想要一份新鲜油海和配薯条的格鲁斯特汉堡，就这么过分吗？” 裹着橡胶的加比拉尼人叹气。“真会演。把你的肥屁股塞进卡座，规矩一点行吗？难得有体面客人在。你手下的加布饼做好后，我马上给他们上菜。” “客人？谁敢不请自来，闯入维克·托尔的地盘？” 瑟露莉安高贵地向华丽的闹事者挥手。“我想那就是我们。您好，托尔先生，我，瑟露莉安，空灵之风，乌昂德·艾芬之华彩，能怎样照亮您的一天？” 小个子匪徒缓缓转身，雕塑般的脸上混杂困惑与惊讶。“好啊好啊。要是有人告诉我，会在加布屋见到一位星际名人，我肯定笑掉大牙，或者因为浪费时间把他打烂。什么风把你吹来了，舞者？” “当然是对美食的期待。你没看过我的节目吗？” 几个帮派成员大笑。“老大反复看过那些节目，尤其是额外节目。” “哦！我很喜欢见粉丝，”瑟露莉安咯咯笑道。“至尊加布饼做好前还有些时间。如果想要签名或合照，我很乐意满足。” 维克·托尔犹豫了一下。“好吧，但别以为我是为了你的漂亮眼睛，公主。” “接下来能签在我奶子上吗？”一个朋克风拉斯克维尔人要求道。 “还有我的鸡巴？”一个衣着暴露的赛博格补充，她正努力把家伙藏在硬光裙下。 瑟露莉安咯咯笑。“鸡巴、尾巴、奶子，我哪里都能签。来吧，别害羞。” 她真的照做了。仙女偶像逐个在帮派成员的身体上签名，在拉斯克维尔人的脸颊、肉棒、阴唇、尾巴和乳房上留下金色旋纹；她先让淫荡字迹清楚入镜合影，再和幸运粉丝拍一张端庄些的照片。她亲吻、抓揉、挤压一切伸手可及之物，把完美乳房压上仰慕者的胸口，将尾巴缠进极其不雅的部位。这场淫荡活动没完没了，越来越多外星人试图获得签名，又吸引几十位新顾客来到加布屋。 五分钟后，期待已久的甜点终于送到。“请让一让！流行明星和她可爱约会对象的两份至尊加布饼！”粉发服务员喊着，挤过斑斓人群走向瑟露莉安的桌子。 “终于来了，”纳蒂松了口气。 丰满加比拉尼人把满溢的华夫饼放在镜头前，突出它们有多滚烫湿润。绿色甜点做成加比拉尼人的脸形，红色果酱是头发，咸焦糖是鼻子和嘴，融化巧克力则是眼睛。饱满的翡翠色脸颊点缀碧根果雀斑，完成了甜点的可爱外观。 “天哪！太美了，”瑟露莉安垂涎着惊叹。“我几乎不忍心吃，造型、香气、色彩搭配，[silly |简直绝了 |华美、崇高、非凡 ]！这是我第一次不想马上开吃。星辰在上，闻起来太美妙了。母亲，请赐予我力量。” 一个帮派成员倒吸一口气。“你有母亲？” “每个人都有妈妈，或者有一个对你意义相同的人。总有一天，我会以舞蹈演绎亲爱母亲一生的悲剧。她献出生命，让花朵得以绽放、为群星播种；她是沐浴星光最美丽的女士，愿我的欢乐幸福能穿过帷幕传到您身边。” “你、你还好吗？也许我们该在这停——” 瑟露莉安摇头。“不。现在不是呜咽的时候，而是品味的时候。好啦，开始吧，”她低声说道，伸手拿叉子。 “我也不客气了，”纳蒂从屏幕后伸手拿自己的餐盘，嘟囔道。“看起来真美味。希望不会全长到大腿上。” “甜心，四期节目下来，你一磅也没胖。闭上眼睛享受吧，”有翼女士说着，把叉子送向嘴巴。她不再耽搁，贪婪咬下至尊加布饼，将绿色面团和利亚舒果酱塞满嘴。“星辰在上！味道的平衡太完美了！甜果酱和松脆碧根果如此相配。巧克力和咸焦糖一样丝滑，在舌上轻盈却滋味浓郁。现在把一切混在一起尝尝，”她说着，在一小块长方形饼上混合巧克力、果酱、焦糖和碧根果，引爆味蕾。 “太好吃了，”女摄影师在两口之间惊叹。“你觉得他们会送到子午城吗？我早餐想吃一份。” 瑟露莉安微笑。“为了你，我相信他们会送。女神啊，太美味了！这么多年来，我从来、从来没有吃过如此美味的东西，”星辰般的表演者低语。她又咬一口，闭眼细品每种滋味。“我不知道绿色面团里有什么，但它与利亚舒果酱结合得宛如天堂。异星面粉与达尔水果，被高明厨师结合成最神圣的甜点！这已经超越料理，是最纯粹的爱！” The panting idol kisses the big doll deeply, locking lips with her for long, intimate seconds, unencumbered by the buzzing toys still rocking her stretched holes. “You’re so hot and cute in this outfit — and the same goes to you,” Cerulleyan whispers, tugging Fifi against her. “I came so hard, so many times... everything feels so cloudy and nebulous, like big, milky, gabilani boobs.” “Serving hot, thic[silly |c |k ] stuff is what we do best,” the small cook replies, curling against Cerulleyan’s pregnant belly. The dirty fairy lovingly pats the tired gabilani, ruffling her pink hair and caressing her pointy ears before giving a very messy smile to the orphaned camera. “I hope you liked this little bonus, my sweet blossoms. If you wanna taste the best the Gyre can offer, look no further! Go to Gabble House and fill yourselves to the brim with gabilani goods!” “I can barely stand,” Fifi murmurs, “let alone think. The next shift’s gonna be hard.” “Same. Do you have the receipts for your outfits and rubber? I would like to see if we can fit both of us inside the sarcophagus,” she says, snuggling Sugar Plum’s bouncy bosom."

rows.original: Cerulleyan smiles. “Well, my sweet Natty – today, your Peer buds will taste a true momean breakfast provided by the lovely tove of Mome. Follow me below the clouds, where aliens and zaika create wonders from scratch!” Without warning, the fairy zaika deploys her wings and dives through the dark clouds. “She’ll give me a stroke someday,” Natty sighs before the camera cuts. The camera turns back on in a very crowded place in the middle of the Stacks. Hundreds of zaika, raskvels, gabilani, and aliens with all sorts of chrome live together in the large plaza, enjoying snacks, drinks, haggling, shopping, and flirting as if they were in a Core world — well, a Core world with little to no clothing and kink restrictions. Cerulleyan stands in front of a peculiar inn. Its Tove architecture looks particularly alien, especially amidst the other buildings. It looks as if the shop was teleported from Mome directly to Dhaal. A big Bread & Breakfast sign hangs above the front door. The neon of the first a sometimes flickers back on before dying out again, giving a kinkier meaning to the welcoming establishment. “Here we are! The most wonderful inn of the Stacks: Bread & Breakfast! This tove-owned establishment opened a few weeks ago and quickly earned a lovely reputation. It’s both a hotel AND a bakery. They always have fresh bread and delicious pastries when you get out of bed or after a long day of work. I’m salivating just from smelling the fresh-out-the-oven treats scent. What do you think, Natty? Should we order a pie or one of their fancy breads?” The shy director hums. “I have never had momean food before. Do you think they have yellow plum cakes? I think they are called momabelles?” Cerulleyan smiles. “Let’s check it out then.” Without further ado, the fairy host flutters toward the door. She enters the alien inn in a symphony of metallic chimes produced by momean mobiles. A red-feathered tove waves at her guests from behind a polished desk reminiscent of an aquamarine geode. “Welcome to Bread&Breakfast. I’m Moaxaloutchi, owner of this lovely estate. What can I do for you?” “Nice to meet you, Ms. Moaxaloutchi. I, Cerulleyan, the Ethereal Wind, Splendor of Ueond Ephine, would like to taste one of your delicious pastries.” The avian shortstack frowns. “Oh! That’s going to be an issue. Earlier today, a Peer came and bought all our goods for a tea party of hers. I can check but I don’t think we have anything left in store.” A floating leyak wearing a white hat and a cute apron floats near the flustered tove. “No need to look. They took everything, even the raisin bread and fig jelly tarts! I’m so sorry, we won’t have anything ready until tomorrow morning.” Cerulleyan sighs. “Well... maybe we can stay here for the night and enjoy your baking in the morning. When will the bakery open again?” Moaxaloutchi quickly counts on her fingers. “Hum... 7am maybe? I’m not sure the pies will be ready before 8am though. What do you think, Nak’Ahdoo?” “Yeah. Come for 8am and you’ll find everything your heart desires,” the leyak baker answers. “Alright then. Do you have a room for two?” The tove receptionist checks her ledger, looking for any free spots left. “We are full except for the Lover’s Nest — our nuptial suite. It comes with a hot tub and a large bed specifically designed to withstand the passion of a long honeymoon night. You’ll have to sleep in the same bed but I don’t think it’ll be an issue for respectable ladies like yourselves. No need to worry about the cleaning, we recently hired a particularly-skilled galotian maid. The things I’d do to know what’s in her washing powder mix.” “Sounds lovely. I can’t wait to sleep in tove down blankets. I’ve been told it feels like hugging a cloud!” Natty sighs. “It’ll definitely be deducted from our paycheck. I call dibs for the hot tub.” Moaxaloutchi hands a bright pink keychain to the winged dancer. “Have a lovely night.”
rows.translation: 瑟露莉安微笑道。“好了，我亲爱的纳蒂——今天，你那些同侪朋友将品尝由莫姆可爱的托芙人奉上的正宗莫姆早餐。跟我一起去云层之下吧，异星人与扎伊卡在那里从无到有地创造奇迹！” 仙子般的扎伊卡毫无预警地展开双翼，一头扎进黑云。“她总有一天会害我中风的，”纳蒂叹息道，随后镜头中断。 镜头在层叠区中央一处极其拥挤的地方重新开启。数百名扎伊卡、拉斯克维尔、加比拉尼，以及装有各式镀铬部件的异星人在宽阔广场上共同生活；他们享用零食与饮料、讨价还价、购物、调情，仿佛身处核心世界——好吧，是一个几乎不限制衣着与性癖的核心世界。瑟露莉安站在一家奇特旅店门前。托芙风格的建筑显得格外异域，尤其周围还有其他建筑作为衬托。看上去就像整间店铺从莫姆直接传送到了达尔。正门上方悬挂着一块巨大的面包与早餐招牌。Bread中第一个a的霓虹灯偶尔会重新闪亮，随后再次熄灭，使店名重新变回更加色情的Bred（受孕），为这家温馨旅店赋予另一重含义。 “我们到了！层叠区最美妙的旅店：面包与早餐旅店！这家由托芙人经营的店铺几周前才开业，很快便赢得了极佳口碑。这里既是酒店，也是面包房。无论刚刚起床，还是结束漫长一天的工作，你总能吃到新鲜面包和美味糕点。光是闻到刚出炉点心的香味，我就已经开始流口水了。纳蒂，你觉得呢？我们应该点一份馅饼，还是尝尝他们的精美面包？” 害羞的导演沉吟了一声。“我从没吃过莫姆食物。你觉得他们有黄李子蛋糕吗？好像叫莫玛贝尔？” 瑟露莉安微笑道。“那我们就进去看看吧。” 仙子主持人不再多言，振翅飞向大门。她走进异星旅店时，莫姆风格的吊饰奏响一连串金属风铃声。一名红羽托芙站在一张让人联想到海蓝宝石晶洞的抛光柜台后，向客人挥手。“欢迎来到面包与早餐旅店。我是莫阿克萨洛奇，这座美丽旅店的主人。有什么能为你们效劳的吗？” “很高兴认识你，莫阿克萨洛奇女士。我，瑟露莉安，空灵之风、乌昂德·艾芬之华彩，想品尝一份你们的美味糕点。” 这名鸟族矮个子皱起眉头。“噢！那恐怕有点麻烦。今天早些时候，一名同侪前来买走了我们所有商品，要用来举办她的茶会。我可以再检查一下，但店里恐怕什么都没剩下。” 一名头戴白帽、身穿可爱围裙的莱亚克飘到慌乱的托芙身边。“不用找了。他们拿走了一切，连葡萄干面包和无花果果冻挞都没留下！真的非常抱歉，明天早上以前，我们都不会有做好的食物。” 瑟露莉安叹了口气。“好吧...也许我们可以在这里住一晚，明早再品尝你们的烘焙点心。面包房什么时候重新开门？” 莫阿克萨洛奇迅速掰着手指数起来。“嗯...也许早上七点？不过馅饼恐怕要到八点才烤好。你觉得呢，纳克·阿杜？” “没错。早上八点过来，你们想要的一切都会应有尽有，”莱亚克面包师回答。 “那好吧。你们有双人房吗？” 托芙接待员查看账簿，寻找是否还剩空房。“除了爱侣之巢以外，我们已经客满——那是我们的新婚套房。房间里有热水浴池和一张大床，经过特别设计，足以承受漫长蜜月之夜的激情。二位必须睡在同一张床上，不过对于你们这样体面的女士，想必不成问题。也不用担心清洁工作，我们最近雇了一名手艺格外高超的加洛蒂安女佣。真想知道她的洗衣粉混合配方里究竟放了什么。” “听起来很不错。我已经等不及睡进托芙羽绒被了。听说那感觉就像拥抱云朵！” 纳蒂叹了口气。“这笔钱肯定会从我们的薪水里扣。我先占热水浴池。” 莫阿克萨洛奇将一个亮粉色钥匙扣递给有翼舞者。“祝二位夜晚愉快。”

rows.original: The camera turns back on early in the morning, or whatever passes for morning on Dhaal. Cerulleyan happily glides down the stairs, fluttering on fairy wings. Her fiery braid and veiled robes fly behind her like a spirit’s ethereal cape, never revealing more than a figment of flesh at a time. Natty closely follows her, doing her best to stay near the agile dancer. Her shoes heavily clop on the wooden planks, as if she were wearing iron clogs or hooved chrome. “Hurry! We’re gonna be late!” Ms. Moaxaloutchi, the tove receptionist, happily smiles from behind her desk. “Good morning. Was the Lover’s Nest to your liking?” The camera nods. “I slept like a baby. Ms. Cerulleyan was right, tove down linens feel so light and warm — like sleeping in a cloud.” “You cannot imagine how hard it was to lure her out of bed. We started the day with a little trip to the tub. Well... a pretty long trip if I’m honest. The massaging jets did wonders to my back,” the pregnant host confesses, stretching her overworked muscles. “I’m afraid we were a little... adventurous, especially once we found what was in the basket waiting for us on the bed.” The red bird smiles. “Sounds like you had a lovely night. Breakfast will be served in two minutes but you can grab a spot in the bakery and choose what you wanna eat and drink before we properly start the service.” “Oh stars, yes please! The smell itself is intoxicating. I can’t wait to see what you have in store!” “Nak’Ahdoo worked extra hard to fill the shelves with custom breads and pastries. Its tentacles find new ways to amaze me every day.” Cerulleyan cocks an eyebrow. “Nak’Ahdoo kneads dough with its venomous tentacles? Isn’t it dangerous?” Moaxaloutchi shakes her head. “The venom evaporates during the baking, like alcohol. All our breads and pastries are safe to eat, although we advise extra caution to our zaika customers regarding our creamiest desserts. Eat and drink responsibly, please.” “Don’t worry. I, Cerulleyan, the Ethereal Wind, Splendor of Ueond Ephine, will show utmost respect to your staff and craftsmanship. Now, if you excuse us, we need to sustain ourselves.” The pregnant hostess happily flutters toward the large bakery annex of the inn. Chromatic aberrations fill the camera as it painfully adjusts to the bright shop. Large booths line the walls and dozens of tables are scattered across the room — soft brown wood meets painted glass and bubbling tanks filled with algae and aquatic life. It’s as if you left Dhaal altogether and walked into another world, or another planet to be exact. Little fishes play hide and seek in elaborate coral reefs and colorful amphibian hop on top of sleek nenuphar while stranger lifeforms swirl in a set of sculpted fountains made out of pink limestone. “Stars above, this is so cute! I walked many worlds, saw the most peculiar and alien biomes, but this is something far above anything I’ve seen before. Natty, we need to visit Mome – like, for real. I can’t pry my eyes off their bright animals and sculpted aquariums.” The camerawoman giggles. “And I can’t pry my eyes off the buffet. Look at how shiny their pastries are! Gosh, they smell soooooo good,” her assistant foams, zooming in on the freshly-baked goods on the low shelves. Dozens of breads, braids, brioche, croissants, donuts, jam-filled buns, cakes, and sandwiches whisper sweet nothings to the camera, luring the purple dancer to them with their golden crust, glazed top, and candied fruits. They are sorted by variety: breads and brioche on the left, sandwiches and grilled goods in the middle, pastries, cakes, and sweets on the right — breakfast, lunch, and dessert. They come in all shapes and sizes: straight, round, square, twisted, crown-like, there’s even a half-moon made out of chocolate and biscuit. “Oh my! So many delicacies! My regal lips won’t have enough room for you all.” The camera zooms out as Nak’Ahdoo, the leyak baker, slowly bounces to the countertop. Its small tentacles sway in the air as it gracefully glides between the oven and the displays with a tray of tove-shaped gingerbread. The poor jellyfish looks tired, sore, but its smile looks genuine. “Morning. What would you like to have for breakfast? Everything’s homemade and fresh out of the oven, and today it’s literally.” Cerulleyan licks her lips. “I don’t know. Do you have something simple yet iconic?” Nak’Ahdoo nods. It slides its tentacles into tiny gloves before floating to the pastry section. “I would recommend a croissant, terran toasts with liashu jam topping, and opmins. The croissants are filled with a nut-based cream with a caramel glazing and grilled almond slices. As for the bread, it’s made out of a special flour obtained by grinding sun seeds: a crop that only grows in the shallow paddy fields. It pairs really well with dhaalian liashu fruit. Opmins are a momean delicacy: candied fruits dipped in dough that are deep fried then served with cherry liquor. It’s served hot, moments after being branded. The taste is particularly sweet and there’s lots of texture and flavor.” “I’ll take one of each,” the fairy entertainer replies. “And you, Natty? What do you want?” The improvised director must be drooling, considering how closely she’s zooming on the big, black brioches. “Hum... Do you have momabelle cakes? I really love yellow plums and I wonder how alien ones taste. If not, I’ll take a chocolate brioche.” “It’s your lucky day! We just had a delivery from Mome with an extra-large portion of our sweetest, juiciest plums! Here, look how ripe and caramelized they are,” Nak’Adhoo flutters, pointing at a mound of brown, spongy buns. “You can have some chocolate brioche too. Just be careful please, the last zaika that tasted it experienced a four hour long milk-induced trip.” “Say no more,” the camerawoman replies. Cerulleyan giggles. “Big, juicy plums for my Sugar Plum.” The gelatinous alien happily bounces. “As you wish. Would you like something to drink with your treats? We have delicious hot chocolate, homemade coffee, and exotic teas that will carry your senses to the stars.” Cerulleyan quickly scours the drinks tab. “One cup of Serenitea with a spoonful of honey, please.” “A momean coffee with extra whipped cream and liquor.” “One Serenitea, a stuffed croissant, golden toasts, and a bag of opmins for the beautiful dancer fairy, and for Ms. Sugar Plum, a chocolate brioche, a bag of plum cakes, and a momean coffee coming right up!” The camerawoman tries to correct the leyak baker about her name, but her complaint is muffled by the sizzling of boiling water and the wail of coffee beans passing through a mechanical grinder. While the drinks brew, the floppy alien swiftly places the orders on exquisite porcelaine plates depicting momean landscapes: banks of yukkoths surrounded by leyaks, the shallow seas under the sun, a coastal village with long, sculpted spires and fields of colorful weeds, an antique tove enclave in the deep ocean, and many more stylized images that transport you to this mysterious planet whose skies are filled with flying whales and mythic creatures straight out of old terran fairytales. It must be wonderful to travel to another world between bites in a warm, soft croissant. Once the treats are ready, Nak’Ahdoo fetches a couple of floral mugs and pours the fuming Serenitea into the left one before adding a spoonful of honey for the taste. Then, the leyak reaches for a bottle of brown-orange liquor and pours some in the other mug. A moment later, piping hot coffee cascades over the sweet spirit, becoming one with the smoky-dry alcohol. Last but not least, the little baker recovers a piping bag filled with whipped cream from one of the fridges and carefully draws a soft, cloudy heart on top of the dark brown sea. “And voila! Two delicious breakfasts for two big girls!” “Thank you kindly. I can’t wait to eat them,” Cerulleyan replies An acute beeping startles the floating baker. “Excuse me please, I must save my brownies and two trays of cherry crumble!” In the blink of an eye, the deep blue leyak bounces back to the laboratory in a blur of half-translucent light. Cerulleyan takes both trays in hand and holds them close to the camera’s lens; “Stars above, everything looks gorgeous. I can’t wait to dig in.”
rows.translation: 摄影机在清晨重新开启，或者说，在达尔勉强算作清晨的时段。瑟露莉安开心地滑下楼梯，仙女翅膀轻轻扇动。她那火焰般的发辫与带面纱的幻影袍如幽灵般飘在身后，每次只显露一小片若隐若现的肌肤。纳蒂紧随其后，竭力跟紧这位敏捷舞者。她的鞋子沉重地踏在木板上，仿佛穿着铁木屐或镀铬蹄子。 “快点！我们要迟到了！” 托芙前台接待莫阿克萨洛奇女士在柜台后开心微笑。“早上好。爱侣之巢住得还满意吗？” 摄影机点点头。“我睡得像个婴儿。瑟露莉安女士说得对，托芙绒羽床品又轻又暖——就像睡在云朵里。” “你无法想象，把她从床上引出来有多困难。我们以一次小小的浴缸之旅开始新的一天。这个嘛...老实说，那趟旅程相当漫长。按摩喷嘴让我的背舒服极了，”怀孕的主持人坦白道，舒展使用过度的肌肉。“恐怕我们有一点...冒险过头了，尤其是在发现床上等着我们的篮子里装了什么以后。” 红色鸟人微笑起来。“听起来你们度过了一个美妙的夜晚。早餐两分钟后开始供应，不过你们可以先在面包房找个位置，正式开餐前选好想吃喝的东西。” “噢，星辰啊，太好了！光是香味便令人陶醉。本宫等不及要看看你们准备了什么！” “纳克·阿杜格外努力地用定制面包与糕点填满货架。它的触手每天都能找到令我惊喜的新方法。” 瑟露莉安扬起一边眉毛。“纳克·阿杜用带毒触手揉面？这不危险吗？” 莫阿克萨洛奇摇摇头。“毒液会像酒精一样，在烘焙过程中挥发。我们所有面包与糕点都可以安全食用，不过对于最为香浓的甜点，我们建议扎伊卡顾客格外谨慎。请负责任地饮食。” “不必担心。本宫瑟露莉安，空灵之风、乌昂德·艾芬之华彩，定会对你们的员工与手艺致以最高敬意。现在请容我们告辞，我们需要补充营养。” 怀孕女主人开心地飘向旅店宽敞的面包房附属区域。摄影机艰难适应明亮店铺时，色差充满整个画面。大型卡座沿墙排列，几十张桌子散布房间各处；柔和棕色木材与彩绘玻璃、装满藻类与水生生物的冒泡水箱交相辉映。仿佛你彻底离开了达尔，走进另一个世界，确切来说，是另一颗星球。小鱼在精美珊瑚礁间玩捉迷藏，色彩斑斓的两栖生物跳上光滑睡莲叶，更加陌生的生命形态则在粉色石灰岩雕成的喷泉中旋游。 “星辰在上，这里实在太可爱了！本宫走过许多世界，见识过最为奇特的异星生态，可这里远远超越过去所见的一切。纳蒂，我们得去莫姆看看，真的去。本宫完全无法把目光从这些鲜艳动物和雕塑般的水族箱上移开。” 女摄影师咯咯笑道。“而我无法把目光从自助餐上移开。看看那些糕点有多么油亮！天哪，闻起来太————香了，”她的助手垂涎道，把镜头拉近低矮货架上新鲜出炉的烘焙食品。 几十种面包、辫子面包、布里欧修、可颂、甜甜圈、果酱夹馅小面包、蛋糕与三明治对镜头低声倾诉甜言蜜语，以金黄酥皮、光亮糖衣与蜜饯水果诱惑紫色舞者靠近。它们按种类排列：左边是面包与布里欧修，中间是三明治与烤制食物，右边则是糕点、蛋糕和甜食，分别对应早餐、午餐与甜点。形状尺寸应有尽有：长条、圆形、方形、扭结、皇冠状，甚至还有一轮以巧克力和饼干制成的半月。 “天哪！竟有这么多珍馐！本宫高贵的双唇可装不下你们所有人。” 镜头拉远，莱亚克面包师纳克·阿杜缓缓弹跳到柜台边。它以托芙形状的姜饼装满托盘，在烤箱与陈列柜之间优雅滑行，小触手则在空中摆动。这个可怜的水母看上去疲惫酸痛，笑容却十分真诚。“早上好。早餐想吃些什么？一切都是自制的，刚刚出炉，而且今天真的是从炉火里出来的。” 瑟露莉安舔舔嘴唇。“本宫不知道。有什么简单却又经典的东西吗？” 纳克·阿杜点点头。它把触手伸进小小的手套，随后飘向糕点区。“我推荐可颂、涂利亚舒果酱的地球吐司，还有奥普明果炸。可颂里填着坚果奶油，外裹焦糖糖衣与烤杏仁片。至于面包，则由研磨太阳籽得到的特殊面粉制成；这种作物只生长在浅水稻田里。它与达尔利亚舒果搭配得格外美味。奥普明果炸是莫姆美食：把蜜饯水果裹进面团，油炸以后搭配樱桃酒。烙好标记后片刻便趁热上桌。味道格外香甜，口感与风味也十分丰富。” “每样来一份，”仙女艺人回答。“纳蒂呢？你想吃什么？” 这位临时导演肯定正在流口水，因为她把镜头拉得如此贴近那些硕大的黑色布里欧修。“嗯...你们有莫玛贝尔蛋糕吗？我非常喜欢黄李子，很想知道异星品种是什么味道。没有的话，我就要巧克力布里欧修。” “今天是你的幸运日！我们刚从莫姆收到一批货，里面有超大份最甜、最多汁的李子！来，看看它们多么成熟，焦糖化得多漂亮，”纳克·阿杜一边弹跳，一边指向一堆棕色海绵状小面包。“你也可以来些巧克力布里欧修。只是请务必小心，上一个品尝它的扎伊卡经历了长达四小时的乳汁致幻之旅。” “别说了，就要它，”女摄影师答道。 瑟露莉安咯咯笑了。“给本宫的糖梅来些硕大多汁的李子。” 胶状异星人开心地弹跳起来。“如您所愿。要搭配饮料享用点心吗？我们有美味热巧克力、自制咖啡，还有能把感官送上群星的异域茶饮。” 瑟露莉安迅速浏览饮品标签。“请来一杯宁静茶，加一勺蜂蜜。” “一杯莫姆咖啡，多加鲜奶油与酒。” “一杯宁静茶、一只夹馅可颂、黄金吐司和一袋奥普明果炸，给美丽的仙女舞者；糖梅女士则要一只巧克力布里欧修、一袋李子蛋糕，还有一杯莫姆咖啡，马上就来！” 女摄影师试图纠正莱亚克面包师对自己名字的误解，可抱怨声被沸水滋响与咖啡豆穿过机械研磨机的哀鸣盖过。冲泡饮料时，柔软的异星人迅速将餐点摆上绘有莫姆风景的精致瓷盘：被莱亚克包围的尤科斯群、阳光下的浅海、拥有修长雕塑尖塔与彩色水草田的沿海村庄、深海中的古老托芙聚居地，还有更多风格化图像，将你带往这颗神秘星球；那里的天空充满飞鲸，以及直接来自古老地球童话的神话生物。咬着温暖柔软的可颂，便能前往另一个世界旅行，想必美妙无比。 点心准备好后，纳克·阿杜取来一对花卉图案马克杯，将热气腾腾的宁静茶倒进左边那只，又加一勺蜂蜜调味。接着，莱亚克伸手拿起一瓶棕橙色酒液，往另一只杯中倒了一些。片刻后，滚烫咖啡倾泻到甜酒上，与烟熏干爽的酒精融为一体。最后同样不容忽视的是，小面包师从一台冰箱里取出装满鲜奶油的裱花袋，在深棕色海面上小心画出一颗柔软云朵般的心。 “大功告成！两份美味早餐，送给两位大女孩！” “非常感谢。本宫等不及要吃了，”瑟露莉安回答 一阵尖锐哔哔声惊动了悬浮的面包师。“请原谅，我必须去拯救布朗尼，还有两盘樱桃酥粒！” 转眼之间，深蓝色莱亚克便化作一道半透明光芒，弹跳着返回操作间。瑟露莉安双手端起两个托盘，将其贴近摄影机镜头；“星辰在上，一切都如此美妙。本宫等不及要开动了。”
rows.raw: " The camera turns back on early in the morning, or whatever passes for morning on Dhaal. Cerulleyan happily glides down the stairs, fluttering on fairy wings. Her fiery braid and veiled robes fly behind her like a spirit’s ethereal cape, never revealing more than a figment of flesh at a time. Natty closely follows her, doing her best to stay near the agile dancer. Her shoes heavily clop on the wooden planks, as if she were wearing iron clogs or hooved chrome. “Hurry! We’re gonna be late!” Ms. Moaxaloutchi, the tove receptionist, happily smiles from behind her desk. “Good morning. Was the Lover’s Nest to your liking?” The camera nods. “I slept like a baby. Ms. Cerulleyan was right, tove down linens feel so light and warm — like sleeping in a cloud.” “You cannot imagine how hard it was to lure her out of bed. We started the day with a little trip to the tub. Well... a pretty long trip if I’m honest. The massaging jets did wonders to my back,” the pregnant host confesses, stretching her overworked muscles. “I’m afraid we were a little... adventurous, especially once we found what was in the basket waiting for us on the bed.” The red bird smiles. “Sounds like you had a lovely night. Breakfast will be served in two minutes but you can grab a spot in the bakery and choose what you wanna eat and drink before we properly start the service.” “Oh stars, yes please! The smell itself is intoxicating. I can’t wait to see what you have in store!” “Nak’Ahdoo worked extra hard to fill the shelves with custom breads and pastries. Its tentacles find new ways to amaze me every day.” Cerulleyan cocks an eyebrow. “Nak’Ahdoo kneads dough with its venomous tentacles? Isn’t it dangerous?” Moaxaloutchi shakes her head. “The venom evaporates during the baking, like alcohol. All our breads and pastries are safe to eat, although we advise extra caution to our zaika customers regarding our creamiest desserts. Eat and drink responsibly, please.” “Don’t worry. I, Cerulleyan, the Ethereal Wind, Splendor of Ueond Ephine, will show utmost respect to your staff and craftsmanship. Now, if you excuse us, we need to sustain ourselves.” The pregnant hostess happily flutters toward the large bakery annex of the inn. Chromatic aberrations fill the camera as it painfully adjusts to the bright shop. Large booths line the walls and dozens of tables are scattered across the room — soft brown wood meets painted glass and bubbling tanks filled with algae and aquatic life. It’s as if you left Dhaal altogether and walked into another world, or another planet to be exact. Little fishes play hide and seek in elaborate coral reefs and colorful amphibian hop on top of sleek nenuphar while stranger lifeforms swirl in a set of sculpted fountains made out of pink limestone. “Stars above, this is so cute! I walked many worlds, saw the most peculiar and alien biomes, but this is something far above anything I’ve seen before. Natty, we need to visit Mome – like, for real. I can’t pry my eyes off their bright animals and sculpted aquariums.” The camerawoman giggles. “And I can’t pry my eyes off the buffet. Look at how shiny their pastries are! Gosh, they smell soooooo good,” her assistant foams, zooming in on the freshly-baked goods on the low shelves. Dozens of breads, braids, brioche, croissants, donuts, jam-filled buns, cakes, and sandwiches whisper sweet nothings to the camera, luring the purple dancer to them with their golden crust, glazed top, and candied fruits. They are sorted by variety: breads and brioche on the left, sandwiches and grilled goods in the middle, pastries, cakes, and sweets on the right — breakfast, lunch, and dessert. They come in all shapes and sizes: straight, round, square, twisted, crown-like, there’s even a half-moon made out of chocolate and biscuit. “Oh my! So many delicacies! My regal lips won’t have enough room for you all.” The camera zooms out as Nak’Ahdoo, the leyak baker, slowly bounces to the countertop. Its small tentacles sway in the air as it gracefully glides between the oven and the displays with a tray of tove-shaped gingerbread. The poor jellyfish looks tired, sore, but its smile looks genuine. “Morning. What would you like to have for breakfast? Everything’s homemade and fresh out of the oven, and today it’s literally.” Cerulleyan licks her lips. “I don’t know. Do you have something simple yet iconic?” Nak’Ahdoo nods. It slides its tentacles into tiny gloves before floating to the pastry section. “I would recommend a croissant, terran toasts with liashu jam topping, and opmins. The croissants are filled with a nut-based cream with a caramel glazing and grilled almond slices. As for the bread, it’s made out of a special flour obtained by grinding sun seeds: a crop that only grows in the shallow paddy fields. It pairs really well with dhaalian liashu fruit. Opmins are a momean delicacy: candied fruits dipped in dough that are deep fried then served with cherry liquor. It’s served hot, moments after being branded. The taste is particularly sweet and there’s lots of texture and flavor.” “I’ll take one of each,” the fairy entertainer replies. “And you, Natty? What do you want?” The improvised director must be drooling, considering how closely she’s zooming on the big, black brioches. “Hum... Do you have momabelle cakes? I really love yellow plums and I wonder how alien ones taste. If not, I’ll take a chocolate brioche.” “It’s your lucky day! We just had a delivery from Mome with an extra-large portion of our sweetest, juiciest plums! Here, look how ripe and caramelized they are,” Nak’Adhoo flutters, pointing at a mound of brown, spongy buns. “You can have some chocolate brioche too. Just be careful please, the last zaika that tasted it experienced a four hour long milk-induced trip.” “Say no more,” the camerawoman replies. Cerulleyan giggles. “Big, juicy plums for my Sugar Plum.” The gelatinous alien happily bounces. “As you wish. Would you like something to drink with your treats? We have delicious hot chocolate, homemade coffee, and exotic teas that will carry your senses to the stars.” Cerulleyan quickly scours the drinks tab. “One cup of Serenitea with a spoonful of honey, please.” “A momean coffee with extra whipped cream and liquor.” “One Serenitea, a stuffed croissant, golden toasts, and a bag of opmins for the beautiful dancer fairy, and for Ms. Sugar Plum, a chocolate brioche, a bag of plum cakes, and a momean coffee coming right up!” The camerawoman tries to correct the leyak baker about her name, but her complaint is muffled by the sizzling of boiling water and the wail of coffee beans passing through a mechanical grinder. While the drinks brew, the floppy alien swiftly places the orders on exquisite porcelaine plates depicting momean landscapes: banks of yukkoths surrounded by leyaks, the shallow seas under the sun, a coastal village with long, sculpted spires and fields of colorful weeds, an antique tove enclave in the deep ocean, and many more stylized images that transport you to this mysterious planet whose skies are filled with flying whales and mythic creatures straight out of old terran fairytales. It must be wonderful to travel to another world between bites in a warm, soft croissant. Once the treats are ready, Nak’Ahdoo fetches a couple of floral mugs and pours the fuming Serenitea into the left one before adding a spoonful of honey for the taste. Then, the leyak reaches for a bottle of brown-orange liquor and pours some in the other mug. A moment later, piping hot coffee cascades over the sweet spirit, becoming one with the smoky-dry alcohol. Last but not least, the little baker recovers a piping bag filled with whipped cream from one of the fridges and carefully draws a soft, cloudy heart on top of the dark brown sea. “And voila! Two delicious breakfasts for two big girls!” “Thank you kindly. I can’t wait to eat them,” Cerulleyan replies An acute beeping startles the floating baker. “Excuse me please, I must save my brownies and two trays of cherry crumble!” In the blink of an eye, the deep blue leyak bounces back to the laboratory in a blur of half-translucent light. Cerulleyan takes both trays in hand and holds them close to the camera’s lens; “Stars above, everything looks gorgeous. I can’t wait to dig in.” "
