rows.original: After a quick ellipsis, the two girls are sitting in a cozy booth near the buffet. “Look how shiny and crusty the croissant is. It’s glazed perfectly, topped with the cutest candied fruits I’ve ever seen. Can you hear the way it crisps when I touch it? That’s the sound of perfection.” “Indeed. And your toast looks particularly good.” Cerulleyan nods. “You have the eye for these things, Natty. The sun seed bread was thinly sliced before being roasted. The crumb is golden and lukewarm: the perfect temperature to apply jam on it,” she says, reaching for a small bowl filled with a red marmalade. “Look how easily the liashu jam dances on its warm surface — something so chunky, so thic[silly |c |k ], turned into something so slick, so juicy. Momean cuisine is just something else altogether. Can I check your brioche? It looks so soft and warm.” The camera nods. “Of course, Mistress Cerulleyan.” “Thank you, dear. Let’s see... Oh! You don’t even need a knife to cut it! The dough is extra soft, with just a hint of cinnamon. I’m amazed by the baker’s skills — look how it mixed the white chocolate, vanilla, and dark chocolate,” she says, showing a colorful swirl to the lens. Creamy yellow, deep browns, and rich, honey-like texture shine in front of the oculus, almost begging to be sampled. “Do you think the baking removed the addictiveness of the milk and dairy product used to make it?” Natty awkwardly coughs. “Not sure. Only one way to find out.” The pregnant host carefully places the brioche back on her partner’s plate and reaches for a momabelle bun. “Spongy, wet, but hot and soft to the touch. Reminds me of someone.” “I-I don’t know what you mean.” You can imagine how bright Natty’s cheeks must be. “It smells faintly of bergamot, just enough to cut the sweetness of the momabelles. They can be eaten with or without custard. According to the menu, it’s sometimes served with liquor to soften the crust, but I don’t think it needs to be any lighter than it is right now. They are big enough for children and small enough for a little break, a treat designed to be had whenever your sweet tooth kicks in.” Suddenly, you hear a deep, guttural grumble. “I’m sorry Cerulleyan, I can’t wait any longer.” The winged dancer giggles. “Well then, time to dig in!” Without further ado, the regal host takes a small bite of her fuming croissant. She chews slowly, licking the nut-based cream spilling over from its stuffed core. Then, she takes a bite of jam-soaked toast before washing it all down with a sip of Serenitea. “My first impression is that it’s a lot less sweet than I expected. It’s not an explosion of sugary delight, it’s something fancier, more refined, like a symphony of tastes and textures that bring each other out. The croissant’s crusty outside disappears in favor of the candied fruits and glazing’s sweetness before the thic[silly |c |k ]er filling tones the flavors down with salty smooches. Stars, the taste is so addictive – it’s hard to resist taking another bite. The toast is hot, grilled perfectly. It holds the jam pretty well and heats it just enough to bring out the jam’s fruity flavors. As for the Serenitea, it’s an infusion of red tea, hibiscus, rose, and... momean gooseberry. The taste is very diffuse, almost ethereal, letting you experience the ingredients one at a time. First comes the delicate rose, then the tea takes over with its blander taste before the gooseberry and honey come up with a sweetened acidity. After this rollercoaster of feelings, the hibiscus finishes the play with its finer touch.” “Sounds delicious,” Natty gushes. “Because it is. How’s your choccy brioche, dear?” The hidden director angles the camera at her plate. “Hum... it’s very soft. The chocolates and vanilla are very high quality, very rich in taste. The cinnamon glazing cuts the sweetness before it overwhelms your senses and makes you yearn for more. I... don’t feel milk highs building up but maybe it’s because it’s heavily diluted. Stars, it feels so good to eat chocolate without risking an overdose.” Cerulleyan smiles. “Glad you like it. Have you tried the momabelle cakes yet?” “No, let’s do it now.” A pair of zaika hands with black-painted nails reach for the deep fried balls. She gently snaps one in two, revealing a fruity interior gushing with juices. Natty squeezes it a little, making it ooze more yellow liquid before taking a bite. “Gosh, it’s soooooo good! It’s nothing like gloomplums. Like, they are smaller but so plump. The cake is here to magnify the momabelle, not the other way around. It soaks in the extra juices and the bergamot gives the exact amount of citrusy flavors to accompany the yellow plum’s flavor. Excuse me dear viewers, but I’m gonna devour them like a cavern pig.” The entranced zaika reaches for her mug and takes a large gulp of cream-filled coffee. “And I just discovered my new favorite drink! The liquor and whipped cream are a biiiiit tough to handle at once but they go sooooo well with the alien coffee. I wonder how they torri- torra- roasted the beans. Like, it’s sooooo strong yet sooooo smooth – I coooould drink it like water.” “Be careful Natty, you might burn yourself.” “Daww, you’re sooo schweet Mistress. You’re alwaaaays so nice to meeeeee.” “I wouldn’t want my friend to get hurt, especially in such a beautiful place,” Cerulleyan says. The girls slowly enjoy their breakfast, taking samples of each other’s treats. They are truly enjoying it, considering going for seconds and even thirds — and after all, why wouldn’t they? In the background, dozens of zaika and cyborgs order baked goods from the leyak baker. It’s a wonder how it can work the ovens and handle the orders at the same time, even with its multiple arms. Not a minute passes without a new batch of cookies, cakes, or breads coming out of the oven on large trays. Nak’Adhoo barely has the time to carry them to the display before being emptied by hungry customers yearning for the freshest goods. Before the little alien can be overwhelmed, Moaxaloutchi joins it and puts a cute pink apron on. The tove lady hops on a high stool and takes the order in place of her floppy colleague. She swiftly goes from the countertop to the shelves, filling paper bags with bread and pastries before serving it to her customer with a sincere smile. It’s so unsettling to see a tove outside of the trade or entertainment industry, and yet here she is, wrapping sandwiches and hot stuff in aluminum foil for chromed workers. After a couple of minutes of messy eating, Cerulleyan and Natty finish their meal. The regal dancer slowly licks her fingers clean, licking leftover jam from her delicate hands before sipping on her cup of Serenitea. “Stars, it was so good.” “It was fantashtabulooous!” her camerawoman adds, doing her best to keep her growing boobs offscreen. In the background, Moaxaloutchi serves a big bruschetta to her last customer. Seeing that nobody else is waiting in line, she removes her apron and joins the merry couple. “Was everything to your liking?” “Indeed. My tongue and belly traveled back and forth to Mome,” Cerulleyan smiles. “Yip Yup!” Natty adds. “Can I havfhe momabelles for layter?” The red-feathered tove nods. “Of course. It warms my heart that so many aliens love my planet’s fruits and dishes so much.” “If I may ask, what made you open an inn on Dhaal of all places?” Cerulleyan questions. Moaxaloutchi clears her throat. “I... was supposed to open a whorehouse in cooperation with the Camarilla and Utopian Skies, but both parties broke the contract the day I arrived here. I used a loophole in the original agreement to buy the building and furnish it to my liking – instead of a love hotel, I opened a resort not unlike the ones you’d find along the Sea of Fantasies. That is the most wonderful place on Mome, if you want to observe banks of wild yukkoths.” “Aaaaand how didja meet Mr. Jelly Fishy?” Natty drunkenly asks. Her face sombers. “I found him dehydrated one night. My kind... they don’t recognize leyak as people, and they did intense lobbying to keep it that way. They sold hundreds if not thousands of them to Peers looking for a fancy pet. Nak’Adhoo escaped from the ship it was on but it quickly lost sapiency after spending too long without sustenance. I healed the poor fellow back and it insisted on repaying me for the trouble. I always wanted to try patisserie but never had the time to learn the trade or to practice on my own, so when Nak’Adhoo proposed to open a small bakery, I pulled all the strings I could to get brand new oven, rolling mills, displays, and machines to turn a backroom into a proper laboratory. Long story short, it was the best decision in my entire life.” Nak’Adhoo floats toward its colleague with a basket full of cream-filled buns. “A little treat for the cheerful lovebirds. Did you enjoy the Lover’s Nest?” Cerulleyan smiles. “That’s so kind, thank you. We had a very pleasant night and an even more pleasant morning thanks to your hospitality and kindness.” “And pashtries!” Natty adds. The leyak’s cheeks flush deeply. “Please, stop it. You’re making me blush. It’s nothing really. A little flour, some sugar, good ingredients, and a good oven will yield you the same result.” Moaxaloutchi shakes her head. “Stop lying. You know full well how important passion and creativity is. Nobody shapes dough like you do, nobody mixes ingredients like you do, nobody sculpts breads like you do. People come here because YOU are a hard working little fellow and because they know how much love you put in your food.” “Agreed. There’s no better way to start my day than with a freshly baked croissant and toasts from your exquisite inn,” the fairy dancer says, caressing her plump tummy. “Thank you, Miss. It means a lot to us,” Moaxaloutchi replies. “Can we take a picture together? My mother is a very big fan of yours.” “Sure.” Cerulleyan joins the red tove and her leyak colleague, taking place behind them for the final shot. The colorful aliens stand proud, holding a fancy braided brioche in their hands with broad smiles on their faces. “If you want to eat delicious pastries for breakfast, look no further! Bread & Breakfast is here for you! Their homemade bread and drinks will take your tongue to heaven!” “The bakery is open from 5am to 8pm and check-ins are possible from 3pm. Whether you wanna spend the night in a warm, tove down bed or yearn for delicious baked treats, there’s a spot for you at Bread & Breakfast! Come and start your sweet voyage with us today,” the short innkeepers say in unison. “Thank you all for staying with us. We hope you enjoyed our culinary cruise as much as we did,” the elegant fairy says. “Stay tuned for delightful bonuses that’ll leave you gushing for more!” Nak’Ahdoo frowns. “Do we have any stuffed buns left? These girls are voracious!”
rows.translation: 经过一段简短的省略画面，两名女孩已经坐在自助餐附近一处舒适的卡座里。“看看这个可颂，多么油亮酥脆。糖衣裹得恰到好处，上面点缀着我见过最可爱的蜜饯水果。听见我碰它时发出的酥响了吗？这就是完美的声音。” “确实如此。你的吐司看起来也格外美味。” 瑟露莉安点点头。“你很有鉴赏这些东西的眼光，纳蒂。太阳籽面包切成薄片后才烘烤。面包瓤金黄而微温，正是抹果酱的最佳温度。”她一边说，一边伸手去拿装着红色橘皮酱的小碗。“看看利亚舒果酱多么轻盈地舞过温热表面——原本如此多块、如此厚实[silly |粗 |厚 ]的东西，竟变得这般顺滑多汁。莫姆菜肴就是全然不同。能让我看看你的布里欧修吗？它看起来又软又暖。” 镜头点了点头。“当然，瑟露莉安女主人。” “谢谢你，亲爱的。让我看看...哦！甚至不需要刀就能切开！面团格外柔软，还带着一丝肉桂味。面包师的手艺真令我惊叹——看看它是如何将白巧克力、香草和黑巧克力混在一起的。”她说着，将一道缤纷漩涡展示给镜头。奶油般的黄色、深沉的棕色和浓郁如蜂蜜的质地在镜头前闪耀，几乎是在乞求别人品尝。“你觉得烘烤过程消除了制作它所用乳汁和奶制品的成瘾性吗？” 纳蒂尴尬地咳了一声。“不知道。只有一种办法能弄清楚。” 怀孕的主持人小心地将布里欧修放回搭档的盘子，伸手拿起一个莫玛贝尔小面包。“松软、湿润，摸起来却又热又软。让我想起某个人。” “我、我不知道你是什么意思。” 你完全能想象纳蒂的双颊此刻有多红。“它带着淡淡的佛手柑香，恰好足以中和莫玛贝尔的甜味。可以搭配卡仕达酱，也可以直接吃。菜单上说，有时还会浇酒来软化外皮，不过我觉得它现在已经足够轻软了。它们对孩子而言足够大，却又小到适合短暂休息时享用，是专为甜食瘾发作的任何时刻准备的点心。” 突然，你听见一声低沉的肚腹轰鸣。“抱歉，瑟露莉安，我再也等不下去了。” 有翼舞者咯咯笑了起来。“那就开动吧！” 高贵的主持人不再多言，轻咬一口还冒着热气的可颂。她缓缓咀嚼，舔去从夹心中溢出的坚果奶油。接着，她又咬了一口浸满果酱的吐司，再喝一口宁静茶，将一切送下肚。“第一印象是，它远没有我预想的那么甜。它并非甜蜜喜悦的爆炸，而是更加华美精致，宛如味道与口感的交响乐，彼此衬托。可颂酥脆的外层逐渐让位于蜜饯水果和糖衣的甜味，随后更加浓厚[silly |重 |稠 ]的夹心又以咸香亲吻将味道压低。星辰啊，这滋味太令人上瘾了——实在很难忍住不再咬一口。吐司很热，烤得恰到好处。它很好地托住果酱，又将其加热到刚好足以释放果香的程度。至于宁静茶，它是红茶、木槿、玫瑰和...莫姆醋栗的浸泡茶。味道非常轻盈，近乎空灵，让你逐一体验各种原料。最先出现的是娇嫩玫瑰，随后茶叶以较为平淡的味道接管舞台，再由醋栗和蜂蜜带来甜润酸味。经历这场感受的过山车后，木槿以更加细腻的触感为演出收尾。” “听起来真好吃。”纳蒂兴奋地说道。 “因为它确实好吃。亲爱的，你的巧克力布里欧修怎么样？” 藏在镜头后的导演将摄影机对准自己的盘子。“嗯...非常柔软。巧克力和香草的品质很高，味道非常浓郁。肉桂糖衣在甜味淹没感官前将其削弱，反而令人渴望更多。我...没感觉乳汁带来的亢奋正在积累，也许是因为被大幅稀释了。星辰啊，吃巧克力却不必担心过量的感觉真好。” 瑟露莉安微笑道。“你喜欢就好。尝过莫玛贝尔蛋糕了吗？” “还没有，现在就尝吧。” 一双涂着黑色指甲油的扎伊卡手伸向那些油炸圆球。她轻轻掰开一个，露出汁水四溢的水果内馅。纳蒂稍微捏了捏，让更多黄色汁液渗出，随后咬下一口。“天哪，太——好——吃了！跟幽暗李完全不同。它们虽然更小，却饱满得多。蛋糕是为了放大莫玛贝尔的美味，而不是反过来。它吸收了多余汁水，而佛手柑恰好提供适量柑橘风味，衬托黄李子的味道。亲爱的观众们，请原谅我，我要像洞穴猪一样把它们吃光。” 沉醉其中的扎伊卡伸手拿起杯子，大口喝下加满奶油的咖啡。“而且我刚找到了新的最爱饮料！酒和鲜奶油同时喝下去有一——点难以招架，可它们和外星咖啡搭配得实——在太好了。我想知道她们是怎么烘、烘烤这些豆子的。它的味道明明这——么浓，却又这——么顺滑——我简——直能把它当水喝。” “小心点，纳蒂，你可能会烫到自己。” “哎呀，女主人你真——贴心。你一——直对我这——么好。” “我可不希望朋友受伤，尤其是在这么美丽的地方。”瑟露莉安说道。 女孩们缓慢享用早餐，互相品尝对方的点心。她们显然吃得非常开心，开始考虑再来第二份，甚至第三份——毕竟，有什么理由不呢？背景里，数十名扎伊卡人与赛博格正在向那名莱亚克面包师订购烘焙食品。即便拥有多条手臂，它能同时操作烤箱并处理订单也堪称奇迹。不到一分钟，就会有新一批饼干、蛋糕或面包装在大托盘上出炉。纳克·阿杜几乎刚把它们端到陈列处，便会被渴望最新鲜食物的饥饿顾客一扫而空。 在这个小外星人应付不过来之前，莫阿克萨洛奇加入了它，穿上一条可爱的粉色围裙。这位托芙女士跳上高凳，代替软趴趴的同事接单。她在柜台和货架之间迅速往返，将面包和糕点装入纸袋，再带着真诚笑容递给顾客。看到托芙出现在贸易或娱乐行业之外实在令人不适应，可她此刻确实正为镀铬的工人们用铝箔包裹三明治和热食。 狼吞虎咽几分钟后，瑟露莉安和纳蒂吃完了早餐。高贵的舞者缓缓舔净手指，将纤细手掌上残留的果酱舔去，随后啜饮杯中的宁静茶。“星辰啊，真是太好吃了。” “简直妙不阔言！”她的摄影师补充道，同时竭力不让逐渐变大的乳房进入镜头。 背景中，莫阿克萨洛奇将一大份意式烤面包递给最后一位顾客。见没有其他人排队，她便脱下围裙，加入这对开心的伴侣。“一切都合你们心意吗？” “当然。我的舌头和肚子已经往返莫姆好几趟了。”瑟露莉安笑道。 “对哒，对哒！”纳蒂补充道。“我能把莫玛贝尔留着待会儿吃吗？” 红羽托芙点点头。“当然。看到这么多外星人如此喜爱我家乡的水果和菜肴，真让我心里暖洋洋的。” “容我问一句，你为什么偏偏在达尔开旅店？”瑟露莉安问道。 莫阿克萨洛奇清了清嗓子。“我...原本应该与卡玛利拉和乌托邦天空公司合作开一家妓院，可我抵达这里当天，双方就都撕毁了合同。我利用原协议中的漏洞买下这栋建筑，并按照自己的喜好装修——我没有开爱情旅馆，而是开了一家度假村，和幻想海沿岸的那些相差无几。如果你想观察成群野生尤科斯，那里是莫姆最美妙的地方。” “那——你是怎么认识水母先生的？”纳蒂醉醺醺地问道。 她的脸色沉了下来。“有天晚上，我发现它已经严重脱水。我的种族...不承认莱亚克是人，还展开了猛烈游说，想让这种情况维持下去。她们把成百上千的莱亚克卖给想要名贵宠物的同侪。纳克·阿杜从运送它的飞船上逃了出来，可由于太久没有获得养分，很快就失去了智慧。我治好了这个可怜家伙，它坚持要报答我。我一直想尝试糕点制作，却从来没有时间学习这门手艺或独自练习，所以纳克·阿杜提议开一家小面包房时，我动用了所有能用的关系，弄来全新的烤箱、轧面机、陈列柜和机器，把后屋改造成一间像样的操作间。长话短说，这是我一生中做过最正确的决定。” 纳克·阿杜提着一篮装满奶油馅小面包，飘向同事。“送给这对开心爱侣的小点心。你们喜欢爱侣之巢吗？” 瑟露莉安微笑道。“你真贴心，谢谢。多亏你们的热情款待与善意，我们度过了一个非常愉快的夜晚，以及一个更加愉快的早晨。” “还有糕点！”纳蒂补充道。 莱亚克的双颊涨得通红。“请别再说了。你们弄得我都脸红了。真的没什么。一点面粉、一些糖、优质原料和一台好烤箱，就能做出同样的成果。” 莫阿克萨洛奇摇摇头。“别撒谎了。你很清楚热情和创造力有多重要。没有人像你一样塑造面团，没有人像你一样混合原料，也没有人像你一样雕琢面包。大家来到这里，是因为你是个勤劳的小家伙，也因为她们知道你在食物中倾注了多少爱。” “同意。再没有什么比在你们精致旅店里享用刚出炉的可颂和吐司，更适合作为一天的开端。”妖精舞者一边说，一边抚摸丰满的小腹。 “谢谢您，女士。这对我们意义重大。”莫阿克萨洛奇回答。“我们能一起合张影吗？我母亲非常喜欢你。” “当然。” 瑟露莉安加入红羽托芙和她的莱亚克同事，站到她们后方拍摄最后一张照片。色彩斑斓的外星人骄傲站立，手中捧着精美的辫子布里欧修，脸上绽放灿烂笑容。“想在早餐时享用美味糕点，就不必再找别家了！面包与早餐旅店随时为你服务！她们的自制面包和饮品会将你的舌头送上天堂！” “面包房营业时间为早上五点到晚上八点，下午三点起可办理入住。无论你想在温暖的托芙绒床上过夜，还是渴望美味烘焙点心，面包与早餐旅店都有你的一席之地！今天就来与我们一起开启甜蜜旅程吧。”两名矮小的旅店老板异口同声地说道。 “感谢各位一直陪伴我们。希望你们和我们一样享受这趟美食巡游。”优雅的妖精说道。“敬请期待令人愉悦的额外节目，保证让你们喷涌着渴求更多！” 纳克·阿杜皱起眉头。“还有夹馅小面包吗？这些女孩胃口太大了！”
rows.raw: " After a quick ellipsis, the two girls are sitting in a cozy booth near the buffet. “Look how shiny and crusty the croissant is. It’s glazed perfectly, topped with the cutest candied fruits I’ve ever seen. Can you hear the way it crisps when I touch it? That’s the sound of perfection.” “Indeed. And your toast looks particularly good.” Cerulleyan nods. “You have the eye for these things, Natty. The sun seed bread was thinly sliced before being roasted. The crumb is golden and lukewarm: the perfect temperature to apply jam on it,” she says, reaching for a small bowl filled with a red marmalade. “Look how easily the liashu jam dances on its warm surface — something so chunky, so thic[silly |c |k ], turned into something so slick, so juicy. Momean cuisine is just something else altogether. Can I check your brioche? It looks so soft and warm.” The camera nods. “Of course, Mistress Cerulleyan.” “Thank you, dear. Let’s see... Oh! You don’t even need a knife to cut it! The dough is extra soft, with just a hint of cinnamon. I’m amazed by the baker’s skills — look how it mixed the white chocolate, vanilla, and dark chocolate,” she says, showing a colorful swirl to the lens. Creamy yellow, deep browns, and rich, honey-like texture shine in front of the oculus, almost begging to be sampled. “Do you think the baking removed the addictiveness of the milk and dairy product used to make it?” Natty awkwardly coughs. “Not sure. Only one way to find out.” The pregnant host carefully places the brioche back on her partner’s plate and reaches for a momabelle bun. “Spongy, wet, but hot and soft to the touch. Reminds me of someone.” “I-I don’t know what you mean.” You can imagine how bright Natty’s cheeks must be. “It smells faintly of bergamot, just enough to cut the sweetness of the momabelles. They can be eaten with or without custard. According to the menu, it’s sometimes served with liquor to soften the crust, but I don’t think it needs to be any lighter than it is right now. They are big enough for children and small enough for a little break, a treat designed to be had whenever your sweet tooth kicks in.” Suddenly, you hear a deep, guttural grumble. “I’m sorry Cerulleyan, I can’t wait any longer.” The winged dancer giggles. “Well then, time to dig in!” Without further ado, the regal host takes a small bite of her fuming croissant. She chews slowly, licking the nut-based cream spilling over from its stuffed core. Then, she takes a bite of jam-soaked toast before washing it all down with a sip of Serenitea. “My first impression is that it’s a lot less sweet than I expected. It’s not an explosion of sugary delight, it’s something fancier, more refined, like a symphony of tastes and textures that bring each other out. The croissant’s crusty outside disappears in favor of the candied fruits and glazing’s sweetness before the thic[silly |c |k ]er filling tones the flavors down with salty smooches. Stars, the taste is so addictive – it’s hard to resist taking another bite. The toast is hot, grilled perfectly. It holds the jam pretty well and heats it just enough to bring out the jam’s fruity flavors. As for the Serenitea, it’s an infusion of red tea, hibiscus, rose, and... momean gooseberry. The taste is very diffuse, almost ethereal, letting you experience the ingredients one at a time. First comes the delicate rose, then the tea takes over with its blander taste before the gooseberry and honey come up with a sweetened acidity. After this rollercoaster of feelings, the hibiscus finishes the play with its finer touch.” “Sounds delicious,” Natty gushes. “Because it is. How’s your choccy brioche, dear?” The hidden director angles the camera at her plate. “Hum... it’s very soft. The chocolates and vanilla are very high quality, very rich in taste. The cinnamon glazing cuts the sweetness before it overwhelms your senses and makes you yearn for more. I... don’t feel milk highs building up but maybe it’s because it’s heavily diluted. Stars, it feels so good to eat chocolate without risking an overdose.” Cerulleyan smiles. “Glad you like it. Have you tried the momabelle cakes yet?” “No, let’s do it now.” A pair of zaika hands with black-painted nails reach for the deep fried balls. She gently snaps one in two, revealing a fruity interior gushing with juices. Natty squeezes it a little, making it ooze more yellow liquid before taking a bite. “Gosh, it’s soooooo good! It’s nothing like gloomplums. Like, they are smaller but so plump. The cake is here to magnify the momabelle, not the other way around. It soaks in the extra juices and the bergamot gives the exact amount of citrusy flavors to accompany the yellow plum’s flavor. Excuse me dear viewers, but I’m gonna devour them like a cavern pig.” The entranced zaika reaches for her mug and takes a large gulp of cream-filled coffee. “And I just discovered my new favorite drink! The liquor and whipped cream are a biiiiit tough to handle at once but they go sooooo well with the alien coffee. I wonder how they torri- torra- roasted the beans. Like, it’s sooooo strong yet sooooo smooth – I coooould drink it like water.” “Be careful Natty, you might burn yourself.” “Daww, you’re sooo schweet Mistress. You’re alwaaaays so nice to meeeeee.” “I wouldn’t want my friend to get hurt, especially in such a beautiful place,” Cerulleyan says. The girls slowly enjoy their breakfast, taking samples of each other’s treats. They are truly enjoying it, considering going for seconds and even thirds — and after all, why wouldn’t they? In the background, dozens of zaika and cyborgs order baked goods from the leyak baker. It’s a wonder how it can work the ovens and handle the orders at the same time, even with its multiple arms. Not a minute passes without a new batch of cookies, cakes, or breads coming out of the oven on large trays. Nak’Adhoo barely has the time to carry them to the display before being emptied by hungry customers yearning for the freshest goods. Before the little alien can be overwhelmed, Moaxaloutchi joins it and puts a cute pink apron on. The tove lady hops on a high stool and takes the order in place of her floppy colleague. She swiftly goes from the countertop to the shelves, filling paper bags with bread and pastries before serving it to her customer with a sincere smile. It’s so unsettling to see a tove outside of the trade or entertainment industry, and yet here she is, wrapping sandwiches and hot stuff in aluminum foil for chromed workers. After a couple of minutes of messy eating, Cerulleyan and Natty finish their meal. The regal dancer slowly licks her fingers clean, licking leftover jam from her delicate hands before sipping on her cup of Serenitea. “Stars, it was so good.” “It was fantashtabulooous!” her camerawoman adds, doing her best to keep her growing boobs offscreen. In the background, Moaxaloutchi serves a big bruschetta to her last customer. Seeing that nobody else is waiting in line, she removes her apron and joins the merry couple. “Was everything to your liking?” “Indeed. My tongue and belly traveled back and forth to Mome,” Cerulleyan smiles. “Yip Yup!” Natty adds. “Can I havfhe momabelles for layter?” The red-feathered tove nods. “Of course. It warms my heart that so many aliens love my planet’s fruits and dishes so much.” “If I may ask, what made you open an inn on Dhaal of all places?” Cerulleyan questions. Moaxaloutchi clears her throat. “I... was supposed to open a whorehouse in cooperation with the Camarilla and Utopian Skies, but both parties broke the contract the day I arrived here. I used a loophole in the original agreement to buy the building and furnish it to my liking – instead of a love hotel, I opened a resort not unlike the ones you’d find along the Sea of Fantasies. That is the most wonderful place on Mome, if you want to observe banks of wild yukkoths.” “Aaaaand how didja meet Mr. Jelly Fishy?” Natty drunkenly asks. Her face sombers. “I found him dehydrated one night. My kind... they don’t recognize leyak as people, and they did intense lobbying to keep it that way. They sold hundreds if not thousands of them to Peers looking for a fancy pet. Nak’Adhoo escaped from the ship it was on but it quickly lost sapiency after spending too long without sustenance. I healed the poor fellow back and it insisted on repaying me for the trouble. I always wanted to try patisserie but never had the time to learn the trade or to practice on my own, so when Nak’Adhoo proposed to open a small bakery, I pulled all the strings I could to get brand new oven, rolling mills, displays, and machines to turn a backroom into a proper laboratory. Long story short, it was the best decision in my entire life.” Nak’Adhoo floats toward its colleague with a basket full of cream-filled buns. “A little treat for the cheerful lovebirds. Did you enjoy the Lover’s Nest?” Cerulleyan smiles. “That’s so kind, thank you. We had a very pleasant night and an even more pleasant morning thanks to your hospitality and kindness.” “And pashtries!” Natty adds. The leyak’s cheeks flush deeply. “Please, stop it. You’re making me blush. It’s nothing really. A little flour, some sugar, good ingredients, and a good oven will yield you the same result.” Moaxaloutchi shakes her head. “Stop lying. You know full well how important passion and creativity is. Nobody shapes dough like you do, nobody mixes ingredients like you do, nobody sculpts breads like you do. People come here because YOU are a hard working little fellow and because they know how much love you put in your food.” “Agreed. There’s no better way to start my day than with a freshly baked croissant and toasts from your exquisite inn,” the fairy dancer says, caressing her plump tummy. “Thank you, Miss. It means a lot to us,” Moaxaloutchi replies. “Can we take a picture together? My mother is a very big fan of yours.” “Sure.” Cerulleyan joins the red tove and her leyak colleague, taking place behind them for the final shot. The colorful aliens stand proud, holding a fancy braided brioche in their hands with broad smiles on their faces. “If you want to eat delicious pastries for breakfast, look no further! Bread & Breakfast is here for you! Their homemade bread and drinks will take your tongue to heaven!” “The bakery is open from 5am to 8pm and check-ins are possible from 3pm. Whether you wanna spend the night in a warm, tove down bed or yearn for delicious baked treats, there’s a spot for you at Bread & Breakfast! Instead of an interview with Ms. Moaxaloutchi and her super cute baker buddy Nak’Ahdoo, I’ll show you how nice the rooms are. Ready for a little tour?” It’s a bit hard to imagine how the place really looks like with the night vision, but the color gradients give you a good idea of how bright and vibrant the rugs and curtains are. They make a pretty strong contrast with the light-colored walls and parqueted floor with their exotic patterns and palpable fluffiness. You can almost feel the soft fabric as Cerulleyan walks across her suite. “Natty and I rented the only room they had left: the Lover’s Nest. “欢迎回来，亲爱的观众们！这期额外节目要来点特别的。我们不采访莫阿克萨洛奇女士和她超级可爱的面包师伙伴纳克·阿杜，而是带你们看看这里的房间有多棒。准备好来一场小小参观了吗？” 夜视画面让人很难想象这里的真实模样，不过色彩渐变足以让你看出地毯与窗帘有多么明亮鲜艳。充满异域风情的图案和仿佛触手可及的柔软绒毛，与浅色墙壁及镶木地板形成强烈对比。瑟露莉安走过套房时，你几乎能亲身感受到那种柔软织物。 “纳蒂和我租下了她们剩下的唯一房间：爱侣之巢。入口很小，放着五斗柜和衣橱，用来存放我们的东西。如你所见，我们把衣服和鞋子留在这里。”她一边说，一边向你展示闪亮的幻影袍与精美芭蕾舞鞋。它们看起来崭新如初；考虑到她经常靠翅膀四处飘飞，这也不足为奇。不过真正吸引你目光的，是挂在旁边那套朋克装束：带尖钉的短袖上衣、厚底靴、皮质迷你裙，以及一件重型[silly |镀铬 |金属 ]乐队衫。她那羞怯的摄影师原来是一朵腼腆的黑玫瑰！ “我太喜欢这些外星图案了。你能相信它们全都来自莫姆吗？那可是我们两位主人的母星！她们说，那里的天空到处都是飞鱼，色彩比这些还要明亮炫目。天哪，你能想象群星之间有多少奇观等待着我们吗？即便是我，‘空灵之风’瑟露莉安，也无缘在莫姆的尤科斯群中滑翔。说了这么多海洋话题，让我想洗个澡了。要不要和我一起？” 瑟露莉安缓缓推开门，溜进铺着瓷砖的房间。即使没有开灯，这里依旧洁净而温馨。几条湿毛巾挂在一只足以容纳两人的巨大浴缸附近慢慢晾干。一个装满化妆品与高级洗护用品的粉色大箱子占据左侧相当大的空间，高高耸立在另一个较小的哥特式箱子旁；后者装满黑红两色的化妆品、洗发水和香皂。 “我们带了自己的用品，不过面包与早餐旅店也提供超级柔软的毛巾和闻起来非常美妙的果香香皂。因为这是爱侣套房，所以这里没有其他房间那样的淋浴间，而是配了一只心形浴缸。纳蒂和我把所有浴盐都倒了进去，度过了一段非常放松的时光。她的双手简直有魔力。即使拍摄了一整天，你也无法想象它们依然有多么柔软灵巧。能有这么优秀的导演陪着我真是幸运——她让每一期节目都变得更加特别。” 她又拍了几组浴室的广角镜头，展示橱柜里的物品和定制毛巾，随后将镜头在浴缸上停留许久。一块带按钮的小面板控制着按摩喷嘴和房间照明；想和伴侣享受一场漫长而色情的沐浴，所需的一切都已齐全。难怪共浴后两人如此放松。“好了，各位，该去卧室了。毕竟时候不早，明天还有漫长的一天等着我们品评美食。” 妖精舞者缓缓飘出浴室，穿过入口，前往另一扇门。她赤裸的双脚踩过木质镶花地板，没发出半点声音；考虑到她的肚子如此圆润沉重，这实在是一项壮举。她的平衡感理应已经一团糟，可动作依旧高贵优雅，仿佛物理法则根本无法束缚她；仿佛她不仅来自另一颗星球，更来自另一个维度，是某种熟悉却又诡异的存在，穿过达尔幽暗朦胧的建筑，并完美融入这里的紫色人群。 她缓缓打开门，露出一个可爱的房间。中央是一张巨大心形床，上面铺着心形枕头和天鹅绒床单。夜视光让画面显得空灵而诡异，仿佛你踏进了女巫的巢穴。一切都俗套得过分，却又十分可爱：床、窗帘、地毯、家具、沙发...不过没有什么比绑在床架上的那名扎伊卡更引人注目。 她身材矫健，肌肉线条清晰，腹肌裸露，大腿丰润，还有一对挺翘的A罩杯乳房。丝滑的娃娃装睡裙几乎一览无余——柔软布料与羽毛饰边搭在胸前，为受缚的身体增添了一丝端庄。带有内置面纱的不透明眼罩遮住她大半张脸，深色蕾丝布下只露出涂过颜色的双唇。她的耳朵与尾巴因期待而抽动：那是格外爱冒险的臣服者特有的恐惧与兴奋交融。 “瑟露莉安女主人？是你吗？” 空灵之风没有回答，更愿意让身体替自己说话。她仍将摄影机握在手里，优雅地爬上床，以超自然气场统治周围的一切。你能听见身下毯子发出极轻的窸窣声，那遥远声响几乎被纳蒂挣扎的动静和粗重呼吸彻底掩盖。瑟露莉安几乎完全隐入黑暗，如同一只睡眠瘫痪时出现的恶魔，给自己找到了一个漂亮玩偶来把玩。 瑟露莉安用手托住纳蒂的下巴，惹得她倒吸一口气。深重红晕涌上双颊；异星伴侣将拇指塞进她嘴里时，那层红色令她精美的肌肤变得更暗。纳蒂贪婪地吮吸修剪整齐的手指，像一名落入满屋禁欲已久奎坦人之中的饥饿斯莱弗伦一样，将它深深吞进喉咙。她的黑色双唇噘起，尽可能紧密地裹住瑟露莉安的拇指，好更加虔诚地侍奉那带着香气的血肉。 有翼的女主兴起额外的恶作剧心思，凑近自己的扎伊卡宠物，长长地湿舔她被遮住一半的脸。纳蒂湿漉漉地喘息；瑟露莉安越用力舔弄她的双颊，那些哽咽呜咽就越发响亮。在朋友手中，她不过是温顺猎物，是一只即将被饥饿母狼吞噬的无助绵羊。“乖女孩。拿出诚意来吮。” 而她确实照做。摄影机锁定纳蒂戴着眼罩的脸，以高清画面捕捉她多么热切地舔舐女主人的手指。无论瑟露莉安将手指插得多深多快，她都竭尽全力用唾液将其舔得锃亮。欲火中烧的舞者则用慵懒长舔满怀爱意地品尝宠物的肌肤，仿佛正在细细品味一根甜蜜棒棒糖。她灵巧的舌头在紫色双颊上打转，将那里舔得如性爱玩具多汁的双唇一样湿润发亮。透过这些淫荡爱抚，你能听见两人的粗重呼吸，看见她们起伏的胸膛，清楚暴露这场小小挑逗让她们多么兴奋饥渴。 对臣服者的侍奉感到满意后，瑟露莉安将拇指从受缚女人口中抽出。她用沾满唾液的手指沿爱人的双唇摩擦，为其涂上一层新的亮泽，随后深深吻住那里。纳蒂贪婪地与怀孕女主拥吻，耳朵在背景中开心抽动——那是女主人唯一没有正确绑在床上的部位。她彻底将自己交给瑟露莉安，把全部控制权让给这名有翼表演者，身心都奉献给这个自己愿意追随至地狱再返回人间的女人。 “真美味。你真是一道可口点心。” 纳蒂脸红了。“谢谢女主人。” 她又从纳蒂唇上偷走一吻，随后躺到她身旁。摄影机拉远，终于显出她们的乳房已经变得多么硕大丰满！现在肯定有E罩杯，甚至更大！瑟露莉安丰硕的乳丘挤压宠物布满雀斑的胸膛，令其像水球一样弹动。怀孕舞者兴起更加淫荡的念头，将饱满肚腹压上纳蒂覆着汗光的腹肌，再用天鹅绒包裹的腹部缓缓摩擦。 “说到点心，我有点饿了。我们该尝尝迎宾篮里发现的零食，你说呢？” 被绑住的扎伊卡脸更红了。“好、好的，女主人。只、只要小心床单。” 你很清楚她们绝不会小心。瑟露莉安缓缓滑下床，取回放在桌上的柳条篮。她将篮子放在纳蒂旁边，然后把摄影机固定在三脚架上，开启自动对焦功能。完成后，她回到床上臣服者身边，翻找那些淫荡礼物。 “哦！看看这里有什么？乳胶手套、含莱亚克毒液提取物的按摩油、蛋形跳蛋、振动肛珠，还有一根又粗又大的穿戴式假阳具。莫阿克萨洛奇女士专门为我们挑选了莫姆最美妙的享受。这里还有一个小惊喜，不过只有你表现得格外乖巧时，我才会用上它。” “含、含毒液的莱亚克按摩油？那不危险吗？”纳蒂问道。 瑟露莉安狡黠地微笑。“只有一种办法能弄清楚。”

Their chosen model seems quite backed up as well, butting up against the bounds of what polite Dhaalian society could accept."

rows.original: [kiro.name] mutters, “Be a helluva lot prettier without that clanker-claw blocking off all the booby,” on her way by.
rows.translation: [kiro.name]经过时嘀咕道：“要是没有那只哐当作响的铁爪挡住所有奶子，肯定会漂亮得多。”
rows.raw: " [kiro.name] mutters, “Be a helluva lot prettier without that clanker-claw blocking off all the booby,” on her way by."

rows.original: [kiro.name] gigglesnorts whenever she sees it. “Do you think she wanks with that arm?”
rows.translation: [kiro.name]每次看到它都会咯咯喷笑。“你觉得她会用那只手撸管吗？”
rows.raw: " [kiro.name] gigglesnorts whenever she sees it. “Do you think she wanks with that arm?”"

rows.original: Penny seems to approve of the robotic arm’s construction, or the breasts behind it. One of the two.
rows.translation: 佩妮似乎很欣赏机械臂的构造，又或者是机械臂后面的乳房，反正总有一个。
rows.raw: " Penny seems to approve of the robotic arm’s construction, or the breasts behind it. One of the two."

rows.original: Penny always starts off checking out the augmented arm on the poster - until her eyes inevitably drift into the mammary ocean behind and cause her pitch a massive tent.
rows.translation: 佩妮起初总会检查海报上的强化手臂，直到目光不可避免地漂进后方的乳房海洋，令她在裤裆支起一顶巨大帐篷。
rows.raw: " Penny always starts off checking out the augmented arm on the poster - until her eyes inevitably drift into the mammary ocean behind and cause her pitch a massive tent."

rows.original: Your raskvel mechanic seems annoyed by the zaika’s lack of visible nipples.

rows.original: Azra rolls her eyes at the cybernetic advert. You get the impression she prefers biological augs.
rows.translation: 阿兹拉对这则赛博广告翻了个白眼。你感觉她更喜欢生物强化体。
rows.raw: " Azra rolls her eyes at the cybernetic advert. You get the impression she prefers biological augs."

rows.original: Celise tries to make her arm look all hard and angular like that, but it never comes out looking right.
rows.translation: 塞莉丝试图让自己的手臂变得同样坚硬而棱角分明，可怎么也做不出正确效果。
rows.raw: " Celise tries to make her arm look all hard and angular like that, but it never comes out looking right."

rows.original: You catch Dane flexing in front of the poster, contrasting and comparing.
rows.translation: 你发现戴恩正在海报前屈臂展示肌肉，互相对照比较。
rows.raw: " You catch Dane flexing in front of the poster, contrasting and comparing."

rows.original: Emmy sneaks glances as the beautiful space-elf on the poster whenever she has a chance.
rows.translation: 艾米一有机会，就会偷瞄海报上那位美丽的太空精灵。

rows.original: You catch Mitzi staring at the poster from time to time, straddling a puddle of her own drool.
rows.translation: 你不时会发现米兹盯着海报，两腿跨在自己流出的一摊口水两侧。

rows.original:
The crude asphalt of this tarmac is one sign of many that these landing pads were thrown together in a hurry. It’s already been cracked and patched in dozens of places, though you have to look carefully under the ever-present neon glow to see it. Flickering holographic displays bid you journey south to an overcrowded taxi stand - the quickest way to venture into the city proper. Many small advisories in black print advise you of danger, but they hardly seem important next to retina-scorching adverts for safe, natural Bright Water.

Other ships park nearby, but the local security is closer to what you’d expect in the core - you can’t access anyone else’s ship without express clearance.
rows.translation:
停机坪粗糙的沥青，是这些着陆台仓促搭建的诸多迹象之一。地面早已在几十处开裂并打上补丁，不过你得透过无处不在的霓虹光仔细观察才能看清。闪烁的全息显示屏招呼你向南前往一座人满为患的出租车站，那是进入城区最快的方式。许多黑色小字警告着危险，但在灼伤视网膜的安全天然澄水广告旁边，它们似乎一点也不重要。

附近停着其他飞船，但当地安保更接近你在核心地带所预期的水平，没有明确许可，你无法进入任何人的飞船。

Many small advisories in black print advise you of danger, but they hardly seem important next to retina-scorching adverts for safe, natural Bright Water.\n\nOther ships park nearby, but the local security is closer to what you’d expect in the core - you can’t access anyone else’s ship without express clearance."

rows.original:
The taxi stand itself is little more than a concrete rectangle divided by two smallish, six-inch thick windows with cheap speaker grates in the center. It’s plenty busy thanks to the Rush and the appallingly bad customer service being dispensed from the other side. Nearby automated kiosks offer you the choice to flag down a taxi instead of waiting in smoggy, customer service hell with the rest of the taxi depot’s needier clientele.

There’s not much else to look at in the middle of the vast, recently constructed landing pad aside from a rotating cast of inaccessible ships. Not much worth breathing here either, unless you’re looking to add smog to your list of acceptable inhalants.

Your vessel lies north. [flags.DIZZY_BOUGHT|[flags.DIZZY_BOUGHT_TALK||There is a rather worried-looking white-furred kaithrit with dark gray tails and a silver collar huddled in a Paragon-branded overcoat stood near the boarding ramp. You should talk to her before you leave.]]
rows.translation:
出租车站本身不过是一块混凝土长方体，被两扇约六英寸厚的小窗隔开，窗户中央装着廉价的扬声器格栅。多亏行星开拓潮，以及窗口另一边令人发指的糟糕客服，这里相当繁忙。附近的自动服务终端让你可以选择拦一辆出租车，免得和车站里其他需求更多的顾客一起，在烟雾弥漫的客服地狱中苦等。

在这片广阔而新近建成的着陆场中央，除了不断轮换却无法进入的飞船，没什么好看的。这里也没多少值得呼吸的东西，除非你想把烟雾加入可接受吸入物清单。

你的飞船位于北边。[flags.DIZZY_BOUGHT|[flags.DIZZY_BOUGHT_TALK||登船坡道附近站着一名神色颇为忧虑的白毛凯斯里特人，她长着深灰色尾巴，戴着银色项圈，整个人缩在典范公司品牌的大衣里。离开前你应该和她谈谈。]]

rows.original: Another blocky taxi station just like the one you initially landed at sits here, though this particular facility sits almost square in the middle of the street. Corporate security looms over it from behind like an overly protective parent, though this particular parent seems to have closed off the streets to the north for some reason or another. If you have business in that direction, you’ll need to get clearance from Dhaal’s zaibatsu overlords or a specific destination to taxi to well on the other side...
rows.translation: 这里坐落着另一座与你最初降落处相同的方块状出租车站，不过这座设施几乎正好位于街道中央。企业安保像保护过度的家长般从后方俯视着它，只是不知出于什么原因，这位家长封锁了北面的街道。如果你要去那个方向办事，就得从达尔的财阀统治者那里取得通行许可，或者给出租车一个远在封锁区另一边的具体目的地...

rows.original:
Suspended roughly twelve feet above a street intersection is a gigantic holographic advertisement for a “Utopian Skies Virtual Vacation.” It consists of buxom alien babes wearing little more than patches on string and a mesh tail-covering - positively scandalous, compared to local norms. When it flickers and loops back to the start, you catch a glimpse of the dingy, pollution-stained city beyond.

Streets lead north, south, and west from here.
rows.translation:
一则巨大的“乌托邦天空虚拟假期”全息广告悬浮在街道交叉口上方约十二英尺处。广告里尽是胸脯丰满的外星美女，身上除了细绳连着的几块遮片和网状尾罩外几乎什么也没穿，和当地风俗相比，简直伤风败俗。广告闪烁着重新循环时，你瞥见了后方肮脏、被污染染色的城市。

街道从这里分别通往北、南和西。

When it flickers and loops back to the start, you catch a glimpse of the dingy, pollution-stained city beyond.\n\nStreets lead north, south, and west from here."

rows.original:
Gouts of steam vent out of grates in the pavement with alarming regularity, forcing you to dodge around them or sputter through them. Locals, you notice, don’t even bother to react when catching a face full of concentrated humidity, fully used to the idiosyncrasies of their city’s heat exchange systems. The glossy look it leaves on their skin doesn’t hurt.

This road bends north and east around a Paragon Inc-affiliated noodle stand. You keep walking when you realize the noodles are moving on their own.
rows.translation:
蒸汽以惊人的频率从路面格栅中阵阵喷出，迫使你绕开它们，或一边呛咳一边穿过去。你注意到，当高浓度湿气喷满脸时，当地人甚至懒得做出反应；他们早已习惯城市热交换系统的这些怪毛病。何况水汽在皮肤上留下的光亮质感也不算坏。

这条路绕过一家典范公司旗下的面摊，向北和向东弯去。当你发现那些面条会自己蠕动时，便继续往前走了。

rows.original: Sputtering holograms above a cheap, plastiboard noodle stand draw the eyes - and at least a half-dozen natives - to ‘Scented Noods.’ Purportedly it’s a reputable establishment that’s stocked with the finest flavor additives Bright Water has to offer. It actually smells kind of nice... until you get a whiff of orange-and-chemical tang. Such concoctions clearly weren’t designed with Terran sensibilities in mind. Among the graffiti here is an arrow painted in curling lines, pointing south down the street. A cartoonish cow’s face is painted below it. Maybe it would be best to keep walking west or south...
rows.translation: 一家廉价塑料板面摊上方断续闪烁的全息影像，吸引了你的目光，也吸引了至少半打当地人，招牌上写着“香喷喷裸面”。据说这是一家信誉良好的店铺，备有澄水公司所能提供的最优质增味剂。闻起来其实还挺香...直到一股橙味混着化学品的刺鼻气息钻进鼻子。这种调味显然没有顾及泰伦人的感受。这里的涂鸦中有一支由蜷曲线条画成的箭头，指向街道南方。箭头下方画着一张卡通奶牛脸。也许最好继续往西或往南走...

rows.original: Three stories of curvaceous, holographic zaika loom over top of you, stretching out her arms in invitation. Distant speakers carry the reverb-laden voice to your ears: “Sticky ports? Get your jacks cleaned at ‘Implantation Implant Station,’ now serving Rushers! Searchable on Dhaal-web, and even the Extra-net!” Sure enough, the hologram appears absolutely laden with cybernetics: a poster child for artificial endowments. The alleyways run south or north through the advertisement’s legs.
rows.translation: 一道足有三层楼高、曲线玲珑的扎伊卡全息影像耸立在你上方，张开双臂发出邀请。远处扬声器把回声重重的声音送入耳中：“接口黏糊糊？快来‘植入体植入站’清洁插孔，现已为行星开拓者提供服务！在达尔网上能搜到我们，外域网也可以！”果不其然，这幅全息影像简直装满了赛博格部件，堪称人造本钱的宣传典范。 小巷从广告双腿之间向南或向北延伸。

rows.original:
A food truck leans off-balance against the curb, pockmarked with rust. The drives are long gone, replaced with cheap metal struts. It won’t be going anywhere, but it doesn’t need to. A near-constant crowd lines up for a taste of authentic Ausar cuisine, but the meat on a spit in the window looks suspiciously like one of the local rodents. Some of the graffiti here looks less like the usual crude drawings and more like an arrow, done all in curling lines. A cartoony udder dripping milk is drawn beneath it. The arrow points north.

The street winds north and west.
rows.translation:
一辆餐车歪斜地靠在路边，车身锈迹斑斑。驱动装置早已不见踪影，换成了廉价金属支架。它哪儿也去不了，但本来就不需要移动。几乎始终有人排队想品尝正宗奥萨美食，但窗口里烤叉上的肉看起来可疑地像当地某种啮齿动物。这里有些涂鸦不像常见的粗俗图画，反而更像一支完全由蜷曲线条画成的箭头。箭头下方画着一只滴奶的卡通乳房，指向北方。

街道蜿蜒通往北方与西方。

rows.original:
Elderly zaika cluster on a balcony a floor up, leering down at the streets over the armor-plated railing. Their shrill voices chatter almost constantly, loudly enough to be heard over the din of the city, disparaging the young and cybernetically enhanced alike. Clouds of steam burst out of nearby vents well enough to obscure you from their ire, though you can’t help but flinch when one erupts out of nowhere. The locals, as they walk down streets to the north, east, and south, barely react.

How long would you have to live here to be so blasé about it?
rows.translation:
一群年迈的扎伊卡人聚在上一层的阳台上，隔着装甲护栏俯视街道，露出不怀好意的目光。她们尖锐的嗓音几乎从不停歇，响亮得足以盖过城市喧嚣，对年轻人和接受赛博格强化者一视同仁地贬损。附近通风口喷出的团团蒸汽足以让你避开她们的怒火，不过当蒸汽毫无征兆地爆发时，你仍不由得瑟缩。当地人沿着通往北、东、南的街道行走，几乎毫无反应。

要在这里住多久，你才能对这种事如此无动于衷？

The locals, as they walk down streets to the north, east, and south, barely react.\n\nHow long would you have to live here to be so blasé about it?"

rows.original: An ancient-looking hospital surplus hoverbed wobbles in the brightest part of the street. Its owner stands behind it, waving twenty mechanized digits from her cybernetic hands and offering her services as a “ChipDoctor”. Projections ring her in a halo of services and prices: 99 credit recaps, 79 credit overclocks, 500 credit owner-tag rewrites, and a host of other quasi-legal services that would only interest a poor cyborg who can’t replace her parts. Back alley doctors really do come in all flavors.
rows.translation: 一张看起来古老的医院剩余悬浮床，在街道最明亮的区域摇摇晃晃。床的主人站在后方，挥舞赛博格双手上的二十根机械手指，自称“芯片医生”并招揽生意。她周围环绕着服务与价格的投影光环：99信用点重新封装、79信用点超频、500信用点改写所有者标签，还有一大堆只有无力更换部件的穷困赛博格才会感兴趣的准合法服务。后巷医生果然什么风格都有。
rows.raw: "An ancient-looking hospital surplus hoverbed wobbles in the brightest part of the street. Its owner stands behind it, waving twenty mechanized digits from her cybernetic hands and offering her services as a “ChipDoctor”. Projections ring her in a halo of services and prices: 99 credit recaps, 79 credit overclocks, 500 credit owner-tag rewrites, and a host of other quasi-legal services that would only interest a poor cyborg who can’t replace her parts. Back alley doctors really do come in all flavors."

rows.original: This road once housed a bakery, some decades back. The signage is still mostly legible. You can’t make out the alien glyphs for its full name, but “CLOSED FOR RENOVATIONS” still reads as clear as day, even in perpetual twilight. On Terra, a place like this would be boarded up. The zaika were a bit more thorough. Steel plates gird the dessicated storefront against gang shenanigans. You suppose you can’t smash a window you can’t even see, though the locals sure have tagged the hell out of it with graffiti. Is that one a picture of one of a tailpussy as a metal flower? You suppose “Razor Lotuses” would make for a badass gang name... The street stretches north and south while an alley rests to the west.
rows.translation: 几十年前，这条路边曾经有一家面包店。招牌上的文字大多仍可辨认。你看不懂组成完整店名的外星文字，但即使在永恒暮色中，“装修歇业”几个字依然清晰如昼。若是在泰拉，这种地方大概会被木板封死。扎伊卡人的处理则更加彻底：钢板包裹着干枯破败的店面，防范帮派分子滋事。你想，连窗户都看不见，自然也就砸不了，不过本地人确实用涂鸦把这里画得一塌糊涂。 那幅画是不是把某个尾穴画成了金属花朵？你觉得“剃刀莲花”倒是个相当酷的帮派名字... 街道向南北延伸，西侧还有一条小巷。

rows.original: You find yourself in a leisure district of sorts, with an assortment of small bars, snack stalls, vice cliques, cathouses, gambling clubs and other places whose purpose you can’t and probably don’t want to know. Probably. At any rate, everything here is small-scale, substandard and decadent, but you can’t deny there is a certain dystopian allure to it.
rows.translation: 你发现自己身处某种休闲娱乐区，周围有各式小酒吧、零食摊、恶习小团体、妓院、赌博俱乐部，还有一些你看不出用途、恐怕也不想弄清的场所。大概吧。总而言之，这里的一切规模都很小、质量低劣而又堕落，但你无法否认，它确实散发着某种反乌托邦式魅力。

rows.original:
Thumping bass lines issue from the building to the west - four of them, each pounding out its own alien tempo in direct contradiction of its peers. It’s exactly the kind of discordant racket you’d need earplugs to endure - or a case of criminal insanity. Flickering strobes of light emerge from half closed windows in ever-shifting hues, but you don’t have any intention of joining in, not after seeing the street level doorwomen. Gang names and symbols flash from industrial holoprojectors mounted on robotic shoulders.

Does it smell a bit like... milk here? No... it doesn’t matter. This is a gang house, and you have no business here. The street streaks north and south away from here.
rows.translation:
西侧建筑里传出轰鸣的低音声部——整整四道，每一道都以自己的外星节奏猛烈敲击，直接与另外几道相互冲突。这种不和谐的噪声，正是必须戴耳塞才能忍受的东西——或者得先患上严重精神失常。半掩的窗户后闪烁着不断变幻色彩的频闪灯光，但见过一楼守门的女人后，你完全没有加入其中的打算。安装在机械肩膀上的工业全息投影仪，不断闪现各个帮派的名字与标志。

这里是不是有点像...乳汁的味道？不...这不重要。这里是帮派据点，你不该插手。街道从此向南北延伸。

rows.original: The street dips down to snake under an overpass’s worth of gigantic pipes. Condensation drips steadily from the largest, stamped “BrighterWater.” You’re pretty certain you could drive a hovertruck down the center of it without touching the sides, and a hovercycle would fit perfectly in the smallest one. Another bears “U.S. Datapipe” - an odd label. Secondary text warns that vandalism or damage is punishable by “involuntary limb-reassignment.” The net-pipe plunges directly into the closest concrete wall, vanishing behind a pair of high voltage transformers. Dhaal’s asphalt artery flows on to the north and south.
rows.translation: 街道向下倾斜，蜿蜒穿过一整座天桥般数量的巨型管道下方。最大的管道上印着“澄亮之水”，冷凝水不断从中滴落。你相当确定，即使让一辆悬浮卡车从管道中央驶过，也碰不到两侧；最小的一根则恰好能容纳悬浮摩托。另一根标着“乌托邦天空数据管道”——这个标签很古怪。附属文字警告，蓄意破坏或损伤将受到“非自愿肢体重新分配”的惩罚。网络管道直接扎入最近的混凝土墙，消失在一对高压变压器后方。 达尔的沥青动脉继续向南北流淌。

rows.original: This street’s holo-sign is almost completely invisible beneath a brighter, orange-fuzzed projection from Paragon Inc’s security division: “In light of elevated crime in this area, this sign has been equipped with redundant security systems and multiple recessed overwatch turrets. Further attempts at theft will be met with lethal force. Have a wonderful day courtesy of your friends at Paragon Inc!” Your Codex’s translation reveals that one of the words in the street’s name is frequently used as a euphemism for the extremely perverse act of penetrating one’s own eggslit with her tail. That would explain the theft. Teenagers never change... though lethal sniper turrets seem to have put a stop to their chicanery for now. The street bends east and south.
rows.translation: 这条街的全息路牌几乎完全被典范公司安保部门更加明亮、边缘泛着橙色的投影遮住：“鉴于本地区犯罪率上升，本路牌现已配备冗余安保系统与多座内嵌式监视炮塔。任何进一步盗窃企图都将遭到致命武力反制。典范公司的朋友们祝您度过美好的一天！” CODEX终端的翻译显示，街名中的一个词经常被用作某种极度变态行为的委婉语，即用自己的尾巴插入自己的产卵缝。这样就能解释路牌为何被盗了。青少年永远不会变...不过致命狙击炮塔似乎暂时制止了他们的胡闹。 街道向东、向南弯曲。

rows.original:
Zaika and Rushers mingle together, owing to the taxi station and numerous alien-friendly establishments in the region (if all the advertisements are anything to go by). Stylized cow-girl holograms beg for you to sample their wares a little further north. Other amenities, like a capsule hotel, can likewise be found that way. You can almost ignore the pan-handlers spilling their stories to other aliens with their palms outstretched for a taste of the core’s fabled wealth.

The street splits in a three way T-intersection to the north, east, and south.
rows.translation:
由于附近设有出租车站，还有许多对外星人友善的场所——至少广告都是这么说的——扎伊卡人与行星开拓者在这里混杂相处。北边稍远处，造型夸张的牛女全息影像恳求你品尝她们的商品。胶囊旅馆等其他便利设施也位于那个方向。你几乎能够无视那些向其他外星人讲述自身遭遇的乞讨者；他们伸出手掌，只求分得核心区域传说中财富的一点残羹。

街道在北、东、南三个方向分成一处T字路口。

rows.original: With a twilight sky and stratospheric buildings on every side, you can see why Dhaal is considered every bit as much an urban jungle as Terra herself. Lit by a looping advertisement for the new line of “Salivation” branded nutrient broths, this shadowy road has enough dark alleys and nooks to hide two or three gangs worth of miscreants. Best get to your destination in a hurry. The Gyre is not a safe place. A brightly lit taxi stand offers a haven for Rushers like yourself just to the east. Maze-like streets burrow through the monolithic skyscrapers like cunt snakes tunneling beneath customs checkpoints.
rows.translation: 暮色天空下，四面八方都是高耸入平流层的建筑；你不难理解，为何达尔被认为和泰拉本身一样，是一片不折不扣的都市丛林。循环播放的“垂涎”牌新系列营养汤广告照亮这里；这条阴暗道路拥有足够多的黑巷和角落，足以藏匿两三个帮派的恶徒。最好赶紧前往目的地。旋环区并不安全。 东边有一座灯火通明的出租车站，为你这样的行星开拓者提供庇护。迷宫般的街道钻过巨石般的摩天楼，犹如阴蛇在海关检查站下方打洞穿行。

A cube-like chunk of armor with reinforced trans-aluminum windows squats in the shadows between skyscrapers. Blindingly bright advertisements flash through rainbows of transportation-themed advertisements meant to draw the eye while a ten-barreled, starship-class turret broadcasts an entirely different message: don’t fuck with Paragon Inc’s taxis.

The streets open up a bit to the west.
rows.translation:
一块立方体般的装甲结构蹲伏在摩天楼之间的阴影中，装有强化透明铝窗。炫目耀眼的广告组成以交通为主题的彩虹，闪烁着吸引视线；一座拥有十根炮管、达到星舰级别的炮塔则传递着截然不同的信息：别惹典范公司的出租车。

街道向西侧稍稍开阔。

rows.original:
Hissing steam pipes leave this part of the city wrapped in a thick fog. Ghostly shapes of neon advertisements flicker all along the narrow path, while the lights of swoop bikes and flying taxis trace spectral contrails above. More than a few zaika have tucked themselves into the nooks of the oppressive buildings, faces buried in handfuls of alien drugs. Despite the stifling steam and hazy fog, you can make out the flash of fresh chrome on a couple of denizens who pass you by.

		It’s hard to see much, but the street seems to go north or south.
rows.translation:
嘶嘶作响的蒸汽管道令这片城区笼罩在浓雾中。狭窄道路两侧，霓虹广告的鬼魅轮廓不断闪烁；上方则有俯冲摩托与飞行出租车的灯光划出幽灵般的尾迹。不止几个扎伊卡蜷缩在压抑建筑的角落里，把脸埋进一把把外星药物中。尽管蒸汽令人窒息、雾气朦胧，你仍能从几名路过居民身上看到崭新镀铬层的闪光。

		这里很难看清多少东西，不过街道似乎通向南北两方。

More than a few zaika have tucked themselves into the nooks of the oppressive buildings, faces buried in handfuls of alien drugs. Despite the stifling steam and hazy fog, you can make out the flash of fresh chrome on a couple of denizens who pass you by.

		It’s hard to see much, but the street seems to go north or south."

rows.original: Glistening sheets of polished copper are suspended on roughly welded, patchwork metal pillars in a sort of make-shift gate. A neon sign projected across its length reads: “The Short Stacks,” though it’s hardly needed. The square is filled with gabilani and raskvel of all sorts and up to all manner of things: squabbling, hauling carts of scavenged scraps, haggling, and hawking souvenirs. An impromptu open-air market has been thrown together by the gabilani, carts and booths of all shapes and sizes blockade the street. Quite a few dusky-skinned natives peruse the smaller aliens’ wares, looking oddly out-of-place on their own homeworld. The ever-social gobs are all too eager to wave you in as well. “Hey Rusher! Wanna be a cowgirl for the milk bars? I’ve got the best stuff! You could be making bank in a matter of minutes!” “Acid rain wearing you down? Buy one of these acid-proof ponchos! One size fits all!” “Cocksocks! Cocksocks for sale! Made for a zaika, but fashionable enough for a rusher!” And on and on. All a bunch of typical tourist junk, most likely. The space is crowded, but the streets lead in all four directions.
rows.translation: 闪亮的抛光铜板悬挂在粗糙焊接、东拼西凑的金属柱上，构成某种临时大门。横跨其上的霓虹招牌写着“矮堆栈区”，不过几乎没有标明的必要。广场上挤满各式各样的加比拉尼与拉斯克维尔，忙着各种事情：争吵、拖运装有拾荒废料的推车、讨价还价，以及兜售纪念品。 加比拉尼临时搭起了一座露天市场，各种形状尺寸的推车与摊位堵塞街道。相当多皮肤黝黑的本地人正在浏览小型外星人的商品，在自己的母星上反倒显得有些格格不入。天生喜爱社交的哥布也热情地挥手招呼你进去。 “嘿，行星开拓者！想去乳吧当牛女吗？我这里有最好的货！几分钟内就能赚大钱！” “酸雨让你受够了？买一件防酸雨披吧！均码适合所有人！” “肉棒套！肉棒套出售！专为扎伊卡制作，但足够时髦，行星开拓者也能穿！” 吆喝就这样没完没了。大概全是典型的游客垃圾。这里人群拥挤，但街道通往四个方向。

rows.original:
This section of the street has been overwhelmed by little food carts, advertising their specialties in bright, garish colors. Throbbing neon lanterns have been strung overhead, from one building to the next, lighting up the corridor with a festive appearance. The customers here are as likely to be natives or rushers as the gabilani themselves.

The busiest booth seems to be a family-run business titled “Bun in the Oven.” Similar-looking gobs scurry from customer to customer, taking orders or delivering large, plump, milk-bread spheres stuffed with various fillings. At the center of the scramble stands a plentifully pregnant gabilani matriarch, cooking each order in a custom-built, portable bakery. Considering the size of her barely apron-covered breasts, you can guess where she gets the milk from.
rows.translation:
这段街道已经被各种小吃车占满，它们以鲜艳刺眼的色彩宣传各自特色。头顶挂着一串串搏动的霓虹灯笼，从一栋建筑连到下一栋，让走廊呈现出节庆气氛。这里的顾客可能是本地人或行星开拓者，也可能是加比拉尼自己。

最繁忙的摊位似乎是一家名叫“烤箱里的面包”的家庭生意。相貌相似的哥布在顾客之间跑来跑去，接取订单，或送上一颗颗硕大丰满、内部塞有各种馅料的牛奶面包球。忙乱中心站着一位怀孕程度相当惊人的加比拉尼女家长，用特制便携烤炉烹制每份订单。考虑到她那对围裙几乎遮不住的乳房有多大，你大概能猜出乳汁来自哪里。

Throbbing neon lanterns have been strung overhead, from one building to the next, lighting up the corridor with a festive appearance. The customers here are as likely to be natives or rushers as the gabilani themselves.\n\nThe busiest booth seems to be a family-run business titled “Bun in the Oven.” Similar-looking gobs scurry from customer to customer, taking orders or delivering large, plump, milk-bread spheres stuffed with various fillings. At the center of the scramble stands a plentifully pregnant gabilani matriarch, cooking each order in a custom-built, portable bakery. Considering the size of her barely apron-covered breasts, you can guess where she gets the milk from."

rows.original: As the food is going out, the fertilized broodmother catches a glance at your own profile. She offers you a big, sympathetic grin before one of her offspring drops a delivery, turning her attention back to the business at hand. She chucks a plastic spoon at him with pin-point precision and begins re-making the customer’s order. Never a calm moment for the materfamilias!
rows.translation: 食物不断送出时，这位已经受孕的育母瞥见了你的身形。她向你露出灿烂而同情的笑容；随后，她的一个孩子失手摔了外卖，让她重新把注意力转回眼前生意。她以精准无比的手法朝他扔出一把塑料勺，开始重新制作顾客的订单。这位女家长真是一刻也不得安宁！

She chucks a plastic spoon at him with pin-point precision and begins re-making the customer’s order. Never a calm moment for the materfamilias!"

rows.original: As you’re taking in the sights and smells of the cookshack, you notice the cook herself taking an eyeful of you. She flicks the big, jingly jewelry hanging from her ears and flutters her dusky eyelids in your direction. If she weren’t already fit to burst, you don’t doubt the amorous matron would be eager to sample what you’ve got to offer!
rows.translation: 你正在感受这座烹饪棚的景色与气味，忽然注意到厨师本人也在饱览你的身材。她拨弄着耳边垂下的硕大叮当首饰，又朝你的方向眨动黝黑眼睑。若不是肚子已经大得快要爆开，你毫不怀疑这位多情的女家长会迫不及待地品尝你所能提供的东西！

rows.original:
The sounds of the western crowds are only a dull roar in this part of the gabilani-settled slum. The streets grow more narrow and the neon lights are a dimmer, reddish hue. Despite the comparatively less mobbed conditions, it feels like the ambient temperature has gone up a few significant degrees. There’s a perfumed scent all through the low, narrow, buildings clustered on either side of you. There’s no shortage of gobs in this part of town, but they’re all hanging out inside, standing in front of tall, pink-lit windows. Judging by their suggestive clothing, hungry glances, and lewd postures, they’re not just admiring the planet’s perpetual dusk. You can see a couple of zaika in one of the domiciles to your right wave the girl in the window their way, the lights turning out when she steps away. To your left, a discreetly hooded peer steps into the window-room, wraps her tail around an effete gabilani boi’s neck like a leash, and pulls him away from his post.

		Those not choosing to sample the pleasures of the Red Light district can head south or west.
rows.translation:
在这片由加比拉尼定居的贫民窟里，西侧人群的声音只剩低沉轰鸣。街道越发狭窄，霓虹灯光也变成更加昏暗的红色调。尽管这里相对没有那么拥挤，环境温度却仿佛明显升高了好几度。低矮狭窄的建筑聚集在两旁，香水气味弥漫其中。镇上这一带并不缺少哥布，但她们都待在室内，站在高大、被粉红灯光照亮的窗前。从充满暗示的衣着、饥渴目光和淫荡姿势判断，她们绝不只是在欣赏这颗星球永恒的暮色。你看见右侧一间住所里有几个扎伊卡朝窗前的女孩招手；她离开后，灯光随即熄灭。左侧，一名谨慎戴着兜帽的同侪走进橱窗房间，把尾巴像牵绳一样缠住某个阴柔加比拉尼男孩的脖子，将他从岗位上拉走。

		不打算品尝红灯区欢愉的人，可以向南或向西离开。
rows.raw: "The sounds of the western crowds are only a dull roar in this part of the gabilani-settled slum. The streets grow more narrow and the neon lights are a dimmer, reddish hue. Despite the comparatively less mobbed conditions, it feels like the ambient temperature has gone up a few significant degrees. There’s a perfumed scent all through the low, narrow, buildings clustered on either side of you. There’s no shortage of gobs in this part of town, but they’re all hanging out inside, standing in front of tall, pink-lit windows. Judging by their suggestive clothing, hungry glances, and lewd postures, they’re not just admiring the planet’s perpetual dusk. You can see a couple of zaika in one of the domiciles to your right wave the girl in the window their way, the lights turning out when she steps away. To your left, a discreetly hooded peer steps into the window-room, wraps her tail around an effete gabilani boi’s neck like a leash, and pulls him away from his post.\n\n\t\tThose not choosing to sample the pleasures of the Red Light district can head south or west."

Though this section of the neighborhood lacks the beaming pink neon of the Red Light district to the north, the implications remain in the lewdness of the holographic projections adorning their store signs. There’s a massage parlor that advertises their hot oil rubdown as ‘orgasmic,’ a micro-bar that promises ‘an intimate experience,’ and an arcade whose sign just shows a filled condom being tossed through a hoop that looks like the female gender symbol. Hawkers outside try to get your attention and draw you into their client’s business, eager to milk as much Rusher money out of you as they can.

			North leads to the Red Light district, while south takes you toward the less salacious parts of the Stacks.

虽然街区这一段没有北方红灯区那种耀眼粉色霓虹，商店招牌上的淫秽全息投影仍清楚暗示了这里的性质。有一家按摩院宣传热油按摩“令人高潮”，一家微型酒吧承诺提供“亲密体验”，还有一家游戏厅，招牌上只有一只装满液体的避孕套被投进形似女性符号的圆环。外面的揽客者竭力吸引你的注意，把你拉进客户的生意中，迫不及待想尽可能多榨取行星开拓者的钱财。

			北边通往红灯区，南边则通往矮堆栈区没那么淫靡的区域。

rows.original:
You’re deep in the commercial section of the Stacks. Though the lighting is more intimate than abrasive, every storefront has more than its fair share of glowing signs. The locals mill about, chatting on their way about town. You can feel their eyes on you, however, as the gabilani warily eye outsiders. Judging by the occasional smashed window and suspiciously crude condemned notice, you’d guess they’ve got good cause to be distrustful of outsiders. It seems like most of the shops here are unofficially ‘locals only,’ but there are at least one or two that still have an inviting vibe.

The road goes north and south from here.
rows.translation:
你身处矮堆栈区商业地带的深处。尽管这里的灯光更偏私密而非刺眼，每家店面仍挂着远超合理数量的发光招牌。本地人来来往往，在前往镇上各处的途中互相交谈。不过你能感觉到他们的目光；加比拉尼人正警惕地观察外来者。从偶尔可见的破碎窗户和做工可疑而粗糙的查封告示判断，你猜他们有充分理由不信任外人。这里大多数商店似乎默认“仅限本地人”，但至少还有一两家散发着欢迎气氛。

道路从这里向南北延伸。

rows.original:
Much of the flash and showy decor of the more forward-facing parts of the Stacks have given way to unassuming buildings. This seems to be a more residential part of the slums, with simple buildings rising up, up, and up in rough-and-ready apartments. Though they’re still overshadowed by the corporate megaliths built by the Zaibatsu, the local housing projects are at least impressive in just how quickly they seem to have been erected. Gabilani work ethic, you suppose. 

The ground floor of the apartment buildings seem to have been set up as shops, mostly for the locals, but open to the public all the same. One, a clothing store, even has a hand-made sign outside that invites customers to “Gwon Inside.” The street runs north and south.
rows.translation:
矮堆栈区面向外界区域那些闪耀夺目的装饰，在这里大多已被不起眼的建筑取代。这似乎是贫民窟中更偏住宅的部分；简朴楼房不断向上、向上、再向上延伸，构成粗陋却实用的公寓。虽然仍被财阀建造的企业巨构遮蔽，本地住宅项目最令人印象深刻之处，至少在于它们的建造速度看起来快得惊人。你想，这就是加比拉尼人的工作精神。 

公寓楼底层似乎被布置成商店，主要服务本地人，但同样向公众开放。其中一家服装店外甚至挂着手工招牌，邀请顾客“格温来逛”。街道向南北延伸。

This part of the neighborhood is in shambles and seems abandoned. The buildings look scorched by a recent fire, the lights are smashed, and the walls have been crudely painted with nasty messages in a luminescent yellow paint. ‘Get Off Dhaal,’ ‘Fuck Neon,’ and other, far less mentionable complaints and curses have been scrawled just about everywhere. This seems to be the work of some zaika who didn’t care for the Tarkus natives settling on their planet. [pc.nmh
		|You can’t help but shake your head. There’s always going to be someone afraid of the future and takes it out on the least defended segment of the populace. The story’s the same, no matter where you go.
		|You cluck your tongue at the sadly unoriginal graffiti. If you’re going to make a statement, you ought to have something to say. And their brushwork? Abysmal!
		|You scoff at the cowards who did this. Buncha xenophobes who aren’t ready for the galaxy at their doorstep. Pathetic.]

The rubble and detritus make it nearly impossible to get a vehicle through here, but on foot you could go north or west.

街区这一带一片狼藉，似乎已遭废弃。建筑像是刚被火灾烧过，灯具粉碎，墙壁则被人用发光黄漆粗糙写满恶毒信息。“滚出达尔”、“去他的霓虹”，以及其他更加不堪入目的抱怨和咒骂，几乎涂满每个角落。这似乎出自某些不满塔库斯本地人在自己星球定居的扎伊卡之手。[pc.nmh
		|你忍不住摇头。总有人畏惧未来，并把恐惧发泄在防御最薄弱的人群身上。无论去哪里，故事都一样。
		|你对这些毫无新意的可悲涂鸦咂舌。既然想发表声明，总该有点话要说。至于他们的笔法？糟透了！
		|你对做出这一切的懦夫嗤之以鼻。一群无法接受银河已经来到家门口的排外分子。真可悲。]

rows.original:
Workshops line this boulevard, buzzing and sizzling with non-stop construction. The ever-inventive denizens of Tarkus have lost none of their stamina in the move to Dhaal. The air is full of the sound of gobs hard at work behind forges, running machine shops, or operating elaborate and exotic tools in the endless quest for the riddle of steel. Low-flying hovercraft swoop down and land in the street to offload a mishmash of metals, electronic parts, and fuel. Your attentive gaze catches the driver discreetly pocketing the payoff from the locals, presumably to keep redirecting Zaibatsu shipments off their original courses. 

You keep your eyes skyward, just in case any more vehicles descend through the smog-clogged sky. The road goes west toward bright lights and east toward sullen darkness.
rows.translation:
工坊排列在这条大道两侧，永不停歇的建造令其嗡鸣滋响。塔库斯那些永远充满创造力的居民搬到达尔后，丝毫没有失去原有干劲。空气中充满哥布辛勤工作的声音；她们守在熔炉后，经营机械工坊，或操作精巧奇特的工具，永无止境地追寻钢铁之谜。低空悬浮载具俯冲降落到街道，卸下金属、电子零件与燃料组成的混杂货物。你敏锐的目光捕捉到司机悄悄收下本地人的报酬，大概是为了继续让财阀的货运偏离原定路线。 

你一直仰望天空，以防还有载具穿过烟雾堵塞的天幕降落。道路向西通往明亮灯光，向东通往阴郁黑暗。

rows.original:
Gabilani are intensely social and nowhere is this more obvious than their densely packed residential district. Buildings of all kinds are pressed so tightly together that there isn’t room to slide a credit chit between them. Some structures are proper buildings, while others seem to be cargo crates stacked one atop another as high as relative stability allows. There’s plenty of scavenged stone and steel making up ramshackle dwellings in one part of the neighborhood, while others seem to be hollowed-out spacecraft. Even the street itself is winding and uncertain, zigging and zagging up and down the way to create extra room for more apartments and homes.

Beaming, corporate lights stream from the south, while the north is more pleasantly subdued.
rows.translation:
加比拉尼人极其热衷社交，这一点在她们人口密集的住宅区表现得最为明显。各种建筑紧紧挤在一起，连一枚信用芯片都无法塞进缝隙。有些结构是正经楼房，另一些则像是货运箱一层层堆叠起来，堆到相对稳定性所允许的最大高度。街区一部分有大量拾荒所得的石材与钢铁，组成摇摇欲坠的住处；其他住处则像是掏空的太空船。就连街道本身也蜿蜒不定，一路上下曲折，腾出额外空间容纳更多公寓与住宅。

耀眼的企业灯光从南方照来，北边则更加舒适幽静。

rows.original:
What were once zaika-built structures have now come into the possession of a number of well-to-do gabilani. These homes have glowing hardlight windows, reinforced doors, security cameras, and well-tended, nocturnal gardens hanging down from their roofs. The street is clean and lit with low-intensity bulbs. A fair number of zaika walk up and down the street, admiring the homes of the affluent or paying a visit to a friend of the Zaibatsu, but the gabilani and raskvel who pass through keep their heads down and their steps brisk. It’s clear who’s welcome in this part of the Stacks and who isn’t. Seems like it pays to know people in high places, even when you’re living in the lowest part of the city.

		The street goes north and south from here.
rows.translation:
曾经由扎伊卡建造的结构，如今已有不少落入富裕加比拉尼人手中。这些住宅拥有发光硬光窗户、强化房门、安保摄像头，以及从屋顶垂下、受到精心照料的夜生花园。街道整洁，由低强度灯泡照明。相当多扎伊卡在街上来回行走，欣赏富人住宅，或拜访某位财阀之友；路过的加比拉尼与拉斯克维尔则低着脑袋，脚步匆匆。谁在矮堆栈区这一带受到欢迎、谁又不受欢迎，答案显而易见。看来即使住在城市最底层，认识高层人物依然很有好处。

		街道从这里向南北延伸。

rows.original:
The street market to the north continues down here, though this part of the city runs underneath a massive, overhanging freeway that cuts out even the slightest spec of the roiling, cloudy sky. Because there’s no chance of acid rain, the locals have filled the space with more permanent structures than the rest of the Stacks: holo-mag stands, outdoor bars, elaborate sculptures, and even an oil-spewing fountain. All of it is illuminated with a series of giant, glimmering, blue globes whose metal frameworks slowly rotate around like gyroscopic stabilizers. Which, considering the builders, they may very well be!

		Rushers peruse the offerings, the lights above giving everyone a turquoise hue, as if they too were gabilani. The street goes north to the bazaar, east to a construction site, and south to the residential part of the neighborhood.
rows.translation:
北边的街头市场一路延伸到这里，不过城区这一带位于一条巨大的悬空高速公路下方，连翻滚阴云天空中最细微的一点光都被遮断。由于绝无酸雨落下的可能，本地人在这里搭建了比矮堆栈区其他地方更为永久的结构：全息杂志摊、露天酒吧、精致雕塑，甚至还有一座喷油的喷泉。巨大的蓝色发光球体照亮一切，其金属框架如陀螺稳定器般缓缓旋转。考虑到建造者是谁，它们或许真有这种功能！

		行星开拓者浏览着各种商品，上方灯光让每个人都染上青绿色调，仿佛他们也成了加比拉尼。街道向北通往集市，向东通往建筑工地，向南通往街区住宅区域。
rows.raw: "The street market to the north continues down here, though this part of the city runs underneath a massive, overhanging freeway that cuts out even the slightest spec of the roiling, cloudy sky. Because there’s no chance of acid rain, the locals have filled the space with more permanent structures than the rest of the Stacks: holo-mag stands, outdoor bars, elaborate sculptures, and even an oil-spewing fountain. All of it is illuminated with a series of giant, glimmering, blue globes whose metal frameworks slowly rotate around like gyroscopic stabilizers. Which, considering the builders, they may very well be!\n\n\t\tRushers peruse the offerings, the lights above giving everyone a turquoise hue, as if they too were gabilani. The street goes north to the bazaar, east to a construction site, and south to the residential part of the neighborhood."

rows.original:
A number of official-looking zaika mill about in the abandoned ruins of a construction site. Their tails whip back and forth in agitation as they survey the scene, loudly complaining about the short off-worlders who seem to have made off with all the equipment and materials intended for the city’s latest construction project. One suggests reporting the loss to the XOs, and letting the Zaibatsu enforcers roust the little aliens out of their boltholes. Another protests that they’ll probably be held accountable for the loss if they speak up. No conclusion is reached, but all agree: the city would be better off without the vulgar little garbage-pickers. 

		Steamy alleys lead north, while the main street leads east.
rows.translation:
许多看起来像官方人员的扎伊卡在一处废弃建筑工地的废墟中来回走动。她们勘察现场时，尾巴因烦躁而不断抽打，高声抱怨那些矮小外星人似乎偷走了城市最新建筑项目所需的全部设备与材料。有人建议向XO报告损失，让财阀执法者把这些小外星人从藏身洞里赶出来。另一个人反对，说如果主动开口，她们大概会因损失而遭到问责。众人没有得出结论，但一致同意：若没有这些粗俗的小垃圾佬，城市会变得更好。 

		蒸汽弥漫的小巷向北延伸，主街则通向东方。
rows.raw: "A number of official-looking zaika mill about in the abandoned ruins of a construction site. Their tails whip back and forth in agitation as they survey the scene, loudly complaining about the short off-worlders who seem to have made off with all the equipment and materials intended for the city’s latest construction project. One suggests reporting the loss to the XOs, and letting the Zaibatsu enforcers roust the little aliens out of their boltholes. Another protests that they’ll probably be held accountable for the loss if they speak up. No conclusion is reached, but all agree: the city would be better off without the vulgar little garbage-pickers. \n\n\t\tSteamy alleys lead north, while the main street leads east."

rows.original: The interior of the store is downright tiny, only accommodating half a dozen people, separated by a counter behind thick, bulletproof glass. All the hardware is behind the counter. rows.original:
It looks like this used to be a steam station, responsible for regulating and guiding the flow of heat through this part of the city. Judging by the damp, hot clouds of fog spilling out everywhere, you’d guess the station’s not quite as operational as it ought to be. Even a cursory inspection shows that a good many of the surface-level devices have been partially disassembled. Perhaps cannibalized by the scavenging locals?

		The main street leads east, but you spy an alley way through the mist leading to the south.
rows.translation:
这里看起来曾经是一座蒸汽站，负责调节并引导热量流经城区这一带。从四处涌出的潮湿滚烫雾气判断，你猜这座站点的运转状态远不如应有水平。即使只是粗略检查，也能看出相当多表层装置已经被部分拆卸。也许是被拾荒的本地人拆来利用了？

		主街通向东方，不过你透过雾气看见一条通往南方的小巷。
rows.raw: "It looks like this used to be a steam station, responsible for regulating and guiding the flow of heat through this part of the city. Judging by the damp, hot clouds of fog spilling out everywhere, you’d guess the station’s not quite as operational as it ought to be. Even a cursory inspection shows that a good many of the surface-level devices have been partially disassembled. Perhaps cannibalized by the scavenging locals?\n\n\t\tThe main street leads east, but you spy an alley way through the mist leading to the south."

rows.original: Stepping inside the seemingly unassuming clothing store feels like stepping through a portal to journey to a dimension composed entirely of garish color and bombastic fashion. Every wall is decked in clothing of every shape and size. The unifying theme of the collection appears to be ‘loud,’ though if you had to pick a second attribute, it would be ‘sexy’ - not entirely unexpected in the land of exposed breasts and perpetual twilight. The doorway to the east provides an exit.
rows.translation: 走进这家看似不起眼的服装店，就像穿过一道传送门，进入一个完全由艳俗色彩与夸张时尚构成的维度。每面墙都挂满各种形状尺寸的服装。这些商品的统一主题似乎是“招摇”；若必须挑选第二项特征，那就是“性感”——在这片乳房外露、永恒暮色笼罩的土地上，这并不出人意料。东边门口可供离开。

rows.original:
The crowd is thicker here, the zaika angrier. You can hear the source of commotion ahead. Someone with a bullhorn is screaming something ahead, if you can just push through to the front. If it weren’t for Feruze and the crackling ball of pain and electricity dangling from her tail, you might’ve found yourself in a spot of trouble. Sometimes it pays to have a bodyguard.
		
		You need to push north.
rows.translation:
这里的人群更加密集，扎伊卡也更加愤怒。你能听见前方骚动的源头。有人在前面用扩音器大喊；只要挤到最前面就能看清。若不是有费鲁兹和她尾巴上悬挂的那颗噼啪作响、充满痛苦与电流的球体，你或许已经遇上麻烦。有时拥有保镖确实值得。
		
		你必须向北推进。
rows.raw: "The crowd is thicker here, the zaika angrier. You can hear the source of commotion ahead. Someone with a bullhorn is screaming something ahead, if you can just push through to the front. If it weren’t for Feruze and the crackling ball of pain and electricity dangling from her tail, you might’ve found yourself in a spot of trouble. Sometimes it pays to have a bodyguard.\n\t\t\n\t\tYou need to push north."

Cybernetically-augmented company guards are formed up around the gate, but with the crowd dispersed, both guards and turrets are standing by at-ease. rows.original: Whew, you’ve been walking for what feels like forever, but your Codex’s chrono says it’s only been five minutes. The road snakes west and north from here, pinned between the monolithic complex structure and the reinforced concrete walls that guard it. Even shaded, the pavement feels almost blisteringly hot. Distortions in the distance make it hard to see the details of where you’re going.
rows.translation: 呼，你感觉自己仿佛已经走了无穷久，可CODEX终端的计时器显示才过去五分钟。道路从这里蜿蜒通往西方与北方，夹在巨石般的园区建筑和守护它的强化混凝土墙之间。即使位于阴影中，路面仍热得几乎令人起泡。远方扭曲的空气让你很难看清前路的细节。

rows.original:
You catch a break from the sun here, shaded by the wall. Dry breezes blast through the artificial canyon, only slightly better than baking in stagnant air. No entrances to the [targetFactionName]’s complex reveals themselves to you yet. Maybe going back to the front would be best?
		
		Or you could stubbornly push on... What’s another five minutes in this heat?
rows.translation:
在这里，围墙投下的阴影让你暂时摆脱阳光。干燥热风穿过人造峡谷，只比在停滞空气中遭受烘烤略好一点。你依然没有找到[targetFactionName]园区的任何入口。也许最好回到正门？
		
		或者，你也可以固执地继续前进...在这种高温里再待五分钟又算什么？

rows.original: Around the rear of the [targetFactionName] complex, you find the caravan of company trucks that you saw coming in have already set down and unloaded their cargo into a pair of heavily-reinforced doors mated perfectly to their rear hatches. There aren’t any guards or workers left back here, at least -- you reckon they must all have gone inside when the job was done.
rows.translation: 绕到[targetFactionName]园区后方，你发现先前看见驶入的公司卡车队已经停稳，并将货物卸进一对高度强化的门内；卡车后舱恰好与门口严丝合缝地对接。至少后方已经没有守卫或工人——你猜工作完成后，他们一定都进入了建筑。
rows.raw: "Around the rear of the [targetFactionName] complex, you find the caravan of company trucks that you saw coming in have already set down and unloaded their cargo into a pair of heavily-reinforced doors mated perfectly to their rear hatches. There aren’t any guards or workers left back here, at least -- you reckon they must all have gone inside when the job was done."

rows.original:
Now inside the compound proper, the atmosphere cools slightly - enough to easily endure long-term without spending a single idle cent on comfort proper. You suspect the air-cons further away from the common folk are allowed to draw significantly more wattage.

Broad tunnels stretch to the east and west through the [targetFactionName] compound. A directory on the back wall indicates that the western branch leads to the executive offices. The break rooms lie east. How come they never give you directions to your probe?
rows.translation:
现在你正式进入园区内部，环境稍微凉爽下来——恰好足以让人长期轻松忍受，却不肯在真正的舒适上浪费一分闲钱。你怀疑远离普通员工的空调获准消耗多得多的功率。

宽阔通道向东西两侧延伸，贯穿[targetFactionName]园区。后墙的路线图表明，西侧分支通往行政办公室，休息室则位于东边。他们为什么从不告诉你探针该怎么走？

rows.original: [targetFactionName] keeps a tidy compound. Recently waxxed floors shine dully beneath the fluorescent lights above, marred only by the panicked scuffs of recent unrest. Illuminated display cabinets proudly show off a collection of unintelligable awards like “Best Use of Synergistic Co-Dependence in a Corporate Setting” or “Most Luminous Advertisement.” An entranceway lies to the west. This corridor carries on to the east, under the sleepy eye of an unpowered security camera.
rows.translation: [targetFactionName]把园区维持得相当整洁。刚打过蜡的地面在头顶荧光灯下泛着暗淡光泽，只有近期动乱留下的慌乱擦痕破坏了表面。亮起灯光的展示柜骄傲陈列着一批令人摸不着头脑的奖项，例如“企业环境协同式相互依赖最佳运用奖”，或“最耀眼广告奖”。西边有一个入口。这条走廊继续向东延伸，一台没有通电的安保摄像头睡眼惺忪地注视着这里。

rows.original: The broad corridor you’ve been following bends to the north and east from here. A potted plant sits in the corner, glowing faintly. Closer inspection reveals it to be made of plastic, lighted by embedded fiber optics in an attempt to artificially parody bioluminescence. From time to time, it puffs floral-scented mist into the air.
rows.translation: 你一直沿着前进的宽阔走廊在这里分别向北、向东弯去。角落摆着一株盆栽，散发微弱光芒。仔细检查后，你发现它由塑料制成，内嵌光纤照明，试图人为模仿生物发光。它还会不时向空气喷出花香薄雾。

rows.original: Locked doors frame your path to the east and west. Offices for minor beauracrats or janitors, you dismiss them as unworthy of the effort t would take to crack them open, notable only as places a hostile security officer or misguided rioter could hide. Neon streamers wave briskly under a hard-working ceiling vent. It can’t be easy keeping this place so cool.
rows.translation: 上锁的门分列在东西两侧。你认为这些门后只是低级官僚或清洁工的办公室，不值得花力气破解；唯一值得注意的是，敌对安保人员或误入歧途的骚乱者可以藏在里面。霓虹彩带在辛勤运转的天花板通风口下迅速飘动。要让这里保持如此凉爽，想必并不容易。

You could breeze on in for a closer look or trundle along the corridor’s length to the north and south.

rows.original:
Once a serene breakroom for the executives of [targetFactionName], you stand in the midst of a shoddily barricaded survival chamber. With its misguided occupants scattered, there’s nothing but upended tables surrounded by wrappers from hastily consumed snack-foods. “Now 50% less carcinogenic!” one brags.

The walls remain largely unmolested, covered over by inspirational displays for sociopaths.

“Do your part! Underpay today!”
rows.translation:
这里曾是[targetFactionName]高管们宁静的休息室，如今你站在一座以劣质路障搭起的求生室中。那些误入歧途的占据者已经散去，只留下掀翻的桌子，周围散落着匆忙吃掉的零食包装纸。其中一张自豪地写着：“致癌性现已降低50%！”

墙壁大体没有遭到破坏，上面覆盖着为反社会者准备的励志标语。

“尽一份力！今天少付工资！”

rows.original:
Rounding a south-west bend, you expose a whole new axis of [targetFactionName]’s base to explore. Helpful signage on the wall indicates that sub-level access can be found to the west, and that a breakroom isn’t far to the south. It might not be a bad spot to take a load off, compared to elsewhere in this dangerous installation.

A crumpled-up flier for a company dining event lies on the floor. It seems proud that the guest fee is only 500 credits.
rows.translation:
绕过一道西南方向的弯，你发现[targetFactionName]基地又有一整条轴线可供探索。墙上贴心的标牌表明，西边可以进入地下层，南边不远处则有一间休息室。与这座危险设施的其他地方相比，那里也许是个不错的歇脚点。

地板上躺着一张揉皱的公司聚餐传单。它似乎很自豪地宣称，宾客费用只需500信用点。

rows.original:
Live stock prices flicker on the wall. [targetFactionName] stays locked at the top, of course, updating with sparkly effects when it twitches upward and subtle dissolves when it slides back down. A watercooler bubbles below it, though the little paper cups you expect to find are long gone and the water has a concerning pinkish tint to it. “Ten cup limit!” reads a warning, just above another sign. “You are being watched!”

This place is starting to remind you of Dad’s MaxCorp stories...
rows.translation:
实时股价在墙上闪烁。[targetFactionName]当然牢牢锁定在榜首；价格向上跳动时会以闪亮特效更新，向下滑落时则悄然淡出。下方饮水机咕噜冒泡，不过你以为会看到的小纸杯早已不见踪影，水还带着令人担忧的粉红色调。“每人限饮十杯！”一条警告写道，正下方还有另一块标牌。“有人正在监视你！”

这里开始让你想起爸爸讲过的马克斯公司故事...

rows.original: “Elevator Access: L2 Employees and Above” Despite the sign, there isn’t any security set up to stop you from barging in and punching any button you want. This seems like a good route to dig deeper into [targetFactionName]’s corporate guts. rows.original:
A dried-on coffee stain lingers on the floor. No doubt it would have been cleaned up long ago, had it not been for the riot, but it’s been left here to mark the site of an accident - or particularly unpleasant news being delivered. Bean-impregnated breezes still tickle at your nostrils when you breathe.

You can follow the compound’s main corridor east, toward and elevator, or west to the executive offices. The air grows cooler in that direction.
rows.translation:
地板上留着一块干涸的咖啡污渍。若不是发生骚乱，它无疑早就被清理干净；如今却留在这里，标记一场意外——或是某条格外糟糕的消息送达之处。呼吸时，浸透咖啡豆气味的微风依然轻挠鼻孔。

你可以沿园区主走廊向东前往电梯，或向西前往行政办公室。那个方向的空气越来越凉。

The air grows cooler in that direction."

A holo-cart sticks halfway out of the western wall. Muted beeps still emanate from somewhere behind the plastery substance. Shards of a shattered display screen ring the floor around it. Somebody’s going to be losing out on a few paychecks once corporate reviews the security cams...
		
		Why, the executive offices appear to have an entrance just south of here. Maybe they’re worth checking out? Alternatively, you could poke around the elevator that’s a bit further down the hall to the east. Surely it leads deeper into the complex.
rows.translation:
一辆全息推车有一半卡在西侧墙里。石膏状墙体后方某处仍传出低沉哔声。破碎显示屏的碎片散落在周围地板上。等公司查看安保录像后，肯定有人要损失好几笔工资...
		
		哎呀，行政办公室的入口似乎就在这里南边。也许值得进去检查？或者，你也可以摆弄一下走廊东侧稍远处的电梯。它肯定通往园区更深处。

rows.original:
Ornate double doors with bulletproof glass panels guard the entrance to the executive offices, according to the sign just above. Luckily for you, they were left unlatched and gently parted by the riot’s chaos. Nothing would stop you from popping in and searching for some clues.

		Of course there are plenty of other locales to pillage in this complex. Signage seems to indicate an elevator isn’t far around that corner to the north.
rows.translation:
按照正上方标牌的说明，带有防弹玻璃嵌板的华丽双开门守卫着行政办公室入口。幸运的是，它们没有上闩，还被骚乱造成的混乱轻轻推开。没有什么能阻止你进去搜寻线索。

		当然，这座园区里还有许多其他地方可以劫掠。标牌似乎表明，绕过北边那个拐角不远处就有一部电梯。

rows.original: An organized desk is a sign of an organized mind. This one is too wrecked to indicate anything other than the power of chaos against long-maintained order. Behind it lies another pair of doors and a staircase to the rest of the executive offices, lavishly indicated by a thick purple carpet of neon intensity. You hope it isn’t radioactive. You can slip back out the security doors to the east at any time... or investigate the offices beyond the stairs to the west.
rows.translation: 井然有序的办公桌代表井然有序的思想。这张桌子被破坏得太严重，除了混乱凌驾于长期秩序之上的力量，什么也体现不出来。它后方还有一对门和一段通往其余行政办公室的楼梯，一张散发霓虹般强烈紫色的厚地毯奢华地标示着道路。希望它没有放射性。你随时都可以从东边安保门溜出去...或调查西边楼梯后的办公室。

rows.original:
This wide hall stretches through the concrete-reinforced walls of the [targetFactionName] base, north toward the executive offices. To the south lies a corner and the way back to the entrance. Interlocking geometric patterns on the walls flash delightfully in response to your passing.
		
		The suits must have a pleasant walk on their way to work in the morning.
rows.translation:
这条宽阔走廊穿过[targetFactionName]基地的混凝土强化墙体，向北通往行政办公室。南边是一处拐角和返回入口的道路。墙上相互咬合的几何图案会响应你的经过，令人愉悦地闪烁。
		
		那些西装客早晨上班时一定走得很开心。

rows.original:
A ladder rests against the corridor wall beneath a burned-out lighting panel in the ceiling, left by a maintenance tech once the chaos of the riots began. The other lights reflect brightly off the freshly waxed floor.
		
		It’s a shame the corporate zaika will never know the joy of sliding around on glossy floors in nothing but a pair of socks.
		
		Maybe when you’re in charge of Steele Tech you can teach them a thing or two.
rows.translation:
一架梯子靠在走廊墙边，位于天花板一块烧坏的照明板下方；骚乱爆发时，维修技术员把它遗留在这里。其他灯光从刚打过蜡的地面上明亮反射。
		
		可惜企业扎伊卡永远无法体会，只穿一双袜子在光滑地板上滑行的乐趣。
		
		也许等你掌管斯蒂尔科技时，可以教她们一两招。

"A ladder rests against the corridor wall beneath a burned-out lighting panel in the ceiling, left by a maintenance tech once the chaos of the riots began. The other lights reflect brightly off the freshly waxed floor.
		
		It’s a shame the corporate zaika will never know the joy of sliding around on glossy floors in nothing but a pair of socks.
		
		Maybe when you’re in charge of Steele Tech you can teach them a thing or two."
