rows.original:
Though the world may be alien, the instruments of business remain familiar. Here, a timeclock sits on the wall, displaying the local time in alien letters. There’s no slot or dock for physically interacting, so it likely operates via some form of wireless technology to painless track its employees comings and goings.
		
		The air to the east grows warmer, closer to the entrance. The west, it cools to comfort on your way to the executive suites.
rows.translation:
尽管世界属于异星，商业工具依然令人熟悉。墙上挂着一台考勤钟，以外星文字显示本地时间。这里没有可供实体交互的插槽或接口，所以它大概通过某种无线技术，无痛追踪员工的来去。
		
		靠近入口的东侧空气越来越暖。向西前往行政套间时，温度则逐渐降至舒适水平。

rows.original:
The deeper the elevator goes below ground, the more you notice a hum of heavy machinery growing in the background. You feel it rumbling through the floors. It sounds like you’re entering some kind of factory or production factory. No doubt [targetFactionName] produces some of their goods here, where their methods are concealed from the prying eyes of the city. The elevator door opens south into the underground factory complex.

You can ride the elevator back up to the surface.
rows.translation:
电梯越是深入地下，你就越能注意到背景中重型机械的嗡鸣不断增强。你能感觉震动透过地板传来。听起来你正在进入某种工厂或生产设施。[targetFactionName]无疑会在这里制造一部分商品，让生产方法避开城市窥探的目光。电梯门向南打开，通往地下工厂园区。

你可以搭乘电梯返回地表。

If this security checkpoint was staffed, you might be in trouble. Instead, the scanners sit abandoned. No guard will stop you from slipping between two of the scanners instead of through the indicated aperture. You’re free to scamper deeper into the facility - or peek into the security office to the west.
		
		An elevator back to the surface is to the north.
		
		The factory floor rumbles to the south.

若这处安保检查站有人值守，你可能会遇上麻烦。可扫描仪如今无人看管。没有守卫会阻止你从两台扫描仪之间溜过去，而非穿过指定开口。你可以自由地深入设施——或窥探西边的安保办公室。
		
		北边有一部返回地表的电梯。
		
		南边的工厂地板不断震动。

rows.original: The security station is as you would expect: desks full of empty caffeinated beverage containers pointed at walls stacked with security monitors. The dozens of feeds provide a more than ample view of the facility, even into the Research and Development wing where you have to make do with blurry black and white footage. You can exit the office and return to the security checkpoint to the east.

		You can head west, toward a large, crane-shaped machine, or east toward another intersection.

工厂地板在这里变得开阔，但卡车大小的储存箱数量足以让通行看起来像走迷宫。幸运的是，CODEX终端内置地形扫描仪已经绘制出足够详细的地图，能让你顺利绕行。你只需留意区域内是否有巡逻队。
		
		你可以向西前往一台巨大的起重机状机器，或向东前往另一处交叉口。

To your west, you can see a cargo crane, big enough to pick up one of the giant crates (like the one blocking the way south) and tote it around the factory.
		
		The factory floor stretches east.
rows.translation:
一条传送带从北墙伸出。由于失去电力，它静止不动。尚未完工的塑料外壳躺在上面，还没有贴上未来将会承载的炫目商品名称。西边可以看到一台货运起重机，尺寸大得足以提起一只巨型货箱——就像挡住南边道路的那只——并将它搬运到工厂各处。
		
		工厂地面向东延伸。

rows.original: The factory floor stretches away to the south and west, around the squared-off corner of a ten foot tall cargo container. Its ceilings rise higher than the cargo tunnel to the north’s, high enough for squat cranes to rearrange the stacked resources as production warrants. A lingering puddle nearly wets your [pc.foot], fed by a steady drip from a pipe above. Despite the label ‘water,’ what emerges is brackish and foul. It smells like it could strip paint.

rows.original:
During full operation, this tunnel would be used to stage finished goods from the factory for trucks at the loading bay to the north. Now it lies empty, a back way into the factory itself, which grows louder with each southward step you take. A neon-illuminated sign on the wall reports, “Only 16 accidents today! Great job!”

		The source of those accidents is clear: rumbling machinery to the south, blasting out its discordant cacophony. A rack of safety equipment hangs on the western wall beneath a sign that reminds you that the company must be compensated for lost labor in the event of an injury. Most of the hardhats are already cracked, whatever they were cast from already flaking apart. Most of the gloves have holes in the fingers. No wonder the workers get injured so often... and riot.
rows.translation:
全面运转时，这条隧道会用于暂存工厂成品，等待北边装卸区的卡车运走。如今这里空无一物，只是进入工厂本身的一条后路；你每向南走一步，工厂噪声就会变得更加响亮。墙上一块霓虹照亮的标牌写着：“今天仅发生16起事故！干得漂亮！”

		事故的来源显而易见：南边的机械轰隆作响，爆发出不和谐的嘈杂声。西墙挂着一架安全装备，下方标牌提醒你，若发生工伤，公司必须得到误工赔偿。大部分安全帽已经开裂，无论使用何种材料浇铸，表面都已开始剥落。多数手套的指部也有破洞。难怪工人如此经常受伤...以及发动骚乱。
rows.raw: "During full operation, this tunnel would be used to stage finished goods from the factory for trucks at the loading bay to the north. Now it lies empty, a back way into the factory itself, which grows louder with each southward step you take. A neon-illuminated sign on the wall reports, “Only 16 accidents today! Great job!”\n\n\t\tThe source of those accidents is clear: rumbling machinery to the south, blasting out its discordant cacophony. A rack of safety equipment hangs on the western wall beneath a sign that reminds you that the company must be compensated for lost labor in the event of an injury. Most of the hardhats are already cracked, whatever they were cast from already flaking apart. Most of the gloves have holes in the fingers. No wonder the workers get injured so often... and riot."

rows.original: A thick wall hems you in to the south. The concrete floor below, cracked and scuffed in a half-dozen places, seems like it was cured too fast to achieve proper hardness. Nonetheless, it bears the weight of the factory’s weighty cargo containers. A wide gap leads west across the battered floor. The heavy arm of a cargo crane rests across the way north, like a crude mechanical archway.
rows.translation: 一堵厚墙封住南边。下方混凝土地板有六七处开裂磨损，看起来是凝固得太快，没能达到应有硬度。尽管如此，它仍承受着工厂那些沉重货箱的重量。一道宽阔缺口穿过破损地面通向西方。货运起重机的沉重吊臂横在北边道路上，如同一道粗糙的机械拱门。

rows.original:
You catch a glimpse of the south wall as you move. It’s heavy stuff, blast-hardened concrete, and in far better shape than the floor. It’s the sort of material you’d expect to see in a military base - and not spent on a factory wall, even one skirting the burning hellfire of Dhaal’s sunward side.

East leads back the way you came.

West continues through shipping containers and conveyors, deeper into the facility.
rows.translation:
移动时，你瞥见南墙。那是厚重的防爆强化混凝土，状态比地面好得多。这种材料通常应该出现在军事基地，而不是花在工厂围墙上——即使这座工厂紧邻达尔朝阳面燃烧的地狱烈火。

东边通回你的来路。

西边继续穿过货运箱和传送带，深入设施内部。

East leads back the way you came.

West continues through shipping containers and conveyors, deeper into the facility."

rows.original: An auto-packer straddles between two of the thicker crates. The conveyors that should be feeding it sit bare and idle, abandoned in the chaos. Spindles for spools of shrinkwrap stand similarly bare. A tangle of wires spills out of the control cabin like intestines from a gut wound. It won’t be running any time soon, and you can skirt through the gaps to continue west.
rows.translation: 一台自动打包机横跨在两只较厚货箱之间。本应为它送料的传送带空空荡荡、静止不动，在混乱中遭到遗弃。用来安装收缩膜卷的转轴同样空着。一团电线像肠子从腹部伤口流出一样，散落在控制舱外。它短时间内不可能恢复运转，你可以穿过缝隙继续向西。

It won’t be running any time soon, and you can skirt through the gaps to continue west."

rows.original: Just to the south lies an airlock of enormous size. It’s maw could casually devour one of the cargo crates you’ve bee threading through all this time. There’s even a conveyor that feeds directly into it. Above, a heavy loader arm dangles from the tracks. This area is less deserted. Every now and then someone emerges from the airlock. You’ll have to be careful to avoid being seen.
rows.translation: 正南方是一座无比巨大的气闸。它的大口能轻易吞下你一路穿行其间的某只货运箱。甚至还有一条传送带直接通向内部。上方，一条重型装卸臂从轨道垂下。这片区域没那么荒凉，时不时会有人从气闸出来。你必须小心避免被发现。

You’ll have to be careful to avoid being seen."

rows.original: Yep, this is an airlock alright. It’s in much better shape than the factory leading up to it too. You can tell where [targetFactionName] is pumping its money, and it’s not into the facade you just left behind, no sir. The floor is freshly polished, and the walls lack a single scuff or mark. Carefully engineered shutters cycle on either side to the north and south to keep the dust and debris away from the science that is no doubt being done to the south. Now you’re getting somewhere...
rows.translation: 没错，这确实是一座气闸。它的状况也比通往这里的工厂好得多。你能看出[targetFactionName]把钱花在了哪里，反正绝不是你刚刚离开的那副门面，绝对不是。地面刚刚抛光，墙上没有半点擦痕或印记。精心设计的闸门在南北两侧轮流开合，将灰尘与碎屑挡在外面，免得影响南边无疑正在开展的科学工作。看来你终于有进展了...
rows.raw: "Yep, this is an airlock alright. It’s in much better shape than the factory leading up to it too. You can tell where [targetFactionName] is pumping its money, and it’s not into the facade you just left behind, no sir. The floor is freshly polished, and the walls lack a single scuff or mark. Carefully engineered shutters cycle on either side to the north and south to keep the dust and debris away from the science that is no doubt being done to the south. Now you’re getting somewhere..."

rows.original:
Research and Development seems like a completely different world than the factory to the north. In place of gritty concrete and corroded containers, you see expanses of glossy waxed floors framed by matte pearl walls. The hallway stretches east where numerous doorways branch off to the north and south, offering entrance to cleanrooms, vacuum chambers, and other places unlikely to contain the probe - or your cousin.
		
		A smaller corridor dips south, beneath a sign directing to a break room. 

		And of course, the airlock back into the factory sits just to the north.
rows.translation:
研发区与北边的工厂仿佛完全不同的世界。这里没有粗糙混凝土和锈蚀容器，取而代之的是大片油亮打蜡地板，四周由哑光珍珠色墙壁围住。走廊向东延伸，许多门道向南北分岔，通往洁净室、真空舱及其他不太可能藏着探针——或你堂亲——的地方。
		
		一条较窄的走廊向南延伸，上方标牌指向休息室。 

		当然，返回工厂的气闸就在正北方。

rows.original:
R&D’s pristine hallway hooks a sharp louie toward the well-used double doors of a company breakroom. The surrounding signage indicates that the entry is constantly surveiled. [targetFactionName] doesn’t tolerate time theft. A pneumatic waste tube rests in the corner, maw open wide to display the razor-sharp teeth it uses to shred refuse. “Careful!” warns a sign just above it, displaying a hand with bloody stumps at the knuckles. It offers no guidance on how to safely use the machine.
		
		The airlock lies to the north.
		
		The breakroom is east.
rows.translation:
研发区一尘不染的走廊猛地左转，通向公司休息室那对使用频繁的双开门。周围标牌表明入口始终受到监控。[targetFactionName]绝不容忍偷懒。角落里摆着一条气动垃圾管，敞开大口，露出用来粉碎废物的锋利牙齿。上方标牌写着“小心！”，图中一只手的指节处只剩鲜血淋漓的断桩，却完全没说明如何安全使用这台机器。
		
		气闸位于北方。
		
		休息室位于东方。

rows.original: The researchers’ break room isn’t occupied when you and Feruze step in; the only noise comes from a pair of holoscreens quietly playing advertisements for [targetFactionName]’s own products. Really preaching to the choir, aren’t they? Aside from a couple sterile white tables, a fridge, and countertop, most of the break room is dominated by [var0 |an old-school set of arcade cabinets with prop guns — modeled after company pieces, no doubt. They carry such illustrious titles such as Union Buster and Hostage Rescue: No Prisoners. [syri.fucked|Subject matter aside, Syri’d probably love this place. ] |a series of pumping stations, which are connected to the counter’s faucet by a hose. A helpful note stickied to the side of it says “Company mixer, try your co-workers’ brews :D” in a flowery handwriting. |a VR machine and a half-dozen lounge chairs with visors slung haphazardly over their backs. There’s a stack of program diskettes next to the machine’s terminal — everything from pornographic power fantasy to pastoral crafting simulators. The only genres that seem missing at a glance are the violent ones. [syri.fucked|Poor Syri’d be bored out of her mind here.] ]

rows.original:
It’s too white. There’s no other way to put it. The floor, the walls, and the lights combine to dizzying effect. For someone raised in a system with a yellow sun, and terran standards in space, this much white feels... unsettling. The sight through a sealed door to the south doesn’t help. They’re conducting experiments in there, blasting creatures not too dissimilar to New Texan varmints with some kind of radiation that you can only perceive as even more light - after it passes through three layers of semi-transparent shielding.
		
		The Research and Development Hallway soldiers on to the east, deeper into the facility. To the west, you can spy an airlock and a sign indicating a nearby break room.
rows.translation:
太白了。除此之外无从形容。地板、墙壁和灯光共同造成令人眩晕的效果。对一个在黄太阳星系长大、又习惯太空中人类标准的人而言，如此多的白色令人...不安。南边密封门后的景象更没有帮助。她们正在那里进行实验，用某种辐射轰击与新德州害兽颇为相似的生物；辐射穿过三层半透明屏障后，你只能将其感知为更加强烈的光。
		
		研发走廊继续向东深入设施。西边则能看到一座气闸和指向附近休息室的标牌。

You see an alcove on the northern wall housing an emergency decontamination station. Most UGC planets mandate they be within a certain distance of potentially harmful chemical work. Not so on Dhaal. This is the only one for all of R&D according to the signage. The finer print beneath contains notice that usage of this station communicates consent to work the next 25 days unpaid.
		
		It does not look to have been cleaned in a long time.
		
		You can follow the hallway to the east, where it bends, or back to the west, toward the airlock.

你看到北墙凹室里设有一座紧急去污站。大多数银河联合邦联行星都强制规定，它们必须设置在距离潜在有害化学作业一定范围内的位置。达尔可不是这样。根据标牌，这是整个研发区唯一的一座。下方小字通知称，使用本设施即代表同意接下来二十五天无薪工作。
		
		它看起来已经很久没有清洁。
		
		你可以沿走廊向东，在那里转弯，或向西返回气闸。

		It does not look to have been cleaned in a long time.

rows.original:
The inside of the warehouse is thankfully devoid of the kaithrit guards you saw outside. This small space seems to have been an office lobby or perhaps the front end of some business before Utopian Skies snatched it up for their private storage. Scattered and abandoned furniture litters the empty room, to say nothing of discarded magazines and crumpled food wrappers. They’re supposed to have someone here, that’s for sure, but the holoscreen set up in the corner seems broken, likely why the appointed lookout has forsaken his post. 

		You take a quick sweep around the room, but find only further evidence of the indolent felines. Empty bottles, stubbed smokes, and a handful of used condoms, but no weapons. Though, you can’t help but notice a few bullet holes in the walls. It’s anyone’s guess if those were the guards playing with the smuggled arms, their overseer making a point about alertness, or evidence of the sentries taking care of a prior trespasser. Thankfully, your fate - one way or the other - lies deeper in the warehouse.
		
		An industrial elevator lies to your south and seems to be the only way to Malai’s goal.
rows.translation:
仓库内部没有你在外面看到的凯斯里特守卫，真是谢天谢地。在乌托邦天空公司将此处据为私人仓库前，这片狭小空间似乎曾是办公大厅，或是某家公司的前台。散乱废弃的家具遍布空荡房间，丢弃的杂志和揉皱的食品包装更是不计其数。这里肯定应该有人值守，可角落里的全息屏幕似乎坏了，大概正因如此，被指派的警戒员才会擅离职守。 

		你迅速搜查房间，却只找到更多证明这些懒散猫科人作风的东西：空瓶、烟蒂和几只用过的避孕套，却没有武器。不过，你不禁注意到墙上有几个弹孔。没人知道这是守卫摆弄走私武器留下的、主管为了强调警觉性而开的枪，还是哨兵解决先前入侵者的证据。好在无论结局如何，你的命运都在仓库更深处。
		
		南边有一台工业电梯，似乎是通往玛莱目标的唯一道路。

"The inside of the warehouse is thankfully devoid of the kaithrit guards you saw outside. rows.original:
The elevator here is well maintained and discrete enough not to draw any notice. The bottom level of the warehouse, however, is somewhat less so. Massive crates of wood, plastic, and steel fill the space in towering rows that zig, zag, and turn what should be a straight path into a labyrinthine affair. Lucky for you: the stacked freight blocks any line of sight the guards down here might otherwise draw on their unexpected guests.

		With little immediate risk of ambush, you take a careful assessment of your surroundings. The room is dimly lit by flickering lights high above. Zaika need very little light to operate at peak alertness, but their corpo goons aren’t quite as nocturnal, and the glare of additional floodlights to the east tell you that’s where the kaithrit have gone off to. There’s no evidence of armaments at this end of the warehouse; just a ton of Utopian Skies miscellany. You see 100-gallon jugs of flavored lube, cartons of tail-length condoms, and chests full of body oil promising a long-lasting glisten for stripper poles and strippers alike. Presumably, excess materials for the Zaibatsu-run brothels.
rows.translation:
这里的电梯保养良好，也足够隐蔽，不会引起任何注意。不过，仓库底层就没这么整洁了。木制、塑料与钢制巨箱堆成高耸长列，蜿蜒曲折，将本应笔直的道路变成一座迷宫。幸运的是，堆叠货物挡住了下方守卫的视线，让他们无法看见这些不速之客。

		眼下没有遭伏击的风险，你便谨慎观察四周。高处灯光忽明忽暗，令房间十分昏暗。扎伊卡人只需极少光线就能保持最高警觉，但那些公司打手并没有那么适应夜行；东边额外泛光灯的强烈光芒说明凯斯里特人去了那里。仓库这一端没有任何武器迹象，只有成堆乌托邦天空公司的杂物。你看见容量一百加仑的调味润滑液桶、装着尾巴长度避孕套的纸箱，以及装满身体油的箱子，宣称可令钢管与脱衣舞娘都长久闪亮。想必是财阀经营的妓院剩余物资。

rows.original:
The elevated gangway running along the storage site’s upper reaches is so deeply plunged in the inky darkness the natives so love that you’re practically invisible up here. None of the security drones point up this far, even if they were equipped with night vision filters. The grating is a little unsteady, however, and you move slowly, to be sure the motion doesn’t attract unwanted attention.

		Suspended this high, you’ve got a good view of just how cramped the ground level is. Trying to find what Malai’s looking for is going to be a nightmare without some assistance! Maybe you can get the guards to point you in the right direction; assuming you can get the jump on them, that is. You can’t see there from here, but the faint sound of conversation filters up to the rafters, letting you know that they’re definitely down here.
		
		The ladder back down to the warehouse floor lies to the north. The catwalk continues to the east, leading to a discrete little office.
rows.translation:
沿仓储场地上层延伸的高架通道深深没入当地人喜爱的墨色黑暗，使你在这里几乎隐形。即使安保无人机装有夜视滤镜，也没有一台会朝如此高处拍摄。不过，格栅有些不稳，你缓缓移动，以免动静招来不必要的注意。

		悬在如此高处，你能清楚看出地面有多么拥挤。若没有帮助，想找到玛莱寻找的东西简直会是一场噩梦！也许你能让守卫替你指出正确方向，前提是你能先发制人。你从这里看不到她们，但隐约交谈声传上椽架，说明她们肯定就在下面。
		
		回到仓库地面的梯子位于北边。高架步道继续向东，通往一间不起眼的小办公室。

rows.original:
The makeshift hallway that winds through the disorganized depo is flanked by boxes on every side. You spot a dumpster-sized container that contains fresh neon bulbs - excess from their ‘light up the city’ initiative, no doubt, when Rushers first arrived on the twilight world. But there are plenty of other, less savory crates here too. You spy a rack of coffin-like pods with a host of alarming tubes inside right next to a strongbox filled with ‘employee-mandated collars.’ 

		No sign of weapons, yet. The brighter lights to the east seem like the likely direction to push on towards. All that lies to the west is the darkness of the building’s exit.
rows.translation:
穿过杂乱仓库的临时走廊蜿蜒曲折，四面八方都被箱子夹住。你看见一个垃圾箱大小的容器，里面装着崭新的霓虹灯管——毫无疑问，是行星开拓者初次抵达暮光世界时“点亮城市”计划剩下的物资。但这里还有许多不那么体面的货箱。你发现一排棺材般的舱体，内部接着大量令人不安的管线，旁边就是一个装满“员工强制佩戴项圈”的保险箱。 

		仍然没有武器的踪影。东边更明亮的灯光似乎是最值得继续推进的方向，西边只有通往建筑出口的黑暗。

rows.original:
At the far eastern side of the warehouse, you find yourself in the lair of the kui-tan merc. As the leader of the kaithrit squad, she’s made herself a personal little room to get away from the bois when she needed some peace and quiet. There are a number of personal items neatly arranged on a low shelf, like a cybernetics repair kit, some fur brushes, steel polish, and a half-used bottle of self-drying shampoo (for the kui-tan on the go!). Besides several empty condom boxes, and quite a few heavily-filled condom bubbles, there’s little else of note. You suspect the boss was smart enough to take anything important with her when she bailed on the corpo gig.

		[flags.MALAI_QUEST_COMPONENTS_ACQUIRED||You disregard all that, however, turning to the hermetically sealed, steel chest in the far corner. It’s quite hefty and outfitted with elaborate biometric locks that’d take even a master hacker far too long to take apart through brute force. This, then, is the whole point of your infiltration. Thankfully, you’ve got the code. Get in there and take anything you find back to Malai. That boy’s gonna love this haul.]
rows.translation:
仓库最东侧是奎坦佣兵的巢穴。身为凯斯里特小队领袖，她给自己布置了一间私人小屋，在需要清静时避开那些男孩。低矮架子上整齐摆着许多私人物品，例如义体维修套装、几把毛刷、钢材抛光剂，以及半瓶已经用掉的自干洗发水（适合奔波中的奎坦人！）。除去几个空避孕套盒和不少沉甸甸的避孕套泡泡，这里没什么值得注意的东西。你猜头目放弃这份公司差事时足够聪明，把重要物品都随身带走了。

		[flags.MALAI_QUEST_COMPONENTS_ACQUIRED||不过，你没有理会那些东西，而是转向远处角落里气密封闭的钢箱。它十分沉重，装有复杂生物识别锁，即使黑客大师也需要太长时间才能用蛮力破解。这正是你潜入此处的全部目的。幸好你有密码。打开箱子，把找到的一切带回给玛莱。那小子肯定会爱死这批战利品。]

rows.original:
The suspended walkway has brought you to the exterior of a second-story office. The room has a tremendous glass wall, allowing a supervisor to look down on the movements of the employees below. Or, it would if anyone were in it. The room appears dark and empty. Considering that Utopian Skies seems to be using this site to smuggle weapons in for a future syndicate war, they’ve shut down normal operations and are just using hired muscle from off-world to keep an eye on the goods.

		There’s still power running through the room, however. You spot a security terminal inside that could be helpful. The only other way you could go is back west to climb down, or a little further east, if you wanted to get a look at what you’re up against.
rows.translation:
悬空步道把你带到一间二楼办公室外。房间有一整面巨大玻璃墙，方便主管俯瞰下方员工的一举一动——前提是里面有人。如今房间漆黑空荡。乌托邦天空公司似乎正利用这里走私武器，为将来的集团战争做准备，因此她们已经停止正常运营，只雇佣来自外星的打手看守货物。

		不过，房间依然通着电。你发现里面有一台安保终端，也许能派上用场。除此以外，你只能向西返回并爬下去，或者再向东走一小段，看看自己将要面对什么。

rows.original:
The interior of the office is messy with disuse. A considerable filing cabinet close at hand looks like it’s been cleaned out, probably right before this site got converted into a waypoint for gun runners. There’s a large desk, strewn with memos, invoices, employee reviews, and similar paperwork. Though you just give them a cursory scan, it is plain that things were going poorly for the little people caught up in Zaibatsu schemes. What’s more, the smashed neon tubes in the corner tell you exactly what the former occupant thought of her employers’ desire to make the planet brighter for the sake of the visiting aliens. Small wonder they’re using freelancers instead of keeping the old staff on duty.

		[var0
			|Right next to it lies the security console. It consists of a digital keypad and several screens showing what the surveillance drones are seeing. Everything is being transmitted, certainly to the crew downstairs, and possibly to Utopian Skies themselves. You’re going to have to deal with the security feed if you don’t want the corpos to know what you’re up to, much less the threat of XOs coming after you in the streets!
			|The security console on the far wall has been disabled, its feeds looped from old recordings. Nobody’s going to see you coming, and there won’t be any record of anything you do in the warehouse to come back to bite you on the ass later on. Damn you’re smooth!
		]

办公室内部因久未使用而杂乱不堪。手边一个相当大的文件柜似乎已被清空，大概就在这里被改造成军火走私者中转站前不久。大桌上散落着备忘录、发票、员工评估与类似文书。尽管你只是匆匆浏览，仍能清楚看出卷入财阀阴谋的小人物日子并不好过。更何况，角落里被砸碎的霓虹灯管清楚表明，原来的使用者对雇主为了取悦外来异星人而让行星更加明亮的愿望有何看法。难怪她们会雇用自由佣兵，而不让老员工继续值守。

		[var0
			|安保控制台就在旁边。它由数字键盘和几块显示监控无人机画面的屏幕组成。一切都在向外传输，肯定会传给楼下那群人，甚至可能传到乌托邦天空公司。若不想让公司知道你在做什么，更不想让XO在街上追杀你，就必须处理这路安保画面！

rows.original:
The metallic balcony ends here, with no way to go but back the way you came. Still, you’re glad you made the trip: you’ve got an eagle eye view of the busy part of the complex. Down below, the corpo hirelings have set up a makeshift room between all the crates. Scavenged neon floodlights illuminate their little home-away-from-home, while hammocks strung from one box to the next give the felines a rather casual living space. Small cartons of street food are piled up on a shallow crate in the middle of the space, but most of the kaithrit seem occupied with a huge, glowing screen. It’s hard to tell exactly what they’re watching, but considering the specialties of their employer, you don’t doubt it’s some sort of native smut.

		As far as the guards themselves, you’ve got eyes on the four kaithrit. Each one has some heavy equipment close at hand. Guns, armor, even a huge riot shield! Though the four boys are outfitted differently, their casual demeanor and friendly attitudes suggest that they’re part of an established team, not just a mish-mash of hirelings. Dealing with the whole group isn’t going to be as easy as just showing up with a winning smile or a big gun. You don’t have a view of their boss, the kui-tan woman, but from the scene outside, you suspect she’s even less likely to roll over without some vigorous convincing.
rows.translation:
金属阳台在这里抵达尽头，除了原路返回外无处可去。不过，你很庆幸自己走了这一趟，因为这里能鸟瞰建筑群最繁忙的区域。下方，公司雇佣兵在所有货箱之间搭起一间临时房屋。捡来的霓虹泛光灯照亮他们临时的家，吊床从一个箱子挂到另一个，为猫科人营造出相当随意的生活空间。装街头食物的小纸盒堆在空间中央一个浅箱子上，但大多数凯斯里特人似乎正全神贯注地观看一块巨大明亮的屏幕。很难判断他们究竟在看什么，但考虑到雇主的专长，你确信那是某种当地色情内容。

		至于守卫本身，四名凯斯里特人都在你的视野内。每个人手边都放着重型装备：枪械、护甲，甚至还有一面巨大的防暴盾！尽管四个男孩装备各异，但他们随意的举止和友好态度表明，这是一支配合已久的小队，而非临时拼凑的雇员。要对付整个小组，可不会像带着制胜微笑或一把大枪登门那么简单。你看不见他们的头目，也就是那名奎坦女人；不过从外面的场面来看，你怀疑她更不可能不经一番强力说服便乖乖屈服。

You enter the building, keeping your [pc.weaponMain] at the ready. The entrance is rundown and derelict, but you slip inside without issue. The inside is dark, but there is enough light to see, overhead lights providing some illumination. 

Seems the place might not be so abandoned after all.
rows.translation:
你走进建筑，随时准备好使用[pc.weaponMain]。入口破败荒废，但你毫无阻碍地溜了进去。里面一片昏暗，不过头顶的灯具仍提供了一点照明，足以让你看清四周。 

看来这里或许并没有彻底废弃。

rows.original:
You stand in what is surely a loading - or perhaps unloading - bay area. Large roll-up doors sit on the left wall, while towards the right side of the room lie smashed and poorly stacked pallets are littered about. A rather strange-looking piece of machinery sits nearby: some sort of Dhaalian version of a forklift you wager. Whatever it is, it looks completely and utterly ruined, much like the rest of the building.

Despite the state of the structure, the doors are solid and sealed tight. Nobody is getting in or out through them.
rows.translation:
你站在一片显然是装货区，或者也可能是卸货区的地方。左侧墙上装着大型卷帘门，房间右侧则散落着破损且胡乱堆放的托盘。附近停着一台模样颇为古怪的机器：你猜那大概是达尔版的叉车。不管它究竟是什么，看上去都已经彻底报废，和这栋建筑的其余部分如出一辙。

尽管建筑破败不堪，那些门却依然坚固，而且封得严严实实。没人能从那里进出。
rows.raw: "You stand in what is surely a loading - or perhaps unloading - bay area. Large roll-up doors sit on the left wall, while towards the right side of the room lie smashed and poorly stacked pallets are littered about. A rather strange-looking piece of machinery sits nearby: some sort of Dhaalian version of a forklift you wager. Whatever it is, it looks completely and utterly ruined, much like the rest of the building.\n\nDespite the state of the structure, the doors are solid and sealed tight. Nobody is getting in or out through them."

rows.original:
Looking around, you find yourself surrounded by a sea of vending machines.

At first, you think the factory must have produced them, but on closer inspection you realize they seem much too new to be produced here, although they are only marginally less destroyed.

Smashed, vandalized, or otherwise scarred, the machines look like they’ve taken a considerable amount of abuse, although they seem relatively new to your eye at least. Regarding them closer, you notice a common trend among all the machines: they dispense one sort of drug or another.
rows.translation:
环顾四周，你发现自己被一片自动售货机的海洋包围。

起初你以为这家工厂以前就是生产这些机器的，但仔细查看后，你意识到它们新得多，不太可能产自这里，尽管其损毁程度也只是稍微轻了一点。

这些机器有的被砸烂，有的遭到破坏，还有的留下了各式各样的伤痕。它们显然受过相当严重的摧残，不过至少在你看来都还比较新。进一步观察后，你注意到所有机器都有一个共同点：它们售卖的全是某种药物。
rows.raw:
"Looking around, you find yourself surrounded by a sea of vending machines.

At first, you think the factory must have produced them, but on closer inspection you realize they seem much too new to be produced here, although they are only marginally less destroyed.

Smashed, vandalized, or otherwise scarred, the machines look like they’ve taken a considerable amount of abuse, although they seem relatively new to your eye at least. Regarding them closer, you notice a common trend among all the machines: they dispense one sort of drug or another."

rows.original:
Entering the unsealed room, you find yourself in what feels like a tomb. The very air itself tastes like death on your tongue, stale and dust-laden, scratching its way down the back of your throat. A blanket of ashen grime is painted thick onto every surface, stray particles drifting as you make your way inside.

The room is small, and feels confining rather than cozy. The far wall is covered with a mountain of monitors, most of them cracked or otherwise destroyed. Below them sits a daunting console, likely to control the many screens above. It seems completely non functional, but you wonder if power could be rerouted again. You dismiss the notion after a moment, noticing several wires at its base chewed to shreds by some local animal.

The purpose of the room isn’t apparent to you until you look leftward, spotting a few hooks on the wall. An old jacket, rotten and falling apart, hangs from one of the hooks; the scrawling across the back of it is impossible to read for quite a few reasons.
rows.translation:
走进这间没有封闭的房间，你感觉自己仿佛踏入了一座坟墓。就连空气都带着死亡的味道，陈腐而满是尘埃，刮擦着你的喉咙一路向下。每一处表面都覆盖着厚厚一层灰白污垢，你走进房间时，零散的尘粒随之飘起。

房间很小，给人的感觉不是舒适，而是逼仄。远端墙壁上布满了堆积如山的显示器，其中大多已经开裂或彻底损毁。显示器下方摆着一座令人望而生畏的控制台，多半是用来操控上方那些屏幕的。它看起来已经完全无法运作，不过你还是想过能否再次把电力转接过来。片刻后，你注意到控制台底部有好几根电线被当地某种动物啃得粉碎，于是打消了这个念头。

直到你转头向左，看见墙上的几个挂钩，才明白这间房的用途。其中一个挂钩上挂着一件破旧腐烂、正在解体的夹克；由于种种原因，写在背面的潦草字迹根本无法辨认。

"Entering the unsealed room, you find yourself in what feels like a tomb. The very air itself tastes like death on your tongue, stale and dust-laden, scratching its way down the back of your throat. A blanket of ashen grime is painted thick onto every surface, stray particles drifting as you make your way inside.

The room is small, and feels confining rather than cozy. The far wall is covered with a mountain of monitors, most of them cracked or otherwise destroyed. Below them sits a daunting console, likely to control the many screens above. It seems completely non functional, but you wonder if power could be rerouted again. The purpose of the room isn’t apparent to you until you look leftward, spotting a few hooks on the wall. An old jacket, rotten and falling apart, hangs from one of the hooks; the scrawling across the back of it is impossible to read for quite a few reasons. "

rows.original:
You find yourself in a very different environment from the rest of the factory. What was once clearly office space for the building is now a near-incomprehensible mess. Desks, chairs, and tables are spread around the area, most of them upended and otherwise trashed. While the rest of the building has a distinctly abandoned and forgotten feeling, the space here feels different to you. It almost seems like it was ransacked; and based on the way the dust in the room is disturbed, it must have happened recently. 

To the west,
rows.translation:
你发现这里的环境与工厂其他区域截然不同。这里曾经显然是整栋建筑的办公区，如今却变成了几乎无法理解的混乱景象。办公桌、椅子和桌子散落四周，大多翻倒在地，或遭到其他形式的破坏。建筑其余区域有种明显被遗弃、被遗忘的感觉，但这里带给你的感受截然不同。此处看起来几乎像是遭到了洗劫；从房间里被扰动的灰尘判断，事情肯定发生在不久以前。 

向西，

rows.original:

The very air is thick with sin, tasting of smoke, sweat, and spunk. Nearly every surface in the room is loaded up with empty bottles, food containers, or some sort of illicit substance, many of which you don’t recognize. Even the floor is covered in a thick layer of junk, some of it trash, but you manage to pick out a few oddities among the rubbish. Jezzy must have been squatting in here for quite some time, and seems to not be the sort to tidy up after herself.

A large couch sits in the middle of the room, visually sticking out like a sore thumb from the rest of the decor. The office’s desk has been shoved against a wall facing the couch, a very modern monitor planted on top of it, playing some sort of documentary about deep sea cephalopods.

rows.original:
You find yourself in what was once a small infirmary, but are not so sure the label still applies.

The shelves are bare: not even a single bandaid to be found among them. Unlike the offices however, this space doesn’t feel like it was ransacked - it just feels empty. Medical diagrams line the walls, seemingly perfectly preserved, while a desk and chair towards the side are both upright and intact. An examination table on the far side of the room does look like it’s seen better days, but the wear seems to be due to age rather than abuse.

As you take in your surroundings, something about the room really starts to stand out: there is almost no dust. While the rest of the building is coated in the stuff, the infirmary is pristine. The reason why seems obvious: somebody has been cleaning it.

Despite the fact that it’s about as far from stocked as imaginable, nothing is out of place. Even the items on the desk appear neatly arranged.
rows.translation:
你发现自己身处一个曾经的小型医务室，不过已无法确定这个称呼是否仍然适用。

架子空空如也，甚至连一片创可贴都找不到。不过与那些办公室不同，这里不像遭到洗劫，只是单纯地空旷。墙上排列着医疗图解，看起来保存得十分完好；旁边的办公桌与椅子也都直立且完好。房间远端的检查台确实显得有些破旧，但磨损似乎源于年久失修，而非遭受破坏。

你观察周围时，房间里有件事越发显眼：这里几乎没有灰尘。建筑其他区域都覆盖着厚厚尘土，医务室却一尘不染。原因似乎显而易见：有人一直在清扫这里。

尽管这里距离物资充足的状态要多远有多远，却没有任何物品摆错位置。就连桌上的东西也排列得整整齐齐。

rows.original:
Clean and sterile, the basement of the factory is nothing like the structure’s main floor. The floors, walls, and ceiling are all pristine white, enameled and gleaming. The lights on the ceiling are soft but effective and fully functional, unlike the fixtures up above. 

You sincerely doubt this was the original look of the basement; its getting the impression it was painstakingly renovated to its current state. The cost of which would have been sizable you reason, considering the difference. The derelict factory above must surely be a front in order to hide whatever is going on down here.

The only way forward is through a doorway to the north side of the chamber.
rows.translation:
工厂地下室干净无菌，与建筑主层截然不同。地板、墙壁和天花板全都洁白无瑕，涂有搪瓷并闪闪发亮。天花板上的灯光柔和却效果良好，而且功能完整，不像上方那些灯具。 

你确信地下室原本绝不是这副模样；这里给人的印象是，有人煞费苦心地将其翻修成现在的状态。考虑到前后差异，你判断这必定花费不菲。上方废弃工厂肯定只是一层伪装，用来隐藏地下发生的事情。

唯一的前进道路是穿过房间北侧的一道门。
